Price for this coffee jumps all over the place -- I used to buy it but not since the price jumped.  Excellent at a maximum price in the low twenties with free shipping.  Otherwise overpriced.  Find something else cheaper.  Five stars for the coffee.

I recently purchased an 11 oz. bag of whole bean Seattle's Best Level 3 coffee.  The bag described it as a "medium" roast.  As I don't care for the usually burnt, bitter tasting darker roasts I previously tried, I thought I'd give this a try.  When I first opened the bag, I was struck by the very dark appearance of the beans and a burnt odor.  I was skeptical that I would care for this coffee at this point, but decided to try it anyway.  Unfortunately, my fears were confirmed when I actually tasted the coffee -- first black and then with sweetener and milk.  The bitter, burnt taste was very pronounced and this was at less than half the recommended brew strength, i.e., 3 level tablespoons for 8 cups.  If this is in fact "medium roast" coffee, I really don't want to know what the "dark roast" is like. I will not be buying any more Seattle's Best coffee.

I've tried several types of coffee, but this is by far my favorite. It has a very pleasant "nutty" flavor. It's incredibly smooth. Most types of coffee give me heartburn when I drink "too much". However, Seattle's best doesn't give me any heartburn whatsoever. I'm a loyal fan. I will add that I purchase mine at Wal-Mart (seems to be cheapest there), and I can find online coupons regularly for $1.50 off each bag, which helps a lot.
A very convenient way to purchase, what I feel is, one of the best tasting coffee beans around.

The fern arrived not properly packaged, very small specimen in dry soil,  half of the leaves fell offafter first three days. The plant died completely after one month. Interesting plant but buy it somewhere else.
The plant, which looked gorgeous upon arrival, was soon filled with bugs - bugs that plant insect killer did not kill and that ultimately had to be thrown away.  What a waste.

I ordered a Rabbit's Foot Fern and it arrived in a short time and I was very pleased with the product I recieved. I would definitely recommend this company to others and if you are looking for something unique, whether for yourself or for a friend, I would definitely recommend a Rabbit's Foot Fern.
VERY UNUSUAL PLANT BUT NICE PLANT..TOOK A WHILE TO GET STARTED BUT NOW GROWING NICELY..CAN'T WAIT FOR THE FEET TO START HANGING AROUND RIM OF PLANTER.
I remembered these as a kid and giving them as party favors went great. It was better than just giving little plastic rings
Bought these to use as party favors for a child's birthday.  They went over great and everyone loved them.  Who doesn't love a Pez?

Length:: 1:34 MinsWhenever my grocery store is all out of this variety of mushrooms fresh, I reach for this dried form. I like this brand as it's a better buy.It stores easily, and is very healthy. In this clip, is a short demonstration of product use.

Well, I know I can't compete with Groovin Guy's video review, but I must say these mushrooms are very handy to have around when we want to add an earthy, meaty flavor and texture to stew, tomato sauce, frittatas, even pizza.  I have found them a bit of a challenge to rehydrate if they are not going to cook a long time.  Here is what I have ended up doing:  I pour some water over them to cover, and pop them in the microwave till the water nearly boils.  I let them soak for about five minutes, or until cool enough to handle. Then I snip off the stems with kitchen scissors and cut the larger mushrooms in half.  If they are going into something that will not cook a long time, I reheat the water and let them hydrate another half hour or so before using them.  If they are going into a stew or long cooking sauce, I add them in at this point to finish cooking.  Strain and use the broth!  It is rich and satisfying for soups and stews.

column9: Would rather buy the brands that don't use added sugar
column10: These are extremely yummy fruit snacks! I am always on a quest to find organic, easy, yummy foods for our busy family. I was excited to find these and quickly bought a box, I've been impressed with all the Annie's products I have bought. They didn't disappoint in the taste department, but.... I am a little disappointed about the ingredients in these.Ingredient #1: Organic Tapioca Syrup-this appears to be a great alternative to high fructose corn syrup and other sugary additives. Here's what I pulled up about this ingredient-" Tapioca syrup provides the sweetness needed in a natural way. Produced from tapioca starch using a natural fermentation process, tapioca syrup is a gluten-free and non-GMO (genetically modified organism) alternative to corn syrup, sugar, honey, maple syrup and molasses."  [...]Ingredient #2: Organic cane sugar-this is just sugar. It's organic, so it wasn't grown using pesticides or anything, but sugar is sugar and I try to limit it as much as possible. I'm bummed that this is the 2nd ingredient.The rest of the ingredients aren't really a big deal to me, but here they are: organic tapioca solids, organic white grape juice concentrate, pectin, citric acid, ascorbic acid, colors (tumeric, black carrot juice concentrate, annatto), natural flavors, sodium citrate, organic sunflower oil, and carnauba wax (from palm leaves)So why am I let down by this product? There are tons of great tasting fruit snacks out there that don't use any extra sugar to sweeten them. Stretch Island Origional Fruit Leathers don't use any extra sugars, here's the ingredients of their summer strawberry fruit leather- "Apple Puree Concentrate, Pear Puree Concentrate, Strawberry Puree, Organic Natural Strawberry Flavor, Lemon Juice Concentrate. All Sugars Are Found Naturally In The Fruit." Clif sells their Twisted Fruit rope that has no added sugar. Archer Farms sells a fruit snack for a great price that has no added sugar.So the Annie's Organic Fruit snacks are a great tasting snack that is far above those icky artificial brands that are loaded with artificial dye's and sugar, but I still think there's some room for improvement by using only fruit to sweeten it, rather than cane sugar.

column9: This is by far the best Earl Grey in K-Cups and at the right price!
column10: I brew this Bigelow Earl Grey tea using the 6oz setting on my Keurig® Platinum B70. It is by far the best Earl Grey for the Keurig systems and I have tried them all. I went through several of the "TeaPackages"; random assortments of various teas packaged together available here on Amazon. Most seemed artificial, bland, or simply didn't compare to their bagged counterparts. This was not only my favorite Earl Grey but also one of my favorite teas in general available in K-cups.For a little more perspective, I am an avid tea drinker. I consume 10-15 cups of tea a day. A majority of the tea I consume is Matcha or Hunmatsu-RyokuCha. I never mix sugar or milk into my tea. As such, I am particularly interested in teas that are robust and flavorful and not bitter. The bagged Bigelow is very good, not my favorite bagged Earl Grey but very good none the less. The K-cup variety is very close to the bagged version. For this I applaud them as few others can say this.That being said, our machines are perfectly capable of providing hot water for bagged teas. So why the K-cups? Convenience. Regardless of how good this and other K-cup varieties may be, nothing compares to a slow steep. Be it a bag, steeper or infuser they will always win over the instant cup varieties. However, nothing I have found beats the convenience of the Keurig system when it comes to guests and a good cup of coffee/tea. The Keurig system is so easy to use it takes little to no effort on the hosts part to provide a guests favorite beverage as our guests can brew a cup themselves! It's for this reason alone that I have gone through so many varieties of both to ensure an adequate selection of what I consider a good cup of joe and a great cup of tea.

The manufacturer will rebuild the door for about half the cost of a replacement with a new door and provide a new warranty.  Shipping time is the only consideration in all this, leaving the door non-functioning whether ordering parts, a new door or refurbishing the old door.  We have had excellent success with the door for several years, and in spite of the current problem, I would recommend this door to everyone.I do however want to warn potential buyers of a specific vendor "Better Life 24/7" that is a non-responsive vendor.  I was told to expect my door no later than October 21st.  On October 24th I queried the vendor and did not receive any response from my inquiry.  I know that vendors have little control over the USPS or UPS/FedEx services, but a simple acknowledgement of my email to them (thru Amazon)would have been nice.  I can not recommend anyone purchase anything from "Better Life 24/7".It is now November 8th, I have yet to hear anything from "Better Life 24/7".  I have the greatest respect for Amazon, they filed a claim for the damaged product and I received a full refund.

We bought this with the hope of preventing cats from getting out.  They are smart enough to bait the dog to come near the door and let them out or in as they wish.I think this door is overpriced.  It does not come with a battery or charger, and you really need 2 batteries so you can charge one while using the other.  We installed it into a door, so using the ac power cord is not a good option.  Also, our puppy chewed through the wire connecting our computer to the Internet the first week we got him, making us nervous about a power cord in his space.We got a 2nd puppy.  A few days later we found the cover of his collar transmitter in the yard.  I guess the two dogs played too roughly and the transmitter came apart?  The button battery from the inside was missing, and it was 5:30 pm.  We looked in the grass for it til it got dark but never found it.  Swallowing a button battery is a medical emergency, kind of like appendicitis, only it can affect any part of the GI tract.  So we had to take both dogs to the emergency vet to get x-rayed to see if either had eaten the battery.  No battery in either dog, thank goodness, but we spent a bit more than $250 for that information.  The collar transmitter should have a screw or something to hold it together better.I am currently writing this from my bedroom, and I hear the door opening and closing over and over.  A dog must be sitting too close.  Guess that means we will be charging the battery again in the am.  I'm annoyed by the sound, though it is not horribly loud.  I really wish we had gone with a heavy duty magnetic type door.

column9: Very expensive pet door - but only one of its kind!
column10: I bought a medium automatic pet door in October 2011. Very happy with the door and my dogs quickly took to it. I paid $330 for the door + another $200 on collars and replacement collars. My door did malfunction about 2 months after the 1 year warranty (of course). I was originally very frustrated for a few reasons. First, I spent so much money on their product and couldn't believe it went out so soon ... and second, I was frustrated with the initial customer service person on the phone. They have an amazing follow up team that I spoke to a few days after I called about my broken door ... they were extremely helpful and they stand behind their claim of "engineered to last a lifetime". Perhaps I just got the 1 door that went out too soon?? Only time will tell. However, they have sent me a replacement door with an extended warranty. This really proves to me that they stand behind their product. It really makes me feel good about their product AND the fact that I have spent so much on their product. I knocked out 1 star only because these doors and collars are super expensive. A downfall ... however you get an awesome door that you can't find anywhere out there!A note on their waterproof collars ... not really waterproof so I wouldn't spend the extra money on them. Mine have gone out with just a simple drizzle outside. Instead I recommend the regular collars and buying a few back ups.

We have 2 dogs, both mini aussies, 30 and 50 pounds.  We were going crazy letting them in and out, and the last time we went on vacation and had a pet sitter come over, they chewed things all over the house waiting for her to come by to let them out.  So, my wife said, "We have to get a doggie door."  I began researching the field.We didn't want a traditional "flap" door because of the likely HVAC leaks and the potential for animals to enter our home.  So, I decided we needed something with an electronic sensor and lock.  The only other electronic door that has any sales volume is the Pet Safe door, but reviews for it were not at all favorable.  That left the High Tech Power Pet door as the only good option.  We had to buy a new patio door to install it (because our existing one was all glass), but decided it was worth it based on reviews.The reviews are correct (you can read many, many at[...]). This is the best solution for anyone wanting to let their pet out when it wants to go out.  Our dogs learned immediately how to use it.  Now we can go to bed at night knowing that if Pepper or Dusty want out, they can go out.  And squirrels, etc. won't be able to get in.  The only problem is our two cats feel left out.  But they lose their collars, and the sensors are expensive.The only negative is the sensor.  I know we are going to have to buy more of these, and at $35 a shot, that is going to add up.  Also, they come with a simple thin strap that goes around your pet's neck.  There is no easy way to attach it to a traditional collar.  They should make an attachment that permits this.  The good news on sensors is they are light weight. They are also directional, so if your pet walks by the door but doesn't face it, the door most likely will not open.  If your pet stands there in front of the door, it will stay open, waiting for the pet to go through.  It's basically a Star Trek door for your pet.The best part was Amazon Prime.  Not only was the door cheaper than ANY PLACE else, we got it in 2 days.  I love Amazon Prime!

I purchsed this door about a year ago.  I dont know how I lived without it.Since the purchase neither My 8yr old German Sheppard or 5 yr old Husky havemade one "mistake" inside. It took less than a minute to train them to use it . Thedoor is transparent yet is tinted to add privacy.I had this professionaly installed / hardwired so I didnt have to fuss with battery chargingevery month, but do have the battery backup as well.The only reason I gave this 4 Stars , not five is because I have run into just one issue the transmittercollar is prone to snap apart when the dog scratches neck area xtra hard and the foot hits the transmittercover causing both the cover & battery to fall off. Between the two dogs it has happened only 3x total / in the past yearOther than that I have not had one problem.  It is about as attractive as it could be for a dog door.It gives me the freedom as well not having to  rush home knowing my dogs are doing the potty dance.see my 3 customer pictures attatched to item.

column9: Good door, but collars need work
column10: Overall the door works well, and our main complainy is with the collar.  The first collar was the standard one that came with the unit, which managed to fall apart within a week.  The company allowed me to upgrade to the more rugged collar for $10, which I did.  I also added a piece of electrical tape tightly around the seam of the plastic to make it more difficult for the transmitter to pop open, which has worked out well.The problem with this collar unit is that it needs to stay directly under the dogs neck, due to the directional sensor.  If it moves to the side of their neck or on top of their neck it won't work.  For our dog this happens about half the days that he wears it, rendering the door completely useless while we're at work, which is the reason we got the door to begin with.  I'm also concerned that he may get locked out of the house on a cold day when the collar gets repositioned.  We've tried attaching the unit to other collars (including his invisible fence collar that has prongs), but they all seem to rotate on his neck.I called the company to see if they had any tips on how to fix this issue, but they had no recommendation for me.  If anyone else has experienced a similar problem and figured out a way to fix it, please let me know!
It works great but my rottie couldn't fit thru it.  Pls mk a bigger one.JD

column9: Your dog may die plus horrible customer service.
column10: The door comes with the MS-2 ultrasonic collar.  After several months of use the top popped off the MS-2 ultrasonic collar and the battery fell out.  My dog was trapped outside all day in the Florida heat.  I'm lucky she didn't die from heat stroke.I called customer service. They told me that my dog had removed the lid!!  I explained that my dog was unable to remove the cap/lid.  The lady in customer service said to me "Are you saying the lid jumped off".Perfect.  I have to hear that when my dog is panting and drinking water like crazy due to a flaw in their product.

The previous owners of our house had installed an earlier version of this door that finally failed after several years of hard use. We loved that door so much that we decided to replace it with this version, despite the high cost. First lesson, the dimensions between the old (mostly metal) door and the new (totally plastic) door are not the same, so I had to widen the opening by sawing a larger hole through my house. That done, the door has generally performed magnificently. This one is much quiter and has more features, including the ability to adjust sensor sensitivity, selectively turn off sensors, and use a battery back-up. As other reviewers note, the collars are the weak link, with crappy build quality and spotty reliability. The batteries seem to last about 4-6 months for a mostly indoor dog, and can sometimes be hard to find locally. The door also seems to malfunction on very hot days--my door is on the side of my house that gets direct sunlight in the afternoon. But that malfunction is, thankfully, a fairly rare occurrence. The other occasional issue, as other reviewers note, is sometimes odd directional issues with the collar that I have never quite managed to figure out. All in all, however, the door works perfectly 95% of the time and we do very much love the thing despite its quirks. I really fear the day that they quit manufacturing it, or change the dimensions again--I'm not sure I can make the hole in my house smaller!

We have had this door for over a year and it has been one of the best things I have ever purchased! We have three dogs, two large older dogs, and one small. We used to spend our day letting them out 100 times to chase squirrels only to let them back in two minutes later. The barking to go in and out was constant. Now their behavior is completely different. They let themselves in and out, no more barking, and freedom for us! When we are at work or gone long periods of time, we no longer worry about getting home to let them out. The only problem we have had with the door is that when it is really cold (teens or below), the door sometimes goes up and down a few times before it finally closes. Keeping in mind that it has probably opened and closed 600,000 times in the last year, I am happy with it's track record. One of our older dogs is afraid of everything... cameras, phones, etc. I was afraid she would be too afraid to use it. With some treats she learned to use it in about 15 minutes and has had no problem since. Great product!

This is a great product.  We just got new doors and windows in the house so I figured the old flappy dog door needed to go.  This one works great.  Air tight seal so no more drafts.  It took our poodle (not a particularly smart one) about a week to get completely adjusted and now she prances in and out at her pleasure.  Also, it's nice to know that no other critters can come in, just our own adorable poodle critter.  It was pretty easy to install but I didn't have to cut a hole in the wall as I was just replacing our old dog door with this one.  I also decided to get the backup battery with the door in case of a power outage.  It's a bit on the pricey side, but worth it to me.
The door is pretty cool. But the collar didn't last a day, we failed to see that they cost $30 each. Door is great. It is nice that it doesn't close on the dog, will open back up if it is closing.

column9: Good product except for the transmitter collar
column10: This remote control pet door works as advertised: a pet with a transmitter approaches the door, the door opens, the petgoes through, and the door closes behind the pet. However there are several issues: (1) the lower-end collar is not waterresistant--if it get wet the transmitter shorts out. (2) Both the low-end and high-end transmitters are flimsy--the batterylid easily pops off, sometimes breaking the transmitter in the process (I'm on my sixth transmitter); the solution here issimple: I wrap the transmitter with two winds of strapping tape and this solves that issue. (3) The transmitter mounting collaritself is flimsy nylon that uses a dual ring rather than a snap or buckle: my cat shredded his collar in a few days, and I havebeen unable to reuse the transmitter--the transmitter attachment point is too narrow to accommodate a strong collar. I wouldlike to see a transmitter with a real mounting ring.The last issue is more of a design challenge rather than a problem: my female labrador needs access to the outside. My indoor-onlycat quickly figured out that if he could get the Lab near the door, he could use the door as well. Cats are smart that way. What Iwould like to see is a reverse-polarity transmitter that I could put on the cat that would force the door to close on approach.I recommend this remote-control access system to those folks willing to deal with the issues noted in the preceding paragraphs.

column9: Cheaply made and NO customer service
column10: I bought the large high tech pet door 8 months ago. From the beginning, it took buying 5 collars before I could get 3 that worked. The collar radios are cheaply made, they fall apart. The nylon collars themselves easily come unravelled and are virtually impossible to find replacements.The door itself worked perfectly for 6 1/2 months. Then it began sticking in the open position. I have reached out the manufacturer several times, but have NEVER received a response. After reading their website FAQ, I decide to replace the motor assembly. This requires completely removing the door from the wall, removing no less than 28 different screws, prying the fly wheel from the old motor, attaching the new motor assembly to the fly wheel. Next, I wanted to test the new assembly, but you can't set the door upright without reinserting the majority of screws. Thankfully, the door worked perfectly. I reattached the back completely, then reattached the door to the wall... All for the tidy sum of 90.00 with shipping.One week later the door began sticking again. I contacted the company again... Still no response... The symptoms this time were a bit different. The door opens, then attempts to close 5-6 times, before successfully closing... AND this only happens as the day goes on... Not early in the morning or after several hours of non-use... I re-read the company website FAQ... They suggested replacing the motor assembly AND motherboard... After several days of no response from the company, I was getting desperate. So I ordered the motherboard... 60.00 later, the door is still acting the exact same way... Working perfectly in the morning, but sticking as the day wears on... I have spent almost 700.00 with this company and they have failed to respond to a single email or phone call... They suck!

We installed our pet door about 2 weeks ago and so far it works great! Our two dogs are taking awhile to get used to it. At first they were scared of it, now they both use it but one of the dogs doesn't realize yet that I don't have to be right there for him to go out. I'm sure he will figure it out as time goes on.My only advice would be to not necessarily follow the instructions on what height to put the door at (it says to put the bottom of the door an inch lower than your dog's chest height). We followed the directions on the height to install it at, and our 40 and 50 lb dogs practically have to leap out the door rather than calmly walking out. Other than that, I love it!We did go on the High Tech website and ask a question before we bought it and never got a response, so it seems like most people's reviews about bad customer service are true...

I could not live without this door! One of the best investments that I have ever made. I was hesitant due to the cost but it is worth every penny. I have 6 dogs and never have to let them in or out. Our home is in a wooded area and we never have to worry about unwanted critters coming in. The collars aren't the best of quality so i took the sensor off and put it on their regular collar. Once i had three of my dogs try to get through at once and it jammed the door but i contacted Better Life 24/7 and they sent a new door out right away! It' a must have!!!!!

I purchased this door with three "waterproof" collars that are also to work with an invisible fence type of containment system ($100 each). I don't know why, but whenever I put a colar on my Siberian Husky, the collar only works for about a day. The company has been good about replacing the collars (3) so far, but I don't know how much longer I will using this door. I had a single flap door and I will likely be replacing it with a manual double flap door, as between keeping the collars charged and replacing them, my dogs are back to asking to be let out multiple times per day and night and are driving us crazy. Sure the automatic powered door is more energy efficient, secure, and keeps out unwanted pests, but I think I would rather have a little draft and an occasional rodent get in rather than going through what we are going through now. It does work fine for the other two dogs, so I am still giving it 3 stars, but since I can't figure out why the collars stop working, it is hard for me to reccomend it any higher.

I purchased this product about 4 months ago. The customer service stinks and it's almost impossible to reach a human. My do just fell in the pool and now the collar doesn't work? Thought it was waterproof. I just might contact the BBB on these guys. I hate poor customer service! there is another company called Better LIfe 24/7 and I cannot figure out if they are one and the same?

We have had this door for about four years now and I don't know how we would get along without it.  We have two dogs and two cats and I truly believe this door must go up and down at least 100 times a day.  The first door quit working right at one year.  When I called Hi Tech Pet they agreed to send me a new door since I was so close to the warranty period.  Whew!  Then that door worked for three years with no problems at all.  A few days ago it would not go up and down.  We immediately headed to Amazon to see if they carried it.  They did and it was on prime!  Hi Tech Pet said it was probably the motor, but since the door is used so many times a day my husband opted for a new door.  Since the hole was already cut in the wall it was an easy fix to install this one.  It fit exactly as the old one did.  I ordered the door on Tuesday afternoon and it arrived by UPS on Thursday at 10:00 a.m., so we had the door from Amazon in less that 48 hours(but it was a long 48 hours for the human doormen!).I love this door.  The pets are so used to it that they didn't understand when they couldn't get in or out without us opening the door for two days.  I was not happy about that either.  I love the fact that it locks down securely when it closes.  I don't know how directional it really is because ours usually are just headed in or out, not hanging around the door.  We keep it on max most of the time since the puppy tends to go through at breakneck speed.We are in a rural area and would probably see many different critters in the house if we used the magnetic flap type of door.  This is stylish, secure and used to the max in our house.  Worth every penny for the aggravation it saves us.

Love the door the dog uses it every day. The only issue is with the house alarm and the dog going in sets off the alarm.  I need to change to a differnt type of sensor on the Alarm. Why do I need a Alarm system and a dog?  Ask the wife, I have no idea.

I work nights and sleep during the day. This door allows my dogs to go outside and back in on their own!!! Thus, no more lost sleep letting them out! It also keeps other unwanted critters out. You would not want a skunk or raccoon following them back in, trust me on this!!! Ive been there!!! The door is a bit pricey but in my opinion well worth the price! You wont be disappointed............

We've had this door for over a year and a half now, and it has worked well the whole time.  It's a bit noisy; not too bad, but I wouldn't want to be trying to sleep too near it.  Also, be aware that a six foot man can get through the opening.  We had paramedics come to the house with an incorrect address for a call.  Our dogs happily escorted one of them to the door, it opened, and he was able to crawl in and look for the victim. Otherwise, the door is locked from the outside and it would take considerable noise and effort to get it open.  Anyway, I'd buy this again.  I'll write a separate review for the collars/receivers, but the short version is, don't bother with the (even) more expensive version.

We love this door. My husband is very high tech and when he saw this product during our home reno, he purchased it and had the new wall built to spec, to fit this door.This was before the puppy even arrived. We used the door to teach Hazel to go outside. Often, she just sits there and looks out the window,.The installation was smooth, and the only trouble shooting we did was to play with the tightening of the screws so that the door raised and lowered without sticking.This is the best solution for our home, as Hazel ( a 30 pound labradoodle) can come and go as she wants.One suggestion I would make is to purchase several collars- not because they are not sturdy, but our dog is a VERY active dog and has mangled two collars.I highly recommend this door.
I have a question. Are these collars with the sensors going to be too big abd bulky for my 6lb dogs ? I want to order but am worried the collars will be uncomfortable.

I love Market Spice green and black teas they are second to NONE!  The unique cinamon/orange flavors are very soothing and at the same time stimulating w/o the harmful types of more common energy drinks.

I really enjoy this brand of tea. To put my comment in perspective, I'm not a coffee drinker and do not care for many teas. So, die hard tea drinker may not appreciate the flavor in this tea that I so like. Add a little honey and I could drink this tea for hours. It also makes great ice tea.

Was looking for something warm to wash down lunch while at a client's office and this unfamiliar tea was the only option beside's coffee which I had had my daily fill of. The flowery aroma caused me to question the choice, but the first sip confirmed that I had stumbled on something truly wonderful. Am putting in my order as I write this review. MarketSpice (cinnamon-orange) Green Tea 1# Bag
I got hooked on Market Spice tea when I lived in Washington state.  It is still the best.  Great tea, great service with my order.

This product is delicious. I took a Savory Seattle tour and learned that their products uses fresh herbs with with natural and artificial flavors (most likely from oils) and contains and requires NO SUGAR. Sweet enough on its own and healthy. Try there spices as well. Market Spice alone is a five start store.
A tea that's sweetish and flavorful in a natural and spicy way.
Much to my amazement, this is even better than the original MarketSpice Tea.  Has a different, very subtle flowery note in the background.  Very good.

Thought I would be thrifty and buy a 1# bag instead of the tea bags.  Bad move on my part.  This is no where near the quality and flavor of what I have come to expect from the the Marketspice tea bags.I am now back on amazon to order the teabags.  :-(

I have always loved this tea.  There is one thing i wonder about, though.... sometimes the orange is so strong that it burns my mouth when drinking it.  So I figure maybe i am steeping it too long....or squeezing out the water from the leaves too much and thus getting the orange oil....and if i dilute with water...then the tea just tastes bland....so i don't think the problem is that it's too strong.At any rate, I make sure to have this tea on hand and drink two cups just about every day!Thank you, Market Spice for offering it in Green tea....which tastes sweeter then the regular black tea Market Spice.

column9: Nice tea. Could hardly make the difference with the traditional black tea version
column10: OK, to me it just tastes like the "traditional" black tea version of the MarketSpice Tea. But I can't tell why I'd prefer this green tea version.

I saw the other review and hoped that it was a fluke. My dog adores these treats, and my local pet shop no longer carries them.At the time I ordered, this product listing was quite clearly for 15 packs of five. Instead of the 15 packs the product listing stated, I got one, and now the seller has edited the page. (My order history still shows "15 packs"--I'm not inventing this.) The price is fair for one pack, but for nearly $6.00 in shipping, I could have ordered these from any number of other places online that have ethical standards.The treats are a total 5 star, by the way, but don't buy them here.
This juice is tart...for me that's what I like..its like a cherry tart in a bottle..plus add that there's so many cherries per bottle
All the teas I ordered have been great.  This is a little stronger so I tend to use less of it when making a pot or cup of tea.

I have long loved Zhena's Gypsy tea since I discovered it at a Green Festival and my favorite has always been the Ginger Peach, but for some reason stores near me don't seem to carry this flavor anymore.At first, I was a little put off by the price. But since you can make a lot more tea with loose tea instead of bags (and I use a bigger than normal tea ball for my 20 ounce cups),it really is a good deal. And the resealable bag helps keep it in good shape!

column9: Better than the sum of its parts and worth the price
column10: I rarely buy spice blends - I mean, why would you buy 2 ounces of spices for 6 bucks? That's crazy! I have most of the spices at home already and I could combine them in the same way. But. This company (recently renamed but the same stuff) has a way with how they combine the flavors. Heat Wave is one of the best, but the other salt-based varieties are also amazing, like Oh Zone and Splash.After I've bought and used them up, MAYBE I would take the grinder and add back in my own raw spices and take it from there. But I doubt it. I just don't think it would have the same effect.

Blue Crab Bay Co. Steaming Spices, for Crabs & Shrimp, 1.8-Ounce Container (Pack of 6)I love my seafood and so does my family. I stumbled upon this in one of those little boutique shops that there for the summer and never return. Steaming anything with this combination of spices just makes everything taste better. Lobster, shrimp, vegetables all taste great. For years I hadn't found any thing better than Old ... Enjoy

column9: Five Stars! This Stuff Is Just Sensational!
column10: Last week I picked up a four-pack of Virgil's Cream Soda. It was excellent! In fact, it was so good that I went back to the store and picked up a four-pack of Virgil's Root Beer which I had noticed on the shelf next to the cream soda. Yesterday, I had a couple, one in the afternoon and a second late at night. Well, what can I say? This is simply the best root beer I can ever remember drinking. It's nice and rich and creamy and wonderful tasting. They say it's micro brewed and is made of all natural ingredients. It's evident that the brew has had quite a lot of attention, quite the contrast to those mass-produced things that most people drink. It's expensive, but I'd estimate it to be only about 50 cents a bottle extra and I can afford that for the really exceptional taste. They list about 10 individual spices that are used and that's what it tastes like. You might recognize some of the individual flavors, such as the vanilla and licorice I could pick out. Of course, cane sugar syrup is used as a sweetener. This stuff is just sensational!Gary Peterson

column9: Best root beer I've ever had
column10: I can't get enough of this stuff! This is the first root beer that hasn't left a stale taste in my mouth afterwards, no doubt because of the radically different ingredients lists (If you want to test it, I'm sure somewhere there are either single bottles or 4 packs available.)I definitely have no problem paying $23 ($45 with S/H) for a 24 pack, and next time I'm preparing a party, I'm going to buy the 2-pack of 5-liter kegs.

I was kind of disappointed with my order, hope it was just me, but many peaces didn't had any nuts... could be that i was the lucky on to get a package with few nuts inside... but the few parts that had nuts... yummy!!

It is not fair to review this item without comparing the contents to that of different boxes of the same name and content.  I found the contents of the box I opened to have dry edges and not too much flavor.  Not bad overall, but I expected softer, tastier morsels.  Again, this is not a fair review without a same product comparison.

Yum! These are fresh and delicious. It's real hard to eat just one piece! Wish there were more nuts in them, but all in all, we are very happy with the purchase.The price is great too. We would definitely recommend this brand.
The Turkish Delight is authentic, not the imitations  you can buy in a regular B & M discount store. It is exactly what it says, small soft nut candies, covered in powdered sugar, delicious.
What a treat, this is one of the best fruit teas ever. Healthy and flavorful, great gift that goes well with homemade jams and jellies!!

I ordered this online for a coworker who loves chocolate. The basket arrived very fast, was packed great, and the presentation and variety in the basket was the best! If you are looking for a great chocolate gift basket...I recommend this one.
I have sent this basket a number of times to family and friends.  I always receive wonderful responses, and have often shared these wonderful chocolates.
I got this for a friend. She loved it. It arrived quickly and in good shape. Very good purchase.

column9: a great gift for any occasion
column10: I sent this gift to a friend, she just loved it, and the basket was expecially beautiful too.

column9: Good Product, a bit slow on shipping..
column10: I had sent this as an Anniversary gift for my brother and my sister-in-law, The gift was well appreciated and the assortment was good, with the gift basket being decorated well and no transit damage or defects observed.I would have given this 5 stars had it not been for the fact that the time to customer, took nearly 2 weeks, which i felt was a bit on the higher side even by regular shipping mode.This is more like 4.5 stars, its a great gift item, but remember to order well in advance, so that it will arrive on the date (time frame) that you intend.
I purchased this for my wife for Valentine's Day, my wife loved it, she is a chocolate fan, however, I was very disappointed in the amount received.  VERY SMALL
It was a huge hit for staff to receive this for a job well done. Everything arrived in good shape despite the summer heat! Can't go wrong with this gift.

column9: Great gift, but they forgot the CARD!
column10: The chocolate is yummy, the basket beautiful, but the recipient didn't know who to thank because the seller forgot to attach the CARD! Major mistake.

I ordered two of the Grand baskets and although they arrived within a few days, one of the baskets was completey destroyed! I e-mailed the company to see if they could reship a new basket before Christmas which was now about a week away. When the new basket arrived it was about 1/4 the size of the first and had very little selection. Needless to say I will not recomend this company or buy from them ever again.

My now-fiance proposed to me at Lucas Vineyards in New York, and they were so great, coordinating the whole thing...we sent them this as a thank you gift. We got a very enthusiastic thank you letter from them...apparantly, they loved this basket! I'd get this again.

I WOULD NEVER RECCOMEND THIS TO ANYONE.. I OREDERED ON DEC 16 AND IT ARRIVED ON DEC 29TH. IT DOESNT EVEN LOOK ANYTHING LIKE THE BEAUTIFUL BASKET THAT IS DISPLAYED AND THERE ARE MANY THINGS MISSING/. NOT ONLY WAS I SO EMBARASED THAT I COULD NOT GIVE MY NEIGHBOR HER PRESENT FOR CHRISTMAS , NOW I HAVE THIS PUNY THING TO GIVE , WHICH IS NOT WORTH $40... IM GONNA TRY TO GET MY $$$ BACK... THIS IS THE LAST TIME I EVER ORDER FROM THIS COMPANY AGAIN.!!!!

Got this for our retriever / doberman mix...she loved it! Also, it was hilarious to watch her run around the house holding onto it.Bought it for one of our friends pitbulls too, it's a great dog gift!

My dog loved this large bone! It actually lasted 2 weeks or so before it was gone.

column9: Savory Choice Broth Concentrates the Best!
column10: Savory Choice Liquid Vegetable Broth Concentrate, 5.1-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 4)I bought this concentrate in the vegetable, chicken and turkey flavors because I couldn't find vegetable broth locally and my husband needed it for a brine. The little packages are so convenient as well, taking much less space than the typical cans. We're never going back to the "regular" broths.

column9: Use it in all my soups!
column10: Use it in all my vegan soups.  Thankfully I found it here - they have stopped stocking the vegetable at Trader Joe's.  My recipes can be found on my blog - The Heartful Vegan

I discovered these at my local Trader Joe's but then they stopped carrying them.  I hunted and located them under their original 'colors'.  They make a very tasty vegetable broth - carrot and onion flavors are not too strong as in some other broths.

I discovered the Savory Choice vegetable broth a number of years ago at my local Whole Foods store.  I follow a vegan diet, use veggie stock often, make soups frequently, and had tried other veggie broths with no success.  Savory Choice is by far my favorite!  Then, by chance, I discovered the same product at Trader Joe's and I was really happy.  Last year Trader Joe's discontinued this product, and Whole Foods no longer carries it.  On a whim I checked Amazon.  Success!  I recently purchased 16 boxes (4 packets of 4 boxes).  Let butternut squash soup season begin!

I don't know why Trader Joe's discontinued this product, but they did.  I was very happy when I found it on Amazon.  The vegetable stock that comes in a carton is too sweet and too bland for me.  I find this concentrate flavorful and convenient.  I use it not only to make soups and stews but to add flavor to stir fries, sauces, casseroles and any other dish that needs a little extra flavor.

column9: A game changer in the kitchen
column10: Was heart broken when Trader Joe's stopped carrying this item (was marketed under their name). Could not find anything that could adequately replace it in my meat and soup recipes. So happy to see this on Amazon - reasonably priced, packaged well, delivered flawlessly. Delicious. Low sodium and organic. Wish I had thought of Amazon sooner.

I am a true believer of making your own broth/stock at home. Whenever I cook chicken or beef I always save the broth/stock and freeze it for later use. But when I am out of it I need some trusty brand with no MSG and low sodium. That's my reason to buy the Savory Choice Vegetable, Chicken and Beef broths. These are very convenient since they come in individual packages and the product is in liquid form, just add a cup of water and you have a broth ready to make any sauce you want.

This broth is really good and tastes way better then other broths ive tried. Its also convenient because of the little individual packs. This is low sodium, but doesnt really taste like that. Its got a nice reddish hue to it and I think I taste a prominent tomato flavor along with other vegetables. Its really quite good. The other flavors by this company are equally delicious.

Finally! A GREAT tasting product that does not contain MSG and is Gluten Free! Since when did the foods we eat, all become science experiments! Thank you Savory Choice for making a great and very handy product. Not only is it great, but it's easy to store. Got the Turkey, Vegetable, Beef, Chicken and the Demi Glace. THANK YOU, THANK YOU, THANK YOU!

This vegetable broth is flavorful and so easy to use! I frequently use this instead of chicken broth, as the flavor is superior to many chicken broths and wins over bouillon hands down. I like to take it camping because of the size.  It's also great for those small amounts of broth that doesn't require an entire can--it doesn't take up a lot of cabinet space, either. Use an entire packet with less water for a more condensed broth.

I bought these veggie stock packets after they stopped carrying them at Trader Joe's. I love that the small box holds 10 or 12 cups worth of stock, once you add water. It's great for my small kitchen, and means I don't have to buy another big box or can of stock each time I need it. Less waste, too, both from packaging and from throwing out half used big boxes of stock.

So as part of a program for weight loss, I have been trying to find foods to satisfy my sweet tooth that actually have nutritional value and are low calorie. They are light, flavorful and fulfilling. I was also babysitting my friends kids who were begging for cookies and candy, and I instead let them share a bag of these and later that night they asked if they could have another instead of ice cream for dessert so I was kinda shocked.

column9: Blue Diamond Roasted Brown Sugar Cinnamon Almonds
column10: Blue Diamond Roasted Brown Sugar Cinnamon Almonds taste great, with all the benefits of almonds, and the 100 calorie packs take the edge off nicely.  Great healthy snack and a good price from Amazon.com

I bought these because they are portioned in 100 calorie sized packs.  There doesnt seem like a lot in each one but it does keep me full until mealtime which is what i wanted. I wish I could find them locally.

I am on a weight loss program and am always looking for great 100 calorie snacks and this is definitely one.  The cinnamon brown sugar coating is just sweet enough to please the desire for something sweet. I would highly recommend this product.
Absoletly amazing! I love these almonds, and I am not a big 'nut' person.  They are the perfect size for my mid morning snack and stave of my hunger until lunch time!
I think this is great tea.I've been drinking itFor a year now and it is my favorite everydayTea.I do recommend this tea to anyoneWanting a good cup of tea at a good price.

column9: beware - description says it's organic but it's not
column10: Please be aware that this tee from Frontier sold by ABC is non-organic.  I informed ABC about it but the product's 'Ingredient' desciption still mentions organic Earl Grey tea.To be fair they offered me to return the merchandize and receive a refund.

Frontier makes a lovely earl grey.  It's better than 99% of what's out there and if you buy it in the one pound bag it's a heck of a good deal as well.  This has been my everyday tea for more than five years and I still love it.  Sure, the earl grey from Marriage Freres is a tiny bit better (and for $8 an ounce it should be) and makes an lovely Sunday tea, but the Frontier is almost as good, a fifth the price and a whole lot easier to get my hands on now that I no longer live a quick subway ride from Balducci's.
received product promptly on time and in good order. loving a good v8 juice is a delicious thing to do. they are stacked neatly in my kitchen. they'll be consumed in no time. i love vegetables.

I received the chestnut flour promptly.  It is of great quality and has been ground perfectly.  I have already made chestnut crepes with Nutella and bananas.  I look forward to purchasing from this supplier again.  P.S. I vacuumed sealed and froze half of my purchase because chestnut flour can spoil over time.
hojicha tea taste great with lemons and Apriva. hojicha tea has less caffeine that's great for pregnant women and those with high blood pressure.

I love these and wanted to buy them in bulk, hoping it would be cheaper, but this price is higher per bag than I have ever seen in the grocery store. Also, they do not have my favorite flavor, salt and pepper.

I am usually somewhat reluctant to try new Bloody Mary mixes because I am so frequently disappointed.  Not this time.  Zing Zang is an outstanding Bloody Mary mix and already contains Lea & Perrins Worcestershire Sauce and Tabasco sauce, which for me are two must haves in any Bloody Mary concoction.This mix has a nice tomato base and leans toward a strong peppery flavor, which becomes even stronger if you add in additional Tabasco, which I often do because I like my Bloody Mary's fiery.If you are a Bloody Mary fan, this mix is a real winner.

Zing Zang Bloody Mary Mix has a nice spicy zip to it.  It tastes great.  You don't need to add any alcohol to enjoy a nice glass of this Bloody Mary Mix.  Just add ice for a refreshing drink.  I've served this to family and friends and everyone wants to know where to get some!

column9: Makes the BEST Red Beer/Chilada's ever!!
column10: If you like a good red beer or chilada 1/4 cup Zing Zang with 12 oz's of your favorite beer and a little dash of lime salt to top it off and you have the BEST red beer ever!! Zing Zang is pricey, but bought locally it's totally worth it!

Life before my Bloody Mary Sundays was blah and boring.  Then I discovered Zing Zang  and never want to look back!  It tastes so good when it hits your lips!  JUST AMAZING!  Every sip is tasty and leaves you wanting more. Go for it!  You will not be disappointed!

I Must Say I used to live in Myrtle Beach 4 years ago and this is when I first tried the Zing Zang Bloody Mary Mix!! And I was hooked I would drink a bottle almost everyday Well if not everyday every other day. It Is The BEST!! Then I moved back to my home town Pittsburgh and I was searching every were and I finally was able to find it here I was Soooo Happy!! I have all of my family and friends hooked on this product Never Change the ingredients Or anything about it. IT IS THE BEST MIX ON EARTH. Thank You for Your Time

I made my own Bloody Mary mix for years after learning a great recipe while bartending, but I just can't touch Zing-Zang.  No other bottled mix is anywhere near it, either.Want to blow your mind?  Add a teaspoon of ground horseradish, a little more fresh ground black pepper, several pickled green beans and pearl onions and rim the glass with lime juice and celery salt.  Feed the celery stalk to your vegetarian friend; garnish with your favorite pickle spear instead.  That's not a drink, its a meal!

On a recent visit to New Orleans, we took a cruise down the Mississippi on the Steamboat Natchez.  The Blood Mary we each had was amazing, especially compared to the New England variety we were used to drinking.  When we returned home, we e-mailed the Steamboat Company through their website, and they graciously told us what brand of mix they use, and it is Zing Zang.  Now we have a little bit of New Orleans in a bottle.

I love this mix, I'm actually drinking it now as I write this review!  But don't worry, I'm not too drunk yet...  I can still form sentences.I just realized I'm consuming 75% of my DAILY sodium, just on one 10-ounce drink of this stuff!  Wow, I am going to be bloated tomorrow.  How the heck can 1 serving size be only 3 ounces?  Who drinks a 3-ounce bloody mary, or only one?  That is a really unhealthy amount of salt.  So I would add sodium-free tomato juice to this, and not drink it straight with vodka.The mix fairly spicy-- I would consider it medium, so for some this may just burn your mouth, it does mine, but I like it. And could use more of a tomato taste.  Has MSG in it, which isn't a problem for me(activates flavor receptors in the tongue), but can cause headaches in some people.  It also has sodium benzoate, a preservative.  But in moderation, it tastes great.
This is great! Everything about it is just right! And , not too salty. Bloody Marys are supposed to be salty. It even has celery salt!!!The best yet . Bye Mr. And Mrs. T.......

I have always loved red beers (beer and tomato juice), during a dinner out with my girlfriend in Kansas I ordered a drink similar to my traditional red beer but they used corona beer and Zing Zang Blood Mary Mix.  From that evening on it is one of my favorite drinks.  Soon as I got back to Texas I bought coronas and Zing Zang and haven't looked back.It gives the beer alittle extra KICK!

I love salt. But holy crap is this mix salty! When I make my own bloody Mary's I don't add any salt at all. I haven't even finished my drink and my mouth feels like I ate an entire bag of sunflower seeds. it's almost undrinkable in my opinion.
This is my favorite bloody mary mix and the best one out there, so far as readymade mixes go...everyone should try it!
I absolutely love a good bloody Mary. I've tried a few mixes and this is by far the best one. It is perfectly seasoned.

I love Bloody Mary's and have tried many mixes as well as adding my own ingredients to the mix. I feel like Zing Zang got it down to a tee!! You can take it anywhere without having to lug along the Worcestershire sauce, Tabasco, etc. Two thumbs up!! Yes it might be a bit high in the sodium dept. but when drinking I usually don't take the health factors into account all that much!

I enjoy bloodymary's but at times making a mix from scratch is too timely so I settle for something different.  I've tried several other Bloody mixes with poor results.  The Zing Zang Bloody Mix is the closest I've come to homemade.  It's extremely tasty!  No more skipping an urge for a bloody when this mix is at hand. Highly recommend

This was an excellant transaction.  Items came way faster than expected & were packaged extremely well!  Love the Zing Zang - have to order it as it is not available in my state.  Won't drink any other bloody mary than this!

My wife and I have shopped around and tried a lot of different Bloody Mary mixes, both local and big name brands.  While the others range from bad to very good, none of them come even close to the taste of Zing Zang in our opinions.  I love it with either Tequila (Bloody Maria) or the traditional Vodka.  I don't know what's in this stuff (and probably don't want to know) but it's delicious.  We normally add Worchestire and/or Tabasco (or Texas Pete sometimes) and occasionaly Old Bay to the other mixes.  We don't add anything to this one, it doesn't really need the extras.
This is probably the best Bloody Mary mix there is! Found out they also sell it at Albertsons near us.

This stuff is like crack in a bottle for me, I can't stay away from it!  Wonderfully spicy, great tang to it and just all around great taste.  Even the consistency is just right.  I don't even add alcohol, just pour it over ice and sip on it.  I'm completely addicted, this is the best tasting Bloody Mary mix I've ever come across.  I buy it at my local Wal Mart for less; can't seem to find it online for a good price.  Zing Zang's website sells it for a bit less but shipping is a killer.

Even if you're not crazy about bloody marys, you should try this mix.  It's the perfect level of spiciness, and you really need to only add the vodka.  I've served these bloody marys to many people and have received nothing but rave reviews- definitely try it!!  If you're in Houston, you can get it locally...
This stuff really is as good as everyone says.  Certainly not the most value priced brand but well worth the money.  ROCKS!
This is the best bloody mary mix I've tried. It will sure to be a hit on first pour.
Yes, this a great Bloody Mary mix, but I can buy twice the amount (64 oz) at my local liquor store for the same price!  ($8 + tax)So, why is it so expensive here at Amazon?
This must be a south east product, because I never saw it until I went on vacation to S Carolina. Tried it and it looks and tastes very good. Noticed that it has 1% alcohol in it. Don't know why...
I usually make my bloody mary mix from scratch....but this is the best pre-made mix I've ever had. Very close to my own recipe.
Zing Zang tastes great and makes a wonderful Bloody Mary, but it will make you swell up like a tick the next day!  I say drink with caution!

column9: This Product is marketed "low-sodium" - but look at label!
column10: Look at the label in the picture.  Sorry folks, but 610 mg sodium per 100 g (that's only about 3.5 oz) can't really be "low sodium".  I don't understand Zing Zang's claim especially since Tabasco Tomato Cocktail Bloody Mary Mix, mild  claims 485 mg /100 g and Mr./Mrs. T claim 640 mg / 120 g.  They are all way HIGH in sodium.  American Heart Association recommended sodium intake per day is about 1500 mg - so 2.5 servings of this stuff is it for the day?  I don't think that any of us can really believe that this stuff is "low sodium" as it says in the description of this product.  Amazon should insist that the description be changed.
I don't know what you guys are thinking but this is AWFUL!  It's much too bitter and has not sweetness AT ALL! Try the "World's Best Bloody Mary" mix! That is AWESOME!

column9: Not as good as I remembered
column10: When it first came out, this pasta salad was a favorite of mine, particularly for entertaining and for when I needed a quick, cold meal. But I haven't purchased this in over 10 years until now. Not sure if my memory is faulty or if it's changed that much, but it's not nearly as flavorful as I remember, Also, when I first got it it came with mayonnaise packets which was great because I don't use mayonnaise enough to keep it as a staple. The mayonnaise packet made it a lot more convenient for when I had to whip together something on a moment's notice.
We love this salad, but it is not sold in the North East for some reason.  I am really glad Amazon offers it for sale.  It arrived quickly in perfect condition.

column9: What the heck, it's got Bacon now?
column10: I used to really like this stuff when it first came out, YEARS ago, but now I see it has bacon in it, WHY MESS UP ON A GOOD THING?  Due to religous reasons I can no longer eat this (because of the pork bacon bits).  It was a quick meal for a "poor" single girl on her own way back then.  I LOVE anything ranch, but why did then mess this up??

column4: Isle of Yew "Where all the geese are swan..."
column10: Heather honey is thicker and smokier in flavor than other honeys. One might say it is the single malt of honey. I have ordered this honey repeatedly from this vendor with great satisfaction. I use it on scones, in cranachan, in compotes, in toddies, etc. It is also rumored to have health-giving properties as it comes from the heath flower. Curative or not, it is wonderful stuff.

Let's separate my opinion of the vendor (who delivered the product without trouble) from the product. I have bought and tasted over 25 honey varieties, and like nearly all of them, being indifferent to just a few. This one has a moderately strong flavor, and a stronger aftertaste, neither of which is at all pleasant. If this were the world's only honey flavor, beekeepers would not be able to make a living. It is the only honey variety so far that I've actually disliked. I wish the vendor well--the service was good--but the product is just not palatable.

Haldirams Soan PapdiI was given a box of these flaky sweets by a friend from Bahrain and found them to be absolutely devine. So glad to have found them online so that I can order some to give as gifts to my other friends.
This is the best beer salt I've had.  Just be warned it has a pretty good kick to it.  Good lime flavor and a strong chili spice.

Just bought this while in America temporarily, and quite frankly I don't think much has to be said about this. It is my tea of choice when I'm in Ireland, and I was desperate enough to have to seek it out while I am in the US for the summer.It's Barry's. You can't go wrong.

I discovered this popcorn salt years ago at a grocery store, and have used it exclusively ever since.  Because nearly ever store now sells flavored salt, which I don't care for, I have ordered boxes of this salt online and taken it with me wherever I have gone.  I have had more than one roommate rave about this salt after trying it... much to their own surprise.  To first time users, please note that the salt is very fine and the holes in the top are proportionally large, so be careful not to pour too much the first time.

If you are a salt lover and eat popcorn, then this is what you want to buy. This powdered salt is the perfect form to actually stay on the popcorn and not just fall to the bottom of the container as regular salt does.
Best popcorn salt! Won't buy any other brand or kind. Every one who eats our popcorn rave on how good it taste! All because of the salt!

Every dessert product I've tried from Dassant has been excellent.  I wish Amazon carried more varieties, because I know they are out there.  They are easy to make for the emergencies when you must bring something and are a notch above most box mixes I've tried.  Not overly sweet.
This is the easiest and tastiest applesauce cake with out the hassle .  Everyone will think you made it fromscratch.

column9: Dassant has great products. This one is so so.
column10: I look around for bread mixes to use and ran across Dassant Cinnamon Chip Bread Mix, 16-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 6). I rate that 5 stars! Awesome taste, can't mess it up and almost no extra ingredients. So I figured I would try there other mixes.The American Pie Applesauce isn't my favorite, but it is much better than other brands.This takes eggs and a whole cup of applesauce.The flavor is really good and it is very moist.Easy enough to mix with a spoon.I would easily recommend all of the Dassant mixes over any other I have tried.But the Cinnamon Chip Bread is the best!

I first purchased Dassant bread/cake mixes several years ago.  I just recently tried the American Pie Applesauce Cake Mix.  As with their other mixes, I was very satisfied.  The Dassant mixes are very quick and easy to prepare.  All of the mixes I have tried taste great and everyone seems to love them.  The American Pie Applesauce Cake Mix is also very versatile.  It can be served for breakfast, as a dessert, or as a snack.

I loved this.  I used butter for the oil, and added raisins and walnuts (one handful each- I'm too lazy to measure).  It was fantastic.  I realize it would not be too hard to actually make the whole thing myself- but I'm busy.  I work and I've got kids, so to be able to pull out a mix and have it taste like home- made is great.  I don't even measure the apple sauce.  I just use two of the organic apple sauce cups I send in my kids' lunches.  That's slightly less than one cup, but I don't care- it's easy and the cake comes out perfectly.
I used coconut oil where they called for cooking oil and 1 cup of pecans.  Came out great and was delicious.  Great products.
this mix  requires more ingredients than the beer batter bread mix...it was not worth the wxtra work or ingredients. the beer mix is splendid and user friendly

column9: The Finest, Strongest Aroma, Best flavor, Longest Lasting Bag Chai Tea!
column10: Just read the title, seriously. I am a tea junkie and love my Chai. After purchasing many from the local supermarkets and whole foods. I was sold on Stash brand for the powerfully good aroma and flavor they seem to provide in their teas. If you like very watery tea you may not like this Chai as much as I do. For me, one tea bag makes a quart of good tea!

flavor, body and aroms, this tea has it all. subtle yet bold flavor so its not overpowering, it has a firm body thats enjoyable and a unique aroma that is most enjoyable. very fews teas can rival stash quality, so try these

I don't know what has happened to formulation or processing of the "big name" Earl Grey teas in the past several years, but the quality of those had degraded to such an extent that I went looking for a replacement. I am happy to say that I have found it in spades in this brand!  The bergamot comes through not only in the aroma but also the taste. (I also really like the color of the box!) This company also makes a "double bergamot" Earl Grey but I actually prefer the regular (this one) to the double. If you have become unhappy with your current Earl Grey, I recommend that you give this one a try.

I find that most (not all) people in North America brew their tea for too long a period.  When I first visited China I was amazed at how quickly after pouring the boiling water into the pot, they poured out the "finished" tea.I recently purchased a Keurig machine and have it perfect for making this tea.  I only drink it iced, perhaps that is the difference?  Two bags in the permanent filters and run through twice (using the large cup setting).  Poured over ice with a bit of milk.  I use Stevia for my sweetener.No bitterness.  Just perfectly brewed aromatic Chai Tea.  With the double spice, it gives my tastebuds the perfect "kick" that I desire.

column9: This chai tastes very good but should include more black tea leaves.
column10: This chai has good flavor but needs more black tea leaves to make a fully satisfying cup of tea. It leans on cloves but not overly, to my taste. The Tazo chai has more tea leaves and tastes very good if used properly -- 2 mugs of tea or an extra large mug from each tea bag. I've gotten used to the Stash spicing now (have enjoyed 6 boxes) and like to drink both the Stash and the Tazo (also finished 6 boxes), which I drink straight, in succession, in the morning. Then I switch to decaf Tazo chai which is very good and makes 2 mugs per tea bag.

column9: Stash tea can vary batch to batch
column10: I have, in the past, positively reviewed other Stash flavors, Ginger Lemon and Holiday Chai.  Had a problem with the Double Bergamot tea once, but then a second shipment was excellent.  But this Double Chai Spice has a strange chemical flavor. Tried mixing it with regular black tea because the chai seems to be lacking a tea flavor.  I have tried other brands of chai and have made my own.  There's something off about this - it's got a strongly astringent, bitter flavor.  I wonder if it's because the spices are ground to a powder?  The best chai is made with whole spices.
Everytime I brew this in the office, co-workers come up to me asking what smells sooooo good!  This is really a very nice tea!

My wife loves this tea. More than that, she love this brand of Chai Tea.  We tried to find it in are grocery stores and no one keeps it in stock.  The scent is really what does it for my wife but it tastes good and has just the pick-me-up you need.
This is an excellent tea that combines both the benefits of black tea with an excellent peach flavor.  I let it brew for four minutes.  It makes an excellent cup.

I have never cared for flavored teas.  I'm not sure what made me try this, but I am so glad I did!  It is positively addicting! The aroma is wonderful and it tastes even better than it smells. I have signed up with Amazon's auto-shipment to insure that I will never run out.  Simply delicious!
I didn't think the flavor was strong or distinctive enough. A pretty inoffensive tea, but after being spoiled by Tazo's Teas, it's hard to look at a tea like this the same way.
This tea is a wonderful treat on a cold night.  The cinnamon aroma is very enticing.  I have been buying this for years and Amazon always has the best price.

This tea is hard to find so I bought 6 boxes. When you open the packet, the bag smells exactly like fresh peaches. The taste is not masked by other flavors such as cinnamon. It makes wonderful iced tea.

Stash Premium Chai Spice Black Tea can be hard to find on the local shelves, but is never more than a few clicks away on Amazon! The price is great and delivery is always as promised. Enjoy your tea from Amazon.

column9: As a person who has never really liked tea
column10: this is my drink of choice.  I'm addicted.  I drink 3-4 cups a day simply because nothing else tastes this good.  I've tried other chai-spice teas; none of them compare.  The downside to telling everyone to buy this tea is the prospect that you might actually do it, raising the prices.  You should try it, it's good.

This tea is very hearty...definitely "double" in spicy, chai flavor!  I recommend it to anyone who likes a stronger tea. And you can't beat the deal especially with the Prime program -- save a couple of dollars + free shipping!  Add a little sweetner and cream and it really enhances the flavors!
Stash teas are very tasty. The flavours are rich and full bodied. Enjoy a cup alone or with friends and remember to live in the present moment.

column9: Best of the Earl Grey teas
column10: A classic tea, great by itself or with a large chocolate brownie drenched in dark chocolate syrup. Earl Grey seems to be a difficult tea to blend properly: without the proper proportion and quality of bergamot, the tea is either astringent or overly flowery. In my opinion, Stash gets the blend just right with their standard Earl Grey (the decaf version is also terrific, but to my taste the double bergamot drowns the tea flavor). I've tried several other brands, and can hardly drink the others. Don't say you dislike Earl Grey before trying this blend!

This is some awesome tea and I fear complete addiction is coming my way.  I just tried it for the first time today and am here on amazon ordering some, so I might keep plenty on hand for my Chai drinking needs.  This is a very smooth tea and will never produce a bitter taste.  It is like liquid pumpkin pie with real whipped cream.  A major part to my mouth and serenity to my senses.  I HIGHLY recommend.

To my taste, the Stash brand of Earl Grey Black Tea (in tea bags) is the best I have found. After trying Twinings, Bigelow and a few others, I discovered Stash and found it to have a fresher, cleaner taste with a more pronounced bergamot fragrance. It costs slightly more than the others but seems well worth it to me. Also, buying it in quantity through Amazon brings the cost down significantly as compared to local grocery chains.

column9: Better price than the grocery store
column10: I buy my office supplies from Amazon.com. When we were out of tea I thought I would check the prices on Stash teas compared to Safeway. Yup - it's cheaper here. And I can buy bulk and have it delivered directly to the office. win-win.

I am an Earl Grey fan, and had tried many different brands.  Once I tried Stash, I never needed to check another.  It's a wonderful tea, with a full bodied flavor.  A great pick-me-up at any time of day... and it comes in decaf too for evening enjoyment.

I fell in love with Stash Peach Tea in about 2005 when I had it at the Hobnob Tea Room in Loveland CO. Not only can you select it for your lunch but you can buy a box from the stock they keep on hand. Because it's a family owned restaurant (not a chain) naturally they have to charge enough to pay for s/h. I found it a little cheaper at Vitamin Cottage. I always had a big cup after lunch at my desk at the post office where I worked in the passport office. Every time customers or other clerks would come in they would say "wow what smells so delicious?". It began to happen that I would make a trip to Hobnob or Vit Cott and they would be out of my tea. That flavor does not seem to be carried even in stores that carry Stash. So I found it by accident on Amazon while looking for something else entirely. I was so happy. If I purchase enough at a time it saves me nearly a dollar a box over all. I drink it every day so VOILA I found a great deal on Amazon. Thank you!!!
The tea was great. It was used by my husband and mom, and tasted by me :o) It goes great with fresh mint thrown in with the brew!
This makes the best iced tea ever.And in the winter I can drink a cup hot and remember that summer is not "that" far off.In Momtana, in the winter, we appreciate any thing that reminds us of summer.

...Stash Chai and Amazon's auto delivery service! Unlike many chai teas, Stash does not use black pepper. You get the good spices without the funny bite. Our office is addicted to this -- no morning goes by without a cup of chai! So the Amazon deal of free shipping every three months works perfectly for us. No more running to the grocery store -- or doing without because we forgot!
Wonderful smell and taste!  I have regular and decaf both, each very good.  Pronounced black tea + spices..far from a light green tea!
Great tasting tea.  Much cheaper to purchase in bulk from Amazon than at the grocery store.  Thank you Amazon!

I already liked regular Stash Earl Grey and so dared to try this doubled bergamot variant. This Earl Grey variant is the best I have tried out of many. There may be ones stronger in both aspects of the black tea and bergamot or more balanced -- but I only know that this "Double Bergamot Earl Grey" is a very balanced rich black tea with bergamot -- and it is organic like other Stash teas. This doubled bergamot Earl Grey is great hot with milk and brown sugar -- or icy with just a tad lemon or lime to add to the bergamot -- or without such additions. Also it is so rich someone can add it to other plain, even modest, black tea [bags one-for-one] for a more mellow bergamot tea. I even found it interesting with black mint tea [bags one-for-one] as this variant is not overwhelmed by other teas +++

The strong, spicy aroma (clove and cinnamon dominate) makes this flavor my favorite of the black tea offerings.  Could easily pass for potpourri with it's wonderful bouquet. The flavor stands up well to cream and sugar/honey if that's how you take your chai.
I absolutely love this tea. I let steep about 3-5 minutes to extract all of those wonderful spices this tea contains; then add cream and sugar. Extremely recommended!!!

There is nothing but a strong clove flavor to this tea.  I have had better chai teas with more subtle flavoring.  The Yogi brand is a good one.  If you love clove, then this is your tea.  Unfortunately, I don't.

I was introduced to Stash a few years ago when I sampled their peppermint tea, which was so powerful you could smell it through the packaging. It was so delicious I decided to get a box of each of their tea samplers, including black.Now I have another Stash favorite. After running out while on vacation I had to try a number of different Earl Grey teas (Bigelow, Twinings, Generic Grocery Store brand), and though adequate, they lacked the extra bergamot kick I'd grown to love. With Stash you get a fragrant, excellent quality tea, and they know how to package it for freshness.This is one of my favorite morning hot drinks when I want to start my day with a nice jolt. And if you have a sweet tooth like me, serve hot with sweetened condensed milk.

But thankfully, Amazon is there to be my supplier!This is strong tea, but I love it.  I can't tolerate so much as the scent of coffee, and I never was a morning Mountain Dew person, but this gets me moving in the AM.  I've cut back in that I don't brew two bags in a mug for 20 minutes at a time like I did a decade ago with Earl Grey.Super Target used to carry it around here, D/FW, but I think I may have singlehandedly cleaned them out over the course of the past year.The great thing about Amazon is, not only can I buy six+ months worth at once but there is no tax & free shipping.  Between those extras and not having to go anywhere to purchase it, it costs well below what it does at the store.

My husband will drink nothing but double bergamot earl grey from Stash, I used to by it straight from Stash but this is much faster and still a good price! I will probably set up a autoship order as soon as I figure out how fast we go through 6 boxes.  If you like Earl Grey, you really need to try this tea! They also have a green tea version

I used to spend a fortune on good Chai Tea at the coffee shop.  Then, I discovered the double-spice tea.  We both loved the stronger flavor of the spices.  To my dismay, on my next trip to the grocery store, the double-spice tea was nowhere to be found!  It was one of those items that apparently wasn't on their regular ordering schedule.  I looked it up on Amazon, and, there it was...six boxes at a time, on subscribe and save, a decent price, and quick delivery!  This tea is great with a "sweetener of choice" (I generally use stevia or agave in mine) and some milk or cream, hot or cold.  My hubbie drinks it with no additions at all and it is his "pre-sleep" tea of choice.  I've also used 5-7 bags in my iced tea maker and the result is yummy iced tea (or, add just a bag of this tea to regular tea for a hint of spice).  Stash teas are great overall.  I like the fact that they are individually wrapped in a "foil" wrap that holds together well and can be taken to the office or wherever without dissolving in one's pocket or purse!  It IS black tea and contains caffeine!  If this is a problem, try the Good Earth Original Caffeine-Free tea.  Also available on Amazaon, it is a delicious, slightly sweet, cinnamon-y tea!
This is one of the teas that I drink on a daily basis. It has a good flavor, but is basic enough that its part of my daily routine. Love it!
I love this tea.  It's refreshing especially in the hot summer.  Very naturally tasting and clean

Stash teas offer rich full flavors from light refreshing teas to the full body spicy aroma or the rich chai teas also comes in Decaf.  The longer you brew the stronger, serve with french vanilla creamer.  Enjoy.**FYI**Amazon offers these by the case of 6 boxes only. Not the individual box of 18cnt tea bags.  Yep, thats 108 tea bags, to share with the office & family.

This tea is absolutely wonderful.  I usually stick to plain black tea, but this double spice is really good.  Awesome with cookies or cake that have cinnamon, clove or chocolate in them.  Try putting a splash of vanilla soy milk in it...excellent!

I have been a tea drinker all my life, and Stash has some wonderful flavors! I think I got primarily hooked on the finer teas when my parents drove us to Canada as children every year.  I primarily drink Earl Gray teas because they are a deep rich teas, but not overpowering.  When you drink Earl Gray, you feel like you drank a fine cup of English tea.  The Double Bergamot added to the Earl Gray is even more superior!  Bergamot is also relaxing.  This is a wonderful blend and very difficult to find in stores.
This cinnamon flavor in this tea is overwhelming. It really hides any tea taste. Would not buy it again.

column9: Gets me out of bed in the morning!
