THEN, add your tea bags, and dont let it brew for more than FOUR MINUTES. THEN, like ALL CHIA TEA, it must be VERY sweet, for the spices to "work". I add asparteme, and LOTS of it ,and a bit of honey, and some SOY MILK....ALL DONE!!! Stash's chia tea is the best, the VERY BEST. I tasted them all. There's no black pepper, chicory, or other wierdness.  SO, even tho with white chia you only get 18 bags of tea per box, instead of 20 with the GREEN or BLACK CHIA, its worth the few extra pennies for this tea. BUT, first, do you like WHITE TEA, and DO YOU LIKE SPICES? (and if you dont like to sweeten your tea, or add milk/soy, just stay away from CHIA. ) PS. dont make this the old TIBETIAN way, cos you dont want to BOIL white tea.

Mine, all mine.  A tea that is hard to find.  A dash of milk and a touch of sugar and mmmmmm.  Unique flavor and a real treat to have when I get home in the evening.  If you haven't tried chi, you don't know what you're missing.  Great product.

I absolutely love this tea. I usually mix the black and white chai teas together. White tea is really good for you..However, to my disappointment.. Everytime I order this tea, I get sent the wrong one. Instead I've received two boxes (containing 6 packages) of "Organic Premium White Tea".. Which, is not the same at all.. Huge disappointment with my order, though no hard feelings to Amazon - they did all they could. I still absolutely love this tea and would recommend it to any chai lover!

column9: Above-average quality at an affordable price
column10: The truth is, you almost always get what you are paying for. In the case of this product, you are a bit above the average 'value' curve. It's not my 'number one' white tea but it is a solid 'number two'. The kind I drink almost like I drink water, several cups a day.The 'Stash Premium Tea' is not top of the line 'premium' but I enjoy drinking it. I guess, I could call it my 'staple' tea. Since I'm not into 'flavors', I actually have a subscription for the plain variety. These teas, I drink them every now and then or serve them to guests who may care for cup but they are not my daily drink.And, just in case someone did not know, there's nothing special about 'chai'. Translated into English, 'chai' means 'tea'.
I prefer the taste of black chai tea.  White chai tea probably has more anti-oxidents and other useful substances since it is processed less.

This product may be exactly what is described but I don't like the taste. For me it has too much clove taste and is almost medicinal in its strength. After steeping three minutes I couldn't finish the cup. With a two minute steep I could tolerate it but I know I won't finish all the boxes. I wish I could have found it at my local store to try first before buying so much.I like Chai flavored creamers so I should have just ordered plain white tea and added that. The positive ratings made it sound good but for me the spice flavor is overpowering (like euclayptus menthol).
When I ordered this I thought I was getting plain white tea not a spice variety, don't really care for it.
We don't make beer, but we do make chocolate malts, and this is a great product!  I've also put a teaspoon in hot chocolate mix.  Possibilities are endless, and it dissolves great.

The jams and jellies were very good. It's nice to take to picnics, the beach, and lunch! You don't have to pre-make the sandwiches so the bread doesn't get all soggy by the time you eat it.I only gave it 4 stars because there is only 40 of the yummy strawberry jams and 80 of the grape and mixed fruits.  They are also pretty small, so to make a peanut-butter-jelly-sandwich, you need 3-4 of the jellies to make it nice and gooey!But overall, very tasty!

We got this jelly so we could take it on a road trip and not have to worry about refrigerating anything. There is a lot of little packets in the box. We have a whole lot left after a 14 day trip. (we didn't eat it everyday though, I think we used 3 or 4 per pb&j that we made) I still have to figure out what to make to use the rest up.It tastes good and was convenient to take on our trip. If you are trying to do something similar I would suggest it. I think it was a good value for the price and the convenience of the product.I got the order quickly and had no problems with the product or seller.
Unfortunately the jellies were hard and old. The idea was to set them on a few tables in the garden for a brunch the day after the wedding for our out of town gust. It was terribly disappointing.
great product and didn't come all squashed like others i have bought from other sites. i didn't count how many of each king there were, but it looks to be an even amount.
Living alone it is wonderful to have small portion food items in various flavors. I would definitely recommend this product and will be searching for other food items.

This is NOT welch, but cheap PPI brand which you can buy in sams club for $7 or so and it is rubbery. We used to buy this from sams and after a month or so, realised that customers can not use it as it is complete rubber.Called amazon, they refunded in full. That's good.
This 200 pack Welch's Jelly Assortment was ordered for a church food pantry.  The product arrived quickly and in good condition.  This is a great value and the church was happy.

This jelly is absolutely impossible to spread.  It takes 4-5 packs just for 1 slice of bread and it is globby because you can't spread it.  I won't be buying this ever again and hopefully you won't either.
I ordered this product to go with the Skippy peanut butter cups that I sent out to some guys in Afghanistan. Product came on tiume and as ordered!
There is something in the jelly which makes it harden to the point it can't be spread on toast, just won't come off the knife.
Great for my family we drive big rig trucks. Makes quick p&j without having to carry around jars ofJelly

As a lifetime member of Weight Watchers, I know that a pan of brownies in the house can easily lead to a pan of brownies in my belly.  What I love about No Pudge is that you can make a single serving.  Directions are on the box.  I mix two tablespoons of my favorite lowfat yogurt (the BEST is Axelrod black cherry - which makes this a Black Forest brownie) with 1/4 cup No Pudge mix and pop it in the micro for two minutes. This is a double brownie.  The single brownie is too dinkie to satisfy me.  Then I slather the rest of the yogurt over the brownie.  The creamy yogurt mixes through the chewy brownie and is my hands down favorite send my belly to bed happy nighttime snack.  5 weight watchers points with the double serving and yogurt.

column9: Easy, quick and consistantly delicious brownies every time!
column10: Trader Joe's has been carrying the No Pudge Brownie mixes for over a decade and it's not unusual to see customers buying them by the case.  At the current price of $15.55 for 6 that makes them $2.59 a pack if you have Amazon prime or use Super Saver Free shipping and that's not a bad deal.  What mnakes these brownies so popular is that all you have to add is yogurt.  I add Vanilla Nonfat yogurt and sometimes I'll toss in two tablespoons of instant coffee of espresso powder to jazz them up.  You don't need butter or eggs - just the yogurt.  Once you do that, you stir 'em up, pour 'em in the pan and in no time you have delicious brownies!  They aren't as ooey-gooey as some mixes but that's what I like about them.  They also aren't cloyingly sweet.  They are simply a nice, fudgey brownie that you don't have to feel too guilty about eating. I always keep a couple packages in the pantry to whip up for unexpected company or for whenever that chocolate craving hits you out of nowhere.  The best thing about No Pudge Fudge Brownies is that they are easy to mix, quick to cook and they always come out to be the same good and fudgey brownie you are longing for. Keep some on hand at all times!

My husband and I are crazy about these brownies! They are fresh and ready to eat in no time at all with a chewy, gooey, chocolate-y flavor.  I like to add a scoop of Frozen Cherry Yogurt to the top of the still-warm brownie.Did I tell you how easy they are to mix-up? The package is complete. You just add some yogurt.  And the best part...it's easy to just mix enough for a couple of brownies and then pop them in the microwave.  That's if you don't want to mix up (and probably eat) the whole pan at once.I also like the packaging for these.  The boxes stand up easily in my pantry and because of the hot pink color they are always very easy to find.  These are a wonderful treat that you really don't have to feel bad about enjoying. I give them 4 stars only because I think they are a bit pricey...but then, as we all know, usually you get what you pay for. Recommended!

Don't listen to o'l Kevin up above. These aren't just good fat free brownies...these are good brownies period. In fact, they are the best I've ever had. When my wifre made them and told me they were fat free, I was thinking "ok here we go - these are going to taste bad". I couldn't believe it when I took a bite. I thought she was playing a trick on me and made another batch of real brownies and gave them to me. Once I tried them, she couldn't get the pan away from me. Amazing. You will love them. As for Kevin - there are something wrong with your taste buds bro. Get it checked out.

I don't typically buy foods that are advertised as non-fat for precisely the reasons that a previous reviewer mentioned--they're gummy, barely taste like what they're supposed to taste like, and just generally disgusting.  I also don't like fat-free foods because of all the chemicals and added sugar that usually goes into them to give them something resembling their full-fat texture.This product really is different from all those other fat-free products, though, and I genuinely enjoy it.  The ingredients are all things I typically would keep in my cupboard without feeling the need for a biohazard sticker on the door (if only I had time to bake).The fact that one can make an easy single-serving brownie in the microwave is an added bonus for all of us who don't live with a big family of people who will eat our homemade creations, or who simply don't have time to make a pan of homemade brownies.  I concede that these are not as good as a gourmet fudge brownie, but they are precisely what I'd hoped they'd be when I got them: yummy, quick, easy, economical, and above all chocolatey.My favorite serving suggestion: drop a few chocolate chips in the cup before putting them in to bake.

column9: We don't have to feel bad eating these brownies!!
column10: These are by far the best fat-free desert out there! I am a pleased to say we order these cases two at a time! My kids love to make them,and take them to school. No pudge rocks!!

column9: Fat Free Fudge Brownies-Hit the spot for less
column10: These brownies really taste like brownies and they dont wreck your diet if you dont eat the whole box at a sitting! I make them in the mini muffin tins and put 2-3 at a time in zip lock baggies to help me to enjoy them in moderation. Brownies are my favorite chocolate snack food and these are very sweet, chewy and satisfy my chocolate cravings.

column9: You'd really never know they were fat-free
column10: No Pudge brownies are AMAZING. They truly taste just as good as brownies with all the lovely fat in them. These are all natural, too--as in, the ingredients are few, and consist of normal things you have in your pantry. No 15+ letter chemicals here. All you need to add is 5 1/2 oz fat-free french vanilla yogurt. These brownies come out VERY chewy, so if you like yours softer, double the amount of yogurt. And check out their website for other recipe ideas!Seriously--you're not going to buy six boxes only to find out they taste like cardboard. They're FAT free, not sugar and taste free. You will want to tell everyone you know that this mix exists! Delicious!!

I am currently on Weight Watchers, and originally saw people raving about these brownies on the message boards there.  I decided to try them out, and they were AMAZING.  You just add fat free vanilla yogurt (or even water, applesauce, or sour cream if you have no yogurt at the time), bake and ENJOY!!  I got the original version, and then added a tsp of mint and they were AMAZING.  Super chocolatey & chewy and there are a number of ways to tweak the recipe to your liking--like adding shredded coconut, bailey's, caramel sauce, etc.  I will say over $5/ box is kinda pricey, but they are hard to find at a lot of grocery stores, so this might be your best bet.  The 6-packs are a very good deal, so I would recommend that over the single box....trust me, it will be worth it!!!

It was 11 pm on a Monday.  Someone sent me an e-mail detailing the waffles and berry sauce she was going to prepare for a weekend brunch.  My mouth began to water just as I was getting ready to head to bed.  Darn it!A subletter in my student apartment had left No Pudge brownie mix in my cabinet, and when I came back from the summer break, I almost threw out the box when I saw it.  I typically don't buy anything low-fat or non-fat, as I prefer to recognize the ingredients in whatever food I purchase and eat.  (The "everything in moderation" motto of my 88-year-old grandmother has worn off.  For my healthy under-30-year-old self, a little butter is fine in a fruit and veggie-rich diet short on processed foods.)Anyway, there was nothing around to satisfy my sudden must-have-chocolate attack.  The pink box called out to me from the back of the cabinet, and I winced.  No Ghirardelli in sight.  Low-fat chocolate?  Well, if I must.  I figured the brownies would be horrible but satisfy a craving, and that I could then pitch the rest of the pan.Not the case!  The craving hit at 10:55 pm, and I was cutting the brownies (having added *regular* Brown Cow plain yogurt with a tsp+ of natural vanilla) at 11:40.  They were really good warm.  The next day, completely cooled, they were even better!  I actually think that that chocolate taste of these is much better than any brownie mix I've ever encountered.  With the yogurt I used, the consistency was more cake-like than chewy, but I'll deal with that minor shortcoming.  These were awesome, and I'll be buying a supply of my own!

cooks perfectly every time and is a real treat if youre not into the cakey taste of ordinary brownies but really want something fudgey that you dont have to eat too much of. perfect straight out of the oven over mint chocolate chip ice cream!
Love these brownies.  Serve them to friends and family-not one complaint.  Nice to be able to serve a brownie without trans fat and other undesirables.  Chewy, chocolatey and delicious.

The Kitchen Gods are kind! This is the best tasting, good for you brownie mix in a box since Bob's Red Mill brownie mix! Easy to make, perfect every time and even kids love them! You won't know your eating healthy when you bite into one of these scrumptious, gooey squares.
You would never guess that these brownies were Fat Free.  Even my little girl loves them.  They have become a regular treat in our house hold.

Makes great brownies.  I've only tried it with yogurt, not sour cream or apple sauce as also suggested.  Very good and fudgy.I probably wouldn't get it again, the ingredients are pretty simple, I'll probably just make it myself next time, from scratch with egg whites and yogurt instead of whole eggs and oil.I do like how there is the one serving recipe instructions.  I've never used it but it's thoughtful.
If you like brownies but are concern about the calories... don't fear no more... these are the perfect brownies. Soft, chewy, just perfect... without all the CALORIES

I like these because they taste like regular, full-fat brownies.  The texture is moist and chewy, and the flavor is nice and chocolatey.  Perhaps the best part is that they are so easy to make.  All you need to add is fat-free yogurt.  Yay!!

These are the easiest and best fat free dessert I have found out on the market.  If you have ever made any fat free brownies before you would know that a lot of the recipes just aren't that great.  These would make you believe you were eating some gourmet fattening brownies.  I am a chocoholic and these are my favorite!!!
These are great tasting and low calorie! You can't go wrong with a case of these. You will use them up quick.

I have been a long time fan of No Pudge!  Our local grocery stores quite selling it for some reason, so was very pleased to find it on Amazon. It is by far our favorite desert. Best with a little non-fat Cool Whip on top. Yummmmmm!

No Pudge! Fat Free Fudge Brownie Mix, Original, 13.7-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 6)Thi product is easy to bake (my husband bakes them himself) can add mint or coconut for variety, freezes well.  Tastes delicious.

column9: Hard to believe these are fat free
column10: These brownies are really good and it's hard to believe they're fat free.  If you're trying to watch what you eat, but still want a sweet chocolate fix, these are great.  I make them as directed and they turn out moist and delicious!

First of all, this product is GREAT value. 6 boxes for only like 8 bucks?!?! YES.I love to make them in my dorm room in a mug :) perfect sweet snack...and now hopefully I won't gain a freshman 15 xDlove it :D

This is an awesome product. I work at a weight loss camp as a nutrition and culinary instructor, which means that one of my duties is to serve snack to the campers twice a day. This one is a FAVORITE around here with the kids AND staff! You can prepare it using applesauce or yogurt, like the box says. Both come out really awesome. They do tend to be a bit gooey when you cut them--not a huge problem though! There is enough stability to cut pieces and serve them for sure. Awesome product. I will be purchasing some when I go home from camp!

I had just started weight watchers and my friend introduced me to this product.  They were so good!  They were the perfect combination of soft and chewy.  I've served these to family and friends and they really enjoyed them too (they had no idea they were fat free)!  Serving them with strawberries is the perfect combination!One tip - just don't put them in the frig to store.  They will be come slightly hard - easy fix - put them in the microwave for 5-10 seconds and they'll soften up!

column9: They taste decent, but not at all like real brownies.
column10: I usually buy real brownies, but these intrigued me so I wanted to try them. I could tell they would be too sweet for me after licking the batter spoon and I was put off by all the cocoa dust that flew out when I dumped the package. They were easy to make though and cooked just fine in cupcake liners. They made about 12 cupcakes. I ate maybe 3 with LOTS of milk and then dumped the rest in the trash. It's not that they taste horrible, it's that they taste absolutely nothing like real brownies. They taste like dark chocolate and sugar goo, in my opinion. I can't stomach diet drinks or anything made with beet sugar or fake sugar either, so I'm not surprised that I hated them.I just realized that, to me, they taste very much like Snackwell's devil food cookies. I never liked those, but I know plenty of people that did.

These taste BETTER than traditional brownies in my opinion, not as heavy and no where near the grease (because there is none!) So quick & easy to make, and my 5-year old loves to help mix the batter.  House smells awesome for hours after baking :)

column9: Good brownies to eat with ice cream
column10: I'm not on a diet or anything, my husband just bought these because they were on sale at the local grocery store and was intrigued by the Just Add Yogurt label (we are huge yogurt eaters). These are pretty decent brownies: almost-normal consistency, fudge-y taste (batter was amazing!). But there is a slight odd after-taste (fruity? cocoa powder?), if you have sensitive taste buds and are used to the standard brownie. To get by that, just eat these with ice cream or whipped cream and strawberries. (Although that kind of defeats the purpose of the fat-free I guess). I probably won't buy these again just because I love regular ol' brownies. But these were fun to try.

These taste great but not so great that I can't control myself with them. I can have 1 or 2 and be done for the day. I make them with 8 oz. of yogurt. I have tried cherry yogurt and I have tried vanilla and put coconut extract in the mix. I like to play around with extracts and yogurt flavors. They are also good topped with a small smudge of peanut butter. Very good and fudgy!
I love No Pudge Fudge. All natural and a simple list of ingredients  I add organic yogurt and oatmeal to make a great treat.

I am pregnant and so far went from 120lbs to 150lbs with 3-5 weeks left. I wanted something natural yet satisfying and sweet to help get me thru without going overboard. No pudge did the trick! They are not identical to full fat brownies, but pretty close. My husband eats them but compared them to a kid cuisine brownie. I think they are much better than that and with only 100 calories and being natural, they are great!

One package is 12 servings. 2 WW PointsPlus per piece if you are keeping track. Add the batter to a new shiny 12 spot muffin tray, which I spray with non-stick spray first. I usually cook for about 375 degrees for about 30 minutes. These will come out very crispy around all the edges. To prevent me from eating them all in one day, I throw them in a tupperware container in the freezer, and grab one when I need it. Thaws very quickly, or throw in the microwave for about 10 - 15 seconds for a crispy outside and a warm soft inside. Also add low fat whipped cream topping if you want, we keep ours in the freezer, which makes it almost like ice cream. I use non-sweetened generic brand applesauce instead of yogurt, and add a little vanilla extract just as the recipe on the box recommends. I have made it w/o the extract and really no difference.

Here's a fantastic Weight Watcher's secret... No-Pudge is 2.5 points (Points+) for 1/16 of a pan as prepared with fat-free yogurt. If you add 3 Tbsp oil to the mix, they will taste like a full-fat brownie but for only 3 points instead of 6.

column9: Excellent substitute for the real thing
column10: Pudge Free Brownies, recommended to us by a pair of nutritionists, are an excellent substitute for the real thing.  They take care of your craving for a dessert sweet and at the same time they do not hurt you and your low fat diet.  Try baking them in a convection oven for a different taste sensation, too.

I, too, adore these brownies. Perfect taste and texture. What I do, is make them in mini muffin tins (a whole box makes 24!), put them in individual bags right after they have cooled (3 mini muffin sized brownies equals out to 198 calories), and I throw them in my freezer. When I want a sweet snack mid-afternoon, or after dinner, I just grab a bag out of the freezer. I am not tempted to 'eat the whole tray', or even 'eat them before they get old', because they are pre-portioned and frozen. :)

You would never know that these are fat free brownies based on the taste and texture. The best part is that the mix can be used to make single portions, perfect for people like me who like a yummy baked good as an occasional treat but don't want the temptation of an entire pan of brownies. A quick zap in the microwave and you've got a warm brownie. Cooked according to instructions, brownies are cake-like, but you can reduce the cook time by a few seconds for a fudgey brownie. Even my kids love these - and they normally turn their noses up at light or low fat versions of desserts (which is often justified). Highly recommend!

My absolute favorite treat is a brownie. I love these chocolatey dense squares with their crunchy, chewy edges. I couldn't believe it when I bit into these and found they met every expectation I would have for a brownie! I've tried so many low fat brownies and have always been disappointed but these are AMAZING brownies! I enjoyed them 100% as much as a regular brownie! I couldn't believe how good they were and I wouldn't have known they were fat free if I didn't make them myself! I usually add an ounce of walnuts to the mix but they still come out to only 130 calories a brownie and that's a normal size brownie - not a 2 bite square. LOVE these! Thanks No Pudge for giving me delicious brownies again!
These brownies are very good and help satisfy my sweet craving.  If you are doing weight watchers, one brownie is 3 points.
I've was introduced to this product several years ago.  They are very good!  I like the fact that you can use yogurt, apple sauce, water etc. to make these brownies.

I don't generally buy fat-free products because they usually taste like crap.  These brownies are surprising good for a fat-free brownie.  However, they are a little too sweet (and this is coming from someone who has a major sweet tooth). Also, when you first eat one of these, they seem to taste really great, so maybe you'll have another . . . and another.  But by the time you start the third one, you'll notice a slight aftertaste of some kind, like it's missing something important (and it is:  fat).  So, these aren't bad to ride out a sweet craving, but they're definitely not as delicious as "real" homemade brownies.

I love chocolate, and it was really difficult for me to give up my usual brownies, chocolate chip cookies, etc. when I started eating healthier about a year ago. Thankfully, I discovered No Pudge brownies, which satisfy the chocolate cravings and sweet tooth. I always have a pan of these brownies in my fridge, and I've still lost almost 100 pounds.Though No Pudge makes different flavors of brownies, I always get the original flavor and use different flavors of yogurt to get differently flavored brownies. I like to use black cherry or strawberry yogurt. Top one of those brownies off with a small scoop of frozen yogurt and you have an amazing dessert for only a couple hundred calories. You can also add dried fruits (I like dried cherries) to the mix before baking, and they turn out great. This mix is really versatile, and it always bakes up absolutely perfectly.
These are amazing.  Taste great without all the fat, perfect for my low fat diet.  Try them, you would be disappointed.

I love this brownie mix because it's so easy and doesn't require ingredients that I don't normally have (I don't stock eggs and oil in my fridge/pantry).  The end result is a product that has a texture that is more similar to cake than it is to a fudgey brownie (or says my husband).One caution:  do not overbake, otherwise the brownies become extremely tough and hard and not-so-delicious.  The box recommends a baking time of 30-35 minutes when poured into a standard 9x11 pan.  If you use mini-muffin pans like I do (either 12-count or 24-count), I would recommend reducing the baking time to 25-30 minutes.

My husband and I are in love with these brownies. We'd been getting them from our local grocery store for a couple of years now, and were so excited to see them on Amazon Subscribe & Save. I don't care what others may tell you, these brownies taste exactly like regular. They are incredible. The raspberry and mint are also incredible. You mix the package contents with one container of fat-free vanilla yogurt (we ALWAYS use Yoplait)...so simple and so good. Which reminds me - besides being easy, delicious and guilt-free, you can burn some calories making them! Lol. The batter becomes so thick, you really have to crank it. But it's SO worth it! Please be sure to give it a try yourself instead of going by any bad reviews!

These are really great.  I like them as single serve RAW for that chocolate fix and I just cooked a double batch in a 13x9 pan with FF vanilla yogurt and they turned out amazing.  I only cooked them about 30 mins and they were done.  They turned out really fudgy.  Let them cool completely.  It is a little bit of a pain to portion since they are so fudgy they stuck to my SS spatula I was using to cut. They are delicious.  You can't go wrong here.  My husband thinks they are OK.  He likes full fat ghiradellis.  Def try them out.  I'm curious about the other flavors.

My absolute favorite brownies!  My child has an egg allergy so these are perfect since they are made with yogurt.  (For those that aren't brownie connoisseurs, most brownie mixes require eggs.) If you are skeptical, just try them.  The price is worth it, they are fat free, and if you find that they are not chocolatey enough, add chocolate chips.  I swear they will not disappoint!

column9: Can Guilt(less) Brownies Still Taste Good??
column10: I was hesitant to buy No Pudge Fudge Brownie mix. I thought that fat free would mean that the brownies would taste nothing like brownies or maybe the brownies would have an odd consistancy. How could not using oil but yogurt give that chewy brownie texture that I love? I am pleased to say that all of my worries were for nothing! These brownies are AMAZING! I love that I can make a single serving which is perfect if I need a chocolate fix. My 10 year old picky son loves them! If you want a special treat you can mix the brownies with a flavored yogurt...raspberry or blueberry are to die for! I recommend No Pudge Fudge Brownie mix to those that love brownies but not the fat!

column9: Light & Rich! I'm never going back!
column10: I read an article about No Pudge brownies somewhere and made a mental note to try it out someday. My grocery store now carries them so I thought I'd give them a try. I use fat-free plain yogurt and two drops of vanilla extract (which honestly doesn't really make a difference at all if you don't have any; I've tried both ways) and they still come out faaabulous! I make them all the time for girls' night-in; it's always a favorite! In my house, these brownies have never seen the light of dawn -- they go fast. :) I love sweets and baked goods but I stay away from them to keep in shape. I'm serious when I say that I don't have to worry with these brownies (even if I splurge on a couple extra pieces..out of 12). For some reason, I don't gain an inch! They're filling yet light, moist, rich, and are composed of the perfect texture ..not being too chewy, dry, or cake-like. Make sure not to over-bake them to the point that the top gets lighter and dry. If you see it start to happen and your brownies aren't ready, cover the top of your pan carefully with aluminum foil and it should be fine. I recommend this to everyone. I hope they never go out of business haha.. I plan on using their mix for life.

OMG these brownies are so ridiculously DELICIOUS! They are way too easy to make to taste this good. My only word of caution is to be careful of downing the entire tray as it completley negates any of the perceived benefit you feel from them being fat free.  Keep in mind, calories are calories and you will NOT be able to stop eating these!P.S. I'm not on a diet. I just buy these because they taste the best.
These no pudge, fat free brownies are incredible.  Very easy to make and absolutely delicious. I baked them in a muffin pan. Highly recommend even if you aren't on a diet!

No Pudge Brownie Mix is the best !!!Just mix with Dannon Lite Vanilla Yogurt and you can have the best chocolatedelight ...without making brownies !!! Although if you are making brownies they microwave as brownies very well... they are good but don't try to eat them when they are too hot !! I've done that.Enjoy No Pudge....my local supermarkets seemed to quit carrying it and I triedto Trader Joe's version but the texture was grainy and the taste was zero.I ordered 18 boxes via Amazon so I am a loyal fan on No Pudge !!

I've lost 89 lbs since January of 2010, and I wanted to say that these have been a staple of my dieting. I'm not saying this was the only dessert I had but I have to say that it was one I had most frequently and still continue to have!  My favorite way and practically the only way I've served this was the single serve. I'd take 4 large tablespoons, sometimes 5 of the mix, and then I'd add 2 tablespoons of unsweetened applesauce.  I felt that this would help combat the extra mix and guarentee this was not adding any extra calories or fat that the yogurt sometimes has, and more importantly, no extra sugar. I'd add this to a microsafe coffee mug.  Once in a while, I'd add a few extra treats: a teaspoon of chocolate chips, or a teaspoon of peanut butter (which DOES add fat), and sometimes if I have any, a very small spoonful of ice cream.  And I ALWAYS add a small dose of low fat whipped cream to the top.  Part of dieting means treating yourself, and while I have this sometimes a few days a week, I never noticed a weight gain while consuming this.  This stuff is wonderful!!
All you need to add to it is yogurt. Every time I make it I am asked for the recipe and how do I get them so moist. Plus it is healthy and fat-free. These are our whole family's favorite brownies.

If you are looking to watch your caloric intake but still love the taste of a pretty yummy brownie - then this No Pudge brownie is for you... 120 calories per brownie (and it is a decent size) 4 different flavors (mint, raspberry, cappacinco and original)... yum!  and considerably cheaper than buying them in the store.

column9: Great fat free brownies, even non-dieters like them
column10: Even non-dieters love these.  1 box, made as per instructions (I use a 6oz container of nonfat vanilla yogurt usually) makes 1 pan, but I find that it makes a decently thick brownie if you use an 8x8 pan and adjust cooking time accordingly.  I couldn't spread the whole batter out into a larger pan. The batter is very thick and when all you are adding to the box of powder mix is a small carton of yogurt, it seems unlikely that that small amount of yogurt will turn a bowl of powder into a bowl of batter but if you keep stirring, it does happen. I also tried it using nonfat plain Greek yogurt plus a tsp of vanilla but it was too thick so I had to add a few tablespoons of water and then the batter came out perfect and the brownies were just as great as always. I like that you can do single servings in a bowl in the microwave (I double these as they are pretty small).  These brownies are not as gooey and flakey as a regular decadent type but they have more a thicker chewy-ness (like a crust but not hard or flaky) on the bottom and outside edges that some people prefer.  For a nice treat, top these brownies with fat free Cool Whip and some sugar free chocolate syrup... diet brownie heaven. They sell this mix in my local supermarket and it's about $3-$5 depending on if there's a sale.  These brownies are very sticky when cutting them so it's also good to make them in muffin tins instead of brownie pans.

They actually seem to vary by batch. Sometimes they are excellent and sometimes they lack a little flavor. I still like them and will continue to buy. I am at about 5,000 ft and have to do the high elevation recipe modification.
These are the Best Brownies and they are Fat Free. My entire family loves them.

I made these brownies with Light Yoplait Vanilla Yogurt and they were amazing!  They were so moist and delicious.  I have recommended them to everyone I know!  They do stick to the pan a little more than average brownies, but I'll take that over super fatty brownies any day.  When you first start mixing these it may seem like there isn't enough yogurt in them to smooth out, but with a lot of stirring they'll end up mixing wonderfully.  I love these brownies and recommend them to anyone!

I was skeptical, but hopeful, that these would be as good as the other reviews led me to believe. These brownies are as fudgy and chocolatey as claimed and in my opinion taste as good as any full fat brownie I've ever had. I like my brownies more fudgy/chewy than cake-like and that's exactly how they came out following the standard recipe. If I didn't know, I would never guess they're fat free brownies.

These are possibly the best brownies ever.  They are sweet and chewy with a slight crispiness to the top. I like to make them in a muffin tin.  They are only "no pudge" if I can manage to not eat the whole pan!

I followed the instructions precisely to make a cake instead of the brownies - but it turned out just alright. I noticed the more I kept it out (not in the fridge) the harder it got :(I tried to warm it in the microwave just before consuming, but that did not help either!They were so tasty for being fat free, that I have to try baking it brownie style and see if it works out.

These are easy to make, tasty, and best of all not fattening-that is if you don't eat the whole pan at once.  This is a good price Amazon is selling them for.  All you need is  vanilla yogurt or applesauce to make them and the batter is delicious!

I made a single serving in the microwave last night using a generic, low calorie, low carb vanilla yogurt. I was pleasantly surprised! It was so yummy. Very chocolatey. I had to add more than 1 tbsp of the yogurt, but only a tad. I have not baked a whole batch yet, as it is only me in the house, so I cannot comment on how they turn out in the oven, but the single servings are great.
I absolutely love these brownies.  They are soo good.  I do not feel guilty when eating them, especially when I eat two or three at a time.

This are a little more expensive than regular mixes but they are fat free and taste GREAT!  They don't sell them where I live so I asked my mother, who lives outside of Chicago, to check the prices at her local grocer. Turns out these are about 50 cents cheaper per box at Amazon. I tried them with and without the egg white (egg white makes a more cake like texture) and they great either way.  Definitely worth the money.  I'm making a batch for Valentine's Day with some raspberry preserves on top.

column9: Can't believe how good these are!!
column10: These are so easy to make, and they taste great!!!  Just add fat free vanilla yogurt, mix and microwave for a single serving...top with fat-free Cool Whip or frozen yogurt.  Can double the single serving and still microwave for just a little longer for a larger "single" serving.  Would suggest measuring when making single servings since much of a variation in the ratio of mix:yogurt will change the consistency of the brownie.

If you're like me who is trying to watch her weight and craves chocolate 24/7 then you must try these brownies! All you need is 1 small container of vanilla yogurt. I buy organic yogurt to mix in.  The hardest part with these brownies is trying to control yourself from not eating the whole pan! I usually hate fat free stuff but these are just amazing! Try them!
Super easy to prepare-just mix in fat free vanilla yogurt & bake. Always awelcome treat. Great served warm with frozen yogurt.

Our family loves brownies and these are great. Not only are they healthier for you they taste good. We like to add nuts to them. I was making them with yogurt but have switches to unsweetened applesauce. just a little tip. They are hard to cut so we tried making them in a muffin pan it works great. you get 12 individual brownies. Just grease the pan add the batter then bake for 22 to 23 minutes. about 2 minutes after taking them out of the oven get a fork and gently nudge one corner to get them out of the pan, do this to each one.then let them cool. works great. I like mine moist so I put them in an airtight container while they are not totally cooled. Enjoy these great brownies!!!!

The brownies are awesome!!  I am going to try the other flavors asap!  Even if you don't like low-fat, fat-free stuff, try this..  The brownies are wonderful & super easy!  My hubby who hates anything that even looks low-fat LOVED these brownies!Happy Eating!

column9: really good and great shelf life
column10: I'd sure like to know what "Kevin's" wife did to his brownies. These brownies are really good and they remain moist for a couple of weeks in anair tight container although they only stayed uneaten that long once while I was away on vacation.

column4: Penny Pinching Polly "Check out my website fo...
column10: These were brought in for a potluck at work.  We weren't told they were fat free until after we had eaten them all!  They are delicious and do not taste fat free at all.  I tend to avoid fat free foods because they never taste as good as the "real" thing but these really do taste like brownies!  YUMMY  My 2 year old even loved them.

These are great - and not just because they are fat free brownies - but beacause the company  has tons of varying uses for them to be made into other things - like cookies and cake and still keep the fat out!  Can't live without them!

These brownies are so easy to make. Just add yogurt, mix and put in oven. They come out very moist, almost gooey. They taste pretty good too. I was pleasantly surprised and like to eat them. I add nuts and flax seed meal to make them even healthier. Enjoy!!!

column9: Tasty, but took hours to cook, wet inside
column10: I'm not sure why it took about two hours in the oven to get these brownies to finally finish cooking.  I used a pyrex baking bowl, at the correct temperature about 8x8 and they just seemed to stay drippy in the center.  I did used a greek style yogurt, not sure if that matters. Does anyone have any tips or know what I did wrong?The aroma and flavor is fantastic. You'll never miss the fat, but watch the calorie count - it's still pretty high. Don't fool yourself into eating the whole pan.I later tried much cheaper Duncan Hines and substituted pineapple (puree'd) for oil.  While not at tasty as 'No pudge' brand, it baked on schedule and tasted nice. Substituting pineapple seemed to give it a slightly more cake-like texture.

I saw this box on the shelf at the store and hesitated to buy for a while. Then one day, I was craving chocolate and remembered no pudge, so I gave them a try and really enjoyed them. These brownies are a great substitute for full fat ones. These taste rich and decadent and are easy to make. Plus the ingredients are plain and simple. I top it with lowfat ice cream for the perfect hot/cold treat. Remember, fat-free doesn't mean calorie free. Instead of 12 (120 calories) servings, I cut them into 9 squares for 160 calories each. They are rich enough that you don't need a giant serving. Try them, they will definately satisfy your chocolate cravings. I'm not someone on a diet or anything, I just like eating better and tasty versions of my fav foods.

column9: Moist and delicious, great for Weight Watchers
column10: If you're watching your weight or not, these brownies are very tasty.  They're gooey but taste wonderful and so easy to make.  Just stir in 1 container of yogurt and mix by hand.  If you are a Weight Watcher, they're just 2 points a square.

Based on the positive reviews I decided to purchase this fat-free brownie mix. As soon as the box arrived I made up a batch for the microwave. It smelled really good while cooking, but unfortunately I did not like the taste of these brownies. They were very bitter tasting to me. I am not a chocolate fanatic, so maybe that is why I did not like these.I am very grateful that Amazon bent the rules and refunded my money on this food item. I will be donating  the remaining 5 boxes to an area food bank.

column9: Beware: LOOK AT BEST BEFORE DATE BEFORE USING!
column10: I love the product, but the stock the Amazon sent me was about 8 months passed the best before date stamped on the box.Make sure that your product is fresh and safe for consumption by verifying the BEST BEFORE DATE!
When first out of the oven, they had the typical box mix taste and were so-so, but they became even worse the next day when they became rubbery.  Would not buy again.
I find it disturbing that this comes up in the GLUTEN FREE SELECTIONS!!!  THIS IS NOT GLUTEN FREE, OR EVEN WHEAT FREE!!

Here's a review by someone who is not fat, not on a diet, and who has not ruined his palate with fat free confections:These are the worst brownies I have ever tasted!  My wife bought this mix because it was the only one available at Trader Joe's when she shopped.  She didn't tell me they were fat free, but as soon as I tried one, I knew.  It had all the hallmarks of fat-free baked goods - gummy, flat, and the chocolate tasted like cocoa powder, not like rich fudgy chocolate.  I almost had to spit it out, it was that awful.And do you want to know why fat free foods taste so bad?  I'll let you in on a little secret:  the secret ingredient in good-tasting food is... you guessed it - FAT!!!!!  Fat and oil molecules transport the lovely taste of foods onto your taste buds.  So stop being so afraid of fat!  A little bit won't kill you!  Just exercise a little self-control and don't eat the entire box.  One properly made brownie is more satisfying than a whole plate of these vile things.So if you like real food that tastes good, don't believe the reviewers that raved about these brownies.  These people have a hidden agenda - they are trying to convince themselves that these little nuggets of evil actually taste good and are good for them.

column9: High quality salt at a bargain price
column10: coarse salt from an old supplier in Trapani, Sicily. This is 12 kilos of salt--yes 2.2 pound boxes, or more than 26 pounds. Works well in a grinder

I was expecting the pictured gift packaging.  This is a good price for sea salt, but I was hoping that it would come as shown in the illustration.  Am I being naive???  Would have been a nice little hostess gift as shown in the illustration!
The product is as advertised.  Tastes great with hot mustard and smoked swine!The curry is a little light but the seeds are fresh.  I will buy this product again.

column9: Very Decent Tuna - Polar All Natural Solid White Albacore from Amazon
column10: In April we purchased a case of the Polar All Natural Solid White Albacore Tuna in 12-Ounce Cans from Amazon.  Very nice quality, the wife, kids and grandkids all love it.  Jumped back and ordered another in the same month.  Great stuff!!

column9: Finally a treat my cats will eat!
column10: I didn't know these came in Salmon - we had been buying the Rabbit ones and all kitties unanimously loved them so I thought we'd try these ones - and again it was a clean sweep - everyone went crazy and meowed for more!  Best of all they are only one calorie - so my "catkids" don't get any fatter - LOL!  Natural Balance pet foods are our favorite!
Dried Carrot Slices, 2 oz.THIS IS A NICE PRODUCT, BUT I FEEL YOU SHOULD GET AT LEAST 1/2 MORE OF THE PRODCUT, IF NOT DOUBLE, FOR THE PRICE.LINDA

column9: too salty for a general purpose rub
column10: Maybe OK for a boston butt, but as a general purpose rub I find it too heavy on the salt. Admittedly, just how salty is "too salty" is a highly subjective thing, and some others obviously like this rub quite a lot. But looking at the nutrition info on the label, the sodium content in this rub is substantially higher than most other commercial rubs/seasons I've tried. So just be forewarned that if your salt preference is more on the conservative side, this may not be the product for you.

column9: Beware of the good reviews this is a very salty rub
column10: I bought this product due to all the good reviews.  I bbq using a weber smokey mountain often.  I usually make my own rubs.  I thought this might be a good product to keep on hand in case I didn't feel like making a rub.Most good bbq rubs have a base of salt and brown sugar.  This rub does not contain any sugar.  It is however very heavy on the salt.  I am used to using a large amount of rub when bbq to get a nice bark.  I made some ribs using this rub and they were so salty they were almost inedible.  I tasted the rub before hand and cut it with some brown sugar but clearly not enough.I have used this rub on other foods and had better results.  A little is very delicious on french fries or corn on the cob where I use this in place of salt.If you intend on using this rub heavily for low and slow cooking plan on cutting it heavily with brown sugar.  I prefer a salty spicy rub over an overly sweet rub but this is too much on its own.  I just wish they used more of the other ingrediantes and less salt as the spice is very tasty.If you plan on using this to spice up other foods in place of salt you may be very happy with this.

Funny name aside, this is a cook's dream.  I was introduced to it during a cooking class.  A chef mentioned that Butt Rub has many uses beyond barbecue.  It's a great flavor enhancer (no msg) to almost any meal.

I have tried all sorts of rubs and have found some good ones, but they come at a hefty price, this is by far the best rub for the price bar none. Also, I use it on every type of meat, chicken, pork, steak and seafood. It is the only dry rub I will use for steak!

column9: the best for big pieces of pork
column10: This is the best rub i have found or even made. No need to drive yourself crazy trying to perfect your own rub, they have done it for you.With butts and whole chickens/turkeys it is great. On ribs go very sparingly, it can overwhelm them! I also like to melt this in water/applejuice/vinegar/butter and inject it directly into the butts (10 to 12LBS typically). I like the keep the butts in the "shrinkwrap" they come in from BJ's overnite then put the rub on at least 4-6 hours prior letting the meat come up to room temp in a bag till it is soaked in then i add another sprinkling. I got a "pizza" shaker type metal shaker that makes the application easy and it works out great. I slow smoke often and 1 gallon of this lasts me right around a year but I use it for everything! Really is worth the money, you will not regret it, just go easy on the ribs as it is a bit salty ad full flavored.

I grill and barbeque a lot and use "rubs" that I make and a very few commercial products, mainly because most commercial rubs aren't all that good. Byron's, however is the real deal: since buying this stuff, I have used it on ribs, pork butt roast, steaks and turkey. It produces consistantly great results on grilled food, low & slow barbeque and even on oven roasted meats. It adds a nice zip to soups, salads and veggies too. I will be seasoning the Thanksgiving turkey with it at the request of my SO.I concur with the reviewer who urged potential customers to get the big size: it gets used up real fast!!
Learn about this Rub from one of the BBQ sites I visit. I've tried it on Tri-Tip and Chicken and the Family loved it. I will buy this again when I run out.

The only problem with this rub is that I thought I was getting the jar, not the large size container.This stuff is amazing. It's like everything that tastes good on charred, dead animal flesh got together and conspired to bring the world a delicious alternative to salt and BBQ Sauce. I strongly suggest liberally coating on chicken, pork, beef, and anything else you can get your hands one. I spilled some on eggs once. Those eggs came to life, fried themselves, found some bacon to pair up with, and plated themselves while pouring me a glass of delicious orange-mango-pineapple juice.I love this more than Penzey's seasoned sea salt, johnny's sea salt, penzey's barbecue dust, and puppies. If you knew how much I love puppies, this last sentence would cause you to gasp in amazement.

My girlfriend told me about this seasoning, and every since then, Curtains!  I Swear, I try to put this seasoning on Everything. Lol. This blend is simply AMAZING!!! I SOO Wish I could put more stars here for this. Because I definitely would.

My whole family loved this rub. We have used it on steak,chicken,ribs,brisket,in fact everything we have smoked or grilled. If you are looking for a great stand out rub that enhances every type of meat then buy this one. You won't be disappointed.

column9: Great on everything, low sugar for real BBQ
column10: I love this product,it's Dinosaur Cajun Foreplay and this for me! Equally good on chicken and pork, beef and fish. It is a bit salty because of the low suger levels, (so minimize burning) but that is what makes it good for real BBQ. It's still balanced enough to put on anything. Really really great rub, just buy the big one and never mind all the other $5 botttles of everything else! (except Dino, of course!!)
Bought this rub because of the great reviews.  Not bad just ok.  I like  "Bone Suckin Rub" much better.

I have watched hundreds of shows on BBQ,, I saw Bad byrons on one show and thought i'll give it a try !! sooooooooo tasty,, just the right amount of twang !Almost out,, will be ordering a bigger batch this time!

My husband and I use this on basically everything we throw on the grill or smoker. It's a good seasoning "go to" when you need something quick too. My husband is an avid BBQ eater, viewer, wanna be judge, and quite honestly, I prefer his creations over anything we've eaten at a restaurant. I digress from my review to give you that facet of our history in order to say other than a rub that we make to test, this is what we use now and for as long as we've had a grill. Usually the rubs we have made pass by the way side b/c we prefer this to anything else we've tried.
Awesome flavors!  I would definately grab the butt rub and put it on some big ole pork again.  I love that it's not so salty.
This is a great product.  Tastes wonderful on steak, prime rib, and chicken.  Give it a shot, I think you will enjoy it.

ok  I was real skeptical on trying anybodys rub but I kept seeing this name come up time and time again on the BBQ competitions I was seeing on TV. So I google it and got it. I went to my local grocery store first and got the little bottle but it went so fast I had to get a bigger one. What a difference it makes to have a solid rub you can use on anything you cook. I use BBBR on almost all of my meat. It's a great base to any real cooks rub. I use it along with some other ingrediants I normally use and it's the real deal !!. The name says it all, Byron is one Bad dude !! If you are thinking about trying a rub other than your own then start with this one. You won't be disaapointed.
good rub, great taste, a little salty but over all nice for presentation and ease of use, highly recommend to others to use this product as well.

I was sent a multipage e-mail from Amazon a couple of years ago on barbecue accessories,spices, sauces and rubs. That's when I first tried  Bad Byron's Butt Rub. It is the only seasoning I put on my steaks & chops now. My friends have noticed it when I have had them over for a barbecue. I've turned several of them onto it also. It's True , every thing goes better with a little Butt Rub.

A friend of mine gave me my first bottle and I was hooked. I take chicken tenders and stick a folk in they several times rub Byron's on the meat. Put these, I do 6 to a pack, in ziplock bags and wait 45 minted put on grill or mini kitchen grill Wow great
I Love It... I Have Been Using This Stuff For 3 Years And Ever Never Ever Had A Better Seasoning For Pork!!!Really Good On Grilled Pineapple Too!

column9: I use this stuff on any kind of meat!
column10: I had a friend bring me some of this from Alabama, she bought it because the picture was so funny!  I tried it on a ham, and HOLY COW!!  Now we use it on EVERY kind of meat, and talked her into breaking hers out and trying it, she loves it too.  We use it on roast, steaks, have used it on seafood, all kinds of things, LOVE THE FLAVOR!!!

I use this rub on everything including chicken, ribs, turkey and the obvious Pork shoulders. The seasonings come together to create a spicy bold flavor that just adds to the already present flavorful meat your are cooking. Great with sides also.
So far, used the rub on pork chops and it turned out great.  Can't wait until summer for BBQ ribs.
This stuff is great on everything.  This is the best spice blend I've used.  I even use it on weird stuff like mac & cheese and popcorn.

I bought this along with Pappy's and Stubb's rub to taste test them all. Overall Byron's was the best tasting/flavor. I like the smokiness of this rub on the skirt steak that we grilled. I went back for 2nds and 3rds. :) As with all rubs, there is a lot of salt. So you have to be careful how much you rub on. Overall the best tasting.. Very pleased.

I love Butt Rub! This is one thing we can't live without in the kitchen. We don't use it as a rub since we generally don't cook items such as barbecue but I use it as a seasoning. Goes on almost anything, pizza, eggs, French fries, salad, hummus, sandwiches, pork chops, steak and on! So much better than plain old season salt.

Butt Rub is by far one of the best rubs you can buy. I normally make my own dry rubs (especially for some things like ribs and pork butt) but this stuff is delicious! It has the perfect amount of twang. I've tried tried it on steaks, burgers, pork chops, country style ribs, etc. and all with great results. But I find it is especially fantastic on grilled chicken and is almost the only thing I season my chicken with now. For those that say it is too salty, this is not a sweet rub nor is it meant to be, and there is a such thing as using too much!  Don't listen to them though, buy some and you definitely will not be disappointed!
We've been using this on almost everything we cook. It was so good that I started sharing samples with friends. Now, I'm running low. I should try to get some samples from my friends...LOL!!

I never write reviews, but I felt this product warranted one.  I was introduced to this product when I purchased a Big Green Egg at a store in Cape Cod.  It is great on anything and everything.  It makes a wonderful rub on pork loin and ribs and I have used it to spice up my chili and chicken soup.  It is so delicious and a staple in my kitchen.

column9: great on more than just meat!
column10: I recently began a diet and was looking for something to spice up hard-boiled eggs, raw vegies, and plain baked potatos.  This rub adds a nice flavor and heat without the calories. The service was impeccable. I ordered this product on a Friday and it was delivered and on my front porch the following Monday!

I was watching a food network cook-off, and one of the teams was called "[...]" and I just had to type it in and see what came up. Luckily, it was this delectable spice mix and not something funny :)Butt Rub is awesome on just about anything! If you go on the actual website, you can see the never ending list of possible culinary creations. Its awesome on meat, but also on texas toast (mix with honey, butter, and grated parmesan cheese, spread on the bread and toast in the oven), deviled eggs, homemade fries(or even the kind from the freezer)... there are tons of ideas to put it to good use!I recommend getting the big jar, we already ran out which is why I'm on this page tonight. And just in time for fathers day! It makes a great gift for a Dad that loves to bbq.

The main ingredient of this rub must be salt, because it overpowers everything else in it.  It pretty much ruined some perfectly good ribs I bar-b-qued, and I certainly won't be using it again.  I recommend Corky's dry rub instead of this.

column9: Easy as Pie, Almost as Tasty
column10: This Risotto is a good as you'll get in any restaurant and its very easy to make.  All the flavors are great.  Our supermarket chain stopped carrying the product (don't have any idea why).  So now I get it on Amazon.  Same stuff, same great taste.  Cooks up in about 21 minutes.  Simple directions.  No constant attention.  Enjoy!Shipping was fast and easy.  Don't be concerned that you have to buy a six pack.  It's a dry good so it keeps for a long time, but it'll be gone before you know it.

Love this stuff although it feels like cheating since it requires NO attention whatsoever.  Fastidious friend who is from Milan swears by it.  The chemicals are mildly disturbing, but it is so easy...and we're going to die from something...  OK, that's a huge rationalization but it is quick and easy and tasty and with two teenage boys in the house, I can produce a decent dinner in under 30 minutes - without Rachel Ray's annoying voice in my head.

column9: Brie like God intended it to be
column10: East of Paris is Meaux and environs.  This is the ancient home of true brie.  This is one of the two or three best.  It is not expensive, even when you add another third for shipping.  This is a big six pounder wheel.  You are paying for proper storage.  You can even cut it in quarters and freeze three for up to six months if you wrap tightly in a double freezer wrap paper.  Stored properly, this cool ripening takes two months to fully develop.  Muscular, but never sharp, this 45% minimum FBD (yep, FAT) will make you forget all others.  Serve with sauterne to be completely debauched.  Otherwise a chalky, flinty white will be proper.  Hang the box when you are done.

column9: Definitely has helped!  Best price is here at Amazon!
column10: An Update 6/29/2011:  We like this product enough that we are placing another order for 5 packages.  Of course this product cannot cure our dog, but because of this product, he acts like he is not hurting so much and we have put off the surgery.  We still haven't found a better price than that offered on Amazon.Original review 1/15/2011:  Our 9 pound schnauzer started limping, then his hind leg started collapsing inward at the knee. Our vet took x-rays which showed--in layman's terms--knee joint problems on both hind legs.  He said it was caused by "genetics".  We love this dog so much, but corrective surgery is in the thousands (per knee).  While we decide on a future course-of-action, our vet prescribed anti-inflammitory pills and Glyco-Flex III Mini Bite-Sized Chews.  Our dog loves these chews.  We tell him to come and get a "treat"--and he believes that it is and comes running.  Yes, running.  He is no longer taking the anti-inflammatory medication, but continues with the chews.  At the moment, his leg is no longer collapsing, but we can tell that the knee with the biggest problem is still painful and stiff--but not like it was just weeks ago.  This stuff will not solve our dog's problem, but it sure seems to have helped.  We are going to continue buying these chews for our dog--and if you do some comparative shopping, you will find that Amazon's price is almost half of what you'll see elsewhere.
I have been purchasing this product for over one year, you can count on the best price plus fast reliable service.

I am very pleased with this product. My dog is 17 years old and was getting a bit stiff in her joints. I was looking for something that would help her flexibility. I think these chews are helping her. She doesn't seem to be as stiff as she was before. I worried that I may have trouble getting her to take them. But, she actually looks forward to getting them just as though they are a treat. I will buy this product again. I do recommend it to anyone.
These have helped my older dog with stiffness in her hind legs and they are a good treat that she loves and that are good for her, too.

My 2 month puppy had a weak cartilage and I was adviced to give her this product in a week her ear when up thta was amazing. People did not want to buy her because they thought it was a defect and now her cartilage is not weak it is better and I have so mnay people interested in my puppy.Thanks wonderful product for weak cartilage..

My little girl jammed her shoulder and her physical therapist recommended this.  She loves the little medicated treats.  As a human, they really smell awful but it does not matter to the dogs.  I only give it a 4 rating because it is a bit pricey.

I have heard that this product is excellent for maintaining or improving canine joints.  My dog who loves all other treats would not eat this chew. I even ground it up and put it in his food and he rejected it. He even rejected it when I put it in cheese.  My sensitive nose does not detect any smell, but apparently the perlin (an ingredient) has a strong scent to dogs. At any rate, I learned that for some reason , dogs who reject the chews like the tablets and vice versa. The tablets are chewable and  have the same ingredients, but, oddly enough, the PROPORTIONS  are completely different.  I have not tried the tablets yet. Although the chews are guaranteed, the seller refused to take the product back, until I involved Amazon :)I cannot rate its effectiveness since my dog did not like it. In terms of flavor, I guess it receives  a poor rating!PS I was forced to give a rating in order to print this review
Very hot. not for the weak mouth. There is not wuch vineger so it has it's own unique taste.
This is the best basic habanero sauce I've tried with a nice flavor and a lot of heat. 2nd only to Tabasco Habanero sauce but that is a jamacian sause and this is a more vanilla flavor.

Green chili sauces tend to be milder than their red companions, and this "Castillo Salsa Habanera - Green" is no exception.  It has a nice, tiny little kick to it, but it is mild enough that I could just pour it straight into my mouth.So, unless you don't have much tolerance for heat, you are buying this for the flavor, not the spice. And this does have a nice flavor.  It is a good blend of habanera, garlic, and some other spices, without being too vinegary or overpowering.  We had some fajitas for breakfast this morning, and this Castillo Salsa was poured quite liberally over them.  Delicious.It isn't quite as good as my favorite green salsa,Blair's Jalapeno Death Sauce with Tequila , but a bottle of this Castillo sauce can usually be found in my kitchen.

I love this stuff.  Started a low carb diet and was looking for a better sweetner that didn't upset my stomach/gi tract.  This is really great and the flavors are terrific.  Made myself a cream soda with a little bit of club soda, a few drops of vanilla cream and a few drops of valencia orange!  Highly recommend to try out sweetleaf sweeteners!!

I'm on the HCG diet and these drops are great! I use them daily in my tea but one of my favorite things to do is use the orange flavored ones on a half of a grapefruit, I feel like I'm eating a real treat! They do not taste as sweet as Splenda, but they are a lot better for you!

column9: One of my favorite finds ever!
column10: I love that I came across this little travel sized variety pack.  I'm a big Stevia user and buy the SweetLeaf flavors in regular sized bottles.  I wanted to be able to carry some with me in my purse for on the go.  I purchased this and just love it!  The flavors are all great!  I use the chocolate raspberry the least (although my husband likes that one) and the vanilla cream the most.  What's even better is that the bottles are refillable!
Works great in recipes. But I tried them in my coffee and it has a bit of a funny artificial taste. Will buy some flavours in the large size to continue to bake with.

When I made this purchase it was under the suggestion of others. I was a bit hesitant, as I had not heard of stevia - liquid or otherwise. I am so pleasantly pleased with how little you have to use for sweetness and flavoring. I have used in coffee, tea, on fruits and in plain water. AMAZING!
I love these flavors and use them in everything from my coffee to vodka and soda water and deserts as well. It's nice to have a variety!

"SweetLeaf Liquid Stevia Flavors Tin"  indicates to me that the flavor containers would have a storage tin, however they come with only a cardboard container.  The individal flavor containers are plastic bottles.  For the price, I expected a tin storage continer for ease of carrying the flavor containers in my purse. The flavors taste great, but the description of what is being sold is extremely disappointing.

column9: Love the vanilla, wanted to try different flavors...
column10: First, I definitely should have paid more attention to the size, because these are tiny, and for the price, I assumed I'd have more product, but never mind that, it was my mistake, I should have paid more attention.  On to the flavor.  I have been a fan of the vanilla for a year or so, and figured I'd give the rest a try... I was a little disappointed.  I mix these with plain water or sparkling water, so maybe for a different use, they would be good.  I felt like I had to add so much to catch the actual flavor of the chocolate raspberry, lemon, and orange, that it was waaaaay too sweet.  I'll just stick to vanilla cream from no on
these have the best flavor, can use in water coffe or tea, love it... a must try...will buy again need to try it...

I'm on a no-sugar diet right now and this stuff is a life saver.  I add about 10 drops to a bottle of water and it gives me the sweetness I need.  No bitter taste here.  Love that I was able to try out 4 flavors at once.

I really love all the different flavors, however, I have found that the Stevia liquid is only good if you use just a few drops in your cold beverages, for example, I add the Chcolate Rasberry to my sugar- free, morning protein shakes, and they taste wonderful. But for my loose leaf teas, I use the powder packets.
Small enough to carry in my purse, and a great addition to seltzer or soda water so I can avoid artificial sweeteners when I am out and want something to drink. Great stuff!

I can not taste any flavoring in these, I put many drops into the water, increasing by increments and all it did was make the water sweet, there is no flavor here. I don't understand how others have tasted any flavoring at all because I sure didn't, I so wanted something all natural that would taste good but this is just drinking sugar water so now I have to find something to add some flavor to the water. These work well with tea, since there is no real flavor here you taste the tea and it makes it sweet enough.
kombucha is a non alcoholic fermented drink that will help support a healthy digestion process and immune system if drank on a regular basis. It is not a miracle cure, but it is tasty.

Nothing fancy, just good stuff.  I drink Kombucha for digestion support and this really helps with that.  It also has a nice mild taste and isn't too sweet.  To me it tastes a little like flavored beer and I would compare it to High Country Kombucha as far as that is concerned.  But I like it very much.  Each bottles also lasts for few days so for me they are totally worth the price.

If your looking for a miracle from anything, your sadly disillusioned. This drink and the hot tea form may "help" symtomatic ailments. However, your diet and life style certainly has adverse effects on any product you think is a cure all. Don't blame the products, take a look at your health habits before engaging in a "miracle cure."

column9: I can now type without thinking
column10: Before I used this product it hurt to type, not physicly but mentaly. I worried was I good enough to type? After drinking Kombucha for one week  I feel nothing, I am now mentaly pain free. I use to think twice about offering up my review on a product. With Kombucha in my belly I type away on reviews feeling no pain, in fact I feel nothing in my head.Thank you Kombucha!

I HAVE BOUGHT THREE BOTTLES OF THIS PRODUCT. I HAVE NOT FELT ANY BETTER; MOST OF THE TIME, I HAVE FELT MUCH WORSE. I WAS UNDER THE IMPRESSION THAT THIS PRODUCT WOULD CURE ME OF HEMORRHOIDS. IT DID NOT. I AM FRANKLY SICK AND TIRED OF THESE OVERPRICED PRODUCTS THAT CLAIM TO BE CURE-ALLS OR SOME KIND OF MAGIC BULLET. I WISH I COULD GIVE THIS PRODUCT ZERO STARS, BUT UNFORTUNATELY, THIS RATINGS SYSTEM DOES NOT GO THAT LOW. IN CLOSING, SAVE YOUR HARD EARNED MONEY, AND DO NOT WASTE IT ON A PRODUCT THAT SIMPLY DOES NOT WORK.

I normally get this tea at Teavana stores in the mall or their website, so was excited to see it on Amazon (as I have tons of gift cards here). It seemed to take a little longer then other products to arrive but came in great shape and came with a free sample just like my other orders from the Teavana site have (which makes sense since they're partnered with Amazon). I drink the White Ayurvedic Chai with the  Samurai Chai Mate and they taste fantastic together. They're supposed to be full of caffeine but for me they're my anytime tea. I have to steep a little longer then recommended time as I like my tea strong (with a bit of sugar or honey :) but it tastes great. Not to sickly sweet like some fruity teas.It is sweeter then some of their other teas, so if you don't like sweet then you may want to try out some of their others. I recommend going into the stores and sampling their array of teas they usually have set out to find your favorite. The blend they normally have of this one is good but not always what comes out at home though so don't just go by that one. They use German rock sugar (which they sell) and that costs a little more. Most people will use normal table sugar, honey, or artificial sweetener which will affect the tastes. Anyway, go try the tea, find your tea and drink happy.
Fresh, spicy and complex.  This is a great white tea that doesn't offset color with taste.
This is a sweet tasting and delicious tea. It has dried fruit and seems to have some sugar. If it does have sugar, it is not calorie free. It is very tasty and makes a good iced tea also.

See my review on the Samurai Chai Mate. The two combined is fabulous.One more thing -- we have found that you can use the loose leaves (we just leave them in the tea basket) for several cups of tea with the same effect. So while it's a pit pricey, it's well worth it, particularly if you reuse the leaves.
Great Tea, arrived on time, and in air tight tea package to preserve flavor. Also mixes well with other tea.

I tried this tea in the mall at the Teavana store and it is AMAZING! And that's coming from someone who doesn't normally like tea. I loved it so much I had to buy it, I don't regret buying it in the slightest. It's delicious!

Got this for my sister for Christmas... we both loved it -- in fact we made it by the pot and by the time I was leaving after staying with her for Christmas, it was GONE!  Will be ordering more to send to her.

When I bought the infuser, I need loose tea to go with it. So I tried the White Ayurvedic Chai Tea.  Love it!  I've gone back for more and tried others.  Just got my shipment Friday and haven't tried them all yet!

If you're not from Minnesota you might not know what Caribou Coffee is; quite simply it is some of the best coffee on the market.  It has a delicious smokiness to it that is not overpowering and does not taste burnt like Starbucks.  Coffee is not supposed to taste burnt!  The Caribou Blend is their "middle" roast that has made them what they are and is very well balanced.  It has an amazing flavor and is easy on the stomach too, as I personally have difficulty with some coffee roasts and digestion.
Everything I have ever tasted at a Caribou is a step above the competition. The bagged coffee is the same. The Caribou Blend is a balanced and satisfying coffee.

I am looking for a good tasting coffee that can also kick my day off in the morning. This coffee tastes OK but leaves me sleepy still after two cups plus an acid burning sensation in my stomach. There is nothing very impressive about this coffee to me, all the bitterness and sourness are there and mild coffee taste in there. Disappointed.

Caribou Coffee is a rarity in NY/NJ area. I have been missing it since I left Minneapolis about 6 years back but now I can get it on Amazon. The price is great and the coffee always arrives fresh. Just love it!!!!
This is such a great coffee! There is a slight chocolate aftertaste that is to die for!  Wish it was easier to find....just glad that Amazon has it!

I have tried many different kinds of coffee beans - including freshly roasted at a coffee shop owned by my family - and there is something special about this blend.  Makes my mouth water just thinking about it!

I'm all about good coffee. I try different kinds from time to time, but I always return to Caribou. My local grocery store will only carry the ground blend, so I have to rely on Amazon or drive 2 hours for the good stuff. The price is right and I appreciate the prime shipping every 20 days or so.

Unexpectedly good bang for the buck: who would think that they understand coffee in Minnesota, somewhat far from the growing regions (ok, Seattle too).Hard to say much about good balanced product: rich, but not burned or bitter, easy on the stomach,has caffeine, reminds Starbucks Breakfast Mild, will buy again.

The Caribou Coffee, Caribou Blend is probably the best coffee I have ever had, and better yet I can brew it at home. The taste is smooth and flavorful. I drink it black or sometimes with coffee creamers that make it taste like something you might pay $4 or $5 per cup at retail.

This coffee is dreamy. I just recently started drinking coffee and I started with Eight O'Clock Colombian. It was ok, but it had a very watery taste to it. Just tried this and I have to say the flavor blows the other away! Give it a try and I'm sure you'll agree. BTW, I am using the Aerobie AeroPress Coffee and Espresso Maker to make my coffee and I highly recommend it also.

In Texas, you can't get this unless you have a Keruig single brew machine.  When I go to Minnesota to visit family I load up my suitcase with Caribou coffee. I was so excited to see Amazon sells it for a great price.  Excellent coffee and great flavor.  My husband who never had Caribou until he meet me now loves this coffee!  I highly recommend it!
Caribou Coffee is a rarity on the west side of the country so I love being able to buy from Amazon.  The price is great and the coffee always arrives fresh.
Tastes delicous.  Worth the extra penny.  I'm a big Dunkin Fan, but this is a step above.  Its kind of in the middle of Dunkin and Starbucks.  Not too weak, but not too strong.
I found this to be bland and lacking of flavor. If you like weak, mild coffee this one might be for you. Just didn't do it for me.

column9: Coffee is OK but the Company itself-Terrible
column10: My work colleagues and I have had a couple of bizarrely negative and expensive experiences at local Caribou Coffee shops.We were blown off by store management so we attempted to convey our concerns with Caribou's corporate customer service.Try calling that number and speaking to a live person.  Ha.  Try calling the corporate office and speaking to a live person. Ha.  It ain't gonna happen. After 3 weeks of periodic calling and only getting voice mail on both lines, leaving messages with never getting a call back, it is evident that the customer service department and the corporate receptionist, if they even have one, at Caribou Coffee hide behind their phones.It is a myopic company which disregards that time honored adage that, "if word of mouth is the best advertising, it can also be the worst..."

column9: Great taste, great sauce... just needs a tad more heat!
column10: For starters, the bottle is made of thick & heavy glass which is very durable to take with you when on the go. The taste is very good, and tastes pretty much as you would expect it to. My only wish is that it would have been a bit hotter. Its heat is very very mild (IMO), which surprised me considering the ingredients do in fact list Jalapenos and Habaneros. Other than that, its well worth the money!
Just like they made it back home. Help!  I am hooked....  I finally found what I was looking for for a while

I think of all the Carr's crackers, the poppy and sesame are the best. Watch out, they're addicting, you can munch on them as if they're potato chips.  I love these with my nut butters, cheese, you name it.
