There's a suble creama left in the glass like an espresso would have, but lacking any grittiness.This drink defintely provides a jolt of 155 mg of caffeine for those on the run.  Its contents contain coffee, sugar, potassium bicarbonate, and potassium citrate.  Each small can has around 50 calories.I prefer a coffee drink with a slightly less bitter taste.  But for someone who needs a fast caffeine fix, this should fit the bill.
We I saw this online i had to get it. the taste is just right not to sweet or bitter. the only thing better then this is to go to a illy barista in the morning.

Wow, this stuff is strong.  If you like a strong tasting coffee drink you'll love this.  I tend to like them a little more sweet, but this was drinkable even for me.  If you try it I hope you like it.

I really wanted to like this product but the coffee tasted "thin" and there was a funny, somewhat sour aftertaste.  The coffee is lightly sweetened, which is fine, but other than that it was not a pleasant drink.  I do like Starbucks shelf-stable bottled drinks, so it's not that I don't like this type of product in general, I just didn't like this one.  I will not be buying this in the future.

This is very different than any coffee drink I have had, it is more like soda/coffee.  I chilled mine, and did like it, there is a little soda "fizz" but not much and the coffee flavor is very good and robust.  I didn't find it overly sweet like the other reviewers.  I didn't love this drink, but did like it okay.

column9: Taste is such a subjective thing...
column10: I hate to write a not-so-good review of a product since it's based purely on taste ... which is such a relative thing.Anyhow, I personally prefer my coffee to be sweetened, and this drink wasn't sweet enough for my taste.  Since it's in a can and I drank it on-the-go, I dind't have the opportunity to pour into a glass and sweeten it some more (and who really pours this sort of drink out of the can anyhow?).Now the good stuff ... The portion size was great and would be easy to double stack in most fridges.  The coffee didn't have an artificial flavor and was actually quite good.  I shared a sip with a friend and she liked it very much (again, back to taste being such a subjective thing).Enjoy!

column9: An "Energy Beverage" canned by Coca Cola - It's not good
column10: I have come to expect Illy coffee to symbolize good and consistent quality. I do prefer other brands of espresso, but Illy's consistency is great since it is to be found in many restaurants around the globe.So it is with some sadness that I write a negative review. First off - please note that this is actually a coffee flavored energy beverage made and packaged by Coca Cola. Illy has partnered in order to take proceeds by allowing their name to be used. There might be a some of their coffee used, but it would be processed coffee extract, and so there wouldn't be much reason to use expensive Arabica coffee when extract from lower quality Robusto would work.This canned beverage seems to taste pleasant enough at first, but then it starts to turn metallic. The coffee flavor really is a 'coffee flavor'. There is just something artificial and chemical tasting about this drink. Granted, it's only 45 calories, most coming from the beet extract sweetener.  And don't be fooled by beet sweetener, it's really no different than any other unbleached sugar.  It is regularly used to Chaptalize wine in fact.  Don't be lured in by the low calorie claim: fresh brewed iced coffee without sweetener? Zero calories. Yes. Zero. (okay, actually 0.01 calories! sorry!) So it's not like they're really doing anything crazy by offering this at 45 calories.  It's just less sugar added than the super sweet beverages.  Really it seems the sweetener was added to try and mask the artificial and metallic flavor.There are better iced coffees on the market.  I hope we really start to see some more variety and availability soon.  Other countries like Japan have a huge market for bottled and canned unsweetened tea and coffee, so hopefully we can get on the bandwagon soon.  Hopefully with better tasting results.

column9: What is this product supposed to be?
column10: I do not buy coffee because I need a burst of energy or alertness because caffeine does not have a significant effect upon me.  I buy coffee because I like coffee and the stronger, bolder tasting coffees appeal to me the most.  I also do not appreciate coffees that derive their stronger flavor by over burning the beans during roasting.  I like strong coffees that get their stronger taste from significantly lower water content during brewing.  All other things being equal, this high coffee to water ratio gives a fuller flavor, but at a higher cost.  If money were an issue, I would rather have fewer cups of fuller tasting coffee than many more cups of weaker, less full bodied coffee.  This Illy Italian style espresso meets none of the requirements of a good cup of coffee except that it is made from Arabica beans which tend to be less acidic, smoother and fuller bodied.  However, there are some Arabica beans that are better than others and Arabica beans are no guarantee of a good cup of coffee. I would only drink this coffee under conditions of extreme thirst.  I believe this can of espresso "tasting" coffee compromises on so many elements of good tasting coffee such that I would not want to drink it again.  First, the espresso is weak and it probably derives whatever taste it has by over burning the beans at roasting giving it a bitter taste as opposed to a bold taste.  I know that burning the beans somewhat gives espresso its flavor by releasing more oil from the beans which allows for a frothier and smoother coffee when brewed at higher pressures.  This Illy espresso did release some additional oil, but the taste was not bold because too little coffee was used in brewing.  This does not make Italian style espresso, it makes a weak espresso with a hint of burned coffee beans that I doubt that espresso drinkers will find appealing.  Also, this espresso style coffee has a taste that cannot be described as coffee-like.  If anything it has a chemical like bitter taste that is almost sweet.  Overall, it leaves a bitter and unidentifiable taste.  Perhaps some of the metallic taste from the can has impacted the taste of the coffee.I do not know what this product attempts to be because of all of the compromises concerning its taste, its strength, its name, its market and its price, most of which seem to be contradictory.  I think Illy needs to go back to the drawing board to list what qualities they are trying to produce and see if that is possible in the market.  Otherwise they seem to have met none and made a product that I believe satisfies few.Lastly, the qualities of coffee are varied and thus a matter of personal preference.  I have noticed that those who do not really appreciate a good cup of coffee tend to classify coffee into two categories that are sufficient for them.  Those categories simply classify coffee into those that are weak or strong, modified by too weak or too strong.  I suspect that these adjectives are sufficient for a majority and tend to simplify life by not seeking the cup of coffee that is just right.  Of course, such people would use time saved on the search for truly satisfying coffee by substituting wine for coffee or colors of paint on their walls.  It seems that everyone has their specialty product of which they are aficionados.  For kids it might be cereal for blue collar workers it may be beer.  It makes one wonder if writing a review has already been done on a non-published basis for virtually all products where a choice exists.  To summarize, I don't like Illy espresso drink but I do like a fresh Guinness Draft even though I am retired.

I drink my coffee in much the same way a 12 year old probably would...very light and very sweet. I found this coffee drink to be extremely bitter and not nearly sweet enough. I noticed some people here saying this was too sweet, but I just did NOT find that to be the case. It also left a very strong and not-so-pleasant after taste. If you like your coffee strong and black, then you'll probably really like this. However if you're a cream and sugar kinda person, this will most likely be too bitter for you.

I made the mistake of taking my first sip of this coffee after tasting something sweet. It's bitter! But tasting it later I came to appreciate the flavor.Unlike a lot of canned/bottled coffee drinks, to me this tasted like real coffee. Nice and strong, not too sweet. If you put a lot of sweet-and-white in your coffee, you will find this drink unbearably bitter, in that case I recommend the Cappucino version of the same brand.Nutrition facts: 50 calories in the can, 20mg sodium, 12 carbs (10g sugars, 1g fiber) -- which isn't bad. Caffeine content is 155 mg in the 6.8 fl oz. The ingredients list coffee, sugar, potassium bicarbonate, and potassium citrate. No milk, which is healthier, and I prefer that because I'm lactose intolerant. It also means it lasts longer -- the best-by date on my sample can is Sept. '12 (received April).The can lists this nice coffee as a Product of Denmark. I've tasted coffee in Denmark, and I can't dispute that, though I can tell you this method is a whole lot cheaper.I drank it cold and I really enjoyed this coffee. I would really like to get more... but it is a bit pricy. If you are on the go a lot this is an easy solution.

illy cafe is the original portable coffee drink. It is plain coffee without milk, cream, or any sweetener. It's It may therefore, be more to the liking of coffee purists. illy drinks are available only in the cans (not in glass). While I might prefer glass, these cans are the only option for illy. They are available in 12 packs through Amazon. With a larger order you can get them with no charge for shipping making for a competitive price. They do not need to be refrigerated at all. However, they do taste better if refrigerated prior to consumption.

column9: A little sweet, a little bitter, very good going down
column10: At just 50 calories in a 6.8 ounce can, it seems almost impossible that the drink should be this good. At once slightly sweet with the bitter tinge of a good cup of coffee, illy issimo rivals the Starbucks' espresso shots for quality quick canned coffee drinks. Aftertaste is minimal is the drink has a good color and consistency (not too watery and not too syrupy).

This Illy Caffe coffee tastes a lot like a Starbucks dark roast with way too much sugar. It is much sweeter than I would normally drink coffee, but with small sips, it was quite enjoyable. 6.8 oz is the right size, because I couldn't take much more of the sweetness.Despite all that extra sweetness, you can't miss the deep, rich, bold Illy-quality coffee. If you like dark coffees, it might be worth a try for you.I would have given it 3 stars due to too much sugar, but the coffee taste is worth 5 stars.

column9: not too bad for a can
column10: Even though I hate sugar in any coffee beverage, this is pretty good. At 45 calories a can, there are probably 3 teaspoons of sugar. That's kinda hefty, but it doesn't taste that sweet. While it has a pretty strong flavor, it certainly doesn't have the robust, fresh ground flavor one may expect from Illy. And, it tastes like it's been sitting in a can, because it has. Maybe  they'll ship in glass and solve the metal aftertaste issue?

This coffee drink has a much stronger coffee taste than most -- and I like that.  I don't drink a lot of coffee products, but when I do I want something that is definitely coffee and not a confusing combination of flavors and sweeteners.  In addition to the strong coffee taste, there is a hint of bitterness but it's not unpleasant.  This is not a beverage I would drink daily -- I think it would lose some of its excitement and get a bit boring -- but it's nice to have a few cans in the refrigerator.  By the way, I tried heating a serving... don't bother, this drink is absolutely at its best served well chilled.

This illy issimo coffee drink is a nice pick me up during the day. Has a delicious coffee taste with just the right amount of sweet added. Drink it straight out of the can or in a cup, cold or hot, convenient size.

My husband and I thought the coffee had a nice flavor, but my brother thought it tasted like the can. It was better served in a glass over ice, and we will probably buy it again, especially since the price went down.

illy issimo Coffee Drink, Caffè, 6.8-Ounce Can"Have known the evenings, mornings, afternoons,I have measured out my life with coffee spoons." --T.S. EliotI've always wondered what a canned coffee might taste like, so decided to "break out of the mold", so to speak, and try illy issimo Coffee Drink, Caffè!Love it! :)rich, velvety, color -- no cloudinessvery smooth tasteslightly sweetno bitter aftertasteno coffee sediment to deal with -- which means no wastetake almost anywhere, drink straight from can or pour into favorite glassware, kind of convenience1 can of illy issimo Coffee Drink, Caffè, 6.8-Ounce Cans packs a big punch, so to speak, 155 milligrams of caffeine45 tiny caloriesNo preservatives -- a "plus", imo0 grams of fat -- 'nuf said. :)Does this sound like what you may be looking for? :) You might also like to try illy issimo, Cappuccino Coffee Drink!  off to buy a couple of cases! Highly Recommended!  --Katharena Eiermann, 2012
I'm not a super fan of iced-coffee but I did try this after having refrigerated it. I liked it. It didn't have too bitter a flavor and it wasn't truly sweetened. I'd try it again in the future.

column9: Very Good for this Non-Coffee Drinker!
column10: I will say up front, I am not a coffee drinker. I do like iced coffees but rarely. Compared with the Starbucks bottled Frappacinos, I would say this coffee drink rivaled them. It was delicious and just the right size. It gave a good jolt of energy but I must say I like the fact it was 45 calories. That's a whole lot less than the bottled Starbucks! No preservatives and low calorie plus delicious! Great combo in my opinion!

column4: Marshall Carter "Ornery Gamer, Fiend Club Member"
column9: Not very good...had that stale coffee taste.
column10: I drink a good bit of coffee, most of it iced, so I was expecting something decent with the illy issimo Coffee drink. To my dismay, I didn't like it...at all. It's basically an iced, sweetened coffee drink around espresso strength. The drink had that stale, "I've been sitting for a while" coffee taste that is best poured down a drain. The sweetness is about right (not cloying or overpowering) and it definitely tastes like espresso, but it just doesn't taste like fresh brewed (maybe yesterday). I know it comes in a can and technically can't be fresh, but I've tasted similar coffee drinks that didn't have that stale, skunky taste. It gets two stars for giving a decent energy/caffeine boost, but the taste makes it impossible to recommend.

It surprised me how tasty this drink actually is for being a canned coffee. It was actually really delicious!  This is especially handy to have on a road trip.  The coffee pots in motel rooms are shown to be anything but sanitary as one can imagine...it's not as though they have a dishwasher on that maid cart and sanitize those things.  That said, I'm not one to go without my morning coffee either and I hardly feel like driving around looking for a Starbucks in the morning (or even wanting to spend that on coffee if I found one.)Not that this couldn't be used for a daily coffee fix at home, but it's especially handy for the road; rather that be the road to work for easy car sipping, or--especially--the long road away from your home brewer.It's good to have a pack on hand for me for that reason alone.  While I'm happy with my home coffee, this adds a nice twist to change things up or to keep your caffeine buzz away from home as well.

This coffee is really great cold--like an iced espresso. We don't have an ice machine at work, but do have a fridge. This makes a nice alternative for a morning break. It's also nice poured over ice with a dash of creamer or evaporated milk, which has a lot less calories and sugar than a frozen coffee shop drink and is just as refreshing.

column9: Refreshing way to get a coffee jolt in the summer
column10: I love my coffee in the morning and often enjoy a cup in the afternoon too, but it makes me hot so in summer doesn't feel as good.  That's where the Illy Issimo Coffee Drink comes in.  I get that coffee taste but it is cold and refreshing rather than just making me feel hotter.  It has a little sugar but is not too sweet.  Will buy it again.

Delicious!  While I normally like a flavor with my coffee, i.e. chocolate, I found the coffee flavor to be agreeable.  I've tried many brands of canned/bottled coffee drinks, and this one was very good.  This drink is a wonderful afternoon pick me up.  Per the instructions, I did not shake the can.  I would recommend this drink to any iced coffee drinker.

column9: ONLY if you LOVE STRONG COFFEE!!
column10: This coffee drink is so strong that it dried up all the spit in my mouth for a week.  Not really, but you get the idea.  My daughter happily took it from me and finished it off and thinks it was amazing.  Of course, she really likes Starbucks too.  So, if you love expresso and strong coffee, this IS your drink.  If you are a coffee wimp like me though, look for a lightly flavored cappucino instead!

column9: It Was Just OK and Not Very Special
column10: I really like coffee, but overall I would rate this as "okay" tasting - it is very strong, and has a bit of a bite in the flavoring that made me get a piece of gum to get the taste out of my mouth.  After a couple of sips, I was done and would rate it a 3 out of 5 stars.I opened this can up in the office, and passed around small sampler cups to my co-workers to get their thoughts as I work with several coffee connoisseurs.  Three women and one man said they thought it was good, and the three women would rate it a 4 on a 5 scale while the man said he would rate it a 3..Another man who typically buys and enjoys the Starbucks canned beverages said he would rate it a 3 out of 5 stars.Including myself, none of the test subjects hated it but everyone said the same thing - while they thought it was good, none of them believed it was "good enough" to make them want to go out and purchase some.  When I asked why, they had the same impression I had in that the coffee place downstairs was better none of us were really compelled to add this to our regular routines and shopping lists.One thing to note is there is a lot of sugar in this 6.4 ounce can: 10g!  The sugar and the caffeine combined should give you a little kick in the afternoon if that is what you are seeking.

This Illy Issimo coffee drink has explosive coffee flavor. You really have to love coffee to drink it. That being said, I love coffee. This was great when served cold. The caffeine buzz was tremendous, which personally I could live without, but coffee drinkers will love that.This is a better choice for an energy drink than those soda-based poisons.

I was bracing for this can of illy issimo coffee to contain a less-than-pleasant coffee experience, with a not-so-fresh, and overpoweringly strong-tasting coffee drink.I was wrong.The coffee contained within my little can had great, pure coffee flavor, with no "can taste". It wasn't overly sweet to me (although I DO like my coffee REALLY sweet. Like, "melted coffee ice cream" sweet...), and I was surprised to see that it looked to be just pure, brewed coffee - no cream added. I tend to brew my coffee pretty strong. Being a "single cup a day to wake me up first thing" kinda girl, I have a tendency to think that my daily cuppa Joe has to be beat-you-about-the-head powerful, and, recent changes in my taste have put that into question, as has this brew. It truly does taste like it was freshly brewed, then left to chill just long enough to give you the basis for a great cup of smooth, flavorful iced coffee, whether you choose to drink it straight, or gussy it up with a little flavored syrup and half-and-half (I opted for the latter).The previous can of illy issimo coffee that I'd tried illy issimo Coffee Drink, Cappuccino, 8.45-Ounce Cans (Pack of 12) didn't really knock my socks off; I mean, it was good, but it wasn't the best I've ever tasted. I'd given that to Starbucks' Frappuccino line of refrigerated coffee drinks. But THIS can of issimo coffee drink really was good enough to give Starbucks a run for their money, for me, at least, especially considering that this brew doesn't contain anything more than coffee, a little sugar to sweeten it, and a few preservatives to hold it over (which any factory-made coffee drink will contain, anyway).If you're on the run, and, for some odd reason, aren't able to get yourself a cuppa Joe on the go, I definitely would recommend this drink for the true coffee purist. I'd be surprised if you weren't pleasantly surprised by it!
This is a great tasting coffee, when chilled, it is great! Cans are 6.8 ounces, and a pure burst of goodness!

column9: Slightly sweet, slight chance I'll drink it again.
column10: Strong, a little bitter.  Enough sweetness to make it drinkable.  But there was nothing to savor here.  If you like strong black coffee you might really enjoy this.  I don't and I didn't.

I was pleasantly surprised when I took my first sip of "illy issimo caffe: Italian Espresso Style Coffee Drink." I'm not sure what I expected, but it certainly wasn't the wonderful taste of real espresso coffee from a can. I'm a skeptic and proud of it! My only quibble, and this is a matter of personal taste, I found this Coffee Drink to be very sweet. I am not a sweet guy, no matter what my wife says. I simply don't drink my coffee with sugar (real or artificial), nor do I put milk/cream in it. I love the raw jolt of plain espresso in the morning. This drink definitely has what I like...except for the 10g of sugar. The next time I try illy's caffe, I'll get the one with No Sugar added.O...as an aside, I poured the 6.8FL OZ (200ml) of illy's chilled espresso in a glass and held it up to the light. It was so dark, that no light, not even a ray of sunlight, shone through it. The color reminded me of Guinness Stout.  4 Stars (I had to take a star away because it was too sweet for me.)

column9: Enjoyed this better than I expected
column10: because I love coffee, but I don't like overly sweet coffee. I expected this to be very sweet, but it wasn't. I like a strong coffee taste, and this didn't disappoint. Why not five stars? Because I didn't know if I was supposed to drink this chilled or not. It didn't say on the can or the website what temperature is should be served at. Aside from that, I loved this!
These delightful little cans are perfect. They are delicious, low in calories, don't taste grossly sweet and are loaded with caffeine.
I love drinking illy coffee and it's great that they offer it in can form. For me, it's too dark and bitter, but it is still a great and bold flavor for those who prefer it.

column9: Great quick expresso drink for morning energy
column10: I liked this product as it is a quick cold express coffee drink for early morning.  The sweetness is just right and I definitely get the energy after drinking in the morning.  I will definitely buy this product in the future.

I might as well review both Illy issimo Caffe Coffee Drink & Illy issimo Cappuccino Coffee Drink at the same time, since essentially the only difference is the additional lowfat milk and cocoa in the cappuccino. I am not a daily addict of high end espresso drinks, but I do have both espresso & cappuccino now and then - often Starbucks, but not exclusively. These Illy issimo coffee drinks have a distinctly nutty flavor - more distinctly so IMHO than the comparable Starbucks beverages. No real bitter edge, so for those who need that, this may not work out for you. Since this is so entirely a matter of taste and budget, I'll say I really like the taste but continue to roll my eyes at the prices - comparable to the Starbucks canned products you see at the grocery stores. For a quick pick-me-up treat, I'm all in, and I'd prefer this over the Starbucks stuff.

column9: It's okay -- I might have Starbucks tastebuds
column10: I love iced coffee so was eager to try this. I appreciated that it was lightly sweetened and that it didn't have any added dairy.  The portion was just the right size and I liked the strong espresso flavor.  It did have a bit of a bitter, over roasted flavor to it -- not entirely unpleasant but not a "great" cup of coffee.  I would consider buying this again but wouldn't go out of my way to look for it.

I was quite pleased with the flavor of this coffee energy drink. It has a creamy coffee flavor like a really good espresso. If you're in a hurry, with no time for making a coffee; and want a quality energy drink, look no further.

This flavor of Illy canned coffee I did not enjoy as much as the cappuccino flavor. The flavor was rather harsh and too bitter, and the caffeine jolt was unpleasantly over-the-top. I wouldn't buy this one again, but the cappucino flavor was much nicer and I recommend it instead.

I'm a big fan of coffee, so this beverage piqued my interest.  I have tried Starbucks drinks both at Starbucks coffee shops and from the supermarket.  I like them.  This drink is not as sweet.  It seems there's just enough sugar to take the bitter edge off.  When ice is added it makes a refreshing enough warm weather beverage, though I have tasted better.  What the product has going for it is convenience.  The 6.8-ounce cans are easy to store in the refrigerator and can be taken out and drunk quickly.  No process of first making iced coffee.  That's a definite plus.  It is not as satisfying at room temperature.The flavor, apart from being strong, is harsh to the taste and does not provide the satisfaction that a Starbucks or other espresso drinks in a can/bottle do.  As a pick-me-up, the drink is appropriate, since its hefty dose of caffeine will give the drinker an infusion of energy.  Compared to other similar drinks on the market, sugar content is low (which accounts for its bitterness).For those averse to caffeine or those who have trouble sleeping if they drink too much brewed coffee, this beverage is a no-no.  These days, many folks have cut down on caffeine intake, so this product might be counterproductive to weaning oneself from addictive caffeine.

This isn't bad.  It's very strong and slightly bitter with a touch of sweetness taste. I wouldn't compare to to Starbucks doubleshot since this is a lot less sugary.  It is a nice pick me up and if you love a good strong coffee taste you'd probably love this.  I'm more of a wimp and liked the illy issimo Cappuccino Coffee Drink, 8.45-Ounce Cans (Pack of 12) which is weaker, has milk and is a bit sweeter.  Both are very low in calories and a nice coffee flavor.  Depends on your preference I would think.  Nice product either way.

I had recently tried the illy Cappuccino which had a slightly flat taste.  The Caffe flavor was a big improvement to me, with more sweetness and a richer coffee taste.  It wasn't the same flavor as I am used to from Starbucks but I liked the easy serving size which can be transported to drink anywhere.  The sweetness of this drink is just right, especially for those who don't drink coffee unsweetened.  I found the caffeine in the illy Caffe wasn't excessive and didn't make me too "wired" throughout the day.

This coffee beverage tasted pretty good...it was strong but slightly bitter so I couldn't see myself drinking it every day.  The caffeine gave me a nice morning boost.  The calories aren't too bad for this kind of drink.

I have been a fan of illy products for awhile and I thought this wouldn't be an exception.However, the first sip shocked me with bitterness, plus I wasn't a great fan of the overall flavor.It did have a good little kick and I like that it's low and calories AND it doesn't pretend to be anything other than a coffee drink with caffeine.Warrants the three stars overall.

As a night worker, I'm always looking for a new beverage with 'zip' in it. Almost any coffee product will do. It helps, though, to be fully cognizant of what's in the can before you make expectations.While I guess I was thinking this was going to be another in the long line of Starbucks-type creamy and sweet coffee drinks, this is nothing of the kind. There is just enough sweet to take off the bitter, but this is very much an espresso-type drink - which, if I'd bothered to read the can, I would have realized.Good enough for what it was - and it did hike my alertness somewhat - it comes in a small can, nowhere near the size of even a regular canned coffee. The flavor was okay, but for what stuff goes for these days, the product could be a little more generous.

This review is based on a single can received from the Amazon Vine program.I'm a coffee guy.  I drink it almost every day.  My coffee brewing method of choice is a French Press, and I like a rich full bodied coffee.  I do like iced coffee, and I like sweets, so this thing seemed like a good fit.I couldn't see anywhere on the can a recommendation on how to drink it, so I went with room temperature.  Big mistake.  This is definitely an iced coffee in a can, so keep that in mind.The coffee flavor was fine, but this was really sweet.  I drink sugary coffee with milk, but this doesn't have any milk or cream, so I didn't like it too much.  Your mileage may vary.If you like cold sweet coffee, without milk, you might want to give this a try.

I like a good strong coffee, but I did not enjoy this.The flavor was strong and bitter, yet not very aromatic. It's acidic, a little sour to the tongue. The only way I can enjoy this is adding a lot of milk to it to mellow it out. Perhaps over a cup of ice.On the bright side, it is not sweet, so you can customize your own sweetness.I enjoyed the cappuccino flavor a lot more.

I like iced coffee on hot summer days but since those times are still a couple of months away, I poured the illy Caffe into my favorite coffee mug and microwaved it until it was just the right temperature for me. The can doesn't specify whether this is supposed to be a cold drink or a hot one, so I see no problem with doing this.I also must admit to being someone who only occasionally has espresso coffee, so keep that in mind when you evaluate my review.I liked it.The illy Caffe had a nice, strong coffee flavor. It was just a tad too sweet for me, but that could be a result of heating it rather than consuming it cold. We perceive sweetness differently depending upon temperature and as a cold drink the sweetness might be right. That seems to be the prevailing opinion in the other reviews here, so I'll defer to their judgement.I've tried another illy canned coffee drink, the Cappuccino, and I detected an under-taste of some sort in that one but that's not the case here. It has a nice espresso flavor with no off-flavor notes.The 6.8 ounce can contains 50 calories and 155 milligrams of caffeine.

column9: Great for those times when you are on the go
column10: I found myself in a situation where I had to be in three places at once, and I needed a flavorful boost without the hassle and cleanup of making my own espresso or the wait and expense of getting one at my local barrista.  Right there in front of me was a can of illy issimp Caffe coffee drink.  I popped the lid and took a sip.  This brew is dark, bold and bitter.  I added a packet of stevia-based sweetener and it was much more palatable.  My wife took a sip and we both agreed that we should order another pack of these.Bottom line - an enjoyable, high quality coffee drink.  It is not as sweet or decadent as a "double shot" can, but it taste more authentic.

For the record I'm not much of a coffee drinker.  When I go to Starbucks or McDonald's I prefer to get a mocha (especially a mocha frappe) because it's more like cocoa than coffee.So I guess what disappoints me about this product is that it's pretty much just a cup of coffee.  Despite that sugar is the second ingredient in it, the product really has a lot of that coffee bitterness in it.  If you're someone like me who doesn't like that, then this product certainly isn't for you.That is all.

"Don't shake" it says on the small bullet cans.No need to. And no need to run out to Starbucks and pay $2.50 for their little double espresso shot cans.This stuff is strong, and .50cents cheaper per can, for your afternoon "human reboot".Strong flavor but not bitter. You should enjoy a strong coffee taste if you're going to enjoy this. I do. A nice little 12 pack fits under your desk, or in your desk drawer at the office.

This is the second of the illy issimo Caffee drinks I've tried.  The first was a cappuchino chocolate drink that was tasty, but a little too sweet.  In fact it was sweet to the point of nearly bitter.My understanding is that the illy issimo line does actually come from an Italian coffee maker, but the brand itself is Coca Cola under license of the ILKO Coffee Intl company.  There is a split personality going on here...the can says Arabica coffee and finest ingredients of the quintessential Italian espresso experience.  But the can says product of Denmark that was apparently put together in Atlanta, GA.  The good news is that the apparently international effort of creating a can of this beverage is actually worthwhile!This one is really good...hit the spot perfectly.  There is a little sweetness to it, but its subdued and deep coffee taste.  In pouring, it looks like Jaegermeister (my admin asked if I was pouring Jaeger bombs).  it has an espresso like foam on the surface (which makes sense, it says Espresso Style on the can) and the smell was like a rich cold coffee.  The taste is easy and flavorful.  Unlike the first drink, I'll actually order a case of this one.  Really good.Pros:  Rich taste, works at room temperature (doesn't require ice) and can very much fulfill a caffeine fiend. But its only 50 calries, only 1% of which is sodium.Cons:  10g of sugar in the can (which is only a 6.8 fl oz (200 ml) can).  But the sugar barely registers.  I don't like sugar in my coffee, but I did like this.

column9: Did not care for this one
column10: I have had the illy issimo coffee before and liked it so I was excited to try this iced coffee drink. If you like a strong coffee taste you will like this. I prefer and more smooth coffee taste so this is not for me. The quality of this brand is great though so that is why I am giving it three stars.

This Illy "Italian Espresso Style" drink is one of an entire series of coffee-in-a-can style beverages.  This particular product has 6.8 fl oz and contains 155 mg of caffeine. That's pretty typical of a regular cup of coffee.The taste was pretty basic. In fact, it really just tastes like chilled coffee. It has that bitter coffee bite, somewhat toned down by sugar. It isn't too strong, but if you're looking for a smooth, milky taste then you won't like this drink. Overall, it was okay but certainly not my favorite. It'll do in a pinch as an iced coffee substitute, but I wouldn't go out of my way to find it.

I am reviewing this just for the coffee flavor, which is excellent. It's a flavorful intense coffee flavor, but not too strong. Just right. There is no milk or creamer in this; it is essentially a black coffee drink. Since I like my coffee light, both hot and cold/iced coffee, I did add some half 'n half to this and the result was excellent. But if you don't drink your coffee light, then you'll probably like this right out of the can.

I tend to shy away from cold coffee drinks. I think this is mostly because I resisted coffee until I had to wake up in the morning at the Renaissance Festival and the caffeine was only so successful in waking me. I needed the heat to fully send me into an alert status (and it also became essential in the later weeks when there was frost on the ground and my teeth were rattling). I don't necessarily like the taste of coffee anymore than I like the taste of beer or scotch. I have developed a taste, but that is not the same as having a predisposed desire for it. It's a means to an end and if I am not warmed up in the first sip, that end is less forthcoming.I can honestly say that I enjoyed this beverage. It is just sweet enough to mitigate the coffee bitterness, but not so sweet that you don't know what it is. There is a smooth taste that belies the harshness of the coffee grounds. Furthermore, it is highly caffeinated to the point where my eyes were open wide and I was ready for work.I definitely will buy more.
The illy issimo Cappuccino Coffee Drink, 8.45-Ounce Cans (Pack of 12)  does taste much better than this one in my opinion. This flavor tastes a bit like instant coffee that was just brewed strong.

column9: Great coffee drink. Actually tastes like coffee!
column10: This coffee is great, unlike most cold coffee drinks in a can, this one actually tastes like coffee. It is closer to a black coffee than a sweetened coffee, so if you like them light and sweet, try the Cappuccino flavored one.

I enjoyed this coffee drink.  It is flavorful straight out of the can, with a robust taste somewhere between Dunkin Donuts and Starbucks in intensity.  Moderately sweetened but without any dairy additives, everyone in my family "cut" theirs with half and half to take the edge off the flavor.  If you like your coffee strong and black but don't have access to a pot, thermos or a vendor, this may be the product to put in your lunchbox.  Another solid product from illy issimo!

column9: Strong and sweet but really just cold coffee with sugar
column10: I guess if you are out and about and want a cold coffee, this would do the trick.  Make sure you like your coffee strong and sweet because this drink has sugar in it.  Also, mind the fact that you are not supposed to shake the can!I like iced coffee, but I like to make it myself and compared to mine, this is average.  The strong flavor is nice but it is a little too sweet for my taste.

column9: Delicious, But Too Rich, Kaffe Drink
column10: If you like your Italian espresso to be very dark and bold in taste, then you can't miss with Illy Issimo Caffe . Like its "cousin", Illy Issimo Cappucino, this is an exceedingly rich Italian espresso style coffee drink, but it isn't nearly as rich as the cappuccino, which I have tried recently. However, I thought the coffee flavor was still rich and decided that it needed some improvement by diluting it 50% with fresh milk. I am surprised that a drink as rich as this one is has only 50 calories per can; it's also low sodium too with only 20 milligrams per can. Anyone who is diet conscious will appreciate both salient facts. While I can recommend this to anyone who wants an imported Italian espresso drink from Europe (Denmark), those seeking freshly ground beans, will find Starbucks' version a far more delicious coffee drinking experience.

I got both the Caffe flavor and the Cappuccino flavor for my coffee aficionado husband. While he loved the Cappuccino one, he felt this one was nothing special. It tasted like any other iced coffee (we refrigerated it). It was a bit on the bitter side and strong, but to him it just didn't stand out.

I love espresso, so I was looking forward to tasting this new espresso drink from illy which is made for Coca-Cola. I refrigerated it so it would be really cold and then I drink it.  I was not disappointed...it tasted fresh and was delicious. I wanted more.  I will recommend this to my friends and I will look in the grocery store for this product. We travelled extensively in Europe over the years and acquired a taste for special coffee blends and espresso.  This was the real deal and was exceptionally tasty.

I liked this beverage.  I followed the instructions and didn't shake it.  It is tough to review a product like this since it depends on how you like your coffee.  If you only drink coffee black than this will be too sweet, if you only drink those Starbucks Frappacinno drinks in the little bottle (I do like those!) than this may be too strong.  I like my coffee (hot or cold) with a little milk and a little sugar...this drink was pretty good for me.  It was a little stronger flavor than what I typically drink but quite good.  Not too many calories, not too many crazy chemistry project ingredients, nice flavor...I was happy with my experience.  I am cheap though so I will probably stick with brewing coffee at home and drinking that!

column9: Pleasant coffee taste.  Not real espresso, but what do you expect from a can?
column10: A pleasing coffee drink that doesn't taste canned, but it's not a substitute for real espresso.  If you like iced coffee, you'll enjoy the similar flavor (I had it fridge-cold).If you're used to super-sweet American bottled/canned coffee drinks (like starbucks "mocha" bottled drinks), you're in for a pleasant surprise: a distinct coffee flavor and modest sweetness that comes from a mere 50 calories of real sugar.  But, don't expect this to taste like chilled fresh espresso (and really, can you expect that out of a can, especially one labeled "espresso style"?).A pleasing grab-and-go coffee drink with only modest calories and a flavor reminiscent of pressed coffee.  Recommended.

column9: Coffee Shop Alternative a Welcome Treat
column10: Illy's Issimo Caffe Coffee Drink is an espresso flavored canned coffee. As such, it has a strong flavor.  By itself, the drink may be a little too strong for all but the most dedicated espresso fans. The drink, however, mixed well with milk and extra sweetener to produce a good tasting coffee beverage. Also, when poured from the can into a glass, it produced a beautifully thick foam.

column9: Not bad if you enjoy iced coffee
column10: This coffee drink had a very nice coffee taste that took a few minutes to develop. I am a strong coffee drinker...hot coffee, that is. I usually limit my coffee/caffeine intake to the early morning, so I don't know if I would drink this after my morning jolt. It had a distinct coffee flavor, but somehow I just couldn't get into enjoying it cold. This is a 6.8 oz can that contains 12 grams of carbs, 10 grams of sugar, 50 calories and 155 mg of caffeine. If you enjoy strong, iced coffee, you will no doubt like this drink. It should work well for an energy boost in the PM.

I love espresso.  When I heard about this product I felt like I had to try it, even though part of me wondered (and still wonders) whether there is really a market for espresso in a can.  It tastes really good, rich and full-bodied, with just enough sweetness.  If you ever feel like a shot of iced espresso would go down good right now, this would be the product for you.This is a Coca Cola product.  I was one of the 5 people who thought Coca Cola Black (coffee flavored Coke) was a great product back in the 2000's.  Apparently Coke hasn't given up on capturing a portion of the coffee-lovers market.  The ingredient list is short and sweet and consists of what the illy issimo website calls "ingredients of natural origin" - primarily coffee and sugar.  Although it tastes really good, I just can't imagine getting addicted to this stuff, mainly because when I think espresso, I think of a hot drink.  It just seems like people's mind sets would need to undergo a radical change in order for this product to be successful.

This coffee drink is made in Denmark and imported to be sold by Coca-Cola.  Its ingredient list is short and pretty non-offensive, coffee, sugar, potassium bicarbonate and potassium citrate.  The can is labeled as "no preservatives," so I'm not sure of the reason for the last ingredient.The taste is like a sweet high quality coffee.  IT claims to be an "Italian espresso style coffee" and I suppose it is- although I'm not an expert.  That's about it- no milk or cream taste, but good coffee.  If you like cold, sweet coffee you should like it.The drink contains 155 mg of caffeine, so it's about as strong as your average energy drink or high end cup of coffee.  It contains 50 calories, so it's fairly light in that department, being that it doesn't use artificial sweeteners.

The can of illy issimo Caffe Coffee drink is a small can and at first I thought this is too small, I was wrong!! It has a great flavor and actually did give me extra energy.I have tried other coffee drinks  such as Starbucks coffee drinks and I do not really care for those.If I had to choose this over a larger can I would most definately purchase this, I plan on buying more of these.

column4: James C. Ward "horror and sci-fi fan.."
column9: coffee lovers:  Italian espresso in a can.
column10: great for those who enjoy chilled coffee drinks.  Especially if you like rich, strong espresso type of coffee.  This only has 50 calories, so if you are on a diet, this will fit in with your goals.Tastes great- convenient, small cans.  Perfect to take to work with you, or as you travel in your car.I will defintely buy this product again.
I love iced coffee so I poured my Illy issimo caffe over ice.  Tasty and smooth.  I would definitely buy this product.

This would be a good coffee drink to have on hand.  I did chill it in the refrigerator, and since I don't drink espresso with sugar, I placed this in a cup and added a bit of milk, and liked it better that way.  The milk softened the sugar taste a bit and the bitterness of the espresso.  All in all, a nice beverage.

column9: If It Weren't For the Can....
column10: ...I'd give this five stars. I very much like coffee but I don't typically consume espresso drinks because I find many of them too strong or overly bitter. However, I immensely enjoyed illy issimo Caffe Coffee Drink. It is smooth with just a mildly strong and flavorable after-taste. It's the sort of drink you can sit, sip on and savor. The only downside is the terrible metallic taste that comes from pressing your lips against the can, but that's easily solvable by pouring the drink into another cup. Also, the drink gives a powerful caffeine kick if you're looking for a pick me up.If you love coffee and enjoy espresso drinks I highly recommend that you give illy issimo Caffe Coffee drink a try!

Well, there aren't a lot of chemicals (or ingredients) in this product; coffee, sugar and potassium citrate and potassium bicarbonate.  However, this is a small note that the product also may have traces of milk in it.  There are 50 calories (6.8 fluid oz.); so it isn't overly sweet or tart.  It doesn't have an overly strong coffee flavor, but I think it tastes best either very, very cold, or hot.  I drank one that was cold (about 45 degrees F), and it wasn't all that good.  However, in a pinch, it does give you a decent caffeine jolt (155 mg. per can), and it is easy to open and consume.  Personally, I like the sweeter drinks sweetened with milk, but this one isn't bad.

column9: For those looking for something a little different
column10: illy issimo Caffe Coffee is a wonderful drink. If you are tired of the same old Starbucks routine grab a little taste of Rome with this great concoction. I pour mine over ice and love it. This is for the coffee drinker. If you are not a big fan of coffee I would skip this product.

Generally, I'm a fan of canned coffee drinks - so I'm predisposed to liking most of the ones I try. That being said, the most common weakness of canned coffee drinks is too many of them can be much too sweet so as not to be enjoyable. Illy does a good job of making a light, refreshing coffee drink that is lightly sweetened. There is only 50 calories per can so it isn't too sinful if you are trying to watch your calorie intake.My only quibble is that while the coffee flavor is good, it isn't very strong - this is more like a Dunkin Donut's style coffee than a Starbucks style coffee. If I saw this can available in a store, I'd definitely get it again.

My first sip really surprised me and I think my face said it all: Strong was written all over my face. I wasn't expecting the taste to be as rich as it was, but honestly with just the first sip I wasn't sure if I liked it. But as I continues to sip I started to enjoy the rich bold taste and could really feel the Italian espresso working it's way through my morning sleepy head. By the time I had the last sip I was awake and my mind was alert and I honestly felt more awake then I normally feel when I drink my other cold instant canned coffee. And illy issimo is only 50 calories and only 20mg sodium which makes my other coffee look like is has tons of calories when I compare the two of them. I normally drink Trader Joe's with it's 120 calories and sometimes I feel like I need 2 of them just to wake up in the morning, but with illy issimo 1 can was all I needed and I was awake. With the difference in calories and how well it worked I think it might be time I thought about switching coffee brands.

column9: A Good Balance Between Flavor and Sweetness
column10: It has been a long time since I have had brewed (but not necessarily fresh) coffee out of a can.  Having been exposed to a range of canned coffees in Japan, where, I might add, it is something of a staple among salaried workers and nearly approaches the status of being its own food group, just like instant ramen, I have to admit that I had a few reservations about the product, given that some products in this category hit and others miss, quite often by more than a mile.I can confidently say that the Illy Issimo Caffe Coffee Drink definitely hits the target.  The coffee comes slightly sweetened (with sugar being the sweetener) and has a good texture.  The drink itself is sweet, but not syrupy, and is heavy on flavor, with a pleasant after-taste.  Its aroma is understated, and the coffee tends not to be very pungent, which I found most peculiar given that the product uses only arabica beans.  From the standpoint of caffeine content, I would say that there is a fair quantity here to develop a modest and sustainable "buzz" (readers should understand that, given my 8-cup-a-day coffee habit, my comments on caffeine content are highly suspect).Although I can't say for certain from where the coffee was sourced, both its strength and its aroma would tend to suggest a Central- or South-American origin (and I freely admit that I could be totally wrong here).  Unfortunately, I had only one can of this delightful treat, and if I had a spare can, I would have given it to our resident coffee-snob at work (who, by the way, roasts her own, carefully and elaborately sourced green beans) and much like a sommelier, she could have told me whether or not it was a specialty coffee or just commodity coffee, its probable point of origin and even its terrior.  But I (totally) digress.I had this coffee cold, and I placed it in the fridge for about twelve hours before consuming it.  Indeed, I think it best to serve this particular product cold, as the flavor components and aroma may quickly volatilize (that is, disappear by evaporation) if consumed warm or hot.Overall, the Illy Issimo Caffe Coffee Drink represents a good balance between flavor and sweetness.  Those of you looking for a quick pick-me-up in the afternoon will do well with this product, and those of who like a good, sipping coffee served cold will do even better with it.

column9: stronger flavor and less sweet than many other canned/bottled coffees
column10: While I did enjoy illy's issimo caffe coffee drink, I do have mixed feelings about it.  The good, from my perspective, is that it's less sweet than all of the other alternative canned/bottled coffee drinks I've had, so it tastes more like slightly sweetened, strong coffee rather than very sweet milk with a little coffee flavor mixed in.  That being said, the product is labeled that it's "espresso style" and I think that's probably an overstatement.  Yes, this product has a strong coffee flavor, but it tastes more like a very strong brewed coffee versus a well pulled espresso shot.Given that I generally drink my coffee unsweetened, whether hold or cold, I don't think I would purchase this product regularly.  If you do like strong, cold coffee that's slightly sweetened, this product might be more to your liking than mine.  I'm still rating it 4 ("I like it") versus 3 ("It's okay") stars because I think the product is better than okay and is certainly good for what it is.  If a half star were possible, my personal rating would certainly be 3.5 stars.

column9: Great, if you like cold, sweetened coffee.
column10: This is the best of its kind I have tried: a prepared coffee beverage. It isn't too acidic, and has a nice rich coffee flavor. It is, of course, not hot unless you leave it in the car or heat it up somehow (Starbucks had some deal that was self-heating a while back, but I think it is no longer available.) It is not overly sweet, but is somewhat so--it has 50 calories, so that's a couple of teaspoons of sugar. I would prefer an unsweetened option, but this is not too much. You could easily make iced coffee with this--it has enough flavor to hold up to some dilution from the ice and could be pre-chilled to reduce that even further.Good stuff.

column9: Quality Italian espresso on the go
column10: It's dark and bold like others have said, but that's to be expected from espresso in a can. What I didn't expect, was for it to taste pretty good for what it is. In all fairness, I'm not a big coffee drinker. I don't normally drink plain black coffee or espresso, and tend to prefer a cappuccino or mochaccino or, barring that, a cup of coffee with a healthy dose of cream and sugar. This isn't exactly a drink for me, but even for me this wasn't unpleasant by any means. It has a rich flavor to it--what I'd expect from quality coffee--with a subtle hint of sugar that works really well. I have no doubt espresso lovers will enjoy this and I'm impressed enough by this that I'm confident I'll really enjoy illy issimo's other coffee drinks, such as the mochaccino (which is probably a better fit for a coffee drinker like me).

This coffee tastes very good.  I heated mine in a mug but it would be good over ice too.  Because it is very sweet I would not want to start every day with it but as a treat it's great.  By my calculations there is about a tablespoon of sugar in each 6.8 ounce can.  Cans are aluminum which is appreciated since that is the only substance I can recycle here.

This little can (6.8 oz.)of coffee drink has the flavor of espresso with a not-too-sweet note.  There is nothing artificial-tasting about it, as is often found in other energy boost drinks.  With 155 mg. of caffeine, it contains almost double the jolt in a 7 oz. brewed cup of coffee.  This one's not for sissies.Please note that, with 10 grams of sugar and 12 grams of carbohydrate, it may not be for those on sugar/carbohydrate restricted intake. Other than that, it contains nothing to deem it unhealthy.  It even has no preservatives. (I wonder what this drink might taste like if it were artificially sweetened and have no carbohydrates.)I enjoyed it ice cold straight from the can.  This tastes every bit as good as the Starbucks bottled coffee drinks.  I would not hesitate to choose the Illy brand over the other one.Coca Cola produces it in Atlanta, Georgia under a licensing agreement and it is a product of Denmark.

Lately I've been really getting into espresso, and this small espresso-based energy drink comes as close to the taste of the real thing as is possible for a drink of this kind. It's very light (only 10g of sugars, no fat, no dairy and only 50 calories), and it's very bitter as compared to some other similar beverages. For instance, the 6.5 ounce can of Starbucks DoubleShot contains 17g of sugar, 6g of fat, and 140 calories. Even the Starbucks Doubleshot Light has 6g of sugar, 4g of fat and 70 calories. In terms of caffeine per serving, illy's espresso drink has about 155 mg as opposed to 130 for the Sturbucks drinks.The bottom line is this: if you want a strong, light, European-style espresso drink than illy's issimo is a great choice. However, if you enjoy smoother, more filling taste then check out the Starbucks' DoubleShots.

I'm presuming that one would only resort to canned coffee if there weren't any real coffee available- that's the basis on which I will review this drink.  I still prefer the real thing, but for a canned coffee, this really is not bad.  It's nice and strong, and it has less sugar than other coffee drinks.  I'd actually prefer even less sweetener, but I find myself to be a bit unusual in that.  In any case, this is the closest ready-made beverage I've found that tastes like real espresso.  I can definitely appreciate the convenience.

illy issimo is Coca Cola's attempt to break into the canned coffee drink market. The Caffe flavor is not bad and it works in terms of offering energy and caffeine. Having said that, there is little to differentiate this product from other ones on the market. On the plus side, it has only 50 calories.

column9: The worst thing I've ever tasted
column10: 1. I am purposely writing this review blind of the other reviews.  If I am the only 1 star then consider I must have got a bad can.  That or <1% of the population has a gene incompatible with this recipe :-)2. Is "worst thing" hyperbolic.. maybe.  I remember when I was five I tried tasting some strawberry air freshener, that was pretty bad.  Among intended foodstuffs, this does indeed rank up there with worst3. The ingredients are coffee, sugar, and preservative, so I am not sure how it has gone wrong.  For one thing it tastes slightly carbonated/citric... likely the preservative.  And the sweetness is just way off.  Too high and totally unbalanced with the coffee.  The coffee has a weird mouth-feel.  Ever accidentally sipped form a cup of coffee on your desk only to realize it was from 3 days ago?  Sort of like that.If it helpful to know, I am a coffee drinker.  My general drinks of choice are double-short-americano or triple-tall-cappucino

This is the best coffee-based energy drink. It has tons of caffeine (155 mg), only 50 calories, and no dairy. If you don't like espresso, this isn't for you, but if you hate the sugared-up taste of other energy drinks, check it out.The product description is inaccurate--there's no milk or cream in this.
Very flavor of this canned expresso. Better than the starbucks one.Thus, the Calories should be only 50 instead of 100 in this product description. I will say great item for expresso lover

column9: Strong Flavor and Close to Real Espresso Taste
column10: I love espresso, the stronger the better.  I was pleasantly surprised at the rich taste and strong flavor that this Illy drink possesses.  It is not like the usual bottled or canned coffee drink.  It tastes like it just came out of the espresso machine.  There's a slight sweetness, but just a touch so as to make the drink not bitter.  If you can't get to a real espresso stand, then I highly recommend this drink as a good substitution.

I could not believe how good this little can of perfection was. Very European and premium tasting. It's a strong drink that packs alot of punch, you can taste the quality in this product.Bold and leaves a nice aftertaste. I want one right now lol, I think ill go out and pick some up tomorrow. You cannot go wrong with this if you like a high quality Latte experience. I think it's even better than what Starbucks has to offer quite honestly.I wish this product was more popular and more available in the stores instead of those Starbucks products in the cans. I guess popularity wins every time, but that doesn't mean this product isn't way way better because it is.

column9: Rich Dark Flavor, Great evening or morning drink
column10: I bought this coffee to venture off of the Starbucks double shot drinks...which are still my favorite, but these are great when you don't want as sweet of taste and need more caffeine in your system.It has a very dark and bold taste with a hint of sugar and does the job very well.I would definitely recommend this product to coffee drinkers and those who like pure espresso

column9: Convenient small can of espresso drink
column10: I enjoy just about any coffee, and I liked the illy issimo caffe Italian Espresso Style Coffee Drink too.  It does have a bit of a bitter taste, even though the ingredients include sugar.  So it's not a real sweet drink.  I liked the strong, somewhat bitter taste of it, even though my favorite coffee drinks are mocha style beverages (both hot and cold).I refrigerated the can before drinking, and it was a nice quick cold coffee beverage.  However, I am used to drinking large cups of coffee, so the small 6.8 oz. can seemed too small, and I finished it off pretty quick.  The nice thing about the small can is you can take these with you just about anywhere.  So they are very convenient.I'd recommend to people who like iced espresso style coffee drinks that have a bit of sweetness, but remain a bit bitter and who want very convenient small servings that can be taken just about anywhere.

column9: Not for me, but my spouse loved it
column10: This is my second Illy coffee product and I guess I just don't like them. They are too strong and bitter-tasting for me. I'm not a lover of overly strong coffee flavors, I like them mild and unobtrusive. However, my husband has loved ever Illy product that I've given him to try, and he IS a coffee drinker. He likes anything coffee. So I'll give this a 3; my rating would have been a 1 but his would be a 5 so we'll split the difference.I do like how convenient the drinks are, they would fit nicely into my husband's lunchbox for work.

We love illy issimo coffees. They're not expensive and they usually hit the spot. I was excited to try the illy issimo Coffee Drink, Caffè.It was very disappointing. I found it, while sweetened, to be bitter and watery. (Yes, I know that, scientifically, bitter is not the opposite of sweet, but we know that sweetener changes the flavor of coffee.)  I passed the can to my Gentleman Caller, who is more of a coffee aficionado than I am. He drinks fine espresso as well as old coffee from the bottom of the pot if that's what there is. He agreed that this was bitter.illy disappointed us.I wouldn't buy this if it were offered again. I'd rather buy a soda.The Illy Issimo Cappuccino Espresso Coffee Drink is far more to my liking.

I got this illy issimo Coffee Drink Caffe for my husband who loves coffee. To make sure he was super grateful, I brought it camping with us to surpise him in a moment of caffeine desperation. I was sure he was going to love it because everything tastes better in the woods."Mediocre, not as good as I'd thought it would be," was what he told me.I won't be buying this again.

I usually really like coffee drinks, but I have never tasted anything this horrible in my life.  I have had a variety of other brands and this was the worst flavor I have had.  I would not recommend this one based on its flavor.  Maybe if this brand has other flavored ones it would be better, but the plain coffee one is horrible.  I do not recommend.

I couldn't drink the full cup. It was sweet, and somewhat off, maybe like coffee that had sat in your cup all day, and you don't notice that, and take a big swallow of it. Not awful, but not great. I normally like illy espresso and am willing to add a touch of sugar to that. Perhaps it's another person's idea of a "touch" that makes it not palatable to me.
I found the sugar taste wasn't blended in with the drink well, it tasted like someone had put table sugar in terrible tasting cold coffee.  Not good and expensive.

column9: Great flavor, but give us an unsweetened espresso
column10: This is the second illy issimo coffee drink that I've tried, and both of them have had a great bold taste. Both were also full of sugar. I don't really enjoy my coffee with sugar in it, but I think if illy issimo would come out with a full-bodied espresso drink that has no sweetener whatsoever in it, suitable for using in place of pulled espresso shots for making one's own lattes or for splitting a can in espresso cups, that would be a hit and would be something I might buy to have on hand to serve to guests.

This expresso is very tasty.  I drank it cold from the refrigerator.  It is very sweet.  I liked that. It is not a creamy drink.  Just expresso and sugar, with 2 other ingredients.  It's good to note that you do not shake these cans.  I had a coffee aftertaste.  I think that is normal.  This drink really tastes Italian.  I will buy it again, but I prefer their creamier flavors.

column9: Coffee as good as you are likely to find in a can, best i have had!
column10: I'll preface my review by saying that I generally give 5 stars to products I consider "best of," hpwever, the can aside, it is not the best coffee I have had (I am something of a coffee fiend, and personally partial to African varietals and single estate coffees).  It is the best coffee I have had in a can.  That is not, however, saying much.  The few times I have had canned coffee (I generally avoid packaged processed foods) it has tasted oily, as that is what "non-dairy creamer" is, oil, and the coffee itself was pretty nasty.  This coffee, however, is made by a coffee company, and a European gourmet coffee company at that.  They know coffee, how to choose, roast and brew it.  It is smooth coffee, lightly sweetened, and *without high fructose corn syrup* :)  When I am on the road I generally look for bottled water.  If that isn't available I get lemonade or juice, choosing canned coffee (or a water fountain) if none of the above is available (I just will not consume most of the additives in canned drinks).  This particular coffee, I would bump up in that line, as it is actually more wholesome than most of the packaged lemonade, for example.I would also describe this more as a medium roast, and am surprised, given that they drink pretty sturdy coffee in Italy, that the company describes it as an espresso.  It may be that it is prepared with an espresso roast?  But it is definitely milder than what most people would describe as espresso.  It is, however, reasonably good coffee, prepared with entirely natural ingredients, and that in itself is almost revelatory!

Other than the benefit of caffeine, this really is not a very good drink.  If you compare it to other competitors (namely the at-home Starbucks drinks), it's vastly inferior in just about every category.  The taste is mediocre and not pleasant.  The smell keeps its metallic odor even after pouring it into a different glass.  The value isn't there, either.Overall, it's a very disappointing drink.

column9: Nice Italian-style espresso drink in a can with 50 calories
column10: Having visited Europe many times, one of the things I miss is good espressos. I have a couple of coffee machines at home but I'm always too lazy to make cold espressos! This "illy issimo" espresso-in-a-can tastes good to me. It's not too strong yet has enough espresso bitterness to make it flavorful. Each can has 50 calories, including 1g of fiber and 10g of sugar. The drink is made in Denmark and tastes high-quality. I really liked the one sample can I received from the Amazon Vine program, so I'm going to order more! I do wish it were cheaper since each can is small!
I tried this two ways, iced and hot.  This was very enjoyable both ways.  I will buy this especially for the summer months, a bit of milk and lots of ice makes a wonderfully refreshing drink.

Fifty calories of pretty darn smooth espresso (style) drinking. No cream, no milk, no crazy flavors. This is for those that really like coffee. Ingredients simply: coffee, sugar, potassium bicarbonate, potassium, citrate. If you're an adult espresso fan looking for a pick-me-up without the fat (0 grams vs 6g (3.5 saturated)) in a Starbucks doubleshot espresso and without the fad ingrediants of kiddie energy drinks then this is a great choice.

I usually am not a big fan  of iced coffee drinks, but this one was not bad. It was not sickly sweet, and had a decent flavor.My only complaint was the size of the can/amount of product. In my opinion, it was too small.

column9: Good, but a bit strong for me!
column10: I had never tried this type of product before and got it because I was curious after reading the reviews.  I am not an Expresso drinker and I think I was in for a bit of a shock with the taste.  It had a 'pop' to it, but I found it to be bitter for my tastebuds.  I tried it room temperature and chilled, but neither one really appealed to me.  I would not say it was distasteful by any means, and for the person who enjoys this type of drink, it most probably would be quite good.  I did not experience an unpleasant aftertaste, but I did experience a lingering one.  For me, a person who enjoys a mild cup of coffee with raw brown sugar and cream, no :)

This beverage comes in an 6.8 Fluid Ounce serving.It has 50 Calories per can.It consists of Italian Espresso style Arabica coffee and sugar drink, with caffeine content of 155mg.  It's a Coca Cola product.The drink is lightly sugared, and tastes great. I put my can in the refrigerator and drank it cold.  Tasted like Ice Coffee...The can has a date on the bottom that indicates when the product expires (this one was 9/7/2012)I liked it and would buy more. If you like coffee, you will probably like this drink.

column9: Great pick-me-up on a hot afternoon!
column10: This is a great espresso with just a hint of sweetness.  If you are an espresso drinker this is for you.  If you like lattes, cappucinos, and such, look elsewhere, this has no milk or flavorings, it's just pure, smooth espresso.My preference for anything other than my morning coffee from my Keurig is hot in the winter and ice cold in the summer.  Today's temperature touched 100 so ice cold was the order of the day.  I have a special fast chill compartment in my refrigerator that cools items quickly to 34 degrees and after 4 hours in there I put the can in the freezer for 5 minutes.  It was icy cold the way I like it.  THe espresso is strong and bold without bitterness.  I liked the slight hint of sweetness as I find many coffee drinks to be too sweet for my taste but the Illy Issimo was spot on.  Compared to a Starbucks Double Shot the Illy has a better, more well-rounded flavor.Ok, I raved about the product so why only 4 stars?  The price!  In this age of Starbucks, etc., we are getting used to paying astronomical prices for coffee.  Folks, this is good espresso and convenient in the can but it is still coffee.  I guess we like to pay for convenience.  I could make Illy espresso in my Gaggia Baby for pennies a shot but sticking a can in the fridge is more convenient.  Bottom line, it's still coffee, a very nice espresso, but still coffee.

I have been drinking the Starbucks coffee's for years (the little double shot espresso can, similar to this one)I like this one much more, there is no aftertaste, I really like it, I will get this product instead of the Starbucks if I need to choose between those two.This product taste much better

Illy Issimo Coffee drink in a can was a pleasant surprise. I love coffee but prior to trying this beverage was less than impressed by the chillded coffee-in-a-can that was available. Starbucks Doubleshots and similar drinks by Seattle's Best and Others had been what I had tried. Those were all too weak and had a bit of a funny aftertaste. Illy managed to make a smooth, strong, good tasting chilled coffee with no funny aftertaste.This drink is basically a quick, good-tasting coffee that's ready to go. You must like coffee to like this drink; it's not one of those creamy, foo-foo drinks that are popular but are basically full of fat and void of coffee. It's not as good as fresh made espresso, but when I'm in a hurry and want some good tasting caffeine quick I now have a new go-to drink. Sorry Doubleshot.

I must say that I'm not a huge coffee fan but found this drink to be pretty good, and my husband who IS a coffee drinker really enjoyed it. It has a strong coffee flavor to it, and is caffeinated, so if you need a pick me up, this is a great drink to consume, plus it takes really great too!If you are a coffee drinker, you might like this.

column9: Worthy entry into the crowded Energy Drink market.
column10: I tried this illy issimo Caffè Italian Espresso Style coffee drink for a quick energy lift after lunch. The drink is made in Denmark (not Italy) and distributed by the Coca-Cola Co.Likes:>The AL can chilled quickly (1.5 hrs) in the fridge OR pour in a glass and heat it up in the microwave.>Richer taste of Arabica coffee than illy issimo Coffee Drink, Cappuccino, 8.45-Ounce Cans (Pack of 12) without the fat and cholesterol (from lowfat milk).>Per 6.8oz. can: 10g sugar, 0mg cholesterol & fat, and only 50 calories.Dislikes:>Each 6.8oz. can contains: 155mg caffeine and 20mg sodium.  Not bad but for those who are very sensitive to caffeine, even 155mg could cause an extra hour or two of insomnia (happened to me, drank it around 2PM, stayed up until 2AM).>Easy to exceed the maximum daily intake of 500mg caffeine (as recommended by physicians) with just three to four cans.>Competitively priced at $2.01 per 6.8oz can (12-pack) but costs can add up quickly for heavy coffee drinkers.Bottom Line:Tasty drink for an occasional energy boost but not recommended for people sensitive to or trying to minimize caffeine intake.  Give it a try, some may enjoy the flavor and couldn't care less about the 155mg caffeine; make your own informed decision!

column9: Cold coffee in a tiny can may take some getting used to
column10: I'll confess that I rarely drink coffee. I'll consume it only when I really need to stay awake. That's why I like this product. I can leave it in my car as an emergency drink for whenever I get sleepy behind the wheel.Be aware that it's a just 6.8 ounces, unlike a standard 12-ounce soft drink can.For those who prefer warm coffee, you might not like this product.

I really like this stuff.  In fact, it has now become my go to store store bought ice coffee.  It has a nice strong and real coffee taste not masked by sweeteners or other tastes meant to soften the flavors of real coffee.  My only complaint is that I wish the can were larger.  For those that enjoy there coffee black with no sugar and no cream, I highly recommend you give this a try.

If you like espresso, then you will probably like this coffee. The taste is strong and bold. It is mildly sweetened. One can (6.8 ounces) contains 50 calories and 155 mg of caffeine.Yikes! That's a lot of caffeine! I like coffee, but not this strong so I won't be drinking it again. And just FYI, it is a product of Denmark.

column9: Decent flavor but nothing I'm going to go out and buy
column10: I drink my coffee black and normally make it myself.  But if I want iced coffee, a lot of times it is faster just to buy something canned or in a bottle.  However, I have yet to really fall in love with any of the available products.illy issimo's Caffe flavored coffee drink has a nice, bold flavor.  There's a touch more sweetness than I like, but it's less than most premade drinks.  I do wish I'd decanted it.  Every once in awhile I would get a strong chemical taste, but I think that was due to the can rather than the coffee itself.  One can contains double the caffeine of a Red Bull, but I didn't feel much effect after finishing.  I felt less tired than usual, but there was no jolt of energy.I enjoyed trying this product and feel that it's better than many of its competitors, but I don't think I'm going to go out and buy any.  The periodic aftertaste really bothered me after awhile.

I liked this, very smooth tasting with no aftertaste from being sweetenedand left in a can...amazing.  I added some 1/2-n-1/2 to thin it for thisAmerican palette and still enjoyed it a lot.  If you purchase this, noteit says do not shake...unlike the Starbucks products you better shake orleave 1/2 of the product at the bottom.

For some reason, I had it in my head that this was iced coffee similar to a iced cafe mocha than a Coke that lost its carbonation. I really don't know where I got that idea because the description is clear "Coffee Drink, Caffe".Still, it was a surprise when I poured it into a small cup with ice that it was dark like (you guessed it) coffee.But instead of being disappointed at my unfounded assumption, I went ahead and took a sip and whoa, it was good.Mind you, I'm not a coffee drinker unless one considers a bit of coffee with cream and sugar to be coffee. My expectations were low and yet, this drink was good. Light, not too sweet, but not bitter either. At 6.8 oz, it was also the right size that it wasn't too much either. It was the perfect pick-me-up post-lunch in fact.I probably won't have this too much but I'll try to have it now and again. At 50 calories, it is a much better option for a post-lunch treat than the iced white mocha that I get from a well known coffee chain.So while this drink was different from what I expected, it was a good surprise and I will definitely buy again.

It's just coffee, sugar and potassium no cream.  I was very surprised to find that this coffee tasted superior to canned coffee I have had from Taiwan and Japan.  I guess this is what the coffee craze is all about which totally passed me by.  I would rather have a can of this than an ice cream to cool off - that's how satisfying it is.  But I consider this to be such a luxury drink at two dollars a small can when I don't even patronize Starbuck$. I throw powdered coffee into a milk carton to make cold coffee for myself.  I don't know ... if it were ever offered to me free again, I'd take it without hesitation.  It is definitely delicious but I don't see myself living that lifestyle of splurging on a can of coffee.p.s. I totally changed my mind and am going to order this out of pocket.  Amazon currently has a coupon for it but I was placing it in my shopping cart anyway.  It's yummy and I want more.

column9: Wonderful for making Iced Coffee Drinks!
column10: The pain in the butt that is ice cold coffee that retains the depth of flavor when iced is a constant problem. Especially if, like me, you don't want to make a giant pitcher of iced coffee, just one every-so-often.This was made much easier for me when trying out Illy issimo Coffee Drink. The can was small enough that after I chilled it, opened and poured over ice, there was enough room for flavored creamer! This created a lovely, hazelnutty ice coffee drink without losing the strong, vibrant coffee flavor.Unlike Starbucks iced coffee drinks, I was able to go sugar free with my creamer. While I am not a black coffee drinker, the flavor of this before adding anything was pleasing and not bitter or have an aftertaste. Personal preferences just dictate creamer for me.

If the world ever runs out of coffee I am in trouble. I'd probably count as addicted if they had a test for it. Which means I am always trying new coffee beverages and such to feed my need.This one actually was really yucky when I first opened it. I figured it would be better chilled since it's in a can but that actually made it awful! I let it sit until it was room temp and then it was really delicious. Funny how that works eh?
