I'd probably gravitate more toward the illy issimo Coffee Drink, Latte Macchiato, 8.45-Ounce Cans (Pack of 12) or illy issimo Coffee Drink, Cappuccino, 8.45-Ounce Cans (Pack of 12) if I were looking for more but I think I'll stick with the similar canned coffee beverage I've had in the past.I'd recommend this to the coffee drinker looking for something with sweetness but no cream/dairy.

I really enjoyed this coffee drink.  It has a dark, rich espresso flavor perfect for a hot summer's day, but what I really appreciated the most is that it's not too sweet like many coffee drinks out there. It has just enough sugar to make it tasty and refreshing.  The servings are small in a 6.8 fl oz can so it disappears quickly, but makes for the perfect iced drink and caffeinated pick me up.

After trying both the Illy and Starbucks canned coffees several times I have to say that I much prefer Illy.  It's not the taste so much as the smell of the canned/bottled drink itself.  While neither packaged coffee drink smells as pleasant as fresh brewed, I prefer the plainer scent of Illy over Starbucks which always smells faintly of "gym bag" to me. (though I'm at a loss of how to explain this)That said: the Caffe drink is not too bitter or tinny for coffee out of a can. Though it's not difficult to get a coffee on the go, these little cans are convenient for around town or packing on picnics or trips.  I've had this straight from the can, over ice, and with a little milk added.  It's not too sweet and is a nice pick-me-up.

Normally words like "coffee in a can" would make me want to punch a kitten in the mouth but this had a truly nice effect. It made me feel calmer, less shaky, more like my normal, coffee-needing self. Happier. Granted, i would need a box of them to get through a day but I guess that is splitting hairs because the product has a nice taste, pleasant even, and it is easy to store and hide from my friends who would take and drink it - and then no review.  all this combined for an experience that said I was really happy, surprised even, by just how good it tasted.no kittens were harmed by end of the review.

I generally start my days in warm weather with an iced Americano from a local coffeehouse, and that gave me an opportunity to A/B this drink against a freshly brewed glass this morning. While this canned concoction didn't have the aroma or richness of the freshly brewed drink, it was still quite pleasant. There were no aftertastes or unpleasant flavors, and the coffee flavor itself was rich and not at all bitter.I don't usually drink sweetened coffee, but this wasn't cloyingly sweet, like a soft drink; it was more like a Mideastern-style coffee, where the sugar served to balance off the bitterness of the coffee. At $2/can I'd rather spend a buck more and have a freshly brewed espresso, but this is certainly better than some of the espresso I've had in airports and restaurants.  I think this would be a fine drink to keep in the fridge at home or to carry on car trips or picnic outings.

My workplace doesn't have a coffee maker, and I need my coffee sometimes, so canned coffee has become a staple.This is probably the best iteration of canned coffee I've ever found.  I love whatever they are doing to make the liquid a little thicker.  It's subtle, but it makes a big difference.  I think the quantity is just right, and it produces a nice energy kick.  It's not sugary and it's not full of carbs.I don't personally prefer this flavor (like another flavor of this product better), but it's a nice, strong, bold espresso flavor.  I found it enjoyable, and if that's your favorite flavor, you will be delighted with this.  This if for someone who just wants a good strong coffee as opposed to something that tastes like a frappe with whipped cream and sugar.I think the price for twelve of these is a little steep, so I'll drop a single star, but it is a high quality beverage.

I have to admit that I am not a big fan of coffee, but if it's the right product, I usually love it. Like others who have reviewed this product, I really like the Starbucks bottled frappacinos you can buy in stores, and I figured that I would like this product due to the similarities. This product isn't terrible, but it's not really good either. It had a strong coffee flavor, a little stronger than I like, but there was also a weird aftertaste. I'd have to describe it was sour and bitter, but it wasn't the kind of sour/bitter aftertaste you get sometimes with "bargain" coffee brands; it had a unique bad aftertase all its own. I did like the jolt of energy that it had, but I could get the same amount of energy from tastier drinks. It seems like a lot of people like it, so I don't want to put it down entirely, but for me personally, it wasn't something that I enjoyed.

I had previously been purchasing Starbucks DoubleShots for my quick-morning-caffeine needs but they were overly sweet and rather high-calorie for such a little thing (140 for the regular an 70 for the 'Light')I found these originally at a convenience store and then started ordering in bulk from Amazon for more convenience and a bit better price.If you are expecting sugary or creamy these will not fit the bill but if you are looking for simple, iced coffee these are perfect.For the Caffeine junkies these have 155mg/can compared to the Doublshot's 130mg/can.

Usually I like my coffee hot. Part of the ritual of waking up was that aroma of freshly brewing coffee. But the work schedule has changed to mostly nights , and since the wife and I are now only opposite schedules , making a whole pot in the morning is wasteful.But I still need a boost in the afternoon , and a coworker suggested this. Glad she did. Turns out cold coffee is just as satisfying as hot coffee. The 6.8 oz size seems like just the right amount , and with no significant aftertaste , I can see this as fast becoming part of my afternoon ritual of staying awake !

column9: Not A Great Cold Coffee Drink, But Not Horrible Either
column10: Both my wife and I tried this to see how we liked it. My wife isn't much for cold coffee, but likes espresso when it is hot. I grew up in New England with iced coffee and love it, although I am not much of a fan of espresso drinks, either hot or cold.My wife's description was that it tasted watery and somewhat metallic and I had to agree with her on the metallic taste although to me, it tasted strong and like and espresso drink. I think if I were going to get something like this on a regular basis I would try other products to see if any are better.I suppose we would drink this in a pinch, but it is not a product we would go out of our way to buy.

column9: Starbucks is better but not by much.
column10: This product was tried by my entire family, everyone disliked it.  It had the espresso jolt but tasted metallic and stale.  Nobody wanted to finish the can. I like the Starbucks Coffee Frappuccino Coffee Drink Mocha, 9.5 Ounce Bottles-(pack of 12) better though they can be too cloying sweet.  This Illy was not too sweet it just tasted not fresh. I wouldn't recommend, just use your Keurig and make Coffee People Donut Shop Regular Iced Coffee, 22-Count and make your own FRESH iced coffee.

I love Illy coffee and thought I would enjoy this canned beverage as much as their lovely fresh brewed coffees.WRONG!!!There is absolutely no resemblence between Illy's coffee and this "drink."  It is bitter, and leaves a very strange "off" taste/feel in your mouth after consumption.
I got this for my husband, who is a coffee addict. His thoughts..."It had a flowery, bitter taste. I don't want to drink it again."

I enjoyed the illy issimo Coffee Drink.  While it is not equal to a freshly made iced coffee, it had a nice, rich coffee flavor and did not taste like the can.  For a quick iced coffee drink, it is worth the price, but it is a rather small serving and you will find it gone rather quickly.  I would prefer to have it in a larger container.I do recommend this product.

I'm so glad I discovered this illy product. I dislike canned coffee with milk--and this is basically just espresso and sugar. And good quality espresso to boot. I highly recommend this product if you like espresso and want a can of it to go.

column9: Strong espresso flavor with a hint of milk
column10: Strong espresso taste with a hint of mil, but a tiny bit bitter for me, yet not as much as the cappuccino flavor. If you like a little bitterness, then you'll prolly love this. Thankfully no can taste, which was a concern of mine. I prefer a bit more milk in mine (soy or rice).Otherwise not much to say - plain, no flavors, although I'm sure you could add your own if you want i, but taste fine just like it is.The bitterness was just a hint, which many regular espresso drinkers probably wouldn't notice - for me, it was enough to take off a star, but was still good. Don't know that I'll be buying a lot of it, but for that allergy or headache, when I use that caffeine, it would be great to have around to get rid of those.

column9: Less sweeter than the Cappuccino drink from illy issimo
column10: I prefer coffee with only a teaspoon of sugar and hot milk in the morning instead of the highly sweetened foufou drinks. Illy issimo makes a Cappuccino in a can that is too sweet for my taste. This Caffe drink suits me better. The Cappuccino drink I had to tweak with hot frothed milk. This Caffe was good straight from the can, but is a nice morning cup if warmed with the hot frothed milk.

I was a little reluctant to try this one.  Usually, my cold coffee drinks come with mounds of whipped cream.  However, I like the idea of something I can keep in my fridge and throw into my purse when I hit the road.I must say, from first taste, this was delicious.  The flavor is smooth and there was no discernible aftertaste.  The caffeine kick was good and it kept me going this morning at work.  The pricing is less than my usual coffee drinks and I can definitely see making this my summer go-to coffee!This one is a winner!  I'll be keeping my fridge stocked.BTW - The can says "do not shake".  I have no idea what happens when you shake, though.  :-)  I'll leave it to one of you to experiment with that!

I love coffee and I love espresso, but I've found that I prefer my `shot of espresso' to be accompanied (or to `accompany') something else.  Alone, left unfiltered, the strength of the espresso can be overwhelming.  For me, this illy issimo caffe drink is a tad too concentrated for my taste.  It has a very strong flavor, which many have praised saying that it is very close to the flavor of an espresso, but for me there is a bitter aftertaste that I can't ignore.  The colder you drink this, the stronger the aftertaste and so I found that letting it get closer to room temperature (slightly cooler, but not much) helped make this a more satisfying `sip'.  Still, I'm not as fond of this particular flavor.  I definitely liked the cappuccino flavor more.

Let me first start by saying: I don't drink hot coffee unless forced. I like coffee but I don't like hot drinks. I go for iced, or cold, or cold drinks like this product. I tried both the illy issimo Coffee Drink, Cappuccino, 8.45-Ounce Cans (Pack of 12)and far prefer this product.The taste is bold, smooth, and doesn't have the gritty texture that some canned coffees can bring with them. The taste is good, the feeling is good, and the aftertaste is just like the coffee, not a strange variation of it.I had a little issue with the cappuccino version becuase it had a bit of an emulsified oily feel on the tongue, but this one is good to go.  And at only 50 calories, I would always choose this option. The can is very small and would easily fit in a pocket, purse or bag if you wanted to take it to work or on a trip with you.Enjoyed and recommended.

column9: Good, but not as good as the Cappuccino
column10: I've tried both the illy issimo Caffe and the illy issimo cappuccino.  I gave the cappuccino 5 stars because it tastes like a creamy iced cappuccino made with espresso from a machine.The caffe is also good and also tastes legitimately like it's a not-strong espresso.  However, I didn't find it to be the same quality as the Cappuccino.  It's ok.  It tastes like an ok iced/sweetened espresso/caffe from an average coffee place.  I surely would drink it - it's just not a 5 star product.  Good.  Not great.Note: this drink does not have any kind of cream/milk in it.  It's a black/sweetened coffee.
Nice taste. Best served very cold. Sweet, but not overly so. Strong coffee flavor, but not bitter.The serving size is small.

There's a lot of flavor packed into this little 6.8 ounce can! You can chill it and enjoy it straight from the can or, as we did, pour it over ice and add some vanilla creamer for a fancier drink. This is a quality product that is from a little known company. Drink with confidence, it's yummy!

I have liked other illy issimo products, but not this one.  It's too bitter!  I didn't taste any sweetness.  In fact, to me, it tasted like 2 day old coffee mixed with tap water.  The first taste was not so bad - it was ok'ish, but the bitterness and feeling that it was just old stale coffee kept getting stronger and stronger.  It's nothing like the real thing over ice, even though I drank it well chilled.  I don't think I could have drank it at all any other way.  I'm giving it 2 stars though because it was a very effective pick up - the caffeine content gets a star by itself.

Nice flavor- I would have preferred it slightly sweeter, but as some other reviewers have said it's too sweet, that's clearly a personal preference.While the convenience is great, for the price, I'd rather get an iced coffee (with actual ice!) from the local coffee place. The serving size is fairly small (basically the same size as half a can of soda- not much at all if you like coffee), as well. But the portability is pretty great- it'd be good for grabbing on a hurry or if you're headed out to a picnic or some sort of day out somewhere and need to bring coffee with you.

column9: Good quick iced coffee with a mild jolt
column10: This illy issimo Coffee Drink, Caffè, 6.8-Ounce Cans is a good and quick iced coffee alternative for those of us who need the convenience from time to time, or for those of us who can sometimes feel a bit too lazy to make our own iced coffee. I really do like a good cup of coffee, but even with a 12-cup drip coffee maker, there's never enough to make iced coffee as much as I might like. I'm also one who as a rule drinks coffee black, with no sweeteners, cream or creamy substitutes.I've said 'iced coffee' as the minute I received it from Amazon, I noticed that it said "DO NOT SHAKE" imprinted four times around the rim of the 6.8-ounce can, so into the refrigerator it went for a couple of days.  Opened the can carefully, still wondering what the "DO NOT SHAKE" warning was all about, but it wasn't carbonated, so it was slowly poured into an 8-ounce glass.  At first taste, more of a coffee aficionado's tasting sip, it seemed a bit thin.  On second taste it got better, and a decent iced coffee taste emerged, slightly sweet, but with no objectionable artificial sweetener aftertaste.Reading on this, my illy issimo Caffè said on the can that it's a product of Denmark.  illycaffè SpA is based in Milan, Italy. Coca-Cola distributes it, so is this true international globalism in coffees? I don't know where the can is made.The product description here says that it's "sweetened with beet sugar" so that might account for this.  Beet sugar is more closely related to cane sugar, though there's only 10g sugar content, so I'm not too concerned with this light "touch of sweetness" cranking up a few pounds on the obesity index and I don't plan on drinking a six pack of this on a daily basis. Just glad to see that high-fructose corn syrup wasn't used as a sweetener.  Each can has 50 calories, according to the label, and digging here, the description states that there are 155 mg of caffeine. This puts this 6.8-ounce can just behind Starbuck's Grande (16 oz) iced coffee, which has about 165 mg of caffeine, and that's fine with me.Received this along with an order for illy issimo Coffee Drink, Cappuccino, 8.45-Ounce Cans, which also had that "DO NOT SHAKE" admonition on its rim,  but that's a separate taste issue into itself.Bottom Line:Doing the math, each 6.8 fluid ounce can here breaks down to just over two bucks per serving. If you were making your own coffee at home, a standard cup (8 fluid ounces) of even a premium grade of your favorite coffee would come in far cheaper, so this is no great bargain.  On the other hand, though I wouldn't call this "Caffè" an espresso, it subjectively does have a good taste, and it's far better than some of the caffeinated beverages that I've tried.  So breaking this down, here's my highly subjective rating:3-stars: simple 'bang-for-the-buck' value compared to regular home brewed coffee5-stars: good taste and good caffeine contentThat being said, I'll average this as a solid 4-star product when it comes to caffeinated enjoyment.  Your taste may differ.But one of these days I'm going to ignore that "DO NOT SHAKE" warning and just try it to see what happens...6/4/2012

column9: 2 1/2 Stars -- Too Bitter, Watery With Too Much Of A Caffeine Jolt For My Taste!
column10: I found the illy issimo Caffe Espresso flavored coffee drink to be drinkable but it is not a drink I plan to consume on any sort of a regular basis.While the drink does have an espresso-like taste, it is too bitter and watery to be worth over $2 for a 6.8 oz can. Further, its espresso flavor is just acceptable, nothing special. In addition to my considering this product to be  just an average, at best, drink, I found it gave me such a strong caffeine jolt that for over an hour after finishing it I had a bit of a pressure headache.

If I made my usual morning coffee in my coffee maker (I like it a little on the strong side), added a bit of sweetener and then put it in the refrigerator to cool down for about 24 hours, I would have this drink.  Pretty much exactly this drink.  The first thing I thought of when I took my initial swallow was that it tasted just like cold coffee.  The sweetness was just about where I like it - not too sweet, but not bitter either.  I can see where buying these small, 6.8 fluid oz. cans would be much easier and more convenient than making your own cold, black coffee if you tend to like it cold and take it with you in a hurry.  I'd down about 3 of these every morning if I could afford them.It tastes fine, really does.  I prefer cream with my coffee but I still thought this tasted pretty good - again, just like cold, black, slightly sweetened coffee. I found it smooth and easy to drink. I like ice-coffee and usually make it later in the day from the morning's left-over sitting in the pot. It has 155 mg of caffeine per can so I would assume it could be used as an energy booster for that lag time during the day around 2:00 - 4:00 pm.  The reason for 3 stars is though it tastes just like cold coffee, there is really nothing to distinguish it as something unusually wonderful and unique.And though I did not see it until after I had done it, at the very top of the can it says, "Do not shake".  Why, I don't know.  I shook it good and hard before opening. I guess they just want to keep bubbles from forming but I don't think the shaking altered the taste or texture whatsoever.

It's strong coffee but not aggressively so.  Slightly sweet but again not over the top.  The can labels it "Italian espresso style coffee drink" which would lead me to expect it to be much stronger.The can says "do not shake" which I did so I'm not sure how that impacts the taste.  The can says it has 50 calories for the eight ounce can with 1% daily sodium, 4% carbohydrates, and 4% fiber.  Per the can it contains coffee, sugar, potassium bicarbonate, potassium citrate; not a significant source of fat calories, saturated fats, trans fats, cholesterol, vitamin A,  vitamin C, calcium, iron.  It also states it's a Coca-Cola product made in Atlanta, Georgia, though it also says it's a product of Denmark.

column9: For the Coffee Lover, a Great Alternative to Other "Energy Drinks"
column10: This product describes itself as 100% Natural Arabic.  This is pretty much what it is -- coffee and a some sugar.  I assume that most people will be buying this for a "hit" of caffeine, so I'll compare it to some popular alternatives.Healthy?: Let's face it, most of the other "energy drinks" and caffeinated sodas on the market are chemicals and water. Some of them throw in a couple of vitamins to give the impression that they are healthy drinks, but most are not. Compared to those, this seems much healthier.  It is similar to drinking a brewed cup of coffee.  Is plain coffee healthy?  Probably more so than other "energy" options.Calories: This drink has 50 calories.  The same amount of cola would have about twice as many calories. and Red Bull would have about 80.  Obviously, the artificially sweetened alternatives to this would have very few.  So other than the artificially sweetened drinks, the calories in this are fairly low.Caffiene: It contains 155 mg of caffeine.  A similar amount of cola has about 20 mg.  This amount of "Red Bull" has about 66mg.  A cup of brewed coffee might have 100-200mg.  For its size, this has a pretty good caffeine punch to it.  I could definitely feel the caffeine "kick in" a little while after drinking this.Taste: I found the taste very enjoyable.  It tastes somewhat like moderatly sweetened, slightly diluted, black coffee.  If you like coffee, you should enjoy this as well.  However, if you like your coffee heavily sweetened and/or with lots of cream, this may taste  a little rough.Overall I enjoyed this product, can recommend it,  and will be buying more.

For a canned coffee drink this is pretty tasty. Its not overpowering in its strength, nor is it overly sugary either. Its a nice balance and definitely tastes like coffee.I would like the cans to be a bit bigger, but what could I expect for a 45 calorie drink? Even if you downed two or three, you'd still be making a much better nutritional choice than a regular iced coffee with cream from the 'bucks (which I truly love but do not for a second pretend is low calorie in any way).

I had previously tasted and loved the illy issimo Coffee Drink, Cappucino, 8.45-Ounce Cans (Pack of 12) so I figured I would give this one a shot and wasn't disappointed.The drink has a good balance between coffee and the sweetness. I thought the flavor was very similar to the iced coffee drinks I get from Starbucks and at about $1.92 per can the illy Caffe drink is a much better value. I chilled the can for several days before drinking and got a pretty good energy burst from the drink. With that being said I would like to mention that I'm only an occassional coffee drinker. I'll have a coffee or frappucino from Starbucks a few times a month so more frequent coffee drinker might not get the same energy boost I did.  Overall all I recommend this drink for coffee lovers who like to mix thiings up every once in a while.

column9: Great energy; sweet flavor to start, metallic to finish
column10: I buy illy coffee and espresso grounds on a fairly regular basis, as it is one of my favorite brands of coffee, so I was excited to try their issimo Coffee Drink, Caffe. The first thing to hit me was the sweetness, which was a little unexpected, since I don't normally drink coffee quite that sweet, but it wasn't too overpowering. The overall flavor was actually fairly robust, but missing that fresh-roasted bite, and had a somewhat unpleasant artificial/manufactured aftertaste (perhaps from being housed in a can?).I did, however, get a big energy perk from the coffee, which allowed me to focus and bolstered me through my morning work.Overall, I think I'll stick with fresh ground illy, as there is no beating fresh espresso in the morning. But, if I'm ever in a pinch and need a quick pick-me-up, I might consider grabbing a can as a quick substitute.

column4: T. Lee "God has died lots of times, but someo...
column10: This is rather like the illy cappuccino in a can.  Kind of bland, vaguely metal.  I'm not sure if this was supposed to be refrigerated or at room temperature, but then I'm not sure it would matter.  I wouldn't call myself a connoisseur of coffee, but still, this just didn't interest me.
This particular flavor is not my favorite, it's strong and very bitter.  I prefer the cappuchinno flavor to this.

I really liked the illy Cappuccino coffee drink I previously tried, so I thought I would enjoy this caffe' Italian Espresso style coffee drink as well. While this is less calories (50 per can) and has a really bold flavor, it is a bit too strong for my liking. Now if you are a regular espresso drinker, you will most likely enjoy this very much. I tend to go for my drinks on the sweeter side. I also felt this drink was a bit on the "watery" side. I would have liked it to bit creamier, but obviously that would mean more calories. I also believe espresso tends to be stronger in general. So lesson here: I should have known better because I am not a HUGE fan of espresso. Now that being said, it still was good enough that I would enjoy it occasionally as a mid-day pick me up drink because it certainly helped get me through a mid-day slump! It wasn't all that bad, just not something I, myself would drink everyday.

I was sent this illy issimo Caffe Coffee Drink by Amazon Vine for review. Here's my take on it.I love good strong coffee, espressos, lattes and cappuccino. I did not love this drink. I was looking for a strong coffee taste. Instead I got a diluted drink with a noticeable low-fat taste and a somewhat unusual aftertaste. The coffee flavor was non-existent, the low-fat milk flavor overpowering. Perhaps chilled over ice would improve the drinking experience, but I'm not interested enough to try another can.On the good side: the beverage contains only 50 calories.

Illy Issimo is a 6.8-ounce coffee treat in a can. I chilled mine in the refrigerator and drank it as a pick-me-up at work. Illy issimo coffee drink is smooth (there is no bitterness that is sometimes associated with iced coffee). Illy issimo is slightly sweet as well. It's a bit sweeter than simply one lump in a cup of coffee, but less sweet than a Cafe Cubana (espresso with sugar).Illy issimo is  a tasty coffee treat: it has the smooth bold taste of an espresso coffee sweetened with the right amount of sugar. Tastes great and very refreshing served chilled. A lot fewer calories and a lot more satisfying than a soda, I will stock illy issimo in my office fridge.A few notes about the product:50 Calories per canSodium 20mgTotal carb 12g*Fiber 1g*Sugars 10gCaffeine 155mgIngredients: Coffee, sugar, potassium bicarbonate, potassium citrate, "may contain trace amounts of milk"

column9: Good rich coffee with just a hint of metal
column10: I like my coffee strong and usually drink it black, and this coffee drink wasn't disappointing. I chilled the can first, was about to shake it until I saw the "Do Not Shake" warning in small type around the rim (glad I heeded it, after reading another review!) and sipped it with a straw. It has good strong coffee aroma and flavor, and wasn't too sweet. There was a bit of metallic aftertaste, but I guess that's to be expected with canned premade coffee. I'd get it again.

This little can packs a whole lot of energy!  Creamy and rich, the drink is best over ice and really provided a great pick me up midday.  It's very strong, but not bitter, and the smoothness makes you sip slowly to enjoy every last drop.  I will be stocking my fridge with these for certain.

In a nutshell:  Strong coffee with low sugar and no cream.  Nice energy drink alternative.What it is:  Coca-Cola's foray into canned coffee market (there was one?) in America.  This is Caffe version, which they say is "Italian espresso style coffee drink."  In actuality, it's a simple drink with 4 ingredients:  coffee, sugar, potassium bicarbonate, and potassium citrate (latter two as preservative, probably--although the can says it has no preservatives).  If you count the water and milk (as the can warns that it "may contain traces of milk"), 6 ingredients.  The can notes that it has 155mg of caffeine per can--roughly double that of Red Bull.  Only have 50 calories per can--which is a plus, and impressive given that it has no artificial sweetner.How it is:  Strong without being acidic, with a hint of sugar.  It's pretty smooth, but does have a noticeable bitter signature.  I could not chug this thing.  Note:  the can says "do not shake."  I'm not sure if you should drink it as is, though; wouldn't coffee need to be mixed?  Anyway, if you plan on shaking it, let it sit for a while after doing so; it squirts coffee all over the place when I tried to open it right after shaking.  Lesson learned.  The kick from the caffeine is very much noticeable.  Definitely a good thing to have for a quick pick-me-up.In conclusion:  You don't have to drink Red Bull for caffeine.  And you don't have to pick up a Starbucks Doubleshot (choke full of sugar and cream) as an alternative, either.  I think it's a nice product.Caveat:  Groceries will sell these for much cheaper.
I love this coffee.  This little can pops you in the mouth.  Nice bitter punch on the palate and kicks you in the gut.  The way I like my coffee.

I like coffee.  I do.  Particularly iced.  Now full disclaimer here: my norm is a cold brewed coffee so I am used to a very different coffee,  but I also partake in the the weekly  coffeehouse drink or rare canned drink like the type I am reviewing here.  When I saw on its page that it was claiming to be "bold" and an "espresso-style coffee drink with a touch of sweetness" at only 45 calories?  Well sign me up!  I figured worse case scenario well I'd dump it into a cup o' milk.  How wrong I was.  It was just bitter and nasty and wrong.  I never did figure out if it was the coffee itself or that "touch of sweetness"  but something in this tiny little can was not right and no amount of milk made it right.  I finally gave up, dumping it out, wasting a perfectly good cup o' milk.Shame, I had high hopes for it.

column9: At least it's not as bad as Diet Pepsi.
column10: A few weeks ago, I tried the illy issimo Cappuccino coffee drink, and didn't care for it. Part of it's probably because I rarely drink coffee, but I wasn't too thrilled about drinking what looked like brown water in a can. The Caffe flavor here doesn't fare any better, and I literally spit it out upon taking the first sip.Normally I'd go into the pros and cons about the product, like I do with my other reviews, but I can't think of anything to say other than I didn't like it. The flavor was an insult to my taste buds, it's still a gross-looking clear brown color, and while it might not be that bad for you as far as nutrition goes, you can still do better.I'm going to leave this one to coffee regulars who are used to this kind of taste.

column9: Bland espresso plus non sparkling seltzer equals yuk!
column10: I love illy coffee. I think it is among the finest in the world. I even enjoy illy iced coffee in the can--but not this version. It tasted like bland epresso mixed with nonsparkling seltzer. Only 50 calories but I wIsh they added more calories if it meant this would be tastier. Not sweet at all. Sorry illy. It is a miss.

column9: A real shot in the arm!
column10: This was a rather intense shot of caffinated adrenaline that actually took me by surprise. As this is an espresso drink the flavor might not be for those who don't like bitter & prefer sweet, However if you are looking for a rather immediate caffeine boost than this will certainly do the trick.

It definitely tastes like espresso...bitter and strong. It doesn't necessarily translate to a chilled drink that well, in my opinion. It's good, just not great. If you're really looking for that espresso flavor in chilled form, this is recommended. Otherwise, stick with their cappuccino version...it tastes much better.

column9: The illy issimo Caffè Tastes Good if You Like Black Coffee
column10: I'm sleep deprived because I work two jobs and, therefore, drinking coffee is a matter of survival for me.  I drink iced coffee during the hot summer months.  I jumped at the opportunity to sample the illy issimo Caffè, which is Coca-Cola's attempt to make a profit from America's sudden craving for iced coffee.  Everyone from McDonald's to IHop is selling it.  Normally, I make my own iced coffee at Panera Bread.  The illy issimo Caffè looks and tastes like black, bitter coffee, which I detest.  See the photographs that I have posted showing how dark it is compared to other leading espresso coffee brands such as Starbucks Doubleshot Espresso & Cream (Starbucks Doubleshot Espresso & Cream 6.5 oz x 8 Cans) and Rockstar Roasted Coffee + Energy Mocha [(Pack of 24) Rockstar Roasted Espresso Energy Drink 8 oz ea].  Overall the illy issimo Caffè has less calories and fat per serving.  I posted photos depicting its nutritional value and ingredients.  However, the Starbucks tastes the best; naturally it has more fat and sugar.  On the other hand, the Rockstar gave me more energy, but it has a strange, sweet taste; the Rockstar is loaded with vitamins and minerals.  All three brands of coffee drinks are high in caffeine.  Starbucks doesn't have to worry about competition from Coca-Cola.  Starbucks exceptional taste, in lieu of nutritional benefits, will lure customers.  Most consumers drink iced coffee for its taste rather than its nutrition.  Furthermore, I don't understand why illy issimo Caffè has "Do Not Shake" on their cans.  No one else does.  I posted a photograph of a Starbucks Mocha Frappuccino Coffee Drink [Starbucks Coffee Frappuccino Coffee Drink Mocha, 9.5 Ounce Bottles-(pack of 12)]; notice the ingredients that have settled at the bottom of the glass bottle.  I always shake my cans and bottles of coffee; the coffee may look frothy when I pour it but it has never spewed like carbonated sodas.  Illy issimo Caffè is only recommended for those who like their coffee black with a touch of sugar.  I believe it would be less expensive to make one's own coffee, refrigerate it until cool and then pour it over ice.  Rather than throw it away, I've brought home leftover coffee from my Sunday school class and put it in my refrigerator.  Later, when I ate dinner, I'd pour the coffee into a tall glass full of ice.  I'd add Stevia (Sweetleaf Sweetener 70 Packets) and milk until my sweet tooth was satisfied.  Speaking of Stevia, which is an all-natural sweetener with zero calories, I had to pour Stevia into my glass of illy issimo Caffè before I could finish drinking it.  I ran out of milk or I would have added some of that also.Joseph B. Hoyos

column4: Ursula K. Raphael "AstraDaemon of The Zombiep...
column10: I liked the Issimo cappucino drink, so I thought I would give this a try...the taste is horrible! I've had other expresso drinks (both hot and cold), so I thought I knew what to expect, but this tasted so vile that I could barely finish it. The only good thing I can say is that it definitely gives a boost to the afternoon lag.

This was a really unsatisfactory beverage in taste and aftereffects. I'm not a huge fan of coffee in a can or jar, having partaken of two widely nationally available brands and found them lacking for a coffee fanatic such as myself (consuming an average of 4-6 cups a day). I was hoping that the Italians (via Denmark, where this product is made) would get it right. Sadly, the Illy Espresso company has failed abysmally with this product. The weird thing was that it tasted fine for the first sip: a nice, bracing bittersweet espresso flavor. The second sip, it seemed a little tinny. Then it was salty. But I was committed to finishing this drink to the full, 6.8 fluid ounce end. The bitter end. Because while I got a faint coffee buzz, I also got major heartburn and a stomachache within a half hour of consumption. I'm guessing as an amateur chemist that adding baking soda (potassium bicarbonate, 20 mg sodium per serving in the drink) with an alkaline Ph interacts negatively with coffee's more acid Ph.  Well, I've popped an antacid, and I will say that this product has convinced me that there are no shortcuts in life. If you want decent coffee, make it yourself. This product contains 156 mg of caffeine per serving. If that's what you're looking for, there are other options that won't feel like you drank battery acid.

column9: Approved by an old school coffee snob
column10: I am a coffee freak; I probably need to find a support group.  Coffee is one of my pleasures that I fully embrace and I have no problem admitting it.  However, I am a standard coffee guy.  I don't like the coffee drinks that aren't really coffee, those mixtures that have tons of cream, flavor, sugar, syrup, whip cream, flavor shots and one drop of coffee.  I am a standard coffee drink with a touch of cream and sugar.  Oh and it should be noted I love my coffee HOT.  I am not really a fan of iced coffee.This brings us to this canned coffee beverage that is served cool.  I will confess, I have had a couple of ice coffee drinks that didn't taste bad, if mixed properly and having the right balance of cream and sugar.  Yet this isn't my preferred method of consumption.  Notwithstanding, I decided to give this can of espresso a chance.  After I chilled it over night I gave it a taste.  I must confess the flavor is very nice and smooth.  There is no cream in this beverage, just a hint of sweetness.  I found this to promote a nice balance.  I could tell by the taste a high end blend of coffee was use to make this product.Overall, I am still a guy who will always grab his hot coffee before an ice coffee.  Yet this little can really has a good flavor.  Perhaps it is the fact that the star of this drink is the coffee itself.  There are no flavors or syrups that distract from the coffee, which makes this drink very enjoyable.  In addition, the drink isn't all that big, under 7oz and at 50 calories this beverage is better for the waist than some of the fluffy faux coffee beverages out there.  So coming from a real coffee drinker, I would recommend this drink if I decided that I wanted to venture towards a cooler cup of coffee.

column9: Drink isn't bad, but the Caffè flavor isn't to my taste
column10: I like coffee, and although I don't really drink it every day, sometimes I just really crave the flavor. I might tackle that craving with a regular cup of coffee, some coffee flavored ice cream or a cold coffee drink.I occasionally like a latte or espresso drink, but usually have them hot. I was interested in the illy issimo Coffee Drink, Caffè flavor when I saw it and decided I had to try it.While I like a nice hot espresso, I have to say I don't much care for this drink. It definitely does remind me of a cold espresso, but apparently I don't much like my espresso cold.I don't think this is a fault of the way the drink is made - more likely it just doesn't suit my taste. I should mention that I have also tried illy issimo Coffee Drink, Cappuccino, 8.45-Ounce Cans (Pack of 12) and liked it better than this Caffè flavor.While I don't necessarily care for it, I think it may appeal to others. If you like strong coffee drinks that aren't sweet and think the flavor sounds good to you, I'd recommend giving it a try. If you prefer a milder coffee drink that is sweeter, you will find the cappuccino flavor more to your liking.

That is the third ingredient.  Potassium citrate is the fourth.Is potassium bicarbonate a "natural" ingredient, since it is found rarely in nature?  I drink coffee every day and have never added these two chemicals to my cup of coffee.I have read that potassium citrate is used as a diuretic, particularly in veterinary treatments.  Was it really necessary to add these two chemicals to the "Espresso Style" coffee mix?  If it had been nothing but plain black coffee of typical good illy quality, then it would have rated a 5.  I will not be buying it.

This is the first canned coffee drink that I have tried, and I have to admit it's not for me. The flavor was strong and too bitter for my preferences.If that's what you are looking for, though, this is right up your alley. I'll keep my coffee hot and in a mug.

I love coffee. I love iced coffee. I do not like this. It's not good. I am pretty tolerant of tastes being a little off, but this is way off. It has a stange consistency too. Almost like it is carbonated a little. I couldn't even finish this and I did give it a chance. I studied business in Italy for several months and love a good espresso and even like it chilled. This is not even close to being something I would crave. This is one of the few 'do not buy this' reviews, but I can't recommend this product.

EDIT: I love coffee, but to me, this drink is just strong coffee grounds mixed with water. It has a potent aftertaste and a grainy texture. Hours after I drank a few sips (couldn't handle much after a few) and brushed my teeth, I could still taste this! Very unappealing. This product is definitely not for me.

If you've read any of my other reviews regarding coffee, you know I'm a coffee lover... and I like it strong!  The illy issimo caffé Italian espresso style coffee drink met my expectations.  I divided my 6.8 fl oz can into 3 portions, so that I could try it in different ways.  I had it in a mug after warming it in the microwave and then warmed with some milk, as well as in a glass over ice.  Since it is a little sweet, I preferred it with milk or over ice.  However, it's not bad alone, and would probably be good chilled straight out of the can.  It is made primarily with natural Arabica beans and sugar, with 50 calories and 12g carb per serving.  It also has 20 mg of sodium and 155 mg of caffeine.  I like it!

The history of illy issimo coffee dates back to 1933 in Trieste, Italy. With decades of experience and accomplishments the brand has become a favorite of chefs and barristas in Italy and around the world.This 6.8-ounce can of illy issimo Italian espresso-style coffee with 155 mg caffeine has a strong flavorful full-bodied taste with a touch of sweetness. I found it a big energizer. The ingredients are a blend of 100% Arabica coffee, sugar, potassium bicarbonate and potassium citrate. There are only 45 calories per can. The label says illy issimo's bold, full-bodied, Italian espresso-style coffee is made with the finest natural ingredients and will "awaken the senses while you're on-the-go." I can vouch for that.

column9: Surprise!  A sweetened drink that is not too sweet
column10: I was very disappointed when I found this coffed drink contained sugar.  I drink my coffee & expresso black, and I find soft drinks to be too sweet and thick.  I dilute diet colas with sparkling water.So it was really nice to try this coffee drink, and find that the bitterness and the sweetness were in a nice balance, to my taste.  And the thickness than many sugared soft drinks have was not present in this drink.I'd still prefer an unsweetened version, but this was a nice surprise.

I have been extremely impressed with the illy canned drink line and this was no exception.  It's a refreshing boost of caffeine which offers a great balance between the boldness of the coffee and its sweetness.  Perhaps the biggest selling point was the lack of a bitter aftertaste.I'd recommend this for those who enjoy straight up espresso drinks and for those looking for an afternoon pick-me up.  This is one of the better coffee drinks I've had.

For those who enjoy a more exotic kind of coffee experience, this product may just fit the bill. I am not overly taken with expresso coffee, but this small can was surprisingly refreshing. I drank mine cold, not iced, though I'm sure over ice with a dash of milk would also be good. I would be more than tempted to try some of the other flavors based on this experience.

This is a small can of iced espresso with a bit of beat sugar in it.  Little more and little else.It offers "a touch of sweetness" and it's a very light touch to be sure.  It's not nearly sweet enough for my tastes and could almost pass for unsweetened.  Personally, I'd prefer that they either made it sweetened or unsweetened, and not something in the middle, which this is.The quality of espresso seems pretty good.  It's dark, full-bodied and flavorful.  I personally prefer some milk, cream or frothe in my drink, but that boils down to personal preference.Would I buy it again?  Probably not, but again it's a personal preference thing.  I do prefer some of their cappuccino-style drinks a lot more.But if this is what you're looking for, I suppose it's perfectly fine.

column9: Overall quite tasty for a can of coffee
column10: Illy Issimo Coffee Drink - First, it smells wonderful.  I wasn't expecting it to be sweet.  The drink has a great espresso flavor with a hint of cocoa and milk.  It was good.

The "illy issimo caffe" Italian Espresso Style Coffee Drink is delicious and remarkably non-acidic. I drank a swallow of the caffe at room temperature and could taste the espresso flavor without the bitter aftertaste. After heating it, the dark thick texture and rich aroma were very pleasing. The caffe is sweetened with 10g of sugar per 6.8 FL OZ can, so no additional sweetener is needed. If you have a sensitive stomach, you will like the low acidity maintained by the potassium bicarbonate additive. It is very smooth to swallow and does not irritate the stomach like many espresso products. Low acidity often comes with a reduction in caffeine, but each can of this caffe has 155 mg of the stimulant (about the same as regular brewed coffee with a shot of espresso).  I am definitely going to order a case of the caffe through Amazon at the reasonable price point (a little less than $2 per can).

column9: Illy Issimo Is A Great Pick-Me-Up
column10: The great thing about Illy Issimo Coffee Drink for me was that fact that I could sip on it in my office and actually feel it giving me that added boost that I needed.Hot coffee in the a.m. is a normal thing for me, but to have something cool, refreshing and energizing in the middle of the day is a welcome experience. Not to be gulped down for sure. This is one of those drinks you will want to take your time and enjoy.

I was a little skeptical at first on this one, but I actually really liked it. This was just a good can of strong coffee... cold.I hardly noticed any sweetness to it, and this is coming from a person who drinks it straight from the pot.

This is just like drinking a can of plain, strong black coffee.  There is sugar in it, so it's slightly sweet, but don't buy this expecting a nice sweet and creamy coffee drink.  It says on the side of the can "Italian Espresso Style Coffee Drink" and that's what it is.  I don't really know what "Caffe" means, but this drink is nothing but black coffee with sugar in it.  If you know that's what you want, I'm sure you'll be happy with it.  It has a nice smooth taste and my husband and I both really liked it.

column9: A nice pick-me-up to get you through the day
column10: Illy CafféTitle:  "A nice pick me up to get you through the day"In the sweltering heat of summer, a nice cool refreshing coffee can really get you through the day.  In the east coast iced coffee seems to be everywhere, but in the midwest canned coffee seems to be the only way to get your fix.Unlike that Seattle chain of coffee, this canned coffee has a much smoother flavor.  A touch of sugar and creaminess makes it a good treat at only 45 calories a can.  I had one after a workout and it was a nice way to keep me going.  I'd still prefer brewed coffee, but I'll keep this one at the fridge at work whenever I'm lazy.

Nice coffee break and only 50 calories.  I am not a huge coffee drinker and prefer my coffee hot, but I still thought this product was pretty good.  Now my husband is much more of a coffee drinker and he really liked this product.It definitely provides full-bodied coffee flavor and the fact that this only chalks up 50 claories is a huge plus.  I also think the size is just right--although my first impression was that is was a bit small.

My husband loves espresso.  We have a bialetti that he regularly uses at home to make espresso here.  I was once told by an espresso lover that a bialetti is the best way to make espresso.  All that to say-- it is something that my husband loves.  Typically, we use illy espresso to make his espressos at home, so he was excited to try this.  He has enjoyed Starbucks Doubleshots, but truly prefers a smooth espresso with just a touch of sugar.  This illy fits that bill!  The Starbucks doubleshot has a touch of cream in it--my husband explained to me that it needs that bit of cream in order to give it a smooth flavor.  The illy doesn't need it.  It's so smooth without the cream that it's better than a doubleshot.  And for a 12 pack, it's $13 cheaper for 12 ($36 vs. $23).  That sounds a lot better to me!

I love strong coffee and I love iced coffee so this little can is a whopping good time.  I grabbed this on my way out to work one morning and the only complaint I have is that it doesn't come in a bigger can.  However, the strong taste is probably best in moderation.  It tasted freshly brewed and hit the spot. It also gave me that much needed caffeine boost on my way.  Hope they develop some more flavors in the future.

I found this cold coffee beverage to be pleasant. It has a full-bodied coffee aroma, and a nice smooth coffee flavor. There are fifty calories worth of sweetener in it, meaning it is a sweetened coffee, but only mildly so. I enjoyed it over ice. As it comes in the can, it is a straight sweetened coffee beverage with no cream. It is enjoyable as it is, though I enjoyed it most with a bit of milk added and over ice. It contains 155 mg of caffeine (a can of Mountain Dew contains 54 mg and Red Bull contains 80 mg, by comparison), so it could serve as an "energy drink." It's not fresh-brewed coffee, but if you have a taste for chilled coffee beverages and are turned off by the overly sweetened varieties that are usually available cold, this one may be worth a try. It is expensive, though, and it seems overpriced for what you get. Though the flavor is good, I think I will settle for a cheaper alternative. It doesn't live up to a good cold-press coffee in my estimation.

column4: Simon Cleveland "Author of 'Descent: The R. C...
column9: A nice kick start in the AM
column10: Highly recommend this illy product. Takes wonderful, gives a nick kick in the morning and generally keeps the energy level high for several hours. If you love coffee in a can, this is your product.

column9: Pretty impressive for a canned product!
column10: This Illy product is the first one to actually capture true espresso flavor in a can. Sweetened the way one needs to bring out the full caramel complexity of the bean. If you like dark coffee, and want a can without dairy (or prefer to add your own milk) this is a very nice option.

column9: Smoother than Starbucks Double Shot and nice as an Ice-blended too!
column10: I was very pleasantly surprised by the Issimo Caffè canned drink.  at 6.8 ounces it's about the right size to drink right out of the can or to split in half to make Ice-blendeds.  I tried it both ways and found the cofee taste to be strong enough for my taste but free of any bitter aftertaste or metal "can tatse" that I sometimes get with Starbucks.  With 10 grams of sugar, it is a little sweet right out of the can but I'm OK with that.  I liked it better mixed with some nonfat milk and unsweetened dark chocolate powder dissolved into hot water and made into a reasdy-made syrup I keep in the fridge.  It whipped up nicely and at a much lower calorie and sugar oad than a Frappuccino.I've been looking for a new canned coffee item to keep in the office and at home for some time since Amazon stopped carrying the Cinnabon Lattes in cans.  This has about the same amount of suagr but 20 or so fewer calories so I'm pleased.  I can see myself skipping trips to Starbucks and/or Coffee bean & tea leaf and saving myself a signficant amount of money!  Hey, I like that!  Give it try.  It's pretty much straight brewed espresso with some usual preservatives and of course the sugar.  No added oils or thickeners or colrings like the Crushed bettles in the strawberry Frappucinos from Starbucks - so what you see is what you get.  What you get is a nice, smooth cold Espresso that you can pound down instead of a nasty red Bull or sip slowly and enjoy the taste. Issimo makes canned Cappuccinos as well.

column9: For those who like/love strong coffee....
column10: illy issimo Caffe is a strong coffee drink.One 6.8 oz can contains 50 calories, approximately 2 1/2 tsp. sugar, & 155 mg of caffeine.If you like strong coffee, you'll probably like this drink. I prefer mild to medium tasting coffee.After chilling & sampling illy issimo Caffe drink from the can,  I  added sugar, cream & ice to the rest..and enjoyed a perfect cup of iced coffee.

I don't drink a lot of coffee mostly because I find it so difficult to find the blend of blackness and cream and sugar. Temperature is also a difficult think to master (it always seems too hot or too cold!) However, this coffee blend is a masterful mix of my favorite sweetness, creaminess, and blackness. It's rich, but not too rich. It's sweet, but not too sweet. And no bitter aftertaste!  I refrigerated it and thought it tasted great cold.With that being said, I would never spent $2 on a little tiny 6.8 can of it. But if coffee is important to you, this is a great-tasting product. And a great--albeit unhealthy--way to boost your energy!

"illy issimo Coffee Drink, Caffè" packs a potent coffee hit in a small package with only 50 calories. Of course, because the coffee flavor was so rich, after a few sips I took the opportunity to make a fabulous dessert drink. I poured the "illy issimo" coffe drink into a large, tall glass, and added a big spoonful of sugar and some whole milk (cream would be even better). I stirred it well and added some ice, and the rest is history. Yum, yum, yum! How convenient to have such coffee richness in a small, portable package. Perfect on its own, but full of possibilities!

column9: illy issimo Coffee Drink Caffè SHOULD have added Expresso Caffè - LOVED IT!
column10: This illy issimo Coffee Drink Caffè from Coca~Cola / Coke - is really strong, just like a Caffè or Cafè Expresso should be: whereas frankly I am surprised it lacks a surname of "Expresso" added on to it! It packs a lot of punch into it, so if you are a Caffè or Cafè Expresso lover - YOU WILL LOVE THIS no doubts about it. ONLY 50 CALORIES IN A CAN! However the name of Expresso is in tiny print on the back of the can pertaining to the history; but I feel it still should be up front and just under the label. EXPRESSO LOVERS - THIS ONE'S FOR YOU!

I received both the Caffe and Cappuccino versions and did a side-by-side taste comparison to see which of the two I might prefer over the other.First I tried the Caffe version and was surprised to discover it was just black coffee. I prefer cream in my coffee, so I was hesitant to taste it as it was. But I tasted it and found it to have a nice medium coffee strength with a bit of sweetness to it. In my everyday coffee I don't add sugar, but on occasion it's nice to have a special coffee drink, and since it's been hot here lately, I had poured it over ice as well. I added cream and found it to be quite enjoyable. It's one of those conveniences that one could easily become addicted to.Next I tried the Cappuccino which had a similar taste and flavor as the Caffe, but was milder. I prefer my coffee stronger, so my preference was for the Caffe and still I would have liked it stronger (perhaps this is offered in another version). But the Cappuccino was also good and I had poured it over ice as well. I was concerned about both coffees being packaged in cans as I don't like my drinks to have a metallic tinge to them, but I did not notice anything out of the ordinary. I had, however, poured the drinks over ice into a glass, so that may have helped. Regardless, it was really nice to have sitting out on my deck on a warm day. Hot coffee just does not sit well with me in hot weather.All-in-all, if you're looking for a mild, sweet coffee drink that's quick and easy to take with you on the go or to pour into a glass at home, this is a good choice. It's small and convenient to slip into a purse or briefcase. While the coffee is mild, it still gives a quick pick-me-up in the morning, or in the middle of the day if need be.

I have tried the cappuccino version of this drink (which is great), and was excited to try this drink, following the instructions I did not shake.  I opened the drink and took a sip, the coffee is strong and has a full body, and has a good taste (for canned coffee), however (I am not sure if this is from transport, or what), the coffee is very watered down and I feel like I am tasting mostly a watered down coffee (like iced coffee where the ice has melted).  The watered down taste of the coffee sticks with you, so be prepared to need something to clean your palate afterwards.I do not know if the one I got went through some sort of shock or excess moisture phase during shipping to fridge, but I found it to taste watered down (not sure if it was just mine or all), the coffee is very strong and has a bold taste, but due to the watering down it takes a way from the flavor and makes it tough to drink.

Calories 50Total Fat 0gSodium 20mgTotal Carb 12g  Fiber 1g  Sugars 10gProtein 0gIngredients: Coffee, Sugar, Potassium Bicarbonate, Potassium CitrateI am not a hot coffee drinker, but I occasionally enjoy some of the iced coffee varities and I wanted to give this a try. It is not a drink for me. I could not take more than two sips of this. It has a VERY strong coffee taste and to me is very bitter. If you love the taste of coffee, you will probably enjoy this.

column9: Not too bad for espresso on the go
column10: This coffee drink was surprisingly much better than expected considering the other reviews I read.  Its a cold Espresso drink.  Upon its arrival I stuck the can in the fridge for a couple days for it to chill.  I took it out, opened it and poured into a glass.  It has a rich coffee flavor without any bitterness reported by the other reviewers and it wasn't sweet to me.  The can states not to shake, and I think the wording means > No Need to Shake.I think the secret to this little caffe on the go is to make sure its good and cold.

If you find yourself out on the road past your bedtime, you may be looking for something to keep you awake.  There are endless concoctions available: colas, 'energy drinks', tablets.  Here's another.  This little can packs a fairly potent wallop that comes on in just a few minutes.  It has a sweetened coffee-like taste that isn't bad--but that's not the point.It's called espresso, but it really isn't.  There are none of the aromatics that make the experience of espresso what it is.  At home, I'll take the time to grind the beans and brew a real cup.  But if you're looking for that teeth-gritting buzz that keeps you between the median line and the shoulder of the road, this might do it.

I should start by saying my general tastes in coffee lean towards the sweeter drinks, flavored lattes and milky beverages. For me, this was a little to bitter for my tastes. My husband, however, enjoyed this very much. He is a black coffee, no flavor shots in the latte,  kind of guy. He thought this tasted like iced espresso. For me, I like the cappucino version of this beverage better, but if you are a more no frills kind of coffee drinker, this beverage may be more your speed.
i like illy in general and this makes a very drink.  a little bit more bitter than illy cappuccino and just the right size.

To me the illy issimo Coffee Drink, Caffe had a very bitter taste to it. I was not smooth as I expected it to be. It also has an after taste which I did not like. It is strong like Coffee and Expresso sould be, but I don't think it should it be bitter.

column9: Strong coffee in easy to drink little can
column10: Four individual coffee lovers from different cultural backgrounds conducted a sampling of the illy issimo Coffee Drink, Cappucino, 8.45-Ounce Cans (Pack of 12) side by side with this illy issimo Coffee Drink, Caffè, 6.8-Ounce Cans (Pack of 12) and we had an exact split on the selection of a favorite between both samples.  Of note is that the Caffe single serving can is a couple ounces smaller and half the calories.  My personal preference was the Caffe because I found it to taste fresher, less like a canned beverage, less sweet, and stronger in the coffee flavor.I gave away my Nespresso machine and currently do not have an electric espresso maker other than the Delonghi EMK6 Alicia Electric Moka Espresso Coffee Maker and prefer very strong coffee.  I still make it on the stovetop or prepare French drip coffee.  I sometimes use Splenda and froth steamed milk.  I used to roast green coffee beans but have also given away my roasters.  I grind beans prior to preparing coffee.  Just a little history for my frame of reference in writing this review.I liked the Caffe much better than the Cappucino.  Because I seldom use sugar, my first taste was of a very sweet, strong coffee, but when I continued drinking, it appeared to be less sweet.  According to my computations, this contains over a tablespoon of sugar, way more sweetener than I'd add to any beverage.  Nevertheless, the coffee flavor was very good and I will try the illy issimo Coffee Drink, Caffè (No Sugar), 6.8-Ounce Cans (Pack of 12).  The information provided says these beverages contain no preservatives, but each has potassium bicarbonate, potassium citrate listed as ingredients.  I don't know about the usual life expectancy of the illy beverages, but my can expires in less than two months from now.Our natural instinct is to shake a non-carbonated beverage, but there are strict instructions stating that the can is not to be shaken.  The can is nice to look at, smaller than a soda can and may cause problems in a beverage holder if you take these on a road trip.  Since I prefer to have my beet sugar come from the whole beet, I would pass on this beverage, but would recommend it to a person who likes a strong coffee in a cute can that chills well, has an easy to lift aluminum tab, and is probably very nice over ice.  It's better than an average canned coffee beverage.

Illy Issimo's Coffee Drink is slightly sweetened with sugar and contains 155mg of caffeine.  The taste is mild and their is little aroma.  The aftertaste is unpleasant and otherwise the drink tastes like coffee that has sat out for a while.

column9: A little shot of Italian Caffe
column10: Recently I tried Illy's Cappucino product and I loved it.  I decided ti give it  a try with Caffe, Italian Espresso style coffee drink.  Drink comes is a small 6.8 oz can that is easy to pack and carry.  I drank my coffee cold.  One cannot go wrong with drinking it on room temperature either.  Can does not require shaking; drink contains 50 calories  and no fat.  This drink is stronger than cappucino and a little bit bitter.  There is disticnt flavor and strenght in each drink.  I liked both, but my preference in the morning is coffee with some milk in it.  For that reason, I would recommend Caffe as afternon "pick me up" type of drink.This product is made in Italy and it is distributed in USA by Coca-Cola company.  This fine Arabica bean coffee will give you Italian espresso experience.  There is nothing better than an old world coffee drink (in my opinion).

I tried this flavor and the mocha flavor, also available from vine. I prefer the mocha flavor over this one. This one is a very strong coffee flavor with no milk or flavors to water it down and I do not like strong coffee.

column9: Good in a Pinch, But Definitely Not to Replace
column10: For those who are going on a hike, a run, or basically anywhere else you can't get a decent coffee, Illy Issimo Coffee Drink isn't a bad idea.  I didn't think it was overly sweet, and when cold, it tasted okay for a canned coffee.  However, if given the choice between making my own iced coffee and putting it into a travel cup, or grabbing one of Illy Issimo canned coffee, I would opt for the travel mug iced coffee.  Two main reasons - 1) one less can to go into the trash (or recycling, if lucky) and 2) homemade iced coffee tastes a LOT better.  In fact, here is a recipe that's easy AND stores well:  [...]That aside, Illy Issimo isn't too bad.  It may not appeal to all however (my husband thought it tasted awful), so I would definitely try before you buy it in bulk.

I'm a fan of coffee, but I like it sweet. I want to taste the flavor of the coffee, but the sweetness adds depth and richness to it. This little coffee in a can was good, but not as sweet as I prefer.

column9: Thoughts from an experienced illy drinker
column10: A little background:  I own a Gaggia for illy espresso machine Gaggia for Illy Espresso Machine that works with illy single-serve pods illy iperEspresso Capsules Dark Roasted Coffee, 5-Ounce, 21-Count Capsules illy iperEspresso Capsules Medium Roasted Coffee, 5-Ounce, 21-Count Capsules.  I like the flavor of illy espresso, but my favorite is still the Nespresso line of coffee Nespresso Citz D110 Espresso Machine, Silver Chrome.  When I saw that Coca-Cola was distributing illy in-a-can from Denmark, I immediately thought it might be a nice cold drink for my early morning, one-hour commute into the city.This morning I pulled two cans from the frig and drank them as I drove to work.  I tasted both the "caffe" and the "cappuccino" illy issimo Coffee Drink, Cappucino, 8.45-Ounce Cans (Pack of 12)flavors.  Here are my thoughts:  The coffee in these cans is nothing like what you make at home in your espresso machine--the richness is missing.  illy makes a medium and a dark roast; the coffee in these cans are more like the medium roast--definitely not dark.  But, bottom line, coffee in a can tastes exactly like you feared it would:  Coffee with that "special" canned taste.Comparing the two flavors that I sampled this morning, I like the cappuccino better than the caffe.  I think the cappuccino works better than the caffe as a cold drink.  The caffe was not a drink to be chugged down.  It is suited to sipping as it is not a thirst-quencher.  With the first few sips, I noticed a pronounced tangy flavor that I did not care for.  By the time I got half-way through the can, I had pretty much gotten used to the tang and it didn't bother me.I did not notice any bitterness in either of the flavors.Be aware of the size of these cans:  They are not as large as soda pop cans.  They are narrow cans, with the cappuccino can about an inch taller than the caffe can.  I mention this because I had trouble finding a place to set them in my vehicle's console because they are so narrow.  Your vehicle's can-holder space will be too large for these cans.  You  would have to wedge them in somehow to keep them from toppling.So, as with most everything else that you buy for convenience-sake, with these coffee drinks you sacrifice flavor for handiness.  If you really don't have time in the evening to put together a bottle of iced coffee for your morning commute, then the cappuccino is not a bad drink.  If you like a sweet coffee and if you like milk in your coffee, then the cappuccino is not a bad choice.  Personally, even though I don't have any extra time in the evening, I think I'll try to find the time to build myself an iced coffee for the morning--because I've just realized that it is very pleasant to have cold coffee to drink for my long commute, and canned coffee is not to my taste.

column9: Good if you like a quick cold coffee type beverage
column10: This is good if you need a quick cold coffee fix.  Otherwise, save your money and brew your own and ice it.  The flavor was good, but not something that knocked my sox off.  Would I buy it? If it was on sale and if I was going on a road trip.

I usually avoid cold coffee drinks. They are usually too oily, sweet, milky or bland.  I was most pleasantly surprised by this drink. The touch of sugar adds more smoothness than sweetness to the robust expresso bite.  It contains no fat but has 12 grams of carbs. The small, slender can is easy to transport and the pop top makes for easy opening.I enjoyed this product.  In addition to using it as a beverage, a little bit enhances the flavor of chocolate baked goods (think brownies) and cuts the sweetness of buttercream frosting. So skip the run to Dunkin Donuts for an iced coffe and pop open a can of illy issimo instead.

column9: Illy stands for refreshing coffee drinks to me!
column10: This is my second Illy coffee drink to try and review- Again I wasn't disappointed. It had a nice strong coffee flavor, not too sugary.. Gave me the perfect coffee fix!! The perfect on the go drink when I don't have time to brew my own. I will be purchasing more of Illy coffee drinks in the future- Love my Starbucks but their drinks have gotten more sugary for me!

I'm a coffee drinker, and an energy drink drinker as well.  This product was a decent, but not incredible mix between the two.  The Caffe tasted like a cold shot of expresso, with lots of sugary sweetness added to it.  I did notice a little pick me up for a couple hours before it wore off.  For the price it isn't bad, it works at keeping you awake, but I probably would just drink a cup of hot coffee instead of this next time.  If you're a cold coffee drinker, you may be more inclined to like it.

Well, reviews for this drink are all over the place, so I can't say my review is definitive. Anyway, this drink met with negative results, here - too sweet and rich, but, it would be best to judge for yourself or look at several reviews. For me, not being a regular coffee drinker, I prefer a cold Coca Cola or iced tea, rather than any iced coffee drink anytime. Plus, at about $2 for a can, too expensive for me - but I'm a cheapskate, so keep that in mind.

column9: You Have To REALLY Like Iced Esspresso To Drink This
column10: I sampled the caffe flavor.  illy issimo comes in five flavors: caffe, caffe no sugar, cappuccino, mochaccino, and latte macchiato.Unless you like iced coffee to begin with, and then iced espresso to boot, you probably won't like this product.  This has no dairy type ingredients, so you will either need to drink this "black" or add something to it.  I tried it straight out of the can into a glass, chilled.  It was really strong, as in very bitter.I softened it a bit by adding some skim milk and sugar.  Even though this is sweetened with beet sugar, the bitterness far overpowers any hint of sweetness.  I added about 3 teaspoons of sugar, and then used about two ounces of milk mixed with this 6.8 ounce can. That made it more palatable.  I then added some crushed ice and poured some over the ice.  Better yet.All in all I would say this is for only hard core iced coffee drinkers.  If you lean more toward a sweet coffee with lots of sugar, this probably isn't going to be up your alley.But if you are an iced coffee drinker and like the bold taste of espresso, you might want to give this a whirl.

column9: very strong, not too sweet, and packed with energy--only 50 calories!
column10: I personally preferred the cappuccino, but I am not exactly a "real" coffee drinker. For people who enjoy a stronger flavor, this is the drink! It has a bold flavor with minimal bitterness (considering its strength) and only a hint of milk and sugar. The size is smaller than the cappuccino drink, yet it has much more caffeine and fewer calories, so in terms of bang for your buck, this drink is an excellent way to start the day, especially during the summer. Here are some numbers relating to the content of this drink, as well as info on the Illy Cappucino 8.45-Ounce Cans, in case you wanted to compare:Illy Caffè, 6.8-Ounce Cans (THIS product)50 calories, 155mg caffeine, 0g fat, 10g sugars, 0g proteinIlly Cappucino 8.45-Ounce Cans (The other one I tried and reviewed, which is milder and sweeter)100 calories, 81mg caffeine, 1.5g fat, 18g sugars, 4g protein

You know your drip coffee maker, Mr. Coffee, over there in the corner?  Long cold, the coffee is just sitting in the carafe until you clean it out, right?  Try this: pour it over ice in a cup.  Taste.  Now you know what this coffee drink tastes like without spending the money.Yes, it sounds harsh, but this should have been better than it is.  Convenient, for sure, and the size is a perfect afternoon fix.  But it doesn't taste like delicious brewed coffee.  It just tastes like cold coffee.  There's a difference.  The taste isn't bad, but not great.  It's not flavored up with sugars and creams, which is a GOOD thing...some of us hate sweet coffee that has unnecessary calories.  So, were I on the run, I may pick one of these up if it were cheap, just for ice-cold convenience.  But definitely not assuming that it was something extra special.In fact, surprisingly, it may be helpful to know that MonsterJava Monster Coffee + Energy Drink, Vanilla Light, 15-Ounce Cans (Pack of 12) makes a coffee drink with protein that is really good that I've been buying (cheaper at the local store than the big A).  Sure, it's not especially delicious coffee, but with the protein, it makes a great afternoon slump kicker.

column9: For Fans of Cold Espresso, AKA Brand X Doubleshots
column10: I had tried the illy issimo Cappuccino and found it to have a strong coffee flavor but with out much of an aftertaste, giving it what I assumed was it's "Italian style" coffee quote on the can.  But here with the illy issimo Caffe - the flavor is very bold and the taste sticks around.  Now for some, this is a definite plus.  I think this coffee is designed for coffee fans of bold flavors, dark roasts, French roasts, and especially espresso.  The sweetness is very light and almost vanishes before you can even realize it's there.  It gives you a nice smooth initial flavor, then the coffee comes over the top, dominating the taste.  To me this compares very nicely to Starbucks Doubleshot, except that this seems to have distinctively different coffee bean flavor that is hard to explain as different from Starbucks - but it is slightly.  As for the sweetness, here in the description as I write this - it says 45 calories.  It actually has 50 on the can.  So not for sure if this is an oversight or a recipe change.  Either way, this is definitely something for espresso fans.  If you are looking for a great pick me up during the sweltering summer, this is a nice alternative to hot coffee.  And price-wise, this may save you a few bucks over the price of Starbucks Doubleshot.

I do warn all that this coffee is quite bitter tasting.  Personally, I like the bitter taste and so give this four stars.  But some might want to pour this in a glass and add some ice cubes to cut the taste  a bit.
Sludgy, thick, burnt coffee grounds is what comes to mind after one swallow of this concoction.  If you can finish the rest, more power to you.

Yes, I'm a coffee junkie.  I really liked this drink.  Smooth and just sweet enough.  It's not really that strong so unless you like really weak coffee, I dont recommend putting it over ice.The only problem I had with this drink is the 6.8oz can wasn't big enough.Thank you.MEF

Generally, I love coffee. I prefer hot coffee made from fresh ground beans and I drink it black. I've tried many of both iced coffee beverages and coffees with espresso shots from the big chain, and I've found them completely delightful, though expensive. Unfortunately, this canned, low-calorie Italian espresso style coffee drink is a no-go for me.I'm assuming this is to be served cool from the refrigerator, although I'm certain my reaction wouldn't be any different had I drank it at room temperature. The texture is unsatisfactorily grainy. The flavor is unpleasantly off, either from beans that aren't bold enough or from a mixture of ingredients that ruins the flavor of a good bean - either way, I didn't enjoy it.It's a 50 calorie beverage; with a low 20mg sodium and 12g in carbs, so it balances out nutritionally for a coffee drink. The beet sugar is where it gets its 4g of fiber, its 10g of sugars and likely the peculiar graininess.This is a convenient on-the-go option for someone who likes coffee, but I like coffee, and I do not like this.

I sampled this product and was not impressed. It took me several sittings to make it through this can. It's metallic, bitter and not a pleasant caffeine beverage. Although NOT a coffee connoisseur, I suspect one would better appreciate the bold bite this beverage delivers. I'm not sure if this was the only coffee available I'd choose it again. There are better tasting options available and also at better price-points.

This is the first canned coffee I've tried. I found it to be a major disappointment. It was very bitter. I know other reviewers have said it was sweet. I certainly could not taste any sweetness at all. There was a definite metallic edge that I did not enjoy. We poured it into several glasses and had a panel of judges try it, all of whom love their coffee. Not one person finished it. "Ick!" was the overwhelming response.

column9: Bitter - Not Sweet and It Has 10 grams of Sugar
column10: The ingredients in this product are: coffee, sugar, potassium bicarbonate and potassium citrate. It has 10 grams of sugar. Note this does not have a dairy product ingredient in it.This is a thin consistency drink with a bold bitter coffee taste. I detect no sweetness at all, although it has 10 grams of sugar.I like the taste of bold coffee with french roast or cofee and chickory New Orleans style or Vietnamese style coffee drinks. This was bold and strong but a thin consistency and bitter despite the sugar added.This drink did nothing for me. I prefer a real cup of hot coffee with half and half to give it a creamy consistency, or I like a strong coffee iced coffee drink or I like an espresso based coffee drink or a frozen Frappuccino type of drink. I love strong coffee that's bold. I usually only use one sugar in a large coffee so I don't like it super-sweet by any means. This is just bitter and I rate it 2 stars = I Don't Like It.There are other iced canned or iced bottled prepared coffee drinks, milk or no milk products that I prefer the taste of such as the ones made by Starbucks (i.e. glass bottled Frappuccino) or the little aluminum cans of espresso drinks such as Starbucks DoubleShot.

The world changed for the me the first time I tried a bottle of Starbucks Mocha Frappucino about 10 years ago. The product tasted better than the one you get in store, and the convenience of being able to grab a bottle of a Frappucino and take it to the office was great. Illy's Issimo Caffè "Coffee Drink" comes in a sharp-looking six-ounce can, so there's no disputing the convenience of the product. However, the taste was another matter - flat, bland, and underwhelming. In fact, if I had to rate the flavor of all the packaged coffee drinks I've tried over the years, this would be close to the bottom of the list. Perhaps their other drinks pack more of a flavor punch, but Issimo Caffè Coffee Drink was a disappointment.

column9: Potent but the taste is not for me
