It gives me a good quick boost that I need to begin the day.

column9: Did not like the taste ... strong with a bitter bite.
column10: I did not like the taste of this canned coffee.  It had a very strong, bitter bite.  I took two sips and could not drink anymore.  My husband (who loves about anything coffee) said that he didn't really like it either, but then he polished off the can.  This is definitely a personal taste item.

Right up front: I like this drink, even though I usually don't want my coffee tampered with: No sugar, No milk or cream, No frothing, No cinnamon, No nonsense.This has a definite espresso flavor and is very sweet. The potassium bicarbonate and potassium citrate effectively cut the bitterness that one would expect. I poured the drink into a glass, and there was no aluminum can taste.Actually, since it is based on espresso, I found that half the can was enough for me. At another time I might enjoy a whole can (which is still less than 7 oz.) Even though was cold, I drank it like espresso--one sip at a time.My energy level usually slumps in the middle of the afternoon. I found that by taking a short break and _slowly_ drinking the illy issimo coffee drink, I was refreshed and ready to go on with my day. (Could they have found a more awkward name than: illy issimo Caffe Italian espresso style coffee drink?)But now the true test: Will I actually buy it? Yeah, the next time I go to my local supermarket I will check it out. If it is no more expensive than Amazon, I will probably buy some to have occasionally. (If you are not really out in the boonies, it just seems strange to buy food from Amazon--and I have bought a lot of different stuff from Amazon.)Notes: -->I noticed some other reviewers were drinking it (and it was suggested) when they were commuting or in a hurry. Drink brewed coffee then. Don't rush through espresso--that is just disrespectful. -->Also, on the can, the promise seems to be that the coffee itself is natural, not necessarily the whole product. -->Yes, I know that the energy boost was from relaxing, enjoying the drink, and the sugar, because it takes an hour for caffeine to actually kick in.

column9: It's all right for a canned coffee drink.
column10: illy issimo Coffee Drink Caffe is an okay canned coffee drink (if you're into such a thing).  Drinking coffee out of a can is an acquired taste, you either like it or hate it.  I happen to enjoy drinking coffee-on-the-go and its not that bad.  That saying, I wouldn't go out of my way to purchase a can.  But, if you enjoy drinking canned coffee then you'll want to buy some to try it out.  Please, do not shake the can before drinking or freeze it.  I would drink it at room temperature (I dislike the taste of cold coffee).I would recommend it for those who already enjoy coffee-in-the-can.

My wife and I shared a can of illy issimo Coffee Drink. I am not a great fan of cold coffee so I included my wife's opinion in this review, since she drinks iced coffee daily. The illy was too strong for both of us, but was not bitter. If it had been hot I probably would have liked sipping it, it seems to be close to the strength of espresso. My wife added ice and a lot of flavored half and half and found it very good. Doing as she did, rather defeats the purpose of a can of coffee that one opens and drinks on the go. I would recommend this drink to those who like cold espresso.

column9: Very good true coffee drink without the sweet overload.
column10: One thing I have found with premade coffee or latte drinks is the overload on the sweetener. Why? It kills it. Not the case here. Excellent flavor, great over ice. A+++

column9: This Hard Core Espresso Drinker Loves It
column10: I really enjoy this illy issimo Coffee Drink. A lot. It's the perfect espresso treat for the hard core coffee drinkers who cringe and run away at the sight of a blonde or medium roast coffee.This is a smooth, perfectly sweetened espresso coffee drink that is a very satisfying chilled beverage to enjoy on a hot summer day. I found it to be of a much better quality than the canned and bottled coffee beverages sold by that coffee company you see on every corner and have kiosks inside more and more stores.It is also very refreshing to find a canned beverage that is sweetened with beet sugar, NOT high fructose corn syrup.I'm anxious to try more illy coffee drinks!

column9: Strong and sweet, a good summer alternative to brewed
column10: This is a pretty typical sweetened packaged espresso drink. It's adequately strong, could always be stronger, since odds are pretty good you'll be drinking it iced. For my taste, it could be a bit less sweet, but it's not cloying against the coffee, and it's a nice sugary sweetness.I tried it straight and iced, with and without milk, and liked it all 4 ways.During the summer, I try to brew a big strong pot every few days and keep it in the fridge for iced coffee, but I like this as an option to keep on hand in the fridge for days I run out and don't want to wait for my usual stuff to cool. It would also be a convenient take-along booster if you're traveling somewhere with questionable coffee or visiting family members who brew theirs like a weak tea. The flavor and strength is much better than the starbucks instant packets, which are also a decent take-along booster.With 155mg caffeine (about 1.5x an average shot of espresso, similar to a good cup of strong brewed coffee), this has a nice pick-me-up with a low pee factor.For my money, it's a bit too pricy for what it is for everyday use. I'm too cheap for coffee at home at $2 a pop.

column9: Not my cup of tea...or coffee as the case may be
column10: Maybe I'm not their target customer since I don't generally drink iced coffee but frankly I thought this was kinda gross.  Drinking yesterday's coffee left in the pot without reheating it would be equally satisfying as  this canned beverage.  Didn't enjoy the flavor nor did I find it refreshing in any way.  I'm glad my Vine sample was only one can!

column9: Quite Yummy, actually.  Strong.  Not very sweet.
column10: I like expresso,and coffee, and I like iced coffees, so it stands to reason that I would like this product, and I do.  I recommend it in a gkass, over ice, but it's quite fine from a can.  It's a strong coffee and refreshing coffee, and tastes more fresh than I actually expected from a can.  I will purchase these in the future for morning caffeine on-the-run (running out the door with a cold drink sounds much safer than with a hot one!).  I recommend for people who long strong or iced coffees that aren't particularly sweet.  :)  Happy Mornings.

I was excited to get this coffee drink, but once I tried it, I was a bit put off by its bitter taste. I expected the taste to be strong, but not bitter - I could not get past that to the actual flavor. I would not try this drink again.

This was very good, sort of creamy. It was just coffee and some sugar inside so I added some half and half. I tried it just black first, but I found it too strong.  Adding the half and half made this a very tasty treat for me.  I say treat, because I don't usually add sugar to my coffee.  I forgot how good it tastes!  This was really delicious.

column9: Decent, but wanted a little more flavor
column10: This was a tasty little drink, but not beyond special. I'm comparing this to the "stellar" chain out there. As far as a cold/iced coffee goes it is strong, but a little too sweet for my taste. Sort of like when you buy a sweetened tea and think- is there tea in this, it's like drinking sugar. I added a bit of milk and it helped smooth it out a bit. Not a bad little drink of you like cold, sweetened coffee.

column9: Good enough substitute for iced coffee
column10: This small (6.8 fl oz) drink has a nice clean coffee taste, with enough sugar to make it sweet, but not annoyingly so.  If you are looking for a substitute for a trip to a coffee shop for iced coffee, this is less expensive (roughly $2 per can currently).However, making iced coffee at home can give better results (assuming good coffee, freshly roasted, and ground just before brewing).  By that comparison, $2 per for 6.8 fl oz seems rather expensive.A few other brief notes: 1) This is not espresso in a can.  It is an "Espresso STYLE Coffee Drink".  To me, the taste is more reminiscent of a strong cup of coffee with sugar, but not espresso. 2) It is sweetened with sugar...not corn syrup.  The ingredients list is quite short: coffee, sugar, potassium bicarbonate, and potassium citrate.  Not sure what those last two ingredients lend to the taste (they are not preservatives), but I never use them when I make iced coffee at home, and I'm happy with the results. 3) Finally, since I keep an eye on "points" in my daily diet, I note the following: 50 calories, 12g carbohydrates, 0g protein, 1g fiber.  (I wish Amazon would include the nutrition label for each food product it sells.)All in all, a decent coffee drink that is less expensive than a similar drink from a coffee chain, but more expensive than making iced coffee at home.

column9: Good coffee, but additives leave aftertaste
column10: There is a nice strong coffee flavor and the right amount of sweetness to the drink but the additives leave an acidic aftertaste that is a little off-putting.  Maybe a little cream or vanilla flavoring could help?

column9: Good coffee taste, not too sweet
column10: The can of illy issimo Coffee Drink claims "100% natural Arabica coffee and the finest ingredients".  There are in fact only four ingredients, the first two of which are coffee and sugar. Note - no High Fructose Corn Syrup here.  The other two ingredients aren't what you'd typically put in for yourself, potassium bicarbonate and potassium citrate, often added to drinks to regulate acidity.The taste is pretty good for a canned product - nice strong coffee flavor, the way I like it. Perhaps a bit more sugar than I would normally use, but less than I find in most commercial drinks. There is a hint of chemical in the taste, but it isn't obnoxious. I found it quite refreshing. One can is 50 calories, about 2/3 what you'd find in the equivalent amount of soda.  Caffeine content is 155mg per can, about on par for brewed coffee and maybe twice what a typical can of an "energy drink" contains.

I tried the cappuccino one as well, and I like that one better. This one is good, but tastes more like iced black coffee with no sugar/cream. So if that's your preference (you prefer it black or like to add your own sweetener/cream), then this is for you.I could still drink it, but definitely prefer it with a little extra cream in there.

I didn't like this. It was so strong and after watering it down by half it was still strong. I thought espresso was suppose to have a lot of caffiene so I expected an energy boost but instead I took a nap 2 hours later..... I guess if you like espresso and that strong taste you'll like this but I didn't and I tried it on ice and hot.

column4: Glenda Boozer "Live, live, live! Life is a ba...
column9: Pretty good coffee, especially nice and cold
column10: Ok, for me, this needs to be sweetened and mixed with milk (vanilla soymilk or dark chocolate almond milk are awesome), but it's actually not a bad thing having a serving of good (strong but not bitter or burnt-tasting) coffee in the refrigerator ready to grab. I mixed it with the amount and type of milk I wanted, sweetened it as I pleased, and yumminess happened, my way; I like that. There is a lot of coffee out there that tastes nasty to me, but this is the good stuff.

column9: Not a fan of canned coffe, but this was good
column10: Although I am coffee snob so I don't at all like canned coffee, I am always miserable when we go camping and don't have my coffee (I get headaches).  So this was my idea and it DOES work for that. I've tried some Starbucks types and they were totally disgusting to me.  This was tolerable though. I actually prefer the caffe one over the cappuccino(I prefer sweet), but my husband preferred the cappuccino. So if you like a good stronger coffee flavor, try the other. Good for camping or if you are wanting something higher quality than Starbucks (did I just say that?!), then try these!

I just don't really see the market for these things at this price.  This is bad cold iced coffee with a somewhat synthetic chemical like taste.  Provides caffeine if that's what you are looking for but the taste is somewhat horrible.

Coffee preferences seem very personal and heated debates can erupt over the subject.  For me, this coffee is very good.  It's not too sweet -- just the right amount of sugar.  The taste was rich with no strange or bitter aftertaste.  There was also no 'burnt taste' that I've experiences with other brands.  Regarding other reviewers who complain about a strange acidic or a citrus taste, I couldn't taste anything funny like that.  Be aware that the product contains a preservative named potassium citrate, an odorless but not a tasteless chemical.  The vast majority of people have no problem with the chemical but there are a few where it hits the taste buds in an unpleasant way.  You'd probably know by now if you were in that minority because this preservative is common.Note that I like cold coffee so I poured the room temperature can into a glass with ice.  Thus I was tasting something slightly diluted, and yet it still tasted great.  I also should say that I am not a huge coffee drinker, but I do like coffee candy and coffee ice cream.BOTTOM LINE: if I was in a store or on Amazon and wanted to buy some espresso style cans of this size, I would either pick this brand or Starbuck's brand depending on which one was cheaper.  They both taste very good.  If the prices were equal, I would probably go with this brand just to give myself more long term taste test with the product.

If you have read many of the reviews for this product, you would notice they are all over the place.  Canned coffee drinks - particularly espresso drinks - are definitely not for everyone.  This drink is rather sweet for such a product but very strong.  In fact, I would expect most people to be put off by the strong flavor after a sip or two and, judging by the reviews, that seems to be the case.  In other words, those who like their coffee weak of heavily diluted with cream should stay away from this one.Now for the rest of us.  The flavor is quite clear and strong but it surprised me by its sweetness.  This would not be a problem per se but the mixture does not seem to go together well and leaves a bit of an aftertaste.  Overall, a refreshing drink on a hot day but I can't give it a clear thumbs up.

column9: The best 'canned coffee' product I've had.
column10: I recently reviewed another flavor of this same drink: illy issimo Coffee Drink, Cappuccino, 8.45-Ounce Cans (Pack of 12)... I find this caffé variety to be superior to the cappuccino variety, in both flavor and value. As far as 'canned coffee' goes, this is probably my favorite to date.PROS:- Bold coffee flavor, but with just a touch of sweetness to cut the bitterness. I found it to be robust and refreshing at the same time.- 155mg of caffeine is a hefty boost in the morning- 45 calories mean you can drink this without feeling guilty, and the use of beet sugar is cool (to me)- no preservatives, natural coffee flavor, etc. add another layer of 'guilt-free' to this productSUMMARY: This is my favorite 'canned coffee' so far. I've used a french press, various drip makers, and have a Keurig at my desk at work -- but, if I was in a rush, I'd definitely be fine with drinking this stuff on the go. Right out of the frig it's flavorful, refreshing, has enough caffeine to get you going in the morning, and is low-calorie and preservative-free. I normally don't buy products like this but am seriously considering it after enjoying my free sample.

Most Americans have little experience with canned coffee products, but I lived in Japan for over two decades and cold canned coffee pre-dates the Starbucks we see in the refrigerator sections in the U.S. Canned coffee that is not liberally diluted with milk is often an acquired taste, especially for those who are used to something less intense or only hot coffee.Canned coffee can be ruined by the passage of time or too much acidity. Illy issimo seems to have combated possible unpleasant flavors that might emerge by adding a fair amount of sugar. This is a fairly sweet espresso, though it's not cloying. It's pretty robust and has a pretty strong coffee aftertaste which reminds me of robusta blends rather than arabica (which tend to be mellower).It's hard to recommend food items to others because tastes are very individualized, but I did enjoy this and feel it is better than average for a cold canned coffee. It's not going to beat a freshly made espresso, but then it's not supposed to rival the real deal. If I were in a hurry and wanted an espresso jolt, especially in the summer, I'd buy this.

I noticed on this coffee that I am not supposed to shake it, so I wondered if this was why it didn't taste very sweet, despite having a good deal of sugar in it.  It tasted decent for what it was, but I am not sure if I would buy it in a store if I saw it.

column9: Loving iced coffee I was excited to try this.
column10: I let the can chill a few days and when it got to be 103 outside I thought now it is the time. I filled a glass with ice and poured it over. Looked good until I tasted the first sip. I don't even know how to describe it. Strong for sure and like a bit a sweet was hiding in the background. So I tried adding some splenda to see if that would help, mmmm, just a tad. So I tried some soy milk which I like the taste of, nope not an improvement.Overall it seemed acidic to me and mostly unpleasant. I was unable to drink more than a few sips. Maybe the latte variety would be more to my taste, this not so much.

column9: Not too bad! A Little too Sweet
column10: I have to say that I did read some of the other reviews before trying this drink.I'm a coffee drinker but I like my coffee creamy and light. So I thought this would be super strong. I refrigerated it (not sure if that was right or not) and was surprised to find it okay. It wasn't great, it wasn't spit out horrible, it was drinkable and okay.I found it to be smooth and very sweet (not wicked sweet but probably a little too much). I drank it all but probably wouldn't buy it. I guess I prefer an iced coffee over the strength of this.My husband, who is more of a strong coffee drinker than me, didn't like it.

column9: Very strange, off taste, somewhat acidic
column10: There is something very odd with the sweetener in this drink, I think. It tastes at first like strong black coffee, almost burnt, with some sugar and no cream added to it. Quickly, however, a really strange acidity overwhelms the rest of the taste. It's a little like that cheap liquid "diet" sweetener from the 1970s, which tasted like chemicals if you had it by itself.  It would probably be okay in this coffee if the coffee itself didn't taste burned, or if it balanced with more cream-type taste.  In fact, I finished the rest of the can I had by mixing it in with about 2 ounces of pre-made iced coffee in a carton, and that made a huge difference.I drink coffee daily and really enjoy other illy issimo products. This one just is not that good.

I should start with a disclaimer that I am a real coffee lover and a habitual consumer of strong brewed Arabica cut with nonfat milk but no sugar. I learned to love iced coffee at my mother's knee - she too loved coffee but in summer when hot brew was intolerable, made her cold glass of joe with whole milk, sugar and then ice cubes.This illy issimo caffe Italian espresso style coffee drink struck me as really strong although reasonably smooth but with some kind of a taste of - perhaps - citric acid. Something "chemical". Something that stays on the tongue when you'd think it wouldn't.I waited for a nice hot day to have this; had it chilled down in the fridge, waiting. It did give me the fog-clearing of caffeine but when I found it a bit strong, I tried cutting it with my nonfat milk. Whoa - the color didn't even alter, this is STRONG stuff. When I got to half milk, it began to have a lighter look, and the taste became more what I like. I kept sipping it and getting a reaction that it tastes somewhat chemical compared to my usual brew. I wanted to like it but don't completely but that may be just me, and partially the effect of it having the sugar that I am no longer used to.If you prefer your coffee without sweetener as I do, please note the manufacturer does produce an unsweetened version.

I was expecting more like a starbucks iced coffee; sweet with milk/cream.  However, this is rather light on sugar and cream. A little too bold for me. Bold to a point of bitterness. Anyways, if you like bold taste of coffee without and sugar and cream, this is it for you.

column9: tastes like a good cup of coffee - albeit cold
column10: I drink coffee for the flavor - I typically drink decaf and since abandoning artificial sweeteners 7 months ago, I use real sugar, sometimes cream. Since I'm unused to this volume of caffeine, it was unwise for me to consume this can late in the evening. I was wide awake all night long, unable to sleep more than a few minutes here and there.  It's unusual to get a product in a can that only has 4 ingredients as this illy issimo Caffé coffee. While it contains sugar, it was not sweet enough for me by any stretch - but I like it sweeeeet. Still, it was fully satisfying. My husband is a champion drinker of coffee. If coffee drinking were an Olympic sport, he would medal in it daily... so I let him sample this drink to get his feedback. He said he doesn't like cream in his coffee. I informed him that it didn't have any, but he insisted he could detect cream. I personally think he was thrown off by the temperature - he prefers piping hot, and I had just pulled this can out of the fridge. That being said, if you cannot tolerate cold coffee, you will not be in the market for this product. Personally, I like it at any temperature.

"How can something with sugar as the second ingredient be so incredibly bitter?" said my husband after his first taste. I couldn't answer, my mouth was puckered like an old lady at a lemon eating contest.Hubby reached for the Hazelnut creamer, poured a little in, and we both agreed it made a huge improvement.I realize there are plenty of manly men out there who like their coffee black and their women strong, or something like that, but no one in our family resembles that description. However, for people who like cold black coffee, this is probably a very refreshing drink. For a generation brought up on super-sweet flavored and whip-cream-topped coffee concoctions, I doubt this will be a hit. Unless they use it as a challenge, like eating a teaspoon of cinnamon, or drinking Sriracha sauce straight from the bottle.
I loved this drink.  It was smooth and creamy and tasted even better when I heated it up.  I would definitely buy this again.

I recently tried illy issimo's Cappuccino (8.45 ounce can) and really enjoyed it. I decided to try their slightly smaller (6.8 ounce) Caffe coffee drink as well, and I came away largely disappointed.  Obviously, there is less here to enjoy.  After a few generous sips, I found the can nearly drained.  I appreciate the fact that the entire drink clocks in at only 45 calories, making it perhaps the healthiest of all the commercially available cold coffee drinks.  I was also pleased to see that it uses beet sugar as a natural sweetener as opposed to corn syrup, and of course, all illy issimo drinks uses 100% Arabica coffee.  So, there's no denying the quality.But in short, this was not nearly as tasty or as satisfying as the Cappuccino I previously tried.  The Caffe was intense, slightly creamy, and just about as sweet as I would want it.  But it left me with a bitter, unpleasant aftertaste that lingered far too long.  You should not feel the sudden urge to brush your teeth or drink cold water after enjoying espresso, but that is exactly how I felt after finishing this.  Therefore, despite the quality ingredients, the initial taste, and the impressive low-calorie count, I cannot recommend this.  I'd rather double up on the calories and enjoy a larger can of their superior Cappuccino.

column9: Mellows nicely over ice but there are better options at lower prices
column10: At only 45 calories per can, it is in a class by itself; at more than $1.91 per can, it faces a lot of competition for my morning pick-me-up, including Green Mountain Coffee Lake & Lodge and SToK Caffeinated Black Coffee Shots.My wife didn't care for this blend's full-bodied flavor but I preferred this over illy issimo Cappuccino, which we also tested for free through Amazon's Vine program. My wife prefers coffee hot and with milk and sugar. My preference is to drink house blends, espresso and Americano black (hot) or over ice.This sweetened, bold ice coffee is best enjoyed over crushed ice. Straight out of the can is a bit harsh (see picture) but this blend mellows nicely over ice. My best advice is that you purchase a single can of illy issimo Caffè before committing to buy a pack of 12.Rating: Three stars.* 100% natural Arabica coffee* No preservatives* OU-D Kosher* Sweetened with beet sugar* Offers a RTD coffee option for lactose intolerant consumers* 6.8 fluid ounces (200 milliliters) per canNutritional Information:* 45 calories* 0 grams of fat* 10 grams of sugar* 155 milligrams of caffeine

I'm an avid coffee drinker.  I drink it black, cold, in a frap...  Illy happens to be one of my favorite brands for making lattes and cappuccinos, so I felt pretty confident that this drink would be good.  I was half right.  This may be one of the oddest things I've drunk yet.At the first sip, it tasted like lightly sweetened, fairly strong espresso, but there was something off.  I took another sip, trying to figure out what it was, but I couldn't quite put my finger on it.I decided to try pouring it into a glass to see if this alleviated the strangeness.  I took another sip and, yep, still strange.  It took me a while to realize that the strangeness was that it seemed almost like it was carbonated, yet it didn't fizz.  This made no sense to me, so I checked the label to find that potassium bicarbonate and potassium citrate are two of the ingredients.  Bingo.  My guess is these ingredients are conspiring to give this coffee a strange, difficult to describe aftertaste.Ultimately, this ruined the beverage for me.  Even though I liked the taste of the coffee and thought it had just the right level of sweetness, I couldn't get past that weird tang and vaguely fizzy feeling.  I won't be coming back for more of this.

The drink is something hard to find -- an affordable indulgence. This is not a cream based coffee beverage so it contains no fat or milk products. The ingredient list is short -- coffee, sugar, potassium bicarbonate and potassium citrate. The product contains no preservatives.Its rich, smooth espresso flavor is slightly sweet but not cloyingly so. The Caffe flavor is not at all bitter and there is no aftertaste. It is utterly delicious and I won't hesitate to buy it in the future.

column9: Very good for a canned coffee drink
column10: I am not a lover of canned coffee drinks, they are usually too strong and too sweet. I really enjoyed this drink. It was just a touch too strong for me but it had just the right amount of sweetness. I prefer to make my own iced coffee but if I couldn't do that, I would purchase this brand. It was just the perfect size and had a full, rich flavor.

Don't kid yourself into thinking that a can of this will magically transport you to the Amalfi Coast -- but it is a nice treat nonetheless.  Tastes like slightly weak espresso with sugar.  It's a little sweet, a little bit lemony tasting, a little bitter, but all in all quite good.  The cans are small -- about half the size of a typical soda can -- and the price seems a tad high considering the size of the can.  And if you like milky, creamy coffee, this won't be your thing.  If you like sweet coffee without cream, you might enjoy this.

column9: Terrific for making frozen blended coffee
column10: I was interested to try this product in making my occasional frozen blended coffee.  I find it a pain to have to brew coffee only to let it cool off first before I can make my blended coffee.  If I don't let it cool, the hot coffee melts the ice too quickly, ruining the "frozen" part of the treat, and then I might as well just have made a hot latte-style drink in the first place.  I had toyed with the idea of making my frozen treat using canned espresso, and decided to give it a try with this.I did taste this straight out of the can.  Even though I am not a black coffee person, the taste of this was average as far as coffee goes.  It was strong, which of course it should be, but I didn't find it bitter.  The bubbles were not like soda bubbles.  Rather, it was like a mild fizz, and I can't even come up with something to compare it to, because all other carbonated beverages I've had have been far stronger in the carbonation than this.I added the can to my usual recipe in the blender.  The first thing I noticed when I was finished blending was the foam.  Lots of foam, thanks to the carbonation.  It was great, actually, and I liked it a lot - it gave the whole thing a real cafe' feel, like I'd made this with fresh espresso.The flavor of my blended beverage was better than when I make it with my regular coffee, more like when I order one of these at a coffee shop.  Again, I'm sure this is because I used more of an espresso-style beverage, like a coffee shop would do.  The coffee flavor wasn't watered down, and it mixed well with the other flavors I had added.For my purposes, this drink did exactly what I wanted.  I will gladly use it again for making my frozen treats.

column9: it's coffee. in a can. it's illy issimo.
column10: Okay, I admit that I'm a bit of a coffee snob. Enough so that I roast my own beans and grind them fresh before each cup and I look down a bit on Starbucks and Peet's. Still, just like I believe wine in a bag or box could be good if you actually use good wine - better, maybe, depending on the wine and what you intend to use it for - I also believe that using good beans and processing them properly you could, maybe, get an excellent cup of coffee in a can.Normally I wouldn't be trying coffee in a can simply because it usually seems to have milk in it and I don't consume any dairy, but this illy issimo contains just coffee, sugar, potassium bicarbonate, and potassium citrate. I'm not sure what the last two ingredients are for, but wikipedia says they both impart a slightly salty taste and are used to regulate ph...so maybe it's either of those or both. The can says "100% natural arabica". Not sure what the "natural" part is supposed to mean - maybe it's just a way to sneak "natural" onto the label - it's a term that's not really regulated so it's slapped on a lot of stuff without really meaning anything. Not too impressed with the "arabica" part...75% of all coffee produced is arabica and some of it is pretty nasty dross. Still, illy is supposed to have a good reputation, so despite the meaningless hype on the can I have tentative high hopes for it.These cans are kind of small, closer to a Red Bull than your traditional can of soda. I put my can in the fridge to chill it, then opened it and took a sip. Well, blech...I did not like that at all, but then I normally don't like coffee and sugar without any (non-dairy) milk, so not really a surprise. I put four ice cubes in a glass and then the coffee and it filled my glass most of the way. The rest of the glass I filled with one of my two favorite soy milks, Sunrich Naturals (which is the one they use at Blue Bottle) gave a little stir and sipped again. This time, it actually tasted good! Good enough to drink the entire thing, even though really I'd had my coffee for the day. Oh yeah, and better than an iced latte from Peet's or Starbucks!Would I drink this again? Yes, actually I would. The main thing stopping me would be that I'd only want to drink it if I had access to a glass with ice and some soy (or other non-dairy) milk, which certainly could happen but if I'm at home I might just as well roast and grind my own beans and if I'm not at home all of a sudden the whole ice/glass/soymilk thing requires some pre-planning. They should make illy issimo canned coffee drinks with soymilk right in the can...then I bet I could think of lots of reasons to keep a case of it on hand.

column9: Italian Coffee Drink - too bitter AND too sweet...it's ok.
column10: The illy issimo Coffe Drink (Caffe version), is 6.8 fluid ounces of 100% natural arabica coffee, sugar, potassium, bicarbonate and potassium citrate.  With 50 calories, 12g carbs and 10g of sugar, it's a decent "health" profile (only 20mg sodium, which is low).  It contains No Preservatives (according to the label), but the taste is just strange: I drank it cold straight from the fridge, and found it to be both too bitter AND too sweet at the same time (I don't know how they accomplished that).It's ok, but not something I would probably drink again unless I had to.  I drink coffee with cream (and sometimes a touch of sugar) every morning, and often a non fat latte as another choice: I love espresso (but with cream, not straight), so maybe that was the deal here: I missed my cream.  I think this drink might have benefited from a bit of cream and a bit less sugar.

This Italian Espresso style iced coffee drink has a fine taste and is not overly sweet.I think the price is pretty steep, especially considering the size of the can, which is only 6.8 fluid ounces.It is very small.It is all natural though and so maybe must be more expensive.My personal preference is Seattle's Best Iced Coffee Lattes which are slightly more generous at 9.5 fluid ounces and that is a big difference to me.Recommended if you don't mind higher price in a smaller can.

column9: Good canned espresso drink, not too sweet
column10: I tried the illy issimo caffe (definitely serve cold) and this offering has a good strong espresso taste with a nice caffeine buzz.  The drink is also sweet, but there is a mild off putting aftertaste, almost like an artificial sweetener (the drink is sweetened with beet sugar, not cane sugar).  I don't mind the strange aftertaste that much since the drink is Kosher, has only 10 grams of sugar and 50 calories.  The best part of this coffee drink is the rich, full bodied espresso flavor.  This is a good drink if you like cold espresso drinks and don't mind trading off a little aftertaste for a lower calorie, less sugary drink. I will get this drink again.

Illy's coffee drink has exactly the right balance of sweetness and coffee flavor. Drinking it ice cold on a hot 90 degree day is refreshing.This is a beautiful coal black liquid. The espresso flavor comes through very nicely, good intense coffee flavor, with a hint of tartness. Sometimes I like syrup sweet drinks, but mostly I drink coffee black. I've tried iced coffee before, and generally don't like it. This drink, on the other hand, has just exactly the right hint of sugar sweetness (not sweetener or high fructose corn syrup sweetness). The drink has a good mouth feel, slightly thicker than water with a creamy finish. The aftertaste is surprisingly nice, a good coffee flavor.What I particularly like about this drink, it has an authentic espresso coffee flavor without being masked by heavy cream, milk, or sugar. Compared to any Starbucks drink, this is head and shoulders better. A wonderful cold beverage for the summer.

I am not a huge fan of canned coffee drinks, but I am always looking for easy coffee. This drink tasted just okay. It had a weird aftertaste that I can't quite describe. The size of the can is adequate. I definitely will not be purchasing this again in the future. If you like convenient, ok tasting coffee to go, this is it.
These cookies arrived fresh and delicious as usual.They are a good value and you have plenty to share. I don't understand why I have to use more word necessary to describe my experience.

My husbands favorite cookie. I try to avoid them-for obvious reasons, but when I do indulge I like to take a cereal bowl, dump some cookies in it and then microwave till warm.- less than a minute. They take on a totally different texture. My dog loves them warm! They have a good portion of nuts and chips

I remember when Wally Amos opened a Famous Amos Store in my Tarzana, California neighborhood (1970's). Those cookies were spectacular.....and so fresh.  They were made as only a neighborhood bakery could perform this ritual. I loved those cookies back then. Unfortunately, neither Wally nor his beloved stores  sell those great cookies of yesteryear any longer. However, the fact that I can get a modern day version of a good old classic delivered to my home, at a very reasonable price, provides my family and I with some great comfort food to satisfy our hunger for sweets.  Just remember these are mass baked cookies from Keebler now........but still, oh so good!  They are very addicting and often vanish quickly.  Maybe that's why we're purchasing six boxes at a time, twice a year!!
My husband loves this syrup, It has a much better mango flavoring then the torani syrup.Can.t find any where. But this is excellent mango syrup.

I ordered this syrup for my daughter who uses it in her ice tea.  She loves it.  She first had Mango Ice Tea at a local restaurant and asked them what they used to give it the mango flavor and she was told Monin Mango Syrup.  Now it's the only way she wants to drink ice tea.

Every so often we like to give our two girls a special meal. This Wellness formula is a perfect pick. We try to feed our girls as much of a grain free diet as possible and Wellness always has great options of us. What I really like about this one was the chunks of everything, so you could see what was going into the bowl. I have no problem with traditionally ground wet dog food (and Wellness makes those too) but when I'm wanting to give my girls something special, I want it to look special (even though I know they could care less). Wellness can run a little pricey, so this particular product especially might not be what you want to feed on a day to day basis, but it's great as an occasional treat.

This is the only treet that my 8 year old resue can eat.  Due to the treatnent that this dog suffered from her previous owners, she had to have all but two of her teeth removed.  This item is great. It's soft enough for her to eat. It's easy on her to digest without causeing any problems to her system.This item has become hard for me to locate in my area and when I found it here I couldn't wait for it to arrive.  It's nice to receive this item when I want it.

I use the canine carry outs as treats and for training.  They are just soft enough to break into 6 bits a piece and use them to train.  My dogs love them.  My brother's dogs love them too so I bought him a box.

column9: My Dogs LOVE Canine Carry Outs!
column10: My dogs absolutely LOVE these treats & I LOVE that Amazon has them on Subscribe & Save! Super Fast Shipping & Cheaper than I can get them in the store!
I can't say how great they taste but my Akita pup seems to like them a lot.  I break each piece into 1/3 rds and use them for training.  The price on Amazon was great plus I opted for free shipping.

My dog loves these, given as a treat or reward in addition to his regular dog food.The flavor must be sensational the way he looks forward to them.It is a reasonably priced treat of a soft and chewy consistency. My dog is a small Yorkie, so two a day is more than enough for his size and weight.
Looked for something other than chocolate and found these organic cookies which were well received by the grandchildren.  Would certainly look at this seller again.
This was purchased as a gift.  My sister said they tasted very good and were really cute.  However, for the $$ you pay, she only got 8 cookies.

I didn't get a chance to sample these organic cookies myself, but I sent a box to my sister in law as an advance Easter pick-me-up surprise and they have been a phenomenal hit. The cookies are delicious and look great, and  Beautiful Sweets has a whole variety of themes for year-round occasions.One very minor issue, I wish the product page had specific information about shipping times. It took Beautiful Sweets about a week to ship my order; there's nothing wrong with that, but it would just be nice to know, especially when you're used to Amazon shipping everything so quickly.On the positive side, they emailed with tracking number as soon as the package shipped.I will definitely be ordering more from Beautiful Sweets in the future. Sister In Law doesn't know it yet, but she's getting the Halloween special!

column9: Great flavor, convenient, but has MSG and nitrites
column10: We love pesto sauce on pasta, and on nights when I can't make my own from scratch I love having a package of the mix waiting for me.This sauce tastes good, and has recognizable pieces of basil in it, but I won't buy it again because of the ingredients.  Pesto sauce is supposed to be basil, olive oil, garlic and salt, and not much else.  This product has "Beef, Mechanically Separated Chicken Water, Salt, Corn Syrup, Flavorings, Dextrose, Paprika, Hydrolyzed Corn Gluten, Soy and Wheat Gluten Proteins, Sodium Nitrite, Lactic Acid Starter Culture." Just the words "mechanically separated chicken water" put me completely off of this product. Hydrolyzed corn gluten is a fancy name for MSG It also has 480 mg of salt in each serving - each package having 3+ servings.I like McCormick's spices, but I'll be looking for a more natural pesto sauce mix next time.Edited 27Apr2012 to add:  Thank you to Jonathan (see his comments below my review) for suggesting Simply Organic Sweet Basil Pesto.  I bought it and love it!

column9: Best pesto sauce in a package mix!
column10: We love this pesto sauce mix and it's hard to find at our local grocery store so I get it from Amazon.  This is the only pesto mix that my kids like!!  They've eaten it since they were small and now they want it at college :-)  No spinach in this one (Knorr's has that) so it's a simple basil product.  If we don't have time to puree basil leaves or find the right spices, this package mix is a great substitute.

column9: Gives me gas and the runs, but tastes great!
column10: Great value and convenient to have this delivered!  Just make sure you use high fiber pasta, this stuff runs through you faster than grandma's chili!

After you've had these chocolate chips, other brands will seem almost tasteless. Guittard is the company that supplies chocolate for See's Candy.The only thing I'd say is be careful you don't get addicted to them. I was having a handful of chips after lunch and dinner, but recently switched to a totally healthy concoction: Place two bananas in a blender, add a cup of raw cashews or half a cup of cashew butter, 3 tablespoons of cocoa powder and a teaspoon of vanilla. Pour into an ice cube tray and freeze. Tastes like Fudgesicles! I got the recipe at DrFurhman.com.

Has a real smooth taste, I don't even put milk with just sugar. Has a kick like a five hour energy and red bull combined but doesn't give me the gitters. Its great stuff and a bag lasts about a week at 5 cups a day

This coffee is some of the best, most smooth coffee I have ever had.  It had a nice robust flavor, with no hint in the taste of the extra caffeine. I almost exclusively drink flavored coffee and have for years, but I prefer this over flavored now.  I wish it was available in stores.  I highly recommend it!

We wanted to cut back on our caffeine intake a few years ago, & used to try to split regular coffee with decaff. We like good coffee & when I found this already pre-mixed, I was excited. I have had this on a regular monthly order for probably a year now, & we love it. For the two of us (1 to 1 1/2 pots a day) 4 cans last about a month. GREAT price & GREAT coffee. If they ever stop this on regular delivery, I will be one sad person. If you haven't tried auto delivery on products you use all the time, it is the cats meow. I live in a semi rural area, & it is easier to have it delivered regularly & not have to think about it.

column9: Need a lot of coffee to brew a cup
column10: This may be labeled a medium roast but the cups it brews more closely resemble dirty water. It takes a lot of grounds to brew a cup that has any flavor at all. I generally enjoy light and medium roasts, and when this is brewed correctly there is a decent if unremarkable flavor. But I have to pack the filter to get any taste at all. I do appreciate the lower caffeine content, as I generally enjoy an extra cup of coffee in the afternoon. I can't recommend this - following the directions on the label produces undrinkable coffee.

column9: All right coffee. Somewhat better than folgers.
column10: This coffee is alright. The taste is rather sourish and a bit bitter. It just does not taste very good. Maybe its because I am used to Lavazza and Sturbucks beans, but thats how I feel about it. I tried making it in my drip coffee maker (I have a very good coffee maker that releases most flavor) and french press, still it tasted mediocre. I ended up giving this coffee away.

This is the one coffee you may have at any time, day or night. For the caffeine sensitive, Melitta Classic Lite is a gift. For those who want the added spank of strong caffeine, Classic Lite is a welcome change, a break away from the "spike" of heavyweight coffees. I like my coffee on the strong side but Classic Lite is so tasty and mellow that I would simply add two more spoonfuls to the coffee machine on top of the usual load and, voila, I got a cup of delicious, "non-aggressive," extremely pleasing coffee. I always take it with agave. Classic Lite also tastes great with flavored creamers; my favorite is French Vanilla. I discovered Classic Lite after I reviewed Amazon's coffee offerings and decided to taste. I've made a note and will be making sure Classic Lite is always available in the house. Thanks, Melitta!

column9: Lite on Caffeine and Acidity, FULL on Flavor
column10: I have been drinking Melitta Lite for about 5 years.  It is far tastier than any of the other Lite or Half Caffeine Coffees out there.  My preference in coffees is medium to strong brew; my coffee should taste like coffee. Melitta Lite certainly does have the body of a good coffee while being gentler to my tummy and my nerves.Good thing that Amazon sells this in the subscription program, so it is delivered right to my door and I always have some on hand.

switched to this melitta lite coffee from dunkin' donuts coffee.  delicious, flavorful, smooth brew without leaving jangly coffee nerves or early morning digestive difficulties.  the low acid and reduced caffeine really help.  highly recommend!

My grandson loves Crystal Light Lemonade.  I find it saves me money to order it from Amazon in bulk.  In fact we all like the terrific flavor.  I recently tried a store brand and was not satisfied with it.

Okay, maybe it's not exactly unbelievable, because it is exactly what good maraschino cherries looked and tasted like when I was a kid. They are dark. The syrup is thick and dark. The aroma is the essence of cherries and their presence in a cocktail is magical -- taking cherries from a flavorless, if colorful, garnish, to another layer of delicious bouquet and taste.Unless you are over 45, it is quite possibly you never tasted a maraschino cherry like theseWhile the price is not inexpensive, the value, in terms of what is added to any drink or recipe with these, is quite high. Two of these cherries will outpower a dozen of those bright red "things". And don't let cocktails be the only use. Your children deserve to experience what a "cherry" cola or other soft-drink "should" taste like, or an over-the-top sundae or banana split. Similarly, I believe I am going to get my wife to make a Bavarian Schwartzwalder Kirchtorte (Bavarian Black Forest Cherry Cake) with these to really experience the sublime bliss that is cherry and chocolate.They muddle in cocktails extremely well and infuse the entire drink with an exquisite hint of cherry. Old Fashionds and Manhattans become more sublime, and cherries suddenly hold their own with oranges, lemons and other fruits in a cocktail.

Like nearly everyone I know, I grew up with the neon red cherries. They had a distinctive taste, and maybe the distinctive taste made me think they were good. Try these, and you'll understand what the other reviewers are raving about. Incredible, densely-flavored and delicious. They're expensive enough you'll probably save them for your special cocktails, but you'll be glad you did.
these cherries are fabulous. kick the red american ones out of the fridge and eat these instead. they're sweet, rich and flavorful. i wish i could eat these all the time.

We have gotten into reviving old cocktail recipes, ie Manhattan, Old Fashioned, etc.  Many of these call for maraschino cherries, which usually means the neon red plastic super sweet tasteless things in the jar at the supermarket. We ordered Luxardo cherries from Italy and WOW!  These are the real thing. The cocktails are so much better.  As usual, when you decide to make something yourself, always use the best ingredients. You will be rewarded when you taste the results. These cherries are great!
These cherries are absolutely amazing! They make the difference between an ok Old Fashioned or Manhattan, to the best you've ever had. Buy some. Now.
They cost so much and they are so good.  Upped the price of our Friday night old fashions, but worth it.

column9: Perfect for Manhattans, Old Fashioneds, and other mixed drinks
column10: Once you've tried these, you will never go back to using those bleached-and-dyed red cherries.  For a Manhattan, use these cherries, a nice rye, and "Antica Formula" sweet (red) vermouth by Carpano - you won't be disappointed.

Damn tasty, add a rich, mellow sweetness to a Manhattan. Unlike the day-glo, sharp and sickly-sweet abominations you often find, these are a welcome garnish to cocktails.Try a few on some vanilla ice cream. Damn tasty.

I enjoy a quality cocktail.  Two.  As you know, the finest ingredients make the most excellent drinks.  Marachino cherries, key garnishes in a variety of cocktails, come in a variety of qualities.  Most offer up a glisteningly red cherry, a little crushed, with plenty of sugary matrix.The Luxardo cherries are similar, but have a much thicker, darker purple-black syrup, but the same crushed little cherry.  I did not find the consistency or quality of the cherry itself to be of any lesser or greater quality than your average marachino cherry.  The syrup, however, was less run-of-the-mill.  It's not nearly as sweet and imparts some distinct cherry flavor.  The syrup is drastically different from normal marachino cherry syrup, so be carefull with those old fashioneds and manhattans.  I did enjoy a fine drizzle of it over a frothy bourbon sour (yum).  It may do well as an expensive substitute and impart a change of hue to a cocktail or two.  You'll find a fine use, i'm sure...Worth the price?  ummm...not on my salary (and consumption rate). I was expecting something impressive.  These were not.

Yes they are NOT cheap! But, when you serve yourself , or a guest,  a Manhattan with these cherries at the bottom instead of those insipid things we call Maraschino cherries, you will be ruined for life. JUST TRY THEM!

I was in Dallas when I originally discovered these tasty cherries.  If you are an Old Fashion lover, then these cherries are a "must have".  They are smaller than their counterparts, dark in color and loaded with flavor.  I know it is strange to get excited over a cherry, but these are delicious.

column9: No finer cherry on the market!
column10: These are the cherries you've been waiting for.  Dark, intense, just chewy enough, with a sweet but not cloying lingering flavor.  I don't know how I made manhattans without them.

column9: Will take your Manhattan over the Moon!!!
column10: I was trying to get my homemade Manhattan as good as my favorite bar and was wondering if the cherries were the ticket. YES!!Definitely worth the money if you are seeking to make the perfect Manhattan! Try it with the Sazerac Brand Rye Whiskey for a change of pace from the bourbon...amazing! column9: A new perspective on a Manhattan
column10: If you love a good Manhattan and especially enjoy the cherry at the end, these cherries are for you.Very dense, sweet and in a syrup, two cherries and a bit of syrup add a better sweet component than sweet vermouth. These things were born to be in a Manhattan!  Also recommend skipping the vermouth and adding the Italian liquor Amaro.  That and these cherries will change your Manhattan experience forever
These tasty cherries and cherry juice make such a difference in your cocktail!  Use instead of regular big maraschino cherries.....They are the best !!

I have been considering these for a while but didn't want to pay shipping charges so when I found them locally I decided to give them a try.  Made manhattans and froo froo frozen drinks with them at a party last night and nobody particularly raved. The syrup is very thick and rich.  They are quite good but not worth the exorbitant price.  I probably will not buy them again.

I purchased this product after reading the great reviews here on Amazon and on cocktail-oriented websites. Having spent a good deal of time experimenting with different recipes to make my own cocktail cherries, I was eager to try this classic product. I very much expected to love these.  Unfortunately, I found these a little disappointing, and I thought I'd share a more measured evaluation with other Amazon readers.Visually: The Luxardo cherries look great; nearly black in color and coated in a very thick dark red syrup. They're also small; maybe half the diameter of a bing cherry that you might buy in the produce aisle. I think they're somewhat smaller than the commonly available cheap pink maraschino cherries.Aroma: They smell very nice. Like cherry soda, I guess.Texture: They're quite firm. When you bite into them, there's a slight "pop" before they dissolve into sugary goo. It's a little weird if you're expecting the texture of fruit.Taste: This is my big complaint. Yes, there's a nice cherry flavor, but it's completely overshadowed by the fact that they are SWEET. I mean unbelievably, mind-blowingly, unpleasantly SWEET. They are a mouthful of pure cherry-tinged SUGAR. I hadn't quite realized this from reading the earlier reviews, and I was expecting something like a slightly sweetened natural cherry flavor. Make no mistake: this product is candy, and it no longer has any similarity to the texture and flavor of an actual cherry.I purchased this product to dress up our cocktails, but I don't really want to drop a lump of candy into my manhattans. However I didn't want to give up on this expensive product, so I've tried an experiment to try to salvage them: I've poured off most of the syrup from the bottle and topped it off with unsweetened brandy.  I'll let it sit for a few days in the fridge, and then I'll check back to see if they're more palatable. I'm hoping the booze will temper the cloying sweetness of the product.In the meantime, we've gone back to using our home-made cocktail cherries. They actually taste like cherries.

I saw these cherries on Chef John's demonstration of his Foldovers other wise known as Gallettes...they looked so good I had to try them. Now, I'm NOT normally a maraschino cherry fan (you know the kind that come on icecream sundays...I usually never eat these) ....BUT Luxardos are nothing like those we find in our grocery store...they're very rich and just melt in your mouth...THESE CHERRIES ARE SO WORTH IT!!!!!! Yes, they are pricey, but you got to try them at least once, they're AMAZING!I keep them in my fridge for an occational sweet tooth treat...you know,I think I'm going to have one right now!
Give your cocktails the Luxe treatment with Luxardo maraschino cherries.  These are incredibly rich.  The cherry flavor is strong and authentic.  I will never go back to grocery store cherries!

I couldn't find this product in any store, so I was glad when I found it here. I wanted to get it in time for a birthday gift that was only a few days away. I wasn't expecting it to ship right away and figured I'd be waiting, but it shipped the next day and I was able to give it as a gift in time. Oh, and they are delicious.
Perfect for a manhattan and old fashioned! This product arrived earlier than anticipated and in perfect condition. I would recommend these cherries to anyone looking for a delicious cocktail.

First, I love these cherries. I make specialty cocktails, and these do terrific in both old fashions and, of course, Bourbon & Cherries.I'm addicted. Though, you might find them for less (when counting shipping) at your local alcohol warehouse.

column9: For your Manhattan this is an absolute necessity.
column10: Why cheapen your wonderful Manhattan with a store bought, probably high fructose corn syrup infused, bright red cherry. This cherry as just as important as the top shelf vermouth (Carpano Antica Formula Sweet Vermouth) and, of course, the rye (not bourbon!!). Plus, great service from the amazon.com retailer. My jar had a crack in it and a replacement was shipped; no questions asked. Treat yourself to these cherries. Treat your self to a top shelf Manhattan. You deserve it.
Forget those fake, pink, imposters and get the real deal. These are real cherries, in real cherry syrup, and a must for any home bar. Manhattan anyone?
If you are hesitant about the price, don't let that deter you. These cherries are a flavor explosion you won't want to miss. Fabulous.

Bourbon or rye, soda or not, if you make your old fashioned with fruit Luxardo Cherries move it up a level. Same story for Manhattans.After all, you use premium liquor in your drinks, why not premium cherries?
We used these cherries mostly in drinks which they are awesome in. They have such a rich flavor you would swear they were made by iron chefs.

Once you have tasted these you will never go back to the bright chemical colored and tasting super market variety of Maraschino Cherries. These have all the flavor and texture of real fruit. they make the perfect Manhattan and are quite good spooned over ice cream. The flavor is truly a revelation.

If a grand Manhattan, on a cold winter night, before the fireplace, -- is your thing, make it grand with an Italian Cherry from Luxardo.  The best.  Two oz. Dickel.  One oz. Red Vermouth.  Teaspoon Luxardo juice.  One cherry.  Shake with ice and drink straight from Martini glass.  It doesn't get any better than this.

column9: You wouldn't believe there are cherries worth this price, but they are amazing!
column10: These can absolutely make a cocktail go from good to incredible.My favorite: brut cava, vodka, cherry syrup (home made in my case), and one of these with some their own syrup... perfect Marilyn Monroe.They are a must-have in your home bar if you are a cocktail lover.

column9: For a gourmet manhattan, thank you Amazon.
column10: How can a good manhattan be enhanced?  I found out at the U. S Grant hotel bar in San Diego where they serve Luxardo Gourmet Maraschino Cherries with the manhattans mixed there.  I had them write down the name of the cherries and when I got home in Florida several days later an Amazon order was placed. Got the cherries three days later. My popularity in the neighborhood has been enhanced, also, as this is an experience not to be missed and as a good neighbor I passed it on.

These Luxardo Maraschino cherries are nothing like those radioactive red cherries packed in sugar water. These are real live Maraschino (a variety like Bing) cherries packed in very thick syrup. They have really great wild cherry flavor and are much smaller.The one complaint I have with these cherries is the incredibly thick syrup. For cocktails the syrup is too thick for my taste.The cherries are small, about half the size of the Maraschino cherries found in most stores. There is real intense cherry flavor in these little nuggets. The cherries are all stemless, so they require a pick of some kind for drinks. On the other hand, on top of ice cream, the lack of stem is a great thing. Sadly watching your friend tie the stem up in a knot with their tongue, will just have to be done with other cherries.There is no alcohol in these cherries. The 360 gram jar contains about the same weight of cherries as a standard sixteen ounce jar of radioactive cherries.For cocktails, I prefer cherries preserved in brandy, Morello Cherries in Liqueur and Kirsch Unique recipe Griottines from France 11.8 oz.Luxardo makes some amazing products, their cherry liquor and lemoncello is fabulous. Their canned cherries are wonderful, certainly a step a long ways up from those radioactive cherries.

My original review was pretty harsh, but after a few months I have gotten somewhat used to these and enjoy them more than I did originally. I will restate, however, that Griottines are much better and have less of a fake syrupy taste and hard chewy texture.I bought these at the recommendation of a local liquor store owner, who thought that they were amazing as far as cocktail cherries are concerned. My past preference has been Griottines, which never seem available on Amazon these days (in the larger, more reasonably priced jars). The Griottines are nice small, tender sour cherries. I would suggest finding those somewhere on line in the larger (10+ oz) size, which is more reasonably priced than the small size, or these Luxardo. Do yourself a favor and seek them out.

A very very strong candied cherry flavor, almost like the Cherry flavored Sucrets.  You probably would not eat Cherry flavored Sucrets on their own for dessert, but these Luxardo cherries cook very nicely in desserts.  Still, the flavor was a little "flourescent" and unnatural in the baked goods.Probably better left for drinks.  The texture of the cherry is far superior to a normal store bought Maraschino cherry. Very firm.

We have a couple cats as a part of our household. They always seem to be hungry and underfoot when we're in the kitchen. We feed them twice a day and mostly with dry prepared cat food. One of them requires a prescription dry cat food because of a urinary problem. In any case, I'd think the little dears would get awfully tired of that dry crunchy stuff so every once in a while we give them some special treats. My wife bought a variety of Fancy Feast Appetizers for them and every now and then we split a flat between the cats in addition to the dry crunchy granules. Do they like the appetizers? Oh, yeah! But then, they're not really fussy and will eat almost any type of cat food. I guess, the treats mainly relieve our guilt feelings.Gary Peterson

Great Tasting Coffee!  I only knew Green Mountain Coffee in small K-cups, and never thought about the company and/or quality until I received a sample for review from Bzz Agent.  I now know that this is a great coffee and good company.  I received two bags - Pumpkin Spice and House Blend for review.  Both are equally wonderful.  Both are Fair Trade Certified, and Made in the USA - two great things, - support our planet, and support US economy.  Both House Blend and Seasonal Pumpkin Spice are Kosher, carrying  symbol.  Very nice packaging, and I love the one way valve that let's you smell the coffee.  Great feature if you have someone over and want to let them smell the coffee before you brew it.House Blend is USDA organic, which is great.  Coffee tastes just as it says - Medium Roast, with very nice full body and is not overly acidic.  Regular grind is nice size grind and not small powder that you get with some other brands.  Coffee keeps its taste both hot and cold.Seasonal Pumpkin Spice surprised me by the fact that it is not overly spiced.  I generally do not like spiced coffee as most of the spiced varieties completely overpower the taste of coffee, but it is not the case here.  Wonderful blend where spices are just right - giving you nice taste of coffee with just a hint of spices bringing you in touch with the season.  Seasonal Pumpkin Spice is lighter than House Blend, but very unique and first Pumpkin Spice Coffee that I was able to truly enjoy.  Probably worth mentioning that Pumpkin spice does have both natural and artificial flavors, and artificial flavors are a minus in my opinion, but it absolutely does not impact the overall outstanding quality.  Just as the house blend, nice grind and keeps all the flavors when coldI am now a fan of Green Mountain Coffee and would definitely recommend it as high quality, great tasting, not overly acidic, premium coffee, that can be enjoyed both hot and cold!!! Great Job Green Mountain Coffee!!!

A lot of tea, excellent bulk, strong and fresh, good for making summer iced tea pitchers or any quantity drinking.  Hot with stevia and lemongrass oil drops is wonderful. I have tried other brands but the bagged lemongrass teas have too little tea in the bag per what I wanted. This is a lot of tea! There is some fine powder but it dissolves quickly, and it's mostly lemongrass leaves/stems. At first sight it seemed a little dry=, but the quality is good. One scoop makes a strong cup.  And it's one of the only organic lemongrass teas. Also the package is now sealable, keeps it fresh. air-tight seal-able. Lemongrass is also available in essential oils, a drop or two enhances tea (or Thai coconut soup). Repeat order!

Yeah, I agree it is kind of powdery but there is still more lemon "grass" than powder.  I have a feeling that you're just going to get powder as the strands of grass break and get moved around in the bag.  I just think.. well, I'm still getting the benefit.  I like the flavor.  Reminds me of fruit loops in a way :)  I will have it alone or add green tea sometime :)This is my 3rd time ordering this tea.  My ND suggested it to boost my immune system.

column9: More like Lemongrass Powder than Tea
column10: I rarely review anything but this may save someone from making a mistake.I tried lemongrass tea from another source (adigo tea) and really liked it so I looked for a cheaper bulk source on amazon.  I figured all lemongrass tea must at least be similar.  Boy was I wrong.  This tea has the consistency of finely ground sawdust. There are no real leaves from the lemongrass plant.  What's worse, is that the taste is very weak and somewhat weird.  I tried several different steeping temps and times with no luck.  This whole bag is now going in the garbage as I've ordered new stuff from my original source.

Being at the point of my life when going out for dancing and cocktails with my husband is never going to happen again and going out for dinner is getting closer and closer to the time when we used to go out for lunch, I needed a new stimulating activity and chose trying new coffees to fill that need.Sooooooo, after reading all the 5 star kudos about Jacobs Meister Rostung coffee (ground) and judging that the price was right I hit the "add to cart" button.The coffee arrived yesterday and all 4 packs were tightly vacuum sealed so they're fresh. Good.Opened a pack and the first thing I noticed was that the coffee looks quite dry.Brewed a pot after dinner for myself and a dinner guest so I had someone to share the "fun" with. He drinks his coffee with sugar only and for me it's just cream.We sipped, tasted, considered, mulled over and sniffed our cups of coffee.Here's the conclusion: It has a very earthy taste, not terrible but my taste buds weren't cheering at all. It is also a bit acidic for my taste even with cream or in my guest's case, sugar added. Over all the flavor reminded me very much of the Costa Rican blend coffee that famous $4.00 a cup place sells and I don't like that one very much either.Also, for the first time in eons my stomach felt very acidic after finishing my cup of coffee...can't blame that entirely on the coffee - it might have been from my cooking.Overall this coffee was dry, has a very earthy taste, seemed acidic and will not be on my 'will buy again' list.

We like this better than the Jacobs Krönung. It seems smoother and more flavorful. Great price. This is not for folks that like the Starbucks type of coffee. It is roasted lightly.Jacob's Coffee Jacobs Meister Rostung, 17.6-Ounce (Pack of 4)

column9: Good Quality Rose Congou Type Tea - Light Easy-Drinking
column10: The first thing you notice when you open up the tin is the aromatic floral scent of rose but it's not overpowering.  Once brewed, the tea is a deep red color and rosy tasting.  It makes for a mellow cup of tea and is easy drinking and light in caffeine.  You can enjoy a whole pot full here and this makes it great company with a long novel.  Definitely not a bracing breakfast style tea if that's what you're looking for but if you like subtle aromatic teas, this is a sure bet.  Doesn't get bitter even with oversteeping.  A real pleasure.  If you like this, try lychee congou if you can track it down.  Very aromatic and mellow as well.

column9: A fantastic addition to my tea assortment!
column10: I should start by mentioning that, although I have enjoyed a wide variety of teas over the last ten years or so, I am not the most refined tea drinker here so you should probably check out some of the other reviews as well.I discovered Taylors of Harrogate probably 5 years ago and I have loved their breakfast teas very much. I had not come across their China Rose Petal until a few months ago when a British import shop opened in a nearby town (Haddonfield, NJ). I bought it because I loved the jasmine petal teas that I bought when I was in China and I love a certain rose incense, so I figured that I would love rose petal tea as well.When I tried it I was slightly disappointed because it wasn't very strong, by my standards, though I admit that most tea drinkers probably appreciate delicate teas as much as they do strong teas, though perhaps in different situations. I like my tea to look like coffee once I've added milk and this wasn't strong enough for me so I had to try again, this time blending the rose petal tea with a stronger unflavored black tea. It was in this way that I settled on an absolutely fantastic afternoon tea - one cup of water, one teaspoon of China Rose Petal, and a bag of P.G. Tips.Rose Petal Leaf Tea has made an excellent addition to my assortment of tea and I enjoy it in my own way all through the winter. If you aren't as hung up on strong tea as I am you will likely appreciate subtleties that I miss doing it my way. Either way, if you are interested enough in rose petal tea to read reviews on Amazon then I can only imagine that you will get your money's worth from Taylors of Harrogate China Rose Petal.

Taylors of Harrogate offer a variety of teas.  These may be had in tea bags or in the loose leaf form and packed in gorgeous tins.  From Yorkshire Gold, ideal for cold winter afternoons, to the classic Earl Grey, Tayors' teas are top of the line.  China Rose Petal tea is perfect blend of a black tea with a light addition of a few rose petals.  The bouquet is sublime. The taste terrific.  Strongly recommend.  A super gift or a treat to give yourself.
Took me several years to find this online since our local Balducci's stopped carrying it.  Nice rose flavor.  Makes me happy to drink it in the morning or afternoon.  Good quality as always.

This tea is wonderfully delicate and aromatic, and stays that way even if over-brewed. It has far less of a kick than the black teas I usually favor, but for me that's a good thing. In fact, this tea has made it easy and quite pleasurable to cut my caffeine intake while still enjoying a gentle lift from a memorable morning tea.Also, while most of the Taylor's loose teas are composed of the broken up leaves used for filling tea bags, this blend is a whole leaf tea.

column9: Taylor's of Harrogate China Rose Petal Leaf Tea
column10: This is good quality tea and I am enjoying it.  It doesn't have as pronounced a rose flavor as my favorite Rose tea, which if Republic of Tea's Rose Petal, but it is only available at limited times.  And this is very good.
The tea arrived in a timely fashion, but unfortunately it was stale and rather flavourless. It does not compare with the product as purchased in the UK or sent to Paris.

Black tea not only tastes and smells good, but has a multitude of health properties.  Black tea has been credited with regulating blood sugar; may prevent stroke; promotes heart health; boosts energy and has a fraction fo the caffein found in coffee.  It's also a good stress buster.  Black tea also helps to maintain healthy cardiovascular and circulatory systems.This tea has a rich, pleasant aromaof rose petals.  The tea itself takes on a rosy color when you brew it.  The tea itself has a soothing, pleasant flavor and you can actually polish off a pot of this tea.  For those who like a gentle, subtle flavor and a gentle, subtle drink, then you want this tea.  This tea is a good companion with some soothing George Harrison and a good read.  I highly recommend it!

The smell of the leaves themselves are extremely fragrant, yet the tea itself has a light rosy flavor and is very soothing. It also comes at a great price! You get a lot of tea leaves with this order. I drink this fairly often and I plan on buying more once I run out, but that won't be for a very long time.
I absolutely love this rose petal tea! It's delicious and I like that it comes in a pack of two !
This is a very pleasant tea. I like black teas with flowers and this one is my fawourite for afternoon tea. Less expensive on Amazon than my local store where it is not always available.

column9: My favorite Rose Petal leaf tea
column10: I have compared this with the Tao of Tea Rose petal black, and it's far superior. Not only do you get more quantity, the quality is higher as well. This tea has larger, tastier leaves, larger and more abundant rose petals, and doesn't contain any "rose essence" to make up for lack of flavor as the aforementioned brand does (check the ingredients).This is great iced as well! Also, try it with a bit of raw organic honey. I can't keep enough tins of this in stock I love it so much.

column9: Excellent Blend of Black and Rose.
column10: Was a little skeptical at first but after the first pot I am thinking about ordering a couple of more two paks.

Not enough menthol flavor and a little too much sugar. Would also like a little more pine flavor. However, this is one of the best tasting candies I have ever had!  If only they would cut about 1/3 of the sugar in it.

My husband loves these jerk nuts but they are very hard to find in stores. My order arrived quickly and was packaged nicely. I would order from them again. I was satisfied with my order and would recommend these nuts to anyone who likes a little spice on their peanuts.

I eat mine mashed on buttered toast with fresh black pepper. These are medium fish, running 5 per tin, in good condition, tender but not quite mushy. These are my first hot-sauce sardines. The spicy hot sauce almost overwhelms the taste of the fish, so I'd say this is more of a protein/hot-sauce experience than a sardine snack. Luckily, they're not too salty. The sauce is very spicy for a mass consumer product, but for dedicated heat/pain folks, I'm sure these fishies will be almost mild. Frankly, I was surprised by how decent these fish were for the price compared to some of the other cut-rate sardines I've tried. When I need a change from my usual sardines in tomato sauce, I'll reach for these guys. Heck, I had a positive enough experience that I'm looking forward to trying other brands of hot-sauce fish.

This is a taste made by brilliance and dedication of the 100 or so people who live at the Italian commune Forteto in the Tuscan hills.  The cows and sheep herds live on the farm. Pecorino Stagionato is tasty and memorable.  It is a fine cheese to serve guests and to keep around to indulge yourself.

column9: Ass Kickn' Ketchup is kick ass
column10: Spicey, good meatloaf recipe. Love the stuff... bout several bottles of it! Tried it on burgers, fries and used as dipping sauce, and it has always turned out wonderfully. Looking for other things to use it with... like chili.

I often found this kind of Japanese style curry in my lunch box when I was young. I really grew up with this. Kokumaro is relatively less sweet than Vermont curry, the other kind of curry also sold by House Foods. It is a good ingredient for meal-rich curry.
Tastes the best. you will get used to the hot taste in your mouth after a while and it is so good. Stains white stuff and tupperware though so beware!!

My mother used to cook this all the time. I decided to make one myself. The directions weren't hard at all and I was able to replicate hers. I soaked the potatoes in water overnight. This allows the potato to become soft. I highly suggest you do this. You can use half of one box of curry to make less. I made a crock full with one box and I think I'll be eating this for 2-3 more days. Luckily, I have two other roommates. So use half if you're only eating for yourself. This claims to be 4 out 5 hotness but I don't think it's that hot. I had to add two tablespoons of red crushed peppers to spice it up but it was still not hot enough for me. It doesn't affect my rating because I know my tolerance for spicy food is crazy high.My roommates loved it. They never had it before and I think Kokumaro curry is a great introduction to the world of curry.

While this is reasonably spicy, it somehow seemed less satisfying than the Java curry I had last year. And on occasion it left me with a bloated feeling, but it probably was just my system or the vegetables I used. I would go with House's Java or Vermont curry next time.
I love this curry sauce so much. It's so easy to follow the directions and so delicious. Will definitely buy again.

I should start this off by saying that prior to trying this mix, I have NEVER liked bloody marys. Every time I tried one, I would be disappointed, and grossed out. Now that being said, this mix blew my mind! It is the best bloody mary I've ever had, and I love love LOVE it! Definitely worth the money as it is concentrated, and delicious with some lime flavored soda water added. MMMMmmMMMMMM.. I'm having one right now! :)

Thick and disgusting.  Not even particularly spicy.  You have to dilute it (obnoxious hassle) but even with ice sitting in the drink for a long time or cutting it with seltzer, an Iguana Bloody Mary is still syrupy and unpleasant.  I poured the remainder of the bottle down the drain.  You're better off making your own Bloody Mary from scratch or for mixers, Mr. and Mrs. T's is still the best and most reliable.
