Russell Stover Sugar Free Jelly Beans are a good substitute for Jelly Bellies. Many flavors taste the same as the more expensive Jelly Bellies.  I enjoy the variety of flavors.  Unlike some sugar free products, where all flavors taste the same, Russel Stover Sugar Free Jelly Beans have distinctive flavors that run true to what you expect.  I especially love the buttered popcorn, cinnamon, and licorice flavored jelly beans.

These jelly beans taste as if they are full of sugar, but they are not. I must say the flavors were excellent!!  The only problem that any of us had was if we consumed more than a handful, we had very bad stomach problems.

I love Russell Stover.  These jelly beans are not too sweet for me, have a nice fruity flavor and no after taste.  But you have to be careful with portion size.  You may want to eat as many as Russell Stover says that you can, but don't.  Stomach rumblings will occurr.  You can have about 10 jelly beans to get a flavorful sugar rush without offending friends and family.

column9: Tastes amazing, but makes you miserable
column10: These jelly beans taste fantastic. I loved eating them, but the problem came afterwards. I saw the warnings about not eating too much, but even just a few made me incredibly ill.

There is a disclamer on this product, stating that excess consumption may cause gastric distress.They are wrong........ a SMALL serving caused me to have gas, a regular serving (1/4th of a bag) caused me 4 hrs of diarrhea.
These taste great, the best sugarfree jelly beans I've ever tasted. Of course be warned that most sugarfree candy if you eat more than seven or eight at time you will have stomach issues.

column9: Tasty But Not As Good As They Used To Be
column10: When this product came out a few years ago, the box included the dry mix, as well as a separate pouch of moist raisins.  These muffins were a big hit every time I made them, even for our tweener nieces, who usually look at anything bran as "ew gross."  Unfortunately, the manufacturer changed the recipe, and now dry raisins are simply incorporated into the dry mixture.  I noticed a distinct negative change in the moistness of the muffins.  And is it just me, or did the fat content increase?  At any rate, still a tasty and relatively healthy option for breakfast.  And very easy--and fast--to make.

column9: Sun-Maid Honey Raisin Bran Muffin Mix
column10: Thank you Amazon for carrying this product I found it available when living in Massachusetts, now in Virginia, couldn't find it on the shelves in several stores I visited.  Much easier to purchase thru Amazon, a dozen boxes delivered to my door, how good does it get?  Thank you again, I use egg whites instead of whole eggs and instead of using oil, use apple sauce and a very healthy muffin will be enjoyed.

You need to try them.

Wow Sun Maid -- you NEVER disappoint!!!I baked these muffins, even adding pineapple, as suggested on the side of the box -- the muffins (all 12 of them) came out of the oven as scrumptious, semi-moist morsels of perfection, right up to the slightly crispy but still juicy raisins on the tops of each muffin.They stored well - I eventually put them (covered with foil) in the fridge, and now I am taking the remainder to work with me.You only need one egg per mix, and some oil or butter, and liquid (in my case I used pineapple juice as liquid) -- it takes very little time to mix (I used a big big serving fork to mix up the batter with) and they pop into and out of the oven in no time.The price is right and the result is delicious!!!

I first tasted these  yummy muffins at a bed and breakfast.  The owner almost didn't want to admit that the muffins came from a box.  But I didn't care, I just wanted to know how to get them for my own kitchen oven.I've not been able to find these in the grocery store so I tried Amazon.  Amazing!  Sometimes, I add chocolate chips and pecans to the recipe for an even tastier treat.  Excellent muffins!

This mix is very good, but even better with fresh or frozen berries.  I've added marionberries, boysenberries, blueberries, and raspberries, all at various times.  The blueberry was not quite as tasty as the other berries, but all were good.  I usually just add a full quart bag of frozen berries and bake the whole thing like a cake. It comes out like a cobbler and SO good.  It doesn't have as much fiber as you'd think, but still super.

These have got to be the best muffins ever. My kids LOVE them! We bought them for years at our local grocery store. Then they stopped carrying them. I found them at another local grocery store but only for a short time. We haven't had them in well over a year. So when all 12 boxes arrive here in the next week, we are going to be so excited!!!! I like to break up pecan halves on top before baking. The pecans get nice and roasted! THANK YOU AMAZON FOR CARRYING THESE! PLEASE continue to do so.

Since there seem to be no more Sunmaid Honey Bran Muffin mixes out there, I bought this brand but it doesn't compare. I won't purchase again.
i share my muffins with the women in the other trailers on my street. in the rv park in florida. that way i don,t have to bake any ,they bake them for me. a great way to get to know your neibours.
These muffins are great, so moist. Not dried out like other mixes can be. Can't find at store's around here...

column4: Paul Tognetti "The real world is so much more...
column9: The best bran muffins I have ever eaten....period!
column10: While I have written lots of reviews on amazon.com I very rarely review grocery items.  But when I find a product that I can enthusiastically endorse I enjoy passing on the information to my fellow Amazon members.  Such is the case with Krusteaz Honey Raisin Bran Muffin Mix.  This product was formerly marketed under the Sun-Maid brand and has been around for about ten years now. My wife and I count ourselves very big fans.Prior to the introduction of Krusteaz Honey Raisin Bran Muffin Mix I had never really seen a bran muffin mix at the grocery store.  You could either make them from scratch using the recipe on a box of Kellogg's All-Bran or buy them at a bakery on donut shop.  Since we never had the All-Bran on hand we always opted for the latter option.  Happily, Krusteaz solved that problem with the introduction of this fantastic mix.  You can whip a batch of these muffins in just a few short minutes and within an hour you will have hot tasty bran muffins emerging from your oven.With Krusteaz Honey Raisin Bran Muffin Mix you get tasty bran muffins that are crispy on the outside and soft and moist on the inside.  Best of all they are packed with juicy and delicious Sun-Maid baking raisins.  Bran muffins just don't get any better than this.  I would take these muffins over any other bran muffins I have ever had.  They are that good!  We generally find that we can make 6 good size muffins from this 18.25 oz package.  Krusteaz Honey Raisin Bran Muffin Mix generally sells for about $3.00 per box and is rarely on sale.  Also, I have found that not all supermarket chains carry this item.  Just to be sure we don't get caught short we generally keep 4 or 5 boxes on hand. I was pleased to discover that this product is now available through Amazon. If you love bran muffins like I do and have never tried this product I urge you to do so.  Very highly recommended!

column9: SunMaid Honey Raisen Bran Muffin Mix.....Great muffins.
column10: These are the best bran muffins I've ever eaten!  When my local grocery store no longer stocked the item, I liked them so well I ordered 12 boxes from Amazon!  To make them even better, I mix in 8 oz of pecan bits. Twelve boxes seems like a lot, but since my niece and her family introduced them to me, we divide the twelve boxes and they go fast!
I can't get these muffins at my grocery store any more, and my husband and I love them.  I was so happy that I could purchase these on Amazon.  Very happy husband now.

***** THIS REVIEW IS FOR THE SUNMAID HONEY RAISIN BRAN MUFFINS NOT Krusteaz.  It appears that Amazon has switched products.  Just wanted to make sure that anyone reading this would know that this review was written specifically for the SUNMAID product. ****I was SO thankful to find these muffins on Amazon!  I fell in love with them back when they were on my grocery store's shelves and was extremely disappointed when they disappeared.  Although I love the fact that I can purchase them on-line, it would be fabulous to have them in the stores again someday.  Even if you think you don't like bran muffins, you need to try these. Very good healthy muffins no longer available in Omaha, NE. I modify the mix by adding flax seed. I have one every morning. Delivery was prompt and product arrived in excellent shape.

My local stores stopped carrying this mix and I'm thrilled to be able to buy the mix through Amazon.  I highly recommend this mix to anyone who wants a moist Bran Muffin. After reading several recipes for homemade brownies, I decided to play it lazy and go with a box. column9: I made chocolatey, scrumptious semi-healthy CUPCAKES from this mix!
column10: Ghirardelli chocolate is absolutely the best. (It's even a valid reason for going to San Francisco for a weekend -- especially to their Pier 39 shop. But I digress.)- I am a very healthy, conscientious eater who happens to luuvvve good dark chocolate -- which is, after all, from a natural plant, full of antioxidants, and it keeps your hair silky & shiny, not to mention the theobromine and phenethylamine releasing the feel-good seratonin from your brain...you with me? - So, in order to satisfy both sides of my Gemini nature I decided to alter the suggested additions to this Ghirardelli Brownie Mix as follows: instead of l/2 cup oil, I used 1/4 cup of organic virgin coconut oil, slightly nuked just to melt it (you can read about why it's the best oil for you), and an additional 1/4 cup of water to balance the scoop of chocolate whey isolate protein powder I add to the batter, to establish a better protein/carbohydrate balance, which slows down the 'sugar rush' to your bloodstream.  I then decided to make cupcakes, because they bake faster and I wanted a warm one ASAP.  I greased the cupcake tins with butter and preheated the oven to 350 deg., baking them for 20-25 minutes (use the toothpick test). It made ten VERY delicious cupcakes, which at about $2.50 per box is only a quarter for a gourmet chocolate cupcake -- such a deal, yes?  Enjoy! ~

column10: i want to first of all start off with the fact that i LOVE bobo's bars.  they are amazing and this is not a review of them, by any means.  this is a review on the actually seller of the bars here on amazon.  the bars, which are pretty much the same price to get at the store and from bobo's directly, arrived hard and overly sticky and not crumbly, as they should be.  when you buy them as they are meant to be, they are soft and crumbly and moist and amazing.  when i purchased them here, they were hard as a rock, sticky, and not crumbling in the least.  so disappointed since they are not cheap.i recommend the bars themselves, just not through this seller.

I love Bobo Bars: they're a great snack after a workout and love to put them in my kids' lunch boxes. Unfortunately, I was sent a box of bars that are just days away from their expiration date. They're old and stale, which is really disappointing since I was really looking forward to them. I guess I'll have to learn to make them myself or spend more time in Boulder, where you can get them everywhere.
very good and filling, perfect for a quick snack or when you won't be able to eat a meal soon

This is a great-tasting, low fat product that is not available in the supermarkets in my area.  My favorite from Genisoy is the salt & pepper, but this product is right up there. I'm always skeptical of the soy based snacks regarding taste, but these, the salt & pepper variety and Glenny's BBQ fit the bill.
The chips came quickly and they were fresh, but they really need more garlic and onion flavoring.  I probably won't order this again.
I have been searching for a great tasting crispy snack that contains no corn, wheat or gluten.  I have finally found it, these soy crisps satisfy all my wishes.
I found the flavor to be flat, and almost tasteless. I would recommend the manufacturer add more flavor to their recipe. Crunch appeal was good
Cottage cheese + Soy Crisp's = awesome snack, also not that bad for youPros:- Tasty- Healthy- We regularlly purchase these and are never withoutCons:- Not healthy when you eat the whole bag

My only complaint for this product was that all three boxes had the same "mystery combination" so there was not a whole lot of variety. However, I was lucky enough to get Gushers so I was a happy camper. :)

Although the product photograph suggests that these combo packs will contain Stickerz/Stackerz/Shapes, the six disappointing boxes we bought did not. column9: If you want your kids eating...
column10: If you want a kids snack that is full of articial flavors and dyes and corn syrup... This is the one for you!

Jelly Flops are about half the price of first quality Jelly Belly beans.  Almost all of the Jelly Flops are edible and generally they taste the same as their premiun counterparts.  There are some factors to consider:1) There are a lot of the same flavors and none of others.  For example, in one bag, there can be more than 25% of a single flavor.2) The predmoninant flavors vary from bag to bag but there always seems to be a lot of red, green and purples.2) Most flops simply don't have the JB logo imprinted.  The remainder consists primarily of 'doubles' and a few 'triples'.  JB must reject anything larger than 3 beans since I've only rarely found these.4) Almost all of the beans are the most basic flavors.  There are virtually no special flavors, including: tropicals, alchohol, cinnamon, licorice and all mints.If you buy these from Amazon, not only do yo receive free shipping but also the occasional discount.

column9: Ok, but not worth the price
column10: These freeze pops are a great flavor but they really aren't anything that's a huge amount better than the mainstream freeze pops that are out there.  In short, they just aren't worth the price you pay for the Jelly Belly name.

It is awesome to find a product still exists from when you were a child.  Quaker Oats Grits have been around for quite some time and are still as wonderful as ever.  These grits do take 45 minutes of cooking time and stirring, however, the outcome is well worth the time and trouble.  These oldfashioned grits, I think, are much better than the quick variety.  I believe that once you try them, you will not return to the quick grits.

So glad to find these.  It's hard to have homemade biscuits and "quick" or, God forbid, "Instant" grits.  Put these on first and by the time the rest is ready, you have fabulous grits. I am a cook so time to do this isn't an issue.  Try them once and you won't go back!
You can't buy the real thing in the stores anymore, so this is a great find. Arrived in excellent time and shape. I will be a returning customer.

I can't find these in local stores (even the health food stores here don't sell any old-fashioned grits!), so was delighted to see them on Amazon. They come out thicker, creamier, and with more satisfying big pieces than the 5-min grits sold in the grocery store. They are just "not gritty!" (Good grits are not gritty, believe it or not!)Wonderful, fresh, super quick shipping with Amazon Prime. What more could you ask for?
I was ver disappointed when I opened this to fine that I paid almost $10 for a container of grits that normally cost no more than $3  plus the package didn't have a invoice or return label.

[[ASIN:B0002XIC0U Quaker Old Fashioned White Grits 1 lb 8 oz. container - 6 Unit Pack]Absolutely tasteless goo. Not a hint of true flavor found in the original Quaker Old Fashion grits and I don't mean the more recent "Instant" and "Quick" Quaker grits. I was appalled. I hope Amazon will find something better.
Haven't found these in stores for ten years. They cook up just as I remembered. They come out creamy with a nice consistencey. It is so good to have them back again.

column9: Correct product, different color box now.
column10: Got my 6 boxes they were the correct old fashioned grits that take a long time to cook.  Box color is now blue instead of red.

but I will never order a 16 pound bag of dog food with those shipping costs tagged on again.  I somehow thought I was going to save something.  Aside from having to wait 10 days for something I could have gone to PetSmart down the street for...oh, well you live and learn.

column9: Eukanuba adult small breed dry dog food
column10: Thanks. I can buy this dry dog food cheaper from Amazon than anywhere else. It is so easy to order this item from Amazon.com. Thanks again.

column9: Cheapest Price Around For A Great Dog Food
column10: If you are looking at this page then you probably already know that Eukanuba is a great food for your dogs. About ten years ago it was recommended to me by my vet and breeder and we haven't used anything else since. We have 2 1lb+- chihuahuas and are always struggling to keep them fattened up as they run around like the energizer bunny. One of our faves, very smooth and easy on the acidity without being bland, HOWEVER, the Tassimo retail is 7.99 each. Where is Amazon getting the inflated 'retail' price? Retail for a Pack of 2 is only $16, NOT $20. They do this on every T-Disc.

column9: Great Big Good Tasting Cup of Coffee
column10: I believe this is the best choice of any coffees used with the Tassimo.  It not only has a good taste, but it give you a large normal mug size cup of fresh brewed coffee.  The other Gevalia coffees are great (well, not the decaf), but they're too small.  I was using 2 for each cup of coffe.  This product has both.

column9: a bigger pour for your money
column10: i didn't realize that these pods actually brew a bigger (not watered down) cup o' joe.  i'm a big fan first thing in the morning, when i tend to prefer two cups of coffee.  this seems to be the perfect compromise!  i think it's 12oz vs the normal 8oz.
we love our tassimo coffee maker and this is our favorite coffee.  you can't go wrong with gevalia

column9: A GREAT WAY TO START THE DAY
column10: At our house we know it's a good morning when we begin the day with a steaming cup of this rich, full-bodied brew.  The flavor is the best - strong yet mellow, pure unadulterated coffee, no unique flavorings.  Plus, the aroma is superb. Now, that would be enough but to have a large 12 oz. cup is another bonus.  This is what my significant other refers to as a "real cup of coffee."  We use rather heavy 6" tall mugs that keep the coffee hot. Sunday mornings with the NY Times and a cup of this coffee are the best.  Enjoy!  - Gail Cooke

Of all the Gevalia coffees, this is my favorite.  To have a large cup in the morning is what I look forward to every day!  It tastes great, I am even having one in the evening.  It is more than the other coffees, but it satisfies my coffee craving.  This is probably my third or fourth time ordering the Morning Roast and I will continue to order this coffee.

column9: GELVALIA COMPARED TO MAXWELL HOUSE - T-DISC
column10: I bought this by mistake, thinking it was Maxwell House. It's ok and I'll drink it anyway (it's too expensive not too). Taste wise, I much prefer Maxwell House's 12oz T-Disc and it is lot's cheaper also, however, apparently Amazon can't sell Maxwell House yet. I'm waiting!!

I am very picky when it comes to coffee, but I've really been enjoying this product and would definitely recommend it to anyone for their choice of coffee. Very good flavor and just the right strength.
The product is great but bed bath and beyond has better prices.  they are 8.99 for 14 disc of the exact same item
I FIND THE TASSIMO COFFEE MAKER ALONG WITH THEIR COFFEE PRODUCTS TO BE BEYOND BELIEF ... GREAT ITEMS

In addition to making an outstanding cup of coffee, this is the only coffee in Tassimo's product line that produces a full 12oz. cup of coffee.  All of their coffee disks should be boosted to produce the larger cup size.

I love, love, love that this pours a 12 oz. cup vs. the standard 9 oz. cup.  The coffee itself is a bit on the weak side for my taste, but I love a super strong brew.  That said, I would get this again just for the 12 oz. pour.  My husband who prefers a slightly less strong brew than me, really enjoys this coffee.

I love my Tassimo coffee maker, but this is not one of my favorite brands. I've tried it and I will buy again when the price is right, but I think the taste is a little "thin" compared to other brands I've tried.

column9: Too Big For a Mug, Not Big Enough Flavor
column10: The Gevalia Morning Roast fills a coffee cup to the top so that there is no room for creamer.  I could forgive that and use a larger mug but what I can't forgive is the lack of flavor.  It's listed as "medium" but I find it weak and tasteless.  Full disclosure: I like bold coffees.UPDATE:  If you find yourself with a box of this coffee, here is a workaround for lack of flavor.  Turn off your machine when the coffee level is at the level of a normal 11 oz. cup of coffee.  You will find something to taste when you leave out the rest of the water.

column9: How many t-discs in here, help?
column10: I'd like to order this, but Amazon customer service is clueless about how many t-discs are in here, they told me to contact Tassimo (yeah, right)!Anyway, can anyone who has ordered this particular item from Amazon tell me how many t-discs come with this packaging. This coffee's main advantage is its size!The coffee itself is nothing special and it certainly does not deserved to be labelled as a "medium" roast coffee.  In fact I wonder, how weak must Gevalia's mild brews must be.I was excited about the variety of coffees when I purchased my Tassimo but so far I have been disappointed by all except the Starbuck's blends (which are pricier).  I made a special trip to the US to purchase a few packages of these since many comments pointed towards a comparable alternative to the Starbucks.Having gone through a few now, I'd argue that it's the same as the Nabob Morning Roast sold in Canada.Now back to the size argument, if you had an extra 3oz to the Starbuck's house blend, you will have much richer tasting 12 oz cup of medium roast coffee.

This coffee was a severe disappointment. Chuck it right into the same bin as the "fashionable" starbucks brews.Pros: Quite strong, and you get a full cup. The shock of bad taste facilitates a fast awakening in the morning.Cons: Taste.

After just purchasing my Tassimo machine, I have been tasting different brands. The Starbucks has too strong of a taste, and this Morning Roast too weak. Unfortunately I purchased 2 orders of this morning roast, and will have to endure quite a few more servings. In addition make sure you have a large coffee mug, because as advertised, this T-Disc makes a large cup. I am still searching for the perfect morning brew . . . .

column4: Kennie Holmes Worlund "In love with coffee"
column10: I love this product.  Amazon did a great job of getting it to me in a prompt time.

column9: Great when you want a large mug of coffee
column10: This is the only Tassimo I have found that provides you with a nice, large mug of coffee.  The others only fill my mug about 2/3.  Great, rich flavor.
If you laike a big volume coffee in the morning this one is great! (as are the most Tassimo coffees in general).
My wife and I bought the system so she would have access to the Starbucks lineup and we both agree that this is better.  We love it.
I've been a Gevalia user since the Tassimo was introduced.  Other products have come and gone.  The Gevalia flavor and consistent quality are what keep me coming back.
Shipped quickly. As advertised. Quality as expected. Works great! Really like that these make a full cup of coffee.
I like this product a lot.  It's full-bodied for those like me who drink their coffee black, and it's strong enough for those who like to add cream and sugar.

This coffee along with the Tassimo coffee machine makes the best single cup of coffee. This coffee along with many other choices Tassimo offers makes it a no brainer if you really love coffees and teas.

column9: The only coffee my hubby will drink!!
column10: Love our Tassimo and LOVE Gevalia!!!!  Love the fact it brews a larger cup.  I just wish they would do that with the signature blend!

This is one of my favorites for our tassimo.  It is a medium flavor coffee I would say not being a coffee expert.  I like that it is automatically set for tassimo to make a 12 oz cup instead of the 8 oz cup.  Great flavor in the morning.
Cofee itself is of good quality. I have to mention that this is a "large" size cup, which might suit those coffe lovers that like to fill up their travel coffee mugs.
Pleased with the product and the ease with which it was ordered.  Shipping time was really great.

This is a great coffe maker, for the purpose of making one cup at a time.The coffee tastes great, I used the Gevalia brand. Now that I have this appliance, I wouldn't want to be without it. Looking forward to trying various types of coffee.

I bought a Tassimo and I bought a Keurig and I kept the Keurig. The Keurig was easier to use with the K-Cups and they were much easier to find in the retail market. I also preferred the taste of the Keurig coffee selection.

[...]A nice mainstream coffee with no unpleasant flavors. Not too mild, not too bold, and not unduly acidic. But you had better make sure you have a large mug, because these T-discs are programmed to make a very large cup of coffee. if you have to make one drink then start your commute, then that's justifiable, but for at-home drinkers, you may get a better experience from less liquid. It won't get so cold and lose its optimum taste-delivery temperature.Why do you want 12 ounces of coffee in one shot? 8 ounces twice, a half-hour apart will be a much better experience. However, if you have these T-discs if you hit the button when the mug is filled to around 7 ounces, you get a nicer drink. Less over-extracted and a bit more bold. If you are looking to quench thirst, drink water before your coffee.As with all the T-discs, you can improve your experience by starting with a warm cup/mug/glass and by never using the add more-water-to-overextract-the-grounds feature. If you feel you must add extra water to your cleverly designed coffee drink, do it with plain water using the yellow cleaner disc, not through the spent coffee disc.

Himalayan Splendor is my favorite tea to start each day with energy and alertness. It is so smooth and has a very good taste and aroma. Just the smell is enough to get me moving and in a great mood. In fact my wife can tell when I have had my cup of Himalayan Splendor( big smile).

This is our favorite peanut butter.  Once you've eaten this you will not want to eat another brand! My husband, son and I eat some daily so that is why we order the 9lb pail.  Yummmm!! And the extra bonus is that it's organic, no salt or sugar!

column9: the best peanut butter of all time
column10: 'everything's subjective,' etc yeah ok, but this peanut butter makes all other peanut butter look like the hot brown mess it comparatively is-- i would buy a 9lb bucket of it, but i have this nightmare about peanut butter becoming sentient and suffocating me in my sleep so probably best not to 'trigger' that whole thing any more than necessary

These little cans of tuna spread are great for a snack or the start of a quick lunch.  The flavor and texture are good.  Keep a few of these cans and some crackers in your desk and you'll be set for those busy days at work.

This little can of tuna is just great. It's very tasty and convenient. My son likes the fact that it's packed full of protein. We like it so much that I have made it a standing order. It's always in my desk at work and I share it with my co-workers. They like it too.

The flavor and scent of Simply Organic's flavoring is strong and true.  It is really a light oil extract, so it also seems to have a much longer shelf-life. Considering that the price rivals many of the artificial extracts on the market--yet is clearly better quality--I find it to be a superb value.I love this whole line of extracts, and specifically the lemon extract.  I use it for both baking/cooking purposes (I often replace or supplement vanilla with lemon, as the two flavors really seem to enhance the overall product), as well as to make organic concoctions.One example: I love the smell of Bigelow's Lemon Body Lotion as well as Tutti-Dulce's Lemon Merengue line, but they are pricey. I find it's more cost-effective for me to just buy an inexpensive vanilla-scented body cream, melt it down in the microwave, mix in some of this extract, and when it re-sets it smells just like the expensive stuff!I am also going to try a new toning mask of witchhazel and the lemon extract, which is supposed to help clarify and minimize pores.  Considering the low cost and high-quality of this product, I find myself looking for all sorts of ways to use it.

This tea is similar to Market Spice, Good Earth Original and Hobee's Cinnamon Orange iced tea, but I prefer it to any of those. It has a very smooth character and full body with a nice balance of cinnamon, cloves and orange. It's not subtle by any means and honestly the actual black tea flavor is a bit steamrolled by the aromatics, but I really like it. It is surprisingly sweet; I don't know if there is sugar in here, but it tastes like it.The packaging is very attractive, though I recommend cutting the adhesive band that holds the lid on--if you try to peel it off, it'll split and leave white adhesive residue on the pretty black tin.
This tea is absolutely wonderful. Tastes like Red Hots. The flavors are nicely balanced, strong but not overpowering. I enjoy it with some sugar and milk - sort of a different take on Chai.

Love this tea. It tastes as good as it smells, unlike many teas that are fragrant but disappoint in the taste department. I enjoy it with cookies for my afternoon snack. I even add a little of it to my flavored black teas if I want them to be a little sweeter.
I love this tea!  It's the best I've ever had.  The only problem with it is that it will spoil you and you'll never want any other tea.

column9: cozy, delicious tea for the cinnamon lover.....
column10: What a lovely tea this is!  The tea is a blend of three types of cinnamon, cloves and orange mixed with black tea.  It is perfect for a dreary day, or as we get out here in the bay area, those foggy days where you just want to cozy up to a nice cup.I especially love this tea with a bit of sugar and just a splash of milk.  It's definitely for those that like a bold tea, full of aromatic spices.This also was my first tea purchase of Harney & Sons teas.  I had tried a tea-room that used their teas and they were so wonderful that I felt I had to bring one home to try that I hadn't had a chance to sample.  I would most definitely purchase more teas from Harney & Sons.  They are highly aromatic, delicious and would make a nice purchase for yourself, or pair up with some other tea goodies, for a lovely gift for a friend.

This is a great flavour should you like Red Hots....it is very easy to brew too strong and it becomes a challenge to down the cup, but when you find your level, this is a wonderful tea.  Tastes great and is just so different from anything else.  Love it, and will happily buy this again.
The tea was of great quality and it tasted like dessert the packaging was great and it was here in a reasonable time I will definately be purchasing again :)

Holy cow this stuff is amazing. How can they even call it tea?  Tea is that boring, flavored water stuff.  This stuff?  Nothing close to boring.  My sister gave me some to try and I can't get over how good it is.  It's like eating some kind of sinfully, delicious dessert, only without all the bad, empty calories.  I add honey to it, but really- you don't even need to add a sweetener.  It can stand alone.  This has the most heavenly aroma too.  But if you're only so-so on cinnamon- BEWARE.  This has intoxicating amounts of cinnamon.  Delicious!  Now, where can I get some more...

These bars would have been perfect had they not been so heavily loaded with sugar. I had better satisfaction with a 3 Musketeers bar, no kidding. Why not a "diet" version, or a diabetic version using artificial sweetener?  Maybe they possibly do fill you up but only for a few minutes...  they set off that blood sugar spike:  Eat one then you want another!  That's the  infamous "high glycemic index" in demonstration for you. When I realized I couldn't maintain with them, I gave them to the whole family. They all went through them super fast.  At least it was a tasty good riddance!  Will be buying any sugar free high protein MR bars instead.
These bars in the peanut/chocolate or the chocolate chip are the best!  They fill me up have good fiber and protein content.  Whenever I can get a good deal at Amazon I stock up!

I already wrote a review for the chocolate chip ones, though I thought I was writing it for this flavor, so I will just copy and paste. THe both taste good.I bought these bars as a meal replacement, since I am usually hungry about 4 hours after I had lunch, or 2-3 hours after breakfast, so I have to survive before the next meal. This does the job well. I can stay without eating for another 2-3 hours. It also depends how much water you drink, sometimes all you need is water to get rid of the "hunger". It's the way your body tells you you need water as well.My stomach is somewhat sensible and doesn't like a lot of stuff, but these bars never bother me.I also think they are tasty, but only the chocolate ones. I tried the strawberry ones, but they are too creamy. I also liked the chocolate chip ones, they both taste similar, though the chocolate chip ones have more fiber than these ones :P

column9: Best tasting protein bar out there.
column10: The only downside to these for me are that they taste so good i want to eat them like candy.  About as dense and filling as most other bars of the same weight, but taste a lot better.  Chocolate chip flavor is good as well, but this is the best flavor.

These bars are very tasty.  I mean, they're not a candy bar, and they don't taste quite so good as a candy bar.  They are a bit drier on the inside, in particular.  However, they are much more satisfying than a candy bar, and they are still very sweet.  While a single bar is not a whole day's worth of food, one can get by for quite a while on one, without the sugar crash I experience after eating sweets.  The only gripe I have about Special K is that I wish they could have a "diet" option in which they reduce the calorie content with the addition of some artificial sweetners.  Nonetheless, these are the best "meal bars" I have had, and I have tried a bunch of different brands (south beach, atkins, fiber 1, etc.).

I eat these on a daily basis, they're that good. I can go weeks of having one or two a day until I start getting burned out, and after a couple of days I'm always ready for another. Special K meal bars have just the kick to last those extra two hours at the end of the day, or replace a junky fast-food breakfast. I feel like I've had a lot less problems with fatigue and stress since I've started keeping one handy all the time; when I start to get tired and grouchy I pop one open, get a short jog around the building, and I'm good to go. I go through about 2-3 boxes a month. After hundreds of bars I'd say the taste and texture could be improved just a little, but they're the only bar I've liked so much, while costing so little, that I eat it constantly. Never had a stale one. Get the subscription, it's so worth it.

Much better than Nutrisystem. I bought the Nutrisystem plan for 8 weeks, less than half the food was edible, comparing this to their breakfast bar this is by far better tasting and it does make you feel full longer.

column9: Pretty good for a couple hours
column10: It's what it says it is.With 190 calories, it takes away hunger for about 2-3hours.This has very rich chocolate texture/taste and some may find it a bit too sweet.So, I wouldn't eat 2 in a row.
I think these protein bars are very tasty but overwhelmingly sweet for me.I will not purchase again because im watching my sugar intake...

I have been replacing a few meals with these bars and I have been dropping a couple of unwanted pounds. The double chocolate and chocolatey chip stay in stock in my pantry at all times. They taste great, they keep me satisfied, they are a perfect on-the-go meal, and they have helped me lose some weight. I heart them so much. :-) If for some unforeseen reason these bars ever go out of production I will be really devastated. Sad, but true. :-)Thank you Special K for the awesome bars!!!
Satisfyingly sweet with lots of protien. I eat it as dessert or quick pick me up.

The Special K protein bars are by far the best protein bars I have ever tried. While they are not for body builders who need much more protein..they have just the right amount of protein to keep me full. Sometimes I do not have time for breakfast and these keep me full until I can go on my first break at work.

I have reviewed other products I used while trying to lose a few pounds, such as ADKINS. I have also used Special K Meal Bars to quell that late night snack urge and replace a meal..They work !! They taste great. By ordering the same number of boxes from Amazon as I would have purchased at a retail store. I saved money!! Imagine that..lose weight and save money !! My only concern was, would they be fresh. They definitely were.In fact,some I have purchased at retail stores, were not. I'm totally satisfied with these purchases and will buy again from Amazon !!

I really like these bars.  I didn't think they'd taste good so I was pleasantly surprised.  I don't know if they'd replace a meal but they do have fiber and protein.  I am usually rushing around in the morning, so they are great to grab for breakfast.  I've also used them as a pre- or post-workout snack, or if I'm craving chocolate (they're fewer calories and much healthier than a candy bar).  I'm definitely hooked.
Yummy product. I eat this everyday at school as an afternoon snack. 10g of protein really helps to get you out of that tired mood. And I'm sure the chocolate helps too.

I unfortunately work in a job setting where we do not just get to take breaks when we feel like it or snack while working. This can be a problem for me, as I tend to get hungry every two hours and sometimes only get a 10 minute break. These bars are small enough to eat quickly and keep me full til I can have a real meal. They are tasty too!  A bit like a chocolatey rice crispy bar. Only downside is price. On sale they work out to be about a dollar a bar, which is about the same as most protein bars, I just wish I didn't have to resort to an extra $20 a month protein bar to keep my stomach happy.

column9: Low fat, high fiber meal replacement bar
column10: I eat a high protein meal replacement bar every day for breakfast, and I have lost several pounds. The bar is high in protein, which does keep you fuller longer. By lunchtime I am usually pretty hungry, but I can hold out until lunchtime without a problem. They are a bit dry, so I always have a drink on hand while eating them. The chocolate flavor is great, not that cheap tasting chocolate that usually comes with diet products. The bar has a nice chew, but isn't overly chewy, nor does it stick to the teeth. They have a good flavor - not the best bar I have ever eaten as far as taste goes, but better than tolerable for sure. These bars are lower in fat content to some of the Slim Fast meal replacement bars, which is why I tried them in the first place.This high fiber bar will keep you feeling full for several hours, and replacing a meal a day with them does create results. Following their diet plan of two meal replacement bars a day with three snack bars will more than likely increase weight loss from the few pounds I have lost eating one bar a day.

column9: We eat WAY too many of these!
column10: I've been eating these for a couple of years now, and my boyfriend finally tried them and now he eats them more than I do!  They're great.  The only issue I have with them is that sometimes the quality is different -- not sure if it's something that happens during manufacturing or afterwards during storage/shipping, but occasionally we'll get some that don't taste as chocolately or are gritty or something.  On the other hand, it helps keep them from all tasting the same.  They're particularly great on the go!

I was really surprised by how good these taste, as most protein bars tend to be a little bland.  But these are anything but--as another reviewer commented, they almost taste like candy!  The 10g protein is satisfying enough, although lower than most protein/meal bars; the 5g of fiber, however, helps out with filling you up.  They actually have 170 calories, not 190 like Amazon says - not a big difference, but still a nice surprise :)  The bars are also pretty long compared to Luna, Balance, and others, making them a little more of a filling visually, if you know what I mean.  Overall, I like them!

column9: High Protein Snack for my Growing Boys
column10: I started buying these last year for my boys to take for snack time at school.  They were complaining about being hungry after most snacks.  These fill them up until lunch and they love them!

column9: Special K...tasty and chocolately  meal replacement
column10: My supermarket ran out of the Double Chocolate at the old price of $5.99.  When I re-checked again, the price was $7.25 a box.  I got 3 boxes for $19 on Amazon (including shipping) and within 2 days so I think that's an okay deal!  I love these after a workout or before going to the movies.  It curbs my appetite for up to 3 hours so I don't crave food during the movie or raid my freezer after a strenuous workout.  I also like the pink lemonade protein powder but I haven't been able to find that on line.

So, in my long search for meal bars, I have tried any I have ever seen on the shelves. My general reaction to most of them is that they are like eating cardboard. Also, the "flavor" that most claim to have is not there. So, from childhood I loved double chocolate granola bars. Not healthy at all, but I was a kid. I saw these on the shelf, and decided to try them, despite the many other double chocolate bars I had tried recently. To my surprise, these taste amazing. Has a very chocolaty taste, with no awful after-taste. Also, eating them is just like eating my granola bars I remember...except these are much better for you.I of course don't promote these to people who are on diets that need to watch more than calories, as the fat content and sugars may be a little high for many people. But I can tell you I am male, 5'11", and weigh about 180. This bar with a piece of fruit will keep me full for my entire 5 hour morning.

column9: The best way to lose weight!
column10: I absolutely love these bars!  They are better than any candy bar I have ever tried!  Super!  At only 180 calories- it's a better than any other  chocalate fix I've tried!

When the men are away, the women don't want to cook. These are really great because the taste is good (driiink something with them), they satisfy your hunger for a meal, and they are healthy. Plus it doesn't involve heating anything up or cooking. It's helped me stay at my regular weight because without it, I was just munching all the time because I didn't want to cook.
These are the best tasting bars on the market. I eat two first thing in the morning and I am good until a last lunch at 1.
These bars are "yummy good".  They fill the need for something to eat to tide you over until the next meal or use them instead of a meal when you are in a hurry.

I have tried these and the Chocolate chip and the chocolate caramel.  They are each delicious.  They are the best tasting "protein" bar I have ever tried and I have had many.  These have 10 grams of protein which is plenty to give most people a relatively healthy  snack that also somewhat fills you up.  They each have 170 calories, not the 190 that this product information says.  Now if you are watching sugar carbs, there are 15 grams of those so probably not good for that type of "diet".  In most stores they cost $6.99 per box of 6 so this price of $14 for 3 boxes of 6 is pretty good.

This is one of many high protein bars on the market.  I would not call it a meal replacement, but it does have (according to the wrapper) 10 grams of protein, 5 grams of fiber, and some amount of vitamin and mineral content.  It is something that you can eat quick, if you did not have time for lunch, or something to fill in during a long afternoon.  It has a light crunchy texture and a good flavor.  170 calories is not overly high, and is less than some other energy/protein bars with similar amounts of protein and fiber.

column9: Better than I thought it would be
column10: I am a chocoholic trying to watch my calories/fat/carbs and still enjoy life. A friend recommended these bars for breakfast.  I saw the price in the grocery store and thought maybe not. BUT the price with free shipping at Amazon made the cost per bar much more appealing so I decided to give it a try. LOVED IT!! They taste better than most of the other breakfast bars and they have more nutritional value that almost all of the others. For Weight Watchers, they're only 4 Points (PP)which is a good choice for breakfast.

My husband is on a Doctor supervised medical meal replacement diet.  I'm doing it with him with over the counter products.  This bar is really good.  I use them as snacks, as well.  I eat half a bar for a mid morning and mid afternoon snack.  Sometimes I skip the afternoon and eat the second half for an after dinner snack.  It's very tasty - not at all griddy, and satisfies the body's need for protein, and my sweet tooth.  I eat a regular food meal (low cal!) for dinner.  Please do NOT do this without letting your doc know - especially if you have diabetes, or any other medical issues.  My doc has done bloodwork and is monitoring my progress so she can cut down my diabetes and other meds as needed.  So far I've cut my metformin in half, and my cholesterol and triglicerides have come down amazingly!  Enjoy!

column9: Tastes good, keeps me from being hungry
column10: I don't really eat these on a regular basis. These are my breakfasts when I sleep in late or my lunches when I can't be bothered. I carry one with me in my bookbag/purse just in case. They taste good and keep me from being hungry for hours afterward. One of the few bars that I've seen with a decent amount of fiber and protein. My husband likes them too. I can easily see these being a good daily breakfast if you're busy or trying to diet, or as an addition to a meal if you're trying to gain.
This is a great deal! It is way cheaper than the grocery stores in my area for this item!  This is the 10 grams of protein per bar, the full size meal bars.

column9: Hydrogenated Palm Oil in this Diet bar
column10: Well, these taste ok, but there's partially hydrogenated oil in these bars-- really? Ugh.Ingredients include:Coating (Sugar, Partially Hydrogenated Palm Kernel Oil, Cocoa Processed With Alkali, Whey, Nonfat Dry Milk, Soy Lecithin, Sorbitan Monostearate, Salt, Polysorbate 60, Artificial Flavor),

column9: Great meal substitute - even for a 4-year old!
column10: I bought these bars as a quick meal replacement or snack, but my 4-year old son (an extremely picky eater) has enjoyed them for breakfast more than anything else I've offered!  He thinks they are candy bars and requests at least one daily.  The nutritional information on the package suggests that they are an even healthier, heartier choice than granola or cereal bars. Now, if he would just leave me a few...

I need to eat 1 or 2 protein bars every day as a post bariatric surgery patient to ensure that I get enough protein every day. This double-chocolate Special K protein bar (10g protein, 180 cal), is my very favorite protein bar, since it tastes more like a chocolate candy bar with crunch. I've been eating 4-5 per week for over a year and I still don't get tired of them. There may be bars with more protein, or ones with more fiber. but none with better taste in my opinion. Buy one box and you'll be hooked.

column9: A delicious healthy alternative to vending machine purchases
column10: This is a very delicious and nutritious alternative to what you'll find in a vending machine.  It tastes good and is large enough to sate even the hungriest of us all.  Best of all, unlike other meal replacement bars, there are no sugar alcohols or substitutes.  Moreover, for such a tasty bar, it packs a good amount of protein.  I highly recommend it.

I am so happy with this purchase!  I've tried so many different meal replacement bars without finding one that tasted like FOOD.  This is the best tasting meal bar I have ever eaten.  I don't have much time to eat lunch during the week and this is a perfect meal on the go.  It tastes like a yummy candy bar and not a chalky protein product.  I highly recoment!
I love these.  I am a teacher and get to school at 6:30am.  The meal bars get me through to lunch. They keep me from running to the vending machine.

Although marketed for dieters, these bars are GREAT for teens whose eating habits are not always the best. I have a son whose idea of dinner is limited to burgers, grilled cheese or chicken nuggets. At least with these bars, I know protein, fiber are not going to be an issue, especially when running to sports practice, while keeping fat and calories down. Love the autoshipment--I always have them on hand.

Kellogg's Special K Protein Meal Bars are amazing.  I love the chocolatey taste of the Double Chocolate flavor.  But perhaps the strongest recommendation for this product is how satisfied I am for many hours after eating one.  And it feels good to know I have had a  dose of protein even thought I did not go to the trouble of cooking a meal.
Special K Bars are very delicious and they satisfy my sweet craving. I have (1) one every day as a treat to keep me on my Body For Life / Eating For Life program.

I've been eating PowerBars for years, and thought I'd try a double chocolate Kellogg's Meal Bar.Holy cow! It's like biting into a ground-up mixture of styrofoam and dirt that's been compressed into a semi-solid then dipped in overly sweeten chocolate. The beach sand residue left in my mouth from this thing is horrible. I've got half the bar sitting here in front of me, and I really don't think I can finish it off. Yuck!Judging from the other reviews, maybe these gross, awful things are an acquired taste or maybe my taster is just seriously out of whack. Whatever the case, they're downright nasty! Even the smell is bad!

I trusted the people who raved about the taste of these bars, and they were right. I cycled through South Beach, Atkins and others and though this does contain high fructose corn syrup (wish it didn't), it's the best combo of taste and value I've experienced.
I love this bars,i'm a chocolate woman.I love the flavor and the price is good.Hurray for Kellogg's,and Amazon for the price.

I love(d) these bars. They taste like a candy bar, have fiber, fill me up, whats not to like!Oh wait... they use SOY PROTEIN.I'd heard about the dangers of men/boys eating soy protein before from friends/colleagues and pretty much dismissed it as tinfoil hat conspiracy theory. But when Men's Health had a large report on it, I figured it was worth the time to do some independent analysis.Long story short (and don't just take my word for it, I could be a crazy person on the internets) if you are a man, you are essentially taking large doses of estrogen every time you eat one of these. Note only does estrogen not help out in the muscle building department, the soy phytoestrogens have been linked (through legitimate research) to a whole lot of bad things, namely behavioral, pulmonary, circulatory diseases.So eat these things if you'd like, but I will be running not walking away from them. And it REALLY bums me out because they taste great... I just wished Special K would have ponied up the couple extra cents to whey protein...sigh.
This sesame chicken noodle soup bowl is the nastiest-tasting instant soups I've ever eaten. It's just very bland, simply put!
I bought some of this tea when I was in Seattle and I have been dying to get more.  It really is the best tea I have ever had.  It is great hot or cold.
This is the best tea - well worth the price.  As mentioned prior, this tea is great hot or cold.  It has a bold, spicy aroma.  By far, my favorite.

I put this kit together tonight with my two young sons and we had a ball. (We paid $10 for it at Fred Meyer, which was $5 off their normal price, so beware that the cost on this site is ridiculously high). The pieces were easy to assemble and the tray that comes with the kit is handy (beats having to find some cardboard to cover with tin foil. My only complaint is the frosting because it got overly gooey before we could finish our assembly and it wasn't tough enough to hold some of the heavier candy. I kept putting it in the fridge to firm it up a little. I'd also recommend cutting the tip of the frosting at less than the 1/4" that the instructions recommend. I'd say 1/8th" would have been better. Overall, I was impressed with the finished product. It was easy to clean up the mess, there was plenty of candy and some to spare, and the kids had a blast. I bought a similar kit in the shape of a train and we look forward to putting that one together as well.
but I found it at target and paid $8.00... great kit, but look around because 13 bucks (and almost 10 to ship) is too pricey.

column9: Gingerbread House Kit is a Big Success with Grandkids!
column10: Reasonably priced, excellent quality merchandise as you usually provide.  Speed in delivery, no problem with availability of product or delivery.  Thanks for another job well done.  My grandchildren totally enjoyed putting it together as did their parents.
The product was tasty, easy to make, fun and the package was received very quickly even being overseas in Iraq.  I was impressed.
This kit arrived in a timely manner and has all pieces necessary to build a cute house. Pre-baked gigngerbread will save a lot of time.

Pros:-Great kit, came in good shape, nothing broken except maybe a candy cane or two.-Ton of candy, a lot more than you'd need.  I ended up eating half of it on my own-Easy to make, simple, whole family can enjoy.Neutral:-Frosting is a little hard to use until you get it really warm (requires some hand stamina)-Base is a little boring, some parts are bigger than the pieces (such as the foundation for the stick men to stand up or trees) so it was harder to get it to stand upCons:-Shipping price is a little exorbitant for the size and shipping quality

column9: Works fine, looks nice, shipping pricey...
column10: This kit made a nice gingerbread house with everything included.  It's not too hard to make something as nice as what you see on the picture.  The snowmen and Christmas tree were a little tricky to stand up in the frontyard, but we got it to work eventually.  As another reviewer mentioned, the shipping does add over 50% to the cost, so watch out for that before you buy.

Length:: 1:42 MinsWe did have a lot of fun, but after opening the package discovered most of the panels were very broken.  Here's Jada and our somewhat drafty, well, very drafty, start of our gingerbread house.

By far, this has been the best kit ever. The frosting is already made to go (unlike some others where you have to mix the powder). Also, the frosting is truly sticky and holds the gingerbread parts super well. Every other kit I've ever worked doesn't do so good. Also, there is this tray where the base of the house goes and holds it well. It was just the best. I plan on buying the same one next year.

This house was quite large and comes with more than enough frosting and candy.  Everything is high quality and very fresh.  We got 3 houses and had a contest between our children with grandchildren. It was easy and fun for all ages.  After a while, we couldn't resist and decorated the extra cookies, then ate them.  All the flavors of candies along with of the frosting are delicious!  This is a new tradition for us and can't wait to do it again next year.  Merry Christmas!
Nice large sized kit with lots of candies for decorating.One candy cane was broken from shipping.. but I suppose these thingsare going to happen.. overall a very nice kit!

This is the second gingerbread house I have bought through Amazon - and this company - and I was extremely satisfied both times. The kits arrived on time and in good shape.  One broken piece the first time (which was easy to fix) and totally intact this year.  My granddaughters and I spent time "gluing" the pieces together with the frosting that comes with the kit, then decorated them with the enclosed candy.  The kit includes everything you need, so when it arrives it is ready to go.  I will definitely buy from this company again to continue our tradition.

This house kit is really nice! It comes with a tray that holds the gingerbread and makes assembly real easy. The icing is plenty, so it will satisfy the most creative of gingerbread architects. ;)My only problem was that some of the candy was gum balls. So, for those children who can't hold gum without swallowing it (as is my daughter), this is not the most optimum kit.

I ordered two of the houses for my grandchildren in Seattle to be delivered before my visit for Thanksgiving.  We had fun putting them together.  There was more than enough candy and white frosting to make beautiful houses.  Although we won't be together for Christmas, it was fun doing something special together to prepare for it.

I bought this gingerbread house to make with my 3 & 6 year old and it was excellent!  Both kids were able to build and decorate themselves.  I was impressed with the amount of frosting and candy.  In fact, we had lots of frosting and some candy left over.  It turned out so cute.  I can't wait to do it again next year.  The tray that the house sits in is really nice and sturdy and helps the little ones be able to decorate the house themselves.  I highly recommend it!
I bought 4 of these houses and we had a decorating contest on Christmas.  It was a really fun activity!  The houses are easy to put together and are super cute!
This company is a pleasure to deal with. Customer Service was a joy. Would definately order from this company again.Had a slight problem with gingerbread houses and they were a joy to deal with.

Gingerbread house was easy to make, frosting was very tasty. I used cardboard instead of the plastic tray so that it would be more stable. I used some other candies (hershey's kisses, sour patch candies, & used chocolate raspberry cookies for the roof) because I didn't like some of the candies included.The candy canes were broken, which I guess happens during shipment. There was a minor break in the roof, which was easily repaired by putting frosting and leaving it in the freezer for 15-20 mins. I had a lot of leftover candy and green frosting. Wish there was more white royal frosting, but it was sufficient to make the house. All in all, I was very pleased and would buy again.

We do a gingerbread house or train every year, so we've seen our share of kits.  This one is very nice - pre-made house pieces, icing bags and lots of candy to choose from.  It's easy to put together and a lot of fun for the kids to decorate.  It is overpriced here as opposed to our local store, but the kit itself is fantastic!

This is actually the second year in a row I bought this, so this bad product experience has been confirmed.  The roof just does not stick on.  It mentions to hold it in place for 1 minute while the icing sets, but that just doesn't do it, before we knew it, the roof was slowly sliding down.  Tried propping it up with sticks, but messy and difficult.  Thought we had it, came back 15 minutes and the whole rotten structure had fallen down like a cheap house of cards.  I haven't tried eating this current one, but the last one was not very tasty either.  It was a frustrating time for us, and a sad time for the kids to see it fall apart.  Do not buy!

The kit was great.  I really liked how our house turned out.  I would not recommend this if you're looking to eat the pieces that comes with it.  The frosting is very close to glue which is great for actually making the house.  If you're making this with kids I would recommend buying some candy to either rather than what comes with it.  Again it's great for making the house but not really made for eating.

column9: Good kit, not worth stated price.
column10: I bought 5 of these for a group of girls to assemble at a party.  The kits were complete, all pieces were intact after shipping and went together reasonably well.Could use more candy, but otherwise no complaints.  The stated price is ridiculous, but the sale price is fair.  You can also buy similar kit at Target or Michaelsfor same price, less shipping.  I would recommend shopping there first.

This gingerbread house kit is a P.of.S! While working on the first one with my daughter, one of the roofs collapsed as we were GENTLY putting candy on top of it. Had to run to the store and buy another one. Same thing happened! Re tried using unbroken parts from both houses to piece it back together and the whole thing just fell apart! I followed directions meticulously, waiting nearly 30 minutes instead of the suggested 15 for the frosting to solidify. I didn't put any more pressure on the thing than necessary but the thing still broke apart.$20 later, I'm stuck with a sloppy, sticky mess in my kitchen, no gingerbread house and a disappointed 4-year-old on my hands! This product sucked!

column9: A Waste of Time and Money
column10: Most pieces were broken upon arrival. I knew, from baking our own gingerbread houses in the past, that broken pieces could be reassembled using icing. But not the icing that comes with this kit! Ultimately, we tried cutting the broken pieces to form a new gingerbread house. Again, the icing failed -- it wasn't strong enough to keep the pieces together.Tasted good, though.

I bought this when my three year old daughter asked to make a Gingerbread house. I saved it until today, a week before Christmas, as a fun thing to do on a lazy Saturday. When I opened the box I was really disappointed to see that almost every piece of the gingerbread house was broken. I tried to glue them back together with the icing provided, but that didn't work. I also noticed that the pieces didn't seem to fit together very well, despite the handy tray that has little supports built in. The side walls were't long enough to fit onto the front and back panels and eventually the house caved in (without the roof, since those pieces were damaged the most and could not be repaired with icing). Thankfully my daughter is distracted enough with the icing and candy provided that she's not too upset that we don't have a gingerbread house, but I am very disappointed.

My girlfriend (Ash) and I have never made Gingerbread Houses before. After checking out the reviews for the various houses we settled on this one. It was shipped promptly, so we set out to make an amazing house (while watching holiday movies). The first thing we noticed was a corner of one of the walls had broken off. This was easily fixed by smearing some icing on the edges. It held well and you could not even tell that it was broken. The key is letting the icing dry long enough, so it acts like glue.Constructing the house was not too hard. We let it sit and then we started to ice the roof. This was hard. The instructions say to cut a 1/4 inch hole in the bag of the icing, but this is too big. It made gobs of icing go on the roof. Ash ended up having to use her fingers to smooth the icing out. We could not outline the windows, and we did not achieve the thin spray of icing the picture shows on the box. This is the one thing that prevented me from giving this kit five stars.The frosting tastes great. The candy does too and it is plentiful minus peppermints. We are still eating candy pieces. They stuck well to the house thanks to the frosting. The Gingerbread tasted good for Gingerbread. We aren't huge fans of it, though, which is something we discovered after attempting to eat a house.We had a lot of fun making this house. I outlined the process (with pictures) on my blog here:[...]You can see how easy it was for us to construct our house.Overall, we were quite pleased with our experience and plan to continue the tradition of making a Gingerbread House next year. This kit is great for beginners, so long as you cut a smaller hole in the icing bag.
This house had a number of broken pieces, but they were repairable with the icing.  There was not enough candy to really decorate the house.
This was received in pieces and my daughter said the gingerbread tasted like dog biscuits. On the positive side Amazon fully refunded my money.

I bought this 'deluxe model' for $24.00 (not including shipping which made the grand total over $29.00).  I walked into Target the other day and saw the exact same kit for $9.00!  The product is fine but I feel completely ripped off...don't buy it through Amazon.com...go to Target!  I wish I had read the reviews before purchasing.

Two years running I have purchased this kit from Walmart or Target for my kids to compete against each other in creating their holiday houses. (My daughter always informally wins the competition as my son eats too much of his candy before it's done ;) ) The Gingerbread is far to hard to eat for anyone with an ordinary bite, but that didn't stop the little guy. It's a cute kit, well made, each year there are slight differences in the supplies, but same house design - which is starting to bore my kids, so we may try another box kit or get bold an and make our own template & "ginger bread".BTW - we get ours at Walmart or Target for about $6 less than on Amazon, however with free Prime shipping here and not needing to run off to the store to buy this isn't a bad price.

You can buy this EXACT SAME kit at Target for $8.99 (regular price 12.99) and save yourself the outrageous price and ridiculous shipping costs.  Normally I like the goldbox deals but this is highway robbery Amazon!

THIS CHIRISTMAS WE BEGAN A NEW TRADITION...MY DAUGHTER AND I ORDERED GINGERBREAD HOUSES FOR THE FAMILIES OF EACH OF MY GREAT GRANDCHILDREN.EVERY FAMILY HAS RESPONDED WITH THANKS AND "HURRAHS" FOR THE IDEA AND FOR THE EARLY ARRIVAL IN THE FIRST WEEK OF DECEMBER OF THE PRODUCT.  THIS GAVE THE FAMILY TIME TO BUILD THE HOUSE AND GAVE THE YOUNGSTERS A CHANCE TO PARTICIPATE IN CHRISTMAS ACTIVITIES EARLY IN THE SEASON. IN EVERY CASE THE PARENTS TOLD US THAT THE GINGERBREAD HOUSES WERE THE CENTERPIECE ON EVERY BREAKFAST TABLE. WE WILL DO THIS AGAIN NEXT YEAR FOR SURE!! THANKS FOR OFFERING SUCH AN EXCELLENT PRODUCT.  VELMA SPEARS SHOCKEY .. PEARLAND, TEXAS.

column9: good houses, but one out of four broken
column10: The houses were good, plenty of candy, and the kids were happy but one of the four I ordered arrived broken, too broken to fix up with frosting.
Easy to make gingerbread house that looks so good it's hard to want to eat it! The kids grabbed a little bit but it was more of a great decoration.
The gingerbread house comes pre-assembled. The problem with that is that ours came broken in about 10 places. Basically unusable.

A total nightmare. If you are going to make this, use crazy glue or a support system for the walls and roof. They keep sliding out of place. Some of my pieces came broken, and it tasted horrible. Dont waste your money.

column9: Not the best kit I've used
column10: We ordered this house to assemble before Christmas. Unfortunately, 2 sides of the house arrived broken in half. We thought we could use the frosting to glue it together but after putting it all together, the cracked pieces caved in. If it hadn't been so close to Xmas, we would have returned it before attempting to assemble it.  One other issue is that the kit did not come with a frosting tip (like kits we've used in the past) which made it difficult to apply the frosting.

We were extremely disappointed in this product.  Not only was the Gingerbread tasteless, the gumdrops were dried out and hard as bullets AND there was a piece of WOOD in the bag along with the gumdrops! Can't say anything positive about the company's "quality control"!I will never purchase this product again.

My daughter and I build a gingerbread house every year.  This one came in very cute packaging exciting my daughter as soon as we opened the box.  As with any gingerbread house it's a little tricky to get everything stuck together.  We let it dry overnight and decorated the next day.  Comes with many different decorating candies sprinkles and candy canes.  Overall a very fun house to build to continue our tradition.

column9: junkie no deluxe model ginerbread house kit
column10: this is no deluxe and the items wont even cover the house it is not like show in pic it is a waste of my time and money...you suck
Broken into 50 pieces when it arrived.  Ruined.  Had to try to glue it together, and then ultimately get another one.
Gifted this to a friend to build with her grand-daughter.  They both loved it!  And the price is right.

I ordered 4 of these kits for an office Christmas party. We all had a great time putting them together. The kits did contain plenty of decorations, but we bought some extras and extra icing just in case. The icing in the kit is very thick. I especially liked that the kit contained a plastic stand that held the house in place without having to rely on the icing to keep it upright.

column9: loved building with my 2 year old!
column10: this gingerbread house was so easy to put together and so cute!  built and decorated with my 2 year old in about 20 minutes.  the icing was pre-made so i didn't have to mix anything which is great.  just cut a hole in the corner of the bag and go.  just don't eat the icing...yuck! my son liked it but, well, he is 2.  i only gave it 4 stars bc 2 of the gingerbread pieces were broken when it arrived but since it was so close to christmas i didn't have time to return it so i used them.  just used some extra icing and covered the cracks with candy.

column9: Gingerbread house was broken when it arrived
column10: 1 of the 5 gingerbread house kits I ordered was in pieces when taken out of the box, not just the typical pieces, I mean instead of 4-5 pieces there were probably 30 pieces.  Probably the shippers fault.  It was so great to find these houses on Amazon!
I sent this to family who are grandparents, and they made with grandchildren.  Was not only easy, fun, but made a beautiful holiday tradition!

column9: I will definitely buy it again!
column10: I bought this for the first time for my daughters (14 yrs & 11 yrs).  They had a blast putting it together.  There was enough of everything. We had to throw away the left over icing and it was quite a bit. The candy was plenty, they didn't use it all because they didn't know where else to put it hajajajjaja.  The box was intact and parts were not broken.  From reading the other reviews I was afraid it was all going to be in pieces, but I was very wrong. All the pieces were in perfect condition. And the gingerbread was delicious. I am definitely going to purchase this again next year - we've started a new tradition :)

As others eperienced, my Gingerbread house had a rough journey. The packaging was a little loose and caused the box to shift around easily and ended up cracking several of the cookie panels(front and back). I was able to use Elmers glue to fix them for assembly but only after allowing to dry overnight. The cracks were still visible, but It was my only option as there was not enough time to return it for an exchange before Christmas. I must say that had I known how hard the icing would be once cured, I could have just used that instead of the glue. That stuff could be used as mortar mix to build a brick house. Even though this is made of edible materials, I would not attempt to eat any of it after assembly as it would probably chip your teeth.Overall this was a good experience, but just know you are gambling if you have it shipped. It would have to be packed in peanuts to arrive safely. The bubble packing they use now just can't protect it unless they overstuff the shipping box, and that could crush the contents as well.AVS

column9: A lot of gingerbread for 10 bucks!
column10: Honestly, you do get a lot of "food" for the price which is awesome, if you plan on snacking on the gingerbread after you build it. The frame for building the house really helps with the whole process, so the house doesn't fall down while you're making it. Unfortunately, the candy that it comes with isn't the greatest, but the frosting is yummy! Just make sure not to over-frost the roof, or it WILL collapse, it's inevitable haha.
I bought the gingerbread houses for young children 4-10 ages to build for christmas. The kids had a great time and their were plenty of candies aqnd icing to complete any design.

column9: Outstanding Tea for Connoisseur or Non-Connoisseur Alike
column10: Like many, I have drank tea for many years, decades, actually, and have had the opportunity to sample everything from the standard bagged teas available everywhere to some of the most expensive hand-made teas developed in Europe using traditional processes. I won't try to pretend this St Dalfour tea is the equivalent of these highly esoteric (and incredibly expensive) teas, but what I can say is that this is a truly great tea for the bagged varieties, and, due to its unfamiliarity, would certainly qualify as a "sleeper" find. I can recommend this particular brand and variety as one of the best I've had.What makes this so good? First, the ingredients are all natural, with no artificial flavors or fillers (check your labels carefully and be surprised to see how many flavored teas rely on artificial flavors). To take it a step further, the ingredients here are all organic (see the information on the boxes and on the website to read about this), with no pesticides, artificial colors, or flavors added. At first blush, one might not be immediately attracted to a "black cherry" tea, but the manner in which St Dalfour blends this results in a flavorful tea that contains a subtle flavoring and aroma of black cherry that is really wonderful.If you prepare the tea correctly, you'll end up with a very smooth and delightfully flavored tea that may become your favorite. One secret for this, or any, tea is to not steep the tea more than 60-90 seconds MAX, and then remove the bag. It might seem like too short of a time at first, but if you force yourself to keep to this time, with a few dunks at the end, you should begin to see how tea can really taste if it isn't over-steeped and allowed to turn bitter. (Everyone has a strength preference and so you'll have to experiment at first, but if you can keep it to no longer than 90 seconds, that should be ideal.) Further, if you have a water boiler that allows you to select temperature, if you use a water temperature right below the boiling point, that smoothness can be extended further.An easy recommend to the tea lover, this tea is one of my favorites. Five stars.

column9: If You Enjoy Lime, This Tea is For You
column10: *****Dry Desert Lime is an unusual premium Numi tea. It is herbal tea (caffeine-free) containing solely dried lime---that's all---not lime and green/black tea, not artificial lime flavor, but real lime---alone---a truly remarkable feat. It is certified organic, and is kosher. It has the most amazing tart and lovely taste.  If you like lime, you'll love this tea.  If you don't like lime, definitely pass, as it is a very intense "lime experience".  I love it!On the box, the manufacturer lyrically writes: "From the far reaches of the Arabian Desert, this rare lime has been enjoyed for thousands of years, both as a spice in Middle Eastern cuisine and as a teasan. Traditionally harvested and dried in the hot desert sun, this oasis of Vitamin C has been drunk to soothe just about everything. The first taste brings a distant yet familiar impression, leaving the trace of a fleeting memory on the tip of your tongue. We find that its clean, bracing, and reviving citrus pleasure, nicely balanced with a touch of sugar, lifts the blues. Try it, you'll fall in love with it!"The price is perfect, a big savings over single boxes. If you like Numi teas and enjoy lime, get it---you won't be sorry. If you are new to Numi but love lime, or are curious to try it from the description, I do not think you could find a better source than Numi. In fact, I have never heard of anyone else making this tea.  I enjoy serving it to company, but even more, just for me.*****
