column9: Nylabone Nutri Dent Edible Dental Chews (36 SMALL / 17.7oz)
column10: My chihuahuas eat bag after bag of these and have never gotten tired of them. Best treat I've ever got for them.

My guys love these things...and the best part about it is that they're good for them too!!  I shudder to think what I would be giving to my two dogs if Nylabone hadn't created these Nutrident edible chews.
This is a dog treat with essential Omega-3 fish oil, so the fact that my dogs love these is great news for them AND me!

My dog loves it, she gets exited only from thinking she is going to get one. Her dentist is also happy with her teeth and it looks like this product delivers.So why only 3 stars ? I'm not sure this product is good for the dog health. I heard some rummers abouth dogs who had problems with it and I always susspected the way it looks. Just doesnt look like something that can be good for the dog.So what do I do ?Eventhough my dog is medium size I give her the small ones and only few times a week. I hope it will not affect her health in the long run.BTW, if u ask my dog to rate, she will probably give it 6 stars (or bones), it is her favorite.

column9: Beware of this product--one of our dogs died.
column10: You should monitor your dog very carefully if you give him/her these chews. One of our dogs died as a result of eating these chews, and the other three were very ill for two days. This product is very difficult for dogs to digest and can result in blocked intestines and infection. Since the package did not contain any warnings, we thought they were harmless. Be very careful if you buy these for your dog.

Unfortunately my dog only likes the beef flavor of this product.  I accidentally purchased the green version.  I did not see the beef version offered.  Luckily, I have another dog that likes green just fine.

I had just bought the package, so the expiration date was far away.  After just two minutes of boiling (package indicates 5-7 minutes), almost all the noodles had broken into tiny pieces.  I immediately dumped them into a colander and covered them with cold water.  I had to serve them in my pasta primavera because my dinner guests had already arrived.  My primavera looked pathetic and unappetizing.  I should've stuck with DeBoles artichoke noodles, which have never failed me.  At least I didn't continue boiling the smithereens according to package directions, or they would've turned to mush, as they had for another one-star reviewer.  Eden can go ahead and send me a new box after I complain, but it's too late for my dinner guests.  Never again, Eden!

I have used this and other products from this provider and truly enjoyed them, BUT, this last order was disturbing as when I and others that I gave the rest of the case to, cooked it = not many ribbons but mush more or less.  bar code is 2418211118update - Eden contacted me and are replacing the order.  An excellent company to deal with
These were easy to fix and delicious!  My whole family loved them and they are a beautiful color in dishes!
Eden organics are the best and not owned by the big guys!  We can only hope it stays that way! I love all their products and feel I am eating the best quality food available.
delicious hazelnut and almond filling between two layers of milk chocolate like a gourmet peanut butter cup.  reasonably priced.  enjoyed by my family

I recently had the good fortune to visit Dubrovnik, Croatia, and at the Hilton Hotel where we stayed, these were given to us as an evening treat.when we were flying home, we flew through Zagreb, and were lucky enough to find these for sale there in the Duty-Free shop at the airport.  I only wish we had purchased more of them at the time.so happy to see they are available through Amazon.  Well worth it.
These cookies are utterly delicious and the perfect size otherwise you can keep eating & eating!  LOL  No will power.

Our family has LOVED these for years.  Usually we get these at a local confectionary but they are out of them so went to Amazon. And this is a great price eventho' it seems high.  If you like blueberry and/or strawberry, you are likely to love both!!!  We give these as gifts, too.  Enjoy!

This is really a very high quality cinnamon. Good consistency, strong flavor, evenly ground. Because it's organic (protects the environment) and from Ceylon (which apparently is of much higher quality and better for your health than from other locales) I will only buy this. Highly recommended.

Indus Organic Ceylon Cinnamon Powder has been a must-have for me from the very first time I tasted it. Forget about the adulterated, irradiated cinnamon powder that lines the shelves in the supermarket. After having done my own extensive research I discovered that organic Ceylon cinnamon is by far the best. Of all the varieties of  cinnamon Ceylon cinnamon is the one that provides health benefits. I was happy and relieved to discover Indus organic Ceylon cinnamon powder here at Amazon. It is certified organic plus the flavor is exceptional. I enjoy it with my favorite snack of 1/2 cup of plain yogurt, fruit and nuts. To that combination I add 1 1/2 teaspoons of this product. It tastes absolutely delicious! It adds a subtle sweetness without the calories, of course, and is much better for you than artificial sweeteners. Experiment to find out how much or how little cinnamon you may require on your sweet potatoes, apples, winter squash, etc. For example 1/2 teaspoon cinnamon powder is just the right amount to sprinkle over one sliced apple.  Also it is great in recipes in which cinnamon is an ingredient. Additionally, each packet lasts for a long time while it maintains freshness. I am a loyal customer of Indus and highly recommend the Indus Organic Ceylon Cinnamon Powder.  Enjoy!

column9: High quality cinnamon purchased through Amazon
column10: Good tasting cinnamon.  High quality product.  Well packaged in leak-proof foil lined bags. Finely ground and sprinkles easily.  Will definitely order again.
I bought Ceylon cinnamon because I read it was safer and better than cinnamon sold in US. I love the flavor and aroma. I use it in oatmeal, coffee, desserts and certain vegetable dishes.

You can really taste the difference between true cinnamon and sweet cinnamon from the Casi tree. This cinnamon has a more earthy flavor and all of the benefits I was looking for to add to my morning yogurt.

Ceylon Cinnamon was recommended to me as a homeopathic remedy for osteoarthritis in my index fingers.  One teaspoon mixed with a tablespoon of honey taken with very little water every morning before breakfast.  I cannot say the finger joints are much better, but the cinnamon was delicious and will be the only one I use from now on.  The packaging, company, shipping, etc. was all very good too.

I bought this cinnamon because I read that it is better for your health than that found in the stores.  This cinnamon has a very smooth and fragrant flavor, I am very pleased and will never go back to store bought.  The package came very quickly without problem.  It contains a lot of cinnamon so I put some in a shaker and the rest in the freezer.
I'm very pleased with the product. This is the best cinnamon I've bought.  Disolves well and taste good.  I reccomend this product.
Some may not like the taste of real Cinnamon is what I hear.But this is the best I have found and I like it.
I love this balsamic vinager. it has a great flavor, on par with some of the more expensive ones i have tried.
Ordered this Balsamic Vinegar from igourmet.com and as usual, it was delivered right away, packaged wonderfully and the vinegar is absolutely the best I've ever had!

column9: ooh, so good butterfinger crisp bars
column10: these are delicious. i was so glad to be able to get them on-line since a friend just loves them and was finding them hard to find in local stores. she was very pleasedand so was my grandson who ate one...

These just arrived, and I was first taken aback by how small the jar is (perhaps a squat half-gallon size), and it it is a scant two thirds full, not full to the top, as shown in the picture of the product (I am aware of the issue of settling, but trust me, you can't shake these enough to come close to the volume shown, in fact it is closer half full now). It is difficult to tell from a photo, but somehow I thought it was one of the large jars you you see in convenience stores; not even close. The silver dollar size is near accurate, each round is slightly larger than a silver dollar (this is a ground and formed beef jerky, not a natural muscle meat product, so the item size is consistent). The lid bears a large red label marked for retail sales at four for a dollar, which means that for the price I just paid ($18.82 for one jar), for the purchase of the entire jar, you are getting a bonus of about four of the little rounds off the full retail price if sold individually, or just under $.23.5 per bite size round. Curiously, there is a blank where it clearly shows the product weight should be listed, but I would estimate no more than a pound, tops. As to value for the price, I'd give it maybe two stars.This is a smoked, peppered beef jerky product, and I can see what appears to be pepper in the formed meat, but the flavor is quite mild on both counts. It isn't bad, but it's nothing to write home about, either. In all fairness, I like peppered meat, so I was looking for very peppery flavor; if you like a very mild pepper flavor you might be quite pleased. There is no natural grain to the meat, so it is sort of an odd leathery texture(much like fruit leather does not retain the original texture of the fruit). To me, this tastes about like a less salty than usual traditional jerky, which usually has some pepper; but being advertised as a peppered product, to my tastes, it falls short. I would give it a three on flavor; it tastes alright, just not a great spicy, peppery jerky.Over all, it doesn't taste bad, and I'm not going to throw it out, but it wasn't what I expected, either value or taste wise; I wouldn't buy it again.
Item not what I expected but my husband liked them. My husband wll take them to work to share with the technicians.
This was very tasty tea and the company had great customer service.  Their product is very healthy and I'd recommend it to anyone.
the delallo product is to die for but nutricity is the bomb (literally). they sent ii in an unmarked box. received it with two broken bottles and have not been able to resolve it with them
This product is too salty and has too much preservative. Just get your smoked product at your local fresh fish store, or in the refrigerated section of your favotite grocer!
I love banana flavored things and this banana popcorn nailed it right on!  I loveed it.  I will definately check out the other flavors as well.  Looking forward to ordering more!!!

Most marmalades are so sugary that they mask the underlying bitterness of the citrus.  This one puts the bitterness on display, to good effect.  This is a real marmalade, and not an orange-colored jelly.  Great on buttered toast.

The word 'bitter' is a category, not the experience of this wonderfully fruity and chunky preserve. Hero brand Orange Marmalade Bitter has plenty of sweetness yet the natural tang is present, along with orange fiber and rind to enliven morning toast. Try it on roast pork. This is my favorite fruit spread of any kind, hands down. I give it 6 stars.
I paid twice as much for shipping as the cost of the product.  The product had too much gooey filler and only a slight amount of orange peel.  It wasn't all that bitter either. I won't do that again!

I love marmalade and constantly am searching to find an exceptional product.  This was not it.  The bitterness was there but the product was just too dense as if it had too much pectin.  I blended it with a domestic marmalade and together they were satisfactory.  The search continues.

column9: when they say "bitter" they REALLY mean it
column10: I like a middle of the road marmalade, not overwhelmingly sweet, but also not too bitter. This product, in a 20g serving, has 10g of sugars and to me it doesn't taste like it's even remotely sweet. If you really like a bitter marmalade you'll probably like this, but it's not to my taste.

My cousin gave me a recipe for Pennsylvania Dutch Chicken Pot Pie... one of her Facebook friends said she found the noodles on line.  I looked, found these, and ordered!  They were exactly what I needed, and tasted delicious!

I ordered McCormick brand and received a different, unknown to me brand.I truly believe that if I order a specific brand I should get that brand and not a replacement one, without my previous approval.I am very, very disappointed, what else can I say as a repeated customer.UPDATE @ same day...I received a refund (in full) from Amazon the very same day I reviewed the product since they agreed that the product delivered was NOT the product ordered. I am satisfied now and reassured that Amazon's customer service is very good, best service indeed.
Not to sweet, not too bitter. The blueberry is not overbearing, but yet you know it's there.  Overall, I like it.

I love green tea and all it's health benefits.  Until I found this brand I was making my green iced tea at home. The blueberry flavor is subtle, but just enough. I love that it's not high calorie but refreshing, and it tastes so good it doesn't need a lot of sweetener.
A lot of spotlight on Honest Tea, but I think Tea's Tea is way better! Not too sweet but you can really taste the tea, very refreshing!
All of the flavor of MW without the fat!  I will never buy another "mayonaisse" again if I can help it
Walmart stopped carrying this larger jar of Fat Free and sells the smaller jar (half the size) for the same price as this jar. This is how I will purchase this from now on.
Amazon is the only place that I can buy this product. We use it rather than the lite or other.

When we adopted two small shih-tzu puppies, we went to our local pet store and sampled a variety of puppy and adult canned foods. The biggest difference in puppy diets is that they are higher in fats and calories for high-energy fast growing puppies. Our puppies are not picky at all, so it wasn't like there was one they hated, but what we liked about this food was that had identifiable food chunks in it - duck, carrots, peas, etc, it wasn't too smelly, they have good solid poops with it, and they are growing quickly / happily on it! They've been eating it for three months now with no major issues, so it is our go-to food until they hit 1. We like it so much that I bought some of the adult food for our senior dog, and he is doing great on it - he has sensitive stomach issues, so not all canned or dried food digests well for him, but we've had no issues with this brand for him (Senior Plate, Turduckhen, Thanksgiving plate, etc).

My dog is very very picky, I gave him this and he savored every bite and licked the bowl clean. Also, no more loose stool,whereas with every other food I tried, he would just leave half of it in the bowl until he was starving,then beg at the table for scraps. He would also have unpredictable stools, mostly loose. I highly recommend this food to anyone who cares for their dog like I do.

My pregnant goldendoodle was very picky at the end of her pregnancy and I couldn't get her to eat anything other than chicken and rice (homemade).  This food was a lifesaver for her and her pups. She absolutely love it.

Merrick's never fails to disappoint.  I believe their high quality canned food helped my lab live 17 wonderful years, and now I am feeding my 3 month old lab puppy Merrick Puppy Plate.  He loves the taste and so far has been very healthy.

I've tried several other holistic puppy canned foods (wellness, blue buffalo, etc) and this one was the winner for my pup(cockapoo). Any other canned food would give my sensitive pup loose stool. But with this one, he has never had a problem. I highly recommend this food!
I adopted an older standard poodle puppy that we couldn't get to eat anything.  Tried this and he hasn't stopped loving all Merrick foods.  No digestive upset at all for him.
Too large of chucks for puppies. Whole foods can cause choking, also this food caused diarhea in my puppies.

column9: So much easier on my babies tummy.
column10: When we switch my daughter from nursing to eating her first solid foods we started with rice cereal.  The misery that caused will be forever emblazoned on my memory.  Colic, gas, and it backed her up right proper.My wife and I started researching alternatives on the Internet.  We found a bunch of references to how Barley was easier on a tummy.  That Barley soup/broth is often what is given to people recovering in hospitals etc...  I went to every local store looking for some.  Family and friends that had used it used to buy it locally.  I couldn't find it anywhere.  I found it here on Amazon and bought this pack of 12 boxes.We found rather strongly that this was much easier on my daughters tummy.  She continued to eat without distress after we made the switch.  We started using it just as cereal and then as she got older we started using it as a thickening agent and filler when mixed with pureed vegetables etc...  She liked things better when they were less runny and we liked things better when she was happy.We will be ordering more here shortly for the twins that have now joined our family.  For us it worked great.  I really do recommend it as a far better option that rice cereal.

column9: gerber barley cereal - very healthy choice for a baby
column10: Healthy choice for my baby, very convenient package, easy to prepare, my baby loves it, no added milk or fruit, which may either spoil the real taste of the product, or cause allergic reaction. Best choice for busy parents.
These boxes are smaller than the size I normally buy in the store but I think that's a bonus.  They stay fresh longer since they are sealed.  Great product.
I have to say, I'm definitely looking for a deal when it comes to baby food and this is one. Compared to the store prices even with coupons, buying by the case is a great buy.

column9: My son's 2 and this is still his preferred breakfast
column10: I mix cereal, cheese & hot milk, and my son gobbles up his breakfast.I find this to be the best when compared to nutritional value when compared with Rice, Wheat or Mixed grain.

column9: Good Nutrition, Doesn't Like The Taste Much
column10: It's good and filling for my child but when given to him by itself he doesn't like the flavor. I usually mix it with a banana but I have recently started to buy the mixed fruit cereal which is sweet and mixing one pack of each and that seems to do the trick. Plus, the oatmeal is cheaper than the mix fruit so it lasts longer :-)

column9: Easier online, no deal on price
column10: I purchased this product online because I couldn't find it in the stores at that time (2 days later it was in the store also). It's good that comes quick, save a trip to the store, however, no deal on the price; same as Walmart, Kroger, etc.

column9: 50c per box more expensive than stores
column10: I purchased this product online because I couldn't find it in the stores at that time (2 days later it was in the store also). It's good that comes quick, save a trip to the store, however, the price is so much higher than Walmart, Kroger, etc (50c per box more expensive, total 7$ more expensive than the stores)

column9: Gerber is always the best food for baby
column10: My baby loves this cereal. He is allergic to many foods, but with Gerber I can be sure that there are no hidden ingredients. EAsy to prepare, easy to keep fresh, convenient packaging. I highly recommend it to the parents as one of the first foods for a baby.

the only reason I purchased this on amazon is because I could not find it in the stores and the pediatrician had recommended it for my infant grandson.  It does not disolve well and tends to clump up in the nipple.

I keep Gerber 'Mixed' and 'Barley' on hand all the time. The 'mixed' consists of rice, oat and wheat so I mix a box of that with a box of the 'barley' and have a completely balanced breakfast cereal. I don't use it for people: I keep it handy for when the dogs have upset tummies and their regular food is too harsh on their digestive systems and they need soft, easy to digest food that fills them up and is healthy for them.  As their tummies return to normal, I reduce the baby cereal a bit and add in some of their normal foods and as they continue to improve, the baby cereal gets reduced while their normal foods eventually return to full bore.This is good for them, too, after dental cleanings/extractions, surgeries, when they need a little help in the 'bowel' department (fiber), or just as an added treat to change it up a bit in their daily diet.I have used this in place of bread crumbs when making a meatloaf (ok, I was desperate), but didn't care for the texture of the meatloaf once cooked. It was too soft for our liking, but still quite tasty.
So glad this is available on Amazon. Used to buy it locally at Menards but they stopped carrying it. Just make sure you order it in cool weather, otherwise it melts together.

column9: Not the best I've had but it's still pretty darn good
column10: I bought these because I was given a bag of S'mores snacks and it tasted so good I wanted to get more so I decided to get these but they don't taste as good.My biggest gripe is the yogurt covered marshmallows.  They're too big (about the size of a small marble), they're crunchy and there's only like 15 in each bag.  As far as I know S'mores don't have any yogurt and the marshmallows are not supposed to be crunchy.  The other brand bag I was given had lots of small marshmallows and they were soft and smooth, not crunchy.  I wish they would drop the yogurt part and just throw in the soft marshmallows.Also it has peanuts and chocolate morsels (just like those Hershey kisses but smaller) AND on top of that it has chocolate covered peanuts (just like M&M peanut but without the shell) so I don't know why they would add those when you already have peanuts and chocolate.For the price though you can't beat it.  You get a total of 95 Ounces which is slightly less than 6 pounds of this stuff so I can't really complain.Either way it's a good snack, doesn't taste bad at all.Get it for the kids, yourself or your workplace.

I have been using Willingham's BBQ rub for years on ribs, brisket, pork chops, chicken, shrimp, etc.  It is incredibly versatile and adds wonderful flavor to each dish.  The key to the effectiveness of any rub is the freshness of the spices and one whiff from this jar will convince you that you can't get generate any more freshness other than to make the rub yourself.  I have done that too and I couldn't find a recipe that has produced as many consistent compliments as Willingham's.  WARNING...ice cold beer must be consumed while cooking and eating when using Willingham's!

column9: Great Rub That Goes With Everything
column10: Willingham's Original Rub is an award winner for a reason.  It's delicious and really takes your meat to the next level.  It's good on steak, pork, chicken, etc.  I use it on my ribs and get compliments every time.  Highly recommend!

I purchased this product based on a referral from the Comedian/Radio Talk Show Host Steve Harvey.  He put his seal of approval on it and for the most part, I have found him to be an expert on quite a few topics.  The best thing about it is that you can use it for poultry, fish, and beef.  I will get rid of all the other seasonings I have and clear my pantry.  And it tastes so right on all my meat!  I  chose the original, mild seasoning.
We love dry rubs. My sister sent us Willinghams to try and we've been hooked. It is peppery and sweet and goes with anything on the grill. Our new favorite.

My son eats this stuff with a spoon. I just shake it directly on my tongue.The Willingham name is famous in Memphis for great barbecue, and this is one of the reasons. I always keep 3-4 bottles of this on hand cause I'm afraid of running out. Works well even with jerk chicken and fish but where it really shines is on ribs or pork shoulder. It has transformative power. Also works well with John Boy and Billy's Hot BBQ Sauce.

I use to live in Memphis, TN and actually was handed a free bottle of seasoning by the creator and owner of the company, at that time just starting.  I have used this product ever since, and make sure that i have extra bottles in my cabinet.  If you rub this on your ribs the night before, and put them covered in the refrigerator the night before, and then put the ribs and some additional rub in a large stew pot and cook the ribs slowly; you're in for a wonderful experience.If you love BBQ sauce, after you take the ribs out of the water put them on a large cookie sheet after dipping them in your BBQ sauce. Cover with foil, and bake 200 degrees for 2 hours. If you really plan ahead, dipping in BBQ sauce the day before and allowing the sauce to melt into the ribs only enhances the experience.NEVER add BBQ sauce to any meat on an open flame.  The sugar will carmelize when removed from the open flame and seal the rest of the BBQ sauce flavoring out of the meat.
Wham!!! There is no other product like this in the world!!! No matter what i use it on, or who i serve it to we love it!!! Wham!!!
We have had wham before and everyone we introduce it to raves about it.  It seasons just about anything from steaks to shrimp to chili.

We were introduced to this product several years ago, and have not found one yet that meets it's match.  We love it on beef and chicken.  Try it, I am sure that you will love it also and enjoy your meat even more.

I love this seasoning for almost anything on the grill...but the consistency was not what I'm used to with this. In the past it is always very smooth flowing...not all globed together like these bottles. So tired of having to return things and deal with the hassle, so I just mash it with a spoon before using :(

I absolutely love this rub, and I have been hooked on it for years. It has a great kick to it, and I have found it to be great for beef. I have even used it in batter when frying chicken or making country-fried steak.If you ever had the chance to try it in John Willingham's restaurant in Memphis (while it was open) or at Memphis in May's World Championship BBQ Cooking Contest (BBQFest), you already know what I am talking about!
I grew up on this rub. I was sooooooo soooooo happy to find it on here. Got here fast to crush my craving for some home made burgers with this awesome rub!!!

My brother brought a bottle of Mrs. Ball's extra hot chutney back from a recent trip to Namibia and I have to say, I am very very glad you can get it from Amazon. The stuff is fantastic!  It is slightly sweet, but not cloyingly so.  It has a little zing (at least the extra hot one does) and it adds a lot of flavor, especially to curry dishes.  I doused my curry chicken with it and it is a fabulous combination.What a great condiment.  And much cheaper to buy from Amazon than have to send to South Africa for it!

Mrs Balls Hot ChutneyI first discovered Mrs. Ball's on a trip to England years ago.  I fell in love with it.  Alas, I had only brought one bottle home with me.  This was pre-Internet, so there was no more to be had.  Now I can get it again!It really is a delicious chutney, hot and smooth by comparison with others such as mild and chunky Major Grey's (a very good chutney of a different type).  It's flavor is just right, not too heavy handed with the strong spices, like cloves, which can leave a tinny aftertaste, but enough heat to make you sit up and take notice.If you're new to chutney and like things a bit spicy, give this a try.  It's not only good with curries, but it's excellent as a spread with cream cheese and, thinned with a little juice, makes a delicious baste for a pork roast.  Great product.

If you grew up in South Africa, this would just have a place in your heart. It is like tomato sauce, in that i put it on eggs, roasts, into stew, on fries (chips for those from UK or SA!) especially good with meatloaf! I can't rate it high enough, perhaps being South African i am slightly biased. Thanks Amazon for stocking this.

column4: E. S. Noyes "liza lives to read"
column10: I GAVE THESE AS XMAS PRESENTS BECAUSE I LOVE THE NAME, BUT PEOPLE REPORT ITS A FINE CHUTNEY. THE BOTTLES ARE A GENEROUS SIZE, AND EVERY ONE I ORDERED ARRIVED INTACT.
A truly wonderfull chutney from Southern Africa...Very nice on Currys, BBQ meats and Boerworse subs.
This is an excellent chutney, good full bodied flavor, without the typical strings of similar chutney's.  Not hot or spicy, although the label indicates such.  Great with duck.

These caramels taste great. The salt makes all the difference. It makes the caraemsl taste so much better and makes the caramels not too sweet. The lavendar flavor is subtle and not too strong. Nice soft texture that is very smooth.

Disappointing, not the same!We waited a long time for these to become available again and when we got them they tasted nothing like the ones we ordered last year. They are sort of bitter, not as salty, not as rich. We thought the old version were the best caramels we ever had, we bought several brands of salted caramels on Amazon. These are not the same at all as they used to be. Will NOT buy them again!
These caramels are delicious!  The light saltiness provides just the right amount of contrast to the sweetness.  They are so soft and buttery they melt in your mouth!!
I bought these for my wife who had a craving caramel with a salty taste to it. These fit the bill perfectly.

column9: Not that great- especially for the price
column10: I have had much much better caramels- from Trader joes even.  Their salted caramels are actually pretty great.  These were kind of blah.  I thought with the great reviews they'd be wonderful- but I found them nondescript, and the texture isn't that great.  A big disappointment.
My wife lost 100 Lbs. and is off diabetics  Meds.. and always love Peanut butter cups and she says that she loves them..

It is very hard to find this spice in 14-oz quantities so I was naturally pleased when I stumbled across this offer of a larger amount than the usual at a reasonable price.  I use it a lot so this size package was ideal for me.  The quality is good, however I was less than pleased with the product packaging.  The product came in a plastic sachet which was completely ripped open on one side, causing the seeds to spill out into the packaging carton.  I was able to salvage most of the seeds, but it was an hassle to remove the debris accumulated.

I made a mistake and thought these had not arrived even though Post Office said they had.  They HAD been shipped and arrived quickly but my dear husband got the mail that day and "put them up".  I stumbled on them in the wrong cabinet when I was looking for something else.  I put ghee (clarifed butter) on top of naan and sprinkled these on top.  Nice subtle addition.  When well with curried lentils and cheese.Anyhow - good seeds and good service.

It is really, really hard to find any gum without artificial sweeteners. Nutrisweet, sucrulose, phenylaniline, etc. This gum is simple, real gum made from good ingredients. Kids love it as well as parents.
The flavor of this gum isn't very good and goes out FAST. Also, sugar is the 1st ingredient - only 2 pieces of gum contain 2 grams of sugar.

This is the most delicious lemon juice I've ever tasted. It has a fresh, crisp sweetness that other brands lack. A generous squirt of it makes ice water taste almost like lemonade. Or add it to green tea, hot or cold. This is a high-quality product at a reasonable price.
Liiked this product.  Nice fresh lemon taste and convenient size in case wanting to travel.

column9: carefully consider your intended use of this product
column10: i assumed since Lorann seems to be the market leader in the cake & candy semi-pro flavorings arena, that this would be an excellent product.  I was making a lot of milk shakes with the standard McCormick strawberry flavoring, found in most grocery stores, which worked well but was getting expensive.  I thought this might help me save some money.  Boy was I wrong.  No matter what I did, I couldn't get anything resembling a strawberry flavor.  I couldn't believe it, so I literally titrated the stuff into a glass of whole milk with one tablespoon of sugar added.  Drop by drop.  2-3 drops wasn't too noticeable.  By 9 to 10 drops, there was a horrible chemical mouthfeel, almost a mouth burn.  It was as though I was drinking Kodak film developer or something.  Maybe there was the slightest hint of strawberries, but nobody would have found it palatable. Avoid buying unless you know for certain it will work...I'm giving it 2 stars instead of one because I can't be sure it doesn't somehow become edible after certain cooking or processing steps.

I am in love with the Rise Bar brand. My favorites are their breakfast bars, which have a chunkier and crispier consistency. The energy bars have more of a "Powerbar" like texture, everything is ground, with some shredded coconut added to some flavors for interest. Little bits of amaranth add some texture too, but they are still more soft and chewy than crunchy. That said, the energy bars taste pretty amazing too, and are a better alternative for strict vegans (sweetened with brown rice syrup and tapioca syrup instead of honey).To note, the Rise Energy Bars are very sweet, and almost dessert-like in my opinion. I enjoyed them most as a mid-day treat, particularly when I hit an afternoon lull before a workout. Plus, they are the perfect size for a sustainable energy snack.I love all of the "superfruit" inspired flavors, which are a fun change from the ordinary. That said, I think the blueberry and coconut is still my favorite - the flavors really stand out and are great together!
The Variety Pack is delicious and I love that they are all Vegan, Gluten Free, and Organic. There are 3 of each flavor in this box, and each one was yummy!
I purchased the bars because they were soy free, I enjoyed the flavor because they are delicious. Great post workout snack for those of us who have allergies to contents in other energy bars.
These bars are great for a snack. They have alot of healthy ingredients and low sugar. The bars have a good flavor from the coconut. It is hard to find bars that don't have soy ingredients as well.

I've tried a bunch of different energy bars and this is my favorite. It's not as heavy as some, is quite satisfying, and is not too sweet. It is also organic, mostly raw (which I think is healthier), and doesn't have a ton of weird non-food ingredients. It's also fairly tidy to eat - I like the kind bars also, but they are very sweet and very messy. Generally I cut it in 1/2 - as I don't think I need all the calories at once, and use it as an in-between meal snack, or to help fill me up if I've only had a smoothie or salad for a meal. I used to be a big fan of the lara bars, but I prefer these. I've bought this flavor and the coconut flavor - and buy both in bulk on on subscribe and save.
Very good. Great in between meal bar. Keeps me from being hungry and has helped me to shed some more weight. Taste great and is easy to carry with me when I am unable to stop and eat a meal.

column9: Haven't noticed a lot more energy, but they taste great!
column10: These have a great mouth feel-juicy, chewy, sweet without being overpoweringly so.  They have super antioxidant ingredients like acai, goji, blueberry and pomegranate that I haven't seen in other bars of this type.  They have only a few ingredients which are all natural.  No artificial sweeteners and they are gluten-free.  Great for an anytime snack or for on the go.
A bit different taste than the other bars out there. Quality ingredients. Will buy again.

column9: Goodbye, Chocolate Malt -- Hello, Malt Chocolate
column10: A long-time devotee, I don't expect to buy it again. After I tasted the "new improved" and found it much less flavorful than the old, I did a sniff test. The OLDER jar is more aromatic. Then I compared the ingredient lists. The one posted in Amazon is the old one, which begins sugar, chocolate, malt. The new list begins sugar, malt, chocolate. The new packaging looks blander and less robust -- a clue I should have heeded before buying. As far as I'm concerned there is no longer a Chocolate Malt Ovaltine.

column9: Better buy it now! Too late!
column10: Nestle improved it. Watch out for the new labels. Now, it's overly sweet and has half the vitamins. Darn it!!They switched it out after I wrote this and tied my good rating to it. Shame on them! I'm changing it from 5 star to 1. I'd give it a negative if I could.

column9: So Disappointed by New Ovaltine Malt
column10: My children and I were huge Ovaltine fans...until now. We are so disappointed by the new recipe for the chocolate malt. we won't be buying it any longer.

Started to order Chocolate Malt Ovaltine on here, but read some reviews first.  Then went to my cupboard to see what I had, as it still tastes like the real thing.  Well, I'd had several jars on hand, all with the new look, but now I'm using the second-to-last jar, and it has the new design, but doesn't say "New Improved Recipe".  Still good.  However, I always try to keep an open mind.  Decided to open the last jar which says "New Improved Recipe" on it, had some last night, and it had the worst, fishy-tasting, disgustingly awful flavor!  Will be calling Nestle right away to beg for the original recipe back. Needless to say, I won't be buying any until they do. (Their phone number is on the jar 800-442-0099 M-F 8 a.m. to 8 p.m. Eastern) OR OvaltineUSA.comUpdate: Just spoke with a Nestle rep. He says the vanilla they used in the batch I had was too strong, and they now have corrected that.  We'll see.  Also, he bragged that the new recipe has 12 vitamins (as opposed to the old recipe's 8 vitamins)  I had to point out to him that the new recipe may have 12 vitamins, but they all have only 10% of the RDA, whereas, of the old recipe's 8 vitamins, 5 had 45% of RDA, 1 had 50%, 1 had 60%, 1 had 15%, and they also list Calcium & Phosporous as 8% each (so that's 10 added vitamins).  He said he would tell the "marketing" person what I said.  I had hoped he'd tell the cook!  I'll try another jar with the coupon he's sending me, and then post an update.

Nestle Ovaltine Chocolate Malt, is not even close to a Chocolate Malt! Nestle shouldn't be able to advertise this as a malted drink, because, this product has absolutely no malt flavor at all, at least none I could taste.It does have a fairly decent Chocolate taste, (1-star) and is creamy, , (1-star), but that's where it all stops! I doubled the suggested serving amount, and no malt taste. I then tripled it, and still no distinguishable malt taste. The ingredients do list "malt" as one, so where's the Malt?? Then to top  it all off, it's rather pricey for pretty much just cheap coco powder.

Normally, I don't even look at chocolate milk flavorings for milk, but happened to be in that aisle.  Spotting my old friend Ovaltine, I was looking forward to some nostalgia.  I am a senior citizen, so that was a long time ago.  The Chocolate Malt was my guess for being closest to the original I remember.  The carb content looked pretty low at 9g even though sugar is listed first, and only 40 calories is low for a treat.  Unfortunately, I failed to see soy in the ingredient listing at the store.  I am one of those people who get a lingering metallic aftertaste from the smallest amount of any derivative of soy.  I'm so disappointed!

column9: The New and Improved Receipe is Awful!
column10: My children and I immediately noticed a difference in the taste and texture of the "New and Improved" recipe.  It is awful!  Some have commented on a slight difference in flavor, but for us, it was completely different, and disgusting.  We have switched to Carnation Instant Breakfast and at times, plain old Hershey's Syrup!  We used to buy three cans each of Chocolate and Malt Ovaltine, every few weeks, but we will not buy more until the recipe is changed back to the original.  This change was so very upsetting to our family.  My kids only liked Ovaltine in their milk.This change was unnecessary, uncalled-for and is ruining the brand name Ovaltine after so many generations of loyalty.  This change reminds me of "New Coke!"

column9: Great price! Well, not any longer...
column10: I can only find this at one store here, and on sale it's usually about $5.75 for a 12 oz container. This makes it about $1.50 cheaper! Talk about good deal!I drink a glass of this every single night, so I go through it at a pretty good rate.Better than any of the high sugar, HFCS containing chocolate "flavored" syrups out there!!ETA....well, the price has gone way up AND it is no longer available with Prime or as a subscribe and save item. I am HIGHLY disappointed. Now this is more expensive to buy it here than in my local shops. Too bad.

Great bargain.  This is a healthy alternative to chocolate milk and is also good added to shakes and slurpees.  By purchasing this product from Amazon, which is packed in quantities of four, I always have enough on hand for my family.

I'm not a new consumer of Ovaltine.  But if you've never had chocolate malt Ovaltine, then imagine a 'Whoppers' candy turned into a beverage, or a melted 'malted milkshake'.  I do understand that not everyone cares for malt, but for my 2 cents worth - this stuff should get 6 stars.  I can't always find this locally.  Usually I can get plain chocolate Ovaltine, but not the chocolate malt.  It's also seemingly unavailable at my local discount department store (Target.)  This 6 pack is priced comparably (you know, for when I can find it) and I got free shipping.  I'm just happy that I will have enough and know where to get it when I get low.
It's hard to believe that someone finally came up with a packaged hot chocolate that tastes rich and creamy. This is even better then my home made. Yummy and delicious

column9: Mmm... One of my all time favorite chocolate bars! :-P~
column10: For those of you not familiar, "crunchie" bars are solid honeycomb coated with a relatively thin layer of milk chocolate. Personally, I love 'em! They're one of my all time favorite chocolate bars. They're popular both in England and here in Australia where I live.Not much more to say except that you can buy crunchies in a variety of pack sizes (size being determined by the number of bars included), and this 6-pack is the smallest. I've also seen packs of 12 and 24, as well as bags of "treat sized" mini-bars for sale. Although prices on Amazon do fluctuate over time, as of the time of writing, this 6-pack will wind up costing you just a fraction of a cent under $1.40 a bar. Weirdly, that actually works out cheaper per bar than if you buy the 12 pack; although the 24 pack definitely offers the best value of all at just a fraction over $1.12 per bar. So if you are going to go to the trouble of buying chocolate bars over the internet, it may be worth your while buying MORE!!!That said, it's not like these are a health food. So please... Enjoy in moderation! ;-)Theo.

Get ready, cause you can't just eat one!!!!  Crazy good!!!  I bought the 6 pack so I could share with mysister when I went to visit..............."uhhhh......what  6 crunchie bars?  I didn't get any crunchie bars.........nope...sure didn't"....They never made it out of town....Best candy bar EVER!!!!!
my favorite chocolate since young! loved it and it came early too!wished it was cheaper though and the chocolate covering the honeycomb should be a bit thicker.
I am not impressed with this garlic powder. The garlic powder is very powdery and does not seem to have a strong garlic flavor. It is a very strange product indeed.Do not recommend.

Really looking hard for amaretto creamer for my husband who loves it, and thought getting the powder would make it last longer in the cupboard.  As it's an outside website there are no shipping discounts and when I put a case of 12 @ $35.00 in my shopping cart, I was informed the shipping was over $20.00. I cancelled my order as it's not worth it. A 3 case order cost $60.00 to ship and only gives an item price break of $2.69 per case. They need to get something set up with Amazon which gives a price break on shipping or there's going to be many more people who cancel their orders too.

These are sold at Lowe's in my area and are one of the few treats I will allow my three big dogs. They crumble under these powerful jaws, so I don't worry about choking with them. One of my dogs is diabetic, but these don't seem to effect her blood sugar at all. It feels great to be able to allow her some treats like the other two who aren't restricted. I like the product and the price - good value and quality both!

My dog is a 13.5 year old two foot tall 35-pound mutt, whom I am extremely cautious with in giving bones of any type. I worry that she'll swollow too large of pieces and choke, like she did one day on a rawhide chewy stick. Luckily I was able to pull it out of the back of her throat. Since then I watch her like a hawk and only give her certain bones. These Salix Premium Beefhide bones are made in Brazil. They are 3" long by 1" wide by 1/2" deep. They are basted w/ a natural beef coating that doesn't rub off easily or rinse off with water. They are very hard yet she is able to break off pieces that seem to crumble. I can hear her teeth grind along the bone, for she has to use her jaw power to break off chunks of rawhide. My dog can chew one stick in about 5 minutes, which is not a long time but I know that those 5 minutes she is getting her teeth vigorously scraped. I give her one a day after dinner. She loves them. I wouldn't recommend them to a large dog because they are probably too small. Small dogs may find them too hard to chew. Cost at Publix grocery store for an 8 pack of bones is $1.79 a package.

This pickling spice is of the best quality and flavor results that I have ever found in all the years i have been pickling cucumbers, green tomatos and  garden vegetables. I have experimented with others and you can't compare the taste diference that McCORMICK'S makes.

column4: Snow White "The pressure's on...let's cook so...
column10: A number of my recipes require McCormick Pickling Spice (no Msg), 12-Ounce Units (Pack of 3).  This blend is very difficult to find in large amounts.  My brother also uses this product a great deal,  so we split an order.  I kept one,  he got the rest.  I know I could make my own blend,  but again, getting the volume of ingredients is difficult.  It's just easier this way.
The hard to fine in florida is spice is just like the ole fashioned pickling spice of years gone by.

I am extremely sensitive to MSG, sulfites, etc. - they give me terrible migraines.  Although this mix says "no msg" it DOES contain sulfites, so if a glass or two of wine gives you a headache (wine typically contains sulfites), then this pickling spice may give you migraines/headaches as well.  This is just an FYI to the folks like me who have to be careful what they eat and drink. The sulfites in this pickling blend are used a preservative, which is completely unnecessary in my opinion.  McCormick simply wishes to ensure an indefinite shelf life for this stuff at the expense of individuals' health.PS - I love to make pickles, jellies and preserves, etc., and to give them as gifts.  If you give gifts of pickles made from this spice, please consider warning the recipients about the sulfites.  Nothing ruins a gift like associating a friend or loved one with a gift that makes you ill!  I speak from experience.

These are not always easy to find in grocery stores but I was thrilled to find them here.  I love these and find they're perfect for packing lunches.  The taste and consistency are superior.  Thank you!

While I like the idea of these wraps, the rosemary garlic w/herb flavor was overwhelming.  We tried making a variety of wraps w/different cheese and meats, but the wrap favor was so intense, you couldn't really taste anything else. The whole family tried them and we all had the same opinion.  Now I'm stuck w/a freezer full of them and can't figure out what to do with them.

I have tried other whole grain wraps that reminded me somewhat of chewing cardboard.This wrap tastes great! I did not find it overwhelming in flavor and it was a little nutty, and I love the amount of fiber.

As a vet tech with tens years experience it is my opinion that this is the worst dog food on the market. Yes, of course dogs love it, just like people love greasy, terrible-for-us fast food. In general, people should choose foods that contain only a few ingredients, and as little soy as possible, especially if your pet has any GI problems or any sort of allergies (which mostly manifest as red, itchy, gunky ears), and if so, corn, wheat, and even chicken may be a problem as well. Getting your pet on a better diet will make them happier and healthier and will reduce vet bills.

After trying 4 or 5 different dog foods we came across this one. Yes, the name is funny. The price is good. $22 where I live. We found this food to be softer than other brands and our dog loved it. She sadly passed away a few days ago at age 15 and we donated her new 20 lb. bag of Kibbles 'n Bits to the Humane Society in her memory. We will purchase this again when we get another dog. Great product and price!

column9: pls dont feed your dog this poison
column10: I've recently brought my dog this low budget meal sadly because I live off scholarship money and student loans and no longer live with my parent.......... I was temporarily buying my dog this food until my money came from school because I usually feed my shizu Purina one and refrigerated dog food. ........This food had my dog sick,hair fallen out in clumps, itching badly and throwing up............... I had to call my mother and have her to go out and buy her the food she usually eats. Yes I portioned the food to get her adjusted to the new food and I've done this for two months. I couldn't go on longer feeding my dog this poison ,........so if you love your dog stay away from this food........

column9: DOG LOVES IT....but will no longer order this item.
column10: I have discovered that this product has things in it that can make my dog sick!!  I feed my dog to keep her healthy, was NOT prepared to kill her as I feed her.  She is on meds and a Healthy Pet food now.  I think the company that sells this product should MAKE SURE they are selling a "Healthy Product".Thank you Amazon for the opportunity to "Inform" other pet owners of this situation.

I have seen celebrity endorsements on products before - but I'm the type of person is not easily motivated to buy anything based on what I see and hear strangers tell me on the TV, the radio or the Internet.  But in this case since the Cadbury Mr. Big is on my Top Five list, I was going to buy this item anyway.  But with Alex Ovechkin on the wrapper - it's just a bonus for my Grandson!  He has not figured out that the wrapper does not change what is inside since he is only 5 years old.  I shared a small piece of the Cadbury Mr. Big with him (don't tell his mother...) - but just like Christmas, he probably liked the Special Edition wrapper the most.  Kids are like that...anyway, I just hope he does not chit-chat with his Buds since I will be the one to pay for (and pass around...) the rest of my Mr. Big candy bars.  Yikes!  Bottom Line?  Liked the product since I was much younger and hope that I can keep my teeth (in my head...) long enough to enjoy a lot more of them...
Product is as described by Eden Foods. Although I boiled it in the water a few times instead of soaking it for 10 minutes first.

I had not drank green tea in months because I usually just dont find the taste to be very satisfying. I had read good things about the Celestial Seasonings organic green tea and decided to try again for its health benefits. From what I understand, this brand offers the most catechins which are what give you the health benefits.My shipment arrived quickly and I tried the tea as soon as I got it. I was very impressed. This tea tastes so much better than all the other green teas that I have tried. It's a nice soft flavor. So, overall, I am very glad that I bought the tea. Now, I get a tasty drink and good health benefits. : )

I have used Celestial Seasons teas for many years, but normally buy only the non caffeine , herbal teas.  I selected this Green Tea as so many friends were championing the heath benefits of green tea.Celestial Seasons Authentic Green Tea is made with all natural ingredients.  Green Tea comes from the same plant as black tea but the company dries the green tea leaves  quickly to preserve the natural antioxidants.  Then the green tea is blended with Bai Mu Dan white tea (a rare and young tea) to balance flavor.  I like this blend as pure green tea must be polluted with a bit of milk to partially neutralize the tannic acid.I have been drinking this tea for several months, and I recommend it.

Celestial Seasonings Green Tea, Antioxidant type, is light, refreshing with a mild amount of caffeine. Tea is inside 20 individual bags. So easy to use. Just put one or two bags in your cup, add boiling water, let steep for 5 minutes and then enjoy.  My shipment arrived in fine shape, no broken packages or mangled product. I am delighted to share my feelings about this product and the superior manner in which Amazon handled my order.

Drinking this tea feels amazing! I've been a devotee of this for over three years now. There's no other tea I've stumbled upon I love so much. Great for immune system, mind, skin, over all well being!

column9: Great tea!  Not so great packaging though
column10: I love the taste of this tea.  It's very smooth and not bitter as another reviewer stated.  Very mellow and soothing.My only gripe is the packaging.  With all other tea I've purchased in 20 count boxes, the bags came individually wrapped in metallic packages. These bags are loose in the box without any wrappers.  They're all hooked together like sausage links, and as stated in the description they have no strings.  So you have to fish them out of your tea cup with a spoon.If they were individually wrapped and had strings, they'd be 5 star IMO.  And if you use Amazon's "suscribe and save", not only will this be cheaper, but shipping will always be free.  And you can cancel at any time.  I love this feature!

I have been drinking this wonderful green tea for years. It has replaced coffee in my life and I am more relaxed and healthy as a result.  I recommend this fine product to anyone who is searching for a gentle caffeine lift.

I always buy Celestial Seasonings tea whenever I can.Their product is unsurpassed in quality and taste.Much better than other "natural" or "organic" teas.I just wish they would make a better marketing effort with the retailers in my area. Their teas are virtually non existent in the markets in my area.

This tea is a blend, not simply just Green Tea leaves. Though the ingredient list states this, the name and label do not. Is Celestial Seasonings cutting costs this way? It's safe to wonder. It would be nice if the name was altered to reflect its true nature: a potpourri.

column9: Not authentic, should be called "Green Tea Blend"
column10: I have tried numerous teas from Celestial Seasonings and by and large I've enjoyed them all.  Not this one.  They prominently display "GREEN TEA" on the box cover, and state "with WHITE TEA for SMOOTH TASTE".  But unless you really look, you won't notice that it also has natural lemon, and orange flavors, along with other listed flavorings, and Stevia to boot (for natural sweetness).  All this sounds yummy, right?  I don't think so.  Sure, the first few sips were like "hmm, that's not bad" but quickly the flavor of this bastardized "green tea" became annoying.  Probably not so much the flavor, but definitely the sweetness is too much for me.  But if you like sweet beverages this one is fairly tame so you'll likely find it OK in that department.My main problem with this is the fact that it's advertised as "Green Tea" and I believe this is misleading.  It doesn't remotely resemble authentic green tea in terms of flavor, in fact you can't even taste the green tea here because it's overpowered by the other flavors.  Real green tea is very mild in taste and doesn't need a sweetener because it's smooth and tasty without all the extra ingredients.Even if it wasn't for the misleading here, this mix is still not my cup of tea.  It's "OK" at best, but I wouldn't buy it again and I'm not sure I would even mix a bag or two in with my regular brand of green tea (for iced tea).Finally, I am NOT in the habit of writing bad reviews for products on Amazon.  I believe this is my first.  But I know green tea, green tea is a friend of mine, and this sir is no green tea.

I thought I was ordering authentic green tea, so when I got the green tea and it tasted like lemon and other sweet things and anything but green tea, I was very disappointed. Even from the name "antioxidant" green tea, I wouldn't normally expect such a fruit-flavored beverage. Frustrating. Having said that, I do enjoy Celestial Seasonings Authentic Green Tea as one of the most drinkable low-priced greens, and I also appreciate their eco-friendly packaging. (And, really, it was my mistake in ordering the wrong tea, however I think their packaging or description maybe could be clearer about the differences.)

My co-worker Alice shared this brand with me and it is very smooth.  I find that some green teas are very bitter but because of the white tea added to the green tea. It makes a big difference to me.  Enjoy it!

This green tea is very different to all those that I have had before. It has a very delicate mix of green tea with a most delightful undertone of citrus flavor making it currently my favorite green tea.
This is a great green tea. The citrus is not too overpowering, but gives it a great, smooth flavor. I highly recommend!

column9: Celestia has a big hit with this one
column10: I was lucky enough to find this in my local Dollar General store and I'm going to go back for more before it's all gone.  This tea is not only good for you it's just plain good.  Celestial is way ahead of the pack by blending these ingredients, including stevia that adds both a health benefit and a bit of totally natural yet calorie free sweetness.  BRAVO CELESTIAL!!!!

column9: This tea is not what it seems
column10: I enjoy Celestial Seasonings teas as an inexpensive source of pretty good tea. I drink a lot of green tea, especially Korean green tea, and so most Western green teas are a bit too heavy-handed for my taste. The problem with this tea, though, is that it is packed with orange flavoring - apparently, vitamins, too, - which is nice, if you wanted to buy orange-flavored tea. The orange flavoring completely overwhelms the necessarily subtle taste of the simple green tea. So if you want an orange (green) tea, this is the product for you. I've rated it one-star because there's nothing about the packaging that conveys the strength of the orange flavoring, which should be mentioned prominently, since it is so prominent in the taste.
We have  eaten these before and enjoy them .  We recommend them to anyone who enjoys cashews particularily with the light touch of pepper which makes them delightful.

Reading some of the negative reviews of this product, it makes one wonder if they read the label on the outside.  If the label says "Sea Salt and Pepper Cashews", don't be surprised if there is just maybe a strong flavor of salt and pepper.  Personally, for me there is no such thing as too much pepper, so I love these.
Great cashews just wish they came like they were in California at costco.Much larger container.

If you take regular, old salted cashews and add some pepper yourself, it will taste like this.  The sea salt does not appreciably alter the taste.  However, salted cashews with pepper are a tasty snack.  Good, but nothing special.

column9: Tasty snack, but cashew flavor is overpowered
column10: The sea salt and pepper blend is a nice one.  A perfect mix of pepper to salt, with just enough spicyness from the pepper to give this snack a pungent, tasty flavor.  The cashews are high quality and a smooth texture.  I love the resealable package which seals in flavor and makes this the perfect on-the-go snack package.My only complaint is that the salt and pepper flavor though a great and tasty blend slighty overpowers the cashew flavor.  I love cashews and thus would like the flavor of the nut to shine through a bit more.I'd definitely buy this for variety though

I love cashews, and also like a bit of spice added to most foods, so I thought these sea salt and pepper cashews would be interesting.Unfortunately, the black pepper taste is overwhelming and doesn't really seem to be a good flavor combination to me, the pepper doesn't add to the taste, but ruins the excellent flavor of the cashews.For someone who REALLY loves black pepper, these will probably be a hit.  If you're not a huge pepper fan, I'd skip these and grab the regular Emerald cashews instead.

Have plenty of water handy.  The over-the-top taste of sea salt and cracked pepper nearly overcame all the cashew flavor.  The Emerald almonds were much more enjoyable because they were more subtlely flavored.
These cashews have a definite kick to them. They are spicy and would be perfect with an ice cold beer on a hot summer day. The container keeps them fresh. These nuts are highly recommended.

In wondering how to make a yummy snack even yummier, Emerald has answered the question with this product.  The seasonings enhance this already highly-esteemed nut.  The ground sea salt and pepper is generous as a topping, and the kick of pepper combined with the saltiness covers any savory hankering.Its size is a boon, as it makes it easier to stow in a backpack, carry-on, or a picnic basket  It's also just enough to keep handy in your pantry for last minute guests.  I am adding this to my corral of "What's easy to put out and look really put together?"This is a keeper.

I'm not big on nuts, so I probably would have never purchased this product had it not been offered in the Vine program.  After tasting however, I am hooked.  The salt and pepper coating fresh cashews is out of this world.  It was a nice surprise, and a great new healthier snack for me.  This is worth a try.

We were so effusive in our praise of the last batch of Emerald nuts we tried that we'll sound like corporate shills when we say this one's the best of the lot.  The pepper adds a nice tang that lingers as the final aftertaste.

column9: I love regular salted cashews, and these were tasty, but
column10: I'm not a big fan of pepper and found these a bit too spicy for my personal taste.  But, while I wasn't crazy about these, my 7yo dd, who is a spice fiend (loves pepper), LOVED these, as did my husband.  They both ended up taking the can over to my neighbor, who had to try them, and he told his wife to buy them, as he too now is addicted.  She already purchased 2 cans for him.  While I will be purchasing them again, they won't be for myself though.

column9: You really need to like pepper for this product...
column10: ... and I do.  I'd never expect that black pepper and cashews would go together but they really do.  I recommend gently chopping a small handful and sprinkling them on cottage cheese!

column9: My six year old likes them
column10: I thought they were overly salty myself, but he said he could handle it. The pepper was less intrusive but it may well have been that the salt settles during shipping or handling and one cannister may be different than another. Not sure that I would purchase on a consistent basis but they were all eaten in my hosehold.

We loved these.  Delicious--very tasty, remarkably addictive snacks.  I never thought that I would like to have pepper on my salted nuts...but wow--it added a real depth of flavor that I found irresistible.  Delicious.

These sea salted and peppered Cashews would make a great snack for the guys and gals that like Cashews.  I didn't really find anything about them remarkable, but I'm not a huge fan of Cashews. Also, I'm not sure that the  salt and pepper really added to the taste... I think they would've tasted fine without the extra spices.The Cashews themselves did seem like they were of high quality and fresh. So if you love Cashews (or nuts in general... no pun intended) you'll probably enjoy this product.  As for me, I'm enjoying the dark chocolate powdered Almonds made from the same company... much more.

The cashews are a nice size and mostly whole pieces with some small broken chunks. They have a fresh roasted taste. They are nicely seasoned with ample black pepper. Most pieces, however, are too salty.If these were slightly less salty, they'd be better.

I like cashews any way, so I'm biased.  I really enjoyed these.  They do earn the name of salty, though.  So this product is not for those that need to eat low sodium, but for the rest of us they will be a tasty treat.

These are darn tasty, but subtle they're not. The "pepper" in the name isn't just black pepper; these nuts are hot and spicy, and very, very salty. Good with a cocktail or a cold beer, they're too powerful to eat without a drink in hand. The subtle sweetness of cashews is lost in the coating; you could make the same product out of peanuts more cheaply without really affecting the snacking experience. All in all, though, they're a good nosh, the best of the three "Emerald" flavors I've tried.

I wasn't wild about these at first, but they grew on me.  The pepper is a bit overpowering after the first few bites....it sneaks up on you.  However, after eating them several times I enjoyed them more.  My chief complaint is with the plastic packaging.  Although very convenient, it is wasteful and environmentally unfriendly.  PLEASE recycle the canisters!

We have picked up a number of Emerald nuts recently.  We liked Emerald Cocoa Roast Almonds, 11oz Canister (Pack of 4) and absolutely loved Emerald Marcona Almonds, 11.5oz Canister (Pack of 4), but we did not care for these at all. I have no problem with the quality of the product, but I do have a problem with the recipe.In theory pepper and sea salt sounded like a great combination.  Salty with a slight peppery taste sounded great, but in reality, the pepper was overwhelming. Everyone in our family tried them and no one cared for them. The sea salt alone would have been good, and even a lighter coating of pepper would have been okay.We love Emerald nuts in general, this one just wasn't a hit with our family.

column9: If you need a kickier snack...
column10: Emerald's nut snacks are healthy options. They are packaged in handy carry-along packages, so they're great for camping, car trips, or keeping in your desk drawer.That said, this is not my favorite of the group.The sodium level is high, there are equal grams of sugar and fiber (2), and the ingredients include maltodextrin, sugar, granulated onion, and flavorings. So we are at least a step away from naturally good cashews. Compared to a packet of potato chips, the Sea Salt and Pepper Cashews have more fat, more saturated fat, more sugar, fewer vitamins, and only slightly more fiber.I didn't care for the taste, either, though my husband enjoyed them. They were too salty for me, and the flavor didn't seem natural.They were nice as an ingredient in stir-fry, though.If you want to incorporate more nuts into your snacks but really you wish you were eating barbecue chips, then this might be a transitional food for you.
I liked the sea salt and pepper combination. About 9% daily amount of sodium per 1 oz serving. Tastes saltier than that, but not bad.

column9: Sea Salt and Pepper:  Too much?  Just right?  Yes and yes.
column10: We loved these at first.  While we thought the salt and pepper was very powerful, the cashews themselves were large and flavorful, and the whole thing really worked.  We still love them, but it's a hit-or-miss proposition.  You never quite know how your taste buds are going to react when you open the container and toss a few in your mouth.  Sometimes, without a doubt, it's just a little too overpowering.The quality of the cashews is fantastic, the salt and pepper adhere to the nuts surprisingly well considering how coarse it all is.  There are times when I'd rate these a 4 or even 5, others where I'd want to go as low as 2.  3 it is.Would we buy them again?  I don't think so, but I had to stop and really think about that.  Emerald has a great product here, and we loved their Emerald Cocoa Roast Almonds, 11oz Canister (Pack of 4), but the moments where these are too much, are enough to keep us from going back for more when this can is gone.

Well, this product is pretty self explanatory, and I'm not really sure who buys their nuts from Amazon.com, but when offered some by the Vine program in exchange, I couldn't say no (I love cashews!).  The only thing different about these cashews from your average roasted/salted cashews is the addition of black pepper.  I really did like the pepper addition, although plain salted cashews are still higher on my list.  The flavor is a bit stronger and I can only eat a few at a time.  I also think that if I ate enough of these salt and pepper nuts, I'd probably get sick of them and never want them again, so they're probably best in small doses.  Other than that, I'd say that the cashews themselves are good size and quality, and the roasting was perfect.

column9: Who knew Cashews could be so Powerful?
column10: I really love cashews and these Emerald Sea Salt and Pepper ones were no exception.The cashews arrive in a very nice container, freshly sealed with a decent lid that keeps them quite fresh for a good week or two afterward.I never thought so much flavor could be packed into a tiny nut, but I was wrong.  This product is not for the weak of heart!  As soon as you take you first taste you'll be overcome by the wonderul mix of salt, pepper, and natural cashew goodness.I shared the nuts with a few friends and reviews were mixed.  Half loved them, and half thought they were just way too salty/peppery.  I think you'll really love these if you can handle the extreme flavor, otherwise you might want to look elsewhere.

We love cashews and as we have teenagers always have a jar of them on the counter for quick snacks so I was very interested to try these flavored cashews.The first handful was great. The seasoning is nice but if you have more then one handful the flavors become too strong really fast. A few of our teens tried them out also and had the same feedback.If they had had just a bit less seasoning we would have all liked them much better. If I were to get them again, I'd mix them with the same amount of regular cashews which would be just about the right amount of seasoning for me.

I absolutely love the salt & pepper pistachios that Costco sells and I love cashews so I was looking forward to trying these. Unfortunately these cashews are so heavily seasoned that I got heartburn from them, and I hardly ever get heartburn. In my opinion when your mouth almost burns from pepper then it's TOO MUCH! The idea of a salt & pepper cashew is a good one but I'd take a plain roasted, salted cashew over these any day. To me, the delicious taste of the cashew itself is ruined by the seasoning.

column9: Not a big fan of pepper. . . .
column10: but I liked these. They're tangy and salty, and the pepper adds just a hint of spicy-ness. Some may not like Emerald products; they tend to be heavy on the "flavoring" side of things. I overdosed on caramel covered walnuts once--only for people with a really really sweet tooth. These were much more to my taste--tangy and salty. Try them!
These are yummy. The pepper gives them a nice kick. My only complaint is that for me, they were a little too salty. I'd eat them again though. :)

column9: Good snack, but a bit hard on the tummy...
column10: This is good snack that is easy to bring along. Great container too - love the screw-on lid! However, the pepper taste is quite strong, so be warned that if you easily get an upset stomach or deal with heartburn, this is not the snack for you.  I can only eat about 5 at a time; however, that is also usually all I need to satify my salt craving at 4 pm...I would probably buy this again.

column9: Well roasted, tasty & crunchy, rightly peppered, but a bit too salty
column10: The cashew are well roasted giving it a nice flavor and tasty crunch.  If you start eating one, it is difficult to stop eating them one after the other - typical nuts !  (except of the excessive saltiniess)The cashews also been well flavored with ground pepper, but the only problem is that the cashews have been overly salted - I typically have to shake the canister a couple of times to let the salt settle to the bottom before I take a byte.

This product seemed like a contradiction in terms.The cashew taste was dominated by the salty, spicy,peppery over-kill taste.I wasn't impressed.The essense of cashew is the rounded full fresh taste.These qualities were obscured by the spicing.I love spices and with almonds this would work better .

I asked six people to test out these nuts (three adults and three teenagers).  Four liked the flavor.  One didn't like the pepper flavor and one found it too salty to eat.  Five found it salty and one didn't find it salty at all.
These are tasty nuts in a convenient canister.  My only complaint is that they are a bit too salty for me.  It's hard to screw up nuts, I just wish everything wasn't so saturated with salt.

column9: Can be appealing but don't overeat
column10: I liked this nut product at the time of reviewing. Although the sea salt makes it really salty, the other flavoring ingredients (pepper, sugar, granulated onion, and spice) can be said to enhance the flavor. I found it very easy to overeat this snack due to its almost addictive taste (to my palate anyway), while I couldn't deny the potential nutritional value of this product. "Natural Flavor" is listed as one of the ingredients, but I don't know what it means.

A hint of Pepper is an under-statement!  If you do not like Pepper, than these are are not for you!  For Pepper lovers this may be a perfect snack for you. The container has mostly whole cashews!!  If you love cashews like I do and pepper is what you put on your food (which I don't)than the taste of these will be a different taste experience.  I did like the taste of the sea salt. A good treat for your social gatherings.

What can you say about an Emerald Nuts product?  They are always good quality nuts, and cashews are a personal weakness of mine.  The seasoning is an unusual choice and may be an acquired taste.  The pepper makes this snack surprisingly spicy, so if that's not your thing, don't try them.  I believe the flavor is growing on me, though I find more than a small handful is just a bit overpowering.  Maybe that's a good thing for me, as like with most nuts, this is not a low-fat snack.

If you like cashews, then you will like these nuts!  The salt and pepper give these cashews a zing that you never thought of before. My husband, 7 year old daughter, and myself all thought that the taste was great.Try not to eat the whole container, as cashews are high in fat, but a handful will satisfy that munchies bug.

These things are absolutely COATED with salt and pepper.I like salt and pepper nuts (I had some pistachios once that were salt and pepper and they were awesome), and I love cashews, but loading them with enough coating to have greasy, salt and pepper covered fingers is too much.  Its overpowering.  You can only eat a few before you feel a bit sick.

column9: Tasty and packs a peppery punch
column10: Having always loved cashews, even though they aren't exactly a low-calorie snack, I was looking forward to tasting this product. Nor was I disappointed, but I was surprised. The description promises sea salt with "a hint" of pepper. Well, it's a rather big hint. The pepper provides a shock to the taste buds with these cashews. Partly because one expects salt but not pepper with cashews, and partly because, as I stated above, the pepper is a bit thicker than you might expect. And it's somewhat tangy pepper, too. I like spicy, tangy foods so this is not a problem for me. After a couple of handfuls I had to force myself to stop before I wolfed down the whole can. I like them and I'll buy more. But do be aware that, if you like your food--especially your cashews--on the mild side, the tangy pepper here may be overwhelming. It's pretty bold, and my only caveat is, again, the pepper is more than a hint's worth.

Football season starts next month and Emerald's SEA SALT & PEPPER CASHEWS might well be a perfect addition to the Game Day broadcast as I watch my guys, the USC Trojans, beat the bandini out of all challengers on the way to the BCS Title Game. Fight on! Of course, fans of that other squad across town, the UCLA Teddy Bears, would probably find this snack just as toothsome, but how great an experience can it be, munching cashews or not, watching grown men dressed out in sissy powder blue?I'd perhaps prefer a little less salt and a tad more pepper, but then I'd fall into the trap set my wife whose inclinations favor a low-sodium diet. At 270mg of Na per serving, these nuts are a bit too briny for her; if they contained less salt, I might be forced to share. And we can't have that, especially as she thinks football is for Neanderthals.No edible is perfect, apparently. The hand-wringing, food nannies make sure of that. Their handiwork is evident on the label with the warning:"ALLERGY INFORMATION: This product is processed on equipment that also processes other tree nuts or peanuts. May contain tree nuts, peanuts, wheat, milk, soy, or sesame seeds."Happily, perhaps because I grew up in a less fearful age when kids were allowed to go out and play in the dirt and become exposed to all those nasty germs and allergens and thus acquire immune tolerance, I can now eat these SEA SALT & PEPPER CASHEWS by the handful and not worry that I'll go into anaphylactic shock by halftime.Another nice feature is the ergonomically friendly can, done up in a soothing green color, that allows for an easy hand grip. Also take note of, and visit, the Emerald Nuts website, which is clever and amusing.

The first couple of bites are extremely salty and made me feel like I was over salivating due to all the salt on my tongue.  After a couple of bites, I found the nuts strangely addicting because of the nice pepper taste.I'm not positive if it was because of the amount of salt or the fact that it was sea salt. If the saltiness could be halved down or even paired down to a quarter what it is now, it would be much better. It may certainly fit the beer drinking snack scene, but it's not something I would give to my toddler due to the salt and spiciness of it.

These were a bit delicious but I immediately grew a bit tired of them. There's way too much salt in these and I'm the kind of person who likes my cashews salty. The peppery taste was a bit of a nice compliment and when tasted in with the cashews alluded to a bit of a lime-like flavor, but I found it hard to keep myself from thinking  bout how much salt was in these.
