column9: This Thai Pavilion Pad Thai Passes My Taste Test!
column10: I ordered this six-pack of Thai Pavilion Single Serve Pad Thai as part of a gift for my father. My parents are from Thailand, and I thought this portable instant Thai Pavilion Pad Thai would be good for him to eat when he's at work or when we're busy and don't have a lot of time to cook.  I thought it was ironic and weird timing how I ordered Pad Thai a whole day in advance before all these news headlines emerged on the Internet about two Trader Joe's customers arguing and fighting over remarks and behavior revolving and involving Trader Joe's frozen vegan Pad Thai. This case even ended up going to court. Type "Trader Joe's" and "Pad Thai" if you want to read the whole stories.  Anyways, I don't know how Trader Joe's frozen vegan Pad Thai tastes like (maybe I'll try some Trader Joe's Pad Thai in the future after reading those news stories), but it's a bonus that we can order good Pad Thai online such as that from Thai Pavilion. Thai Pavilion's Pad Thai is not frozen, and you can store Thai Pavilion's Pad Thai at room temperature. Thai Pavilion's Microwavable Pad Thai is delicious. Of course we have to be realistic. Eating this is not going to compare to visiting Thailand, dining at a Thai restaurant, or eating my mother's or any of my Thai relatives' Pad Thai, but out of the instant Pad Thais out there, this is pretty darn good. It's of medium spiciness - more true to Thai flavors and spices since Thai Pavilion write on their box that this is a product of Thailand. This product is all natural, gluten-free, and vegan. Anyways, this meal is very easy to cook. All you have to do is to remove the rice noodles from the plastic bag and put them in the tray. Then you put water in the tray to soak and cover the rice noodles. Then you snap the tray lid on and microwave heat the noodles for three to four minutes. You also have the option of pouring boiling water over the noodles. After completely heating the noodles, you drain the water from the hole slits on the lid corners of the tray (this is my favorite part of the instant cooking). I like the lid tray design, and I thought it was considerate that they packed a fork with the meal as well. Then you remove the lid and add seasoning and oil packets and mix it in with the rice noodles. On the Thai Pavilion box, they boast that they are "True Thai Food", "Authentic", and "Imported". The spiciness and flavor from this Pad Thai, in my opinion, is very close to how real Thai food is like. On their box they say that they have a Spicy Pad Thai Single Serve Microwavable version as well. This is the regular one. This Thai Pavilion Pad Thai tastes so much better than Thai Kitchen's Pad Thai (On Thai Kitchen's Pad Thai box, they say that their Pad Thai was made in China. Thai Kitchen do make some great products such as their Thai fortune cookies. But if you want my complete honesty, when it comes to instant Pad Thai, Thai Pavilion wins. Thai Kitchen's Pad Thai has a sour and tangy taste to it due to the sauce.)Anyways, if you like things hotter, then you can opt for Thai Pavilion's Spicy Pad Thai, which I know my father would like as well. My father loves hot and spicy food items. My father likes to put hot seasonings, Thai chili peppers, Thai Sriracha sauce on his pizza, noodles, rice, etc. So, I ordered Thai Pavilion's Single Serve Microwavable Green Curry noodles as well - they list the taste level on the Green Curry noodle box as "very hot". My father ended up eating all of the Thai Pavilion Green Curry noodles within the month. Garlic Chili and Thai Peanut are the other two instant meals from Thai Pavilion. Give this Pad Thai a try! I have to say that this Thai Pavilion Single Serve Instant Pad Thai passes this Thai American gal's taste test!

column9: The Taste of Thai version is SO much better (and lots lower in sodium)
column10: As of this review, I've also tried the Thai Kitchen and Taste of Thai versions, as well as Dr. McDougals RightFoods version. This one is not great tasting and is loaded with sodium - 810 mg. Taste of Thai, on the other hand, is just 320 mg (and best tasting of the lot, by far) compared to 650 for Thai Kitchen (just another so, so product). Although the sodium is listed as 480 mg for the supposedly "healthy" Dr. McDougal version - it's actually the highest in sodium since McDougal's is only about half a serving, so multiply 480 times 2 to get the real comparative sodium.
This Pavillion Pad Thai is surprisingly good.I liked it much better the the Pavillion Thai Peanut.The Thai Kitchen brand of Thai Peanut is the much better of the two.
I love this one. I do have a complaint that a portion is very tiny and I feel like you could get a little more satisfying prepared meals for the same amount of calories.

What a great value this is. I saved a lot of money, buying this assortment of syrups. And they are all my favorite flavors, too. I love the spicy, fragrant, delicious flavors we all enjoy in the winter. I would love to hear from other people who have tried these syrups, sharing all the ways they can be used. My favorite so far is to swirl the Pumpkin Spice into some plain yogurt. Very good. Any other ideas out there?

These syrups arrived when expected. They are good quality and came with six pumps which I didn't expect but would've needed.  The flavors taste good mixed with coffee, espresso, or hot chocolate. This is a good vendor.

I love that this product is so concentrated.  All of the flavors pack a punch.  I was, however, very disappointed with the flavor of the Chai.  To me, it didn't really taste like chai tea.  Still in search of the perfect chai tea concentrate. :-(  The other flavors are great!  My favorite is the gingerbread.

I love these. The pumpkin tastes like you would expect pumpkin to taste, not just spices. We use these in coffee and yogurt. I just wish they all came in sugar free!!!But they are wonderful for cold mornings, especially.

The syrup is OK. It's very thick, which makes it hard to mix into coffee drinks, which is the whole reason I bought it. I've only tried 2 flavors so far. The eggnog is OK, but the nutmeg is unbearably strong. Based on the other reviews, I'm almost afraid to try to pumpkin spice.I thought I'd give a different brand a try, and I was excited to try the holiday flavors, but I doubt I'll purchase Amoretti again. I would think about returning it if it weren't for the price of the return shipping. I'm just hoping the other flavors will make up for it.The above was my initial review.  The company contacted me within a few days and discussed other ways to use the syrups rather than just using them to flavor coffee.  Apparently I was using a little too much syrup.  If you're used to using other flavorings, you only need to use about half as much with Amoretti.  He gave me a lot of good ideas, such as in yogurt, baking, etc.  He also shipped out some more items for me to sample, including flavored olive oil and a martini mix.  Everything I've tried is delicious.  The ingredients are very high quality.The syrup is thick, but with some experimentation, it's becoming easier to use.  I'm also very happy that the pumps are included with the syrups.I've never experienced such great customer service.  Amoretti really wants to make sure their customers are happy.

I ordered the 6paxk so I would be able to play around with the flavors. I figured I probably would not like the eggnog or the chai but I was wrong. Okay- so the chai won't be my favorite but I know my friends will like it.  What's great about the Amoretti  6pack is each bottle comes with its own pump. They are pretty concentrated so you won't need but half a pump per cup of coffee or whatever you use it for. The customer service is awesome -I received my package 2day !!!  I had ordered the peppermint along with my 6 pack but instead received a Hazelnut.  I contacted customer service and they responded very quickly and were extremely helpful in correcting the problem !! Shout out to Paul  for your help. !!! Oh- and before I forget, each flavor is true to what it's suppose to be and not a flavored sugar syrup !! You will be happy that you ordered this !!!

I was extremely excited about receiving this set.  Once received, the visual aspect of it was wonderful! However, I can't fully say the same thing about every last syrup. Lets start with the Eggnog: this was probably my favorite because it truly tasted like eggnog (alcohol and all) and the smell was dead on, Nutmeg: exactly what it should smell like, Cinnamon: this one reminded me of red hot candies which isn't bad but I have yet to try it in my coffee, Pumpkin Spice: One word, potpourri. I DEFINITELY did not like this one.  Yes, it is called "Pumpkin Spice," but this is not what I expected.  It's waaaaaay too spicy!!  It tasted like tons of spices added onto the Cinnamon.  It's just a NO! Chai: This one smelled like bubblegum and chai tea spice.  The scent was somewhat nauseating to me.  Didn't like it at all.  Finally Gingerbread:  This one was OKAY, but not a true keeper.  There was too much ginger in it to fully call it gingerbread.  Should have been called Candied Ginger instead.So all in all, I WOULD NOT re-purchase this set again.  I really do not like the Pumpkin Spice, Chai nor the Gingerbread although the bottles were nice....~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~UPDATE:  It was only a few days after posting the review on this particular product (set) and my dislike about some of the flavors, that I received a phone call/voicemail from Paul Barsoumian himself about my review.  Quite frankly, I was a bit shocked due to never experiencing customer service like that before.  I was debating on returning this set and just purchasing the Holiday 3 set (peppermint, eggnog, gingerbread I think) since I was not too fond of the gingerbread, chai or pumpkin spice.  He very graciously took the time out to call me and provide a bit more on their products and even how to use them, especially the trio that I did not take to right away.  When using the syrups, I did know that since they were more concentrated than other syrups like Torani, DaVinci, etc and less sugary but what I didn't quite grasp was that you really do not need so much.  The two times that I used the gingerbread syrup, I would put a full pump into my drink (coffee) and it was soooo overwhelming that I literally dumped it into the sink.  However, when talking to Mr. Barsoumian, he informed me that I only needed half a pump if that.  I will say that I have yet to retry it in coffee, but I do like to add a touch to tea for a hint of gingery flavor. I will try it soon though.Even with the Pumpkin Spice and my true dislike for that flavor.  I am starting to wonder if my pre-exposure to other "Pumpkin Spice" syrups have ruined my taste buds with their artificial nature.  I'll admit, when I purchased this set, that was one of the main reasons why I chose it.  Pumpkin Spice just screamed my name.  But when tasting it, my expectations were shot.  I do not blame Amoretti for this because when I actually think about it, this is what Pumpkin Spice SHOULD taste like.  It taste like Autumn if that is even possible, yet without the pumpkin which is fine because the name isn't Pumpkin Pie Spice, just Pumpkin Spice.After informing me of the usages of the syrups and how much to use, Paul sent me a few samples of other products (like the New Pumpkin Pie, Crema di Tiramisu and a few other products).  I honestly thought that when he said 'samples' he meant miniature versions of the original, but apparently these were the original size! Regardless, each flavor that I received was absolutely delicious!  I will say that the Pumpkin Pie was definitely what I was looking for.  And the Crema di Tiramisu was just WOW.  It was like liquid tiramisu.  The espresso flavor blends with the actual espresso in a coffee drink but it somewhat mellows it out leaving the true flavor of tiramisu.  I'd just like to restate that Amoretti has by far, the BEST customer service that I have ever came across.  I definitely plan on trying more flavors from this company and building my ever growing collection of Amoretti Syrups (I already have 14!).I have changed my ratings to 4/5 stars rather than 3/5.  This is not due to a hate for the flavors, but I just have not found my preference for what to put them in yet (have not been given the time), but even the ones that I do not care for as much, I have seen that others do like them.  They are great!

I was excited to receive this holiday pack but I have to say that I am less than thrilled with the flavors. The packaging was very good and I appreciated receiving the pumps for each flavor. The directions state to use 1 1/2 pumps for hot drinks- well this was way too much for my taste. The pumpkin spice flavor was overwhelmingly harsh and spicy. I found if I used enough for it to be sweet, then it was way too spicy. When I used a smaller amount, I had to use sugar to sweeten my coffee. I normally like spicy flavors but this is just too strong. I'm not sure how we'll ever make our way through the flavors. I don't plan on repurchasing.
With these flavorings there is no need for me to add sugar.  I just add some of whatever flavor I am in the mood for.

I just ordered this product - i read, and re-read the item info on the page, eventually i understand it to be that i will be getting a total of 45 cookies, and this is it! In one sense, i thought it was 45 cookies per package, with 3 packages - thus, 45 x 3, but then i again re-read the info, and i gather and the more likely answer is, the total is ONLY 45 cookies!!! Now, this is 'neither good' nor 'bad'. All it is, IS, you are paying pretty much the price that is on  the cookie bag if you were to buy one alone at a supermarket, but having it brought right to your door, thus shipping!  So, you are really paying the SAME PRICE of a GROCERY STORE, and little more, for 'shipping' - but, for me, I have no car, so, to have 3 bags of cookies arrive at my door, while i sit sans car, makes things only a little bit easier.  I still say, it should be 45 cookies PER BAG, with 3 bags in this total, 'special package' deal....  Cause if you think about it, it DID SHOW THE PRICE OF $25 AND UP with a line thru it, thus, implying you were getting over 100 cookies!  Cause why on earth would someone pay, 25$ for the product, alone, then the 7$ shipping on it, if it were only TOTAL 45 cookies? I gave it 3 stars, for it being 'ok' -  and only 'ok' - not great, but, its just one way to make life a little easier, i guess.
It's so good that you can order Pepperidge Farm online and receive in time and price is not all that good but you make up with convenience of ordering online.

Not a personal favorite. Bought it as a gift from amazon but could not find better options. Still, it is Pepperidge and everyone knows they make upper end cookies. 3 Stars which is another way to say average.

They are delicious, Healthy and for only 100 calories has a decadent rich taste! I usually buy the big bag, but this is a perfect amount for a snack and chocolate boost.

I absolutely love these Dark Chocolate covered Acai with Blueberry treats.  I have a really hard time finding them in the stores around here, so I just order them from Amazon.  They have always arrived in good shape, never melted even in the hot weather we have been having.
i am a hot chocolate addict, and this is the best one I have come across. It has a rich flavor with a hint of spices in it. It's really great.

There is way to much surgar in this hot chocolate it's like having sugar flavored chocolate, I am going to have to buy some pure powedered chocolate and mix it in the bag, other then that I would say it would taste good if it was not so sweet.

The first time I tasted this Mexican Spiced Ground Chocolate was in a restaurant in Southern Colorado. It was a cool rainy day and I was in love with it after the first sip.I have never tasted anything this good. I took down the name of the product, googled it, and quickly ordered it from Amazon. I will now be ready for the first snowy day in Denver. It is the best hot chocolate mix ever!!!

I first tried this product after visiting the Chocolate exhibit in Chicago six years ago and it reminded me of a tasty coffee I had in Cancún in the late 1990s.  It makes a great cup of hot chocolate and I occasionally enjoy mixing some with coffee to make a mocha.

I am a big fan of chocolate and cinnamon, and was looking for a stronger cinnamon flavor than Stephen's Gourmet Chocolate Cinnamon (which is very good, but very subtle).This one has way too strong of a generic spice flavor for me.  It almost tastes like someone brewed really strong chai, then tossed in a little bit of chocolate for flavor.  The spice mix overpowers the chocolate, both in smell and taste, and I can hardly taste the cinnamon part at all, which is mostly why I bought it.Also, I drank the first 1/3 of a cup, then stopped and cleared the dishes later.  When I dumped it out, there was over an inch of THICK goopy sediment.  I followed the directions when making it, so I don't *think* I used too much mix, but you might try using less than the instructions call for.I'm going to try it again at some point, using less mix and keeping it stirred in between sips, to see if that helps.  But otherwise I have 3 more canisters to try and give away - if you haven't tried it, buy as small of a pack as you can for a taste test first.

This is a great treat for the Fall and Winter months hunting, camping or just snuggling up to watch a movie. The cinnamon is not too overpowering with the chocolate and has a rich cocoa flavor. My wife drinks it as an alternative to coffee so she can sleep at night.
Ok it makes a Great Cup o' Chocolate! But I really use it in my baking of Brownier, Cookies, etc. Such a good addition to any scratch baking project.

column9: Great Hot Chocolate w/a bit of spice
column10: This makes an excellent hot chocolate.  I also make my own gourmet hot chocolate mix and I use a bit of this to kick up some of the mix.
Tried this while I was visiting in PA. All natural ingredients, while the flavor is exceptional!  Try this one, you'll never drink any other!

This is, hands down, the absolute best hot chocolate ever. First had it years ago in a little cafe in Va. Have been ordering it online ever since. Have also given it to friends & family as a gift and everyone raves about it. A wonderful taste of chocolate mixed with just the right spices. Try it once and you'll be hooked.

To me it seems like too much sugar, not enough chocolate, a little heavy on the spice. Sugar is the first ingredient. But if not for the sugar problem I wouldn't complain about the spice. I tried adding 1/2 pound of powdered cocoa to the 3 pound bag and it was still too sweet. It's amazing to me how far this is from "the best hot chocolate ever" like other reviewers rated. Def try a small bag first to see who you agree with.

column9: Too Spiced And Not Chocolaty Enough
column10: Unfortunately, I was disappointed with this chocolate--too heavily spiced and too sweet; not enough of that velvety, smooth pure chocolate that I prefer. I have 4 tins that I will give away to friends and family.  I'll be back and will let you know how they like it.

A wonderful taste surprise that has spoiled me for all other hot chocolate drinks there ever were.MOCAFE Azteca D'oro 1519 Mexican Spiced Ground Chocolate is a rich, creamy, spice surprise that is not your mama's hot chocolate. If you are a hot chocolate drinker don't miss this.

This is probably the best-tasting cocoa I've ever had at home.  A friend gave me a small tin of it years ago as a holiday gift.  We enjoyed every bit of it but had trouble finding more until it turned up on Amazon.  Smells great, tastes great, and is made with real ingredients (not artificial sweeteners and weird chemicals).  Really fantastic stuff.  It's also great in brownies and cakes - adds some spices above and beyond what most people expect.  Tastes like fall, in the best way possible.  Here's a recipe to try:  a few frozen bananas (for chill and body), about a  cup of crunchy peanut butter, about half a cup of almond or regular or soy milk (more milk if you like a thinner shake), a scoop of this cocoa, and blend.  Drink it right away.  Filling, lots of vitamins, and naturally sweet.  I know people who swear by it as their daily breakfast.  Yum!

I got the 3lb bag and the recipes on the bag call for "scoops." A scoop was not provided in my bag, but they say that 2 scoops is equivalent to about 8 tbsp. However, the nutrition information is given by 38g serving, not by tbsp or "scoop." I measured it out with my food scale and 38g came to exactly 3 level tbsp, so if I made the Iced Chocolate as directed (2 scoops/8 tbsp), I'd be getting almost 3 servings of chocolate mix (420 cal before the milk!). I cut the milk in half (3oz hot and 4oz cold) and use one serving (38g/3 tbsp) chocolate, served over ice, and to me it is delicious with a nice strong spicy chocolate flavor, and it is a reasonable 217 cal when using skim milk.Different palates are going to have different preferences as far as the balance of spice and chocolate, but I can tell you that I like it. My husband does not care much for cinnamon but he also likes it, and my children like it too. We have only tried it cold so far and are looking forward to trying it hot!
I purchased this product because of the reviews I read and I'm so glad I did.  I love it.  If your looking for a good hot chocolate this is it.  Sweet, spicy chocolate...very good.
This is the best drinking chocolate I have had on the market.  The spices are perfectly combined for an authentic Mexican taste. The seller delivered 100% as promised.Thank you.

This stuff is just awful. Doesn't taste like chocolate in the slightest. I've had very good Mexican spiced chocolate that actually tasted like chocolate. This stuff is just a mix of cinnamon and a bunch of other overpowering spices that are not pleasant. I can't believe this stuff has such good reviews. It's iky
I've been using the MOCAFE Azteca for years.  Sweet and a bit of spice.  Mixes easily.  And you can get by with half the suggested amount.  Nothing warms you up faster on a cold, winter day.

i love this spicy chocolate. it's perfect for anytime. the best way to make it, is to heat your milk on the stove and add the chocolate as it is warming. i also add some whipped cream to my cup with a sprinkle of chili powder on the top. love to curl up and just relax with a warm cup.

if you want to try an excellent brand La Parisienne Couture Cocoa you will find is the best one on Amazon.So far I have tried:Bellagio Sipping ChocolateLake Champlain Hot Chocolate MixesLa Parisienne Couture Cocoa (My Favorite)MarieBelle Mocafe Azteca D'oro 1519 Mexican Spiced Ground Chocolate (didn't like at all)Jacques Torres Classic Hot ChocolateVosges La Parisienne Couture CocoaSarabeth's Kitchen Hot ChocolateLa Maison du Chocolat Tasse de ChocolatLove to hear others feedback.....
This stuff is good!!  That's all I have to say.  Rich chocolate, sweet but not overpowering, with a taste of cinnamon and almonds.  Great combination.

column9: Not nearly as good as 2 other Mexican Spiced hot chocolates.
column10: This is the 3rd brand of Mexican Spiced hot cocoa that I've ordered.  This by far is the poorest in tasting.  The other 2 were far superior in flavor.
...but you'd better like sweet. This is not for those who want dark or semi-sweet chocolate. For those of us who like sweet, this is decadent . It is worth the $! Go for it!!!
this is the best mix i have found.  i have been buying it for the last four years and plan on buying it as long as it is for sale.
I had 6 sample packets 1.25 oz. My oldest daughter 12 yrs loved it with whole or 2% milk. Have used some mixed with my morning coffee. Best Hot Cocoa mix I've tried.

So chocolaty and spiced just right! I decided to try this brand after reading all the wonderful reviews. I'd never had spiced hot chocolate before - just the plain store-bought instant kind. WOW! The flavor of this just blew me away! Best cup of hot chocolate I've ever tasted!! I'm hooked!!

Love this stuff.  It has one of the best combinations of chocolate and mexican spice flavors of any I have tried.  I used to live near a bookstore where the cafe made mochas with this cocoa and now I buy it at home for the same purpose.  It also works really well to add a little spice to your cookies.
First found this hot chocolate on the Museum of Natural History of all places. There's a great blend of sweetness and spice. It's so yummy!

column9: Can't get much better than this.
column10: This awesome mix is not your usual Hot Chocolate so if that is what you are looking for do not buy this product. But if you are looking for a chocolate that tickles your senses then you definitely want to buy this. The first time I tried it I was not sure so I drank some more, still couldn't decide so I drank some more. So I still couldn't decide so I drank more and then I knew. . . . Ahhhhh What a delicious hot chocolate this is. One that can not be defined.MOCAFE Azteca D'oro 1519 Mexican Spiced Ground Chocolate, 14-Ounce Tins (Pack of 4)

This cocoa has ruined all other cocoas for me! This is all I want now, but to be honest it is a little expensive, especially with shipping always applied. So when it arrives I hide it. I leave the Swiss Mix and the Nestles out, and save this for moments when I just want to indulge myself. I have shared it occasionally, but only when the kids are very, very good. Try it and treat yourself.

My husband is not a coffee drinker and the nippy mornings left him a little jealous of my warm cup of coffee.  Having just returned from a trip to Santa Fe where I had purchased it originally, I introduced him to the pleasures of morning hot chocolate.  He was hooked!!  Now for the other use, today , the day after Thanksgiving clean up we were at breakfast without any milk in the house, but an abundance of leftover decaf coffee from the celebration, his long face was brightened when I spooned in a bit of MOCAFE Mexican Spiced Chocolate into a cup of decaf.  WOW! a new taste and he loved it!What else can I say, it's a hit around our house.

As a family living with Celiac Disease (Gluten Intolerance) as well as Dairy/Lactose Intolerance, finding tasty hot chocolate mix that doesn't taste like tree bark and dirt (my children's descriptions for other brands we've tried)  is a challenge, until now. THIS chocolate is amazing- we mix this with hot Silk (tm) Brand Almond Milk and WOW! Even our non-Celiac friends and family love it- it is smooth, creamy, rich and delicately spiced. Just amazing and well worth the price! We LOVE it! ADDICTIVE!

column9: The best pre-mixed spiced hot chocolate ever!
column10: I first tried it about seven years. Trader Joe's use to sell it in their stores and at the best price ever!  I am a hot cocoa fanatic AND I'm Mexican.  Per my qualifications, I say this is a great blend.  The ingredients are fresher than Abuelita and the sugar isn't as gritty.  I only wish I could find it wholesale.  Price is a bit steep at Amazon...16 oz. (3-pack) - 34 cents/oz14 oz. (4-pack) - 43 cents/oz.The 3-pack is the best deal (just over $1.00 per 8 oz. serving).  You can get 69 servings for $32.67.I have yet found a better prepared Mexican hot cocoa, seven years later.

This product is, in fact, a spiced, chocolate drink.It is yummy.It is not super-chocolatety, but it does have enough chocolate flavor to warrant it being labeled a chocolate drink.  It *is* very sugary, but what reasonable person believes that a chocolate drink should be anything other than a treat?I give it four stars because while very yummy, it does not send my consciousness into the higher stratosphere of the realm of pure, abstract deliciousness.  It is, however, a product I will purchase again.It tastes sweet, cinnamony, and chocolatey and has some other flavors I cannot identify.  I recommend it if you like or are curious about such things.
I really like to put this on top of the coffee before brewing.  Yummy!
This is a fabulous drink that our entire family enjoys ! It has just the right combination of spices and chocolate.

column9: not my cup of tea, so to speak
column10: This product is great if you like the particular spices used in the mix.  Unfortunately, although I am drinking it, I am not enjoying it as the flavors just don't jive with my palate.  If you really like the spice combination (I like cinnamon, for example, in almost everything, but in the chocolate mix it just doesn't make it for me), you'll love it.  I guess my advice is the product is fine if you like the flavor combination, but I would advise trying the mix in a small packet to determine whether or not it's for you.  I have this huge quantity to consume, and I rarely partake of it as I don't really care much for it.
This is the best spiced cocoa I've ever used. I love to put it in my coffee every morning!
This hot mexican spiced ground chocolate is a great defroster for the winter blast weather.  I love sipping this hot chocolate while watching the snow flakes falling.

I really like this product. I NEED coffee in the morning, so I add this to my coffee, in addition to adding a teaspoon of ground espresso to the cup as well. This has a nice taste to it, not too too sweet & just a bit of a cinnamon-y flavor. Its very good. A little pricey, but buying it in quantity like this saves me a few trips to Whole Foods.

YUMM!! And it's Lactose, Gluten and Soy Free* (*Save Soy Lecithin/lecithinan, which it seems that many with soy allergies can tolerate)Ingredients - per package (3 # bag)Pure Hawaiian cane sugar, Premium Forestero cocoa, ground chocolate (sugar & Cocoa processed with alkali, unsweetened chocolate, soy lecithinan emulsifier, pure vanilla), spices, all natural flavors & salt&Although the tins come with the scoop (which holds about 2.5-3 T.), I get a better price buying the 3-Pound Bag and using a 2 T. coffee scoop. I found the secret to using this in a manner I can enjoy it, as I find the original instructions make it way too intense.  I only add 1 scoop (2T.) to a cup, then add enough hot water to fill the cup half full, stir, then top off with almond milk or coconut milk.  Yummm!!  And, being Diabetic, I get my daily cinnamon!MOCAFE Azteca D'oro 1519 Mexican Spiced Ground Chocolate, 3-Pound Bag

The MOCAFE Azteca D'oro 1519 Mexican Spiced Ground Chocolate is a very interesting drink. Not knowing what to expect [I speculated that the hot chocolate would have a touch of heat], I made a cup as soon as it was delivered. To my surprise, it has a strong cinnamon [and probably nutmeg] flavor - it is a good hot chocolate.I mix the chocolate powder with steamed/frothed milk from my espresso maker - I find this makes the drink much better. It takes a couple of cups to really make an opinion, but I think it is a good hot chocolate to drink every day.

We discovered a cafe that had excellent Mexican mochas about three years ago. They were expensive but we didn't visit that often. Then we discovered this was the powder used to make the mochas. It is all natural and tastes great. It is really rich and has nice spicy undertones. This is the cheapest way to purchase it in bulk.Now we make our mochas at home with an espresso machine and steamed milk. This also is loved by our children for hot chocolate.

I first got this in Ridgeway, CO., driving 40 minutes each way to get a mocha made with thismix. Then the woman who was making my coffee during my stay let me know it was just amix. I couldn't believe it, but it's true, a very delicious mix you can do right at home.
I love hot chocolate, but I found this mix repulsive. There wasn't a strong chocolate flavor and the other flavor notes where far too sweet.  I had to throw it away. I will never purchase this again.

column9: Good, rich and high quality but not what I was expecting
column10: I rather enjoy mexican hot chocolate and am used to getting the thicker ground Ibarra style version.  The ingredients are quality and it makes a good drink appreciated by guests but unfortunately is not exactly what I wanted.
I found this product in a coffee shop in Chincoteague, VA  And was blown away by it's taste.  Energizing, but not too over the top.  And I received it quickly.

column9: Love the cocoa, not the packaging.
column10: I found this cocoa at Bristol Farms while looking for a healthier cocoa without the partially hydrogenated oils in most of them.  I love the spiciness of this cocoa and put half a scoop in my coffee every morning.  I don't drink straight coffee so I carry this powder with me when I travel too.I was thrilled to find this item on amazon after Bristol Farms ran out for a while.  I have received a few of the 25 lb boxes with no problems, but my last $113 box is in the trash after I cut the plastic tie and found baby silverfish in it.  These bags are not sealed, just have a plastic tie aroung the bag opening so lots of tiny things can crawl in.  I know we have silverfish here at my husband's house, but now that I have just thrown $100 in the trash I wonder why they can't seal these bags?  I'm going to have to start buying a smaller quantity and just pay more per ounce so this doesn't happen again.  Unless a few people are drinking this or you only have one serving a day you need to plan for storage of this powder for quite a while.

column9: Do Not Buy Mocafe Azteca D;oro 1519 from Amazon.com!!!
column10: Do Not Buy Mocafe Azteca D'oro 1519 Mexican ground chocolate 3lb bag from Amazon.com. Ordered 1st time on 7/18/10 did not receive Azteca, instead received CHAI The excuse was could not stop the order in time.  2nd time received Chai again although on Amazon's website the product advertised is Mocafe Azteca 1519 ground chocolate. This time i'm told to buy from a out side vendor. SAVE YOUR SELF THE AGGREVATION AND DO NOT BUY FROM AMAZON!!!MOCAFE Azteca D'Oro 1519 Mexican Spiced Ground Chocolate, 3-Pound Tins (Pack of 2)

I've been searching for a good-tasting protein drink since I had a gastric bypass 3 years ago. I saw this product on another weight loss surgery blog and decided to give it a try. You can drink it warm (unlike most other protein drinks) or cold and it mixes quite easily if you use a container with a blender ball. I thought it was a bit too thick when I mixed it according to the directions (2 scoops in 12-14 oz. of water) so the next time I used more water. Others might prefer the thicker version, though. I also added crushed ice after I mixed it which kept it cold longer and made it more like an iced coffee drink. When I travel, I take my empty blender ball container in my carryon bag, stuffed with ziploc bags filled with protein shake powders but on my next trip will be taking these packets instead.

column9: Metallic Taste is the Deal Breaker
column10: Purchased this to use for travel as it's difficult to find iced coffee in most hotels & using water to mix makes it the perfect travel drink. I so wanted to love this. You have to shake vigorously - preferably using a shaker with a stirring ball or filter - as it's VERY grainy & takes about 2 minutes of solid shaking. Grainy I can live with, but the taste is the deal breaker. It has an incredibly strong metallic taste. The only way to soften the taste is to add lots of milk, which defeats my purpose of bringing a water mixing drink to travel. It's expensive for the convenience and would have been worth it - if only I could drink it. Oh well, the search for a traveling, water mixing iced coffee continues.

We've enjoyed this special cooking product for many years because of the excellent taste and texture it provides when preparing various kinds of fish.  We've been frustrated for quite some time because our local sources no longer supply it.  Imagine my pleasant surprise to find that I can convenienty order it from Amazon (one of my most favorite mail order sources).  For years I've counted on Amazon for books, electronic items, and (more recently) cooking items and musical stuff.  Now I can/will add food items to that list.

I got hooked on the House Blend at a gas station near the house. When I found out they had it in the k-cups I immediately stocked up. It's not too acidic (like Columbian) and not too weak (like a breakfast blend). It's my go to coffee for just about any time of the day. Definately worth a try if you have never had it!

This is a nice medium coffee.  Not too strong and not too weak.  It has a good flavor and isn't bitter at all.  I typical go for the donut blend but tried this one because it's cheaper and I don't think I'll go back.
In fact, I am drinking a cup of this now!!  It is a nice full bodied coffee, not bitter, no aftertaste.

Waited awhile for delivery, as this was a promotion and product was pre-ordered, so price was excellent. The coffee is better than anticipated: smooth but flavorful. Definitely my new breakfast/ early morning favorite.

This blend is perfect for any time of the day,  morning or noon or night. My preference is the House blend, because it doesn't leave that lingering sour 'finish' I experience with each sip of the Columbian blend. The House blend finishes clean and inviting , something I don't experience with other blends. And if I feel a need for a little more robust flavor, I'll just pick the smaller serving size, for my taste at that moment.I've sampled a number of blends and brands from various Keurig providers, from Green Mountain to Gloria-Jean's and more, but for me personally, the Van Houtte House Blend is my choice.

column9: Nice, Smooth Medium Blend. Good Cup of Coffee
column10: This Van Houtte blend is a nice, smooth solidly medium blend.  It is not acidic at all.  It is slightly stronger with a touch more flavor than Wolfgang Puck Breakfast in Bed (Medium Roast), 24-Count K-cups (Pack of 2) and is comparable to Coffee People, Donut Shop K-Cups for Keurig Brewers (Pack of 50).Not too weak, not too strong.  Solid medium blend.  Recommended for those who like medium blend coffee.
OMG!!! BEST COFFEE EVER FOR THE KEURIG. I WONT EVEN DRINK ANYTHING ELSE EXCEPT OF COURSE FLAVORS ON OCCASION.  SERIOUSLY BREW THIS ONE ON TRAVEL MUG SIZE AND MMMMM ENJOY!!

Not bad overall. Mild taste. One thing I noticed is beyond 12 oz it tastes watery. I frequently make 14 or even 16 oz cups with other coffees that taste fine. Their Colombian is a bit bolder and can brew a larger cup but my favorite is Coffee People Donut Shop.

Once again Van Houtte scores as my favorite coffee brand. I usually like flavored coffees but decided to get this for friends and family that want "real" coffee. This has a full bodied flavor that is very good.
I like a bolder more fully flavored coffee.  This coffee was just too weak for me. No complaints with packaging or anything else just not my choice.

I was looking for a light tasting coffee with no bitter aftertaste.  I found it!!!  House Blend has all my favorite attributes.  It's smooth, tasty, clean coffee flavor.  I sigh after every sip.  Yummmmmmmm!!
I really like this.  It is medium-bold, but is not harsh, nor does it taste scorched. It has nice balance.
I really like this coffee and have been buying it for several years now.  However, where I was buying it - raised the price considerably.  Buying it via Amazon is the best buy.

My very favorite brand of k-cups! So much so I signed up for automatic delivery , which results in free shipping and an unbeatable price. It is a nice medium roast, no bitter after taste. Just like a fresh brewed pot of coffee in every cup.
This was my first time buying this one and I LOVE IT!  YOu won't be dissapointed.  Smooth and not bitter at all.  LOVE IT and will order again!
This coffee is okay, it's not the best tasting, but it's not the worst.  I would buy it again.

column9: Van Houtte House Blend not tasty
column10: I have tried several different K-cups (Timothy's, Van Houtte, Gloria Jeane) and flavors/roast (bold, light, medium, etc) but this is the worst tasting coffee I ever had in my life.  I don't think there are too many reviews as people don't always leave a review when something is bad or if they have tried this coffee already, they know not to purchase it again which leads to a review not being done.I will never buy this again though I love and prefer the columbian medium and kenya kil. roast from Van Houtte.

column9: Great, if you like K-cup coffee quality.
column10: Van Houtte K-cups are my favorite if I have to drink k-cup brewed coffee.I have tried many K-cup varieties.  None taste as good as home brewed coffee or coffeehouse coffee.

column9: Freshen up gum is still here! Yay1
column10: I was so excited to see this on Amazon - it reminded me of high school. I loved having this gum again, but it does lose its flavor pretty quickly, and it gets hard pretty fast, too.

column9: Absolutely LOVE these!  Handy, healthy, fantastic flavor!
column10: Like another reviewer, I became familiar with Oloves in a snack pack during a flight.  Ever since I have selected the snack pack to get the olives.  They are a delicious snack, packed in the little foil envelope.  Easy to carry, little fluid in the bag, already pitted, and taste fantastic.  I am so happy I can now get in the US.

I would buy the snack pack during my flights on United Airlines just for these delicious olives.  After a long wait and numerous attempts at contacting the company directly to buy the Oloves, I'm soooo delighted to hear they are available on Amazon.I use to like eating olives, but I now love eating Oloves.

I was just introduced to these olives on a United flight this week. Probably the best tasting green olives I have ever had (I usually never eat green olives). I was so happy with them I purchased two snack pack boxes with the Olove packs on my return flight to share with my wife and kids. I'm thrilled I am able to purchase these on amazon and really suggest them to anyone looking for a great snack.

I bought these Oloves for my mother and aunt who were coming to visit me. They had tasted them on an airline and wanted more. As the hostess with the mostess I surprised them with a big box of Oloves at their arrival. These are delicious, healthy and easy to transport. I keep mine in the fridge because I like cold olives, but you can also eat them room temp if you so choose. All in all, a good buy! I just hope that Trader Joe's picks these up, they would be a hit!

I echo what other reviewers have said--I learned to love Oloves when I got them in an airline snack pack, and they are the best. I even tried to get my local grocery store to stock them. I am extremely happy that they are now available on Amazon!  I like to grab a pack when I go hiking or on a car ride--the small packages are so convenient.  And the taste is the best.
These tasty little treats are great for a lunchbox or a hike. They are tender and savory - what more can you ask from an olive??

I have been waiting for these to be available. It's a wonderful company. When I told them how much I wanted some they actually sent me some samples. It was fantastic.Oloves are one of the best things I have ever had in my mouth.
I hated olives until Oloves. They're so delicious and flavored perfectly. I used to get them from a frequent flyer I know who hated olives, but now I can get my own!

I am so glad I can now get Oloves from amazon here in the US. The only reason I would buy the in flight snack was for the Oloves. When I flew with co-workers or family I would persuade them to buy the flight snack so they would then give me there Oloves. Never told them how good they were... guilty, I wanted them all for myself.Best Olives ever. 5 out of 5 just because I cannot give them more stars!

I love oloves!! I have tried finding them in the US for a year and am so thankful that they are now available! They are tender delicate olives, just like the ones you get in Spain. They are conveniently packaged to be taken anywhere you go. Before I was able to purchase them on Amazon I would purchase the United box meal that included them just so I could get my Olove fix!
This is my most favorite tea, and Potrero Tea does a great job with it.  I love that I can order larger sizes as I drink the tea daily.  Delivery was quick and the price was right.

Do you like, love, crave chocolate, look no further. Rich as an oil tycoon, creamy and to-die -for. Got this for a woman friend and let me tell you , actually I cant, Family friendly sight and all, lets just say she really, really liked these shells and I got some great gifts from her. Can;t do no better as a gift and cheaper then a sports car. She even let me taste one, off the charts in chocolate goodness. All kidding aside, this is one great product and hats off to the amazon people for finding another great product Arrive in great shape, promptly I might add.

I first had these chocolates over 20 years ago and when my mom would bring them back when she would go home to Sweden to visit all of her family every 2 years.I know their Belgium chocolates but their readily available all over Europe and Scandinavia.She would actually get them at the duty free shop in the airport.Since she is older now she rarely travels anymore so I was very happy to find these on Amazon.I think this chocolate has to be in the top three chocolates I have ever had.I have eaten many good chocolates over the years considering my mom is from Sweden where they have some of the best chocolates in the world.I think I am somewhat of a connoisseur.If you are a chocolate lover you have to try these chocolate shells they are awesome.

Great for on the go, but a little disconcerting that its brown. Super handy though as my little one has gas issues so you cant shake her bottles so making them away from home is difficult & this makes it a breeze. Just wish they came in 4-8oz bottles.

I received a pack of 8 cans of formula. Which 6 were damaged. I paid $80.00 for all but two cans to be partly opened. I  returned items. However, I still have not received new formula. The product is wonderful.I just wish that the delivery and shipping process was handled with care.

We are a couple from the northwest side of Mexico and we do know about peppers, in fact i don't know any person who tolerate hot peppers like my lovely wife. She can eat fresh habanero without a blink or a sweat.We opened the bottle and we ate about 1/3 of the content during one dinner, maybe that's says it all...! It's tasty and really hot if you use a generous amount. We tried it in carne asada tacos and it was a really good experience (My wife told me that she felt like Scooby Doo in the movie, throwing smoke from her ears... lol). Is it the hottest sauce in the world...? Maybe not but it is a hell of a good sauce.I did some edition of my original review and upgrade to four stars because this sauce deserves a better rating.

I love hot spicy food and especially hot sauces. I have had quite a few and most of these are either so hot that they have no flavor or they are too wimpy. This is one of the few hot sauces that is actually incredibly spicy and very tasty. The flavor is really fresh and not too sour (Tabasco is way too sour), and the heat is amazing! You'll be sweating.

I bought this stuff about two weeks ago and it was really really hot. I like the fresh taste in it. I put just a little on a cracker straight and had to drink a whole lot of water. I also made salsa with it and only used about 10 percent of the bottle and it is still very hot. Believe me when i say this is some good stuff. Hotter than the ghost pepper, and i have bought plenty of ghost pepper sauce.

I was excited when I saw this hot sauce so I ordered it right away. Unfortunately it doesn't live up to its name sake. I wouldn't even call it hot. Reminds me more of a cocktail sauce. Blair's Ultra Death sauce is what I would call hot... but it also taste like sh*t lol. The Scorpion Sauce DOES taste good but doesn't have the heat you would expect or want. It WILL mess up your stomach though.There was another reviewer that stated hes had hotter sauces that didn't bother his stomach as much as this did and he is absolutely correct. You could easily fill up a large spoonful of this stuff, let it set in your mouth a while, then drink it with no burning or sense of heat.... but your stomach WILL quickly disagree. Actually, just small doses of this stuff really irritated my stomach. I can drink a dipping bowl full of habanero sauce with minimal stomach irritation.. but just a small amount of Trinidad Scorpion bothers my stomach quite a bit. I just wish I felt like I accomplished something when my stomach hurts this bad. It's literally like downing cocktail sauce then feeling like you were bashed in the stomach with a base ball bat repeatedly. I do like the taste but the messed up stomach isn't worth it when there's no heat to justify the irritation.

This sauce was no where near as hot as it claims. Tried this sauce along with Dave's ultimate insanity sauce and Dave's was way hotter then this huge let down. Was very disappointed with the low quality of heat it didn't have.

This is by far one of the hottest hot sauces I've ever had, and I love it!!!!!!! Dont buy if your not looking for fire in a jar. Even if you think you've had hot stuff before, trust me you havent! But if your like me and are looking for somethiing insane, give it a try.

column9: A very good all purpose Hot Sauce
column10: Bought this out of curiosity and was pleasantly surprised! It has heat but not overbearing. Used properly you can taste the taste of the chilies ,citrus and garlic. A must buy for any afficianodo of hot sauces. A good addition to my growing collection. I have four different kinds now to suit my needs or taste for the moment.

First of all - All hot sauces will have inconsistencies, its just how it goes. The only way around it is to get the super mass produced stuff(tabasco rings a bell).This is a non-extract hot sauce with a limited ingredient list(less belly pain), if you need more heat just go the way of the extract sauces.This is a terrific sauce and I can see the bottle getting used pretty quickly. Pretty hot but if you want the full effect just do a tablespoon full. Its quickly becoming the go to sauce for flavor and burn, again its not an extract sauce so its not going to touch the heat of those. With all of that in mind I would rate this pretty high among my sauce collection.

This sauce is the very best bought it to bring tears to my friends eyes she didn't flinch she eqat anything hot it is pretty spicey so if your taste buds are looking for the real hot stuff this is it.Next I'm going to try the seeds to grow our own hot pepperfs.
I love this sauce it's just right...hot & spicy w/ just a few drops and can still taste your food.

column9: Tastes good, but the heat is surprisingly low.
column10: This sauce has a nice flavor outside of the heat; kind of a vinegary/fruity taste. The problem with this sauce is that in the mouth, it isn't even as hot as the Naga Jolokia, or even Scoth Bonnet hot sauce I've had. But it did wreak havoc on my stomach and bowels, which was sort of to be expected, but I've had other sauces that were much hotter on the mouth that didn't wreck me in the bathroom. Be warned.

Being a fan of Ghost Peppers, I decided to give this a shot.  Finally did it today...Reactions?  Well, to use TFS DBZ:A references in standard internet Meme format:What I expected- [...]What I got- [...]I am disappoint ;;
This is a good product but not as hot as say 100% Pain Hot Sauce. Its has a little to much vinegar taste for me also. shipping was good but took a little over a week to get to my house.

column9: Of all the different brands Green Mountain has the best flavor for Decaf.
column10: Of all the different brands I have tried Green Mountain has the best flavor for Decaf.  It is very rich in flavor and you don't really think you are drinking decaf.
This coffee we have purchased many times from Amazon and each time it has met all of our expectations. We will purchase it again

We have been using persian nectar black tea for years.  It is so aromatic, full of bouquet and very satisfying.  I highly recommend it to people who like a slightly fruity flavor, but not at all overpowering or leaving an aftertaste on the tongue.
Shockers are my favorite candy.  The candy was very stale.  I will not be buying from this store again.  Be warned.
I love shockers and usually buy them a target, this was a really good price and i gave the second box of rolls to my daughter when she moved into her dorm.

column9: I love Shockers!  The taste fantastic!
column10: I love Shockers!  They taste great.  They are kind of like a chewy sweet tart with a twist of sour to them.  But don't eat too many at one time.  They will color your tongue and leave it feeling raw.  This is the best price I have seen anywhere for Shockers.

I totally agree with the reviewer that said that this was their favorite candy but their order from Amazon was stale. I love these things and hoped for a different experience. Unfortunately the Shockers I received are super stale and take a lot of effort to chew.
WHEN I WAS IN ENGLAND I TRIED THESE DELICIOUS LITTLE CAKES. WAS HAPPY TO FIND I COULD GET THEM HERE.  THERE ARE MANY TYPES.....THESE ARE GREAT WITH TEA OR COFFEE...

The package has only about 12-15 seeds in it. I thought there would be more. I planted the seeds in an indoor planter. Surprisingly, there are five plants coming up in only a few days. I am looking forward to my salad crop.

column9: Could quality and high viability from a company with a conscience.
column10: What can I say? these are organic seeds.  However, I like how the company, Seeds of Change demonstrates some social consciousness.On the practical side, the seeds demonstrated a high degree of viability and the recyclable package has a ziplock closure.  For lettuce-type seeds this is very handy when you want to stage numerous crops.

column9: Just as good maybe better - without the guilt.
column10: You like caviar but haven't stolen anything off the grocery shelf since high school?  Well, calm yourself down and enjoy the value because this is a large helping without the price of individual Romanov caviars added up.  It tastes about the same, but now you can share it!  Don't try to impress a caviar lover with this brand, but since it has very quick shipping across the country, you can intercept the package almost without guilt, hide it in the fridge, and stuff your mouth with caviar anytime. Its got a long shelf-life as well.  Enjoy!
Most satisfactory for the price. Firm eggs with just a tad too much salt but still delightful. I will use this product again.

I can't find caviar anywhere in a two hour radius so when I found this caviar on amazon... I figured why not. When it got to the house I was apprehensive to open it- I've had bad experiences with mail-order foods... but this was PERFECT!  Not too salty, and makes a special dinner even more-so. If you're looking for something special for these holiday meals... order this and prepare to blow your taste buds off for the price.  This earns the Fifi seal of approval!
Best cookies ever. Bought these for my Dad as a birthday present. Try them and you will be hooked. Arrived fresh and in a very cool box.

The biscuits were sent with a gel ice pack, which kept them nice and cool so they wouldn't melt.  They came within reasonable time and I love these cookies.  I will be purchasing more in the weeks to come :oD
These beautifully packaged biscotti are as tasty as they are pretty.  We bought them as a gifts for our employees, and it was a big hit!!
THIS MAY BE A GOOD PRODUCT SINCE I HAVE NOT YET TRIED IT BUT BEWARE OF THE POSTAGE...I PAID OVER $16 FOR A $9.98 BOTTLE...
Seriously.  It tastes like the vanilla filling you get from a breakfast danish.  What it does not taste like is authentic hollandaise sauce.

column4: Cherry pie "Beauty is only skin deep and even...
column10: I used this in cakes, cup cakes and candies, its great in drinks i found as well as long as your making mixed drinks. I really enjoyed this produce and i urge people to try this and experiment with it, be adventurous with your cooking and the flavors you use its truly worth it!

When I first opened the bottle it smelled medicinal. I added it to some iced tea and it tasted just like it smelled, very medicinal and only a trace of fruit flaver. I ordered 2 other flavors and they're the same. I gave it an extra star because service is good, but I can't recommend the extract.

It does not taste like chocolate, not even a little bit. It does taste fermented. And burned. If it were a good, carmelized kind of burned, that would be understandable. Everyone burns the sugar now and then. This just tastes BAD. Everything I have tried it in has had to be tossed, unsalvagable. My advice: Stay away.
I cut up the peels for the citrus in Pannetonne. The peels were flavorful and tasted just like what we would get in Europe.

column9: Good candied orange peel, but not great.
column10: Last weekend we candied the peel from about 28 pounds of oranges (a box from a Florida Grower that was a gift.)using a number of recipes for candied peel as guides. We made orange juice and ordered a citrus juicing attachment for our Kitchenaid because that many oranges was a lot of work! We were happy with our candied peel, but wanted to see how it compared to comerically available items so we ordered 4 ounces of orange peel from France -- the most expensive peel -- as well as the most recommended, less expensive peelCandied Orange Peel Slices 2 lbs (32 oz.)This morning, we dipped samples of all peels in the same dipping chocolateGhirardelli Chocolate Candy Making & Dipping Bar, Double Chocolate Flavor 2.5 LbsThis peel, currently being reviewed was mediocre. It contains much more pith (the white layer under the zest) than ours did, as we were careful to follow Pepin's instructions given in "La Method". As a result of the higher percentage of pith, the candied peel was much more bland than our home candied peel, and less vibrant in color.We concluded that candying peel at home makes much more sense that buying candied peel. It's easy -- the cost is really only the sugar as we either composed the peels or fed them to the cattle previously -- who love them by the way!The packaging of this peel is fabulous, but the peel itself is mediocre.

Received this Seattle's Best Coffee 12-oz. Ground Coffee, Level 4 as a Christmas gift, and found it to be as good as I had heard from friends. The bag said "rich, elegant, complex" and this habitual daily coffee drinker can agree with each of those adjectives. This is one that I will come back to.Had to go look up what the level rankings were for these coffees, and if you like a slightly stronger coffee, as I do, then you might be happy with this one. Will personally pass on the Level 3, but their Seattle's Best Coffee 12-oz. Ground Coffee, Level 5, having a "roasty aroma, rich flavor with low acidity and body" sounds interesting.Subjective rating of Seattle's Best Coffee, Level 4:Aroma: 5-starsTaste: 4-starsBut does it live up to the name "Seattle's Best Coffee" as this brand is called? That could be one of the most subjective opinions here. Call me easy to please, but Eight O'Clock Coffee, Original Whole Bean, 12-Ounce Bag (Pack of 4) is what I call my "standard" everyday coffee. But what do I call a 5-star coffee? Try the Magnum Jamaican Blue Mountain Blend Coffee, Whole Bean, 2 Lb Bag or the more costly Wallenford Blue 100% Jamaica Blue Mountain Coffee 16oz Whole Beans and break out your grinder.Another personal 4-star "standard" is Starbucks Pike Place Roast Coffee, Ground, 12-Ounce Bags (Pack of 2), which should be familiar to many. This "house blend" from Starbucks can be found across the world, and if you want a decent comparison to the Seattle's Best Level 4, this might be it.Again, choices in coffee can be very subjective, so explore and find a favorite. I personally like to keep the 5-star coffees for weekends or special occasions, and that's when I switch to beans and break out the grinder, but again that's a personal choice.Maybe after trying a few more bags this highly-subjective rating will go up, but this coffee dinker is calling the Seattle's Best Level 4 ground coffee a good, solid 4-star choice. And now for another cup...12/29/2011

I never ordered this product. I ordered Henry's Blend which was the description that was offered.Not to be a pain, I tried one bag and I hate it. I wanted Henry's blend .I was and am so upset that I paid all that money for 5 bags of what I thought was Henry's blend .I would never buy coffee without first tasting it. I knew what Henry's blend tasted like.I would have bought one bag of their new coffee and tried it out.Henry's blend was so luscious and rich. I'm lost until I find another coffee brand.I've been buying Henry's blend for years. I miss it and I want it back!!!!!!!!!I want to send it back . He can just refund my money for the unopened bags.
Level 4 is what used to be their "Breakfast Blend".  It's an awesome brew and can be purchased at most Super Wal Marts for $6/bag.

I purchased this hoping that it would taste like Seattle's Best Henry's Blend.  I was very disappointed.  At the time, it was not offered in whole bean form.  After looking all over for Henry's Blend, I finally settled on Ruta Maya -- which requires grinding but is so much better and less expensive than "Level 4."
I went nearly 40 years never liking or drinking coffee.  My husband gave me this coffee and I've been hooked ever since. I love it hot or cold.  I love it!CON:  Price!
The caramel ones tastes great with just hot water!I haven't tried it yet...it may even be better with hot milk...
A cup of this with a dollop of whipped cream is heaven on a cold, damp or snowy, winter evening.  Heaven!

column4: Venus Starlee "Mom of 1 and a bun"
column10: I've gotten the Land O Lakes mint hot chocolate in the variety packs before and this is my favorite flavor, so I thought why not just drink the one I like best.  Actually, I mentioned it to my best friend and she ordered me a case last year for Christmas and I LOVED it!!!

We've had the Land-O-Lakes Supreme, French Vanilla and Graham and all have been excellent.  With numerous others as comparison (Swiss Miss, Nestle, Ghiradelli etc) Land-O-Lakes is the best I've had to date.

This is great hot cocoa!  The cinnamon is probably my favorite, but all the LOL hot cocoa flavors are good.  You can't beat the Amazon price either.  I can buy these at my local grocery store but they're .59 per packet.  Ouch.  A box of 72 lasts quite a while...unless you share, of course :)

column9: Tastes great, wish it were healthier!
column10: "Corn Syrup Solids, Partially Hydrogenated Soybean Oil, Polysorbate 60"It's really good cocoa, and I make it every morning for my husband (he won't drink coffee); we even bring it along on vacation so he can have it. I just wish that list of poisons above weren't included.  I've suggested to Land-o-Lakes that they make a ... "Sweet Nothings" version or whatever they want to call it:  a *totally* unsweetened version, so we can add whatever sweetener we wish to add.The corn syrup is unhealthy in the extreme; the 'partially hydrogenated' means trans fats (and soy is *not* healthy, contrary to the "common" "wisdom"), and the polysorbate has been shown in cosmetics to cause problems (and why is a cosmetics ingredient in a food item?!).That said (er... written), until someone comes up with a healthy product that tastes as good as this stuff does, he's gonna keep drinking these poisons every morning. {sigh}

column9: Supreme Chocolate Makes My Heart Sing!
column10: Instead of creamer and sugar, I add a packet of this to my eight ounces of freshly ground coffee each morning! For a mere 140 calories, I enter bliss! Comparable, both in yummy-ness and nutritionally, to a whole milk Starbucks Mocha Frappuccino®, this Supreme Chocolate mix comes in at 3 grams of saturated fat (30 calories, 14% DV, from hydrogenated soybean oil and coconut oil), 0 trans fat, and 24 grams of sugars (sugar and corn syrup solids). As for price, since I live three hours from the nearest Wal-Mart, the shipped price is actually a little better than I would pay locally, and it arrives practically overnight. The entire box of 72 packets is only 7"x7"x18", and consists of six smaller display type boxes of twelve packets each. These 6"x7"x3.5" display boxes will tuck neatly into the smallest kitchen upper cabinets, and will maintain the individually wrapped single serving packets in a neat upright position. All in all, this is a big luxury for a little price, which is something that makes my heart sing!
Walmart sells these at $0.47 each and these are priced at nearly $0.62 each. Enough said.

column9: This product really calls for 10 stars
column10: This the best hot chocolate I have ever had.  I love this flavor.  I introduced it my niece and she now loves it as well.
I love this flavor, It is the same price as Walmart, but this is easier, plus you get 72, hard to find 72 at walmart all one flavor

column9: An Excellent Cup of Hot Chocolate!!
column10: Being a hot cocoa lover as I am, it's hard to believe I've never tried Land O Lakes Supreme Hot Chocolate until I received it as part of a gift basket. I must say, it was one of the best cups of hot chocolate I've had in a long time.I've tried soooo many different brands....from the most expensive to the least expensive. This ranks up in my top 3...which is a hard place to get to in my eyes (or taste buds?).At approximately $0.40 a serving, this is a great deal.You'll find this hot cocoa rich in taste and quite creamy as well...even though it's simply made with hot water.Make sure you follow the instructions on the packet....6 oz. of water per packet.Go ahead...try it...you won't be disappointed!

On cold winter evening my husband and I enjoy drinking hot chocolate while sitting in front of the fire watching a good movie. This is the best hot cocoa mix we have tried yet ... it is delicious! Of course we also like to add a bit of Bailey's Irish Cream, which makes it even better. YUM!
This french vanilla delight is warm and soothing on a cold winter day, or even a not so cold day.  I first received a few packs as a Christmas gift and was delighted to see it available from Amazon.
i ordered mint chocolate and got supreme. i am very unhappy, becouse you cant return it..

This cocoa is rich and flavorful, nicely chocolately! I only wish I could get the flavors in individual boxes. I love most flavors offered, but would love to be able to get my favorites on their own! I like to give packets as Christmas gifts to people I work with done up with a cute package and winter poem. Everyone seems to love it!

I never get tired of mint chocolate cocoa! Can be pricey, try to catch when on sale or shop around Amazon's vendors for the lowest price. Quick turnaround when ordering, never been disappointed and I order ALOT!

I'm not a huge hot chocolate fan. They all seem to taste alike to me no matter the brand. I happened to get this kind in a mug as a gift. I tried it one night and I love it, love it, love it! It is ssooo good. I have never heard a bad thing about it!

This is the best hot chocolate I've ever had.  It's all my family drinks.  I give packets to people all the time to try and they always LOVE it.  BUT you have to mix it with milk to get the full deliciousness.  I'm never without a stash of this hot chocolate.  I buy it in volume because we drink so much.
Love this hot chocolate and I feel it I got this product at a very good price.People should try it it is delicious and so great to have on a cold winter day or anytime is a good time.

This cocoa dissolves in a nice way without a lot of chocolate clumps at the bottom of the mug. The cinnamon flavor has a 'cozy' aroma/taste. There are several other delicious Land O Lakes cocoa flavors including French Vanilla, Supreme, and Caramel. It's yummo in my tummo ( I find myself saying this a lot when I'm drinking it!). Several months a year the elementary school fundraising company called Market Day features a large box of Land O Lakes cocoa (assortment of flavors) for a much lower cost than in most grocery stores.
I was given these as a gift and immediately went to the net to find the other flavors available.  It's some of the best hot chocolate I've tried.

column9: Time to buy hot chocolate again
column10: And you might as well buy this. It is creamy and chocolaty, kind of like what one reviewer said before, like drinking a chocolate bar.
It may be a small packet, but it packs a powerful punch. I usually add a little extra water to make it not so strong.

column9: seriously? over a dollar a packet?
column10: I cannot believe how expensive these are!  Even at the local grocery store they are only $.69 per packet, full price.  When you add in shipping, you are paying over a dollar a packet. Outrageous!

column9: Great product - but horrible pricing on Amazon
column10: This is amazing in a pasta, macaroni, or potato salad!  Even on toast it is good!  The texture is a bit different, but really, it is soy free, so its pretty hard to get it to have the same flavor you're looking for when you're missing a common ingredient.  Amazon's pricing on this is terrible... $11 a bottle?  Are you kidding me?  Whole foods has it for $4 a jar (twice the size of the bottle).  Get real, Amazon.

This is the best mayo I have EVER tried, and I've tried a lot.  In fact, mayonnaise is possibly my most favorite food in the world! I love it, and I love this one most of all!  I can't believe that another reviewer actually suggested that it tastes like Miracle Whip. Miracle Whip is a disgusting, sweet, icky mayonnaise imposter and this mayo has absolutely nothing in common with it.  It is not sweet at all, and it actually has flavor.  Yes, it is a tangy flavor, but mayonnaise is supposed to be tangy.  If you don't want tangy mayonnaise, get something bland from Walmart and be done with it.  If you want mayonnaise that tastes like perfect, homemade mayo, then get this.  Added bonus--no horrible little soybeans are involved at all.

I have tried Whole Foods 365 mayo and this Spectrum canola mayo.  Both taste like tangy, skunky Miracle Whip.  If you hate Miracle Whip, then you should NOT buy this mayo.  The only positive about this mayonnaise is that it does not have genetically modified soy oil or corn oil.

I have been on a deep search for a mayonaise that does not have soy in it due to my soy allergy.  I tried this with very high hopes but it just have a weird tangy taste to it.  Not a good tangy, because I love tangy. Just not good....so the search continues.
I love this mayo and it is one of the healthiest mayos available at this time. I highly recommend it.

I often come across a product that repels me.  Then, occasionally, my taste buds change direction to the point of craving the aforementioned "repulsion."  The first time I can remember this phenomenon was with Kombucha.  I hated the vinegary bite, but kept drinking the beverage because of its health benefits.  Now, I have to ration the stuff to protect my wallet.  More recently, I fell into the same trap with this mayo.On first try, I felt like the product simply tasted "wrong."  I disliked it, but I'm thrifty; I didn't toss it in the trash.  By the 3rd or 4th try, my brain had accepted that this tasted different.  I began to appreciate the merits the flavor does have.  The texture is different, too.  Most mayonnaise seems more whipped (with air in it).  This is smoother and creamier.  Actually, more like the food prep mayo I used to use when I worked in a deli.I guess another comparison would be with orange drinks.  If you grew up on SunnyD Sunny Delight , Orange, 48-Ounce Single Serve Bottles (Pack of 8), than fresh squeezed orange juice would seem completely off the mark.  You would, however, come around eventually.

Thanks to a combination of Hi-Tor Neo Diet and Vita Gravy (and the sub-q fluids prescribed by the vet) my cat, who was given a diagnosis of advanced kidney failure and a certain impending death sentence two months ago, has amazed my vet and everyone in the vet's office. As a previous poster has already said, many renal failure cats are presribed the Hill's k/d or a/d diets and they absolutely hate it and won't eat it. My cat would not touch the stuff -- wouldn't even smell it -- I had to force feed him for weeks. I finally found the Hi-Tor Neo Diet, which is almost as low protein/phosphorous as the Hill's prescription diets. My cat loves it and is finally gaining back some weight. The vet had also prescribed some vitamin drops, which he also hates. Then I found "Vita-Gravy", which is also available at Pet Food Direct. He loves the taste of the Chicken Vita-Gravy mixed with the Hi-Tor Neo. Now he's getting the extra nutrition he needs to balance his blood levels, while really enjoying the taste! If your cat has renal failure and is refusing to eat, you might want to try this combo. Good luck! I hope your kitty fares as well as mine has so far.

column9: OK, not the wonder food I was hoping for
column10: My cat has renal disease and has been on Hill's k/d dry and canned food for over a year.  Recently she was getting picky about eating and not wanting the either type of the canned k/d.  Based on the Amazon reviews, I ordered the Hi-Tor Neo Diet hoping that she would love it.  At first she did love it (something new/different I think), but now she is very ambivalent towards it and lately has preferred the k/d.  Perhaps it is due simply to her personality or perhaps it is due to her stage of renal disease, but I have not seen any difference between k/d and the Hi-Tor Neo.  Other than the renal disease, she doesn't have any health issues and is still pretty frisky for being 16 years old.

My cat has had a poor appetite for months, which was explained recently by a diagnosis of chronic renal failure. I dreaded the prospect of trying to switch him to an even less appetizing food than what he was currently refusing to eat. Sure enough, like many other CRF cats before him, he wouldn't touch the Hill's canned k/d or Royal Canin pouch renal diet. I searched online for an alternative and found Neo Diet. On the advice of one "5 paw" customer review, I gave it a shot. He gobbled it up with such gusto that I could hear the chomping and lip smacking from across the room! I can't remember the last time he's eaten that enthusiastically. What the heck is in this stuff???

Well, rats.  I finally found a renal cat food that my cat likes, and they change the formula!!  To defend her pickiness, Sabrina has had renal disease for 6.5 years.  She's been through all the mainstream renal cat foods and sooner or later, tired of each of them. No going back, either.  Kitty with a memory - my luck. I read good reviews about Hi-Tor Neo Diet early this year, and ordered a case.  She SCARFED that food down!  Things went along swimmingly until my last order >> hmm, new label, new size, new consistency, doesn't smell the same.  For a week now, Sabrina has consistently taken a few bites, then turns her nose up at it.  She's eating maybe 1/8th of what she used to eat. I'm shipping the remainder back, and the new search begins.....sigh.  Anybody else having this experience?

My cat is in the early stages of renal failure and I bought this as part of my efforts to find an appropriate food he would eat.  Unfortunately I've offered this product twice and it was tried for a mouthful and later ignored.  Interestingly, I also have a young cat (formal feral) and even this former dumpster-diver sniffed and walked.  I will continue to offer this and hope it catches on eventually.There are other products for the condition but this one seemed to be the most palatable from reviews.  There also seems to be some controversy over whether a cat in early stages of kidney failure should be fed a low protein or low phosphorus diet.  Further, there seems to be an issue in later stages with cats losing weight and not wanting to eat, and I am not sure if a food like this would encourage eating.  One day at a time.So here I am with the smallest amount one could buy (24 cans).  If this food doesn't get a decent reception soon, I will probably donate it to my vet's office for other sick cats to try.  If you've got an ill kitty, and you've been told to try a low protein/phosphorus food, it can't hurt to do lots of reading and try this, but no miracles in my household just yet!Update March 2010 - It's been 1 and 1/2 years since I wrote the above review.  Your vet advice and results may vary, but my cat has done very well on a normal diet since then.  After doing much reading and talking with our vet, special foods are not yet called for for my cat.  Have your cat's blood levels checked to see if they are doing ok with phosphorous and you and your vet can decide from there if food like this is advisable.  It may be better to discuss if your cat can stay on regular food and use a phosphorous blocker.More and more I am reading that weight loss is a problem for cats in kidney failure so keeping the food desirable to them could be a big deal.  My cat is having more issues with the accompanying hyperthyroidism than with the kidney disease currently, and while he has indeed lost some weight, his blood tests are showing he's doing pretty well.

I read the other reviews which lead me to try this product.  Our 17 year old cat (Angel) was diagnosed with renal failure and the vet put her on food that she would not eat.  That forced us to mix the vet food with other cat food and Angel still lost weight.  Angel is a very small cat and has weighed approximately 6-7 pounds her entire life.  When her weight dropped to 5 pounds we thought she was on her way out.  We purchased this food and she LOVES it!  Angel has been on it for about 6 months now and she is back to her normal weight. She begs for it. What an awesome product!

column9: A life saver for my kitty!
column10: Finally! My cat had been eating k/d diet both wet and dry for years. Suddenly she lost interest in the canned and I was forced to add sardines to it. Sort of defeats the purpose of limiting the protein doesn't it? Well, I  was heartsick because already thin to begin with, she wasn't eating enough to gain weight. She would just sit and stare at her bowl. In desperation, I knew I had to find a better food, so I read the reviews here and ordered a case and voila! She eats it without sauce or sardines. She can't get enough of it. I had to order another case. So now she's eating one can a day which is good. Though I wish they would make this in a dry too, so she could nibble through the night. She won't even touch the dry anymore! And we all know what a wet diet can do to the teeth. I highly recommend a dental treat such as enzadent oral chews and a daily cleaning or adding a dental additive to the water. But I shouldn't complain, she's eating and that's what I wanted. Anyway, I don't know what they put in this food, but my cat sure likes it and thanks to it, she's going to be around for a long time still!

I have no complaints about the food at all; it seems to be a high quality, low phosphorus food for cats with chronic renal failure (CRF).  My CRF cat is really finicky though, but he eats it pretty good.  The food is very moist, which most cats seem to like.
