I do mix even more water into the food to make a gravy, just so he gets extra water.  The food was shipped in a timely manner, and overally, I have no complaints.

My cat has two issues, early CRF and IBD.  The IBD caused her to stop eating completely.  Prior to that, she was very picky and wouldn't eat any renal diet(and I tried them all).  I originally passed on Hi Tor because of the by products, but I was bent on getting her to eat a renal diet.  Fortunately, she loved Hi Tor.  She is always crying to be fed now, and eats 2 cans a day, and would eat more if I let her.  Cats are picky, so not every cat will like it, but if you have a CRF cat that isn't eating, it's worth a try.  If your cat won't eat it, donate it to a shelter or a rescue group.  I'm sure they have CRF cats that could use it.Update 2/20/10:  They have changed the formula for the food.  It's more dense, and the cans are 5.5oz rather than 6oz. It looks more like regular cat food and less like chopped bits o' parts. My cat doesn't like this as much, but that may be the fact that she can't lick it up like the previous version.  I have to try adding water to it to see if it helps.

Unfortunately my cat has been in cronic kidney failure for some time so he needs to have a low protien diet. We tried the one from the vet and he wouldn't touch it. I then tried this and he eats it really well. It's been hard to find at pet stores recently so finding it on line is a god send. My vet is very pleased with my cat's weight gain and one of the reasons is he likes this so well. I definately recommend this for anyone who's cat needs to be on a low protien diet. The price is much more economical than the KD diet from the vet and cats seem to find it much more palitable.

My 15 yr old cat was diagnosed with kidney disease a couple months ago and upon my vet's suggestion I began feeding kitty the Prescription Diet K/D wet and dry food.  My cat stopped eating the wet food all together after about a week (the dry food wasn't touched from the start) and started losing weight which was concerning.  I tried the Hi-Tor Neo Diet after reading the good reviews on Amazon.  I'm pleased to say my cat eats the Hi-Tor (my cat didn't care for the vita gravy stuff) so I didn't have to resort to force feeding (thank goodness!).  I'd definitely recommend the Hi-Tor as it's low protien and it's more palatable than the K/D.

i bought 80 bucks worth of this because of the other reviews of this product. my cat won't eat it. period. so just like in people, taste is subjective. buy a small amount and try it out first. hopefully your cat will love it. i'm sure it is a good product quality-wise, which is why i didn't rate it lower.

column9: Your kitty's life is worth trying this
column10: My cat is almost 8 years old. Being the runt, she has always been a small cat, weighing about 7 or 8 lbs on average. I notice she just wasnt her happy little self and to my horror was down to just 5 1/2 lbs. Like everyone else here, the prognosis was kidney failure. There was absolutely nothing I could do to get her to eat the prescription canned food. Mixing with the old to wean her to the new didnt work. Adding water, making it warm, trying every kind available from my vet, I was at my wits end. She was getting sicker by the day eating just the dry food. Then after much reading of blogs, kidney failure webpages, etc, everyone raved about the Hi-tor food. I was afraid to purchase 24 cans of something she wouldnt end up eating, and my vet did not carry it nor did the yever hear of it. I figured my cats life was worth $25.00 and gave it a try. WOW, is all I can say! She IMMEDIATELY ran to the bowl, gobbled it up and asked for more! I have now began to feed her the canned food as often as she asks for it. She looks better, has had less vomiting, and has gone back to playing with toys and pestering her sister kitty, so I KNOW she feels better. If this only helps prolong her life for a little while, I know it was well worth the money to special order it. I plan on taking a few cans to my vet so they can consider carrying it in the future. Thank you Hi-Tor! Now please make a dry kidney food!

My vet says my cat is in the beginning stage of CRF. I've been changing his diet from dry Science Diet K/D to wet.  Everything I've been reading says wet food is best as long as it is human grade.  Unfortunatly, he won't eat the HI-Tor. Now I'm stuck with a case of it.  It should be sold in smaller quantities for trial purposes.

column9: Good Supplement/Replacement for Rx Cat Food
column10: My 17 yo cat with chronic renal failure was on the prescription foods by Hill's and Royal Canin for a year. She did fine on these, however they are expensive over time. The Hi-Tor Neo food is not quite as low in protein, etc, as the Rx foods, but still lower than regular cat foods. (The need for this is disputed, by the way.) I mix it half & half for my cat, she eats it all and after several months remains in stable health!  I've saved some expense and I think maybe a bit more protein is actually good for her. So I plan on purchasing more of the Hi-Tor Neo canned food.

column9: My little old man LOVES this food
column10: My little 15 yo Siamese has one very small kidney and needs to be on a special low protein diet.  My vet recommended Hi-Tor Neo a couple years ago and he took right too it.  Granted, he's not all that picky but he gets very vocal when he's ready for his Neo (the Siamese yowl).  Obviously he loves it and he's very healthy and active.  Sometimes I add some water to it to make a "gravy" when he's a bit dehydrated and he thinks that's an extra special treat.  Highly recommend this product verses the prescribed brand that's more expensive and not so tasty to the felines.

Just had my cat diagnosed with CRF and was really struggling getting him to eat. I tried EVERYTHING - warming the food, mixing it with chicken broth, mixing it into other food he used to like eating. The smell of the prescription diet (I tried both Hills and k/D) just drove him away.Well this stuff works. He is gobbling it up. What a relief. Can't figure out why the local pet stores don't carry Hi-Tor, but for now, my extremely scary problem is solved.

column9: Great food for my geriatric cat...
column10: My 15 year old cat is happier eating this stuff rather than just dry Iam's food.  He has kidney disfunction, but he seems to be doing better now despite the failing condition for his age.  The only problem I have with ordering from this supplier on amazon.com is this:  I got clobbered with spyware. I'd rather go to: [...]. and order it direct. kk

My cat was 20 years old and in severe CRF when I first bought this.She has always been a picky eater, and now was almost a non-eater.This product,combined with extra water and a little low sodium water-packed tuna mixed in, has gotten her to eat well enough that I have ordered it a second time, and would certainly try it with any cat in the early stages of CRF or beyond.Changing her food, combined with vet care that includes perscription thyroid meds, combined with epakitkin supplementation,  has all helped tremendously.  The thyroid meds alone were not enough.  Feeding her Neo Tor and epakitkin seems to really help (as much as anything can help at her age).  She refused all other supplements.  She has gone from severely anorexic to gaining 1 pound (in 2 months) and having more energy.  She never lost interest in life, even when she wouldn't eat, but she has more ability to pursue life now.Not a cure for old age by any means. But worth a try.Shipping was quicker than promised.
Very good product.  Shipped quickly.  My cat is 19 and needs renal food.  She likes Neo a lot, especially the gravy.

Four out of four cats will eat it, as long as it's not for every meal. Kitty with kidney disease doesn't mind it, but won't eat it consistently. The fact that he'll eat it at all is amazing, because he wouldn't touch any of the vet diets. From can to can it's a little inconsistent in terms of moisture content - cats all definitely prefer the cans that are more moist, have a little extra juice. I'll buy it again.

My 18yr old cat has had CRF for over 2 years. She  has never really liked her prescription renal food but tolerated it. Recently she has been losing weight and not wanting to eat her food. I thought I'd try the Hi-Tor after reading good reviews on it. I'm so happy I did. My cat loves it!!  I'm so happy to see her eating again. The food is very moist and she just digs in. It smells tasty too compared to that dried out canned prescription food. She is one happy kitty.

Used this product that I heard about for cats with CRF(chronic renal failure-kidney disease)  My cat is a finnicky eater and was not eating the prescription foods(Royal Canin, Iams, Hills K/D) too well and losing weight.  She took a liking to this food and eats regularly now. I actually mix half of Royal canin with 1/2 of the high tor neo and she seems to be doing very well and has gained her weight back.  The product is supposed to be low in protein and phosphorous which is essential for cats with kidney disease.  I give the product a thumbs up and so does Smokey my cat.  I have already purchased 2 more cases the second time around as my cat has taken a liking to it and it helps save on shipping.

column9: The best food for cats with renal problems
column10: My cat has kidney problems. The prescription cat food offered by the vet was expensive and useless because she refused to eat it.  This cat food has the lower protein requirements she needs AND she loves it AND it's reasonably priced AND it's non prescription.After being on this cat food for a year, my cat's kidney function has improved.I highly recommend this cat food.

My cat wouldn't even touch this. He sniffed it, looked at me, and tried to bury it.  (Digging at the kitchen tile, unfortunately for him, did not work.)  I tried on three different occasions, thinking that maybe his belly was just upset that day from the CRF. He never would eat it.  Now, I've got a case (minus three cans) of it.  Guess I'll donate it to the local animal shelter.

column9: Hi-Thor Neo diet for senior CRF cat
column10: My 18 yr old cat (Mr.Kit T) was diagnosed with CRF and heart problems nearly 5 months ago and was near death.The advise of 3 vets was to put him down.  Vet#4 prescribed antibiotics, Prednisone,and Enapril. The only food advise was have T eat whatever he would eat the most of. He had dropped to under 5 lbs from his usual 9.  For 2+ months human baby food, home made chicken broth, water and Pediasure were all he'd take. T was only eating the baby food if it was hand fed to him, licking one little dab at a time off the tip of my finger.  He refused most other foods after a taste test including the expensive prescription brands.Despite mixed reviews of the Neo diet I decided to try it.T ate 1/3 of the first can all by himself with no prompting. In the past 2 1/2 months he will consistently eat this stuff and has gained a couple pounds. He likes it better when the can is freshly opened. If it has been refrigerated, bringing it up to room temp. & sprinkling 1/2 a crushed PetAg Taurine tablet and 1 Vetri-science Renal Essential tablet on top will get him going. (Note he will not touch it if it has been microwaved even for a second!).  On a good day he can finish 1 1/2 cans but mostly it's 1 can/day.  He now is back to batting paper balls around and the occasional catch-me-if-you-can chase around the house. He still has some problems with hard stools so I also add ~1 1/2 Tbsp cooked oatmeal, 2-3 Tbsp cooked, mashed sweet potato per Week and 1/4 tsp. Kefir live cheese/yogurt ~ every other day.Can't say for sure how much of the change is due to the Neo, drugs or other supplements but since Neo is 95% of his diet, I have to believe it is a major factor.  May not be the same for all cats but it has saved me a lot of time and expense in comparison to the first couple months of this final journey.

column9: Hi-Tor Neo Diet for Cats Review
column10: This product is an excellent value for all cats that have renal failure. My cat cannot get enough of it. I have saved alot of money by not buying through my vet. The nutritional guidelines for this product is very comparable to the product my vet offers needed for cats that have renal failure.

Like others, I found my cats initially interested, but they quickly (a couple of tries) decided that Hi-Tor Neo wasn't for them. For my two kitties with late-stage renal failure, I am working my way through some other commercial cat food options that don't advertise themselves as renal diets, but that have phosphorus and protein levels comparable to those of Neo-tor (which is a little higher than prescription renal diets). There is very valuable updated diet information available at [...] if you are looking for information on the protein and phosphorus content of cat foods (The site provides breakdowns for both canned and dry cat foods). I have found that they prefer the Organix flavors listed there, which have comparably low protein and even lower phosphorus. It is a little more expensive, but you can buy it by the can at local stores to try it-- I've never seen Hi-Tor Neo in a store.

column9: Special diet for a special friend
column10: My special needs cat is very finicky about food and has rejected many others. This food is very moist and is readily eaten at each feeding.
PRODUCT CAME IN A TIMELY MANNER. OUR CAT DID NOT CARE FOR IT, BUT HE IS NOT HAPPY WITH ANY OF THE CAT FOOD THAT IS DESIGNED FOR KIDNEY DESIEASE.
We have tried other CRF foods for our cats, but they always seem to hate it after the first week. The cats love Hi-Tor Neo, now they are very vocal about when they want their food.Love it.
My cat loves the food and is doing very well on it.  It was delivered almost immediately.  I am very pleased. It's tough finding food good for kidney cats will eat.

Like everyone I read reviews on, I was trying to satisfy my CRF cat. As soon as I got the package in the mail, I opened a can for her dinner and she did not want any part of it. I was so sad and discouraged. I was hoping this was the ticket! So I threw that can away after trying a couple more times. 2 weeks later I decided to give it another shot. She ate it! Now it's all she eats! Not sure what the hold up was but she eats it now! I have been on this streak for 2 weeks now and hope it stays! I gave 4 stars after coaxing, she now eats it and only "likes" it. There us no absolute love in it. I also did what others suggested which was the Vita Gravy. She simply licked all the gravy parts and not the food. Tricky cats. So I then mixed it all together and wouldn't touch. So good luck others!!! Just have to try a few times!!!

For a food recommended for kitties with kidney issues I was a little surprised to open the can of wet food and see a concentrated blob that looked drier than other typical cat foods.  But, I add water to the bowl of wet cat food to give her even more hydration anyway so the fact that she enjoys it and it's better for her is all that matters!

I have two cats, ages 14 & 15, and as a former breeder, I highly recommend this food.  It is very low in phosphorus, which should be limited in elderly cats who may be prone to renal failure.  I find it comparable to many of the prescription foods out there that are much more expensive.  And it is quite palatable - they love the taste!

column9: Good food at a better price
column10: My cat likes this food much more than the overpriced, ripoff garbage the vets sell.Even with shipping it's cheaper, and delivered right to my door. One less errand to run.

column9: Change in formula not well received
column10: Let me start by saying that the seller did an excellent job of packaging the case with not one dented can and it arrived quickly. My cat refused to eat the Purina NF and Hills K/D sold at my vet's office and was willing to starve himself if that was all he was offered. I read many reviews on other sites prior to purchasing and located a site where you can order individual cans. Great as a trial in case my cat refused to eat it. However, that site sent me 6 cans of the old formula and 6 cans of the new formula.  Being new to this brand, I turned to the internet to figure out what had changed. Apparently, the ingredient listings have not been updated for the new formula, even on the manufacter's site.  The new formula lists beef as the primary meat ingredient.My two cats including one that does not have kidney problems were initially enjoying the food, licking their plates clean with a distinct preference towards what turned out to be the old formula. I thought finally I had found a kidney diet that wouldn't end up in the trash. By the time I received the shipment, the attraction had worn off. One of my cats vigorously claws at the floor in an attempt to cover the food dish and the other (diagnosed with kidney disease) runs from the bowl after a few bites. They have gone back to eating regular food for now.  However, I am going to try and mix the more enticing food into the Hi-Tor before I completely give up on it and request a refund, and continue my search.  My local humane society does not retain "special needs" cats or dogs so donating it is out.  On the bright side, this seller has a 30 day return policy.

my 17 year old cat was put on Hills prescription diet k/d.  she ate it for a month and got sick of it.  now i alternate the two brands and one month later it seems to be going well. I'd recommend getting two brands to alternate since the options are so limited.

column9: Not sure if this food is the best option.
column10: I'm not convinced on this brand yet but we are trying it. A crf cat needs low protein and low phosphorous. The data on this from Tanya's guide for Crf cats shows this has pretty high phosphorous for a renal food.  .72% vs .38% on the K/D. Also has 36% protein vs. 28% with the K/D. Its more equal to senior formula foods than the prescription foods. It might not be the best choice. It does have high fat though vs other brands which is my hope for keeping some weight on my 18 year old crf cat.

My 12 yr old cat is starting to show signs of kidney involvment; he is also has a thyroid condition common to cats.  And of course, he ranks at the 99th percentile for FINICKY eaters.  Other prescription brands have been a 'no-no' with him.  Imagine my utter surprise when he gobbled up Hi-Tor Neo cat food like it was gourmet wild halibut caught fresh just for him!!  So glad I found a product that is palatible as well as beneficial.
My kitty with CRF won't eat many of the brands carried by our vet, but this one he'll actually eat ON OCCASION.  So it's really hit or miss. But I'll try anything to keep my boy eating!

column9: A food that my kidney failing cat will eat on her own!
column10: My cat has kidney failure, I couldn't get her to eat on her own so I was force feeding her with wet food mixed with some water to thin it out in a baby medicine syringe.  She HATED it, I cant say I blame her. This is the first food she has willingly eaten on her own in weeks. I have been experimenting with different foods to entice her and nothing has done the trick. All of the research I did made me change how all of my cats are fed now,  they all get Wellness canned food mixed with some dry. My Mama's was having none of it though. As soon as I opened the can of this food she seemed mildly interested - better than her running from because she knows what's coming! Thank you!

column9: The cats seem to like it
column10: I can't say I'm impressed with the look or the texture of the food, but it seems to satisfy my cats. Hills k/d is way too expensive and with some eyebrow raising ingredients (corn), however, my CRF cat needs a low protien/phosphorous diet. When it arrived it seemed to have bits of jelly stuck to the sides of the can which was rather...gross. As far as ingredients go, not the best, but definitely not the worst. Not grain free if you are concerned about giving grains to your cat. At the very least no corn.All in all, it's serving the purpose of feeding my cats until I can find a CRF friendly grain free alternative.

More palatable than any other CRF food on the market - plus does not require a prescription.  My cat enjoyed it better than any other low phos. catfood, but being a Fancy Feast junky, has not been a cureall all to feeding him. Recommend buying Epakitin to block phoshorus levels in regular food if your CRF pet won't eat in addition to Hi-Tor.

column9: Our cat doesn't like this food, and the ingredients are very iffy
column10: I'm not really sure what I was thinking when I bought this food, except that I was freaking out about my cat being diagnosed with chronic renal failure. The ingredients in this food are really not something I would normally even consider feeding to our cats, but like I said, I was freaking out! Usually cats like crappy canned food, so I figured, what the hell and opened a can. Not only did our chronic renal failure cat turn his nose up, but so did the other 3 cats. Oh, well! I'm sure it's better than any of Hill's Science Diet products, Purina anything, or Royal Canin's prescription diet, but not by very much.

column9: She likes it - MIKEY likes it!
column10: Remember the old cereal commercial about MIKEY?  Well, my CRF cat isn't named Mikey, but it's still as shocking that she likes it!  At first, neither of my cats, the CRF cat nor the healthy one - cared for this food.  However, now that she's feeling a bit better with a holistic vet, she and healthy brother LOVE this food.  Little miss picky is eating it with gusto.  I am one that believes that the low protein diet for cats is never a good thing (dogs yes, cats no).  So most times I mix this with something like another high protein cat food, or human canned tuna - to bump up the protein count.  The controversy with the protein levels for CRF animals is basically in a nutshell, dogs are NOT carnivores as are cats, thus low protein is good for them with CRF - but cats ARE carnivores and require protein (and fairly high amounts at that) to live healthy.  So, this is a great mixer food for her, and as long as she'll eat it, I'll give it to them both.  Thanks NEO for a nice juicy food that tickles her fancy!

That's what wifey said when I told her that I had ordered "gourmet" squirrel brand peanut butter from amazon. I put the two jars in the refer and today I made a couple of your basic PB and J sandwiches to give it a go. This stuff is top shelf amazing. How so? It sat in the refrigerator for two days and came out of the jar smooth as silk. You know what usually happens to p'butter when it chills. It turns into the consistency of concrete that hasnt quite set yet. Try to spread it out on bread or something and it tears the surface up and turns your snack into something that you eventually toss to the dog. The flavor was intense but not "earthy" tasting. Went down like a fine wine. Ok, thats overkill, but you get the idea. I never thought I would do a review on Peanut butter but this version was deserved. Damn good, a fair price and certainly up for a re-buy when I burn through the two jars I have. It wont take long either. I go through a lot of the stuff..

column4: Desert Gypsy "A Brooklyn Girl Out West"
column10: I should be embarrassed to admit this but I had to stop ordering this because I ate four bags in one day; this is NOT normal behavior for me. Now I know how crack addicts feel.I *would* like to recommend 479* because this is the BEST caramel corn EVER, but alas I cannot because of the inherent possibility of winding up a co-conspirator in anyone else's resulting addiction

So you know that weird aftertaste you get when you eat somewhat artificial snacks? Well guess what, this fleur de sel caramel corn doesn't leave you with that! It amazes me that they can produce this totally crisp, and fresh product without using corn syrup and other unnatural favors that overwhelm my snack corner. This is an awesome snack and the more you eat it, the more you can taste the welcoming salt flavor.  It's really different from the basic caramel corns I've had, but in a GOOOD way, I definitely recommend this to all!!!
My husband absolutely loves this popcorn! :) He asked me to order more! :) This popcorn is delicious; I will be ordering more! :)

This caramel popcorn was absolutely delicious!!!  The 6 bags I ordered didn't last long in my house.  The price is a little steep, otherwise I would've ordered my second case already!  I'm waiting for a "special occasion" to order again, but definitely will!!!

love these popcorn. i cannot stop eating them! I would consider these popcorn as an upgraded cracker jacks, but organic. my fiance also agrees on how delious these popcorns are and he says "these are addicting".

I order this product after seeing a segment on a National news program. With the new trend of coupling sea salt and various flavors I was excited to try this product. I gave a bag to my parents before I tried it, they really like caramel. They did not respond with the enthusiasm I expected. They said they would have never known there was salt if I hadn't told them. So then I tried a bag. I feel the same. Maybe I was expecting more. But the picture on the front of the kernel with Sea Salt and the kernels in the bag didn't match. The popcorn itself was crisp with a good caramel flavor but I would have liked a bit more salt granules added. Save your money, purchase regular Caramel Corn at the grocers.
This is a superb olive oil for salads. It is very pricey however. So it is to expensive to use for cooking.

column9: Finest Supreme Monkey Picked Oolong Tea ........ or just OK, to mediocre.
column10: After having tried this Oolong style tea in a friends Chinese restaurant (which was her personal stock) I set out to try to purchase something similar.  My friend is from Fuzhou, PRC and her family works in the tea industry there.  The product she gave me to drink was lighter or more delicate tasting in flavor or quality.  This product is not all that smooth and mediocre when compared to the type she had.  This product did maintain that characteristic good Monkey Picked Oolong Teas of never becoming more bold in taste as the tea steeps longer all the way through your drinking experience. Preparing the tea in your YiXing teapot chinese style will improve your experience and  is better than typically American style brewing. It seems priced close to some of the offerings on the net.  I will not fault the service of the company.  This product is slightly less refined than some picks.

"Blue Diamond Almonds, Whole Natural" are whole "raw" almonds in a 1.5 ounce pack.  They're great for staving off hunger and have no added salt or ingredient besides almonds.Although you could easily make these yourself in snack bags, the Blue Diamond packs offer convenience and better shelf life.The package is a tube like bag, so you can pour them into your mouth - you don't even need clean hands to eat these. Great with a fresh fruit smoothie for a convenient "meal" in a hurry.  Excellent for travel or carrying to work or class for a mess free snack.
I like these because there is no salt to get in the way of the natural goodness of the almonds.

I keep a couple of theese tubes in my lunchpail or gym bag that way I always have something healthy to eat. This is a great snack and because they are raw you are not eating anything bad. They have saved me from visiting the fast food restaurants on my way home from the gym or also from eating junk I shouldnt from the vending machines at work. Great product.

column9: Flavorful! Arrives in good shape. No peanuts here!  Repeat buyer.
column10: Nice to have a source for this great Chex Mix. It hits the spot!Chex Mix of old had peanuts. No longer, so enjoy this without fear of peanut allergies!

Chex Mix Traditional is a fabulous blend of crunches and tastes that make everyone happy. As good as it is, we are not one to stop at perfection, and have mixed portions differently. Try raisins, M&M's, walnuts, etc. It's not just a snack, it's an adventure!Yum!
Exactly what I wanted. It would be better if it was packaged in a pretty container. But the violets are perfect!

The violets arrived very quickly! (I only waited about four days for it to arrive on my doorstep.) I am an experienced candied voilet consumer and the quality and taste of this product didn't disappoint me. You get what you see in the picture which is always a plus. I'm going to use them in a Lavendar/Violet shortbread cookie recipe I have and I can't wait!

column9: Smaller than Expected but Still Good
column10: I bought these for my candy buffet at my wedding. The packaging is pretty poor, they are basically free in a box with no shrink wrap around the box itself, so sugar was all over the packaging and I worry about the candy going stale. The slices themselves are also smaller than what you'd typically find, which isn't necessarily bad, but just a word to the wise. The product does have good flavor and a very nice texture, a bit firmer than most fruit slices I've tried.

First Colony Whole Bean French Roast coffee is a deep, dark, smooth tasting coffee with absolutely no bitter after-taste.  I use three heaping tablespoons (having ground the beans just prior to putting them in my Krups coffeemaker) to 16 ounces of cold water and enjoy the most wonderful coffee I've found in a long time.  I'm going to order it again very, very soon and would highly recommend it to all those looking for a perfect cup of coffee.

column9: Be careful - this product is misrepresented
column10: Be careful with this one.  I thought I was buying what's pictured: a box of 6 packs of 12.  The low price should have been a giveaway, but I just figured it was old stock that they wanted to get rid of and I was only buying it to use in an activity in our Vacation Bible School.  When I received my one little box of 12 today, I went back to their amazon listing to see what happened, and sure enough, there is a warning that what's pictured is not a representation of what you're buying, and nowhere do they state exactly how many Fizzie tabs you're buying.  I wonder how many other people have been burned the same way.  If it's been a problem in the past, what they should do is post an accurate photo and accurate description.  Buyer beware.I will NOT be buying anything from this merchant again.

A man I used to work for brought this coffee back from his trip to Germany.  By the second cup I was ruined for any other kind.  Incredible coffee!  I have started giving it out as gifts and it is a great hit.

column9: From the Washington DC Metro area
column10: Without a doubt the BEST coffee...Absolutely no bitterness!  Order with confidence and enjoy.  So spoiled by the taste that I cannot drink any other coffee.

column9: Super Smoker's Tennessee Flovored Bar B Q Sauce
column10: This is the GREATEST Bar-B-Q sauce!!  I found this in St Louis when we were visiting our daughter 3-4 years ago, and have become "hooked" on the stuff!  It's better than any other sauce we've tried anywhere!!  I stock up with 5-6 bottles every few months...It's cheaper through Straub's (via Amazon), and shipping is super-fast! (I usually receive my orders in 2 days)

I am so disappointed with Felidae canned cat food (chicken and rice in chicken broth - MORE LIKE CHICKEN PASTE).I would normally feed a can a day to my foster cats and permanent cats and they would devour it.  Not any more, not since they turned this to a chicken-paste texture.And another thing....WHAT IS WITH THE FUNKY-SIZED CANS?  Did they even think how hard it is to find a cap that fits this.Guess I'll go back to Wellness - at least it's not paste.Did I tell you how disappointed I am?

column4: spazzysteph "... nothing to see here, keep mo...
column10: I wanted to make sure my kittens had the best, healthiest food and read many reviews on Felidae and how good it was for kitties.  My cats won't even touch it, and unfortunately I bought two cases of it.  Oh well.
My cats were not 100% on board with this canned food.  They really like the dry Felidae, but they didn't sing the canned food's praises.

column9: Nutritious wet cat food, kittens love it
column10: My kittens were just introduced to the chicken and rice formula after not being interested in the chicken/lamb/ocean fish blend and they seem to like it a lot so far! I love that it is so wholesome and contains real food instead of meat by-products like most other brands.

I was satisfied with this product. Being a food item, for using in recipes, not much to say either way on it. I need it for gluten free baking and the packaging and delivery were as expected. Sweet Rice flour adds a but of dough enhancement to hold it together a bit better than just white rice flour. I am always pleased with the quality of Bob's Red Mill products.

I am a big fan of Zatarans Creole mustard, thought I might take a chance,loved the name!Really good product flavorful,little heat great addition to remulade. I used it with fennel in a remoulade sort of way with crispy sweet potato cakes as well as blue cheese and walnut chicken farinetes. There is a sort of bitter quality that is nicely tempered by mayo, creme fraiche or aioli.

These cashews are tasty (for unsalted), fresh tasting, and come in a great container with a handle that can be used for many other purposes when the nuts are gone. I like to use a handful of cashews when pureeing soup to thicken it - healthy and delicious.

column9: a bit too oily, not packed well but edible
column10: The cashews arrived in a huge somewhat flimsy plastic bag.  Bt the time they arrived the natural oils had been released so they were a bit too oily.  I rolled them in paper towels to blot the oil then roasted them in the oven at 325 for 20 minutes.  That did the trick to drying them and getting the crunch back.  Despite all that they are tasty.  Not the greatest cashews I've had but okay.

The best tasting cup noodle soup I ever had and it's so easy.  just add hot water and about 1 minute (I'm impatient and it's still so hot) it's ready to eat.  I usually get an unpleasant aftertaste with cup noodles, too salty or msg, not this one.  just tasting good and I think it's low fat, low cal too.  very good.  I am recommending to all my friends and family to try.

This the best of all the Dr. McDougall's soups by far. The second place is the Miso.I have tried the Minestrone, the black bean, and the Ramen. None of which do i recommend.If you like onions only a little, this is a great soup to have on hand!!

I've only had onion soups that were beef broth based in the past and was curious to see how this vegan onion noodle soup would be.  It's very light - not overly oniony, but having a lively 'black pepper' type spice flavor to it.  The noodles are rice noodles and plentiful in this cup of soup.Good things about this cup of soup:-The portion is a good size; I would estimate 14-16 ounces prepared?-The flavor packet comes separate, so that the powder does not congeal or settle to the bottom of the cup in a concrete-like mass.  I remember this being a problem back in the 90's with healthy soup cup varieties.-The sodium count is 14% which is fairly low.-The whole cup of soup has 180 calories.Great portability, easy prep.  Nice to have on hand in the office for a quick snack or part of lunch.

I decided to roll the dice and bought Spring Onion and Split Pea Soup since I like drinking soup and I wasn't disappointed, but a little scared because this is my first time ordering food type items from Amazon. My sister thought I was crazy because this is something I normally don't do.This is by far my favorite tried the Pea Soup and it was a little bland for my taste compared to this ambrosia. I will try again tomorrow with some seasoning but this soup was perfect. It was very light and tasted good normally I expected very little when it comes to cup of noodle soups but this was the best microwavable soup I ever tasted who knows I might take a risk and buy the other flavors from Dr. McDougall.
i've tried every flavor of these mcdougall soups now and i really like them all. they're the perfect eat-at-your-desk quick lunch!

column9: A very nice, low-cal, instant noodle soup without the junk additives, thanks Dr. McD
column10: I've tried various Dr. McDougall's products (as I'm lazy in the kitchen and anything quick to fix, but healthful, is a boon). This is one of the nicer soups. I didn't give it 5 stars, which I'll explain below, but I still recommend this to folks who like instant noodle soups, but want something vegan, vegetarian, non-gluten, or without a lot of added junk.For a mere 180 calories, this is a very generous serving of soup with pleasantly-textured rice noodles. The flavor packet (with dried veggie mix including shallots, garlic, green onions, white onions) mixes in without lumps. It is microwaveable, but I like adding boiling water and letting it sit a few minutes. The broth is very "oniony", and if you don't like a strong onion/garlic flavor, this is not for you.The one star removed is for me finding it too salty. This almost has 700 mg per cup, which may not sound like too much for convenience soup, but I found it was very salty to my taste--and I love salt. I also found that there is a very faint, slightly unappealing undertaste (again, YMMW, it might just be my taste buds), that kept it from being a five-star soup for me. That said, I enjoy this soup, and I would order it again, simply because it's hard for me to find a noodle instant soup that satisfies me in the taste and texture dept. This one has lovely texture and a pretty decent flavor, and it doesn't have the artificial colors and flavors or trans fats that I don't want or need.Another good Dr. MCD product! And with the subscription option, comes out to a tad over a buck fifty for soup for lunch. I like that, too.
doesn't really taste like anything although the noodles have a decent texture. i probably won't order this item again. i tried this company's black bean and lime soup and it was a little better.
I have a sensitive digestive system and have to be careful what I eat.  This soup tastes good and doesn't cause any digestive issues.

This soup is a quick tastey lunch. The onion flavor is mild. I have gotten many different varities of McDougall's soup. Id say next to the miso soup this is my second favorite. I will be getting these again. It is an easy vegan-friendly lunch.

column9: Not as good as I was expecting
column10: This soup was pretty bland. Not gross, just not enough onion flavor for my taste. Also had to add more time than the instructions said because the noodles didnt cook. I may add an egg and some hotsauce next time, and see if that helps.
I love this one, too.. hard to find any ramens that don't have meat in them.. making these reviews is making me hungry and wanting to order some of these.. lol :o)  Onions are good for you.
I now have tried about six of the McDougall soups and I think this is my favorite that I find myself going back for the most.

I have tried 6 different kinds of Dr. McDougall's soups and this is close to being my favorite.If you like fresh tasty foods this is a good choice.I often notice people will said food is bland and this is because they eat over-processed, addictive and over seasoned food.Part of eating better means ,never eating alot of foods found in the American diet ever,if you like onions and you eat well you should like this.

I love Dr. McDougall's soups (most of them anyway).  These are one of my favorites and they came in a 6-pack, which is wonderful.  I take them to work for lunch at both places I work.  you just put the hot water in and let it sit to a little while, and it's delicious!  Most of his soups, if not all, are vegetian and some are even vegan.
This soup is quick and easy to make. perfect for lunch or a quick supper.  It has very good taste and texture and is not to oniony tasting.

I love this soup it's definitely my favorite flavor. It's great in the winter or when you're battling a sore throat. I always look forward to eating it and it's great to take when visiting non-vegan friendly family members.

Dr. McDougall Right Foods food cups are, for the most part, excellent.  The ingredients are of a good quality, and most have a good taste to them.The two downsides of the product are that they're relatively high in sodium, and of course the cost.The food cups are perfect for those who want a quick snack, and they also work well when poured over such as pasta, rice, or a baked potato.

First off, buying these Noodle Soups, it's rare that any of them taste GREAT.  Nothing tastes like homemade.  But, comparing Dr. McDougalls Soups to stuff like Ramen noodles, etc....well, there's no comparison.  Ramen may be cheap...but the sodium content and crap content alone will kill you.We've tried several kinds of these Dr. McDougalls, and our favorite happens to be the Spring Onion.  Very tasty (to us).  Also very eatable, unlike some other brands I won't mention.  I also see there are some lower sodium ones we're gonna try next.

We buy several flavors of McDougall's soups for winter outdoor activities. These are absolutely the greatest. They taste great, easy to carry in a backpack, no meat or dairy (vegan) and are ready in about 5 min after adding hot water.Perfect for skiing!!!

column9: has no taste, very dissapointed in this purchase :(
column10: i enjoyed the mcdouggals packaged oatmeal so I thought of trying this noodle soup. sadly, this probably the worst purchase I have made on amazon, the soup has no taste, noodles taste like paper, and the seasoning just isn't good, i wish i could return my remaining 5 cups but I don't think amazon will take back food items. waste of [...] :(
Tasted bland - did not have the freshness and aroma of sping onions - Would not buy again

column9: If you are into soups that tasty like fecal matter, eat away.
column10: I bought this soup based on the reviews, I was looking into getting something besides Cup Of Noodles. I should have listened to the my inner fat man and stuck to the bad for you soup. Not only did this have a horrible taste, but it also didn't offer enough to eat as a meal alternative. The soup is easy to make, but the bland noodles, tasteless soup will leave you wanting to throw up and kicking Dr.McDougall's in the nuts.
The price was very good and I can only get plain at my local stores.  Love the Cheddar and Onion flavors!

As a Weight Watcher Leader I recommend this product to my members!  2 of them are still "0" points plus!  They are light and crispy,,,,tasty and with so  many flavors they are great with a meal or just as an evening snack.  So glad to have discovered them!!

I purchase a lot of baby food in bulk through Amazon.  This is the first food that I've found that not only would my little one not eat, he literally gagged on it.  I tried it myself and found that it tastes terrible.  There's something in it I can't quite put my finger on, but it is wretched.  In an attempt to see if it was just us, I gave the remaining case to a friend of mine whose daughter is 3 weeks younger than my son.  He also said she gagged on it and wouldn't eat it.  It 20 pouches ended up in the trash.  I wouldn't recommend this unless you've purchased just one and know that your little one will eat it.
The flavors are very American Thanksgiving, and this is easier than fixing a plate and then pureeing it, but there is a strong herb smell that my daughter has a hard time with.

If there is no wholesome food available, this could do.  However, this is high in salt, low in fiber, high in carbohydrates (tastes like sweet candy), and uses highly processed ground turkey.  Even gourmet pet food offers real chunks of meat.  This is supposed to be for advanced babies, but it's mushy with bits of ground turkey and corn kernel peels.  It would be good to see more WHOLE bits of food, less salt, less sweetness, more fiber, and cuts of real meat (not highly processed ground mystery turkey) with more meat.  It is healthier for me to use frozen vegetables with meat than this Sprout concoction.  They get two stars for trying to be organic.

This was the first Sprout Organic Baby Food I'd given my son.  From the first bit he loved it and ate the whole pouch in just minutes.  He's normally takes his sweet baby time to eat so I was thrilled to find something he'd literally gobble up.  The packaging is a bit difficult to deal with, I'm not a big fan of the pouches, I always feel like I'm leaving money in the bottom of the pouch and not too thrilled about the high sodium content.  But he loves it, he'll eat it, it's relatively healthy, and since I don't have time to make him gourmet, organic, hand mashed foods on a regular basis, this works great for us.

This Turkey Dinner is one of only two Sprout Stage-3 meals that my baby will eat.  (She's now 13 months old, and has been eating these meals since she was about 10 months old).  Unlike many of the other Sprout Stage-3 foods, this one isn't overly thick and chewy.  There are visible bits of vegetables and turkey meat, but they are very manageable, so they don't make my little-one gag or quit eating because the food is too difficult to chew with the few teeth that she has.  It smells pretty good, too ... Like real "cooked" food, rather than ground-up "baby food."  Most importantly, my baby loves it and routinely opens her mouth very wide for additional spoonfuls.  This has become one of our "go-to" meals when there's no time for a home-cooked meal or finger-foods.

I'm sitting here with the Sprout Holiday Vegetable Dinner package of baby food in hand and I don't know where the reviewer came up with the salt content.  Calories: 140; Total Fat: 4 grams; Sodium: 20mg; Carbs: 24 grams; sugars: 4 grams (Since there is 20 grams difference between the carbs and the sugars, this generally indicates there are no additional sugars added and what IS there is from the natural sugar in the veggies) Fiber: 2 grams; Protein 4 grams;  In fact, I have looked at several of the Sprout baby food packages and their sodium is quite low.  I was in the middle of the ordering process to get this from Amazon when the review caught my attention in regard to the sodium content and I had to comment!

column9: Love Sprout, BUT NOT this one
column10: My three boys love Sprout foods, but I have tried this one for the last two months, turkey w/herb roasted vegetables, and they won't eat it.  Someone else also mentioned that the herb smell is strong.

column9: Tasty, healthy food you can feel good about serving baby
column10: My son loves the Sprout pouches of food, and I think this one may be his favorite.  I taste all of his baby food, and I must say that this one is very tasty.  (I don't want to feed him anything that I would find disgusting, as is the case with a good deal of baby food out there.)  It is made with wholesome ingredients, and it is great for travel or on-the-go meals because you don't need to refrigerate before opening.  My son gets very excited when he sees that I'm opening up a Sprout pouch!  I've been very happy with all Sprout products I've tried, and this one is no exception.

My toddler son loves these meals and I feel good feeding them to him.  They are made simply and even look like a meal ground up (not like the old meat baby food meals that looked unnatural).  They are large meals (5.5 oz) and organic so, to me, I felt they were a great deal on Amazon and well worth the cost.
I just cancelled my subscription after learning that 1 pack (5.5oz) contain 135mg of sodium. Way too high for 13 months old child! Its like feeding her cheetos for dinner

If you've never tried Kona coffee, Aloha Island is definitely the one to start with.  Kona coffee is grown in the Kona district of the Big Island and regarded by some to be the best coffee in the world.  I'm not a coffee aficionado by any means, but you can taste the difference with Kona coffee - it's full and rich and almost mocha-ish.  I always reserve Kona for lazy weekend brunches or to serve with dessert after a lovely dinner.  Aloha Island operates the only quality management program in Kona, so their coffees are certified as 100% Kona.  Which just means that you're guaranteed to get quality Kona coffee if you order from them. Keep in mind that Aloha Island has three grades of Kona coffee that they sell - gold, platinum, and diamond (which is supposed to be their private reserve).  Obviously, it gets more expensive as you go up the ladder.  The gold is very good and a great place to start sampling their fare.
Hands down this is absolutely the best kona coffee I have ever had in my life..This is the smoothest and richest coffee you will ever have...Go ahead and spoil yourself, you'll be glad you did!!

column9: Smooth and Sublime--This is Kona for the Hawaiian Demigods
column10: The aroma from a pot of this coffee is earthy and heavenly at the same time. Everything about this product--packaging, texture, and taste--tells you that it was lovlngly produced under rigid standards. Moreover,if you've tried a lot of "kona" coffees like I have, you know how widely the taste and quality can vary. This is the coffee you serve to the treasured few in your life who really appreciate the finest.

I can see why plenty of people will think this is the best coffee ever. It's some of the smoothest, least bitter coffee I've ever tasted. The aroma is also delicious. Opening the bag and taking a whiff right away is a must if you want to try this.But I'm the type of coffee drinker who loves it black, so I need a coffee with a rich flavour on its own. I don't wanter bitterness, but I love coffee with kick to it.I'd call it too mild but that's kind of oversimplifying it. It's worth a try to make up your own mind though.

Aloha Island Coffee Company Bonzai Pipeline Dark Roast is a very mediocre, insipid coffee, rather acidic for a dark roast. The beans are of unknown origin, but if there are any Kona beans in this anonymous mix, they must be the ones other roasters threw out as it doesn't even vaguely taste like Kona. Actually, Aloha Island Coffee Co. isn't even in Hawaii, it's located in Santa Ana, CA, an area not exactly known for great coffee. The coffee is extremely overpriced for the poor quality you get, which is why I gave it one star, and you would be better off buying some of the better brands commonly sold in supermarkets at about one-third the price. I ordered the 2-8 oz bags, but I couldn't even make it through the first one and have thrown the second in the garbage. I would never buy anything from Aloha Island Coffee company again.

I'm more of a tea drinker but occasionally want something different and I like this to keep me up or wake me up too. So, keep in mind I haven't tasted lots of coffees. I find most coffees bitter and gross, like starbucks or whatever my mom buys. With some splenda I actually enjoy this, so even if you don't like coffee give this a try. It's definitely one of the better one.

This coffee is the absolute best.  I found it by accident a couple of months ago and now I can not have any other kind of coffee.  It may be more expensive than some, but well worth it.  Plus, you aren't going to want to go out to Starbucks anymore!  Manufacturer ships quickly too!

column9: these pods fit the senseo holder and it's great Coffee!!!
column10: I'm not a fan of Senseo brand coffee pods so I've been using espresso pods from Green Mountain (not great but way better then senseo) for some reason they quit making them so I was searching for pods that fit the Senseo after reading the review I took a shot in the dark and ordered a box of them from Amazon and fell in Love I use them with the espresso pod holder I got from amazon (not the single pod holder that comes stock)and have been enjoying the best espresso I've had in years.  I liked them so well I just ordered 2 more boxes

You wake up early on a sunday morning and you turn on your other side because you want to sleep a little more. But then you smell something like scrambled eggs, fried oignon rings and above all the strong scent of espresso...This is strong coffee like the Italian espresso. Take care you don't boil the water, otherwise it will loses its flavor. The water should be between warm and hot. I use it black with a small lump of brown sugar. A real amateur will tell you that the use of any sugar is sacrilege. But what can I do? The flesh is weak.

column4: I'm A Retired Biker now "Da-retired Biker"
column10: Pretty good coffee I really liked itIt is a bit on the strong side or it may be the way I brewed it but it is a good tasting coffee in my opinion.

Product looked and smelled great - however, it was not clear from the description that this product is for non-ESE pod machines. I like the idea of organic and US source, this just didn't work for me.
Coffee from Hawaii is the best in the world, specificly the Kona side of the island and this is no exception.
This was purchased for my daughter and her husband.  I was very pleased with the selection of items in the basket.

It's rich and dark without being bitter with the burnt bean taste.  I love this coffee.  It's a tad expensive, but well worth the cost.  I keep it as my private stash and only serve it on the holidays to company.

column9: Great taste, lower sodium than soy sauce, cheapest @Amazon
column10: A friend of mine introduced me to the Liquid Aminos when I had to strictly lower my sodium  intake. It was hard to find in several grocery stores. Once you use this, you'll never use soy sauce again, not even low sodium soy sauce. It also gives steamed vegetables a lot of flavor without the use of salt.A 4 pack bought at Amazon is cheaper than buying it in the store. And you'll be surprised how much you use once you've tried it on some of your favorite foods that have always needed salt. I have had friends and family try it, and their families love it now.Give it a try. Maybe start with one small bottle, and then get your 4-pack here for a much better deal.

I love these tomatoes, they taste great and they cook well. But what is with the price??  I buy these by the case at a warehouse store S--- C---- and the case is only $6! (Unless you are in a situation where you have to have groceries delivered) I can't see spending more than triple the price for the convenience of home delivery.  It is a shame, I would love to have groceries delivered to my home, and I can see paying a bit more for the convenience, but this price is excessive-- no thanks!

column9: Rating the tomatoes. Not the price!
column10: I buy these by the case when meijers has them in their 10 for $10 sale. Usually a couple of cases. I love the tomatoes. After the summer is over & freshh tomatoes are.gone I use these in Everything I make that requires tomatoes. I hate those tasteless so called tomato things the stores sell after the summer ends. Won't buy them! I use these canned petites on tacos, hot dogs, burgers, sandwiches ( have to let them drain in a mesh strainer for about an hour to get the liquid out. Which I save. ), I even have them on salad, pizza, etc. They are great! Look in you're local stores for.a better price. The price here not good. The product is Fantastic!!

This chicken base is very smooth and melts right into whatever dish you add it to. The flavor and texture is comparable to McCormick's chicken base except this has a bit more of an onion flavor to it. This is VERY concentrated and salty so be sure to not salt your food when using this and then adjust your salt accordingly.

I purchased this dinner kit because it's not only vegan but it's gluten free... and that's the only reason why I give it three stars. Finding vegan convenience foods that are relatively healthy & gluten free is quite the challenge.If you like really spicy food you'll enjoy the heat from the seasonings... but it really lacks flavor. I added some salt, but it's really missing something else. I probably would not purchase this again. If you're accustomed to authentic Indian food you'll be really disappointed.

Much, much, better than I expected from "dinner in a box"!  You do need to buy your own chickpeas (2 cans, or equivalent cooked), but I would just as soon eat this as any I've had in a restaurant.  Highly-seasoned and very satisfying.

I picked up a few boxes at the local grocery store.  I love Indian food, and the Gourmantra products are amazingly delicious.  I love that I can buy these on Amazon.  I still haven't tried the Korma flavor, but I plan to do so soon.

I bought a BIG jar of this coffee from the local Tesco store the last time I was visiting home in the UK. It cost about 5 GBP. When I ran out I wanted to replace it and found this listing on Amazon. Notice there is NO information  about the size of the jar. The only clues are the whopping great price tag ($15.49), the insane amount for delivery ($6.45) and the shipping weight (1.2 lbs). I reasonably expected this to be the big size based on that information. WRONG!I received my order very quickly, it was well packaged and the coffee IS pretty good. BUT...the jar is only the 100g size which is TINY! I expect a markup on European goods  because they've come a long way to get to the US, but this is ridiculous. I can only assume that the lack of size information is a deliberate and blatant attempt to sucker people in. So well done, Enjoy Better Coffee, you got me. However, I won't be a repeat customer and I'll happily post this review to dissuade others from patronizing your rip off company.UPDATED 12/08/09I see they've added the size of the jar (100g), so at least you know what you're getting. But it's still a rip off.
We had this coffee in France and loved it.  So we were happy to find it available in the US.  It's more expensive than American instant coffee, but far better.

Just came back from my vacation in Poland (what a great country; our hotels & shopping places cannot come close to their new ones!)Because their economy is truly fantastic - I paid for exactly the same coffee (even better) Carte Noire Expresso Gold Instant something about 20~22 zloty's.After transferring to US dollar - about $6.00. Voila!Is this price on this page for real? Wouldn't be cheaper to buy a whole box in Poland and mail to my address in Wisconsin?By the way, this coffee is absolutely marvelous!!! For the taste 5 stars.

There is just no other instant coffee which can even begin to compare to Carte Noire, and when I moved from the UK to the US a few years ago, I was disappointed to discover that it isn't in the shops here (at least, not that I have ever been able to discover) so I was very pleased to see it on Amazon.But the price... wow <fans self> this isn't for every day drinking anymore. My husband bought me a jar as a treat at Christmas though, and it was absolutely lovely to have it again.I think next time I go back to the UK for a visit I will probably half fill my suitcase with coffee for the return trip! I have seen that Carte Noire now sells 150g of their instant coffee in lightweight bags, as well as the heavy glass 100g and 200g jars (the larger jars weigh 460g when they are empty) so it won't be such a big extra weight in the suitcase anymore.

I drink this coffee like crack when in Europe and always manage to bring a couple jars back with me. For instant coffee, the taste is superb - you don't want to drink anything else, but I can't justify paying this much for one small jar of instant coffee.Completely agree with SoldierMan's review - the taste deserves 5 stars, and if you happen to find them while outside of the States, it probably would be cheaper to just buy a bunch and ship them back to yourself!For the time being, I'll hold myself over with 2 pack of the ground version from Amazon and see how that compares ($20 for a total of 17.6 oz - about 500 grams), because my husband and I are seriously in withdrawal for that coffee. Time to break out the coffee press! Yes, it's that good.Kraft owns this brand, you'd think they would release it in the States, too. :(
My cats were not real interested but they are older and prefer interactive toys. Kittens might be more interested in this.
These are about the tastiest pickles on the planet. Especially the spicy ones. They're the perfect size and perfect crispiness - without all the preservatives nor colorings. YUM

column4: notAyesperson "Always in search of good books"
column9: Adds a BOOST to ordinary foods...
column10: There is a food truck not far from me with some pretty good chicken, fried biscuits and fries.  The chicken is smoked then fried.  I immediately noticed a cayenne-like seasoning which was awesome, and not at all too spicy.  When I went back, I asked the man for extra seasoning.He gave me the whole bottle to use as much as I like and turns out it was Tone's Cayenne. Now, I must order this!  Trust me, sprinkle this stuff on some fries along with honey (the way these guys do at the food truck)  you'll never look at fries the same way.  I was literally licking my styrofoam container.  It also works wonders on smoked/fried chicken.  Love it!
The bag is large so make sure you have plans to use it after opening. The apples began to go bad after a short period if time. I'd say use them within a month if opening them. They were tasty though!
I love Bigelow tea. It is hard to find decaf tea for k-cups. This is a very tasty tea.

Quite simply, the best k-cup tea in my opinion. If you like rooibos tea and like pears, this one is hard to go wrong with. It has a very slight hint of pear flavor, so you aren't overwhelmed. I love drinking it with a little honey and cream/milk. If you have never had rooibos (an african red tea), it has a very mild flavor with almost no bitter aftertaste that a lot of other tea has. It has no caffeine and is very smooth.

column9: A Different Flavor, But Different In a Good Way
column10: Have just ordered a few more cases.  :)For those who have never tried it before, your first experience with it would be that of a very sweet flavor at first taste with a barely-there hint of pear flavor.  The more you drink of it the less sweet it seems.  Some in the family like it with the usual cream & sugar but I prefer it with nothing else added.  We typically use the 8oz setting but on occasion will do the 6oz setting (but there is no point in using the smaller cup size setting to get the extra taste if you're going to end up putting cream & sugar in it anyway, mind you).It is a flavor that gets some getting used to but it works wonderfully as an after-dinner tea or mid-afternoon drink.  If you are looking for a 'different' flavor, give this a try.
This is the best tea in K-Cup form that I've tried to date. Smells good, smooth tasting, just right. Recommended.
I like rooibos tea a lot and this tea is no exception. It's fragrant and smooth. I don't taste or smell pear, though...

I mean earthy, like dirt.  This tea is very woody, and earthy.  There is no Pear aroma, flavor, I don't know why it is even on the label. I don't hate it, but will find trouble trying to finish the 48 cups I bought.  I think anyone who buys this must have tasted Rooibos tea before. I love the organic part of this drink.  I did not find this tea weak, the flavor is just bland, except for the slight woody aroma, and an earthy taste.  It is unique alright, but not like a tea to me. Maybe it takes getting used to.
flavor is weak.i used the 5 ounce setting to maximize the flavor but the flavor was barely detectable...also, i tried brewing it at 192F; didn't make a difference.

This is a delightful tea and I usually drink it for desert. I find it has a wonderful aroma of pear and a sweet taste of Rooibos tea with just enough pear so as not to be too overpowering. I recommend it highly. Love the fragrance as it brews, just delightful!
I cannot find the French Vanilla Jell-o instant pudding in my grocery, but found it online and at a good price. Delighted as I use it a lot.

column9: Consistant French Vanilla pudding every time
column10: Jell-o brand pudding is a quick and easy to make product.  Follow the directions on the box and you will have a consistent pudding every time.  I find vanilla in general to be a bit plain on its own.  However vanilla puddings can easily be used in a multitude of desserts.  Use the pudding between layers of a layer cake, add the pudding to cake batter for a moister cake, or use in trifles.  Homemade pudding is always the best, but when time or skill is lacking, this product is an excellent alternative.PROS:Easy and quick to prepareConsistent pudding every timeVersatile product for use in many dessertsCONS:It's a mix (But who regularly makes homemade pudding these days?)
Who doesn't like French Vanilla?!?!?! I use this for a snack or to make banana pudding or evening to give away when it gets close to the expiration date.

Never saw this flavor in stores, but saw it on Amazon and it sounded good. It is a unique flavor, not neccessarily refreshing, but still good. Not a "Freshen-your-breath-minty-clean" type of gum, but it is an exotic sweet flavor. I like it.

column9: Hard To Find In Midwest USA
column10: Every other flavor of Orbit is available in stores where I live except this flavor so I order it online.  Lime Melon is the only flavor I'll chew because it doesn't make my sensitive teeth more sensitive.For me all the mint flavors have the uncomfortable side effect of making my sensitive dental work not feel good.  The Lime Melon flavor is unique and delicious.
Lime-Melon is my favorite Orbit gum flavor, and NOBODY sells it in New Orleans...except a few places in single packs.  I was so happy to find it on Amazon.
We LOVE this flavor!  We haven't been able to find this flavor in the stores, so it was nice to find it online.

column9: Reminds me of my favorite ice cream from childhood
column10: Perhaps I'm a little biased since this gum tastes exactly like my favorite melon flavored ice cream but this really is the most delicious gum I've ever chewed in my life. If you're looking for a long lasting gum, this is NOT the gum for you. The gum does not last long and after about an hour of chewing, it begins to get too soft. If you're looking for a fresh breath minty gum, this is also NOT the gum for you. The gum great as a sugarfree alternative for those with a sweet tooth. 5 stars for flavor only.
Nice melon flavor and it lasts but I really didn't taste any lime in there at all.  Still, I would buy it again.

After years of using Amazon, this is my very first review! (Sorry for being such a slacker).A friend gave us some Palm Island Salts (black, red and green) as a housewarming gift and we really love them all. Our favorite is the black, which is just amazing, but this red is a close 2nd. It's amazing what a difference it makes in the food we cook, compared to other sea salts we use, and all our guests take notice when I use it! We still use Redmond Sea Salt for day-to-day cooking, and it's very good too, but whenever we want to add something special, we add the black or the red. A single 6-ounce pouch lasted us about 6 months, so a little goes a long way.
Palm Island Premium's red volcanic sea salt is really great to look at; great taste and texture.  I've got it in my barbeque arsenal, all ready for summer!  Try it on roasts, too.

After reading about the Water Cure and Dr Fereydoon Batmanghelidj's work I've tried many real sea salts from various parts of the world. This is by far my favorite, just plain wonderful, both by itself, in water, and used on food. I can just sense the nutrition in this when I put it in my mouth. Given what comparable salt costs in health/whole food stores this is a bargain too. Thanks Amazon & Hawaii Kai!
I gave it 5 stars because it tasted fine, but it is the instant couscous. I still do not know where to find the long cooking couscous.

This is a good quality couscous and it's imported from Morocco.It was delicious to eat with vegetables and chicken. Making couscousthe traditional way takes about 3 hours but it's worth it and a largeenough quantity can be made to serve many people or last for 3 meals.This Dari couscous is worth trying out!

Couscous is finally a very popular alternative to rice, pasta and potatoes in the USA, but most of the couscous is not produced in Morocco.  My first taste of couscous was years ago in Paris and the Dari brand is the most similar to what I tasted first in 1975.  You do not need a couscous pot for this product, but you certainly can prepare the traditional meal by separating individual semolina grains into light, fluffy particles by rubbing it between the hands if you so desire.  With neither the inclination nor time, you can prepare it as simply as you'd like by using a microwave, boiling water and a few fluffs with a fork.  Dari produces semolina, barley and corn couscous at this time and I'm looking forward to trying the barley which is currently available on Amazon.
Excellent product that I have bought several times already. Nice alternative to French foie gras!

I bought this for Christmas for my wife who is from France. She was very surprised and said it was excellent. I would buy this Foie Gras again. This company sells different types of Foie Gras, they have a Grade A or B, they have de-veined and they have fully cooked. This was a Grade A which was not de-veined, but it only had 1 small vein in it which was very easy to remove. We spread this Foie Gras on toast and also cooked some on top of deer tenderloin & backstrap. I think this Fois Gras is the closest you'll get to the traditional French Foie Gras. It arrived in a styrofoam cooler box with 4 freezer packs in it and it was still cold when delivered. I give it a 5 stars and will buy it again.
I wasn't going to write a review, though the product is excellent...till I saw that I needed to balance out the idiots rating this 1 star and using this as a forum to preach.  So 5 stars from me!

A wonderful substitute to fresh foie gras!  It is absolutly fantastic in both flavor and texture!  My favorite thing to do is soak them in whole milk and honey for about an hour then saute them in truffle oil!  Luxury at its finest! column9: If you knew how it was produced
column10: If you knew how foie gras was produced, you probably wouldn't buy it. Ducks are intensively raised from birth, their toes cut off so that their talons don't have to be maintained. They are manhandled so forcefully that many ducks break wings or legs or sometimes even necks. They are forced into individual cages and remain there, until they are forcefed fat through long metal tubes, to swell their livers. They are given so much food that they struggle to breathe. This happens 3 times a day. Sometimes, the ducks don't survive this maltreatment, and their bodies are thrown into wastebins.I am not a vegetarian but I believe that it is wrong to intensively raise animals in this way. Please show your support and boycott the sale of foie gras.

You might want to check youtube to see how foie gras is obtained before you buy it.  It is obtained through torture. The ducks and geese are violently force fed an incredible amount of food until their liver becomes diseased, engorged and fatty.  This is extremely painful and cruel.

column9: Excellent Greek white - great for entertaining
column10: You don't have to be Greek to enjoy this fabulous white. I often find it hard to interpret professional wine reviews so I will provide the simplest evaluation possible. Imagine an excellent Savignon Blanc with a mild citrus taste but slightly sweeter. That is what you experience with the 2011 Santorini Sigalas Assyrtiko. It is an excellent white wine to serve at a gathering,  with or without hors d'oeuvres.If you have never had an assyrtiko or moschofilero, they tend to be slightly sweeter than most mainstream whites from California or Australia but are a long way from dessert wines.  To the American pallet, Moscholifero tends to have overall stronger taste than assyrtiko. Of all of the Greek white wines I have tasted, this is the best. Friends agree.  It is also a solid value at the 20 dollar price point. Incidentally, this wine is one of the highest rated ever by major reviewers -- 93 points by the Wine Advocate.Greek wines often haven't been well received in the US by non-Greeks.  From what I have experienced, there are a handful of truly awful Greek wines that simply taste nothing like mainstream white wines.  These extremes have tainted reviewers and dissuaded consumers from exploring Greek wines. This wine is a example of something mainstream consumers and connoisseurs alike can enjoy - either with dinner or while entertaining.

It went from 4 boxes for the same price or less if I remember, to 3 boxes in a shipment without a price change???And no warning that it was going to include one less box and charge me for something different???

column9: Great right down to the bottom of the box!
column10: These are super, of course, with a cup of tomato soup; great with a cold soda or iced tea; or all alone with no accoutrement whatsoever! In cooking, you can crush them up and add them to seasoned breadcrumbs for a new twist on chicken cutlets, or use them instead of croutons with salad. Cheez-Its are great, and the price from Amazon with free delivery is really good.Great stuff!

column9: Get your Cheez-It fix at the lowest price possible
column10: This is the best price for Cheez-Its that I can find. If you choose Subscribe and Save, you're paying just a tad over $2 a box. I'm happy, the kids are happy, my bank account is happy.The bonus is that I don't look like an unfit dad buying multiple boxes Cheez-Its at the supermarket! Thanks Amazon!

I like these better than any chips around -- high-potency cheese flavor, crispy -- what's not to like?  I have to package these up in "single-serve" packs or I WILL eat half a box at one sitting!Mine arrived in great shape, too -- no more "crumbs" than I would expect to find in a box purchased at the supermarket.  And these are MUCH cheaper than the local stores, too.

column9: More addictive than wood to a termite...
column10: Once I start eating a few of these, I begin to pray that I don't eat the whole box. Delicious, tangy, and long-lasting flavor. I usually don't have my prayers answered, but I begin to pray that I don't eat the next box in one shot! Once in a rare while, you'll get a box delivered that has some crakers broken into smaller pieces. Don't blame Amazon. The people who deliver the product don't exactly treat it like the Hope Diamond when they handle it, and Amazon usually makes it up to you in a fair way. I'm sure the crybabies who will "never" buy it again were reimbursed! In any case, don't weigh yourself for a few days if you do what I do (or eat a few more salads...). Never get tired of the taste. If you're lactose intolerant, be ready to wear a nose clip after you finish! Bon apetite!P.S. It is cheaper on Amazon than any supermarket I go to. As others have noted, even when the supermarket has a sale, it barely matches it. No need for me to use public transportation, no lost time. No-brainer!
From the grocery store!! Four boxes arrived broken and crumbled. There seems to a packaging flaw. Oh, well back to the super markets for me.

Cheez-it's are awesome, so I'm just going to give the rating for that. However, there is potential for breakage. I don't know if my UPS guy was in a bad mood that day or what, but my Cheez-it's are 4 boxes of crumbs. I'm thinking of making crunchy,cheesy chicken fingers for the kids with them. They are too broken up to eat them otherwise.
My husband and I love, love cheez-it's. I only buy the original. Why would anyone want to mess with perfection. Don't buy low fat, because they don't taste the same.

Well if you are not familiar with this product and you love cheese and cheese flavored snacks then you deserve a box of these to reward yourself for whatever task you just completed. Cheez-It's are a go to snack for me and getting to buy them in bulk is a great deal!
love thees crackers great with tomato soup or on tuna or chicken hot dish great value well worth the money will be buying more.

These type of crackers are the absolute best, second only to the Big Cheez-It's. They seem to be the cheesiest cheese based crackers, as I have tried Cheez Nips, and prefer these. I find these are a bit saltier than Nips, which is another reason I love them. With a big glass of milk, these are up there as one of my favorite snacks - ever!

These crackers are delicious. These crackers are more than likely addictive to a whole lot of people. They are very cheesy and great for a snack. They are also not messy. I just got these today from amazon and they do not expire until Oct,2011 way more than enough time. Being that my family and I can down one of these boxes in a week. I got my 4 boxes for $10.05 the price shot up to $10.37 a few days after I already purchased mines. Still a good deal thought since when they are on sale at the store they are $2.50 a box. So you are only paying a few extra cents. WARNING!!! Very addictive and cheesy! :)

These arrived fresh and as good as the local product.  Crisp and tasty, my kids love 'em.  I like 'em OK, but prefer PF Goldfish myself.  But these are very good and a classic.  A good value when you can combine a coupon w/subscribe and save.

column9: The one time it's okay to be cheezy...
column10: At the current price, these are a great deal (4 boxes for about 11 dollars), so hopefully that won't change. Cheeze-It crackers are one of those snacks that I think you can have at (almost) any age. They have a perfect amount of cheddar taste, not going overboard but still giving it a perfect amount of flavor. The bite-sized crackers are very easy to take with you and a perfect snack on the go or to curb hunger until the next meal. Have them with your lunch, watching the ball game, after dinner, before lunch, whenever. At many stores, CheezeIts have skyrocketed in price ($4 a box), so this is a great deal if you are a "Cheeze It" fan.Great buy!

column9: Like these a little too much
column10: I love these crackers they are very cheesy, in a good way, and they are easy to eat.  The best way I found to eat these is to get a small bowl of raspberry applesauce and start dipping.Delicious!
I would tell anyone who loves cheese to buy CHEEZ-IT baked crackers. They have a great taste and make a great snack! I use them to top my vegetable casseroles. My family loves them!

column9: How Do They Get All The Cheese In There?
column10: I love Cheez-Its, always have and always will. I like the convenience of being able to point, click and have them delivered to my door. I have ordered these several times and the product is always quality.

Beware.  The photo of plant on order page shows large white flowers. There were no flowers on the two plants that were shipped from Amazon.  This is unsatisfactory, particularly for an expensive plant.

I have to disagree with the 1 star reviews.  Used on it's own, this syrup is 'ok' but you need to experiment to get the right mix.  The ideal mixture for a large latte is to use just one tablespoon of this syrup with a dash of ground cinnamon.  I think the 1 star people are using way too much.

Chasing that wonderful Pumpkin Spice Latte' flavor I tried almost every conceivable concoction ... and I have learned a lot a long the way! First and foremost, the extra cost for the sauce vs the syrup is WELL worth it.
