I have five totally indoor cats, which means that they have zero access to fresh greens.  One of them, aptly named Monster, will eat anything that looks remotely like a plant; green fabric, faux flowers, my floral purse.  Thus far we have tried approximately 5 other brands of cat grass and this one is the biggest hit.The cats all love this stuff, and we are also snipping bits off for our chinchilla and box turtle.The packaging is nice and sturdy so the cats cant destroy it while munching.Greens are thicker and healthier looking than most of the other brands we've tried.Directions are easy to follow.I like that its USDA certified and provides batch information for each bag, including contents, date tested, and type of wheat.Unlike many other brands of pet greens that only target cats, this is marketed towards a variety of animals and includes suggested methods for feeding each.  I am the inventory mgr at a petstore and this allows us to reach more customers with the product!The company, Bellrock Growers, supports animal rescue, adoption and shelter programs, which is an added bonus to an avid animal lover!The only downside is that I have to hide the container while the grass is regrowing!  The cats will go to great lengths to find and munch on it.I highly recommend this brand of pet grass!

column9: A healthy and natural hairball remedy that's hugely popular at our house
column10: The senior cat in our fairly finicky 3-cat household has a foot injury that's taking a very long time to heal, so I've had to close off feline access to the patio where my cats like to graze. Hairball upchucks ensued in short order.  The Cosmic grass seed from the pet store was a big hit, but it's been out of stock for weeks now. Which is how we came to try this. Was a tad worried about how quickly my guys would do away with the contents of such a wee small garden-in-a-bag. But the crop it produced  is much more dense than other kitty grasses we've tried and is still going strong after a couple of weeks on the floor next to their water dish--despite heavy use. It often gets tipped over, but since nothing ever spills out, that's not a problem. My cats, for some reason, won't eat snipped grass scattered over their food. They will only chomp greenery straight from the source. This product is perfect for that.Update 11/30/11: First batch lasted a full five weeks.  Have ordered more.

Grew like a charm in the window; per reviews from others I only put about half the grass seed in there and it was still really thick / lush. Of the four cats, only one of them chowed down on it pretty regularly.While the packaging was pretty conveinent, the cats didn't like it very much: even cutting the edges back, the sharp edges of the package seemed to bother them.While this was a neat product and did everything it said it would, in the future I'm just going to get a pot and a package of grass seeds.

Pros: Easy to grow (even the "pot" is included - although we placed in a different planter)  Organic seeds  Doesn't seem to foster mold  Deters cats from eating the houseplants  My cats LOVE itCons: Can't find official confirmation on whether the soil is also organic (seems treated for bugs-resistivity)  About 2x as many seeds as necessary for the bag (not actually a "con")Cat breeds: 1) Male British Shorthair, 2) Female Russian Blue, 3) Male Ocelot mix

I bought this grass for my very picky (tortoiseshell) cat and she loved it.  Every time she walked through the room she would either rub her face on the plant or take a few bites.  If I so much as dared to touch it while she was nearby she would swat my hand away!  And she's an indoor/outdoor cat, so it isn't like this is her only option for fiber either.I say "be careful" because after about two weeks I noticed she stopped eating it, then by the third week it was all wilted and brown.  I'm no greenthumb by any means, but it seems I should have used a free draining pot (like the instructions say to do...I'm just an idiot) instead of the opaque, closed-bottom one I chose.  It turns out I had the grass swimming, and when I dumped out the pot it was probably the foulest smelling mush on earth.  I had to open all my windows and run the attic fan to clear out the stench!That's not the product's fault at all, hence five stars.  In fact, I'm about to reorder and start a new batch since she liked it so much.  I'm just throwing this review up here so other inexperienced growers like me can hopefully avoid the same mistake!

column9: Amazing Value,  And Fast Grow Time.
column10: This is by far the best pet grass kit I have ever used. It's hard to see in the picture but this product is USDA organic, a huge plus. Also this can just about anywhere, just stick on a windowsill for about a week and you have some amazing pet grass. Amazing Value And Quality

column9: Our cat is addicted to this grass!!
column10: When we took in our first cat I had no idea that cats crave greens naturally.  Until one day I noticed my plants were all chewed up and bits & pieces were all over the carpet.  So I tried this Bellrock pet greens and now our cat won't eat his food without it!  I just trim some of the grass and sprinkle on top of his meal.  It's super easy to grow and one package lasts me about 15 days.  Super!

column9: worked but better to use a pot
column10: I got this to see if my dog like this as well as he likes lawn grass and he did! It grew fast and was very easy however the base of the stems and soil got moldy after awhile I think because it is hard to water the right amount in the bag. At least it was for me. It is a nice idea though and it did work!

My wife bought this at a store as an impulse buy.  It was cheap, so no big deal, but I had doubts that it would grow since we live in an apartment with only a small balcony that doesn't get much light.I did not do a great job planting either.  I grabbed a clump of dirt off the top, poured in the seeds, and threw the clump of dirt back down on top.  Noticing it was probably too deep for the seeds, I shook the bag.  Most of the seeds ended up on top.  I figured it was a lost cause, maybe a couple strands would grow.4 days later, I noticed several grass stalks (this WITHOUT being in the sun, mind you).  Once the stalks got above the height of the bag I put it outside where it gets maybe 3 hours of light...and a week later it was flourishing!This stuff is incredibly thick, not browning at all, and incredibly strong.  Our cat loves it (and no, she hasn't thrown up from eating it, which was our main concern).I am very glad my wife purchased this stuff.  I always felt bad that our cat, who was probably a stray for many years and used to the outdoors before we adopted her, was cooped up in an apartment.  Now she can at least enjoy getting a bit of sun and nibbling on some fresh plants.

I tried to follow the directions on the package to the letter.  However, I was not really able to cover up the seeds since the soil was already in the container.  I mixed them around some and so some were covered and some were not.  Despite that, the grass grew quickly and richly.  I just kept it moist at all times and out of the sun for the first few days (until the sprouts were about an inch high) and then in sunlight the rest of the time.  It has been wonderful.Our cats love it and both take turns attacking it.  They can't get enough.
Got two 1/2" high - and as thick as a piece of thread growths.  Very disappointed.  Like all pet parents I was looking forward to doing something fun for my three cats.
so easy to use.  my cats love it!  no more vomiting! i highly recommend this product and seller.  it arrived much faster than i expected so great all around experience.
Kitty seems to like this sprinkled on her food...Glad I bought 2, because I forgot to water one for a few days... Brown grass doesn't work...
great :) now my cats eat this instead of my houseplants!  i can use this pouch 3 times by dividing the seeds!

column9: Pet will eat it if you mix with their food
column10: It grows really fast, but my dog and cat will not eat it. I cut it and put it in with their food.

column9: Pretty ridiculous how well this grass works
column10: This grass grew really fast and two of our three cats enjoy it. We're toying with whether or not we cut it up and put it in their dish or if we can leave it out without them creating too much of a mess, but either way this is a great (and affordable) product that your cat may love.

column9: Must cut the grass and hand feed it to your animal
column10: The kit works well and produces a lot of grass. Pretty easy to use if you have the right tool for poking holes in the bottom of the bag. I wanted my cat to be able to munch on this at his leisure but have to cut for him because the grass is so close together he cant put it out on his own. The amount of grass if great. Would prefer a grass that my cat can graze on his own.

column9: My cat cannot digest this grass
column10: I ordered this product out of curiousity and because of all the positive reviews. My cat would sometimes eat our plants or our neighbors' plants so I thought this product would stop her from doing that. However, whenever she'd eaten a plant, my cat would always end up throwing it up because she couldn't digest it. I thought that she would be able eat and digest this product since it's "pet greens garden wheat grass." I had no problem with the growing of the grass. Actually, it grew beautifully (took about 5 days to really start growing out of the bag). However, my cat cannot digest this grass either. Multiple times now she has eaten some grass only to throw it up about 5 mins later. I am somewhat disappointed in the product.

column9: As Easy as Pie - and No Mess
column10: I was looking for an easy-to-grow, foolproof grass-growing kit - and this is it! You take the package, punch a few tiny holes in the bottom, pour in the provided seeds, water it and - voila! - just wait a few days and your cats will have delicious grass spears to munch on. You can cut the grass or have the cats eat out of the bag. My only complaint: a bit expensive (thus 4 stars only).  I wish these packs came in larger quantities at a discount.

I planted this as directed in the bag provided.  It sprouted and grew very quickly.  As soon as I put it out for the cats they attacked it.  I only used about 1/4 of the seeds provided and it was perfect.  The only problem I had was the cats keep tipping the bag/planter over when they try to eat the grass.  I ended up transfering the grass into a planter.  They love it and it looks beautiful.  I love it because I was unable to have any live plants in my home (they eat any plant whatsoever) now I have this vibrant green grass that they can safely eat!

The bag said to add water and keep in a cool, shaded place.  That's all that I did and I had a giant bag of grass within days.  I was amazed!When I'm home I put the bag on the kitchen table and the kitties jump up and nibble on the blades of grass.  They seem to like it OK, but it seems to be more curiosity than anything else.I looked up whether humans can eat the grass, too, because wheat grass is full of beneficial nutrients.  So far I've gotten both yes and no, so I plan to research it more.  If I can eat this stuff I'll be psyched!  Easiest gardening ever.Gave it four stars because the cats don't love it and it's more of a novelty item.  But it's cheap and easy enough and fun to watch them play with it, so why not?

this grass is great..I cut some for my dog and the next day it grows taller...I only planted half the seeds..looks like this could last me a month..just on half the seeds ..and my dog loves the taste..:)))

column9: Good product, but not tasty enough
column10: This is a great product it grows very pretty, very quickly, but my kitty was not very fond of it.  Im not sure what it is, but she would rather eat the grass outside.

I had my doubts about growing grass in a package, but this stuff grew like mad.  The cats both ate it cut up in their food.  It doesn't say how much to give them, so it's a guess, unless you ask your vet, but they aren't suppose to eat too much - whatever that would be.  It's been a couple of weeks and the grass is not as healthy green looking so I guess it won't last, but I would say it was worth it.

column9: Grew, but dog not crazy about it
column10: We have a White Shepherd that loves eating grass and since you never know what is sprayed on that grass, we bought this as special treat for her.  The kit grew very well and continues now for several weeks.  However, other than to dig it up and play with the dirt, she really won't eat the grass like she does outside.  She will eat it if we mix it with her food, but she still eats the outdoor stuff.  HOWEVER, this is NOT the products fault.  This kit does just what it says it will do, grows well and easy.  She eats it, but not from the pot.  So I don't blame the product for her choice, I just find it comical!  (She probaly wouldn't use a pet treadmill either!) :)

My cat, Miss Princess, did not like this "grass" as much as the "grass" that I purchased from Wal Mart.  The seeds grew nicely, but she was not very interested in the green stuff.  I do not think I will purchase this again.

column9: Good package design, not long lasting
column10: The greens were popular when they first grew, but they didn't last long before they started turning yellow.For the same money, I'd just buy grass seed in the future.  Good design of the package, though!

I bought this because my indoor cat tries to eat grass every time we go outside. Followed the suggestion of others to only use 1/2 of everything. That doesn't leave much dirt for the required 1/4 inch to cover the seeds, so I was doubtful, but I tried it anyway. Bottom line: worked great, grew fast, cat is eating it, we're happy.
Easy to grow a lush patch of grass that the cat loves.  Much better than any other cat grass I've tried in the past.
Despite my following all the directions, not 1 single blade of wheat grass broke the soil.  How do I get my money back, since I have used the product?  Will be more careful next time.

When I ordered this product, I was too lazy to convert "3-4 mm" to inches and consequently discovered the "Coarse Grinder Salt" was almost 1/4" (1/6" to be exact), way too coarse for my salt grinder.  Shortly after receiving my order from Amazon, I received a courtesy email from the Spice Lab to make sure I was happy with my order.  I replied that actually I was not happy, but the fault was mine because I didn't convert the metric dimensions to English units and consequently didn't realize how coarse the salt would be, which was too coarse for my salt mill.  Two days later I received a package of smaller crystals, no charge.  That's amazing customer service!

This product seems to have replaced a similar previous product (Natural Himalayan Crystal Salt). The previous prodcut was a deeper pink color and the texture was better than what I was finding elsewhere. This new product (Himalayan Organic Natural Unprocessed Cooking Salt) is much more like what the competitors are selling. I've enjoyed all my products from The Spice Lab, but was disappointed with the replacent for this product.

This pink salt has a very nice subtle flavor. I didn't know salt could vary in flavor until I tried this one. We bought the salt initially because (a) it's organic and (b) my daughter wanted pink salt! But the flavor is what really made the difference. I don't know much about salt, but I want to say that this has a "rounded" flavor meaning it isn't harsh or distinctive on food, rather it seems to become part of the food, going in and bringing back the flavor of the food in an enhanced way. Sounds silly, but I am learning good quality ingredients really make a difference.

Yes, I do use this product for salting some of my foods, but it also has another handy use. Because the grains of salt are much larger than normal, I use this salt to clean my cast iron grill and skillet. I pour one or two tablespoons of salt on the slightly warm grill or skillet, and rub the salt into the bottom and sides of the pans with a wadded up paper towel. The salt even quickly makes short work of cleaning the RIDGED bottom of my cast iron grill pan. Works perfectly. I usually keep two or three packages of this product on my spices shelf because I use it frequently both for salting food and cleaning the cast iron.

We were pleased with this salt. It's actually more salty than regular salt, even kosher salt or sea salt.  A little bit goes a long way!  I don't usually cook with it, but add it to things afterwards. I've been hand grinding it.

Not sure, but have been reading about Himalayan salt and apparently there is a high fluoride in this salt according to several reviews I've read, and that's not so good.  However, it looks very nice in my salt mill and tastes much better than Morton salt and I don't use it everyday.  Also, it's mined in Pakistan if that really matters.

placed the order on tuesday, received it on saturday with the cheapest shipping; super faster. the himalayan salt comes in a sealed ziploc bag that has a bottom that allows it to sit up vertically which is convenient for storage especially if you have way too many spices and sacks of beans and sugars and what not like me. in addition, it came with 3 samples (himalayan salt, lemon citron flake salt, and cyprus white flake salt) weighing quite a few grams each (sorry, doesn't say the weight and i don't have a scale with me at the moment).as far as product quality goes, i typically buy my himalayan salt from whole foods and aesthetically this salt look exactly like the salt i get from whole foods. i haven't tasted it yet, but i bet it tastes like salt. of course price wise this salt (the spice lab) is WAY cheaper than buying himalayan salt at whole foods (even including shipping).

This is a great salt; it has a wholesome flavor and, I noticed it doesn't make you thirsty or rise the blood pressure as regular salt does. That's the benefit of the natural balance of minerals in it. I would recommend this to friends and health conscious people.
This salt is so pink and taste like the ocean, I love it. Make sure to buy a grinder of some sort if you plan to use it on salads or sprinkle on cold dishes.

This is the first time I have used land mined salt.  I usually use salt from various sea sources.  After reading several reviews here on Amazon I decided to try this salt.  I was very pleasantly surprised the first time I tasted the salt. The flavor was fresh and subtle.  Not like the salt you usually buy in the grocery stores. Plus it has a lot of trace minerals your body needs.  I highly recommend this salt.

I love pink himalayan salt! It is loaded with minerals and taste great.  I don't have to use as much as the conventional table salt and I don't feel bad about using it because I know that it's also really good for my body.

column9: What I have been looking for....
column10: The product has far fewer pink crystals than shown in the picture, which is perfectly fine with me.  The salt is coarse, excellent for salt mills.  It tastes great and the size is what I wanted and haven't been able to find elsewhere.  The price and service is excellent, as well.

column9: the only salt I use--except herbamare and trocomare
column10: I have not purchased this from Amazon yet as still on what I purchased elsewhere BUT I noticed many people buying the one pound bag. Just to let you know: one kilo equals 2.2 lbs. Why would you buy the one pound bag on something that never goes bad when you can get more than double for just a few dollars more.Dr. Mercola's comments regarding Himalaya salt benefits are what started me using this initially a few years ago. Many micronutrients, great purity. One person questioned the iodine: no salt naturally contains iodine unless it is iodized or contains some sort of seaweed. You can easily see his comments at mercola.com.Himalaya salt has a very 'clean' taste--add at the end of cooking.
I bought Himalayan Organic Salt twice. Each time, quality was really good and service was fast and courteous (The Spice Lab's). I will buy it again.

I was very pleased with the Himalayan salt. It really does taste much better than ordinary salt and you can actually taste some of the other minerals in it. I would describe it like licking a salty rock, but in a good way. Very pleased and will be buying more.

I have never ordered sea salt before. i thought this was great. I was afraid it would have some additional flavor that I wouldnt like. Instead it was fresh tasting & natural. I like the pink color, but glad it doesnt come out pink.

column9: Very good salt for a very good price
column10: I'll certainly be a repeat customer. I had a tough time finding large salt crystals to refill a grinder, but this fit the bill nicely.Flavor is clean with slight minerality. The color is not a deep as some other himalayan pink I've seen, but it's a very good finishing salt, and a good conversation piece when put on the table in a clear grinder.Also, the seller included a coupon for a future purchase in the package, which was a nice bonus.
This salt has a slightly earthy taste. It is moderately coarse. I bought a ceramic grinder for when I would like to have it a little finer. I love this salt!

Great salt! Though now that I know how great it is I will have to buy a bigger bag next time. Mixed with some epsom salt and essential oils this makes a great bath salt. Ground up a bit finer it is wonderful for cooking. Will certainly buy again.

I had been told that Himalayan salt was much better for you.  After shopping around, I found the best deal was through Amazon.  It came in a heavy resealable bag and works great in my salt mill.  I would buy this again and recommend it to my friends.

I use this salt very liberally now especially after finding out that its table salt you really need to avoid.  Our bodies need salt to live and this is the purest kind out there.  I plan to make this salt a part of my regular diet.

I love this salt!!  The delivery was quick, the price was reasonable and the salt imparts a wonderful flavor to everything I eat!  And, it doesn't burn my tongue!  I will be using this salt for ever more!
I absolutely love this salt.  The flavor is awesome and at a great price.  No more box salt for me.

I discovered this salt about 2 years ago and have not looked back. I love it. The Spice Lab gives you a high quality product for a great price. It is hard to describe Himalayan salt - you get more salty goodness without using so much. It is delicious!
Great buy!  Fantastic taste and pleasing pink hue from the iron content.  I prefer a grinding salt, and this one is unprocessed for it's better for you.

column9: Slightly pink in color, but salt non-the-less.
column10: Can't tell it is any different than normal salt, except for a slight pink tinge. But if it has all the great minerals and stuff... all the better!

This salt is so tasty!  It tastes nothing like the iodized table salt.  This has a light, mild taste that greatly enhances meats, vegetables, etc.  It's pink/peach color also looks very pretty in my clear Cole/Mason grinder.  It grinds very finely with no issue.  In fact, this salt grinds so finely that it leaves a fine coating, almost like a powder, around the inside of the clear grinder.  If you're a neat freak, this might bug you a little and you might find yourself wiping out the top of the grinder.  Great salt and the bag lasts a long time.

Just like in the store for a fraction of the price. I purchased this to refill my expensive pink salt grinder. A million times better than table salt. I don't know if it tastes any different from regular table salt but I think there is something about the shape of the crystals that changes the way the salt hits your tongue. If you have a good grinder I highly recommend checking this stuff out.

This salt is great and way cheaper than any of the local spice shops. It does seem more difficult to grind than other himilayan salts I have tried, but doing a little at a time makes it well worth it. Would i buy it again?? YES
this is a fine example of mineral-rich himalayan salt. The packaging also keeps it fresh. It comes in a zip-seal pouch.
Fast service and item was exactly as described. Would purchase from this seller again. They even sent along more information on this salt and others as well as sent me some samples.
This is my kids favorite of the salts at the moment.  I like it too, and will keep it in my collection. Great deal also, and great company to do business with.

The bag was smaller than I expected, but that's probably just me being bad at estimating things.  The salt seems good, however, I was a little disappointed that the photo showed the salt to be much more vibrantly colored than they actually are.  I mean, they are pink, just not so bright pink as it shows.  The salt has a good flavor though.  I'd say it was worth the price.

Salt tastes fine, cant say about the health claims. 3 stars is because of the packaging. The grinder top is too large for a comfortable grind. I have fairly large/strong hands and have a hard time turning the grinder. For me, when the grinder is mostly vertical to 45deg, it is difficult/impossible to grind directly onto food. Works fine if cap is left on & held in a horizontal position & them remove cap & use. The grind gives a nice fine grind (better than my OXO I also got at Amazon).

I got this for work, as I am a cook. Everyone noticed that I have had a change in the flavors of my food. They said it was a good change. Personally I have enjoyed useing the salt in different foods. I do like it very much.

I use this Pink Himalayan course grain salt in salt grinders because it looks great, but also I make my own homemade Herbal Salt using Rosemary, Lemon Thyme and Pink Himalayan course grain salt...tastes great and look great in the grinders and shakers.  I've very satisfied.  I plan on making up some more Herbal Salts for Christmas gifts using this Pink Himalayan salt.  Very satisfied!
We grind our salt/pepper/spices fresh and this is out salt of choice.  It's milder than regular table salt, which allows for more precise control of how salty you want your foods.

The Spice Lab is a completely wonderful company!!!I received my order promptly. The salt is very high quality and a beautiful pink color.Due to my miscalculation, I ordered crystals that were too big for my grinder.I sent a note and asked if I could exchange it for smaller crystals.Customer service answered quickly and said "They were sending me a bag of smaller crystals" completely free.How wonderful of them!!!You don't see that very often these days. I commend Spice Lab for having such wonderful "customer service!" I am now a dedicated customer!!! Thank you Spice Lab for my quality salt!! I am going to make "Sole" and cook with it every day!!!

column9: SALT OF THE EARTH - Himalayan Style
column10: Silly me, I didn't even know there was such a thing as pink Himalayan salt.  A friend actually mentioned it to me as we were discussing moving into a vegetarian life style.  So now, it's like buying a red, Ford Mustang.  It's all you see on the road or, in this case, on the shelves of the stores.I'm actually glad I purchased this and have stopped using regular old white salt almost totally.  The salt does seem to have a milder taste but I don't find myself using any more of it than I did with the good old "when it rains it pours" variety.Since ordering this from Amazon, I've managed to find some here in my little town but it is way expensive.  When you purchase this you will also need a salt grinder unless you like throwing big chunks of salt at your food.  Worth getting the two together, however, especially if you purchase a grinder with a glass container as the salt really looks attractive in a pretty, transparent grinder.  And, of course, it tastes good, too.  About it's nutritional value I admit to knowing zip.  Does salt HAVE nutritional value?  In the meantime, I give this four stars.  If I find out more about the actual food value I'll update this review.

column9: Pink it was love at first sight!
column10: Best Pink Salt On The Planet! It will make all your dishes taste better. i put it in a glass jar for chow watmore ken i talk about it is pink salt i resifet it fest

I'm not a coffee expert, just a decades-long enjoyer of this daily drink; usually two cups.  Long favored French dark roast until I read that Italian is supposed to be more flavorful.  This is my first brand of Italian and I'm a new convert to its rich, bold, non-bitter taste.  Add a little squirt of Agave nectar and a shot of whole mile, and my taste buds are happy.  Great coffee's not cheap, but prime shipping makes this easy to swallow.

This mix is exactly as advertised . I Decided to add chopped onion ,sesame seeds and a small amount of Chile paste and  the results were outstanding . I also used .75 lbs of Ahi instead of the full LB. and it worked fine .I would buy this product again .
This seasoning is so easy tpo use and very delicious.  So glad I got several packages at the same time.

Bought these on sale here at Amazon.  What a good value!  1.5lbs of chocolate for a bit less than half-price is a must-buy.  They taste fresh.  Who cares if they have the wrong-colored wrapper?  Buy and enjoy!
I purchased these for a couple of my son's friends to take with them to an overnight trip in NYC.  It was my random act of kindness, what better than with KISSES !!

*****Ashby's Japanese Green Tea is a distinctive, strong, great-flavored Japanese tea. Nothing wimpy or mild about it, and I'm glad, because it's so enjoyable. I made a large thermos with one tea bag, left the tea bag in, and drank it for several hours, and it never got bitter. I then made more tea with the same tea bag. The flavor is definitely Asian and I could drink cup after cup. It smells great, too.Ashby's of London writes this about Japanese Green Tea: "From Japan, this pan-fired tea is lightly rolled and dried over a fire in a large flat bottom pan. This tea contains the desirable "Polyphenols" that have been reported to be a cancer fighting substance. It has a very light, fresh taste and produces a transparent greenish colored brew." I agree, but please note that the tea is distinctively flavored, not mild (which I really like) and delivers a wonderful tea experience.I highly recommend it, and if you enjoy Asian teas, or want a true green tea, you'll not go wrong here.*****

column9: Good to Know I'm Helping Birds
column10: I just ordered another 2-pack of Audubon coffee. I won't say the taste is wondrous, but it's very good. The price is comparable to buying something like Starbucks in the grocery, and I'm happy to know I'm helping birds by buying this product.

This is my favorite coffee of all.  The flavor is excellent.  It's organic, bird friendly, fair trade.  What is there not to like about it?  I've tried other organic brands of coffee and this surpasses them all.  Highly recommend.

OMG, I can't believe the variety of these "Sides" that Lipton has to offer. After devouring the tasty Stroganoff Side, I just had to try another "stick-to-your-ribs" meal, so I went for this Rice Medley.At the risk of sounding like a glutton, I'm going to confess I made those little, impolite moaning sounds while eating this dish ... but who wouldn't? The flavor of this yummy rice dish is enhanced by vermicelli, dried peas, carrots, and onions in chicken-flavored sauce.  Mmmmmm ... Oops, there I go again! (Well, at least I'm not burping. ... lol)Oh-hhh, I see other tempting varieties: Asian Sides, Fiesta Sides and more, and all just as easy to prepare as the Stroganoff (see previous review).Excuse me, I'm off to the kitchen again. These are so easy, so delicious, I may never "cook" again.Reviewed by: Betty Dravis, 2008author of: Millennium Babe: The Prophecy

great product especially with the subcribe & save amazon option.  cant go wrong here.  easy and quick side dish for whatever your cooking.  great to make if you have people over for dinner and not sure what everyone likes.
These tomatoes are the best I have found for cooking sauce. All of the other brands I have tried were 1/2 water. Some of the cans have arrived dented, but the quality makes up for it.

I just used these in a beef stew last night and was very pleased with the tomato flavor they added to the stew. The tomatoes themselves are about twice the diameter of grape or cherry tomatoes. My wife just picked them out of the can one by one, mashed each with thumb and forefinger, and dropped them into the stew. Without peels, they cooked down and just became part of the stock.You can buy these with and without basil added. It looks like a couple of people who reviewed here were shipped the SKU with basil by mistake, and instead of handling their problem with customer service, blamed it on the product. Here's what you do if someone ships you the wrong product. Instead of mis-targeting the product, call customer service and tell them to send the right product, and send a shipping label to return the wrong one. If they won't do that, call your credit card company and deny the charge. It is that simple.

column9: Not sure what the griping is about...
column10: This is a great product and, with the subscribe and save, about half what I would pay at my grocery store (and it's delivered free!) I did not have problems with getting a different kind of tomato than I'd ordered -- I got the regular whole peeled tomatoes. As for the cans being dented, sure, a couple of them are bound to get dented considering it's TWENTY POUNDS OF CANS BEING SHIPPED ACROSS THE COUNTRY. A couple dents are to be expected, folks.Overall, it's really tough to complain about this (though the price does seem to have jumped since I ordered them ... too bad.)

column9: Love the Product But Watch Out for Dented Cans
column10: These tomatoes are FABULOUS and worth the extra cost.  My first shipment came in with no problems.  Unfortunately when my second one arrived 8 of the 12 cans were dented, two so badly that a can opener can't be used on one end.  I am hopeful that the sender will make it right.
I thought I was buying plum tomatoes-I recieved plum tomatoes with basil. I can't return it and I am dissappointed with this seller.

I ordered peeled plum tomatoes and received a 12 pack of diced tomatoes instead.  Every can has a dent in it which isn't as big of a deal compared to not receiving what I ordered.  It would have been nice to have had the option of waiting on additional plum tomatoes (if they were out of stock) vs. them sending me an alternate product.  Not too happy about this...

column9: I love Cento, but read the ingredients carefully!
column10: I was shopping a little too quickly and subscribed to this item thinking that it would be plain plum tomatoes. They contain basil, as a previous reviewer mentioned. I wish I had read that reviewer's message! It is clearly notated in the ingredient list, but the picture doesn't show it at all.I can use these and will happily use them, but they are not as versatile to my cooking style as plain tomatoes.Amazon, if you are paying attention, add Basil to the title of this item!!!

Having a child on a GFCF diet has made it very difficult to locate foods to help make her feel like she's included when other kids are eating or there's a party in school.  This item helps do just that!Great texture and flavor...I highly recommend!
I really enjoy this chocolate bar since I'm allergic to dairy & gluten.  Plus I found its cheaper to buy in bulk.
You know when you have a box of raisins and they sometimes stick together and turn hard? This is not what you will find in this bag. It is fresh, it is sweet and it is good!

column9: A Basket of Grapes in a Bag
column10: We like raisins (Sun Maid Raisins, 12-Ounce Bags (Pack of 6)), and if you knew how many we eat, you would be shocked. We eat them on our cold cereal, in our oatmeal, mixed with almonds, stirred up with peanut butter, and by themselves.They are good to eat and good for people. They are pure food . . . "grapes and sunshine" Sun-Maid calls them.  They are made in California's San Joaquin Valley from Thompson Seedless grapes.  One pound of raisins is 4 ½ pounds of fresh grapes.  The hot summer sun makes the grapes sweet and juicy.In addition to snacking on raisins, we like to cook with them.Here's a classic recipe using raisins. My sister Ruth won a prize with it in a cooking show, and she shared it with permission in Flavored with Love: Mary Lou's Family and Friends Can Cook.Ruth's Prize-Winning Broccoli Salad4 cups broccoli½ cup raisins½ cup onion½ cup nuts½ cup celery½ cup real bacon bits½ cup light mayonnaise½ cup sugar¼ cup vinegar (apple cider or white)Mix the first 6 ingredients.  Make a sauce out of the mayonnaise, sugar, and vinegar.  Pour the sauce over the salad. Toss and chill.Lately we are paying more attention to nutrition.  Raisns have 130 calories in a 1/4 cup serving.  There are condensed food.  They contain no fat. They have natural sugar with a large carbohydrate load.  One serving has almost no sodium but 310 mg potassium.  Diabetics and renal patients should consult with their dieticians before including raisins in their diets.I hope you enjoy Ruth's recipe and find this review helpful.
These raisins were great. They have a long shelf life, taste great, and there weren't any surprise ingredients when I checked the label or the packages.

I feel like I have tried all the brands out there and find that these are still the best.  They have a naturally sweet flavor, they are moists, and smell very fresh.  I love them in serial and also for baking or just eating plain.

Good product, good brand, and cheaper than buying direct from the Sun Maid growers store. Two things not ideal: At least one bag was not sealed on the side seam, and no expiration dates on bags. They taste fine, though.
These raisins are very good, moist and tasty. You get so many bags fo the price. Great value.
Great tasting.  Not too sure if the price is a deal compared to the grocery stores.  However, the quality of the fruit is superior to the quality found in the stores.
The raisins were fresh! This was my first time buying food from Amazon and I was impressed
I received the packages of raisins in a reasonable amount of time and was totally satisfied with the purchase.

column9: Perfect size for fresh, good tasting raisins!
column10: I like buying the Sun Maid Raisins in 12-ounce pouches and in packs of 6.  They stay fresh and I never run out of one of my favorite additions to my breakfast old-fashioned oatmeal every morning.  Thanks Amazon for another tasty product that can be delivered to my front door!

column9: Fantastic Raisins in a Convenient Package
column10: Sun Maid raisins are delicious.  They are plump, moist, flavorful, grown in the USA and have no added ingredients or sugar.  Really, the ingredients list on the package has only one ingredient:  California seedless raisins.There has always been one big problem with Sun Maid Raisins:  their packaging.  It used to be that the raisins were packed in cardboard cartons that didn't seal or re-seal well and the raisins would dry out and get unappetizing, especially when they got smushed, stuck or smeared onto the cardboard package.Happily, Sun Maid has finally found the perfect solution to their packaging problem.  These 12 ounce pouches are wonderful!  They contain a reasonably small quantity of raisins (about enough for a big batch of oatmeal raisin cookies) and are resealable too, so it's no big deal if you don't finish the whole packet at once.

Excellent Product!  I have purchased two shipments of these raisins and both times they were plump and juicy.  I love that they come in resalable bags instead of the cardboard boxes.  The subscribe and save price is much better than what I could buy them for at my local super market.

I've been subscribing to Newman's organic raisins, but I decided to try these, as they are a less expensive. I prefer these raisins now. They are big and juicy and taste fresh. After all, what goes into the process of making raisins? Not much involved. I'll stick with these from now on.
I put these on All-Bran to create my own raisin bran with more fiber than store-bought raisin bran.  Result is delicious.

For less than $2 a bag, this is a great deal. Raisins are raisins and at my local grocery store these go for $3 a bag. The only thing that's cheaper is the huge 24 oz boxes of store brand raisins, which I rather not get since they're so huge.

column9: GREAT DEAL, GREAT PRODUCT, GREAT HEALTH SNACK!
column10: I believe in Sun-Maid raisins :-)... it is one of my all time favorite snacks since childhood. Lately I was passing it by because of the high price in my local stores.  Buying it from this site is the best deal anywhere. My order came quickly, the raisins came well packaged, and was soft and fresh. Also very reasonable priced for a fantastic amount.  I'm "raisin" everything now, from oatmeal cereal to cookies and fruit cakes. They are simply delicious! I will definitely be re-ordering.

column9: Fresh, but not as Advertised in the search products section
column10: I had searched for baking raisins and while you can use these raisins for baking they are not as good as raisins formulated by Sunkist specifically for baking.  True baking raisins come packaged in a liquid that makes them plumper and sweeter tasting in baked goods.However, as always Amazon stands behind their offerings and exchanged the product for me.THANK YOU AMAZON!!!P.S.  Note to Amazon:  Please make it more prevalent on web pages for nonreturnable products that the product canNOT be returned.  I appreciate your consideration of my suggestion.

The best gift I give my body when it needs potassium and energy. Half way through mountain biking, surfing, step master, weightlifting, hiking etc. when I stop and want to insure that I have the right energy, I feed my body hot tea with raisins, grapefruit, banana, etc. since the potassium keeps my muscles flexible and the natural sugar in the fruit itself, gives me an immediate glucose which burns immediately and turns into energy and most importantly it tastes great. I keep the big bag in the refrigerator inside another zip lock bag and only take what I need on weekly basis even though I consume this frequently and need to purchase another bag every month. Excellent tasting.

Sun Maid Raisins provide an excellent snack for persons on the go who want quick energy; they are also healthy for just about anyone, too. They are fat and cholesterol free and they don't have sodium. Raisins contain dietary fiber as well. Moreover, just 1.5 ounces equals one serving of the fruit we need to have in our diets every day. Excellent!The packaging allows for easy transport and the stay fresh reclosable zipper works well. If for some reason the zipper on your bag doesn't work then use a tie from a loaf of bread or something similar to keep the package closed.Moreover, Amazon correctly notes that these raisins are delicious with yogurt and cereal. They can be used in salads and numerous other recipes, too. I add them to hot oatmeal in the morning to give the otherwise bland oatmeal a natural sweetness that wakes up my taste buds big time! SMILESUnfortunately, raisins contain few vitamins and they do contain some carbohydrates. Amazon also notes that these raisins "may contain an occasional grape stem or wood piece." Consult your doctor if this concerns you. I wish they contained vitamins; this disappoints me so I will take off one star to make this a four star review.Overall, however, Sun Maid raisins provide us with a healthy alternative to candy bars and junk food when we need that snack or burst of sugar energy. They help us get the fruit we so badly need in our diets and the packaging allows us to carry them around easily.Buy some like I did and ENJOY!!!

One can buy cheaper unbranded raisins, like supermarket brands, and sometimes they actually pretty good, plum and moist as good raisins ought to be, but sometimes they are dry and crumbling, but you can't complaint because they cost you less. In contrast, raisins from sun maid bought at local stores were always good. I was unpleasantly surprised therefore to find the raisins that arrived with my order to be these same clumps of dry, low quality type of raisins as those no brand discount raisins sold in some food markets. I'm sure they still good for cooking but not for eating out of a bag. Very disappointing.

column9: Glad I ordered the sunmaid raisins
column10: Got the raisins, and they were what I expected.  Thanks!

column9: Occasional stem, wood piece or rock!
column10: I was eating a handful of Sun-Maid raisins when I bit into a rock!  The description does warn against occasional stems or wood pieces, but I was sure surprised when I nearly broke my molars on a stone about the size of a raisin.  I wrote the company to see if they wanted to examine the stone or the package of raisins, but never received a response.These raisins are very tasty, but I have to give a one star rating based on Sun-Maid's poor customer service.  A solution is to eat them one at a time, inspecting each one prior, but what about oatmeal raisin cookies?  I am not sure I will ever be able to eat these raisins with the enthusiasm I used to have.

my dog loves these... and she is a "liver shunt MVD" baby who is sooo sensitive.  But these don't seem to bother her condition, and actually help her.  It's a true treat and she likes the flavor.  And they do seem to calm her down.

My mother always has Bisto in the cupboard to help thicken drippings from pot roasts. I was glad to locate it through Amazon so that I could give a boost to my crockpot beef stews and have it on hand for browning in other beef dishes. It makes a nice, tasty gravy over potatoes, hot sandwiches, etc.  It's a British product so it's not readily available in local supermarkets.
Bought this as i couldnt find it in the shops anywhere and was missing it so bad. It arrived really quickly.
Good product.  Easy to use and the flavor is deep like a gravy should be.  Quite spendy tho for the quantity.  Would purchase again.

column9: A very sensitive stomach is settled. Waggy Tails!
column10: Our poor little pooch (ok, ok ... a big ol slobbery mess) had some serious stomach issues since we moved to the city from 4 acres of freedom. We tried everything to help her adjust, including altering her diet. Adding small amounts of oatmeal and rice to her regular food helped, but we kept having to increase the portions. Eventually, she was eating too much people food, and not enough dog food. We knew it was doubtful that it was a medical problem because of prior history of stress induced digestive issues. Not only that, she always had a fussy stomach to begin with (already vet checked). Nonetheless, we were beginning to get worried.Finally, on a hunch, I visited a local family owned pet store down the street. The kid there obviously knew his stuff, and the products. I explained the situation, and he recommended California Natural. I never wanted to try this brand because of the price but I decided to trust him.Well, the problem cleared up completely in less than 2 days. There was very little, if any, transition period between her old food and California Natural. The, ahem, results (if you will) are now normal, occur less frequently, and compact (sorry to be gross.)At first, I was worried about the cost. I realize now, a resulting vet bill could cost far more. I am now looking at this as a preventative measure; an investment into her health and longevity. If we had started her on California Natural at the beginning, she probably wouldn't have the "fussy stomach" I mentioned earlier. Not only that, we might have saved countless dollars, hassle, discomfort, and emotional distress by avoiding trips to the vet.The food satisfies her, she loves it, and it is gentle on her stomach. And, I am told, it is healthy stuff. All I can say is - hallelujah!Thanks guys -- from Sandy the pooch(and us) (California Natural Lamb Meal and Rice Adult Dry Dog Food

So far, this is one of only 3 dog food brands that I've found that my Border collie and adopted Australian Shepherd do well on. They used to itch and shed a lot until I switched to this food. Our australian shepherd had pink around his mouth and on his belly before switching. It has limited ingredients, less chance of food alergies. I have tried many high cost and probably high quality foods but nothing worked. I ended up having the best luck with this and with Purina one smartblend of all foods. I know, I know, that's not what you read when you research the internet but my dogs do best on Purina or this California brand.

The strong flavor and scent of jasmine enhances this tea. I'm not sure how else to explain this but this tea generates a calm atmosphere when I drink it. The Jasmine aroma has a powerful, almost overwhelming after taste once you sip it. Initially you have to get use to it but once you do its addictive. I sometimes add some honey for a little sweetness. Give it a shot you will love it.

I ordered this tea knowing that it was sourced in Thailand. I thought I would just have to accept that it wasn't as good as the normal Japanese one that I get at the corner deli.However, I received a shipment about a week or two ago and to my delight found that the tea is once again from Japan! I'm drinking it now and the difference in quality is amazing! The one from Japan is so much better!THANK YOU AMAZON! You have made my day!

I am not a tea expert, so I cannot attest to the health atrributes of this drink. I do buy several varieties of Ito-En Teas, and this is my favorite. The tea is light and fragrant, and tastes really great when chilled. Don't forget to take advantage of the subscribe-and-save to have the convenient delivery and discounted price!

This tea has a delicate jasmine flavor, is sugarless and perfect size.  Discovered this tea in all of the vending machines in Japan, and originally ordered it through Ito-En, but it is cheaper on Amazon.

column9: Ito En Jasmine Japanese Green Tea
column10: This is made in Thailand and does not taste the same. The old made in Japan drinks are totally superior in taste, after taste, aroma. Didn't listen to the other reviewer about the formula change with the made in Thailand drinks and ordered 2 cases but didn't want to go through the trouble of returning. If you had tasted the old drink, you will greatly be disappointed. If you have not had Ito En before, you may still find this drink good. Sorry, not for me.Update 7/14/12:I saw a comment from other buyer that he/she received a Japan made batch. I went ahead and ordered 2 cases. Sure enough, they are now Made in Japan. The interesting thing is this batch tasted "watered down", exactly like another reviewer said!!! I now understand what he/she meant. Bottom line: there is definitely some quality consistency issue here (at least post Tsunami time). It is batch dependent, facility dependent ( have seen Thailand made, Japan Made, and have seen comments about Hawaii Made!). Good luck to all who seek good tea. I have switched to brewing my own tea and bought the tea from Eto En directly.

column9: Best tea there is, love the jasmin
column10: I see two reviews saying this is made in Thailand.  I would like to know why people think this since it only says Hawaii on the bottles.  Could someone please let me know why people are saying this is made in Thailand?On the first page of the Ito-En website it says it is imported from Japan.I find this to be the most delicious refreshing tea there is.  It is like drinking the delicate juice of the jasmin flower.  Jasmin is the most often used natural fragrance essence ingredient in perfumes.  The flower has a scent that carries far and is what heaven must smell like.You wouldn't ordinarily think that a tea flavored with flowers would be good but this is delicious.  It does say on the list of ingredients that real jasmin is used.I have been getting this at Whole Foods and paying almost two dollars a bottle for it.  I have no problem downing two bottles of this a day.  I checked the bottles from Whole Foods and they say Hawaii, no mention of Thailand, so I'm not sure exactly where this is actually made or if Hawaii is simply the import area, or it is actually made there.  But it's no problem as it is delicious and hasn't killed me yet so I am purchasing a case here to save money.  I also signed up for automatic delivery.  The only problem is I need more than twelve bottles a month.If I knew for sure it was made in Thailand I would still get it.I'm not suffering any ill effects after drinking two bottles a day for the past month.

I highly reccomend his tea. Stick it in the refrigerator and grab it to go.I read the two negative reviews on this..why  the bad reviews I have no idea but if your some Japanese aficionado then stick your nose high and walk away. ,. This tea is authentically delicious as stated by some snobby Japanese tea drinker friends...this tea has a fragrant jasmine flavor that is delicate yet powerful. The green tea has a nice kick to it so gets you calmed yet energizedPerfect for everything from a nice summer picnic to eating tamales withI have this on the subscribe and save ship plan and find that it is  perfect to get every month.Now I wish that amazon would just offer TJ's kombucha for that too. I would be set thenJUST A NOTE HERE,,,,, Ito en offers the tea in a different  square bottle which is cheaper, I don't think that is the same formula as I did test them both  back to back. The one in the teas tea square bottle  is probably more akin to a watered down American version that caters to the McDonald junk food culture. What does that mean, you  ask? Well it means many people In the us have watered down Taste for things and  wouldn't want a nice fragrant jasmine in their tea, just sayin. But it's ok if you don't eat mcDd and still like a softer version.

I was skeptical about trying this product as I usually don't like bottled tea products. I was pleasantly surprised at how well this product tasted. I am an avid jasmine green tea drinker and found this product a refreshing alternative to freshly brewed tea. I love the aroma and taste of this item and that no sugar or artificial sweeteners have been added to it. Best of all this product is great refrigerated to enjoy on hot days!

column9: NOT JAPANESE. It is from Thailand
column10: They should put the origin of the product in the information so we can make more informed choices about our purchases. This tea is from Thailand. Do not be fooled. No thanks.

These noodles made me gag. That is not an expression. It's the truth. I spat them out and poured the remainder into the garbage disposal. I will continue to use spaghetti squash as a pasta substitute.

Believe it when you read all the reviews that say these smell fishy and have an odd texture ....It is true that the noodles take on the taste of the other ingredients that they are mixed with but it does not take away from the odd texture

NO RETURN!  NO REFUND!  The texture of all of the Miracle Noodle products is like eating plastic fishing worms.  I read the reviews and tried every way possible to improve the experience of eating this stuff.  5 minutes of rinsing, par boiling etc.  When you buy this item you are stuck with it.  Aamazon.com will not stand behind the quality of your experience.  Don't take a chance of losing $80 like I did.

I ignored the bad reviews because, really, I can eat and enjoy just about anything.The fish smell is pretty unpleasant, but the bulk of it does rinse away. There continues to be an unpleasant smell after, that's no longer fishy, but its there and impossible to get over with the horrible texture essentially forcing your mind to never get over the fact that you're eating something that's not quite right.Someone described these as bad calamari, which I find inaccurate because bad calamari still passes as food in my book. These feel artificial. It doesn't taste bad, but it feels like you are chewing on rubber bands, the noodle just will not break down. Ultimately, your natural reflexes take over and you just can't swallow a mouthful of rubber bands.I'm trying to find redeeming qualities about this to pull the score up to 2 stars at least, but I just can't. Sure, it works as a flavor carryng mechanism, but so do rubber bands.

column9: not bad for zero net calories!
column10: I tried these noodles and they are not the same exact taste and texture as regular pasta but really not bad at all for zero calories!  I reordered again so that tells you I liked them.  Not LOVED them, but liked them, and when you add fresh homemade tomato or vegetable sauce over it, its really pretty good!  And no gluten, no calories!
I rinsed these repeatedly (read that this would help with the fish scent), but it didn't help. The texture is awful. We ended up having cereal, because none of us could stomach these noodles.
I use these in stir fry. Love that they are guilt free and will absorb flavor of sauces you are cooking in. They do not over cook or under cook.

Okay, I had to try them as the thought of substituting noodles with a low cal low carb alternative was hopeful.  I received the case and immediately opened them up and cooked exactly as prescribed.  To me, they tasted like silicon and I could barely choke them down.  I threw the rest of the packages away as I knew there was no way in the world that I could ingest them.  To me they are nothing less than gross and I would not recommend them.

If I could give less than 1 star I would. These vile "noodles" are disgusting in every way. If you can get these vile things down and keep them down then you should be on tv with Andrew Zimmern on Bizarre Foods.
Want the truth? These noodles smell like fish and taste like raw squid. WICKED GROSS, SAVE YOUR MONEY!! THIS IS THE TRUTH.

These come packed in a bag of what I can only assume is fish juice. To put it simply, they reek of fish. Rinsing them off and boiling them only helps to some extent; you're going to need to drown them in something strong if you don't like your noodles to smell like week-old carp. Once you get past the smell, they are a reasonable replacement for noodles, though they are more chewy than the real thing and they have sort of a tangy aftertaste. They might be okay in an oriental dish, but they were ghastly by themselves (I tired both fettuccini and red meat sauce).

column9: Not a replacement for pasta, but overall very good
column10: If you're expecting something even remotely similar to semolina pasta, you will be disappointed.  I did not have any issues with the smell.  Yes, they're chewy.  But nothing that was totally off-putting.  If you're trying to cut carbs or calories and are willing to try something new, they are excellent.

column4: William R. Berry "To work in the service of l...
column10: I guess it boils down to one's taste buds or the outright need to have pasta in your diet, both I can live without thanks to cabbage, cauliflower and broccoli...all which I shred to appear like either rice or "broccoli slaw" or eat my spaghetti sauce or whatever other sauce with other ingredients without pasta.  I was diagnosed Type 2 Diabetic four months ago and despite taking insulin I couldn't get my blood sugar under control; I made the switch to LCHF and  less than a month later reduced my insulin by half and again by half and today I manage my diabetes without any insulin, pill or injection.  A reviewer used the analogy of eating rubber bands and another, cartilage and both are right.  I remember someone recommending me Dreamfield's pasta...except it tasted pretty darn good but falsely advertised it's product; it was no different than Ronzoni's Smart Taste which I allow myself to eat about once a month as a splurge treat.  I gave up long ago thinking this sort of stuff is low carb heaven and accepted it was better to retool my recipes then to allow myself to believe I couldn't live without starch; come to find out, I can.

These are terrible.  I eat a lot of diet items and have never come across something so gross.  The texture is just weird and has no flavor. It does not take the flavor of what you are cooking.  I had one package and threw the rest away. Don't waste your money people.

I have been hearing about "Paleo Noodles" for a while, so thought I would finally give them a try. Didn't love them, but didn't hate them. They come in a liquid, and almost have a fishy smell when you open them, but once they are rinsed and cooked they weren't bad. great that there are no calories, etc. and although made from fiber, did not cause any stomach discomfort. So, if you are watching your weight or carb intake, definitely give them a try!

This was a horrifying experience. I was really excited to see the noodles advertised on one of my favorite "deal" sites, and when the cost of noodles averaged out to about a dollar per package, including shipping, I decided to purchase them. I did some research on Wikipedia to make sure I wasn't secretly purchasing poison, but I should have done further research to understand what I was really buying.First off, these noodles smell like fish. Like nasty fish. They are packaged in water in what has got to be the most unappetizing presentation ever. The texture is disgusting and the noodles are this creepy, pure white. Do we have any Doctor Who fans here? Do you remember when the Tenth Doctor has opened up a Cyberman and those white cyber-innards come out? THAT IS WHAT THESE NOODLES ARE. Seriously, Google "Doctor Cyberman innards" and the first picture is of The Doctor getting ready to embark on what he doesn't yet realize will be the most depressing meal of his life.You can't even call them noodles.I tried. I really did. I washed them (ugh) and boiled them and sprinkled seasonings and alfredo sauce and shrimp. The noodles still smelled like fish, but I pressed onwards. I ate about two bites and threw the noodles out, then I went and threw out all the other packages of noodles that I had just spent about $30 on. That is how nasty these things are.

column9: If you enjoy rice noodles, can tolerate jellyfish noodles, and asian food - these are fantastic!
column10: I just discovered these while looking for low carb snacks.I am so happy I did!First, if you are looking to eat these with red marinara sauce and meatballs, I wouldn't recommend it. I am not saying don't do it (I haven't tried it yet either), but the texture and flavor or these really isn't suitable for that.I eat mine with butter, salt, Parmesan cheese, and garlic.Basically if you ever ate jelly fish noodles and liked them you will like this too. If didn't like them, well, you may still like them because they are NOT fishy or crunchy (like some review say). I really don't see how anyone can call these "fishy." I even forgot to rinse them once and didn't mind.However, if you like rice noodles you will pleasantly surprised. They have the slightly slimy, slightly "Crunchy" (has a bite to it, but really crunchy but not swishy like regular pasta) that rice noodles have. That being said, these will be FANTASTIC in pad thai.The noodles absorb flavors wonderfully and cook really fast. They taste great too. My only complaint is that the bags are a bit small and they are somewhat pricey. But if you are craving noodles or starches they work. I've eaten them more than once as a "late night binge food."They do make a great substitute for carbs and starches (NOT a substitute for a "meat" as one reviewer said) and they are quite satisfying.

column9: When is a noodle not a noodle?
column10: Well I liked the idea of the noodles. I took seasoning from an oodles of noodles packet and put it on the Shirataki noodles. Still way to much sodium there, but I was just testing them out. They were just ok. I could tell they weren't real noodles. It was a texture thing. I haven't given up on them though. I still plan on trying some of the recipes out from the web site. I also plan to try some of my own recipes out using them in place of other types of noodles. Slightly expensive at Two dollars average for a seven ounce bag. But what diet food is cheap? I even decided to buy the rice noodles and want to give them a try as well. Will get back to you on my final opinion.

I read some reviews that said the product had strange or fishy smell.  If you follow the directions  (drain, rinse, and parboil) there is no odor.  Slight odor when comes out of package but then disappears.  The texture of the noodle is great.  I like it better than pasta.  It takes on the flavors of what it's cooked with.  The only problem I had was that the nutritional information on the package was incomplete.  I contacted Miracle and they provided.  There are approximately 2 servings per package with 1.5 grams of fiber per serving....and as the package says no other calories.I can't have pasta - Blood sugar problem - so for me this Noodle is perfect.  I give it 5 stars in spite of the nutritional information shortcomings...they were easy enough to obtain from Miracle.

It is zero calories so I figured I would try. Grocery store brand was much better, but still not great. Only way that it is tolerable is after cooking them, you store them overnight with chili, spaghetti sauce, etc. It will soak up some of the flavors that do make them tolerable.

These noodles have no calories and absorb the flavor of whatever you mix them with. They have a sushi smell to them when you first open the bag however after you rinse them the smell ig gone. I love how quick I can make a meal.

Of course this cannot replace real pasta but if you're on a no-carb/low-carb diet, this is a wonderful option to have.  I just cooked one bag with tomato-based pasta sauce.  Verdict?  I am happy and satisfied.If you do not have an issue eating real pasta, I don't see why you'd settle for this.  Nothing like the real deal.But again, if you need to cut back but have the urge to eat pasta, this is a great option to have.I am stocking up.

I think these noodles are the best discovery ever!!!!  Yes, when you open it, they do smell fishy, HOWEVER, when you eat, no fishy taste at all.  I am doing the Ideal Protein Diet which has a lot of limitations and if I didn't discover these noodles to eat, it would have not been easy to stay on this diet.  The best way I found to make these noodles is stir fried with veggies.  The more water you can remove with paper towels, the better they taste IMO.  Great product that I wish I can get locally.  I find myself ordering these noodles every other week.  My picky 12 year old son who is on a gluten free diet thinks they are great too.  I make a marinara sauce with shrimp and throw over noodles and he loves it.  Great product!

column9: Best replacement for Asian noodle dishes for low carb dieting.
column10: This product and all other variations of this is a god send for people on a low carb diet and given up eating regular Asian style noodles. The key word here is Asian. This noodle won't replace those who want it as a sub for American or Italian style dishes. It's not made for it and wont work. Besides buying it here, the only other places that carry this type of "noodle" are in Asian markets. That should tell you that it's only a good replacement for Asian style noodles.This goes great with any stir fry, cold mixed, pad thai, or Pho style broth.It's super easy to prepare, just drain, wash it in cold water, blanch it in hot water and it's ready for use.These noodles are tasteless on their own so you need to add flavor to it. Cold mix it with sesame oil, soy sauce, scallions, some veggies and mix in the noodles, or add some peanut sauce. I haven't had any smelly issues as these noodles absorb the smell of the dish you cook it with.They have a chewy consistency but not to the extreme of calamari. To make it less chewy, leave it in the wok a little longer.
I like these noodles and the fact that they can take on the taste of what ever sauce you put on them.  I will be buying more in the future.

Unlike some reviews I read, these ASOLUTELY have a Fermented disgusting fish smell. The smell is OVERWHELMING.  After rinsing for 3 min it does go away, but lingers on your senses.  The "noodles" are gelatinous like clear rubber bands (fettucini).  After eating I al so find not satisfying at all and I still want something to eat.  They are also EXPENSIVE.  Basically you're buying a cup of cooked "noodles".  Too good to be sure? yes. I agree with the other reviewer;  eat the regular noodles and ride your bike more.
Love it! Very good any sauce and prawns! Easy to meal prep is quick!! Saves time too! Very satisfying. Not heavy like pasta!

Let me start by saying that these ARE NOTHING LIKE NOODLES! While they have the shape of them they taste nothing like it. I was all for adding something to my HCG diet that would help with keeping me full but I could NOT get past the texture of the "noodles".If you are an adventurous person who doesn't have texture issues, then these might be for you. My husband will have to eat the rest of the 5 packages (and he will eat anything) and he agrees that they are weird and sort of have the texture of squid.  I even followed the directions to a T but still couldn't get rid of the "fishy" smell.  I even tried holding my breath while I chewed but I couldn't past the issue of what they feel like in my mouth. And I swear I could feel what I swallowed, sticking around in my throat. It took hours for the sensation to go away.

The fact that these noodles are 0 calories earns them a few stars but they don't have many other redeeming factors. They are a little slimy in consistency and I can't imagine eating them in anything other than a stirfry dish with LOTS of sauce!
love the item,no issues, well packaged and tastes great...will continute to purchase!just toss with sauce and they are ready to go

I have now tried all the miracle noodles and have found these to be best. The consistency is closer to a chewy rice noodle, which I like and they are great with sautéed veggies! The angle-hair is also good, but the rice is really gross consistency. I cant say I dont miss traditional noodles still but these are fabulous to cut those carbs and still fill a bowl with more than just vegetables.

column9: To The Moon and Back... Welcoming "Pasta" back into my meals
column10: I absolutely love these noodles.. They are the bomb.Open package, rinse, add to your favorite pasta meal..My very favorite is to cook up bacon.. LOTS of bacon. then add my favorite garlic, ginger, mushrooms, peppers, tomatoes, whatever vegetables I have in my fridge..Add them all together, cook until tender, add a whole pkg of noodles and then shut off the fire.Throw in a large handful of fresh spinach and let wilt.  Throw in some hot chili paste and Ta-Da!!!Nothing else needed..You don't even need cheese!I have not found any other substitute that allows me my favorite pasta dishes without Gluten..Now I can have my pasta and eat it, too!Cheap, easy, they absorb whatever flavors you're cooking with, and the best part? ZERO CARB!!!!!!Now you can continue to be healthy without ever having to cheat with wheat!

column9: Zero calories but....more filling than regular pasta!
column10: I am SOOOOOOOO happy to have found these noodles!!! I've been calorie counting and these noodles have allowed me to more easily stay in my 1200 calorie daily limit....and also be gluten free! Prior to discovering these, I had taken pasta totally out of my diet. They're also so easy to prepare. For soups, Stir Fry's, etc....these are a wonderful replacement. And...I even put spaghetti sauce over them, etc....as well.....just be sure to do the last step, with the paper towel, before using them in that way or they'll be too watery.

column9: Definitely weird, but very filling and 0 calories!
column10: There is definitely a trick to these and it took me a bit before I could really figure out how to properly prepare these. When they come out of the package they have a strange almost silicone smell and a rubbery texture. I dump them directly into a colander and run hot water over them for about 30 to 50 seconds while agitating them with my hands. After this I let them dry and sometimes even blot them with a paper towel a bit otherwise the sauce just slides off. Then I dump my favorite pasta sauce on there and I'm good to go! Not the real thing but still a very satisfying zero calorie replacement!

column9: Perhaps not a 'miracle', but close enough for me!
column10: If you are looking for a pasta replacement that has the exact texture and flavor of white-flour pasta, you are barking up the wrong tree. If you are looking for a reasonable replacement for high calorie pasta dishes I think this fits the bill. First, when you open the bag there IS a definite 'fish' smell...which completely goes away when you rinse the noodles under some water. I used alfredo sauce and all I could taste was the flavor of the sauce. Second, the texture is definitely more 'rubbery' than traditional pasta...it kind of reminds me of squid tentacles. This was a bit off-putting for the first couple of bites, but by the end of the meal I was already pretty much used to the texture...I personally prefer this texture to the 'grainy' texture of whole wheat pasta, which is not even that much healthier than white flour pasta. I think after eating it a few times I won't even notice the odd texture. For me the trade-off is worth it...a bit of a texture issue for no calorie, no carb pasta? I'll take it!!

I add these noodles in with veggies cooked in the wok, soup or with spaghetti sauce.  It makes a low calorie dinner, but is very good.  Anyone who is really watching their weight will enjoy them.  Others who can't use any type of substitute won't like them.

OMG! This product is Soooo healthy BUT...It probably isn't so healthy if U can't stomach them! These noodles are just short of Gross! And to some they will indeed be way beyond Gross! I can eat just about ANYTHING...but these noodles surely slowed me down! They are like clear jello noodles...no taste except a little fishy...but the consistency is...well...GROSS! They are hard to disguise but I am trying! I cover them with a very tasty vodka spaghetti sauce...this is the only way that I have been able to eat them so far. If U purchase these...good luck! U'r gonna need it! The soy version of the shirataki noodles are much more palatable! And almost as healthy so I will stick with them!

These take a bit of work; rise them off, then boil for a bit, then try to dry them off, then fry them till squeeky, then add them to your item you're making.  Good luck trying to cut them.  They have no taste so works well in stir fry, or soup, or even spagetti sauce.  I am used to dry noodles; these are slippery and wet when you take them out of the package.  I'm not impressed.

column9: You'd be surprised they are worth the try.
column10: The texture might seem chewy and strange at first, but it's because inevitably you compare it to traditional pasta.  If you had never tried pasta, I'm sure you'd say it tastes great, and it does.  I mean, it doesn't really have a taste but it absorbs the taste of the sauce or the ingredientes you add.  I prepared the shirataki mixed with chichen and other vegetables and even with butter, herbs and spices; and I loved it.  I also had a psychological satisfaction too, knowing I was cutting down on a lot of calories and adding more fiber to my diet.  It's definitely more expensive to eat these noodles than regular pasta, but not for much.
I saw Chef Rocco D feature these and thought they must taste great! In actuality, the texture, odor and flavor was awful. I spit out my first bite and will be discarding my other packages,

Noodles arrived on time and in perfect condition, however I do not recommend this product, not the consistency I was looking for chewy like squid rings.  Not use to the texture, wish I knew what to make with them, tried pasta sauce and made a aisia noodle stir fry, both came out undesirable. Bought 12 packs, not sure what to do with the product.

I love pasta but I hate the stuffed feeling I get after eating it and the high carb content. I BOOUGHT these noodles FROM AMAZON because you can get them for a GREAT PRICE and FREE SHIPPING. I'm really don't understand all the complaints as the noodles were easy to prepare, if the instructions are followed correctly the noodles do not smell, and absorb sauces beautifully.  I've had these noodles in both hot and cold dishes and they are fabulous. No carbs, no calories, and no weight gain. HIGHLY RECOMMEND!!!!
The noodles smelled odd when I opened the bag. However, once rinsed and mixed with another dish they weren't bad at all. For no calories, they aren't bad at all.
For the price, it's a pretty solid value. The noodles are very feeling and taste just about like normal noodles to me. No carbs is a huge plus! I will be ordering these again forsure!

I canceled my ship and save on this item.  The package costs more than the local grocery store, per item.  And it's smaller in weight than the local store's product.  I was also surprised that the noodles are clear.  But in the picture, they do look clear.  The local product contains tofu to give it a more noodle-like look (and more calories).So all of that to the side, I do think this flavor of shirataki noodles are less smelly than other varieties I've tried.  And they taste like the others, which pretty much means no taste.  But they do give you somewhat the experience of eating a noodle while really saving on calories.  As with all shirataki noodles, they're a tad bit slimey and can be a little bit hard to eat at first.To use this product, I rinse it very well in a collander, trying not to smell it as it comes out of the package.  Then I heat them in the microwave 2-3 minutes to warm them up.  Rinse that water off.  Top with other things, like steamed Asian mixed vegetables.  I toss them in a little curry as well.

Used these in combination with my low-carb diet so I could indulge in spaghetti with the rest of the family.  Taste isn't an issue, because it absorbs the flavor of whatever sauce you put on it.  I wouldn't eat them alone though -- reminds me of the Lion King's comment: slimy but satisfying.

I was looking forward to trying these miracle low to no calorie noodles. Dr Oz's praises lured me to hunt them down. But the proof is in the tasting and for my family that was disappointing. Perhaps the hype was too much. I'll have a hard time disguising the last 4 packages of (fettucini-type noodles) in dishes so as to use them up.

The noodles don't really have too much taste on their own, but they have an unpleasant smell that does not seem to go away, even with rinsing.  The shipping box was damaged and I was missing one package.  Overall they are OK.  One positive is that they do help fill me up!
Great way to have "pasta" without the carbs.  Just remember to rinse.  My family can't tell the difference!I recommend for diabetics as well as anyone who wants to avoid extra calories

Miracle noodles are the best thing around.  I've made spegetti a number of times using miracle noodles and the taste is fantastic.  I've cooked for the whole family using miracle noodles and no one knew that they weren't real noodles.  We love the tast and cooking with them is very easy.
