Since realizing that my son is gluten sensitive/celiac, I have tried a lot of different GF pastas, so was excited to try this based on the great reviews. While I would agree that it is the best rice/potato based GF pastas I have had, I would not say it is the best GF pasta out there. It is still quite chewy and there is a lot of starchiness in the water when it's done cooking...like glue. Taste and texture improve when it's reheated and liquid is added for absorption. If you are looking for a GF pasta that's better than regular pasta, try the Quinoa/Corn pasta by Ancient Harvest. That is the best GF pasta in my family's opinion.

I am personally trying to eat gluten free. I purchased this product in hopes that I could still eat things like Macaroni and cheese, as long as I could find a suitable alternative for my wheat pasta. This product does exactly that. I have cooked about 6 bags of this stuff so far, and nobody can tell the difference between it and regular pasta. I have noticed that it takes about 15 minutes to cook, which is longer than normal pasta, but other than that, its perfect. If you are looking for a healthy alternative to pasta.....I would recommend that you give this product a try.

This is the best gluten free product that my husband and I have tried.  When you eat this macaroni you would never know it was gluten free.  We have tried other gluten free macaroni and will continue to buy bionaturae gluten free macaroni products.  Try it and see what I mean.

column9: Very good. Worth paying a little more for.
column10: Gluten-free foods are pretty expensive, especially for a single mom. But pasta the teen will love, and that doesn't have what seems like a 60-second window on timing for being edible, is a big deal. I have overcooked and undercooked this, and while it was apparent, it was no worse than it would be with doing the same with ordinary pasta. It makes great real mac&cheese and chicken pesto pasta and the bulk buy means I never have an excuse to eat gluten and take gluten-ease and "hope to live to do better another day" -- because I have something better at hand. I think the elbows seem ever so slightly thicker than the cheap gluten-ish stuff in the store but not enough to consciously notice unless you're looking for some difference. I wish this was cheaper but I'm willing to pay it.

My son has celiac so we have been searching for tasty pastas- this one is easier to prepare than the rice pastas (less likely to get globby) and handles sauces better- consistency is closer to wheat pasta also, has less flavor than the quinoa blends so needs a sauce to make it truly palatable-if you are looking for a pasta to go with a tomoato based sauce so with this one.

column9: No good with tomato sauce or mac & cheese sauce
column10: I tried this many years ago (same ingredients as they have now) and I really did want to like it because I know how bad regular wheat pasta if for me and I've been loving elbow macaroni since I was a kid and  hoped I could make my own mac and cheese out of this. But white rice also gives me tummy trouble and this is made mostly of white rice. But that's not the only reason I gave it just 2 stars. As I've said in my other bionaturae pasta reviews, if I had to eat gluten free I'd rather give up pasta than eat this stuff. All of their pastas are made from the same "formula" (that's what they call it). And no matter how many times I've tried it, different types of pastas, different cooking times, they all taste chewy and sticky. The taste is not horrible but texture just ruins the entire eating experience.My full review is below. This review will not show as a verified Amazon purchase because I bought mine locally. But if you do choose to buy this and can't get it locally, Amazon Prime is the way to go. Check out Amazon Prime (http://www.amazon.com/gp/prime) for details on how to get Amazon Prime shipping perks for free, or ask me about it.~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~PROS:> Organic> Gluten Free> Kosher (circle K symbol)> Produced at a dedicated gluten free facility with no risk of cross contamination with dairy, tree nuts, peanuts, or eggs.> The manufacturer is one of a select few in Italy who are authorized by the Italian Ministry of Health to produce gluten free pasta. The factory tests for the presence of gluten during each production cycle. Independent testing is also done at a laboratory in the United States on each lot before the products are distributed in this country.> The actual taste is a little like regular pasta. But the texture was so bad I couldn't finish it.~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~CONS:> Tacky, sticky, chewy. It was so chewy it stuck to my teeth.  They claim it has a true pasta-like texture. As an Italian-American from NY who has been eating pasta of all kinds regularly for over 50 years, for me it does not have the "true pasta-like" texture as they claim. Like I said, sticky, chewy, tacky.> It felt like wet cement in my stomach. It made me constipated because it is not made from whole grains. And smothering it with my special melted cheese sauce didn't help any. It just made it heavier in my tummy.> Being organic and gluten free is the only thing I can see good about this stuff. But as I've mentioned in other reviews, poop can be organic and gluten free but that doesn't mean you should eat it. Sorry if that sounds crude, but I think it really goes make a good point.> It is expensive, but if you have already tried this and like it and can't get it locally, then Amazon Prime is the way to go. I was eager to try these after I heard about them, but ended up being rather disappointed.  I love chocolate and marshmallows and thought this mix looked delicious, so I picked it over the other varieties available.  Unfortunately, the mini marshmallows are nothing like marshmallows -- I was expecting them to be like those found packaged with hot chocolate or in cereals, but they're solid little sugar pellets that are way too hard to chew comfortably.  The graham cracker pieces are also overly crunchy and unpleasant.  The coconut flakes, which I would generally imagine are hard to mess up, seem to be more sugar than coconut...they pretty much melt in your mouth, but not in the good way.  The milk chocolate candies are good (mine did not contain peanut butter as another reviewer mentioned), as are the cocoa roast almonds and honey roasted peanuts.I had been wanting to try the Chocolate Cherry mix, but after this experience, I'm not so sure.  Emerald had a good idea that was, unfortunately, shoddily executed and left me with the opinion that they should stick with what they know...nuts.

column9: Other Emerald trail mixes are better
column10: These are alright, but I really don't like candy peanut butter (even though I do like the stuff you get in a brand-name jar).  I've also never heard of making smores with peanut butter, but for some reason these have a bunch of little M&M-sized peanut butter candy things inside.  Also, the marshmallow-like extrusions are pretty hard to crunch up.  Overall, I liked this reasonably well (the graham chunks are good, as are the cocoa almonds and honey-roasted peanuts - and even the hard marshmallows), but the peanut butter really turns me off.  If you, however, enjoy the way the peanut butter-like filling in a generic Reeces peanut butter cup tastes, and you think you would like that taste on smores, you may also like this. :)

I bought these when my local grocery store didn't carry the Emerald S'Mores Trail Mix.  It was a great price at just about $.46 per ounce.  Since the packages are bigger it doesn't provide any portion control but that's easily fixed with snack size ziploc bags.  Great product, tastes great and great price. Would definitely buy again.

I love this snack mix and it was supposed to be a package of 6 bags (5.5ounce each).  I received only 1 bag!  And thereturn policy prohibits this from being returned.  $13.00 for i tiny snack bag -BEWARE of these food items on Amazon.

if you got a sweet tooth this trail mix isnt bad but it really lacks fruit. i took a handful of these bags on a five day kayak trip down the james river and the first thing i realized was how much better it would be with raisins or cranberries fortunately i had these with me and added them into my mix every morning before launching. other then that great flavor and the price was good.
This trail mix is great! It is the perfect mixture of salty and sweet. This is great for a snack and it sticks with you.
I love this mix! It is the perfect sweet snack. The only bad thing about them is that it is hard to put a bag away after opening it.  :]

column9: Beware!!  These are addictive!!  Great Snack!!
column10: There is only 1 problem with these . . . Once I open a bag, it is VERY hard for me to put it away without finishing it!!  I'm not really a fan of almonds, but the cocoa almonds in the Emerald S'mores Trail Mix are even pretty good!  The last time I bought these locally, I paid $2.29 + Tax/Each at Kroger here in Columbia, TN.

I love Emerald Trail Mixes and this one certainly fulfills the need for chocolate while still eating healthy. I would recommend this to any chocoholic who is looking to eat small energy snacks throughout the day. Great to take on the go!

I love this stuff. I ran the New Years Eve Emerald 4 mile run in NYC this year, and I got a free bag of the smores mix. I've been addicted to it ever since.some stores refuse to carry it, and it's their lose.best tasting trail mix I ever had..MM

column9: Nice mix of crunch and soft, salty and sweet
column10: Overall this product tastes amazing.  Its crunch is a bit hard.  The graham cracker cubes are tasty but take a bit to get through.  Even the marshmallows are dry and crunch.  Most of the chewy soft comes from large coconut flakes and the soft centers of candy covered chocolate pieces (think M&M's).  The nuts are typical, good crunch Emerald quality.  I am a big fan of their Cocoa Roasted Almonds so when I saw this mix on sale at my grocery store I had to give it a try.  It would be very difficult to not eat the entire bag in one sitting.  I measured mine into one ounce servings and then put them where I could not see them so that I have to think of it to find it.  Yes, it is that tasty.  If I see it I will want it and will therefore eat it.  I typically have respectable self control around food, but sweetened nuts seem to be a weakness of mine.

The Stonewall Kitchens Cheddar Asiago Cheese Sticks taste great. These have great cheesey taste. I love the way Stonewall Kitchens mix different flavors together to make great tasting treats and this one fits in perfectly. These have a very rich Cheddar Asiago taste and the crunchness may them great for dipping or just eating plain. Great value for your money.

column9: Some of the best tea I've ever had...wait, maybe it is the best
column10: A friend gave me a gift certificate to the spa where she works for my b-day last year. I got to swim, relax, and drink this tea. I swear on anything, that I wanted to steal ALL of the tea from the place. I also had the ML Ginger Twist. If I could live on tea, these would be my sustenance. I can't say enough about this tea, and am obviously not as well-spoken/written as the other reviewers -- but, dang! this tea is goood.

column9: Another wonderful tea from Mighty Leaf
column10: For some reason this tea is listed only as Jasmine, but for those of you looking for "Mountain Jasmine" this is it!  This tea smells of Jasmine and makes a glorious afternoon tea as it is light on caffeine.

Organic Spring Jasmine is a nice light to medium tea with a calming scent of jasmine coming from the cup. The jasmine part isn't overwhelming like other blends can be, but it's more like a delicate floral aroma behind the main taste of the China green tea in the bag. The green tea itself tastes fairly delicate yet still green, without being very vegetal or fishy, like some greens can be. The ingredients are of high quality, and it has a medium to heavy body, or "mouth" feel, for a tea. Combined, the flower & tea work in perfect tandem; when sipping the cup you first get the floral of jasmine, then you get the beautiful flavor of green tea. So yummy! I would call it a perfect pairing.When I serve this to anybody, they immediately say "Oooh I LIKE this!" (or some iteration of that), and then ask from where do I get the tea. Then, they either start the same scouring high and low for the tea that I once did, or they plain out ask me to buy some for them because they can't stop thinking about it once they've had it.Note: Mighty Leaf teas are the best bagged teas; they have quality handcrafted silk-like tea pouches that let the leaves (yes, LEAVES) inside fully steep & expand without adding any additional "bag" flavor, as some paper bags do. This creates an exceptional cup of tea for the individual. They just scream "quality". Once you see one of the bags, you will probably want to get some for yourself, too. I'd say Mighty Leaf teas would make great gifts for tea lovers.Thanks to Amazon, Organic Spring Jasmine is now a staple in my home - through the subscribe & save, you can get a 3-pack for around $15 at the time of this writing, which is quite a deal considering the quality of tea you get for a comparable price to supermarket brands. I hope they continue to supply it forever since I now drink it every day.

column9: Please bring this back to the subscribe and save program!
column10: I love this tea. This is by far the best Jasmine tea available in mass-retail shops. I just wish it was still part of the subscribe and save program!

This is a nice green tea, but while it has a nice hint of jasmine in the bag it really gets lost in brewing so that this really just tastes more like a good green tea.  If that's what you're after I'd recommend this tea, but if you're after a more jasmine fragrance and flavor experience I find this one a little weak.  The Adagio Jasmine I used to order (now I guess listed as an Oolong by them) was much more to my liking, but it also was a bit overpowering to some so like everything it comes down to personal taste.

As a devotee of Mighty Leaf teas, I decided to try the Jasmine tea. Having never tried it before, I was pleasantly surprised at the light, smooth flavor and the amazing smell coming from the steaming hot cup! I'm obsessed with Jasmine tea now!

I just love this tea. It is delicious and also comes in biodegradable pouches, what could be better? It is a delicious taste of jasmine and it is great that it only has light caffeine. I would recommend this tea any day!

Actually I was looking for 'jasmine mist', which I was hooked after staying in a lovely hotel.  Instead, I decided to try the organic spring jasmine:it still had that lovely fragrant and taste of the jasmine mist, but a tad less strong.  it was just peeerrrfect.  One bag held its flavor for a large teapot, if you want it stronger then just use it with a good size mug.  I normally like my tea strong, so this tea held its own in terms of flavor and strength.  Sometimes, I just allow the tea to go cold and there is no lost in fragrant and flavor.  So glad that amazon is supporting this brand.

I am insanely MAD for this tea! (Is that redundant?) It's not just the perfume of jasmine, but there's some mysterious astringency that happens on my tongue. With a dash of agave nectar for a hint of sweetness... I cannot get enough of this brew.

This is my favorite green tea.  I tried many different kinds when I was cutting back on coffee and this was the best.  It is the perfect blend of green tea flavor and jasmine, not too flowery.  It has a wonderful smell as well.  I enjoyed drinking and smelling this tea as much as I had previously enjoyed my first morning coffee.  Also the tea bag material makes it easier to save and rebrew for a second serving.

'Nuf said. I'm like a crack addict with this stuff; store-bought, dried-out flakes just won't cut it anymore after having this stuff. I love it so much that I make sure to order well in advance of me running out--can't risk going without or [horror!] being forced to buy subpar tea from the grocery store. EXCELLENT.

I am a tea lover, biased more towards strong black tea,and often times make mix my own version of customized tea (brewed). This mild jasmine teas, has captivated my taste buds, surprisingly flavorful for a tea bag. It is not bitter at all, with a pleasant taste and aroma.

I wish this wasn't so expensive (at least it's about 33% cheaper here on Amazon).  I first tried this as the standard tea served at Din Tai Fung in Bellevue, WA.  I immediately fell in love.  Definitely a step above brands like Twinings (my wife doesn't think so, but the difference is marked).  You can taste the difference in the whole leaf in the bag.  The floral flavor is pronounced yet doesn't overpower the tea.  Lovely cup.
This is the best green tea ever.  Ihave purchased several boxes and will continue to buy it.  It is a little pricey but worth it.
This is a light but flavorful green tea and for once a bag really does make two cups! The jasmine flavor is just right for me, light but definite.
This herbal tea is well worth every penny. It is refreshing and unlike any other herbal tea I have had!
If you are a tea lover like myself, you will LOVE this jasmine tea! It has so much flavor and depth to it! HIGHLY RECOMMEND!

I am a huge tea fan. I drink hot tea more than I drink cold water throughout the day. So, it is easy to say that I am very picky when it comes to my tea. I have tried tons of different flavors and tons of different brands. My friend recommended Mighty Leaf and I decided to give it a try. The second that the three-minute brew time was up, I immediately smelled one of the greatest scents I have experienced. The jasmine is not too strong and not too weak. While drinking the first cup that I made for myself, it actually made me feel very relaxed. There is a perfect ratio of herbs to 1 tea-bag. I am very glad that my friend gave me the recommendation and hope to buy a case of other flavors to try.

It's fragrant and delicious!  In the warm months, I make a whole pot with one teabag, and add a little bit of honey, then let it cool, and put in the fridge, and drink ti as iced tea.  I love this stuff and drink it every day!  And buying it from amazon in this 3 pack for $21 is much more economical than buying each box individually - they run about $10 per box in New York City.
I have ordered this tea product for years. Recently I ordered and paid for a pack of 3.  I received a 2 pack.  What a rip off!!!

column9: Didn't get what I paid for!
column10: Description says 45 total whole leaf pouches but I only received 15.  Extremely disappointed and I feel completely ripped off.

column4: W. Robert Kiser "Happily living in Tidewater"
column10: These anchovies were wonderful!  They were intact (not mushy) and very flavorful.  When I bought these they were eligible for Free Shipping, which made the deal even better.
As Anchovies go, these seem to be great tasting. I think they taste great in salads and Pizza. These are full flavored Anchovies which anchovy lovers will like.

My husband and I were so tired of buying those mushy canned anchovies in the supermarket. We both love anchovies and these are perfect. They're nice and firm, if a bit large. I do have to remove some of the larger bones, but all good anchovies are like that. I did notice that the oil they're packed in gets a little thick when kept in the refrigerator, but we just blotted it off before adding them to our salad. Try them on buttered saltines - delicious! I will be buying them again.

You love them, don't love them or you will never try eattinganchovies. That is usually the way it is. For those of you whoare passionate and really enjoy eatting anchovies then givethis product a try. Whether eatting them just because, puttingthem in salad or saving some money and putting them on pizzaslices, this product does not disappoint. Not much more to addif you have read the other positive reviews here about thisparticular product. Upon placing the order the product arrived8 days later. My only issue was one of the bottles appearedslighty ajar and the oil/liquid had slightly leaked out. Theproduct seemed well packed so I can only assume it may havebeen roughed up by the delivery company. All things consideredgiving this product five stars and I highly recommend.

column9: Couldn't find any bottled anchovies in my area....sooo
column10: The only anchovies I could buy in my area were canned and could not be reused after opening. I had a left over bottle of Bellino and found them on Amazon.  Unfortunately, I ordered four bottles and one leaked in the box.  I contacted the seller and they more than willingly refunded me.  Thank you for such speedy service and for such a great solution to my search.  A satisfied customer.

i use these for pizza and there the best! they dont fall apart and cook nice. my friend likes to drink martinis with anchovy stuffed olives but all the store bought ones lose the stuffing because they are filled with a paste. so he stuffs his own and these work fanastic. if you like anchovies get these.

I'm not an expert and only use anchovies occasionally which is why these are perfect: in glass and olive oil they sit waiting patiently in my fridge to be used in a sauce or dressing to add just the right bit of salt or umami flavor.

column4: A Research It Maven "Just the facts please"
column9: Check out the REAL weight of these before you buy!
column10: Zoom in on this image and you will see there are three (3) 12 ounce jars in this item - two asparagus and one green beans. That makes them over twelve dollars apiece! The info here on Amazon says 47 total ounces. Not true! and Gerties is better asparagus, anyway! Gertie's Finest ® Pickled Green Asparagus (1 case contains 6-34.5 oz jars with Free Shipping).

Pearl couscos is different from regular couscos in that it has a better mouth feel. It absorbs the flavors of various spices well, so it can taste as varied as your imagination and cooking skills allow. We love this product and will order it regularly.
Probably the best soda I've ever had. The beer and the lemonade go very well together. Very pleasant. twenty words kdkal;dsfjj jjlaksdjf

This is the best non alcoholic beverage I have ever enjoyed. Just delicious, and a natural product without any scary chemicals or weird engineered hi-syrup corn fructose stuff.There is nothing like a cold beer on a hot day, or so I thought - Shandy soda has that same refreshing, thirst -quenching quality, without the buzz (and calories) from alcohol.

My wife recently came back from the States, and she brought back a bunch of yummy treats including a bag of these jelly bird eggs. These eggs are not sour by any means although the mixed berry is slightly tart. This is actually my favorite flavor. The lemon eggs don't get me very excited; however, my daughters are a fan of them. My wife actually thinks these eggs for the birds. It should be noted that she doesn't care for super sweet desserts. I enjoy these guys so much that the sinner in me wants to hide in a corner and eat the whole bag in one sitting. I know that is wrong so I only eat a few at a time and share them with my daughters. I'm a good boy. I do want to say that my wife only paid a buck for this 9 oz bag at Wally World.

column9: Very good coffee for my Bunn MC
column10: I have finished using the Keurig because I went through 2 in one year; and they are not cheap.  They never seem to last for me anymore.  I also was having a tough time finding the coffee I liked.  I really wanted something that had a fresher taste.  I wanted something made in the USA so I bought a Bunn MC.  I am happy with it as far as a single serve coffee maker goes.  However,  I was having a tough time finding good coffee.  I went on Amazon, and researched.  I bought a sample pack, one that was called "Mahale Highlands" (not this brand however) was in the sample pack and I really liked it.  I found this particular brand (Wolfgang Puck) and it was cheaper and I got a larger quantity.  It is a very good coffee; not bitter and I feel that the product is of high quality.  The taste is evenly balanced and has a fresh taste the Keurig pods were lacking.  I have made this coffee for other people and they agreed:  it was a very good cup of coffee.

column9: Superb rub for pork and lamb...
column10: As a spice mix fan, I have to give a strong thumbs-up for Chef Tom's Pork Rub.  The dominant notes in this mix are cumin, coriander, and chile.  This isn't a hot mix per se - if you want to kick things up a notch, I'd recommend adding a dash of cayenne - but it is excellent.  Only the two standout mixes that Chef Tom sells: Chef Tom Douglas Rub With Love Salmon Rub and Chef Tom Douglas Rub With Love Chicken Rub are better.This is best on baby back ribs, lamb chops, and pork roast.  I only remove a star because the mix isn't that versatile: it's not particularly suited for spicing up soup, chicken, or fish.

I applied this rub onto a pork shoulder and let it sit overnight in the fridge. I smoked it for 10 hours the next day and the meat turned out fabulously. The rub gave a definite spice to the shoulder but I found it heavy on the paprika and somewhat sour with an after-taste. The ingredients were very straightforward and pretty much what you find in almost all of the rub recipes online but I think I'd prefer a little sweetness to complement the meat.  Next time I'll try mixing my own spices but it'd be handier to have everything pre-mixed.

column9: Great Rub for Pork and Lamb
column10: Very nice, balance rub for pork OR lamb.  Best if it is allowed to sit on the meat overnight and then grill the next day.  Interesting blend that is slight spicy but really brings out flavor.  This is expensive, but you do not need very much for full effect.  I realize that I could blend my own but it is nice to reach in the pantry and come out with quick flavoring variety.

column9: If you love ginger and tea, you HAVE to have this
column10: Might Leaf Teas are my absolute favorite teas and this is my favorite flavor.  Mighty Leaf teas so much more flavorful because they are basically loose tea in a fabric tea bag.  If you're wondering if they are worth the price, my suggestion is to buy one box and be amazed at the difference.  This can be the "special" tea in your collection.  The ginger flavor in this tea is wonderful, and it's complimented by the fruity flavors of tropical fruit and lemongrass.
This is the most amazing brand of tea I have ever had... I'm going to try other flavors.

Just tried this tea in a restaurant for the first time and fell in love. So happy to find it here. I love ginger tea but this has a lot of other flavors too that make it oh so yummy. I sweeten with stevia for a quilt free drink.
Love their products but they are not cheap.  I buy on Amazon because local retailers charge an arm and a leg for Mighty Leaf.  With prime shipping and lack of tax it is cheaper to buy this route.

After reading the many glowing reviews of MightyLeaf Tea, I thought that I would splurge for a real treat.  Unfortunately, my first cup was not at all tasty.  I do not normally use a sweetener in my tea.  However, I tried a second cup with a sweetener and it was fine but not exceptional for the price. Since the MightyLeaf tea bags have leaves of many plants, it is not clear how consistency is maintained.  Maybe, I just got a bad tea bag.

column9: Nice, but a little too much licorice
column10: I made a cup of this tea using a 1/2 tsp of honey and steeped it mildly (light yellow color). The first half of the cup was very nice, although I didn't taste much ginger. The second half of the tea started to taste strongly of licorice/anise, which unfortunately I don't like.

I wanted to have a more healthy type of mushroom on hand for cooking other than the canned variety so tried these.  I let them "reconstitute" for quite a while (a couple of hours...though package says half an hour...) based on reviews of other dried mushrooms.  Though they're mushroom caps, there still was a small stem portion on a few and even after all that soaking, they were still rather tough so I cut them off before cooking.  They cooked well (used them in beef stroganoff and also sauteed them with butter on their own) and they tasted good. Only issue was the odor they gave off when soaking - very strong/not pleasant - but this didn't affect taste at all. Will definitely use again/keep on hand for when I can't get fresh mushrooms.

Look elsewhere for a better DEAL on Amazon by buying bulk than this ripoff OVERPRICED item.Besides, these contain stems/partial stems, which not only cheapens the price but wounds up uneven done-ness. If you want best quality, your best bet would be to look for stem-free (caps only) variety even though they tend to cost more. From one gourmet chef to another, hope it helps.

column9: last time these were sliced, not whole caps
column10: howdy y'all,last time i ordered these they were sliced, not whole caps. i far prefer them that way and won't be ordering this version. it's quite odd that amazon refers to this item as the same i ordered last time. [*grin*]if the sliced version returns, then this is a quite tasty and very easy to use item.i would rate this a FOUR if the item was what i had bought previously. since it has changed to something very different, i'll rate it a THREE.take care,lee
I am happy with this purchase. Shiitake mushrooms are supposed to be a very healthy food, and these 1 oz packages make it easy to keep a supply on hand. They taste fine too.

This pasta is by far my favorite brand. I've tried others and this one is delicious!!! I don't taste a diff. b/w this and regular pasta anymore. I've gotten my whole family to eat it and they love it too. I highly recommend it!
These cook up a little fast and so you have to be careful not to over cook them.  Other than that, they taste great and are very good for you.  Win-win!
Family and friends can't tell the differnce between this and wheat pasta.  It's great and reheats well.

If you don't have a stove, you can microwave this, too.Microwave Tinkyada Baked Penne(Ahem.)Ingredients:Bag of Tinkyada PenneJar of spaghetti sauce  (The large kind. Muir Glen is gluten-free)1 cup waterceramic dishsaran wrap or a plate about the size of the ceramic dish1200 watt microwaveOptional:Parmesan, vegan parmesan, or merlotPour half the bag of penne into the ceramic dish.  Cover the pasta with the entire jar of pasta sauce.  Add one cup water.  Mix well. Cover the ceramic dish with saran wrap or a plate, leaving a small corner uncovered to vent.  Set the microwave to run for 45 minutes on 50% power.Walk away.  Contemplate world peace, or have a nice glass of merlot.  After 45 minutes, take the ceramic dish out of the microwave.  Sprinkle with parmesan or vegan parmesan.("Yes, it's really cooked." Tinkyada is amazing.)

Yummmmmmmmmmmmmm!!! Finally, gluten free pasta that TASTES GREAT! No weird aftertaste, and it cooks up al dente. Granted, as with any other GF pasta, it takes about twice as long to cook as non-GF pasta, but at least this Tinkyada pasta doesn't fall apart as soon as it's cooked. Tinkyada pasta holds up for reheating. You can use this Tinkyada Penne with some leftover marinara sauce like Bertolli Organic Sauce - Traditional Tomato & Basil - 24 Oz. Glass Jar (Pack of 3) and some pepperonis or Italian sausage slices, top it with some cheese, and viola you have a quick weeknight dinner. Or, toss some of the Tinkyada penne with some Purdue Italian Grilled Chicken Strips, a little seasoned olive oil, some presliced onion+peppers, some Parmesan cheese... Throw some Udi's GF dinner rolls on the side, a bottle of wine... just sayin'  :-)Tinkyada pastas of all varieties are a staple in our pantry:Tinkyada Brown Rice Lasagne with Rice Bran, 10-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 12)Tinkyada Brown Rice Elbows with Rice Bran, 16-Ounce Packages (Pack of 12)Tinkyada Brown Rice Spaghetti with Rice Bran, 16-Ounce Packages (Pack of 12)Tinkyada Brown Rice Spirals with Rice Bran,  Gluten Free, 16-Ounce Packages (Pack of 12)Tinkyada Brown Rice Fusilli, 16-Ounce Packages (Pack of 12)Tinkyada Brown Rice Fettuccini Style with Rice Bran, 14-Ounce Packages (Pack of 12)Tinkyada does it ALL gluten free, and they do it ALL VERY WELL!!  :-)

column9: Didn't care for the clumpiness or flavor
column10: These noodles are thicker than normal which is why the longer cooking time and claim to won't fall apart.  I found they clumped together while cooking and I didn't care for the flavor.  I much prefer Mrs. Leeper's Pasta Organic, Rice Vegetable Twists, 12 Ounce Bags (Pack of 12)

The tinkyada pastas are the best.  It is the only one I buy.  I have had celiac for over 9 years and have tried many different pastas.  The brand cooks great and tastes great.  When we have people over for dinner they don't even know it gf.  They are always surprised when we tell them.

This is the best gf pasta. I make it for myself and for non gf family. They  agree that it tastes like "regular" pasta. Does not get mushy and never has stuck together as one reviewer noted.  I make this at home and I bring it to restaurants. They are happy to cook it in a clean pot and use "designated utensils" to avoid cross contamination.  Buying it from Amazon is a great money saver and is delivered to my door!Tinkyada Brown Rice Penne Pasta with Rice Bran, 16-Ounce Packages (Pack of 12)Try it..you'll really enjoy it! Also have tried the spagetti , spiral and elbow shells!

As I've said of all Tinkyada products we use, it's fabulous.  In fact, it's hard to over-state how good this is.  I've tried whole wheat pasta in the past and found it bitter.  Once we tried this, even my husband stopped asking for white flour pasta.

This pasta is amazing!  I have served it to non-GF extended family and they could not tell the difference between this and semolina pasta.  Just be sure to check the pasta frequently as it cooks - rice pasta behaves differently than regular pasta and can go from perfect to mushy in no time flat.  All rice pastas are NOT created equally and Tinkyada is the best!

I highly recommend this pasta.  And I love being able to buy the organic in bulk quantities since the stores seldom have more than four packages at a time!!This pasta has a wonderful texture and taste.  My husband is vegan and has a gluten allergy.  This pasta fills our needs for everything that you would use standard wheat pasta in:  Pasta salads, pasta with pesto, pasta with tomato sauce and our favorite, Mac and Cheeseless casserole.  Tinyada doesn't get mushy like other rice pastas.  I have used both the organic and regular and have been equally satisfied, buy prefer to buy organic if at all possible.I can highly recommend this product as a cook of more than fifty years!
This is a good product.  If you have to eat gluten free, this is a must.

I ordered these, even though the price was high to see if Necco was still as good, and it's delicious. Beware, however, if you want nice whole wafers...about 1/2 the rolls in the bag contained all/part broken pieces.
I use many DeLallo pastas.  They are definitely top of the line.  You won't regretspending a little more and buying these products.

I recently picked up a couple of packs of this mix at a local dollar store.  Like most people I am familiar with Marie Callender's products and I figured for a dollar, how bad could it be.  Well now that I have sampled it I am afraid that I have to agree with the other reviewer here that says its taste is downright weird, and honestly speaking, not like cornbread at all.  I followed the directions by adding an egg, milk, and oil, (1/4 cup of each) as directed, and even though it said it could be cooked in the microwave in a couple of minutes, I opted for the oven figuring it would come out better.  It cooked up easy and fast enough but that is where the pleasure of this mix ended its virtues.  Unlike most cornbread I have baked it rises really high in the cup and is very light and fluffy.  And it's is not crumbly like most good corn bread is either.  As for it's taste, there is next to none in my opinion.  I was taking big bites of the muffins with a generous amount of butter on them and still couldn't get a hint of corn bread flavor. And trust me when I say I have tried many different corn bread mixes in the past.  Everything from Jiffy to Larry The Cable guys brand. What taste I did sense was truly downright strange.  Not really awful, but as tasteless a cornbread I have ever had. It reminded me more of a cheap cake mix in texture and taste than a cornbread. I'm not even going to bake the other pouch I have. In conclusion, I would not recommend this mix to anyone, at any price I'm afraid... : (

I bought these because another comment said these were better than Jiffy. I think these are terrible and I like Jiffy much better. These don't taste anything like the corn muffins I make from scratch. They don't even taste much like corn. They're just plain weird.Also, another reviewer said that you "just add water," but these require eggs and milk. Maybe that person got a different product which also tastes good.Don't buy these. They're so bad I'm going to donate the remaining packs to a food bank.

We tried these on a whim (Can you really go wrong with Marie Calender's?) after eating the Jiffy brand ones for some time. These taste better, and are just as quick and easy to make. Just add water! We'll definitely buy these again.

I suppose doing it from scratch might be better (might be) but for a quick and fabulous corn bread, this is it. Although it's good as is, I like to add an egg and some plain Greek yogurt instead of oil for a total protein grab-on-the-go meal.

I was not impressed with this. It is Extremly dry! Has very little taste. I even tried adding honey & brown sugar, helped a little. I will skip this brand & stay with jiffy or red mill stuff which is better.

If you are in a hurry and just want that wonderful taste of fresh made bread, these Marie Callender's corn muffins fit the bill.  Just add water. No need for all those extra mixings.  I love the simplicity.Bake for 20 minutes or so and pull out your fresh baked corn muffins.  I grew up in the south and corn bread is such a comfort food to me.  It is so great to be able to have some so quickly with little to clean up.Overall- I highly recommend these muffins.

These are California dates. Sweet yet not very fleshy, rather tough and dry. The ones I purchased came in a plastic bag with a ziplock.If you are used to the wonderful medjool dates, which are the perfect snacking date because of their large size, soft flesh and delightful sweetness, you will probably not like these ones.However, for cooking/baking these are fine.

This has been my favorite brand of pitted dates for some time now. The last batch however had an actual living moth that flew out of the container when I opened it and at least half the dates were infected with maggots. The smaller batch containers I get at the supermarket are fine.

I buy these dates from a local market in Houston, and I go through a box in about a week or two .. they're so good ..Yes, some of them are dry (which I prefer), and some are soft.  It really depends on the batch, but you get a bit of both in each package (ratios vary per package).Dates go perfect with nuts.  whether it's walnuts or almonds, but I found "blue diamond oven roasted sea salt almonds" to be a perfect match.  I stuff each date with 1 or 2 almonds, and I get a perfect combination of sweet and salty .. try it!This is an excellent snack that has lots of fiber, and it tastes great!

This was my first time eating dates, so I've nothing to compare them to, but what I can say about them is that they're mildly sweet, but a little drier than I expected. They work fine as an ingredient, but I don't think they're good to snack on or eat plain.
VERY GOOD, THE DATES WERE VERY GOOD.THEY WERE JUST WHAT I WAS LOOKING.I WILL GET THEM AGAIN.THEY WERE A LITTLE SWEET, BUT YOU GET USE TO THAT. THEY MAKE ME GO EVERY DAY.

The dates were fine, but note that the packaging was rectangular, not round.Since we were sending these on, this required repacking to fit the gift tin.Not an issue if you're taking the dates out of the packaging anyway, but FYI...

I've got a bit of a sweet tooth. Doesn't everyone? Well, I try not to keep candy and related sugar-packed items around the house because if I do, they'll disappear. But I do like sweets now and then. I've found a wonderful natural substitute: a product put out by Sun Date. I buy 2-pound (32-ounce) containers of dates, very much like illustrated here and put out by the same company. I found them at my local warehouse club. The ones I buy are Fancy Medjool Dates with pits. The ones listed here are unspecified pitted dates. I'm sure either would work, perhaps equally well. In any case, these dates make a wonderful sweet treat for people who are trying to stay away from manufactured sweets. Plus they offer a good source of dietary fiber. Outstanding snack!Gary Peterson

I ordered this product and am using it to make sugarfree ice cream in my ice cream maker. Combining sugarfree Jello vanilla pudding mix, 2 cups of this product, 1/4 cup of Splenda, 1 tsp. of vanilla and 3+ cups of milk makes a pretty tasty ice cream.

I stopped using dairy about a year ago. The hardest thing was trying to find a "creamer" for my coffee. I was using almond milk, but it just wasn't adding the creamy goodness of half and half. The first time I tried this product, it had been sent to me by mistake when I ordered the unsweetened version. What a great mistake! I am SO pleased to find a product that is healthy, dairy-free, and tastes great in my coffee! I have not had the problems someone mentioned about separating, etc. Don' let the "sweetened without sugar" aspect scare you. It's very lightly sweetened with one of the healthier sugar alternatives [erythritol].
This product is good in tea.  However, it does separate(depending on the tea) or curdle just as some creamers will in fruit teas.

I had originally purchased this product at a local supermarket and had liked it very much. When the store no longer carried it, I turned to the internet. MimicCreme is a great non-dairy, non-chemical (all natural) cream substitute. I use it in recipes (especially soups and desserts) that call for cream. My husband likes it so much, he often drinks it plain!

I've purchased the cane sugar version of this product which was too sweet for me and now am on my third order of this product. I use it daily for my coffee (Hagen organic freeze dried) and no longer add stevia. It reminds me of oat milk and does not have a nutty flavor, more of a slight caramel flavor to me. I'm perplexed another reviewer did not like it in their coffee although I guess if one is used to diary and has not experimented w/ other "milks" it might be too different. I hope they will make an organic version in the future.

I LIKE THE PRODUCT VERY MUCH BUT BE AWARE THAT THE "BEST BY" DATE IS FEBRUARY 5, 2012. I MAY NOT HAVE ORDERED IT HAD I KNOWN THE DATE, BUT THE PRICE THAT I PAID WAS VERY LOW COMPARED TO THE CURRENT LIST PRICE. THE CURRENT LIST PRICE COULD REFLECT FRESHER PRODUCT....

column9: Gross in coffee -- maybe for other cream uses but NOT for coffee!
column10: Bought this because it's advertized as good as a coffee creamer too.  I found the taste pretty bad for use in coffee.  Avoid! Get the stuff that actually says coffee creamer on the box itself. I'm giving one star because of poor advertising. Maybe this works okay as a substitute for other cream uses. Not sure yet.
Lab, Golden, and even my Yorkie love these. 4 of 5 stars--- only because they do not smell very good to me. The package must remain tightly sealed, otherwise the cupboard smells terrible.

My senior dog just loves these. I try to buy 2 packages at a time, so we don't run out. The only down side is when she brings it to bed, I wake up with little shards in the sheets.  Oh well.  They seem to keep her teeth tarter free. I trust this product, there is nothing but beef ligament, no additives, no perservatives, nothing but lig.  I highy recommend this product.
We love this sauce.  Not only a great marinade for grilling, it is also great to use as a condiment for burgers, etc.  Great tasting!
These little plums are hard to find where I live! Please get more varieties...no seed  and sweet and salty.  I have had toOrder from Hawaii! Freight kills! These are pretty good!
This tea helps me sleep through the night.  I avoid meds, and this tea works for me.  I just wish they would bring it back as tea bags.
This item is no longer in the stores, was so glad I found it on Amazon.

column9: Republic of Tea - Ginger Peach and Ginger Peach White - YUMMMY
column10: I guess we have all been conned into believing tea cannot be good from a bag.  You have to be a true snob to believe that after you've had Republic of Tea.  I've tried at least a dozen and, so far, my favorites are Republic of Tea Ginger Peach and Ginger Peach White bagged teas.  It's a bit expensive but, if having a smooth and flavorable cup of tea is your thing, this is The Tea for a delightful morning brew.  The smell is exquisite and the taste is soothing and full-bodied.  It has no bitter aftertaste, no sting, no bite.  Just wonderful taste and small.  You've love it!

This was a beautiful example of a "Sharps Pygmy Japanese Maple". It looks just like the picture...usually not the case. The packaging was excellent and arrived very quickly. As slow as this tree grows...pay a little extra and don't be disappointed. Two thunbs up for BonsaiOutlet!!!!

In general, I'd recommend that you would go to a local brewing store and work out exactly what you need and want to get started brewing your own beer. You'd likely end up with a setup that is pretty similar to this one. That leaves price and flexibility as the main issues. Glancing at a brewing catalog, it looks like this setup isn't a bad deal pricewise. And of course if you don't have a local brewing store, then buying this one is that much easier. Do compare the items included in any of these kits, there are a lot of them listed on amazon, some for as little as half of the price of this one. And remember that you can save a lot of shipping cost by buying kits without bottles. Use your own collected bottles.

Ordered and received kit in Jan 2011. Started brewing March 3 2011, drank first bottle around April 4. Bavarian Hefweizen, very good taste, about 5-6 percent alcohol or 10-12 proof. Must follow directions and keep everything clean. Quality kit contained everyting to make your first brew, but I've added a few things like hops bags and thermometer and extra bottle caps. I do not recommend buying inexpensive kits. I also recommend buying "Joy of Home Brewing" to go along with the kit. The kit directions are basic, the book has helpful tips. The price I paid was better than what I would pay locally, in this area, by about $40. I prefered new bottles, as I didn't want to mess with finding and cleaning bottles with non twist off caps. Extra 12 oz. bottles run about $12 for 24 bottles. First batch figures out to about $3 per bottle, which includes the cost of the kit. After that it's about 50 cents a bottle. As a side note, I started my second batch May 19. Enjoy! :)
I bought this gift for my son-in-law.  He loves it..  He bottles his beer and distributes around the family.  This is a definite winner for whatever occasion.

Overall a great kit, but it came shipped with a broken Hydrometer and siphon... been unable to contact the company to get it replaced. I couldn't wait any longer so I made my first batch this weekend and I had everything I needed for the first part. I'm going to have to get creative with the transfer from the one bucket to the other. Would be a 5 star if the parts were packaged better or they would respond to the broken parts.
I bought this for my husband for Christmas. It had a broken hydrometer and we still haven't received a replacement.
This is a great kit and came with everything my son needed to get started on brewing his first batch of beer.

Unlike the "Soup at Hand" product line, making this a single serving hasn't reduced the taste or appearance of the product at all.  This is pretty much true of all the single serving Campbell's soups in this size, which is called a "Soup Bowl".  Originally, these bowls were smaller, more on the order of 10 or 12 ounces.  At 15 ounces, this is a bit more than a single serving, at least for me.  I would like it a bit smaller.  I would also like to see more products sold this way; for example, Cream of Mushroom and Bean with Bacon would both be on my favorites list.
arrived as promised and ahead of time no cans we smashed or destroyed currently enjoying a cup as i write. ordered this and tomato..mmm mmm gud

This is a really nice Kenyan, very similar to the Batdorf & Bronson Kenya AA.  Perfectly roasted, with the bright acidity that is a Kenyan hallmark, and definitely more assertive than the Diedrich offering.  I'd rate this as a tie with the Batdorf & Bronson, with Diedrich coming up a close second.NOTE:  This review was for the Kenya AA, NOT the Kenya AB.  Apparently the AA isn't currently available, and the title was switched without creating a new ASIN.  I haven't tried the Kenya AB.

The description states that this is roasted the day they ship.The first order I placed was 2 months old. I wrote Amazon to notify them and they kindly shipped me another order, free of charge.Same roast date.I made this in an espresso machine and a french press. It tastes like office coffee. Coffee flavored water.Check your roast dates, YMMV. It's a white tag on the bottom. It's written in julian format.

I love this coffee. I tried the dark, and felt it was a bit too 'charcoally' tasting. This is not. It's smooth, has lots of chocolate notes and has an incredible aroma. It's not full bodied, so if that's what your seeking this won't be your favorite, but if you want something that simply tastes wonderful then this is it.

column9: Rich & Indulgent Kenya AA Whole Bean Coffee
column10: My husband is a complete coffee nut and we both love this coffee.  Kenya AA is rich and less acidic than other coffees.  I had been purchasing this type of coffee from another vendor and decided to try Coffee Bean Direct, I am very satisfied with the quality of the coffee, packing of the product, and speed of shipping.  I will be a returning buyer.

I only use Coffee Bean Direct beans now.  Great free shipping with Amazon.  Great taste (for me, anyway). Reasonably priced.  Fresh.  I use this Kenya AA for caffene.....and their CO2 Columbian for decaf.  Very happy with this stuff.

I've had better, but this is good coffee. It's a reasonable roast, not at all oily, with a nice aroma and not too bitter.I like the resealable 1lb bags; with the big 5lb bags from CBD I could never get through a bag before the coffee started tasting stale or even moldy. Ordering 3 resealable 1lb bags, that problem is gone.
Good Coffee, Good Price, Quick Shipping, Great Pakaging, what more can you ask? Coffee is packed in 3, 1Lb. bags that are resealable. The coffee is very fresh. IMPRESSIVE!!!

Kenyan AA coffee is probably my favorite coffee of all that I have tried.  This is a great coffee from Coffee Bean Direct.  I am on the subscription for the coffee.  I plan to continue ordering the coffee.
The beans are over-roasted. I believe Kenya AA should have a mild, winy flavor. This coffee has a slight burnt, bitter taste.

Finally, I found an online coffee that'll match or beat S.B. or Peet or Seattle B.I'm a "House Coffee" guy and use 190 filtered water poured over grind in a paper cone, WOW!PLEASE KEEP this stuff as good as it is now, thanks.
This coffee is far better than what one could normally buy at this price point. Though not quite the star that some coffees costing three times the price are, it is a very good coffee value.

I love this fish rub. I put this on every type of fish, including seared tuna. It's just amazing. I'm not as big a fan of the chicken rub they make, but this serves all types of protein so I just use this.Whenever I serve fish to someone they always ask what I put on it, and I hand them a can of this fish rub. That's why I buy the 6 pack. Fabulous stuff.

I actually bought this by mistake, not realizing that I would get only 18 pods for $20.  Usually Senseo delivers several packages of 16/18 pods.I'm glad I got it because it is great coffee.  Kona coffee is grown in a small section of the Big Island, so the supply is very small, hence, the high price.  When you combine Kona coffee with other Hawaiian coffees, you get a drink with a strong, complex taste, well worth the price for the occasional cup.I still have seventeen pods left, and I will space them out carefully.

This coffee is pricey but oh so good. Each pod is sealed in an individual aluminum packet so remains fresh and delish. Sometimes I add a touch of chocolate Silk soymilk and enjoy a cup of dessert. I would recommend this as one of my favorite coffees for the Senseo.

column9: Salsa lovers need to try this flavor
column10: After I tried the variety packs, this one was my favorite of them all.  It has a unique taste that's still good for everyday use.  Quality brand overall and the shipping was fast.

Very Stale, i had a leftover jellybean from a previous purchase/seller that i crushed in my finger in comparison with these and they are definatly VERY stale if not fake not to mention most are smushed and look like blue candlewax and sugar. at least they came in 2 days right?

column9: Nice taste, but where's my cracker??
column10: I was informed by my gift recipient that these crackers arrived with incomplete packages. That is to say- something occurred at the factory and instead of six little crackers in the package, you get perhaps four, and the entire side of one cracker is exposed with the cheese uncovered in the pack. Obviously a defective run, but why wouldn't someone notice? When you have a 90 count package and most are defective, I mean...what the heck?The taste is good on these crackers, I can say that for them. But it embarrasses me to purchase something for someone else and have it be defective.
Bought them as a gift for my husband...we can never find the cheese on cheese crackers in the store - only the peanut butter.No problems at all.  Arrived on time, in one piece, perfect!

column9: This is my new favorite gum!!
column10: A few months ago I discovered Mentos gum, and loved the way the gum had a very long lasting chewability.  The first flavors I tried were Watermelon and Red Fruit.  After some online searching I found that there were a number of different flavors, so I ordered some of each flavor so I could have my own little taste test.  After all of the sampling, Sweet Mint emerged as my absolute favorite.  It has just a little bit of a mint bite, and proved to be very enjoyable.  A lot of the mint gums just completely overpower you when you start chewing on them.  I now order the Sweet Mint flavor by the box, so I can always have a good supply on hand.  Watermelon anod Red Fruit are still on hand, too - just not in the quantity!

Any good dark chocolate is bliss, so Hershey's picked a good name. These are just like the little wrapped chocolates by Dove, and I really don't have a preference. They're both luxurious and worth a try if you're into smooth dark chocolate.
Excellent taste. very smooth with no bitterness at the end like some many green teas can be.  only negative is the tea can turn cloudy moments after brewing.
This tea has been one of my longtime favorites.  At first I was skeptical about buying a 100 bag box....but it's GREAT!  Now I have tea on hand all the time at a great price.Enjoy!

Maybe this says something about the psychedelic effects of jasmine tea.  First, anon_2003 thinks there are snails in the teabag.  Then Graham rips anon for saying they were in the bottom of the cup, even though anon wrote that they were in the bag, not the cup.  I guess this is the proverbial tempest in a teacup.In any case, I like this jasmine tea.  It's not too perfumed, and does have a smooth taste.  No snails.  But . . . wait!  There are little green men in that teabag!

The jasmine is a wonderful scent as well as tasty. This tea doesn't have the typical "mushed weed" flavor that some green teas have (which is why some people don't like it). The scent and the smoothness makes it a great way to get the good stuff (antioxidants) from drinking tea!The 100 count package is good if you drink tea frequently and still lasts for months.
This tea will not disappoint, it's my new favorite! I love the light, flavorful quality and will continue buy. Price can't be beat with Amazon's free shipping and fast delivery.

This is a delicious light & delicate tea. The flavor is nice and smooth. The scent is just wonderful. Their machine must be off, because my boxes have both been a few bags short. But the price is awesome compared to buying the small packages one at a time from pretty much anywhere, so I can overlook that. Overall, a complete bargain for a wonderful tea!

column9: Lovely tea (for eyes, nose, taste buds...)
column10: I really like this tea... I am not a tea lover, but this one is SOOO devine...The packaging, the smell, the taste...really yummmi!!!!

I have purchased this tea for quite a while and it is the best tea out there for Jasmine Green Tea. The taste is not overwhelming and the finish is smooth and sweet. I have never had any snails or other "non-leaf" items in my tea! Besides, if it comes as a tea bag, how can the snails be in the bottom of your cup?? Shouldn't they be in your bag? I think you should wash your cups more often, or step away from the pipe!
A friend highly recommended this product to us.  While they are good, the price I paid was not a good value.

As I recently became vegan, and have incorporated tofu into my diet, I wanted to get a protein powder that was without dairy and soy.  This one fit the bill, and has vitamins and minerals included that many vegans risk being deficient in (B12, Calcium, Iron).  I add it to my oatmeal, I think it makes the taste richer and I appreciate that there are no added sweeteners.  The reason I give the product 4 stars is that, although I should have inspected more closely and seen this before purchasing, it has 270mg sodium per serving.  I find this to be too high, I even find my oatmeal a bit too salty.  Thus, I plan to mix this with another soy-free powder to lower the sodium content.  Otherwise, I think this is a great product.

Have been using this product for several years mostly in smoothies and shakes and yes there is a bit of a weird taste maybe from the pea or possibly the mushrooms that have been unable to mask no matter what tried. Yet nutritionally this booster is quite good... so, in my opinion, it is worth it; maybe have even developed a liking to the taste. Currently using this product more in foods like soups and it really seems to work better flavor-wise. Also for baking (breads, muffins, vege-burgers, loafs) it's a great way top bump up your protein intake.

column9: Naturade Soy Free Veg Protein Booster
column10: This is for the hardier consumer, taste wise. If you don't mind the flavor of powdered peas, this one is for you. Good texture, good dissolvability. Price is what you would expect--no bargain but not a killer. There is, however, most definitely the flavor of peas there, and nothing really covers it up. I like peas when they are green and I have to chase them around on my plate. In the form of a vanilla, or chocolate, or coffee, or banana, or blackberry, etc., etc. drink?--naw.

Thank god somebody came out with a non-soy protein powder alternative! Soy is added to almost every food product out there and it's NOT GOOD FOR OUR BODIES!!Some people may not like the slight "pea" aftertaste or graininess, but what powder isn't grainy? Anyway, all the ingredients in this product are healthy alternatives to other products out there. The natural flavor also allows you to add chocolate or fruit or any other flavor you choose to mix it up a little. A great addition to my morning breakfast.
This tastes terrible. I am used to having a flavored protein and the strong flavor is really gross and hard to mask. I wasted $25. :/

I almost didn't believe this was going to be a 32oz container when I ordered it because I buy the 16oz at local grocery stores for the same price all the time.  So, twice as much for the same price!!  This is a great product I've been using for years.  It's great for vegetarians because it does NOT contain soy, which is great in moderation.

I was recently diagnosed with gestational diabetes and being a vegetarian, tofu and eggs were my only pure-protein options and I grew sick of those very soon. Discovered this protein powder and have been using it in my cooking ever since. I have added it to soups, stews, curries and smoothies. I am yet to try making rotis with it.  I prefer it cooked in my meal than in smoothies. It is better used with something that already has an overpowering taste. The product's website says it CAN be used in cooking, so I assume the nutrient value is not lost by doing so.I think it is a little high on sodium, but atleast it gives me more options in my food now. I have not tried any other protein powders, so I don't know how it rates compared to others in the market taste-wise.

I use this product to supplement my protein intake..i also eat fish and yogurt for protein...i mix this product in a shaker with white grapefruit juice..the red or pink grapefruit juice is too sweet...i like the taste and also the energy boost from this product...it does taste very "earthy" but that is fine...i drink the protein shakes thru the night at work and i have plenty of energy...i do not drink any caffeine and have plenty of energy...i highly recommend this product...try it with the white grapefruit juice too!

This protein powder was quite good. However if you are used to sweets and proteins that taste like candy you will notice that this product is not sweet, but its not chalk dust either. I have used this protein in shakes and smoothies with fruit and without fruit and it didn't affect the taste of my food. My 14 year old daughter doesn't mind either (she's picky too!!!) This is a keeper for me I thought this was going to be like "other" protein powders I have tried that are vegan that taste like bitter crap but I was pleasently surprised this one is quite good it mixes well by the way not gritty at all !!!!!!!

This is a great soy free and dairy free vegtable protein powder.  It mixes well.  It dissolves easily in water or juice. Mixed with filtered water or juice, it tastes quite pleasant. It has no sugar, so it doesn't taste sweet. This is a big plus for those seeking a low glycemic diet.

The taste isn't great, but you can get used to it (I mix mine in water).  I am a vegan and I don't like eating a lot of soy (I think it may upset my stomach).  This product has 0 grams of sugar and only 4 grams of carbohydrates and is very low in fat, so you cannot expect it to taste DELICIOUS. There is 22 grams of protein per serving from non-soy vegetable sources, so 3 shakes a day for a work out routine plus snacks in between is a routine worth trying.

Great for skin and muscles. I blend it with skim milk and sometimes a flavoring, although it is great with just milk. I will keep this product in my eating regimen. It helps to tighten my scalp. My hair doesn't fall out like it was before I started drinking this vegetable protein.

This product tastes horrible.  I was looking for a soy free protein and came upon this item.  I mixed it with soymilk and it tasted like pea-flavored chalk.  I thought I might have used too much powder so I tried half the amount of powder and it still tasted the same.  Not wanting to give up, I mixed in a scoop of strawberry flavored whey protein and it truly tasted like a combination of strawberry and chalk.My fiancee then tried it and couldn't take more than a sip.  In the end, I was able to down three cups of it, but I don't think I can drink any more in the future. I am going to take them up on their money back product guarantee.

These are less like mints and more like "SweetTart" or "Smarties".  They are perfect for my kids with braces who need to eat xylitol after every meal and snack to cut down on cavities.  My kids love to eat them and Amazon' subscribe and save price is by far the cheapest on the internet for these.Studies show that by chewing a couple of grams of xylitol after every meal that cavities can be drastically reduced. Its too early to tell for sure if these are working, but since my kids can't chew xylitol gum with braces, I'm hoping this will give them the cavity-fighting benefits of xylitol.

Very weak flavor and last only about 45 seconds in the mouth.What's the point of taking the mint if it does almost nothing.I was an sugar contained Altoids user for 9 years.I'm going to try these next: Eclipse Sugarfree Mints, and Spry Mints.Well, I've tried the Eclipse Sugarfree Mints and they are much stronger and last a lot longer.  The Spry mints are somewhere in between the two.

just the same great tasting Miracle Whip that I have used for years, but how did they develop this new bottle that empties completely? No kidding...as you squeeeze this bottle, the product doesn't stick to the sides like so many condiments do...when it's empty, it's COMPLETELY empty...absolutely NO waste...!!

Probably geared for the revolution, cutting edge "let's ban mayo-type advertisement". When I read the reviews, I noticed someone mentioned the box was light. Great product, I never cook this in the microwave because sometimes it takes longer and not all microwaves are the same.  I've read people reviews and they said there were small brown pieces that were hard, that means they were not cooked long enough.  The best way to cook these are to use a medium size pan, pour the pack into the pan and shake it around and bake them in the oven @ 400 degrees for 4-6 minutes, keep a close eye on them because they burn easy.  But it is worth it to cook it in the oven, very hot and fresh and no uncooked curls.  They will appear to be brown at first but they "poof" up in the oven once they're heated.  I would say do not microwave these in a bag, use a oven safe plate, that way you can actually see them puff up, older/cheap microwaves can take 4-6 minutes to cook.
These are so much better than the pre-packaged ones.  Not too many calories.  I cook mine for 2 min and 20 seconds in a very small microwave.

column9: Pretty good, but I am not sure that I will buy again
column10: It was quite a commitment for me to buy this quantity of pork rinds from Amazon but I decided that I would "give it a go" since I like the pork rinds that are sold in grocery stores and I figured that these could only be better since they'd be fresher when microwaved. I ended up only buying the hot variety since it seemed to cover the taste of the rinds better than plain or bbq.  After reading the reviews here, decided to give these a try.I had never had anything other than the bagged variety of pork rinds.  As others have mentioned here, these are far superior to anything you will find in a bag.  Way, way better than any bagged variety I have sampled.  Plus the make this great popping, crackling noise when you take them out for a minute or so that I greatly enjoy for some reason.Do mind the cooking instructions.  If you overcook, they will end up tasting closer to the bagged taste you are trying to avoid.  Still better than bagged though.  I tried different times in my microwave but found it best to watch and take them out as soon as the bag stops rising.  You will sometimes have some that did not expand(you can pop these back in the microwave to try and revive them) but it is not worth burning some of them to try to ensure all have expanded.

column9: A for freshness, but d*mn are they salty.......

I love these bacon curls or pork rinds as some call them. I was so happy to find them again. Easy, delicious and high protein snack --- I eat them every night watchng tv. Never had a bag that didn't perform well........LOVE THEM!!!!!

column9: Snap crackle and pop of pork rinds
column10: Few things are as enjoyable in life as freshly popped pork rinds.  Modern technology has enabled us to produce the epitome of snack foods in a hot, fresh version.  I will be relegated no more to the listless depths of popped corn.  Pork rinds are the ultimate man chips. Very similar to microwaved popcorn, you just shake the bag and put em in your microwave for about 2 min and voila, hot fresh pork rinds.  When you pop them you have to get accustomed to the fact that they don't "pop" like popcorn - they just crackle a bit.  So it is a bit hard to tell when they are done and usually through trial and error you will get the perfect time depending upon the type of microwave oven you use.  Mine is 900W and takes just under 2 min. A couple of pieces will get burnt, or as I affectionately refer to as char. The bag will inflate slightly.  When they are done, you open it up and you are greeted with an aroma that is bacon heaven.  Put one in your mouth right away and it will stick to your tongue like a live octopus.  They are a bit salty so they make the perfect accompaniment to a nice cold beer.  I didn't find them too spicy, just enough.  If you want to be creative, you can throw em in a bowl right after they are done popping and throw some salsa verde or any other kind of salsa you have.  You will be greeted with a chorus of wonderful snaps like getting sizzling rice soup at a Chinese restaurant.  Throw on some shredded cheese and the result is "man nachos".  My wife thinks that it is utterly disgusting, even though that hasn't stopped her from eating them.  Trust me, they are delicious, but don't let em sit too long or they get soggy.

My husband loves these so much he never wants to run out. I've always thought pork rinds are disgusting, but when he 'pops' a bag in the microwave the smell and the sizzling and the warmth and the crunch ... I have to admit they are really good!

While I don't react badly to MSG it still makes me a little nervous.If you're on a low-carb diet this is a great choice for snacking or even meal replacement.

column9: The Microwave Pork Rinds Are Surpisingly Fantastic
