column10: (i have very thick-coarse-healthy-never dyed hair)i bought this product at my local drug store. there were many types to choose, so i got the root volumizing shampoo and cond.. the scent is ok, nothing special.. the first use cleansed my hair well, lathered thick, and left it smooth and sleek with a nice amount of volume.. the second use was just-fine (same results)..this morning i noticed my hair was FULL of flakes! THICK FLAKES!! the flakes were HARD and STUCK near the roots of my hair shafts. they were all-over my head. i don't know if this is a normal part of the cleansing or detoxifying of the scalp.. but i have never had issues with flakes.i took a shower right away after trying unsuccessfully to pull the hard pieces out (like a monkey picking lice)happily most all of the pieces dissolved out. i went to the store later feeling self-conscious  that the flakes was showing or more would come back..i am going to continue using this for 7- 10 washes because i feel this is a "normal" part of the process. but if these flakes continue.. i will stop..UPDATE** i finished the bottle and got another one.. i haven't seen any more FREAK FLAKES.. the product is still so/so.. i dont love it, but dont hate it. it is fairly affordable, but you get a small bottle, so i think i will be buying panteen next.. good luck on this MIRICLE product.. lol

Okay, my hair isn't that long. But I'm on as an extra and casting asked me to let my hair and beard "grow wild." It's still in the starting phase, so I can't go to great lengths about how CLEAR SCALP & HAIR BEAUTY Strong Lengths Nourishing Shampoo does the long thing. It does the job without an overpowering scent and without leaving residue. I like it.

column9: A little goes a long way
column10: I tried this shampoo with the conditioner and I am so pleased with the results. My hair is course but brittle. I have been using this shampoo and conditioner ever since my last hair cut. It has been over a month and my hair looks so good. It is healthy and shiny. Now I don't do anything to my hair but comb and go. This works really well for me and I have used a lot of different shampoos. I like that it doesn't have an overwhelming scent and doesn't take much to get my shoulder length hair clean.
I've been using this product for about two weeks and I think my split ends are no longer split.  Besides that, it's a nice shampoo and leaves my hair feeling silky and clean.

column4: Kimberly J. Karas "a New England mom"
column9: I like it and will continue using.
column10: This is a great shampoo it is helping keep my hair in better shape while I am trying to grow it longer.  I have had less breakage and my hair is fuller looking and soft.  The texture of the shampoo itself is thick and has luxurious lather.  I would honestly compare this to salon quality product.  I have the conditioner as well which I do not need to use daily as the shampoo is moisturizing enough for my hair.  I don't know if it is actually promoting growth but it feels good whatever it's doing!

When I saw this shampoo available to Amazon Vine reviewers, I requested a bottle. After a horrible color treatment years ago that burned my scalp and forever changed not only the amount of hair on my head but its texture as well, I'm always interested in shampoos said to be good for hair "prone to breakage." The fine print, though, indicates that the shampoo does all these great things, including restoring the scalp's natural moisture balance, only when used in conjunction with the conditioner, which was not sent to me.After using the shampoo and my existing conditioner for a couple of weeks, I bought the Strong Lengths conditioner. I've used it a few times, and so far there's not much to report. My scalp does seem slightly less itchy than it is prone to, but then again, it's not wintertime, when the heater runs nearly constantly and dries out my skin and scalp. I've not discovered the oiliness from using the shampoo that other reviewers have reported, but oily hair is not an issue for me in general. Neither the shampoo nor conditioner are expensive, so buying the conditioner as well wasn't a hardship, but I disliked the asterisk about needing both the shampoo and conditioner to experience the shampoo's true efficacy.I plan to report back in a few more weeks about how well both products work together, but I can't say much about how the shampoo works on its own. Yes, it cleanses my hair as promised, but if it's being nourished, the jury's still out.

The main problem with the product is that it leaked a lot in transit.  Luckily it's packaged very well so the package didn't arrive dripping but it was a mess to clean.  Also I received the shampoo courtesy of Amazon Vine but if I had actually paid for the product and lost a big portion in transit I'd be very unhappy.  Overall I feel like the shampoo leaves my fine hair almost too soft so it's not holding it's style terribly well.  It smells great and feels wonderful to put my hands in but isn't quite giving it any volume or lift.  I would not spend the money on this version of the shampoo in the future.

Pantene is the brand I have always used and been most satisfied with but I was really happy with this new Clear Scalp Conditioner (the conditioner is great too).  The smell alone makes you want to try it.  It reminds me of the old "Salon Selectives" brand.  Anyway, my hair does seem smother and less frizzy.  It is shiny and I got a compliment on it the other day which I hadn't received in a while so it must be working.  It is comparable in price to Pantene as well.

column9: This is a keeper.  Smells delish.
column10: This shampoo smells so clean and subtly fresh all day long!  I love it! Love it!  You only need the smallest little dab to get a really good lather worked up.  I am on several medications that have made my hair very weak and almost a year and half ago it fell it out in large chunks.  My hair is fine, wavy and likes to tangle with itself.  It is prone to breakage.  I sleep on satin pillowcases, with a satin head wrap on.  I baby and pamper my hair and spend a lot on products that will strengthen it or keep it in shape, I'm a product junkie for better or worse.  I try shampoos and conditioners frequently and return to my old standbys.  These is a keeper for me.  I used it for 3 weeks before coming to a conclusion.  I had my scalp 'cleaned' before I started.  I go to the beauty college and they do a deep scalp treatment and clean your scalp of product buildup.  Three weeks later according to my hairstylist I still did not have any build up to scrap.  So my head was very clean leaving the hair follicles free for growing.  I had about 10% less breakage according to the beauty schools breakage test.  Which for me, is a plus and improvement, I am trying to grow my hair out, I can't do that if it is constantly breaking.  For conditioners I need something that has some power in the shower to detangle effectively and leave my hair smooth and tangle free.  Some of the more expensive conditioners do not have the thickness or something in the cnditioners to really soften and separate my hair.  This conditioner really worked without me having to double dip and use twice as much conditioner.  For the price and the smell and the noticeable improvements I say yay!  How does a shampoo and conditioner get a 5 from me....no breakage at all.

column9: Fine shampoo for the $; not a huge difference in my hair
column10: I received a bottle of the Clear Scalp and Hair Beauty Strong Lengths Nourishing Shampoo and have been using it exclusively for the past 3 weeks. I wash my fine, shoulder length hair almost every day; I've been trying to move to every other day, as it's better for your hair.Second on the ingredient list is Sodium Laureth Sulfate, which may have less chemical impact than the similar sodium lauryl sulfate (SLS), but is still an allergen for many people, and could be why some reviewers are noting hair loss with use of this product. Interestingly sodium chloride (salt) is one of the ingredients. Most shampoos don't have added salt, so I thought it was a curious addition.I did not notice any strengthening properties. It actually seemed like my ends might be slightly drier than normal (nothing a little shine serum couldn't fix). My hair felt very clean the first week, but my scalp has started to become oilier than usual (sometimes at the end of the day, my scalp looks like I haven't shampooed for two days).In terms of chemicals, this shampoo is too new to be included in the Environmental Working Group cosmetic database, but the biggest issues are the fragrance (parfum) and the DMDM Hydantoin. Other chemicals that would score as moderate (4-5s) include the sodium lauryl sulfate, Zinc Pyrithione, Laureth-23 and Laureth-24. Poloxamer 407 is slightly lower risk, but has some bioaccumulation concerns.Overall, it didn't seem terribly effective at giving me stronger hair. But it's not the worst chemical load of "conventional" shampoos, and it's a decent price. I would consider purchasing it but it would not be my first choice of shampoos.

Within only a couple weeks after starting to use this shampoo (along with the conditioner, CLEAR SCALP & HAIR BEAUTY Strong Lengths Nourishing Conditioner, 12.7 Fluid Ounce), I have noticed a big difference in the softness, strength and health of my hair. My hair tends to be very dry and this shampoo-conditioner combo has worked wonders.My daughter also loves it because it's such a clean product (without all the dyes etc. that can weigh down fine hair), leaving her hair shiny and silky. She kept stealing mine so I had to get her some of her own.The packaging states it has nutrients for the scalp and the hair and I believe it. I trimmed my hair right before I started using it and it has definitely helped prevent split ends. It's every bit as effective as the shampoos I've paid premium prices for in salons.I'm liking my hair more than I have in a long, long time, and am looking forward to seeing the results after a few months.

I've heard that there truly is no differene between cheap shampoos and those found at specialty salons/stores. I've tried both and it is probably true. That said, this new Clear Shampoo is certainly on the cheap side, and so far, I like it. It has a pleasant smell and it goes on thick, with a consistancy of conditioner. It lathers very well and washes away quickly. It cleans my hair and I guess I can't expect much more than that. So far it has not weighed my hair down at all, and I have pretty long hair. I would recommend this shampoo to anyone.

I used Clear Scalp & Hair Beauty Strong Lengths Nourishing Shampoo and have a few pros and cons. Pros: use a small amount, lathers well, smells nice, cleans hair well. Cons: font on bottle too small (word "shampoo" should be larger so you can differentiate between the shampoo and conditioner easier), seems to make my hair fall out (another brand did this as well) but not sure if it's the shampoo only or a combination of shampoo and conditioner.So, mixed reviews. I like the product but don't like losing my hair. Since I have a lot of thick hair, it hasn't affected me much but I don't want to continue losing it just in case.
I had my friend wash my hair with this- my scalp felt clean and my hair stayed in place (using no other product)...the lotion like feeling on my scalp made it tingle- in a good way:)

column9: Clean smell, volume day 1, then oily & flat on day 2
column10: I used the CLEAR SCALP & HAIR BEAUTY Strong Lengths Nourishing Shampoo and Conditioner for a week.  This shampoo is made for people with long hair, so I wanted to try it.  The smell is very clean, and the shampoo isn't all watery like a lot of other shampoos.  The first day I love how it makes my hair look.  It gives my hair a volume it doesn't usually have, but by day 2 my hair is flat and oily.  This shampoo and conditioner may work better for you, they just didn't work with my hair and scalp.

column4: Lettetia "As Long As I Am Able To Read, I Sha...
column10: CLEAR SCALP & HAIR BEAUTY Strong Lengths Nourishing Shampoo, is one of the finest shampoos I have used in quite some time.  The nourishing part of the product is very well described, as it really has made a difference in the way my scalp feels.  Having used this shampoo for two weeks now, I would recommend this product.

This product was neither good nor bad. After use, I didn't notice anything different from other shampoo I use.  Since I tend to use good products, this actually means it appears to be a decent shampoo.  It just didn't rock my world in any way.  For the price, it is a nice choice.  Certainly better than some of the drug store cheap shampoos that dry out your hair.

This shampoo is a cream shampoo that claims to nourish the scalp, but the second ingredient, sodium laurel sulfate, is a known scalp irritant. The shampoo is also tinted pink, as is the matching conditioner. I don't like using hair products with dyes because they stain my hair. It is also heavily scented. I won't use it again, and I wouldn't recommend it for anyone else.

I love this shampoo that left my hair shiny and squeaky clean. I've been using it for a week and have already noticed how softer and bouncier my hair feels and looks.I recommend using the accompanying conditioner for this product for best results.Overall grade: A+

I ordered Clear Scalp & Hair Beauty hoping that it would control my flakes.  The shampoo smells great, not overpowering, lathers well, and leaves your hair feeling squeaky clean. Unfortunately, it wasn't very effective at controlling flakes in the week and a half that I've used it.  My husband loves it though as he's found it to be very effective against flakes.  I think that in terms of flake control, it will depend on how strong you need the formulation to be. I'll have to stick to Nizoral & Neutrogena's anti-dandruff shampoo myself.

Easy to hold bottle, pleasing scent on the shampoo. It lathered very well and rinsed cleanly, paired up with the conditioner, it left my hair feeling very soft and clean. The only bad thing about it, was how it was shipped, in a bubble wrap manilla envelope. Being shipped like that, caused the bottle to leak a bit, not a lot, but I did have to rinse the bottle off before use. Other then that, it's great.

column4: K. Hernandez "DailyReadz - One Great Book Eve...
column10: I also had the problem with the bottle leaking a bit during shipping. But I love this shampoo!  It smells absolutely amazing, and feels heavy and creamy. It washes clean and leaves my hair soft and shiny with no frizzy ends. Feels great too!

I am an activer person. That means I wash my hair (at least) once every day. With that daily ritual, it takes an inevitable toll on my hair. In an effort to combat breakage, get my tresses clean and just try a new product, I ordered the CLEAR SCALP & HAIR BEAUTY system, through Vine. First of all, this product smells fresh, and it has a creamy consistency. I felt it cleaning my hair, right away, and it didn't feel like it had the stripping quality so common in some fortified products. It rinsed clean and my hair felt protected. We shall give this a week (like it says, on the bottle). I am satisfied, so far.

column9: Decent Shampoo.. Bad Packaging and Bottle Leaks in Shipping
column10: First, like others have mentioned, mine arrived in a plastic wrap in a package with its lid open and shampoo all over the interior of the plastic wrap. Not only was it a mess to open.. but 1/3 the bottle was already gone. Next came trying the product.. so far 1 weeks time and I will update again after a month goes by. When I first put some on my hair and begain to lather I stopped and made sure I used the right bottle.... its like a cream, and doesn't feel like a shampoo normally would feel. I thought I grabbed the wrong bottle! I'm mixed on how the product feels, though it did leave my hair nice, but my other shampoos still do better. I tend to use various products and never the same shampoo when I run out. Its almost as if my hair gets use to a product and it no longer works well, so I mix it up.I do like the smell to the product and don't find it overwhelming as others suggested. I did not find it dulled my hair (I do have highlights)My hair did feel clean, not oily or dirty looking as others have experienced. Think this is a try it out and see kind of product. Everyones hair is so different so each review is based on the persons kind of hair really. My hair is normally not oily, but is flat and below shoulder length with highlights. I saw no major changes compared to other products so for that reason its OK. I do not like the cap to the bottle and again how its packaged. Nothing like getting a product and loosing 1/3 of it and having a huge mess..... perhaps if you want to try it try it at a local store.

This shampoo cleans well and leaves your hair soft, but I can't discern any difference between this and most other shampoos on the market.  It has a light, pleasant scent -- not too perfumey -- and it lathers well.  I would use it again, but it's nothing to get super-excited about.  Regarding the claim about getting your hair stronger in seven days, I honestly can't say I noticed that.

column9: Smooth, rich and silky, but worth the price?
column10: I have never been one to seek out specific shampoo brands.  I purchased whatever brand was on sale.  As long as it lathered up and did its job, I was happy.  The Clear Scalp & Hair Beauty shampoo proves there is a difference.First of all, the shampoo is far richer than other brands I've used.  It comes out of the easy-to-use dispenser in thick ribbons.  When it's massaged into the hair, it creates a luxurious feel -- an experience far removed from the routine shampooing I had always done.  In fact, I was inspired to do more scalp massaging than ever as I lingered in the shower.It has a faint scent, not an overly perfumed one, and I liked that.  I can't really confirm the fact that it has strengthened my hair, as I've never had a problem with "breakage."My wife used it and was pleased with how smooth her hair felt after the shampoo was rinsed out.  She has used several kinds of better shampoos over the years, and she reported that the Clear Scalp & Beauty shampoo compares favorably.  Neither of us used the shampoo in conjunction with its companion conditioner, which further leads me to believe we saw no appreciable difference in our hair being strengthened.The big question:  Would I seek this product over others in the future?  Perhaps.  I do like its rich texture, so that might lure me back.  However, a premium price might easily point me back to more economical products.Conclusion:  This is a good product that lathers better than many shampoos, leaving the hair smooth and easy to manage.
I like the mild fragrance of Clear Scalp & Hair Nourishing Shampoo. It has the essential vitamins that helps prevents my hair breakage to a good extent. The hair becomes silky and soft after usage.

column9: Good shampoo, but the conditioner's the real find.
column10: I've been using the Clear Scalp & Hair Therapy shampoo and conditioner for a couple weeks now, and my hair has never been healthier. I have a great mass of very long, very fine, very straight hair which has a tendency to get very static-y and has absolutely no body. From the very first use, this system made my hair feel much fuller, much smoother, much richer -- all around much more beautiful. I have never seen such an immediate or thorough effect, and all without any feeling like there was product weighing it down. However, after mixing and matching (using the shampoo and conditioner together, using the shampoo and a different conditioner, and using the conditioner and a different shampoo) I've come to the conclusion that most of the work is being done by the conditioner (CLEAR SCALP & HAIR BEAUTY Strong Lengths Nourishing Conditioner, 12.7 Fluid Ounce); the shampoo with the conditioner is a *little* better, but not so much better that I feel like I have to spend the extra money on it. The conditioner I recommend without reservation; the shampoo is just a nice bonus.

column4: Shawn Kovacich "Author and Creator of numerou...
column9: It Does A Good Job, But ....
column10: I gave this product to my girlfriend to try since she has long, color treated hair.When I first got this, a lot of the product was all over the plastic bag that it came in. Be warned, they sent it in a padded envelope and the shampoo was everywhere.From there, to me it has an interesting fragrance, nothing horrible, but nothing that I just have to use either. The first time I used it, I had to use a bunch of shampoo because I just couldn't get it to lather. After that, it was back to the normal amount to suds up my hair.When I first used it, I noticed that my hair felt a little drier and stripped. This is something that I notice every time I use a different brand of shampoo which I thing is just the feeling of the built up old product getting washed off my hair. With repeated use, this feeling went away.I also used the corresponding conditioner. Within the first couple days, I noticed that my hair felt thicker and softer. The ends of my hair still have the remains of some bleaching and are drier than the rest of my hair. They felt smoother after a couple days of use.The only negative thing I find is that my hair gets greasy faster with the use of this shampoo. The only thing I can think of is the extra nutrients that are supposed to help the scalp is just adding too much to my all ready normal scalp.Over all, this is not that bad of a product. I like how my hair feels softer and seems to have more volume without drying out the ends further. Using the conditioner does help the ends too, more on that on the other review. But I do admit that I wouldn't get it again just because of how greasy my hair gets with it.I think if you are looking for a product that will help your dry hair, this is one to look into.Shawn KovacichAuthor and Creator of numerous books and DVD's.

Obviously everyone has different types of hair, and shampoos will affect every hair type differently. So, for clarification's sake, my hair is:- Plentiful, but very fine and therefore easily broken.- Straight with a small amount of natural body.- Lacking in volume.- Easily weighed down.- Oily.Because of the nature of my hair, it stays healthier when it is kept short. But, stylistically I prefer it long. So, I thought this shampoo (and the conditioner that goes with it) wouldn't be a bad thing to try. **Note, I did use both shampoo and conditioner previously that were geared toward strengthening hair.**I have used it for three weeks, and I'm pleased with the results. I have noticed less breakage over the past couple of weeks and I've also noticed less hair falling out in the shower or when I brush. Although it is costlier than my typical shampoo choice, I think it just might be worth it to at least alternate between this brand and a less expensive brand. And yes, I did notice a difference within the first week (the brand claims seven days). In fact, I noticed a difference in manageability within about three days, although it was probably closer to two weeks before I started really noticing a difference in the strength of my hair itself.I will say that most of what I noticed is related to the conditioner, so I will write a review of that separately. But, I can also say that leaving this step out and just using the conditioner with a different shampoo is not as effective. So, the pairing of the two is essential for the best results.

column9: Terrific hair products for fine hair!
column10: I've been using CLEAR SCALP & HAIR BEAUTY Strong Lengths Nourishing Shampoo, 12.9 Fluid Ounce and CLEAR SCALP & HAIR BEAUTY Strong Lengths Nourishing Conditioner, 12.7 Fluid Ounce for three weeks before writing a review, just to give them a good test, but there was a noticeable improvement in my hair after the first shampoo.  For several months, I had been getting hairs caught in my comb when combing out my wet hair.  After using these products for the first time, there was only one hair left behind in the comb.  After shampooing and conditioning a couple of times, there were no longer any hairs in the comb at all.  I've waited three weeks to see if these products would accumulate on the hair strands, because my fine hair just collapses under the weight of product build-up.  But there doesn't seem to be any build-up at all.  They leave my hair manageable, soft (but not limp) and very shiny.  I was surprised that neither product is clear (both are pearly in color.)  Be advised it takes very little product to work up a rich lather, so start out small and add to it or you will be rinsing for a while.  I really love both these products.

It's shampoo.  It works.  My hair was soft and it smells good. It didn't weigh my hair down either.  I haven't noticed any noticeable change one way or the other after using it.  It's not anything better or worse than most drug store shampoo, despite the price being slightly higher.

Nothing stands out in regards to this shampoo.  I have used it for about a week and it has done the job.  It does not lather up excessively.  My hair feels clean after I use it.  It does not have any scent.  For the right price, I would use it.  Unfortunately I would not pay a lot because it does not have that expensive shampoo feel.

After almost 10 days of use, my wife says that her hair is so strong she can easily pull out a car from a ditch... Not really, but...no noticeable difference between this and any other shampoo in terms of impact - less dryness for sure, lathers well and has a not-so-overpowering fragrance.  Ingredients list mention more "natural" components than most others but is not an organic shampoo - perhaps, this price point is meant to reflect "not organic, but not a chemical soup" segment.  Overall, slightly over-priced for its value. No real differentiation with any of the other products to warrant a premium.

This shampoo claims that it will, "give you stronger, more beautiful hair in just 7 days."I completed this try out  and really have not noticed any difference between the results of it and several other shampoos that I use that are on the lower end of the price scale.The shampoo is extremely thick and creamy - so much so that I spent twice as long rinsing it out as any other shampoo I have used.My hair is about 8 inches below my shoulders and seems to be becoming more delicate the older I get; so I will say that this did not damage or seem to be harmful in any way. In fact I had gotten sunburn on my scalp in the part of my hair and this felt very gentle on that tender spot. So if the price suits you, it would be okay.

column9: Smooths my hair without weighing it down
column10: Usually, I have to choose between a shampoo that will leave my hair frizzy or one that will weigh it down, leaving it greasy looking.  Even when used with the conditioner, this does neither.  My hair looks shiny and clean, without even a hint of frizz or that weighed down greasy feeling I get from other products.This one is a keeper.

I don't like the scent of the shampoo, but, the texture and sheen of my hair is just as good as it is with any of the other products I use.  There isn't a compelling reason for me to switch to this one.  If you're happy with what you're using, stick with it.  If you aren't give this a try.

So far, so good.  The subject:  blonde fine, straight hair with no split ends.(BTW: no shampoo or conditioner can fix split ends.  Only cutting can fix them.  You can prevent them, not fix them with shampoo and conditioner).  But I digress.....This hair has a personality of its own that includes having to be washed every night or it will be greezy.  Yes, greezy; not greasy.  The bottle says it takes up to seven days to see a difference so we may have to do an update.  The shampoo has a nice smell; nothing too perfumy.  It rinsed out fine and did not seem to strip my hair.  My hair is soft and looks clean.

Certain fragrances put my sinuses in a spin the minute my nose invites them in. That's just what happened the moment I smelled this shampoo.  If you happen to be sensitive to odors, I doubt you'll want Clear Scalp.  I don't know what the chemical is that bothers me, but it's a synthetic throb of a smell that's become less common as fruiter scents entered the market.  It's hard to describe, but years ago, Clairol's after-coloring conditioner had it, as did Pantene.  (I sniffed the latter in the market today -- like Clairol, it no longer contains that odor.)To be fair to Clear Scalp, I'm an extreme overachiever when it comes to having a picky nose, but my encounter with this particular product ended with me popping a sinus pill and a couple aspirin after getting a dab of shampoo on my hand.  (I rinsed it off quickly but the odor clung to me for hours, faint but twinge-inducing if I got my hand near my face.)  Consequently, I didn't dare use it or the conditioner on my hair.  I'd have to give it one star.My husband, however gives it four stars, knocking one off because he doesn't love the fragrance. (He doesn't actively dislike it, but prefers coconutty scents.)  He loves what it does to his hair -- and I can see (and feel) why: his hair feels silky and thicker because the shampoo (and conditioner) give it more body.  It looks good.As for the odor, he there wasn't a trace of scent left tonight, nor are my sinuses bothered when I sniff his hair.The shampoo definitely does nice things to your hair, but I'd suggest a test-sniff before purchasing.

I used this product for 10 days.  Loved the scent, at first my scalp did feel clean and healthy.  By the end of the first week my hair began to change.  It seemed I could see scalp through my hair in full sunlight (noticed in the rearview mirror in the car).  I had noticed my hair was becoming fly away, which generally only happens in the dead of winter, never in the summer.After day 10 it was obvious something was very wrong.  My hair stands from root to tip were much thinner, half thier  normal volume.  My healthy hair was now baby fine!  It was clear that the cause was topical since the effect was every piece of hair, the entire length of each strand.  I had  not changed or added any other product, process, or activity in my routine other than using this shampoo.  I did not use the companion conditioner, I stuck with my usual conditioning product during this trial.This product stripped away the cuticle and actually reduced the thickness of my hair.  I did not actually lose hair (no bald patches, no extra in the brush, no breakage).  Just seemed to eat away at the hairs but left them intact.  This was not a welcome effect as I have light, fine hair to begin with.  There is no way to reduce the damage, other than discontinue use and let the hair grow out naturally.  This will take time since my hair falls at the middle of my back.  Yes, others have noticed the loss of volume and how thin my hair looks.Doing a sink test with the remainder of the bottle - washing a test clipping of my daughter's thick, coarse hair with it daily for a week to watch it break down the hair.  There are a lot of chemicals in this product and something in the formulation is causing damage!  I noticed other reviewers mention fly away hair, loss of volume, and hope they stop using it before it reaches the point mine has.

Generally, I use a non-shampoo method on my hair. I'm willing to try shampoos, but most shampoos seem to cause a lot of split ends compared to the baking soda/apple cider vinegar method.This one has been exceptional so far in that my ends aren't splitting. I have hip length, medium thick, fine, straight hair. It's normal, which means other than the tendency to split, it's neither dry nor oily. It's also not dyed.I use this shampoo as instructed. Massaging it into my scalp, then shampooing the length of my hair using a dollop a little bigger than a quarter, then follow with with the matching conditioner. I don't heat process, and use a wide tooth comb to detangle.  My hair is clean, and well moisturized. It's really soft and manageable all the way down to the tips. I don't know if there is less breakage, but there are less split ends than I'm used to with shampoos and conditioners. This is going on my list of acceptable shampoos.

After I chose this product for "Vine" I realized that it will take way more than one bottle of shampoo to determine whether it decreased breakage, unless I count the hairs in my brush before and after using it.  I used it and it worked like shampoo.  I have no complaints.I noticed that it is available through subscribe and save for a very reasonable price and it gave me an idea.  My very hair-enhanced daughters use literally gallons of shampoo and conditioner.  If you're swimming in waters originating in Montana and note when you get out, your hair is cleaned and conditioned, you have my girls to thank for it.My idea is this - if their shampoo comes through subscribe and save, they will have to make it last until the next shipment.  So I will be letting them try this  product to see if it meets their standards.

This lovely scented shampoo is very concentrated. I used the amount that I regularly use for my chin length hair and it lathered into a rich, luxurious foam that was thick and I could immediately feel it coating my hair. I really had to rinse to get it all out. It left my hair very soft and weighed down, so much that I had to deal with fly-away and static all day long. One thing that I really liked was the fragrance, I closed my eyes and breathed in deep while cleansing my hair. I just didn't like how it weighed my hair down.

The discovered the Columbian-blend Starbucks Coffee about a year ago; I've tried ~6-8 different Starbucks blends, but found that the Columbian strikes a perfect balance in flavor and boldness.  Very flavorful but not overwhelmed with that bold espresso bitterness you get in something like French Roast blend.

I no longer have to spend $5 for a cup of coffee at Starbucks at the corner.  I've tried several flavor and this is my favorite.  If you are looking for somewhat strong one, this is it.  Highly recommended.

column9: The Best Colombian Coffee you can get - from Starbucks!
column10: Having tried many Colombian Coffees including Specialties; there just isn't any that comes close to the one that my old Colombian friend who resided here for awhile while attending University and as Hospital Intern before returning back home; having tried Colombian Coffee from her own homeland. I just couldn't find anything that came closest except Starbucks Colombia which is only a Medium Roast Blend but close enough to what I had drank from what she bought over from her own Country in Colombia.I was surprised to learn from her she was disgusted here in "Americas" of what they had deemed as Colombian coffee when it was merely a mixture of this and that, showing me the labels; that was when I began to start reading coffee labels.  Furthermore, she even indicated that while they do grow coffee beans in Colombia, but a small percentage of them are actually pure Colombian. So much did I learn what the Colombians did, With her being gone, no idea if she has returned back to the USA or is stuck in Colombia. But one thing she taught me that I never had forgotten was "READ THE LABELS". I was even surprised by some of the expensive, imported 100% Colombian coffee were not, but rather a mixture of this and that with Colombian coffee being at the very bottom of the list! I guess the saying still rings true, "if it's too good to be true, it prolly is..."Not so with Starbucks Colombia Coffee!Whenever I drink this, I remember her brothers, her families, and of course her - whether I am at Starbucks or at home. To some, might find this rather strong, but I never use the exact dosage, I use less for that reason - for it is so rich and full of flavor, there is no need to waste it. I keep mine sealed, and yes, in a Freezer Zipped Bag to keep its freshness.I also use this for Iced Coffee as well during hot summer dog days of the months, it is refreshing.

This is very good blend nice body and hearty flavor definitely worth a try if you haven't yet. I still prefer Starbucks medium breakfast blend but I will buy this every once in a while for a change of pace.

This coffee variety (Columbia) offers a nice alternative to the Pike Roast which the company uses as its default blend at their coffee shop locations. When traveling thru O'Hare Airport in Chicago I'm usually a customer of the MacDonald's for coffee, since the Starbucks in the United Concourse only dispenses Pike (except at seasonal times with Holiday/Christmas Blend). I keep the unopened bags in the freezer to prevent the ground beans from oxidizing.

I am very pleased with this purchase.  I enjoy Columbian coffee.  I find the flavor to be superior to all others as it's not weak, but it's not overpowering.  It really is perfectly middle ground.  If you want a brew that you can just sip and enjoy, then I would definitely recommend this.

column9: Very Fresh and Good Price On Special
column10: I received this coffee on special.  I was a little worried that it wouldn't be fresh or something because it was on deal, but the coffee was very fresh and the price ended up being cheaper than anywhere I could find it locally.  Thanks again Amazon for saving me a few bucks!!

I have a 4 cup coffee make and I put 5 teaspoons of coffee grinds to be brewed. I love it and it seems to be very strong so far for those intense workouts. Will but another set for work as I work the graveyard shift.I drink it black with two tablespoons of sugar and the flavor is really nutty.

column9: Amazon ships balanced nutty, not what I ordered
column10: I ordered 6 bags of Medium Colombian Coffee, when I started using it I noticed differed taste, then I read carefully the label on bags, it showed balanced nutty Colombian Coffee, this is not what I ordered, I do not like its taste.

column9: Bold - just short of a French Roast
column10: I like this coffee. It is NOT a French roast but as  another reviewer said it is Bold and has some good flavor with no "off" tastes. The beans are roasted to a dark brown, not the oily black, typical of a french roast. Yet it is similar to a french roast with a nice strong flavorI was very disappointed with another Boyer's selection - their "Denver" blend - which I found so bland that it was almost tasteless.This is a great buy and I would recommend it. The vacuum sealing seemed far better this time when compared to the Boyer's "Denver" blend I tried a month earlier.A minor point - the bag is not as easily resealable as most bulk packaged coffees and you may want to store it in a container rather than trying to reseal the bag.

I have purchased Boyers Rocky Mountain Thunder in the past directly from Boyer's in Denver and been very satisfied with the product.  The 40 oz bag I ordered from Amazon was not fresh and therefore not as good.  When the product is fresh the beans have an oily appearance to them and these beans were dry.
This product is a delicious strong coffee blend.  The flavor is big without being bitter.  If you like your coffee strong and robust, you should try it.

I bought this for my son last year for a Christmas present (he loves whole bean coffees) and he really liked it.  In fact he asked where I got it but I wouldn't tell him, this way I can give him more this year for Christmas.  The huge bag was sort of meant to be a "gag" gift but turned out to be a real deal.

column9: Boyer's Rocky Mountain Thunder Coffee Beans (40-Ounce Bag)
column10: Boyer's Rocky Mountain Thunder Has a Bold and rich flavor.It's a dark roasted coffee bean. We grind our coffee beans freshat the start of the week. I grind the beans very fine, almost like powder to draw that Bold And Rich Flavor from the beans. Don't have to use as much coffee when the beans are ground fine. We purchaced a bag of this coffee about two years ago while in Colorado Springs. When we returned home and needed more coffee I could not the Boyer's brand any where. I went online and found that Amazon stocked Boyer's Coffee. I'm a Happy guy again.
I expected a bold, rich coffee. But this product reminded me of the cheapest supermarket brand.

column9: Good Everyday Coffee  - No Bitterness When strong.
column10: This makes a good cup of coffee but it could be more robust for our taste.  I just make it stronger but that means I will have to reorder again sooner than I had planned.

I don't know why this is so hard to get in the grocery stores.  It is the best artificial sweetner out there IMHO.  There's no after taste, and it gives a flavor just as if you were using sugar in your tea or coffee.  It also does not give any acid reflux like I've experienced using other artificial sweetners.

column4: I. D. Barbosa "one million dollar smile"
column10: NatraTaste is a very good sugar for me while Splenda and Equal cripple my muscles which makes them hard to get up of the bed in the morning. I don't have that problem with NatraTaste which is supposed to be the same kind of sugar.

Cans came crushed and six were open and leaking on everything.  Amazon credited me for six open cans.  However, after opening some of the rest, there were  black spots on top.  This should never have been sold, as I think the cans were old merchandise.  Never again will I buy this product.

column9: excellent natural food for my puppies
column10: Up until I discovered this brand, I was prepping the dog's food myself...I don't give my dogs commercially prepared dog foods.I first found this dog food in my local grocery store and was very happy to see the ingredients were really all natural. Later I was upset to discover that the grocery store stopped carrying this item. I found it on Amazon (who knew?) and ordered it at the same price and free shipping, to boot.BTW, my dogs love it though I still add a little home cooking to it.

14 out of 24 cans arrived dented, due to inadequate packaging (boxes were shrink wrapped to a cardboard tray and then thrown in a shipping box with a small amount of butcher paper).  Dense material like canned goods should be surrounded with packing peanuts in order to arrive undamaged.  Needless to say, I will not order canned goods again through Amazon.This is not the end of the story.  Amazon's standard policy on damaged food is 10%, or 20% maximum discount.  In this case, 58.3% of the food  arrived damaged--and no way was I going to pay for what I won't use.  After 1/2 hour on the phone, the customer service manager granted me an "exception" and allowed a refund of 58.3% of my purchase price.  But I should not have had to waste so much of my time insisting on it.That said, Harmony Farms dog food itself is a great product.  The reason I'm willing to pay almost $2 per can is that it's made in the USA (no danger of melamine, etc.).  So there you have it.  Good product, but you'll probably be happier if you find a place to buy it locally.

I am really pleased with this food, and so is my dog. It is a premium food at an affordable price. More importantly though, my old dog likes it and eagerly looks forward to it. We have also noticed that the terrible flatulence he had daily has stopped. To be fair, at the same time I switched his dry food to Happy Hips, so that may also be a factor.  I do wish they made smaller size cans and made a variety pack with more than 2 selections in it, but I am happy with this food and will continue to buy it.

When a shampoo is really creamy I tend to think it is going to weigh down my hair. Such was not the case with this luxuriously lathering shampoo. It deep cleaned my hair and scalp and seemed to leave each strand a little more nourished. After I blowdried my hair I could really see an increase in volume. My hair was also shiny and quite bouncy. One thing I noticed while using this shampoo is that you need less conditioner. I also had to learn to use much less shampoo than I normally use. Just a quarter size amount in your palm is all you really need. The mild floral scent is also lovely.~The Rebecca Review

column9: I like it - I'll buy it!
column10: Clear arrived just as my other product was all gone, so I was ready to give it a good try.  I have short, gray-silver, rather thin hair, so I'm always looking for something to "pump" it up and give it some body.  This shampoo really works - I like the way it cleans, leaving hair squeaky clean - and, with my usual blow-dry, I was definitely sporting a more "poofy" style.  My hair didn't flatten out the way it usually does the next day, so it looks like I've found my new root-boosting shampoo!

column9: Cleans well and doesn't give oily rebound
column10: When I first saw the shampoo I was skeptical- it looked the consistency of white hand lotion and I was afraid it would hold down my fine hair.  But it doesn't. The smell is light and the shape of the shampoo container is opposite of the conditioner so people with bad eyes won't confuse them while in the shower without glasses. It is too soon to know if this will help hair grow by nourishing the roots but when used with the matching conditioner and a blow-dryer it seems to have a lasting lift.  I've used it twice. Will report back if there is long term hair growth (although that might be more than a shampoo can do.)

column9: Creamy, pleasant shampoo -- leaky bottle detracts
column10: I used CLEAR SCALP & HAIR BEAUTY Volumizing Root Boost Nourishing Shampoo for about a week.  It's a very creamy shampoo, and a little goes a very long way. I have long, thin hair, and I like shampoos that don't weight it down, but make it feel fuller and lusher.  This did that.  There is a floral scent, which may or may not be pleasing to all users.  I found it stronger in the bottle than on my hair, which was left gently scented after blow drying.I did use this with the companion conditioner, CLEAR SCALP & HAIR BEAUTY Volumizing Root Boost Nourishing Conditioner, 12.7 Fluid Ounce, so I can't comment on whether or not the shampoo on its own works to "volumize" hair.  The label does suggest massaging the shampoo into the scalp (to nourish the roots) -- I did this, but whether it works or not will be determined over time.The leaky bottle seems to be an issue with most of the reviewers here.  The shampoo arrived wrapped in plastic, and then in bubble wrap.  The bottle has one of those push-down lids, which is simply too loose to seal properly for shipment.  I didn't lose as much of the product as some reviewers did, but the bottle was a sticky mess that had to be cleaned off before using.Bottom line, this is a serviceable shampoo that left my hair feeling soft and full.

column9: I do not use scented shampoo so I won't be able to try Clear shampoo
column10: I had seen commercials recently on TV for Clear Shampoo. My hair used to be oily and thin but with age has become more dry and frizzy. When I saw this was available through the Vine program I ordered it. I'm always looking for the next best shampoo. It was packaged in a padded envelope. When I started to open the flap I could smell a strong scent in the package. The shampoo bottle itself was wrapped in plastic so if by chance the bottle was punctured shampoo would not leak out. The shampoo is made to come out of a small hole in the top of the flip-top. I realize since it was in the package the scent was concentrated but nevertheless I did not like it. I am sensitive to smells so generally don't use scented products, especially shampoo. Others may not find the scent bothersome but that is not the case for me. I won't be using the shampoo because of it so I will not be able to provide any further review of it.

I did not buy this at first because I figured it was another gimmick all shampoos guarantee they are the best thing for your hair etc.This product is worth the money and I saw results after one use and keep seeing healthy hair after each continued use.ProsNice scent that lastsHair is shiny and not weighed down by excessive productHair visibly looks healthierCons-If you are used to a thick coverage with your shampoo/conditioner (i.e lather and creamy conditioner) this probably isn't the product for you.-Small container sizeRemember this is not a regular shampoo and conditioner so it is not suppose to be used as one make sure to read directions before you use so you can see maximum results.

I have seen the commercials for this product on tv, and so, I was excited when I saw I could try it for free on Amazon Vine. I was not at all happy with this product.First, when I received this product, it had a plastic bag over the top. But it was completely open on the bottom and not sealed on at all. As a result, about a 1/3 of the shampoo leaked into the envelope.Second, I tried this product for about 5 days. I really liked the scent of this shampoo and was anxious to try it. But this shampoo is extremely thick and goopy. It is very hard to rinse completely out of your hair. Even though I was only using a quarter-sized amount at a time, this product left my hair very dull, heavy, and greasy looking. my hair is very thick and I have a lot of it, and it does tend to be oily, so I don't typically use conditioner. After several days, this prodct made my hair look like I hadn't washed for a while. Needless to say, I have stopped using this product and gone back to my old shampoo. I was not all happy with this product and wouldn't recommend it.However, I let my mom try it and she just loves it. She has a lot of hair, but it is baby fine. Her hair tends to be flat and doesn't have much body. She said that it makes her hair feel a lot more full and soft. So results seem to depend on your hair type. If you fine hair, I would recommend giving this product a try. However, if you thick hair, I would recommend skipping it.

This volumizing shampoo should probably be used with a conditioner from this CLEAR product line, but even without the separate conditioner, this is a nice product.  I'm not sure what a five star shampoo would consist of, so I'm giving it just four stars.  I think it's fair to say it's above average, for sure.

column9: Subtle clean scent and a great basic shampoo
column10: This shampoo promises to add volume to your strands and it is clinically proven to aid  in restoring your scalp's natural moisture balance. It has Nutrium 10 which is an advanced moisture complex of vitamins and nutrients including vitamins B5, C & E, sunflower, almond, soybean & coconut oils & aloe vera.  The scent is pleasing and lingers even after your hair is dry.  It lathers easily and rinses cleanly. I didn't notice too much of a difference in my scalp but I did like the shine and bounce this formula gave me when I used it with the color protect conditioner.

I was skeptical about trying this shampoo, because it seemed too inexpensive to be very good, but it was on a great sale so I decided to go for it.  I have long hair that is very fine (but a lot of it) and am very prone to flyaways. My hair also gets oily pretty fast. It also tends to get stringy and tangled throughout the day because it's so fine. I have to have a brush handy to keep it nice.After a few days of using this shampoo (in combination with the matching conditioner), I noticed a nice shine to my hair and the flyaways weren't as prevalent. I didn't notice a change in volume, but so far the changes were positive, so I kept using it.  Now I've been using it for about 3 weeks, and I can definitely say I love this shampoo.  The flyaways are almost completely gone, my hair is shiny and soft, and it definitely has more bounce and volume to it now than it did a few weeks ago. My hair also isn't ending up so stringy and tangled by the end of the day.  If these results continue through to the end of the bottle, I'll definitely be getting this again, especially since it's way cheaper than the shampoos I usually buy.  Plus it smells great!The reviews are varied on this shampoo, and hair type seems to be the biggest factor.  I'd say for really fine hair, it works well, but everyone's hair is different!  Personally, it worked wonders for me.

It's hard to find a product that will make your hair look shiny and healthy and still have lots of volume.  Clear Scalp does just that.  I was very impressed with the luxuriously thick lather.  It almost feels like whipped cream once you start scrunching it around in your hair.  I love it.  The only reason I didn't give it 5 stars is that I don't especially love the smell.  I think they were going for something that would appeal to men or women so it's basically just a sort of bland, fresh smell which isn't bad but I'd like something more floral or citrusy.  At any rate, my hair, which is fairly short and color treated, washed thoroughly clean with only one lather.  I went on to use the corresponding conditioner and that review is posted with the conditioner.  Needless to say, I loved them both and will definitely buy these products in the future.  Everyone in my family has tried it and all have remarked on how shiny, soft and bouncy their has looks after just one use.

column9: CLEAR SCALP & HAIR BEAUTY Volumizing Root Boost Nourishing Shampoo, 12.9 Fluid Ounce -- well worth its volume in gold!
column10: CLEAR SCALP & HAIR BEAUTY Volumizing Root Boost Nourishing Shampoo was the eureka discovery of the year for me, especially because I did not expect any difference in my hair from a shampoo that goes for about $5 a pop.  However, wow, once I tried Clear Volumizing shampoo, the product has taken the place of my other costly volumizing shampoos.This Leo's mane is the most important feature on my body, and I have never sacrificed great hair for cheap products. However, hairspray queen that I am, anything that says it will give a boost to my super-fine, limp hair finds its way home with me.From my initial encounter with Clear, I saw a difference.  My hair looked fuller.  Other costly products make my hair look fuller, but with a drier look.  This shampoo gave me sheen like a conditioner without the limp feel of a conditioning shampoo.  Additionally, my hair was so much easier to style than after shampooing with those costlier volumizing shampoos - a half a bottle of hairspray on my hair as opposed to a full bottle!  LOL!Seriously, I've been using Clear for over a week, and I can't get over the difference in my hair.  Oh, yes, the fragrance is nice and the appearance of the shampoo itself,  but to me--I don't care if it smells like manure pouring out of the bottle, I just want -not good--but great hair ... so I can give that lioness within full reign upon the day ahead ... this brand of Clear is something to roar about.Stacy Lytwyn, Marketing Guru/Motivational Speaker/JournalistAuthor: CONSUMMATE CONNECTICUT: DAY TRIPS WITH PANACHE

After the careful consideration of a team of players, the general consensus was that the CLEAR SCALP & HAIR BEAUTY Volumizing Root Boost Nourishing Shampoo, 12.9 Fluid Ounce works well for most types of hair. It is not particularly fragrant and that was cause for satisfaction from those that dislike strong smells emanating from a clean hair. The amount offered versus the pricing makes this product your average purchase. For someone who is plagued with thin hair this shampoo does, indeed, revitalize somewhat the hair and scalp, but the results are probably in prolonged use of the same product.Overall, everyone appeared satisfied and still enjoys this shampoo on the daily routine of life. The container is solid and secure and no unwanted spills were reported when transportation was required. With these conclusions in mind this shampoo get a very decent 4 Stars rating from us.

I ordered this because I was running out of my usual shampoo and decided to try a new product. I was pleasantly surprised and very delighted with this shampoo. It has a pleasant smell but not heavy like some. It suds up well with not much product and rinses to leave your hair fresh and clean. I have very fine hair and need a product that will give me volume without heaviness and I can say with confidence that this product does that. I will definately buy it again.

I like this shampoo.  I don't know that it necessarily volumizes hair, but it definitely cleans the hair and scalp really well.  Also, this is the thickest lather that I've ever had with a shampoo, so I like that as well.

I received & reviewed the dandruff formula version of this shampoo prior to using this. I loved it and got great results; however, I was no fan of the overpowering scent. Happily, the fragrance in  this one is far less overwhelming, and the results as just as good if not better. I love this shampoo. It is my current favorite, and I intend to buy this well after my freebie runs out.Speaking as someone with fine, oily hair which must be washed everyday in the summer, this leaves my hair clean without feeling stripped. It also does a good job removing product build-up. It's truly better than many of the salon brands I have tried. Overall, a winner.

Full disclosure:  I didn't try this shampoo myself.  However, my wife (and, as you will see, my daughter) did try it.  The following are my wife's comments as transcribed by me.Having heard a lot about Clear's products (and as the frequent sufferer of "bad hair days"), I was looking forward to trying Clear's Volumizing Root Boost Nourishing Shampoo.  Sadly, after two weeks of daily use, I can safely say that the product didn't meet my expectations.The first thing I noticed when I opened the bottle was the fragrant, but not overpowering, clean scent.  While the shampoo did look like thick milk, I wasn't bothered by its appearance.  Upon application, I found that the lather was abundant.  But, my first hint that the product's performance wouldn't match its presentation occurred when the shampoo's very nice scent dissipated quickly after I rinsed my hair.  The disappearing scent was matched by little, if any, volumizing, and no root boost, as evidenced by the number of fly-aways that I had after starting my use of the shampoo (equal to the number I had before using this shampoo).  I will say that my scalp didn't dry out from using the product.  But, there really wasn't any difference in my scalp's condition from before using Clear.I used the Clear shampoo both before and after I had a haircut, and the result was the same.  I will offer two caveats to my general observation.  First, I didn't use the Clear conditioner, or any other conditioner, with this shampoo.  It's possible that using the conditioner would have helped the shampoo's performance.  Second, while I have slightly wavy hair with medium body, my six-year-old daughter has very thick straight hair.  I tried the shampoo on her, and found her hair kept the fragrance and had a nice shine and bounce to it.  So, perhaps this shampoo works better on thicker hair.Overall, Clear's Volumizing Root Boost Nourishing Shampoo wasn't anything special.  While I liked the scent and the lather, the results on my hair were negligible.  After all is said and done, I'll go back to my old shampoo once I'm done with this bottle of Clear.

column9: Great Product and Even Better Design
column10: Having turned the product over to the women-folk for their analysis, it received a positive review. I honestly don't know much about shampoo and usually just use the soap from the dispenser at the gym, so my level of expertise in this area is less than zero.However, they like it for several reasons. First, it seems they like the over quality, fragrance, and all that stuff. Second, the design is great. The bottle can be stored with the tab at the bottom so that you don't have to shake the living daylights out of it when it gets half full.It's nice to see a bottle of shampoo that hasn't been squeezed so hard it looks like it's been mangled by a bear.Points for quality and design. I'll be picking more up soon.

I have really enjoyed using Clear Scalp and Hair Beauty shampoo.  It has a pleasant fragrance and my hair feels really clean and not weighed down.  However, the bottle is poorly designed.  Shampoo leaks out of the top where the two pieces are combined and also leaks out the lid.  A more conventional bottle would improve this product.

I've got hair that on a bad day has the texture and attractiveness level of tiny feathers, completely uncontrollable and lacking in body and focus.  As a result, I've got a pile of shampoo and conditioner combos stacked on my tub shelf.  Most make my hair feel waxy.  Some dry it out even worse than I thought possible.  A couple do nothing for the body but smell really nice.  Naturally I had to try Clear Scalp & Hair Beauty volumizing root boost nourishing shampoo.  I did not have high hopes.I was pleasantly surprised (still am) that it works (in conjunction with the matching conditioner) so well that I like my hair again.  The shampoo feels silky in use and leaves my hair the same way but with a subtle added body boost.  Nice fragrance, rinses clean quickly, removes the tons of product I tend to lavish on my locks to cement them into place, and my hair looks really good all the time.  Woo-HOO!I've only been using this product for about a week, but I look forward to even better results as time goes by. Definitely worth a try.

I am always looking for volumizing shampoos. I have a few that I really like, but I find that my hair is more manageable when I switch between two shampoos and conditioners. I had never seen this product before and decided to try it. My hair loved it, and that means so do I.I like it because:It has a nice scent to it - not that awful fake apple smell that so many shampoos have.It definitely does not weigh my hair down.My hair seemed to be a bit fuller after blow-drying than usual.I wish they made a version of this for color-treated hair. That would be perfect for me! In any case, I like this shampoo enough that I am going to try the corresponding conditioner in hopes that it will deliver the same results.UPDATE: I have tried the conditioner. It's quite honestly the only "volumizing" conditioner I have used that actually delivers on that promise.I have very fine, straight hair that doesn't have much fullness. As a result, I have tried just about every volumizing hair product out there. My hair is definitely fuller after using this conditioner, no matter what shampoo I use with it, and it maintains the fullness between shampoos. It's also soft and very easy to style. Without a doubt, this brand has become my new favorite.

column9: Volumize - For a Certain Hair Type
column10: As noted by some other reviewers, my sample of this product also leaked in transit. This may be a package design that needs to be re-thought.Anyway, it comes out of the container feeling quite thick and goopy, rather more like a conditioner than a shampoo. It didn't feel very much like shampoo. It lathers indifferently well, and as far as the scent goes ... meh. Take it or leave it alone, nothing particularly special. My hair is very fine and wavy; it did a satisfactory job of volumizing, but I can easily see why other reviewers with straight and not-so-fine hair would be left dissatisfied.

column9: GREAT RESULTS AT A GREAT PRICE!
column10: I have baby-fine hair, but tons of it.  I usually purchase salon shampoos which range from $15 - $20 per bottle.  I am always looking for a shampoo that will provide me with softness and manageability without the need for a daily conditioner since conditioner tends to weigh my hair down and make it appear flat.  When I first opened the bottle, I was pleased with the pleasant scent.  It is aromatic, but not overwhelming.  With the first use, my hair, which is currently dry from daily swimming, was softer than it had been with a much more expensive salon brand.  I was worried that the softness might lead to a flatter appearance.  To my surprise, my hair was manageable and styled very nicely with plenty of lift at the root.  I have now been using the shampoo daily for almost a week and am very pleased with the softness of my hair while still getting the volume I am looking for.  I have truly been getting better results than I had been getting from a salon brand costing over three times as much.  I recommend you try this product!

column9: Worked fine, won't replace my usual
column10: The Clear Scalp and Hair Beauty etc. shampoo worked fine to clean my hair, (medium length, very fine, very naturally curly), and it left my hair soft and as manageable as curly hair can be in a humid summer climate.  However, I noticed my hair and scalp felt slightly grungier than usual the day after shampooing.  This made me suspect it may not rinse out as cleanly as my usual brand (Pantene Fine Hair Solutions Volume Shampoo). The shampoo is very strongly scented,  somewhere between fruity and floral.  I didn't care for the fragrance, but I didn't notice it once my hair was dry.  Presumably it is being packed differently when shipped to retailers, as I, too, had shampoo all over the package when I opened it.

column9: Mixed results for fine, thin hair
column10: I'm always in the market for new product that will add volume without weight to my not-so-fine fine hair.  After reading multiple reviews on this shampoo, I was a little worried that I was in for yet another disappointing, weighted-down hair experience.  What a pleasure then to note on first use that it not only supplied more body but was helpful in controlling those unfortunate waves that develop with age.I think this shampoo builds up over time; I get good results with occasional use, but regular use makes for a sorry, drowned-rat effect. Interesting though, while humidity (of which we have little here in Denver) is my hair's worst enemy, rain on a Clear Scalp shampoo day did not raise that dreaded halo of frizz.

My wife used this product and has nothing but good to say about it. She has told everyone how good it is. She said it brought real shine to her hair and left it as soft as can be. I as she would say it is the best. We will buy it.

column9: 'Clean' shampoo has a pungent perfume scent, works OK as a shampoo
column10: Like most women, I'm always on the lookout for that next really great beauty product, whether it be a cosmetic, a perfume, or a hair product. One of the basics for me is having healthy, pretty hair. When I saw CLEAR SCALP & HAIR BEAUTY Volumizing Root Boost Nourishing Shampoo, I was intrigued. The name implies something very basic and healthy without too many chemicals.When it arrived, I was disappointed to find that it had not been packaged well. Where the conditioner (which was sent in a separate package) had the dispenser taped down and the entire bottle wrapped in plastic, the shampoo was merely wrapped in plastic. Without the tape holding the dispenser closed, the shampoo leaked all in the plastic during shipping. On a good note, the plastic wrapping proved good enough to contain the leakage so that it didn't even touch the cardboard box.When I removed the plastic, I was immediately stunned at the pungent perfume smell of the leaked shampoo. I had expected something light and `clear' and not this heavy perfume stench. Once I finished washing the bottle off, the scent stayed on my hands for hours afterwards, lasting through several thorough hand washings. For someone like me who prefers most products to be unscented, this was a huge turnoff.Although the shampoo has a heavy perfume scent, it isn't quite as bad when used in the hair as it had been when it was leaked out of the bottle. It is still a stronger scent than I like, but not as bad as I feared.The shampoo washes fine but I have to say that it doesn't do any better than the Pantene Shampoo that I have used for some time. It also doesn't seem to make any difference in my hair's volume than my Pantene offers.Once this bottle is finished, I will return to Pantene. I prefer it's lighter, fresh scent and am very satisfied with how it cleans my hair.

Was excited to try this shampoo due to the volumizing claims. I have very thick, heavy hair that just hangs there, so am always on the lookout for something to pump up the volume! Maybe it would work on someone with finer hair, but it did not give me the hoped-for results.It arrived in an envelope, with the bottle wrapped in plastic. Sending shampoo in an envelope seemed like a strange choice, as mine had leaked enough that I needed to wash the bottle off. The shampoo has a pleasant scent, and comes out of the bottle thick and creamy. Lathered up nicely and was easy to rinse out. It cleaned my hair, but did nothing more after several weeks of usage, so don't think I would buy it.

This product has improved several issues for me. For one, I have sensitive skin & so my scalp becomes irritated rather easily. Within 2 days of using this shampoo (& just the shampoo at the time, so imagine how much better the results when using the conditioner as well), I noticed a reduction in the number AND size of scalp bumps I had. Also, in recent years I have had major issues with tangles. Well, this shampoo left my hair so soft after just the first use even, I don't at all have to worry about struggling to comb my hair through when I use it. And now I see they have multiple products I can use, specifically formulated for my color-treated hair as well--excellent!

column9: Super Drying, Strong Smell, Poor Cap Design
column10: I have fine, medium length hair and normally use a very mild shampoo that cleans well without drying my hair out, followed by a good Rinse-Out conditioner. My favorite shampoos are Paul Mitchell's Shampoo One and Pantene Pro-V for Fine Hair Volume Shampoo. They wash really clean and leave my hair nice and bouncy. I couldn't wait to try this New CLEAR Scalp and Hair Therapy Volumizing Root Boost Shampoo. What everyone wants, who has fine hair, is body at the roots. They list a lot of vitamins in this shampoo for your scalp that sound great too.When this New CLEAR Scalp and Hair Therapy Volumizing Root Boost Shampoo arrived it was sealed in a plastic bag inside of a bubble wrap envelope. The bag was soaked through in both the bubble envelope and the inner plastic sealed bag. When I opened it up to see what was the problem- the cap is so poorly designed that it leaks at the seal. The flip top was not opened, it literally leaks at the seal, where the bottle connects to the cap. I can't even begin to tell you about the strong smell of this shampoo. It is overwhelming and so perfumey, it's really hard to take. I ignored this poorly designed bottle and the strong perfume smell and went on to try the product, as sometimes shampoo smells are milder when you rinse them out of your hair.The first thing I noticed is that the shampoo is a really thick pink cream- not like my see through completely clear Shampoo One or completely clear see through Pantene for Fine hair. This should have been a dead give away that this shampoo is not good for fine hair, as my hairdresser said if you can't see through the shampoo- it's NOT for Fine hair. I tried the shampoo and it hardly foams up, but lays on your hair, coating it really thick. It doesn't rinse out well, leaving my hair greasy, yet my hair dried frizzy and felt dried out at the scalp. This is without a doubt the strangest shampoo I've ever used- how can a cream leave your hair and scalp dry and frizzy? The smell was not as overwhelming when the shampoo was rinsed out- but still not a pleasant smell. I couldn't wait to wash my hair again with my Pantene and get this strange drying cream out of my hair. If you have Fine hair- I would not recommend this shampoo- it was one of the worst shampoos I've ever tried.

column9: Does the job, but not for everybody
column10: Clear Scalp & Hair Beauty does what it claims - my hair felt fuller after washing - but because it has sulfates as a leading ingredient, it is not perhaps for color-treated hair. Color aside, it has a pleasant scent, lathers well, and washes out without leaving a greasy feel as some nourishing shampoos do. If color detriment was not involved, I would not hesitate to use it again.

I waited until I'd used this shampoo for a couple of weeks before reviewing to make sure any difference I saw was actually due to the shampoo.  Well, it seems to be.  My hopelessly limp, dry and fine hair looks terrific.  I haven't used any conditioner either, just the shampoo.  I also have problems with dry itchy scalp and have noticed that's improved as well.  I generally have several different shampoos I switch between but would rather have only one or two brands in use.  I've only had one other brand please me enough to rebuy, otherwise I'm just trying to use up whichever kinds I have on hand.  I see a commercial and hope that kind will meet my needs, but they rarely impress me.The other type that I've found I like needs its companion conditioner as well and I'll continue to use it, but I really value being able to meet my hair needs in one shot (no conditioner) and will continue to use this brand regularly.  The only downside I see is that there are so many different formulas, all with long names, that remembering the one I want will be a challenge.  Guess I'll have to keep this in my Amazon cart to refer back to as needed :).  I looked through the various kinds offered and thought this formula seemed like the best for me.  It does indeed offer lift and body without drying my hair, leaves my hair manageable and feeling healthy and my scalp feels less dry.  My hair, which is thin, also appears thicker, which I'm grateful for. I definitely recommend this brand.

column9: shampoos well but didn't give me volume
column10: The shampoo like the conditioner has an odd feel to it, it kind of feels like it coats my hair. Maybe that is the way companies are trying to achieve volume? It didn't create any volume for me it actually made my hair a little more flat. I have wavy hair and as long as the products do not leave a heavy coating on my hair it remains wavy and has some decent volume. Sorry to say this did not create any volume at all for me. I think it is actually more suited to someone wanting to make their hair more smooth and straight.

The name says it all- Clear Scalp and Hair  - leaves your hair clear of all products used since the last shampoo! Volumizing - not only does it build up your hair at its roots, but also gives it volume to the end of your hair. Nourishing - if your hair tends to be dry - you will want to try this shampoo! My hair has never looked so good nor has it ever been this easy to manage!

I got samples of this shampoo and conditioner so I tried it yesterday. For the first time EVER I did not need to wash my hair the next day. All the buildup on my scalp is gone and my hair feels silky smooth. Everyday I scratch my scalp and get my fingernails full of gunky build-up but today....NOTHING!! I only used this once so I will come back to update. Must buy.

I had seen the commercials on TV and thought since I have naturally fine un-treated blonde hair I would give it a try.Within one month my hair was falling out. Not just a little, A LOT.  Hairbrush full, shower, or just falling out.Thought it might be Thryoid, hormones or something else.  Went to the doctor and had all blood work done.  Everything FINE!I read comments for all brands of CLEAR on Amazon, found A LOT of people were having the same issues....Quit using the shampoo and went BACK to Pantene.  Within 2 weeks, my hair was slowing down in falling out.  Within 3 weeks, much to none was falling out.Called the manufacturer and complained.  They said this was unusual...  I advised them to check customers comments on Amazon.They offered to send me coupons for free porducts...If you want to give this shampoo a try, good luck.  If your hair starts to fall out, remember this comment.  IT MAKES YOUR HAIR FALL OUT.

Had long hair in the 70's , and a little shorter every decade since. Not really by choice , just kinda a "gettin' older" thing.So wanting to preserve what I have left , I look for products that nourish a depleting field. Clear Scalp And Hair Beauty" does the job. It is very refreshing to apply , and doesn't over-foam like SO many competitor's. Rather invigorating and rinse clean.

column4: M. Whitmore "Buying books has put me in the p...
column10: I purchased this shampoo at a local big box retailer. I had high hopes for this product as a "normal" shampoo (aka NOT Head and Shoulders) that would also mitigate symptoms of dry scalp (though this is not the dandruff formula, it does contain zinc pyrithione, which is the active ingredient in dandruff shampoos).Overall, I have been disappointed in this product. Most egregiously, it makes my hair stringy and very flat--the opposite of the volumizing effects it claimed to offer. In addition, it only did a passable--not great--job at keeping my scalp moisturized. I suppose perhaps the specific anti-dandruff formula does better with that, but since this shampoo claims to promote hair AND scalp health, I expected better. Finally, as ofther reviewers have mentioned, the product can get gloppy; the bottle gets blocked up pretty frequently, even though I'm careful not to leave it open or spill any shampoo around the opening.I gave two stars because the shampoo does have a pleasant smell and a nice lather. Maybe it works better on other hair types, but this is not the stuff for me.

I found this shampoo to be nice but nothing exceptional.  I like the clean smell and it does rinse out clean but the increase in volume wasn't anything to run home about.  I would buy this just for the fact it does rinse clean and doesn't leave any residue behind!

I tried this shampoo and was very disappointed.  The product left my hair looking greasy or oily even though it was clean.  This wasn't later in the day, but as soon as I finished using it.  It also did not increase the volume of my hair.  I had also hoped that it might be good for my scalp, but I did not find it especially good in that regard either.

The selling point of this shampoo is that it doesn't contain parabens so, theoretically, the target market for these is the health-conscious.  As such, I think this falls rather short of the mark.The consistency of the shampoo is all right; it's a bit thin so it's easy to spill at first.  Once you get used to it, though, it's fine.  It lathers well, and it does the job.However, it has a horrendously strong perfumey chemical fragrance.  We find this fragrance truly awful (and overpowering), and it completely undermines any concept of "clear" or "pure" or "less unhealthy" in our minds.We'll take a pass on this one and stick with something less obviously scented.

I like this shampoo and I've very picky about what hair products I use. It leaves my hair soft, silky, and clean and helps keep it tangle-free! (Full disclosure: I use this shampoo w/ the matching conditioner 99% of the time so I'm not sure if it's the shampoo or conditioner that helps with less tangling, but even before using the conditioner after shampooing my hair feels nice and smooth and soft and not knotty.)The shampoo smells fantastic and I like it better than Pantene and Herbal Essences and other more expensive salon brands that I've tried like Paul Mitchell.The bottle doesn't say that it's safe for colour-treated hair, however I have highlighted hair and have been using this product for several weeks with no ill effects on my coloured hair. Your mileage may vary of course.

column9: Seems to do what it claims, with nice mild fragrance
