column10: This is an interesting new product.  The shampoo, used along with the conditioner, seems to actually increase fullness of my fine hair.  It will probably take using it regularly for a month or two (I didn't notice any claims about a period of time for it to work) before one can be sure.  It has a very light and pleasant fragrance.  Usually I prefer fragrance-free but this is not bad and I've not noticed any itching or burning I usually get from fragranced products.  It has a flat end to stand it upright in shower or bath (opening end is down to enable use of that final last drop.  It lathers nicely even with the hard water here.  Left my hair squeaky clean and is something I would buy again.  Thanks!

I really like this shampoo.  Not a lot is required for a full head of suds, but more importantly is the softness and shine it gives your hair.My hair is very fine and has thinned over the years.  I'm not quite sure this product makes my hair look any thicker, but it does appear to have more body.I will continue to use this product.Thank you.MEF

I used this CLEAR SCALP & HAIR BEAUTY Volumizing Root Boost Nourishing Shampoo & Conditioner this week and am enjoying very light and bouncy hair.I have a ton of very fine medium blonde hair that is to my lower back and this shampoo and conditioner combo really works for me! I shampoo my hair about every other day or so.I will be buying this again once my review samples run out, it gives good results at a great price.

This is a decent shampoo. However, it is not clear; it is milky. It is heavily fragranced with that fruity floral beloved of pretty much all drugstore shampoos--why? It left my hair feeling coated and silky--like I'd used a combination shampoo+conditioner--which is a scary thing to a person with fine, thin, limp, hair, such as might be expected to choose a volumizing root boost shampoo. I cannot imagine who would use the matching conditioner.That said, my jaw-length hair is not weighed down and I didn't use or need to use any extra conditioning product either. It is overly fragrant with a girly teen kind of fragrance.Of course, it's stupid concept to begin with--the only way to "nourish" your hair or scalp is by eating good food. You can condition it, which is what this does well enough. I might buy it again if it just weren't so perfumed!! If I got a migraine, I'd need to wash my hair!

column9: Smells great and makes your hair look great
column10: This is a creamy and thick formulation that cleans styling products out of my hair without stripping it.  My hair is left feeling soft, full and smelling great.  I'm a big Pantene fan but this is a great shampoo to alternate with.  I didn't need a conditioner which helps keep my hair looking full and not flat.

column9: Smells great, cleans well, but isn't volumizing
column10: I've got fine, curly hair so I have to be careful not to use conditioner too often or it will be limp and the curls won't be bouncy.  I sometimes use shampoos with the conditioners already in them, because separate conditioners are too much.  I often use volumizing shampoo because it tends to strip oils out of my hair and keep it from  being weighed down.I liked this Clear Scalp & Hair volumizing root nourishing shampoo.  It lathers nicely and smells good, and rinses easily.  The bottle is easy to hold on to, and the price for 12 ounces in the bottle is good.  Like some of the other reviewers reported, my bottle arrived in a plastic bag.  The bottle had popped open in shipping and some of the shampoo had leaked out in the bag.This shampoo left my hair soft, shiny and obviously moisturized, but it did weigh my hair down and I had to wash it again the next day. I didn't notice any volumizing with this shampoo - in fact it had the opposite effect for me.I gave the bottle to my daughter to try, since she has dry hair and uses tons of conditioner with every shampoo.  She really liked the scalp nourishing aspect of this product, although she didn't notice any volumizing effects either.
My hair feels pretty silky and seems to be less frizzy than normal. It has less volume than with my normal shampoo, though. The product is fine, but nothing remarkable.

column9: Nice Shampoo, not really volumizing though.
column10: This shampoo has a nice light scent and a pretty lavender color.  The ingredients are a mix of healthy ingredients and conventional ones.  I have long hair so it is hard to give it volume because of the weight, but I didn't think this one particularly did much for my hair.  Towards the middle of the day I think mine started to get oily, which is a problem I have, but it was compounded by this shampoo I do believe.  In sum, this shampoo is okay but not great.

When I was younger, I was prone to trying whatever new product came along, eschewing the various benefits that I was seeking. Seldom, if ever, was there a payoff. When I see an advertisement for a product promising "bigger," "better," or "stronger," I don't even consider it. Imagine my surprise when I tried this new shampoo and actually noticed more volume in my hair after blow-drying it! Even weirder, two people asked me if I'd had my hair cut the day I used it. Seriously. It's not a miraculous change--it's a shampoo, not a weave--but it definitely makes a noticeable difference. The only negative comment I have, is that it has a fairly strong perfume scent, which I tend to avoid in soaps and shampoos, but I will absolutely continue to use it.

I really like the quality of this new shampoo...lots of bubbles, no fadeing of my blonde toned highlights either.  Also, it does what it says, lots of lift and volume.  The only thing I would probably change is the scent.  The scent is not anything special, but the quality of this product is great.  I will definitely purchase here.

First off, let me say that this shampoo smells fantastic and has great lather - two things that I value in a shampoo. Unfortunately, this shampoo has also left my hair a bit dry and without shine. I have color treated hair, and do not typically use a shampoo for color treated hair, since I find that the extra moisturizers in shampoos designed specifically for color treated hair tend to weigh my hair down. I typically purchase shampoos that are supposed to add volume, since I also have very thick hair that tends to get helmet-like if I don't use a volumizing shampoo. But apparently, this shampoo is not moisturizing enough for my hair type. So, if you have color treated hair that tends to get dry, I would suggest another shampoo or another brand.

This is a rally great shampoo! I have spent a small fortune over the years on shampoo's that promise greater volume and, sadly, have found very few that deliver. This, I'm happy to say, is one of the few. First off the shampoo itself has a nice thick texture to it and a very mild, not overpowering, pleasant sent. The end result is good volume and a visibly shiny, silky appearance to the hair. This shampoo is now in my shampoo rotation which up to this point included Johnathan Product and John Frieda Luxurious Volume (two other shampoo's I highly recommend to those with thin hair). I think it's a good idea to switch up shampoo's periodically. Will definitely be using this shampoo for a long time!

The main problem with the product is that it leaked in transit.  Luckily it's packaged very well so the package didn't arrive dripping but it was a bit of a mess to clean.  Also I received the shampoo courtesy of Amazon Vine but if I had actually paid for the product and lost a portion in transit I'd be very unhappy.  Overall I feel like the shampoo leaves my fine hair almost too soft so it's not holding it's style terribly well.  It has some gorgeous shine though and the colors in my hair seem very bright.  I'm not sure I'd spend the money on it in the future however.EDITED TO ADD:  Since I switched to this shampoo I've gotten a number of compliments on my hair and a bunch of people have asked if I got my hair cut (which I haven't).  If this continues then I'd certainly consider buying this again in the future.

I have bi-racial hair and highly processed colour treatment, so I'm beyond fussy with what I'll use on it to keep it clean. For over 10 years I've been using exclusively Redken's All Soft, at $20 bucks a bottle. It's never failed me and is certainly worth the price.When I've been at hotels or friend's homes, I've tried various products but in one washing, my ultra-tech hair style came out looking like a Witch's Broom...dry, brittle and awful...all in 1 washing! So, it was only because this was FREE, did I try it.I'm glad that I did! My hair is short (2") and layered and I did receive not only volume but also the 3-colour treatment did NOT lighten. And, it was as smooth and silky as the Redken product! A strange added bonus is that the white gold diamond pendant that I wear 24/7 actually sparkled MORE, after being simultaneously washed in the suds. LOLNow, I alternate between the pricy Redken and this brand, feeling happy and smug with saving the extra money.Side Note: When this product was shipped to me, it was double wrapped in shrink-wrap plastic but I could still smell the shampoo when I opened the envelope it was shipped to me in. After using a paring knife to cut/peel/slice away the double shrink wrap, I inherited one fat mess of shampoo oozing out from under the cap! No matter HOW MANY TIMES I'VE WASHED THE CAP, shampoo continues to leak out of it. So, if you can't find this product in a store, keep a head's up that THIS might happen to you, too. Doesn't detract from the quality of the product, however.

A couple of months ago I started using the Clear brand shampoos. I began with the "Strong Lengths" shampoo and conditioner, and my primary complaint was that it seemed to rob what little volume my hair had. So, I was excited to try the "Volumizing Root Boost."I will say that I did see an increase in volume. But, my hair is very fine and I just got it cut pretty short. So, if I didn't see an increase in volume to some extent with this shampoo, I'd call it a flop. The problem I have is that my hair is now more fly-away and less sleek and shiny than it was with "Strong Lengths."Here are my primary observations:1. My hair has appeared much healthier (and I have received comments from others to that effect) since I switched to Clear shampoos. That includes both product sets that I have tried.2. I would love to have tried the volume boost shampoo and conditioner set before I got my hair cut, but with short hair I'm not sure this would be my first choice. As much as I hate to use other products for volume, I think that might be the better solution for me.3. I have not tried using this shampoo with one of the other conditioner options, although I did try the volume boost conditioner with the strengthening shampoo. I don't know that I saw much of a difference mixing those two.So, bottom line - I still really like the Clear brand, and I don't dislike this particular product from the brand. I'm happy to have it and use it, but I'm not sure I'd go out of my way, with my hair cut and type, to purchase this product over other Clear products.

This shampoo is supposed to volumize and nourish the hair. I'll have to use it more. It smells good, suds are very thick and rinses clean. Doesn't make my hair dry. The one problem I had was the way they shipped it. It leaked in the envelope and the plastic bag they had it in. Wasted half of the bottle.

column9: Works as Shampoo, Not Sold on Volumizing roots
column10: What can I say? It's shampoo, it lathers up, smells pretty nice, cleans your hair and it burns when it gets in your eyes. As far as lifting my roots to make me look like a hair model, well, keep looking. After using it a few times, I noticed my root volume was about the same as when I use cheaper shampoo. I can say a little goes a long way. It only took a small amount (about a nickle size worth) to give good lather. And the shampoo has kind of a pearly, opaque look to it. Not that it makes any difference, but it did give me a moment of, "oooh,pretty."

column9: Not bad, but not for colored hair
column10: The shampoo arrived wrapped in plastic wrapping inside a padded envelope. I didn't have any leakage, but I did pick up a strong scent inside the package, but fortunately it isn't that strong when using the product (strong scents and I do not get along well). The shampoo has a very thick consistency and you don't need much to work up a lather. I've used it about four times now, and while I'm seeing a bit more *bounce* to my very fine hair, I suspect I'd have to use it for a longer period of time to see if there's any improvement to encouraging any growth at the scalp. And therein lies the rub - I don't think this is color safe. I'm at the end of my color cycle and due for a retouch any day now, so a bit more fading wasn't a huge issue, but if I'd just had it done and got that much fading I'd be a seriously unhappy camper. Not great, but not bad either IMHO.

column9: Might be good for others but NOT ME!
column10: The first problem I had with this shampoo, was expecting to see something CLEAR poured into my hand, given the name of it. When it came out a pinkish opaque I should have known that was only the beginning. But I proceeded to use it anyway and was sorely disappointed to the point of all out frustration, perhaps anger. I have very long hair, almost to my waist, and it's always been fine/limp, so seeing that this shampoo says VOLUMIZING, I expected it to do that. Instead it went on like conditioner without having used shampoo, and ultimately it felt like I gave my hair an oil bath. I actually had so much oily residue (or whatever that was!) as a result of using this, that I had to wash my hair again with GOOD shampoo (Pantene), to get that stuff off my hair. But in the meantime, while assessing the consequences of using "CLEAR", I found my hair to have zero body or fullness, and it was nearly impossible to get dry, or maybe it did get dry and felt so oily I couldn't tell. Either way, I absolutely hated it. I have been wondering what they were thinking, making a product like this. And as for it being opaque instead of clear, I find that odd, because every other volumizing shampoo I use (Pantene, Dove, Suave, etc) comes out clear and yet does not use that as their claim to fame.Regardless of that, I very generously gave this 2 stars because I am assuming my hair type must be at least partly to blame for my bad experience. I would hope this shampoo is useful for someone that has excessively dry or "wiry" hair who needs the deepest conditioning to tame it or soften it.

column9: Nice fragrance, good quality and fair price
column10: The bottle is attractive and its easy to get just the right amount of shampoo.  Don't need much though because it is thick and creamy.  I love the fragrance and the fact that it soaps up easily and rinses clean. I also like the price.  This is good value for the money.

Like some others who have commented, I always buy the least expensive -- Head and Shoulders -- for years. But this was an offer to good to pass up -- a free Amazon Vine trial.It exceeded my expectations. Based on the reviews of others, I used a very tiny amount and it was more than adequate.The entire family now uses it and loves it. My wife does the shopping; it will be interesting to see if she searches for this product the next time she goes shopping. I have no idea how it compares in price to Head and Shoulders, but it does not matter. It's great.

I have oily scalp and shampoos either end up leaving too much moisturizer in or too drying and gives me dull, fly away hair. I had no issues with this one. It's a cream like liquid that doesn't leave any oily after effects. Hair feels clean but not dry. I've only been using it for less than 2 weeks, but so far it's clean and clear sailing.

column9: Creamy shampoo that really is different
column10: We've always bought the cheapest shampoos in the store, judging that they were all pretty much the same.  Well, in this case at least, there is a difference.Both my wife and I tested this shampoo as well as its sister product, Total Care Nourishing Shampoo.  We saw very little difference between these two products, but they both stand well above the typical shampoo.  Coming out of the bottle they are both thick and creamy, and very little is needed to get a good lather going.  When it comes time to rinse out, they wash off easily, leaving no residue.  I was suspicious at first because my hair did not feel "squeaky clean" after rinsing, but once my hair was dry I could see that it was both clean and soft, not oily, and stayed that way all day, even wearing a hat.  Both shampoos also give some weight to the hair which, with my thinning hair, I really appreciate.  My wife also reported that with this shampoo, she felt no need to use conditioner.  The reader will see essentially the same review on both of the Clear Scalp products we tested, the only difference between them being that this one (Volumizing Root Boost) probably leaves the hair with a little more weight.  But we expect to give up our practice of buying the cheapest shampoos and will purchase one of these in the future.

column9: Your curly hair will love you for using this!
column10: I received this shampoo weeks ago and have been using it ever since.  It suds up nicely and really cleans my hair.  For curly-haired people, this is a great, light shampoo that doesn't feel heavy on your hair.  The volume-boosting has worked well, and my hair is not frizzy at all after using this product.  Also, it has a light floral smell.  You'd be surprised at how many volumizing shampoos have a strong, chemically odor.  This was aces all around.  Great, great product!

column9: Just so so.....shipping issue as well
column10: My shampoo was shipped in a bubble envelope and when I opened it the inside was a wet, goopy mess. The shampoo bottle was place in a plastic bag first, and then into the bubble envelope, but there was a slit in the plastic bottle and I list about 1/4 of the product as a result.Once I rinsed the bottle, I put it in the shower to try the following morning.  The shower seat was a goopy mess as well. Apparently there was a second leak from the bottom somewhere.I decided to try the shampoo anyway.  I have very fine hair, but quite a bit of it. My hair tends to look good when I wash it and dry it, but then go flat within an hour.  I was unsure about how this would work as it felt more like a cream rinse when I applied it than a shampoo.  I found it a bit hard to rinse out, and although my hair looked fine when I blew it dry, I did not have any extra volume like I was hoping -- based on the advertising.It wasn't awful in any way, but it isn't one I would buy again.  Plan to stick with eith my Paul Mitchell or Redkin favorites for now.

column9: Hair is soft and looks full.  Shampoo smells like the 80s.
column10: I have lupus, and every time I get a flare, I lose a ton of hair.  I also have severe reactions to some hair products that can cause even more hair loss.  A volumizing shampoo that doesn't cause bad reactions is like gold to me.  This shampoo works very well and did not cause my hair to fall out or my scalp to bleed.  The only downside to using it is the smell.  It smells a little cloying, like lotions and shampoos from the early 80s.  Whatever it is, my skin didn't react to it, so all's well that ends well.

column9: Serviceable shampoo perhaps better suited for buying in person
column10: I have been using this shampoo for a week now. I have been using it alone, without the additional conditioner. My hair is long, straight and very fine. I use volumizing shampoos as a matter of routine. I usually move between Pantene Pro-V Fine Hair Solutions Volume Shampoo and Paul Mitchell Thickening Shampoo, Lemon Sage. Both of these work great for me, although they have different issues. Pantene is instant volume, but coats your hair. Lemon Sage, if used with the conditioner, works well but costs a good bit more. It also creates build-up, but not nearly as quickly.I found this shampoo pretty much on par with those (left my hair soft, full and pleasantly but not strongly scented), with one exception - my hair looks pretty good immediately after I wash it, but not so good the day after, and since I typically wash my hair in the evening this means I don't get the benefit when I want it most. Both Pantene and Lemon Sage seem to last from shampoo to shampoo.Like Pantene, this product does build-up. The effect of this is to actually weigh down your hair and make it look flat and greasy. This can be counteracted by periodically using a good clarifying shampoo - weekly or every other week. I'm in-between at the moment, as the one I've used for some time has gone off the market. I wound up picking up Suave For Men, Deep Clean Peppermint even though I'm not a man, because it was the only one the store I was in seemed to carry, and I was out. But I'm in the market for something better. This one strips away the build-up, but it's very harsh; it actually burns my scalp.I experienced the same problem many others have reported: while it was only a small amount, my bottle leaked in shipment. I doubt I lost much product, but who would want to lose any? If I ever decide to pick this up again (and I may not, given the next day issue), I'll probably look for it in a store.I'll note that the product may perform better with the matching conditioner, but it might also lead to quicker product build-up.

column9: Mixed Feelings... Poor Packaging.. Hair Decent?
column10: First, like others have mentioned, mine arrived in a plastic wrap in a package with its lid open and shampoo all over the interior of the plastic wrap. Not only was it a mess to open.. but 1/3 the bottle was already gone. Next came trying the product.. so far 1 weeks time and I will update again after a month goes by. When I first put some on my hair and begain to lather I stopped and made sure I used the right bottle.... its like a cream, and doesn't feel like a shampoo normally would feel. I thought I grabbed the wrong bottle! I'm mixed on how the product feels, and thougth it would leave my hair hanging heavy from the feel of the product but it did not I have let my hair air dry and have blow dried it as well. Even with air drying I did feel some volumn to my hair. My hair is normally flat and I have used various products for volumne. However this product did not do any better then other products like Pantene, Herbel Essence, Paul Mitchel, and others. I tend to use various products and never the same shampoo when I run out. Its almost as if my hair gets use to a product and it no longer works well, so I mix it up.I do like the smell to the product and don't find it overwhelming as others suggested. I did not find it dulled my hair (I do have highlights)My hair did feel clean, not oily or dirty looking as others have experienced. Think this is a try it out and see kind of product. Everyones hair is so different so each review is based on the persons kind of hair really. My hair is normally not oily, but is flat and below shoulder length with highlights. I saw no major changes compared to other products so for that reason its OK. I do not like the cap to the bottle and again how its packaged. Nothing like getting a product and loosing 1/3 of it and having a huge mess..... perhaps if you want to try it try it at a local store.

CLEAR SCALP & HAIR BEAUTY Volumizing Root Boost Nourishing Shampoo. This scalp and hair volumizing shampoo is great for hair in need of volume. The shampoo is a creamy liquid and comes in a bottle that is easy to hold and open in the shower. It is called a nourishing shampoo because it nourishes the scalp as well as the  hair. The shampoo contains ten vitamins and nutrients which certainly make the product and hair smell good. I love this shampoo and it really has helped my hair by giving it more body and volume.

column9: Really does add a little volume
column10: I have super straight, baby-fine hair that has been my despair all my life.  Mess with it much, trying to give it volume, and you'll give it distress, which it shows by becoming yet more fine and breaking off.  So I was very interested to see if this shampoo could help.  And it really did give my hair a little extra bounce.  Not a huge amount, but there was a discernable difference.  It has a nice fragrance, too, and my hair feels really clean without any residue on it.  My only gripe is the bottle.  It's smaller at the bottom than it is at the top, and shaped oddly, too.  That's fine when it's in the little pocket holder in my shower, but when I get it out to use it, it's very easy for it to get unbalanced and fall over.  But, it's not that big a deal, overall.  I plan to try the conditioner, too.

The shampoo made my hair quite dull, and it was greasy just a few hours after washing, and made my scalp itch. I didn't notice any root boost or hair having any more volume, it looks quite fuzzy after the shampoo. I threw it away.

column9: Smells wonderful and leaves my hair soft and full bodied
column10: This shampoo is as wonderful as the conditioner.  It has a very fragrant and fresh smell.  I used this along with their conditioner and let my hair air dry. Besides the great fragance that remained, this shampoo (along with their complementary conditioner) left my hair full-bodied and soft.  I love this product and really like the sleek light lilac bottle it comes in (especially since my bathroom is light purple).From now on this will be one of my shampoos. I already ordered two extra bottles from Amazon besides the free one I got for review.POSTSCRIPT - The only complaint I have is that the bottle should be designed so that the product label can be read while it rests on its spout like the CLEAR SCALP & HAIR BEAUTY Volumizing Root Boost Nourishing Conditioner, 12.7 Fluid Ounce.  Basically I store the bottle flat end down so that the shampoo is always at the bottom (near the spout) and can be dispensed easily.  However, when you store it this way (which is the way the conditioner bottle was designed to be stored), the writing is upside down unlike the conditioner bottle which has the product label showing correctly.  This is a minor issue, however.

column9: I can see myself using this shampoo conistently
column10: I have very dry skin, including my scalp. I don't have a dandruff issue, just a dry scalp no matter what shampoos I've tried. This shampoo has stopped my head-scratching.Clear Scalp shampoo has a creamy feel to it. It's heavier than most shampoos I've tried, but lathered just as well. I felt like I was using a cream instead of a shampoo. it rinsed out well, leaving my hair less tangled than my usual shampoo does. Once dry, my hair feels silkier, smoother, and my scalp is really not itchy anymore - no more scratching my head. Using this shampoo feels like I've used a moisturizer on my scalp and hair - but it doesn't leave an greasy feel behind. As for the volumizing part - I can't vouch for it giving your hair more body - I already have big hair that I'm forever trying to control. It didn't flatten my hair out, which, if you want volume, is a real plus.I don't now how they did it, but I'm a real fan of this product and fully intend to keep on using it.

First, a note about packaging for this shampoo.  It arrived in a padded mailing envelope, and inside that, the shampoo bottle was tightly taped inside a plastic bag. Good thing, because the inside of the plastic bag contained about a third of the shampoo, which had leaked from the bottle!  So, a different way of shipping this product is a must.Next, some more specific information about the shampoo itself:1)  The scent is very strong. (Best described as a fruity/floral.) I could smell it even before opening the mailer, and I thought that was because of the leakage, but the scent remained strong even after cleaning up the spill. If you don't like strongly scented products, this may bother you.2)  Bottle design is okay (product comes out a small hole in a flip-up cap), just not appropriate for the shipping method they use, as already mentioned.3) Product amount is 12.9 oz, and since you need about a half-dollar size amount, it should last awhile.4) Cleansing properties: It does not lather "richly", or offer a head full of bubbles, but rather has a creamy, low-sudsing consistency.  (Which is why I used that half-dollar size amount.) My scalp and hair did feel cleansed after use, even minus the big bubbles.5) Conditioning: I can't say whether my scalp was "nourished", but my hair DID have BIG volume after blow drying, and also felt smooth and healthy.However, the down-side for me, and the reason for only four-stars, is that, after two uses, I noticed some color-fading. Eeek! (My hair is colored once every 4-5 weeks, and I was only on week 2 of color when trying this shampoo. Usually, I use L'Oreal EverPure color care system shampoo.) Now, the color fading may be because I'm "of a certain age", and my hair doesn't hold color as long/well as it used to. Or maybe the change from my usual brand just looked "different" to me.In any case , I felt this product delivered on its promise to volumize and help with healthiness, but the color-fade was a concern for me. If necessary, I'll return again to add comments if the color fade becomes more noticeable.

An amazing thing happened to me today.Yesterday the Clear Scalp & Hair Shampoo showed up from Amazon Vine.  The package had been crushed a bit and there was a fair amount of the shampoo leaking through producing a pleasant scent.I put the container in the bathroom showed with it today and didn't think much of it being a guy.Later today the wife tried it and as we sat down she immediately asked if this was available in stores?  I asked why and she went on and on about how great her hair feels and how it gave her a better curl.She went on and on and on about it.Now other than the Remington King of Shaves Alphagel Sensitive Shave Gel 5 oz. (Pack of 2) which I found absolutely fantastic stuff like shampoo doesn't move me, my folliclly challenged head only cares if the few hairs I have are washed well.But my wife is a different story, I have NEVER in 24 years heard her go completely gaga over a hair care product and as the rule says, if da mama is happy EVERYONE is happy.I usually don't go beyond vine for these health and beauty products but I guarantee I'll be buying this stuff regularly from Amazon.If that doesn't tell prove the quality of this product I'd like to know what does!

column4: Ursula K. Raphael "AstraDaemon of The Zombiep...
column10: I have straight fine hair, so I am always looking for ways to make my hair look more full. I can usually tell after a week of use if a volumizig shampoo really works or not; thankfully this works better than the Pantene for Fine Hair that I tried.The lather is rich, which feels great when shampooing, and I get about as much lift as I do with blow-drying my hair upside down. I was pleasantly surprised at how the lift lasts most of the day.The only thing I didn't like was the scent - too perfume-y for me, but my husband & son told me they thnk it smells nice like flowers. :)

column9: every bit as good as scalp version
column10: i reviewed another version of this shampoo which supposedly moisturizes my scalp.  this one supposedly gives me volume.  i don't know about those claims.  i cannot tell any difference between them.  but they are both great shampoos for grey hair.  plenty of lather, nice lilac color, easy to grasp bottle and reasonable price. i have been using this after swimming in the pool.  it is taking the chlorine out of hair as well as the special anti chlorine shampoo i use which costs twice as much.  my only quibble is whomever packed this had it leaking inside its pouch.  thus i got shampoo over my hands the moment i opened the package.

column4: Jean  Yates "jean, jewelry designer, book and...
column9: Leaves hair so well cared for you will feel way younger than your years
column10: My husband and I both tried this product. We have different types of hair. We are in our late fifties, early 60's in age.  My husband's hair has never been dyed. I have been dyeing mine since my 30's. He has hair which doesn't require any sort of conditioning. He prefers to use Prell (a very drying shampoo).I have hair which is brittle, breaks when you brush it, and is fine to boot (I am a redhead). My "crowning glory" generally drives me nuts. When we have the money, I search for the finest products to try to fix my hair. Nothing works.Wonder of wonders, this shampoo did the trick for both our hair types.  My husband doesn't need to use a conditioner of any sort when he uses this shampoo, and his hair comes out looking like he is a fifteen year old.I use it, and totally LOVE how my hair feels.NOW let my editor try and joke that I look in photos like one of those cartoons where you have stuck your finger in a light socket and your hair is flying all over the place and frizzing up!This shampoo is a great buy, and for the first time in years I feel as if I have tons and tons of hair, due to the volumizing effect. It is great!  We recommend it!  Appropriate for two types of hair at least!

column9: Did Get Some Volumizing + Curls Seemed to Last Longer
column10: I have fine hair so even though I have lots of hair, I do like to find products that increase the volume.I used this product for about a week and it did seem to make my hair look thicker. I just HATE hairspray plus I think I used my fair share back in the '80s so I never use the stuff now and after using this shampoo and curling my hair with hot rollers or my curling iron, it did seem like my curls lasted longer than when I use my normal daily shampoo which is not volumizing.I thought the scent of this shampoo was fine - not overpowering at all and it dissipated quite a bit after blowdrying and styling so that by the time my hair was fixed, I hardly noticed it. I also like the texture of the shampoo. It's really creamy and thick, almost like a cream rinse.The only downside to this shampoo was that for me, it's an absolute necessity to use either cream rinse or a leave in conditioner/detangler with it because after shampooing, I could hardly get a brush/comb through my hair without adding back some "moisture". However, the times I didn't use a conditioner or detangler, though it took a long time to comb out all the tangles, it didn't seem like my hair was fly away or damaged looking after it air dried but it did seem that it had more static in it without the detangler when I blew it dry.Overall I would give this shampoo 3.75 stars for the volumizing and the fact that my curls seemed more bouncy and lasted longer than when I use my every day shampoo.I also tried this brand in the "Damage & Color Repair" version and I think I prefer it over this one but I'll keep this one to use when I want to use my hot rollers.

I have short very fine hair.  I was hoping that after chemo it would come back with a better texture, but I think it is even finer than before and even a little thin.  This shampoo did great!  After using it and drying my hair it actually had some body. It wasn't just lying flat to my head.  I have used it several times with the same results.  I like it a lot.  I don't know how it would work for other hair types, but for short fine hair like mine it is good & I will continue to purchase it.  Instead of using gels etc. to give my hair body I use the shampoo, blow dry & then use Aveda Light Elements shaping wax.  They work great together! I am so happy that The Vine Program had this as a choice and that I chose it to review.

I received Clear Scalp and Hair Beauty Volumizing Root Boost Nourishing Shampoo and the conditioner from Amazon Vine two weeks ago and have been using it ever since.  It does a good job shampooing.  It suds up nicely and my hair very clean.  Using the conditioner and the shampoo has not made any difference in the volume of my hair.  That might be because I have thin fine long hair.  Just the weight of my hair could be keeping the volumizing from being effective.  My one big complaint is the size of the print on the container.  The smallest print is the word shampoo.  I wear glasses for reading and do not wear them in the shower (does anyone).  The print was so small that I could not tell which was conditioner and which was shampoo. I solved that by using a black marker to put a large S on the Shampoo and a large C on the conditioner.  It would have been nice if both words were in large print on the bottle.After I wrote this I had my hair cut much shorter.  I can tell a difference now.  It does give my hair body and volume now that it is shorter.

column9: Very nice...with an issue or two
column10: Obviously, if you read the other reviews here, there are a couple of problems with this shampoo's container. Like other people here, my bottle came open in transit and leaked. Not as badly as some, but still that is not acceptable for a product you will sell online. Also, the odd bottle shape is a bit top heavy and likely to fall over..and no doubt leak more.But that aside, it is a very nice product. For me, the scent was quite mild and nice. The pinkish color is fine for me but maybe not what a man might like. It is thick, but I like that. I always put my shampoo in my hand, add a little water and later it up before I rub it into my hair. I always have and that worked just fine. Does it increase volume? I am not sure, but it let my hair very soft and nice and easy to style.

column4: Lettetia "As Long As I Am Able To Read, I Sha...
column9: Works great for my thin baby-fine hair
column10: I have thin, fine, baby-soft hair and have tried 100's of products to get volume.  It was when I tried Clear Scalp and Hair Beauty Volumizing shampoo that I finally found a product that worked well with my hair type.  Note:  the bottle does not state that it is for fine or thin hair, but it did work on mine.  I recommend this shampoo to anyone who wants more volume in their hair.

column9: Seems very good though not cheap
column10: Well, I can't say anything negative about this shampoo except that it is more expensive than a lot of good shampoos. That said, it smells nice and my hair seems OK after using it and feels good when I run my hand through it. About its claim of volumizing the hair, it does seem to do that. So, overall I am satisfied with this product, but for me, cheap shampoo works fine and will remain my first choice. But, for those seeking what this shampoo claims, I do recommend it for those who are interested to at least try it.

I have been using Clear Volumizing Shampoo for a week.  I love the way it makes my hair look.  I have fine/thin hair but the results have been great so far.  I have only used it on my scalp/roots as I am careful not too shampoo the rest of my long hair much because (any) shampoo makes my hair too flat.  The smell is pleasing, the volume is comparable if not better than other shampoos.  I can not yet comment on the strength or health of my hair but will check back in several weeks to do so.  The shipping left much to be desired, the shampoo had some leakage - perhaps not the best bottle design.

I had never heard about this shampoo before I was asked to try it and write a review. I am very fussy about my shampoo as I have fine straight hair that loves to do it's own thing no matter what you do. I color my hair which makes it equally important to have a shampoo that works well. I have tried so many brands in my lifetime of over 60 years looking for the right shampoo for my hair but always was disappointed and had to settle for what ever worked for awhile. UNTIL Clear came along. I was a bit sceptical about trying a new shampoo again but thought why not? So I did and I was really surprised that it actually did what it said it would do. It does give you volume. It does leave your hair feeling clean with no build up which seems to be a big problem with most shampoos. I have a skin alergy and this shampoo did not give me a problem at all. The big thhing is no build up of unrinsed shampoo left over. I leave the shower feeling like my hair and my scalp are squeeky clean and it stays clean for more than a day. I would recommend this shampoo to anyone who wants or needs volume for their hair. It gave my hair a lift the first time around with my blow dryer and I did not have to go to the salon to get a salon look. Since I visit a salon every month for a cut, shape, and color that means something to me. BUY IT -- or at least try it once. I believe you will be pleasantly satisfied just like me.

I can't  imagine what hair needs volumizing if not fine straight hair, but this shampoo really doesn't work well for that kind of hair.  It feels rather luxurious - creamy & smooth - and it has a nice, light scent, but it's really too heavy for thin strands.  My hair is shiny, but limp (even limper than usual), and it has to be washed every day with this shampoo, rather than every other day, which is my normal habit. If you want an excellent, affordable shampoo for fine hair, Suave Professionals Volumizing Shampoo by Suave, 12.6 oz works great.

My wife and I both use this shampoo and like it. It has a nice scent and you don't need a lot of the product to get a nice, rich lather. It rinses out well. We both have very thin hair, and I feel this product does, indeed, make our hair look thicker. My hair also generally gets oily pretty quickly, and this shampoo seems to prevent that. I also think this is a good value for the price. It sure beats spending double-digits for salon products that give the same result. I recommend that you give it a try.

column9: Great shampoo - creamy with nice scent
column10: I generally don't pay much attention to shampoo. I buy whatever is on sale, dump it on my head, rub, rinse, and get on with my business. This stuff had a nice creamy texture, and I took a little extra time to gently work it in. It felt good and rinsed clean. My hair felt nice after I used it, and it has a nice if somewhat flowery scent. Good price for a good product.

column9: Has been working well in conjunction with the volumizing conditioner

column9: THE WINNER FOR THE NOT YET READY FOR MARKETING IS . . .
column10: I have long, fine hair, shoulder-length+.If dry it can break when combed/brushed.Before CLEAR, I used shampoos/conditioners by Paul Mitchell [[ASIN:B002N5MI8C Paul Mitchell Extra Body Daily Shampoo, 33.8-Ounce Bottle] and Pantene [[ASIN:B001F51V3E Pantene Pro-V 2-in-1 Shampoo and Conditioner, Classic Care, Packaging May Vary, 25.4 -Ounce (Pack of 2)]. They give my hair shine and satisfactory body. And less breaking. I'd hoped to have it look even better, be tougher with CLEAR. So I took a shot.CLEAR Scalp and Hair Therapy/Nourishing Shampoo with its sales pitch of 'nourishingthe scalp' seemed believable, like stimulating/nourishing the scalp. Oops; not-so.Terse instructions say "when using shampoo and conditioner" "apply to wet hair, gently massage into scalp, lather and rinse." (Two statements, connected by an asterisk) Seemedunclear.Before rinsing, CLEAR's goopy consistency made me doubt its sticky white lather could get past the hair (not really a lather; no frothy bubbles). The consistency is like a women's facial creme. I took pictures of my frothy Gorgon-Head scary-odd hair. Pretty funny, kinda scary.I tried finger tips to rub the glop into my scalp. Maybe some got through my hair, but its heavy-consistency turned hair follicles into slimy protrusions like bright white heavy meringue; sticky and thick like tooth paste; both funny and weird. I tried rubbing it into my scalp; it just glopped together in my hair. Afterwards I had to wash my hands twice. The white stuff that couldn't get past hair covered my fingers, palms.My hair doesn't have observably more volume; after drying, the hair seemed sort of frizzed; literally less shiny, healthy. I repeated the treatment a week later, justto be sure. Same effects, problems. And there's more:The label said an ingredients list was on the label's back.'Just peel itoff'. And it was, evidently rushed to market, upside down and backwards.Last shot at CLEAR: The plastic bottle has an flat oval top. The container came in a fitted, sealed plastic sleeve inside a padded Amazon mailer. Shipping shakes evidently poked the flat top and inside the sleeve was slopped with the gooey white glop.Back to the lab, CLEAR Marketeers. I'll stick with Paul Mitchell and Pantene.

column9: Avoid this product - It is unhealthy
column10: This product contains aspartame. This is a toxin with over 90 known side effects. It has caused cancer in rats, though it's very difficult to know if it causes it in humans (because at one point we all consume aspartame and it's still a pretty new product). Aspartame is an alternative to sugar. It's an artificial sweetner. Companies use it instead of sugar so that they can cut down on the calories in a beverage. However, I'd rather have 35 grams of sugar in my system than the kind of agonies that aspartame brings. Don't get me wrong, if you consume it in moderation it's ok, but do NOT consume more than 1-2 packets of this per day. I had no idea the effects of this product until I began consuming it at my only thirst quenching beverage. It all but destroyed my bladder and gave me tons of headaches. Since getting of it, I feel a lot better in both areas. It's a shame, because these packets are incredibly delicious and there's really nothing else on the market that tastes as good.In my experience, I've found that the best alternative is Propel from Gatorade. It's low in calories (10 per bottle) and it only has 6 grams of sugar per 20 ounces. Propel Zero tastes terrible, so avoid it. But regular Propel is fantastic. Not as sweet as Crystal Light, but still good, and much better for you. It uses sucralose for its artificial sweetner, and I trust Gatorade to not go for a bad one (havent heard anything bad about it). Sobe Life water is disgusting, and regular Gatorade has way too much sugar. So if you're looking for something to drink on a regular basis, you can't go very wrong with Propel. Stay away from anything that has aspartame. It's a tough sell, because it really does taste good - but it's just not worth the health risks.

"Classic Curry" from Spicy Nothings is perfect - the consistency, the taste, the spices, etc. Whenever my wife and I wanted good chicken curry, we'd end up driving 20 minutes and spending $30 at a nearby Indian restaurant...With this, however, cut up some chicken, cook it in a pan, add a bottle of "Classic Curry," let it simmer for 5 minutes, and you not only get a BETTER meal (and healthier), but you can easily feed 2-3 people for $10. Can't recommend it more highly.

Found this gem at my local health food store. I had been looking for a bottled curry sauce that I can just throw onto some chicken and not have to make actual curry sauce myself. Tried out this sauce and I was blown away. It tastes amazing, and coats everything perfectly. It tastes like I spent hours perfecting the sauce when I literally just dumped it on there from a jar.This stuff is so good I made sure I got every drop of it out of the pan after cooking, and licked my plate clean. Then I told my family about it and sent them all a jar. I brought it into work as leftovers and had coworkers following me around just trying to find out what smelled so amazing. I'm not exaggerating at all.
....of this FANTASTIC sauce !!!My entire family is addicted to it.I like it better than Kaimal's brand. Delicious stuff!!!

I was visiting the San Diego area for summer and got a chance to try all the 3 different sauces. I'm an Indian and a cook, and God, did they taste good!! These are the best Indian gourmet sauces I have ever tasted in the US, and believe me I've tried a LOT of products. I wish they start selling them in the Midwest too.-S
...this stuff is GOOD! Amazing for a jar sauce. I couldn't recommend it more highly.  --df

I am not East Indian, but I have enjoyed this cruisine all my life, and thats a long long time. Back in the 1970s we owned a restaurant in Cucamonga, California that served Indian food one night a week. The other nights we served American, Mexican, Greek, Spanish, and Arabic food. along with entertainment of that country. Having been taught by several of the best chefs of Indian food, (North and South), I know what it should taste like. This product is among the best you can find in a jar. I used to make it from scratch, but now I use this excellent product. Try it. you'll like it.
Yummy!!  These are the best shortbread cookies that I have ever eaten!  They taste like homemade!  Please get them back in stock soon!!!

column9: She is a thing of beauty
column10: After going through the Amazon checkout, I awaited my delivery of Kraft Macaroni & Cheese with great anticipation. In fact, as I waited, I became quite impatient and actually strangled a homeless man. It wasn't my finest hour, nor is it something I'm proud of. Regardless, I rather quickly descended into a life a crime and drug abuse. But soon, the UPS man delivered my order; I was ecstatic! I quickly made the macaroni & cheese, keeping strictly to the directions on the box. I did have a little trouble trying to get the packet of cheese out of the little, perforated hole out of which the macaroni is poured, but it only proved to be a temporary setback to my redemption. Upon completion of the meal, I fell into a pool of joy as the warm, cheesy elbow macaroni noodles slid down my throat and into my stomach. Suddenly, I found myself free from my drug addiction! I couldn't believe it; all my withdrawal symptoms disappeared quicker than Judy Winslow from "Family Matters." I then said to myself, "If this can do that for me, I wonder what other wrongs I can correct. I found the homeless man I had earlier killed and force fed the mac & cheese to him. Much to my surprise, he soon revived and thanked me for the meal, as that's all he had ever wanted. He later became a successful businessman, and has only the mac & cheese to thank for it. After fixing all the problems I had caused, I ate the last spoonful of mac & cheese. Not long after mastication, Publisher's Clearing House showed up to my front door with a check for $5 million! I attribute all my success in life from that day onward to the box of KRAFT MACARONI & CHEESE.At $60 a box, it is a bit pricey, but well worth it.

I grew up on Kraft Macaroni and Cheese. I still love it and now my daughter loves it, too. There are all sorts of fancy macaroni and cheese, but only the Kraft classic will do. It's not too runny and not too cheesy and not too gooey. I make it "lite," as per the directions on the side of the box, and it comes out healthier and I like it just as well.
Absolutely delicious.  And legal for diabetics with 1 1/2 carb choices.  The almond butter covering is really good.  The almonds are large pieces.  Great breakfast.

Do not know what happened with the previous reviewer.  I found this product to be hot but not too hot.  According to the manufacturer, it has 10% habanero and the rest being regular crushed red and Ancho (for a little flavor).  Maybe the previous reviewer thought he was getting 100% Habanero - but the label says CLEARLY - Hot Habanero BLEND!  The manufacturer says that more than 10% Habanero became a health hazard for the packing process workers...  All in all, a quality product for a great price (dried habanero are $25 a lb and then you have to chop it).

I was looking forward for some crushed pepper for pizza and pasta dishes boy was I super disappointed had a smokey flavor with no heat.I ended up buying a food dehydrator and some habeneros so much more heat and flavor....Don't waste you time or money I wish I could get a  refund!!!
We used to buy at trader joes.  Since they ran out of crystallized ginger, with no supply on the horizon.  We bought from The Ginger people and will continue to do so.

I bought this ginger for my wife thinking it was probably made in Australia or in U.S.A. because the only factories listed in Ginger People's web site were in either Australia or California.  Therefore we were quite disappointed when we found out that it was made in China.  We could probably have bought it cheaper in the local Chinese grocery store.  We tried it and it was both very gingery and sugary.  All you could taste was a full month of sugar and it was so HOT.  The ginger also came in small cubes and they should call it candied ginger.  Some were quite tough.  In short, I was not very impressed with this product.  We could probably purchase better products in the local Whole Food.  We were also skeptical with it being Organic since it was made in China where the standard for "organic' can be substantially different that that of the States.
Wonderful soft nuggets of baby ginger. Just enough spice. Enough sugar to feel like a treat but not too much! I love em!
This crystallized ginger is tender, juicy, hot and sweet. Perfect for studding dessert loaves, making ginger tea or even just snacking.  The cubes of ginger are quite large.
Love ginger and love this product! I always keep some on hand and order this regularly! I prefer the baby ginger that is sliced in larger pieces.

This ginger is excellent.  It is fresh and juicy and isn't stringy at all.  I don't cook w/ ginger, I just eat it straight from the box, so I can't comment on this particular brand's cooking quality.  The cubes are small and generously sweetened, I usually eat 5 or 6 at a time.My only gripe is that it's a little more mild than I prefer, but that's just a personal preference, I enjoy a very spicy ginger.  I was surprised this ginger turned out to be so mild because several other reviewers have remarked how hot it is.  If you're looking for a very spicy ginger, you might try another brand.
This crystallized ginger is excellent for and upset stomach or for dealing with bloating.  The taste takes a little getting used to, but after awhile it's rather refreshing.

I am really pleased with this crystallized ginger.  I was previously eating the Reed's crystallized ginger.  I like this a little bit more.  The sugar to ginger ratio seems a little better.  Also, the ginger seems fresher somehow; maybe it has to do with the packaging, but either way I like this ginger quite a bit.

This is fantastic, if you like crystallized ginger that is... It is not too hard (like some other ones I have tried) not too spicy and it's USDA organic. What's more, a bit of ginger a day is good for you! I eat at least a couple of pieces a day. It's also good for alleviating nausea.

column9: Like ginger gumdrops.  Tasty but boring.
column10: I like my crystallized ginger in the form of natural looking slices that are big and sort of chewy.  These are perfect little uniform cubical pieces that are more like ginger gumdrops than anything else.  It was impossible to tell that from the package illustration, so I'm rather disappointed, especially because crystallized ginger can be had for way less money.They are tasty, however.  This is a high quality product, just not in the form that I like best.
I LOVE crystallized ginger. It is really good for digestion.The taste of this ginger is amazing .If you like ginger try this one.

column9: THE best muesli ever. No kidding.
column10: I'm extremely pleased to see Amazon offering this cereal. Alpen (No Sugar Added version) is the best muesli available in Britain. Believe me, I've tried most of them (British expat). And your American mueslis don't come anywhere close to the deliciousness of this. Swiss-style muesli in general is much easier to eat than traditional muesli - mainly due to the fact that it softens in milk much faster and it includes whey powder which makes it a little sweeter and creamier when you add milk. I've tried a few other brands of Swiss-style muesli and this one beats the lot. It has just the right amount of raisins and nuts in it. :-)A perfect breakfast, can't wait to eat it again!

column9: Alpen Cereal, No Sugar Added, 14-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 6)
column10: Delicious and very good for you. This is a chewy cereal that is very satisfying. Even your kids will love it. Multi, whole grain with almonds, hazel nuts and raisins for natural sweetness. I encourage you to try this cereal, you will not go back to the overly sweet, non nutient, American grocery store type of cereal

column9: Cereal was stale, expiration date almost invisible
column10: Cereal with nuts and no preservatives can develop a rancid taste pretty quickly if it's not consumed before the "sell by" date.Unfortunately the order we received from Amazon was over two months past its expiration date, and it noticeably tasted stale.It took quite a while to find the sell-by date. The Alpen box is a very light tan color, and the date is printed in white on the box top. It's practically invisible. I had to angle it just right toward a light source in order to read it.Amazon does not accept returns of grocery items, which is a good policy, but they did give a prompt refund.Judging from the other reviews, I'm sure the cereal is excellent when it's fresh. We may try it again in the future.

column9: best way to buy in the US it seems.
column10: Still the small boxes, rather than the big bags that I used to be able to pick up in London Supermarkets, but this is the cheapest most reliable place to buy I know in the US. It seems to be randomly available at other supermarkets elsewhere  and often at extreme mark-ups.

column9: Looking for Cereal w/o sugar&high fructose ?
column10: This is a good buy. Real food. No corn syrup and the main taste is not just sugared cardboard.

Very good healthy choice, doesnt taste at all like gravel (which I expected). Hard to find tasty no sugar, preservative or color cereal. The carbs are high but so what I eat this in the morning when you should eat majority of carbs.

After eating this cereal years ago, i was hooked. Now i can't find it in my city. I am thrilled with internet shopping!  This museli is one the best i have ever had. it is intensely satisfying and filling and so good for you too.I have added a bit to oatmeal for a different taste sensation at times. it is delicious.Buy soon you will not be dissappointed!

I first ate Alpen many years ago and now I eat the no sugar added version.  It has been available locally (in Austin,Texas, home of Whole Foods) off and on over the years.  My local grocery store quit carrying it recently, so I am very happy that it is available through Amazon.com.  It is so delicious, it is not only the only muesli I like, it is my favorite cereal--the only one I liked almost as much over the years was Skinner Raisin Bran, but this one has so many different textures and flavors, it makes breakfast a much better meal.

I love this cereal and then couldn't find it in the South for a long time. They no little down here about eating healthy. Thank you, Amazon, for offering it! I also mix it about 50/50 with Kashi (no sugar!) 7 grain cereal. Either way (straight or mixed) it is tasty and a great way to start the day. At one time I even wrote to the manufacturer in the UK complaining about the lack of outlets in the USA for their product. When I did find it, it was outrageously priced. Enjoy!

column9: Very tasty and healthy, but could be more in box
column10: I really enjoy this cereal, appreciate its health benefits, and have an Amazon "subscription" for it.  I also enjoy the "no sugar added" Familia Muesli.  The main downside of this Alpen product is that each box is small, and consequently lasts me only three breakfasts or so.  For that reason, the Familia product might be a slightly better value.  I buy both products just to have some variety.
Very tasty, crunchy, lots of raisins and nuts, NO SUGAR! Excellent product. A good buy for anyone watching their sugar intake.
My local store used to carry this cereal and then discontinued it. I decided to try ordering it online and have bought it this was ever since. The price is right and it's easy!
This is a very hard-to-find cereal in the USA.  Amazon makes it easy to buy in bulk because they are smaller boxes and will keep longer.  I can't get enough of it.

column9: BEST Breakfast sugar w/o ADDED sugar - YUMMY!
column10: This a great muesili, full of fiber and nutrients.Two versions are on store shelves, with or w/oadded refined sugar.  I have enjoyed this cerealfor more than 35 years.Pour on milk or rice milk, wait 5 mins, then eat withBananas or blueberries.
This item was on a wait list.... I didn't think it would ever arrive, as it's been month's.  I'm glad it's finally here!

column9: THIS STUFF IS GREAT...TASTES BETTER THAN ALL THE REST!
column10: This is a great cereal.  Doesn't get soggy in milk.  No sugar is needed, because the fruit within makes it sweet. However, they also make a product with added sugar.

It is virtually impossible to find cereals on grocery shelves which have "no sugar" (and "no high fructose corn syrup").  I stumbled across this one and of course came to Amazon.com to see if it was available here.  Once again, I am very happy to find what I am looking for to be so convenient. My only regret is that multiple boxes need to be purchased at one time.  I would appreciate the option of being able to order a single box rather than 6 at a time since I am the only one who eats this cereal at our house.  Maybe I can convince my husband of this healthier option now that Amazon makes it affordable!!  Thank you Amazon, for your wide variety and excellent prices... and the auto-ship program!
Item arrived faster than anticipated, which is always nice!! Will continue to use this seller.
I really like this cereal. I just use water. I will try milk but for now it's super tasty as is! I agree this needs to be a bigger box. I go through a box in 3 or 4 days.

We've been buying Alpen for years as the closest product we've found to a Swedish whole grain museli we loved while visiting in Stockholm.  Very low sodium (15 mg), 6 gr dietary fiber, 7 gr protein, and 3 gr fat in 2/3 cup -- a half a cup serving is enough for me eaten as next described.  This has sliced almonds, hazelnuts and raisins and is absolutely super with any sort of yogurt (I prefer plain no fat, my husband likes low fat Yoplait fruit varieties), some skim milk and, if available, your favorite fruit -- fresh or canned.  Or, add some additional dried fruit; we like cranberries in the winter.  Best of all, Amazon's price with automatic shipping has been much cheaper than the grocery store (where it's about $5 a box and hard to find as well.)  We eat about 6 boxes a month as we have it most days.  Do try this!
Alpen is crunchy, tasty, and good for you. I love it with some fresh blueberries and milk.
You just can't buy muesli like this in the USA at a local store!  This shipped very quickly and the cereal is wonderful.  Thanks for providing such great service.
Not much to say. I  like the taste of Alpen better than that of any other Muesli and Amazon is one of the few places that sells it. All the retail food outlets in my area have dropped it.

I you Love sushi purchase the perfect Nori, it has a rich nutty flavor that compliments both fish and vegetables. As a snack it is is a delicious healthy organic choice.  Buy with confidence.
Drinked for like 2 weeks, nice taste and really invigorative. Don't drink in the second part of the day, hard to fall asleep

I love this Chef Pauls NO salt NO Sugar Lemon PepperUsually when you see Lemon Pepper in the store it has too much saltBy the time I have it tasting enough of Lemon Pepper it is too saltyThis one does the trick.Would recommend it to anyone.

column4: Laura Roberts "Author of The Vixen Files"
column10: This kitten food is definitely baby-cat approved. We adopted a kitten, and were unsure of his exact age, so we fed him a variety of foods to see what he liked. While he grew picky about certain canned foods (including another kitten food made by Science Diet, which he had seemed to like at first), he always licks his plate clean for the Baby Cat Instinctive. Tried this for Christmas on a prime rib roast. Everyone raved. Tried it on steaks, again, rave reviews. Ordering more beef and the fish one. Going to try it on halibut!

I even tried a pack of their soup. As a result, I use the "beef rub" or the "pork rub" almost every time I grill. The flavor is so good, you can't really use too much or too little. Bought a case of this on Amazon after an unsuccessful search everywhere else.  It's my mom's favorite and a kitchen staple for me- we use it on any meat and often on sliced veggies before roasting.  Highly recommend!

We bought the pack of 6 at a very good price and gave one to our daughter. The paper bags are lined with plastic, and seem to keep the rub fresh. Very happy with our purchase.

This product was in our local stores and the butcher sugested it. Been useing it now for several years, and really like it. Good color and char. Remember its a rub not a dredge. Go light a first; you can always add, but hard to subtract.

column9: AWesome, best Natural bar on the Market

I was pleasantly surprised by this shampoo.  I've found many shampoos don't deliver on their promise to provide a clean clear scalp, while at the same time providing soft manageable hair, but this product delivered.The texture of the shampoo was very enjoyable, its thicker than most shampoos and creates a great lather.  Further the shampoo has a good scent, and won't leave you with a strong shampoo odor.  The overall odor of the shampoo is simple which is great for a guy.After using the shampoo for a short period of time I noticed that my scalp was increasingly clear of both dandruff, and other build up.  If you are a person that uses product in your hair, over time that build up can become very annoying, and this shampoo did a good job of clearing that up.  I have also suffered from having an itchy scalp at times, and this product worked better than other over the counter products that promise to relieve scalp problems.

This is an excellent men's shampoo that should be used once or twice a week to keep your scalp feeling great and moisturized. I wouldn't recommend using it everyday as zinc pyrithione may scour the scalp if used a lot. Think of it as an exfoliating treatment for your head.I have read reports that Zinc pyrithione may reduce hair shedding and I have read reports that excessive use may cause hair shedding. So my advice is to use it once or twice a week tops and you will notice an improvement in the feeling of your scalp and your hair will smell very nice. Used like this, it works fantastic.This shampoo seems a little more creamier than Head and Shoulders and your hair smells and feels better since this has other ingredients that H&S doesn't have {Panax Ginseng Root Extract, Tea Tree, Mint, Coconut Oil, Sunflower Seed Oil}.Overall, great men's shampoo and I highly recommend it.

column9: No better...no worse...than regular shampoo...for us, at least
column10: First, to the efficacy of the product:It leaves a filmy coating on our hands (and, we assume, other skin areas, including scalp) even after many rinsings...not a pleasant feeling...and yet, we do not notice any real difference in dandruff control. We used it every other day for a week.In addition, the scent is very strong...and some may find it unappealing.Finally, as at least one other reviewer has noted, the packaging does not hold up well in transit: our sample arrived in a padded yellow envelope via USPS and was leaking all over the place. We thought it was inadvertently damaged during shipping...and disposed of it; Amazon very nicely shipped another one out, but that, too arrived in a leaky mess. This time, we cleaned it off and proceeded to test it out, with the above results. So, if someone does order it online, just be aware that this might be an issue.So, overall, we cannot fully recommend "CLEAR MEN SCALP THERAPY Anti-Dandruff Shampoo, Strong & Full" based on experience, but as with any product like this, it might produce better results for others, so it might be worth a try. Just be careful with the shipping, and maybe wait for a decent price for the first time around.

The obvious goal of an anti-dandruff shampoo is to get rid of those white flakes. Everything else is secondary. This shampoo achieves that goal, and does so without unpleasant scent or unmanageable hair. In that way, this shampoo is superior to the organic tea tree oil shampoos available at higher prices. I used this shampoo several hours ago and asked my family to determine whether my hair had any peculiar scent associated with it. Believe me, my 8 year old son would be quite honest about any inappropriate smell. They uniformly said they could detect no smell whatsoever. My hair is clean and there are no flakes. So we're all done there and the product gets five stars.Packaging leaves something to be desired only in terms of shipping. On mine, the push-top lid was pushed somewhere along the way leading to leakage. Big deal...very little was lost and I rinsed the container after removing it from the packaging. I'd suggest a small adhesive sticker on the push-lid designed to keep the product closed until removed after shipping. That should solve the problem.

This is a good shampoo.  It's always good to have hygiene products made for men.  It lathers up rich, doesn't have a bad smell to it and leaves hair feeling full.I don't have much dandruff, for I do not use much product in my hair like hairspray, gel, etc.I recommend to add this product to men's HBA list of shampoos to use.

My husband has used Head & Shoulders anti-dandruff shampoo for a good 15 years, so I thought it would be interesting to have him try this product. After a week, I asked him what he thought and, in his typically manly-man fashion, he shrugged. "It's OK, but I don't use it anymore," he said. After a bit of prodding and asking specific questions, I found out that he noticed a significant increase in the amount of hair in the shower drain after he washed his hair with this product. For this reason alone after three days he stopped using the product completely. He also commented that his hair didn't have that "clean hair smell" after shampooing.I will add that I purchased another CLEAR SCALP THERAPY product for my own use, and had absolutely the same problem -- a noticeable (seriously noticeable) amount of hair in the shower drain after shampooing. I don't know if this is a problem with all CLEAR products, but it has been with the two that we've tried.This will not be a product we will buy in the future, as we both found it causes serious loss of hair. I now have two full bottles of this product (one for men, one for women) and neither will be used again.

column9: Fragrance was over powering plus, due to poor packaging, we never tried product.

I often skip conditioner for my short hair and it is fine.- Scent:  Fresh tea tree and mint scent.  The mint is barely there so you don't notice it unless it is mentioned.- Tea tree oil: love this ingredient.Dislikes:- Wish it had more tea tree oil.  Not getting that cool tingle and strong scent it can provide.Overall I'm happy with this and will buy it if it is competitively priced.

column9: Clear Men Therapy: Strong & Full, and it works
column10: We all know that washing hair with shampoo removes excess dirt, sweat, pool chlorine and oil, as well as other unwanted products from the hair and scalp. But removing dandruff and skin particles that build up in hair takes something a bit stronger and that where products like CLEAR MEN SCALP THERAPY Anti-Dandruff Shampoo, Strong & Full come in.The key active ingredient in this shampoo appears to be pyrithione zinc (1.0%), which is a formulation known to reduce shedding, and according to some sources, moderately promotes hair growth. I've used the CLEAR MEN SCALP THERAPY Anti-Dandruff Shampoo, Cool Sport Mint before with very successful results, and earlier this year, that formulation became my daily shampoo. I also have a closely trimmed beard, and when dandruff occasionally shows up there, it's irritating.So where does this one fit in? Is it any better in controlling dandruff? Both of these shampoos appear to have the same general list of ingredients, but the key difference seems to be that the directions for the Cool Sport Mint version say; "for best results use daily." This Strong & Full version states that "for best results use at least twice a week or as directed by doctor."Personally I've settled into using the Cool Sport Mint variety as a regular daily shampoo, but supplement it with their CLEAR MEN SCALP THERAPY 2 in 1 Anti-Dandruff Shampoo and Conditioner, Dry Scalp Hydration a couple times a week, as it has the conditioner built in. This Strong & Full version is the one that I use for mostly afternoon and evening use when my hair has gotten wet from strenuous exercise or after cycling. Hair can really get wet and nasty after being out on a mountain bike for a couple of hours in the summer.We all have different hair and different needs, but if you do get occasional (or frequent) dandruff, all of these products will do the job, and their descriptive titles are pretty accurate. I'll list all three here so that you don't have to go digging or searching if you want to try them out:* CLEAR MEN SCALP THERAPY Anti-Dandruff Shampoo, Cool Sport Mint - daily use* CLEAR MEN SCALP THERAPY Anti-Dandruff Shampoo, Strong & Full - occasional use* CLEAR MEN SCALP THERAPY 2 in 1 Anti-Dandruff Shampoo and Conditioner, Dry Scalp Hydration - has conditionerIf I had any complaints at all it would be that there isn't enough of the tea tree ingredient in any of these. For anyone who has used a good shampoo with a decent concentration of tea tree, such as the Paul Mitchell Tea Tree Special Shampoo, you know how good that extra tingle can feel on the scalp. It also aids in dandruff control, but it's far more costly.Bottom Line:I first received the Cool Sport Mint version as a Vine selection, tried it and liked it, so I moved on to try the others. Since then I've re-ordered the first one to replace my older daily shampoo, and as the other versions run out, will do the same with them. Can't recommend one over the other, as we all have different heads of hair, and what would work for one may not be as good for another. Again, none of these have enough tea tree for my liking, but that's a personal thing, and I guess it's what works best for each persons hair. In any case, this Strong & Full version is excellent and highly recommended, but so are the others.8/6/2012

column9: Good shampoo that does what it says...it gives you big hair!
column10: The phrase "strong and full" is a big deceiving because the odor of this shampoo is quite mild, which I prefer. A little bit lathers into many suds so this bottle should last a long time. So, many washings from this bottle means an economic deal. It really cleans your hair well and even 24 hours later, after sleeping, my hair still feels quite clean and not greasy at all. For me (and this is a personal gripe), this shampoo does indeed give you full hair. Since I don't need my hair to stand up taller than it already does, I probably won't be using this shampoo much. If you have thinner hair and want your hair to appear bigger and fuller, this shampoo should do the trick.

My boyfriend normally uses Head and Shoulders for dandruff control and after 4 weeks of use found Clear just a good however Clear left his hair feeling just a little bit greasy after use. His theory is that it maybe it has too much conditioner but the product is just shampoo not a two-in-one product.Also as others noted the shampoo arrived with evidence that it had been leaking. This would be a red flag if I had paid for the product.For the price this is listed at I would recommend Head and Shoulders over Clear.

column9: A Little Goes A Long Way
column10: I requested this shampoo and gave it to my husband to try.  He says it is a very thick shampoo, so a little goes a long way.  It does leave the hair shiny and soft, but you definitely need to use a conditioner with it or the scalp will get itchy.  The scent is pretty strong and perfumy.  But my husband says it does not linger for too long.  He actually enjoys the scent.

I have to say that this is a very nice shampoo.  This shampoo is marketed for men, which basically means it has more of a masculine scent and is designed for men's hair.  I personally believe it is more of the former than the latter.  I have used shampoo that wasn't designed for men and my hair didn't fall out of my head, although there was the risk that my head might smell like strawberries or kiwi melon.With that being said, this shampoo by Clear is a very pleasant smell.  The shampoo is made with a combination of tea tree, natural mint and ginseng.  Theses fragrances combined really promote an appealing aroma.  I would say that this allows for a bit more of a masculine scent (not that I have anything against strawberries or kiwi melon).  It is also designed as an anti-dandruff product, I don't have dandruff, didn't have it before this product and don't have it as I type this.  I guess it works.The shampoo itself looks like glue but works in very well into hair and suds up wonderfully.  My hair felt very clean and refreshed after using this product.  I believe it is the mint in the shampoo.  Oh and never fear, this product will not leave your scalp feeling like you rubbed Vicks vapor rub on your head.  I have used a hair product that had mint in it and that was the result.  This is not the case here.  Overall a great product that I could see myself using again.

column9: Helps Me Manage Hard to Tame Hair
column10: After using H&S for many years I thought it was high time to try something else and see if I couldn't improve my current shampoo situation.  Clear Men Scalp Therapy sounded interesting so I figured "what the heck" !  You get almost 11 ounces in this bottle which is a bit less than my current brand.The bottle is easy to grasp and manage in the shower without becoming slippery from the water and opening is a breeze thanks to the push down lid.  I found that while the consistency of this shampoo seemed a bit thin to me, very little was actually needed to achieve a full head of suds and to clean my overly oily hair and scalp.After using Clear Men Scalp Therapy for 10 days I can happily report at least the same dandruff reducing results as I got my my mainstay Head and Shoulders. But since the shampoo is apparently more concentrated, I used less and it actually rinsed out faster.The shampoo left my hair feeling totally clean with no trace of any sort of residue other than the scent which is not overblown.  I am a bit surprised by other Amazon reviews stating it leaves a bad residue and has a very heavy scent. I wonder if perhaps the quality and type of the water has something to do with all of this? We have VERY hard water here by the way. I can honestly say it rinsed clean for me and I didn't smell like I had fallen into a vat of perfume.Also, it was immediately apparent that rather than standing straight up and sticking out at odd angles, my hair seemed very relaxed and symmetrical before combing.  I have NO idea why, but it does for me anyway.  If I can consistently find this brand at the same price I may seriously consider using it full time and retiring the old H&S once and for all.Everyone has different tastes and while I really LIKE this shampoo, others may not.
