This shows signs of being a discontinued product. It has certainly disappeared from Oregon stores and I know our current isn't currently going out on a limb for consumer protection. I stockpiled enough to give me time to reformulate it or get close enough for jazz. Not using those disastrous little plastic bags for anything other than a road trip will be a serious improvement. Its cheaper too. Here the initial thought:search this on Amazon: Matcha Green Tea Powdersearch on google: nature's flavors

It's a cheap energy boost. The taste isn't great but I can tolerate it for the quick, convenient energy supply.What's unfortunate is that when I first started drinking this it was Blueberry Pomegranate. One day, without warning, the Blueberry was gone to be replaced by Blackberry Pomegranate. I greatly preferred the blueberry flavor.

The tea taste great, not to sweet or tart and it does not have a chemical taste or after taste.  It provides me with energy I need for school, studying and gym at lower cost than vitamin water and fuze green tea which both taste great but have a disgusting after taste of chemical and sugar.  What I enjoy the most is I can drink several of them without getting a crash or stomach pains as I would when drinking coffee.

It tastes great to me. I love blueberries and pomegrantes so what's not to like. I only use a fourth of a packet per 8oz. glass of water. I rather drink this tea than the sugery cola I usually drink for an energy boost to do housework with arthritis. If you are expecting it to taste like juice, you will be disappointed. It is NOT meant to taste like juice. It taste like tea with a mild infusion of fruit.

column9: An Excellent Boost of Energy Just When You Need It!
column10: Great product, great taste, and so reliable for providing that extra shot of energy we all need right after the lunch hour, or whenever you need energy to just start your day.  It lasts pretty much throughout the day and has no  negative effect whatsoever on sleep.

I love this product, I don't know how I'd get through my work day without it. A great alternative to coffee. Sweet, but not overpowering and fake tasting, which is a plus to me as I hate sweet tea and I also hate the taste of aspartame.
I like this tea...although I prefer to drink it hot. I just add it to hot water...everything dissolves and the caffeine gets me going...
These make drinking more water a reality for me.  Nothing could be easier.  I keep them in the desk at work.  They are in the kitchen drawer and in the glove box of my car.  Wonderful!

column9: Great flavor.  Too bad it contains aspartame.
column10: Sadly, I did not realize before I purchased this that it contains aspartame.  For that reason, I wouldn't buy it again.  The flavor is great.  I like it better than the raspberry/lime flavor.  But aspartame is very bad for you, and they should just label this stuff Lipton Powdered Rat Poison.

column9: Description is wrong - has Aspartame instead of Splenda
column10: I dunno how Amazon gets this wrong - this cruddy tea comes with brain-drilling aspartame instead of Splenda. I am almost tempted to apply for a refund here. "Tea" mix is tasty enough I suppose but the cruddy bait-and-switch ruined the experience.

Haven't tried this flavor yet, but have tried others and what I do to avoid the clumping factor start is with hot water (I have instant hot water at my kitchen sink), just enough to melt the tea granules, then add the cold water...works everytime.  If I forget to make the tea this way it always clumps...

MY HUSBAND AND I JUST LOVE THE ENERGIZE TEA BY LIPTON. It gives us energy through the day to keep going and off the mocha's and ice coffee's. We put it right in our water bottles and off we go. We haven't tried the other flavors but love this one because it's energize... give it a try....

The real question is if the health benefits of green tea outway the side effects of using artifical sweeteners.  Yes his product contains aspartame.  That's enough for me to never use this line of products.

I dont care if it is BLUEBERRY or blackberry/pomegranate. Seriously if you mixed water, dirt and added some fake sugar it would still taste better than this STUFF!!  I got it to try while I work out for a little extra boost. Unfiltered tap water is better over this crap. Sorry but just being honest.

This is DISGUSTING! My sister gave me a pack for Christmas and I'm sorry to say, I will have to give them back and have her try one for herself. Anyone who likes this must not have taste buds. I'm not trying to insult anyone but the taste is indescribable as well as the smell. It makes me nauseous thinking about it. How does a good idea with great fruit flavors have to be screwed up? This is why I don't like Lipton teas. They taste fake.

This mix is just awful.  No matter what, it will not fully dissolve.  Even after the most vigorous shake, I'll still see clumps at the bottom and big particles floating throughout the bottle.  To make matters worse, it has a sickening taste - literally!  I started to feel sick almost immediately after drinking a bit - the artificial flavoring is truly overwhelming.  And this is coming from someone who relies heavily on artificial sweeteners, so it's not like I'm new to these things.  Definitely not worth buying; I much prefer Crystal Light.

I tried to change food on him to a cheaper brand, but he refused so I decided to crack out the cash! However, I wanted to say that one thing that upset me when I got my order today (a few days early!YAY!) was that the bag is half empty.  I know it's by design but I think it could really save packaging and stuff if the food actually fit into the bag and not been twice the size of where the food ends.  I like that the food has good things for my dog and not crap.  I feed myself only organic food, why would I feed my service dog anything other than that too?
Have 2 years old Pomeranian he loves this food best food every very health does not make the poop stink which is very important since he goes on the potty pad great food.

column9: The best food I've ever witnessed my dogs eat
column10: We have an eight year old Pomeranian and an eight month old Papillon that refuse to not eat one another's food. Our dilemma was that we needed something easily digestible for our old-timer as well as a protein rich meal for our pup. We also caught wind of the dog food filler conspiracy and, reluctantly, switched from our supermarket bought, corn meal heavy brand to one of the higher quality names.Nature's Recipe Dry Dog Food for Adult Dog, Easy to Digest Chicken Rice and Barley Meal, 15 Pound Bag was our first choice and it seemed to go well. Our Pom's bowels became a thing of regularity wonder and our Pap was growing big and strong...kind of. We began to notice some hotspots on our Pap and excessive scratching from both dogs. Our eyes were peeled for fleas and we treated the hotspots with topical ointment to no avail. I was making a return visit to the pet-meds section of our local pet superstore when I was cornered by a sales rep from Nutro. Before I could avoid him he had already asked me what dog food we currently used. I told him, and he immediately asked me if we were having any skin issues. I was sold before he told me what I needed to buy. He filled me in on the idea that the particular blend of Nature's Recipe that we were using lacked some essential nutrients key to healthy skin and coat.We have been using Nutro Ultra Small Breed for several weeks now and I could not be more pleased. Our Pom's insides are still working like a clock and, amazingly, our Pap's hotspots and itching spells have already been healed. I love this food...and I think my dogs like it too.Just one warning: when our older dog was eating the same quantity of Nutro as he was his previous foods, he began to put on weight fairly rapidly. In other words, one might want to monitor intake and the associated weight impact for a while and then adjust accordingly.

I recently changed his food from Nutro Max to Nutro Ultra and it made my life a lot easier. I had to hand feed his previous food to him because he doesn't care enough to do the hard work himself. I also had to give him Angel Eyes (which he hates) through his treats and not through his kibble. About a week ago I've been giving him Nutro Ultra and the much smaller size of his kibble makes it a lot easier for him to chew. I no longer have to hand feed him and I can give him his Angel Eyes through his kibble, so feeding him has become much less of a hassle.
since ive purchased this dog food. i have noticed my dogs coat. its shiny and less fur has fallen out. they have more energy and their poop is much healthyer.
My dog as very bad food allergies and this is the only food we've found that she can eat!

I bought this stuff on a whim at a health store and feel in love with the stuff. It has a nice strong ginger taste. To me it tastes almost like a carbonated chai tea. It's much cheaper for me to buy at my local store though.
These handy packages are perfect for the tobasco lovers in the world. You never have to be without your favorite hot sauce!

column9: Small boxes but sooo worth it.
column10: Ok... My husband is the cutest man alive. I told him how much i love the bunches in the Honey Bunches of Oats cereal and he gave these to me for my birthday. I got a few chuckles from friends but everyone ended up eating them all! (they are 4 small boxes and they go FAST!)

It's lightly sweet, stays crunchy in milk, and keeps my stomach happy until lunch.  I LOVE this cereal, and I'm thrilled I can get it shipped to me with Prime since my local grocer stopped carrying it.

After reading the 1 star rating of the previous reviewer, which had nothing to do with the product itself but more so an issue with the vendor, I had to review it myself. If you are a fan of the "bunches" clusters in honey bunches of oats, this is the cereal for you. It is nice and crunchy and does not get soggy in milk very quickly. It is almost granola-like, but better in my opinion. 5 Stars!

When I was a kid, Post used to make a cereal called C. W. Post. It was a granola type cereal that was the absolute best. It disappeared from the grocery shelves sometime in the 1980's.Fast forward to today. Walking down the grocery isle, I noticed the single row of just bunches, high on the grocer's shelf. Over the years, I had tried to find a granola cereal that could live up to the legend of the C.W. from my childhood. Sampling all that I could find, I had no luck equaling that wonderful crunchy taste.Likely this new find, Just Bunches, would also disappoint, but I figured I should give it a try to see if it came at least close to what I remembered. It was from the Post people, perhaps they reached deep into their cereal recipe box and revived an old flavor from the past.... One could only hope.It the parking lot of the Grocery, I cracked open the box to give it a taste. Instantly I was transported back to my childhood, munching on cereal and watching Saturday morning cartoons, the road runner, bugs bunny, it all came back...I had found the 'holy Grail' of cereals.... ok, maybe that's taking it too far, but man its really good. So good, I subscribed for auto ship every month.

column9: Delicious with vanilla yogurt and frozen blueberries
column10: I was so thrilled to find 'Just Bunches' by Honey Bunches of Oats offered online since I can't find it in stores anymore.  Make sure you realize what size boxes you are purchasing.  These are so small they're almost sample size or something.  These are not the size that you purchased in the store.

Not sure why only one store in my shopping area carries this cereal as it is awesome. I love it and so does my body. I try and eat it every day and hubby likes to top his other cereal with it as well. Forgot to pick it up at the only store where it is available at today, so tried to make homemade granola--near total flop. I think I will be making a trip into town to get some more boxes. I'm glad amazon carries it in case I can't buy it, but why doen't other stores carry it?

column9: So glad I can find this on Amazon
column10: This cereal is hard to find and I recently stocked up on it at one of the "big" stores only to find it not available on my last trip there.  So I'm glad I can still buy it online here and hope it doesn't get discontinued altogether.  My kids love it, plus I think it's great on top of vanilla yogurt.

My grandchildren and I got hooked on "Just Bunches", the crunchy bits in the Post cereal Honey Bunches of Oats.  Just Bunches is no longer sold in our local markets so we were delighted that we could order the cereal through Amazon. Just Bunches makes a delicious parfait.  Put yogurt in a bowl, add some Just Bunches, and top with blueberries or sliced strawberies.
can't find this product in local stores anymore. ordering online is the only way i can feed my  bunches habit.
My whole family loooves this cereal, either alone, in yogurt or mixed with other cereals.  I used to be able to find this in my local store but no longer...so this is a good solution at a good price.

This is, like it says, just the clusters of oats without the flakes. It's a nice change from the Honey Bunches of Oats, or it's a nice thing to add to the original if you think it doesn't have enough of the clusters.  Unlike the original, it makes a nice snack.  Either way, it's yummy.
We always liked the Honey Bunches of Oats cereal and always looked for the bunches. So what could be better than getting Just Bunches!!!!!!!

I've been eating this cereal for a few years now and its the best. But now they are discontinued and its hard to find.This product ships from Fernly NV and mine expires in 5 months.The box looks so small it is the smallest Ive seen. Ive bought small boxes before, but these are smaller. I would say that its as small as my Ipad2. Only about two bowls per box. Put it in perspective a can of soda is 12oz, this box is 17oz. Really small!I thought that it was a comparable deal to the supermarket (they were expensive at the market when available) but when you take in the size its a bit silly.I was ready to order 20 boxes but via prudence waited to receive one order first. Thank goodness.Too small. Must have been for a chain of hotels/timeshares to sell to patrons or something...

column9: DON'T BUY! ONLY ONE SHAKER NOT THREE AS DESCRIBED! RIP OFF!!
column10: DON'T BUY! ONLY ONE SHAKER NOT THREE AS DESCRIBED! RIP OFF!!  Enough yelling, this is the best salt ever! But they only shipped out one 9 ounce shaker when the description says 3 pack.

I could not remember where I originally purchased this but I liked it so much that I checked on Amazon and was fortunate enough to find it.  When my mother visited me for a few months she was crazy about this and wanted some to take back home with her.  So...after looking all over for it I finally looked online.  I purchased enough for my mother, myself and other family members.  It has a great flavor but not too salty as I don't like regular table salt.  This is perfect.

column9: Cook's Pure Vanilla Powder (1.5 lb. jar)
column10: This vanilla is the best! I use it in homemade yogurt since liquid vanilla doesn't seem to work. I got 2 1.5 lb. jars last summer and have used one completely up. I use it in everything that requires vanilla. The taste is so much better. Even sprinkle it on pancakes, french toast and many other things.. I recommend this product to everyone who likes good tasting food!!

I found out about this product in Starbucks. I add to my French Vanilla Tripio (three shots of SF Vanilla; three shots of SF Hazlenut; three shots of Expresso; add soy milk; Cooks Vanilla Powder, cinnamon and raw sugar) OMG!!! Delicious!!!. I googled the Cooks company after looking on the cannister. The Cooks company sells it, but Amazon was cheaper. A must buy. Give it a try if you love Vanilla as I.

column9: Great product, could not find locally
column10: We used to buy the vanilla powder in Oregon, but couldn't find it in Cape Coral. The 1.5# container is a real bargain.

Note the Disclaimer: product may be different than pictured.  Pa. Dutch Gen'l Store doesn't know Barbados Molasses from old motor oil - and the label on the jar doesn't state what is in it. This goop is no different from Brer Rabbit sorghum (syrup) that you can buy in your local grocery store, other than it costs 3X as much through Amazon.  When I contacted Pa. Dutch Gen'l Store I was told they were just the distributor, so tough luck if I ended up with the wrong product.  Amazon is silent.  Lesson: DON'T TRY TO BUY "MOLASSES" FROM A BOOK STORE.  And DON'T BUY ANY PRODUCT FROM PA. DUTCH GEN'L STORE.  "GOLDEN BARREL" ISN'T THE "BARREL MOLASSES" YOU ARE LOOKING FOR.  It's just a name on a label.  A PENNZOIL label would have been just as accurate.  The Disclaimer conveniently allows the vendor to display any picture, but ship anything from axle grease to dishwater.  Amazon needs to go back to selling books and stop trying to be Walmart.

I found this stuff when I switched to glueten free diet, but after adding glueten back to my diet, I still eat this several times a week. Some of the reasons I love this: it doesn't  become completely mushy, has a nice texture. Not crunchy, though. The flavor is nice, but I add brown sugar and frozen blueberries and cook with half milk/half water (of course not frozen once I eat them). Another great thing about this cereal is that it cooks quickly, comparing to steel cut oats. If you're a hot cereal fan, you'll like this, if not...send it to me. I'm so excited amazon carries this with prime (finally!). I've been buying this in 25# bags direct from BRM, now I can buy smaller bulk!

If you love oatmeal or other hot cereals but need gluten free-This is it!  Quick and easy to make  Can make a batch in the pressure cooker in 5 minutes eonough for the week.  If you need or just want to go with a little less gluten in your life, try it you'll like it!

I'm big on healthy hot and cold cereal, and this fits the bill. Add a little agave nectar and chopped walnuts and you've got a nice alternative to oatmeal. Also, it's obviously great for those of you that have a gluten allergy. Finally, the price online is better than you'll see in the grocery and health food stores.

My aunt put a tin of this in with my Christmas present and I loved it so much I had to buy some.  It dissolves completely, and is rich and chocolatey.  I put a spoonful in my afternoon coffee sometimes for a treat.  I highly recommend this product.
This is the best cocoa mix I've had. The only downside is you have to use so much to make cocoa. It goes quick!

column9: Lower sugar than most, packed with great flavor!
column10: These bars are wonderful!  Full of nuts and the box says just 6 grams of sugar, much lower than others I have tried.  The protein really fills me up and keeps me sated for 2+ hours. I think they taste like Cracker Jack without the popcorn, very light and crunchy.Other nut bars I have tried are chewy and the nuts tend to lose their snap sitting in nougat-style binding; these are lightly sweet and brittle.  I break up the bar before I open the open the pouch and pop in the clusters while I work to keep me away from the donuts in the break room.The price is fantastic: the amazon.com 6 pack breaks down to 57 cents a bar, which is WAY less expensive than other nut bars of this quality.  I used to eat KIND bars, but they are over $1 a bar and more sugar.There are only 8 ingredients and I can pronounce and recognize them all; there is corn syrup in these, but it is not High Fructose Corn Syrup (which is modified and not very good for you).  I eat about 3-4 of these a week.Another tip: I am 6 months pregnant and find these a perfect thing to keep in my purse for when I need a nosh to keep me from getting light-headed, the protein and low sugar keeps me buoyant and doesn't send me crashing.  One of these, a string cheese and a piece of fresh fruit is a filling and easy mid-day meal when I am pressed for time.
I am so glad Amazon offers this product.  Of all the Nature Valley bars, this is my favorite, very crisp and crunchy with great flavor. Makes a great breakfast with coffee, or a snack.

column9: More peanuts than Almonds and 1 month expiration date
column10: The bars have more peanuts that almonds...maybe it should be called"Roasted Peanut Almond crunch"How do they expect me to eat 36 bars in a month?Amazon should display the expiration date so that people know if they want to buy them or not.

column9: Such a tasty treat that your mouth will thank you!
column10: I received a box of the Nature Valley Roasted Almond Crunch bars and a box of the Nature Valley Peanut Crunch bars to try and write a review on.  They are both delicious but I admit the Nature Valley Peanut Crunch bars is my favorite!  My husband preferred the Nature Valley Almond Crunch bars but he also likes almonds more than I do.  These bars were not at all what I initially expected.  They are almost like a brittle.  They are sweet and crunchy.  The Almond Crunch bars contain almonds, sunflower seeds and peanuts.  The Peanut Crunch contain peanuts, sunflower seeds and almond flour.I have always liked granola and protein bars because they are easy to take with you and give you a quick pick me.  Low and behold, I have found a replacement!  I'm definitely hooked on the Peanut Crunch bars and I keep one in my purse at all times.You owe it to yourself to try these tasty bars at least once.  You can't go wrong with either of these YUMMY crunch bars and you won't be disappointed!

These rip up your mouth. Very brittle texture. I have to break up the bar into very tiny pieces to eat - too hard on the mouth to just bite into. Grown-ups only ... Not a good snack for kids of ANY age. I have a box at work that is reserved STRICTLY for hunger emergencies. I won't buy again once the box is empty. The flavor is good but they are just too painful to eat!  Ouch!

I love these. They're gluten free, which my family needs, they have lots of protien, fiber, and healthy fat, and they are portable. We use these on days when we're running late and don't have time for breakfast--its a healthy breakfast substitute my kids can eat in the car on the way to school.

Nature Valley seems to have broadened their line of healthier snacks, and I'm sold.  These are great.  The peanut version is also good, just depending on one's personal preference of peanut or almond.  We love them, and they are great pick-me-up.
These bars taste great. The ingredient list is nice and short. They're a little brittle and can break easily. That's not a problem for me so I give these tasty treats 5 stars.

column9: I'd rather just eat the ingredients
column10: I don't understand the point of these bars. Take a variety of roasted nuts, stick them together in bar form using corn syrup, and what do you get? A good way to lose a lot of nuts all over the front of your shirt every time you take a bite.The bar form adds nothing to me, except for corn syrup that I neither need nor want, and just makes it harder to consume. I would rather just eat the roasted nuts!
Tasty, but a healthy snack this is not.  Absolutely coated (glazed) with sugar, hard as a rock.  Get it for a dessert, as candy.  It shouldn't be called a granola bar.

column9: Great gluten free snack or breakfast.
column10: Yes it does have a lot of nuts and isn't chewy but it taste great.  A lot of gluten free bars taste awful. The Luna bars aren't bad though. I am buying in bulk at amazon because the stores could care less about gluten free shoppers and don't have them or are out.  My husband is not gluten free and he likes them.

column9: Gluten Free nature Valley roasted Nut Crunch Bars
column10: I was very skeptical about this product, it was like peanut brittle, kind of hard.  I was expecting something soft like mose Nature Valley bars.  I bit into it and was instantly hooked.  It tastes very good, is good for you and on top of that it is Gluten Free.  I love these bars
This is a crunchy bar that is filling. It's a little salty and sweet. Too salty for me. It is filling.
I love these for portable snacks to keep in my backpack. But I would think, especially buying so many boxes at a time, that the price would be better.

These bars are great for a snack, for a pick me up on a hike, or to satisfy a 'need a yummy' pang.  My favorite thing is to smash up a bar and then sprinkle it over yogurt for a really  good breakfast.
These bars are great! It is so nice to have a good tasting, granola bar.  They only have 6grams of sugar but are a great combination of sweet and salty. I would but them again!

The first shipment was as expected,however;the follow shipment ( 2nd )was very disappointing. Most of the bars were broken into small pieces and among the few that weren't broken were under size in comparison to the others.Aside from all of that;the broken pieces had the same fantastic flavor as the none broken ones.Hopefully,future shipments will contain less broken Granola Bars.
These are a personal favorite of mine. They are hard to find in the grocery stores around here. So I get them sent to me via subscribe and save. Very, very satisfying snack.
NV Almond Crunch bars are the best. Great for breakfast or a healthier alternative to dessert. Flavor is fantastic. Like eating brittle without the overly sweet taste. Wonderful aftertaste.

Everyone in family, both young and old, loves this crunchy granola bar.  Bars are not too sweet but satisfy hunger for a sweet snack. Great that they are nutritious and don't melt like chocolate.  They are handy to tuck in a lunch box, purse, or backpack if needed. We always try to keep some on hand.  Those who need to be gluten-free do not feel cheated out of a dessert.  Amazon frequently offers good sales on this item.

These are some of my favorite nut bars, and are very cost effective compared to some of the alternatives.  These bars have just the right amount of sweetness and saltiness for my palate.  Lots of almonds and peanuts.  I also enjoy the sunflower seeds.I've purchased a 36-pack (6 boxes of 6 bars) of these three times now, and I'll undoubtedly be purchasing more.  I eat several of these each week for either for breakfasts or an evening snacks.  Totally hooked.Great job, Nature Valley!  Thanks, Amazon.
These bars are ok, not the best I've ever had, but ok.  They are definitely crunchy.  They are big and difficult to eat for kids.  I will probably not buy them again because I don't love them.

long ago I got NV's peanut crunch at Costco and loved it. but they stopped carrying it and I couldn't find it anywhere locally. I was excited when I saw Amazon had the almond crunch. price was good with the subscribe and save plus an additional discount. product arrived very quickly--couple days before estimated delivery date. excitedly took a bite and was quite disappointed. bar was very hard and somewhat stale. canceled my subscription immediately. site won't let me give NO stars.

column9: Great Snacks for home or on the go
column10: I first encountered these at a close out store, and was pleased to find them still in production. These Nut Bars are the answer to my Why is Granola So Sugary/starchy Question.  They are nuts not oats and grains, there is a bit of rice but not much, they have a hard head quaking CRUNCH that is so satisfying. Not crispy but crunchy, Not gooey, but chew inducing, jaw workout.I like the, got them for my Boyfriend and recommend them to my Mom and Dad.  Another bonus is because they are not grain based the carbohydrate count is reasonable, 13g of carbohydrates, 2g of fiber and 6g of sugar. That beats any so called healthy granola bar to the ground as far as sugars go.The only down side to my order, is that this order had 6 boxes and so far I've gone through 3 of them and they have all been broken up in the package. That doesn't affect the eat-a-bility of the bar since you are gonna crunch it apart anyway,  It would only matter if you were presenting the bar without the package and that's not typical except in fake photographing for advertisement. :p  They got eaten up just the same.  They are good with a glass of cold milk, or my favorite a glass of cold Plain Unsweetened almond milk. If you're gonna be nutty, why not go all the way!Edited August 21, 2012Well, I'm a bit disappointed. I started buying these bars on subscribe and save at $14 per package of 6. In April of this year the price was $16/6, and I delayed buying more because i was having financial problems, but I just came back to add a early shipment to schedule and I see that the price has JUMPED TO $22 PER 6 BOXES. That's a $7 increase  in price in just 4 months! How do they justify this price HIKE!? Yeah it's a hike, cause it only increased $2 over two years now $7 in 4 months. What's going On!?  I won't take away any stars cause the product is still awesome and tasty, but I was paying $2.66 per box and the price is now $3.66 per box. That's a huge jump in price. I don't know...

So far these have become my favorite granola bar from Nature Valley or anywhere else. I just discovered them a few months ago, and since my supply was getting low, I went to Wally world today and bought them out except for one box that was way in the back and beyond my reach.  Sometimes I'll have one in the morning and don't feel hungry for hours. They are very crunchy, and take awhile to chew since I don't want to do any damage to my teeth, and also  have high fructose corn syrup~ wish it was honey instead, but I like them.
I eat mainly vegetarian so have to make sure I find protein in other foods.  Nuts are a good source of protein and these bars also satisfy my snack habit and enjoy the crunch.

My doctor recently told me to adopt a gluten free diet and I've been having trouble finding things that taste as good as products with gluten.However, these granola bars are AWESOME! They taste great, I dont even miss the gluten!  A simplified ingredient list is hard to find these days, but Nature Valley has done it without sacrificing taste.Yes, they are crunchy, they have whole nuts in them people and are called NUT CRUNCH!

column9: Good stuff but kinda high on salt.. :(
column10: The nuts are good for you but what about the salt? From the taste of it, I think that this is pretty high on sodium 180mg/bar. I think thats pretty high considering that too much sodium is not good for you and we tend to have quite a bit of sodium in other stuff we eat. Tastes good. And if you are really hungry, you can eat one of this bars and it will make you feel full for 60-90mins.
I've really enjoyed my Nature Valley Nut Crunch granola bars.  Tasty & healthy.  Order came very quickly.  Thanks
Best snack I've had since Celiac diagnosis! I sometimes have one as a quick breakfast, too, they're very filling! Thank you, Nature Valley!

These bars are great tasting, but for folks with teeth that can't do crunchy stuff that takes a lot to bite into, these may not be for you, may damage fillings. Not a chewy bar at all. All crunch. At least the ones I got were very crunchy-not chewy
Good stuff, took off a star cuz you can't eat more than one at a time though, little too salty.

Very tasty.It's hard to find something which has as much protein (6g) as sugars (6g).  I just wish that the sugars were really sugar instead of corn syrup; also, it would taste even better (in my opinion) if it had 2/3 as much sugar.  but still the best snack bar out there.

column9: Delicious but super hard on the teeth
column10: If you like peanut brittle then you'll like this.  Really nutty and brittle-like in the crunch.  I didn't expect it to be so brittle and had a hard time eating.  Was too salty for me but I liked the content of nuts and the delicious flavor so I may repurchase in the future.
Good stuff but extremely hard and brittle.  Looks like the glaze over the bar to hold it together made it extremely hard to eat.

column9: Tasty snack, full of energy, low carb.
column10: These are good, but beware. It's roasted nuts, so it's about 60% fat. That's good for active people, and would be awesome as trail food, sports snacks, or for my kids, but for those of us who sit on our duffs all day, these don't meet our dietary needs.Even so, these are very tasty. They're not too sweet, and not too salty.  This is the Almond Crunch which has better flavor variety, but the Peanut Crunch is OK too.  Both have peanuts. Both are the same amount of protein, fat and sugar.
I am addicted to them and feel good about it because Almonds are good for you.  They are also gluten free--and that's goodness.
Both of us really like these.  They are all nuts with a little syrup connecting them.Crunchy and very tasty.  Great value at Amazon price, especially with so many almonds in them.

column9: Finally a truly gluten free bar from Nature Valley
column10: These bars are very different from the other non gluten-free Nature Valley granola bars so it's important to set the proper expectations. It's hard to describe, but essentially these bars are just nuts bound together with some sort of sugary honey binding. As you can imagine it makes these bars extremely crunchy and somewhat hard on your teeth unless you break them apart in your hand first. Once you get past this challenge you'll find the bar to be delicious and very filling since it's basically just nuts. The nutrition info can be a little misleading because all of the calories/fat come directly from the nuts which isn't a bad thing. These are definitely worth trying out and we're finding that they are in more and more supermarkets these days.

I actually ordered these by mistake when trying to purchase a Peanut Butter snack bar but was PLEASANTLY surprised. They taste great and are healthier than most snacks. Been eating one of these daily! I also got a good deal on the price with subscription which makes them taste even BETTER :D

There aren't many crunchy breakfast bars out there that aren't also super crumbly. I love these. I have one pretty much every morning when I'm driving to work. They have pretty good protein and fairly low calories. The only thing I don't like is the fact that there just isn't any variety. They just make Almond and Peanut flavors. I really wish there was a Cashew variety.

column9: One of my favorite gluten free snacks
column10: There's a lot of snack type bars but so few of them are gluten free.  These are and they are delicious.  Crunchy, sweet, and salty and really satisfying.

The ingredients sounded good, so I tried a box.  They did not meet expectations. The bars were very hard and crunchy to the point of being difficult, and they were just too salty tasting for me.  No more.

This product is superior to almost any other nut bar on the market and the only one I buy on a regular basis, because it is composed almost exclusively of nuts (almonds)and seeds and is not too sweet.

A friend gave me one of these bars to try, and I am hooked.  I thought they would be like other granola bars, but as another reviewer says, they are almost like a nut brittle.  I buy the almond variety, which is almost entirely nuts, sunflower seeds, and a sweetener to hold it all together.  They are sweet and nutty, just like nut brittle.  The taste is amazing, but there are only 6 grams of sugar in the bar!  That's what keeps me going back... they're not completely healthy, but they're not as bad a candy, either.  They are a great protein-filled snack with a dessert-like flavor.  I like granola bars well enough, but I don't look forward to eating them.  But I actually look forward to one of these as an evening snack with a cup of tea.

This is the best snack bar I've found. Pure peanuts, almonds and sunflower seeds. No sticky granola filler. WARNING WHEN ORDERING!: I ordered six boxes. There are six bars in each box. However the ordering information is misleading and instead of getting the six boxes I'd paid for, I got one box with six bars. On the other hand, Amazon apologized for the mistake and sent me six boxes in addition to the one I'd received.
We enjoy this so much we placed a 2nd order soon.  The flavor is great and it's quite nutrious.
Great taste and it does well to fill you up and keep you healthy. Helps fill the food cravings that add pounds.

column9: when they said crunchy, they meant it!
column10: These bars are very hard and crunchy.  They are so hard that most of the bars are broken into pieces already when you open them up.  I will say that they do taste pretty good however.

column9: Sent very close to expiry date!!!!
column10: Got them at a good price through GOLD BOX DEAL OF THE DAY. But we were very disappointed to find out they expire in 1 month. We can't eat 6 boxes in 1 month!!! Sneaky Amazon!!!!!
A lot of bars (36),,, too brittle. Biting into a bar leaves crumbs all over the floor. Will probably not buy again.

column9: So yummy and good for you too!
column10: These bars are filled with good-for-you nuts and just a little sugar to hold it together. That's it, just nuts and a little (6 grams) sugar. We eat at least one of these every day. Highly recommend.
I love these nut bars, I wouldn't consider them granola bars really...more nuts than granola.  These are great for travel because they don't get smashed.
This is a pretty good nut bar. I repeat it is a nut bar with plenty of nuts and sweet but a little salty.

I really like nuts and I like sweets.  This is the best of both.  It provides protein that I need and satifies my desire for crunchy foods.  I had gastic bypass three years ago and it is the perfect meal for me.  My nephew is diabetic and he carries them everywhere.  Definitely a two thumbs up!  Only one downfall is that they break easily in the package.The way I see it, they have already broken up the bar into bite size pieces but for those who are unfamiliar might end up with a mess in their laps.

column9: Great taste, but 3x warehouse pricing and wasteful packaging.
column10: They aren't kidding when they say "crunch"--these are extremely crunchy and very tasty bars.  At first I was uncertain that I liked them, but I warmed up to them quickly.  They are a fantastic snack.However, the value just isn't there.  In warehouse shopping clubs, you can buy other Nature Valley bars of the same quality for about 1/3rd of the price and get 30 bars in a case lot box, rather than 6 small retail boxes.  At today's price, these bars are about $0.56 each vs $0.27 from a warehouse club.
The nut crunch is OK. Each pack only has one piece. (Not like most of the snack bars which have 2 pieces in each pack.)

Trying Illy espresso for the first time I was really looking forward to it, primarily because of all the publicity the company gets.  After following the directions in my new espresso maker I pulled the shots and came away disappointed.  This is very average espresso.I've been drinking espresso for 20 years and making it at home for the last 6.  The crema was below average (very thin) as was the flavor (especially when I paid $11.95 plus shipping for an 8.8 ounce container).  I have since pulled other shots with the same result:  flavor was not robust and very, very average.

I just spent a month in Italy and got hooked on Illy brewed in a standard drip filter coffee maker. I used 6-7 coffee spoons for a 10-cup pot. Once I got the right ratio, I found the coffee full-bodied and sweet without acidity. I am glad I brought a couple of cans back from Italian grocery stores; it costs double here. Keep in mind that it is canned coffee, so don't expect it to be as robust as fresh roasted from your local coffee shop. But, if you like to experiment with different coffees, give it a try. It is packaged in a nicely designed can with a screw-on top that seals pretty well.
This candy makes a good treat for a cocktail party. Just make sure to keep the kids away. It packs a powerfull punch.

Wonderful hard candies filled with pockets of liquor (grappa, rhum, whiskey, etc.).  If you haven't had them before, they can be quite surprising when you get to the middle (a burst of liquor).  Definitely not for children but fantastic for adults.

These hard candies have a terrible non-taste.  There is a goo in the center that tastes like plain corn syrup only not sweet;  there is absolutely no liquor flavor to this product.  It resembles a stale cough drop at best....no kick, no zing,  no sweetness.  Yuck.  I will never buy this item again.  ( I checked the expiration and these don't expire until 2015 and if that's the best/freshness you achieve then forget this food item ) This is why this candy is just about 2 dollars a bag;  you pay for what you get. 2 thumbs down; save your money on another brand after dinner liquor candy.
Yes it is really filled with liquor how who knows....but it is great and has a little kick.  Reasonable cost...order a case trust me everyone you know will want some of it...great gift!

Not good at all. Didnt like the candies. And you cant even return them. Total waste of money. Candies are so hard that you cant even get the taste of liquor. The liquor filled chocolates from Anthony Berg is way much better.

I bought this soup with low expectations but I was pleasantly surprised.  It tastes homemade. I served it over rice. Now, if Amy's could start putting their items in tetra paks, all would be even better.
Tasty!  I've already ordered my second case, it's that good!  Hurry up Amazon and add this item to your Subscribe & Save program.  Thanks in advance!

This is a tasty product that I really like. Unfortunately the standard put-up is 12 cans in a half-carton -- a cardboard box bottom and a flexible plastic film top, which apparently is a cost-cutting measure. The cans bang into each other during shipping, because the plastic film top is the equivalent of putting them in a bag.The cans arrive severely dented, which could compromise the seal, and allow baterial contamination. Although I pointed out this problem sometime ago, my most recent shipment arrived damaged again.
I was not sure I would like canned lentil soup. But this was above my expations. Actually very good. Nice smooth flavors. Just wish there were big pieces of veggies in here.

Do you know how hard it is to find soup that doesn't have sugar in it? Really, really hard.  I do not eat sugar and discovering Amy's soups (well, most of them) has been such a gift.  Despite their very healthy ingredients, they are all delicious and they make dinner or lunch on a busy day so much easier.  We order them on subscribe and save and they come out to a very affordable amount per can.  Not bad for an entire lunch! (P.S. I throw them in my Stanley thermos after heating them up in the morning and they are still hot by lunch time...)

I love this soup and it is somewhat hard to find in stores. This is why I bought it on Amazon. However the order arrived with half of the cans dented (a couple of them really bad). This should not happen and it is a health issue. I would not buy them in this condition at the supermarket. Amazon should have inspected them before sending them.

column9: Coffee beans were stale and flavorless
column10: Coffee was not vacuum sealed. Did not have that fresh coffee aroma which I would expect when I opened the bag. When I brewed it, the coffee tasted like dirt. Tried twice with different grinds and strengths, but there was no hope for it. Stale, flavorless garbage.

column9: Raw Organics going back to Paradise
column10: Raw is eating from your Organic garden of fresh grown fruits and vegetables.It is also all the nuts growing from the mountains that surrounds us through out the land from the forest. Although grown from a tiny little seed that the sun and rain helps in growth it is our heavenly father our creator God who truly makes them grow and should be appreciated for his gift of life to us all and for our home the planet we call earth .I used to be a true vegetarian then I went to only eating Poultry and some fish and eggs through out the years.Now I will eat vegetarian soup made with some beef stock but I don't care for the meat itself and no pork.I am still Organic Alternative and Green but I am slowly trying to go back to being that true vegetarian that I used to be however going raw will take a some time because I have a little hard time chewing with my teeth like my friend but after I get my dentures I will be able to adjust into it .Right now I am canning for winter storage.I have dehydrated my whole garden into green super power food that I added to my barley greens. note if you choose to cook get the Fagor Pressure cooker caner That I got it helps make the meals go quicker and is a lot healthier than baking and Broiling or grilling and never fry food.Well I will let you know how the canning turn out and one day I'd like to make home made all fruit yes that's right not jelly or jam.Hi Again so far so good I have canned 4 pint jars of my home made spaghetti sauce with 4 of Chili and 4 vegetarian soups with 2 red cabbages and they sealed and are ready for winter when things get rough as around here it is hard to get organics so when I do I get all that I can like I just got up at the farmers market this late fall and then I either freeze them or can them and even dehydrate them.So I will keep you up to date but I need to try and get some organic fruits and that is hard to get again around here.well catch ya later as I never say goodbye!Just get this wonderful organic fruit nut and seed mix it has no preservatives and is delicious and affordable and if I can get it you can too. column9: blue 1 food coloring = severe abdominal agony
column10: I *cheer* the fact these pickle relish packages contain turmeric spice which is a super powerful anti-inflammatory (strong enough that my husband used turmeric capsules over pain meds when he had surgery for a hip fracture a couple years ago..)However... these pickle relish packets contain BLUE 1!  FD&C BLUE 1 causes severe abdominal distress in a percentage of the population (many of whom have yet to make the connection).  If you aren't sure why Blue 1 is such a bad idea, check out the FDA press release stating blue 1 is "casually linked" to fatalities they investigated.I recently attended an event where these relish packets were served. Stoopidly I dumped the packet onto my food and a few hours later, like clockwork, I was in severe abdominal distress. Major GI issues. Checking around, sure enough, these packets show blue 1 in the ingredients.  Just 1 packet had me doubled over in pain.. and worse.Parents: if you aren't sure why your kids randomly seem to develop stomach aches, diarrhea, abdominal distress, bloating, cramping or worse - bloody stools, start reading the food labels of everything consumed 24-36 hours prior to onset. A pattern will undoubtedly emerge...

column9: A Crispy Pastry Disk. Light Taste And Slightly Sweet.
column10: My nearby Fresh and Easy Neighborhood Market stocks a lot of exotic and interesting gourmet products. I enjoy trying them out. Today, there were several large boxes of Ines Rosales Sweet Olive Oil Tortas imported from Seville, Spain. So what is this? Well, I had no idea, but they looked good. So, I bought a pack of 6.3 ounces and it contained six tortas. Well, they're like a five-inch diameter thin crispy pastry disk that is somewhat like a pie crust. It's fragile and quite easily broken. The flavor is light and slightly sweet. The instructions suggest to serve them with cheese, perhaps also with coffee or tea. I had one with my evening salad meal. One of the tortas is listed as 14o calories and half of that is fat, presmably olive oil. So, now I know what tortas are. They're  a tasty item, but I doubt I'd buy a second pack.Gary Peterson
It is a very taste snack and well worh the price.  This is the second time I have purchasedit and would certainly do it again.
These are full of flavor.  Never will go back to the smaller blow pops!  Love the super blow pops.

These Blow pops are great for the sucker part, than the gum afterwards. 130 calories per Super Blow Pop. The stores normally charge .50 per pop, so this is a good deal. I find in the boxes that I've ordered do have less Cherry and Sour Apple, and more of the Strawberry and Watermelon.

I bought these for my maltipoo and she just absolutely loves them. There is nothing better than a "star". She gets one every day and when we see we are getting low, a quick look on amazon is all it takes to refill her cookie jar.
my dog loves this treats and can't get enough of them, totally worth buying for all types of dogs. It helps with there teeth so that the teeth stay strong and healthy.
My dog loves these and she is very finicky. They keep her teeth cleaner than any other chew product. They are worth the cost.
I love this product and the quality and freshness was outstanding and the swiftness of receiving this product was very good
Candy was old and nearly broke my teeth.  Don't waste your time or money.
I got the product when I suppose too.I always liked to chew the hotdog gum.This is just as good as it use to be.Exactly what I wanted.Rate excellant.

NO IT DOESNT COME WITH ANYTHING BUT THE SLICE OF PRIME RIB BUT ITS GOOD ON ITS OWN. IF YOU BUY A STEAK AT THE STORE DOES IT COME SEASONED? NO. TRY IT AND FIGURE IF YOU LIKE IT OR NOT. I PERSONALLY LIKE IT AND I BOUGHT A FEW BOXES FOR FRIENDS AND FAMILY AND THEY LIKE IT TOO.

column9: Closer to 3 and a half stars, but I'll be fair and round up
column10: I fairly recently got a package of various products from Omaha steaks as a birthday gift from a friend.  Included was a couple boxes of these prime rib slices.  I won't call them wonderful, there's no substitute for a prime rib sliced off of a freshly cooked roast in a well run steakhouse.  But for what they are, a precooked steak that's frozen, they aren't bad, and do make a good way to have a last minute entree for unexpected company and/or when one is in a rush and don't have too much time otherwise.I normally don't comment on other reviews in my own, and to be fair I already posted a comment in the one star review's comment section, the one titled "YUCK".  But a few comments here also if I may:  1)  The fellow complains about the lack of au jus.  It's a condiment.  It's like complaining about the lack of grated horseradish (I know people who like prime rib with such) or any other condiment people might eat with prime rib or steak in general not being with this.  Unless a package says that a condiment is included, I don't assume that such would be.  So without trying to belittle the author of "YUCK", I find his complaint to be unwarrented.  If he wishes there to be au jus, there's au jus that one can buy from the spice section of most grocery stores.  Or one can use the juices in the individual packaging for each steak slice and try to make some if one knows how.  2)  Although again I don't think these warrent a five star review, they are hardly flavorless.  Not a strong flavor, but I did detect a bit of a flavor from some rub that was put on the outside before cooking and slicing.  The steaks themselves DID taste like prime rib to me, albeit obviously prime rib that had been frozen.  So I'm not sure what "YUCK" got, but it apparently was different from my prime rib slices.

Nasty, gross, and terrible. I could end it there, but I won't. They should be ashamed to sell this product. I love prime rib. It's my favorite meal. Even bad prime rib is usually good. You can't even tell what kind of meat this is. Also, it does not come with any type of Au jus. Au jus it kinda what makes it prime rib and not a ribeye. There is none. There seem to be no seasoning on it either to make up for the lack of Au jus. If I was out to eat and was served this, I'd send it back to the kitchen in a heartbeat.

column9: I agree about the Ginger Snaps switch-out, but...  I won't live without these!
column10: I agree with the previous reviewer's experience.  My first batch of these "new" pastilles were about half powder, and I'd (at that time) vowed to never purchase them again.  That was easier said than done, though, and after a few months I picked up a couple of tins at my local health food store.  Totally different!  They seem to have completely addressed the issue.  They are larger than the snaps, but they are smooth and compact, now - even shiny on the surface.  This has been without exception for the past two dozen or more tins I've worked my way through.  I don't think I can live without them!The quotes inside the lid aren't nearly as good, however...

column9: Not quite what I was expecting
column10: I'd had a bulk bag of St. Claire's Ginger Snaps and really liked them. When I finally ran out, I looked for them again, found these Ginger Sweets and though they were the same thing.  They are not quite the same - they're a lot larger, much softer and very prone to disintegrate into a lot of white dust.  My shipper did a valiant job of packing them, and even so, the dust was EVERYWHERE in the package.  Fortunately it stayed IN the package or I might have had the FBI on my doorstep.  They really aren't suitable for mailing long distances.  I sure wish that St. Claire's would bring back the smaller, harder Ginger Snaps, but oh well.  I won't order this kind again.

I really like the flavor and texture of this mole.  If you wanted to use it as a sauce, I would use less than the recommended amount of water or chicken stock in the directions so that it will be a little thicker.  If you were to mix cooked chicken with it, I would follow the directions.

I bought the Cascabel Sauce in this San Angel line from a Whole Foods market.It is excellent, I fried up some pork chops and onions and ate it with rice and cascabel sauce on the chops. You dont need much sauce as it has extreme, yummy and savory complex flavors. Its just right, well balanced. I love it, will try on chix and steak soon! I did not try the Red or Black Mole' yet.

column9: I sprinkle it over her kibble and she loves it.
column10: I have been giving my dog the dehydrated dog food as an extra treat to add to her kibble.  I have been looking for something I can add to my dog's food to give her a bit of variation, that won't make her tummy sick.  This was the perfect solution.  You can actually see what is inside and the ingredients are mostly very natural.At first I rehydrated the food with some water and added kibble on top.  This worked out great and it was so much easier than taking wet food out of a can.  I suppose if you aren't too concerned with financial costs, and your dog is doing well on this food, keep going.  But 6 pounds of food for $20.00 is not going to work for me.I realize that the directions say you should add water but the owner of the local pet store that I purchased this from suggested to sprinkle a small amount on top of kibble, just dry.  I did this and my dog liked it.  At one point she would just lick up the dehydrated bits; and slowly eat the kibble.  I mix the dehydrated parts with the kibble now.  This made the dehydrated food last much longer than.  A box lasts a few months now, and my dog enjoys eating her meals.So far I have tried the Herbed Lamb and Beef Zucchini.  My dog seems to like each one equally.Pros:1. Good for sensitive/allergic dogs.2. Can use de/rehydrated.3. Apparently it tastes very good.Cons:1. The price.2. Does not last very long.

column9: finally a food that settled my doggie's tummy, but recent price increase outrageous
column10: No matter how highly rated of a kibble we would get for our little shih tzu & yorkie mix, she would throw up about three times per week.  Once we switched to this raw dehydrated meal at the recommendation of some folks at a local pet store who have a pomeranian with a sensitive tummy, the problem was solved!  Even if she would get into something she was not supposed to, no vomiting, seemed to do miracles for her digestive track in general, so was very pleased!  Have also used the chicken formula, which we have had a great experience with, as well.  Also - she LOVES it!  To save money, we would buy the large 8 pound bag and I am very sad that the price has recently risen so drastically (Nov. of 2011 from $60 per bag to $75, BIG jump).  Because of the price increase, we had switched to Grandma Lucy's (Artisan freeze-dried), with equal success as far as no vomiting and her loving the food, but have switched back to Addiction because she was looking thin, as if the protein content was not enough.  I would recommend calling around to specialty feed stores in your area to find the absolute best price.

This food is amazing... we've tried numerous types of foods... (Royal Canine RX, Hills RX, most of the top named grain free dry kibble, frozen Raw).  She has a hard time digesting hard kibble & will eventually stop eating the raw patties.  This is the only food that our shih-poo has consistently gobbled down day after day.  Very easy to prepare.. mixes well if you decide to add in a little more meat.  This has not upset her sensitive stomach.. we are very pleased with this food!

The product description is incomplete. It also contain High Fructose Corn Syrup. I threw it in the trash. They got my money ... once with their deceptive advertising. They will not get it again. Shame is there isn't a zero star rating
Our kitten loves this food, and it doesn't upset her tummy like the Wellness Kitten food did. I would recommend it!
We bought this for our cats as we've decided to cut way back on the amount of corn products they eat.  All three of them liked the Fedlidae; I will be ordering more.  The price was reasonable, too.
he eats it and has good protein less filler and reasonably priced for a premium food
My two cats love it.  I was surprised since they are picky eaters.  It comes at a good price as well.

column9: Good for allergies, terrible for hairballs
column10: While I prefer wet food for my cats, one of them will only eat dry food. And he has a food allergy that causes flaky, itchy skin and a dull coat. I wanted to try this as the Felidae canned food is high quality and this food is supposed to be good for cats with allergies or sensitive stomachs.We've been feeding this to our two cats and our foster kittens for a couple weeks now and please explain to me why my 7 year old cats suddenly have terrible hairballs. Every day they dry cough and choke, especially my cat with allergies who will only eat the dry food and therefore consumes the most. Even the 10-week old kittens who are short-haired are coughing a little bit. My adult cats are vomiting hairballs now too. Not only is this alarming, but it necessitates the need for a hairball remedy. I should also include that IAMS indoor hairball dry food is what I was feeding when my cat showed symptoms of allergies to food. I am not even sure I will get through the rest of the bag, I might just throw it out. I don't wish all that coughing on strays, shelter cats, or rats.The reason I gave two stars -- this food has helped with my cat's allergies. His coat is shinier and his skin is not flaky. But in our case, these benefits are far outweighed by the suspiciously new and sudden coughing/hacking/vomiting.
This food is not a hit at all.  Both cats are not interested in even trying it. I'm glad I did not pay alot for it.  Will give it to a shelter.

I don't eat sweets but I eat fudge and have had the pleasure of tasting many a fine recipe but none have been as tasty as Mo's - none.I tried the standard chocolate and the vanila crunch and it was to die for. I reluctantly shared it with four others who were really taken back about how good the fudge was so it's not just me - it was a hit all the way around :).One thing to note is the fudge ( I bought 1/2lb of each) came in a lovely decorative box totally suitable for gift giving so you could purchase and have it sent directly as a gift knowing that it will be arrive wrapped nicely and professionally.In my reviews I like to include the "cons" but there simply are none for Mo's Fudge - I will never buy any other fudge again and doubt you will either after you give theirs a try.
My aunt loved the fudge.  "Ymmy." She is pretty particular, too. I will buy more sometime to send to her.

My 13 year old male cat had a lot of problems with hairballs and vomiting.  We had tried several foods (including those specifically for hairballs) and none of them helped.  Since he started eating this food about a year ago, things have been greatly improved.  It's only very rare that he will vomit or have hairball issues anymore.  Also, his coat is shiny and he seems to love the taste!  I definitely recommend this food.

I had to find a cat food with high fiber for one of my cats. She was having "Issues" and the vet said she needed higher fiber in her food. She's been on this food and isn't having problems any longer. It's also working on my other cat who used to get crystals. She's been eating this food with no problems.

This is the only dry cat food that I've served to my two cats since I brought them home in Sept 2009. They love it and I love that it is healthy for them. It isn't entirely grain-free but doesn't contain corn, soy or other ingredients found to be unnecessary for a cat's health. I am dismayed that I can no longer find this cat food at my local pet supply stores and that the price on Amazon has increased by $10 in the past three months. I will still likely order it, unless I can find a similar product for a better price.

I have two longhair cats, one of which is overweight as well.  One or the other, perhaps both, would cough up hairballs from time to time, so I got this and also whiskas temptations hairball control cat treats.  The combo seems to have completely eliminated the hairballs.  Be careful not to give your cat more than four or five of the hairball control treats per week however, as too many will give them the runs.  My fat cat is a bit slimmer too, but only by three oz.'s.  At least she isn't still gaining weight. I have only given them one bag so far.  I plan to continue.

column9: Yup - works really well for us!

These peppers have a nice flavor and look good (no weird-looking strips or questionable coloring).  Yes, this is a lot of red pepper strips.  But I did a little research on-line before buying to see if it's okay to freeze canned peppers (after removing them from the can of course) and found that it was.  I'd include a link but they typically get screened out, so I'll offer that there's a website called Chowhound with a forum that offered good advice and suggestions, both for freezing and what to do with all those peppers.  I rinsed & drained them and froze them on cookie sheets before bagging.  The texture did change somewhat after freezing (a bit mushier) but the taste is fine and it's not like they went into the freezer crispy as they were in water in the first place.  (Just as a general rule, foods with high water content freeze less well.)I wasn't so pleased that both cans arrived with dents. You can't return food on Amazon so that could be an issue if the dents were *really* bad enough to cause concern.  It made opening them a little tricky.  The cans were not well-protected in the box shipped by Amazon, so it's possible the fault lies with Amazon and not the product manufacturer/provider. (Just for the record, after dozens of years and hundreds of canned goods consumed, I can say that I only ever had one -from a supermarket- that WAS truly bad and it was obvious - the contents looked *off* and actually sizzled over the top when opened! Disgusting.)I watched the price on these peppers and got them for under fourteen bucks w/free shipping which I found reasonable.  Now I've got a bunch of little bags of peppers in the freezer to use as needed.  I'm pleased.

This Keebler Cookie & Cracker variety pack has 36 small pouches inside. 9 mini Fudge Shoppe Fudge Strips cookies, 9 Cheez-It, 6 Animal Crackers, 6 Scooby-Doo cinnamon Graham Cracker Sticks, and 6 mini Chips Deluxe Rainbow cookies. I like all of them and think they all taste great. Each pouch has just the right amount to give a little snack - not too much. Just one note about the name is this item. It's called a Cookie & Cracker Assortment on the box. But because of the sugar content of both the animal crackers and the graham crackers those are more cookies than crackers making the box mostly cookies - with the Cheez-It the only true cracker.

These snacks maybe most suitable for young children ages 5-12, but they're also perfect for a busy and hungry college student. Why? It's convenient, and it's tasty, perhaps slightly better than your typical vending machine/fast food because of the controlled serving portions (each pouch is about one ounce in weight).As of the time of writing, at $10/box, it's not cheap, but if you compare it against retail/school dining choices, it's kind of a bargain, because each pouch comes out to be about 25 cents per pouch. This is one-fourth of the cost of your average vending machine snack. To make it more worthwhile, for college students, Amazon throws in the free shipping with Amazon Prime, which means that it gets delivered straight to your door, which is a HUGE time saver, because you don't need to drive out to the store and buy snacks. Plus, PORTION CONTROL! (of course, this requires resisting the temptation for second serving of snacks, which admittedly is hard to do so)My least favorite snack in the assortment is the animal crackers. They're just really dry and tasteless, almost like a cardboard substance. But I think they're are only six of them in the box, so it's not too bad.My absolute favorite snack has to be the fudge cookies. They are AMAZINGLY good. The fudge/chocolate melts in your mouth and the cookie is kind of buttery and melts along with the fudge/chocolate. It's really good. My only problem with the cookie is that they market it as a shortbread cookie, which it really isn't ... it's just a fudge cookie. Everyone knows that the Scots/Brits are the best at making shortbread cookie. Nonetheless, digression aside, the fudge cookies are awesome in their own right.Anyways, try one! The assortment isn't perfect, but if you're short on time, you won't regret it.

column9: Nice stroller treats (and carry around the house treats...)

My puppy loved these treats. They were just the right size for her. They have just enough rawhide to keep my puppy entertained and happy without having too much to be bad for her. They did not upset her stomach as some of the other reviewers have stated. I also gave them to my moms two dogs and they didn't have any stomach problems with them either. Every dog is different so what works for my puppy may not work for yours. Just try these treats and I hope your dogs is just as happy with them as mine was.

column9: look good but not for my picky dog

column9: My dogs don't like peanut butter much I guess...
column10: I wish my 3 dogs would have liked these more, but none of them really likes peanut butter, so these were just okay.  I wanted them to like them because they're good for them, but, although they ate them, they didn't treat them like anything special.  Usually if they get a treat they really like they run off with them, each to a separate area.  These, they took, and eventually ate, but they didn't hide them, or run off with them.  These are probably great for dogs that love peanut butter, but not one of my dogs does.If your dog likes peanut butter treats, I'd definitely give these a try, but I won't be buying these for my picky dogs.

I gave this chew to a labrador.  It was probably a little small for him as he was able to put the whole item into his mouth and choked on it once.  It took him approximately twenty minutes to consume the whole treat.The fun bites have a hard rawhide outside and a softer center.  I liked that it was not a messy product; there were only a few crumbs left behind.  It does not have a strong odor.Not sure about the "digestive support", the dog got the squirts later but he seems to have a sensitive stomach and that often happens when a new item is introduced into his diet.Update - 8/4/11 - The labrador mentioned was just diagnosed with a bad pancreas, so this product neither helped or hurt his issue. He is now on a special diet for his lifetime.
My dog really loves the FunBites MiniCongo Digestive support bones. She goes wild for the inside and will chew the outside after. Overall, I highly recommend as a safe dog snack.

These treats might be fine for larger dogs, but they were not good for my 13-pound miniature poodle.At first he wasn't really sure what to do with it, but he finally started chewing on it. The outer rawhide separated and the dark center came out. My dog abandoned the rawhide at that point and concentrated on the flavored "filling." The package says one per day for a dog of his size, but I should not have let him finish it. Although he didn't throw up the treat, he seemed to be a little "off" after eating it, as if he wasn't feeling very well.These are probably OK for a large dog, but I will not give another to my miniature poodle. And I would not feed even a large dog more than one a day, despite the package recommendation.
It took our dogs a little while to warm up to these, but they sure enjoy them now!  I haven't noticed any digestive difference, though.  They are a good size for our small dogs.

Generally when she eats grass she up chucks it, she hasn't since a few days after starting with these. Her breathe is also noticeably better. She is 10 years old and you can see that some of the crap off her teeth has come off since chewing these. I give her one a day.

column9: Keeps Your Pup Busy for a While
column10: I have a beagle mix who is about 6 months old so constantly chewing everything.  Most dog treats (even the solid rawhide pieces) don't last long enough and she ends up begging for more right away or moving on to my shoes.  The miniCongo chews are larger than I expected and quite a bit heftier.  I don't think she quite knew what to do with it the first time I gave her one.  She quickly figured it out, however, and spent well over an hour working on it.  She really seems to like the flavor of the filling.  Now, when she sees me reaching for one, she starts licking her lips in anticipation.I was really impressed with the quality of this product and the fact that it provides digestive support is a definite plus.  I will be buying this product again for my dog and would recommend it to anyone who has a medium to large breed of dog.  It's a bit too large for the smaller breeds.

column9: Murphy likes them just like the other FunBites...
column10: I gave the bigger version of these to my dog Murphy, and he seemed to love them. These arrive from Amazon pretty fast as usual, and I soon unleashed a few on the big guy. Chomp Chomp Chomp... he was chewing away... I read some other reviews where their dogs had issues with these bones. I checked on my dog a few hours later, and he was fine. Its hit or miss with these. I own a english lab btw.

If our dog could talk he would tell you how much he appreciate these leathery treats that taste of peanut butter and contain papain to assist in digesting the hide.  Whenever I give him one he takes possession of it eagerly and goes to work on it.  Usually he takes a break in the middle but then he'll go back and work on it some more.  On one occasion, he had a bone that he really shouldn't be chewing but he willingly surrendered the chop bone for one of these treats.

The pets seemed to enjoy these about as much as the FunBites Calcibone.  A product that they enjoy,while providing them with healthy digestive support?A good product for our pets (and yours, too)!May I suggest that you (and your pets) try them?I rate FunBites MiniCongo Digestive Support...4 stars!
My dogs: I have three. Jake is the Great Pyrennes,  Stormy and Pepper are min. schnauzers. the three of them love these chewies.  They chew them down to nothingness and love every moment of it.

column9: Not so mini! Pomeranian not impressed at all!
column10: I rarely give 1 star reviews, but how do you rate it higher if it does...nothing?First of all, I was a little surprised by how large these "mini-Congos" are.  We have an 8-pound Pomeranian and the only reason I chose these is because of the word, "mini".The "mini-Congo" is a full inch in roundness and about 3.5" long.  When you go to the pet store and buy "mini" treats, they are about the size of a matchbook or so.  This seriously looks like something for a medium-large sized dog.  I can only imagine a regular "congo" is enormous, heh.But all dogs love bones and they all love to chew on something, right?  Well our Pomeranian is not impressed.  He looked at it, licked it for a little bit and left it alone.We also give him these "dental sticks" and he hates them (well he doesn't devour them like he does a real treat).  He will lick them and put them away for awhile and if we don't give him any treats for a couple days, he'll go ahead and eat the dental stick.Well it's been over a week now and he won't go near the "mini-Congo" treat at all, in fact he'd rather go eat the "dental stick" he doesn't like.So it is confirmed, our dog simply does not like these, plus he can't even put his bite around it to begin with.  Caution - these are not so "mini" for your "mini" dog like our Pomeranian.Two paws down says Chocco.

These are dog treats. I have given them to my dog, and he enjoys them - he will lay down and chew and nibble until they are gone. However, he will do that with the ones I make here at home, too. I have not necessarily seen any "digestive support" effects, which is why I'm giving them 3 stars. For what they are (dog treats), they seem just fine - as specialty treats that are supposed to be helpful to dogs, they don't seem to be living up to the claim. Whether or not I would buy these would probably depend pretty much on price - they aren't worth paying a premium for the "digestive support" claim, but if they have a decent price as plain dog treats, then I can see purchasing them every so often to have around.Editing to Add: I make it a habit not to look at others' reviews before I type mine, so I wasn't aware of the issues with smaller dogs. My dog is a medium-size dog (Blue Heeler Mix), and he didn't appear to have any issues with chewing, swallowing or digesting. Knowing that others are having issues, I will probably not give my dog any more, just to be on the safe side - a massively expensive vet bill is not something I want to encourage! I will leave my 3-star review as it stands, since I did not personally experience any difficulties, but can say in all honesty that I will not purchase these in the future.

column9: All the dogs LOVED these treats
column10: I have two finicky dogs. They are particular about their snacks and food and while they will like something at first, they will not like it later on. Frustrating, but reality. So I gave two of these treats with my friends dogs to see their reaction as well.I have a schnauzer/poodle mix and a jack russell/chihuahua mix? I am sure about the schnauzer poodle and not totally sure about the jack russell/chihuahua as they are rescues. But they are about around 18 months old and 10-12 pounds; they both enjoyed the first rounds of treats TREMENDOUSLY. I mean, sat down and chewed on them for HOURS. Which is amazing because they are both such active dogs. Also, they did not have gas or digestion problems after eating, which was great.My friend gave the treats to her yorkie and bulldog and they loved them too. She said that it was the first time that her bulldog has growled, ever and he is three years old. They also did not have gas or digestion problems.Now, the real test - the other three treats for my dogs. Would they eat them or lose interest? They chewed them and loved them just as much as the first time. Okay, maybe not quite as much, because they lasted longer the second time, but still had the same great results.I would not give these  treats to my dogs on a regular basis, just because I don't believe in lots of treats. But on special occasions these are the treats I will be ordering. They loved them and their digestion did not change. I highly recommend these treats!

I have really finiky eaters but so far they have loved all these fun bites products. Usually they would just turn their nose up at dog treats but they chew and chew on these and it's good for their breath and teeth. They last quite a while too.

I can't really speak to the digestive support benefits of this product.  I'll assume it works, but only if you can force your dog to eat these.  My experience:I gave one each to my obese Jack Russell (Gizmo)and blind diabetic quasi-chihuahua (Bruiser).  These guys are true chow hounds and general treat fanatics.  Gizmo had to work hard to finally get his softened up and eaten.  (He has big, strong jaws).  Bruiser couldn't even scratch the surface on his.  He finally discarded it, and Gizmo (a treat thief) wasn't even intterested in it.  I put the treat back in the package unscathed.Plan B -  I introduced these to my daughter's two large and very hungry ex-racer greyhouds, Mosche and Canova.  Mosche (the bigger stronger of the two) examined his and abandoned it.  Canova struggled through his with little enthusiasm.After reading some of the other reviews describing digestive problems brought on by these, I'm not going to even take a chance.  The dogs don't like 'em anyway so into the trash with what's left.  Thumbs down on this one.

These are 4" in. long dog treats with a 'center' of chewy material. The outside coating is made of raw hide. They are not greasy to the touch and come in a resealable pouch. The dog enjoys tearing open the raw hide and eating the centers, but she does not go crazy over them like she does other dog treats. She generally leaves the raw hide behind after she has eaten the center which is a bit messy. I noticed the dogs stool getting very soft. Not sure if this is due to the the "digestive support" built into the product. I will report more later.

column9: Too big for small dogs...but my pup loved them
column10: Who doesn't love Peanut Butter?  My pup sure does.  She chewed and chewed on these "mini" congos.  She is generally pretty picky but definitely gives these 2 paws up.My only complaint would be the recommendations on the packaging.  They say they are for small dogs, once a day and there isn't much mini about them.  I took it away from her after awhile because I felt a whole one of these is just too much for a small to medium dog.  They are probably a good size for larger breeds.  You might want to pace your little one on these.  Unlike several comments on here, she did not experience any digestive problems but that might be because I didn't give her the whole thing at once.Overall, she liked them and I would recommend them.  Just use with caution.  Remember you are the best advocate for your pet.

FunBites MiniCongo's for digestive support are the perfect size treat for my 30lbs mutt, Tuna.  She went nuts over them, and think it is because of the peanut butter flavor.  She had quite a few hours of fun.Like other FunBite products they are a huge mess.  There are large chunks all over the place! Unlike other treats, Tuna did not go back to lick up her crumbs, she just abandoned them.  I though this was odd.  Also, I am not sure exactly how these are supposed to sooth digestion, but it seems to give Tuna diarrhea.She liked them, but it does not look like they liked her.
