column9: Sapporo Ichiban, the high end of low end cusine
column10: Sapporo Ichiban is my favorite brand of ramen to buy, the flavor packets are very flavorful and to me, the extra cost is negligible.When I cook them I boil the water, toss in some frozen broccoli and some precooked chicken chunks, toss in the noodles, let them cook for 6 minutes or so, toss in the flavor packet, and then once its all stirred up nice, crack and drop an egg onto the whole thing, letting it cook for a few more moments, pouring some of the broth on top of the egg, it makes for a very flavorful and satisfying meal.

These aren't bad noodles, but they're certainly not the greatest. In all honesty, they taste almost exactly like Maruchan's beef flavoured noodles, but a tad bit better. Unlike Shin noodles, it has a lot less sodium in it, for those who have heart trouble. It has roughly half the sodium that Shin has, (Shin having between 30-50% depending on the flavour you get).If you interested in trying some different kind of noodles for some reason or another, then I would recommend trying this.

I like the flavor of these--I wish sour cream and onion Chex Mix was more widely available at stores.  HOWEVER, please note that this is NOT Chex Mix.  There are only "Chex" in the bag; the bag contains no pretzels or other carbs.

I recently purchased a box of this candy at See's and all three of us noticed the dark chocolate was very good, but it lacked the molasses flavor. I was able to return it to the Northridge store for a refund, but found after the fact, that the box of half dark chocolate caramels and butterscotch squares had a sugary inner part as well. I and the other people believe See's is cutting corners in what they make.

these are not waterproof or durable. the boots get holes in them and the velcro strap comes apart. this is an overpriced cheap product. I bought these for a lot less and wanted to buy more because they do not last. When I saw the price for these I thought maybe it was a different product than the ones I had, but it is the same thing. They might last a month if you don't use them every day. I used mine to walk my dog in the snow and at least one got holes and fell apart within a couple of weeks.

column9: My new favorite but cheaper at the grocery store
column10: This is a really rich, dark coffee and lives up to the Starbucks name.  While I have used k cups for several years, it has been hard to find one that was bold enough.  I liked Emeril's Big Easy Bold for a while and still like Green Mountain's Espresso Blend but neither have the richness that this one from Starbucks has.  Right now though the Amazon price for 30 is 48.98!  For a pack of 16 it is $9.99 at my local grocery store and Bed, Bath and Beyond carries them for $14.99 but you can use their $5 off or the 20% off coupons which are everywhere.  So until the price here drops some, I will pick it up at my local store.

Yes, it's expensive, but it's really the best Sumatran k-cup.BTW, so you know where my preferences lay, the k-cups I prefer are the Starbucks Verona, Sumatra, and Pikes Place, along with Van Houtte's Mexican Dark Roast, and Tomothy's Columbian LaVareda (NOT the Dorado).

column9: Gives Cafe Verona a run for the money!
column10: I have been buying the Starbucks Cafe Verona K-cups at Costco since they came out.  I love them.  I would give them 7 stars if I could.  I found these Sumatra K-cups at Amazon Warehouse and got them for an average of $.65/cup, which I think is fair.  I had never tried the Sumatra, but glad I did because they are very good.  Very bold, very smooth, not so bold it tastes like you're drinking from an ashtray.  Amazing how Starbucks gets their K-cups to taste pretty dang close to the real thing.

column9: GREAT TASTE, NOT SO GREAT PRICE
column10: Cheaper at Target. $14.99 for an 18 count. I thought for sure it would be cheaper online, but I was wrong.

I love dark roast coffee, served with or without cream/sugar, and this Sumatran k-cup is most assuredly a dark roast, but I found the flavor and aroma of this product to register as slightly bitter/burnt.  It did not overwhelm my senses, and it was easily alleviated and made better with the use of creamer, but it still wasn't my favorite of the K-Cups that are available.  I thought it was "okay".My husband didn't enjoy the Starbucks version of Sumatra, stating that he felt it had a somewhat chemical-like aftertaste even with cream and sugar.  We used over half of the box, to make sure that our opinion wasn't perhaps based on a faulty serving or two, but ended up giving the remainder to our neighbors; unfortunately, this Sumatra just didn't work for us.

This is the best K-cup coffee I have found yet.  The Pike Place is a close second, but the Sumatra holds up well to a larger cup (either the mug or large mug size).  If you're using a travel mug, stick with the dark roasts.  Wish it came in decaf - I love my Keurig, but I can handle only so much caffeine!Also, I have found the Starbucks K-cups disassemble easily (more so than some of the other brands), the foil removes very cleanly, you can compost the grounds and paper filter, and recycle the plastic.

column9: Bold, and full of flavor, good flavor
column10: My husband loves the Starbucks Sumatra K-Cup. Of all the samples of bold coffee for the Keurig he has tried, this is by far his favorite. It has just the right amount of flavor and strength for his taste.

I prefer grinding my own coffee and using my Aeropress to the K-Cup for single serving brews. When I heard Starbucks was coming out with a K-Cup I was genuinely excited! For two years I've dealt with weak "dark" roasts. Iced coffees with a K-Cup are a joke. While nothing will come close to espresso out of a Keurig (I recommend the Mypressi Twist V2 if you are on a budget), the Sumatra Dark from Starbucks is the best K-Cup yet. It is smooth, dark and even brewed with crema. This is not acidic like many of the South American blend K-Cups. It is slightly more expensive, but it has made me start using my Keurig again. I would have given it 5 stars, but one cup of the 5 I've made so far came out a touch weak.Do yourself a favor if you shelled out the cash on a Keurig. Get the Sumatra!!!

So far, I've only tried this one and Pike's Place (see my review for that here) and I have to say the Sumatra is superior to Pike's Place, with a satisfyingly rich, bold flavor. In the coming days I'll try their House Blend and French Roast to compare and post quick reviews on them as well.

column9: Excellent K cups if you get it at a good price
column10: Im not a huge fan of starbucks pike place but I like some random starbucks coffees so I decided to try this K cup.Pros:-Tastes good, bold and darker but not too bitter-Dark but not over roasted-I got it on sale (BOGO in starbucks store: ~$.50 a cup)Cons:-Pretty expensive online and in the grocery storeOverall I like it, but would wait for it to go on sale again

This product arrived with several of the items damaged in shipping.  The coffee was very good with robust flavor and slightly acidic.  Because of the poor condition of the coffee when it arrived, not all the cups were usable. I found this coffee was best suited for  morning.

Came quickly (a couple of days), and is exactly what it's supposed to be - Starbucks Sumatra. We started using a K-cup machine in our office and, being a self-proclaimed coffee snob, I wasn't so sure I would like it. These Sumatra K-cups aren't QUITE the same as my French press or even what  you get when you go to Starbucks. But, it's good coffee, cheaper than Starbucks or even the grocery store, and came right away. I'll be ordering again soon.
This is by far the best deal on Starbucks k-cups. Enjoy the wondeferful taste of good coffee at home at an affordable price!
Starbuck's Sumatra is the best and most flavorable coffee. Pleasecontinue to sell it this way not just individual boxes.I have triedmany others but haven't enjoyed the flavor like this one.

I love my Starbucks Sumatra first thing in the morning.  I was not always up early enough to take the detour to Starbucks and now I don't have to!  These KCups are perfect and delicious. Now I can have my fav coffee even before I take off my slippers!  I love this product!  It's easy to order - arrived quickly and the price was good.
If you like a dark bold flavor this is the one for you.  Starbucks Sumatra coffee is a deep rich flavor that bold coffee drinkers will love.

If you're like me and like to try out every single K-Cup that comes out, you know a few things about them:1. If they don't say "Extra Bold," they're terrible2. The coffee always looks and feels a little "flat."3. It's easier than drip, but never betterThis Starbucks Sumatra K-cup, though, rocks. You see it right away as the coffee comes out with a nice foamy top. Then it tastes great, with or without milk. It doesn't quite taste like a "freshly" brewed Sumatra, but it's as close to real coffee as the K-cup gets.
My fav is french roast but got this flavor is a friends fav, I mix with the semi sweet chocolate syrup and poor over ice then add up to 1 cup of milk for an iced mocha...... delicious!!

column9: I don't always drink coffee, but when I do it is sumatra
column10: I'm a big tea drinker - but this coffee is some of the best I've had. I make mine over ice and I love it.

When this coffee brew is described as dark, it is definitely not kidding. One 8 oz portion of this strong, rich coffee is enough to replace my usual two large cups of other brews. I am generally a black coffee kind of girl, but I find that I enjoy this more if it is tempered with a little bit of skim milk.
As usual, Starbucks doesn't disappoint...however the price could keep me from buying it again.  At $.50/serving less Green Mountain's "Dark Magic" does the trick on my budget...Cheers!

column9: Moldy and rancid brew (evaluated over a year's time)
column10: I often find the Starbucks K cups yield a moldy and rancid tasting brew. We have tried an assortment of Starbucks K cups flavors obtained at numerous outlets over the last year. It feels like this is a secondary (or even tertiary) market for Starbucks beans that don't make the grade. Or possibly Starbucks has production/storage/transportation issues when bringing the Starbucks K cups to market. It is a ding to the brand. Luckily, I am a devout Starbucks follower, so I will stick to their more proven bags of beans and grinds.
Decent coffee.  Ridiculously overpriced.  Starbucks should be ashamed for charging a buck and a half for a cup of coffee made at home.
Reminds me of being a little kid again back east.  Brings enjoyment and fond childhood memories.  Tastykake definitely one of the best out there.
My grandson made a lot of new little friends with these!  He loved them, and his friends loved them as well!!  I was tickled to see him so happy to get these addressed to him at his home!

this is a great tasting snack, full of things that are healthy.  A little pricey, obviously, but no more expensive than a pint of ice cream.Iherb is one of the best online merchants around, as well.  Order with confidence--reliably quick shipping, great prices & selection.

Taste matters A LOT if that's all you'll be having until lunch.  This tastes terrific.A single packet, 3/4 cup of milk, and 3 ice cubes whirled in a blender or Magic Bullet and you have got yourself a tasty breakfast.Great for on-the-go mornings.

It mixes easily with water or milk.  No blender required, though blending does make it frothy.It's a great emergency-preparedness item to have on hand.Tastes good, and even better if for some reason you haven't eaten and are famished.  If you have any insulin resistance going on, you will crash because of the high sugar content.  This is not great nutrition as with some of the protein powders, but with milk it suffices nicely.This is not a breakfast "food" per se, in my opinion.  It's a snack to tide you over, not a substitute for a meal.  Sending a kid off to school after only a serving of this would be unconscionable.It's more akin to a chocolate shake.  Makes a nice treat, or dessert beverage.It is what it is, and it excels at that.  No need to make it more than it is.

I am a pediatrician and use this product in chocolate and strawberry as a dietary supplement for my very picky 2yo eater. She enjoys the flavors and even asks for "coco milk and berry milk." Would highly recommend for anyone who needs to supplement calories and fill in holes in a diet.
I like to make shakes for my kids using this or the strawberry flavor.  It has some vitamins in it and the kids really love the taste.

column9: Been using CIB for many years
column10: Started having this as a breakfast drink years ago. Keeps me going all morning. In the beginning, I used to just mix it with milk, but it just didn't keep me satisfied all that long. Slight variation in preparation was a quick remedy. Now, I mix 1/3 cup yogurt, 2/3 cup reduced fat milk, a banana (or other fruit), and a cup of ice in the blender. Makes a nice thick frothy drink.

I started drinking this when I was pregnant & nothing sounded good to me but it has since become a staple in my morning routine.  I drink one on the way to work & typically don't feel hungry for a number of hours.  I make this very quickly with milk & ice only stirring with a spoon & it is plenty smooth prepared that way.  I would highly recommend this!
I don't eat right at all I am very picky and I use these to supplement my diet. Great source of vitamins. for on the go. I actually drink one for breakfast and one before bed. I buy at sams in bulk

These edible pearls were exactly the right size and just what I needed for a wedding cake I was making!  They sure saved me a lot of time and money, that's for sure.  I just wish that I would have KNOWN what size they were when I ordered them.  I took a chance on them and they were perfect!  Awesome...thank you, thank you!  Speedy shipping, too!

If you like melon and gummies, you will love Kasugai's Melon Gummy.  Melon is my favorite of all of Kasugai's gummies.  Because they're small it's easy to overdo it.  I found my self throwing a handful into my handbag thinking they'd last a few days.  They lasted a few minutes.  I know I am ashamed of myself. ;) They're not too sweet.  The gummy is fruity and very very tasty.  I find them easily in stores and not just Asian markets.  They are overpriced here in my opinion.

I purchased this product because I was experiencing edema/swelling in my feet, ankles, and hands. After drinking just the initial 3 cups (as directed on the package), all 3 parts of my body went back to normal! I was so overjoyed and was starting  to think that nothing short of a prescription would help me. Thank God for this product!

I have been using Weightless Tes for a couple of years now and along with some other healthy choices it totally aids in digestion and keeking your system clear. I helps to flush it so you can keep your weight down as well. It tastes delicious.

column9: If you really want "weightless", Don't try this
column10: Waste of money.If you like to have cranbery tea, it is good product. For weight loss? please don't buy it. I have used for months but gain weight about 20lb by far. Of course weight loss is associated with many different factors but it NEVER decreases your appetite, burns fat, nor increases metabolism. I did exercise at least 30 minutes twice a week and have moderate levels of physical laber - but never worked!! Maybe it is just me but you'd better try some other products.
Usually a box of 5 bars is $5 to $6.  So a 4-pack at $22.16 seemed to be right.  Well I just paid $22.16 for 4 bars.  If I could leave no stars, I would.
Beefeater went for profit over the health of our pets. Sad! Gimborn (Pro Treats) are still made in the USA.

column9: Great treat for your special pet
column10: I only gave 4 stars because each can has some damp and soft pieces. The majority of the treats are loved by my dogs.
The fortune cookies arrived in perfect condition and are what you would expect from a fortune cookie at a restaurant.
While we originally thought these could be stale .... They came tasting fresh! Made everyone at work happy.Thank You

column9: One of the best beef sticks on the market
column10: I grabbed one of these on a whim while shopping at Northern Tool.  I was in need of a low calorie, high protein snack and this fit the bill.  Little did I know that it was going to taste so great.  The flavor is so incredible.  There is a hint of sweet and and hint of spice to give it a bit of a kick.  The fact that I can enjoy it as an occasional snack without it wrecking my daily calorie intake, absolutely puts this one over the top.Highly recommended!

This cookie is very good. I eat as many as I dare, but my primary use is a a substitute for graham crackers when making 'crumb' pie shells for ice box pies and cheese cakes. They work wonderfully and provide an alternative flavor.  Also great as a substitute cookie for making that Southern favorite, banana pudding.

column9: I've Given My Heart To These Pepperidge Farm Cookies !!!
column10: Pepperidge Farm has a long history of making premium quality cookies; and these "Chessmen" butter cookies are certainly no exception. They contain no artificial flavors, no preservatives and they are crunchy but oh, so wonderfully smooth as you roll them around in your mouth before you swallow them. Awesome!Another reviewer notes that they are aesthetically pleasing; and that reviewer is correct. The cookies have four chessmen on them--you get the rook, the bishop, the queen and the knight--this enhances the appeal of the product. Yes, chess players will love that; but just about anyone who enjoys a good cookie can appreciate these butter cookies. Even if butter cookies aren't your personal favorite, you will fall for these ones--they're THAT good!The cookies are kosher, if that matters to you; and they are certainly designed tastefully enough that you can serve them as snacks for any company you may have visiting you. One caveat, however--these cookies do contain sugar and some fat; and the sugar could convert to extra fat in your body if you are not too active. If sugar and/or fat content pose dietary concerns for you then I would ask a doctor before eating these cookies.Overall, obviously, these cookies are just about the best and they will remain some of the best because of the classic Pepperidge Farm high level of quality control. Buy a bag or two and enjoy some tonight!  SMILES

We were out grocery shopping the other day and, for some reason, the Chessmen cookies called out to me. Usually, I'm not a fan of crunchy cookies, even if they ARE from the delectable Pepperidge Farm bakery.But I decided to try these buttery treats and let me tell you...I am not disappointed! (In fact, I'm munching on them right now.) They are so buttery--so melt in your mouth--they'd be *perfect* with coffee, tea, or hot chocolate--but I tend to snatch them when I need a snack because I haven't eaten all day. (I know...bad habit!)And, this may sound corny, they are beautiful to look at! Not only do these cookies have a raised chess emblem on the front, but they are also washed with eggwhites. (I can tell because of the glistening, golden color!)Rook, Bishop, Queen and Knight--they're all here in buttery brilliance!So if you're in the mood for a fantastic butter cookie, you will LOVE Chessmen from Pepperidge Farm. (And if your favorite soldier or student loves chess--and cookies--this would make a great addition to any care package!)

column9: None broken in my packages...rate product, not packaging anyway...VERY SWEET COOKIE.
column10: Very sugary, a sugar cookie is more descriptive...very good for a sugar cookie though, guess I was expecting a buttery shortbread...a bit disappointed.All Pepperidge Farm cookies have great eye appeal, but they are run by big business.They hop theirs up with too much grainy sugar...just tried the milk chocolate chips kind too...not at all like homemade, because of the grainy, overly sugary taste.
This was a replacement order and they were broken. I mentioned to customer service that they should be bubble or something

A refreshing blend of green, white, and herbal teas.  Low caffeine.  I love the idea of white tea but find it incredibly bland.  Mixing it up with herbs, rooibos, and jasmine green tea makes it wonderful.  Can steep the same cup about four times.  Very high quality and incredibly tasty.  I like it plain or sweetened with steevia or honey.

column9: flowers delivered looked NOTHING like this!!!
column10: I ordered this bouquet to be delivered to my daughter for opening night of a show. I specifically ordered a gerbera daisy bouquet that featured ALL daisies and no other flowers because these are my daughter's favorite flower.  The bouquet she received had ONE gerbera daisy in a bouquet of some other type of flower that resembled daisies. While she appreciated the flowers the bouquet she received was definitely NOT what I ordered.  very disappointed!!!

This is a beautiful, abondant bouquet and is well worth the price. I placed the order late, and hoped that, by opting for the 1-3 day shipping, it would arrive in time. In fact, despite it being one of the busiest times of years for florists (Mother's Day), the bouquet was shipped out expediently and arrived at destination the very next morning. A great deal of care was taken in the packing and packaging of the flowers; they arrived fresh and beautiful. I might add that Falcon Farms has above-and-beyond customer service, one should not hesitate to contact them in case of concern.
These are our favorite Martini onions. Our local shop could not get them in stock any longer.  We were elated to find on Amazon.

column9: The only cocktail onions I'll buy!
column10: The first jar of Sable ad Rosenfeld Tipsy Onions that I purchased was actually a fluke.  My local grocery store was out of the standard cheap ones, and I bought begrudgingly bought these.  Well, I haven't gone back! These onions are perfect!  They have a nice size, and a nice sweet flavor with just the right amount of tang and zip to them.  They're so good that I could eat them plain out of the jar!  (I rarely do, however...  Instead, they go in my Bombay Sapphire gibson-martinis.)

I have recently discovered dirty martinis. My brother in law is the culprit of leading me astray while away on a cruise. I was later up in Upstate NY and purchased some onions to go along with my latest vice when I noticed they were not salty but very tasty! I am a person who loves sweet things espcially if they are pickled. These were the perfect match for me. Since then, my wife and I have been trying to lose weight. Yes, we are watching our fat intake but have discovered it is the salt added to everything that is killing us all. Look at a regular pearl onion and how much salt is in them, it will blow you away. Oh, and the olives, too. Compare that to these new Tipsy Onions and you'll do what I am doing....One Olive and three Tipsys make a wonderful Martini!!!

column9: Good onions, but sweeter than I expected.
column10: These onions are nice, large and crispy - however they are sweeter than I anticipated.  Personally, I prefer a more savory onion for maritinis. I am by no means disappointed with them. They are very flavorful and I love that they are large.  If you prefer a cocktail onion a little on the sweet side these are a fantastic purchase. All of the onions I received were white - no browning at all and packaged very well.

The ordered arrived packed well, but that was as far as it went. The color of the vermouth was brownish and the onions were clearly past their useful date. I wouldn't order from these again at any price. Buyer beware.

These delightfully tasting onions is what makes the difference in a vodka gibson.I used to have regular onions in my gibsons and they were ok, but having a bartender make me one with these onions showed me the difference an onion can make. Glad that I walked into that bar.....
The taste of the onions in this first jar is not up to the standards I've come to expect with my many jars that I have purchased through the years.

I purchased these very large cans of chili because they were priced ridiculously cheaply at the time. I planned to split the cans up into smaller portions and freeze the smaller portions to make a large number of meals. The first can I opened looked a little different from other Hormel chili I have had in the past. The beans were all mashed up and there were large chunks of cubed meat in the chili. Normally the meat resembles little pieces of ground meat. These were weird unappetizing chunks. The chili had no chili taste. It tasted like slightly burned re-fried beans. The night after eating this and the next day, there were numerous trips to the bathroom. Won't give details - but it wasn't pleasant.A few days later, I opened a second can hoping the first was just a one time thing. The second had the same mashed up beans and meat chunks. I tossed it and now have four large cans of chili that I will never use.Maybe this was just a bad batch. It almost seems as if they scraped the old chili residue off of their pots, threw in some leftover meat chunks, canned it and sent it to me. Needless to say, I will never purchase this product again.

column9: Hard to believe a teabag can make sencha this good
column10: I was given two bags of this sencha over the last two years, and have absolutely loved it. It tastes MUCH better than any of the other bagged "green tea" varieties that I've tried so far. It has a nice, robust grassy flavor.I also noticed that the tea is actually GREEN when brewed whereas most other green tea brands are a pale yellow/brown color. These are not my favorite green teas but they are alot better then the other brands.I accually was getting samples of these when I bought from truerenu.com and spotted these out at a chinese market.Decent price, good for when company are over.

I have a very old cat that is frail and having a hard time eating.  The vets office gave me the okay to give her some the KMR Liquid Milk.  My cat loves it and her hair is very soft and silky now.  She has also gained back some of the weight she lost since using this product.  My cat is happier and so am I.

column9: My cats don't like it and my Vet doesn't recommend it
column10: My cat was sick and not eating well so I bought this on advice of a coworker after my cat had gotten a force feeding and meds from the Vet. She wouldn't touch it! I was surprised because both my cats like to lick the milk out of my cereal bowl when I am done. I asked my Vet what the major difference was between cat milk and people  milk, she said they are basically the same but cats milk has taurine added to it, a nutrient that cats need more of. The vet recommended to give the cat regular milk and a taurine supplement if she would eat that. Luckily, after second force feeding she started eating again so I didn't need to go that route. My Vet said that cat milk is way over priced for what you get,

A great product as always from KMR. This is premixed liquid in pop-top cans, so there is no fussing with dry powder.  If you have a big batch of kittens that need this milk replacer this is the way to go.  Yes, it's a bit pricey but worth every cent. As always, this is also great stuff for sick or elderly cats--or nursing queens!--that need extra nutrition.
Great product my persian cat loves it.  but if I give her to much she farts all over the house.

column9: My kitten grew up strong and healthy
column10: When I learned from the vet that the kitten I brought home was only five weeks old (not eight as I'd been told), I bought this formula for him.He is now a year old, strong, frisky, and healthy.  I had no problem getting him to drink it--apparently he loved the taste.

column9: PetAg KMR Beats Any Others Paws Down
column10: PetAg's KMR, (kitten milk replacement,) is, in my experience, the most highly recommended and best-tolerated formula for newborn and young kittens available on the market.  I personally prefer the liquid, as the powder can be difficult to dissolve properly, though it is more economical and easier to make in the amounts you need at any given time.  In my experience, kittens take to it well and don't suffer as many digestive issues as with some other brands.  I recommend a specially-designed formula such as Just-Born with colostrum for the first 2-3 days for kittens who are exclusively bottle-fed from birth, as the colostrum helps establish a newborn's immune system, which most formulas don't, but after the first few days, colostrum is merely broken down in the digestive tract and gives no added protection, so then it's time for KMR.  Follow feeding directions carefully and watch your little ones thrive on this superior formula!  It's never let us down.

I was very happy to find these. I always looked for sassafras flavor candy as a kid, and these are just like them.  It was my favorite flavor of candy. Although the flavor is reminiscent of root beer, sassafras is not sweet like it but a touch bitter, which explains why I found root beer candy too sweet. Not a flavor for everyone, but anyone who likes spice flavors might like them.As for the packaging, there was almost no breakage of the candy, which was impressive, as candy sticks tend to be very fragile.
Delicious, just the right temperature- makes for a much more interesting and tasty martini! Adds zesty flavor to my favorite vodka, and the vodka adds something to the olive as well.
These offer a nice kick that doesn't last too long. My husband and I both love them. They are perfect for when you're craving a quick rush of heat,  (great for after shots too).
The chili pepper spices up this olive nicely. On a "hot scale" of 1 to 10 this pepper stuffed olive is probably a 6 in hotness. Good product.

My husband just loves Reese's Hot Deviled Chili Pepper Stuffed Olives.  He chops the olives up and puts them on every meal. The ease of having the olives shipped right to our home every other month with the automatic shipment is great.

These are the best olives on the market period. Better than any fancy italian brands I've tried in the past. I am addicted to these.Great with alcohol or without. Warning!They are red hot, but the flavor is delicious. A must try for any olive lover!

I tried this tea at a tea room recently, and it was absolutely divine. The tea had a nice balance between sweet and spicy; almost like a chai tea, but even better. My friend, who doesn't like tea, tried it and absolutely loved it. Definitely a great tea.

Most people love peanuts. But, few brands provide quality, natural flavor, roasted just right peanuts. Feridies unsalted Virginia peanuts do. . All natural, no salt and roasted to achieve a great crunchy taste. I will buy more!

column9: Best tasting, non-waxy PURE vegetarian broth on the market
column10: Herb Ox Vegetarian Broth is non waxy (unlike KORR), and is a true vegetarian broth, though becoming increasingly difficult to find in local supermarkets. Have been using this particular broth for over thirty years and I still love its taste and consistency. If you're a vegan or vegetarian, this is a marvelous broth which would compliment any dish, or as a good stand alone. Great for when you are sick also.
Excellent! I use it in soups, mashed potatoes, lentils, beans, etc.  It makes everything taste so good and it provides just the right amount of salt.  I don't have to add anything else.

I'm not vegetarian, so I use them interchangably.Having said that, though, it tastes fabulous, even compared to beef boullion. column9: excellent alternative to the Chicken bouillon.
column10: excellent alternative to the Herb-ox Chicken bouillon cubes, for those who want avoid beef or chicken. We use this one a little less often than the Chicken, but still regularly,and it never lets us down.

So delicious that even though I really don't need an entire case of the stuff, I'm going to pop for one unless I can find it by the jar again.Seriously *yum*. I'd been using other brands of vegetable broth for years when I unexpectedly ran out right in the middle of a batch of soup and had to scramble around in the back of the cupboard, only to come up with a truly ancient jar of Herb-ox Vegetable Bouillon Cubes. What the heck, no guts no glory, so I added one, and after tasting, another, and was instantly head over heels. Best soup I ever had.It's true that the ingredient list contains some questionable items such as salt, soy, whey, partially hydrogenated vegetable oil, and some close cousins to MSG, so if you're a strict vegan or sensitive to microscopic amounts (we're talking two small cubes to six cups of soup) to things that haven't actually been proven to adversely affect your health, run as fast as you can! Me? After looking more closely at the ingredient lists on the other vegetable broths I've tried, this one was little worse than the others and tasted lots better.And who knows? Maybe the extra couple hundred cubes that I couldn't possibly use up in a lifetime will make a great craft project one day. I do have a glue gun, after all. Meanwhile, I'll be enjoying the great taste that this product lends to my own version of vegetable soup.

I had to throw the whole case out.I'm not unusually sensitive, but they are so high in hydrolyzed vegetable protein (the ingredient-list euphemism for MSG) that even a small amount used as seasoning was enough to set off a major 24-hour case of "Chinese Restaurant Syndrome." Not worth the risk.

I think this creates a weird situation where you have a bad product of high quality. I'm a supertaster, so I will describe the product as best as I can. It has your typical oolong bass notes, but the higher notes are very grassy (sometimes oolong is sweet, bitter...etc etc etc, this is grassy). It has a fair balance between bitterness and boldness. Incase you aren't gathering what I'm trying to say... it's a very neutral flavor and doesn't really 'wow' me at all. The grassy flavor taste exactly like wheaties cereal (no frosted).... and that sounds stupid but when you try it you'll instantly make the connection.So, in conclusion it's a plain tea that I won't really hold up high on my tea shrines, but it does have one last unique quality. It taste odd, but I can't stop drinking it. It's like raman noodles... you never say "man I can sure go for some raman", but when you are actually eating raman you make sure you eat every last noodle. It's like that.12/10/11 EDIT: After drinking a few of these, I can say that it's a great tea to drink without anything added. I normally add sugar to most of my teas in some way or another (honey, sugar, guava), but I find that this tea is actually really good without anything added. I'm not going to officially change my 3 star rating, but I am tempted to bump it up to 4 stars.

However, after buying another I have to say I think this tastes pretty good a bit sweet, but I will get into that later.Those saying it tastes like diluted Coconut Water, well obviously if you would actually read the bottle it contains: 10% Coconut Water...  Not only that, it's concentrated and guess what it's printed right on the bottle!  No way you say?  Yes way, read folks your concept and debate went out the window comparing it to 100% REAL coconut water.----------PROS:*Contains Sodium, Potassium and Sea Salt all three are a huge plus ^_^.  These 3 act as electrolytes which we all know by now, help you stay hydrated!  Even drinking a ton of water throughout the day I still feel a bit dehydrated.  After drinking 1 bottle of this I feel satisfied battling dehydration to nothing!*Introduces you to Coconut Water! (I myself am one of those people who likes to get the real thing after experiencing a diluted form of said beverage or food.)CONS:*It is sweet, it has about 5 Tablespoons of Sugar and Stevia Extract making the flavor come out more than usual.  Unfortunately I have to ding a star for this as well, it does taste sweet as people have already stated and I feel they could minimize the sweetness if they lowered the amount of overall sugar.  Stevia is 300 times sweeter than sugar, so really the use of sugar should be pretty low.----------To sum it all up, if you want something that tastes of coconut and keeps you hydrated go for this.  In my opinion it tastes good!

column10: This tastes like artificial coconut flavor, like you would get in a pina colada mix or coconut candy. Real coconut is very mild and subtle and does not taste like this. The rest is water, sugar, stevia, and some other ingredients like potassium chloride and gum arabic. To be fair, it says it's "with" coconut water but I think they decided they could cut cost by adding artificial flavors.  Save your money and go to your local asian supermarket and under a $1 a pop, you can find a brand that suites your dietary needs and taste buds.

column9: fine for the first week until you find the best premium dog food...
column10: Out of all the commercial grade dog foods, this one is a higher quality, but do not let that fool you. First, the ingredients are listed by weight, not by content so there is not as much chicken in the product as you might think. To make matters worse, there is only chicken and chicken meal in this product for protein. Soy meal is only a filler for dogs so they get no nutritional value out of it. If there were more meats and less fillers I would be more pleased with this product. I have a beagle puppy who chows this product down, however, this really means nothing. Just because your dog eats it doesn't make it good for them. Make sure the first few ingredients are meat, and the product has little to no grain (rice, oats, barley are GOOD; corn, wheat, soy, etc are NOT).

I make a fresh prepared mustard using Frontier Mustard Seed (brown, which I grind coarsely and ground yellow.). Frontier mustard is of consistent quality and flavor; I'm proud to use it in my product and gladly award 5 stars.

I don't like tea. I never have, but I've always WANTED to like it. I mean... it smells delicious, it's good for you and it's something a lot of my friends love. I've just never liked it.My husband and I recently switched to as much organic as possible and he started drinking these teas. He begged me to try this and wow! It's the best tea I've ever tasted! I swear I can taste the peach fuzz. It's so light and refreshing! I drink slowly, so one lasts me all day at work because of the generous 16oz can. I don't even miss soda.I buy these at Kroger for $1 a can. I wish I could find a place to buy a case at an even better price. I'd buy a freaking pallet of them and bathe in this stuff.

column9: Love Steaz, however, last order from Amazon was bad tasting!
column10: As the title states, I love Steaz green tea (esp. the Peach flavor), however, the last time Amazon sent me my order (from their Subscribe & Save program), the tea had a very bad aftertaste to it. It was metallic tasting and very bitter. It wasn't expired, so I'm not sure what was the problem. I couldn't return the item (since I guess you can't return food and beverages, even if it's defective), so I ended up throwing it all away. It made me mad because I wasted money. Just an FYI - I have had several similar issues with other food items from Amazon, so I'd be careful to order food and beverages from Amazon. I guess the items stay in their warehouses for long periods or something because I've gotten melted gummy bears, stale crackers, and more bad tasting tea (Celestial Seasonings). I am now very cautious and hesitant to order food and beverages from Amazon.

My local super markets just jacked up the price of a can to $1.89 making the amazon deal so worth it. I've been wanting to buy cases of this stuff since I drink it enough.Anyway on to the tea, this is Tea that actually has a TEA taste to it, not a sugar water taste. I don't understand how adding more sugar to a drink makes it cheaper... it's suspicious and probably evident of either one group is either ripping us off, or the other group is masking low grade products with 56 Grams of sugar. It's probably both or that not enough volume is sold of these products making it a higher price. I drink my tea two ways unsweetened with lemon, or lightly sweetened (not with artificial sweeteners) with a fruit flavor and steaz covers both those desires. Theres a few alternatives, but their peach is definitely the best tasting of the lightly sweetened variety I've ever had.You guys gotta market your self better, I need to see cases of these things at local stores so I can buy them bulk. buying individual cans is making me broke.
I love Steaz!  Tea is so good for your but it is hard to find a brand that does not contain 40g of sugar.  This product is much lower in sugar and much better for you than soda.

I drink Steaz b/ I have been trying to lose weight recently. I gained 20 lb in my first year of law school and am slowly losing due to a changed diet with no candy or soft drinks. I wish I could drink only water but drinking a beverage without any particular flavor makes me feel thirstier and I am never satisfied until I drink something sugary. I like Hint water at 0 calories and 0 sugar per bottle but they are pretty expensive for my student income. That's why I drink Steaz instead.My local whole foods sells steez for $1 a bottle but I have to take the time away from my studies to go there and carry them back. The slight premium for buying it here is worth it. As my review title mentions, there are only 10g sugar per serving. (that's less sugar than an 8 oz glass of milk!)  I end up only consuming 20 g of sugar in 16 oz of beverage. So far, I've lost 5 lb cutting high calorie snacks and drinks from my diet. I definitely credit steez and similar beverages as contributors to my weight loss. Steaz's flavor is subtle but delicious. I like it despite my crazy sweet tooth. I really only like their peach tea though. It's a healthy and tasty alternative to juice.

When I saw that amazon had was having a special price on this tea, I had to try it. This tea is very flavorful, but it is not sickly sweet, and doesn't taste artificial. I'm still looking for some great unsweetened tea, but this is perfect when I want something just a little sweet!

column9: Like the peach, but the cans have had raspberry tea in them!
column10: We love Steaz green tea with peach at our house. So much so that we had three orders per month sent to our home. But our last three orders--while labeled as peach tea--actually contain raspberry tea! Amazon generously refunded us our money as they do not accept returns on food. We have tried to buy the peach tea at two local grocery stores and have had the same experience--raspberry tea in peach cans.I give the peach tea five stars, but zero star for raspberry tea in peach tea cans.I have contacted Steaz about this issue, but have not heard from them . . . .So beware!

column9: One of my favorite tea brands!
column10: I really like this tea a lot! I usually go to Kroger since they are the only ones that carry this tea product. My favorite flavor is the peach mango. It has a light peachy taste with just a touch of sweetness and is refreshing.

column9: Quality Control is non-existing with this brand
column10: I love the Peach Flavor .... but every-other can rates different. I tried different flavors with the same result.It does taste great when they get it right.

This tea has a full flavor with out the HFCS  ( high frutose Corn syrup )  and is rich with antioxidant's  your body needs to fight off  colds and strengthen your immune system .  This tea has a punch of peach and does not  over power any of your foods .

column9: Absolutely delicious, low calorie and organic...
column10: The Steaz line of iced teas are all absolutely delicious and thankfully not loaded with insane amounts of sugar and calories. This flavor in particular had a great hint of peach to it and I could gulp down a case of these a day if I really wanted to.In stores these should be about a dollar each, so as of this review date, Amazon's pricing is significantly higher, but then they are also shipping cases of ice tea for you for free. Enjoy locally until Amazon's pricing comes down again.

column9: I really like Steaz, and this flavor in particular.
column10: I'm a chef at a hospital, and we purchase these for the doctors there. I of course sample a few myself. The subscription price here on Amazon is the same as our preferred vendor price there, which makes it a great deal, and far cheaper than buying these at Whole Paycheck (i mean Foods).As far as the drink itself, the peach flavor is fairly pronounced, but not overwhelming. It is also not crazy sweet. It has some sweetness, but not nearly as much as beverages such as Arizona or Xing Teas, for example. Add to that the organic ingredients and an eye towards healthy consumption, and this drink is a definite winner. I enjoy it immensely.
This is my favorite lower calorie drink.  It is healthy, refreshing, and I don't feel guilty drinking it because of too much sugar.

I found Steaz in my local co-op and I've tried all of the sweetened flavors and peach is my absolute favorite.  I'm trying to cut out soda, and this is the perfect replacement.  I think the peach flavor is the sweetest-tasting of them all, though it's still very lightly sweetened at 20g of sugar for a 16oz container -- an equivalent amount of Coke would be 55g of sugar.  And, it's naturally sweetened with organic evaporated cane juice and not high fructose corn syrup.  A very good choice!

I finally kicked my addiction to soda three months ago, but still want to enjoy beverages with flavor.  I love that it has just a tiny bit of sugar (and calories), but it has boatloads of antioxidants!  I've only tried the Peach so far, but I really like it.  It's a bit hard to find in most chain grocery stores, so I appreciate that I can get it through "subscribe and save".

Packaging was a bubble envelope with 2 clear flimsy plastic bags with the top twisted and knotted. Reminded me of a heavy ounce of weed you scored on the corner. Trying to say packaging was like amateur home made quality. I never bought coral calcium before and had no idea what to expect. It leaves you wondering just what this stuff really is.  I did hope for some directions (but no) as to dosage or tips to use, as the taste of this stuff is really strong and nasty. I guess I expected a tasteless white powder similar to the C itrical tablets I'm used to, only ground up. I guess Ill go to my local health food store and buy something to compare this "product" to to see if there is any resemblance at all before I ingest this unknown substance.  This stuff might be the best ever, but you would not know it from the presentation.  20 minutes after opening the package, and my fingers smell like I've been toking blunts all day. Is that what the good stuff does? I tasted some and even after eating dinner the taste of this crap lingers 8 hours later. My tongue is swollen.  I just licked the army green colored powder off my finger to taste it. I do hope it was not some sort of poison. I plan to return this as it seems unsafe.

Thanks again to AMAZON I found what I needed. I looked in all the major stores in my area and none was to be found, so I went to Amazon.com and there it was/is, and now I have some at home.!!!Thanks again,Leo Romo.
A fine tea! Not too strong, not too weak. I love it as a hot tea ........as well as Iced tea. Love the berry aroma and delicious taste. And not just me...... the whole family likes this one!

I have three dogs who get a rawhide treat each day, so I go through alot. I was looking for some good quality but realistically priced treats. These were definitely it, my dogs love them. They are big, and easy for the dogs to chew.. Thanks for a great product..

Nice flavor - tastes and smells fresh. My only gripe would be that there is no grinder built-in (which would be convenient), but I simply transferred these white peppercorns to an old grinder that I had and it worked just fine.For those curious as to the flavor of white pepper vs black - I must say that they are very similar. The white is perhaps a little more 'tame', but really the difference is just the color.

This is nice quality pepper with just enough zing to add to my recipes.  The pepper grinds nicely and  and stays nice and fresh in the grinder. I will continue to add this to my favorites must have seasoning......
Not much to say really - quality pepper - tastes fine - no grit or foreign bodies.  It is definitely not as pungent as black pepper.
I wanted something different besides the melange and just black pepper and this is a nice change for the pallet.  Product price was reasonable and delivered in a timely manner and was fresh.

column9: WOW!  Take a look at the nutritional facts.....
column10: Yes, these gluten free cookies are absolutely delicious!  There's just no getting around that.  As I was munching my absolutely delicious cookie I had a look-see at the Nutrition Facts printed on the wrapper - that's when I had my second "WOW!".ONE cookie is TWO servings - when was the last time you cut a cookie in half?  So....if you are glutinous enough to eat your entire cookie at one time, you have consumed 340 calories (100 are fat calories)and 40 mg. of cholesterol.  I was astounded to say the least.  As someone with a gluten allergy, I can tell you that there are other really good cookies out there without these kinds of overloads.  Try the Glutino sandwich cookies, for example.

column9: Wonderful cookie + also try the brownies!
column10: My daughter and husband are both gluten intolerant. Found the WOW gluten free cookies in a local store and bought some for them to try. This cookie and the brownie were particular hits. My husband tried them begrudgingly since he has never found any gluten free sweets he likes and he thought they were excellent. I'm stocking up my daughter through Amazon since she lives out of state and doesn't want to wait for my next visit.

column9: A GREAT Oatmeal Cookie (and it's Gluten-Free)
column10: A friend found these, and knowing I was on a gluten-free diet, bought several for me. They are just as good as any homemade oatmeal cookie.

I picked my tin of this at an Italian market here in Salt Lake City. The ingredients are the best. Just pure licorice and natural anise flavor. No sugar, no fake sugar. The flavor reminds me of sen sen, only I think this is smoother. It stays with me for a long time with a pleasant lingering aftertaste. Since I have cleaned up my diet, this is the perfect replacement for that little sumpin sumpin that I occasionally want to keep my mouth entertained.

column9: They're good... But charging over $3.32 per bar is pushing it
column10: For those of you not familiar with the cherry ripe, the filling is a dried and slightly candied mince of cherries and coconut. This is coated with a thin outer layer of dark chocolate. They are extremely popular in Australia, where I live, and are in fact one of the classic candy bars we all grew up with.On the plus side, these things are delicious. So if they don't sell them where you are and you have a yen to try another culture's junk food, let me say cherry ripes are a pretty good choice.On the other hand, at the current price this pack of six works out at over $3.32 per bar. That is a little rich for a chocolate bar, which is the main reason I gave this product only three stars. If I'd felt it to be more reasonably priced I would've gone up to four.Unusually, on a per gram basis I'm pretty sure Cadbury Cherrry Ripe Multipack offers better value. But hey, amazon's prices do fluctuate considerably over time, so it might be worth your while to check my figures. They may well be out of date by the time you're reading this.Theo.

I spent 3 1/2 years in Central Australia and fell in love with Cherry Ripe candy bars. The coconut and cherry filling is super-yummy and the outer coating of dark chocolate make it a total taste treat. How great that one can get them now in the U.S. through Amazon. It has been years since I've had one, and I still remember the lovely taste of a Cherry Ripe.

So, my Jelly Belly order arrived today. First, as the other reviewer said, it arrived in a nondescript plastic bag with red tape to seal the top. The seal was half off and the bag open. I don't know where they've been, but they smell and taste as if they've been soaked in patchouli. It's as if i've walked into a head shop and licked the walls. Very disappointing...

The fruit flavors are my favorite jelly belly flavors.  I never buy the regular jelly belly mix, because it has too many flavors that I don't like, and that I continually accidentally eat.  Like the awful buttered popcorn flavor (WHY?) and black licorice.  I was happy to see that there is a fruit bowl mix.  The only flavor that I do not like in this mix is coconut, and since those are the only white ones I can just avoid those.  No more accidentally eating a flavor that I hate!I was a bit surprised when my order arrived in bulk packaging, in just a regular bag that was closed with a piece of red tape.  I would have liked if the description made that more clear.  It never said that it would arrive in official jelly belly packaging, but I just assumed it would anyway.  It made me a little nervous at first, but all the positive reviews of the seller (in my case, it was The Candy/Cosmetic Depot) convinced me that it was safe.  It did arrive very quickly, at least. I'll still give the fruit bowl mix 5 stars.  Even though (or possibly because of the fact that) I keep finding myself unable to stop eating them until after I feel sick from too much sugar!

column9: Great for my son at college

Bought this box on sale and they are worth every penny I paid. This was my first time trying these 2 flavors, as stated they are good but I still prefer the spice of the banana walnut :) Still rating it five stars for the price!

column9: Very good but a nutrional neutral or negative depending on your view
column10: First, $1.00 per pack is an excellent value. Each pack contains 12 little sachets of two crackers each. The nutritional value listed about the crackers is for four of these little sachets (8 crackers) so each packet has three servings. The taste is not sweet (surprising since the 2nd ingredient is sugar) but 1s ever so VERY slightly of soy/sweet....very lightly salty/sweet....altogether quite nice.  Each cracker is substantial enough to carry any heavy dip without breaking. The sodium is 125 mg. and the sugar is 3g for each 8 cracker serving. All the nutritional info is listed here on Amazon, just thought I'd mention those after the salty/sweet remark.....Altogether I am happy with the purchase but will probably donate about 1/2 the crate of 30 packages to a local food bank.I can recommend these for a nice change of crackers. If you opened a bunch of the little sachets and put them on a platter they'd be great for a party. f.y.i., each cracker is approx. 2 3/4" long and 2" wide.Enjoy.
This was a very good product. The pricing per case can't be beat. I would buy this product from this seller again.

column9: 85% Juice with added water and sugar
column10: I like this product okay, but would rather have pure coconut water (like the Nirvana brand, etc.).  I asked around and looked around, but couldn't find anything on its ingredient list.  Being that it was by far the cheapest option on Amazon for coconut water, I jumped on a case.  It tastes pretty good, but pretty sweet too.  If that's your thing, than you'll love it.  However, I was disappointed by the ingredients list: young coconut juice, water, young coconut pulp, sugar, sodium metabisulphite (for color retention).  It tastes reminiscent of sugar water with a coconut background.  By comparison the Nirvana product I've been buying (pure coconut water) has 15 g of sugar / 16 oz. or about 1 g/oz.  Parrot has 24 g / 11.5 oz. or about 2 g/oz.  In other words, they've doubled the sugar content of an already sweet beverage.  24 g of sugar is still substantially less than a can of pop though at 40-60 g.  So if you're looking for a sweet beverage to replace a can of pop for you or someone else, this could be a good option, but I think the natural coconut water is sweet enough and didn't need alteration.  The addition of sugar water is probably what decreases the price to create such a competitive price.  Nirvana (for example) doesn't have any added preservatives either.  You can learn more about sodium metabisulphite here:[...]The 16 oz Nirvana (as compared to the 11.5 oz Parrot) has the same calories, 0.5 g more fat, same carbs, 1.7 g protein (0 g for Parrot), 6% calcium (2% for Parrot), 8% vitamin C (15% for Parrot), and 6% iron (4% for Parrot).  The Nirvana product is also more expensive at $2/16 oz can vs. 0.50 cents/11.5 oz can for Parrot.  About 11cents for Nirvana or 4.5cents per oz for Parrot.  So it depends on what is affordable for you.Hope this is helpful!

So I went to a local pet store in town that carries a LOT of dog food. When I stepped inside, I had no idea what I was looking for or what the difference was between hundreds of different dog foods. So a helpful employee gave me some tips. He explained to me that the 'low quality' dog foods, like science diet, purina, kibbles n bits, etc. contain a lot of fillers. That is, ingredients that provide no nutritional value to the dog. Translation = WAY more poop to pick up. Then there is the mid-grade dog food, like Nutrisource, that contains fewer fillers. That means the dog eats less, poops less, and is getting better nutrition from his food. I checked the labels of probably 15 different foods and this nutrisource brand looked like it had the best value. Yes, it's more expensive than your lower quality stuff, but the dog will also eat less of it. When my dog was on purina, he was eating about 3.5 cups a day. Since switching to nutrisource, he eats about 2.5 cups. So in the end, this better quality food is not a whole lot more expensive. I know it's unplesant to think about, but I should mention that since switching to nutrisouce, my dog farts a lot less and his poop stinks a lot less too, a very nice bonus for the responsible dog owner who needs to pick it all up.I would recommend this food for any large breed dog. My dog is 70 lbs, german sheppard/chow mix. The "large bites" food should be used for any dog over 35 lbs or so, as the chewing will also help keep their teeth clean!

I purched this product and never received it because fedEx cannot get in my building and they would not leave it in the management office I hope I get a refund.

column9: Most delicious of the packaged soups
column10: This is the most delicious of all the packaged soups I have tried.  Be sure to let the rice noodles set a while so they thicken sufficiently.  I use a fork and spoon  to twirl the noodles.

Know how noodle cups get soggy and are too salty and just get gross after 5 minutes? This stuff is amazing. So tasty that I'm reviewing a noodle cup on Amazon. The noodles are clear, which is a little off-putting at first, but they are firm and very filling. The noodles don't become soggy (even after 45 minutes or so, incidentally), and the seasoning cake is wonderful-- little savory bits of seitan tofu and bok choy that expands to add lovely color and texture. The broth is delicious and umami, without being fishy. The sesame paste packet adds nutty depth. 5 stars.

column9: Not my favorite flavor but still love it!
column10: The Long Kow Crystal Noodle Soups are a great way to get a filling lunch with a very reasonable calorie intake.I prefer the mushroom flavor but this spicy sesame flavor offers some variety!

My wife justs loves the taste of this quick preparation soup. She first receievd this on a Delta airline flight to China and commented it was very fillng. She does not like and never eats airline food, so loves this noodle soup.
This soup tastes great, and is easy to make.  It is enough where it can be a meal.  I really like the bean noodles.

Extremely hard to find in the stores anymore and usually costs around .25 cents a stick. Through Amazon, it was smooth and easy and the cost including free shipping was .10 cents a stick! My kids love cherry jolly rancher and too bad Hershey stopped making the individual smaller pieces.  I can't believe Fire flavor is more popular than Cherry??
We have had problems with the wrappers sticking to the candy but not on this shipment. Every single one perfect.

This is the second time i have bought these cherry jolly rancher sticks and i was very happy with both orders. they are the cheapest i have found anywhere on the internet. these are shipped out from new jersey and i am in a neighboring state so once they are sent out it only takes like 3 days to get them. these sticks are big enough that i can break them into 3 to 4 pieces before i open them and they are like a regular jolly rancher size and they are just flat and spread out instead of in a round tube like. If you only like the cherry these are the best to get for the price and they are exact in taste. Enjoy

I definitely recommend you buy jolly ranchers from here. It's cheap and for me, none of them stuck to the wrapper, and none were cracked when shipped. It's cheap and there's a big quantity. Believe me, I was surprised to see how many jolly ranchers I got.

I received these a few days ago and so far I have not had any of the previous buyers problems with the product wrapper sticking! A few have been broken, which is expected from shipping but the majority are in good condition. These are SO good!
Jolly Rancher is my crack, especially the peach.  These arrived in good shape, the top row in the box had burst into pieces during shipping.  Big deal! I still enjoyed the cherry flavor.

column9: A Cherry Blast from the past!
column10: I bought a 3 package set of these after seeing them on here cheaper and with next day shipping by using prime.  I saved about $1.25 per pkg as well as the $11 shipping cost and didn't have to wait 4-5 days after processing to arrive as I do with another company.  They all arrived unbroken and did not stick despite being left out on my porch in 100 degree weather after delivery.  I'm looking forward to ordering again."
Today I ordered again the candies. They are great, no problem with the wraps and no broken. Great taste!!!!! They don't melt

column9: SO much tastier than the little Jolly Ranchers
column10: I have a major sweet tooth, but I had never really cared for the traditional little Jolly Rancher candies.  One day, a coworker brought in some cherry Stix, I tried one, and I was in heaven.  To me, they have quite a different taste from the small candies; I find them to be much sweeter and tastier.  I couldn't find the Stix in any grocery stores or drugstores, so I ordered them on Amazon.  These things are so delicious, and I'm embarrassed to think about how quickly I was able to plow through a whole box.  At 70 calories a stick, just a few can add up quickly.  I haven't reordered them in a while, because these are just too good to have only one.Before unwrapping one of the Stix, I would snap it in about four places to get it into (still pretty long) bite-size pieces.  It's better to do this with the wrapper on, because snapping the stick will cause a few tiny "crumbs" to break off.  You can also expect most Stix to have a bit of wrapper stuck to them.  But the bit of time spent peeling it off is well worth it for all the sugary deliciousness!

column9: Not as good as they should be (but they're cheap)
column10: My batch did indeed have the notorious "wrapper stick problem" on every one of them.  Not only that, the flavor is a bit off, compared to the box that I purchased from a different supplier a month prior.  I get the feeling that these, which come in a three-pack, are old and past their prime.  I'm still eating them, but will pay a bit more for the next shipment and not buy from this vendor.

my husband and I have been looking for a syrup to match the latte's that we purchase while out, to make at home without all the calories, additives and preservatives.  This is the best flavor and we just love it in our coffee.  we add the syrup along with our skim milk in our frother and it just turns out amazing!!!!  Definately recommend!!!

I ordered the complete set of Totonac sugar free syrups and tested them out with my morning Kellogg's Eggo waffles.Some of the syrups are pretty good; others are really not my thing and I threw them out. My verdict/opinion is: Almond, Maple Syrup and Vanilla are pretty good; the Raspberry is okay (if you crave some fruit taste); but I couldn't handle the taste of the Blueberry, Butter Pecan, Caramel, Hazelnut and Vanilla Cinnamon.The syrup is not thick like most syrups on the market; it's more runny and I find myself pouring some syrup out on to a plate and then dipping pieces of torn waffles.
My pet has to take medication throughout the day and this is a fool proof way do dispense it. Before I purchased I would try in hide his meds in his treats.

I ran out of this baking spray recently and really missed the convenience of a flour and oil in one spray can. It is definitely more work to butter and flour a pan as I had to a few days ago when making brownies. This spray is great when making muffins or cakes. I also use it when making banana bread. So lots of uses and something that is perfect for all your baking needs. One trick when using this is to put the baking pan you are using onto the top rack of your dishwasher. Then you can spray away without getting the spray all over your counter or stove top.~The Rebecca Review

My husband recently bought this for me when I sent him to get cooking spray, originally I thought it was a waste of money, but now I am a believer! I used it to spray down a cake pan, and once it cooled and I flipped it to take it out of the pan it came right out! I didn't have to do anything! It was perfect. I baked muffins for breakfast today, and even still hot, they fell right out of the tin. I don't normally review kitchen items, but this one is so wonderful I just had to! I will now have it on my list of kitchen must haves!

column9: one of the best mixes we've tried!
column10: We've got the double whammy of being gluten-free *and* egg-free, which means that a lot of mixes crumble, or have that squodgy, too dense result. This mix? Wonderful. We've had it dairy-free, and loved it, have mixed in some fresh black pepper (yum), sprinkled coarse salt and rosemary on top, mixed in grated cheese....and watched the biscuits vanish. My two sons love these, gluten eating friends and family are appreciative. The company is very responsive, also, to questions. Lovely company, lovely product.

My husband has been on a gluten free diet for 9 months and we found these biscuits at a local store a few months into the diet but they were cheaper to order from amazon.com. They are so yummy, a smidge time comsuming, but worth it. I don't have to eat gluten free, but I love these biscuits. My husband is very appreciative of having this product as an option for his diet.

I made the buttermilk version and followed directions to the letter, except that I rolled them thinner than the box said.  I didn't notice until after I'd cut them out that it said to roll out the dough to 1-1/2" thickness, and I think mine were about 1/2" thick.  So it may have been my fault, but the finished biscuits were flat, chewy and very dense (almost like a cookie).  I would think they should have risen a LITTLE more than that, even if rolled too thin.  Also, I would recommend SALTED butter rather than unsalted -- they definitely needed more salt.  Another thing -- unless you have a food processor with a very large bowl, don't try to do these in the processor.  My machine is about a 3 cup capacity and it just wasn't breaking up the butter, so I had to dump it all into a bowl and make them by hand.  What a mess!

I tried to save money by buying the store brands but was unhappy with the taste.  As a family that enjoys onion burgers and slow-cooker pot roasts, I had to find a way to purchase Lipton Onion Soup Mix.  With subscribe and save I can get the "real deal" Lipton brand just as cheap as store brands.  Very happy to have found this on Amazon.
great mix for dips, pot roasts, meat loaf, or whatever great value will be buying more shipping was fast del on time.
Great price, especially on Subscribe & Save.  They are just like the boxes you buy at the grocery store.

This stuff is essential to have on hand when making a roast or pretty much anything in a slow cooker!Sometimes, it's hard to find in local grocery stores.  This six pack is priced right and it's enough to give you a good lil stock so that you never run out!

What can I say about this. I have never made soup from it... It is great for dips, seasoning, meatloaf, burgers etc. probably OK for soup as well. I just wish it had a slightly lower salt content, a bit on the salty side for me.
This is the best onion soup. I use it more for an addition to other recipes such as pot roast and chicken and  rice dishes. Also for dip! Yummm
Simple to make, just add to sour cream, irresistible with potato chips and crackers.  I also add to brisket for great flavor.  Subscribe and save price can't be beat!

column9: Swiss army knife of kitchen seasonings
column10: There are very few things in the kitchen (aside from baked goods) that can't be helped with a packet of Lipton Onion Soup Mix.  I was reminded of this when I made onion soup burgers and onion potatoes for dinner last night.  What a pair of classics!  If I weren't watching my waistline, I wouldn't have leftovers for lunch!  This is also brilliant with pot roast, mixed into sour cream as a dip, and I even once mixed into chili.  It's never done me wrong.The one downside: the salt content.  If you are at all prone to bloating from salty foods, avoid this seasoning!  It's no worse of an offender than any other prepackaged seasoning, but I can't imagine anyone attempting to use this as a soup due to the salt content.

Lipton even kind of realizes that it isn't really to be used for onion soup, what with the "recipe secrets" branding and all. Because one ends up with a lot of it, when buying from in bulk packs I did once try it as a soup and it was awful, but as a recipe helper it really is hard to beat.As a helpful hint you can save yourself sometime and just open all the packs into a resealable container, and just use it as a spice. A lot of recipes can benefit from it, but not necessarily an entire packet.

column9: Great deal on a good product.
column10: I have no super tasting skills so in my opinion all onion recipe mixes taste pretty much the same. I have no brand loyalty on onion mixes and I bought this one strictly because it is a much better deal than what I am getting at my local grocery store. These things are normally ~$2.50 a box at the store, but sometimes can go on sale for less than than $1.50, but that still doesn't really beat the $8 for 6 price amazon gave me.I use these things to flavor lots of items including but not limited to: chili, hamburgers, meat balls, stews, and roasts.Overall, five stars for the amazing price.
The same stuff that you buy at the store...only you don't have to go to the store! I'm now stocked and ready to make a shabbat brisket on a moment's notice!
I love this stuff and it's so easy to put this in the slow cooker with a roast.  It taste yummy and it's so inexpenisve.  Great staple for the pantry.

column9: Perfect, and customer service that was OUTSTANDING!
column10: Amazon, Zappos and Nordstrom have the best customer service in the business... that's why we go back to them. Now add in Priester's Pecans because they were top-notch!! Friendly, professional service and super-fast delivery. Oh yeah, and delicious, wonderful, authentic pies! They were the hit of our party... thanks for the great experience, we will definitely be back!

column9: Good staple to have on hand
column10: I use this all the time for various things. The smaller sized cans are nice to be able to add a little protein in to a dish and not worry about having part of it left in the fridge. One can makes a nice serving of chicken salad for a sandwich, only takes a couple minutes to whip it up.
These are very handy to add to my veggies to make soup. Nice size chunks and drain the liquid and you can make chicken salad or even give a salad a topping. Keeps for a long time and always there.

howdy y'all,at twenty-two dollars for twelve cans, this works out to about a dollar and eighty cents per can. that's thirty cents per can higher than at my local grocery. not an acceptable price.take care,lee
never used this before thought I would try it glad I did this is great tasting chicken great for hot dish,or whatever needing chicken great value will be buying more shipped and rec on time.

Should really give this product a below zero review, but there's no choice about that. The first bite is okay, but after eating the whole sandwhich, I realized that my stomach wants to turn upside down, and the after taste is so terrible that I wanted to puke all the food I've eaten. It taste so yukky and horrible that it would not go away for awhile even though I gargle and drink lots of liquid. I wonder if there's a food poisoning in here. Will never ever buy this canned food again!!!
These cheese balls are hard to find...and these are so good...They melt in your mouth and are very cheesy..If you love cheese this is a must buy.

Hi:I bought a 24 pack of these 2 ounce bags (size you would get at Quiznos or Subway with a sandwich) since they were less than I could get them at Costco in a equal pack of Frito chips. I had tried previously by buying a bag at my local Albertsons and they are good. Good chip for dipping sicne they're a little thicker than Lays. The chips are fresh, crisp and great tasting; perfect for putting a bag lunch for work or school.NOTE: Bags are made extra thick paper with a plastic lining for freshness and very difficult to open by hand. Use a knife or scissors.

You just can't beat Kettle Chips.  No other brand comes close to these.  If you like pepper, these are for you.  This company also makes other flavors that are just as good.  And it's not just the flavors that makes this brand stand out.  It's the way they're cooked and the actual flavor of the potato that you'll love!
Found these for a great deal..split the box with a friend and we both loved them.

I love these chips; they are my favorite to dip in French onion dip. They are the best!! They are so much cheaper to purchase on Amazon than at my local grocery store. I highly recommend ordering these chips!!

column9: Better than the other chips I purchased
column10: These have an added kick that made them better than the other rippled chips I bought on Amazon, and they're kettle-cooked to boot, so they had a heartier taste and more satisfying crunch. Great for any kind of dip and they hold up well to any dip.
they don't look very appetizing, but oh my are they good!  very tasty.  i looked up the company and they are an environmentally friendly company.  that just makes it better.
VERY good, arrived fast. Of all the kettle style chips I've had, the thickness of these really pushes the crunch factor. Great flavor, not too greasy. Thanks Amazon and Kettle!

Great value...these are larger than your usual snack bag of chips...big enough to share with two. I like them because it prevents me from eating a huge bag of them!!!Just wanted to add a note that the in the shipping process using Amazon and the chips are not destroyed, they are perfectly fine!

You will get spoiled after eating these chips! These chips are very thick, crispy and flavorful! Most chips on the market are very thin with lots of salt and added colorings on them.Not Kettle! The tangy and sweet taste is remarkable and very, very delicious! I could eat a whole bag myself!!GET THEM!!! THEY ARE SOOOO GOOD!
Love love love these!  They are well seasoned, thick and greasy.  Yum!  They have so much flavor.  No other pepper chip compares.
These are probably the best-tasting potato chips ever. Chips certainly aren't the healthiest snack food out there, but at least these don't have any trans fats.
Simply put, these are my favorite potato chips of all time. Thick cut, great flavor, kettle cooked = yum.  They have just the right amount of heat and a complex flavor that hits the spot every time.

I found this product to be as described. Also found the price to be quite fair, for what was purchased. I actually think the taste of this particular brand, far exceeds any other's I've tried. I also found these chips to be very fresh, from the first bag to the last! I'll most likely be placing another order in the near future, I'm sure!L. Nakao

column9: Ranch isn't only good with tortilla chips....
column10: I have been a longtime fan of Kettle Potato Chips, since I was a small child. The terrific texture and "crunch" of their product never leaves me disappointed - what's more, the high quality ingredients that go into the top-of-the-line flavors they have are first rate. Zesty Ranch does not fail to disappoint me. The Ranch flavor has a terrific, zippy quality (like the flavor name would suggest). It livens up your taste buds, and I am pleased to say that it isn't too salty, nor too greasy. Each chip is packed to it peak with flavor, and it is far from skimped upon. You almost don't need any dip or sauce of any kind on this snack. It speaks for itself. Highly recommended. Makes me want to go crunch on some right now!

column9: Most of the Bags were open
column10: I've eaten these Krinkle Cut Salt and Pepper Chips for years.  I was very excited to find them on Amazon.  I bought the 24 pack specifically so they would be fresh every time I opened them (opposed to buying an 8 or 12 oz larger bag).When I went to get a bag this evening, I noticed they were slightly open and the chips were stale.  I checked the rest of the bags in the box and most of them were open.  I think it may have to do with the oil on the chips.  They seeped into the seal and loosened the glue.I called into Amazon Customer Service and the CSR was pretty rude.  The first question she asked was why I didn't report this earlier.  Duh, maybe because I didn't notice the problem until now?  I've been very happy with Amazon's Customer Service in the past and have been buying 100s of dollars product during this Christmas season.  Hopefully this was just a cranky CSR and not indicative of Amazon's direction for customer service.

My son and I agree. These are fine flavored potato chips! The Kettle brand has a lot of interesting variations on flavoring. This is one of those we like best from their stable of goodies.I went to graduate school in Buffalo, lived in Western New York for years, and frequented the Anchor Bar, where chicken wings were invented. So I rather like the cheekiness of referring to Buffalo wings in this product!And these are tasty indeed. I would prefer a bit more of the bite/heat of a Buffalo chicken wing, but that is not a serious issue. I find it amazing that this product can even hint at the pleasures of Buffalo chicken wings!

column9: delicious -- good thing the bags aren't any bigger
column10: Just the right amount of spice and tangy bleu cheese flavor, plus a lovely crinkle-cut crunch.
