Like I said, it is nice and crunchy, but I miss all those additional flavors that Spicy Pickled Garlic has.Quick delivery too.

column9: It Must Have Been The Roses!
column10: I purchased this to incorporate into my own Ras El Hanout (along with some Lavender Powder: http://www.amazon.com/gp/product/B0015E34L2 , and a number of other ground spices).The floral component of the Ras El Hanout was perfectly accomplished with these two additions [a very little bit goes a LONG way!], and I had plenty left over for use in my experimental perfume-making hobby.The scent of the rose powder is lovely and the taste is not too bitter, with the Rosy 'nose' of the component being greater than the wholly-natural and expected bitterness of it.
The rose powder is very potent and good for making rose water.Well packaged.

column9: Mmm Good - a review of Mi-Del's Ginger Snaps
column10: I am the sort of mom who likes to bake my own cookies because 1) it's fun, and 2) I like to know what goes into them.  However, when that is not practical I buy these ginger snap cookies.I don't mind giving them to my family because they are mostly organic (70%) and they don't contain hydrogenated oils nor corn syrup.  In addition, they contain iron - from the molasses - which is  something you don't often find in a snack.Four Stars.  A superior product in my opinion.  The whole family loves them.  Even my extremely picky son.  The flavor is zingy with a definite bite and each cookie is only 26 calories.  One of the few store-bought treats that I have no problem handing out to the children.Pam T~

My wife and I prefer them just a bit stale - leave them open for a day or so to get just the right amount of chew.  If you don't, they're very, very crisp (but still very good).  Snappy, even.  :)I'll also agree with the comment that they can be inconsistent from one bag to the next, but even when they're off, they're pretty good.As far as flavor goes, one person's spicy is another person's bland.  For my family, they're just the right amount of hot after a few cookies.

these cookies are a favorite of mine.  crisp, with just the right amount of ginger.  I don't know what the other comment is talkin about not havin enough ginger, my mouth gets very tingly when I eat them, and I think I like a lot of spice.

When Whole Foods stopped stocking my favorite ginger snaps, I decided to get a 12-pack from Amazon instead of settling for the "365" brand, which had sugar as an ingredient, giving it a sandy texture in my mouth.  Mi-Del is the real deal and are great with coffee.Ingredients:  Organic unbleached wheat flour, organic dehydrated cane juice, canola oil, unsulphured molasses, ginger, baking soda, sea salt, soy lecithin (used as an emulsifier).  Product of Canada.Update:  I placed my order about 6-months ago and finally worked my way through the 12-pack.  They are not as fresh tasting now, of course but they still go great with my coffee and I consider them a healthy snack.  My sister thought they were too spicy but I love that ginger spice and just placed another order.

These cookies have a clean, crispy chocolate taste -- without the chemical-laced aftertaste of other commercially produced cookies. They are all-natural and made with canola oil, as opposed to the oils that can add to cholesterol problems. The ingredients are mostly organic and they are sweetened with dehydrated can juice, as opposed to the less-healthy commercial alternatives.Now, for the problem: I have never found these cookies in a market near me, and we have only purchased them through Amazon. Because these wonderful cookies are not pumped-up with weird chemical preservatives, the necessity of purchasing them in such big lots means that you are going to be eating a lot of cookies in a short period of time, or going in with a friend on sharing the case! However, given the high quality of this product, you should have no problem splitting up the order.Yummy and highly recommended!

these are a great alternative to normal sugared ginger snaps. the taste varies depending on manufacturing date. you get fiber and get to eat cookies too! i like em better after the bag has been opened for a couple days - they get softer!

My husband loves these cookies; he is a man who watches everything he puts into his mouth and he enjoys these very much.  I must say, through Amazon these cookies are about 1/2 price of the grocery stores' prices.

These ginger snaps are some of the best I've ever had. They may be a little hard for some people, but I find the crunch satisfying. Great flavor without being too gingery.  Too easy to eat a whole bag - I have to exercise control!

column9: Whoa! That's quite a price increase!!!
column10: These are delicious cookies but I just cancelled my subscription. I hope the price comes back down so I can buy them again. They are the best ginger snaps I have found so far but the price is just too much :-(

These are my favorite ginger snaps & I was so pleased to be able to order these in bulk from Amazon.  I even got my first order from Amazon Warehouse so they were deeply discounted.  These are great with peanut butter.  Yum.  I also like to crush them up a little in my mortar & pestle & mix them into my granola.  They also make good cookie crumb pie crusts.  There are so many great uses for these including of course just eating them out of the bag.

My order for Mi-Del Ginger Snaps arrived a few hours ago and I tried my first one ... okay, I'm on my 10th cookie now.  My first bite of one I noticed it had a hard crunch.  I like crunchy cookies, others may not.  I read here that you can leave the top opened on the bag overnight to soften them.  The cookie is about 3-4 bites worth.  On my first bite I could feel a little tongue tingle.  Each subsequent bite produced the same warm tingle and THAT is what puts this ginger snap in a class of its own, never losing that 'bite'.  It's not too overdone or underdone on the spice, it's a perfect little cookie.  Not to mention they are 26 calories each, and ingredient that are pronounceable, this makes for an excellent little treat with coffee, tea, or vanilla ice cream.  Excellent product that I will purchase again.Note: Expiration date on the bags are December 17th, 2010 but I don't think they will last that long.--Sailor Hill, CA

I originally bought the Mi-Del cookies at a local odd-lots store over a year ago. I felt a sense of loss after the store stopped carrying them, since no other local grocer stocked them. So I was glad to see that they were available, albeit in bulk quantities only, via Amazon. I love these cookies, and best of all, they're about as healthy as you can find anywhere. I have to watch my intake of saturated fats, and per 5-cookie serving, the Mi-Del snaps have zero grams of sat-fat. They're delicious, with a nice, somewhat subdued chocolate flavor and a crunchy snap. I keep them in the fridge and they maintain their freshness for MONTHS. Twelve packages may seem like a lot, but I look forward to devouring every one of them. I've also tried the vanilla and lemon snaps, and they're equally outstanding.

I've seen these for sometime in my local grocery store, but was reluctant to buy them. From the packaging they look hard and tasteless. It turns out that they are the perfect amount of softness to dip into English tea and still hold up. And they taste wonderful. Love them.

column9: My Favorite Cookie of All Time
column10: This is the cookie that is the bain of my existence. I absolutely love it.They taste best when they are really fresh so if you buy this 12 pack dont wait 6 months to eat them all ... they dont have a long shelf life ... they get hard and loose flavor even if you never open the bag. This is probably because they are made with natural ingredients and dont have the preservatives found in other cookies.But honestly i love these cookies they are sweet, crisp and very gingery ... even my sister and brother in law who don't eat anything "healthy" or "organic" because they think it wont taste good, where impressed with the taste of these cookies.Now they are hooked too and buy them all the time.

This cookie stands up very well to dunking in milk (about three dunked bites per cookie), and with mostly organic ingredients is about as guilt-free as possible in a cookie. We like a crisp ginger snap, and while the bag isn't self-sealing it seals well if you have a clip. We find the ginger level to be just right -- not overpowering, but definitely there.One correction to the ingredient list posted on this site -- there's no grape juice concentrate in the cookie, according to the bag I'm looking at right now and the Mi-Del website.Per serving size of 5 cookies: Calories 140; Total Fat 4g; Carbs 22g; Fiber 1g; Sugars 11g.

column4: Shop-til-you-drop DIANE "I want it ALL-I want...
column9: So good people are taking them from me!
column10: These cookies seemed to be a pretty good deal when I saw that there was a special offer on them. I LOVE cookies (who doesnt??) but am kinda picky about texture. I dislike soft mushy cookies although if desperate...but I know that "snap" cookies are usually not soft so I took a chance and ordered a case!  I live alone so a case of cookies was, at once, both frightening and decadent---but I think I am going to have to order another case!  Everyone who tasted these asked me "so where did you find these?"  Of course, since I am the online shopper from hell, everyone figured I found some obscure website and paid a fortune. "Natural" and "Organic" are buzz words for "gonna cost ya more" but the price was great per bag. After I told my friends and family who tasted them that I ordered a case---the bags started disappearing pretty fast! I got hit with guilt---What are YOU going to do with 12 bags of cookies? (duh--eat them!) and everyone was very happy to lighten up my stash by taking a bag so I dont overeat! Dont I have the BEST friends and family??? LOL  Seriously--I was happy to hand them over! I enjoy turning people on to new finds. I gave a bag to my Parcel Post guy and my UPS guy (after all--they lug all the boxes to my apartment!) and they were happy! And there is a method to my giving-away madness (especially to the carriers)! Less dropping and throwing around of MY boxes!Ok--they are nice and lemoney (?) but they could even be a bit more lemon-like for me! They are made with more healthful ingredients (no trans-fat) so even though I am pigging out on cookies--I dont feel nearly as guilty! And at less than $2 a bag--I think they are a greal deal! Plus it never hurts to have extra cookies in the house because a cookie emergency can happen at any given moment!  So--order them!  I think you will be pleased!

Crispy, chewy and intensely flavorful -- WOW, they are just great. I've loved ginger snaps since... forever. So, I've tasted lots of brands both good and bad. Some of them have no ginger taste at all -- We like to call them "flour snaps!"Mi-Del Old-Fashion, Swedish Style Ginger Snaps have great taste, healthful ingredients, and I highly recommend dunking in some hot coffee or tea for even more of that comfort food feel!If you don't like them... Well, I can only quote The Lovin' Spoonful:"It's like tryin' to tell a stranger 'bout rock and roll!"

Mi-Del Old-Fashion "Swedish Style" Lemon Snaps are a crispy, chewy, lemony delight! If you are always in search of healthy snacks that aren't short on flavor, these are the cookies for you.These Lemon Snaps are made with organic unbleached wheat flour, canola oil and natural lemon flavor -- there's no artificial "lolly-pop" lemon taste here. You can just imagine squeezing the lemon into the mix, yourself.Five cookies have 140 calories, so it's not too much for a little something to get you through your day, or after dinner as a light dessert without the guilt.Highly recommended. Yum!
i have to agree that these are delicious tasty cookies.  i'm not a vegan & i don't have a problem eating gluten. i just like yummy cookies & these cookies are yummy!
ya cant stop eatin them,they are so good,my friends are addicted to them,,were all gonna explode

These are healthful, smallish (about the size of vanilla wafers), tasty and flavorful snappy cookies.  They are sweet but not overly so and have a bit of that molasses taste that ginger snaps are known for.  They have a really nice ginger bite too.  They are great to have with some tea, milk or even coffee.

Look, I love ginger. Ginger ale/beer, pickled ginger at sushi restaurants, ginger salad dressings... and I love ginger cookies. I have tried who knows how many other brands of ginger snaps and _none_ are as good as these. Mi-Del ginger snaps are the MOST gingery. Spicy. I love how snappy they are.If you are really a fan of ginger, real spicy ginger, then these cookies are for you.

Mi-Del Swedish style ginger snaps are delicious and nutritious!  They are made with organic flour and ginger, and are great with any meal- especially with coffee or tea.  It is not easy to find these treats in a market- and ordering from Amazon is quick, easy, and cost effective.  They arrived promptly, without one broken ginger snap. Thanks, Amazon!

I eat these snaps by the pound, everyday, all day.  Anything ginger tastes good to me.  I'm signing up for the auto-ship, otherwise I'd make umpteen trips to the store.  Finding a cookie with unsulphured molasses is difficult & a requirement for me - I'm anaphylactic to sulphur.My husband is now munching them too, so I'll have to double my order!Thanks Mi-Del!  :)Kristina
These are great. You can't tell they are gluten free, they are just great ginger snaps. No after taste.  Super crispy.  May have to try some of the other flavors.

About five or six years ago I used to buy mi del cookies weekly hoping that the cookies wouldn't add inches to my waist line. From what I rememeber , it was really yummy but had to stop buying them because it's expensive.
I've been eating these cookies for years and years and they are so good - perfect texture, perfect taste - this is a great price - you can't go wrong with these healty ingredients.

I love to bake but I don't always have time.  When I'm really busy, I buy MI-DEL cookies because they taste as good as homemade. My favorite are the ginger snaps. They're crunchy with a real authentic ginger snap taste. I love knowing that they're all natural and the kids LOVE them.

Yes, they're hard and really spicy, but I like it!  And what other cookie can you eat 5 of for only 140 calories and 11 grams of sugar?  And ginger is an anti-inflammatory spice that is good for headaches, arthritis, high blood pressure, you name it!  And they're made with whole wheat and no refined sugar... Wow, this is the world's most perfect cookie!
Love them, very "gingery".  Great with your favorite tea or coffee.  Love that they are using natural ingredients.

column9: The Greatest Snap I Have Ever Snapped
column10: I dip these in my coffee -- alone they are probably a bit too crisp.  However, these have excellent flavor and a great ginger burn after you've had 5-10 of them.  Highly recommended.
Cookies are a little to hard for for me they taste okay but would not buy again sorry that's my review !

column9: Not Very Chocolately, A disappointing texture and flavor
column10: I bought these cause I'm a chocolate snap lover, and I had been craving some. The lack of trans fats and description drew me in.Let's just say this: I took these over to a family party, and none of the kids liked it. NOT ONE. And most of the adults, the best they could say was, 'Eh.' I think two folks had more than one.I'd have to say skip these cookies. They don't make your mouth sing with chocolatey snappy joy.
I received the Lemon Snaps faster than expected, but one of the bags was missing from the order. The cookies are ok, but not much lemon flavor. I give them a 5 out of a 10 rating.

column9: Not My Idea of Vanilla Snaps
column10: I absolutely love the Mi-Del ginger snaps, so I thought I'd try these in vanilla, thinking they'd be just as tasty.  Unfortunately, they didn't have the vanilla flavor I'd hoped for, and I wasn't crazy about their consistency.  They almost seemed stale, although I'm sure that's not the case.  As I actually prefer the name brand vanilla snaps, I gave these away to my local food pantry.

column9: Healthy snaps that taste good, too
column10: I ordered both the vanilla and the ginger snaps, and like both kinds. The high quality organic ingredients provide a "guilt-free" eating experience. I'm not sure if kids would go for them, but will try them out on my nephews next time I get a chance. I ordered two 12-packs so will have cookies for quite a while. Mine expire 6/20/08 so don't buy TOO many in advance.

I like the fact that the Mi-Del cookies are low-fat and use some organic ingredients.  I love the Mi-Del lemon and vanilla flavors, and their ginger snaps are ok -- BUT these chocolate snaps are no good.  I'm a chocolate lover, so this is rather disappointing.  The taste is similar to the ginger snap, but it's off quite a bit - slightly bitter.  It's as if they didn't put enough sugar in these snaps to counter the bitterness of cocoa powder. It also has a poor aftertaste that's slightly bitter (the lemon snap aftertaste is awesome keeps me wanting more).Gotta give it 1 star - yeah, I ate 10 of these to give them a chance, but I threw away the rest of the bag. The crunch and texture is the same as the other Mi-Del Snaps, but the flavor is off.  Not Recommended.
These cookies are hard & somewhatlacking in taste. We threw out half the bag.Mostly because my children did not likeginger snaps & my husband and I did not care for these.
Good aroma, good mouth feel, but the taste...flavorless.  Like a crunchy lump of flour.  Might help if they put some ginger in it.

This granola is the best on the market.  It used to be carried by Albertson's grocery store in California, but was dropped in June 2010.  I searched the internet and found it on Amazon.  Now I will be able to enjoy this delicious granola once again.Kindest Regards

This is the best granola I've ever found.  I hate to say that though because I don't want them to run out of stock and I'll have to wait longer for my next shipment!  Stays crunchy, never stale.  It's delicious!  And since I live in Oregon, I should know a good granola when I taste one.I disagree with another review saying it's very coconutty.  I'm not very fond of coconut and have never even noticed it.  I like this granola because it is somewhat plain and doesn't have any weird textures or dried fruit (which I am also not fond of).  I primarily use this granola to put in my vanilla yogurt.  It's tastes just like it should, like honey and nuts.

Length:: 0:33 Minsthis granola tastes great (nice taste of honey), but some of it sticks to the bowl, due to it's small size. Is that because it's organic or all natural? I'm not sure. If you're looking for a cereal on the smaller side, I'd say this granola is a great pickup. If you're looking for a healthy snack, I'd say that this a phenomenal pickup. Remember, this granola has zero cholesterol.
Try it and you'll agree! Can't find this local anymore. glad it's available on Amazon. Perfect combination of crunchy chewy, all-natural, with a slightly coconutty flavor. Truly the best ever!
The boxes of granola were stale and therefore very disappointing! We will therefore, be very hesitent to order this product again.

column9: my hubs is addicted to this.
column10: we can't buy this granola fast enough. it is delicious. and we are granola-lovers. nice & crunchy, doesn't get soggy in milk. lots of almonds & the honey isn't overpowering. delicious with any type of milk... coconut milk beverage makes it extra delicious!
Great snack food. Helps alot when you ad it to yogurt. Brings the flavor up to an extra notch or two

column9: Tastes Great, Even if it is Gluten-Free
column10: Most of the time, gluten free products taste awful.  I don't understand the hype over it, especially if you are not allergic to wheat and don't have celiac disease (which is acquired GENETICALLY, not through a diet).But in any case, this granola tastes awesome.  I can eat it as granola or cereal and in both cases it's great tasting.  There are four boxes of these so you might get a bit tired of them after some point.
Very good breakfast cereal. Good packaging, excellent value for the money. Goes a long way, has a good, crunchy taste.

I've tried a few types of granola, and this one provides a very satisfying taste. It has a softer crunch than other types of granola, which sometimes are so hard they can hurt your teeth! I don't notice the coconut flavor much, but I don't despise coconut.

I used to buy this stuff from Fred Meyer but then I moved to the east where this is unavailable.  I tried just about every granola that can be bought locally before discovering that I can buy this on Amazon.  I wouldn't be ordering my breakfast through the mail unless it was that good!
Coconut gives this granola a relatively high fat content...but it is DAMN tasty. Great with milk or on yogurt (I prefer the latter).

column9: Great tasting, but a bit pricey
column10: This is one of the best tasting granola I've had. it's good as a ceral, as well as a regular trail snack. The price is a bit much though.

column9: Okay but needs some variety and less coconut!
column10: - This granola is okay; not great, not awful.- The texture is nice.- A bit too sweet for my taste, almost sickeningly so.- The paper thin almond slivers are used quite sparingly.- The prevalent taste is coconut.- It gets rather boring after a while since there is not enough variance in ingredients to make each bite a bit different (as with a fruit & nut granola, for example, where each bite may have a different type of fruit and/or nut to give it some variety) so every bite is exactly like the previous one.- I mixed it with some Bear Naked F&N which improved it
I picked this because it was cheap pound-for-pound, and tasted great.  I also didn't want fruit.The product more than met my expectations - tastes really good!

I had a variety of granola. And this one ranks of my top most favorites. It is a very crunch granola with a coconut main taste. It is sweet but not overly so. I eat at as a snack when im craving something. Fills you up very fast and satisfies any sugar cravings.
Love it.  Will definately buy it again and again.  As a matter of fact, I already have.  I have to keep a stock of it because my daughter loves it, also.
If you want great granola, look no further.  I live in Utah and none of the stores carry it so I have to mail order my granola to get something good!

Compared to some other granolas out there it has a nice golden color and wonderful nutty crunchy taste.  Since I am trying to cut back on the sugar I compensate by not having as much but I just have to have some sprinkled on my plain oatmeal or a couple teaspoons added to my muesli.  It's great in yogurt, milk, soy milk or just crunching a small handfull by itself for a small sweet snack.
This granola did not work with yogurt because too chewy. It does not work with milk because too sweet. I will not order it again. I love the Udi's...yummy...

column4: C. Thomas "Straight to the Point In Colorado"
column10: It's one of the big things I miss most about New York, since having moved to Colorado in April of 2007 - Bakeries. And specifically a really good Coffee Cake. Unless you are living in the heart of Denver there are just no real bakeries to be found. King Soopers and Safeway do try but then I just don't think they really know just how good a good coffee cake should be.Grandma's definitely fills that void for us. This is just a scrumptious coffee cake.I have ordered this in the past from QVC but have found the quality of it different by ordering this from Amazon. The two times I ordered it from QVC - the cake and the sample cakes were wet and mushy and nearly inedible. From Amazon it was moist - as it should be - but not wet and well - simply delicious.I will definitely be purchasing this again, although I wish that the shipping charges were less expensive. I get my head around it by defining it as a treat that anyone hankering for a good coffee cake should allow themselves the luxury of having at least once and a while.
This is the most delicious coffee cake ever!  It is so moist and absolutely addictive!

My Grandma's Cinnamon Walnut Coffee Cake is addictive!  Friends, relatives & coworkers RAVE about this cake.  I get it for about ½ the price shown here at Stew Leonard's, and it's worth every penny!  Best coffee cake I've ever tasted!!!

column9: Healthy treat for my corn-allergic son
column10: Having an allergy to corn and being super sensitive to artificial colors,flavors and preservatives, my 8-yo son has a limited selection when it comes to treats.  Almost everything at bakeries uses mixes that contain these ingredients, even at the Wegman's bakery.  But one day I discovered Grandma's of New England coffee cakes at Wegmans.  I did not want to pay $10 for a coffee cake, especially one that comes in a box, but I was desperate for something healthy.When I served this to my family, I was expecting it to be hard, dry and taste like playdough.  Boy, was I wrong! It is soo moist, the texture is soft and perfect. It was full on natural, delicious flavor without any odd aftertaste. It was gone in a day.  That was the apple, which I bought several times since.  This weekend, I found the cinnamon walnut in Wegmans and I like it just as much.I looked up Grandma's website and was shocked to find it cost twice as much there, and here as well.  I hope Wegman's will be carry more flavors in the future.
I sent these to family and friends at Christmas - they loved them.  I got one, too.  They are moist and rather addictive (hard to walk by and not take another slice)
My wife just loves this product. We have now purchased three and just recently ordered the double one.

I ordered two cakes for my sister in Atlanta.  Only one cake came.  When I called customer service they said they would call me back.  They never did! Never again.  I don't have money to give away! Too bad I was going to order fifty cakes for a party.
I haven't had anything like this for a long time.  Where I grew up we had many good German bakery stores which specialized in German coffee cake.  What a treat it really is.

I have purchased this item in the past.  I intended it as one for home and one for a gift.  Before I had a chance to take it over to my daughter, my husband had sliced into the second cake as well.The texture is moist and creamy.  There is an undercurrent of butter.  The cake had just the right amount of nuts and crumbles.If you need a great hostess gift, or are just craving the exact right coffee cake, this cake is the one for you.

column9: Taste is off, my grandma agrees!
column10: There is something off tasting about my grandma's coffee cake. i've had it twice now and the last time with my own grandma believe it or not. She agreed with me about the taste. Her favorite coffee cake is Fantasicakes coffee cake or Boston coffee cake (you can get both on amazon). I agree totally. I had never heard of Fantasicakes until my grandma mentioned it months ago. So I looked them up on Amazon and ordered me a cinnamon walnut coffee cake from Fantasicakes...one word: AMAZING. One of my motivations of ordering it over Boston Coffee Cake is i noticed pound for pound they're cheaper. I'm glad I did. Either one is better then My Grandma's coffee cake honestly. If you think this is good, i recommend trying Fantasicakes or Boston coffee cake. And another thing about My Grandma's coffee cake is it doesn't have enough walnuts in the middle. FYI I ordered My grandma's coffee cake from QVC and one time i saw it at my local Gelson's and thought i'd give it one more try, but had the same result, an off taste i can't put my finger on. It borders moldy/old flavor I'll stick to fantasicakes.

I order these for my Mom all the time and I've tasted them.  They are moist and delicious.  This is what a coffee cake shoud be, the standard for all coffee cakes!  I can't say enough about this product.  I'm not a "sweet eater", but these are not overly sweet and are just wonderful!!!
This is the best coffee cake I've ever had and in fact the entire family ate all of it on Xmas morning.  I wished I had ordered two.

I have purchased products from CoffeeCakes.com through Amazon for a while with no problem.  All purchases were gifts, sent to another address, no problem.  I live in New Zealand, sending the purchase to people in the United States.I received an advertisement email directly from CoffeeCakes.com with a discount offer.  I attempted to use this offer, but THEY don't accept orders from nasty foreign countries.  New Zealand is not a corrupt dictatorship full of criminals trying to steal banking info from Americans or trying to get you to claim a million dollars left in a paper bag outside a public toilet.Why do they accept orders placed through Amazon but not made directly to their website?  It has upset me enough to stop buying products from CoffeeCakes.com, even through Amazon.  There are lots of other products to send as gifts to friends in the U.S.

column4: I lUv EaMoN! "if you don't like eamon"
column10: Yogurt sucks bad enough, then they make it into a pretzel, it's so dumb. Anyone who likes yogurt is crazy, it's rotten milk.it's nasty. And putting it on a pretzel is gross. I can't stand yogurt pretzels.

You really don't need to cook this cereal if you let it sit in milk overnight in the refrigerator. I use almond or rice milk. Use equal amount cereal and milk.It's cold and refreshing and tastes great.

I tried this cereal recently and loved every bite. I cooked it and it was ready in no time. It's much better than plain old oatmeal and it's a lot healthier for you than the flavored processed oats. I've tried several Bob's Red Mill products lately and I am hooked. I can trust this brand to give me what I want as far as taste and healthy options at a good price.
I was anticipating a product that I had when growing up. What I got was sub-par. I don't know if they have changed the formula, but the flavor was awful. Went right into the garbage can!!

column9: The best, but not the only great choice from Mary Janes Farm
column10: I take these soup packets to work for lunch.  They are incredibly tasty, easy to make using hot water from the coffee machine, organic and wholesome.  I bring along some crackers or bread from home to round out my lunch.  I have also tried the tomato soup, mac and cheese and chili mac.  All are highly recommended for the taste, for the ease of preparation and the fact that you are eating organic at your desk!  The potato soup is my favorite, but all the varieties I have found have been great.  It is so much better than eating from the office cafeteria - cheaper and far better for you.  We eat organic at home and it is great to find a product I can have at the office that is organic as well and that I can have on the spur of the moment.  The whole range of Mary Janes Farm products are highly recommended.

I just got this, and usually I wait a while after receiving a product to review it, but I don't think my opinion will change of this nifty little basket.  I really like it a a lot.  Here is why:1. It comfortably holds about 30 k-cups, 15 in each basket.2.  It seems more modern and stylish (maybe just more "my style") than the other k-cup holders I've seen.3.  I was hoping that it wouldn't be too overwhelming to have the k-cups just piled in the baskets, and it isn't.  My mom has a holder with a slot for each k-cup, and that's nice, but I like the look of this one better.  And, I like taking a second (because that's all it takes) to look through the baskets.  It's fun.4.  The legs have little rubber feet at the bottom (non-slipping non-scratching).The only thing I noticed that I don't like is that the legs are a little flimsy if you hold the basket firmly and push down on the counter and move the basket part around.  It would be nice if the legs were a little sturdier.

I really like the baskets in that they stack up and combined they hold more than most K-Cup organizers I have seen for the home.  My only wish is that it was expandable.  I would like to be able to add another basket or two as needed.  The only current option is to buy another set and place it next to the original basket.

I had been looking for a k-cup storage solution for a while and when I came across these stackable baskets. I was happy because I didn't feel that it was necessary to spend $25+ for a k-cup storage solution.  This fits our budget and looks really nice next to our Keurig.  I'm very pleased with these baskets.

I love these little baskets.  They snap together very easily, are sturdy and have niceindentations for your hands.  They hold lots of capsules without taking much room.I actually bought two sets and have 3 baskets stacked which only take up 14 H X 8 D X 6.5 W inches.

Very simple design and snaps together.  I purchased a carousel type stand for my wife, me being a man I did not want to replace a coffee cup every time I took one out so I opted for the basket-style. Trust me as a man this is a better buy, just dump them in and call it good.
We purchased 2 of these for our Keurig K-Cups. Each basket will hold 15-20 cups.  Looks great and a great price.  Highly recommended!

column9: Buy 2 Sets. You can make it 4 tier - kinda
column10: These baskets are great. Stylish and reasonably priced.I do wish they would sell them in higher stacking sets. As this product is made, the best you can do is buy two of these two-basket sets.... and use the top basket from the second set as your third tier. Of course that leaves you with an extra bottom basket.Let me explain. The bottom basket and the top basket are not the same. The top basket is made in a way where it snaps onto the rails of the bottom basket. The bottom basket does not have that hardware on it. So if you buy two sets, you can only create a 3 tier basket. That is.... if you want all the tiers to properly snap together.Personally I took the bottom basket from my extra set and stretched out the legs to be wider than the opening of the basket. I used that as my top (4th tier) basket by letting friction do the work and fitting the legs into the top rail opening of the 3rd tier. It's not the most stable thing in the world.... but it doesn't fall down either.
Its a great K-cup holder, doesn't take up a lot of space on the counter or cabinet and it gets rid of the boxes taken up room.  Would have been nice if it was a little bigger, but overall its great.
Love that it stacks and doesn't take up much room.The 2 baskets are great for me and my roommate -- just what we were looking for.

This product is great. I like the way that it is an open basket (really 2 baskets) holding the K-cups. I looked at the various carousels which hold the K-cups, and they seemed nice, but a bit too rigid. I like the fact that a variety of K-cups can be tossed into the baskets and chosen slightly whimsically. The product takes up the same amount of room as one of those rotating carousels, but for my money and taste, is preferable.
I love my little k-cup coffee holder. It fits the spot next to my Kuerig and looks cute.  It holds about 30 k-cups which is perfect.

It looks great. Perfect for the nespresso capsules. We color coordinated the capsules, so the darker ones on the bottom and the lighter on the top. It looks very nice, dark color of the frame fits great in our kitchen. Great for the price, most of the other nespresso holders are much more expensive. Fits about 30 capsules in each basket.
I use these baskets when entertaining. Looks nice and holds a good amount of selection.  Looks decorative and stores easily.
I needed to clean up and neaten up my counterspace, wanted to get rid of the boxes of k-cups.  This basket worked perfectly, and it fits more K-cups than i expected.

column9: Baskets are nice and stack well
column10: Items arrived as expected and were packaged well.  These baskets are simple, affordable, and they look fine on the counter.
This K Cup holder is simplistic in design, but it really looks cute in my kitchen. I thought about purchase one of the more expensive K Cup holders, but I am very happy with my choice.
Made it easier to keep the counter near our keurig machine clean and tidy, with an increasing amount of people using it every little bit helps :) [...]

Very happy with this purchase. I have all of my Dolce Gusto Capsules in these two little baskets. Looks good too and not too big. I just wish you could have the option of buying 4 of them at once on top of each other for more space efficient use, so I may buy two more of these.

I ordered this hoping it would fit my needs and it did. I didnt want to use it for creamers I wanted to put granola packs and instant oatmeal on the counter so it would be quick to grab for the family and it fit perfect. Thanks Amazon for quick shipping.

When I bought my Dolce Gusto coffee maker, I also purchased this product.  I also have the carousel for these coffee pods, but wanted another storage container for the extra pods.  This works very well and looks quite nice on the shelf.
Could have used some direction as to how to put it together.  It took a bit but, I figured it out.
The price caught my interest and gave it a try.  The basket sits in my office and looks nice next to my machine.
I brought this item for my husband and daughter for christmas.  they both like it very much. doesn't take up much room on our counter.

Yeah, it's a a cheap wire basket made in China.  It's job isn't glamorous, and it didn't cost much.But I expected a cheap wire basket...not a cheap, rusted wire basket.The rust doesn't cover the entire thing...just parts of the legs.  I have a $300 Nespresso machine that looks pretty good on my desk...Don't want a rusted wire basket sitting next to it.  I'm going to just throw this thing out and get a pencil holder or something to keep my pods in.
If you want to bring back the taste of your last trip to Greece, this coffee will do it.  Fresh and tasty!
I have used other brands and this is by far the best tasting.
Good Basic Greek Coffee.  Can depend on this coffee to be the same from bag to bag.
If you have the equipment for making Turkish coffee, this is worth trying. It has a wonderfully smooth, light taste. The only Greek coffee I have tried and liked more is the Loumidis Dark variety.

Like I ever knew the brand, I just asked for Greek coffee and itmagically appeared. This stuff is great, authentic, and no differentfrom what you'll find in a Greek imports store. Even the price iscomparable. Great stuff!I know they're not equivalent, but I've been hunting for aneasy to use espresso machine to get my caffeine fix. Greekcoffee has at least the same kick, if not more, for a muchlower price point and maintenance. Have Briki, will travel :-).
This is the item to buy when you want classic Greek/Turkish coffee! You can't go wrong with this coffee, the most popular brand.
this is a good one, nothing less or more than expected. though to my opinion, ''bravo'' cafe is slightly better.

There is no way I would have known beforehand exactly how Greek coffee tasted.  I went on the recommendation of an article citing it's medicinal qualities. I'm sorry but this was the worst tasting coffee I've EVER had! The seller was quick and had a good price but again, I DO NOT RECOMMEND THIS COFFEE!

I'm a lover of Cream of Wheat and I found nothing wrong or unusal after buying this product from amazon. It shipped quickly, was safely and effectively packaged (no damages or leaks), and the product is as good as always. It's all very convenient! I don't like shopping, so amazon's subscribe and save option is wonderful for me.

I ordered this product from Amazon because we are not able to find the original Cream of Wheat in local stores. Apparently the manufacturer drastically modified the product but left the packaging the same. I ordered this based on the reviews. Don't believe it! The flavor, consistency, aroma -- all different. It clumps up as soon as you put it the liquid. Impossible to get smooth. This is what I imagine baby pablum tastes like. NOT ORIGINAL, someone should sue the manufacturer for false advertising!
This is the Cream of Wheat  you remember as a child--it takes a little while to cook and you won't find it in the local grocery store.

My dog would not even touch these awful biscuits.  i had to end up throwing them away.  also the details of the ad say you will get 6,  4pound bags.  they sent me one and told me to bad.  amazon sent me back the shipping, but i was stuck with the biscuits.  don't buy these, ask my dog.

column9: Great Tic Tacs and Great seller
column10: These Tic Tacs came six days before the estimated delivery date, and they were packaged nicely in a little tic tac box. The Tic Tacs themselves are wonderful -- I LOVE Tic Tacs! The fresh mint flavor is delicious, with the perfect balance of sweet and minty taste. Everything was packaged and sealed well, and very fresh. I highly recommend this item and seller.

I've tried five flavors of Spry gum: peppermint, spearmint, green tea, fresh fruit, and cinnamon. Green tea is my second-favorite of the bunch. The flavor lasts for several minutes (which is unusually long for Spry gums). The combination of green tea and xylitol tastes a little like green tea ice cream (if you've ever had the opportunity to try that).I really like that the gum is flavored with xylitol. Unlike some brands that advertise that they contain xylitol, Spry actually uses it as their only sweetener. Most sugarless gums make me sick, as I can't handle sorbitol and maltitol well. It's great that I can chew this without having intestinal problems, which is certainly worth an extra star despite the flavor not lasting as long as I would like.

I too have tried all the flavors of Spry and this one is my second-favorite flavor, aside from Peppermint. The flavor lasts about five to ten minutes. I wish it was a stronger flavor so that it lasted longer but this is really great gum. I also love that Spry used ONLY xylitol for their sweetener and it's why I only chew Spry gum. I also like the texture of their gum, as opposed to gums such as "Extra" brand gum. Spry doesn't make your jaw ache like those other gums do because it doesn't get stiffer or more rubbery as you're chewing it, such as other sugarless gums tend to do.

I wanted a sugar, artificial color, and aspartame free gum. Spry provided. I'm a heavy chewer and buying gum in blister packs costs a fortune so I was happy to find a gum that came in bulk. The gum does have a pleasant sweet tea taste and unlike the fresh fruit flavor, keeps it's texture better. The fresh fruit tends to get soft and slimy fairly fast. I've chewed the green tea for well over an hour without it going soft. So, unless the texture issue is just a matter of variation in the manufacturing that changes from batch to batch, if you are a truly hard-core gum chewer go with the green tea flavor.

I wasn't sure what to expect from green tea gum, but the flavor is actually pleasant.  My main disappointment with this gum is the texture.  I don't like hard-shell gum to begin with, but this one sort of crumbles a little when you first stick it in your mouth.  You also can't chew it for very long before it gets hard, but they recommend you chew it for 5-10 minutes after eating, so I guess it's not meant to be long-lasting.  Despite these minor flaws, I'm happy with the product.  It came recommended by my dentist, and I feel it's a worthwhile purchase.

The Green tea flavor is great and refreshing, but it only lasts a few minutes.  I always chew gum in the gym, as it helps with breathing, and found this gum lost its flavor and got hard after only a couple sets.  I still like it, and the packs are large so you can swap out pieces often.

column9: This gum is cheap because it is cheap gum
column10: This gum is easy on the wallet but unfortunately hard on the teeth. It gets uncomfortably hard almost immediately after chewing. The flavor doesn't last very long either. Honestly unless I'm distracted and not thinking about what I'm doing I can't chew a piece of this gum for more than about a minute.

I like green tea flavored products.I don't like that it seems sort of "chalky." I don't really know how to describe it, but maybe like the flavoring was made from a more powdery substance than other flavors?I don't like the texture too much, which gets hard fast.The flavor doesn't last very long.

column9: tastes great, good for your teeth
column10: I've never been a gum chewer, but after my last visit to the dentist I was directed to take on the habit.  Apparently chewing xylitol gum can help kill off cavity-causing bacteria in your mouth.  I bought the green tea flavor since it was the cheapest (.05/piece) and I think the flavor is great.  The gum pieces are small and the flavor doesn't last long, but I only need to chew it about 5 minutes for the dental benefit.  I would definitely buy it again! I wish it came in the 600-pack so I could save the extra packaging.

I just got this product from amazon.com and it is great! It arrived 3 days before the estimated arrival time. I ordered the green tea flavor and it is fantastic. Direct flavor only lasts about 2 minutes but the after flavor will linger in your mouth over half an hour while still chewing. Gum pieces are pretty small but at $8.25 for 100 pieces just pop two in!

My wife is unable to chew gum with cinnamon or mint flavoring. Spry green tea gum is one of the few products that doesn't irritate her mouth. She agrees that the flavor doesn't last long but finds chewing the gum satisfies her desire to much on fattening food.Update: Nov. 2010 - Amazon changed to a new supplier, and the product they shipped was stale.  So, hopefully the supplier and Amazon will make sure they ship the fresh version of this product, not the old leftover stuff.  I change my rating from 5 stars to 4 stars because of this.Update: April 2011 - Our last order is so bad that my wife is going to toss out.  Unchewable is the term she uses.  There is clearly some quality control problem in either the manufacturer, storage, or shipping of this product.  Now my wife is going to try and find an acceptable alternative.  I have changed the rating from 4 stars to 2 stars, although the most recent batch is 1 star.

Spry Green Tea Xylitol GumI purchased thie Spry Green Tea Xylitol Gum tub based on the 4+ start reviews, but I would not give it more than two stars because of the very weak flavor. Even when chewing two pieces at the same time, the flavor does not last more than 5 minutes. This is another example of an expensive Xylitol product that is not worth buying. I do not recommend this one.

Personally I prefer the fruit which I go through pretty quickly, while this has been in my drawer for month now half full. It's also much harder than the fruit or cinnamon flavor. No sir, I don't like it!

The thing I like most about this gum is that it really does make a difference in how clean my teeth look and feel between brushings.  I also enjoy the strong texture which doesn't fall apart like cheaper gum.  I can "click" and "pop" it (in private, of course).  Keeps my mouth busy, and I seem to snack less.  I'm also a green tea fanatic, so I also enjoy the flavor.  The final great thing is XYLITOL!!!  Look it up online.  It's known for several health benefits (immunity, bad breath, etc.).  This has become my favorite gum, and I buy it in bulk to save money.

I bought this gum because of the cost, the flavor and being sugar free  - without reading the reviews.  If I read the reviews before buying I would have seen that this gum is specifically for a dental regimen. It is for after a meal and is not long lasting.  I had planned on giving it away... and then I tried it a few more times, reluctantly, as I needed something!EDIT UPDATE A DAY LATER: I bumped up my review to a 3-star.  I decided to keep this gum on my desk at work.  One afternoon, I popped a piece into my mouth and realized this works better than a mint.  It takes just a minute or two and my breath felt better.EDIT MONTHS LATER: I bumped my review up to 4-stars.  I now reach for this more often.  I guess I'm a reluctant fan.  :-)  Late to the party.  Now, I'm glad I bought this by accident.

Before I developed gum diease, I was not a big chewing gum fan.  Now I use a lot of xylitol products, because the bacteria in your mouth will "eat" xylitol, but cannot digest it.  If you use xylitol products regularly and often, you basically starve the bacteria in your mouth so there is less of it, and you are thus less likely to develop cavities and gum issues.So... I'm chewing this for the xylitol, not for pleasure or entertainment. The flavor of most xylitol chewing gums does not last long, and I'm ok with that because I'm looking just to dose my mouth with xylitol every few hours.That said, this is really tasty gum.  It is unlike any other chewing gum flavor out there.  It satisfies my desire for something sweet better than the usual spearmint, fruit or cinnamon.  Texture-wise, it doesn't break down into bits or become stiff and rubbery, so your jaws don't ache after a while.If you're a xylitol fan and looking for a fresh flavor, and if you like your gum sweet sometimes, definitely give this a try.
Flavor lasts for only one minute for me.It's made in China, world famous for their careful attention to quality control.

I am not picky about chewing gums, I don't remember to have ever found one I did not like.This one... well I cannot say I like. The tastes vanishes SO quickly you can barely realize what it tastes like. Literally, within a minute, any flavor is gone. The texture is harder than most gums, but that is not even the problem. The point is that it feels like having a piece of tasteless rubber in your mouth after 30 seconds of chewing. Not recommended.

column9: Good for an all natural gum
column10: I decided to try this because I have sensitivities to artificial sweeteners and the strange ingredients in regular gum. I also tried some other natural gums, and this one worked best for me. The green tea flavor is nice. I keep it in my desk at work and enjoy chewing a little after I have my salad, since I frequently eat onions. It does lose its flavor quickly, but most natural gums do. I really only use it for breath freshening after meals and for flying, so I don't chew it for long periods of time anyway. I would buy it again. Happy to have found a gum that doesn't upset my stomach after chewing it (I'm not swallowing my gum... the juices just run down my throat and my digestive system does not like them from most other gums).

I have to have chewing gum and chapstick before I go for a walk/run.  When it's cold out I have issues with minty gum because I have sensitive teeth.  Sucking in fresh cold air with the addition of mint has a tendency to give me an "ice cream" headache.  This gum still keeps my mouth moistened during exercise but doesn't pack the mint punch.  I have discovered that the spry gum's flavor doesn't last very long and it does tend to get rubbery after a while and make your jaw tired. I also chew 3 or 4 pieces at a time to keep from biting my cheek.

I love the flavor while it lasts. My wife did not care for it. Either way the flavor lasts about as long as a gum with sugar. I stay away from gums with artificial sweeteners and that is getting harder and harder to do. Try all the flavors and I'm sure you will find one you like.

column9: A Little Tough To Chew, But a Good Choice If Your Looking For an All-Natural Sugar-Free Gum
column10: Sugar-free gum is usually full of chemicals such as Aspartame and dyes (i.e. Yellow 5 Lake, etc.).  Not so with Spry Green Tea Gum.  I was pleasantly surprised to find out that it's all-natural.  Even the flavoring is made with real green tea.That being said, the gum is not perfect.  In fact, I enjoy chewing Trident with Xylitol more than I enjoy chewing Spry gum because the Trident keeps its flavor longer and has a softer texture which I enjoy.  Spry gum loses its flavor very quickly and is very tough in texture, so it takes strong jaw muscles to chew it!However, the Spry gum does taste good and I believe that it is healthier for me than a chemical-filled stick of Trident.  So, I chew Spry gum after meals or when I only have a couple of minutes to chew a piece of gum, and I use Trident when I need a good breath-freshening gum or when I plan to be chewing one piece of gum for longer than fifteen minutes or so.This is a good product and I am very pleased that an all-natural sugar-free gum exists.
While I highly recommend Spry gum, especially since Xylitol is good for your teeth and gums, this flavor is weak and the gum is tougher to chew.

column9: Not a good way to use green tea!
column10: I use this brand of gum - favorite is Cinnamon and others are good, except this one.  Not a good way to use green tea in my opinion.  I will just drink mine.  Don't judge this brand by this flavor.
VERY LITTLE FLAVOR WHICH LASTED A VERY SHORT TIME. DEFINITLY NOT WORTH THE MONEY. REALLY DISAPPOINTED BECAUSE IT SOUNDED GOOD.

column9: xylitol is bad for digestive system
column10: I was hopeful that the Xylitol products would be good for teeth which is true.  However you ingest the stuff.  It has anti-bacterial properties.Your digestive system depends on bacteria to function properly.  Ingesting more than 1 or 2 pieces of gum or mint, starts interfering with this process. Result is gas, diarrhea, etc.  It's not nice. I ended up starting with Yogurt again so I could recover.Xylitol cannot be used in making bread either it starves yeast as well as bacteria.Sorry, but it sounded too good to be true, didn't it???

column9: 7 oz Bag is a little deceptive
column10: I must admit I have not tried these yet. I was very disappointed when they arrived. Each bag is supposed to be 7 oz, but it is really just a small amount of "pasta" packed in a ton of liquid. I never would have paid this much if I new the weight was based on the liquid. They also look like worms, like the kind your dog gets... round worms.

picture of the product looked good - when i recieved it the individual candies were all upside down & a complete mess.  the cardboard strap holding the candies together was almost completely ripped. the crate was all chipped & discolored. i would never order or recommend this to anyone. i never did recieve the other 3.90 shipping charges i was entitled to .

These chocolate bottles are disappointingly filled with a liquor flavored jelly instead of the tiny bit of real liquor our family has come to love and enjoy at the holidays. If you're looking for flavor, this product does not have it.
The product is good but Amazon can't pack it.  Most likely you will get a broken crate that can't be fixed and some of the chocolates will have leaked.

The crate is broken in several places.  The tiny bottles were strewn all over the place and at least one of them is leaking.  This is my second purchase from the Amazon site and I am very leery of making any other purchases. I would like to return this and get my money back.

I would recommend, given the Prime Shipping and the fact that no where in WI could I find true alcoholic (5%) liquor chocolates like this in time for Xmas. The best flavors are the orange Stoli vodka and the Grand Marnier, but that is IMHO.The batch I tasted a bit on the older side, otherwise I would have given this five stars. Despite that, I will DEFINITELY order these again. Cheers to Amazon for getting these on Prime in time for Santa!

When the product was received the box was broken, some of the chocolates were broken, and the chocolates were upside down and scatter throughout the box. I also found that the chocolate itself tasted fine, but the filling was sub par to say the least. Some tasted bad, but most were just bland. I would not recommend this to anyone.

I bought these as a gift for my sister.  I buy her these every year but I usually buy Anton Berg.  She tried one and commented on the lack of flavor and then we tried several others and yes, they were bland.  The chocolate itself was very good, but the filling inside was just bleh.  I honestly could not tell a difference between the flavors.  So I am going to have to replace it with the real thing.  Not a bad price but in this case you get what you pay for.

Had this shipped to my sister for Christmas.  She and her friends LOVED it.  Nicely presented, and they had fun trying all the flavors.  She couldn't come to town for the holidays, so I was glad she got some fun out of it.  And she said they tasted great.
Very Tasty. The crate in which it is packed is very nice and gives the appearance of a high quality product. I got it as a gift and the recipient was delighted. (She let me try some)

it was okay. Alot smaller bottles than I thought, however my guests loved them. The wood crate they came in was a little dangerous, because the wood seemed to have come apart and the nails were sticking out. Other than that, Id probably purchase again with diffrent packaging.

Years earlier I had purchased this similar item for a LOT MORE - but your product was JUST AS DELICIOUS and the savings was TERRIFIC!  I even sent one to my son (naturally I had to order one for our family, too!).  Will definitely purchase from you in the future - Thanks again!
I bought these for my mother for her birthday and she loved themcrate is not well made...fell apart before I gave her them

column9: were those out of shelf life?
column10: I purchased this item for my father. Since time was limited and I had to buy the item online. The delivery was rapid and got them on time. No complains on that part. However, the item was not so in a mint condition. The wraps of the chocolate were stuck to thr chocolate and were hard to peel. Some chocolate didn't have liquor that was supposed be in. it was leaked to the bottom of the case. I wanted to return the item but most of them were okay condition abd I had to take it the next day so I didn't.I was very satisfied with delivery but not with the product. They should check the item more carefully before sending it.

The center was not liquid, but was more like a gel. There was a hole in the bottom of each candy where the liquid leaked out and was stuck to the crate! Chocolate didn't taste good either...outdated??

column9: Use this as business promotion gifts...Clients RAVE about this product
column10: I have had nothing but GREAT comments from clients who have received this as a thank you gift for their business.  I keep coming back to this product.  Can't beat it for the price & free shipping.  I am ordering another one today: 1/27/2012 and I have been ordering these for the last 6 months.  Only once did amazon not do a good job packing this product, but I still received more business from the client upon receipt of the chocolates.  I am self employed & do not have a big budget for marketing.  I love this vendor & this product!

I brought this as a gift for a friend. These candies are real small. The chocolate was great tasting but to me all the flavors taste the same. If you live in Florida or California make sure you do not order this when it is warm out because you will have a mess. Mine came perfect, a little melted but I expected that . It was not bad. I through it in the fridge and it was perfect after all. Great gift to order in the Winter time. Make sure the recipients home when it comes.
Great item bought before and always loved them makes great gifts. Highly recommend. You can not go wrong with this item. Give as a present.

I purchased 2 boxes for my parentsPros: Received within a week. Reasonable priced.Cons: It was shipped in a large box with no packaging so they were all messed up when I received it.Some were leaking and had dried to the wrapper which was hard to get off but some where good.My mother complained but my dad didn't.
I was a little disapointed as they were a gift. The shipping was not adequate and consequently the case for the chocolates came loose and some of the liqueurs had leaked and were sticky.
product arrived very fast and in good condition,they are good but not exacle what i thought they would be,but ill enjoy them anyway.

My parents both love chocolate, and drink fine drinks every now and then, so I figured this would be a great gift.  You'll have to ask them how they taste, but on my end this was a great productPros:-Quick Shipment-Excellent Presentation in the box-Great selection of Liquers - Grand Mariner, Stolichnaya Orange (great with chocolate I presume),Jim Beam, and Remy Martin.Cons:Lots of tape on actual product, took some work to remove without messing up the label or wood.Great product overall - Would be great gift for parents, or any chocolate lover.

Just received in the mail and an when I opened it package the box is in pieces. Have to fix the whole thing before can use as a gift. Very cheap and terrible quality. Prepare to do some work if you are gifting it if not then just enjoy.

column9: Boxes arrived broken with the bottles strewn about
column10: I just received my 2 crates.  They were both broken on the bottom, which is I guess what dislodged the bottles from their holder.  I will obviously have to fix it up quite a bit before I give them as gifts.
Liquor Filled Chocolate Bottles [36CT Display]Great candy. I would purchase this item again.
THIS IS A CHRISTMAS PRESENT BUT I FEEL THAT THE PERSON IT IS FOR WILL LIKE IT VERY MUCH. I HAVE NOT RECEIVED IT AS OF YET.

column4: David J. Hess "the dude and dudette"
column10: Being pregnant I somehow decided that I absolutely needed a snow cone machine. Watermelon is my favorite flavor so I bought this gallon size to last the summer. Have to say that I love making snow cones with this flavor. When I first opened it up and smelled it I thought it was cough syrup. Luckily, when mixed with the ice that smell goes away and you get that watermelony flavor. I would buy this again.

Anyone who has been to France has to fall in love with French food.  The cheeses, the wines, the bread and in this case the pickles!  They are a little more sour than an American pickle, but once you accept the difference, these pickles are terrific.  We eat them with raclette, the fabulous cheese to melt and enjoy with bread or potatoes.  I am so grateful to be able to get cornichons here.  Maille also makes great dijon mustard.

column9: Top Quality, you should do better locally
column10: We are addicted to these little pickles and keep at least one spare jar on the shelf. They are much crisper and cleaner than the other jarred brands sold on here and in stores.  Many of the brands of cornichones sold in local chain supermarkets taste bad. I have had only two that compare in France. These are not sweet, nor overly sour but well spiced.  They are not overpowered by vinegar.  They are near perfect pickles for putting with high quality cold meats and cheeses.  Great for tuna.  Nice in or alongside crusty breads and grainy mustard.  Fruity wine or all kinds of beer pair well.  Slice the long way for hot dogs and sausages on a bun.I like the pull up insert that takes the place of going spear fishing or sticking your fingers down, or worse, spilling out the brine.See if you can get them for about $7 per jar locally.  The shipping is too costly on top of a higher than happy unit cost.

I brought a jar of the Maille Cornichons back from Paris this year and was determined to find some state-side.  I had read that the ones found in the states are made in Canada and not as good.  But, I found these absolutely delicious and will be buying more.
Not what I expected for the price, $15 for 2 jars.  More of a vinegar flavor than mustard.  Can purchase the same quality at local stores at a much cheaper price.

As far as Louisiana style sauces go, this is one of the best and cheapest. Most any"local" type establishment you visit in and around New Orleans will have a bottle ofCrystal on the table. Its not hot at all, maybe a 3 on a 10 scale, but the flavorparticularly for your basic generic Cajun spread is fantastic.The best thing about Crystal is that its not only available at most retail outlets, butits cheap. Locally this 6oz. bottle can be had for $0.69. Comparatively, the 2oz. bottleof Tabasco costs $1.59 at the local grocery so it pays to have a couple of bottles ofCrystal laying around. Its also a beautiful stunning red color that I've learned toappreciate over the years of sampling all the Louisiana style sauces. Next to Chef Paul'sMagic Pepper Sauce, this is my favorite.Good in stews, gumbos, on fish, chicken and pork when you want all the flavor withoutthe burn. If you're cooking for friends they wont mind you throwing in liberal dosesof this stuff. 5 ScoviesBTW, I've been a fan of Crystal for a long time and when they introduced their new ExtraHot Sauce recently I got so excited I wrote the company a letter. Well a week later I gota personal note back from the president of Baumer Foods thanking me for my business, andhe included 2 coupons for any size Crystal Hot Sauce. These guys are doing it right!

column9: Product is fine but postage is too high
column10: I ordered 1 lb of Sorghum flour from Barry Farm Foods. The flour is fine and costs $1.99 but the postage cost was $7.50! That is really too much compared to the cost of the product. I think the postage rates should be stated clearly before the product order is confirmed.Regina T.L.H.San Francisco

My husband and I just looked at each other after eating one of the lemon wafer cookies and sighed.  The flavor is pure deep natural lemon, tart and bright, with a sweet creamy finish--nothing like any other lemon-flavored cookie I've ever bought.  Honestly, these are just terrific little cookies.And when we thought it couldn't get better, we tried the chocolate.  Natural, dense, delicious, dark chocolate taste.We plowed through both bags just going back and forth: lemon, chocolate, lemon, chocolate....No gross artificial taste.  No waxy texture to the cream.  No meek, bland flavors.  Just all-natural goodness that will blow your socks off.Time for another bag.

It is a very tasty treat I enjoy with my afternoon coffee. However, all good things must be had in moderation, and hence I will only buy one pack at a time from the local store.However the price on Amazon is competitive.I don't know why it was tagged as "not vegetarian" because I don't see any questionable ingredient on the list - perhaps someone else can elaborate.The dark chocolate filling has a nice creamy texture without being overwhelming; and nor is it cloyingly sweet.Overall all, I definitely recommend this product.

These are the greatest wafer type cookies I have ever eaten. I've also tried the lemon ones which are out of this world as well. They are wafer type but are cut into small cubes (ideal for snack size) instead of how they usually appear as a longer stick. They are very creamy and have a high quality chocolate taste. Awesome stuff. You'll only be sorry when they are gone and you have eaten too much.

ALL I CAN SAY IS OMG!THESE LITTLE TREATS ARE SO ADDICTIVE AND ONLY HAVE 10 GRAMS OF SUGAR IN NINE WAFERS!THESE ARE BY FAR THE BEST TASTING WAFER COOKIES I HAVE EVER HAD AND IF IT WERE NOT FOR ME BEING ON A DIET, WOULD EAT THE WHOLE BAG IN ONE SITTING!I CAN'T QUITE DESCRIBE THE FLAVOR EXCEPT TO SAY IT IS LIGHT, RICH AND NOT TOO SWEET.I HAVE NEVER BOUGHT THESE FROM AMAZON, JUST FROM MY LOCAL HEALTH FOOD MARKET.BUT THE PRICE ON AMAZON IS CHEAPER COMPARED TO BUYING IT LOCALLY WHERE I AM.
My wife loves these little wafers, but our local stores no longer carry them.  Amazon to the rescue!  Great product, fast shipping.  We are very happy and will continue to order these.
delicious hazel nut taste in a cunchy bite- size wafer cookie. highly recommended. will buy these again.remind me of the hazel nut coffee creamer

These Loacker Quadratini Lemon Wafers are the best I've tasted. They are natural with a real lemon 'punch' in every bite. Plus they are not overly sweet like some other wafer brands. I will definitely buy this brand again. (Since you get eight bags in the order, I gave my mom a bag, my sister a bag, and a friend a bag of these wafers and they all told me the same thing...they love them, what great lemon taste, etc. and wanted to know where they could purchase them.)

column9: Bet you can't eat just one!
column10: Previously, these lemon wafer cookies were sold at Wal Mart; however, they no longer carry them.  Recently, I discovered that Trader Joe's carried a chocolate version and I inquired if they carried the lemon but no, they discontinued carrying the lemon as well.  So, I googled and found that Amazon.com was a source for the cookies.  YES, I can now satisfy that craving for a truly lip smacking little lemon wafer.  While I ordered only one box of them the first time, I will be ordering two boxes the next time--I have a friend and her husband who also enjoy puckering up!  Try them, you will love them!

I tried this product at a friend's house and had to get some for myself.  I was delighted to find them on Amazon for half the price listed on another so called wholesale site.  These make a great treat and would make a wonderful gift if you can keep your hands off of them.  Everyone who tried mine thought they were much better than they had expected from such a simple product.  Having no hydrogenated oils is a definite plus, but watch the saturated fat if cholesterol is an issue for you.
I love these cookies!  what can I say. They are worth buying in bulk!  Yum. Bet you can't eat just one.
These are super high quality wafers. I have had many kinds and this brand is the best I have ever had.
DELICIOUS WAFERS. I FIND THAT EUROPEAN WAFERS ARE LESS SWEET ( LESS SUGAR AND CARBOHYDRATES) BUT VERY DELECTABLE.

we have polished off the hazelnut and are moving next to the vanilla--along with more hazelnut! the price here is very good--i paid $5.49 per bag at Duane Reade. But, like one of the other reviewers, if I buy 8 here, oh they will be GONE! i'm not one for moderation when it comes to treats that i love.

I first tried these cookies while visiting family in Panama.  They were available at the local grocery stores.  When I came back to the U.S. I couldn't find them locally but thank goodness for AMZAZON, I found them and at an affordable price.  I order a carton of eight packages and share them with friends.  They are a delightfully light and fresh tasting treat that soon become nearly addictive.  I have tried some of Loacker's other flavors but the lemon is my all time favorite.  I am tempted to subscribe to them!!

column9: Real Nice. Light Fresh Lemon Taste. Mmmmm.
column10: Here's another of the little items I find in my nearby Fresh and Easy store. It's a British company and they have a lot of imported items. This trip I picked up a bag of Loacker Quadratini Lemon Wafer Cookies. Oh boy, are these good! They disappear real fast. Be ready to apply controls. They're very light and tasty and not overly sweet. The filing has a real light, fresh lemon taste. Real nice. Just right. Just give it a bite and a couple light chews and it's gone and your hand is involuntarily reaching for another one. Mmmmm. Now how am I ever going to keep these around the house? Well, I guess that a lot of others feel the same way. Did you notice that on the 33 reviews, 30 gave it five stars?Gary Peterson
I bought these for my mom and she loved them so much, she won't eat any other cookies. This from a 100 year old who is very picky!

These wafers need to come with a big warning "Addictive"! It takes a lot of self control to stop eating them.  If I did not exercise a lot of self control I would eat a whole bag. Wafers come in a resealable bag, and in theory can last a long time... but in my house the longest one bag lasted was 2 days!I bought the lemon flavor of Loacker's Quadratini wafers. They have a nice strong lemon flavor - nicely tart with a sweet creamy finish, crunchy and pleasant on your tongue. You can chew a wafer to get the pleasant crunch on just hold it in your mouth and let it melt slowly.  Either way you will get an extra ordinary taste experience!I am attaching a photo and two cookies shown from different angles.  Each cookie is 1 inch square. Each consists of 74% lemon cream and 26% wafer.Wafers have no artificial flavors or colorants, and no preservatives.Ingredients:Unbleached wheat flour, pressed coconut oil, glucose syrup, sugar, whey powder (milk), dextrose, soy flour, barley malt extract, lemon juice powder 2%, salt, leavening agents (sodium hydrogen cargonate, disodium diphosphate), emulsifier soy lecithin, natural vanilla pods, lemon-peel-oil, spices.Loacker wafers are made in Austria and Loackers company had been known for their wafers since 1925.Ohhhh, so good!  I signed up for regular deliveries with Subscribe & Save.Ali Julia review

column9: If you are trying to lose weight stay away.
column10: These are amazing and addicting.  It is hard to put them down after you start.  They have a good richness and is mostly filling not wafer.

These are essentially the yummiest, most delicate wafer cookies I've come across. The hazelnut tastes exactly like Nutella, perfect. Each little cookie is 0.5 Weight Watchers points, which is terrific for those of us watching our figures. I usually have four cookies (2 points) with my tea and am VERY satisfied. They taste so decadent. I'm going to try the Lemon next and hopefully will be able to track down the Espresso flavor!

I opened the box when I had two friends visiting!  They went home with at least two packages each as they were having weekend guests.  I still have a bunch.  They were a hit. They are so fresh and so satisfying. I just ordered the chocolate ones for next time.  I plan never to be without them.  I want them on the tea table always.  Trust me.  Read the label - they are great.So, I am adding to the review!  The two friends who were here when the cookies arrived,  I had shared some of the cookies with them  raved about the cookies, wanted to know where I got them and are ordering them.  One had a house full of guests and I had given her 2 sacks, knowing she was having Pumpkin Festival guests - she said they all want these cookies.  I think they are all natural products so that helps.  I have the chocolate ones in my shopping cart but am holding off as I am eating too many,  I ate - alone - one sack on the weekend.  I dare not open more this week.  You have to try these.  I am sure I did not dream about them.  They are not too sweet.  I think you can read the ingredients.  Great for people with braces.  Sigh!OKAY, OKAY, OKAY - I AM BACK TO ADD ON . . . I just bought the dark Chocolate - I don't even like dark Chocolate so I chose that as friends will like them for dessert and I won't be tempted (fat chance) to eat them.  I know I will.  These are the best cookies ever and my lemon ones went so fast.  You will love these cookies!

column9: HANDS DOWN THE BEST WAFER COOKIES EVERRR
column10: Oh my sweetness. These wafer cookies blow my mind!!!I'm not a big fan of waffles or wafers, I usually perfer chocolate chip regular cookies as my treat. Until my mom brought home this, which is a complete disaster because we both are completly like obsessed with it now even though we only bought like one bag at time (trying to have self-control here) Eventhoughe  me and my mom havent buy these on amazon yet but I just want to tell you guys how AWESOME those afer cookies are!!I mean I have never taste something this creamy and delicate. The dark chocolate flavored totally rocked my world~ and from seeing all the reviews makes me want to try the lemon ones so baddd.
This is a healthy snack.  If you can control yourself, just a few are satisfying.  The lemon isrefreshing with just the right taste of sweetness.  I keep them in stock.

column9: Loved the Dark Chocolate; now I want to try the Lemon...
column10: I ran across the dark chocolate ones in Italy at an Autogrill highway rest area.  There were snacks aplenty, but the picture on the bag + the fact that it had an extra 20% attracted me.  So, I got a 10.58 oz bag!  I find them satisfying after eating just a few.  It seemed like a never-ending bag.  I googled when I got home, hoping to figure out where to buy more, and ended up here.  I'm glad I did because, after reading some other reviews, now I'm anxious to try the lemon ones!
I bought almond flavor and wow, these are seriously the best tasting wafer snacks I've ever tasted.I am in love.  Can't wait until I try more flavors.
This wafer has the best tart and freshest  lemon flavor than any other lemon cookie ever!  Put them in the freezer and they taste is even better.

These wafers are PHENOMENAL! They are creamy, not too sweet (I had the regular chocolate ones) and perfect for whether you want just a few or a bunch. They are light and have a lovely texture. I bought these at World Market.

These little Loacker Quadratinis are delicious - in ANY flavor!!  Some flavors are hard to find (or to nab on Amazon, since they sell so quickly!) but you will never be disappointed by these perfectly bite-sized pieces of chocolate, or lemon, or tiramisu, or (my fave) hazelnut!!  You will be hooked on them!!  The only trouble you will have is knowing WHEN to STOP eating them!!  I LOVE THEM!! And I keep coming back to Amazon for more, as they have the very best price for the Loacker offerings!!

These are the best wafers I have EVER tasted. I have a sweet tooth and traveled the world (so I have tried many sweets) but nothing compares to these wafers.Also there is one other flavour Amazon does not seem to sell and that is the coconut wafers. Absolutely unbelievable taste and this is an understatement. It has the perfect combination of sweetness, flavor, size and once you start eating it you cannot stop.My favorite are Tiramisu, Lemon, Hazelnut and Coconut. The rest are fantastic too but I have my own I like the best. Italian products - cannot improve on perfect.Watch your waist line though  :P

I fell in love with the lemon flavor immediately I put it in my mouth. it's a perfect combination of sour taste with cream and sugar. I always eat chocolate, tiramisu, coffee..flavor, this is the first time I tred lemon, absolutely great. And if you put it in milk with cold cereal together with banana slices, perfect!
I love these little wafer cookies. They are wonderful. Great flavor, delicate crunch, and knowing that it's natural and nothing in it is genetically modified makes snacking feel better.

I love these cookies and they are difficult to find in most groceries stores. I was so thrilled when I discovered that I could order eight bags at a time through Amazon.com. They arrived quickly and in good shape! None were crushed. Now I can have my cookies and eat them whenever. I often give a bag as a thank you gift to friends. Then they become addicted too.
We bought some in grocery store by accident and all of us love it but price in store is bit high so we googled on line and found the direct sell.

I actually was in San Francisco when I first tried these wafers. I fell in love with them instantly. When I got home I tried hopelessly  to find them in my area, with no luck at all. Thank goodness for AMAZON I now can enjoy them without having to drive almost 5 hours to San Francisco. And if I may add very reasonally priced.
