Bottled comfort food is always a plus.This has a nice smokey chipotle flavor without being over done.  It's not too hot which is wonderful but gives you that right amount of zest to whatever Mexican dish you decide to use it with.  Personally I found it wonderful as a salad dressing.  I have also used this with some pulled chicken for sandwiches and OMG it is awesome.  Better than barbecue sauce.Taco Bell has given us a rich creamy sauce with delicious smokey flavor that's not too much and not too little.  Got a hankering for Taco Bell then just pull up some of this sauce and whatever you have in leftover in the frig.

column9: We did not enjoy this sauce
column10: I love chipotle flavoring...normally. I've had some Chipotle Ranch sauce that was good and so I thought this might be worth a try. My family did not care for it. It didn't taste like real chipotle but I guess I shouldn't be surprised because Taco Bell isn't real mexican food (to me). I wouldn't recommend this if you are at true chipotle lover

column9: Taco Bell hits the trend for home use
column10: Yep, this is the snazz!  Try it on tacos and burritos, salads that need some zip, or even non-ethnic poultry and beef, if you've tried anything chipotle in the past you're in for a treat.  Most excellent job!  Taco Bell may not be authentic Mexican, but they know how to create some very tasty stuff, and here's their latest that's worth my highest recommendation.

column9: Good to add to chicken quesadillas
column10: I've never had chipotle sauce before, so I don't have much to compare it to.  I got this sauce so that I could add it to my homemade chicken quesadillas and add a unique flavor.  Before I close up the tortilla while on the stove, I add a little of this chipotle sauce to add some spicy flavor to the dish.  It's not my favorite flavor and it doesn't really come close to whatever sauce Taco Bell puts in their own chicken quesadillas, but it's good to add now and then to add some variety to my meals.I'd say if you're a fan of Taco Bell's other chipotle-flavored items, you will probably like this.

The Chipotle flavor is not overwhelming in this. It has a nice spicy flavor, but it isn't too hot. To me it worked better with like taco salads or sandwiches I wanted to punch up rather than being of much use on normal Mexican staples like tacos or fajitas. A nice ranch substitute if you like spicier food.

This is a really good sauce with a little kick of heat. It goes really well on fish tacos or even regular tacos, but there are plenty of other items that it works well with. Definitely give it a buy here or at your grocery store.

If you want to add a little kick and lots of flavor to your chicken then I recommend this.  Yes it can be used with other meats, fish, and veggies - but personally I think it was best on grilled Chicken.Now then...I would not buy a 6 pack before you try this stuff....if it is not to your liking then you are going to get stuck with extras.  :)Great product for us and something we all enjoy.

So my husband enjoyed this sauce and added it to things that he wanted a little kick to.  It is tasty but not spicy.  The sauce has a little kick and was something hubby would use when he just wanted to add a little flavor but not too much spice.  He actually liked it as a salad dressing to change up the usual rotation.  All in all the ingredients are not too bad but not what we typically eat.  If you want a creamy sause to add some flavor to a bland dish, this would certainly do the job.

I was expecting this to be a bit spicier than it is.  I won't go as far as saying it's bland, but it tastes a bit like a spicy ranch dressing.  The bottle describes it as being bold and creamy; creamy yes, but bold... not so much.  Nonetheless, it's a refreshingly unique taste and I found myself using it on a variety of foods.  And not necessarily only Mexican.  In addition to the traditional uses on Mexican dishes, I used it in lieu of mustard on meatloaf sandwiches as well as ham sandwiches.  The Chipotle Sauce added a different and pleasing taste to each.

I decided to try this product, not because of the Taco Bell brand, but because I like chipotle flavor. Quite honestly, I'm not a real fan of these type of branded product.The sauce has a little bit of bite, what I consider mild. But it may be a little too strong for children. Different from many chipotle sauces, Taco Bell's has a stronger tomato flavor. It is very true to the chipotle sauce used in their products.I didn't really care to have this sauce on my tacos or burritos. It does make an interesting seasoning for tamale and enchilada casseroles. I also added a little mayonnaise and made salad dressing. Others may like the sauce on a salad undiluted.While this isn't going to a standard in my kitchen, I will purchase it for special meals.

column4: Kenneth J. Kohutek "Kenneth J. Kohutek, Ph.D."
column10: While no one would confuse Taco Bell for a gourmet restaurant, this sauce surpasses the drive through reputation. I found it to be a tasty topping for tacos, salads, as well as adding flavor to my breakfast eggs. Not too spicy but a good flavor. Although I initially sampled this through the Vine program, I will order this product in the future.

I like Taco-Bell...Not love but like.The Chipotle sauce at the actual restaurant is a little better but still not fabulous. So I was not expecting greatness but was still disappointed.The sauce was more like a ranch dressing with some coloring and not enough spices added in. it was not nearly spicy enough. I needed to add hot sauce just to get near the flavor I was looking for.Disappointed!!

column9: Better than I expected, not bad, fairly spicy.
column10: OK, so I'm no connoisseur of Chipotle sauces, but this tasted OK to me.  Creamy and fairly spicy for a commercial sauce.  I actually liked it, to my surprise.  Better than I expected.  Terribly unhealthy ingredients, though, if that matters to you.  A small serving has 110 calories of which 100 come from fat.  Yikes!  Still this is just a sauce, so I don't consider that too big deal, but mention it for those who might.Bottom line, yes, this is good on chicken and adds a nice smoky, spicy flavor which is what you want.
Really delicious. Love having it in the fridge as an alternative to ketchup on potatoes, rice, even Mac & Cheese. Better than the sauce they use in the Taco Bell stores.
This Taco Bell Chipotle sauce is pretty good, and makes a nice addition for a taco.  It wasn't very spicy, so I would have liked it better if it had a little heat, but the flavor was nice.

Taco Bell has recently launched a new line of sauces you can add to your food.I use this on sandwiches, wraps, and tacos, the chipotle flavor is nice, thick, and long lasting.A strong taste, I highly recommend it and the ranchero flavor

The sauce was great. I enjoyed it with some tacos and later with some frozen taquitos.  Both were improved by adding this sauce -- pretty generously, since it was so good.I didn't think it was spicy -- so if you're looking for a kick, look elsewhere.  It was a great taste, just no kick.My disappointment -- the drop in a star -- is that the product expired within just a few weeks of getting it.  Maybe it sat on the shelf for a while, I don't know, but I was a little bummed to throw out half of the bottle because it expired.So, I would be concerned if I were purchasing 6 of these (as a pack).  Do they ship with only a few weeks left?  I hope my situation was an anomaly, and others can comment on what their expiration dates were.

The word "chipotle" gas been thrown around a lot in recent years, but the fact remains that it is a delicious ingredient in mexican food. I honestly didn't really have high hopes for a taco bell sauce sold in bottles, but I was pleasantly surprised by this sauce. It is by no means gormet, but it does go well with most tacos an burritos I have tried it on, even those which were homemade. Give it a try!

column9: Easily my favorite of the bunch
column10: Of all the new Taco Bell sauces currently available, this one is easily the best and stands head and shoulders above the rest of the pack in terms of flavor.For those not familiar with these new sauces, they are significantly different than the standard packet hot sauces served in the actual Taco Bell restaurant, going for a creamy and smooth flavor rather than adding heat. In comparison to the other varieties available, the Chipotle version isn't as mild as the Jalapeño sauce and doesn't have the overly tangy, almost bitter flavor of the Spicy Ranchero.It works great for things like home made tacos or even for dipping fries, but can also shine in more adventurous dishes.  I used it with surf and turf burritos made with steak and cilantro-lime shrimp, and it definitely added a fantastic finishing flavor.
I added this to turkey sandwiches and it really made for a good sandwich.  Careful on the amount though.  Two Tbsp is 110 calories!  Certainly better than mayonnaise and a change from mustard.

We use this sauce on taco salads where it adds just the right amount of spiciness for our taste. It is not wildly hot, but has a decent kick to it for northern California, anyways. Not a lot else to say other than the squeeze bottle is very convenient.

. . . my family liked!As noted in previous reviews, my family has tried all three of the new Taco Bell sauces.  The Jalepeno and the Ranchero met with decidedly mixed reviews, and I don't have any particular intent to purchase them again.This sauce, however, my family, especially my kids, really liked.  We eat a fair amount of "Tex-Mex" at our house, and the fridge is typically full of sauces of various types.  This one was spicy -- but not overpowering, and had a really nice flavor.This one will be a repeat purchase.

I'm running out of ideas to put this excellent sauce on. Great on salads , nacho chips , even spread on a bagel. This is the product to buy if you like the chipotle taste. But remember , a little goes a long way. A great value for the $$$$$ , as the bottle really lasted a long time , due to the small amount used in each serving.

column9: A great surprise from Taco Bell
column10: When I saw the name Taco Bell on this product, I wasn't expecting much. I don't dislike their food, but I find their seasonings rather bland and ordinary. One taste of this sauce changed my mind completely. Why don't they serve stuff like this in the Taco Bell restaurants? This snappy, creamy sauce is so good I found myself putting it on and in all sorts of things. I even started mixing it with mayo in my chicken and tuna salad. It goes great on all meats, especially chicken and hamburger. I've also added it to the lettuce and tomato I've put in sandwiches just to see how it tastes, and it was a hit. Hats off to Taco Bell for coming out with such a tasty product. Chipotle has really gained in popularity over the past few years, and this is a welcome addition to the product mix.

I liked this one and I was relieved to see there is no MSG included in the ingredients list, unless they're hiding it under an unfamiliar name. It's spicy but not hot spicy, creamy and tastes good. I used it as a dip for chicken strips and think it would make a good dressing for taco salad and in burritos.

I received this right before I left town for a week.  While I was away, my kids decided this looked great, so they had it with tacos one night.  They all (ages 10-14) reported that it was great... a different flavor than the salsa they are used to.  But that was about all they could tell me.This evening, I made up something fajita-ish for dinner for most of the family.  There was still some of the bottle left, so most of the kids used a little with that.  Since I was home, I was able to pull out a bit more information from them.  My non-spicy food kid said that this was maybe a little too spicy, but it was a different spicy.  My "can't get it hot enough" kids said that this isn't very spicy, but they like the flavor.I had a mexi-salad, and used this as salad dressing.  It was really quite good that way.  I loved it with the garden-fresh tomatoes especially.  It is thicker than a traditional dressing, but I just made an effort to toss it all together a bit.I could taste the chipotle in the sauce.  I think it would be excellent in scrambled eggs when I'm throwing in mexican-type veggies (peppers, tomatoes).  This is something I will purchase again.

I'm not a big fan of Taco Bell since their food all taste the same but I was pleasantly surprised by these new sauces.  The Chipotle sauce has a very bold smoky flavor and it goes well with any kind of meat and I would imagine it would top chili quite well, too.  It adds a nice zing to a dip.  I find these sauces quite versatile.  I've even put them on salads.  It's less hot than the Jalapeno sauce but has deeper undertones of flavor, more Mexican.  It must be the cumin.  So ditch those wimpy taco sauces and try the new sauces from Taco Bell.

I like chipotle sauce as well as cajun remoulade sauce. This seems to combine the essence of each, with a nice smokehouse touch.This tastes great on eggs, noodles, chicken, pretty much anything you like to sauce up.Taco Bell takes a ribbing on TV shows for its food, but this is a wonderful product. Maybe they should send some to the late night TV comedians!

I've tried the Jalapeno and the Ranchero and this is my favorite out of the 3. It isn't very hot but you can taste the spices.I prefer this sauce more than most of the dipping sauces you would get from the local fast food chains.This is great on chicken nuggets and almost anything breaded. I also love it on homemade burgers.It is a guilty pleasure I enjoy from time to time.

column9: Very Tasty and Perfect for Tacos with a Zest
column10: I truly enjoyed this product.  It has the right blend of spice and tastes very well on taco and other snacks. Recommend to the person who likes a little spice in their life!
This is pretty good on tacos or as a dipping sauce.  It's not too hot and is creamy and thick.

column9: If you like Taco Bell's mild or medium sauces, you'll probably like this too
column10: Tasting like a mixture of tobasco and liquid smoke, you can use it for topping on tacos, or perhaps taco salad. I would use it somewhat sparingly as the flavor is a bit overwhelming, in my opinion.  While it is not terribly spicy. it does have a rather strong flavor.Those who like to use Taco Bell's medium or hot sauces on their food would probably like this as well.(Personally, I didn't care for it, as it sort of made me want to barf.) I'm more of a "pico de gallo, or chunky salsa" kind of person.

Like the other Taco Bell sauces, this one is also tasty and full of the patented Taco Bell flavor. Good with fajitas and taco salads. I mixed with some hot sauce to give it a bit more kick (not that much as is).

column9: If you are hungering for some Taco Bell - this is the sauce for you!
column10: Interestingly, even when comparing with other sauces, this immediately brought to mind Taco Bell.  I never realized their sauces were so distinctive.With regard to the sauce itself, the consistency is thick, tasting like a mayonnaise base with some BBQ Sauce added and then mixed with some chipotle (minus the seeds). Mildly warm, extremely creamy... certainly not bad... more like comfort food - what you would grab in the middle of the night, not what you would feed to honored guests.So... it fills the bill for standard fare, but would be just as easy to make your own and cut down some of the fat and salt (of which this sauce has a ton of both!!!) and pick up some extra flavor and "freshness". Hope this review is helpful.All the best,Jay

This is a seasoned creamy sauce.  Four of us tried this sauce, and we all liked it, though the consensus was that it was best used in moderation.  It has a pleasant, seasoned flavor, but is not hot or spicy.

I like using various types of sauce on such foods as tacos, taco salads, hamburgers, etc. This is the first time I've used a chipotle sauce and just loved it! The smoking flavor was just perfect for the tacos that I fixed. My daughter tried it and liked it as well.It was thick enough, but not too thick, for something that we ate with our hands (the tacos). The flavor was good, the sauce was not too hot for those who like a more temperate taste. Basically it was a good middle of the road sauce as far as the heat factor, while providing a great taste for anyone who wants something a little different.

column4: Jeff Wignall "The Joy of Digital Photography"
column9: Kind of an interesting taste, but nothing I crave
column10: I'm not a big fan of Taco Bell food, but I've tried a few of their sauces and they're really not that bad. This one is a little tangy, a little smokey, but personally I think it could use a bit more bite. That said, though, I'm really not sure where it work best. I've actually tried it as a salad dressing (not too bad) and on grilled chicken (a little watery for that) and I'm going to try it on grilled shrimp this weekend, I hope.I keep a lot of different sauces around the kitchen for those days when food starts to bore me and while this sauce won't necessarily save a meal, it's not a bad dipping sauce for chicken or even with scrambled eggs. No matter what sauces or dressings I use I seem to spice them up more anyway, so really this is just a base dressing and for that it's fine. I also use Newman's Own Salad Dressing, Caesar, 16-Ounce Bottles (Pack of 6) in the same way--even though it's probably just meant to be a salad dressing.If you're lactose intolerant, read the label: most of these Taco Bell sauces contain milk-based whey and you might want to avoid it or take Lactaid with it. So far it hasn't bothered me.

This sauce has a smokey taste to it but it is not Chipotle chilies,and forget about any heat!  I have had other companies Chipotle Sauces and they have had more heat than this one, I think when they tried to make it creamy they lost the Chipotles taste somewhere!! I would however buy this again for a flavor enhancer...

What's not to love?Great companion for tacos, taco salads and wraps, but works equally well as a dip or topping for chicken, meat loaf, chopped steak, hamburgers or any sandwich.Handy way to kick up many ordinary meals instantly.This is the second sauce we've tried and we've liked them both.

column9: Resturaunt Style Sauce for the Home
column10: I've long been a fan of Taco Bell's sauces and have often taken a few dozen packets of their mild sauces home to use in my own creations.  Problem was that I couldn't take any of the larger sauces home like their chipotle sauce due to the fact that they don't keep any in the main lobby.  Fortunately, they decided to make a bottled version available for mass distribution so us amateur chefs could come up with our own mixtures.The sauce is good; I've been using it in my Mexican dishes such as quesadillas, tacos, and even some breakfast sandwishes.  It works well with just about anything I've put it on that requires a little more spice.  It certainly adds flavor.  I have yet to try and work it into anything fried or Italian (Taco Bell mild sauce works insanely well with sauted spaghetti meat), but I'm sure I'll figure it in somehow.All in all, a well worthy purchase.

column9: Tastes Good ... A Little Goes a Long Way
column10: What's there to say about Taco Bell Chipotle sauce?It tastes good: it's not spicy, but has a zing to it. It's kind-of creamy, and is loaded with flavor. Anyone familiar with Taco Bell will already know this stuff; it winds up on about 2/3s of the food offerings there.It is very calorically dense, at 160 calories per serving, and should - ideally - be used sparingly. A little bit does go a long way towards adding flavor (and extra fat) to meats. I used mine to flavor ground-beef for stuffed peppers, on sandwiches as a condiment (in lieu of mayo), and as a 'dipping sauce' for grilled chicken. It has a great taste and is very palatable, but doesn't have any kind of nutritional value. It's best with a lean meat or dish, because the fat in the sauce adds depth to the taste of whatever you're eating.

column4: Megan Bostic "I am Creative Chaos. I may have...
column10: I thought this was nice and creamy and tasty.  I used it as a dipping sauce for grilled chicken.  However, if you're looking for hot, this barely passes.  The chipotle flavor is there, but not enough for my tastes.Also, it's not the healthiest condiment.  Two tablespoons is 110 calories, 11g fat, and 300 sodium.  If you're looking for healthy, you should stick with salsa.If you're not worried about labels, and you like mildly spicy, this product is for you.

column9: Pretty good, but not sure what to do with it yet
column10: This is a smoky, creamy, and just very mildly spicy sauce.  If that's what you're looking for you'd likely enjoy it a lot, but for me, it made figuring out just what to do with it a little difficult.  Typically when I make tacos, etc, I just use salsa, sour cream, and sometimes hot sauce, so I'm struggling a bit to figure out where this fits in exactly.  It tastes good, but seems almost unnecessary.One use that seems to work pretty well is adding it to a taco salad.  It's kind of a nice addition to keep the flavors a bit more interesting and I might keep some around for that.  It could also add a bit of variety to sandwiches if one is in the mood for something a little different than the norm; perhaps on a southwest style Panini or similar.  I might also try it for dipping chicken nuggets or wings, etc.Overall it seems like a pretty good product, but not something I'd be likely to use daily or even a couple times a week, so I may pick up a bottle every now and then but I probably won't buy a 6-pack of them.  I would rate it perhaps 4 stars on taste but it loses a few points for versatility since it's not really hot sauce, taco sauce, salsa, sandwich spread, or salad dressing, it's kind of something else that I have trouble classifying.

column9: Very good as a chicken dip
column10: I enjoyed it as a chicken dip for roasted chicken. Very nice, a flavor I would buy again. I tried 2 flavors. Second was Spicy Ranchero, which I liked a little less.

This sauce taste is more like an Italian dressing but not a good one is too salty and is hard to find the chipotle on it, I didn't like it the flavor is too artificial for me is like a blend not well made.

Because of the color and "cream" I expected this to be very cheesy, like a nacho cheese sauce. It isn't, it is more sophisticated than that. You can definitely taste the chipotle, but it also has a mustardy-tang going on. It anycase it was delicious on tacos.

First the texture is like thin ranch dressing. It is not overly spicy. It is smooth, smoky, and has enough spice in it to be tasty but still not overpowering. The main ingredient is soybean oil if you ask. I tried it with burritos. It worked out great. I believe it works with burgers or tacos as well. I am even thinking using it as dipping sauce for chips if I cannot find the real one. It is is a good new sauce to try.

This tea is a true English luxury, but once you taste it, it is difficult to be satisfied with less than the finest tea this company makes. Yorkshire Gold tea has more flavor and character than most teas.The secret seems to be in the high quality of the teas selected for Yorkshire Gold and in the shape of the tea bag which allows for the tea leaves to spread out more and I think this enhances the ability for a full tea flavor to develop.This tea blend is perfect to steep along with a cinnamon stick. It is strong enough to serve with whipped cream and a dash of nutmeg.The art on the box was painted by Lizzie Sanders and it sets a nice English mood for your tea drinking experience.~The Rebecca Review

column9: Yorkshire Gold Tea is the best
column10: I had to give up coffee and remembered trying this tea on a business trip to North Yorkshire, England. I love this Tea, drink it twice a day. When I wake in the morning and again in the afternoon. This is my third purchase through Amazon.

I absolutely love this tea, it has completely replaced coffee in my home.. and I loved coffee! The flavor is so rich, smooth, complex and I just want another cup after another! It is incredibly satisfying and I can't see how I lived for so long without it! This tea will relax you and warm your soul. You simply need to try it for yourself.

column9: A tea that confuses me - in a good way
column10: Simply put, this tea is incredible.  I would say I like tea, but I never really crave any tea...except this one.  A cup of this in hand, sitting in a leather recliner and you'll find utter relaxation.  The flavor is so rich and distinctive, after you've had just a couple cups over time, you can nearly taste it when thinking about it.  What's confusing to me is that I'm not a fan of bitter flavors (not a coffee drinker), but I brew this dark and drink it straight and I love it (and it is a solid, black tea).  I'm surprised at the price here...seems very inexpensive (usually I pay more in speciality import stores...seems I'm throwing money away).
Taylor's is an excellent tea.  An old roommate of mine from England foisted it on me several years ago, and I haven't looked back. HIghly recommend.

column9: Original Idea---Kombucha from a Tea! And Decaf, too!
column10: *****This Organic Green Tea Kombucha Decaf from Yogi Tea is certainly unique. It tastes like a mixture of passion fruit, plum, ginger, and green tea. It is mild, and not bitter at all, even when you leave the tea bag in the whole time you drink the tea, as I do. Best of all, it is an easy, convenient way of benefiting from Kombucha, if you don't grow your own (and I don't anymore, as it is not easy or convenient for me). I have never before obtained my Kombucha from a tea; this is a tasty way to do so.I am definitely impressed with this tea and with Yogi Teas in general. Organic Green Tea Kombucha Decaf comes with an expiration date (a good thing, because it's not full of preservatives, plus you can tell if it is fresh). Yogi Tea seems to be another company (like Numi, Aspen, Traditional Medicinals) that values sustainable and healthy practices. Their web site has a helpful glossary of tea ingredients and is beautifully designed, with info about each tea they make.Yogi Tea writes this on the box about the tea's benefits: "Green Tea Decaf Kombucha uses the same delicious recipe as our Green Tea Kombucha but is naturally decaffeinated. Our organically certified CO2 decaffeination method removes only the caffeine while leaving all of the beneficial polyphenolic elements of Organic Green Tea (Camellia sinensis) intact. This method also maintains the antioxidant properties and delicate flavor of our delicious, organically-grown Green Tea.* Unlike other green teas, this special organic Green Tea has a delicate flavor with no bitterness. This formula incorporates the natural antioxidant properties of Green Tea with a concentrated, purified extract of Kombucha-Pure(tm). This extract is made from Kombucha grown in a unique medium of 32 supporting Chinese herbs and is produced without the use of refined sugar or black tea. For centuries, practitioners of herbal medicine have used Kombucha to detoxify the body, enhance the immune system, fight fatigue and soothe an upset stomach.* This convenient form of Kombucha can be taken daily for maximum health benefits."Yogi Tea's use of "Kombucha-Pure", grown in 32 Chinese herbs and WITHOUT black tea or sugar is very, very appealing, and a new and exciting way of producing Kombucha.Note that Yogi Tea also makes a caffeinated version of this tea that has exactly the same ingredients except that the organic green tea does include caffeine.Highly recommended.*****

Outstandingly delicious tea. I ordered one box just to try it and loved the taste! (Plus the fact that is has antioxidants and some other healthy goodies too). It was gone within a week . . . I must definitely order the 6 pack!

column9: The taste... well it may take some creativity
column10: As far as taste, what can we ask for? Plain with milk it's only passable. But heck, it's a hemp protein. Now there are ways of making it taste better and it's a nutritious product. Not too shabby is adding about a half of a decent sized frozen banana (a natural sweetener, thickener, and flavoring) to 8 oz of milk (I use organic fat free milk) to 3 tablespoons of the product. This tasted pretty good, and I would have no problem drinking it like this every day. So what I am saying is that for products like these that don't taste like a Steak and Shake milkshake or a Wendy's Frosty, one would need to experiment to find something that is suitable as far as taste to the consumer. I did think about giving four stars for taste, but it's not god awful and can be gotten around with a little creativity. Plus we are dealing with hemp here so I don't think it would be fair. This is the first hemp protein I have tried so maybe there are better tasting ones out there. However, since I like the way I made it above with the banana and may be able to find other good tasting concoctions, I may be just running risk and find something worse by seeking elsewhere. If I were to stick with this one, and I may, the bottom line then becomes final price. I am not a pure vegan although I do restrict meat intake and usually stick to salmon and chicken breasts when I do eat meat. So I use a supplement like this to fill in days when I don't get enough protein from animal products. I won't eat soy protein, trace amounts notwithstanding, and I would not put Splenda or sucralose (poison) in my system so I needed an alternative protein shake/smoothy. All the regular good tasting standard bodybuilding proteins use sucralose to sweeten them. Well, the ones I like and have used anyway. Even these latter mentioned ones that have the best relative taste, don't taste like an unhealthy milkshake anyway.Update 3/14/2012: Ok this is how I drink it now, and I love it. 8 oz of Pacific Brand organic oat non-dairy beverage (any kind of milk such as hemp, almond, or soy can be used), 1 medium banana, 1/2 cup of raw organic oatmeal (we buy this in the bulk section at Whole Foods), 4 tablespoons of this Hemp Protein, 1 packet of Sweet Leaf Stevia. This is my breakfast every other day. One can add a tablespoon of organic freshly ground (at the store which make it nothing but ground nuts) nut butter if you are not too worried about fat. To me the oatmeal really makes it great.

I really wanted to like this product, but it doesn't taste like much.  The organic cocoa powder doesn't seem to mix well, and the hemp...well, it's hemp, got a funny taste to it -- though nowhere near as intense and malodorous as that emanating from the company's Hemp Pro 70 line!  Anywhere, this one is okay.  If you want a plant-based protein from what seems to be a "progressive" company, this is probably the way to go.  Just understand that the taste is at best tolerable, even with cocoa powder and sugar among the ingredients!  That's how awful hemp tastes....

column9: Tastes good if you know what to mix it with
column10: mixing this with Almond milk and vanilla whey protein makes it taste exactly like a milk shake/ smoothy.  The key is to put it either in a blender or a closed waterbottle because it does require a lot of shaking/mixing

I love this powder. It has a good amount of protein and the omega 3's are a added bonus. Hemp is so good for you and is a great alternative to soy proteins. This is definitely a protein that you need to use in a smoothie, if shaken its very clumpy. Awesome for smoothies!

After trying SOOOO many powders we did settle on this one as being pleasing to the whole family.One of the problems we've had with a lot of the other protein powders is constipation (especially Garden of Life -- holy cow!)The taste of this product in middle-of-the-road; their not going to win any awards.  But if you add stuff (banana, nut butter etc.) I don't think the taste will be a deterrent.  As with all hemp powders it is a tad gritty.Nothing to write home about, but overall:1) My family prefers this one2.) I am good with the product and ingredients3.) It's affordable

This is very grainy and chalky like most other hemp powders I've tried. The taste is fine ( I like chocolate better than other flavors) but I also mix it with vanilla hemp milk, coconut milk, chocolate milk, or whatever else I feel like adding that morning. Tastes don't bother me as much as textures do so if you're like me then the grainy/chalky feel of this is going to be too much on it's own. I have to mix it up with the Nutiva brand hemp powder to smooth it out a little and make it stretch (because Nutiva is more expensive) but is the best that I've had so far.This is pretty much what I was expecting though and you have to remember it is a HEALTH shake and it isn't going to taste fantastic but you can do a lot to alter it more to your liking. If I actually used a real blender and added fruit and honey and some things like that to it the graininess could probably be cut down but I'm lazy and don't have time in the mornings to do that and I'm fine with what I do.

column9: The best hemp protein product I've found.
column10: I have tried a lot of hemp protein over the last several years and have found them to be undrinkable.  I actually enjoy this version and have probably gone through two dozen containers.  I blend it with bananas and either almond or coconut milk.  Outstanding!

I am not familiar with hemp producs at all. I never had anything like it but I love dark chocolate and the grocery store had free samples. So I got home and I mixed it with my coconut almond milk and some crushed ice and it was delicious. It was like gelato absolutely amazing but good for you! The milk has 45 calories and the pouch I got has 60 and it is full of amino acids and I omega 3 and 6 and other vitamins. I am ordering this for my late snack.
Taste great with almond milk. I also take 2 cocoawell tablets a day with this.  My digestion is a 100 times better...

column9: Awful tasting protein partially masked by rich chocolate - 4x as expensive as rice protein alternatives
column10: As an omnivore with a 100-200 gram daily protein intake, I am always looking to diversify my protein sources.  For protein supplements, I find the best value at Costco when purchasing Cytosport whey protein that costs approximately 2.2 cents per gram of protein.  Yet, it gets boring eating from the same six pound bag for months.  So, I recently evaluated two vegetable-based protein supplements: Nutribiotic Rice Protein and Manitoba Harvest Hemp Protein, both with chocolate flavoring.  While the Rice protein has great economics, tastes fantastic and contains few carbs, this hemp protein fails in all three categories.When I initially tasted Manitoba Harvest Hemp Protein, the first thought that came into my mind was "is this product really suitable for human consumption!?"  Olfactory memories from large-scale grass cutting arose.  Even with the rich dark chocolate, I can't consume this protein straight or even mixed with milk.  The pungent taste needs to be blunted with large amounts of cinnamon and Splenda and/or mixing with high protein cereals such as Kashi or Special K.Another undesirable aspect of this protein includes the large amount of carbohydrates:  2.1 grams for every gram of protein. The economics are underwhelming as well.  It costs about 10.8 cents per gram of protein versus 2.7 cents per gram for the Nutribiotic Rice protein or 2.2 cents per gram of protein for the Cytosport offering at Costco.ConsTerrible tasteHigh carb contentPoor economics ProsRich dark chocolate flavoring

I ordered this product hoping it would really change my mind about using whey or soy. I didnt. I have to mix it with my other protein just so i can drink it. It taste like dirt and grass. Not s very good product.

I really love the Vanilla Hemp Protein powder. It doesn't have a very strong vanilla taste, but it helps mask the super nutty flavor otherwise. Mixes well and tastes good to me! Throw in a banana or some fruit and ta da! Healthy, whole food that satisfies my hunger for a good long time. Definitely recommend!

With free shipping from Amazon, this product is considerably cheaper than available locally.  A Japanese friend got me hooked on these noodles.  Better quality than run of the mill ramen, sauce flavor and seaweed great too.  I don't use quite the whole envelope of the sauce mix when tossing on the noodles.

column9: Wow!  I'm so happy to have found these on Amazon!!
column10: These chow mein noodles are absolutely delicious!  They are so much better than typical ramen noodles.  The seasoning packet is a little bit sweeter, and these noodles aren't nearly as salty-tasting as the typical ramen noodles.  The seaweed also gives it an extra oomph.The price offered through Amazon is cheaper than anywhere else I've seen.  This is a good deal!One last thought:  I've noticed, and this goes for all the ramen noodles I've had, that adding a little bit of olive oil to the water as they cook brings out the flavor a little more.  Plus, the noodles won't glop together while trying to eat them.In any event, these are wonderful noodles - sometimes I get on a kick and eat these noodles every day for a week or so.  These are "gourmet" ramen noodles.  Ha!  Please do try them!
It is my favorite food, and it can be prepared in less than 10 minutes with minimal effort.  Absolutely perfect.

column9: The best instant Chow Mein noodles out there - BAR NONE
column10: UPDATE: Amazon no longer carries these, so I went to VeryAsia dot com and you can get the 24-pack for about $20-21 shipped!I've been a huge fan of Sapporo Ichiban chow mein noodles for what must be close to 20 years now.  They were always so hard to find at local stores that I often went months or even years without them. I remember going to the store and if they had them I'd literally empty the shelf for fear I'd never see them again.  Now they are here on Amazon for an affordable, great price!  These are not your average mediocre 'instant' noodle. Their unique flavor has no equal on the shelf. You have to get THIS particular one though...the one with the white package with the red stripes on each side, red and orange Japanese lettering on a yellow background. Beware of competing brands for they taste nowhere near as good! This is the one!

The first time I ate these noodles, I was quite disappointed.  They tasted terrible, and I could not see how they amassed such great reviews.  The second time I ate these noodles, I read the instructions on the package and realized I had made them wrong.These were meant to be eaten like a pasta; not like a soup as I had incorrectly assumed.  If you get these, don't make the same mistake I did in preparing them like a traditional ramen noodle bowl.  Drain the noodles from the water, toss them dry with the flavoring packets and some vegetables thrown in, and you'll be set for a delicious meal.When made correctly, these noodles are awesome.

I've eaten so much ramen in the past year due to not having a car on campus. It's easier to just buy a bunch in case i ever out of food  and won't starve when it's snowing outside.I decided to buy some online to find a better variety than just the chicken, beef or shrimp they offer at the store.I thought it would be thinner noodles but its not. The sauce packet (powder) tastes like worcestershire sauce like the reviews say, but thats all i tasted. The seaweed flakes didn't go so well for me either. There is a slight spice which is usual with the worcestshire. Personally it was just lacking something and wasn't all that appetizing.I will try adding ingredients and see how that goes. I think the preferred cooking method is stovetop for a reason.I don't think it's any healthier than maruchan ramen noodles either.It's made in the usa though, not that that says anything about it. Shipped super fast with chosen standard shipping.Overall judgement: I wish i could say i like it, but i don't.

Hi,These noodles are hard to find in my local grocery store so instead,I just ordered them from Amazon.com  When I drove out of town, I usedto buy them by the dozen and I always enjoyed them.  Each pack has a seaweed pack, and regular ramen noodle season pack, except it is somewhat sweet.  Sometimes your stomach doesn't want a bannana, a piece of cake or an apple for a snack, then you just eat one of these chow mein noodles and you are set.  You may also find it takes a while before your main meal is done, these don't take long before it is done.  You just add a little water, enough that it evaporates the noodles, and that the noodles have their soft & you could even overcook them about 2% so they have a little crisp and soft to them.  There's nothing more to it, they are either a snack or an appetizer dish.
I have purchased this product three times.  It is very good.  A tangy, spicy flavor.  The noodles not too thick, not too thin.  You can add meat or vegetables and have a delicious meal.

Quick easy meal, add some veg, some shredded meat and you're good to go!  I like a little more liquid than the package recommends to get more of a sauce.  Definitley add more water if you're adding veg and meat.

Bought these off Ramenbox.com and I was pleasantly surprised by the noddles. I did not know what to except because I could not figure out what flavor they were. Still unsure even after tasting them how to describe the flavor but it is definitely hint sweetness that is for sure.

These noodles take just a couple of minutes to make and there is only one flavoring pack.  IndoMie noodles are absolutely fantastic and cheaper, but take a little more effort to make - I buy both brands and use as the mood strikes me.  The reason I'm writing a review, however, is more about the price.  Every Asian store I've been to that sells this noodle pack charges around .68, so it's definitely worth buying these at an Asian store (though not all Asian stores sell Sapporo).  I'm hoping Amazon will start selling the boxes of these for less than the Asian stores sell single packets! (Hint . . . hint, Amazon.) Just a note,too - IndoMie noodles are about half the price of these, at least at the Asian markets.

I can't find this product in any local grocery stores any more, so I'm happy to have found it here online...and it comes directly to my house!This product used to be accompanied by a liquid flavor packet, which I thought was better, but either way, I really like the product.

I will start by being forthright about the negative aspects of this product. Mainly, that the noodles and sauce in Sapporo Ichiban's Yakisoba Chow Mein noodle pack are full of monosodium glutamate, a chemical "flavor enhancer" often found in Asian restaurants and store-bought Asian cuisine. The numerous studies done on the ingredient, however, have only yielded inconclusive results about the negative effects that MSG has on the body. The rule I follow is to try to consume all things in moderation. Although these are delicious, I prevent myself from overindulging for the sake of my own health.That said, these noodles are some of the best I have ever tasted and hardly have any majorly different ingredients from other mainstream noodle packs anyway. The seaweed packet goes great with everything else, and the predominant benefit for me is that THESE ARE VEGAN. For those of us who get depressed wandering through the ethnic food section of supermarkets searching through products with oyster and fish sauce and beef and chicken broth, this is the way to go. I like to fry some tofu and vegetables in a sautée pan before adding the noodles and it is SO GOOD. These are certainly not the most authentic noodles that you will find out in the world, but they are quick and filling and VERY SATISFYING and also CHEAP. It's hard for me to imagine a better deal.

Now that I know I can get these from Amazon, I won't have to special order them through my grocer.  I used to live in Japan, and I really enjoyed yaki-soba (Japanese noodles) when I lived there.  BTW - these ARE NOT ramen.  These have Ramen-like noodles, but the powder is yaki-soba flavored, and when you cook them the right way you end up with a flavored noodle, not a soup.  I like to add peas and meat...ham is best.  You can add other things, as well, but this is my lunch of choice when I am home on weekends.Believe it or not, these noodles capture the lion's share of flavor of the yaki soba shops and street vendors I used to frequent when I lived in Japan.5 yummy stars!Just make sure that you follow the directions that come on the back for best results!

first of all, this isn't chow mein. It's japanese yakisoba style instant noodles.me and my girlfriend love these noodles. I'm Korean and she's American, and lot of my favorite Korean noodles are too spicy for her.You can add many different types of vegetables to change things up.We use only half of the seaweed packet. We find it overwhelming when all is used.

column9: Tastes similar to Top Ramen but costs more
column10: I don't understand all the hype over this product! It's o.k., but Top Ramen is so much less!

I like this product because it seems to be less salty and probably has less MSG than normal ramen noodles. You are supposed to cook this with less water, and therefore less soup but I still make it like ramen and like it that way. It tastes different than ramen noodles yet is more satisfying to me.

These noodles are delicious and they are cheap.They're much better than other ramen noodles, but I don't follow the cooking instructions printed on the package.I cook them like this:1. Break up the noodles and put them in a microwavable bowl.2. Pour a cup of water over them.3. Cook for seven minutes in the microwave.4. Add seasoning and seaweed packet.5. Stir and eat.

I love these noodles.  They are my favorite "ramen" style packet food - but *NOT* ramen.  I've been calling them "chow mein" for some time, but other reviewers are right, they are Japanese Yakisoba style noodles.They are cheaper here on Amazon than I can find them in stores, but more importantly, consistently available.  Some local stores have them for $0.99-$1.25, but I have noticed they are incredibly difficult to find.  They seem to be carried randomly. I'll find a store that carries them, buy a dozen, and next time I go back they no longer carry them.The noodles are a wonderfully sweet, rich, salty, tangy-ish flavor.  Personally, I love them, but I know the flavor is NOT for everyone.  Every time I cook them, my husband always says, "ooh, that smells good, can I have a bite?" and immediately makes his "gross face" when he tastes it.  EVERY TIME.  So its a love-or-hate kind of food.  But me?  I LOVE them.  As a side note, they come with a small packet of green seaweed type stuff, but I hate the way it tastes (and even smells - ick!), so I always omit it.(And I'm a vegetarian, so these noodles are perfect for me.)Pros:- Quick to prepare- Flavorful- Cheap- Unique- VegetarianCons:- Sometimes inconsistent availability (outside Amazon)- Packet of green "stuff" (personal preference)- I wish they had a "1.5 packet" size. One packet is sometimes not enough, two is too much.

column4: bekor - "For the honor & glory of God!"
column9: Better Than Altoids Chocolate-covered Irish Mints!
column10: My son told me he'd found a replacement for Altoids chocolate-covered mints and introduced me to Hint Mint, a candy he'd found in his college store. They are cocoa-flavored with a hint of mint flavor, quite delicious. And there is no coating to melt the mints into a big glob should I leave them in the car in the middle of the summer (as is the case when I did that once with chocolate-covered Altoids). If you need just a little bit of delicious flavor but not a big snack, this is the treat for you.
I got these when I was at the beach and thought they weredelicious.  The quanity was much larger and the price muchbetter shopping through Amazon then at any store.
Excellent. I have tried many brands of pom juice and none have the taste and flavorthat Lakewood does. My local grocery store (HEB) quit carrying Lakewood brand so Iwill buy it online from now on.

Very nice flavor. The ingredients all contribute to good health. Tried the pure pomegranate, and the taste is a bit harsh. Would be better if Lakewood clarified what percentage of the juice is pomegranate. The 100% pomegranate is approximately double the price.  Perhaps this blend contains less than 50% pomegranate juice, without the vendor specifying, one is left to guess.

column9: LOOK B4 U BUY!  Not pure pom juice
column10: I was in a hurry.  Based on the part of the label I could read from the web site I thought I was buying 100% pure pom juice.  If you read all the verbage you will see this is just another blend of other juices.  It tastes like apple/pear/pom, in that order, not 100% pom juice.  I have been mixing this 50/50 with 100% pure pom juice just to get rid of the case I bought.  Mixed this way it tastes just fine, but if you are looking for 100% pom juice, keep looking 'cause this isn't it.  This company does make a 100% juice which is what I thought I was buying, as the labels are very similar.  Their 100% juice is great, but cost more.

Buyer beware! This is not pure pomegranate juice. Like another reviewer I was in a hurry and wanted to get some cheap pomegranate juice for my family. This juice is a blend of apple, grape, pomegranate and other juices. Do not buy if you want pure pomegranate juice. In retrospect, it makes sense since pomegranate prices are sky high. One big pomegranate costs $3.00 at our local supermarket now!

column9: Best gluten free pasta on the market
column10: I have been gf for years and Tinkyada is absolutely the best gluten free pasta on the market. Even my teenagers will eat it by choice.

Diamond AlmondsAlmonds are a good source of magnesium. One ounce contain approximately 20% of the RDA for an adult recommended dietary allowance (RDA)Recommended Dietary Allowance (RDA) the amounts of selected nutrients considered adequate to meet the known nutrient needs of healthy people. The RDA is based on scientific knowledge and has been presented by a committee of the Food and Nutrition Board (FNB) of the National Academy of Sciences (NAS). The Canadian equivalent is the Recommended Nutrient Intakes. RDA is generally accepted throughout the world as a valid source of information. At least 40 different nations have as well as organizations have published standards similar to the RDA.Magnesium is the fourth most abundant mineral in the body and is essential to good health. Approximately 50% of total body magnesium is found in bone. The other half is found predominantly inside cells of body tissues and organs. Only 1% of magnesium is found in blood, but the body works very hard to keep blood levels of magnesium constant.Magnesium is needed for more than 300 biochemical reactions in the body. It helps maintain normal muscle and nerve function, keeps heart rhythm steady, supports a healthy immune system, and keeps bones strong. Magnesium also helps regulate blood sugar levels, promotes normal blood pressure, and is known to be involved in energy metabolism and protein synthesis. There is an increased interest in the role of magnesium in preventing and managing disorders such as hypertension, cardiovascular disease, and diabetes. Dietary magnesium is absorbed in the small intestines. Are you taking enough magnesium in the diet? The recommended daily allowance is 300mgs/day for men, 350mgs for women. Magnesium is extremely safe by mouth - too much simply causes diarrhea. Try increasing the amount of magnesium you take by mouth until it causes diarrhea, then reduce the dose slightly so it does not. This is called taking magnesium to bowel tolerance (just like using vitamin C to bowel tolerance.Almonds are a good source of Fiber.One ounce contains approximately 12% of the RDA for an adult.So, in summary, Almonds are a very healthy snack, so what's left to say?Two things:1st be cautious about "bowel tolerance" or "happy bowels" if you prefer.2nd Taste. column9: Fancy Feast, why are you using so many fillers?!?!
column10: Okay, I admit it.I was sucked in my the most adorable, romantic commercials for a cat food product that I haveever seen. I vowed to buy at least some Fancy Feast each week just to show my support for that commercial!  LOLThe cats love the wet food. It is very expensive, and from what I have read on the labels, you aredefinitely paying for the IMAGE, not the quality or quantity of the food. (The cans are only 3 ouncescompared with 5.5 ounces in the other can styles.) I still get it, and they love the ones with cheese the most.So, I thought we'd give the dry food a try. I had my husband grab a bag when he was at the grocery store.How bad could it be, right?  Same company, same "gourmet" promotion on the foods, so surely it has great stuffin it, right?  Well, shocker - NOPE.Fancy Feast is made by the Purina company in St Louis, MO. They are the same ones who make the generic dog chow,cat chow, rabbit chow, ________ (fill in the blank) critter chow.  They are all full of fillers that animals don't need,because it is cheap to manufacture. Why I thought this might be different, I do not know.First off, food mfgs have found the kitty equivalent of addictive MSG, and load their foods with it.This one is no different. Note that BOTH our cats went crazy over this food, inhaling it out of my handbefore I could even get more out of the package. Fancy Feast knows how to make things that smell/taste good to cats.However, most food mfgs know how to make things that TASTE good - how they got there, well, you might not really want to know.Here's the ingredients list (which is in the order of the QUANTITY of the item) for this "gourmet" cat chow - bear with me, this isa really long list of iffy ingredients, artificial junk and food coloring):Brewers RicePoultry By Product MealCORN GLUTEN mealAnimal fat preserved with mixed tocopherolsGround Yellow CornSoybean MealAnimal Liver FlavorChickenTurkeyPhosphoric AcidCalcium Carbonate (in case they get indigestion?! This is what's in Tums!)SaltNatural & Artificial Flavors (more unspecified stuff?)Potassium ChlorideDried YeastCholine ChlorideAdded Color, Red 40, Yellow 5, Blue 2 and "other colors" (Why?!?)TaurineZinc SulfateFerrous SulfateVitamin E SupplementNiacinManganese SulfateVitamin A SupplementCalcium PantothenateThiamine MononitrateCopper SulfateRiboflavin SupplementVitamin B12 SupplementPyridoxineHydrochlorideFolic AcidVitamin D3 SupplementCalcium IodateBiotinMenadione Sodium Bisulfite Complex (a form of Vit K)Sodium Selenite.Sounds yummy, huh?The meat is way down the list, after all the corn, soybean and rice fillers and glutens.How on earth does cat food need artificial food dyes?  The cats won't care.There are many known reactions to food dyes in people - I am sure our pets don't need it either.Was the food too yellow with all the grain meal and gluten, or too white from all the fats?So, the cats love it. I will now consider this the equivalent of a bag of potato chips for humans -okay some times, but NOT all the time. I'll have to watch our oldest cat. He gets super itchy with wheatgrain or gluten in foods, so I'll watch for reactions to the corn.Cats are carnivorous, and do not eat grains in the wild. However, especially with the manufacturing plantsmack dab in farming country, they can apparently get all kinds of leftover grains cheap?If you buy this for your kitties, just know that you are buying the IMAGE more than a quality food.This is not really different than the super cheap pet foods that cost half as much or less.But the bag is nice and shiny and the photo of the kitty is cute.Overall, I was really disappointed to read that ingredients list, when they could do SO much better for our pets.We'll use this as their treats, rather than their main dry food. We'll stick with our Blue Buffalo for that, which isgrain free and actually has meat for the first ingredient!Fancy Feast - marketing genius, but sloppy on the nutrition.

column9: Just like the Southern favorite I grew up with
column10: I never thought I would be able to get any more Field peas with snaps like I grew up with until now. Having moved out west where no one had heard of them, nor could one grow them, I thought my old southern favorite was lost forever.... until now. WOW, Thank you Sylvia !!! These are the real deal too !! These aren't blackeyed peas masquerading as field peas thank goodness.... There IS a difference and any true southerner can tell at first bite. They have the flavor right too in these field peas and snaps. Sylvia has seasoned them to perfection. One would think she is at the stove cooking them herself. What a treat !! Wonderful treasure. Will certainly buy again !!

With my grandparents owning a large farm in South Carolina, I grew up on field peas and were by far my favorite side dish.  After my grandfather's death in the early 90's, the farm became too much to maintain and shut down.  My parents tried growing them in the clay-heavy soil of North Carolina but didn't have too much success, and I couldn't find field peas anywhere else.  After my move to Maryland, I discovered Sylvia's Field Peas with Snaps at a grocery store, read on the label that she grew up on a farm in South Carolina and had to try them out.  They were outstanding!!  Granted, I'd never had field peas with a smoked flavor, but they were the closest to the real thing!!They are a very tasty pea with a great smokey flavor.

Amazon rocks! I ordered a case of these.  They don't taste like blackeye peas,they're much better.Cajuns eat them with pork chops, rice and gravy.We season them with onion and bacon or tasso.My granddaughter loves these and she is vegan.when she's here we try to make homey food.Anyway Amazon,thanks for all your awesomeness.

column9: Hard and crunchy - NOT like the ones I grew up eating and still eat.
column10: I guess I'm in the minority here.  I bought a case of these (spent over $41.00) based on the reviews and the fact that I love Sylvia's greens and the Hoppin' John.  Mine, however, are awful.  They are NOT like the ones I grew up eating.  I grew up on a farm in the Deep South and these are nothing like the peas I'm used to, and I know peas, having not only eaten tons of them, but spent years planting, weeding, picking, shelling and freezing them.  These, aside from being a different variety of pea (as you can tell from the can, they are a brownish-red and have an eye), are not flavored well and have a weird, kind of muddy, taste.  But, the worst part is that they aren't even fully cooked!  They are still partially hard and have crunchy bits.  WHAT!!!  Southern peas should be cooked until they are fairly soft.  It makes me wonder if these are prepared from dried peas, another thing Southerners do not do to field peas.  I'm glad the other reviewers are happy with their purchase. Maybe they have changed since then or perhaps the peas they ate in S. Carolina are just radically different from S. Alabama peas (I doubt it.)  In any case, none of my family would ever serve peas that tasted like this, we'd be too ashamed. I am very disappointed (peas and cornbread are my all-time favorite comfort food and still what I request when I visit my parents back on the farm) and angry at the amount of money I've spent on these and I would caution anyone to buy a single can or two somewhere else to try before plunking down this much money on a case.

Since I usually eat the cracklin style which have more air in them, these skins are a nice change. They are very crunchy most of the time and others have a softer, oilier taste. If you have some good choppers these are the ones you want to try.
These hard strips are too hard to chew comfortably, plus the red pepper flavoring has MSG added, not something I'm comfortable ingesting.

I have had great service from Amazon. When I place my order I always get a e-mail telling me when it will be shipped out. Then I get a followup e-mail letting me know that it has been shipped. My package always arrive in a reasonable time, and I have always gotten what I order. Thanks for the great service and keep up the good work.

It leaked so bad the UPS delivery guy did not even deliver -they said that they will send it back to Amazon directly. (It also damaged other goods packed in the same box!) I ordered a replacement. The second one leaked again! This time UPS delivered it (to let me see for myself?) It was BAD. I did not want to return leaked oil so I tried to use the leftover but NO mist came out - only big drops! It is much cheaper to buy regular canola oil in bottle than a "mister"  that leak and give no mist.  Will not buy this product again.

I usually buy peppermint bark from Harry & David's on the way home for Christmas for my parents.  Since I wasn't able to make it home this year, I purchased the Dove peppermint bark from Amazon, hoping it would be an acceptable substitute.  My parents loved it!  They've asked me to buy the Dove version for them in the future.
Dove Peppermint Bark is the best candy ever made.  I can't wait until Christmas this year when the product is available.  Best Candy Made by far!

column9: Tassimo T-Discs: Gevalia Dark Italian Roast
column10: I HAVE HAD THIS COFFEE BEFORE AND I LIKE IT'S BOLD FLAVOR. WHAT'S NOT TO LIKE. . . .THE COFFEE IS DELICIOUS AND IT'S VERY CONVENIENT TO BE ABLE TO BREW A CUP AT A TIME.  AMAZON IS EASY TO DEAL WITH AS WELL.

When I get cold, I always get severe sore throat (normally lose my voice and bad coughing afterward). Same pattern everytime. I tried many cough drops, spray, etc. to erase the pain but those work for really short period of time only. This time, I tried this tea immediately when I felt my throat getting sore. Oh my goodness, it really worked! My throat felt much better just after one cup, and didn't get that severe pain like I normally do. I'm truly  amazed. I'm not a big fan of the taste of this tea (I thought it's similar to Aveda tea), but it was well worth drinking.

I'm a choral singer and I rely on Throat Coat to keep me healthy and singing through the holiday season and beyond.  I take it any time I feel a tickle coming on, and it's done wonders for me.  I happen to love herbal tea, so I find the flavor quite pleasing.  It's lightly sweet with a hint of cinnamon and lemon.  The herbs really do make the back of your tongue tingle in a very pleasant way.  I couldn't live without it!

column9: Delicious throat-soother will be treasured the next time you have a sore throat!
column10: My whole family loves the flavor and the soothing effects of this tea when we have colds or sore throats for any reason.  It's naturally a little sweet, but honey may be added for additional effectiveness, especially in a dry climate like we have in Arizona--keep plenty on hand!

It was four hours till the gig, my chops were shot from a throat infection and I was the lead singer for the night. I shared my plight with the trumpet player and he told me about this "Throat Coat" tea that he heard of on some daytime variety show.  A famous singer and Vegas headliner who was on the show mentioned this tea and how everyone in the biz used it. So I ran into the local health food on the way to the gig and picked up a box.The bartender gave me a funny look when I asked for hot water instead of my usual 7&7.  I could barely talk, but no kidding, the first song went without a hitch. It was like my voice was on auto pilot.  I even hit high notes I sometimes struggle with.  It was amazing.  My head was still stuffy and woozy from the other meds I took and my ears were stopped up, but vocal wise I had a great night. I think I drank 4 cups that night.The taste took a little getting used to. Its not bad and it is actually naturally sweet.  It just tastes different from anything I've had before.  I keep a handful in my gig bag everywhere I go and share with fellow singers without hesitation. I just bought a case on this site. I drank some at the gig last night as a matter of fact. I didn't NEED it, I just like it now.

column9: Throat Coat is a throat saver
column10: I have a respiratory infection, my throat has been sore and I lost my voice.  Drinking this tea has decreased the soreness of my throat, and my voice is slowly coming back.  It works better and tastes better than the Yogi Throat Comfort.  I will keep a box at home and work.

column9: Sweet Soothing Flavor for a Nightcap
column10: This is perhaps the most flavorful and refreshing tea I have had before calling it a night.  The directions call for a  10-15 min soaking time and it truly does make a difference for the richness of the tea.  The product is appropriately named "Throat Coat" as I have always found it a soothing experience whenever my throat is dry or irritating.

My ENT Doc recommended this to me for my "Dry Mouth" condition which is the result of Radiation treatment of my throat. I bought this and the other variety, "Organic Throat Coat". The other tea worked wonders, this had no affect on the Dry Mouth or the sore throat that I also have as a side effect.

This tea has a delightful flavor. Lightly sweet and just lemony enough to be refreshing. I added a little bit of honey and it was like candy. Despite being scrumptious I feel no effect on the soreness of my throat. I spent time with my boyfriend over the weekend and apparently caught whatever bug he was carrying. He's been home sick with a fever and sore throat for two days and my symptoms have just started. I was hoping to head off this cold at the pass by loading up on some herbal teas (which usually does the trick) but I'm half way through my second consecutive cup with no change what-so-ever. I may just have a super bug that requires something stronger than tea but I was hoping for at least SOME improvement. Back to Halls it is!

column9: Where has this stuff been all my life?
column10: I'm just thankful to have finally discovered this.  It is so incredibly soothing, and it WORKS!  It shortens the length of a cold, and it even gives me a little energy to get through my day while fighting the germs.  I actually really like the taste of it.  I could see myself drinking it even when I'm not sick!  It helped me a few weeks ago fighting something.  Tonight I began feeling like I might be fighting something again, complete with a scratchy throat.  I brewed and drank a cup, and I pretty much feel normal now!  I had to come post a review before I forget how much I love this stuff!

You know how you get thirsty when you have a sore throat but it's much too painful to drink anything? This is the answer to that. Which makes it, in my opinion, nothing short of a godsend. It's extremely soothing -- feels like cotton candy going down your throat -- and the hydration probably helps you get over your illness faster. Not sure if this one really tastes that different from the original Throat Coat flavor, since the licorice taste in this one is very strong, too (which I love!)
GREAT. Best thing you can drink if you have a sore throat or a cold! Even if you don't like tea, I would still recommend it.

This tea is great!  A little sweet. Tastes great.  Kids like it also, great hot alternative to a cup of sugary hot chocolate.  Really makes a sore throat feel a lot better!  Seems to help shorten and/or prevent colds.  One of our favorites!

column9: wow this item is great but why the steep price ?
column10: this is awesome the XXX one. El Yucateco  has 3 flavors.. the red -mild.. the Green. medium hot. and the brown.-this one. XXX.  I buy it at walmart or Fiesta for 1.29 or 1.79 a bottle.  dont pay more for that..

column9: Delicious, don't let packaging fool you
column10: If you see this stuff on a store shelf you might be put off by the color, that's because it's not loaded down with dye to keep it bright. Don't let the garish packaging fool you either, El Yucateco as a brand is excellent.  This sauce is excellent, flavorful and hot without the acidic sharp burning that sauces heated with extract will have.It's difficult to say how hot it is, since that's so subjectivve. I consider myself pretty well versed in hot foods and to me this isn't uncomfortably hot by a long stretch, it's exactly the kind of thing i'd dollop on tacos without a care in the world.

A relative bought me several of El Yucateco's different hot sauces on a trip to Mexico. This is by far my favorite. It is extremely hot (more than two or three drops will render any dish uneatable for most people), but in addition to the spiciness it has a very distinct and delicious flavor. This is something I miss in many hot sauces, they burn your mouth but it's not always they actually add lots of taste.A bottle of the Kutbil-ik lasts a long time since you only need a little to spice up your food. Heartily recommended!

column9: Some of the Best Flavor in Hot Sauce
column10: Many hot sauces focus on heat.  I say, "What's heat without flavor?"  This stuff delivers.  The flavor is absolutely amazing.  The Kutbil-ik is pretty warm but not horrible.  It's scoville rating is a little over 11k as found on their website.  The flavor is very smokey.  When I saw the color, I thought to myself that it couldn't be that great.  I tried it.  It's now my favorite of the three Chile Habanero sauces that they make and my favorite overall hot sauce. It's my personal opinion of course, but while I love Tabasco sauce, it has nothing over on this stuff.

We were pleased to find this product. We had gotten it at a restaurant in the past but they went out of business. Only problem is one of the caps was broken when we received it, allowing the product to leak a little. This made us unsure if it was safe to use.

I've been loving hot sauce for decades, starting out on Tabasco and moving on from there.  I use all kinds of peppers and spices in my cooking and love spicy, flavorful food.  This hot sauce has been my favorite by a margin since I tried it.  I've given bottles out as gifts/party favors and folks who love spicy food invariably love it.It has a great habanero kick but also really good flavor and after-taste.  I add it to almost anything that is good spicy.  I does have a bit of a mexican food aspect, so if you are cooking asian food or something you'll have to judge if it will alter the flavor you are looking for.  I am always disappointed when I decide I have to use something else!The price is right, too - should be able to get it for less than $2!
Great taste and versatile product. A lil' bit goes a long way. It is my hot sauce of choice and this vender,"latin products" has great prices and service.
This sauce is a perfect blend between spiciness and flavor! I reccomend above all other sauces! Will buy frequently.I put it on everything!

I love this stuff! First saw it last week at a new-to-me Mexican restaurant and hunted it down on Amazon.  I love the natural color, the fruitiness of the habaneros, the initial shock, the tingling lips, and the afterburn.  Don't tease normals with this, it's just for the chileheads in your life!
My husband loves hot food.  We purchased this sauce and he is very happy with it.  It is very hot!

This really is great tasting hot sauce. I can't imagine eating certain Mexican foods without it. I definitely agree with other reviewers that the price is much higher than retail, but that's the downside of Amazon Prime. "Free shipping" (at $79 a year) isn't exactly free when you pay three times as much as you would elsewhere.

When I first tried this sauce it was at an airport in Denver...man I was hooked! This sauce has a delicious, mouth-watering habanero flavor. Overall I was very pleased at the spicy kick this sauce has and I would recommend it!I'm considering buying it again and will do so soon for summer barbeque.

This hot sause isnt for the weak, if you, or know someone who's like me, able to drink TABASCO® brand Pepper Sauce - Original Red Gallonwithout taking a drink then this is the perfect sause. We finally got a Mexican Tienda in our town and i buy this from him everytime i visit this family owned and ran store. I have ALOT of it put up for survival / food storage reasons, and inflation fears. I had quite a few Mayan salsas during our trip to the Yucatan and this is pretty close to the same flavor. I pack a bottle to work with me for a couple reasons. Be careful with it, it really is fire in a bottle!
They had this at my local African market but ran out, so I went digging online: best decision ever. Packaging was excellent and it tasted good.
This is another item that I'm unable to find here in Japan, so I was so excited to find this on amazon. My sardine came well packed and on time. Thanks for selling this. Love my sardine.

The sardines arrived well packaged with no defects or dents in the can.  I have been doing sardine taste tests (for no reason really)since I heard sardines from places outside of my region and the states taste much better.  When I opened the can there were two fish, I somehow expected more, but two proved to be enough.  I ate them just as they arrived in the can.  The first taste was typical, stiff and a bit dry.  Then there was this aftertaste that almost tasted of liquid smoke.  The taste lingered and was very unpleasant.  But because I bought them, I finished both fish.  I won't buy again but hey, maybe its just me.

column9: Hard hearted candy manufactured all year, sold now.
column10: For some reason I love this chalky, vaguely fruity flavored confection. I've been waiting all year for Valentines day so I can go out of control and eat these things for no apparent reason. I purchased six of this exact product in this exact size (7oz) and label: five from one supermarket and one from another. The candy seems stale. The purple ones are rock hard and I'm afrade I'll break a tooth so I throw those away, and the green ones are almost as bad so I've given up on them. That leaves the yellow, pink, orange (usually) and blue ones as safe to eat. These aren't supposed to be hard candy, are they?The Necco web site says these hearts are produced all year for sale during the Valentines holiday period. They are supposed to be soft candy. So it seems that you may get a bag from eleven months ago or a couple weeks ago. Good luck! I think I got the from spring 2011.By the way, I got my 7 oz bags for only a fraction of the coin demanded here, so best to look at the grocery store in the seasonal items area first.Also, I bought a bag of the Brach's Conversation Hearts and did a comparison. The Brach's product seemed fresh with no rock hard hearts, but the flaver is a bit more bland. It's difficult to tell if the different color Brach's hearts are meant to be different flavors. They're more like just fresh sweet chalk.

column9: Finally, this company puts out a product that holds true to its name:  PEMMICAN!
column10: This product is great tasting and holds true to it's Cree derived legacy.  Certainly, not true (Native American) Pemmican, it is as close as any mass market jerky product has come.  This, along with its 3 brothers may be a bit expensive, but it's a great splurge every now and then.  Great tasting cut pieces of jerky paired with an separate berry composition..  Be sure to try and eat meat and its counterpart together for an semi-original Pemmican taste.

I've really enjoyed this coffee.I purchased the 3 pack, because I included 1 pack in a wedding gift, thought the whole "Java Love" title would be cute with the coffee maker we were giving them.  We usually drink Green Mountain, but wanted to use the 2 packs we had left of this.  We've been really happy with it.  Not too strong, but strong enough, nice flavor.  I found it to be a little stronger than the Green Mountain VT blend, but in a good way.I'm ordering it again right now!

For about six months, I really thought I liked this coffee, and then I realized that I was adding way more cream than is usual for me.  This is because the coffee doesn't taste very good, so I have stopped buying it.  Granted, it is better than freeze-dried crystals or stuff from the gas station, but really, is that saying much?

I got this coffee at a local market when our whole beans stocks dwindled.... My husband and I are both coffee 'snobs' we had to wean ourselves of our Peets habit when we moved from California last year.This coffee is sub-standard, dried out, tasting of dish water.  Instead... try a Green Mountain coffee like the Espresso blend or the Newmans blends

My cat Mr Jingles is addicted to these tuna treats, and they are healthy that you can feed it to your cat daily. Mr Jingles loves his treats, but it's so hard to find a product that he loves, as well as doesn't add on the pounds. Well I finally found the perfect treat that he can eat daily, and not have to worry about his weight.Continue reading review from my blog:[...]

This is a great deal for the "cat crack" tuna flakes.  This is by far our cat's favorite treat, and she goes nuts for it.  Not super high in calories or fat, so it's better than the junk food treats.  Definitely recommend.
All three cats and the dog LOVE these!  It's wonderful to have a treat I can give my diabetic cat! When my dog is being finicky, sprinkling a little on her food gets her to eat every time.

The first bonita flakes I bought my cats were the Cat-Man-Do brand.  My two cats are pretty picky but loved the flakes.  I bought this brand next because it was cheaper but the cats won't eat it.  I had large long flakes of this brand out and put the very last crumbs of the other kind down next to them and my cats both tried to lick up the crumbs and ignored this brand.I compared the ingredients of the two brands, and the only difference is that CittiKitty contains Ash.  Whatever that means, it was a deal breaker for my cats.Also, if you have a Japanese or Asian grocery store in town, you can purchase katsuobushi, which is pure Bonita flakes meant for human consumption, so a better quality, and they are much cheaper.

This is a great dressing for wet food to get my terminally ill cat to eat enough to keep weight on. When he's not attracted to any of the cans I open, if I embed some of these flakes in the top of it, he'll eat everything it's sticking to. A real life saver without subjecting his kidneys to too much protein.

column4: Lynette355 "Have you ever noticed the age 40 ...
column10: Rain and cold weather go hand in hand, especially because they make our pets go crazy. When it's cold out, the cats can't decide whether they want to go in or out and every time the dogs come in from outside, they're hyped up and full of energy. When it's raining, everyone goes stir crazy from being cooped up inside. Since Texas winters don't see much in the way of snow, we tend to get a lot of rain. Thankfully, we now have TunaTreats to help keep the kitties calm.TunaTreats are dried flakes of 100% pure bonito fish. The first time the container was opened, the cats went wild. The pieces, thinner than paper and light enough to blow away if you're not careful, came out of the container in manageable clumps. Next thing I knew, five cats were swarming me, looking up and meowing, trying to climb my chair. I had a captive audience! What I didn't expect was the moment the dogs joined in.TunaTreats are completely healthy and a good "anytime" treat. Our kitties get a good-sized pinch of their new favorite TunaTreats a couple of times each day. With this, they stay nice and calm as they munch.
