column10: Finally, I tried my raw vegan diet for all of 17 days - it wasn't easy but it was going to be done. And then I bought the raw cacao powder for some desserts. Have to admit, the dessert with banana and the powder didn't come out great but it's because I am not crazy about bananas. Instead, the one we made with figs and almonds, YUM! We have been using the raw cacao powder with that recipe just by putting it in a simple food processor. The powder is delicious. It is chocolatey but not overwhelming and not too sweet or too bitter, it is really perfect. And I love that it's RAW! YUM!

This chocolate is awesome for smoothies and for the chocolate creations i make. I think i got a good deal and it really is great chocolate. Not sure how raw it is but it FEELs Raw. Maybe will purchase again.

column9: THIS STUFF IS AWESOME TO SAY THE LEAST!
column10: This Cocao Powder is the best Superfood product that I have purchased! It is a 150% stronger antioxidant than anything I have found!

Perfect taste and consistency to mix with my berry protein shakes every morning. I usually add only half of a tea spoon to it, otherwise it feels too strong. It's a huge bag and it was a surprise when I received 2 bags. I haven't noticed that it was lot of 2 bags when I ordered. So it's even better. Great product.

I  recieved the Navitis Cocao Power, it came in the form of a powder and it was very rich and very fine and it dissolves quite well in liquid. I like the flavor very much. Ican tell it comes from the criollo variety. I like to use it in my french press coffee mug it makes a very rich ice cold alternatives to coffee. the good thing about it is it so fine that you can even steep it cold water so  you can keep all of the nutrients instead of heating up. sure it's a little bit expensive but a little bit goes a long way I just use a teaspoon in a 8 ounce glass of water and is flavors of very well. I am very happy with this product I would recommend it to anyone it's also good in baked goods.

I had been toying with ordering this product/brand for some time.. recently going the whole food chemical free direction wasn't sure if I'd find many uses for it and didn't want to buy something else I may not use. I couldn't be happier after trying it! I just finished the most delicious easy to make chocolate smoothie I remember having! Way richer and tastier than ice cream or fast food shake! And to think I can enjoy such a decadent treat - guilt free! I used 4 big teaspoons of cacao, 2 big teaspoons of raw coconut crystals, a cup or so of raw milk, sprinkle of cinnamon and one frozen banana. Yum!

If there's any form of chocolate that's good for you, it has to be this stuff: totally raw.  I can't speak to that.  All I know for sure is that is a gorgeous velvety texture and mixes beautifully into yogurt and smoothies.
I make this with soy or low fat milk and Stevia for sweetening.  Add a dash of real vanilla with cinnamon and enjoy a cup of guilt free hot cocoa.  Love it!
I use this powder in smoothies and in my morning coffee.  Tastes great and raw and organic, reasonably priced as well.
To me, this cacao is delicious.  I use it in smoothies with milk, banana, strawberries and agave nectar.  It has the slight bitterness of dark chocolate, which I love.

This stuff is really good.  It has a rich, full-bodied, complex flavor that is unlike anything I have ever experienced with commercially produced chocolate.  Chocolate lovers will LOVE this!!!  And for those who are worried about consuming non-sustainably produced, pesticide laden chocolate, produced by child laborers, this is a GREAT option!

I love this product, I use it in my smoothie every day. Wonderful  product, sometimes they are out of it so I look forward to getting it, terrific in my raw dishes. Raw organic cacao is a great source of mag.
I made some Chocolate Ice cream using CACAOand was the best tasting one so far, better thanHershey and Nestle's. Good service and fast shippingI will buy more in the future.

This chocolate is very good tasting. I use it in protein shakes with whey powder, milk, a frozen banana, and some peanut butter. It makes a great chocolate shake with no sugar (other than what's in the whey powder and banana).I don't understand why organic chocolate cost more than twice as much as non-organic though.

Well, they say it's organic and raw, and supposedly good fer ya. I use this in "healthy" drinks, with a bunch of other healthy ingredients, including macca, fruits, etc. It has a very powerful, almost overwhelming taste. I love chocolate, but this is the "real" thing, where a little goes a long way to make that flavor. It has more protein than fat, along with magnesium and a few other goodies.BTW, Stevia is another one of the healthy ingredients I use, and heartily recommend. As a Sweet'n'Low freak, it's just amazing how good Stevia (low or no calorie natural sweetener) tastes! I bought it here too, but no place to review it!?

The cacao is bitter but it is suppose to be like that. I use 2 Tbsp with about 8 oz of strawberry kefir and that makes for one delightful and nutritious drink! Also, I like how the manufacturer makes this product, they are very careful to retain as much nutritional value in the process as possible. It is a good price too......especially when considering this is truly a SUPERFOOD!
I made vegan brownies with this new to me product!  Everyone loved them, great flavor. Thank You

This is a wonderful cacao powder that I have been buying at a health store at twice the price.  I use it every day in my morning protein shake and I love it. It has more antioxidants than blueberries. A great and healthy way to start your day.

This is the best raw cocoa out there. I recently transitioned to eating raw and use this for everything. My favorite is simply fresh strawberries topped with some cocoa powder and stevia! I use it to make chocolate milk for my kids and MANY other fabulous recipes raw and unraw.
Great quality, great taste!  I use it almost every morning for my smoothies and love the stuff!

The VERY first time, I had to get used to it as tasting slightly lighter than the usual cocoa powder people buy.  Now I'm hooked. I throw it in my morning protein shake along with a cup of blueberries.  I love it and will be buying more when I run out. This is a quality product.

I have been looking for a raw organic cacao powder to use in a bunch of my old recipes.  I am fairly new to this healthier, whole food, organic way of eating.  This stuff is the best!  I used it in a chocolate coffee cake, and my kids told me it was the best i ever made.  The only difference was this stuff.  Plus, i love the way my body feels after eating it.  I am energized without any kind of crash afterwards.  I would recommend this to anyone looking for cacao powder.

Navitas' Dark Organic Cocoa Powder is higher in nutritional protein and fiber than most brands.  It mixes easily in smoothies and tastes great.  The price is very reasonable for the quality and the opportunity to directly support farmers.  Will definitely buy again.
Excellent product at a great price. Add it to smoothies and I am adding it to homemade coconut milk ice cream.

This seems to be a high quality cocoa, the flavor profile is a bit different than your standard cocoa and can take some time to get used to. So all told, good stuff but if you are looking for a fairly standard cocoa flavor, you may want to buy something else. Good but different.
Good quality chocolate and hopefully it's a healthy food. I cannot verify the manufacturer's claims. I just like the product.

column9: Not great for making hot chocolate
column10: I have purchased this product in the hopes of making rich hot chocolate.  (I have always used Droste but I can no longer find it locally.)  This cocoa never gets dark and rich.  I will use what I have left over to see if it is good for baking.

I was concerned that this less processed cocoa powder would be bitter, but it is actually quite mild in flavor, at least the way I use it.  I mix it into plain yoghurt along with some artificial sweetener.  I like it as least as much as the regular Hershey's cocoa that I used previously.  It is not as finely ground and is a little gritty, but I do not mind this.  In fact this is an advantage because it stays put when I mix it whereas the fine powder of the Hershey's tends to escape to the counter top.
I love this powder!  It's the best quality/consistency of any I have tried.  I use it to make raw chocolate and in my shakes!  Yum.
My kids are picky hot coca drinkers and they love this stuff. It also makes great deserts. We used to buy Van Houten in Europe but this is a great substitute and organic!

column9: Never felt better since adding cacao to my diet
column10: I really dig on cacao. I add the powder to my smoothie every day for the antioxidant benefit as well as being a natural stimulant which is more subtle and longer lasting than caffeine.I bought the nibs too as they provide a great crunch (to smoothies or raw) and all the benefits of cacao powder however with slightly lower efficacy.I highly recommend this cacao powder (and the nibs) as a great and tasty addition to your diet.These statements have not been evaluated by the FDA, but this is an amazon review, don't take it too seriously folks.

I have recently switched to an all natural diet and have been searching for cacao powder in the grocery stores around me but have had no luck.  I bought a fairly large quantity of it and have enjoyed every recipe I've made with it!

For the past few years, I've been buying either Hershey's or Trader Joe's cocoa powder, but I recently decided to splurge on the Nativas brand.  All of the Nativas products I've tried have been of excellent quality, and this one is no exception.  It's a dark, rich cacao powder, and the taste makes a noticeable difference in everything I've used it in.  It's pricey, but makes your food taste much better, plus the raw and organic nature of it makes it something that I don't mind spending a little more money on.

I've read that cacao powder is superior to plain old cocoa powder like Hershey's nutritionally. This is pricey but it is USDA organic. Blends well in my protein shakes. I will be ordering more in the future.

I use this cacao powder in my coffee in the mornings. I have to be careful not to use too much or it won't dissolve, but otherwise it works and tastes great. I have also used it in place of regular cocoa for baking brownies and they turned out very rich and chocolatey. This is definitely not the same as Hershey's cocoa powder- not for the faint of heart. Also very rich in nutrients like iron and magnesium, which is why I switched.

column9: bitter taste but good for you and high quality
column10: Upside: it doesnt hav ea bunch of garbage in it like regular choco (Hershey, Ghirrardelli).Downside: It doesn't taste like the chocolate that most americans are used to... not incredibly sweet and fortified with cane sugar.which is OK with me!Hershey's "Natural" blend is not that bad, but this choco tastes better and is always more fresh. It is worth the difference in price, especially if you buy at the subscription rate.
Rich flavor, perfect texture, easily mixes into smoothies, frostings and batter. A mainstay for healthily fixing my dark chocolate cravings!
I use this in my smoothies with maca, fresh fruit and hemp powder.  This is the chocolate is better than plain cocoa powder. Good price and shipping too.  Thank you.

I've been using this raw organic cacao powder regularly for several months now.  The quality and taste are excellent! Granted, it's much more expensive than regular baking cocoa, but for the nutritional benefits, it's well worth it.  I use it every morning in my smoothie, along with Amazing Grass - Chocolate GREEN Super Food 17 oz, organic frozen fruit, and organic milk or almond milk. The combination makes a healthy, delicious breakfast smoothie!  I highly recommend it!
Delicious and nutritious.  Probably better than other brands, but I have not tried other brands because I was satisfied with my first choice, Navitas Naturals Cacao Powder.

Great and genuine product. I did not find any reason why this product deserves less than 5 stars. I first mixed one teaspoon with organic raw local honey, but that was too sweet for me.Now, i am using by mixing one spoon of this powder in one cup of boiled water without mixing any sweetener. My wife is drinking by mixing in warm almond milk. I am surprised to see single stars for this product just because the taste is not good to them. That is the taste of the original cocoa powder, what the company can do about it.

I'm a huge fan of raw cacao powder, and this is by far the best powder I've had. Its high quality with a wonderful taste. And the price for the 2 bags is much cheaper on amazon then I can find in any store around me. I will DEFINITELY be ordering this again when I run low on raw cacao powder!!!!

column9: cacao powder is good for you
column10: Wonderful stuff. Cacao is good for you with antioxidents and can even reduce blood pressure. I make homemade mochas with it and sweeten with Stevia for a healthier alternative to a coffee shop beverage. Bought a big Thermos to carry it to work in so I have refills, also bought that off of Amazon. Well worth the price, both of them.
Simple quick review.I was looking for a replacement cheddar soup from our local natural food store which we loved.This is a great soup.Easy to make and creamy!

We love this soup!  I have it a 5 even though I add a little salt, pepper, and garlic just based on the fact that its our tastes that im catering to with that.  We love soup at a certain restraunt that is very similar but we rarely get to go...this has more than taken over this because we were there the other day and my husband said he liked "mine" better!

Well,there is not much that I can say about this particular item,except that the price was cheap!A lot of the other listings on Amazon are outrageously expensive when it comes to lemon juice for some reason.Its not a very heavy or fragile item,but they always find a way to jack up the price,don't they?I bought this bottle of lemon juice so that I could mix some henna for my hair.I know that normally people use a mixture of lemon juice,tea & other oils,ets,but since oils are bad for the mix,I believe,lemon juice is the best for mixing henna.This is the best price that you will find here for a decent bottle of lemon juice,& I hope that Amazon keeps it that way.

Store mixes are just OK. My mother always made cakes from scratch and frosting. This cake mix tastes like homemade and we love them ...all of them. I am so excited to try the new ones coming out.Since I discovered these we have cupcakes in our house all the time. (No we are not fat)  One cupcake is equivalent to 1/2 piece cake.  I deplore store bought frosting in the can, always have.  This frosting takes homemade. Do yourself a big favor and use REAL butter in the frosting instead of the artificial stuff.  Makes all the difference in the world. Tastes just like Mom's.Kids will love the dots inside the cake. They show up well s long as you do not over beat the batter. The sprinkles for the frosting being all natural, are a real plus. You don't have to buy your own to add. It is just a thing with me, I have to have sprinkles on my cupcakes! Side note, my Mom's dad was a farmer and they always ate lots of  butter and whole milk. My dad's dad was  farmer and ditto.  9 kids in mom's family and 4 in dad's. Of the total 13 kids, 3 have died and all were over 80. The remaining children are still alive are in  their late 80's and  90's. It appears Butter and  whole milk have not had a negative affect on them.Great cake mix and frosting mix. All natural and that is a wonderful thing.For those of you who have said the mix is not sweet enough, you can always add a little sugar! I think it is fine but have added extra sugar at times.

I bought this for my birthday a few weeks ago. LOVE it!!!!!! It tasted so much better than the other box cake mixes, tasted homemade. They aren't super sweet like regular cake mix, they are still sweet, just not hurt my stomach sweet.  That is the best box cake mix I have ever bought. It is nice that it is made with whole wheat flour and real sugar instead of all the crap that's in other cake mixes. Very impressed, and so were ALL the guests. Thats what my son has requested to make this week. Thanks for making such a great cake mix! I will never buy any other brand again.

The cake was moist and not overly sweet, and the frosting tasted decadent without an artificial aftertaste. The dots in the cake itself were hard to see, but the ones on top of the cake more than made up for it. I will definitely make this again, and I look forward to trying the other flavors.
I am taking a cake decorating class and have to make a cake every week.  I am so glad i found Naturally Nora.  I feel a little less guilty and it is sooooooooo good.  easy directions and very tasty.

My kids love Funfetti and I wasn't sure if they'd like an all-natural version but figured it was worth trying.  It was a HUGE HIT!  The colored sprinkles aren't as bright as the artificial kind but still make it fun and festive.  (I imagine it's because they're all-natural.)  The cake is really delicious.  It's dense, kind of like I'd make from scratch.  I'm telling all my friends about it.
I thought the cake wasn't very good. Doesn't compare to the taste of the real box mixes. I was hoping for something trans fat free that tasted every bit as good. Now I'm stuck with 5 more boxes.

column9: Absolutely delicious. Great over noodles, rice, mashed potatoes, anything. Even good by itself as soup with bread.
column10: This was thick and delicious. Not too clammy, clams tasted just right. My whole family loved this sauce. too bad only in small 10.5 ounce can, would have loved larger can.

column9: A VERY VERSITILE PRODUCT HERE.  ITs the only way my wife can get me to eat some of my veggies
column10: When all is said and done, this is a pretty good price here on Amazon for this soup.  I can find it for less when I buy it on sale but am not always lucky enough to find it when I want or need it.  I have Amazon Prime so the shipping cost really is not a factor in this case.This is excellent soup, has 0 trans fat per serving and has been designated as one of Campbell's "Heart Healthy" soups (for what ever that is worth...sounds good anyway).  Do watch the Sodium though.  We are talking 650mg or 27% here.  This of course is part of what you get with the majority of canned soups.  It is rather high (500mg) in potassium though, which in my case is a good thing.Now I seldom set down and open a can of this stuff just to eat a bowl of cheese soup; not of course that there is anything wrong in that, but that simply is not the purpose for which I use it.  I do use this stuff over a very wide range in my cooking.  It is fast, relatively inexpensive and extremely versatile.  I heat a can of this soup to add to various vegetables (I am a big kid and am not overly fond of eating my veggies...there is know way I am going to touch just plane broccoli or brussel sprouts with out something on them).  I prepare several types of dips using this soup as one of the ingredients and as a matter of fact use it as an ingredient is a couple of soups I make...potato soup leading the list.  I have even been known to dribble a bit of this stuff into a mess of chili I make; not all the time, but sometimes I like to give it just a quirky bit of flavor boost.I also like the pop-top opening system on this as I am not overly fond of using can openers.I suppose on thing you might consider when purchasing this soup by the case though is how much of the stuff you are going to use over the next 12 or so months.  I know several families who go through can after can of this stuff but on the other hand I know families that may use three cans per year.This is a very useful product.  I use it a lot.Don BlankenshipThe Ozarks

First off, I am rating the actual SOUP. All my can arrived fine except for the expiration date is OCTOBER 2011. How many of you will use that much cheese soup within 6 months? Very dissapointed with that.

My kids won't eat vegetables without a "sauce."  I keep a stock of this soup on hand for when I don't have time to prepare a fancy disguise for vegetables.  The kids love it and the pricing is great buying it by the case.

Very good soup, if you like cheese. It also makes a very quick mac & cheese, just cook the macaroni, drain then dump in a can. It is also good on cooked veggies. I am sure I will find many other uses for it in the future.
Was getting this every 60 days. Cancelled because not using it often enough. It did get to us on time. Could have used more packing. Sometimes cans were slightly dented.

I have gotten this product before a number of times, as we use it frequently. It is so much better price-wise than the markets. I only gave it 4 stars this time, because of the packaging. It was sent via the Post Office, before it was always UPS. Somewhere along the route, the box practically fell apart and had to be taped up by the postal carrier on our route. Also, a couple of cans were dented in pretty good. Of course, it's hard to tell who was faulty here, but I won't stop buying the soup. A good deal!

When M&M's first hit the scene, I confess to being skeptical about them. THey were just glorified Smarties as far as I was concerned. Then someone at M&M's had a stroke of genius: add peanuts to them! At that moment something special was born: the world's most delicious and heavenly choking hazard.Being a bit bigger than your average M&M, they take a bit more effort to swallow whole, so that is not a reccommended approach when eating them. I have given up trying to wolf them down for that reason.You would think peanuts and chocolate would be a over-done idea. Probably right. But there is something about these coloured little ovals of pleasure. I can easily knock off a whole bag on my own, (that's right: I do not share!). Just give me a few minutes alone with it.For snack, (or a balanced meal in it's own right), Peanut M&M's are about the best there is.

column9: Good leaf quality, very little dust - not as flavorful as other brands.
column10: I started drinking Yerba Mate about 4 years ago.  I used to only drink it tereré (cold) but I was shown a couple of hot preparations with milk and sugar that I really like so now I do it both ways; Hot in the winter and cold the rest of the time.I have tried about 10 different brands.  Amazingly they all taste a bit different. Rosamonte is actually a very popular brand in parts of South America but it was not a favorite of mine.  It felt like no matter how it was prepared it just ended up being more bland than other brands.Yerba Mate is a wonderful substitute for coffee or soda.  It makes me feel good and gives me energy but doesn't spike me up and down like regular caffeine.  My soda intake has gone to almost zero since I discovered this stuff.It is a bit of an acquired taste but I recommend trying it both hot and cold with the different methods available so you can experience the full spectrum of taste that is possible!

Great Mate! I like the flavor. I drink it every morning. Thank you for the fast shipping, and I will be buying from you again. So far I have recently opened up the second bag. I like buying these larger bulk orders from you.
This is a good quality time-tested Yerba mate from Argentina. Tastes good and is a great source of naturally occurring thiamine. Price is decent and three bags lasts awhile.
Maté is an awesome drink and Rosamonte makes an affordable and good tasting product. I would recommend this product to my friends and family.
The sunflower seed kernels are stale and unpalatable; pumpkin seed kernels from the same supplier were not stale, but had little flavor.  Would not order again.
This is very chicken-y and fantastic for cooking.  It's better than any of the boxed brands, and I've tried them all.  It compares to Swanson's organic canned chicken broth.

I love this product because it tastes as good as a basic homemade version.  You can add your own vegetables and other seasonings to create a great soup.  I also use it as a stock base for sauces, soups and replacement for water when cooking rice and grains.  There is no leftover stock to worry about.  One can is used for 1 cup rice.  The product came timely and bubble wrapped.

column9: This is delicious though a bit too sweet with the light syrup!
column10: If you've ever peeled and cut whole mangos you'll appreciate this can of delicious prepared mangos.  There has to be 2 or 3 whole mangos per can.  If they would use the natural mango juice instead of light sugary syrup they would have a HIT on their hands.  Still, even with the high sugar content, these canned mangos are terrific as a cake or ice cream topping or even just by themselves.  I will be buying this product again when it's in stock and on sale again.  If you like mangos and can tolerate some added sugar, I highly recommend this canned fruit.  Roland does a nice job with their fruits but stay away from their vegetables.

I love mangoes.  One of my favorite fruits.  But fresh mango is expensive in the U.S. and also seasonal. I love mango that is sweet and a teeny, tiny bit of tartness. I bought this item thinking that canned mangoes would let me have mangoes during the off-season.  But I am disappointed with this one. I agree with one reviewer that the mango is mushy.  It has been overprocessed to the point that there is no characteristic taste or flavor of mango at all. Even if you try making a milkshake out of this mango, you wouldn't recognize that it has mango flavor.  The texture is horrible.  It is better to go for the canned peaches from your local store instead (I haven't tried Roland's canned peaches). At least canned peaches have good texture and flavor. The taste of this mango is just plain, flat sweetness from the syrup. They look good but don't taste as good as they look. Somehow, they have good fresh mangoes to start with but they need to reformulate the canning process to preserve the distinctive taste and flavor of fresh mango, and while they are at it, they might as well make a no-sugar added version as well.
It's ok, but it's nothing like Libby's caned mango. I really would prefer that it would look a little fresher. It's not as  firm and fresh looking as Libbys. All that said the taste is satisfactory.

These canned mangos taste so close to fresh ones that my grandchildren and husband sometimes prefer them rather than taking a chance that the fresh mangos from the store are actually ripe.  Wonderful quality.

I purchased a case of these based on an Amazon review. I can does not even contain 1 average mango. They are mushy, pick them up with your fingers and they fall apart. Fresh is a cheaper way to go. For convenience consider dried.

I have been drinking Folgers Decaff Coffee for several years, although it was the first time I bought it through Amazon.  This coffee has the best taste since it is to be brewed and I feel like if I were drinkng regular coffee.  I strongly recommend it.
I received the shipment of folgers clasic roast.  It is a good product and I was happy about the shipment.JK

I love Starbucks coffee and drink nothing but the dark blends. This is one of, if not my absolute favorite Starbucks coffee blend! Wish this was in the year round rotation, it would definitely be one of my "go-to" coffees.This blend was originally a "one-off" anniversary tribute blend coffee in 2011. Starbucks decided to bring it back for a limited time in 2012. It is bold, flavorful, unique, and addicting. Hope they decide to bring this coffee back again in the future.
You can't go wrong with Starbucks coffee. There isn't really much to say about it other than that it is great.

UPDATE: I now no longer see on the page that it is organic.  I will now buy:Woodstock Farms Organic Shiitake Mushrooms,and it is at a lower cost.I think these organic shiitake mushrooms have a better taste and texture than the non-organic shiitake from the same seller; they are smaller if that matters; and the cost is low for mushrooms in general, and it's organic.
The mushrooms are quite similar to what I used to eat in China. It is with good quality and the package arrived to me in time and in good shape.

I discovered this product in 2011. Loacker Quadratini make me feel like someone who belongs in a palace. The way this italian wafer melts in your mouth creates a sensation that difficult to describe. So far i think its the best wafer ever created. I make sure and order like ever few months. The ingredients combined are so fine i dont know how they do it.
Kenya, one of my favorites, is a great bold, full bodied coffee with fruity undertones.  Makes a wonderfully delicious cup of coffee.

I have tried several of the Starbucks coffees and enjoy many of them, but Kenya is my absolute fave.  Waking up to its smell makes me immediately happy :).  Thanks, Starbucks for going all over the world to find very yummy coffees!

column9: Great taste ... Black & Orange Round-Up Lollipop
column10: This is a lollipop that has flavor (orange) throughout and quite yummy!  It tastes different, less artificial, than other lollipops and that is what made us order more than once!High school colors are orange and black so used this first for graduation party (having the lollipops fanned out) and then just for special occasion (birthday) or celebrations (sports banquets, etc.).Loss of one star: Part of the lollipop goes over the top of the stick and that is the easiest part to eat, the rest is swirled around a stick that is a small diameter dowel stick. It was a bit of a drawback that part was swirled around this hard stick and you had to try and lick it off or bite it off--you end up leaving little pieces of it on the stick. Would have loved to have had a softer stick that had a bit of give to it or even had a round lollipop that had the majority of it off of the stick. The stick part probably means that this is not for preschoolers.But yummy flavor and thinking of ordering more!

column9: Great Bargain. Great Fruit. Very impressed
column10: Found this company online and ordered a basket of fruit as a trial run. My family and I were very impressed with the product in how it was packaged, and more importantly the taste of the fruit. We will definitely be purchasing fruit from them again.
I did not see or sample this gift I sent my friends but according to them the fruit was beautiful and delicious. My girlfriend loves the basket and keeps it in her home.

I sent this to my parents for xmas and is was lovely. The basket itself was big, and the fruit plentiful and fresh. The entire presentation was wonderful. I am definently going to send another to other family!

The transaction was quick and it was on time, that is why I gave it two stars and not one star. The picture shows an explosion of fruit coming out of the basket. What I received was 9 pieces of fruit in the basket, it looked nothing like the picture... To quote my high expectation Asian family " Y U no buy bigger basket"
I sent to this to my family in Vermont and they loved it!! Stated that the fruit was vry large and in excellent condition. Will definitely buy again!
I sent this basket to my mother as a christmas gift. She said all the fruit was fresh and of the highest quality. I will definately send this again!

This fruit basket was a gift. When my friend received it she was so happy because she and her family love fruit, she especially love that there were so many different fruit in one basket and the fact that there were kiwi's made my friend very happy an that is what I was trying too do.THANK YOU GOLDEN STATE FRUIT!!!!!!!!

I just ordered eight (8) baskets - yes, really - and sent them to 8 different clients for Christmas. There are so many unhealthy gift basket options (candy, cookies, popcorn, snacks) that I thought this might stand out from the crowd and be a nice change of pace. So far the baskets have arrived faster than expected - and I took advantage of the FREE SHIPPING offer - and the feedback has been terrific. "Golden State Fruit" is smart to sell their baskets on Amazon. I am a HUGE Amazon fan, including a Prime Membership. The picture looked beautiful, the reviews were all 5 stars, and they offered Free Shipping. That's all I needed to take the plunge and drop close to $400 with this company. I'll follow up if anything changes, but for now I am very pleased with my decision.

column9: Save your money! Where's the bounty?

I have an iSi Twist and Sparkle Beverage Carbonating System and wanted to make a diet cola. column9: If you got Ginger Beer, consider yourself lucky
column10: I've been making all kinds of soda for the last 5 years from various concentrates, with a home-made carbonation kit that consists of little more than a tank of CO2, some hoses, a filter and regulator.  I regularly get the Homebrew Root Beer and Homebrew Cola and have tried every other flavor they sell.  For starters, the Ginger Ale (and several others) keeps the essential oils in an alcohol suspension, yet is sold in a plastic bottle.  It doesn't take a chemist to figure out just how stupid that is.  Every bottle I've received has been partially collapsed, bubbled/sticky on the outside and has 'particulate matter' on the inside, due to the volume of alcohol migrating through the plastic.  Same with the Lemon flavor as well - it's been totally revolting.Avoid this - get the Ginger Beer instead of the Ginger Ale, use Koolaid unsweetened mixes for the fruit flavors, and really just use the Homebrew label for the Cola and RootBeer products.  Get any soda concentrate with essential oils in suspension (read: most) from a distributor that uses glass bottles.My Soda Rig:*The Carbonator - fits to 20ounce and 2liter bottles: [....]*Ball Lock Disconnect - connects the Carbonator to the CO2 tank: [....]*5lb or 20lb CO2 tank (get the 20 if you don't need your rig portable) - local beer homebrew or welding store.  Make sure it's food grade.*Dual Gauge CO2 Regulator: [....]*3-6 feet clear tubing with 1/4inch interior diameter.  It only needs to handle 50-60 psi, so it doesn't need to be reinforced.Most of this stuff can be gotten cheap from various local sources or somewhere here on Amazon ([....]).  Once you put it together, you can start carbonating just about anything.

column9: great scones- a few recipe suggestions
column10: these scones are absolutely fantastic. i have been looking for a great alternative to starbucks scones for a while and this is it.  first off, i used 4 tbsp of whipped smart balance instead of butter and a tablespoon of soy creamer instead of milk.  this worked well, but just a warning: these scones are slightly savory/salty due to the black pepper and sea salt in the mix.  I found the finished product to be a tad salty (i think the smart balance added salt) so before baking a second time i sprinkled A LOT of turbinado sugar all over the top- problem solved. if you use regular, unsalted butter this may not be as much of an issue.i know that using cubed chilled butter is crucial in regular scones, but here, i found that allowing the smart balance/butter to warm up a bit first helped keep the scones moist while baking.  instead of cutting the butter in with a knife, i threw the cubes in there and made crumbs with my hands. using my hands warmed the butter up a bit more and helped incorporate it into the mix and there were no dry portions.  i think this also helped keep them moist and there was no grainy texture whatsoever when i tried them.before baking, i actually shaped the dough ball into a round disk with thick sides. my disk was about the size of the center of a salad plate.  i then refrigerated the dough overnight and cut them into 4 triangle-ish shapes in the morning.baking a larger scone kept them moist and they looked/tasted exactly like my old starbucks favorites.  they had that nice high, cracked side and the top had a crust and shine from the sugar.  i served them with some pumpkin butter on the side- delicious.buy this product- you will not be disappointed!

I've always found that odd and everyone should make sure to take those extra calories (and the extra caffeine) into account when they drink it.In my opinion: the best tasting energy drink on the market!

I have always been a fan of the No Fear energy drinks and this one is no different. The flavor is great and it doesn't have a nasty after taste like some of those other energy drinks. I will be picking up more of these very soon!

This was great. I'm not fond of Red Bull, but I do love Monster Energy.  This was quite comparable to the taste and effect of Monster Energy.  The serving size suggested is two per can.  But I had to drink the whole thing, it was good. The energy level went from blah to a nice wide awake feeling, without being wired.

I was pleasantly surprised by the clean, sparky taste of No Fear.  It was clean and did not leave much aftertaste.  That, however, is the best part and the super energy part is unavailable for me to define and address with specificity.  On consecutive days I split the 16 oz can into two drinks just before going out for my test period which lasted about 4 hours each.  I was careful to isolate my physical, emotional and mental health for the several days preceding my test period.(Please keep in mind that those items are purely subjective and so are my feelings about No Fear.  Sadly, it is close to impossible to accomplish and objective comparisons with one can of supplement.  Even though the promo suggests that there are 12 cans in the study I only received one.)The high amount of caffeine did not add any detectable energy.  My coffee intake prior to leaving is usually about the same as in No Fear.  Thirty three grams of sugar in a serving (8 oz) should produce a significant increase in energy but I did not notice any.  None of the normal aches and pains reflected any improvements.In short, a great tasting drink with questionable and unproven claims just does not justify the cost per serving.

In general, I have not had good experiences with energy drinks.  Although I like the lift they give on a long day at work, they usually taste so awful I just avoid them.  The only exception was with Monster Java which had various iced coffee flavors and tasted good and gave a good jolt.  Unfortunately, Monster Java is not as common but I keep hoping maybe I'll find an energy drink that won't taste like carbonated cough syrup.No Fear is the latest candidate and it actually wasn't totally disgusting.  At first it actually was pretty good as it had a bit of a sour taste and not the sickly sweet flavor common in such fare.  But about a third of the way through, I started picking up a rather unpleasant aftertaste.  Not as bad as some, mind you ... but enough to make you think twice about a repeat performance.  As far as the kick it gives, it is not as strong as some I have had but not as weak as others.  Basically about average and there was no major crash at the end.  Of course, such evaluations tend to vary with personal body chemistry.Overall, while No Fear is certainly not horrible and is actually drinkable, it was not enough to stop me from looking for something better.

column9: Meh. I think Ill stick with Monster
column10: I go back and forth between Monster and Rock Star. I have a Mega Monster or a couple Rockstars at least 3-4 times as week.  This No Fear was alright. I thought that flavor was just a bit off and not really pleasant.  Between Rockstar and Monster I think Rockstar Punched is far superior if that helps judge the flavor.I didn't get jittery or wired with this, but then again I only had one.One thing it didn't do was upset my stomach like some energy drinks - so that is a plus.All and all I didn't think it was any better than what I already drink. The flavor would not make me want to switch at all.

column9: A Good Tasting Pick Me Up
column10: Admittedly I'm not a fan of that ubiquitous Red Bull stuff.  In fact, I never take any energy supplement at all.  It would be nice to have a "go-to" type safe and tasty energy drink for the times when a cup of coffee just won't cut it.  Enter No Fear.  I immediately liked the taste of this stuff.  It slightly reminded me a an non-alcoholic non-energy drink I used to drink when if was around 12 to 15 years old which was called "Apple Beer".  Basically it had a nice grape/apple base with good fizz and so does No Fear.  No Fear gave me a noticeable lift after I drank half of the can.  I did not need to actually consume the entire can to get the benefit and, as mentioned, I liked the taste.  If it wasn't fairly high in calories I would not hesitate to consume the entire can at one time (this could be a help if after strenuous activity you were feeling shaky and needed some fuel/calories).All told, a tasty energy drink that delivers what the category promises:  a real noticeable lift without making you gag.  I would buy this stuff.

Not being a huge energy drink guy, my reviews for these have a lot to do with taste.  Considering energy drinks go from toxic sugar water to super fruity mess, its hard finding a decent one.With that in mind, No Fear Super Energy is just okay.  It has a bit of a mango taste to it, which I don't mind at all.  As far as energy goes, it does what it advertises it does: gives you a nice shot of energy for 3-4 hours.  Surprisingly, there was no "downer" on this one either, so that was a nice change from Monsters.Overall, this is a decent little energy drink that will probably be even more favorable if you like mango.

column9: Badass can doesn't make you into a bruiser
column10: I used to drink this stuff every day about 10 years ago.  Thought I would try a can and see what it's like now.  Tastes the same; sweet and highly carbonated.  It gives you the jitters just like any other energy drink on the shelf these days if you don't drink them on a regular basis.  This is not one that I frequently see in the refrigerated drink section at the grocery store for some reason.  At $28/12 cans, that's about $2.33 each.  Comparatively, RB is $39.99 here on Amazon for the same quantity.  Unless you are a fanboi or just have to have that taste, this will cost less in the long run.

I actually liked the taste of this drink. I would drink it without the energy factor. The taste alone is the reason I give this product four stars. There are two servings in one can. I only drank one serving at a time. I could not detect any extra energy or alertness. I am a coffee drinker though. It does have caffeine in it, but not an excessive amount. Probably just the right amount so it doesn't give one the jitters. I liked it.

I drank it before going to the gym and it woke me up, it didn't give me the shakes or jitters like some energy drinks have done to me before. The taste is decent as well, it's bittersweet and similiar to a regular red bull, it's almost like drinking a sparkling cidar without the fizz.

In comparison to other products (and pure generic 'yellow' caffeine pills), the No Fear Energy drink offers no better buzz.Every energy formula on the market produces a different energizing feeling, some are clean and high grade, while others like this one seem full of hype without a super energetic effect.Finally, in addition to producing a lower energy range, the taste of this formula is not too pleasing.

column9: I don't usually care for energy drinks
column10: Most energy drinks either taste like sugar water or taste like chemicals. This drink manages to find a balance between the two, while providing a significant energy boost. While higher in calories than some other drinks of the same type, I highly recommend this drink.

This tastes great. I can't say too much about the energy factor, although I should point out that energy drinks don't usually do much for me. It has a very nice mango flavor and doesn't taste like weird chemicals. Try it!

I was really excited to try this and I work at 3 am once a week. I usually take an AMP energy drink with me which I enjoy and works quite well, but I thought I would try this one. It was not a good experience for me. The morning that I drank it, I really needed. I did not get much sleep at all (probably about 2 hours) and I was tired. I started sipping on the the drink and I started feeling nauseous. I don't know if the nausea was because I was really tired (I tend to get nauseous whe I'm tired) or if it was from the drink itself (after I read the label I saw it had 1,000mg of Taurine compared to the 173mg in the AMP. But I decided to stop drinking it and switched to an AMP afterwards and my nausea went away.So, this is not a drink that I will have again, and I'm a little disappointed that I didn't get the chance to see if it actually worked or not. But compared to other energy drinks, the taste wasn't that bad. It wasn't my favorite, but it was a lot better tasting than other drinks that are on the market.

column9: Good flavor and no rush but plenty of smooth energy
column10: They don't actually tell you what the flavor of this stuff is supposed to be but it's not bad but it's not easy to point out the actual flavor either. I gave a taste to several people and got responses from sour apple, jolly rancher apple, grape, and a few others... It seems no one really knows what it is but no one complained about the flavor either.It seems to have a nice mix of ingredients that it doesn't give you a rush of energy but it does keep you awake through the day. I spent half the day just sipping on a can and it really does seem to do it's job without the rush like some other energy drinks will give you. That's a major bonus for me as I really don't like that rush. Overall it's a great product and I'm glad I got to test it out. I will certainly have to get me some so that I can have this instead of the ones I used to drink that I had to stop because of the crazy rush they would give me.I'll have to admit that I'm impressed with this brand and the fact someone actually put out a good energy drink that gives you energy and not a rush.

column9: The Taste is Good... but is the Science?
column10: This drink tastes fine as energy drinks go but is really nothing special. Sweetened by high fructose corn syrup, made tart with citric acid, some grape juice concentrate and other flavors added. 87 mg caffeine per serving and two servings per can. The black can with the angry and fractured skull [with wings on it] will appeal to certain people while turning others off. Marketing is everything with energy drinks. There isn't much science to support them beyond the caffeine improving endurance and concentration a bit. Simple coffee may be the better and cheaper choice for those wanting a boost. Many added ingredients are in very low amounts and should have little effect if any. There is a gram of taurine per serving, but the science supporting its use for an energy boost is not at all compelling.Ingredients:Carbonated Water, High Fructose Corn Syrup, Citric Acid, Taurine, Grape Juice Concentrate, Sodium Citrate, Natural Flavor, Inositol, Ascorbic Acid (Vitamin C), Sodium Hexametaphosphate (to Protect Flavor), Caffeine, Monopotassium Phosphate, Caramel Color, Sodium Benzoate (Preserves Freshness), Grape Seed Extract, L-Carnitine, Panax Ginseng Root Extract, L-Arginine Hydrochloride, Zinc Methionine Sulfate, Soy Protein Isolate and Rice Flour, Guarana (Paullinia Caruna), Seed Extract, Pyridoxine Hydrochloride, Calcium Disodium EDTA (to Protect Flavor), Selenium Complexed with Amino Acids and Polypeptides, Folic Acid, Cyanocobalamin.This beverage is a high sugar[260 calories per can] soft drink with a gram of taurine per serving added and perhaps twice the caffeine of the average caffeinated soft drink. It has less caffeine per ounce than brewed coffee. If you like the taste and don't mind paying much more for a few cents worth of caffeine and some other ingredients of questionable value ... enjoy it!  For most people caffeine presents little trouble... used in moderation. But anxiety, heart palpitations, high blood pressure and digestive troubles can follow slamming too much caffeine from any sources... go easy! Peace.

column9: Tastes good and give you the umph!
column10: I like energy drink with good taste and doesn't give you the crash.  This one tastes good and give you the energy without any crash afterwards.  I haven't see this one in any grocery chains near where I live, but glad Amazon carries it.  But, i woudl defintly buy more if it were available in grocery store, which would make it convenient. Anyways, good drink.

column9: Decent Enough - I prefer low cal versions
column10: The only fear I had in trying out this No Fear energy drink was the fact that it was the fully loaded calorie version (I normally drink low cal versions to spare my tire a bit).  I shrugged off the calories and chugged down this drink.  Taste was actually pretty good - not to overpowering and not too weak - kind of a generic non-offensive taste.  As for energy - nothing too noticeable for me, maybe just a bit of an extra pick-me-up from the full sugar version.Net, net I would drink this again if it was laying around (such as in a buddy's fridge).  But, I wouldn't buy it myself - at $2.50 per pop I would just stick with my tried and true brands such as Monster Lo Carb.  At a lower than major brand price point I might be more inspired.

Let me just say this stuff gives you what you want in an energy drink. While not the very best tasting energy drink on the market, I don't think any other drink give you a kick in the behind like this one does & to be absolutely truthful, taste is not what you buy these for. If you need a jump start pick one of these bad boys up & hold on! Most highly recommended!

No Fear Super Energy Supplement is a big can. Well, about the size of Monster or Rock Star, but if you aren't accustomed to drinking energy drinks, start with something smaller like a baby Red Bull. The first thing that struck me about No Fear was the taste. Sort of a shock, really. I have always, in my mind, compared the taste of all energy drinks to melted Sweet Tart candy, if you've ever had any of that. But No Fear definitely has a more fruity taste that I would compare to sweetened grapefruit. May not appeal to everyone. As far as an energy boost, I really didn't notice one, despite the can being so big that it has over 2 servings in it, and despite the ingredients being pretty much the same as most energy drinks on the market. Some energy drinks get me wired for hours, but not this one. If it did affect me at all, it just wasn't measurable to me. But it's worth a try, at least once.

I drank the entire can in one sitting, but didn't feel any sort of boost in energy. I'm not sure what the effects were, but the taste was decent. Like any other energy drinks.I'd recommend another energy drink that actually gives you a boost, though.

column9: No fear, unless you're scared of dishwater.
column10: I cracked this open to share with my boyfriend the other day.First, I just put some in two glasses, chilled, over ice.  His reaction:  "Good heavens, this tastes like dishwater!"  Mine: "Meh, it's not that bad, but it's nothing to write home about."I took two new glasses and poured some over ice, and added a shot of vanilla vodka.  This yielded the same results.Two more new glasses...this time chocolate vodka.  Better.Now we're out of No Fear drink...and neither of us are bemoaning that fact.  This just didn't have the "oomph" that other "amped" sodas have.  It lacked flavor.One good thing:  It was not over-carbonated.  I am not a big fan of majorly carbonated beverages, and this had just a little.If you're looking for a GREAT "amped" drink, look no further than GoFast.  [...]  I  wish Amazon carried it.  This stuff tastes GREAT, is not too bad for you, and mixes very well with the different flavored vodkas.  (Mixed with chocolate, it's a cherry cordial.)
I love the sobe no fear drinks...no carbonation...great flavor with a little after taste...disappointed that it was discontinued but glad i was able to stock up on amazon...

column9: Not bad, but won't make me change brands
column10: I frequently drink energy drinks and have tried most of the major and some of the lesser known brands. This "No Fear" one is decent, really nothing with it, but also nothing great. The drink contains 87mg of caffeine per serving (take note, a can contains 2 servings!), which is about average, as well as the usual mix of vitamins and other energy-boosting supplements. The taste is comparable to what you'd expect from an energy drink - you probably wouldn't pick these things up because they taste great, after all.All in all, there's nothing much that sets this drink apart from the pack, and because of that I'd rather go for the brands I am already familiar with. (My personal favorite, by the way, is the orange "Hydration" version of Rockstar, which actually tastes surprisingly close to orange soda, has a lower sugar content so it doesn't dehydrate you as badly as other energy drinks, and still gives you a solid boost!)

column9: Tastes great and really packs a punch!
column10: I use energy drinks to get rid of migraines.  On that front, No Fear is great!  In fact, I can only drink half a can at a time, or I get jitters (and I'm fairly immune that type of caffeine effect from drinking a daily Red Bull).I also love the peachy (or maybe mango) flavor.  This is a drink I really like.

column9: Better Tasting, Less Energy, Big 16oz Can....
column10: Ive tried a few other brand energy drinks and never liked the taste of any. Regardless I would drink the horrible tasting drinks to have the energy without the crash when needed and they did work. I found this No Fear Super Energy Supplement to give the same amount of energy but alot more to drink. The taste was not as bad though as the others - it was decently flavored and ok to drink rather then horrible tasting. It has a cherry flavor taste like cola. It is a 16 ounce can though compared to some 2oz drinks so there is alot more to drink. Keep in mind though the can is 2 servings... I prefer the smaller bottles to a big can.When I compare this to 5 hour energy the ones I am use to the flavor is far better with this drink. BUT its alot more can to drink to feel an affect which I actually then prefer the nasty tasting stuff as its a quick gulp and thats it... rather then a whole can to down. I feel more energized wit ha 5 hour energy, you can totally feel the difference. I did not have that same affect with this- it felt like it was starting to work and I was waiting for that full blown kick in energy but it never came. I can take a 5 hour when exhausted and I'm wide awake and alert for 5 hours no problem. With this I  could still head to bed if I desired.I do like the look of the can, its pretty cool looking but, what matters is inside the can. Energy drinks work differently for everyone. I'd recommend trying a few just a can or 2 from each til you find what works best for you. For me, its still 5 hour energy

I found the No Fear Energy Drink to be just the right size serving with a decent taste. I enjoy most energy drinks but this was better tasting than most, it did have the usual aroma of super sweet fruity and strong. I would definitely recommend this to someone that likes energy drinks and wants one with a good flavor.

column9: Just another energy drink... tastes slightly better than average.
column10: I drank one of these in the morning before going surfing. I had a slight hangover from the night before and was a little groggy. This didn't give me the extreme energy boost you'd get from pre-workout powder like Muscletech Neurocore, Fruit Punch, .42 lbs (189 Grams) (which I have also reviewed), but it did help wake me up a bit.A nice thing about this stuff is it actually tastes pleasant. Sort of a fruity, pink lemonade-y kind of flavor. Almost too sweet, but that's better than the awful metal/syrup flavor of a lot of other energy sodas.I typically don't drink this kinds of things, preferring coffee when I need a boost in the morning, but this wasn't too bad. If you are an energy drink person and regularly pound Monster or Rockstar or Red Bull, etc. it might be worth giving this a shot. It's got the caffeine of about 1.5-2 cups of coffee and is a nice flavor alternative to some of the other energy drinks out there.

column9: I'm afraid No Fear is not for me
column10: Here's what No Fear energy drink is: some kind of liquid, dyed some awful color, filled with sugar, caffeine, and a bunch of "energizing" chemicals ending with "-ine", packing 260 calories and a taste somewhere between an unripe strawberry and window cleaner. Does it give you "energy"? Sure, just like anything else that contains 260 calories worth of sugar. Is it good for you? I doubt it. If you are a fan of Red Bull, Monster, and similar drinks, I suppose No Fear will be right up there with those. If you're trying to eat right, lose weight and not get strung out on a bunch of chemicals, an apple or maybe a cup of coffee will probably give you just as much of a pick me up, without all the unpronounceable additives. Three stars for doing what it says it does, but No Fear is not my cup of taurine.

column9: Taste fruity, but if you drink coffee you won't feel a thing
column10: I drink about 24 ounces of coffee in the morning and love espresso.  I also take thermogenics to get a boost of energy so I am always jacked up on caffeine.  For me, these energy drinks don't really give me any boost of energy.  There is a good amount of caffeine in this can, and each can contains 2 servings.  It's a huge can, and actually taste good.  It reminds me of a pomegranate fruit drink.I liked the taste of the drink, and if you are a light coffee drinker, it might give you some energy.  It didn't do anything for me but might work for you.  Give it a shot if you can find it in stores.

Don't be terrified by the picture of the skull on the can. It didn't over caffeinate me.  As far as taste, I would say it was fair. It was very sweet like most energy drinks are, but it was loaded with B12 and B6 vitamins, which I liked. It gave me energy and got me through my workday. I could concentrate and work easily without feeling over stimulated or jittery.  As far as energy drinks go, it did its job well. I would recommend it for anyone interested in a little boost in his or her day.

After having tried many energy drinks over time this one claims to be a Super Supplement.  I would say it works, it makes you feel like you had a bunch of coffee but it tastes sour.  The flavor I had was a fruit punch but it was tart and just very sour, not something I would try again. It may taste better mixed with something or with ice but I only tried it straight from the can.

column9: Pleasant taste that doesn't match the packaging
column10: From the can, I expected No Fear to be a rather masculine drink. The logo and font suggests a manly drink. I was very surprised to find No Fear had a sweet, peachy taste, like a thin, carbonated peach schnapps. It was smooth, refreshing and very pleasant to drink, but didn't quite match the packaging.No Fear felt as effective an energy drink as a Rockstar or Monster (both come in the same size cans). I drink Rockstars fairly regularly and No Fear gave me more or less the same experience. Its taste is a bit more distinctive than a Rockstar though, so it would be more appropriate (for my tastes at least) as an occasional energy drink rather than your regular brand.

I have not had to many energy drinks but i am a Diet Coke addict I thought i'd give this a try. The taste was very pleasing to me almost has a grape fruit taste to it. The can was pretty cool looking nice graphic design.As for energy I consumed after I got out of work from job one around 4 in the afternoon and went to job two filled with energy and then came home still had plenty of energy to sit and read till 2 in the morning. Sort of sucked knowing i had to get up at 6 and do it all again. So I think this energy drink will be fine for weekend use.Would like to find in stores but might have order from here.

I've had Red Bull, Monster Lo Carb, and Five Hour Energy before.  They all seem more or less alike to me.  Each has a somewhat medicinal taste and gives me a bit of a boost for a few hours.  No Fear energy drink is comparable.  The flavor of this one is fruitier than Red Bull or Monster Lo Carb, but it still has a distinctly medicinal and somewhat bitter taste behind the initial sweetness.  The can contains two servings, but there is no way to preserve the carbonation once it's open.  So you're getting a double dose whether you like it or not.I haven't seen this in stores in my area.  I might try it again if I come across it, depending on how it's priced compared to the similar products out there.

column9: Tastes good, effects comparable to Red Bull and Monster
column10: Some of the negative comments by other reviewers about the taste of No Fear Super Energy Supplement led me to expect the worst from the 16 ounce sample I received for review purposes, but to my surprise I liked the taste. I really liked it. I drank the entire can in place of my afternoon cup of coffee one day (which would've been 16 ounces made very strong with freshly ground Peet's French or Italian roast beans), and got a stronger, longer lasting buzz than the coffee would've given me, with no undesirable side effects (e.g., no jitters and no feeling that my heart was racing) or after effects (e.g., no "crashing").Each 16 ounce can of NFSES contains 2 servings, so one can contains 174 milligrams of caffeine. According to the Mayo Clinic, 16 ounces of Starbucks Pike Place brewed coffee contains 330 milligrams of caffeine, nearly twice the amount of caffeine in 16 ounces of NFSES.One thing that brewed coffee does not contain that NFSES and many other energy drinks contain is taurine. A 16 ounce can of NFSES contains 2000 milligrams of taurine, which is approximately the same amount of taurine found in 16 ounces of Red Bull.Taurine is an amino acid that was first isolated from ox bile in 1827, and the name taurine comes from the Latin word "taurus" (as in the astrological sign) for bull or ox. (The taurine in energy drinks is synthetic.) I recently purchased a bottle of Now Foods Taurine 1000Mg, 100-Capsules. According to NOW Foods, taurine "supports a calm mood" or has a "relaxing effect on the mood" (statements that come with the disclaimer that the FDA has not evaluated these statements). And indeed that is my experience when I take one or two 1000 milligram taurine caps without drinking any caffeinated beverage. And so I am led to wonder why taurine is a major ingredient in so many energy drinks. Dr. Neil L. Harrison, who is a professor of pharmacology and anesthesiology at Columbia University says, "Its inclusion in these supplements is a little puzzling, because our research would suggest ... [that] taurine actually would have more of a sedative effect on the brain." (Source: Cornell University Chronicle Online, "Scientists close in on taurine's activity in the brain" 2/13/08.) (According to a 2004 article in Medical News Today titled, "French ban on Red Bull (drink) upheld by European Court," Red Bull claims that taurine can kick-start the metabolism, which may thus be the reason it is included in so many energy drinks. The French ban Red Bull was lifted in 2008: "The drink had been banned in France for twelve years due to health authorities' concerns about unknown consequences of the ingredient taurine, a chemical forbidden in several countries. Until now a modified version of the drink, containing caffeine but not taurine, was on sale in France." Source: Reuters article, "France ends 12-year ban on energy drink Red Bull," 7/15/08)Until now a modified version of the drink, containing caffeine but not taurine, was on sale in France.)A 16 ounce can of No Fear Super Energy Supplement has 260 calories, which is about the same number of calories found in two 12 ounce servings of beer (beer calories vary by brand), one MacDonald's hamburger (250 calories), or one 2 ounce Snicker's candy bar (266 calories). A 16 ounce can of Sugar Free Red Bull has 20 calories.I can't imagine that anyone would want to order a whole 12-pack of NFSES without first trying it to know if they find it palatable and to get a sense of how it affects them.

No Fear certainly does the "energy boost" trick very nicely.  Taste-wise... I generally find Monster and Red Bull to be too sweet: I would rather drink a regular (diet, high-caffeine) soda.  I really like Sobe Adrenaline Rush, which is probably the "least sweet" of the energy drinks.  (I also like NOS Citrus, but that's just because I grew up on Mtn Dew).  All in all, since price is an issue with energy drinks, I usually go with what's on sale.  With that in mind, even though it isn't my favorite, No Fear is absolutely good enough that I'll buy it if it's the least expensive option on the shelf.

No Fear,Super Energy Supplement, 16-Ounce CansNo fear energy drink was tasty and it did have caffeine that gave it a kick to keep you going through the day. It had a high sugar content of 20 MGs. I think that's a little high which made it a little too sweet for my taste. However I know there are people out there that truly like sugar and prefer it in their coffee and tea. Not me! I like something more tart. I truly prefer coffee for a jump start and some of the other drinks to get an actual juice flavor. "No fear" had a fruity taste to it which was probably wears some of the vitamin B content came from. The price seemed a little high so for me I would have to give it three stars and nothing more. I could only drink this in a pinch.If you're going to try this drink then my recommendation would be to use it very judiciously and take the cost factor into account when you're drinking it.

column9: The taste test was a draw in our household
column10: I'm a thirty-something Mom that limits my energy drink intake.  Not because I can't use the extra energy, but because I normally don't care for the taste.  My boyfriend is forty-something and drinks energy drinks on a daily basis, usual right before his evening workout.  He prefers sugar free ones, but occasionally buys the regular versions.  My daughter is a high school senior who likes energy drinks and consumes 3-4 a week, to help keep up with her busy schedule. She doesn't seem to be picky about them; sugar-free, regular, carbonated, pretty much whatever is on sale.  So I decided that we would all try out the No Fear,Super Energy Supplement and to do so I purchased a 2nd can so that we could each have a full serving, which is 8 ounces.  After taste testing, these were the results.Me - I liked the flavor, which surprised me.  It was fruity, without being too much.  There was an aftertaste that I didn't care for though.  I drank mine in the morning and I did feel like I had the same level of energy as my normal 2 cups of coffee and no jittery feelings.  Overall I gave it 4 out of 5 stars.Boyfriend - He didn't care for the flavor at all.  He said he smelled mango, which is something he hates. He of course didn't care for the high sugar content and said he couldn't see himself ever buying this brand. Energy wise, he said it did it's job just fine. From someone that drinks energy drinks daily, his opinion definitely had me listening. He gave it 2 of 5 stars.Daughter - She liked the flavor, energy level, but didn't care for the can design. (Remember she's a teenage girl so they think of these things.)  She did say that these were priced higher than her usual couple brands so that would be a factor in any future purchases. She ended up giving it 3 out of 5 stars.

column4: There's No Stopping Space Vikings T. Edwards!
column9: Similar to NOS or Orangina in flavor.
column10: There isn't a lot to say about an energy drink.  This particular No Fear drinks follows the well charted waters of other similar 16oz energy drinks in composition and expected level of effectiveness.  Where this one goes the less traveled route is in its flavor.  To my knowledge only this and NOS opt for a citrus flavor akin to sodas like Slice, Fresca, or Orangina rather than that all too familiar Red Bull and Monster "is that Taurine?" flavor.  That, in and of itself, makes it a much better tasting drink and considerably easier to drink to me.  To that end I thought this was a pretty good drink which I would buy again or recommend.  Still dramatically high in sugar and arguably unhealthy in general but a good tasting and easy drinkin' energy drink no less.

These days, with so many energy products coming at you a mile a minute you never know what to expect. I was won over right away by the taste. It is delicious! Not like some other drinks with a bad after taste or worse. It is not over caffeinated. Just enough for that morning "kick" and so far no crash either. It is packed with vitamins and supplements such as B-12 and Grape Seed Extract. I drink it slowly over about 30 minutes in the am. That seems to work for me. Try it.

column9: Nice Flavor, Not So Great Energy
column10: When I first opened the can, I caught a whiff of the aroma and thought something had gone bad in the can.  It was truly unappetizing.  I tried a sip anyway, and it tasted fine, so I ventured forth.  The taste is best described as a sweeter Red Bull.  The carbonation isn't overly done, so it has some fizz, but not like a soda, which is also good.It contains 100% daily RDA for several things, including vitamin C, but then no one drinks an energy drink to ward off the common cold.  The true test is the energy boost, and for No Fear I found little of that.  Actually, all I really got was a headache (I am not caffeine sensitive.  I don't drink energy drinks daily, but I have had them about once a week without headaches.).  I'm willing to believe that this headache was a coincidence, but I did deduct stars for the lack of energy in an energy drink.So, overall, bad aroma, nice taste, poor energy.

I was given one can of "No Fear, Super Energy" to try out for this review.  At the outset I should say that I am not a regular energy drink fan, though I have indulged on occasion, largely out of necessity, when I was desperate for energy or forced to stay awake all night.  I have always viewed such drinks as a little bit dangerous and largely a necessary evil but one that is clearly needed during this day and age.  I've never been a fan of the taste, but it's difficult to argue with the burst of energy that such drinks provide.  That said, this "No Fear" big can -- each can containts two servings -- was just OK, no better and no worse than any of the other drinks I have occasionally tried and largely disliked over the years.A few reviewers have described the taste as cola-like or even fruity, and I think that says a lot about the rather, well, ambiguous flavor.  The one thing that I can certainly agree with is the utterly unpleasant aftertaste that tingles like a vitamin or pill that you accidentally bit into before swallowing.  Now, did it increase my energy?  Of course, as any huge jolt of caffeine to my system would do.  Would I try it again?  Well, as I said, I'm not a fan of energy drinks but recognize the occasional need for one.  If I was in need and "No Fear" was handy, sure, I'd drink it again.  Would I choose it over another brand?  No.  There is no real difference in my opinion.  Of course, if you're a fan of energy drinks -- as many of these reviewers are -- your mileage may vary.  This might be the best or worst tasting energy drink ever.  Much like the flavor, it's all very ambiguous.

I  normally resort to coffee based drinks to get my morning started, however, I decided to try out No Fear Super Energy.I have tried the major energy drinks such as Spyder, Red Bull, and Monster.  This one has a taste along those lines.  It was very sugary and carbonated with a grape/citrusy taste.  Shockingly, the vitamins in the drink account for 100% of your daily value for Vitamin C, Vitamin B6, and Vitamin B12.  I must say that it did not get me jittery, but at the same time it did not completely "pep" me up either.  The bad thing is the can I purchased was 16oz which was two servings and 260 calories!  Knowing that, I do not think this will be my go to daily morning drink.

column9: Hey, the can has a cool look and I like the taste... but....
column10: Hey, going on a juicing health kick this year has me try and stay away from energy drinks, but still I sometimes feel the need for a boost.  My standard drink is the green label monster, and I can get it at sale prices in the 16 ounce cans for about a dollar on sale.  I buy a lot when it's on sale and when it's not I get the 2 for 3.00 deals that are frequently made at filling stations.  This is just as drinkable and provides a similar array of energizers and caffeine.The drink tasted to me a little like grapefruit, and I liked the flavor, but not enough to this is a special taste I want to have again!  Frankly in something as highly competitive as the soft drink market, I don't see this hanging around for long unless there is a very big player behind it and they discount it to knock out the competition.  I'm still not sure of the value of energy sodas, they appear to me to run down your health under the guise of keeping you going.  At least it's not the joke like that 5 hour thing, that doesn't even have energy just some cheap stimulants and an overblown price.The price on this one is frankly too much for me to consider, pretty much what the out of the vending machine price would be for a typical energy drink.  Had they sent me more than a can I'd have evaluated the drink over a few weeks, and maybe given a feel good or feel bad report, but with just the one can, I can't make any such claims.  Bottom line is cost, and cost is not very good.  That said it's not awful either, so if this makes it to the grocery, and is on sale I may buy again, just for a change of pace.

The No Fear energy drink is designed to give you a boost in energy when you need to be alert, or are feeling tired. I have tried several energy drinks in the past, and this one is a good option. It is highly carbonated, and it tasted a little strong to me, but it was not unpleasant by any means. I don't think that it gave a better boost than any other drink, and I don't think that it is the best tasting, but it does work. So for that I do give it four stars. If you can get it cheap it is worth a try.

column9: Great taste, gives a good sugar / caffeine rush
column10: I don't drink a lot of energy drinks but when I do then I normally reach for a NOS because of its great citrus taste. I have tried a handful of other energy drinks and I haven't liked the taste of them at all. No Fear Super Energy has a similar taste to NOS and I really like it as well. I would describe the flavor as a very sweet and smooth grapefruit taste. If you are looking for a sugar / caffeine rush then this will get the job done at the expense of high calorie count. I found that this 16 oz. can will give me a nice boost of energy for 4-5 hours.

column9: "No Fear, Super Energy Supplement, 16-Ounce cans" (Pack of 12)
column10: This drink contains a lot of ingredients, many that I was happy to see, such as Vitamins C,B6, B12, Zinc, Selenlum, Folic Acid and Potassium, as well as their Proprietary Blend which includes Taurine, Inositol, Grape Seed Extrace, L-Carnitine and L-Arginine.  Was not happy that it contained Caffeine, Sodium, corn syrup, soy and sugar--For this reason, I would not purchase this as a "health drink."  This drink has sort of a citrus taste and goes down easy when cold.  Eight fluid ounces of this drink is 34 total carbs, so most people would want to drink this 16 FL OZ can in two servings.  This product made me a little sick to my stomach, but I was far from being wired.  I do not plan on purchasing this product in the future, because of the salt, caffeine, sugar, and because 16 FL Oz is just too much to drink at one time.

I got sort of a grapefruit taste out of it with a little of that energy drink type aftertaste. The aftertaste wasn't as pronounced as I had experienced with other drinks either, I really liked that fact. After drinking the can I did get a boost in energy. I didn't notice any crash later on either. I wouldn't say this is my favorite energy drink but it wasn't bad either.

column9: Nice tasting and boost of energy
column10: I drink a lot of energy drinks. This was my first time trying No Fear. The taste is fruity and quite pleasant! I was lagging at work, drank this drink in 30 min and felt energized through out the rest of my shift. The only downfall is the calorie count, I prefer Sugar Free but if looking for a nice sugar/energy boost this will do the trick!

I cant believe I found this stuff online. They stopped selling in central NY so I had to try and fill the void left with other energy drinks to no avail! This stuff has the best flavor of any of the big can drinks by far. The taste reminds of a cherry blow pop. I will definitely keep buying as long as you keep selling!

I am not too familiar with energy drinks, so my experience is somewhat limited. I was feeling pretty draggy at around 6pm, and it was a Friday night, so I felt like I needed a boost. The can said it had 2 servings, but I went ahead and downed the whole thing. Within a minute or so, my head was tingling and my eyes were like saucers. Is this normal?? I don't know if it was a placebo effect or if this stuff actually had an effect on me. It might have also had something to do with the video game I was playing, but I can't say for sure. Caffeine usually doesn't have a big effect on me... aside from causing an occasional acne flare up. (The side of the can DOES say it's not recommended for people who are sensitive to caffeine, so I'm assuming there's some caffeine in there).As for the taste, it wasn't wonderful, but it wasn't terrible either. It tasted like Sprite mixed with Pomegranate juice. It wasn't the best beverage I've ever had, but it certainly wasn't the worst.I'm happy to report I didn't have any sort of crash afterward. I don't know if it really had an effect on me, or if it was all in my head. Nevertheless, this drink certainly wouldn't be bad to try.

This energy drink tastes great and works great!  I am so picky about the flavors of any beverages.. I hate bad after-tastes or being able to taste the ingredients within the drink that taste like vitamins or medicine.. This drink does not have any of this.  I immediately loved the taste - almost like a fruit punch.I started drinking the drink (1 can of 16 oz) at lunchtime and was still going well on the energy it provided at 7:30 PM.I rarely drink energy drinks, but I am NOT sensitive to caffeine (drink sodas and coffee daily) - this energy drink provided a lot more energy than anything else I have tried.  When I do drink energy drinks, I normally like Redbull (ok) and Amp (better), but now I will most likely buy No Fear (best) when I need that extra boost.Each 16 oz can provides 2 servings at 130 calories each serving (for you health conscious people out there).  It contains Taurine, L-Carnitine, and Arginine.  Also, please note that it contains soy (for you that have this allergy).Overall - great taste, great energy provider... I will buy this again!

column9: A teenagers perspective - just so so
