This oil is amazing. And I understand all the reviews, positive and negative. It's a matter of taste. For me, this works. It's cold pressed. It's kept in a dark bottle. I can support it through my orders and help the company grow. Overall, it makes me happy. AND I cook with it. That's right, I cook it - when I need to cook olive oil - and it tastes fantastic either way.Give it a shot, make your informed decision, and then move on if you don't like it. Or get addicted like I am.
It's the only olive oil we use.  We have food allergies and this is the most unadulterated one that we have found.

This is amazing olive oil.  We have used many different olive oils through the years, some good, some not so good.But this is exceptional oil, very tasty!We were impressed with the story of this oil.  Check out the story here:  [...]If you want the best, you must try this oil.  You won't be disappointed!

I gave this Oil to my son as a birthday gift. He said it is fantastic. Rich and flavorful. He wishes he could drink it. He uses it on salads, drizzels it on tomatoes and fresh mozzerella. Also, uses it as a dipping oil with bazil, chapatta or fresh Italian bread. It's HEAVEN!!!!!!!!!!!
Bariani Olive Oil is the purest Olive Oil I've found to date. It's cold extracted which allows all the enzymes to thrive and not be destroyed by heat.
This is the best tasting Olive Oil!  AND so healthy for you too as it is raw or living and is organic!  JUST THE BEST!!!

I discovered Bariani at my CSA during the 90s and remember it as a superior and tasty product.  So I ordered a case (6 bottles) of 33.6 oz Bariani this fall 2010 and boy, was I disappointed!!!  This oil has a BITTER finish.  Sore throat bitter! I dont remember it being like this--this bitterness is memorable!  Has the production changed?  Does the oil get damaged by heat in a warehouse situation?  First impression is pleasant but the flavor is soon replaced by an extreme bitterness.I'll use the Bariani for cooking and hope that Im not poisoning myself.

column9: Even my 5-year old insists on it
column10: This is just great.  It is true that if you get a newly bottled bottle, then the flavors will be a little sharp.  The solution?  Let it sit - it mellows wonderfully in a few months time.My 5-year old refers to it as "Daddy's special oil" and she refuses to eat the usual grocery store suspects.  I think she'd drink it if we let her.

column9: The best olive oil anywhere, at any price!
column10: Put simply, this is the best olive oil you can buy.  It is just delicious, and you won't  be able to use any other brand after you taste this.  I love it!!
I wanted HIGH QUALITY , and this is it. This brand was highly recommended .
Amazing flavor and LOVE that it is truly raw!  Organic, first cold pressed - you can't go wrong with this California olive oil.

column9: BEST TASTING OLIVE OIL ON THE PLANET
column10: WAS SKEPTICAL AT FIRST...BUT ''WOW'' THIS IS THE TOP OF THE LINE......THEY DON'T GET ANY BETTER THAN THIS....

column9: The most amazing olive oil ever!
column10: I actually buy a huge bottle of this olive oil every so or often from the Italian grandmother (a Bariani, I presume) who sells it every Saturday at the Berkeley Farmers' Market. Definitely the most expensive olive oil I have ever bought but also hands down, the very best I had!

column9: Not bad, but not as good as Apollo
column10: I like robust olive oils with pronounced flavors.  Although Bariani was good, it was a bit light with not enough green fruit.  I prefer Apollo Olive Oil, which available here or directly from the producer.

We like a full flavored olive oil and this one sounded like it might fit the bill; however, it has a rather acidic, tangy taste we don't particularly like.  In an pinch I've used it on salad and it was OK, but I wouldn't use it as a dipping oil.  It's fine for cooking, but there are other less expensive olive oils that are also good for cooking.

I won't pretend to be an expert on olive oils;  but I will attest to being a family cook and consumer of olive oils and this one did not strike me as quite what I was expecting. The first whiff gives a hint of stale and when blind-taste-tested in my home kitchen by my husband, my ten year old and me- dipping crusty sourdough bread-straight-up, no herbs, no garlic no other flavors- 2 out of 3 of us selected the OTHER first-cold-pressed, Virgin Olive Oil from Italy;  we were trying to buy more American stuffs but will stick with our imported Italian olive oils for now. OK,  for me, this one is fine for sauteeing- just not the best fresh flavor for dipping or dressings. In case it it matters substantially-  the bottle indicates: 'Harvested  Fall '07 and Bottled 6-21-08'

I have done considerable reading on olive oil quality and sad to say, there is quite a bit of adulterated oil on the market. I cannot determine the true source of their oil, but each of the three bottles I purchased had a very acidic bite to it: either the oil was rancid or simply of very poor quality. Good oil will have a smooth buttery quality to it --- you can sip olive oil with the same delicateness of palate as you would wine. This oil however completely fails this test.

If you haven't tried swedish fish, then I feel sorry for you. Swedish fish are the most tasty, soft, chewy, addictive candy ever. Try them...you'll be hooked (get it? hooked? like a fish on a hook? I'm hilarious).Seriously though, this candy is the best. And what's better than 3.5 pounds of the best candy with free Prime shipping? That's right...nothing.

column9: Please note, these are MINIATURE Swedish Fish
column10: These were a gift and were as expected except for one detail: these are NOT the regular size Swedish Fish, they are a miniature version.  Each fish measures approximately 1" long and 1/4" wide.  Neither the item description here on Amazon nor the product packaging stated anything about this, so the recipient and I were both quite surprised when he opened the bag!  The taste is the same, but I really feel that such a major variation from the customary should be announced so that the consumer is aware of just what it is that they are purchasing.

This fish are just like Heaven in my mouth! They soft chewiness is like nothing you have ever tasted!  I am even eating some right now! But please be warned, these are smaller than the normal ones. I Did not purchase these from amazon but i read someones review and he said they were smaller! But I do not care as long as i get some fish in my mouth! If your looking for something to pick on at night, these are what you want to get! 5 OUT OF 5!
Im the type of guy that enjoys a swedish fish every now and again and buying this will helped alot[even though i finished the  bag in 10 days] I plan to buy again. 10/10

column9: These actually last in this house
column10: Let's just say that all five of us really enjoy swedish fish!  They are usually all gone in a matter of days!  However, I bought this pack for Christmas, but we still have over half the pack left!
Wish it is packed in small counts. But not. Anyway, found this as expected. Tastes ok. Definitely good price though.

Anyone who's been a kid and enjoyed candy knows what these are.  They taste exactly like they did all those years ago.  My biggest question was if these would be the "fresh" good ones I was hoping for or would they be hardened from sitting in a warehouse?  Much to my delight they were about as fresh as I could hope for.  Now hopefully I can finish them before they get a chance to harden.

column9: LOVE SWEDISH FISH...but these were a tad stale.
column10: I LOVE Swedish Fish. And the amount is a TUN, and I'm glad, but the fish I received weren't as fresh as I would have expected. And the fish are also the small ones, not the full size fish. That might be why they aren't as fresh as they might have been (the smaller the fish, the sooner it dries out?)... in any case, I find myself a bit disappointed.

column9: Great Size, Great Bag, Great Candy
column10: Worked out perfectly for the candy bar at my wedding!  Great size.  Resealable bag works well.  Arrived perfectly fresh.  Good crowd pleaser!

When these came, they were super fresh and tasty. Even after a few weeks, they still are good quality and I enjoy eating them. 3.5 lbs is a lot!! So plan accordingly. A normal size bag you buy is 2 ounces, a pound is 16, so you can think of this equalling 28 bags of swedish fish.

Cant say anything other than this is a pretty decent price and they do show up fresh, not sure I would order them in the summer because im sure they will get hot in the delivery truck but my only complaint is that the bag is a bit too small, it doesnt hold enough.  XD

I love Swedish Fish but was horrified when I received a bag of deceased fish!  The bag was torn open in the box.  Some were hard as rocks.  Others had melted into a bloody red mess.  What are you made of that you can house both extremes in one bag?  I'll never eat one again.  I've switched to blue gummy sharks.
The Swedish Fish I received were essentially rock-hard. I'll give it one more chance, at which point I'm probably never going to order candy from Amazon ever again.
These small swedish fish arrived in good condition, fresh and yummy!  Recommend for any occasion, yummy on ice cream too!
What more do you need to know? If you like Swedish Fish, these are it. If you don't, well, you're odd. because Swedish Fish are awesome.

I used this kind of hops in my batch of homemade Blueberry Wheat Beer. They worked great! Only thing the shipping was over priced for such a little pack of hops pellets. You should consider looking for cheaper shipping before placing your order.

This is a great way to use up holiday leftovers!  My family uses this soup as an excuse to play cards and relax after Thanksgiving-- with very little prep we can get a round or two of cards in while the house fills with wonderful smells!  Then the victors get to dig in first-- what a prize!!

Love this stuff.  Too bad it's so hard to find.  And ignore the person who gave this one star, every batch I've ever bought from Amazon has been fresh as a daisy with many months still left before its "best by" date.

This product is PAST the sell by date and is defintiely noticable in the taste. I fell for the low price -- BAD FOR ME.I'm out the money.  I suggest buying from your grocery store before buying these items.

I read reviews preferring Da Vinci, so I gave it a try.  I prefer Torani.  Torani has fuller, truer flavor.  Da Vinci was very thin and had minimally higher sodium.  Can't really justify the price for Da Vinci.  Torani was strong enough to provide flavor and go a long way before needing to be restocked.  I am sorry I bought three bottles of Da Vinci.  But I am certain now, after my taste testing, that no matter what the flavor, Torani has a satisfactory rating with me, and Da Vinci has an unsatisfactory rating.
At this price, I was expecting 3 bottles; got a nasty surprise when 1 bottle got delivered.  Amazon sells other brands of 3 bottles for the same price that taste just as good.

I first saw this in Ross, strange place for dog food but I grabbed one. My dog loved it so much. I had to search for it since it was not available anywhere in other stores. I finally found in on Amazon. Kind of expensive. but my dog loves it and I love my dog. What can I do ...

My shitzu pups love these treats but I just read the fine print and discovered that the California company imports this from china. Given what is put in baby formula in china I can't imagine what they might put in dog treats. Sadly, we won't purchase again for this reason.

I am lucky in that my 1 year Chihuahua isn't picky about his snacks and will eat just about anything. This product is no exception. I gave him one and he promptly took it to his favorite "eating spot" on the rug and went at it. I like the fact that it is low in fat and has somewhat natural ingredients as well as being good for the teeth. Since Chihuahuas can have dental problems, I am all for products that keep their teeth in good condition, since dental cleanings are quite expensive. Anyhow, he knows where his treats are kept and will eagerly anticipate getting one of these or some other tasty snack. Although it's made in China, my dog hasn't had any adverse reaction to the product. The product can get expensive but you can probably find a deal on it at your local pet store. That's how I first discovered these.

I HAVE AN 8 YEAR OLD CHIHUAHUA AND HE HAS NEVER BEEN A CHEWER.  HE DOESNT CHEW HIS TOYS AND DOES NOT EVEN LIKE TO EAT DRY FOOD.  I HAVE HAD TO HAVE HIS TEETH CLEANED EVERY YEAR WHICH IS VERY EXPENSIVE!!!  I HAVE TRIED ALL THE DENTAL CHEWS AND STILL NOTHING.  MY DOG LOVES THESE TREATS!!!  I AM VERY PLEASED AND LUCKY TO HAVE FOUND THEM!  WONDERFUL PRODUCT!

I have bought these many times for my two hungry golden retrievers.  This is one of their favorite treats.  They have had before the rice balls that are on the ends of these dumbbells and the treat in the middle is an added bonus.  They are crunchy so it helps keep their teeth clean.  Will be back buying these as they go thru these quickly.

I have two dogs, a Cairn Terrier/Chihuahua and a Yorkie/Chihuahua. Both are rescue dogs, and both love treats. Chik 'n Dumbells are their favorites by far. I have to ration them in order to make them last as long as possible. I would be willing to buy a larger size, or buy a larger quantity, if the price would come down. They are easily the most expensive treats I buy. Great product.

column9: Good size  for a favorite treat
column10: My Jack Russell loves the dumbbells.  I like them because they are relatively small, as she has a tendency to gain weight.

MY dog doesn't like many treats so I was delighted when I found the small packs at Petsmart.  They no longer carry them. Going online, I discovered that you sell them. For several months I have purchased these from you and my dog has loved them.  My last order seems to have changed.  The texture and color seem different and my dog won't eat them at all.  I don't know if this is a one time thing or the change is permanent.  I am very, very disappointed. The other treats I bought at the same time are the same, or at least she eats them sometimes.So I probably won't be purchasing the dumbbells again, especially since the price has gone from under $30 to $40...ThanksMarye
Great product especially for small dogs.  They are, however, somewhat fragile but as they are shipped in the plastic container, they arrive in great shape.  This was my second order.

My Shih Tzu, who is such a finicky eater, would eat these instead of a meal if I let her.  I gave it five stars from her as I have never tasted them and have no intention of doing so (although if you read the ingredients they are fit for human consumption).

5th Avenue candy bars are truly one of the best out there.  Far superb to the oh-so-sugary, too-sweet Butterfinger, the 5th Avenue takes the combination of peanut butter and chocolate and adds a satisfyingly audible "crunch" to the whole affair - without the interruption that comes from using whole nuts in the bars, as you may notice in Snickers or Baby Ruth's.No, 5th Avenue's distinguish themselves from Butterfingers in the fact that they maintain some semblance of the flavor of peanut butter within their golden centers. Butterfinger seems to content itself with stirring sugar water with a small dollop of peanut butter (and perhaps some food coloring, I'd dare say) before coating the confection with a thin layer of chocolate.5th Avenue, on the other hand, does the lovers of the peanut butter and chocolate combination true justice. Your teeth will glide through the thick, milk chocolate coating before they are but momentarily halted at the crunchy (though not nutty) peanut buttery center; each rapturous bite offers such satisfaction that you will hardly want to have to wait to swallow one before greedily taking another.This review was written by a lover of other chocolate/peanut-buttery delights as: Reese's Peanut Butter Cups (regular or bite-sized), Nutty Butty Bars, Reese's Pieces, chocolate cookies with peanut butter chips, Buckeyes, and peanut butter pie with chocolate shell crust, and S'mores (you must add peanut butter to your grahams for the perfect S'more, y'know).

I remember these candy bars as being quite good.  Unfortuantely, I cannot actually rate these, as they were a gift for my Mother.  However, I can tell you she is thoroughly enjoying them.  Apparently, she has difficulty finding them in the stores.
Love this candy.  It's like.. a Butterfinger that doesn't stick all to your teeth.
A very creamy milk chocolate with notes of caramel. I have used it in making bars - truffles - mousse - and numerous candies and pastries, all results were exceptional.
very good. multi layered. much better than the Voortman sugar-free wafers. Chocolate and Vanilla flavors are good. Lemon is great !
No lemon flavor at all, no taste at all just cardboard texture. I do not recommend this product. I will not ever buy again.

These cookies are so good! One of the best gluten free cookies I've had. Soft and fudgy, perfect for an indulgent treat. I bought them at a local gluten free grocery store, not at Amazon....and with the shipping price currently over $10, I'll stick to buying them locally. ;)
All the sodas were flatWe could not drink them they were so bad!We ended up throwing 99 % of it down the drainI can only conclude it was stored improperly or spoiled in shipment

My parents used to buy the Underwood Roast Beef spread every so often when I was growing up. Sadly, the stores around here don't sell it anymore- it's become quite difficult to find anywhere, really. On a whim, I decided to see if Amazon had it, and as soon as I saw that they did, I had to buy it. The stuff is still as tasty as I remember it to be. We always spread it on bread with mayo, as the spread itself can be a bit rich. I sometimes like to mix it with a little mayo and use it as dip for carrots or spread it on crackers.  When the package came, the whole family decended on it like a pack of wolves. lol The 12 cans didn't last our family too long, but it was well worth the cost. I plan on buying more sometime in the future- I just wish I could find it in my local stores.

why is this product so hard to find in the super markets? the chicken and liver version of this product is quite common.  the roast beef product is great for quick finger foods.  the product came in a timely manner and was packaged nicely.

Thank goodness the local WalMart started carrying this stuff again -- for a while there it was as rare as hen's teeth!  Nowadays I buy a can on each visit, whether I need it or not, just so they'll continue stocking it.  Stuff's great on toast or especially as a meximelt -- slather some on a tortilla shell, add salsa and cheese, fold it over and nuke it for 30-45 seconds.  Yum!

I love love this cheese, the price is great and the texture is amazing.  I've been buying from this company for a while and I don't have any complaint. this cheese taste just like the italian cheese that you would spend a lot of money on and while you can get this one twenty times cheaper!  getting ready to order more because I cook a lot with it but it always last me for four months which is a lot with six people in my family.

Aged cheeses are the perfect thing to buy in quantity...and we did.  What a nice find.  This is an outstanding product, especially when comparing the taste-to-price ratio.  I think the prices being asked for the Italian imports are ridiculous.  In a blind taste test, I know this would equal other parmesans going for 10 times the price....guaranteed.  It doesn't matter if you can't eat it all in a week, it will age perfectly for months in your frig.

column9: Got great price on closeout special
column10: vendor offered great price of less than $10/lb last year and thequality is extremely high and I think better than Italian imports.I cut it up with my miter saw into wedges and hand grate asneeded.  Excellent quality cheese I use on lots of dishes.

My kids love these...I would have to say that if I had one complaint, it would be that the white rice noodles got a little mushy when reheated, but the taste was great!  My kids loved all of the different kinds.

column9: Great way to try GF options
column10: One of the hardest things to get used to in my newly GF lifestyle has been the texture changes. This sampler was a great way to try a few things and see what I liked, and I ended up discovering I really enjoyed some of the pasta types. Pastariso is the only GF pasta brand my husband will eat now; I'm afraid that this change has been harder on him than me, but I'm glad I found something he's willing to eat.

All I can say is yum.  Easy to cook, fun shapes, excellent American made organic rice pastas.  Not sure if it's still available at the price I payed with free shipping, but slightly pricey and worth it.
Good is ramune.It tastes BETTER than Sprite.So order it.Because it is good Ramune.Really.

I'm an avid runner and I was getting tired of eating the really sugary peanut butter. I purchased this kind after recommendation from fellow runners and I must say I love it. You can actually taste the peanuts in it and the honey balances out the salty peanuts with a natural sweetness. If you think that the regular natural peanut butter is to salty I would try this kind! I loveee this peanut butter. It really is a great product. Only problem I noticed is while stirring the oil in, the oil tends to spill out so be careful.

My husband is the black licorice lover, and for valentines day I purchased these cute little Scottie dogs for him, not knowing if he'd like them or not, (he's a black licorice snob), and he loved them....so I'm on here to buy him more...he said their better then the Kookaburra black licorice I usually buy him....only the best for my honey!!  They are soft, and made from all natural ingredients, and just good!

My husband and I just looked at each other after eating one of the lemon wafer cookies and sighed.  The flavor is pure deep natural lemon, tart and bright, with a sweet creamy finish--nothing like any other lemon-flavored cookie I've ever bought.  Honestly, these are just terrific little cookies.And when we thought it couldn't get better, we tried the chocolate.  Natural, dense, delicious, dark chocolate taste.We plowed through both bags just going back and forth: lemon, chocolate, lemon, chocolate....No gross artificial taste.  No waxy texture to the cream.  No meek, bland flavors.  Just all-natural goodness that will blow your socks off.Time for another bag.

It is a very tasty treat I enjoy with my afternoon coffee. However, all good things must be had in moderation, and hence I will only buy one pack at a time from the local store.However the price on Amazon is competitive.I don't know why it was tagged as "not vegetarian" because I don't see any questionable ingredient on the list - perhaps someone else can elaborate.The dark chocolate filling has a nice creamy texture without being overwhelming; and nor is it cloyingly sweet.Overall all, I definitely recommend this product.

These are the greatest wafer type cookies I have ever eaten. I've also tried the lemon ones which are out of this world as well. They are wafer type but are cut into small cubes (ideal for snack size) instead of how they usually appear as a longer stick. They are very creamy and have a high quality chocolate taste. Awesome stuff. You'll only be sorry when they are gone and you have eaten too much.

ALL I CAN SAY IS OMG!THESE LITTLE TREATS ARE SO ADDICTIVE AND ONLY HAVE 10 GRAMS OF SUGAR IN NINE WAFERS!THESE ARE BY FAR THE BEST TASTING WAFER COOKIES I HAVE EVER HAD AND IF IT WERE NOT FOR ME BEING ON A DIET, WOULD EAT THE WHOLE BAG IN ONE SITTING!I CAN'T QUITE DESCRIBE THE FLAVOR EXCEPT TO SAY IT IS LIGHT, RICH AND NOT TOO SWEET.I HAVE NEVER BOUGHT THESE FROM AMAZON, JUST FROM MY LOCAL HEALTH FOOD MARKET.BUT THE PRICE ON AMAZON IS CHEAPER COMPARED TO BUYING IT LOCALLY WHERE I AM.
My wife loves these little wafers, but our local stores no longer carry them.  Amazon to the rescue!  Great product, fast shipping.  We are very happy and will continue to order these.
delicious hazel nut taste in a cunchy bite- size wafer cookie. highly recommended. will buy these again.remind me of the hazel nut coffee creamer

These Loacker Quadratini Lemon Wafers are the best I've tasted. They are natural with a real lemon 'punch' in every bite. Plus they are not overly sweet like some other wafer brands. I will definitely buy this brand again. (Since you get eight bags in the order, I gave my mom a bag, my sister a bag, and a friend a bag of these wafers and they all told me the same thing...they love them, what great lemon taste, etc. and wanted to know where they could purchase them.)

column9: Bet you can't eat just one!
column10: Previously, these lemon wafer cookies were sold at Wal Mart; however, they no longer carry them.  Recently, I discovered that Trader Joe's carried a chocolate version and I inquired if they carried the lemon but no, they discontinued carrying the lemon as well.  So, I googled and found that Amazon.com was a source for the cookies.  YES, I can now satisfy that craving for a truly lip smacking little lemon wafer.  While I ordered only one box of them the first time, I will be ordering two boxes the next time--I have a friend and her husband who also enjoy puckering up!  Try them, you will love them!

I tried this product at a friend's house and had to get some for myself.  I was delighted to find them on Amazon for half the price listed on another so called wholesale site.  These make a great treat and would make a wonderful gift if you can keep your hands off of them.  Everyone who tried mine thought they were much better than they had expected from such a simple product.  Having no hydrogenated oils is a definite plus, but watch the saturated fat if cholesterol is an issue for you.
I love these cookies!  what can I say. They are worth buying in bulk!  Yum. Bet you can't eat just one.
These are super high quality wafers. I have had many kinds and this brand is the best I have ever had.
DELICIOUS WAFERS. I FIND THAT EUROPEAN WAFERS ARE LESS SWEET ( LESS SUGAR AND CARBOHYDRATES) BUT VERY DELECTABLE.

we have polished off the hazelnut and are moving next to the vanilla--along with more hazelnut! the price here is very good--i paid $5.49 per bag at Duane Reade. But, like one of the other reviewers, if I buy 8 here, oh they will be GONE! i'm not one for moderation when it comes to treats that i love.

I first tried these cookies while visiting family in Panama.  They were available at the local grocery stores.  When I came back to the U.S. I couldn't find them locally but thank goodness for AMZAZON, I found them and at an affordable price.  I order a carton of eight packages and share them with friends.  They are a delightfully light and fresh tasting treat that soon become nearly addictive.  I have tried some of Loacker's other flavors but the lemon is my all time favorite.  I am tempted to subscribe to them!!

column9: Real Nice. Light Fresh Lemon Taste. Mmmmm.
column10: Here's another of the little items I find in my nearby Fresh and Easy store. It's a British company and they have a lot of imported items. This trip I picked up a bag of Loacker Quadratini Lemon Wafer Cookies. Oh boy, are these good! They disappear real fast. Be ready to apply controls. They're very light and tasty and not overly sweet. The filing has a real light, fresh lemon taste. Real nice. Just right. Just give it a bite and a couple light chews and it's gone and your hand is involuntarily reaching for another one. Mmmmm. Now how am I ever going to keep these around the house? Well, I guess that a lot of others feel the same way. Did you notice that on the 33 reviews, 30 gave it five stars?Gary Peterson
I bought these for my mom and she loved them so much, she won't eat any other cookies. This from a 100 year old who is very picky!

These wafers need to come with a big warning "Addictive"! It takes a lot of self control to stop eating them.  If I did not exercise a lot of self control I would eat a whole bag. Wafers come in a resealable bag, and in theory can last a long time... but in my house the longest one bag lasted was 2 days!I bought the lemon flavor of Loacker's Quadratini wafers. They have a nice strong lemon flavor - nicely tart with a sweet creamy finish, crunchy and pleasant on your tongue. You can chew a wafer to get the pleasant crunch on just hold it in your mouth and let it melt slowly.  Either way you will get an extra ordinary taste experience!I am attaching a photo and two cookies shown from different angles.  Each cookie is 1 inch square. Each consists of 74% lemon cream and 26% wafer.Wafers have no artificial flavors or colorants, and no preservatives.Ingredients:Unbleached wheat flour, pressed coconut oil, glucose syrup, sugar, whey powder (milk), dextrose, soy flour, barley malt extract, lemon juice powder 2%, salt, leavening agents (sodium hydrogen cargonate, disodium diphosphate), emulsifier soy lecithin, natural vanilla pods, lemon-peel-oil, spices.Loacker wafers are made in Austria and Loackers company had been known for their wafers since 1925.Ohhhh, so good!  I signed up for regular deliveries with Subscribe & Save.Ali Julia review

column9: If you are trying to lose weight stay away.
column10: These are amazing and addicting.  It is hard to put them down after you start.  They have a good richness and is mostly filling not wafer.

These are essentially the yummiest, most delicate wafer cookies I've come across. The hazelnut tastes exactly like Nutella, perfect. Each little cookie is 0.5 Weight Watchers points, which is terrific for those of us watching our figures. I usually have four cookies (2 points) with my tea and am VERY satisfied. They taste so decadent. I'm going to try the Lemon next and hopefully will be able to track down the Espresso flavor!

I opened the box when I had two friends visiting!  They went home with at least two packages each as they were having weekend guests.  I still have a bunch.  They were a hit. They are so fresh and so satisfying. I just ordered the chocolate ones for next time.  I plan never to be without them.  I want them on the tea table always.  Trust me.  Read the label - they are great.So, I am adding to the review!  The two friends who were here when the cookies arrived,  I had shared some of the cookies with them  raved about the cookies, wanted to know where I got them and are ordering them.  One had a house full of guests and I had given her 2 sacks, knowing she was having Pumpkin Festival guests - she said they all want these cookies.  I think they are all natural products so that helps.  I have the chocolate ones in my shopping cart but am holding off as I am eating too many,  I ate - alone - one sack on the weekend.  I dare not open more this week.  You have to try these.  I am sure I did not dream about them.  They are not too sweet.  I think you can read the ingredients.  Great for people with braces.  Sigh!OKAY, OKAY, OKAY - I AM BACK TO ADD ON . . . I just bought the dark Chocolate - I don't even like dark Chocolate so I chose that as friends will like them for dessert and I won't be tempted (fat chance) to eat them.  I know I will.  These are the best cookies ever and my lemon ones went so fast.  You will love these cookies!

column9: HANDS DOWN THE BEST WAFER COOKIES EVERRR
column10: Oh my sweetness. These wafer cookies blow my mind!!!I'm not a big fan of waffles or wafers, I usually perfer chocolate chip regular cookies as my treat. Until my mom brought home this, which is a complete disaster because we both are completly like obsessed with it now even though we only bought like one bag at time (trying to have self-control here) Eventhoughe  me and my mom havent buy these on amazon yet but I just want to tell you guys how AWESOME those afer cookies are!!I mean I have never taste something this creamy and delicate. The dark chocolate flavored totally rocked my world~ and from seeing all the reviews makes me want to try the lemon ones so baddd.
This is a healthy snack.  If you can control yourself, just a few are satisfying.  The lemon isrefreshing with just the right taste of sweetness.  I keep them in stock.

column9: Loved the Dark Chocolate; now I want to try the Lemon...
column10: I ran across the dark chocolate ones in Italy at an Autogrill highway rest area.  There were snacks aplenty, but the picture on the bag + the fact that it had an extra 20% attracted me.  So, I got a 10.58 oz bag!  I find them satisfying after eating just a few.  It seemed like a never-ending bag.  I googled when I got home, hoping to figure out where to buy more, and ended up here.  I'm glad I did because, after reading some other reviews, now I'm anxious to try the lemon ones!
I bought almond flavor and wow, these are seriously the best tasting wafer snacks I've ever tasted.I am in love.  Can't wait until I try more flavors.
This wafer has the best tart and freshest  lemon flavor than any other lemon cookie ever!  Put them in the freezer and they taste is even better.

These wafers are PHENOMENAL! They are creamy, not too sweet (I had the regular chocolate ones) and perfect for whether you want just a few or a bunch. They are light and have a lovely texture. I bought these at World Market.

These little Loacker Quadratinis are delicious - in ANY flavor!!  Some flavors are hard to find (or to nab on Amazon, since they sell so quickly!) but you will never be disappointed by these perfectly bite-sized pieces of chocolate, or lemon, or tiramisu, or (my fave) hazelnut!!  You will be hooked on them!!  The only trouble you will have is knowing WHEN to STOP eating them!!  I LOVE THEM!! And I keep coming back to Amazon for more, as they have the very best price for the Loacker offerings!!

These are the best wafers I have EVER tasted. I have a sweet tooth and traveled the world (so I have tried many sweets) but nothing compares to these wafers.Also there is one other flavour Amazon does not seem to sell and that is the coconut wafers. Absolutely unbelievable taste and this is an understatement. It has the perfect combination of sweetness, flavor, size and once you start eating it you cannot stop.My favorite are Tiramisu, Lemon, Hazelnut and Coconut. The rest are fantastic too but I have my own I like the best. Italian products - cannot improve on perfect.Watch your waist line though  :P

I fell in love with the lemon flavor immediately I put it in my mouth. it's a perfect combination of sour taste with cream and sugar. I always eat chocolate, tiramisu, coffee..flavor, this is the first time I tred lemon, absolutely great. And if you put it in milk with cold cereal together with banana slices, perfect!
I love these little wafer cookies. They are wonderful. Great flavor, delicate crunch, and knowing that it's natural and nothing in it is genetically modified makes snacking feel better.

I love these cookies and they are difficult to find in most groceries stores. I was so thrilled when I discovered that I could order eight bags at a time through Amazon.com. They arrived quickly and in good shape! None were crushed. Now I can have my cookies and eat them whenever. I often give a bag as a thank you gift to friends. Then they become addicted too.
We bought some in grocery store by accident and all of us love it but price in store is bit high so we googled on line and found the direct sell.

I actually was in San Francisco when I first tried these wafers. I fell in love with them instantly. When I got home I tried hopelessly  to find them in my area, with no luck at all. Thank goodness for AMAZON I now can enjoy them without having to drive almost 5 hours to San Francisco. And if I may add very reasonally priced. They are not overpowering with the amount of sugar other wafers have but yet are so delicious. I can't wait to try them once again.

These little wafers are yummy! My kids love them and they're a good treat to have around the house for something small. Pour them into a bowl when you have company-- you won't have any left! I like them with tea. As another reviewer stated, they're not quite as sweet as what I'm used to, but they're creamier. Yum!
I just love this little snack.  It is a very light and creamy wafer.  I usually buy it at Cost Plus but lately they are always out.  I am glad I can still find it online.

i grew up in italy and loved these wafer cookies... i had almost forgot how good they were. then i decided to order some just to refresh my memories and ended up eating 4 out of the 8 bags in less than a 24 hour period (i did have some help). everybody that tried them asked me where i got them.i bought the hazelnut ones and i think that hazelnut is such a better choice to combine with chocolate and cookies than peanuts like they do here in the states. i wanted my friends to try different flavors so i ordered tiramisu, vanilla and lemon.....i see they have an option to deliver them ever month or two but i think they should deliver them weekly. lol.

I have to say I was looking forward to getting my favorite cookie, without paying the local $4.89 per package.  I always buy from Amazon whenever the price is right, and they have what I want.  The packages of wafers came as expected, however when I got them, one package had it's seam split and wafers throughout the box and they were less then fresh.  The other packages appeared to have gotten excessively warm as the wafers had slid off of each other, causing a "slanted' wafer.  Not the upright wafer cookie I expected.  All in all, I will take a second look before I buy eatable items from Amazon.
The whole point of a cookie is for it to taste good!  This product tastes little better than wood.  Sorry I wasted my money.  Do NOT buy.  Save your money -- they are not worth the calories!
I realize once they came in the mail that I paid double the amount for each box. This is no deal I paid five dollars a box and they had a price tag on the box for two dollars and fifty cents

column9: Love them, but hard to find...
column10: ...Though this may be simply due to this being a new launch by General Mills.  I first came across these bars in the snack aisle of a pharmacy, if you can believe it, and by the next day, came back for a bag full.  The best thing about them is that, so far, they actually taste like a bowl of Lucky Charms without all the mess of milk and a spoon(!).  The individual bars usually come in boxes of six individually wrapped treats, the price is still quite reasonable in-store (Wal-mart only so far) at around $2.30 a box, so the package deal here on Amazon sounds like a deal.  Surprisingly, I found that these treats are much more filling yet still sugary-tasting than many other cereal bars I typically try such as Rice Krispie bars, those thin little 'flavored' granola bars, or even the Cheerios-like cereal bars.  In fact, Lucky Charms Treat bars actually seem to have less calories and sugars included than if you actually had time to sit down for a bowl of cereal!  So... if you're a parent, you can be at least a little more at peace with giving the kids what they want anyway.  And if you're an adult that's still a big kid at heart (like me), you can enjoy a nice sugar-rush from your childhood as you run for that last bus to work... marginally on time, for a change.P.S. I've also tried GM's new Golden Graham Treats cereal bars and, while not quite the same feeling is evoked here (I'm a marshmallows girls; what can I say?), I'd recommend those as well if you want a little change of pace.  They're just a little too sticky for more than the occasional, at least for me.
This was bought as part of a gag gift, but all of them got eaten (by adults. Everyone liked the flavor.
Delicious and arrived in a timely fashion. Would not hesitate to purchase this product again or to use this vendor.

This is a really great tea chilled extremely cold or with a lot of ice -- perfect for sunny days!  Honestly I should give this 5 stars but its getting 4 because they've changed the recipe from the prior brew (bottles with apples all around the label).  Honestly I can't even describe how the taste changed but it has, only slightly though.  This is still an Ito-En product despite the also new Tea's Tea labeling.

I first tasted the apple tea flavor when I was in Asia and have craved it upon my return to the US. I'm sooo glad that Amazon has decided to carry this as I am unable to find the same flavor even at the fancy grocery stores.  I would recommend this to anyone :)

Tea's Tea (Ito En) generally makes pretty good products. This Apple Black Tea is a good combination of light apple flavor that doesn't overpower the tea itself; the blend is smooth with no harshness. It is not too sweet, but adds just the right amount of flavor to an already excellent black tea. This is probably one of the best flavored teas made by Ito En. Buy in bulk.. I find it difficult to find these teas in my area, so I love the subscribe & save program for this!

Every time I give this to someone to try, they love it!  Its sweet but not too sweet and the taste of apple is just delicious.  Its very hard to find this tea so I was so excited when it finally came into stock on Amazon!  Also, the low calorie blueberry green tea is pretty tasty as well.

My husband and I love to cook.  We just ordered all the Palouse Brand products and are so excited about the quality of each of them.  We had many ask for the recipe, but it wasn't the recipe it was the great quality of our ingredients.  Palouse brand isn't just packaged cutely it is the real deal.  If you like to cook this product is a must try!  Thanks Palouse brand for bringing fresh, great ingredients to my family table!

Palouse Brand Lentils are the best lentils I have ever had.  These lentils hold their shape and texture, they are tender, and the taste is beyond compare. They are great is soups, salads, chilli, you name it. This company produces a lentil that is a true connoisseur's delight and well worth the dollars.  "Palouse Brand" is delivering on their promise of an outstanding product!

Pardina lentils are my favorite.  They hold their shape when cooked so, being a vegetarian, they are great as a meat substitute in things like sloppy joes or casseroles.  The dryland hills of the Palouse in eastern Washington and northern Idaho produce the best lentils, dry peas, garbanzo beans and wheat, much of which are exported to India and Asia.  Pardinas are great in soups, salads, casseroles and rice pilafs.  Palouse Brand are the only brand of lentils in my kitchen.

We have cooked these lentils in the crockpot, added a little Texas Pete, chopped onions & dried red sweet peppers. Allow to cook several hours in crockpot, & check tenderness of lentils.  Added smokey salt for flavor or optional: smoked turkey leg or county ham hock.  Add some cooked brown rice before taking up & serve.  Great complete meal!

These are really good tasting lentils. The first thing I notice was the lack of that shinny coating you see on store bought lentils. When you open the big you can tell right away there is something different about these. They cook easily and hold their shape and taste great.

Brown lentils are actually difficult to find in the grocery store. These are much better quality anyway. They are bigger and the end product tastes better than your run of the mill grocery store lentils. To the reviewer who gave a subpar review due to the bag not having directions...google is your friend.
I love these lentils becasue the skin is less noticable when you cook them. I bought some for my mom and she said they are the best ones shes ever seen.

My one year old loves lentils, so I was happy when I found a good sized portion of GMO Free lentils. They cooked well and tasted delicious. They are a little smaller than what you usually get at the grocery store, but that might be cause they are Spanish Brown.
These are excellent lentils -- clean, flavorful and easy to cook to perfection. Highly recommended. Especially with carrots, garlic, cumin and spinach.

Lentils are as staple of our diet, and these are great. There actually is a noticeable difference in taste from standard store bought lentils. I love that they are certified GMO free and the packaging is quaint and rustic. But, really, the flavor and the knowledge of where it came from are the biggest selling points for me, and the price for the quantity is spot on also. I will buy these again for sure.Enjoy!

These are excellent lentils, from a great agricultural area. I've been to the Palouse several times, a wonderful, amazingly beautiful region of rolling green farmland in eastern Washington/northern Idaho, famous for photography, rich soil, and, well, lentils.  They even have a lentil festival every August, no kidding. When I saw these lentils on Amazon I had to try them - I belong to Amazon Prime, get free two-day shipping - and they are excellent. Like others say, they are small, firm, and really flavorful. They take more time and water to cook than most other kinds of lentils I've used due to their firmness, but retain their shape really well.  They are also chewy, not mushy, and the flavor is kind of nutty. You can do anything you want with them - make curry, soup, salad, mix them with rice or quinoa or chopped veggies, season them any way you like. I love lentils in general, other faves are red lentils (sweet and mushy, make great soup) and black lentils (tiny and round, and a great alternative to black beans) which I can get at local health food stores, but these are truly top shelf, and I've never seen them in stores. I agree with what someone else said, too, they are very clean, I haven't found any rocks or twigs in them. Just great lentils. I'm ordering a five pound bag this time so I can have them on hand for awhile - and I love knowing I'm supporting a great gem of a growing region by buying them.

My wife cooks a lot of lentils. This product is far superior to other brands on the market, and we've tried them all. The flavor is amazing and cooks nicely. From now on, our family will only buy Pardina lentils. And, we like that it's made in the USA and GMO free.

Lentils have the ability to take on the flavor of whatever they are cooked in.  I have made two different batches from this mini potato sack of lentils.  The beans have turned out well and I have yet to find rocks or other strange colored objects that appear in bags of store bought beans.

All lentils are not created equal. I have has lentils that were more expensive and less expensive. These are by far the best lentils I have ever tasted. They cook extremely fast, they are tender and the taste is off the charts. Every one that has tasted them raves about them. Excellent value for your money.

column9: Just buy them - they are excellent
column10: I think I may have just made the most delicious lentil soup of my life!  This is an excellent product and you will not regret your purchase.

At $15 for 5 pounds these lentils cost $3 a pound.  My wife was very unhappy with me as she can get them for a dollar a pound at the store.  I told her - these are super lentils and she said they better be for the price.  Kidding aside - don't buy these, buy your lentils at the store!
Lentils in a big bag. It came with no cooking directions or suggestions and when I emailed them the response was blah!I didn't see the great customer service they bragged about. It must not be there.

column4: Donotstalk "I like a good book and a good deal!"
column10: These are amazingly good, I just can't even begin to tell you how much I love them. They're a perfect snack when you have a sweet tooth, and they're a perfect snack when you want some crunch. I've replaced my pretzels, my donuts, and my other goodies with these.

Since trying the Seneca chip brand I'm convinced that they are lacing their products with addictive drugs. They are incredibly delicious, invariably fresh and meticulously packaged. I can't leave them alone!

These sour apple chips are very sour.  I can only eat them one chip at a time.  Just as well since they taste great and lets me savor the flavor.  They are definitely a bit different from the other Seneca Apple Chips flavors which are much sweeter.

I really enjoyed my apple chips and by ordering a case, I saved myself a few dollars of which I would have spent at the "convenience" store for the same thing.  The "sour apple" was a little too sour for me, but I ate them anyway!!
Just like the granny smith kind but with a light dusting of sour powder. Ate the whole box of 12 in approx. 3 days. PLEASE BRING THIS ITEM BACK!!
The 3 boxes of apple chips arrived dented and some bags had many broken up chips. The flimsy packaging (no support or padding-just bags in a box) can't stand up to UPS.
The texture of these chips is terrible, it is like eating styrofaom, the taste is not bad but far from delicious. There are new much better option

This is going to read like an ad for the company, but rarely have I been so completely satisfied by a product.  I was specifically looking for dried habanero chilis that I could grind myself for a variety of uses.  I had never purchased from this company before and was concerned that the peppers would be leathery and not really dry enough for my grinders to work correctly.  No worries!  These chilis were exactly what I was looking for.  They were perfectly dried and I was able to grind them very easily into the different consistencies that I need for my various uses (jerky, salsas, etc.)  The peppers are first rate: the flavor is awesome - the perfect habanero combimation of smokiness and buttery heat.  It is obvious that they started out with only the finest fresh chilis and dried them to perfection.  Not only that, but the delivery was faster than promised and the packaging was excellent as the peppers arrived in perfect condition.  There is no question where I will go when I need to replenish my supply.  If you need perfectly dried chilis of the highest possible quality, look no farther.  You will NOT be disappointed.

column9: Absolutely AMAZING. Worth the cost--you will never regret it!
column10: I have six cats and switched to the Blue Buffalo brand six months ago, in June 2010. With six cats--all of varying age, weight and sensitivities--and not being able to afford multiple foods for each of them, it has been extremely difficult to find a single good food that works for them all.In June, I started with Blue Buffalo Spa Select Finicky Feast. All of my cats fell in love with the taste of this food. I was amazed by their improved appearance, energy level and overall health. It was like candy for them but, unfortunately, they ate it quick and my two most sensitive cats were gorging themselves on the food and then throwing it all up before it was digested. With Blue being so pricey I couldn't afford for it to end up in inedible chunks on the kitchen floor.So, I switched to the slightly higher priced Blue Wilderness Duck. Cats being carnivores naturally, this food was amazing as well. It took them a few days to adjust but once they did, their energy level shot through the roof, even higher! While the vomiting problem lessened to about 65% of before, it was still a problem. So, I gathered myself for a long sit at the computer and began researching the various types of Blue cat food all over the net from user reviews such as this one, to blogs about the cats of Blue users and even scientific studies to prove whether Blue Buffalo and other "holistic" pet foods were really all they claimed to be (and worth the high prices).For my research, I considered the varying ages, weights and sensitivities of my six cats. After about two hours of reading, comparing-and-contrasting and even research into other SUPPOSEDLY "good for your cat" foods such as Science Diet and Royal Canin (NOT so good--compare the labels for yourself), the answer to my six very different cats dietary needs was as clear as a bell--Blue Buffalo Longevity Adult. But I was made very quickly upset and disappointed, however, when I discovered that this variety of Blue Buffalo cat food proffers the meats and oils of three fish ( whitefish, menhaden and salmon) as it's primary ingredients. Back in the days when I fed my cats Purina One thinking it was a special "good for your cat" food I discovered that all six of them simply detested fish flavored food of any kind; probably the only dietary issue they had in common.So, I consigned myself to a future of Blue Wilderness Duck with lessened, though nonetheless wasteful and messy, cat vomit on my floors. It was then that I received a blessing in disguise! My car broke down exactly at the same time as I ran out of cat food. I learned that it would be three days before my car was fixed.And so, I had to borrow cat food from my in-laws. Unfortunately, they feed their cats a disgusting and extremely UNHEALTHY dry kibble called "Atta Cat" with ground yellow corn as it's main ingredient. I, and my cats, were devastated. They refused to eat it and went mostly hungry for three days.Finally, my car being fixed after three days, and I rushed out to Petsmart to buy a bag of Blue. I decided that, after three days of going hungry, orange diarrhea and unanimous vomiting I figured that maybe my cats wouldn't mind some healthy AND tasty Blue fish-flavored food. I was very nervous because I knew (or thought I did) how my cats felt about fish. Nevertheless I brought home Blue Longevity Adult and--to my shock and amazement--the three-day fast was completely unnecessary. My six cats went bananas for this food and they all began wolfing it down out of one bowl before the bowl was on the floor! I thought they might just be extra-hungry that day but their enthusiasm for this variety of Blue Buffalo dry food has not lessened a single bit--they love it!Not only do they love it but the vomiting has stopped altogether and my one obese cat has shed pounds and slimmed down to the muscular and energetic cat he used to be and this is a miracle! Not even the other varieties of Blue were able to do that. All of my six cats are healthier than they have EVER been.Let me also note here that after I first switched to the Blue Buffalo brand six months ago, all of my cats grew brand-new lustrous, velvety soft and thick coats of fur and strong, healthy musculature. Their eyes all sparkled and they had so much new-found energy--bouncing off the walls and ceilings--that I was left gasping for breath after playing with them.The switch to Blue Buffalo Longevity Adult has quadrupled these results as well as eliminating hairballs and reducing litter-box mass and odor to nearly zero! This food is so amazing that I almost can't believe it, myself. With all the good protein, healthy fats, antioxidants, omegas, B vitamins as well as a multitude of other vitamins and minerals, whole fruits and vegetables, not to mention Blues cold-formed LifeSource Bits that are like little multi-vitamins in the food, my cats are eating better than my husband and I and I can't help but think it's too good to be true when I see how beautiful, healthy and EAGER to eat their kibble (every morning on the dot) my cats have become.I cannot begin to explain how WORTH THE COST this miraculous food is. It helps overweight and oversensitive cats shed pounds and fight allergies as well as helping overly-skinny cats gain muscle mass and healthy-weighted cats to maintain--I've seen it all with my own eyes. If you have a multi-cat household and are looking for an GOOD, wholesome food that caters to them all, individually and as a group, you must try Blue Buffalo Longevity. If you love your cat or cats, you must switch to the Blue Buffalo brand. I promise--you will NOT be disappointed but delighted day in and day out with your new super-kitty!Go to [...] to receive a $3.00 off coupon on your first purchase of Blue Buffalo cat food. Truthfully, from a non-compensated and very happy consumer and her six cats: if you love your cat or cats, feed them Blue!

column9: Safe healthy food for your cat
column10: My cat thoroughly enjoys this food, and she can be a picky eater. She would not touch the other flavors of Blue Buffalo, before they changed the shape and style of the food. But she eats the Longevity. I also feed this brand to my dogs.Blue Buffalo uses high quality ingredients and no cheap fillers like corn and wheat. It is all natural, with no by-product meals, which means your cat is not eating hooves and beaks. With the pet food scares recently, I am very picky about what to feed my pets. I feel that Blue is safe, especially since it is manufactured in the U.S.

This has to be the best dry cat food available.  Check the ingredients against any list of the best for your cat, and you will agree. The kibble bits are quite small and so easy for my cat to eat. He is simply GORGEOUS after being on this diet for the past 9 months.
My tabby likes this food alot,and its healthier without the fillers.It's more expensive but it's worth the health of my cat.Greg

column9: YES!  Best cat food...no more vomiting
column10: My kitty is 14 years old and she started throwing up alot this spring.  I switched to Natural Balance  and it was good for a month and then she started again.  So I tried the Longevity formula and so far have had great results.  First of all, she seemed to like the taste and the transition to a new food was a breeze.  She has been on this formula for a couple of months and has totally quit vomiting (except when she eats grass of course); she had lost some weight and seems more fit and trim.  I am sooo glad and highly recommend this formula.  I will see how she does over the winter when she is less active, but for now I am greatly pleased and so is she!

I have one cat and she is very picky about her food. She's not a fan of chicken based foods, turned her nose up at wet food since the kitten stage, and I wanted to feed a corn and wheat free diet. Cats are carnivores after all. I switched her to this food after one bag of specialty food from the vet's office. She has been eating it exclusively for about a year now and the results are amazing. Her coat is luxurious, teeth and eyes are perfect, small stools, and relatively no gas (a tremendous difference from when I adopted her from the shelter). She free feeds and is totally indoors so she's a little heavy but nothing too extreme at 11 lbs. The kibble size is perfect too. After having worked in a cat-exclusive veterinary clinic for many years, I've seen many high-end foods come and go. Some were better than others. This food should be more widely available, especially at grocery stores and veterinary offices. I live out 'in the sticks' and on the months I don't order a bag from Amazon I make an 80 mile round trip to Petsmart just to buy a bag of Blue Buffalo Longevity. It is worth it, hands down. Buy this food and your cat will not be disappointed.

We have 2 cats. One is 7 and the other is 16. We wanted a healthier food for our cats and dog so when I saw an ad in a magazine for this food I got online and researched it more. There happened to be a coupon in the paper that week so I went to our pet store to buy some. I must admit I was shocked at the price and almost didn't buy it because even with a $5.00 off coupon it is way more than I was used to spending. I am so glad I didn't back off and continue with our old brand. I saw a huge difference in the cats in just a few days. Our 16 year old cat, who normally laid around all day and couldn't jump up on our fireplace mantel (her favorite napping spot on the winter) anymore was racing through the house and playing with our other cat. She is now able to jump up on high places again. Hairballs have virtually disappeared and we very rarely have them throwing up anymore, which was almost a daily occurance in our household. I have tried a few of the other Blue Buffalo varieties and as long as they are chicken my cats love them. Sometimes I mix the Blue Wilderness with the Blue Regular for more nutrients. My only complaint is, I wish they had trial sizes because my cats normally hate any cat food with fish, but I would love to see if they would eat the Blue Buffalo kind. All in all if I could give this a 10 star I would. I know this a rating for the cat food, but we are just as pleased with the dog food. And as for the price.. you don't have to feed your animals as much because there are no fillers so for us the price evened out because I don't have to buy it as often.
While my cats will pretty much eat anything without problem, this food they seem to throw up a lot on...perhaps since the pieces are so small, they just suck them down without chewing them up.

This past summer our veterinarian recommended this adult food for my 17year old cat. Noah has been pretty picky her whole life when it comes to food, yet she has heartily taken to this healthy grain free food. Blue Buffalo is worth the price!

column9: From the Creators of Toddler Health
column10: TODDLER HEALTH - THE STORYMission:  To stand for the health of children everywhere in helping parents find the necessary tools to support them in RAISING HEALTHY AND FIT KIDS physically, emotionally, psychologically and spiritually.When Dr. Visser was 8 years old, his father passed away from an obesity induced heart attack.  Subconsciously it began a profound quest within him in the field of prevention and wellness medicine.In 1993, Dr. Visser was seeing about 100 patients a day at his clinic.  His clinic, Visser Wellness & Research Center is based on treating people holistically.As a last resort many times, moms would come in to see if he could help their children, who oftentimes, suffered from chronic upper respiratory diseases, poor nutrition, ADD, ADHD and poor or slow developments physically and/or psychologically.  Dr. Visser started noticing a pattern in these kids -  allergies to dairy, soy and high sugar products.  This started for him a journey in seeing what could be done.  With his TV show "Wild Medicine", Dr. Visser was able to travel around the world and work with some of the best minds in the fields of wellness.The obesity epidemic as well as the nutrient deficient children worldwide in both poor and rich countries became painfully obvious.  This is when Dr. Visser and his wife Lin and with the birth of their own child, Kai starting delving deeper into the issue.  A trailbrazer in childhood obesity research, Dr. Visser is continually on the forefront of addressing kids' evolving developmental needs and raising the awareness of proper guidance, movement and nutrition for healthy and fit toddlers and children. Through his recent clinical research on 10,000 children and the obesity pandemic, Dr. Visser has identified a great need for new nutritional options for toddlers.Dr. Visser embarked on the journey to fill the need for alternative options to dairy, soy, high sugar content foods for parents.  In 2000, he started actively putting together a team of healthcare professionals to develop the most innovative and nutritious product line for toddlers and children.  With the latest study findings at University of Minnesota, his own research and the guidance of FDA scientist consultants, TODDLER HEALTH product line was created.The product is designed to eliminate the concerns of parents with regard to the nutrient deficient eating habits and to address the obesity threat that kids face today.This project is from the heart.  Healthy Children make Happy Parents!  Thank you for reading "our story" and have a healthy, happy day!Dr. Richard Visser, PhdLin Young  Visser

column9: Life saver for toddler with allergies
column10: I ran across this product at a local Whole Foods last year.  When I went back to get more, they didn't carry it anymore.  I've looked all over Dallas for this stuff and no one carries it.  It is the only supplement/formula/protein powder that our 2 year old WILL eat and CAN eat.  She is allergic to dairy, wheat, and eggs.  She loves it and will drink it to the exclusion of everything else, including juice.  It's worth every penny!!  Thanks for carrying everything under the sun, Amazon!

This formula totally saved us during the transition from nursing. My third had strong allergies to soy and dairy and when we discoved this fabulous product we were totally relieved. He loves the taste and is still asking for it at 2 1/2 years old. The ingredients have been carefully chosen and I appreciate the high nutritional value and clean product list. For moms just trying it out, be patient as the babies take a few tries to get used to the texture. we have really relied on this product and highly recommend it.

My little boy loves Toddler Health which is great because he doesn't always like to eat as well as I would like him to.  I mix it with rice or almond milk and it's good to go.  As a treat I'll blend it with some frozen fruit when he's hankering for ice cream or sweets.  It's nice knowing on the days when he won't eat one green vegetable that he is covered nutritionally.
Critical item for our household which includes severe food allergies.  Best price out there!  Strongly recommend this product if you have a young child with dairy allergies.

A couple things you should know -First, I do like this product and will continue to feed it to my baby. She is 18mths and I am transitioning from toddler formula to this drink. So she drinks it from a bottle.It tastes fine, I mix it with water. But it is grainy, it has never fully dissolved, I might try putting it in the blender. And there is always some sludge at the bottom of the bottle, and in the nipple. You also need to use a wide fast flow nipple. And the measuring scoop is too large to mix in the bottle, especially when only using 1 hand :)I have been using it for a few weeks now, sometimes mixing it 50/50 with her formula and sometimes she'll have it straight. She is fine with it but does ask for a sip or two of water after a full bottle of it straight, I guess to wash it down. Her stomach might have taken a week to 'accept' it but nothing major.Overall, good product. My mom has been pushing me to get the baby off dairy... And why not when there is a drink like this out there. And I am so confident in the nutritional value I won't even refill her multi-vit once she is on this fully.

column9: Excellent "milk "substitute for toddler who can't have dairy & soy!
column10: Daughter has dairy/soy issues and we were so happy when we found this! Breastfed for a year and then started to supplement with Toddler Health! She loves it and I am happy that she is getting so much Vitamins, Calcium, etc (instead of using Rice Milk which is so high in sugar)! Would definitely recommend it to any toddler over 12 months!!
The Toddler Health formula is wonderful.  It is difficult to have to wait for it on the waiting list, and takes awhile to ship, but is worth it.

As a nurse practitioner, I've learned a lot about infant and child nutrition. First, you must understand that children under age 2 NEED fats for their brains to develop. Brain matter is mostly fat. If babies and toddlers don't get enough fat, their neurological development will be impaired. Human breast milk is mostly fat (about 50% of calories); while the other half is milk sugars (lactose). Protein is actually a very small part of human milk. Nature naturally has saturated fats & cholesterol in mother's milk for infant mammals, as well as the yolk of egg for baby chicks. In other words, fats, particularly saturated fat and cholesterol are very necessary and healthy for a rapidly growing infant body and brain. That is why FULL FAT dairy is recommended by all doctors for every child under the age of 2.Anyways, in reviewing the nutritional data on this drink, it is very low in calories, especially fat calories. I'd be concerned if parents tried to replace dairy with this drink. A child's brain and development could negatively be affected by not having enough fat. Plus a child would not get enough calories with this drink.Most other countries in the world use milk for their children- not necessarily cow's milk though. I've breastfed my daughter for 1 year, and have now switched her over to goat's milk, which is recommended for children who have milk intolerances or sensitivities. The fats and proteins in goats milk are more broken down, making it easier to digest than cow's milk. If you are looking for a healthy alternative to cow's milk, I'd recommend goat's milk much more over this "rice drink".

I like red wine and I live vinegar, but didn't know what to expect.  I took a chance and ordered.  What a wonderful mixture.  Bolder Creek's products are first rate in the first place, and based on that premiss that I why I took a chance.  You won't be disappointed.  Wonderful flavor mixture and everyone that I've shared with enjoy them as well.
So far, this is one of my top two favorite flavors of Boulder Canyon chips!  I haven't bought a bag yet that hasn't been devoured by my family in one sitting!

column9: Stick with the sea salt & vinegar
column10: I love this company and I love their products, but this particular flavor combo just doesn't work. There is a nice vinegar tang up front, but the jelly donut aroma and sweetness is downright odd. It was a nice idea, but I'm sticking with the good old malt vinegar variety.

column9: Kettle potato chips:  Fully loaded baked potato
column10: I have never met a Kettle brand chip I did not like. These chips have a great loaded potato flavor, which are flavorful. I like the sweet onion chips better, but these are also at the top of the list for great-tasting potato chips. Kettle chips are great chips f/the money!

column9: Fresh, Lightly-Spiced, Crunchy Kettle Chips. Good Value, Good Product.
column10: After buying bags one at a time (at a hefty markup) at nearby stores, I decided to try bulk ordering some snack foods on Amazon. I was very pleased with the price and the products.These jalapeno kettle chips are not overly spicy; they have a slow-building spice that starts very subtly a grows if you eat the whole bag, which I'm embarrassed to say I did quite a few times.The chips arrived well-packed and fresh. column9: glad to find them in 1 oz size
column10: I buy mostly for vending, so the size of the bag is important. Kettle's 1 oz bag is a good size although it seems a bit less than full. Salt & Vinegar flavor is satisfying, about an 8 out of 10.

Glad to find these in a one ounce size but the bag seems a bit less than full. It's hard to find single serving chip bags that vend well. Sometimes they are too wide. or too plump with air. Bag size is good. BBQ flavor is about an 8 out of 10.

one of the best chips that you can buy...and i've tried all the kettle varieties, and many others.  There's only a slight taste of jalapeno, and they are delicious. Perfect with a sandwich or alone.If you like being addicted, these are the chip for you. ...See you at addicts anonymous...

The title says it all. Great flavor, hint of spice, excellent crunch. We eat Kettle chips by the truck load at my house, we like all the flavors but this one far and away is our favorite, never enough bags to get us to our next shipment.
