Also, a moderate amount of acid will subdue the strong flavors of ginger, lime, garlic and cilantro without over-powering them. Classically, a German-style Riesling fits these parameters perfectly."

column9: Some of the best chips anywhere
column10: Kettle chips are thicker and crunchier (though greasier at times) than other chips, and the honey dijon flavor is great.  They don't have the overwhelming salty taste some cheaper chips have, and the 2oz size is great for an adult size snack.

column9: the defacto standard for Salt and Vinegar chips
column10: I've always liked Salt and Vinegar chips but most of the time the stronger flavor was at the bottom of the bag. Not with these, the vinegar is overflowing right from the first chip and doesnt stop until you've finished the bag. These are very addictive. If you like salt and vinegar, these are the ultimate chips. Nothing else compares.
Tasted good. Spicy. Those that don't like spicy should stay away from this. For the price paid, very good buy.

These are seriously delicious, especially if you like plain potato chips. My only concern is they're very oily. I understand they're "kettle chips" and they're "fried" (small batches and all) but when you open the bag (That's another thing, very strong bag! Need scissors!) there's a coating of oil on the inside of the bag and on the chips themselves. I suggest a blot/shake on some paper towels before consuming. Either way, they have a yummy potato taste, and very satisfying crunch. Delicious!

This bags are very difficult to open with the aid of some tool, such as scissors, don't even try without scissors.They are crispy and taste like chips that aren't advertised as being salted. They definitely aren't healthy, because I can feel the grease all over my fingers when eating them, and I can see the grease at the bottom of the bag, too.They are high-quality chips, and deserve to be put on your table.

Kettle Foods, Inc. makes the best tasting potato chips I've ever eaten.  With a variety of flavors, from classic Barbeque to their unique Spicy Thai you'll find the right flavor for your mouth. And not only do they taste wonderful, but these all-natural chips are cooked in safflower or sunflower oil for zero cholesterol.But why is it a GoGreenMart&More product of the week? Kettle Foods, Inc. is a "Green Giant", a company highlighted for their environmental practices.  They convert waste oils to biodiesel to power some of their company cars. A roof-top solar panel system creates 120,000kWh annually for production and they offset 100% of their additional U.S. energy usage by buying renewable energy credits. Not only are their efforts for the future but they care for the present by rejuvenate a neighboring 2 acre wetland eco-system. And during recent building construction, they earned a Gold rating from Leadership in Energy and Environmental Design (LEED).Now your mouth will thank you and so will the environment.
These really are amazing chips. Don't be put off by one of the cheeses being blue cheese...it is so subtle that even blue cheese haters (like me)will enjoy these.

column9: The chip with a kiss of salt
column10: These chips are delectably delicious. I am on a low sodium diet. I didn't have to give up totally something that I truely love to snack. These chips are bursting with flavor, and you can't really tell they are missing all that salt. There is just a kiss worth on a chip, but beleive me, it is a total makeout!!!

Not too salty like regular supermarket chips, this is a snack that will not overwhelm you with guilt! When you just gotta have some chips, Kettle Chips Lightly Salted chips are the what you've been searching for.There's no cholesterol, no trans fats, no artificial anything -- and because of the manufacturing process, they actually seem to have kind of a home-made quality.This is an excellent product!

I agree with the company motto "A Natural Obsession".  I tried a small bag at the local store and immediately bought in bulk online to save about 30 percent.  The flavor of these is very strong, so they are best paired with a food that has a very mild flavor, like steamed vegetables or plain whole grain bread.  Otherwise they compete or clash with the other food.

The New York Cheddar flavor is my favorite of all the Kettle Brand potato chips. These are flavorful and crunchy and will make your mouth happy. Unfortunately, it may do the opposite to your backside, so don't do what my mom did and eat an entire bag on an empty stomach or you may spend the afternoon in the bathroom.I still give it a 5 of 5 stars.Also, the online price at Amazon is better than anywhere else I've seen them. Combined with Amazon Prime you'll be getting a great deal on these chips.

These are my new favorite!  I have always been a fan of salt and vinegar but these honey dijons have replaced them as my new number one!  They do have a strong taste so loving the honey mustard flavor is a must if you hope to like these.Price wise...I do not see that they are that much of a deal here.  I purchased them for $2.99 at the grocery with no shipping.  I would have given the product 5 stars (easily) had it not been for the price.  The taste is fabulous -- you won't be disappointed.
These chips were good. I ended up eating a whole bag a day for a while cause they were so good. I am glad that they do not have any dextrose in them like lays do.
these are the best chips out there.. nothing can beat this taste. if you like honey mustard then you will definitely like this.. once you eat it you wont stop..addicting stuff
I dont know if they were fresh or if they were supposed to taste like they did. I checked the expiration date it was current but still tasted kind of stale to me !!!
At first I was thinking, "cheese flavored chips?"  But I love them.  The herbs they used are just delicious.  The cheese is not overpowering.  They are yummy and crispy!!

The Spicy Thai chips used to be the best tasting chips on the market.  However, Kettle Foods has changed the ingredients used, with ginger  being the most important that is now missing.  Notice that they removed "ginger with attitude" from the bag.  Sadly, the changing of the ingredients has ruined the chips for me.  They aren't that good anymore and the spice level is virtually non-existent.Here are the original and new ingredient listings:Original IngredientsSelect Potatoes, Safflower and/or Sunflower Oil, Honey Powder (Evaporated Cane Syrup, Honey)Salt, Garlic Powder, Jalapeno Pepper, Ground ginger, Onion Powder, Habanero Pepper, Dried Parsley, Citric Acid, Cilantro Extract, Ginger Oil, Cayenne Pepper, White Pepper, Lime Oil.New IngredientsPotatoes, safflower and/or sunflower oil, sugar, dried cane syrup, salt, maltodextrin, yeast extract, spices, garlic powder, onion powder, dried parsley, jalapeno powder, citric acid, natural flavors, lime extractI'm assuming they changed the ingredients in order to cut costs for their new owner,  Blue Diamond.  They might want to get rid of  "Great Taste Naturally" from their bags as I don't consider maltodextrin to be very natural.Great job Kettle!  Way to ruin a great thing!

I Was sent 3 week past "Fresh by date" stock. Chips are noticeably not fresh in taste. Won't order again.EDIT: And just to add to the dangers of expired stock one of the bags had a rat hole in it, black marks on inside of hole very obviously rat. unfortunately I put a chip in my mouth before I saw the hole.Very bad form amazon.

I try to be good, but when I feel like indulging in some delicious, gourmet potato chips, these New York Chedder potato chips are the first flavor I like to go for, when I see them at the natural food store.  The chips are tangy and crunchy and satisfy your potato chip fix like no other brand.

column9: ONLY awful because SOMETIMES they are awful
column10: and THAT is  the problem. I order these by the case of 12 - and when they are good, which is over half the time they are the BEST kettle chip, THE BEST! and then I get a case of the worse - the potatos are mealy and old so I just throw them out and order again, expensive BUT when they are made with good fresh potatos they are the best - the last case is what prompted me to write this - the potatos were weird - like they were almost sour as in going bad - and I even wrote the company that makes them - SO if you want the BEST kettle chip there is try these and if the ones you get are NOT the best try again!I, myself am done ordering because it is creeping me out that they are using soured potatos and either not noticing or not caring.

I got the sea salt and vinegar chips from Kettle.  I am used to the Salt and Vinegar chips in the white bag if I am allowed to say that.  Anyways, my first impression for this is wow at all the chips you get for the price.  I got the 9 0z x 12 bags and wow it is so many for the price.  You can tell they are high quality chips just from the packaging, also.  Well being used to the cheaper chips I wasn't expecting how mellow these things are. column9: A Rich Flower Garden in Bloom.
column10: A Ming Dynasty (AD 1368 - 1644) creation believed to lower cholesterol and promote longevity, jasmine tea consists of Chinese green tea leaves - usually green teas from Fujian province, which is also home to the semi-fermented Oolong and smoky Lapsang Souchong - scented with jasmine flowers. Traditionally, the flowers are harvested during the day and stored in a cool place until nightfall, when they develop their full fragrance. They are then layered over the tea leaves, which have previously been steamed or heated to prevent their oxidation. The tea's quality is determined both by the quality of the green tea used as its base and by the effectiveness of the scenting process. Brewed, it has a delicate, silvery color and a rich fragrance reminiscent of a flower garden in bloom.

Due to very poor packing, 7 of the 14 pouches I ordered broke and so I had to throw them out. They leaked everywhere - what a mess! I am very disappointed! What a waste of money!

Sorry but these things taste horrible and look even worse.  The packages are quite small too.  I had most of my family (seven of us) sample this and none of the kids could stomach it save one and they weren't eager to eat it more than the one time.  It was a terrible waste of money.  I suppose a very small child (under 2 years) who isn't capable of complaining or doesn't know any better might eat it but I can't believe the other reviewers can get anyone to eat this stuff.Sorry but it isn't mine or my families bag of fruit and I can only give it a rating based on my experience with it.

Get the carrot & apple or pear & mango flavor from Plum Organics instead.  This was overwhelmingly sweet.  Like giving my babies candy.  The "Yello One" is almost as bad.  I recommend sticking with the other flavors, especially carrot, parsnip, apple.  And frankly, I think Plum Organics makes better tasting blends that are delicious but not too sweet.

I am a twenty-six year old female. I'm short, and my metabolism isn't the worse, nor the best. I was looking for a healthier alternative to most snacks I find at the store, I was told this resembles applesauce and to try it. It's has a pleasant applesauce feel, and taste good to boot. Only qualm is, that it's a small snack and will not make you content if you're starved. Good to use in-between meals when not starved though!Update: August 4 2011 - I recently ended up with GERD and a really bad bleeding ulcer, due to stress and grief.  I have problems keeping food down and went on a baby food diet for the sake of thriving.  This stays down but is beginning to cause some indigestion at times.  I'm not saying it would cause you guys to reflux or anything of that sort,  but it was really acidic and caused me to choke.  My throat now burns a lot,  and feels sore,  Please be weary if you're having gastrointestinal problems.  Babyfood is such a great idea if you're having problems keeping things in,  and need to retrain your stomach and intestines.  Just be careful,  some are more acidic than others.
When I purchased this, I thought about a healthy smootie anywhere anytime, but it doesn't taste very good. Not sweet and yummy enough. Sorry for being so technical.

column9: Is that what they call "green" packaging?
column10: After you've consumed your THREE OUNCES of organic "green" juice, the package will remain in a landfill for the next 450 years before it finally decomposes.  I'm sick and tired of companies trying to act all healthy while using piggish materials like this for their packaging.  Give your kid a freakin' apple.
Don't tell anybody, but this sugar is the secret to the worlds best Chocolate Chip Cookies!  Just use it in your favorite recipe, and watch everybody struggle to figure out what makes them so awsome!

Dark Muscovado sugar is fabulous !It's important to note that it is absolutely necessary to store it in a sealed plastic or glass container so it doesn't turn into a sugar boulder.Bought this sugar on a whim thinking it MIGHT be good and it certainly looked like something a different than you'd ever find in a supermarket.What a thrill it is. Granted, the packaging is plain, nothing at all fancy about it but what's inside is very fancy with a flavor so divine that it invites you to try it in everything.Here are a few of the things I've used it for since it arrived in my kitchen.Adds an elegant, gourmet flavor when used as a topping on french toast.On hot cereals such as oatmeal, cream of wheat, cream of rice it tastes rich and the steam rising smells so good.And here's a news flash: Mix a rounded teaspoon or two in hot or cold milk for a real treat. Or if you're like me and  into making from scratch hot cocoa, instead of mixing granulated sugar into the cocoa powder mix about 1/2 as much Muscovado sugar for an out of this world cup of hot cocoa. The flavor is deep and heady with an aroma that will knock your socks off.Want to add some pizazz to your beef stew? Add a half teaspoon of Muscovado to it about 1/2 hour before it's finished cooking.It also will add great flavor to chili when you add teaspoon full to it near the end of it's cooking time.Cut up a few apples, an orange and add a 1/2 cup or so of dried cranberries and a handful of crushed walnuts or pecans, sprinkle a rounded teaspoon of Muscovado sugar on top and give it a light toss. Let the mix sit in the fridge for an hour or so and you have a grand fresh dessert OR - and let me tell you this is so good you'll want to do it again....instead of serving that mixture cold (it's winter here), pour it all in a sauce pan and simmer it until the apples are soft. Serve it warm. OMG! it's good.I've also tried the warm mix with a splash of Peach Schnapps and a dollop of whipped cream added right before serving and the flavor blew me away. All of our dinner guests have given it rave reviews.The next thing I'm going to try it in is whipped cream - I'll come back and let you know how that goes.

As a diabetic cooking without sugar can be very difficult for certain dishes, but useing a substantially unrefined cane sugar is an option that doesn't shoot glucose levels up alarmingly like refined sugar.  It does have a Molasses taste so quite often rather than using molasses Ill use Dark Muscovado.  This product thought is gooey and unstable so after opening I keep it in a vacuum sealed jar.

Most brown sugar one would buy is either white sugar with molasses added or sugar that is tan which has a small amount of the molasses left in.  This seems to be the real thing, dark brown and almost gummy with all the minerals from a large amount of the molasses.  Rich flavor, I use it in coffee.  Seems like it might be too strong when you just try it on it's own, but it has a positive effect on whatever I add it to.

I ordered this on a whim after reading the reviews and I was not disappointed! This sugar is so flavorful you won't want to go back to using regular brown sugar. The only problem you'll have is trying not to eat it! Sometimes I find myself sneaking teaspoons from the bag :P  I use it regularly in coffee, oatmeal, etc. and I can't wait to try baking with it. Someone here mentioned it's the secret ingredient in their chocolate chip cookies. My mouth is watering just imagining how yummy that would be. Try this sugar - you will be amazed!
I got a bag of this for Christmas and used it to sweeten my coffee.  Wonderful stuff!

I saw Bobby Flay using Muscovado Sugar in one of his bbq sauce recipes.  Since my local market didn't have it, I went right on Amazon and found it... Wonderful product & service - came SOO quickly! A+++!

I read a lot about Muscovado sugar for years and decided to order some for my Christmas baking.  I give away a lot of baked goodies as thank you gifts to friends, family and those who have helped and supported me and my family over the year, like my Vet and the hospital staff.  There is no comparison.  Everyone was asking what I did to the recipes to improve on already excellent products.  As I was making the doughs and batters, one taste told me that I was onto something great.  I'm not going back to regular sugars.  Muscovado is worth EVERY penny of the extra costs.  Try it once and you'll be hooked.  I am.  Just wish I had purchased it sooner.

V E R Y impressed with this product.  I have experienced Muscavo suger from South America and wanted to try sugars from other regions.  My expectations were more than met.  This has the most molassas content of any dark sugar I have experimented with. Planning to try more of India Tree's offerings soon.

This has a very rich flavor.  Yes, it's mostly just a sweet taste like suger, but it also has distinct flavors. I am partial to all dark foods for health reasons, but this one has the added benefit of making coffee taste better.  1/2 teaspoon can be a treat for kids.

This is one of my absolute favorite sorts of sugars to bake with. The molasses flavor is very rich and adds something wonderful to the whole wheat I use in all my baking. It combines very well with spices like ginger or cinnamon, it goes well in chocolate, and goes very well with coffee. More delicate flavors might be overpowered by this sugar.I really recommend it for spicy shortbread variations if you like to experiment in cooking. I use shortbread to try out sugars and sweeteners and to see how they combine with different flavors.This makes a very dense shortbread with a nice molasses warm flavor.

I stumbled on this sugar as I experiement a lot. I found that I can replace white sugar and especially brown sugar with this for many recipes and almost always have a better outcome. It has a much richer taste and texture and I sense it might be a bit sweeter than regular sugar, that and its much more expensive so I scale back a bit. But, I have not noticed any negative impact from doing that. I really recommend this product!
The extra expense is worth it. We baked homemade organic cinnamon rolls and used India Tree Muscovado instead of refined cheap dark brown sugar and you could taste the quality.

This very dark sugar has a wonderful rich molasses flavour that is ideal for baking or just adding to oatmeal.  Many if not most other brown sugars are simply refined white sugar that have had flavouring and colour added, they taste like a very sad imitation of real Muscovado sugar.  If a recipe calls for dark brown sugar I will only use Muscovado sugar.

column9: From Cane Grown in Volcanic Ash
column10: I first found this sugar while working at Larry's Market in Seattle. The India Tree company is also located in Seattle. It was one of the greatest food discoveries I'd forgotten about. Well, not quite. I just had no idea why the sugar we ate in Africa was so rich and similar to molasses in color. This sugar is milled on the island of Mauritius off the coast of Africa and has the divine flavor only possible from cane growing on volcanic ash.Here in America, most of the brown sugar seems like white sugar coated in a brown coloring in comparison to this rich, dark and almost seductive slightly salty tasting sugar. When I found this sugar, it brought back tons of childhood memories. Mostly memories of eating a spoonful of sugar as a treat. This sugar is "that" good. Muscovado is slightly moist, has a very high molasses content and is delicious in gingerbread, coffee cakes, chocolate cakes and anything with chocolate in it. You can basically use this sugar in any recipe that calls for "dark brown sugar."When making cookies, you will notice some of the lumps don't quite work themselves into the dough. This is no problem, because then you just find a few sugar lumps in your cookies. If you prefer your sugar to be perfectly soft, you can add a piece of apple to your sugar jar until the sugar softens.This is one of my "Top Ten" ingredient finds of the century.~The Rebecca Review

column9: More flavorful than I thought possible
column10: A true brown sugar, almost unprocessed.  The taste is (obviously) sugary, but with complex notes that cannot be put into words -- way beyond the finest molasses.  Add in the modest price and large quantity, and you have a winner here.  My recommendation: put this on grits/oatmeal for a unique treat.

I was afraid this might be too strong for hubby's coffee (I use stevia myself), but he likes it.We made chocolate chip cookies using entirely this sugar for both white and brown sugars.  They were AMAZINGLY rich. Normally, we can get through a double batch in 2-3 days, but with this sugar, they were so amazingly rich, we couldn't eat more than 2 cookies at a time.This is MUCH richer than most sugars, even other whole cane sugars.  I am now cutting my recipes to about 3/4 the sugar I used to use.

Great for sweetening coffee and oatmeal. I have found many amazing things to do with muscovado sugar and I will never go back to artificial sweeteners again!!Another one I constantly use is the brand called EL MAESTRO and I usually buy it on ebay. It has a pure, strong molasses taste much that I absolutely love. I believe its imported from the Philippines where they specialize in that. Don't get me wrong, both El Maestro and India Tree are amazing products!!But yeah, you can't compare muscovado sugar to any other sugars out there. Perfect with any recipe, especially coffee and tea... and marinating meats!

Looking for a good brown sugar I came across this Muscovado Sugar.  It has a fairly small grain.  Unlike some of the other brown sugars, it is moist and sticky with a great aroma--hints of vanilla and rich spice rather than a molasses smell.  It's great on its own and I find that it works very well in recipes that use vanilla, cinnamon, nutmeg, ginger and seems to add more moisture to muffins and cakes (it works really well in carrot cake).  It also works very well in chocolate cookies...well, anything chocolate!  I think it's not as sweet as some of the other brown sugars I've baked with, so you might need a little more.As for keeping it moist, as long as you don't open the packs, the sugar maintains its consistency even if it stands around for a long time.  Once opened, it needs to be kept in a tightly closed container.  I also use a sugar clay bear and it seems to work fairly well although with time some of the sugar does turn into little hard clumps.

column9: Enjoy the taste of brown sugar instead of wondering if it's there.
column10: I read a lot of reviews on brown sugar to find one that I could taste in my recipe after cooking.  I make homemade granola bars and it's so easy to lose the brown sugar taste when cooking.  With the Dark Muscovado you get a hint of of the taste with every bite.  I also like the way it melds so well with the vanilla flavoring and butter.  I will be getting more when I run out of what I have.  The price is right for the quality of the product and I find this brand better than what I was getting at the natural foods store.  I do keep mine in the refrigerator and I would like to add a special thank you to the manufacturers for their packaging.  It is so easy to close and sill the bag after opening.  So far all the packs of sugar have stayed soft until I've used all of the contents.  You can tell by just one use that this is quality sugar.

column9: 6 dollars a lb for brown sugar
column10: The address is shilshole avenue.  A shill living in a hole; selling you 6 dollar a lb brown sugar over the internet.  ..... Sounds about right.

We use it to make Frappuccino. It works great! But Beware! Our recipe called for a teaspoon of the Xanthan gum. Not a good Idea. This stuff is a great thickener but a tablespoon turned my Frappuccino into bread dough. Now we use a pinch. It ought last us forever at those increments! Really great buy!

column9: First Time Using It : Gravy Success.
column10: I'm trying to avoid using cornstarch or flour and still have a gravy to put on meat. I added one teaspoon to 2 cups of cream/water on medium heat until the ingredients were simmering and well mixed. It thickened more in the serving dish and became a perfect gravy. I am switching to this.

I was looking for a way to thicken my protein shakes to make them more palatable and found this to be a great alternative. I mixed the shake ingredients together with about 1/2 teaspoon of the Xanthan Gum and refrigerated it overnight. The next morning I dumped it in my blender with some frozen fruit and it was PERFECT! You can drink it slowly and it maintains the thickness even when not ice cold. When I would use crushed ice it was a race to suck it down fast enough before the consistency got too runny and the flavor was of course always watered down. This is a great alternative and the little bag will last me forever!

This is expensive but you only have to use 1 or 2 tsp for whatever you are making and it does a great job thickening and 'keeping all the ingredients together' unlike some others (corn starch, tapioca, etc.)

column9: just what I was hoping for
column10: I had never used this product before and had researched it.  I have purchased Red Mill items before in my home grocery stor and like and trust them.  This product was no different.  I am pleased with the folks who sent it, too.  Fast and packed well.  Thank you.

column9: A must for gluten free cooking
column10: Gluten free flours require some type of replacement for the gluten found in other flours. Xanthan gum is the best option we have found and BRM brand is the best quality we have found...and we have been at the gluten free diet for a decade now.

column9: A good buy, essential for gluten-free baking
column10: This is a good buy in this quantity - though to preserve it, I pour some into a jar with a lid that screws tight, and reclose and seal the bag carefully until it's needed.  The jar sits with my baking supplies and I measure the xanthan gum from that as needed.  I do wish it were sold in a container made to reclose tightly.

When I opened the box a good portion of the product had leaked through HOLES throughout the bag. As far as I am concerned this product is GARBAGE bc they won't let me return it. I'm not ingesting an open bag of product. It was an expensive lesson!
I grew up with these as a kid in Germany and I love the flavors! They taste very natural and I think much better than starburst.
I buy this tuna because there is no salt added, and my husband is on a very strict no-sodium diet.  The bonus?  It tastes great, and is ecologically sustainable.

This is basically hamburger helper for Chinese/Thai food. It's not going to be amazing, and you shouldn't be holding any delusions that this would be better tasting than sitting down at a restaurant.That said, I'm lazy as hell about cooking. I did it professionally for 5 years and hardly ever want to do it at home any more. I bought a box of this from my local wally world and made it today with about 6oz. of sauteed chicken added.It turned out really well. It was a bit chewy (rice noodles don't firm up like wheat does) but all in all I enjoyed it.For a cheap, easy meal this is a great product. Beats the hell out of ramen. Fairly healthy, too. Low fat and sodium contents. I plan on ordering many more.
Ok so I ordered this item on line and was disappointed. It not only tasted bad but I was stuck with six boxes of the stuff. You just can't get good thai in a box period.

column9: Relief for sore throat in Suzhou, China
column10: I was teaching at the Suzhou, China technical college when I developed a sore throat/cold. The faculty brought me Golden Throat Lozenge drops that worked wonders for me, especially helping me to stop coughing in the middle of the night. I tried other cough drops when I got back to the U.S but nothing worked like Golden Throat Lozenges. Now I have a supply to help just in case I need any in the future.The delivery time was very prompt and the product well packaged.Mary Ellen McFadden
i'm very happy with this product. delivery was on time and everything came in perfect condition. thanks!

while on tour in china our tour guide noticed me coughing excessively. he offered me a pack and i was amazed thes are the best cought dropes EVER.they come nicely packed in groups of 5, try them they are the best. do'nt know what is in them but they will stop you cough for sure.

column9: A little too strong for me
column10: I host conference calls all day and my voice is starting to crack. I ordered these in hopes of soothing my voice. I don't really have sore throat, just terrible allergies this year and constant talking on the phone. They are too strong for me and I hate I ordered the large box. I can't use them one after the other for sure.

I bought these in the airport in Beijing because I had a sore throat and was about to board a 14-hour flight home. THEY WORK! And taste pretty good too. But in the product features section it lists "Expelling wind"... ??? I don't think it does that. Maybe if you're thinking in terms of the traditional Chinese "six excesses" system....

column9: Golden Throat Drops work very well
column10: These were recommended and sold by United Health Care in Beijing, a hospital that has European certified physicians and practices.  Our whole family went there for medical care while we were living in Beijing and we really relied on the Pharmacy's advice.

column9: Chocolate/coffee tinged root beer? YES PLEASE!
column10: While I still consider Boylan's Natural Root Beer (featured here on Amazon in a 12pack) to be the ultimate root beer by design and result (it's a birch beer and a sasparilla and a vanilla cream soda and...), Saranac is currently my favorite "exotic" root beer. (Boylan's, despite its exotic design, comes out quite conservatively standard as a root beer "taste".)This is entirely due to the notes of chocolate or maybe coffee (or both--obviously the tastes are related).If the notion of a slightly cocoa-flavored root beer appeals to you, and you don't mind spending somewhere between 2 and 4 dollars a bottle (depending on your shipping options), then buy with confidence! (All cases I've ordered from Amazon so far have come packed securely in well-designed containers, too.)

Saranac makes a very refreshing root beer with excellent flavor - not just a sugar taste. If you like A&W you would probably like this as much or more. Definately worth trying if you are a root beer fan.

I have traveled extensively and discovered this paprika on one of my many visits to Spain. I used to buy cans of it and bring it back home for my own personal use and for gifts. Spanish paprika is the best in the world and this has a wonderful, smoky flavor.

This paprika is delicious and robust and incredibly flavorful!  It has a smoky flavor that compliments any tex-mex style cuisine.  It is fantastic sprinkled on chicken, fish, pork or tofu!!!  Add with it garlic powder, onion powder, cumin, chile and you'll have a totally authentic (uniquely/deliciously) flavored dish!  Super yummy in rice too!  Great with beans!  Basically, anywhere you'd like to try paprika that is unlike anything you'll buy in a traditional american grocery, try this!  Your family or guests will be asking you how you came up with something so delicious!  Usually only available across seas, it is a secret you will be glad you discovered!

This Spanish "paprika" has the beautiful red color of Hungarian paprika, but not its unassuming flavor. This Spanish version, pimenton, has a pronounced smoky flavor. It's going to be interesting to find new ways to use it.
I love these right out of the box.  They are imported from Italy and unfortunately most of the breadsticks arrive broken.

These are the very breadsticks Dr. ATW Simeons recommends for his HCG protocol.  They have been great to have on hand as I'm not a fan of melba toast, the only other alternative.  I do wish I had ordered plain instead of the rosemary though...the rosemary are great when I'm having something that "goes" with that flavor, but a little off with, say, Mexican oriented meals.

I tried to eat this with some saltine crackers, which i like to do with most seafood. But the taste was just how can i put this....disgusting. This "might" be good for crab cakes but eating as is didn't go well for me.If you notice its very cheap compared to Crown Prince Crab Meat and believe me there is a very good reason. This crab meat is imported from Singapore.

If you want the most fancy crab meat that money can buy, then you should choose lump crab meat.  If you want a good dependable economy crab meat, you may want this one. It is better than any cheap crab meat in my supermarket.  I've had over 12 cans of it and never found a shell fragment.  The meat is totally white and mild.  I use it in soups, cheese bakes and dips, and it works just fine.  This is a good dependable crab meat brand that absolutely doesn't deserve the bad reviews it is getting from former buyers.
The so-called crabmeat is pure mush. I don't think it is really crabmeat. Forget about it !!!!

When I read the reviews for this product, I originally thought people were just being too picky, but I see now that I should have stayed away from this "crab meat" When it arrived, it was more like grated up crab mush with the taste having no resemblance to crab. It improved a bit when cooked, but it has SO MUCH shell grit in it that I can't enjoy my meal. I bought this product to save money because the price compared to local supermarkets was great, but I now see I really REALLY got what I paid for. Cheap!I rarely write product reviews, but this stuff was so awful, I had to.

ADVANTAGES:  (1)Tastes moderately good just as it is.  It doesn't have shell fragments or other defects.  The color is slightly pinkish in most areas and more moderately pinkish in other areas.  This product is not high-grade lump crabmeat.  This product is adequate-grade non-lump crabmeat.  (2)Unlike those difficult-to-open 4-ounce cans of crabmeat sold by MW Polar brand, these 6-ounce cans sold by Consul brand can be opened conveniently using a can opener.  DISADVANTAGES:  (1)The quantity of crabmeat is very bad.  After squeezing the opened can to drain the water away, the level of the crabmeat drops to below the halfway point in the altitude of the can.  This means that the price for this product is actually a bad deal, not the excellent deal that others who have commented on this product have been fooled into thinking.
Good crabmeat; made great sandwiches. I even made some crabcakes with it, and they were a big hit. I would recommend this product; it's a great buy!
this is not crab meat, it is mashed, in a bath of liquids and chemicals....forget buying this if you are searching for real crab.

column9: Sweet taste and shell bits (See customer image I uploaded)
column10: I tried a can of crab from the grocery store that was $4 a can. All is was was particles of crab meat kind of like coffee grinds out of a used coffee filter. It really didn't have a flavor to it. I ended up just putting it on some lettuce with ranch and ate it like a salad. I will never buy it again.But I really love crab meat and sushi but I can't really afford it nor do I have the time to dine out much. So I'm looking for some type of substitute for fresh seafood even though I know it won't be nearly as good so I have extremely low expectations.This was more like shredded crab mixed with particles of crab meat BUT there were a few thicker pieces in there like maybe from the leg of a very tiny crab. So it was better than the grocery store kind I tried and cheaper. BUT this brand had pieces of shell in it--the other did not. This one had sugar added to it so it tasted sweet which makes no sense to me.So I might possibly try this again knowing full well I'd do better just going to a Chinese buffet since that's the closet I will get to fresh crab in Appalachia. It's not something I will buy reguarly. Maybe once a month or every couple months. It's cheap. It somewhat has a crab taste if you use your imagination. It basically tastes like tuna.I will save up some money and try lump crab meat in a can next. Wish me luck.
These cranberries have far too much sugar...The taste of the berries is ruined by the taste of all of the sugar almost to the point that there is almost no cranberry flavor!!!
This was a post-visit gift to friends who usually buy a similar product at Trader Joe's.  They said that the cranberries were delicious and that they are enjoying them.

column9: BEST dried cranberries I've ever had!
column10: In comparison these are larger, softer, and even a bit juicy!!!I usually buy the major or evern generic brand of dried cranberries carried at my local grocery. So, these are the ONLY organic dried cranberries I've ever had so I cannot say that these are the best in the organic category but these taste SO MUCH better than any non organic brand from my local grocer. I will buy again! :)

column4: FOREVER student of Life:D "Always learning co...
column10: NOT so sweet as Newman's own!! Glad I cancel to otto order, it would be nice if Amazon would do his!Side note AMAZON STOP Using DHL PPPPPI'm better now, I'll have a bit more of the Cranberries, Less sugar & more Fiber :))Get some you wont go wrong!!

column4: Vicky Loebel "Author: Keys to the Coven"
column10: I hate artificial sweeteners, and I'm not absolutely crazy about Stevia, which has a very strong, sweet taste (different from sugar) but I really wanted to break my mocha habit and cut back on sweets. Two drops of this in skim milk and coffee makes an excellent substitute for my old heaping teaspoon of sweetened cocoa.I'd like to carry this in my purse to change those impulse Starbucks Mochas into Skinny Lattes, but the bottle says to refrigerate "for freshness" after opening, so I'm not sure how perishable it is.

column9: It's hard to strike a balance with this flavor
column10: I've read a lot recently on how bad artificial sweeteners are for our health, so I decided to give this chocolate flavored liquid stevia a try.I simply cannot drink my coffee black, I was adding Hershey's sugar-free chocolate syrup and skim milk to my morning coffee. This stevia is a good substitute, but it's a flavor/sweetener I will have to learn to love. So far, not loving it, but it's better for me so I will buck up and maybe change my star rating later.I am experimenting at the moment, starting out with 5 drops per 8 ounces of coffee, it's sweet enough, but not enough chocolate flavor. Upping it to 8 drops per cup, it's starting to get there with the chocolate flavor, but it's too sweet.The Sweetleaf is all natural, has no calories, and is also rated 0 (zero) on the glycemic index.Also, you may think the price of this is expensive initially, but one 2 ounce bottle has around 300 servings, so it's cheaper for me considering the price of the Hershey's sugar-free syrup.

The bottle use to say 'Dark Chocolate'... so I don't know if this is the same.I don't like stevia usually, but when you add the cacao... it is sooooo yummy.I can get kids who (seriously) won't drink water at all, to drink it all day long when I add a few drops of this.Or totally get rid of 'chocolate milk'... just add a few drops of this stuff and whalaa.I put it in my health-smoothies to make them taste delicious.I carry a bottle in my purse everywhere.Trying to cut down on sweets, but want to totally quench your sweet-tooth?  Just put this in your water and you'll be satiated.

My chiropractor recommended Stevia as an alternative to the artificial sweeteners I had been using.  I had been having chronic migraines, which he deduced were a result of my use of Aspartame.  Initially I was skeptical, but decided to give it a shot anyway.  I am happy to say that since I now use Stevia instead of any artificial sweeteners, I'm headache free!  Stevia comes in lots of flavors, even rootbeer, which I've used in sparkling water in place of diet soda - it's delicious and no headaches!  What could be better ...highly recommend! (PS this is the best price I've found anywhere ...)

I use this in making fake fudge. Sweet, definitely chocolate!I don't use sugar so this works perfectly for me. I would highly recommend to people whether or not they have to control their sugar intake.

I like to keep a bottle in my purse so I can order water in restaurants. We live near the beach, so the water is pretty bad. This stuff is wonderful.It does say to refrigerate "for freshness", but as far as I can tell that just means to keep the flavor strong. Usually after 6 months or so the flavor won't be as strong but I don't mind buying a new bottle a few times a year.
This is great!  I've been adding it to things like iced coffee, lattes, and black cherry carbonated water.  This has been helping to ween myself off of sweets.  yay!

A wonderful product to put in water. It regulates blood sugar, I have read, and tastes sooo good you'll forgo that chocolate bar!I use it in coffee for mocha.  Stevia is a great non chemical sweetner and I have been using these products for a few years.

My girls love yogurt but the flavored yogurt is so much more expenisive then to get a quart of plain. I buy the plain yogurt then add drops of this to flavor and sweeten it and the girls love it and the yogurt does not have all the added chemicals and sweeteners that get added.

This stuff is great! I use it to make cafe mochas and chocolate covered strawberries. So yummy... The key to stevia is to use it very sparingly. Too much and it is bitter, but the right amount tastes great! I barely use half a drop on each strawberry and it is more than enough. Maybe you could dilute it in a little water or something to make it easier to use the right amount. I love stevia, no more white sugar for me!

column9: Trident White SUGARLESS Gum with Xylitol
column10: This is a great product for people who want to improve their oral health.  The key feature in the gum is Xylitol, a sugar derived from the birch tree.  Xylitol is naturally sweet, so no added sugar is necessary, however, the added benefit of xylitol is that oral bacteria (the ones that cause tooth decay and gum disease) ingest xylitol, cannot digest it, and as a result - die!  This lowers bacterial counts in the mouth, which if done consistently, lowers the pathogenic bacteria, thus lowering the potential for cavities.  There are several gums that advertize the ingredient xylitol, but check the package carefully, some add additional sugars that bacteria love, thereby negating the positive effect of xylitol.  Most people who buy xylitol gum do so with the intent to lower cavity risk.  A usual daily dose of xylitol is chewing 5 sticks a day for 5 minutes a time.  Several toothpastes also have xylitol in them, such as Spry Spry Sugar Free Toothpaste with Fluoride, Spearmint 4 oz.  (I always recommend a toothpaste with fluoride, so get the Spry with fluoride - it also comes in a non-fluoride formulation too).  The flavor of this gum tends to wear off rather quickly, but then the intent is to dose the mouth with xylitol, not necessarily to promote gum chewing or gum chewing pleasure.Bought in bulk, as in this package, the cost is reduced.kone

If you are a fan of recycling, you will be happy to know that Celestial Seasonings print their boxes on 100% recycled paperboard with 35% post-consumer content.

I drink one to two of these K-Cups a day (have been doing so for 6 mos now).  Love it - perfect tea - not bitter not weak.  I have come across the occasional K-Cup with a bad lid seal (and it will blow the grinds into the cup then) but I choose not to get worked up over the failure of a 40 cent item when the others in the pack are fine.  2008 EDIT: Ok, , I have to agree with the other reviewer a little more - the quality of these K-cups is inconsistent and they do blow grinds more often then they should.  I am still drinking this tea as much as ever as the flavor is not replicated in any other brand.  2009 EDIT: It's June 2009 now and this is still my main drink.  The K-Cup blowout issues seems to have been resolved in the last few boxes.  They must have fixed the problem.  A great tea.

Great find on Amazon! I had not found a decaf K-cup tea on any of the regular K-cup sties ... most decaf offerings were green tea or herbal. (Green tea is prohibited if you take the prescription drug Coumadin)Smooth and flavorful, does not brew as dark as using a tea bag, but just as rich.Priced below other teas on other sites and arrived nicely packaged, no extra packaging to dispose of!The best feature of this purchase was the use by date ... over 12 months away. Other sites have sent coffee and teas that had sell by dates within 3 months!I now use Amazon for all my K-cups because of price and service!

After reading pros and cons on the Twinings English Breakfast K-cups, I decided to take my chances (based on brand name and favorable reviews).  I was very pleasantly surprised that the taste and brew strength of the tea are of the best quality ... especially for a decaffeinated blend.  I've made numerous cups and never once had the problem of tea leaves seeping through the k-cup, as mentioned by some reviewers. It's a great way to make a quick cup of tea and I highly recommend this product.

column9: Tea Time for a Pregnant Woman and Her Man
column10: My wife and I are big fans of the Keurig K-cup system mostly for the fact that you can get a consistent tasting cup of tea or coffee in under a minute (Ours is always on, so no warm up time).  It saves us about 2.5 minutes per day of unnecessary steeping time.  That adds up to over 15 hours a year for each of us!  That's 15 hours for each of us to fall in love all over again with the rich bold flavor of this decaffeinated english breakfast brew which is a favorite of my wife during pregnancy.
I picked the wront tea, cause I don't like this one as much as the regular English tea.  I will change my order next time.

I have been ordering K cups from Coffee Cow for 2 years and I will go back to them ASAP.  There were 2 kcups in each of the boxes that were broken and tea...very  very fine tea... was everywhere...not 2 mention I was now 4 cups short.  The remaining cups were one third the weight of the Timothy's tea I had on the shelf.  The tea tastes like dish water. I will never order this again. What a waste of money!

Compared to Celestial Seasonings English Breakfast, this tea is weak.  The tea tastes like the second run of the other brand.  Purchased Twinings because much cheaper than C.S., but will not make that mistake again!

column9: Tea leaves too tiny... they end up in your tea cup.
column10: I couldn't wait to have decaf english breakfast tea k-cups!  I was so disappointed when they arrived because the tea leaves must be too tiny as they end up coming out of the k-cup during brewing and you end up with almost the entire k-cup of tea leaves floating in your tea cup.  YUK.  I am so disappointed.  I wish someone would come up with a good decaf k-cup of english breakfast tea... please!

column9: The Best But Hard To Get
column10: This is the best Tea out there. But it is hard to find on Amazon!!!

We really enjoy the Twinings k-cups.  I'm a casual tea drinker and I think it's a really good cup of tea, and there's no wait for water to boil and for the tea to steep.  My wife is pretty particular about her tea and she quite likes it as well, but feels that there's no beating making tea the old fashion way.  So, not quite as good loose tea or bagged tea, but certainly a lot more convenient and a lot quicker.

column9: K-Cups are great for more than just coffee
column10: I was a bit skeptical at first that my wonderful K-Cup machine could produce a great cup of tea.  I am a huge fan of the coffee I brew with it, but tea can be tricky to brew sometimes.I have to admit that after I tried two sips I was in heaven.  I wouldn't have been able to tell you that it wasn't brewed on the stove top.  The tea tastes just as good as the bagged version, and the fact that I can drink it in less than 2 minutes creates a total winning package for me.
Those in our office who are sensitive to caffeine just love this tea as a replacement for the "real thing."
This is really a great tasting tea and I have a cup every morning. If anyone is looking for a good decaf tea, this is one I recommend.
This is a wonderful tea for the keurig machines.  If you like a tea with no bitter taste then this is the one for you.

This is my DW's favorite K-cup, she seems to go through two to three per day.  I'll have a tea about once per week, and I find this to be quite good as well.  Although still cheaper on Amazon than other sources, this used to be much cheaper here last year!

This decaf tea is awesome.  I bought it for my pregnant wife who can't have caffeine, and I have been stealing them to make iced tea with... Brew this over ice and it makes an AWESOME tea. I will be buying this one again.
The tea is good (for non-steeped) but my last order had several pods with loose/compromised foil tops which means it explodes in the Keurig and tea spurts out dispenser.

column9: too weak or too large a mug
column10: I can only use the smallest brewing cup size for one K-cup of this tea.  It does taste good that way, but it takes 3 k-cups to get my breakfast mug!  I'm going to try regular Bigelow black tea next.
The Brits have something that AMERICA NEEDS AND WANTS!  and we purchased it at AMAZON. COM
The decaf version of Twinings English Breakfast K-cups tastes just as great as their regular!  Twinings definitely makes the most authentic-tasting K-cup teas around!

After trying for so long to find tea pods (regular and Decaff) for the Keurig coffee maker, I am both relieved and pleased to have found it on Amazon.  I ordered the auto ship option so that I know there will always be my favorite tea in the pantry for me.  And if its not there, it will be arriving soon.  I love it and I'm sooo happy!!!

We have used this tea since getting our Keurig system.  This is a decaffeinated tea and is not readily available in stores in our area, so ordering online is a must. We are scheduled to receive another order soon.  This service is exceptional.

column9: Very weak compared to the regular Twinings English Breakfast
column10: My wife drinks the caffeinated Twinings English Breakfast Tea on the largest Keurig setting almost five times a day.  I accidentally ordered the decaf version and she has been trying to drink these at night instead of the regular.  Unfortunately, whatever the process that is used to remove the caffeine from the tea leaves this K-Cup extremely weak and watery.  To her, the lowest setting is comparable to the medium or high settings on the regular English Breakfast.  If you're a serious tea drinker like my wife and you need a decaf tea, you might want to try a smaller box or some other brands before buying 50 of these.
it is so hard to find decaf tea for the kerig maker. the flavor is great the price is great and I will buy it again for sure
Twinings has the best tea blends.  I love the Decaf Breakfast Tea. It has great flavor and the decaffination doesn't take away from the flavor.

The taste of the decaf tea was excellent, but the tea leaves came through the K-cup, causing the tea to pour very slowly from the Keurig machine.  I had to strain my cup of tea into another cup to remove all the tea leaves.

Tea was delivered on time, packaged well - no damage, great service. However, the tea is weak. I used the minimum amount of water for the Keurig brewer to work and still not much tea flavor. Very disappointed in this product. I will not purchase again.

I have been drinking this tea for a long time and am 100% satisfied with every cup.  The flavor is perfect... not to weak nor too strong.  It also makes delicious iced tea, too.  I usually drink caffeinated drinks, but like this because I can enjoy it any time of day or night and not have to worry about the caffeine keeping me awake. I have never had a problem with the grinds getting into the cup, as some other reviewers claim.  I also have never gotten any k cups with a bad seal.  I would highly recommend this product if you love a great tasting cup of tea that is ready instantly.

HiMy order arrived quickly, in good condition .  The tea is excelent and just the correct strengh for  my taste,which is mild flavored. I am able to make two cups from one k cup if i like. Neither is too strong or weak.Good price, good taste and great service,gets an A+Arlie

column9: Great price, fast shipping, great product.
column10: I cannot find decaf tea K-Cups in any store and they are so expensive on the Kuerig website.  This was a great product at a GREAT price.  The shipping was right on time and I got exactly what I ordered.  I will definitely be buying this again when I run out of K-Cups. :)
This has become my favorite tea!  I now drink more than I used to, simply because it is delicious!

column9: twinings english tea selection Keurig cups
column10: This item always arrives in a timely way and I love to sit and relax with my cup of tea. Thanks for your great service! pc

column9: Excellent Tea for Two or One
column10: This is excellent tea for anyone using a Keurig machine.  The perfect cup of tea for one or two people.  Easy to store, easy to use and easy to dispose of.

This tea is by far the best K-Cup tea available, however some boxes have had problems. Some of the K-Cups are not airtight, and the foil lid is not sealed completely. This has happened in two of my past four orders in the past few months. About 30% of the K-Cups in each affected box have this problem. The unaffected K-Cups brew excellent cups of tea, and I would recommend this product once Twinings fixes the issue with the foil lid.
I have always been a big Twingings Tea fan and was glad when I got my Kerug that they have K-cups too!!

This is now our favorite tea. It's great as iced tea. Now we are spoiled and are not satisfied with a pitcher of tea from tea bags when we can have a tall freshly brewed glass of English Breakfast. Also enjoyed it in winter as hot tea. We drink a lot of it so we use decaf. We will be keeping this on hand always.
Works great in the K-cup brewer, good tasting tea and so easy to make a quick cuppa.

This tea is one of the few decaffeinated K-Cup teas available, so it's a good thing it consistently makes a delicious cup of tea.  I also have used it to make iced tea - good for that, too.I'm not a tea snob...I just know what I like

If you love black tea, you will love this.  So tasty and every single cup is fresh fresh fresh.  I saw below that someone had leaves getting into their tea, and I havent had that happen, and i drink this all day long.  I think something mustve gone wrong with their box........definitely a great deal! yum!!
I love breakfast tea, but during the cooler days, I've found that drinking it later in the day affects my night time sleep quality. This tea gives me the flavor I want without the buzz.

column9: Good cup of decaf for the Keurig
column10: I boought this primarily for my wife who prefers decaf in the evenings.  Although she still prefers a steeped cup of tea, this is a nice alternative that is ready more quickly.
The free shipping got me to order but I can still drive to bed and bath with their coupon and pay $2 less

I have just finished my second cup this morning and this is a great tea!  Especially if you are looking for a decaffeinated product, then this is highly recommended.Taste great and it has replaced coffee for me in the morning!!

This is the worst tasting tea ever. It really tastes just like cardboard and I am shocked that it doesn't have less stars. I recommend Celestial Seasoning Tea over this - tastes like real tea instead of packaging. You cannot return it either so don't bother buying it.
These K cups have a deep flavor for a decaf tea . I usually make a 12 ounce cup with just 1.

I am a decafe tea drinker that was unable to find any for a Keurig locally. This has great flavor, not weak or watery. Price is great for the amount of K-Cups in package. Will be sure to purchase again
I couldn't be more satisfied with this tea.  I have never had a problem.  The tea is the perfect strength, whether I make it to drink it hot or add ice for iced tea.
These K-cups brew an excellent cup of decaf tea! Wonderful fresh brewed taste in just a few seconds with the Keurig brewer. You won't be disappointed.

I never had the English Breakfast Tea before, and found the flavor mild and good.  I don't like strong teas, and wanted a black tea that I didn't have to water down or add suger to.  This is a good tea, and buying it from Amazon was also a good deal.  I normally pay $12 a box, and it is more like $10 a box, when you purchase the pack of two.Thanks again, Amazon, and Twinings!

column9: Great tea and a fast way to have it !!
column10: Its the greatest way to make tea since the invention of tea pots!!Great products all the way..

I had to order this twice and still have not received it!!! I ordered it the second time on Feb 6 and it says it's in stock but they're not shipping it until Feb 26!!! I am canceling my order and will not shop from these people again!!!! I should not have to wait well over a month for something and then not even be able to contact them about it!!!!

I am so glad they decided to make this tea available in the K-cup.  I really appreciate a good cup of tea but don't need the caffeine from 8 cups a day, and this tea actually tastes great in the decaf variety.

This is a wonderful cup of tea!  Made with the traditional cream & sugar, it is full bodied and bracing.  The Kuerig brews it fast and hot. This is a wonderful cup of tea!  My son recommends this highly -- I like the decaf... My son recommends the regular.
My wife is smart and read the directions on the box.  That helps cause her smart husband made it with water

Bought this yesterday and was very excited to try the salted caramel one, since I LOVE IT at Starbucks.  Made it according to directions and was very disappointed with the flavor.  Tasted sort of like dish washing liquid... Definitely won't buy again.
These are probably the best hot chocolate I've had at home. Very rich flavor and relatively low in calories (under 120 a packet, I think). Love all the flavors.

We bought this assortment from Costco for $5.99 (they were clearing it out).  We were excited to try it, but quickly disappointed.  It is hard to describe the flavor, but it doesn't taste like the rich flavor I was expecting.  The toasted marshmallow was the biggest fail.  It just has dehydrated marshmallows added to the mix...nothing really special or "toasted" about it.  It seems like a lot of people like it with coffee, but if you just want delicious hot cocoa this would not be my choice.  My husband's comment was that even Carnation Brand tastes better than this hot cocoa!
Tastes just like Starbucks from the store. Of course it's wonderful in milk with higher fat, but works great in skim as well.

I was excited to try these flavors but I cannot tell any difference between the toasted marshmallow and the salted caramel.  They both just taste like any regular pack of plain hot cocoa mix you can get in the grocery store.  Only thing is these are more expensive and cost more to make since you must use milk.  Won't waste my money again.  I'll stick with melting chocolate chips into milk if I want a really rich/decadent hot chocolate.

We tried one packet of each of the assortment. Each one was virtually tasteless. The peppermint felt like grit. The marshmellows might as well have been missing. Could barely taste any salt in the salted caramel.

Perfect for topping off the evening or just getting it started.  This hotchocolate was incredibly smooth and very creamy.  Don't use water, but Half n Half.  Ooolalaaa........Your taste buds will jump for joy!Merry Christmas just got Merrier!

I first bought this sauce when a local chief recommended using as base (with butter, plum wine, water, shallots, ginger, and garlic) for pork (yum) but it turned out my picky son LOVES chicken marinated in it (wouldn't eat chicken previously, now it's a favorite - thanks Koon Chun - he also will only eat steak with their BBQ sauce). I am writing this review as I make another order (for both). Shipping is a couple of dollars less at reseller's web site.

column9: BEST there is, turn plain chicken into a gourmet feast
column10: A lady I knew belonged to an ethnic group that traveled around the world seeking artifacts from ancient civilizations and they would host dinners at each other's houses once a month; her stock dinner consisted of chicken wings cooked in nothing but this wonderful sauce, carrots sauteed in brown sugar, butter and ginger, green salad with Girard's original dressing, cold cooked broccoli served with sour cream and those French fried onions in a can and the dessert was vanilla ice cream with ginger biscuits soon to be available from Amazon.This sauce MAKES the chicken and all you have to do is bake chicken basted with this sauce, nothing else and you have created a fabulous and unique dish out of a very common food item.

column9: Better than the Other One... but not dark rich sauce I was looking for
column10: I love Mu shu Pork.  When we order at Chinese restaurant, they call the rich dark sauce included with it "plum sauce".  But when I ordered two "plum" sauces, neither were anything like the wonderful "plum" sauce I love.  One of those was simply awful (like sugary syrup with almost no plum flavor)... THIS ONE was much stronger and more flavorful, but not the flavor I was looking for for this dish (will try as marinade to test).So apparently the chinese restaurants I order from incorrectly call the sauce "plum" instead of "hoisin".  Either way, the "Koon Chun HOISIN Sauce" is the very rich, dark "plum" SAUCE that is ADDICTIVE and DELICIOUS that I was looking for!  Can be used for other dishes (like Chicken), I'm sure, but especially delicious on Mu shu pork type recipe.  LOVE IT!

I mistakenly ordered "ground" coffee when I intended to order beans.  This is a good, full bodied coffee, but does not have the really dark "French Roast" taste that I prefer.  If this meets your taste, this is an excellent coffee bargain.  Shipment was fast and accurate.
Was disappointed as I have been trying to find a reliably good 5 pound bag of ground coffee. Honestly the quality seems similar to no-name canned grocery store ground coffee. I'll keep looking.

I have tried this coffee for a week now and I can no longer drink it as it upsets my stomach due to the high acid content of the coffee.  It went out with this mornings trash.  A total waste of money.

column9: Coffee Bean Direct French Roast Espresso (Ground)
column10: Considering I ordered this mistakenly thinking it was whole-bean (thanks to my erroneously trusting Amazon's less-than-stellar search engine), this coffee, as all the other whole-bean coffees I've ordered from this roaster) is more than satisfactory, but less than great.

These things are incredible!!!At parties, they are almost always the first thing to disappear.The flavors are wonderful.They make a great side with steaks.  They are good thrown in a salad.Friends of mine that hate feta absolutely love these.

I have been buying these locally for almost $17 a pound and one day I saw them refilling the olive bar and noticed the label. It's this exact product and they are my new favorite party food. Everyone raves about them and they require no prep at all. The only thing I recommend is drain as much of the oil off as you can, as they can be greasy. They are only mildly spicy, and go well with all types of fare. Despite my best efforts to cook everything I serve, no matter what else I make, these always take top compliments.
I love Macrobars, but I've noticed that the peanut goes first than the other flavors just sit around. From now on I won't be purchasing the variety pack.

column9: Gluten Free Macro Bars the perfect quick GF snack
column10: These delicious Gluten-free snack bars taste like slightly sweetened nut butter and are chewy and satisfying.  Can even replace a meal in a pinch (especially breakfast).  Taste like a treat but are sound nutrition and free of common allergens.

I'm impressed with how easy these bars are to eat, very good flavor and energy.  I like them better than Lara Bars but they do have more sweetener in these to be fair.  I'd give the protein peanut a 5/5 star because the nutrition is really good, the cashew cookie is about a 5/5 in flavor but the nutrition profile is suspect since it has low protein....I won't take off stars but it is a concern I want to let others know about.

The date one takes getting used to, but is still pretty good. The "high sugar" rewivw is misleading, there is a good bit of sugar from the rice syurp but it didn't cause me any I'll effects. A hypoglycemic friend introduced me to these after her Dr reccomended them over what she was eating. It apparently is a better sugar than what we typically get. Of course, I didn't eat 3 (660-720 calories-who isn't worried about diabetes? That is almost two meals worth for one snack)

These taste okay, but have a really ridiculous amount of sugar. I guess they are meant to appeal to the masses who care not of things like weight gain and diabetes. Eat 1.5 bars and it'll have your head spinning.
This is a sweet than salty licorice ball that melts in your mouth or if your like me impatient is great soft and chewy.

column9: My Yeast of Choice ofr Mead
column10: Lalvin 71B-1122 is my yeast of choice for mead.  It is delivering consistent, tasty results.  I prefer my meads to be sweet and this yeast has never failed me.  Other yeasts can give dryer results that are less desireable for meads (in my opinion).One note of caution - it does take a significant amount of time to finish.  (I do not use yeast nutrients or energizers as I am brewing for a specific audience and prefer not to have modern ingredients in my mead.)  That being said, I will continue to use it and be patient.  Good mead is worth the wait!

I use this yeast in all my fruit meads. The smoothness it produces and the large temp range it can be used in makes it my only choice. I did not like the results in a regular mead with no fruit. I do agree with other review it does take a long time to finish.

Just now poured up some great wine. This type of yeast was used to make a sweet red ( from Welches Grape Juice ) and the alcohol content it produced was up around 12%, which is not too much and not too little. Great product!R

This product exceeded my expectations.  Great cranberry flavor!!! We used it as a base for a BBQ sauce put on grilled chicken. It is a little thick and hard to get out of the bottle.  The best part about this product is that there is NO corn syrup to sweeten the product.

Absolutely excellent!  Could not stop eating this.  Raw cashews, peanuts, Spanish peanuts, walnuts, almonds, sun flower seeds with big shavings of coconut, oat flour covered dates, raisins.  Delicious!  Highly recommended.  Went out and weeded the garden with all the energy from this great trail mix.
This product would be fine, I'm sure, had it been fresh.  Mine has an old, rancid smell and flavor as if it had been stored in a hot warehouse or garage.  I'm sure it all depends on the seller.

I got a really good deal on like eight bags of these. I probably should have put 2 and 2 together and figured that they may be overstock. They were a bit harder than candy we received of the same brand at our law firm as a Christmas gift.

Your dog will love these treats. My dog does not have any food allergies, but he loves these treats nonetheless. I tried the sample pack and as soon as he sees me reach for them he goes nuts. In fact, I often use them when I work with him on Go Find. He will not stop searching until he finds his Gibbles Nibbles. Great product and I don't even have to bake them. Added bonus for mommmy...:)Renee W.Pet Gift Baskets by Renee
My dogs love these treats. All three of my dogs ate them and wanted more. Very healthy treat for dogs, would recommend.

When I recieved this product it seemed to be fine but when I thawed out the product in my refrig. the package had not been sealed correct or it was torn. It was expensive and I was not a happy camper! Would not buy again!

I have not purchased from this seller yet, but I have used this exact coffee repeatedly.  I have tried many other decaf. coffees, and this is the best in terms of strong, smooth flavor, which is essential in my opinion if you are a decaf. drinker.  It's the closest taste to the natural flavor enhancement that comes with caffeine.
there are not that many pieces in each package. I counted 8 small pieces. And they have way too much salt on them. Not worth the money
I dont think its as salty as the others review it. It had a great taste, but for the amount you get for the price you pay i dont find this product worth it.

column9: Tasty - Wish they sold a bigger bag
column10: I like the flavor of this salmon jerky.  Unfortunately, it's not quite affordable in these little bags.  I wish they sold a larger bags at a discounted price!

I have always had a love for Salmon, however it is difficult to eat on the go.  These packages from SeaBear have filled that void to perfection.  The only drawback is the small portion size and price, otherwise the product is exceptional.  The salmon is not overly dried out and still contains a small amount of moisture to allow for a pleasant eating experience.  I order these bags on the monthly refill program to offset the cost to a degree, but I feel the product is worth the money.  Try it!

This is good but I think that it is very much oversalted.  I bought this because reviews of other brands said that the quality was very all over the place and I can say that at least with this brand I made the correct choice on that front.  All of the pieces were of a good consistency.While I did enjoy them, for about 4$ a bag I probably would not buy these again.

column9: This jerly is a little too salty.
column10: I really like to eat jerky, beef, turkey, salmon, tuna and some of the harder ones to find like venison and bison.  I like a variety of flavors, pepper, original, teriyaki, etc, but this salmon one was a little too salty.  The size of the salmon jerky was good, small enough to eat with one bite, and the flavor of the salmon was maintained with the smokey flavor.  Everything was just overpowered though with the heavy hand of salt.

Back when salmon were plentiful, Alaska natives used dried salmon to feed their sled dogs during the winter.  Now salmon jerky has become a gourmet food snack.  Not everyone likes smoked salmon or salmon jerky, but I grew up eating smoked salmon and have always liked the flavor.  SeaBear has a good line of products, and has always been a good source for salmon products.  Salmon is a good source of Omega 3 and is heart healthy.  The jerky may seem a little high on salt, but some salt is needed in your diet to prevent problems like muscle cramps.The 1.25 ounce bags are listed as having 14 grams of protein with only 70 calories.  It is something that you can put in a day pack, or just keep around for a quick snack.

The salmon is pretty tasty.  A little on the salty side, but still good.  Not tough to chew too.  The only grip I have is the price.  17 bucks for 5 ounces.  I'd give it more stars if there were more in there, or the price was lower.

I LOVED this jerky.  It was like salmon flavored bacon!  You have to be a salmon lover, obviously, and I am.  The texture was like bacon and the flavor was so delicious!  I wish it was just a little less salty though.  I gave a couple packages to my dad and he said he burned through it immediately and loved it.  I work as a bartender so I have 7-9 hour shifts without having time to stop and eat.  These packets were perfect for my dinner.  I could pop a piece in my mouth inconspicuously and be satisfied.  The only problem being my breath!  I was worried I smelled like I ate cat food while talking to my customers.  Oh well. I gotta eat too!  I will order this again even though it is expensive.  It's good for me and it's a luxurious treat!

the idea of this product is good, but it was way too salty for me. I couldn't eat it, and it wasn't cheap. I don't eat salt or sodium-ladened food if possible anymore, so this set me through the roof.If you enjoy salty food, you'll like this.

My packages came with tiny pits and pieces. :-(  Not one piece was bigger than my thumb nail.  The picture is deceiving.  The texture is good, but the overly salty flavor seems like it actually masks the taste of salmon.  And believe me I LOVE SALTY foods, which is why i was drawn to this.  I would not order this again because only the color resembled salmon, the rest was too small and salty to tell.  Very disappointed.

I expect salt in a salmon jerky, but this is fully twice the salt level as a similar item I also purchased. Worse, it permiated the flavor. It was like salmon jerky texture with salmon-salt flavor.  The package is 1.25 oz and in what seems stilly, claim 1.25 servings. Gee thanks. So of course we will eat the whole thing and the 38% of salt for a day is really about 46%.  I might as well eat Campbell soup if I wanted salt poisoning at that level - it'd be a lot cheaper.I did find one bone. I would not count that as a problem.  I did not like that the pieces were chopped into fairly small chips.

This salmon jerky has the right texture, the right moisture and the right chewiness to be the perfect salmon jerky.Sadly, they completely messed it up by oversalting it, and then throwing more salt on it.  After eating a few packs in the evening, I actually woke up from thirst in the middle of the night and had to drink water.  Twice !I wouldn't feed this to my dog.

column9: Salty, Delicious and Healthy Salmon Jerky
column10: I've been a fan of beef jerky for years, but due to my recent pescetarian lifestyle change I no longer consume it. The cravings for jerky still haunt me so I was thrilled to see a salmon alternative. My first taste impression of this jerky was "Wow this is salty!". The salty taste may be a bit overbearing for some, but after a few chews I became quickly accustomed. It is much leaner than beef jerky and a bit tougher. At 70 calories per serving, this jerky makes for a tasty omega 3 rich snack. Some may think it's a bit pricey but you are paying roughly 4.50 for each bag; which is the average cost for any jerky that I've encountered. Quality always triumphs over quantity. I would recommend this jerky to anyone who enjoys the delicious taste and health benefits of fish.

I am told this is NOT as salty as standard beef jerky! (not just the opinion, check out the nutritional information and compare to beef jerky) "Moist and chewy" as stated on the package. I might have been seeking something more dry and flaky?FISH AND EGGS are GOOD for digestion!However, what is potassium Lactate? Is this cow milk derivative? or is it bacteria from animal intestines?  some cheese is processed this way). We are way too curious. I'm usually vegan, actually, 17 yrs, don't tell anybody,...  but on Doctor's recommendation I thought we would try fish. column9: How long do I cook it?
column10: I tried the smoker bag twice. Since my bbq is very hot (3 burners at 30,000 btu each) I need to cook at a very low heat setting. I've tried ribs and steak. If you follow the directions I estimated it should smoke for about an hour or so. Boy were they overcooked. Since the directions also say not to open the bag it's hard to know how much time. If you have a very hot bbq, as I do, you may try cooking half the time, say 30 minutes. One thing for sure, the bag really works. I've never had a real smoker type bbq but the bags do a great job. ps, don't try your kitchen oven as the bags really give off alot of smoke and would smell up the house if you don't have a high output exhaust system. Experiment on your timing. Good Luck

I'm not the government telling you how you should spend your money. ........I just highly recommend you go somewhere else for your Ramune. Like Japan. Or a Japanese store. Not here.

column9: Awful custumer service from faerie's finest
column10: Don't order from Faerie's finest, you will be wasting your time. Order your product from somewhere else.Ingredients were not available for shipment when they promised and I kept calling for a status of my order. Every time they told me the same thing: "next week we'll receive the ingredients and after that we'll ship the product". Over an over the same thing until I got tired and I had to cancel my order. The person on the phone was not willing to help or answer my questions. Very frustrating and a waste of time.

Each can I've opened has a blend of mashed and chunky beans which makes for a good base for add-ins like salsa and cheese for homemade Nacho Dip, my homemade comfort food. Sometimes canned refried beans are a oily/greasy mess. This is almost as good as granny's home-cooking without the muss or fuss.When I can catch these on a good sale I'd buy these again.
I was so happy none of the pocky was melted and they were not stale either. A very good buy!

Upon seeing convention-goers playing games with it, I decided to try it out and see what the big deal was all about. I was not disappointed. The flavors were a bit unique upon first tasting it, but they quickly grew on me and I ended up eating nearly half the box by the end of the day. They have just the right amount of sweetness and a very smooth texture that's fun to play with. I look forward to buying it again.

Purchased for a daughter who needs to avoid gluten.  The texture is great, like a bakery shop coffee cake.  Very nice presentation...could be proud to serve it to guests.  Delicious flavor of the apricots too

I've tried every flavor of Betty Lou's Gluten Free Fruit Bars, and while I love them all, the apricot is my absolute favorite. The bars are dense, moist and chewy and the fruit filling is perfect; not too sweet, not too tart, with chunks of apricot throughout. At 4 Weight Watcher's Plus POINTS, these are also the lowest POINTS-value of all the bars, so I toss one in my purse whenever I know I'm going to miss a meal. One bar keeps me going for hours and helps me stay on track with my nutrition goals.
Betty Lou's fruit bars are a great take-along snack for those on a gluten free diet.  All varieties have tasted great & good to put in your purse for a pick-me-up during the day!

have tried several flavors of these, all are fantastic.  Lots of fruit filling and a gluten free outer layer that's not grainy.  They are somewhat delicate so don't keep them in the bottom of your purse all week....
