The smoked taste of the Chipotle pepper is fairly unique. Sadly, if you like this sauce you could be buying a bottle monthly given its diluted nature. So if you are used to keeping a bottle of Tabasco in your pantry for half a year, it won't happen with this variety.I've been taste tasting 6 other Chipotle hot sauces. This sauce is at or near the top of the other Chipotle sauces. The only real competitor is El Yucateco Chipotle Hot Sauce. The Tabasco Chipotle has more vinegar while the El Yucateco has some added sugar and tomato paste. Both are excellent.Keep in mind, this sauce is far more diluted than the traditional Tabasco hot sauce yet it is far more potent and richer tasting than many other Chipotle based sauces. At least in this sauce the Chipotle flavor is concentrated and the added vinegar is not overpowering. Certainly this is the best tasting Tabasco hot sauce currently available and the only real competitor I can find is the El Yucateco Chipotle Hot Sauce which has less vinegar and a bit more tomato taste. The other Chipotle sauces I have taste tested are so diluted that they lack any real flavor and can be easily dis-qualified.Try a bottle - if you like the Chipotle pepper (I think you will) you'll love this sauce but you should also try the El Yucateco Chipotle which is also excellent yet a bit different. Beyond these two Chipotle based sauces I have not found any other Chipotle based sauces that even come close to these two!

column9: The Fourth New Flavor of the Quintessential Condiment!
column10: This was the fourth modern variation on an essentially unchanged, bestselling product for more than 140 years.  Other flavors are:Orginal Pepper Sauce (hot) (2500-5000 Scoville Heat Units),Green Pepper Sauce (milder yet) (600-1200 Scoville Heat Units),Habanero Sauce (hottest) (>7000 Scoville Heat Units).Garlic Pepper Sauce (milder) (1200-2400 Scoville Heat Units),Sweet & Spicy Pepper Sauce (mildest) (100-600 Scoville Heat Units),but this is Chipotle Pepper Sauce (mild) (1500-2500 Scoville Heat Units).Dueling histories of the McIlhenny Company are available: (authorized) Tabasco: An Illustrated History and (unauthorized) McIlhenny's Gold: How a Louisiana Family Built the Tabasco Empire, for those curious about how this most remarkable product and business empire came to be.Note: "A pharmacist named Wilbur Scoville invented the Scoville Scale in 1912 to measure the heat of peppers. A 'Scoville Unit' is actually a measure of capsaicin (the chemical in hot peppers that is responsible for their heat).Scoville's test was a comparative taste test that is considered subjective by today's standards. A more sophisticated method is in use today, but in honor of Wilbur Scoville, the unit of measure is still called the Scoville.The capsaicin level in peppers can vary from plant to plant due to local environmental conditions. This means that a pepper's rating is an average measure.The hottest pepper on record is the Bhut Jolokia with a pungency of over 1 million Scoville Heat Units (1,001,304, to be exact). By contrast, the Bell Pepper comes in at less than 100 Scoville Heat Units."

column9: Want your dog dead?  If so, buy this product!
column10: I was in a hurry as I shopped at my local pet food store late on a Saturday night.  My dogs needed dog food.  I buy a high quality dog food, it's ingredients contain everything my vet wants me to be feeding me dogs. I also wanted to get them some special treats. But in my haste I picked up a bag of these "gourmet" chicken breast treats.  Usually I read the label on everything I give my dogs.  Not this time, they looked healthy and were very similar to other chicken breast treats I normally buy.  Had I carefully read the back of the bag I would have immediately returned them to the shelf and moved on.  The words on the back of the bag "not for human consumption, wash hands thoroughly with soap and water after handling this product"-"made in China" would have tipped me off!!!  I never saw these warnings until after my beloved jack russell became very ill only mere hours after eating one of these treats.  My vet wanted to know what had she eaten that was different?  I handed him the bag-he looked it over in horror.  My dog developed an obstruction from the treat, which caused bloat because nothing could pass, salmonella and e-coli poisoning, and an infection in her heart giving her a 4/6 heart murmur.  She had to undergo expoloratory surgery, 7 sets of xrays, 2 ultrasounds, multiple blood tests,an ecg and we're not done yet.  She is still in recovery, tests still pending.  This was one of the healthiest dogs my vet cared for before this incident.  Never had a health issue in the past, never a heart murmur.  At 9 years old most people thought she was 3 or 4.  I have been told the heart murmur has been caused by the infection settling in her heart, which is now irreversable.  Which means if she makes it through all of this her life expectancy just went from 16+ to 10 or 11.My vet cultured one of the treats and could not believe what disease and bacteria it was loaded with.  I cannot believe I took such good care of her for 9 years and then put her through all of this suffering because I didn't take the time to carefully look the product over. Thank you, Cadet and IMS Pet Products for contributing to my dog's pain and suffering.

Flavorful, strong without bitterness or "diner" taste.  I brew the 7oz size.For reference purposes my in store drink is a Starbucks Americano.My favorite k-cups are:Starbucks French RoastStarbucks Caffe VeronaStarbucks Pike Place RoastGreen Mountain Xtra Bold Sumatran ReserveGreen Mountain Double Black DiamondGreen Mountain RevvGreen Mountain Dark MagicOther k-cups I've tried:  Coffee People Jet Fuel ,Green Mountain Dark Magic Decaf, Emeril Jazzed up Decaf, Starbucks Caffe Verona, Coffee People Black Tiger,  Starbucks House Blend, Starbucks Breakfast Blend, Starbucks Sumatra, Wolfgang Puck French Roast, Green Mountain Lake and Lodge, Green Mountain French Roast, Caribou Mahogony, Wolfgang Puck Sumatra Kopi Raya, Emeril Big Easy Bold
If you like coffee that is flavorful, dark, and somewhat strong, this coffee is spectacular. I have tried numerous dark coffees and this is the best.

column9: High price BUT a great cup of coffee...
column10: Simply the best K-cup I've sampled so far (and I've sampled many).  If you like bold, rich coffee than you should definitely try this one. When it comes right down to it, it's still cheaper than buying a cup of coffee outside of the home (even at a donut store) so I don't see the price as that exorbitant. Sometimes quality comes at a price.

The best K-Cups I have tried so far.  Others have said they like Newman's Own, but that this Starbucks Dark French Roast is better and I have to agree.  A bit stronger than Newman's.  I just purchased this 54 pack, but I have already went through a couple of 12 packs (not beer :-) .  I also recommend the TAZO Green Tea.

Amazed at how much I got for the small price. Best coffee I've tasted for the Keurig machine if you like, bold dark flavor in your coffee. Had the order within a week--Highly Recommend!! I just ordered another box!

This coffee tastes like chocolate that's gone bad.  It's overpriced and just not very good.  Starbucks has always over-roasted their beans.  I guess if you like that then you might like this coffee.  To my tastebuds however, it was just bitter and gross with a weird off-taste that left me making faces long after the cup was gone.Also, to all the reviewers who are saying that this was finally a strong k-cup, I say bah.  There are many other brands that make a cup just as strong but much better tasting.  This was just swill.  Bitter gross swill.If Coffee People still made their french roast I wouldn't have even bothered putting this in the brewer.  San Francisco Bay Coffee One Cup for Keurig K-Cup Brewers, French Roast, 36-Count is my current favorite for my Keurig.  It's so much cheaper than a Starbucks k-cup.  But even if it weren't, it's still a better cup of coffee.Don't waste your money.  Overpriced and over-roasted equals bad coffee.
absolutely yummy liquor infused cherries.  too bad there's only about 6 in the jar.
I had these with a slice a quality cheesecake and it was delightful. I highly recommend them! Perfect little jar for a little sweet treat.

Nothing brings a smile to my face more than seeing a yard full of dead and dying weeds. Key word here - "DEAD!"When I moved into my new home, the front and backyard looked horrendous. The place is overgrown with weeds every summer and always looks disgusting. My son would try to pull the weeds, but it's tough to get to the root. I don't have a green thumb anyway and highly allergic to most plants. In the future I plan to get the yard done over with concrete and bricks where I don't have to deal with nature on that level, but I don't have the funds right now to begin the process. Until then I searched online to try to find something that will give these weeds a knockout punch! Well this is it! I ordered 2 bottles, had my son spray liberally in the back and front yard and I waited for results.  To my amazement this stuff really works. My son applied 2 applications and around the 2nd or 3rd day 95% of the front yard was an ugly shriveled up yellow.  Only 5% of weeds sprung up over a couple of weeks (this could have been the places my son missed) but the rest have seen their last day  even though we've experienced a lot of rain over the past couple of weeks.I plan to order more to make sure these weeds stay away forever! After seeing the results, I'm now a believer.
An overwhelming smell and taste of preservatives. Left the package open on the kitchen island and when the family came home they wanted to know why I was spraying for bugs. Seriously!

column9: The mangoes are good but the cherries ...
column10: I usually buy dried mangos at the asian food stores, but when I saw this at Costco, I couldn't resist. A 22oz bag of dried fruit for less than $9 is just too good of a deal. Unfortunately, like a previous one star review, I was overwhelmed by the artificial smell when I opened the package. Upon closer inspection of the ingredients, I think the cherries are to blame. I salvaged the mangoes, and I've frozen the cherries. Not sure if I'll ever get around to using them. See the ingredients and you'll know why:IngredientsMangoes: sugar, sulur dioxide (which is pretty normal, if not ideal, for dried fruits).Bing Cherries: sugar, citric acid, fruit and vegetable concentrates (color) sunflower oil (???), natural flavors (???)Royal Ann Cherries: sugar, citric acid, fruit concentrates (color), sunflower oil, natural flavor(s)

I like dried fruits, both as a snack and as an item to pack with my noontime work lunches. Plus, I almost always take them along when I go on camping trips. Nutritionally, they offer almost all the advantages of fresh fruit, but they don't require refrigeration and have a long shelf life if the bag seal is maintained. Typically, I buy the dried fruits in large bags and dole them out in smaller portions from there.Yesterday, I was in my favorite warehouse store and found a large bag (22 ounces) of Kirkland Signature Dried Mangoes and Cherries. Mmmmm, That ought to be good. Two different kinds of mangoes and two different kinds of cherries. Well, they're delicious! Nice mix of flavors. Fresh and chewy with a nice sweet and fruity taste. Yum! These won't last long!Gary Peterson

column9: Best Ackee Jamaica has to offer
column10: Best Tasting ackee ever. Together with the atlantic salt fish, great meal in minutes. Go ahead and try it, you will not be disappointed.

I love it, I love it and I love it.  My family loves the dish I make using this Ackee.  I lived in NYC for many years and enjoyed so many different ethnic dishes.  I even learned how to make a few.  The recipe for Ackee & Codfish is my best yet.  Please don't ever stop offering to sell this via internet, as it is so hard to find in Delaware, especially the Linstead Ackee. It is such a great dish and I have a great recipe for this dish, but have difficulty finding Ackee or salted dried cod in our local markets.How fun it was to find this Linstead Market Ackee on Amazon.  The ackee was great tasting arrived super fast and I am so delighted with this product and will continue to purchase it.  Anyone wanting great tasting Ackee this is it.

I just ate the last can. Being so far away in Guam while eating this reminds me of the good old Jamaican cook food. I love love this stuff.I never knew ackee could taste so good from a can. I will definitely buy it again.

The Ackee was SO GOOD. One disappointment is one can of 4 I ordered of the Ackee was bent in shipping. This product is absolutely my most favorite Caribbean product, but it is expensive. Be careful not to shake the product in the can as it is VERY delicate. When using it in your dishes, be very gentle when you add it to your recipe. Very nutritious product and so good. One tin of 4.4 oz is enough for ~100 cups (I use a 1.5' mesh infuser).As usual with Kusmi, the tin is beautiful, with raised flower details and old-fashioned design and colors. Anastasia comes in the dark blue tin.The leaves are whole, a deep black with no other visible ingredients.The nose is extremely bold: lots of bergamot, lime and orange blossom with a very sweet appetizing varietal black tea undertone.The mouth is rich and full and the citrus notes are not acidic.I brew this tea a little lighter than my other Kusmi teas (3-4 min- dark amber, vs my usual ~7min) as the intensity of the oils is strong. However, the tannins are low and the finish very smooth so it is hard to infuse too much. Itdoes not get bitter.I do not add anything but my Mom likes a cloud of milk in hers. Sweeteners are not needed as it is so round in mouth.To my knowledge, Anastasia is the most popular of Kusmi teas. You can also pick it up from Dean and Deluca to avoid shipping or directly from the Kusmi website (where shipping is unfortunately expensive but the choices are ).Try this beautiful tea blend; it is a real luxurious treat!Cheers!

this tea while a bit pricey, is excellent. Hint of Jasmine and full aroma make this tea a good choice for a special occasion

column4: Paul Tognetti "The real world is so much more...
column9: Bread from a tin can?  Preposterous!
column10: Bread in a can?  Sounds positively revolting right?  Not so fast.  The  Burnham & Morrill Co. of Portland, Maine has been in the canning business for more than a century now.  These are the folks who bring you that staple of millions of American households--B & M Original Baked Beans.  But the folks at B & M also produce a companion product of old New England-B&M Brown Bread.  This is an item that most Americans have probably never sampled or for that matter ever even heard of.  When you pop open a can of  B & M Brown Bread (which is steam cooked right in the can!) I will be the first to admit that it does not appear to be particularly appetizing.  But looks are deceiving.  B & M Brown Bread has been a popular item around these parts for generations.For lots of New England families the tradition of  having baked beans and brown bread for supper on Saturday continues to this day.  Many of us grew up with beans and franks and brown bread on Saturday nights.  This is just the kind of  rib-sticking, intensely flavored food that we crave around here, particularly on a cold, blustery night.  Legend has it that brown bread is closely related to an earlier bread known as "rye and Indian" (from "Indian" cornmeal) or "thirded" bread from its use of rye, cornmeal, and wheat flours.  Now you might surmise that bread that is actually cooked in a can would be full of preservatives. This is simply not the case.  Despite its downright creepy appearance  B&M canned bread is actually about as natural as anything out there.  The ingredients listed on the can include water, whole wheat flour, molasses, dextrose, rye flour, whey, corn meal, baking soda, buttermilk, salt and corn oil.  Compare that to all of the junk found in your favorite snack food!  What's more, B & M Brown Bread tastes great!  B & M Brown Bread comes in two delicious varieties--Original and with Raisin.  I love them both but am partial to the raisin.  Brown bread is not something I purchase very often these days but when I do it is a real treat.  Just heat and serve!  B & M Brown Bread is great just as is or with some butter and really is the perfect accompaniment to a franks and beans or ham and bean supper.  Try it sometime!Now I am not really sure if you can even find B & M Brown Bread everywhere in the country.  It's great to see that it is available through Amazon.  Around here it sells for about $2.00 a can.  What prompted me to write this review is that I saw this product advertised in a catalogue for $8.50.  Such a deal!  The catalogue describes the taste of B & M Brown Bread this way;  "Extremely moist and dense, this New England treat is made using only natural ingredients and has a rich molasses taste that comes through with every bite".  I would concur.  So go ahead.  Be brave.  For a taste sensation just a tad bit out of the ordinary I recommend that you give this all-time New England favorite a try.  Highly recommended!

I, like others, saw this product and was curious enough to buy it.  I'm glad I did.  The bread out of the can was dense, moist and smelled somewhat sweet.  After eating a piece and deciding that it was sweet enough that I wouldn't be making any grilled cheeses with it, I read the can and took the suggestion that I try it with PB&J.  It was great.  The molasses taste of the bread went well with the sweet topping.  Although I feel as though I must warn any people reading this, and are thinking of buying the bread...If you do not like molasses, you will not like this bread.

Bought this for our rainy day storage items but had to open up one can to give it a try.  I had heard that it was really good toasted and then smothered in butter.  They were right.  It's going to be hard not sneaking out another can.  I'd like to try the version with raisins now.

This is a favorite of mine, personally, since I had it on a camping trip.  Tastes really great when you "bake" it in a campfire wrapped in tin foil.  (or, you can be bold and cook it in the can, but good luck with getting it out!)  Getting the bread out of the can is the biggest challenge, at least when you try to make the loaf "neat."  You can't find this product locally where I live now (in Texas), so I ordered it online via Amazon.  I didn't need a case, but the shelf-life of this product is "years," so I'll be stocked for awhile.  This bread is rich with molasses (good source of Magnesium), tastes great toasted with butter, and is quite filling.  A GREAT camping food.  Great with baked beans, and anything one would serve with baked beans... hence, why it's offered by B&M!  Only 4 stars because of the difficulty level of getting the bread OUT of the can!

column9: review for B M brown bread
column10: The service was very good.  I received the item quickly.  I likeB M brown bread, and I have not seen it in our local stores recently.  I recommend the product but I suppose it depends on whether you like brown bread or not.  If you like brown bread, try it.

The cans are about the size of a chunky soup can.  The bread is a semi-pain to remove, but I love it;  it is a prefect breakfast bread as it is sweet enough to eat without any toppings, but it is not too sweet.  It is very filling as it is the consistency of a moist, thick muffin.  The bread is very fitting for fall/thanksgiving.

column9: Most purchased with this item: Jaws of Life
column10: Seriously, I was very happily surprised with this excellent brown bread. I found it to be nice and moist, with the texture and even the taste reminding me a bit of fresh gingerbread or a good rich muffin. The problem I had, however, was not insignificant. I exchanged emails with a very nice and accommodating representative of B&M, and apparently I got a can with inside walls that somehow escaped being thinly coated with vegetable oil. Hence, especially since the inside of the can has horizontal ridges, vertical to the direction that the bread needs to be slid, the can had a fiendish death grip on the bread. The instructions say you may need to ease the bread out by using a spoon. If only. This only creates a cave in the bread, maybe useful if you are into bread sculpting. Even using the cutaway lid, which should be the perfect size, you just keep compressing the bread on that side, of course with every quarter-inch or so of compression you're losing slices you paid for. The simplest way for me was sliding a thin steak knife around the edge, but since, again, the can has those internal ridges, you end up mangling/losing part of the product. Overall, ordering this bread as long-term backup is perfect for me, so I will probably order again. But it is a little depressing that we just launched another rover to Mars, to join another that is still operational, yet we can't manage to get a simple vegetable oil coating consistently inside of a can of bread. Out of twelve cans purchased by yours truly, so far I have opened four, each time soon wanting to call emergency services to bring in the Jaws of Life, but then figuring they might be needed more out of the highway. That aside, Thumbs Up to B&M for a delicious long-term-storage product.

This is a wonderful product I tried it for the first time a Month a go and promptly ordered 2 cases. as far as getting it out of the can it works great if you open both ends and using the lid or bottom push the bread out it comes out nice and neat it is good with anything on it the Grand kids love it with Nutella. also Amazon is great ! I had an issue with a shipment and they resolved it very quickly  five stars for the product and five stars for Amazon Thank You Amazon !
Excellent emergency source of bread  Bread is dark and moist and makes wonderful toast. or when buttered is just a very good snack

The bread itself is very moist and flavorful.  However, I ordered a 12 pack, and when it arrived, every single can was dented.  As most people buy this product for long term storage, this is definitely a problem.  I will probably buy more bread in the future, but will purchase it from another vendor.

I ordered a package of 6 cans previously, and that order was completed as I hoped. So when I bought this order of 12 cans, I was expecting more of the same. However, of the 12 cans, 6 were dented, and 4 of them badly. It doesn't appear the seals were broken and the cans aren't swollen, etc, so the bread is fine. But based on the other reviews, anyone about to buy this product needs to be aware of the condition it might be in when you receive it.As for the bread itself, it is delicious. It's very dense and fairly sweet. It goes well toasted with butter or with peanut butter (to my taste buds, anyway). This stuff isn't available in stores here in Texas to my knowledge, so I'm glad I can buy it on Amazon!

Excellent product! Absolutely the best canned bread I have ever had the pleasure of sinking my teeth into. It is hard to find in my area so I was happy to be able to purchase it on Amazon. It was about the same price as the grocery stores and there's FREE shipping! It made this bread a bargain in my eyes.I purchased 2 cases of plain and 2 cases of the raisin. The breads are sooooo fresh!Easy to get out of the can if you remove both lids and run a table knife down, and around, the inside of the can. Use one of the lids to push the bread out of the can.Try it if you have never had it. You're worth it!!
The expiration date on the top of the cans was 6 years old.  I opened one can immediately and ate it.  The brown bread was still good but 6 years past date is really unacceptable.
I had to order it on line because they dont carry it in stores in the central states. I had to have my friends try it. They all liked it too.

I purchased a pack of 12 for long term storage, and 11 out of 12 canswere dented.Storage cannot be "long term" if the can is dented. I had previously purchased apack of 12 so thought I should check those also. 3 of 12 were dented.Looks like I will be eating a lot of brown bread this winter while looking foranother place to purchase.

I bought a case of this as part of my canned survival food storage. Needless to say it tastes awful and won't order anymore. I love molasses but for some reason I just can't stomach this. I was hoping it'd be a "canned comfort food" for a survival situation, but the only comfort would be not opening it in the first place.There's so many more options ouch there, canned bread is just not a good idea.

column9: Excellent, but keep them in the bag they come in!
column10: These are amazing! Sweet, crunchy and satisfying. It may seem like alot to buy, but they go fast! *********WARNING: The best place to store this product is in the bag it comes in! The bag must be specially designed to keep out moisture. I kept some in a ziplock bag and the rest in the bag they came in (just clipped it closed with a binder clip) and the ones in the ziplock bag got soft pretty quickly, but the ones in the bag that they came in stayed crunchy and are still crunchy.

column9: Decent but not my personal favorite
column10: These apples are true to how they're advertised and what I expected from the other reviews I read. They are pretty crispy and easy to eat. I personally like the flavor and texture of slightly-chewy dried apples better, so 2 pounds is a lot for me to get through. If you prefer crispy dried apples through, these are for you. I understand what another reviewer meant by a "musty" flavor in some of the chips; it makes them a little less appealing though not inedible and I think it's just the nature of the product.

This was my first try with organic dried apples.  I have decided to avoid pesticide ridden fresh and dried apples.  When the package arrived I was a little disturbed at the lack of labeling of any kind.  They were identified as Bare Fruit Fuji Apples packaged for Amazon, with an address for Bare Fruits. Weight one pound. That was it.  No use by date, or any kind of a freshness indicator. No ingredients list, though I assume the ingredients are just apples.  But how can I know for sure?  They came in a sturdy silver mylar type bag, very well padded for shipping.  I haven't come up with a way to reclose the bag for freshness.  Even my vacuum sealer system, which works on most mylar bags will not reseal this one.  My first try at the chips themselves was a little disappointing.  Many of the pieces were almost too small for munching.  The taste and texture was foreign to me.  But then a little later in the day I was surprised that I wanted more.  Maybe taste buds just need a chance to get accustomed to a new thing.  Now I love them. The Fuji taste comes through beautifully,  They are slightly crunchy without being hard straight from the bag.  I have also thrown a handful in in place of other fruit when making oatmeal in the morning.  When added in the last minute or so of cooking, they come out plump and flavorful.  My husband is taking them instead of potato chips with his lunch and finds them to be a satisfying mid afternoon snack. I am now thinking of other ways to try them, both rehydrated and dry.  Maybe in muffins?  Rehydrate in maple syrup to use on pancakes?  Or could I use them as an alternative to peeling and slicing apples for pie?  Two one pound bags is alot of apples, and since I don't know how long they will stay fresh I am ready to explore.

I was a little concerned about buying these in bulk after reading some of the previous reviews.  My concerns were unfounded, I was delighted with the product.  There was no musty taste in any of my bags, (I bought 4 1# packages).  They taste exactly the same as what I buy in the smaller snack packages from the grocery store.  This is a great product, sweet and crunchy, and WAY less expensive to purchase this way.

I was very excited to find this product in bulk, healthy and organic. What I wasn't happy about was the musty taste that every third bite or so possessed. The ones that didn't taste musty were delicious. They were so good in fact that it inspires you to keep trying and then...mustiness bites you. Yuck.

I've been looking for something like this for a while.  I don't care for dried "chewy" fruit.  These apples are nice and crispy.  They're sweet.  There are a couple that are chewy but for the most part, crispy.  I love them.  To find some that don't have preservatives is amazing.I highly recommend them.  You'll have trouble putting them away.

A very good tasting dried apple. They retain the Fuji flavor and are quite sweet. I mostly use them in my cooked cereal and they plump up nicely and add a nice flavor. They are cut thinner and are more crispy and less chewy than the dried apples I used to take on camping trips, but with the lower moisture content they are more economical. The apples are well packaged and should stay fresh for a long time unopened. I have had no trouble keeping the opened package fresh by folding over the top of the original package and placing it in a gallon size freezer bag. I am on my second order and signed up for a subscription (additional discount and free shipping).

column9: Great or me and my dog!
column10: I accidentally ordered these when looking for apple chips like Pannera Bread serves on Fuji apple salads. As soon as I placed the order I thought they were the wrong product and tried to cancel it, but was not able to.  I then ordered a case of apple chips, which were delicious, but full of sugar and calories. I ate the chips and had these left.I was surprised when I opened the bag to find that these are exactly what I was looking for.  They are not the thick, chewy dried apples that I thought they were.  They are thin and crispy, but without added fat or sugar.  I am enjoying them as a snack, stirred into oatmeal and tossed into salads.  I am also using them as low calorie, inexpensive and healthy dog treats, where they are a big hit.Some of the chips are medium and some broken into not much more than crumbs, but it is easy to pull out the size you need for your current use. They are all smaller and thicker than the apple chips I bought.According to the information I have been able to find, there are 29 calories in 1/4 cup (12 grams) and no fat.  The shelf life is one year, but there are no "use by" dates on the bags.I am very happy to eat my "mistake" and will gladly order these again.

I didn't read the reviews closely before I bought the product.  When I detected mustiness, I came here to warn others, and found that it had already been brought up.  This is a serious issue if there may be mold and mycotoxins behind it.

These are a great deal & I enjoy snacking on them.  They are a little tart for my taste, but are really good.  I knew they would be tart, since they are Fuji....but decided to try them anyway.  I do plan to buy them again.

column9: I can't describe how much I love these apple chips!
column10: I don't eat flour or sugar products so my choices are quite limited. Plus, I have many chemical sensitivities. I use an ounce of these chips with frozen fruit I whip into a smoothie-like substance and it's pure nirvana!I know people have complained about a musty smell or flavor. Well, maybe it's because I don't eat much processed food, but these chips are so sweet and fulfilling for a snack-type food and I would definitely have noticed such a smell.The only reason I gave it four instead of five stars is because I do think I have a slight reaction to them (eczema that worsens if I use them too many days in a row).But getting the bulk price has saved me a fortune. They are close to $4 for an ounce in Publix or Whole Foods.

I've been buying Bare Fruit's dried granny smith apples from Costco for a while now-large 14oz bag was less than $5. I bought 4-6 at a time because, just like Costco, they're known to discontinue good items!  Well, they did - Bare Fruit now sells their Cinnamon apple chips, which (to me) aren't good at all-too much of a good thing (cinnamon) just makes me sick after about 10 chips. Bring the grannies back! So I decided to look on the internet for an alternative & found these Fuji dried apples - they're really good (not as good as the grannies), but almost.  The only issue that I have is that I bought 4 bags (2 packs) and the chips are like crumbs-kinda like the bottom of your cereal when you're about to run out.  I was hoping for larger pieces - more like chips! These are remnants, sadly. The pictures shows full, round apple pieces - I had not ONE full apple chips, 98% were 1/2" in size and I had to pour them into my mouth like crumbs.  Very disappointed!!!
Great product. No fat. All natural, nothing added. Great crunch and taste! Favorite company by far!

The apple chips are sent in a silver package, not clear.  The flavor was okay but was afraid they were contaminated.  We received the bags with at least 4 different 1/4" size tears in them.  It had small pokes all over the bags from the apple corners poking through.  If the package is open at all there is a chance of getting stale and contaminated.  I like the bag that the apple chips come in "Bare Fruit Cinnamon Apple Chips", the apple chips do not poke through packaging.  I stopped my monthly order of the Bare Fruit 100% Organic Bake-Dried Apples, Fuji, 1 Pound Bags (Pack of 2) due to the packaging. Who wants to eat anything torn open...

column9: these are not rings, and have lots of the core left
column10: we'd bought them because they were in washington state. but they are dried hotter and are therefore crisper than other apple rings. and they have lots of core bits which are very hard

These taste wonderful and as long as you look before popping bits into your mouth, you can avoid the additional roughage of core parts and stems.  Sadly, I need the dried fruit for making up fried pies and the work of separating, core, stem and skin from the fruit makes this a product I will not be a repeat customer for.

These are not the slightly moist, pliable dried apples you're probably used to. They are crisp, but still easily eaten straight from the bag, which is how most of mine are eaten. I do add them [along with raisins or dried figs] while cooking oatmeal and they are great that way, too.

I order these on a regular basis.  Very low in calories, crispy and tastes just like apples.  Why go for the sugared, unhealthy snacks, when you can have the real deal?  Buy these huge bags and put them in snack bags to save money.  I can't recommend these enough.
Wow!  Just got my first shipment.  I can't believe they taste this good, are organic, have no sugar added, and are so affordable.  I've already submitted another order.

I bought a 5 oz bag of Bare Fruit Fuji dried apples a couple years ago, I don't remember where, for a ridiculous price.  Still, I went back for more because they are soooooo good.  Gone.  "We don't carry them anymore."  Rats.  Checked other stores.  Nope.  Finally found them at Sprouts, price not so awful, but still pretty high even on sale.  Enter Amazon.  Just thought I'd check out organic & gourmet foods here.  BINGO!!!  Same apples, in huge 1 lb bags.  Absolutely love them.  I'm sitting here munching on them right now.  Just as addictive as potato chips, twice as tasty, and healthier.  Yea!  I may have to subscribe to Prime so I can order them as often as I need to and not run out.  LOL!

The only downside to these apples is that I can't stop eating them! I found the pieces to be a nice sizes (about 1/4 of a cored circular apple slice), not musty at all and no seeds so far (as other reviewers had noted).The one year shelf life is nice. I keep extras on hand for emergencies. During a recent evacuation there was nothing healthy to snack on while waiting around in a hotel.I eat a gluten-free, vegan diet and only eat organic apples, which is why these are my perfect snack.

If you're looking for a snack that's more natural and less processed, these are great.  I prefer these to other brands of dried apples (e.g. Sunmaid) that are only partially dried and remain chewy (or rubbery).  These are crisp, like potato chips, but with real flavor to them.  These are made from Fuji apples, and while Granny Smiths would better, they don't seem to be available in bulk (at least not from Amazon).  I agree with the reviewer who says you should keep them in the bag they come in, and disagree with the reviewer who mentioned a "musty" taste. I've gotten through two bags of them, and they've all tasted fine.

Had previously purchased the cinnamon flavor at Costco and loved them, but they don't carry them any more.  Found a bunch of flavors here, figured I'd try the Fuji as they seemed to be the best value.  Quite yummy, even w/o the cinnamon.  Pieces do seem smaller than I remember, but that does not affect the flavor.  Biggest problem seems to be similar to regular chips:  eating too many!  :-)
They are very small pieces adn taste a lot like the skin, not my favorite. I can make these better at home. I prefer buying the bare fruits with no skin. or just make your own.

I am a huge fan of these. They are light, crisp and hit the spot. For 2 lbs of organic apple chips you cant get a better deal. I have these shipped every two months. I take a few in a baggy as a snack or when i make my cream of wheat in the morning i break up a few. They are a healthy alternative to alot of the snacks out there. I would recommend these to anyone.

I have ordered these apples twice now to make sure of my discovery.  The apples are NOT cored.  So therefore, you are eating the core, seeds and stem.  It taste awful when you bite into these parts.  I will not be ordering again.

I don't like cinnamon and I don't like apples, so I was surprised when a friend offered me Bare Fruit 100% Organic Bake-Dried Cinnamon Apple Chips, 2.6 Ounce Bags (Pack of 12) and I liked it. I figured I'd like it even more without cinnamon so I found these on Amazon and oh my... they are AMAZING!! I have eaten one full pound and have not experienced any bad chips like the one reviewer who said they were musty. My roommate ate the other pound and said one chip was incredibly sour, but all the others were great. The only reason I took off a star is because the packaging did not include nutrition information. It was easy enough to find on livestrong, but I definitely think it should be included. Because the chips are all different sizes they don't give an easy to visualize amount, say 1/4 cup = this many calories.. You really need a foods scale to know how much you're eating but in case its of any use to anyone, 24 grams of chips is 58 calories. 16 g is carbs, and 2 g fiber.I gave some to my dad to try. He grows about 10 different varieties of fruit trees, including apples. He said he's dried apples before and they taste the same as these! He takes care not to use anything non-organic or unhealthy so its good they taste the same! Also for some reason they store better in the shiny bag they ship in. I divided one bag into ziplocs to be able to grab for snacks, and they got sort of soft, whereas the chips kept in the original bag inside a ziplock stayed crispy and fresh.
These dried apples are very good. They are crispy not chewy.  Perfect little snack, and very happy to know that they are organic.

Discovered this product at Costco via their Dried Apple Medley (Granny Smith, Fuji, and Gala). Realized I was picking through the bag for the red ones (avoiding the Granny Smiths!), since they were the sweetest, crunchiest, and yummiest! I desperately hoped they were Fuji, since they don't sell Gala on its own like this. And, YAY, THEY WERE THE FUJI APPLES! 2 LBS OF SWEET, CRUNCHY APPLES IN BULK FROM AMAZON!! :D No more picking through! (Even though the Costco 14 oz bag of the medley was $5.99 and a better deal for dried apple chips in general...)Also make sure, as others have noted, to keep the apples in the bag they came in. Ziplock bags don't preserve food as well as metal/foil-lined bags, and so the dried apples will go stale in Ziplock bags.
We really liked these at first then we started getting a few bad pieces in each bag and lost taste for them.

column9: Fiji apples chips are crispy and naturally sweet
column10: Love these dried apple snacks- no added sugar. As expected, the Fiji apples ones are crunchier and sweeter than the Granny Smiths. But they tend to crumble more- wish they can packaged in the resealable bag like the Granny Smith variety! Much better price ordering in this bulk size- they do not last long since they are so tasty!

Bare Fruit apple chips (Fuji apple) are delicious with explosive flavor. The shipping was quick and the chips were intact, without breaking and crumbling. Superior product with dozens of recipe uses. Worth every penny.

Bare Fruit Organic Bake Dried Fuji Apples are dellicious!  The are crunchy, sweet, and VERY satisfying!  It's hard to find good, healthy, non-processed, easily tote able snacks, and these totally fit the bill.

This is one of those perfect products for me because I have a hard time getting to the store for live, organic fruit. I found that if I add some water into a saucepan and heat up about a cup of these, I not only get soft and fat apple slices to make a pie or add in the food processor for sauce or other cooking pleasures, I also get some fresh apple juice too. I will definitely be ordering these again. I do keep them in the package, which is easy to fold or crimp for freshness, in the bottom crisper of the fridge.
Satisfying snack. But, they will lose their slight crisp texture and get kinda chewy when mixed with other moist fruits in a trail mix, so keep them sealed & separate.

After reading these mixed reviews, I didn't know what to expect from these. Well, I finally had to put the bag down to write this review. The first one out of the bag wasn't particularly crispy, but that was fine--it still had a very strong apple taste (I don't see how anyone can compare these to cardboard unless their tastebuds are compromised somehow). The next dozen pieces were very crispy. And I find the taste to be very flavorful (with 61-year-old tastebuds...). So count this review as a definite YES! And now I would like to go back to my snacking.
The Bare Fruit 100% Organic bake dried applies are delicious! Highly recommend and we will be buying more in the future. Sweet, crisp and so enjoyable!

column9: I would give them a zero star if they had one
column10: I threw both bags out. Wasted $18 plus dollars. They were not fresh. I felt like I was chewing on cardboard. Don't waste your money.

These apples should come with a warning -"Addictive". They are very crisp (not chewy like air dried apples) with a tart/sweet taste and as impossible to put down as a bag of potato chips. Fortunately, they are just Fuji apples with no flavorings, chemicals or preservatives added. My kids are nuts for them and they are great for school lunch. A no-guilt healthy snack and they are good with fruit dips. Have not tried to reconstitute them to cook with yet but planning on trying them in fried apple pies like my grandmother made with air dried apples. Have been through several packs and have not found any with the musty taste mentioned in other reviews. They MUST stay in the mylar bag to stay fresh. Will be ordering a lot of these apples.

I love these apple chips and eat them every day.  They make a great low calorie snack. I have bought them at Costco when they have them in stock but the Amazon subscription is so easy and about the same price. They arrive automatically every month.  It's a very convenient service.

column9: Back to the store for me
column10: I bought this snack in a store initially and fell in love with them, I must say I really enjoy the taste, I love that it's all natural and low in calories, the product gets a 5 star for taste. I ordered the 1 pound bag on auto-delivery but I must say I'm dissapointed because about one third of the bag was crumbs. The pieces are so broken, I cannot eat them as chips as intended. I waited until I opened the second bag before writing this review but I'm really dissapointed at the amount of crumbs/really small broken pieces that were in the packaging in the second bag as well. When I buy them in the store, almost the entire bag are large chips. I have discontinued my auto delivery. I guess I'll just continue to get them at the store. What a let down.
I love these.  They are sweet, crispy, and delicious.  And very healthy too because they are dried, not fried.  The only problem I have is that they are addictive, I can't stop eating them.

You must try these Apples! I fell in love with the apples after I bought a bag of them at Lego Land. Once I got home I looked on the internet to see where I could get more. Some are sweet and chewy others are full of flavor and crunchy! I'm addicted!!!!! I'm signing up for the automatic delivery.

These apples are dried, but so good.  Watch out for the occasional seeds or stems, but even the core tastes good when dried.  I can't get enough of them.  I thought a bag a month was enough.  Now I find 2 bags a month are not enough.  I need to order more.
These dried apple chips are both great tasting and a super texture!  The price is also the best I have found for any similar product.

As we get older an are allowed less to eat, it's good to find something good for us and that tastes great. These apples are delicious and are quite filling. We use them as snacks, plain or mixing them with other dried fruit. We also eat them on salads. I couldn't be more enthusiastic about a product. Our fiends buy them and leave a bowl out for their grandkids instead of candy. It's a perfect snack and the kids love them. If the price sounds high, remember they are dried apples, so they are very light.
The is a great value - 2 lbs for a low price. The fruit inside is crunchy and every piece looked fresh. It's sweet but not too sweet, and I like that Bare Fruit doesn't add artificial sugar.

column9: Great product, great diet snack, great for kids!
column10: I just love it! All my co-workers bought them after they tried mine. My kids love them as a snack. These are crunchy and have sweet/sour taste. Sometimes you come across the chewy one. I like them too.
Was very excited for these to come, however when I got them. I was NOT happy, not a good flavor or texture.

I purchased these dried apples as a healthier substitutes for times when I want to eat chips. And these baked-dried apples are awesome!The flavor is quite natural, it's like the real apples that not very sweet, and I even got some quite sour pieces. And the apple pieces are real-cut from apples, you can tell several parts from apple - although already shrink. People who are complaining the flavor should be aware those that tastes good usually has hidden preservatives or sugar added. In the end, a real apple wouldn't taste much better than these dried apples.I have to admit that they tend to be a little bit too crispy some time that biting is not very easy. But it does help me to slow down while eating it - it tastes so good to me that I just can't stopping getting for more! Plus, the 2pack 1 pound is good amount - not to little that you have to order again and again, also not too much that u'll worry about ever finishing it.I'll try dried mangoes and cinnamon apples for next time.
The dried apples were good as advertised.As a result, I am ordering them again and recommend them to anyone interested in dried apples.
It's a great, healthy snack to keep around! It's crunchy and not too sweet. Also, if you keep them in a ziplock bag, they retain its crunchiness very well.
These are a nice break to the typcial dried fruits.I and eat just a few of thsse a day and feel satisfied.They can be stored a long time since they are dried.

I was pretty disappointed when I received these. They just don't seem to taste right, and the texture just seems off. I opened the second bag hoping it would be better, but more of the same. I would NOT order these again.

Delicious crunchy substantial even my puppy begged me for it whenever I nibble on it.  Best snack u could get your hands on ... I couldn't help binging.  But hey who cares.  It's organic and it's apple

I get these bags for my rabbit to supplement her diet of hay and pellets. She gobbles themup every day. I haven't tried them myself but who cares. She loves them and I will continueto get them for her. Enough said.
This product was a great value and tasted delicious.  If you are looking for a quick and healthy snack I highly recommend these baked dried apples, two thumbs up

I found this snack item when searching Amazon for something healthier.  It's 100% organic, baked apple chips which satisfy a craving for something sweet and give a good level of fiber.  I'll be back for this one and likely to try similar products from Bare Fruit.

These are so yummy I have ordered them twice this month! I had set up delivery every 2 months but they were so good, I now order them every 2 weeks! I just wish I could find out how many calories are in a cupfull.

We have purchased these dried apples several times now.  For me they're a great afternoon snack that satisfies my hunger but also my sweet tooth - they keep me from reaching for chocolate or other less healthy alternatives.  We'll continue to buy them.I would recommend that you keep them in a dry place and in a container that seals.  We live in a humid climate and had to discard some because they became spongy and gross.

These apples are sweet/tart and have a mostly crisp texture.  Some are a bit chewy, but I like the variety. I will be putting these on subscribe and save to make sure I have them on hand at all times!

I was looking for 'apple crisps' but didn't want artificial ingredients or sugar added.  These fit the bill! Deliciously tart and semi- sweet.  Crisp enough but still a bit chewy...the best part?  My kids HATE them! Yum, Yum...more for me:-)
These dried apples are great for snacking right out of the bag or used to make our own homemade cereal! They're a great healthy treat!
These organic Fugi apples are the best dried apple ever.  So good they are already out of stock & no longer available.

column9: Very crispy, Great Apple flavor with a slight sweetness
column10: The price on this product is great, compared to the other prices on the market. You will not get a true apple taste or texture like the freeze dried ones. However, your not paying $25 a pound. These are very crisp and do have a great apple taste with the slight sweetness you'd expect from a Fuji apple. There is peelings on the apple pieces but it doesn't seem to make them bitter. About half of the pieces will need to be handled and ate in the way you would peanuts; for an adult this is fine but not a small child. Personally, I found them great and have signed up to get them shipped every month. Being a diabetic, these are a great item. Low in carbs (6 carbs per 1/4 cup) and helps with sweet cravings.

These are much more economical than candy and a whole lot less calories!  The flavor is great! These apples are addicting. They are sweet and crunchie. Why eat potato chips when you can have these delicious, healthy, low-calorie, fat-free chips.  They also fit well into my budget since I only work part time and go to school.

column9: Bare Fruit dried fuji apple chips
column10: The product arrived in durable packaging which helps protect its freshness very well.  The chips are crunchy, nicely sized, and flavorful.  I am delighted to find this item and will continue to purchase it!
I love these apples but they were expensive in small amounts.  These were wonderful, we just kept them in the bag they were shipped in and closed it with a chip clip.

Maybe it's the type of apple but I wasn't very satisfied with the taste. These were like the crumbs at the bottom of a potato chip bag. I haven't even opened the second bag and I won't purchase these again. The apples I buy from Fresh Market taste much better; they tend to run out of stock that's why I tried these.

Great sweet crisp apple chip.  No additives or extra sugar.  Great way to get a little treat without extra guilt of eating junk.  12, 13, 15 year old kids love them too.  looking forward to packing them in lunches in the Fall.  Best bargain is to buy the big pounder packs and divide them up yourself.  The little bags are good but too expensive for the convenience. Love these but not the Granny Smith Apple chips as much. Granny's not as sweet.  I want to try the Mango chips next.

These dried apples are a fantastic deal and they are really tasty. I'm happy to bag them in sandwich baggies for my kiddos so they can munch on these as if they were potato chips. They are really crispy and taste delicious. Thanks Amazon!
I have used this product for years. I put a handful of the dried apples in the bottom of my bowl and then put oatmeal(instant)on top-zap it and then add walnuts and dried cranberries. Yummy!
Outstanding!  These apples are addicting.  They are sweet and crunchie.  Why eat potato chips when you can have these delicious, healthy, low-calorie, fat-free chips.

I had been buying dried apples at Trader Joe, and saw that the ones from Amazon cost less, so I signed up for a series of three shipments. I was terribly disappointed with the quality when the first batch arrived. I could eat the TJ apples out of hand, but these were far too hard and dry to be edible without cooking I canceled my next two shipments, and Amazon gave me a refund.
I love these apple chips.  They are mildly crunchy, very apple tasting, and go along well with a healthy snack of nuts and seeds. Fantastic product.

These apple crisps taste great and satisfy the urge for a sweet, crunchy treat. Since they are organic and low calorie, they are a guiltless snack. These backed crisps are available at Amazon for an incredible price especially if you get a subcription.

These are delicious and are a great price.  Buying in the larger quantity makes these apples more affordable (although still a little pricey) and I love that they are organic.  I had been looking for a crunchy dried apples (as opposed to the chewy softer dried apples sold at my co-op) and these are perfect--crunchy and sweet without and added oil or sugar.  You won't regret your order!Courtney

column9: Great organic snack and new packaging
column10: This is a wonderfully healthy snack!These organic Fuji apples are very tasty and I really like the new foil packaging!!!For the most part, these apples are eaten right out of the bag. They are especially great for road trips and camping. When opened they are crisp but do pick up moisture quite readily. So you may wish to re-bag them if you do not eat them all right away.

When ordering this type of food online, we're always mindful of expiration dates and freshness. The batch of dried apples we just received is crunchy, fresh and full of flavor. While we enjoy organic dried fruit, we're not fans of the "rubbery" dried apples most often available. These apples are a satisfying snack food, and are perfect for a healthy lunchbox treat. While we eat them straight from the bag, they seem suitable for adding to oatmeal, yogurt, and for baking. I would prefer that the bag be labeled "organic" (so that I know that they know), but I'm taking their word for it... Enjoy!

column9: Love these, they're so addicting and much cheaper to buy online.
column10: These are super expensive in the supermarket. This is the bestdeal you can get. I used to buy these at costco and they stoppedselling them. This is a really good deal, they came fast and taste amazing.
I read so many comments about these dried Fuji Apple Chips. Most comments were good. I found these apple chips to be very tasty and crispy. I will buy them again.
I think these dried apple chips are the best I've ever tasted. They are full of flavor and no after taste.
I really liked these apple chips - they taste real, and they stay crisp and fresh.
Crunchy dried apples.  Yummy!  No added sugar, no preservatives, no colors, THAT'S WHAT I'M TALKING ABOUT!  And the two bags are huge, you get lots and lots of apples!  Good deal!
I've never had crunchy dried apples before but these are now one of my favorite snacks. They are very satisfying, crunchy and sweet.

Huge dried fruit consumer - this product is by far the best crunchy dried apple I've ever had.  Often dried fruit loses the underlying flavor.  With this stuff you can taste the apple, that's how good it is.

These apples are so tasty and healthy at the same time. Everyone in the family loves them.  They are crunchy, but also a little chewy.  The price is excellent compared to the dried apples we were buying at the health food store.  We have these set to ship out automatically once a month.
I just got these in the mail today and can't stop eating them. No fat, no added sugar, just pure crunchy apple slices. They are wonderful!

I have been a user of this tea for the last five years and even have compared it with several other brands. It keeps coming out the winner!It is truly a great product and makes the best brew for a honest tea lover.

This is the best tea I've ever tasted - period! Each canister has a double lid plus comes sealed in plastic to preserve the flavor. On opening the lid, the rush of bergamot aroma hits your nose. Wow! You also smell the flavor of the black tea (unlike some other Earl Grey brands where all you get is the bergamot). The leaves are indeed the prized small buds from the top of the plant.This tea cannot be over-brewed. I left it longer than 5 minutes a couple of times and it never became bitter or acidic. Always you taste the smooth black tea and the bergamot is strong but never over-powering.I also like that you're supporting a local grower and the workers instead of being syphoned off into a large mega-corporation.If you like Earl Grey, get this tea! You won't be disappointed.

My entire family enjoys this loose leaf tea! It is our favorite. We're very picky about our tea and this is good quality. The flavor is mellow even though it's an Earl Grey. It isn't bitter like some teas, but smooth. I highly recommend trying it if you haven't. I am a repeat customer.

column9: VERY pleasant surprise! (from a Peet's drinker)
column10: It started with Peets coffee in Berkeley, 1980....couldn't then, get better coffee. Now much older, I'm picky about what we drink. THIS tea, I used to order directly from Sri Lanka; $10 for 4 tins, and $30 for Fedex!!! Now available from Amazon, it is VERY HARD to find any Earl Grey that is FRESHER, or of higher QUALITY. Peets in the a.m., and Dilmah Earl Grey in the p.m., for a refreshing LIFT, that coffee just can't match - weird, but true. Wish we could try a SAMPLING of the other GREAT Dilmah teas...but, no one has gone that MARKETING route, sadly.

I love loose leaf tea - the large leaves brew slowly, giving flavor but not bitterness. It has a subtle quality about it that sets is apart from the grounds found in tea bags. This tea does not have that quality. Rather than whole leaves, the tea is ground-up bits like in English breakfast tea. Even after brewing the leaves are tiny chunks. Rather than a long, slow brew, I found that this tea takes on a bitter edge after as little as two and a half minutes. I usually brew tea bags longer! If you keep the brewing short and use a lot of leaf to compensate it can be drinkable, but why bother when you can do better with a bag? I won't be buying this again.

For those who truly love Earl Grey tea, pass this one by.  For those who have never tried loose leaf Earl Grey, please don't let this be your first.  While many have complained about the "chopped" state of this tea as opposed to true loose leaf, that is hardly the biggest problem with it.  It was the acrid aftertaste that caused me to write this one off as a lesson learned.  The bitterness absolutely overwhelmed the pleasant bergamot experience that Earl Grey drinkers so anticipate.  While I agree that the double-lid canister is an excellent design I think it will serve me much better by holding another brand of tea.

I purchased this tea over a year ago and thought it was great. After I ran out, I was contemplating reordering it, but decided to read some product reviews. A few reviews mentioned that it was not a whole leaf tea, so I decided to look for a whole leaf variety. You can really tell the difference. The Dilmah has a bit of a bitterness to it and the bergamot flavors are not very strong. Look for a whole leaf variety instead.

Absolutely the best Earl Grey I've ever had and I've had a lot.  It is very smooth and rich, with just enough bergamot (not too much, not too little).  As others have said, this tea is never bitter, just full bodied.  I plan on never buying any other brand.  Love that it is ethically grown, single origin and comes in loose leaf.  I bought their green tea and loved it as well.  Cheers!

the Bergamot used here smells and tastes like rancid Lychee nuts, so if you are just looking for a pleasant black tea, pick something else.  A tea at this price point should not be using "flavoring" but the real essence, oil or dehydrated Bergamot citrus fruit.  The leaves are cut up into 2mm bits, so you must use a paper filter when seeping this loose tea.  The double capped tin does a fine job of air sealing the tea, so there is no need for an inner foil wrapper as others have contested.
The right combination of aroma, kick and taste. It is very rich, while not bitter at all. I've tried numerous loose leaf teas, this one is the best so far.

I purchased based on reviews here and was very dissapointed. I had just finished a bulk order of Bigelow Earl Grey from here at amazon, and it was REALLY good. I just thought, oh, a boutique tea with good reviews ought to be better...NO. Save your money and go with the Bigelow (Bigelow Earl Grey Tea, 40-Count Boxes (Pack of 6)), no kidding.

Great bergamot aroma, but unacceptable bitterness. , My question is this real bergamot oil used in the process or just an artificial substitute? Usually when the natural oil is used it states so. This tea only list bergamot "flavor" as the ingredient. This is usually a clever "legal" way of cheating on customers.Second, like some others have written, I also noticed a harsh bitter aftertaste when brewed past 5 minutes. Thats not very long and one shouldn't have to put a stop watch to a cup of tea! Maybe an artificial bergamot makes it bitter? I've been searching for a replacement  for an old favorite.Best Earl Grey ever was Williamson & Magor, but sadly the company is no longer solvent after a 100 plus years. They used genuine bergamot "oil" and it was phenominal! Dimah's tin caddy is fantastic and should be an industry standard!Update: Taylors of Harrogate Earl Grey Leaf Tea, Loose Leaf, is awesome!!! Beats this bitter Dilmah impostor like a rented mule. Taylors of Harrogate is even better than my old favorite and uses "REAL" oil of Bergamot.

Just like the other person said, this is NOT Godiva. It isa very cheap UNSAFE piece of cheaply glued fabric and plastic with a few Hershey's chocolates in it. I honestly wouldn't even pay $1.00 for them, let alone this price.

column9: item received is completely different than item description
column10: item received are 2 plastic containers about 5 inches tall filled with peanut butter cups and Hersheys kisses. No Godiva chocolates. No wooden picket fence. Rabbit missing eyeball. Ripoff, scam.

I sent these baskets to my two grandkids.  What did they get?  A worthless piece of junk that I could have bought at the dollar store for less than a dollar!  BE WARNED DO NOT BUY THESE AT THE VERY LEAST IT IS FALSE ADVERTISING. I didn't want to give it one star but couldn't publish the review unless I answered the question.  If I could rate it minus 5 stars I  would although it probably doesn't even rate that.

My 12 year old cat had seemingly developed some stomach issues and was vomiting nearly every day.  I suspected they were from an intolerance to dyes and other unnecessary stuff they put in mass market cat foods.  Since she's been on this,she hasn't gotten sick once!  Hallelujah! If your cat has a sensitive belly, try this!  Also, I will say that she really likes this food...I did try a few others along the way (Blue Buffalo, By Nature) but she didn't  love them.  This food smells fresh and is very very tiny...little balls smaller than a pea.  It's easy for her to eat and digest.

My 7 year old rescue cat came to me skinny and with huge patches of coat missing. She would lick and scratch at herself until she created sores, and was overall, pathetic looking. She also vomited daily. I tried numerous high quality foods to no avail. Then I found Spot's Stew sensitive. I chose the seafood medley since seafood is her taste preference. She loved the food; but more importantly, in days the vomiting stopped entirely. In a few weeks she grew coat. Now, four months later, she has absolutely NO vomiting (not even hairballs). Her coat is thick and lusterous, and she has gained a significant amount of weight. Because this food has such a high protein and fat content, I have to feed her less or she would gain too much weight. But Spot's Stew has changed this animal's life. I recently adopted a Lhasa Apso puppy whose coat is dry and itchy. I have switched her from Wellness (her breeder's choice) to Spot's Stew Salmon for puppies. She LOVES this food, and she has always been a picky eater. I am expecting the same coat changes that I found with my cat. I was a dog show fancier, breeder, and kennel owner for 15 years, and if I were still in that business, I would be using Spot's Stew for all my animals. It's not cheap, but it's worth every penny of the investment. OUTSTANDING food.
Halo dry cat food is all I feed my cat and she has the shiniest coat you have ever seen! Even my vet mentioned she has never seen a cat with such a shiny coat.
My cat's been eating this food for over a year and he loves it! I highly recommend it!

column9: They love it - both of them!!!
column10: Yesterday, I had posted a rating of 2-stars for this product because one of my cats got violently ill after eating it.  Afterward when I tried to give him a little, he wouldn't even go near it.  I was worried about my cat, so he was my main concern.It turns out that my previous suspicion was right:  he got sick because of a hairball, not the food.  I feel so relieved that he's okay.  I'll just have to make sure to brush him more so this doesn't happen again.  So, I've upgraded ny review to a 5-star rating.Now, he loves it!  When I fed my cats this morning, my cat who got sick gobbled it down with gusto, like he normally does!  That was such a relief!  There weren't any pieces left in the dish.  I mix it with Friskies to give them a little variety, which they seem to like, so it's easy to see when they don't like something.As a side, both of my cats also love the Halo wet food - it's their favorite thing to eat.  They go crazy when I give it to them for dinner!  I am still waiting for the Lamb Spot Stew to show up - it's a new flavor for them and I'm sure they'll just love it.

column9: Tiger Says Spot's Stew's a Winner!
column10: My 10-year-old cat has tried a couple of organic cat foods and while she's liked every one (Blue Buffalo, Solid Gold Katzenflocken) she REALLY likes Halo Spot's Stew.  I read about Spots Stew in a veterinarian's column in the Sunday paper.  Others had said wonderful things about it.  So I bought it thru Amazon and Tiger loves it!  Tiger highly recommends it.

I have been a fan of Halo pet food for several years now.  Halo, truly is a wonderful brand of food with quality ingredients.  I decided to purchase this "sensitive" formula because my cat was puking up several times a week. Needless to say, I was ready to try the sensitive formula because who really likes to clean up cat puke.... Major Yuck!!!Anyways, my cat is on her 3rd bag of this formula and has done remarkably well.  The puking has decreased dramatically and she seems more satisfied after eatting with this formula plus her coat looks remarkably more shiny.  She eats several mini meals a day.  I've noticed that helps with the puking situation as well.  I am so happy that Halo created this "sensitive" formula, it has really made a positive difference in my cat's overall disposition and health.  Yay Halo and yay Amazon for carrying this formula of Spot's Stew since my local store doesn't carry it!

The first bag, all three of my cats gobbled up.  However, my oldest cat started losing his fur and turned his nose up at the second bag.  I don't think there was anything wrong with the food.  The other two were still happy.  He's just getting older.  So while I still had enough to easily transition them, I went back to a completely grainfree food.

I purchased this food after 4Health cat food was recalled. I got the seafood for sensitive stomachs because my cat throws up after he eats sometimes. He loves the flavor and I'v had no problems getting him to eat it. I knew this flavor would be a good choice because my cat goes nuts over tuna fish. I make sure to shop around and find it on sale because it is not sold locally around me and I must buy it online. I love that it does not have preservatives and it is made from food grade meats and all U.S. or Canada ingredients.
I needed to find a cat food for my cats that was healthy and also tasted good.  Alot of the cat food at the grocery do not meet that criteria.  I am very pleased with Halo and my cats love it.

column9: Smells like French fries but my cat loves it
column10: Our cat has had trouble with some other cat foods we've tried with her. She always seems to be stinking up the house with her gas or her visits to the litter box. We tried a couple different high end cat foods. All they did was make it worse. We started getting more natural food for her and it helped but not by a whole lot. I found this by searching through Amazon and reading some reviews. We decided to try it out.She's doing much better now. She is hardly gassy anymore (except when she gets scared, pfffft! lol) and her poop doesn't smell horrible anymore. She also doesn't stink up the litter box room anymore. We are in love with this cat food even though, for some weird reason, it smells like French fries. No complaints there but it's just weird. I'll try to post a video of my cat eating it. She absolutely loves eating this food!

column9: My Cats Will Not Touch Halo
column10: My two cats are older (16 & 13), yet they will try something new for a while and return back to their favorite.  They did not touch Halo.  I tried it out by putting the Halo alone in a bowl for them and noticed that they would not eat it. Then I provided them with their favorite Purina One Maturity and they proceeded to eat. Two days later, I placed the Halo and Purina One in separate bowls, they only ate the Purina One Maturity.  The product sounds wonderful but cats are finicky creatures.  I returned this item which is much more expensive than other brands.

column9: Transformed our sickly, skinny, girl into a beautiful fat cat !
column10: We adopted a beautiful gray kitten from the local rescue shelter, after a year or so she began to become very lethargic. She lost weight and her coat became very patchy - she was scratching and itching constantly. She also vomited nearly every day.The vet thought perhaps food allergies were the culprit and he recommended another premium food, which helped with her coat, but she continued to lose weight.We are becoming very concerned at this point, and decided to stop into a local specialty pet shop. They recommended Spot's Stew sensitive.The food has most assuredly changed my cat's quality of life. She has gained weight, her coat is shiny, healthy and full, the scratching and itching has ceased. She is full of life again and very playful.I HIGHLY recommend this cat food if your cat has sensitivity issues. It truly has been a life alternating choice for our cat. It has been several months and we are quite pleased with the outcome.Thank you for reading my review.

I have a cat with a very sensitive tummy.  Since being on Halo for sensitive stomachs, he has no more bathroom issues.  Everything is normal and no more smelly box!! Of course I had him checked out by the vet first!

Our cat had a rash under her chin that she was only making worse with her constant scratching.  We changed her kitty food to this, and within two weeks, not only was the rash gone but she ate it up.  Haven't seen the rash since (one year later) and she has the healthiest mane.  Recommend it without reservation!

Our cat was on a mysterious vomiting spree for several months -- he threw up partially digested food nearly every day.  Even after blood tests, X-rays, and ultrasound, we couldn't figure what his deal was.  We tried giving him prescription and novel protein foods, as well as different brands of foods, but every morning we'd find that cold, semi-chunky puddle on the floor.We looked around for new foods to try and found Spot's Stew.  Pet foods are hard to pick out, since there doesn't seem to be a very thorough understanding on what's nutritiously suitable for our pets.  Are blueberries and zucchinis any more suitable for cats than corn?  And is it worth the premium?  No clue, but we decided to give Spot's Stew a try.Our cat has been on this food for a couple of months.  He still vomits once every couple of weeks, but it's an improvement from vomiting every day.  The smaller size of the kibble definitely seems to help with digestion.  If the cat does vomit, the kibbles are saturated with fluid; in his other foods, they came out still hard and compact.  No word on whether the special formula helps with the stomach problems.  He seems to adore the taste.Some reviewers said that this food made their cats' poop less smelly.  I have to disagree.  Our cat's poop smells terrible.  It smells kind of cheesy now.  But it's good that this food goes down and out rather than up and out.  We'll stick to this brand.
Since we started using Halo cat food our five indoor cats stomach probems have all but disappeared.  Oh the Cat's love the food too!

After trying many expensive "good for your cat" cat food, I was really hoping that this was the one.  One of my cat's is very over weight and because this is a low carb food, I was excited to try it.  Neither of my three cats will eat it.  I bought two flavors, the turkey and seafood flavor.  They won't eat either one.  Now I'm stuck with another two bags of cat food.

Being significantly Swedish in upbringing I like a good dark roast. Blacksmith Coffee's Skånerost make's me wish I had some plattar and lingon berries to go with my french press. The owners were even nice enough to sign my receipt and wish me well. Thank you Mark and Nancy.

I used to be the only one I knew who loved this candy, then eventually my wife grew to love them also... We started calling them "Vitamin G" way back in the early 90's, but then my youngest daughter came along and she is also an addict!But here's the deal, I grew up loving the hard stale Good and Plenty that came out of the "Choo Choo Charley" boxes, but once I stated buying the 7 ounce bags and got fresh Good and Plenty, I grew to even love it more. Here on Amazon is about as good of a deal as you are likely to find at about $1.40 bag it is less than I can find at even the discount grocery stores where freshness is hit and miss.

column9: Good & Plenty -- just like you remember it.
column10: It's Good & Plenty -- is there really anything else to say? It is still the same old fat-free, delicious licorice candy it's always been.One thing to note is the AMOUNT of candy you're getting -- you're getting a lot. Seriously. You're getting 12 fairly large (half-pound) bags of candy. This will definitely last you awhile.

This is one of my favorite candies of all time - the sugar coated black licorice candy that comes in white or purple.  I've been eating Good & Plenty in the movie theater since forever.  I got tons of it while trick-or-treating over the years.  Eat too much of it and you might get a sugar high and a headache.I highly recommend this candy.

I must have gotten used to rather stale Good & Plenty because once I received this order (speedy shipping ala Prime) and tasted from the first bag (and each bag thereafter) I was pleasantly surprised to find very soft licorice - yum.  No packaging problems with my order (no holes/punctures) - the packages were secured from movement with the inflated baggie things.  And yes, I've reorderd :)

I really like these bags of Good & Plenty! They are just the right size for eating and sharing! You get more than in the usual "theater box" size and enough to share or put away for later! One nice thing about Good & Plenty is that they'll keep a person "regular" (LOL!). If you like black licorice you'll love these (if you've never tried them) and the colorful sugar coating adds just enough sweetness to cut the licorice "bite". These bags travel well and are easy to "smuggle" into the theater! Enjoy!

column9: Choo Choo Charlie loves Good & Plenty
column10: always was and always will be a great candy. loved it when i was young, adore it when i am all grown up.

The boxed candy is hard 90% of the time.  Granted I have to pay a bit more, but the bagged candy is soft and chewy as meant to be, so worth it.  Don't understand why the Good n Plenty company doesn't sell more of the bagged candy to the stores, so thank you Amazon!

Good & Plentys has been one of my favorite candies since the early 50's. Recently, someone told me they remembered when they were black and white, rather than pink and white. I told him he was mistaken. Does anyone remember when they were not pink and white?
you know you want them.they are fresh, testy and well packaged for shipping.
