column9: Love the candy, hate the packaging problem
column10: 8 of my 12 packages came with holes in them and candy spilled all over.  I love Good & Plenty but there must be some type of packaging problems.  Hopefully I will receive a refund and the problem will be fixed before my next subscribe and save shipment arrives.  Other than that problem, the remaining candy is fresh and tastes great.

column9: Tasty but won't eat unless they change the coloring
column10: This is my favorite candy but I found out they use cochineal for the pink coloring. Cochineal are beetles scraped from cacti, dried and crushed. I don't eat food with bugs in it. It's a shame they don't change it because these are SO delicious.

Very high quality marzipan! The loaves are the perfect size, not too much or too little. Great price for them too. They are sold individually at Adams Fairacre Farms for $5.99. Highly recommend. Be Prepared, once you eat one, you can't stop! :)

When fresh, Niederegger marzipan is out of this world. These bars arrived stale and dry, which sapped them of much of their flavor. Maybe take a chance if you've got to have marzipan and this is the only way to get it.

Previously bought marzipan potatoes but they were sold out, so tried these. Niederegger marzipan is the best I've ever tasted but the chocolate is overpowering. The potatoes were better because they were pure marzipan and the flavor really comes through.

Niederegger is one of the finest, if not the finest, brand of marzipan. The wonderful almond taste is not too sweet, and the dark chocolate is terrific. The bars we were shipped were quite fresh and delicious. If you haven't tried these, you ought to.

column9: I Wasn't Sure About This One, but Wow!
column10: Peanut Matcha.  I was a little hesitant.  I don't know what it is about the idea of peanut flavoring in a tea ... it just doesn't sound right to me.  I am all for just about any other type of nut (yeah, I know that peanuts aren't technically nuts), but, peanuts just sounded too weird to me.  Then I tried Peanut Taffy and this changed my whole idea of how good peanut flavor can taste.So, I got the courage and I ordered this Matcha, and I'm pleasantly surprised.  It's really quite good.  Much better than I expected it to be.  It is good prepared traditionally, with water and whisked well, but then after taking my first sip, I decided I wanted to find out what a pinch of salt might add to the flavor.  And so I added a tiny pinch of sea salt and I LOVE this.  It is really yummy!Smooth, rich and creamy.  Nice peanut flavor, balanced well with the fresh, leafy green taste of the Matcha.  Really tasty - much tastier than I expected!
this is a good soda bread and very easy to make,i also obtained one item for a gift.
Always a quality product.  Good ingredients and keeps your blood sugar at a good level.  Good for traveling or taking on the go.  Doesn't melt.

column9: From the birth Place of Coffee
column10: I am officially addicted to coffee, I mean the real coffee which I roast, grind and brew, the first time I had Yiragachefe was when I was deployed to Iraq, my wife neighbors and some other family members knew I really can not live with out coffee, up on my return from Iraq I went to Ethiopian store in San Diego and asked store owner if he has this brand, unfortunately in the USA this brand is sold only by starbucks, but he told me to try some other export standard version of Ethiopian coffee brand, I try 1LB that was my starting point to roast my own coffee, it is almost three years now. That store is on Al-Cajon PVD and I had 15% discount every time I buy my coffee, finally when I moved to East cost I bought 30lb in fear of availability in Louisiana.I am not sure about legitimacy of Indian store in selling Ethiopian coffee but I highly recommend this coffee only if you really know what coffee means, the real coffee comes unroast, and ungrounded 2 shoots of Espresso can keep you moving the whole 8 working hours, this is natural straight from jungle and it's organic no hormone or fertilizer is used to grow it, sadly once it hits our American market it start giving part of its caffeine away to energy drinks and some other things so you will never find real clean and untouched one  on any market but in Ethiopian Stores. I will add some pictures of my newly roasted coffee and show you how easy it is to roast 1.5LB of coffee in about 15 minutes.Please try this unroasted organic you will really like the taste and you will enjoy your day.

column9: Great product...based upon my pup's reaction!
column10: I was looking for a soft-chew product to replace a skin & coat additive that I used to buy from another manufacturer.  My dog doesn't like the gel tabs that most pet supply stores sell.  The Pet Naturals product is great tasting to him.  He actually looks for them first in his bowl before eating his food.I've since learned that my local pet store sells these items.  I'll choose to buy the product locally because the cost is the same, given the shipping and handling charges assessed by the on-line vendor.

this product was a suckarooney. i really looked forward to it because it's unusual, and sounded yummy. WRONG. i mixed it as instructed, using milk instead of water as directed to make it lighter. it comes with a small jar of huckleberry jam, that is to be mixed into the batter. it was interesting, so i did it. the batter was thick and lumpy, even after mixing well. the instructions said it would be, if done correctly. when i poured the batter, it kind of "blopped" onto the griddle. each pancake took a while to cook, but i was patient. each cake was very HEAVY and cakey. it literally stuck to the roof of my mouth. the lumps exploded into bursts of mix in my mouth. the flavor did taste like huckleberry, but still had a packaged, jammy flavor. i really hated it, as did my husband. his response was, "what the **** is this mess? i hope you didn't pay much for it!" unfortnately, it's very expensive, and NOT WORTH IT. i have all the other jam, jelly, and syrup products from "wild wilderness", and i have been very pleased at the delicious, fresh flavors. but this one was a dud. you would do better to use your usual mix or recipe, and add some jam to it. don't waste your money on this.
I needed a size larger for my bonsai and this was just right. Plus like the look of the pot.

And, if u do, use a fork!  It's that easy!  Biggest problem with ANY mix usually involves  over-beating, especially when recipe calls for adding eggs.  Cooks tend to beat and blend to the point that eggs become tooooooo frothy.  That can make a big difference in outcome.  Beat eggs and other wet ingredients first, then lightly add mix a half cup at a time.  Then stir or beat until all nix is wet!  U'll see a HUGE difference in outcome!
I love all Krusteaz products and these are no exception. Delicious and easy. Great for BYO dessert affairs. I use them for church meetings and they are ALWAYS GONE!! What a tribute!

column9: WOW!! These taste better than Pecan Pie!!
column10: I was more than impressed! I made these for my friend who adores pecan pie... and he liked them more than the pie! I did add a little more butter to the crust because it was too crumby and it turned out DELICIOUS! I will be making them again!
Not only was this a wonderfully easy preparation but the bars are incredibly good.  Can't stop eating them.  This is a can't miss mix!
The product tasted good.  I enjoyed them.  I would order again.  I love red velvet cake so I knew I would like red velvet petits fours.

This is my first time trying petit fours, and I must say they lived up to what I expected. If you like or want to try petits fours, I don't think you can go wrong with the Swiss colony brand. The whole cake was fresh and had a good taste to it.

This stuff is great.  This is the second pack of 6 I have purchased.  The gold dash flax seems to be less noticeable then the regular when added to food/recipes.  I put ground flax on my son's peanut butter and jelly sandwiches.  Both boys don't even notice it when I use this gold dash flax !  I also use it in my pancake batter, muffins, waffles, etc.

column9: Premium Gold Dash O'Flax truly Golden
column10: I understand and truly believe in the benefits of flax but in usage I have always not liked to have the pure seeds for putting in yogurt on in salads but this is ground cold-milled which gives actually two great benefits.1. Long shelf life by bottles show 2013 - April due to cold milled2. Pre-ground, just add litterally a 'dash' and you are set.Each serving has 200mg of Omega 3 and 50mg of Omega 6 great for the digestion and lowering cholesterol.This is really a great product and easy delivery to things that I use flax in like salads, cereal, fruit.

Great product, good price, fast shipping. This product retails in stores for a much higher price, and that's if you are lucky enough to find it! This was a great deal and I would highly recommend this seller to all.

I really like anything peppermint, so I decided to give this one a shot. The main thing I don't like about it is that it's not really pepperminty. I wish it was more minty and flavorful. If you are looking for just plain-ish salt water taffy, you could give this a try. But if you're looking for something that's minty, this isn't the one for you.
I got this formula on time and it was well packaged so I knew it was not damaged durring shipment.

column9: Folks, this is diet - keep that in mind
column10: Before you read my entire review, keep the following in mind: A quick internet search will show you how many calories and carbs are in a normal Pina Colada.. my search results showed me that it's typically a 500+ calorie drink.  Baja Bob gives you a 30 calorie substitute.  Let's remember this 470 calorie difference between the drinks while reading the reviews.  To put things in perspective, it would take only 7 normal pina coladas to gain a pound of fat, but to gain a pound with the Baja Bob version, you'd have to drink more than 116!Now that my disclaimer is out of the way, let's talk about the flavor. If you follow the directions and mix with ice in a blender, not only is the taste pleasant, but the beverage is surprisingly creamy.  This is a very sweet mixer and not something that I would like to drink every day, but it would make a great party drink.  A wonderful way to show that you're an accommodating  host to your diabetic or low-carbing guests.  I would have at least one other Baja Bob's mix on hand that doesn't require a blender too, such as margarita mix.Overall Baja Bob makes decent substitutes for full-calorie drinks.  No it is not nearly as good as a "real" pina colada, but most diet soda drinkers are already used to the differences between their diet and regular drinks.  I have managed to lose 10 lbs in the past month on my low carb diet without giving up drinks.  A close friend of mine lost about 30 over several months and had a drink every now and again, within reason of course, but Baja Bob did not throw her off her diet.  I can't say the same about a normal pina colada.

column9: Best of the low carb mixers.
column10: I found if you add a little bit of splenda and some vanilla or maple extract, that you can make this mixer taste just like a regular pina coloda!The next best flavor they make would be the lemon mixer, but the rest of the  mixes are a bit tough on the pallet....

I LOVE pina coladas, but haven't been able to drink them in years because of how fattening they are.  I tried the Baja Bob's mix and don't find it that bad.  There is a bit of a different taste to it, but nothing offensive.  I used it with Malibu coconut rum.
makes wonderful pina coladas when you can't have a lot of sugar in your drinks.we will be having more this weekend, can't wait!!!

If drink disaster has a taste, this is it. BB pina colada mix was so bad, I thought it was expired. Using Splenda is a bad idea, Bob. If you read these reviews, sCRAP this recipe and if you gotta go sugarless, try stevia, much smoother...

I had high hopes for this product because I like Splenda & I normally drink diet soda anyway. So I feel like I'm used to the "after-taste" that non-diet soda drinkers complain of. Unfortunately it was awful! The first sip was o.k. but by the 3rd, I couldn't take the "funky" after-taste anymore & had to throw it out. I may still try another flavor & hope for a different result but I definitely DO NOT recommend the Pina Colada mix!

The Margarita Mix is excellent!  I've also had the Cranberry Martini Mix which is pretty good.  But this was really disappointing.  The coconut taste is off and it has an aftertaste.  And it feels like something is coating my mouth after I drink it.  I bought a 3-bottle package and will have to toss it.

column9: No other martini olive will do
column10: Once you've had a martini with an Ybarra Piquillo stuffed olive, no other will do.These olives have a rich, profound flavor - not just the bland, salty flavor ofsupermarket green olives. And the piquillo pimentos really taste of red pepper(though they're not hot.)If you choose your gin with care, you should do no less for your olive.  Justbeware the temptation to snack on these olives by themselves - else you mightfind your martini oliveless!
We bought these same olives at a small market when we were in Spain.  They come in a can there, and were of course less expensive.  But they are the best olives we've ever had, and worth the price!

column9: A little pricey, but worth it
column10: Although I am something of a circus peanut connoisseur, this was my first experience with colored (as in "other than orange") circus peanuts, and it was quite a good one. The peanuts arrived in good shape in a cellophane bag with a "Sweet Gourmet" sticker on it. (A little confusing, as the listing shows them "by Spangler.") I didn't realize until I read up on the history of circus peanuts that they're supposed to be banana-flavored; I always thought it was just some unique circus peanut flavor. In this case, the orange peanuts are regular flavor; the yellow ones are obviously lemon (and my least favorite, despite my love of lemons); the pink ones are a subtle cherry; and the white ones...oh, the white ones. Vanilla. Creamy, sugary deliciousness. Wow. If I could order just vanilla, I might never go back to pseudo-banana.The price was reasonable for such quality, but the shipping (twice the price of the product) was not. But I suppose that's the fault of the shipping company, and it's probably a good thing anyway. If shipping were, say, free, I'd be well on my way to diabetes. This way, I'll only order these peanuts as an occasional special treat. And a treat they are!

The peanuts arrived to me in a timely manner along with the rest of my purchaces. As soon as I looked at them, I realized that they had been over-heated along their journey. The colors had bled onto one another and some were even sticking to each other. (The white peanuts had the most color transfer of all of them.) I had wanted to use these to decorate cupcakes, but with all of the sticking and bleeding it'll make them hard to use for that purpose. I'm sure they'll taste just fine, I'm just disappointed about the way they were handled during shipping.
These were a huge hit at my daughter's 3rd birthday party. We had an elephant/circus theme. Only downside is I should have ordered a smaller amount. We had about 30 guests.

Veri Peri Mild is delicious for those of us that love an extra kick in our sauce with great flavor too, and not so spicy!  The sauce is so versatile!  Try using it on pizza, in salad dressing, or as a marinade for meats and veggies!

You may be wondering why the price of this juice is so high.  The reason is its purity.  The label says it all: Just Cranberry.  There are many health benefits to drinking cranberry juice, but the sugar in most of the brands counteracts these benefits.  The price listed here is what my grocery store sells for 10 bottles, not the full case of 12.  So, you sort of get 2 freebies!My palette cannot tolerate this juice at full throttle.  I like to fill up my one liter bottle with filtered water and about 4 ounces of the cranberry juice twice a day.  I often add some Ginger People Ginger Juice ( 12x5 OZ) for added health benefits and better taste.

I got this almonds for my daughters wedding candy buffet and they look as beautiful as in the picture and they taste so good, there pricey but they are worth it I mixed them with ivory color almonds and it looks just stunning .Now you have to be careful with what almonds you order this are eatable theres some that they been sold cheaper and they are not eatable so be careful . Also theres some that they just have a gold wrapping . But this ones are eatable and they have the gold finish shiny coat . This are the ones if you are looking for beautiful gold almonds .Thank You
Perfect, fresh, timely delivered and delicious caviar! Thank you so much, can't wish for any better. Recommend this to everyone with no reservations.Kosher Canadian Red Salmon Caviar - Orthodox Union

I have just been told by 'back to NATURE' that this has been discontinued.We started noticing that it was disappearing from shelves all over our area about 2 months ago. We asked every place to check for availability, yet never heard anything other than it is backordered.I used 'back to NATURE' website to do the 'contact us' thing twice and never received a response.I came to Amazon while searching online and placed myself on the notify when this product becomes available list.Today I decided to try and call back to NATURE. I spoke with the person that answered the phone, she said she could help, and after discussing my difficulty finding the product she offered to 'research' and get back to me. I must note she attempted to collect quite of bit of personal information. She assured me that I could simply go back to the local groceries and ask why they were not stocking it however I insisted that it was not available anywhere nor here on Amazon so the problem was not my grocer.I wasn't quite accepting her quick 'research, get back to me, and get of the phone approach' so I asked to talk to someone else and she got me on the line with her supervisor Lizzy.After reviewing the above and being offered a 'research and get back' solution I was a bit more insistant and it was then that she said '.. that product had been discontinued due to a lack of sales and once discontinued it is inlikely that it will become available again...'. At this point I was more than just a bit disapointed and shared with her that in my local market the 'Cranberry Pecan Granola' just happened to be the only one of their granola selections that was always selling out, week after week over the last several years and I found it curious that the one selection that did appear to sell was discontinued.I guess it is only popular here!

My husband and I tried several brands of Granola as a topping for our morning yogurt. Back to Nature Cranberry Pecan was the best, by far.  Whenour local markets stopped stocking it, we went online to find sources.  Weorder six to ten bags each time. This is one product that needs noimprovement.  It is the perfect balance of crunch, chewiness, and flavor. Itmakes a small breakfast filling and satisfying enough for the entire morning.

This is one of my favorite all-time granola's- chewy and crunchy, sweet and oaty, great flavors. I think the supply must have dried up because the two providers I had been getting it from stopped offering it. Aii, the pain.
I have this cereal mixed with Kellog's K and it just adds another level for my morning healthy breakfast. It does not get soggy with the milk which is important to me.

Absolutely love thie Back to Nature Cranberry Pecan Granola.  It's awesome mixed into yogurt for a complete meal.  (Actually like the Wild Blueberry Walnut with Flax Seed even better but it's not always available.)The deal on Amazon is much better than our local grocery store price.
I've had a few of the granolas from Back to Nature and this Cranberry Pecan is one of the best ones.

column4: D. Rich "Excited by the written word"
column10: I was turned on to this granola by my sister. She lives in another state, so when I returned home, I had difficulty finding it in my area. Thank goodness for Amazon! I order this 6 at a time and I now share it with my sister. I use it to make yogurt parfaits -- fresh strawberries and blueberries with some vanilla yogurt makes the perfect breakfast or snack! Plus, it's pretty healthy and filling.

column9: Delicious but beware of the calories reported on Amazon
column10: This granola is very tasty as is another variety of Back to Nature Granola I tried - Back To Nature Chocolate Delight Granola, 12-Ounce Pouches (Pack of 6).The granola is crunchy and has a good balance of sweetness.  It is absolutely delicious with milk.  However, even though the bag says there are seven servings; there really are only three.  The nutrition informaton on Amazon is wrong - you really need to double the calories.  I almost rated this product 4 stars for misleading the consumer. Even though Amazon has a disclaimer on their site, the nutrition label (calories) is incorrect for every Back to Nature package when you compare it to the one you receive.

This seems to be a great product, and was much appreciated by my daughters.  Apparently the box is adorable.  But to send a fresh product, the sellers rely on overnight shipping.  They shipped my packages the night before the holiday, despite a big storm being predicted.  This package got there just fine; my other package was 2 days late.  Sellers were pretty accommodating though, and tried to be fair, so I still give this 4 stars.  In future, I wish they would ask which day a person would like the package to go out..

I first tried this item about a year, and a helf ago when I saw it in my local Stop and Shop supermarket.  LeRoux Creek Organic Apple Sauce, Golden, 4-Ounce, 4-Count Cups (Pack of 6)  Since I have a digestive disorder, I cannot use regular applesauce and have resorted to using only organic foods. I like the Leroux Creek organic brand very much.  It is absolutely delicious, and I wouldn't use any other brand.

My daughter enjoys cinnamon apple sauce and this one delivers! Tastes much better than the store brands loaded with high fructose corn syrup. We try hard to eat organic products as much as possible and highly recommend this product for lunches and snacks.

Wow - this stuff sells out fast -- I no sooner got an e-mail from amazon saying it was back in stock than when I went to order it, amazon said there's was only 1 left in stock so I was able to grab the last one this time ---- the same thing happens at the grocery store: they get it back in stock and it sells out right away.This has a wonderful aroma when you open the container. It's a slightly citrus smell and you can smell the spiciness of the pepper. The definite plus - and the reason I gave it 5 stars - is that there's no salt, no MSG and no added sugars. It seems most seasoning products have salt and sugar listed as some of their main ingredients - why pay an arm and a leg for salt and sugar?Mostly I use this on fish and chicken although I have used it on pork tenderloin when I'm going for a more citrus flavor for the pork. One trick I've learned is that this stuff tastes even better if you can soak or marinade it and let the dried herbs blend and come to full fruition in some sort of liquid -- my favorite is white wine. That's definitely not necessary as it's good just as good if you just shake it on top of food, but the "soaking" seems to blend the flavors really well.Ingredients contain (per 1/4 teaspoon) no calories, no fat, no salt, no protein, no carbs, no nothing. Here's what's in it as listed on the container: onion, spices (black pepper, basil, oregano, celery seed, savory, thyme, cayenne pepper, coriander, cumin, mustard, rosemary, marjoram) garlic, lemon juice powder, carrot, citric acid, lemon peel, natural lemon flavor, oil of lemon, turmeric color, chili pepper. Just so you know, there's a definite peppery flavor or taste to this.Being an old lady, I really watch my sodium intake (as well as sugar and fat)and use these types of products on a regular basis.

Today is my father's birthday. If he were alive, he would be 92. He died in 1984 from heart-related maladies. Still, one remembers one's father on his birthday, alive or not, for a loved one is always alive in memory.So why Mrs. Dash Lemon Pepper Seasoning? My father was a taste bud fanantic. No, let me re-phrase: My father wanted taste to explode on his tongue. He's one of those who shook Louisiana hot sauce (Louisiana Original Hot Sauce, 3-Ounce Bottles (Pack of 36)) or pepper sauce (Trappey's Hot Peppers in Vinegar, 4.5-Ounce Glass Bottles (Pack of 12))--I refer to the hot vinegar that preserved the hot peppers--onto all kinds of food from fried eggs to peas and beans.Many years ago when I visited for the weekend, I brought with me Mrs. Dash's Lemon Pepper. Oh my gosh! My father loved that flavor!! I left the bottle, of course. Every time I visited thereafter, there was always a bottle in his cabinet. I lived in another city at the time. My brother, who lived in the same town as my dad, told me that our father raved over that Lemon Pepper many times over the years!Bottom line: If you are seeking a great taste sensation, Mrs. Dash's Lemon Pepper may be just the thing! It satisfied the buds of a man who LOVED his food flavorful!(Note: There is no salt or MSG in Mrs. Dash's Lemon Pepper.)

I've been trying all kinds of herbs and spices in an attempt to replace my use of salt.  All the Mrs. Dash varieties are great, but I really love the lemon blend.  I use it in scrambled eggs every morning. It absolutely beats every other lemon-pepper I've tried in many years of cooking.  It's even great in soups, on buttered toast and baked potatoes, in cottage cheese, rice etc.  In addition, use in to enhance traditional chicken, fish and beef recipes.  The flavor brightens up anything you put it on, and the savings cannot be beat when you buy them in bulk, 6 bottles at a time.

Salt free, and the lemon and pepper taste are great in anything.  Mrs Dash seasonings are the best there is for salt free products, they enhance the just about anything you use them on but, the salt free lemon pepper is my favorite and I've been using it as long as it's been on the market.

I love Mrs. Dash spices, altogether! I love this one on fish and chicken, and to spice up salad dressing, both homemade and commercial (if you use Walden Farms calorie free dressing, this helps with both the flavor and the chemical taste of several of them).I always put my seasonings on about two hours before cooking if possible, and steam a lot. Also great on spinach, with Apple Cider Vinegar (the real stuff, with Mother). As the seasoning soaks in, the "bits" of vegetable swell, and make lovely surprise flavor as you eat them.Best price I've found is here at Amazon.
This dog food is wonderful. My golden is allergic to a lot of products but she is doing well on LeLamb. I received my order quickly. I am happy.

I bought this for my daughter and her husband for Christmas. They have a dairy farm and it brought smiles to their faces when they opened the box. My daughter has some health issues and even she was able to eat it. They loved it!

I mix three spoons of this in with my very picky borzoi's dry food every morning and evening, and she actually eats the entire bowl. Hallelujah! It is so hard to get my dog to eat. I feed the dry version of this food and my other dog (an akita) loves it, but my borzoi needs the wet to "tempt" her.So I recommend this product to anyone who has a picky dog. You don't need a ton of it, just a few spoons, and wa-la! Your dog will eat.

The whole department is addicted to these wonderful little treats.  The candy jar is empty by the end of the week so this is a much better option rather than the small bags I've been getting at the local pharmacy store.  The individually wrapped pieces make it a sanitary treat for everyone to grab.
Great to pass out as tokens of gratitude. Everyone smiles when they get one.They are easy to stash for a rainy day in your purse or office

column9: Superb Grains Make the Best Cereal
column10: This is the best 7-grain hot cereal blend I have eaten in my 54 years.  Better than Bob's Red Mill or Stone-Buhr brands.Easy to cook on a stove-top or a microwave, Cream of the West really shines if you soak it overnight in the saucepan water then turn on the stove in the morning.We use this to make homemade 7-grain bread. Delicious!

The 7 grain is really good, our store in Apple Valley stopped carrying this brand so we are going to order online... butaaaaa think about it, you'd have to really like something to order it online, as far as food goes, lol.Good stuff~

column9: A wonderful noodle that's hard to find in many grocery stores.
column10: This is a thicker noodle which is popular in a Polish dish I make whenever I can find them.  It's the typical Bacon, onion, sauerkraut and noodle dish served with Keilbasa(Polich Sausage).  Thank you Amazon for carrying the item.

My mother used these noodles while I was growing up. Once I moved out and half a nation away I tried to find a noodle that matched. Never could find one. These noodles are not sold in very many stores so finding them on here to order is awesome!

These are the best noodles you can buy.  They taste just like the homemade ones my Mom used to make.  No other noodle comes close to tasting homemade.  I'm glad Amazon sells them as they are hard to find in stores.

My grandmother used to make homemade noodles, rolling the dough out with a rolling pin and using a knife to cut the noodles into long strips.  I never thought I would be able to find anything close to her homemade noodles, but the Mrs. Weiss Kluski noodles sure come close.  Just be sure not to over-cook or the noodles become too soft and mushy.  Thank you, Mrs. Weiss, for bringing back memories of my grandma's kitchen!
Mrs. Weiss's Kluski noodles are the best I have ever used for my chicken soup. I highly recommend them to any cook who wants to make a difference in the consistency of noodles in a soup or casserole.
These noodle taste just like the homemade ones my grandma made.  Our local store quit ordering these, so I order online.

When I was very young, my Slovak Grandmother made homemade noodles. This is before everything was renamed "pasta". She would roll out the dough til it covered the dining room table, then roll it up into a long tube, then with a flash of her big knife, chop chop until it was a huge pile of noodles.We hung them everywhere like streamers til they dried to be put in soup.This is the only product that even comes close to her "homemades". The older women in my family swear by these, as they taste "like Mama's". I can't find these on the West Coast (home of bad noodles & snooty pasta), and in only one supermarket chain in Maryland. I love being able to purchase them ONLINE, and share them with my friends out here.Hey, Mrs Weiss, tell your kids to distribute these in California so more people can buy them!

These noodles cook up thick and chewy instead of turning to moosh. There is never a leftover noodle at our place when we serve these. Our local supermarket stopped carrying them so we were delighted to find them available here.Good with pot roast gravy, also very good with Oriental dishes you can buy frozen. Easy to eat with chopsticks.They also make great soups.

Mrs. Weiss' Kluski noodles have been around since I was a child. They don't sell them in local stores. It was easy to find on Amazon.com. I promptly ordered them so I could split the order with my Mom. This is a dumpling noodle and is used in many Polish dishes. It's so nice to have these in my pantry; especially when they arrived in a matter of days after I ordered them.

column9: The noodle is not good for me
column10: The product is not like what I expected. It tooks long time to cook and not as normal chinese noodle at all.
Excellent salsa verde, nice and chunky with a good flavor.  Has some spice, detectable to spice wimps, but not overwhelming.

I saw this advertised on TV and found it in one grocery -- ONCE.  I'm so glad to see I can get it on Amazon!  I use it for marinades, stir-frying, and any other time I think it might add a nice twist on regular soy.  I'm not sure why stores around here haven't jumped on board!
I love this soy sauce.  I had it at a sushi place in Nashville and couldn't find it any grocery store.  I was so happy to find it on Amazon.  It is great even just with plain rice.
This is a really sour product, I highly recommend this product for all you sour candy lovers!
I have such a hard time finding this stuff and I love it! So glad I could find it but the shipping was a little pricey.
This is my favorite sour candy ever!!!! Great company too!! I e-mailed them regarding the nutritional info and recieved a reply within 4 hours!!! Will buy from again in the future!!

I would say that Niederegger Marzipan of Lübeck, Germany is the global trend setter for the best quality Marzipan candy.  Only two other companies match their quality - one in Germany famous for making the "Mozartkugeln" and the other is from Denmark - Anthon Berg.  Most other Marzipan makers are certainly not bad, but they are not as good as these three.  I look forward to the day when Amazon.com will offer the standard chocolate-covered Anthon Berg Marzipan bars for sale (they come wrapped in dark pink wrappers, and totally match Niederegger in taste and quality).  They cost somewhat less than Niederegger as well.
Awesome noodles! I would recommend rinsing the noodles thoroughly before you cook them. I noticed an odd flavor when they are prepared without being rinsed.
I love Simply Organic.  This is a great item to sprinkle on your meal and your salad.  I highly recommend and the bottles are really packed, no room for settling.  You get your moneys worth.

These puffets are so amazing!!!  I discovered them while visiting family in LA, where they are carried in Whole Foods.  My daughter isn't always the best eater and she loves these.  Now at 17 months old, every time I open the freezer, she runs over and looks for the box.  If it's on a lower shelf, she yanks it out and shakes it at me, begging for me to zap one up.  They are also great for traveling.  I always pack a couple for those long flights when she won't eat anything else.  Still hoping that they get distribution in NY state Whole Foods, but I will gladly order from Amazon until then.

These puffets are great. My 1 year old just loves them, great for breakfast and a great healthy snack.  They are ready in under 2 minutes & they made my kitchen smell like fresh baked banana bread!!  I cant wait to try the other flavors!

This is my favorite of the smoothies (but the mixed berry is good, too).  Really great yogurt flavor, with a subtle peach flavor that's not overpowering.  More like a "white peach".  Absolutely delicious.

If you are looking for a great introduction to tortas - little crisps, immersed in olive oil and infused with flavors like seville orange, this product is for you. With origins in Spain, tortas are a great addition to any spread, and only need a little slice of cheese just to accent their flavor. This is going to sound like a funny serving suggestion - but, I recommend eating them with the sprinkled sugar side up. When I ate them with the sugar "tongue side" down, they had a sour aftertaste. And, while very intriguing, I preferred to taste the delicious flavor of the olive oil.
I have a 3 yr. Old Berner and a 7 month  old Entlebucher Mt. Dog. They think this is the best treat.

I began purchasing this brand at my local walmart store on the suggestion of a friend.  The lable suggests that feeding your animal this product will make their waste firmer and less frequent.  That part was certainly true. Unfortunately the ingredients in this food are shown by a variety of other websites to cause allergic reactions or worse in animals. No response has come from the company, but I was able to find an article about the RECALL of this product from national chain stores last month because of possible instances of pet death.  Don't feed this to your pet if you love them.

I was very happy to see a natural dry cat food at Walmart.  I've fed my three cats (ages 11, 6, and 5) this food for months and they all like it.  No diarrhea, no barfing, no problems.  I checked the FDA recall list and it is NOT on it.  The closest search match on the FDA site is NUTRO Natural, not the same product...

Rub is great on salmon.  Easy to use with lots of different herbs. I will try it on chicken next.

column9: Celebrating "Talk Like a Pirate Day" with a bottle of Piraat!
column10: YARRR!!! Ya lily livered land lubber!! Today is "Talk Like a Pirate Day"!  What better way to celebrate the 10th anniversary of this international holiday, than with a nice bottle of Piraat Belgian ale?  Lauded by the 'Guide to Belgian Ales' as "[O]ne of the top five ales of the world," Piraat is an opaque triple golden ale with a 10.5% ABV.  It has a full bodied "Belgian" flavor and a noticably hoppy finish.  Unfortunately, in my area of the world, this ale is generally $3 to $4 more expensive than other comparable Belgian ales.  Thus, I don't purchase this one all that often.  However, seeing as this is a special day, I made an exception.  At 10.5% ABV, this ale really has a kick... If I drink anymore, I might start makin' people walk the plank an' scrub the poopdeck!Happy "Talk Like a Pirate Day"!

column9: Just like you made them yourself
column10: These are the best if you like the kind of seeds you make yourself during Halloween.  If you like the white ones that you find at the gas station stores you won't like these.  They taste fresh out of the oven, brown and lightly salted.  These are by far the best I've ever had.

I had just gotten home from my weekly bowling league to find my fiancee in bed with our neighbor.  You know how they say that a mother has so much adrenaline pumping through her system when her child is in danger that she can just about lift a car off of it?  When I saw those two desecrating my queen-sized air mattress in the corner, I got so worked up that I could have taken that mother and her child, locked them up in the trunk of that car, and tossed it onto the roof of of the self-storage facility around the corner, the one with the orange hangar-style doors.  That's three stories high.  Anyway, the two fled out the back door and I went into a rage.  I broke everything in the house that reminded me of her.  The toaster-oven she used to make me pepperoni bagel-bites for breakfast each morning, the ironing board that we trimmed the legs down on so that it could double as a coffee table during that Pawn Stars marathon last July.  After about 45 minutes, I was totally drained from breaking stuff.  I took the truck down the road to the Citgo station to refuel and got a sleeve of those mini-powdered donuts and a Redbull Zero because my doctor says that too much sugar will make my Diabetes flare up.  It's a lot less syrupy than the regular Redbulls, but it definitely perked me back up.  On the way home, that Mr. Mister song about Broken Wings came on and I knew it was a sign because my heart was broken and Redbull gives you wings.  At that point, I knew I had to forgive her.  We've been happily married for 8-months now with a little one on the way, and I can honestly say that without Redbull Zero, I may have never gotten up the courage to patch things up.  I highly recommend this product to anyone going through a rough patch in their relationship.
I love dried fruit, and these apricots are some of the best I have ever had. Moist, favorful and of the best quality.

I order this pearl sugar to make liege waffle.I looked up other Belgian pearl sugar too but it was way to big granulate.This sugar has just right size and amount for my waffle.I definitely will order again later when I need it.

column9: Harves of creamy spices and flavors
column10: Mayonnaise is an interesting product, cool, smooth and creamy it's the lush counter partner of the low cal mustard but it's of those things people think they don't like until they taste it in the proper way and that's all it takes for a secret love affair with luxe sauces  and recipes that can be made with it to start.I am a big fan of sandwiches and any new way I can spruce them up, especially with nice sauces and spices is always at the top of my new ideas to make for lunch or to fill into an interesting menu on the weekends. The Rouille is spicy, that I deducted just from looking at the angry orange color in the jar, the color of auburn harvest on a stormy night. The taste is of cream immersed in a sea of chili peppers and garlic with a peppery background. My favorite way to eat it is in a sandwich with a leftover cold coconut breaded chicken cutlet with some crisp romaine in between two toasted crusty slices of bread smeared on the inner sides with the Rouille spicy mayonnaise . The taste is a tropical rendition of a Caesar Chicken Sandwich I get at Hale and Hearty here in NYC but much easier since I made it at home and it took no effort.Great on bread, meat or as a condiment to any afternoon snack or smeared on some California roll for a spicy finish. There is no end to the amount of uses this product provides.- Kasia S.

column9: Perfect for Popsicles and Italian Ices
column10: Barry Farms is known for their quality and rare, hard-to-find ingredients. Xanthan Gum is no exception, but anything can be found on Amazon, right? Barry Farms to the rescue!Xanthan Gum is used to modify the viscosity of liquids, on a very low scale (typically 1/3 tsp per 1 gallon). Because of the difficulty in combining Xanthan Gum to a liquid evenly, you should mix this into your liquid very slowly, in a blender at full speed, and it should be one of your steps (before adding other ingredients, including Guar Gum).Many ice creams and popsicles, even Italian ices, call for two main ingredients: Xanthan Gum and sometimes Guar Gum (also available from Barry Farms: http://www.amazon.com/gp/product/B00015UC5M?tag=a52-20&ie=UTF8). Both of these gums behave quite differently, and Xanthan Gum can be harder to mix into your liquid solution (again, mix in slowly via blender running on high), but both are effective means to preventing crystallization of liquids, which is the secret to making softer ice cream and popsicles instead of rock hard ice!Another interesting characteristic of Xanthan Gum is its ability to thin out when subjected to forces such as shaking (called shearing), which makes it great for poured sauces, as it will thicken back up after having exited the bottle. It can also prevent oils from separating from liquid-oil emulsions (think salad dressing). It is also more stable under a wider range of temperatures and pH than other gums.Xanthan Gum can also be used to give dough the stickiness that is needed in gluten-free baking, as gluten is usually what gives that sticky characteristic to dough. And no matter the use, Xanthan Gum will always remain colorless and flavorless, so it can be used for just about any need that suits it.

Here's the short rundown on my take:The lime margarita mixes (both the original and the Key Lime) are fantastic - both blended with ice and on the rocks they hold their own with any Margarita mix I've tried. I prefer the original since it's a little more "tart" the way I think a lime margarita should be in my book. For folks here that complain about it being too limey they may want to try the key lime - it's a little milder.The strawberry margarita mix was ok - a bit sweet for my taste but to be fair I'm not really that big of a strawberry margarita guy to begin with.The Pina Colata mix was very good and even my wife liked that one as well and she _never_ partakes in cocktails with me. Note that there are around 4 carbs per serving with this instead of the usual zero for the rest of their mixers. The coconut cream in the mix has a few carbs - but totally worth it. Creamy and smooth blended with ice in a good blender. Very nice.The mojito mix is decent. I can make a pretty passable sugar free mojito myself but this is pretty good. I probably wont bother to stock up on it because it's not a must have mixer for me.All the martini mixes were just awful in my book. Other folks seem to like them, maybe it's just not my thing.  The apple and cranberry tasted like medicine to me and I promptly tossed the rest of the bottles after the first taste. The lemon was pretty poor and I gave it a couple shots before throwing the rest out.I didn't care for the hurricane mix and tossed the rest - but again, to be fair I'm not really a hurricane fan to begin with so I'm not necessarily a good judge on this one.The sweet and sour mix made a nice whiskey sour. Not the best I've had by any stretch but perfectly servicible in my book.Finally the Mai Tai was pretty good - Not my favorite drink in the world but this was as good as any I'd had.So they're batting around .500 give or take. Definitely worth picking up a few bottles and testing out - I think some folks that are skeptical, particularly about the margaritas and pina colatas will be pleasantly surprised.

column9: Decent, but super strong and acidic
column10: You have to cut this down with Sprite Zero or water (Sprite Zero preferably), because it's SO strong - super limey and acidic.  Better than the Finest Call Carb conscious (which has sugar alcohol in it and makes you feel kinda sick), but not better tasting.

In principle a Splenda Margarita mix sounded like a great idea. The execution was terrible. I poured both of my two bottles down the drain. You would have to be pretty desparate, or otherwise never have had a decent margarita if this was your choice. I would rather skip altogether, as one of the other reviewers had suggested as well. The market has a long way to go to support less sugar in drinks.

column9: Baja Bob's Drink Mixes - DON'T BOTHER
column10: I would be the first to applaud these products if they were good.  Unfortunately, I would rather give up drinking that have to drink this tasteless slop.  There is a very nasty, artificial acrid, too citrusy, while at the same time too sweet, taste to these products. The strawberry margherita mix has a very faint taste of strawberry, but no amount of doctoring could make it drinkable.  I poured the mix out.  The Mai Tai mix -- poured it out.  I bought several bottle/dry drink mixes of all their varieties without trying them first.  BIG MISTAKE!  I am either going to pour them out or throw them out, since the folks at Baja Bob's web site have refused to even respond to my request that I return the unopened products for a refund.  You will also note that on their web site's "fan club" page, there are 0 entries.  Save your money unless you are totally desperate.  You'd be better off using Crystal Light Ruby Red Grapefruit.  Now, that tastes pretty good mixed with Vodka.

I think Baja Bob's is terrific!  I took another reviewer's advice and added a little Triple Sec to the Tequila and mix and it was fabulous.  Surely, anyone who is ordering this has tasted diet drinks before.  If you are used to drinking only drinks with real sugar, you might not like it.  It is perfect for anyone who is trying to cut back on their carbs and still wants a Margarita.  THANK YOU BOB!!
I gave the Pina Colada mix one star because it was pretty bad, but the citrus ones I find to be quite drinkable.

I'm not sure what the people expect who do not like this product.  I use this as well as the OTB 0 calorie mix you can buy at grocery store and I think they are both great.  I love the margarita but had all the calories.  Give it a try and you will not be sorry!

Although not stated in the ingredients, it has a subtle yet definitive taste of cumin. I assume it is in the mix they call spices. I think it's brilliant. A full flavor sauce that goes with everything. Has a fair amount of heat.

I've been drinking Yellow Label Tea since the 80's. This is an excellent and versitile tea, makes for a good hot tea and also a refreshing iced tea. A bit stronger than regular "brisk lipton" tea typically found in the U.S. I used to have to wait until I traveled to the British Virgin Islands or the Bahamas to find this tea, but now it's on Amazon (darn, my excuses to travel are dwindling!). This is an Orange Pekoe tea in 200g bags. You can find different varieties of tea marked with the "Lipton Yellow Label" brand, usually loose leaf teas. For instance I have a Sri Lanka-packed metal tin of "Pure Ceylon," a box of "Coarse Black Tea" packed in Mumbai, and another "new bright & rich" Mumbai variety which is a blend of "Assam teas." These other varieties can be found in middle eastern, Indian, and Asian markets here in the US. All good teas, but this Orange Pekoe in the bags is the most convenient and has the smoothest flavour.

column9: Why this isn't a common US tea is beyond me.
column10: Traveling world wide, I've come to much prefer good tea to bad coffee, and good teas are so much more common.Yellow Label is one of the most popular teas in the world because it has a rich, clean flavor without bitterness.  Its clear distinctive red color makes it also one of the prettiest.  The only supermarket teas I've found in the US that taste similar are the "English Breakfast" labels.  If you like these, or like strong black tea flavor without the bitterness or muddiness of overbrewing the usual black teas, you should try Yellow Label.

I first enjoyed Yellow Label in the Caribbean 20 yrs ago and have since in travels worldwide been looked at oddly at groceries as I purchased 20 boxes to take home. There it was only tea, in the US it wasn't available...or oddly in London which appears on the label.  A letter to Lipton 6 years ago gave no explanation for not marketing in the US, just "coupons to try our other brands".  Finally, Amazon has it and even better a market in Chinatown here in NYC.What makes it great?  It's the only black tea that is full flavored but not bitter.  It's so smooth that you literally can make a pot of it, leave the bags in, reheat it the next day and still have no bitterness.  This is a tea lover's tea that I have turned numerous travel companions onto for life and something I would be lost without.

I was first given a box of this Yellow Label from a co-worker who had traveled to China.  I instantly fell in love with the smooth flavor.  I found it in a Food Max in Stockton, Ca but then the store closed down.  I have been on a search for the last two months because my loose leaf is almost gone also.  I was brewing the tea for the staff in my office and they all love it, so when I ran out of tea bags they all wanted to know where I got the tea from.  The flavor is so smooth that you almost do not need any type of sweetner at all.  This should be made available in the states in at least one major grocery store.  I am buying enough to share with my friends.....

column9: Even if you don't like tea . . .
column10: . . . you'll love this one. I fell in love with this black tea blend when I lived in Europe, and was disappointed when I returned to America that I couldn't buy it here. One taste of this smooth tea and you might change from coffee. It's the best cup of tea you'll ever drink.
It has a distinct taste that differs from the regular Lipton. I wish it were more readily available in the stores in US.

I drink lots of hot tea. Don't confuse this with the Lipton Tea you find at the grocery. There is no comparison. This is the good stuff. I bought this at a local farmers market(Atlanta) and since they closed, no one else carries it, so I ordered it from Amazon. Specify "Yellow Label Tea".

column9: Does not taste like Lipton Yellow Label tea sold in Italy, possibly stale, no expiration date on pkg.
column10: This is a repeat of the same review I left for another Amazon listing for the same tea (but at a significantly different price).  Despite the price difference, both listings appear to be for the same item and are sold by the same Indian Grocery.  From reading the other reviews, it is clear that at least one other customer had the same bad experience as I did.I was initially excited to find Lipton Yellow Label Tea on Amazon, as I just got back from Italy and fell in love with it there.  The Lipton Yellow Label Tea in Italy doesn't taste anything like the weak, poor-quality Lipton we get in the U.S., but the tea I ordered on Amazon (sold by Simply Beautiful) is actually manufactured for India and tastes bitter and/or stale.  You can't see from the photo, but the writing on the packages I received is not in English and says it was manufactured in Canada for India.  It is hard to tell whether the variety sold in India just tastes different than the kind in Italy, or if the tea was in fact stale, because there is NO sell-by or expiration date on the package (very disturbing), and the bags are NOT "foil-wrapped for freshness" as described on Amazon.  I was extremely disappointed in the taste of this tea from India, having looked forward to the lovely, full-bodied Lipton Yellow Label tea bags that I brought home from Italy.  Not to mention the fact that I would never want to buy imported groceries that don't have an expiration date, so there is no way to know how long they've been sitting in the warehouse, if they are stale, or when they will go stale after opening (especially since they are not individually wrapped).  I returned both boxes of tea and hope to get an Amazon refund soon.  I am very bummed.

The Lipton Yellow Label tea is a step above the "regular" Lipton sold here in the States. This is your basic, everyday black tea but it is much more flavorful and bolder than the Lipton variety sold in supermarkets here. It brews a good, bracing cup of tea. I recommend it over the supermarket variety any day. I have used this to make iced tea as well and while it's good over ice, it is best served hot.

I recv'd this tea in great condition. The packing and timeliness were great. I love this tea. It takes me back to when I had our son in an Italian hospital near Pisa, Italy. They brought me Lipton Yellow Label Tea. That was many years ago and I never forgot how good it tasted or stopped looking to buy more once we left Europe. Hubby and I were talking about it and I thought of Amazon! It was right here. I'm enjoying it in the afternoon for a pick me up! Good stuff!

I must echo the praise of Lipton Yellow Label tea.I don't know how this label may differ across countries, but recently I spent several month-long trips to Pakistan, where Lipton Yellow Label is pretty much all the black tea they serve, and tea is served all the time.  After getting around the initial shock of their custom of putting up to four teabags into 16 ounces of water there, I came to like the Yellow Label tea.  Then when switching a few times to Twinings tea at the hotel business center, I realized that Yellow Label is much better than all the tea I'd been drinking heretofore.  Comparing Yellow Label to other Litpons, other tea available in America, and even Twinings, which I considered the top of the heap, Yellow Label was clearly better.  A Pakistani friend who travels to the U.S. says that American tea is "insipid" and refuses to drink it.  I now agree, and think that Lipton Yellow Tea is the best tea I have ever had.  Now I've got to figure out where to buy it.  As far as I'm concerned, Yellow Label is the tea most worth drinking, which no doubt accounts for its popularity in Pakistan.
I discovered yellow tea while on vacation in Thialand. I drink it daily now instead of coffee.  In the summer, it makes a great sun tea.

This is a brand of orange pekoe black tea that is drunk all over the world. Lipton sells it in many countries, and while the product might have the same smooth, almost inoffensive base note, to me the UK version tastes very different than the Indian version, which is perceptable stronger and has a more "citrusy" note. While it doesn't hold up to some premium orange pekoe teas, it is distinctly better than the Lipton tea available in US supermarkets.

column9: A great tea by Lipton. Just as in France.
column10: My wife loves this tea, so I was pleased to be able to order it for her so easily in North America. It arrived promptly, and in good condition.
The company did do a refund for the tea. It looks the same as the box that comes from London. However, it is produced in India and has a very strong, almost bitter taste.
I first had this tea in Egypt.  It is so superior to the Lipton sold in the states that I was grateful to find a source online.

column9: Better than US marketed Lipton Brisk tea
column10: Discovered Yellow Label while on a trip to Japan.  I had arrived in Nagoya for a meeting, and had time to  wonder around a market...really just rubber-necking.I bought the familiar Lipton label as well as several other teas.  Yellow Label has a little more pronounced flavor than the US marketed Brisk Lipton tea.  If you are a tea drinker, you will probably enjoy the flavor. The worst part of brewing and drinking Yellow Label...trying to get rid of the box of US standard Lipton Brisk tea I already have sitting in the pantry.

I've been buying primarily whole leaf, oolong, pu'er, jasmine teas from a wholesale tea market in Beijing (Malian St). Though the price is far cheaper than the Ten  Fu (Ten Ren) teas and other retailers, the discernment in quality seemed questionable. I am a simpleton concerning tea. So rather than purchase $90/kg for the base Assam tea, I went to Carre4 and bought an under $5/box of Lipton Yellow label Black tea 100 bags for the consistant quality.

After running out of my usual every-day tea, Trader Joe's brand of "Irish Breakfast Tea," I found this Yellow Label first at my local Chinese supermarket in the tea aisle. I had only had the "brisk" version before and wasn't such a Lipton fan, but I needed tea and bought it.Contrary to the rather dusty, mild (watery??) taste of the "brisk" American version, Yellow Label has a good flavor and no bitterness, even when brewing for 6 min (I brew a small pot with three bags in the morning). Not quite as rich as Assam tea when mixed with milk and sugar, but a good substitute. And you can't beat the price. A very nice, full every-day tea.
This is the perfect maple sugar candy...melts in your mouth. The price was also extremely fair. I would buy this again, and recommend it to my friends.
I found Lysanders product while waiting for steaks to be cut on South Padre Island.  Really a great product line, not just the chicken rub.  Check out the other seasonings as well.

I have been using this rub for a few years now it is wonderful on chicken (not to mention no msg and all natural).I usually just cut up a whole organic bird and sprinkle it on evenly bake for 30 minutes and it comesout delicious every time (I do spray it with oil during the bake to keep it moist and crisp).All of my kids love it they ask for the "good chicken"all the time.  It is how I got them off only fried. My local store didn't have it in stockso I came here. have to have it.

We like the pop-top lid on the canned foods eliminating the can opener wrestling match and test of dexterity. Opening the can of Artemis, one sees a solid dog food, light in color with bits of foods like carrots, peas, and potatoes readily visible.Our three pooches like Artemis and  their parents do also. The ingredient list is commendable with no fillers and none of those horrendous animal scraps found in cheaper dog foods. Mostly I like seeing the inclusion of potatoes in the mix. We like the density of the canned food; those runny canned products with high liquid content tend to dirty and stain the canine whiskers and beard. One user of Artemis commented that her dog had much less gas and fewer stools. I'll have to monitor our girls more closely to see if this is the case with them. I do notice a welcome firmness in Evie's stools though. If you're looking to try a premium pet food, give Artemis a try.More reasons to try Artemis -Natural DHASuperior grade protein (human grade)Multi protein sourceSelect vegetables and fruitsCustom vitamin and mineral packageBalanced level of omega 3 & 6Probiotic/prebioticSkin and coat conditionersNatural - contains no added chemicals, preservatives, artificial additives, or by-products.No wheat or cornGuarantee- Artemis guarantees your pet will thrive and be satisfied or 100% money back.
Usually when you buy a duo of oils, one is usually way better than the other but both are pretty good.  I've had slightly better black truffle oil at this price but I thought the white was very good.

column9: Great tea and an even better bargain
column10: I'm a lifetime fan of Lipton tea so, there was no risk in this purchase for me.  A 20 count box of Lipton green tea bags is $2.99 at the local Kmart which makes the 240 bags in this box, a $36 retail value, a steal at $20.  The only negative in this review is that once brewed, the tea looks nothing like a green tea.  Instead, it has a nice golden brown appearance like the normal Lipton product.  I bought a bottle of Lipton diet green tea as a comparison and found the 1.5 liter bottle to be good, but too sweet for my taste.  Instead, 6 tea bags and four packets of splenda make the same amount of tea, but much more palatable.  At six bags per bottle, I can make forty bottles of a tea that was about $2 retail for just $20.  If you're intent on having a tea that is a pale light green then this product is not for you.  However, it's a good value, if not exactly the product being advertised.
I have used this product for a long time as Lipton has always been a trusted brand.  I do go through A LOT of tea, so buying it on Amazon was quick, and more affordable then other stores.

My husband drinks a lot of green tea, and this is one of our preferred brands.  I also appreciate that the tea is naturally decaffeinated.  He drinks probably up to half a gallon of tea a day, and I appreciate that he doesn't have a large caffeine intake.

I am so happy I switched from coffee to Lipton Decaff Green Tea.Coffee had been giving me an acid build up which is secreted through my skin, causing burning rashes.Not that I don't love coffee, but the Lipton Decaff Green, of which I drink sometimes 2 pots a day,causes no acid build up. So join the happy tea drinkers. GO GREEN!!!!AMAZON HAS THE LOWEST PRICE ON THIS ITEM......BELIEVE IT!!!!

column9: Lipton Green Tea, Decaffeinated, Tea Bags, 40-Count Boxes (Pack of 6)
column10: Packed well with other purchases. Free shipping, too. Great quality product. Fresh, tasty, healthy. Hot or iced. Will purchase again!
I like green tea, especially when I'm sick, and this did the trick. I think Lipton is the best Green Tea. Fast delivery, as promised.

column9: Easy on the stomach and doesn't keep you awake
column10: Let it be said that I am one who absolutely LOVES my coffee, perhaps a little too much, because for awhile I was drinking about a whole pot (!) a day by myself.It was when I got a stomach ulcer though that I was forced by my doctor to severely cut down on my intake of coffee permanently.  I still enjoy 2-3 small cups a day but no more.Thank heavens Lipton Decaffeinated Green Tea was there to come to the rescue in my case for the desire to drink more beyond that.  I am a huge music fan and am usually listening to my vast CD collection when not at work and seem to always want a hot, soothing beverage to sip to pass the hours by as I listen.  Lipton Green Tea is great for that.  It's extremely easy to make, good for you, naturally decaffeinated and has that clean, pure taste that all Lipton tea has come to be known for.  I think I'm hooked for life on buying the 40-packet boxes at my local store and highly recommend it to those like me wishing to cut down on or even completely eliminate their daily dose of traditional caffeinated coffee.

Getting this product through Amazon has been a pleasure.  The pricing is better than typical retail and it's delivered to my front door free of charge.  I selected to get it sent to me once a month and I can still monitor it and make any changes if necessary.  Again, highly recommended.
No problems. Delivered promptly. . .But I wish i could have the equivalent in bulk, to save money, as I am an avid user of decaffeinated green tea and this habit runs into money.

column9: Average - good value when Amazon offers Lipton on sale
column10: We combine with decaf Large Lipton Ice Tea Bags to make iced tea.  Good value on Amazon when special (happens aboug 2x per year) on Lipton purchases $15-$20 off.  We drink a lot of iced tea in Florida so quantity is no issue for us.  Besides keeps fresh until you open the package.

column9: Very nice tea, like the caffeine free!
column10: I use this tea quite a bit.  It's good hot and cold, makes great iced green tea, and you don't have to worry about the caffeine.
I have tried other green teas, but always come back to Lipton as it has the taste I most prefer.

I have become a Decaf Green Tea addict.  Green tea is so good for you and since I cannot stand caffinated drinks this decaf green tea is perfect.  I have to go easy on coffee as it contains too much caffine even in the decaf kind.  This green tea has really helped with my blood pressure and I found out the caffine can cause it to rise.  As long as I stay off too much salt in the diet and decaf, low fat I have been able to stay off medication for high blood pressure.  I can keep that steady with the decaf green tea, this was a bargain for a case lot.  Having the shipping free and delivery in two days it is a saving all around.

Lipton Decaffeinated Green Tea is the perfect thing to drink when you want a soothing hot or cold iced beverage. It works wonders to combat laryngitis as well. The tea bags contain decaffeinated tea which means you'll never lose a night's sleep from drinking this! SMILEMoreover, there are no additives nor are there preservatives. You can use these tea bags a very long time after you bought them in a store or here at Amazon.com online. Amazon states that this tea has antioxidants and in fact it does--but the antioxidants are in the form of flavonoids which are all natural antioxidants. Some evidence suggests that flavonoids reduce the risk for coronary heart disease at the same time that they lower your risk of several types of cancers. Tea flavonoids can also improve your body's immune system.I normally find this green tea most useful for those nasty winter months when I inevitably catch a miserable cold. I heat the water until it's almost at a boiling point; then I put the water and the tea bag into my cup. I let it steep for a few minutes before I add milk and one packet of "sweet and low." It's absolutely delicious!Overall, this is a fine quality green tea that will not over stimulate you with caffeine. It is an aromatic hot beverage for when you have a cold and it also makes a delicious iced tea drink on a baking--hot summer's day. Pick some up and try it--you will not be disappointed.SMILE

column9: Great Green Tea, but how many bags are in this order...
column10: I really like this green tea. I find it to be much better than the other brand. I add a little lemon and splenda to mine and enjoy it hot or cold.What I wonder is if it is 6/40 count boxes like the title reads or 6/20 count boxes which is in the description??? Hmmm.....If it is 40 counters then this is a great deal.
This is a good alternative to caffeine.  I like the taste of it.Lipton Green Tea, Decaffeinated, Tea Bags, 40-Count Boxes (Pack of 6)

I work with fondant a lot and I use to buy just white then color it, but that takes a lot of time, is messy, and the colors always turn out different. I discovered Fondarific and I love it!! They have tons of different colors and different flavors. The taste of this is good, the only problem I have is the color is a little darker than I would have liked and when I mix it with white for a lighter purple color it looks more pinkish purple than true purple.
Initially I did not like the color, but once I kneaded it, it was fine.  Good flavor.  Item was shipped as expected.

column9: Best Fondant EVER! Great for Newbies!
column10: Easy yummy fondant. great for beginners! i love this fondant! wonderful color.. always makes great cakes!  I have used on several cakes. Even the Justin Beiber Cake!
I absolutely love fodarific. This is the third one I've bought and I will continue to buy. It taste really good, and is so easy to work with! Definitely worth the money. Thanks!!
This product made my poor dog sick! I never seen her so sick before. I DO NOT recommend this product at all!
I get the raw seeds to use in homemade granola -- so the seeds don't over-toast -- and I found this brand of excellent quality -- a good value too.
I had no idea that totally "organic" could mean totally "tasteless." The best thing that these can be used for is in cooking oriental dishes or making salads.
thought i would try these new hansen beverages in island blast smoothie;worth the trial! So yummy I have everyone at work wanting some
Rich garlic flavor.  This is why I ordered it and I am not disappointed!  Generous amount provides enough to last awhile.
This is the best mochi i have had so far! It was very fresh and tasted amazing and it shipped super fast!

I just received my shipment of this mochi yesterday and it tasted weird, not good at all. For clarification, I got the red bean and it comes with six in the package (I couldn't find anywhere how many were inside). I ate the first one, didn't like it, tried another and then threw the rest away. I'll stick to my Kohaku kind, just figured I would try out another brand now I know better.

I was disappointed because it was not like mochi that I have had (and enjoyed) in the past.  The rice cake and bean paste were of about the same consistency, and about equally sweet.  And it didn't have the nice flavor of either the rice cake or the bean paste.

I didn't get these to gross out my family or friends; just curious about the environmental and nutritional advantages Entomophagy.  These should eradicate the fear instilled into me by society and pesticide companies :-DI think I got an expired sampler pack because they tasted rancid and the added flavors are indistinguishable between each of the packs (bland).
