Purchase Pacific Rice milk.

Not only is this tea good tasting, but it works great as a laxative.  I don't drink this tea every day, but only when I need to restore regularity when I travel.  I always bring a few convenient to pack tea bags with me when I expect to be out of town for more than a few days.

I bought this tea as a way of helping to regulate my system and perform a cleanse. Wow, this tea is gentle, and certainly does the trick. I highly recommend to anyone wanting to perform a cleanse, and enjoys the taste of chamomile tea.

This is an excellent tea, I use to use another brand but it caused my stomach to ache and have several loose bowel movement, with smooth move i have a normal soft free of pain move without the diarrhea and the stomach ache. This is a good product especially if you have hemorrhoids .
This extract has a very strong alcohol aroma, so much so that it is difficult to discern any pistachio flavor. You might as well use a liquer instead- you'd probably get a better flavor.

These are nice and at $28, a good value.  They taste yummy and are pretty satisfying.  They're vegan, preservative free, and have only a half gram of monounsaturated fat each.  My only issue is that the calories are a bit high and the nutrients a bit low.  Each (appx) 5x3" cracker is 70 calories and has only 2 grams of fiber.  Aside from phosphorous and magnesium (6 and 4% RDA respectively) the only health benefit is 2 grams each of protein and iron.  For a cracker, they are pretty filling but it's still easy to go through a LOT of calories in a short time.  With a thick, no-sugar spread a couple of these would probably suffice for a heavy breakfast or light lunch.

column9: Fruit Crunch is better - in my opinion
column10: I've been a Ryvita fan for a number of years, and the Fruit Crunch version is my favorite. They are just sweet enough to satisfy my sweet tooth (and keep me from making a disasterous vending machine raid) and filling enough so that I can get by eating 1 or 2. I don't need any spreads or goop on the cracker....they are fine without. Anyway, I thought I'd try these Fruit & Seed Crunch crackers since amazon had a Friday promotion. The currants are much smaller and not even obvious vs larger pieces in the Fruit Crunch that add some pleasant chewiness. The seeds aren't plentiful...these taste more like a sweetened rye cracker. If given the choice, I'd still choose Fruit Crunch over Fruit & Seed Crunch.

column9: Are these supposed to be blackened?
column10: Not what I expected, nothing like the illustration on the package.  I have enjoyed Ryvita products previously, but will not purchase this item again. Two seeds and one raisin per brick of corrugated meal do not make the pain of eating one of these worthwhile. Food should not break into shards and try to stab you. Also, the image suggests that the product is toasty golden.  No evidence given of fireblasted blowtorch charring. Tag suggestions: good god I can't feel the roof of my mouth.

My local store has not carried this flavor is years.There is a subtle hint of sweetness which I cannotcompare to anything else available at my localstores.  I consider this a real treat and I'm gladto have it available to me.

column9: and our mice love it too
column10: Not only pretty tasty for humans but, after mice in our basement found their way inside a stored box, I discovered they are the ideal bait (in crushed form) for a humane mouse trap. Six and counting in two days.

These are awesome!! Whole grain, sweet, but not much sugar. So as a diabetic, I am happy, happy, happy.A friend (not a diabetic) had one, then two, then three. He begged to buy a box from my secret stash as even in Seattle I can't seem to find a store that stocks them as regular merchandise. They are perfect to pack for a day trip, a late night snack, or any other time something crunchy seems appropriate. Yummmm!

column9: At least you "feel" like you are eating something healthy
column10: My first taste and I was disappointed.  I and a daughter have gone through 4 boxes at this point and this is what I've found:Taste is like those huge pillows of shredded wheat cereal pounded down into a hard, thick crackery crispbread.  Not even close to the amount of seeds in the picture and maybe 1 or 2 currants per crispbread.  The added brown sugar gives it the allusion of being sweetened with currants when they are so "absent" that the sweetness is definitely the sugar.  I've found 1, possibly 2 currants per cracker.  Needed at least a tiny bit of sodium as is lacking in taste.  It's much more blackened..much...than the picture which I suppose hides the fact it has very few seeds.It tastes best microwaved for about 15 to 20 seconds then covered with a thin layer of cream cheese.  Doing this makes it a tasty treat.  But then covering anything in cream cheese makes it a tasty treat.  Not enough nutritional value and taste for me to purchase something so odd like this again, unfortunately.
Although these are yummy, I have guilt about the brown sugar in them. Not actually necessary, and they do have wheat flour whereas regular or multigrain Ryevita just has Rye flour in them.

column9: Great snack food, took a chance and I am very happy I did.
column10: What a find!  these crackers, I mean crispbreads, are great.  My boys love them as they have just enough fruit and nuts to add a more spalsh of flavor but not so much to overwhelm the taste buds. We have already gone through two boxes, and that was in a week.  I hope Amazon gets more of their flavors.

These crackers are quite unique.  Interesting that they are called "Fruit and Seed Crunch," because the only fruit in the product is 14% currants, which adds a bit of a tang to the taste, nothing else.  As a Vegan treat, these are quite satisfying.  I smear some peanut butter on two; and that's breakfast.Imported from Great Britain, these crackers are made with whole grain rye and wheat flour and then lightly dusted with pumpkin and sunflower seeds.  Honestly, one of these things is quite filling.  The fiber content is good, too.As part of a healthy diet plan, these crackers are excellent.  Substitute these for bread and see how you like it!
They make me think of what Styrofoam would taste like with seeds and raisins.  But I guess they are a good choice if you are desperate for a healthy snack.
absolute right choice for me! I feel so good with the texture of fiber and pure flavor from seed!
I love the product.  The case I received had short dates, Jan 2013.  Inquire before you order. I'm not sure how easy this would be to do.

This is an excellent choice for a morning meal or an afternoon snack.  I was pleasantly surprised with the sweetness from the fruit in it.  The best benefit is the fiber!  Here is something that tastes great & you still get the nutrition.Ryvita Fruit and Seed Crunch Crispbreads, 7-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 10)

I love these! I actually don't care for any other flavors of crispbreads, but these make a really nice snack just on their own. I am not a health nut by any means, but these are a great alternative to reaching for typical sweets or snack foods when you need an afternoon snack.
These crackers are so good and good for you!  peanut butter is good on them too! With the sweet of the fruit and crunch it satisfies.
I was at my friend's house in Syracuse. I bought these crackers in Wegmans. I loved them, but Hannaford at home doesn't have them so ordered from Amazon. Now all my friends love 'em too!

column9: The Taste is Not the Same
column10: I don't know what the maker of this wonderful cracker has done to these crackers but the taste is not the same. It's not as good. When I take the first bite, it tastes bland. I believe they have eliminated the amount of currents they previous put in them. Ryvita Fruit and Seed Crunch Crispbreads, 7-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 10) They are still a wonderful source of fiber and you can still fill the sweet tooth void but there is something missing or "not enough of" which is lacking in the cracker.Thank you.Anita Shahda

Not sure why I can never find this flavor in the grocery stores (none!) RYVITA makes delicious crackers, but this one takes the prize. Spread creamy goat cheese or cream cheese on it and your in heaven.
Just sweet enough to be a snack and satisfying enough that I don't need to eat half the box to feel satisfied. No guilt here.I'll definitely buy these again!

As a nutritionist and author,I was always looking for a quality cracker, one with fiber and flavor.  Ryvita Fruit Crunch is it! I've been recommending this cracker to my clients forever, and was shocked to learn that recently they were no longer carried in supermarkets.  Thank goodness for Amazon!  I bought a pack of ten boxes and have been giving them to my clients --and of course keeping some for myself.  Remember that two crackers is the equivalent of having a slice of bread when you have them with perhaps a cup of tomato soup, an ounce of cheese and a little salad for lunch or dinner.

column9: Best damned fiber crackers in the supermarket
column10: Ryvita Fruit and Seed Crunch crispbreads are not too sweet but not so dry and dissicated that you want to smother it in peanut butter (although they taste great with PB!!!).  I eat these straight up as a snack at work or with a morning cup of coffee/tea.  Just the right amount of crunch and sweet.  Lots of fiber and lower in carbs than many others.  Can not beat these crunchy crackers.

I love this product and was thrilled to see if offered as a subscription.  It makes a great snack just by itself or a light meal with your favorite nut butter or cheese.  For those of you who use Weight Watcher points 2 crispbreads=1 very filling point

column9: Looks NOTHING like the box picture!! No seeds or goodies on cracker!
column10: I can't stand false advertising >:-(The crackers are two mostly plain solid layers with stuff in between. I think there may be some seedy and fruity things inside, in between the layers...not really consistent fruit 'filling', but just randomly distributed small fruit/seed bits. Cracker tastes good when your bite happens to catch a fruit thing, but that happens like 3x per a cracker.  (Each cracker is the size of a regular index card.)Basically, CRACKERS ARE NOT SINGLE LAYER COVERED BY TONS OF SEEDS AND FRUIT BITS like you see in the picture!!!  Don't expect that!With that said, they weren't that bad.  NOT sweet (unfortunately), and taste kinda fibery.  Pretty regular dry healthy crackers.  They are not filling, unless you tend to be filled up by index-card sizes of crispy dry whole wheat bread.  But they may help curb your appetite for a short while?I enjoyed them of cheese and honey on top :-) Yummy.Summary:- cracker= 2plain layers with very little fruit/seed bits in between- feels healthy- tastes okay.
I thought the addition of fruits & nuts would soften the cracker & not be as tough as most of all the other Ryvita "crispbreads", but ney!They're crispbread for horses!

column9: Hamster food in disguise!  No thanks
column10: Well... looks like hamster food, smells like hamster food, oh yeah and it TASTES like hamster food!  These crispbread crackers are nothing short of disgusting.  Health food does not mean that it needs to taste bad! I find nothing wrong with all-natural foods that actually taste good.  There are plenty of alternatives that offer whole grain and fiber and are much more flavorful.  The no sodium aspect is difficult to ignore but unless your tastebuds have suffered some sort of great catastophre than I warn you to look elsewhere for something more palatable...

column10: I got 3 sets of food for my 6 month old to have some variety. Came on time and is perfect, I miss the box but these are still cute.  Highly recommend for classroom or even office usage. I will probably order this again next year as well.

On my last trip to Costco, I picked up a 26-oz. bag of Wild Roots coastal berry blend trail mix. We actually get this from Costco, which is only about 10 min from home and less than 5 min from work for me.It just helps to buy these at a much lower price at about $9.99
Delicious.  Just plain delicious.  Wish I could afford a pound.  Arrived promptly and well chilled.  On toast points with creme fraiche it is a perfect delectable snack.

column9: do NOT drink unless you can pass out!
column10: This stuff is incredible.  I picked up a few bottles for my husband who's a big Marley fan and also happens to enjoy tea...  Before he got to them, I had about half a bottle one afternoon while we were playing with our kids.  I sat down on the couch and ended up taking a nap (which is something I never ever do).  Guess I should have read the label first!  I thought it would just relax me, not put me to sleep - so now I drink a half bottle before bed.  Sounds cheesy, but it quiets my anxious mind.  I sleep SO well with this tea and I wake up feeling happy and refreshed (not weighed down and grumpy as I usually am in the morning).  Keep in mind, I'm a lightweight at 117lbs and 5'4.NOTE:  I found this at the store at 1.50/bottle... I'm really bummed that Amazon jacked up the price here.

column9: I think Marley might be on to something guys...
column10: The flavoring is very good, not harsh at all and very easy to drink. However I can go down to my local grocery and get it at $1.50  a bottle, still making it much cheaper for a 12 pack there.

column9: 12 pkg Marley's Mellow Mood Black Tea Peach Raspberry passion fruit
column10: I was given this by my daughter in law, and it works as I slept through the night, rare for me. Plus it is sweet nectar.  She bought it for me from a party store.  Your price is high in comparison to the party store.  1.79 a bottle vrs 2.60 per bottle when bought in a case of 12 for 31.19. I'm tempted to pay it, but will check out the local stores first.

I visited my mom in California over the holidays and she had some of this in her fridge. One night I decided to try it. Usually I get on the laptop and stay up for hours researching whatever might be on my mind...usually until 2 or 3 in the morning! While drinking this tea I fell asleep in the middle of my research before 10pm, before even finishing the bottle! I finally went to bed and had the best night's sleep. I woke up at 730ish and never felt so refreshed that early (I'm obviously not a morning person).Unfortunately, the prices here are a bit high, and I don't think I can get these where I live. In my opinion, though, unless you can find them locally for cheaper, the $31 is still very much worth it!

column9: Better than the best stuff on earth.
column10: the greatest tea ever. i actually am a distributor of this product the only one in so. cal but not being one sided. better than any prescription drug on the market. and better for you in the long term.

I have to get up at 4AM, and the longer the days get, the more difficult it is to fall asleep at a reasonable hour. Not with these wonderful tasting drinks! I am out cold within an hour. . . tops. I have tried Neuro, Zen Serenity, and now these, and these are the best by far (taste, effectiveness, etc.). I wake up feeling great; not like when you take a sleeping pill. Also, I ordered from Marely's (I assume this was a typo), and their customer service was SUPERB when I had a slight issue. As far as the price, a night's worth of sleep without taking a pharmaceutical drug, is worth every penny to me.

column9: Both Tasty and a Great Sleep Aid
column10: The only problem that I have with this item is that it does not in fact put you in a mellow mood. It knocks you out completely. Within an hour of drinking this, I have a really hard time staying awake. That's why I purchased it though, to relax and eventually help get me to sleep. I have also not noticed any side effects with my sleep, when drinking this multiple nights in a row and then stopping, like most sleep aids.It is also really tasty. It holds up extremely well against any other fruit beverage. This may be a con though as constantly wanting to drink a beverage that knocks you out can't be good for your social or work life.

column9: Love it! Black Tea preferred! Prepare to get sleepy though!
column10: I didn't know that this drink did more than just taste good the first time I drank it. I knocked out (fell asleep!) The taste is great, and we prefer the Black Tea over the green tea version. It is hard to find but we have found it at Sprouts Market and also some Shell Gas Stations. Check MMM's website for Store Locators. Walmart also sells it online but my local Sprouts store is cheaper than any online outlet so far. Good drink! Wish they also made the drink without the sleep effects.

Recently found Bob Marley's tea at a few select stores. It is very refreshing and has a nice clean taste to it. It is very relaxing but in no way put  me out. I can drink it any time of the day. I tried both the black tea and the green. The green one is the best and it is sweet but not too sweet. I thought I might be able to get a better deal on Amazon but doesn't come close to the $1.50 or $1.70 that I find them for.

column9: been 2 months and still have not received the product

This is a delicious tea that will help you relax before sleep time. Unfortunately, it is hard to find; I did not find it in major retailers and grocers in my area and it's expensive to purchase on-line.

This is by far the best TASTING sleep drink I've had. In fact, I find myself frequently wishing they made a "non drowsy" formula so I could sip it during the day, it's really that good! However, if you're a full blown insomniac (such as myself) looking for 8 hours of sleep in a bottle, this may not be for you. It's great if you need to catch a long nap, like 3-4 hours, but if you're looking for a full night's sleep I recommend Neurosleep! A little pricier, but that will take you out for a good 7-8 hours.

I bought this from my local grocery store just to see what it was about. Looked cool, and I drank a few sips as the can said it might make you drowsy. I definitely felt a "head change" the first time i drank it, and immediately went for a red bull to balance out the effects. That night I was having trouble sleeping and was laying awake at 1:30am. I remembered I still had a can of this in the fridge and drank the whole thing.. column9: bob marley really does help me sleep!

I was really surprised that after a few sips I was really not so bothered as i thought.  When I got home, I was reading the bottle, saw that it was quite natural ingredients, so since I never sleep for than 3-4 hrs. I bought a case at amazon.  Have used it off and on all month especially when I was upset and not sleeping, the calming affect helps me get back to sleep.  sandy in Central NY

column9: Better than a sleeping pill until you become tolerant
column10: This really knocks you out and gives you great sleep without feeling any hangover. It's amazing. (It's also quite tasty, kinda like Snapple only if you drink too much you turn into Rip Van Winkle.) A family member recommended it and I'm glad I tried it. I wish it wasn't so expensive and more available though. Often, Amazon is out of stock and nowhere else on their website is listed as a seller.Update: I've noticed that since I started drinking this every once in a while when I have sleep issues, even if months have lapsed at a time, I've become more tolerant to the effects of the drink. (I found this, also, when I took Valerian pills directly. Valerian root is one of the ingredients.) So one bottle or two doesn't really put me to sleep anymore. This might just be me but I'd suggest not using it too often to avoid becoming tolerant. Just use it when you really need it...which I do but I tend to become tolerant to things very quickly. I wouldn't mind if the cost wasn't so exorbitant. Drinking two bottles a night can become pretty pricey if I'm having a week of insomnia. The thing is despite the price this does really beat the side effects of a lot of the sleep aids out there and trust me, I've tried A LOT of them. This is great for once in a while when your sleep schedule gets out of whack.Also, I discovered that Walmart sells the drink for $20! And it ships free if you purchase more than $45 so it's worth going over to Walmart to get 3 cases at a time.

This was a terrific bargain.  This is also my dog Jax's favorite dog food and the purchase price was half what I usually spend.

column9: Good to ship to elderly relatives
column10: I live in California and have an elderly Aunt in Mississippi. She does not drive and has to depend on others for trips to the grocery store. The prices for things like Oatmeal may not always be competitive with places like Walmart or Costco, but ordering grocery items through amazon.com is a great way for me to help out my Aunt. column9: great way to start the day!
column10: This is a good way to start the day and this box will keep you going for almost two months.  Just add hot water and you're set.  It's quick and easy to prepare and very filling.  Plus, the variety pack will keep things interesting.

I purcahsed this oatmeal variety pack assuming I would receive the various flavors listed in the picture such as banana bread and cinnamon roll.Nope.I get a box with just 4 flavors including 13 packets of original. column9: May be able to find cheaper but a great deal non the less
column10: I needed some more oatmeal for breakfast and this hit the spot. I myself need more than just one packet and will typically use a plain and another flavor to use up the plain oatmeal. I don't know anyone that wants to eat plain oatmeal but that is my solution for the packs rather than throwing them away. Several people complain of the price but not having to deal with going to the store for it and the taxes of it more than makes up for any differences.

What is pictured and what you recieve is not the same!  The picture when I ordered had 6 or 7 different flavors pictured, one being banana, which is the main reason I ordered and I recieved only original flavors.  I will not recommend this seller and will never order from them again!
It's cheap. For about 18 bucks, you get 52 packets of oatmeals.I usually take three packets of these each morning.

I like the large variety of oatmeal but less that a week after purchasing this on Amazon (with Amazon Prime) for $18.59 on March 20th, I went to Costco and found the same exact product for $9.39. Save your money and buy it somewhere else.
This is a quick breakfast and a great value.I usually add a banana or other seasonal fruit along with milk or water

Amazing price compared to the grocery store and a great multi-pack mix. I like adding raisins and dried cranberries to mine, makes a great healthy breakfast. No surprises in this one, we all know what Quaker Oats are.

column9: Too Expensive and not what I expected.
column10: The box I got is same as I can purchase from Costco but more than double the price, it's crazy.  I gave this a try cause I though this is different variety pack, No, it's just like you can get from Costco but more than double the price. save yourself some money.  This product needs detail information on what's inside.

Those little packets are wonderful for a quick low calorie weekday breakfast. My favorites are the cinnamon&spice, raisin&spice, and the apple. They are so easy to make and I usually have them after my exercise. With the exception of the warehouse stores (Sam's, Costco) it is extremely rare to see the 52 packet boxes.

When I ordered this product there were many more flavors listed such as "cinnamon roll" & "banana bread"....so this is why I ordered.  When it came in the mail it only had 4 flavors.  Cinnamon & Spice, Apples/Cinnamon, Maple Brown Sugar, & original.  I won't be purchasing this again on Amazon.

False advertisement here. The variety I received is not what I ordered. If you are out of a particular variety don't send a replacement unless you have contacted the customer for approval. I don't think I would order a bulk variety again. I'll order the individual flavors instead.

My box contained 18 packs of Maple & Brown Sugar, 15 packs of Apple Cinnamon, 14 packs of Cinnamon Spice and 5 packs of Original. Overall this is a good selection of a product that I enjoy on almost a daily basis. The flavored oatmeal might be a little sweet for some people, so be careful using this product if you have Diabetes.Please rate this review if you found it helpful.
This 52 pack of Quaker Assorted Oatmeal was ordered for a church food pantry. The product arrived quickly and in good condition. This is a great value and the church was happy.

Not much to say here - it's Quaker oatmeal, just in a bigger box than you'd get at the grocery store. My only problem is that there's plain in the box, but that's clearly visible, and I knew it when I bought it. I just wish they offered a big box without plain flavor.

column9: It is under $10 at BJs and Costco
column10: Good product, but this price is beyond stupid.  It wouldn't cost this much if you bought 6 boxes of the 10 pack at walmart.
Tasty oatmeal start for the day. Cooked in the microwave while you get ready for work.

I got a 5lb bag of rolled oats from the farmer's market in Detroit.  Little did I know how hard it was to properly flavor blan oatmeal without adding 2lbs of sugar.  This solved my problem and makes my morning breakfast that much faster - boil, add, stir.  But why did they add like 6 packets of the plain stuff?  The cat won't even eat it.

I was shopping around for this same box of oatmeal and come to find out just before I was going to Hit buy that our neighborhood costco has the same box for only 9.99 so that makes this box here a rip off double the price.

I bought these after recently being diagnosed as type 2 diabetic.  Probably not the right thing I have found out. They are handy for a quick breakfast.  The taste is not all that great although the texture is much improved over the older product.  Have offered them to other people, but they are not really enthused over the prospect of eating what one called 'wallpaper paste'.  I'm going back to coffee and toast.

column9: The Right Food to Wear, and a Tasty Way to Wear It
column10: The stress of a tough year is starting to get to me. I've been puckered up so tight for so long, I'm afraid my puckerer may have frozen that way.So I've been searching for inner peace -- and outer unpuckering -- in personal relaxation products. But expensive gadgets and doodads would just angry my blood up further, so I'm seeking Samadhi on a shoestring budget.When my wife goes to a spa to relax, she always gets some kind of oatmeal facial scrub treatment. I don't know much about pampering, but I'm intimately familiar with a wide variety of hot breakfast cereals. If oatmeal on the face is relaxing, then I'd sure give it a try.I heated several packets of the oatmeal in the microwave, per the cooking instructions, added a little milk and layered it onto my face. I'm not sure what's supposed to happen next in a 'professional' treatment, but in my bathroom, a lot of it just glooped off into the sink. The rest felt... well, like oatmeal on my face. Sticky. Warm. Lumpy, in a way that was less 'relaxing' and more 'get it off my face-y'.The oatmeal did smell nice, and made me sort of hungry, but I don't think I relieved any stress by putting it on my face instead of IN my face. Maybe next time I'll try wearing it with eggs over easy, or a rasher of bacon. Bacon makes *everything* peaceful.

I bake a lot of bread and cake. This Xanthan Gum is a very fine powder product that emulsifies cakes without changing its color and taste. After using this Xanthan Gum in my bread and sponge cake, the pastries remain moist and fluffy longer.
This is a very good product and the cheapest price for a pound that I've seen.  I will be getting from them every time I need some.

column9: Add body at little calorie cost
column10: I see this ingredient on product labels everywhere so I thought I'd check it out. I always liked thick shakes growing up so I thought it might be a way to make a sensible shake or smoothie with the body of a more indulgent drink. Guess what  -  it's amazing! It does the job to the nth degree. With the addition of about half a teaspoon you can make a fat free shake that almost refuses to pour out of the blender. I wouldn't reccommend any more than half a teaspoon to start because you can always add more liquid. I did that and wound up with a full blender full of drink and it was still almost too thick to pour. It's also very popular in salad dressings because it adds body and cling. Home made ice cream is another natural. Try it and discover your own uses.

column9: A little goes a long way
column10: A must for low carb foodies!  I've used it in baking, making low carb ice cream (which gives the ice cream a real "mouth" feel) and thickening sauces without the use of flour or corn starch.  Amazon has the best price on it, too.

I bought this because I was looking for a lower cost alternative to the $12 small bags of Red Mill Xantham gum I had been using to make gluten free bread. I was trying to lower the total cost per loaf, otherwise I might as well buy the loaves in the frozed section which are pretty good. I had already figured out a means to cheaply combine my own flour ingredients so I wouldn't need to purchase the expensive Red Mill gluten free flour. Next, I located on Amazon a great bulk deal on bakers yeast that also added to cost reduction (and was superior in result too.) After buying this Xanthan gum, I further reduced the price per loaf significantly. I have found this product works well and have not noticed any difference in quality of my results with my bread. So, I am very happy to have found this alternative at a more reasonable price. I also like the zip lock bag it comes in which is much more handy for baking and easy handling than the Red Mill bag.

column9: I use this as a thickener in y lotions and creams
column10: Works like a dream.  This and Guar Gum are the only thickeners I use. This gives my lotions a nice, spreadable quality that makes my lotions feel moist with out being wet or greasy.  Be careful, if you use too much it will clump and leave a slimy feel.  Excellent product.  "Xanthan Gum! WOW!"  Anyone get that reference? :)~

column9: An excellent product for an excellent price.
column10: I was a bit apprehensive about straying from the familiar Bob's Red Mill brand of gums, but I'm perfectly happy with this product. There's no discernible difference between this and the much-more-expensive BRM brand, so if you know you'll be using xanthan gum often, this is what you'll want to buy. I use some every day and have barely made a dent in my supply!

I do a lot of gluten free baking and this is such a great deal.  Fresh, effective,and saves us money.  I've purchased this xanthan gum three different times now and the quality and price cannot be beat.
This came well packaged and I found that this gives my yeast breads a longer shelf-life and far moister end product. If you love gooshy white bread, this is THE trick to making it super moist!

column9: great food additive with other uses
column10: This is a great deal for Xanthan gum. I used some of this as a thickening agent during cooking with great results. The re-sealable bag keeps the product good for quite a while (possibly years if you refridgerate it) and I found no observable difference between this brand and other more expensive ones. A little xanthan gum goes a long way and this 1LB bag should last you quite a while.

column9: a little goes a long way
column10: Just restocked after being out for a long time.  I'd forgotten that you need so much less than cornstarch if you are substituting.  Maybe 1/4 as much?  Clumps less than cornstarch as well.
I use Xanthan Gum for my home made lotions, creams and serums to name a few and it works perfectly! You need just a little and that will go a LONG WAY! This will last me forever!

I grind my own grain and make all of our bread.  I have LITTLE kids and traditional home made bread is pretty coarse and difficult for them to chew, so I tweeked my recipe and added this to my dough to make a lighter textured bread.  This is pretty pricey in the stores here so finding it on Amazon has been a great budget saver.  The quality is great and the packaging convient for storage.

For St. Patty's day I made my niece Gluten Free Irish Soda Bread using Gluten Free A P Flour, adding 2 teaspoons per cup of flour used and it came out tasting just like the regular bread.  Like I said, it works great, thank you for such a wonderful product, I will be doing a lot more Gluten Free baking.

We have to do a bunch of gluten free baking for my family.  This is the second time I have purchased this exact product.  I was disappointed to see that the cost went up 5$ since last year, but it's still about 7-8$ then purchasing at local retail shops.  This lasted us about 1 year using it for our baked goods.
A little goes a long way. Think baby steps when using, if you aren't using a recipe. I made fruit smoothies, with or without ice.

Ordering through Amazon is the easiest, safest way to order online. I received my order quickly and have never had a problem with an order being shipped incomplete. I order gluten-free products online because the deals are much better than anything found in the local grocery stores. Xanthan gum is costly enough, but you can buy it for less online. The product was fresh, sealed well and performed as expected.
Makes my gluten free breads and desserts the absolute best! My bread seems to be nice and tender--not gummy and gluey. Thanks Essential Depot for a great product.
I looked around for some a decent price on this stuff. This was the best I could find. It arrived quickly and was just as expected.

I was reluctant to purchase Xanthan Gum, thinking it was too expensive, and frankly, it was a foreign ingredient that I had never used before.  To my absolute delight, I found Xanthan Gum to be an indispensible ingredient in gluten free baking!  It is easy to use, and will last a long time in your pantry.  As any Celiac's patient (or person with gluten sensitivity) will tell you, it's wonderful to bake a Gluten free birthday cake from scratch, with the confidence that everyone will want to eat it!

column9: exactly what I wanted - great value
column10: This is a great product at a great price.  It arrived on time and was packaged well.  I will purchase more when I need it.
Since you are looking into purchasing xanthan gum I assume you know what it does. It acts like it should, and the resealable pouch is very nice.
I have just started using Xanthan Gum in my protein smoothies! A little goes a long way, but the texture of my shakes are now so think and creamy.

column10: I bought this along with Sunbeam 2591 350-Watt MixMaster, Black to make some bread and cakes.I wasn't too impressed with the mixer but this Xanthan Gum is incredible stuff for the price.It thickens up nicely and gives a great texture.I will be coming back for more.
I have used this product all year without any problems (For gluten free baking).  Works great and best price I've found.

column10: ....Use it when you want something a little less tumeric-bright. One stop spicing if you're making a tanjine too. All the moroccan spices I ordered were surprisingly different from each other. So feel free to experiment.

I first bought this cereal at the HEB grocery store and it's priced between $4 and $5 for 1 box. It taste pretty good. Amazon currently sells it for about $3.95 a box, if you opt for subscribe & save. It's crunchy and takes longer to sog, which is what I like. I don't like Nature's Path Flax Plus Multibran Cereal or Heritage Flakes (not sure which one I tried). It gets soggy too quickly.And if you're curious about the expiration date, all 6 boxes (arrived 2 days ago) are dated for December 2012.

I never smoked,and have all my taste buds intact. This cereal is less sweet then corn flakes or wheaties by a long shot. They really have a multi grain flavor. One thing to note on these boxes,the serving size is small and there are not very many servings per. I suggest buying the bags if you like to eat ,"A real bowl" not a cup of cereal. It's far more cost effective. I'd give this cereal five stars if all the ingredients came from North America. The cane juice and rice bran flour are from South America.

Nature's Path organic multigrain oatbran flake cereal is a great tasting product and it's very nutritious and friendly to the diet (i.e., very low fat, low sodium, good protein, high fiber content (at least 5 grams by my standard), and low sugar). I've been consuming it for a long time.
Great cereal, always seen in my cupboard. Amazon pricing most fair keeps me coming back.

column9: I used to like it but they made it too sweet now
column10: This used to be my favorite cereal. It had fiber, good taste and texture but in the past year or two they started making it sweeter and sweeter. I don't like sweetened cereal. At least with an unsweetened cereal I can choose to make it sweeter myself. But if it is too sweet out of the box there is no choice to make it less sweet. I contacted the company and told them I didn't like how sweet they had made it now. They denied that they had changed anything. They lost me as a customer after that. I was buying 6 boxes a month for almost 2 years straight. I stopped. I waited a few months and decided to try again to see if they had changed their recipe back the way it used to be. I just opened a new box and it is still sickening sweet for my tastes. Goodbye Nature's Path. If I wanted super sweetened sugar cereal that is what I would have bought! Anybody want free 6 boxes? You can have it!!! Yuck!

column4: J. H. Minde "Everything I need is right here"
column10: Do you like ginger? Are you aware of it's health-giving qualities?  Ginger has been shown to settle the digestion, to act as an anti-inflammatory, and may even shrink tumors and inhibit cancer cells. I've seen this specific product recommended in various articles on Naturopathic health. It TASTES healthy. It tastes great, too.Ginger Beer (as opposed to Ginger Ale) is loaded with ginger. And it's rarely more loaded with ginger than here in REED'S EXTRA GINGER BREW---At 26 grams per bottle, you can practically SEE the ginger in it. It has a lot of ginger "bite."Unlike the soft drink megacorporations which produce a tasteless and overly fizzy sugar water they label as "Ginger Ale", Reed's microbrews it's soft drinks in a process similar to that used by a beer microbrewery. There is no alcohol in REED'S EXTRA GINGER BREW. 25% of REED's EXTRA is fruit juice, part of which contributes to the sugar content, which is comparable to other sodas. REED'S should be a treat, not a substitute for water.REED'S GINGER BREW comes in three varieties, ORIGINAL, PREMIUM, and EXTRA. The amount of ginger increases with each variety (It's a little odd that PREMIUM has less ginger than EXTRA). The labels are similar so check carefully to decide which variety you want.

column9: Oh, My! A Fine Soft Drink!
column10: I've had "ginger ale" as a soft drink off and on throughout my life, both the regular and the diet varieties. It was okay. Then I spotted Reed's Extra Ginger Brew (all natural Jamaican Ginger Beer) in my local Fresh and Easy Neighborhood Market. What is this, I wondered? Well, looked it over and decided I just had to try it. Oh, my! It was good! Really good! It was so superior to the "ginger ales" I've had that there was just no comparison. And this drink tasted like real ginger and it  was good and strong! Boy, this is a fine soft drink. A bottle has just about the same calories as regular soda and I note 37 grams of sugar. I'm going to have to watch it. This stuff goes down so easy!Gary Peterson

column9: It's good, but not the best
column10: I like this. Sometimes I even love it, like - when it's a furnace outside and the ginger beer is ice cold. But it's not the best I've had. If you want a very gingery beer, try The Ginger People. They infuse their beer with real pieces of ginger - ginger that you can see. Fever-Tree offers a nice, refreshing ginger beer as well.

column9: Can't get enough of this ginger beer!
column10: I fell in love with Reed's Ginger Beer Extra Ginger Brew years nearly 20 years ago. I may not be an expert on ginger beer but I know what I like and it is Reeds!

I Love ginger ANYTHING..  This is a non alcoholic brew that offers two strengths of ginger. I prefer the 26 gram bottle. Snappy and bubbly.  It's my "eye opener" in the morning . Once you get hooked , you'll miss it when it's gone.  So, I buy 2 cases (48) bottles at a time.  Also is used for goosed up coctails in trendy bars. Try something different and give yourself the benefits of ginger in your life. Mildly spicy with a Jamaican flare. Twist off cap, so bring it with you.  If I have a little stomach queeze, this drink will fix the problem.

This bubbly crisp ginger ale has an excellent strong ginger bite to it. There is no sugary taste to it like far too many ginger ales on the market. There is just a hint of honey to this lovely concoction. The crispness of all of Reed's Ginger Ales is incredibly refreshing on a hot summer day. Try it over ice cream for a ginger ale float!

column9: If You Have a Stomach Ache, Drink This
column10: Seriously, if you have a stomach ache and drink a bottle of this, it will go away.  I started drinking ginger ale a few years ago because I had stomach problems and read that ginger helps as does peppermint tea.  It both does indeed help, but when I found this I became hooked.  I drink one every day and have no more upset stomach, ever!  I love this stuff and don't understand the bad reviews.  I have tried some of those other brands people are mentioning and they really don't taste any better.  It's funny how someone always has to come along and slam something good and tell you how to do it better.  This is my favorite of all the gingers I've tried.  Get a bottle ice cold and drink it and you will love it.

column9: Can't believe this isn't a 5/5 on Amazon
column10: Trader Joe's consistently has the best price on this, barely under $1/bottle. This has got to be about my favorite beverage. I am surprised to see any negative reviews. This does not taste like Ginger Beer. Ginger beer has more bite and is very sugary. This is much more refreshing, but it also has a bite, not much, but enough.

This ginger beer is really good. It is not as aromatic as some of the others which is one of the reasons I like it. I usually buy it for about a dollar a piece at the local grocery store. Can't beat that anywhere.

This item was a gift for a relative. They were so overjoyed that I was showered with compliments. Now that we have the order straight I expect to conduct further business with Amazon in the future. Thanks.

Reed's is probably the most well known brand of premium ginger beer on the market, but it is a mediocre beverage by itself and as a mixer. Even the Extra Ginger doesn't pack much of a ginger punch. I would give it 1 star, but it's better than Canada Dry and uses doesn't use HFCS. I prefer Natural Brew Outrageous Ginger Ale for drinking by itself or as a mixer and Gosling's as a mixer only, although Gosling's contains HFCS.

While certainly not as awful as Ginger People's ginger beer, I don't recommend it.  I love a good ginger beer, and this is all that my local grocery store carries and I still won't buy it.  To be fair, there are different styles of ginger beer and taste IS subjective.  But I can't help but feeling that something like Cock and Bull or Barritts is MUCH better and more "authentic".  (Although they are not nearly as natural.)
Trader Joe's discontinued Bundaberg but kept this line. Go figure. Exotic label, bland taste. Bundaberg is one of the best I've ever tasted. Reed's: forgettable.

I have been searching for a good ginger beer, trying to find something that might compare to Bundaberg Ginger Beer, and was EXTREMELY disappointed with Reed's.  I was looking for that sweet gingery flavor, with a nice strong bite, and found Reed's to be nothing more than a bland drink with a lingering burn, NOT a bite, that resembled heartburn more than the gingery spice blast of a decent ginger beer.  Reed's was rubbery tasting, and tastes similar to a cheap non-alcoholic beer.  I literally couldn't finish my first bottle.  I pride myself on being able to eat and drink just about anything... so to be unable to finish this drink says a lot.  Oh Bundaberg, why aren't you sold in US grocery stores???

We found these wonderful treats in Scotland a few years back. Since they're 95% dried fish, our terriers went nuts for them. (The tiddler size is perfect for smaller dogs.) They were difficult to locate in this country, so every time we went back to the UK we would stock up. Now that Entirely Pets features them, life is perfect...

While I agree that these nuts are quite tasty, the total weight of the eight packs is one pound. Thats $26.00 per pound for cashews! I can buy fresh-roasted spiced cashews at the local gourmet nut shop for half that and see them roasted right in front of me!
I tried these nuts at the Food Network's Food and Wine Festival and become a fan. The unique flavor of the Indonesian spices are unforgettable. A must try item for those cashew lovers!

What a really great product! All the flavors from this company are delicious! (I'm lucky enough to have tried them all!) The cashews are amazing quality and the recipes reeeaally pack some flavor - these are anything BUT bland! Love the convenient vacuum seal packs...prevents you from having to open a whole jar - everything stays fresh. Much better than your normal snack mix!!

These cashews are so delicious! They are fresh, full of flavor, and packaged for easy to-go activities. Helping Indonesian farmers produce a quality product is an added benefit. They are a great snack to get you through a Pilates or yoga routine.

column9: LOVE THIS TEA--it is the best!!!

I find this is the best litter for controlling odor.  Many of the stores have discontinued this product and since I feel it us the best available I order it online

column9: A Happy Dog is a Green Dog
column10: My wife and I share our home with the Three Muske-Terriers: A male Westie, a male Cesky and, the Empress-of-All-She-Surveys, a female Scotty. The Empress is alergic to wheat, (along with corn and soy), so I had my doubts concerning Pet Greens Roasted Chicken Recipe w/ Wheat Grass Dog Treats - wheat grass after all is just "juvenile" wheat. But apparently not to worry! We're half way through our first bag and no allergic reaction, (you haven't lived until you've seen a crazed Scotty in the middle of an allergic frenzy chewing on her tootsies). Now, putting aside her allergies, the Empress will eat almost anything - and so will the Cesky. But the Westie gives new meaning to the term "finicky" - and Asta gives these treats five barks - I mean, stars. So what's up here?The treats are mostly roasted chicken meal, supplemented with dried chicory extract, organic ground wheat grass powder, lecithin, salt, cultured whey and garlic, preserved with "mixed tocopherols," (I'm not a chemist, but I think that's a fancy name for vitamin E, sourced from vegetable oil). The wheat grass doesn't contain any wheat glutten - which I think is the reason it doesn't trigger the Empress' allergies. Wheat grass is an excellent source of any and all of the nutrients contained in fresh vegetables.The treats are small "jerky-like" rectangles - no more than an inch by 3/4s of an inch, and maybe 1/16 of an inch thick, (they may be more appropriate for small to medium size dogs - a large dog would want three or four at a time). They're great for a quick reward and at only about 4 calories a piece, there's not much danger that your dog is going to put on unwanted pounds, (however I wouldn't suggest that you carry them loose in your pocket or purse - they smell strongly of garlic - I keep 'em in a zip lock baggie).As far as I can tell, the ingrediants are all natural, but only the wheat grass is organic - if you are interested in organic treats, I suggest that you check out those made by Wagatha or Robbie Dawg.Bottom Line: I think that Pet Greens offers both a change of flavor and a change in texture from most common dog treats. The Three Muske-Terriers are scarfing 'em down - your furry buddy probably will too.

Having older rescued dogs with very few teeth, the treats also needed to be soft enough for them to chew. Pet Greens Treats fulfilled all of these requirements.
