This, in my opinion, tastes more like my local coffee house brew than any other K-cup on the market.  and Amazon has great prices on these, especially with subscribe & save.
I was leary to order this coffee but after reading other reviews I decided to give it a try. Very good taste if you like the taste of coffee,

column9: This stuff is strooong!!! Does what it says!
column10: I thought I would like this because I like to think I like bold coffee.  Wow, this isn't bold.  It is stand up and knock your socks off it is soooo bold even at the biggest setting.  So if you enjoy a powerful cup of coffee this is for you.  By the way the filters work great in my machine and all else is perfect; if only I liked the coffee.  So after being knocked to the floor by my coffee this morning I am going to crawl over and try the breakfast blend. Four stars for the filters and minus one star for my personal preference on the coffee.

in error the review I just submitted attched to emeril's big easy (also excellent)now down to business.just recieved my first order of s.f. bay / fog chaser immediatly made a cup.was unsure as I just purchesed a cusinart k-cup mach. worked perfectly regardless.the strength / flavor is all it was touted. & the price is resonableI'll be back often!!!!billw......

I was having trouble finding a good everyday coffee for my new Keurig. I like a strong flavor, but all the "bold" ones I tried were too bitter, some even tasted burned. The "not-bold" ones were too weak. I decided to give the San Francisco Bay Fog Chaser a try because of the reviews, recommendations from friends, and I like their minimal packaging. This coffee is great! Exactly what I was looking for, a strong rich coffee flavor with no bitterness. Perfect for me!
Overall, great price, nice medium to bold taste!  I also like the "less plastic" container as it helps cut down on oil consumption and helps the environment.
I have purchased 3 flavors of SanFrancisco Bay Coffees and have been pleased with all of them.  The pod is a bit different than the typical K-cup but the flavor of the coffee is GREAT.

I have used a K-cups for years. Found San Francisco Bay Coffee cups and decided to give a try.  As soon as I opened the first bag I knew it was going to be amazing.The smell of the coffee grounds was awesome.  I did not know until then how I missed the smell of fresh grounds.  That woke me up immediately. Love the Fog Chaser coffee!  Can not wait to try other flavors!  Highly recommend.

This coffee is just what I wanted - not too bitter and not as strong as some coffees. The aftertaste is easy and smooth. I appreciate the packaging into smaller groups of cups, in order to keep the coffee fresh.
I used to drink Newman's Special Blend or Starbucks Sumatra but this is at least as good and cheaper. I'll spring for the 80-cup box this time.
I've been looking for a good quality coffe for my Keurig, and have tried many options (Starbucks, Mountain Green, and others).  I now found my coffe, good robust flavor, no bitterness.
I found this coffee very weak - I had to lower the cup size to get some flavor.  I would not order this again.

Found these by accident on amazon. If you like strong coffee, you'll.like fog chaser. Some days I find it a bit too strong, hence the 4 stars. But, I do love the price, what you get for the price, and the fact that it works wit my machine. I like the French roast too, maybe a bit more. It is strong as well.

column9: Now the standard in our household
column10: I like a bolder cup of coffee - not "Starbucks-bold" but full bodied and flavorful.  The SF Bay Fog Chaser really fits that bill.  Not over the top strong but very flavorful.  Its great that this product offers competition to the traditional K-cups.  Price is lower but quality is very high.  We've never had an issue fitting this into our Keurig brewer.  The only issue mentioned by many others is the small "sediment" in the bottom of each cup.

column9: Very strong , flavorful coffee at a great price
column10: They come in bags, I think nitrogen sealed. It is enough to last a week each bag.Flavor: Very bold, very strong but not bitter or acidic. Very much like costco coffeebut far more flavorful and complex.Can do a full 10 oz and it is still strong with milk.Less plastic to waste
Right amount of caffeine to wake you up.  Flavor and strength are fine too.  I will buy these again as soon as I run out.

column9: San Francisco Bay coffee K cups
column10: The coffee tastes okay, strong but doesn't have great flavor. The cups fit in my Keurig but not in my dispenser. For these reasons, I wouldn't buy them again

column9: Absolutely delicious, best cup of coffee around!
column10: I rarely rate things 5 stars, this coffee deserves the top rating. It is incredibly good, I don't think I want a cup of coffee and then I remember these are in the carousel for my Keurig machine, I change my mind in a heartbeat. It's like having a box of your favorite snack in the cupboard and trying to resist eating it, but you know it's there and you keep thinking about it.The flavor of this San Fransisco Bay coffee is rich, complex, and delicious. I can't think of a cup of coffee that I've bought anywhere that can beat the bold, rich flavor of this brand. It's like drinking a glass of fine wine. My favorite k-cup previous to this was Tulley's Kona Blend.The packaging of the individual coffee pod threw me off because when I opened the plastic bag with the pods in it, a very strong aroma of coffee filled the air. I wondered if the paper filter bottoms of the pods wouldn't let the coffee get stale, so I put them in a ziplock baggie. Time will tell I guess if the paper filter will allow the coffee to get stale or not. On the other hand I liked that there was a more green solution to the regular plastic coffee pod holder. I'm torn on this, I 'think' I'd rather have the pods be the more usual plastic in order to preserve freshness, but time will tell. I doubt any of the pods I have will have time to ever get stale however, because I'm drinking them all the time.

column9: Excellent Taste and More Robust Brewing with These Type of Pods
column10: I previously purchased a smaller quantity package of this coffee and, liking it as much as I did, I purchased this 80 count package as the price per cup is about 18% less per cup.  This coffee is strong, but not too strong, and good-tasting that not only tastes great but has a nice aroma.The pods are a little different than your traditional plastic K-cup portion as, instead of any plastic around the sides or bottom you have basically a mesh coffee filter holding the coffee grounds. This appears to make a more complete brew, and allows more of the flavor to come into the actual coffee. You will see a dirty residue at the bottom of your cup due to this filtration system vs. a "clean" look from a normal K-cup pod. This seems to make sense as the normal K-cup pod has all of the brewed coffee escaping through the pinprick hole vs. the full brewing experience of these pods.As the pods are in this filtration medium the coffee is not air-tight sealed after you open the package of pods. I have put the unused ones in a sealed Ziploc bag to keep them fresh.I also shared this with some folks in the office, who liked it so much they ordered their own so it's not just me who likes this stuff.  I believe I have found a new favorite coffee!

I was so excited to get my box of Fog Chaser. I had been paying nearly $40 for Starbucks at a wholesale club and only for 40 cups. I had cut myself to one cup per day! Then my friend shared this link and I thought "Why not!" It arrived quickly, and smelled heavenly. I like dark, strong coffee, and I could tell by the smell it would fit the bill. The real test is in making it. I brewed it this morning--no grounds in my coffee, and no residue left in my cup. Wondered if the soft filter cup at the bottom would work, and it does. How great is that???? It doesn't taste like instant coffee either, which some imitations do. 80 cups for $33 is an awesome deal...that is around $0.42 a cup. If you buy the little boxes at WalMart you only get 18 for $10..which is around $0.61 per cup...you save $0.19 per cup, which doesn't sound like a lot, but you would spend $50 buying as much at WalMart to get 80 K cups. So you are saving $17. I love it!!! Order yours today, you won't be disappointed.

column9: Better than every real K-Cup there is
column10: Thanks to Green Mountain (Keurig) buying up all the K-Cup makers, traditional K-Cups keep getting more and more expensive while getting less and less good.Bad combination.I was almost resigned to buying my own coffee and using the Ekobrew refillable filter until my Keurig gave out but then I came across San Francisco Bay Coffee's Fog Chaser non-K-cups.WOW, I can actually use the large cup setting again!These deceptively little pods pack a punch and while I'm no coffee expert, they are consistent and taste great.Now I'm just hoping that Green Mountain doesn't take them over...

I am one of those guys that dont like the rising price of k cups. This works great and makes a pretty goodcup of coffee. It is very easy to clean up.. just throw away. At the current price of 16.99 it is about .47per cup or .40 with subscribe and safe. I also like saving money using the EKOBREW the refillable k cup filter, when you use that you can put in your own grinds and it costs about .25 for starbucks. This is a little easier when you are finished though and is a Good Value.
These K-Cups arrived promptly after ordering; the are convenient to use, and the coffee tastes great. Highly recommend the product. Have had no problems.

column9: No Fog involved here, clearly a yummy winner
column10: I was at first hesitant due to the 'weird' lack of a normal kcup but other reviewers take on this flavor tempted me. THANK U for tempting me, this flavor is crisp, delicious and downright 'good stuff'.I will definitely reorder over and over, now one of my favs.

I was a bit leary when I ordered this, as it wasn't the traditional K-cup but no need to worry.  It worked just fine.  Only problem is, they don't fit in my K-cup carousel all that well and tend to fall out if I turn it too fast.  Beyond that, the coffee tastes just fine and I LOVE the aroma in the kitchen.  Since they have a kind of mesh/fabric back, the aroma of the coffee comes through.  I HAD to have a cup as soon as they arrived just 'cauze it smelled so good!

I'm pretty much a coffee snob and don't care for most of the choices offered for K-cups.  After trying the San Fracisco Bay French Roast I don't think I'll be able to go back to any of the other K-cups!  It tastes so much fresher than the others and has a rich flavor that beats most gourmet coffee at the high-end shops.  Try it if you like real coffee.

column9: Strong, But Not Acidic or Bitter
column10: I like more full bodied, strong coffee, but usually find they are too bitter, acidic or taste like burnt grounds. The SF Bay Fogchaser was none of the above. I like the "cup" it's a lot less packaging than the normal k-cup (which isn't accepted in our recycling can). With these, I recycle the top and plastic ring and throw the rest into the compost pile. Yes, they look funny, and yes you need to put them into some sort of airtight container to keep them fresh, but a small change for a pretty good cup o' joe.

This product makes a great cup of cofee, bold but not bitter, no bad after taste. The smell starts the experience  and the satisfied full flavor follows. I will buy this product as long as it is available !!

I am not familiar with other San Francisco Bay Products, but, Fog Chaser will get you moving in the morning.  Definately a dark roast for those of you, like me, who want a quick pick me up in the morning. Yes, I have more than one before going to work. I have tried several different dark roasts & this is in my top 4.

column9: Would not purchase this product again
column10: I prefer a stronger bold cup of coffee, which other review promised this brand/type of coffee was, but I found that I had to use the smallest size brew size cup on my keurig to get any flavor at all, therefore using double the pods ( smaller than regular refills)  don't recommend. Too bad because the price is right.
This coffee is outstanding, nice strong flavor without bitterness.I am wondering if these k-cups can be used in a Kreurig Vue?

THIS COFFEE IS SUCH A GOOD FRAGRANCE AND SOOOO GOOOOOOOOD TASTING! THIS IS WHAT I CALL A CUP A JO! AND SMELLS SO WONDERFUL FROM OPENING THE BAG, TO BREWING IT AND DRINKING IT. GOOD JOB ROGERS FAMILY! THANKS! I WILL BE ORDERING MORE FOR SURE. ANY OF THE K CUPS CAN'T TOUCH THIS! BELIEVE ME BECAUSE WE HAVE TRIED THEM ALL!
This is definately a fog chaser!  Love this coffee...will continue to purchase.  Of course, I love to visit San Francisco...so this reminds me of that wonderful city!
when your coffee maker motor starts to weaken and sound like a mack truck . Use these the paper filter makes it easy than those plastic ones and the coffee taste great!

I love strong coffee - not bitter - but strong and flavorful.  I grew up in New Orleans and loved the coffee.  I have tried several "bold" coffees and find that they are not flavorful at all - just strong (and bitter).  I bought the fog chaser from the local grocery out of pure frustration of not being able to find anything in a K cup to my liking.  Low and behold I LOVE THIS COFFEE.  It is good, strong coffee with a ton of flavor - very smooth.  Those nay-sayers - stick with the mild/medium stuff.  If you want good strong coffee - this is it.
Very good coffee, have had them for a while, like each amount in small bages. this keeps the other frish.I will be buying more, the tast was better than other k-cups. amazon is great.
It's a good Coffee but I think it was a little to strong for me.But It does have a nice taste

column9: Good Coffee and great price plus better for environment
column10: Tastes great and cheaper.. Looks a little different but it is a nice clean design. Pods work very well and fit well also. Have several friends and relatives on the product now and they are very pleased also...Love it

column9: Finally, Less Plastic and Really Bold  Coffee!
column10: I just poured my first cup of San Francisco Bay Coffee One Cup for Keurig K-cup Brewers, and it is great! First of all, the Fog Chaser Coffee will do it's job to chase the Fog away: It is REALLY BOLD! I brewed a medium cup because I like bold coffee and was not sure if this brand would deliver. Next time I will not be afraid to brew a large cup. The coffee is rich, flavorful, and did I say Bold?Secondly, I love my Keurig, but hated feeling guilty about all the plastic I was adding to the landfills using the Keurig K-Cups. This pod uses at least 1/3 of the plastic of the standard K-Cup: There is a plastic ring holding the mesh coffee filter pod to the foil cap. Environmentally, this is a step in the right direction. I also feel the design of the pod is what allows the coffee to brew stronger, smoother and with more flavor!My husband does not like his coffee as bold as I do, so I look forward to trying out the other flavors of San Francisco Bay Coffee One Cup.

Ordered this on Sunday and recieved it on Wednesday. So the shipping was very fast. The cups aren't the usual cups you get from your local store. Looks more like a k pouch. That being said it is good coffee. As soon as I got them I had to try it out. Tasted fresh and brewed very well. I am glad that I have a subscription as this will be a morning regular.

I tried the San Francisco Bay Coffee Fog Chaser since they have reduced the cost & plastic waste by reducing the packaging. I love a good strong cup of coffee and I love my Keurig brewer.  But I am a cheapskate at heart and hated paying the price for the regular K-cups. This is a great compromise.Since it does not have the plastic cup base and is just a round filter hanging from the top ring, you have to keep them sealed in a zip-lock or similar air tight container or they will not stay fresh.  That is a small inconvenience I can live with.  They also reduce our use of plastic and the trash we generate and I suspect that there may be health benefits from not brewing the coffee in the little plastic cup.
This product is fabulous! Delicious coffee, great price, and the packaging uses only a fraction of the plastic used in traditional Kcups.

This coffee is not what I expected.  I thought it would be a bold coffee similiar to Starbucks, but it is not, and it leaves a sediment in my cup, which other don't .  very disappointed and will not re order this brand again.

My husband and I are always trying new k-cups to see what's new. We were both pleasantly surprised by this coffee. It was bold but really smooth. It's a great morning and just the right kick for the afternoon pick me up.

I use these in my Keurig B130, they fit well and save plastic. I brew fog chaser over ice- its got a nice medium flavor.The frustration free packaging works fine. I put the opened pods in a ziplock in the freezer- stay fresh for a week.

column9: So happy I found this coffee!  No plastic aftertaste!
column10: I have been using a Keurig for about 18 months.  I love the convenience, but feel guilty about wasting the plastic and my husband doesn't like the k-cups cause he says the coffee tastes like plastic.  This brew cup is great...less plastic to waste and the coffee taste fresh!  5 Stars!

column9: Great coffee, works fine in old-style B30 mini machine
column10: My 5-star rating is in comparison to other K-Cups I've had, not compared to beans just ground and brewed in my Technivorm Moccamaster. Having said that, this is still a satisfying cup of coffee. My wife was drinking Coffee People Donut Shop as her everyday cup, has switched to this. For me the DS was OK, but I favor the darker brews like Paul Newman Extra Bold and the Van Houtte Eclipse. I like this Fog Chaser quite a bit better, and it's a great bonus how much less plastic waste the cups create. On top of that, they're cheaper, so extra bonus. If you like strong, but not bitter, coffee, this is definitely worth trying.

This is great coffee! I can not say enough about how bold and rich this is. I was pleasantly surprised at the richness in the coffee, because I feel like most of the k-cups are kind of weak. This coffee is so good that my husband has declared we will ever buy another brand again. I love the packaging on it as well. I'm not sure if the filters at the bottom instead of the plastic are what help the coffee to taste so good, but it's a great idea! So much less waste and coffee wasn't meant to be streamed through plastic anyway. I wish more k-cups were made this way. We have no problems with the coffee going stale before we get  through the 10 in each package. I store them in the k-cup holder I have and they are still perfect. LOVE LOVE LOVE this stuff. Highly recommended!

This has been running much less than other K cups so I gave it a try.Lower cost than K-cups but more than using an Ekobrew cup with your favorite coffee.Much stronger smell when you open a plastic package.  Not a pleasant coffee smell but some people like that dark a roasting, look at Starbucks.Cons: not very complex, darker almost burnt roasting, some bitterness.If your preferences are more to the Nantucket Blend on the roasting scale this is not for you.Added, I see they have a Breakfast Blend which according to reviews is milder and more complex. However they helpfully point out it is still roasted more than other brands and I believe the amount of roasting is part of my objection to the flavor.

Because of the minimal packaging I didn't expect much or even for the cups to work as well as the usual ones.  I pleasantly surprised at the excellent flavor of the coffee and the way the cups stood up to brewing. This is a very dark roast, not for the timid coffee drinker. It would do well as an iced coffee due to it's rich, bold flavor - hmmmm, not a bad idea, I think I'll try it right now!

My wife is the coffee drinker in our house. Pete's, Starbucks and a whole host of local coffee spots come under her purview. And then there are all the coffees at the grocery store. She has now deemed Fog Chaser for her Keurig coffee maker the best!

column9: You get what you pay for
column10: This was an extremely affordable item, but the old adage you get what you pay for applies here.  The coffee was nothing special and tasted like discount coffee.  One of the best aspects of the single-cup coffee maker is that you get a cup of coffee that is strong (depending upon your preference), fresh and, tastes like a cup of coffee from one of the chain reatil locations, without the retail price. This coffee tasted like weak, old coffee - coffee that was made in a drip maker.  In my opinion, not a "Fog Chaser" at all.

I love this coffee.  Great flavor, great price.  I wish I'd found it sooner.  I haven't had the experience with "stale coffee" as some of the other reviews state, but I have left the coffee in a ziploc bag instead of in a holder.

Great stuff! Tastes fresher than all of the other types of k-cups; and I've tried all the major ones including Starbucks.It looks like you save ten cents over everyone else as well. The only negative; because of the way they are packed and manufactured, my 30 cup k-cup carousel is now useless.

Coffee People Kona Blend Island Style has been my favorite (prepackaged) coffee for my Keurig.  Fog Chaser may come in a close second.  I started on this one as the Kona hasn't been available for awhile now.  The Fog Chaser is a medium-bodied blend that does well any time of the day.  I like it iced also.  It's smooth with earth and cedar notes.  Not sweet, but not bitter.  A nice balance.Don't be fooled by the plastic bags with the air seals on them.  No coffee, no matter if it's whole bean, refrigerated, or in fancy packaging will retain the same flavor profile it had in the first weeks after it's roasted.  Coffee should be drunk in about 2-3 days after it's roasted and for about another 2-4 weeks.  The majority of flavor in coffee comes from it's aromatics, and they are gone in a relatively short period of time.  When I have time I buy green coffee beans, roast them in my air pop popcorn poppers, wait 2-3 days, grind as needed, and drink it all in the next 2-4 weeks.  TMALST  These won't go bad if you leave the bag open on a counter.

This coffee is delicious but very strong. Not for the faint of heart...it will wake you up!!!It has a wonderfully rich aroma while brewing and a deep yet not bitter taste. This is a great deal for K-cups and supports an environmentally friendly company. I would wholehearted recommend.

I've really enjoyed this K-cup. The coffee is strong and flavorful and I love that the Cups are recyclable. After I open the package, I put the remaining K-cups in a container in the refrigerator to help keep them fresh.
I thought this product would be amazing, based on the way it smelled when I opened the bag, but it was just average. Not great, but not awful.

After reading the reviews we jumped in with both feet and ordered this and the French Roast. Here's my take on the Fog Chaser after drinking all 36 cups:* I prefer the French Roast, but I like a darker roast. This has a fruity undertone, similar to a Breakfast Blend, that I personally don't care for. But, my husband likes it and I find it drinkable.* Don't be scared by the look, it's just a K-Cup without the plastic case. I love that this seems more eco-friendly.* Okay, it's true, they smell a little funny. Not quite sure why they don't just smell like coffee, but who knows what other K-cups smell like without the plastic cover, right? Our solution was just not to smell them before brewing.* The taste is pretty strong, and my first cup tasted bitter and not so great. We don't use sugar or sweeteners so there was nothing to mask the taste! But, like most new things, after a couple of cups over a couple of mornings I found the taste was fine, especially for the price. I don't know if I would serve this to company though, I like darker roasts but most people don't, and this is a little more bold than mild. There is a not-totally-pleasant aftertaste, but not enough to not drink it.* I read a tip that said to prevent grounds in your cup, close the brewer lid slowly and gently. Works for us, we've had NO grounds in our cups.So there we go, I'm ordering them again to take advantage of the Subscribe & Save option. I'm not going to say that this is the best coffee I've ever had, but for that 1st cup in the morning it's just fine.

column9: Just to net it out, good coffee.
column10: I almost didn't bother writing this since everything i have to say is covered by others.  Stated simply, it's good coffee, excellent price, with less plastic to go into the trash.  I often run two cycles (one large and one small) using the same "k-cup" (not really a k-cup but functions as one) and mix them together. To calibrate my opinion, I'll mention that I am a huge fan of Dunkin Doughnut coffee and I tolerate Starbucks.

column9: Finally a K-Cup that makes a bigger cup of coffee
column10: Because this Fog Chaser K-Cup makes a very strong regular (a.k.a. SMALL) cup of coffee, it is a great pod for making a larger (travel-sized) cup of coffee that is the perfect strength.  This is absolutely the best deal I've found anywhere online for any K-Cups, and this brand has proven to be of excellent quality as well (I've also ordered French Roast Decaf and was happy with those too!).Because these have a filter-type bottom, you will have to keep them in a sealed bag or container once the individual bag has been opened to keep them at optimal freshness, but this is easy to do and, in my opinion, not a big deal.Great price + great taste = great value.  You can't go wrong with these.
This is great stuff.  One of my all time favorites.  If you like strong coffee then you will like this.
First time user and found this coffee is very good.  Not too acidy or overly strong.  Good stuff!  I would order again and definately recommend this to others

PLEASE READ!!!!! Do not let the bad reviewers drive you away, I almost didn't order these because of them. If you like REAL coffee not fluffed up flavored coffee but real coffee this is for you. I have tried pretty much every K-cup on the market and the only ones I enjoy are midnight magic and jet fuel. If you like either of these two you will enjoy this cup of coffee. A little about my coffee preference, I mainly enjoy french pressed strong coffees because the flavors are out of this world. I do have a Keurig (Christmas gift) for about 5 years now, sad part is I only use this if I ran out of time in the morning. With all of that said do realize this is not even remotely close to a french press but is now being added to my very small k-cup approval list.

What I really like about this K-Cup is that it is not a normal K-Cup encased in plastic. The coffee is enclosed in a filter, which results in less plastic in the landfills. In addition, the coffee itself is a nice strong cup worthy of it's name, Fog Chaser. It is my favorite cup of coffee in the morning. I have made it a point to subscribe and have it delivered every month.

Though it may not be the BEST coffee I've ever tasted, it's pretty up there, and for a price that's a fraction of the other K-cups, it's 5-stars in my book.  I get an 80-pack box from my local BJ's for $28, so it works out to be $.35/k-cup.  It's much more rich and flavorful than other k-cups I've tried (donut shop, green mountain, gloria jean's).

I first bought this at a local grocery and liked it so much I went to amazon to purchase it on an automatic delivery.  It has a different packaging than most, but it works the same.  The pricing is much better than purchasing either in the store or online individually.  This is my first auto delivery from amazon.  I am very pleased with the coffee and the shipping process.
This is a great coffee, very strong and tasty, not just bitter and bold.The lack of a plastic cup at the bottom is neat, reduces waste significantly.

Count me among the fans. I love the lower-waste design of these k-cup compatible pods. It is a mild inconvenience keeping them in an airtight container, but the investment in a tight-sealing jar paid for itself with the first case. It was smart to package them in bags of 12, so each bag is only open for about a week.  The coffee is good. Not astonishingly strong, but pretty rich and balanced. They don't advertise it here, but the company's coffee is fair trade/direct trade as well!

column9: Great Tasting Coffee, Great K-Cups Too!
column10: A friend offered me a cup of this about a week ago. Wonderful stuff! Disappointing when he told me, it's not in stores. (At least not around here, so I have to order on Amazon...) It's great tasting coffee!  And more importantly, even though it brews in the Keurig, it's NOT in little plastic cups.More than two years ago I switched to the oh-so-convenient K-Cups, despite reservations about brewing coffee in little plastic cups. (1)Very hot water steeps in Plastic cups. (2)Lots of little plastic cups go into landfills or incinerators.  Now, finally, there's a product with all the convenience of the K-cup brewers, but none of the drawbacks!  Why didn't someone think of this sooner?

I really like this coffee. It's bold, yet smooth as well. I especially appreciate the simpler packaging with much less plastic waste. Additionally, I don't think the coffee grounds touch plastic at all, just the foil top and filter. They work impeccably in my Keurig.

column9: Less waste, great taste, go for it!
column10: Our family really likes this brand of coffee.  The package the coffee by the dozen in plastic bags to ensure freshness and the taste is a mild to medium flavor.  The subscribe and save is a great way to save money (around fourteen dollars for thirty six cups) and ensure you're never without coffee.  Although it's still wasteful, each cup has less plastic than the regular k-cup coffees out there.  I actually like that you can see the coffee and the little filter pouch it sits in.  We recently found out that costco is selling this brand of coffee (french roast - which is much more bold) for a more economical price (eighty cups for around thirty six cents a piece).  We will continue to purchase and suggest you try it out at least once.
I like a bolder coffee than my husband does and this one is good enough for me. It leaves a pleasant after-flavor. I am impressed also with the design of the cups. I'd certainly order it again.
It was much too "sharp/harsh" for me.  Had to add cinnamon and half-and-half just to get it down.  Really sorry I purchased two boxes of it!

column9: Only decent coffee. Poorly filtered and goes stale
column10: I purchased this because another reviewer likened it to Coffee People's Jet Fuel.  Unfortunately it is not even close.The first cup seemed fine. The flavor immediately after brewing is good, but as soon as it cools down some it turns harsh fast.The open-filter is a poor design. It can and absolutely will go stale.  I compared the scent of the final coffee pouch(cup?) from a previously opened bag to a newly opened, and the scent is completely different. Think old coffee can vs. freshly opened.The other gripe on the filter is the poor filtration. There is always sediment at the bottom of the cup.About me: I am very picky about my coffee. I drink it straight black and brew at 8oz with double filtered water in a Cuisinart Keurig coffee maker.  I don't reuse k-cups!My favorite coffees are Coffee People's Black Tiger and Jet Fuel, Caribou's Mahogany and Van Houtte's Eclipse.

column9: San Francisco Bay Coffee One Cup for Keurig K-Cup Brewers, Fog Chaser,
column10: Both my wife and I like this coffee.  one brew per cup for her is how she likes.  I brew a cup 1-1/2 times to get the flavor I like.  Very good price.  If there is a down side it would be the container is not your typical k-kup, rather a round filter at the bottom holding the coffee.  It works fine in the Keurig and we keep ours unused in an air tight container to keep fresh

The San Francisco Bay coffee was delivered to my home very quickly and I found the product to be professionally wrapped in several small packages offering fresh coffee over the entire period of use; Amazon puts a lot of thought into what they sell and how they sell it.While I found the product different and a bit stronger in the beginning I think I will tray another brand not quite as strong next time.

Love this coffee - when it first arrived I thought I had ordered the wrong thing as the "pods" are quite different from regular K-cups, but they work perfectly and I think the coffee tastes much better than the coffee in the plastic pods.  The Fog Chaser is a nice, not-too-strong, coffee, perfect for that first wake up cup in the morning.

column9: Best value for quality k-cup coffee!
column10: From the moment I cut open the sealed bag containing the coffee pods, I could appreciate the quality of this coffee, as the wonderful aroma enveloped my senses.  The coffee taste only bolstered my appreciation, as the flavor was rich and delicious.  Highly recommended!  (Note: I have no connection with this company... just a happy customer)

column9: Great bold flavor and great value
column10: Love these k-cups, bold flavor similar to Jet Fuel or Big Easy with less of a French roast flavor.  I can actually get a 12 Oz. cup and still have good flavor.
wonderful full bodied coffee and a great price; much less 'offensive' packaging than a normal K-cup; works just like a normal K-cup; no problems.

column9: This is the best one yet!
column10: "Fog Chaser"...a great description! Extremely fresh. The taste is surprisingly deep and rich for a medium roast, or "Full City." I usually drink a darker roast just to get the extra bit of flavor, but this one is even better than San Francisco Bay's French Roast. The only other coffees that come close are Brooklyn Bean Roastery "Fuhgeddaboudit" and "Cyclone," two of my other favorites, along with Green Mountain Revv.Keep in mind that these are "pods" rather than actual k-cups, so after you open the bag, you will need to seal the unused capsules in a zip bag, preferably in the refrigerator (not the freezer). Doing this, I've never had the coffee go stale. If you like deep, flavorful coffee, I recommend you give this one a try.
The design of these pods are so much better than the Kcups.  Give a full bodied rich cup of delicious coffee.Wish there were more flavor options in this packaging.  Fantastic!!

Good option for K-Cup coffee makers.  The filter pod fits right into the machine and brews a great cup of coffee with less plastic waste.  The packaging allows a pretty good price point, but for a stronger better tasting coffee  (you know the one named after the actor) I will stay with club stores 80 pack for $39, keeping the coffee price just below that 50c mark.
The taste was ok, but every cup ended up having sediment at the bottom of the cup.  I will not be buying this brand again.  So far, Brooklyn Bean Cyclone and Coffee People Jet Fuel are my favorites.

No sediment, just great tasting (and smelling) coffee.  Tired of Emeril's constant price changes and packaging changes.  This is as hearty as Emeril and as smooth with less waste to Mother Earth and much less money.  Very impressed, been using Keurig for over 5 years and this coffee is great.

I am not big on posting reviews but this coffee is awesome!  The aroma when you open the bag, the smell while it is brewing, I just cant say enough good about this coffee!!  Yes is it not the same K-Cup we are used to seeing - so what!!!  It works great and I will just store them in a canister - it is worth it for a good strong cup of coffee.  Something, in my opinion, that has been missing from K-cup selections.  Hope this review helps!!

I like the concept of eco-friendly packaging. It fit and brewed in my Keurig just as a regular K-cup does. The coffee was smooth and aromatic but a bit too smoky for my taste. Maybe I will try a different blend.

After living in Europe for 6 years, I have become very picky about coffee.  I am not a "coffee snob"...I can't tell what aroma a coffee may or may not have; I can just taste the difference between good and bad coffee.  Don't be fooled by the price of this coffee or the different looking k-cup; this coffee is top-notch.  If you like good coffee, this is worth a try.****EDIT****I thought about writing a long rant, about how the negative reviewers of this coffee, don't know what good coffee taste like, but I thought twice.  They just like a different taste to their coffee.  So instead, if you like Folgers, Maxwell House, Green Mountain, The Coffee People, etc., you will probably not like this coffee.  The people who will like this, should know who they are, by my previous comment.  I did find a couple of varieties of coffee from the same manufacture I did somewhat enjoy; Coffee People - Black Tiger, Green Mountain - Black Magic and Sumatran Reserve, although I did not like it enough, to purchase them again.Here is a list of coffee I really enjoy and come in K-Cups.Caribou Mahogany, Starbucks Sumatra and Pikes Place.
Thses cooffee pods are extra nice because there is much less plastic and work just as well.  The flovor is nice and bold without being bitter.  I have re-ordered and will continue to do so.

Very smooth with no aftertaste, slightly bold. I use a medium size setting, I think 7 1/4 oz. on my maker. It seems necessary to store them in an airtight container after opening, to keep fresh. One of my current favorites.

I stumbled upon this coffee while browsing Amazon and was instantly interested because of the price and when I looked further I saw that it had much less plastic.  I decided to try it.  It is sooo  good.  I can see this being my new favorite coffee.  I will have to see how it stores.  I do like that there are 3- 12 packs so I only have to open 12 pods at once.  I'll store them in tupperware or something but I can't imagine it will be much of a problem.  It really really is a wonderful, strong, flavorful cup of coffee.  Thank you SF Bay Coffee.
Great coffe! Ordered the French roast to see if it is as good. The pod design is very good.Enjoy!

This is one that truly seems to depend on your taste in coffee.  I served it to five people at the office because I personally love it.  Two of them said they couldn't finish the cup, while the other three thought it was the best they've had. I personally like the more traditional taste of brewed coffee that this product produces.  The plastic k-cups always seemed to have an awkward taste to them, almost as if I wasn't really drinking coffee.  I do get a small amount of sediment in the bottom of the cup, but also don't mind that.  Since it does turn the inside of my white cup pretty black, I suppose I should also start thinking about what it's doing to my teeth and my insides, but the flavor seems to make it all worthwhile anyhow.  At the office it was clearly a love it or hate it type reaction - this from four people who usually choose a bold coffee and one who always drinks light (but happened to love this).

After buying the SFB French Roast K-Cups, I thought I would give the Fog Chaser a chance.  Wow!  What a good and strong cup of coffee.  Stronger than the French Roast.  I will keep buying these!Just an update:  Recently I found k-cups on sale and bought a box of what used to be my favorite.  After brewing the coffee and drinking it, I realized, I did not like it!  The SF Fog Chaser is superior to the k-cups offered.  Will not go back to the regular k-cups again.
makes a good cup of coffee at a reasonable cost. not a true k-cup but works well in a keurig.

I stumbled across this coffee, and I'm so glad I did !!!  Just received it today, was curious so I made a cup.  Great flavor, a bit bold, but very smooth.  I think my husband will love it tomorrow morning.  Signed up for the auto shipments, which takes the price a bit lower and I don't have to place an order every month.  Great product and love the auto ship !!!!

column9: San Francisco Bay Coffee OneCup for Keurig K-Cup Brewers
column10: I was a bit skeptical when I saw to alternative to the original K-Cup,  I tried the Fog Chaser and have to say it is a great product.  Good balanced flavor and strong too.  I usually buy coffee by the case at Costco but this is a superior option.  Less plastic also makes them more ecologically friendly and potentially recyclable.  Two Thumbs Up!

I am so glad I read the reviews on this coffee product.  The cups fit the Keurig very well and make a tasty cup of coffee!  I like the fact that there is no plastic base to it (less plastic in the trash).  I will buy it again and again.  My favorite coffee thus far.  I have subscribed to this so it will be shipped automatically every month.

column9: Nice taste, but can buy it for less elsewhere.
column10: Fog Chaser is a pleasant tasting cup of coffee. I like the more environmentally friendly cup/pod design, but since it comes twelve in a plastic bag, I don't know if it is a net eco-plus. I also can buy it at Wegman's for much less than from Amazon.

This is an intense, rich, flavorful coffee. While I like a robust flavor, this one seems quite acidic. It does "chase fog", for sure! I think it has a real caffeine kick to it. The cups are intersting in that they have a wider brim so they fit right into the Keurig without touching the bottom poker. I brewed a 12oz. cup and a 16oz. cup. The 16 was more to my liking, but the acidity of the coffee made it difficult to finish either cup. Just a little too strong for my liking. Interesting packaging. We drink several cups a day, so I don't believe it would get stale. And they do fit right in the carousel.

This is a great full bodied coffee. I have tasted different brands and have a few I would call favorites, this is one. The design of the K-Cup without the plastic cup at the bottom is very different but you don't even miss it. You will love the taste of this coffee.I haven't tried the other flavors San Francisco Bay puts out but I'm tempted.
good coffee not to strong not to weak enjoyed very much will continue to order this brand of coffee in the future. Thanks so much

column9: Robust Alternative for Discontinued San Lorenzo Dark
column10: Another manufacturer recently discontinued my favorite k-cup and I have been searching for a replacement - Fog Chaser is my choice - robust and flavorful, it is best consumed black - it certain chases the fog of sleep and and helps to get my days started.

Hands down, this coffee is the best K-cup compatible product available..  Filter system is superior to K-Cup, much of the natural coffee oils actually make it into your cup.....  HIGHLY RECOMMEND - subscribe and save a +

Bravo for the new Eco Friendly Pod.  I actually forgot what fresh, real coffee tastes like.  At first I was taking back but the strong, robust flavor.  Then after a few sniffs and sips I felt rejuvenated.  For the first time since I got my Keurig I realized that I missed fresh brewed coffee.  The taste is so fresh, so lively, so good.  The price is also an added bonus.  This Crazy Coffee Mom is really hooked.

column9: Don't let the different form factor scare you off - they'll work in your Keurig
column10: These work just fine in any Keurig-style coffee maker - if it uses K-Cups, it can use these.  If anything, these are probably a bit more environmentally-friendly than standard K-Cups simply by virtue of containing far less plastic.The only problem is, they just don't taste that good.  The coffee itself leaves something to be desired, surprising considering the history of the company that makes these. (full disclosure: I worked briefly for these folks back in the late '70s. Since I have a personal connection to the products, I really wanted to like them) I liked this better than the Rainforest Blend (which I found weak and watery) but not as much as the French Roast. (which I didn't really care for that much when I first tasted it, but found it grew on me as I worked my way through the case and compared it with other K-Cups)Keep in mind that this review is based on a single cup, and I didn't really like the French Roast when I first tasted it either, so you might want to take this with a grain of salt until I've had a few more opportunities to sample the product and compare it to other varieties.  I'll update if my opinion changes with time, but on first try, I doubt I'd buy this again.  It's better than the Rainforest Blend, but I'd be more likely to buy the French Roast than this.Like other One Cup varieties, these leave a bit more sediment in the bottom of the cup and produce more "crema" - the brownish foam floating on top of a good cup of coffee - than most traditional K-Cups.  The Fog Chaser seems to produce less than either the French Roast or the Rainforest Blend, for what it's worth. I found the flavor just a little on the thin and bitter side.
It fits fine in my Kreuig.  My low rating is for taste. It was ok, not terrible... but not something I am excited to have in the mornings.  Put some flavored creamer in it and all's good.

column9: Coffee as good as green mountain!
column10: Just recieved this coffe for the first time. San Francisco Bay "Fog Chaser", I like a bold coffee and this one delivers...great balance flavor and this cup design works great! With so much less waste and the price is outstanding! Thanks San Francisco Coffee Co.

column9: Best Keurig cup of coffee I've had!!
column10: These "cups" have a little filter at the bottom instead if a plastic cup which allows for less waste in the trash can, yeah!! I always felt kind of guilty putting so many plastic cups in the garbage. Now to the coffee it is absolutely the best I have had.  A 10oz cup is possible without tasting too watery, especially with the French roast.  Every one of the Rogers family cups are great.  The fog chaser is a little smoother than the french roast but nice and dark.  The french roast is great also not quite as bitter as the usual french roast even the decaf is great.  This coffee rivals fresh brewed easily and is less expensive which is a bonus for those of us who want the freedom of K cups but don't like the price.  I will buy this brand from now on, I am a loyal customer of this Old San Francisco Bay Coffee.  Rogers family thanks for bringing real coffee to Keurig.

column9: Yay, less plastic! Boo, weak coffee!
column10: These smell FANTASTIC! Too bad the coffee is weak. When the machine brews, the last 70% of the stream is hot water. (Every other K-Cup brews fine.)

OK, I know there are over 200 reviews, but I just had to add my two cents. THis is by far THE BEST approach to this one cup (kcup) system. Not dispensing with the pod system, which is slightly less toxic to the environment. Ok, so without a doubt a step in the right direction on the kcup systems; but the coffee....WOW..this stuff hits your nose when you open the bag and keeps hitting it each time I open the zip lock I put them into, after opening the original ( slight dig on the company for not making a resealable bag..come on man!  Anyway, can't say enough about the coffee, I have tried just about every bold, dark, espresso, medium roast, you name it, and this one is my favorite so far.I may have to buy some beans or grounds to use to make my own.Thanks!

I really like the idea of the large filter on the bottom.  I hate when one of my K-cups would not work correctly and leak everywhere but this design prevents that. The coffee tastes great with no bitter after taste. I will be buying this again!
This particular coffee is a bit strong for my taste. It was worth a try and you certainly get good amount of coffee for the money.

column9: Great coffee, less waste in packaging
column10: This coffee is a good selection if you like a dark, full-bodied brew to chase the fog, and dislike the waste inherent with the convenience of a Keurig K-cup brewer. Works great, less material waste and less packaging waste. I do think it is a good idea to keep them in a sealed container, but an old coffee can works great.

column9: Not bad - Had better - I'd buy it again
column10: The flavor of the the Fog Chaser is pretty good. Bold, yet not "too" strong.The cup design seems to work/brew okay, just maybe allows for a small amount of "fines" to sneak into the coffee cup.The price is attractive and makes it a "re-buy" if I'm running low on Coffee People Donut Shop...These need to be kept in a air tight container. I use a zip baggie.

This is a great idea to reduce packaging and works great on the kuerig brewer.  The coffee was wonderful, and the price was much better than the regular k-cups. I would love to see them come in flavored coffee also.

When I ordered this coffee, I hoped the majority of the reviews were correct, and they were. I am really happy with Fog Chaser. I've bounced around through all the Keurig dark roasts and in my opinion, this is better than all of them. The aroma and taste far surpass any K-cup I've ever had. I store the coffee in an air-tight container, and have had no problems with freshness. They work perfectly in my B70 brewer, and I do wash the K-cup holder every couple of days or so because these have a real filter instead of plastic. The price is great, especially with Subscribe and Save - never going back to plastic K-Cups!
This is some great coffee. My wife likes it too. It has a good blend of flavors and isn't too bitter. I'll keep ordering it.
A perfect blend, and a good bargain.  The coffee "pod" cups fit perfectly in the Keurig.  I bought this coffee for my husband who is a fussy coffee drinker.  He loves it!

This was a new item for me, believe me I have tried them all. The new type of K-cup is great! It lets the coffee drain much better.  I am ordering more...Thanks San Francisco Bay Coffee for your new way of packaging.

column9: Great way to make K cup coffee
column10: Great coffee flavor.  Great price!  Like this method.  Use coffee canister to store once open package.  I use the subscription for an even better price.
This was a new brand for our Keurig, so I did not know what to expect. I was surprised with no "k-cup" - but this works very well and seems "greener." Tastes great.

I like coffee but I don't have a palate that can differentiate between a coffee with subtle hints of vanilla, grass and one with "smokiness." I just know whether I like it or not. To me there's two kinds of coffee, the smooth kind and the kind that has a bite.I feel like Starbucks and Dunkin Donuts have a bite to them, something that makes them different. This Fog Chaser coffee is like that. There's something about it that makes it different and I think it's really good!The cups are not your normal K cup so I just got a metal tin and put them in there to keep them fresh.If you do the subscribe and save on amazon, it makes these cups very affordable (for k cups).Overall, very good coffee.
Bold taste, but the roast isn't too strong.  This is a nice, every-day cup.  Brews well in Keurig.  I also bought the Rainforest and French Roast (which I love).

Coffee has a very good taste, is not bitter and has a pleasant aroma. The only problem I have with it is it comes in a fiber womb, not plastic like most other K-Cups. And sometimes it allows the coffee sediment to leak through. It doesn't happen all the time, found to be about 20-25% of the time. Also you have to place cups in a zip lock baggie to keep fresh, after you open Mfg's.bag. If it weren't for this I would have given it 5 Stars.

column9: Not Quite a K-Cup, but awesome coffee!
column10: First of all, the coffee is quite rich, and definitely appropriately labeled Fog Chaser!  Non bitter, smooth bold medium-dark roast.  It is one of my personal favorites.  But the purchaser should be aware of how this coffee is packaged. It works great in the Keurig machines but the packaging is not a true K-cup.  A K-cup, as designed (and probably patented), is a small plastic cup sealed with a foil lid, under which is a coffee filter pouch of a single serving of coffee.  The packaging on this does not have the plastic cup encasing the foil lid and filter paper pouch of coffee.  I suspect the manufacturer is saving in paying licensing fees from using the K-Cup design by excluding the cup.  But you have to use different storage containers for these packages, as using the usual racks and other means of storing K-Cups will allow air to get to the coffee and cause it to go stale unless stored in an air-tight container or plastic bag.  Also, this packaging may not work in Keurig brewers that automatically dispose of the spent K-Cups.  Another slight inconvenience is that the brewed package leaves a wet coffee filter sack of coffee grounds, whereas with a genuine K-Cup, the spent package only has one small hole in the bottom of the plastic cup, the rest of the package is dry upon disposal handling.
The moment I opened the bag I knew this was going to be good.  The Aroma was FANTASTIC.I have this in my office at work and several other people have had a "wow" reaction to the aroma.

column9: Fantastic Product and a BIG Surprise
column10: I am very surprised that the biggest secret about San Francisco Bay single service coffee , which works perfectly in famous brand K-Cup makers, has not been revealed in any of the previous comments.  Or at least I did not find the secret yet revealed.  I love Amazon.com and am a high volume customer but folks, you can get this product at COSTCO at a significant savings.  An 80 count box at COSTCO is just around $30; unit cost is about 34 cents.  Do not hesitate because of the 80 count box.  The contents are packed 8 units to a heavy duty sealed nitrogen filled bag that will hold for over a year.  You will find the 'good until' date clearly printed on each bag.  When you cut open the bag (you will need scissors) the phenomenal fragrance of freshly ground French Roast coffee comes right at you.  If you like that rich smell of fresh ground, this will be almost as good as when you drink it after brewing.So is this a good coffee?  I am an old restaurant guy and I always prefer my coffee rich, dark and not bitter.  I tried virtually all the K-cup samplers available so I could do a comparison of the DARKS, BOLDS and FRENCH ROASTS I could find.  Other than a few Sumatra brews, this SF BAY product stood out at the top of the list.  That even includes the really expensive stuff that is good but not good enough to be price competitive or flavor superior. If you do not at least try this coffee in your K-Cup brewer, you are missing a unique opportunity for quality and value.  If you shop at COSTCO, you need to look for it and get the best competitive single serve French Roast around town.  You will also find that San Francisco Bay bulk coffees have been sold at COSTCO for a very long time.Now, about that little filter material container in place of the plastic cup you are used to seeing.  Well, the Rodgers Family who produce all the San Francisco Bay Coffees (and other labels), are independent and want us all to get their premium coffees without having to pay the Royalties to use the "K-Cup" brand name...and they do not want to infringe on copyright designs, so they were inspired to have this design created.  The entire container portion of the unit is indeed a filter and allows for the best extraction methodology.You must be asking yourself if I am a "shill" for this company and the answer is an emphatic NO.  I am just a life long student of consumer economics and I really like to give credit when and where it is earned.  The Rodgers family business is located in Lincoln, California in the vicinity of where I live - and I also like to support my local business.You may forget all about what I have said here, but you will always remember San Francisco Bay French Roast once you have tasted it.

Like others here I am always on the lookout for a K-Cup bargain. With such an attractive price I finally decided to give San Francisco Bay's Fog Chaser a chance. I was a little worried about the unique design of these cups. However, after receiving them and brewing a couple of cups of coffee I can say that there was no need to worry. I would describe this coffee as Medium roast, maybe leaning towards dark. It has a nice distinctive flavor, and the Amazon Frustration Free packaging really is frustration free. We store our open cups in a sealed container to help maintain freshness. All in all a good cup of coffee, and as long as the price remains competitive I will be a repeat customer.

column9: New K-Cup brewers are great, especially the lower price.
column10: I'm thrilled that we can now purchase less expensive K-cups.Keurig was definitely getting too expensive for me.I tried the Fog Chaser, it was good, clean-tasting coffee but not as strongas I thought it should be. And the free shipping from Amazon makes itmore appealable.  Will be purchasing again.

What a surprise when I got home from the grocery store and opened this package to find cups that really look nothing like the ones you are used to.  I was a little worried when I saw that instead of all plastic, this actually is made out of very little plastic and the coffee is actually held in material just like regular coffee filters.  I love that they are not as destructive to the environment as the others.  The company really believes in freshness since they put these little pod/pouches in a sealed pouch and then stick them in the cardboard.Now mind you I am truly wedded to my Green Mountain Dark Magic, but I decided to try this because of the price.  And I'm not one bit sorry I did, I feel a tad guilty for semi-abandoning my Green Mountain! This Fogchaser blend  makes a good strong  cup of coffee without giving me the  feeling that the lining of my stomach is going to burn out.I'm thrilled to see that I now have an alternative to Green Mountain and I can even save money since it is at least 3 dollars cheaper (at least in my grocery store) a package.

Decided to give this a try since k-cup (all coffee?) prices have been going up.  Brewed with the large mug (not tumbler) size on my Keurig B70.  It isn't as dark as Peet's from my ekobrew adapter, but that might be because Peet's does a darker roast.  Stronger than Green Mtn Colombian.  Maybe about the same as Dark Magic.Coworkers agreed that we'll probably buy more since we don't have to do any coupons from other vendors to get good coffee at this price.

column9: A step in the right perfection
column10: 5:45 a.m. The alarm just went off. You want to be on the road before 7. You find the kitchen, get out the kettle and start the water boiling. Get out the Boodum, fill it up. Wait. Water boils. Pour it in the press. Wait.  Wait more. Can't wait any longer. Push plunger, drink, coffee is weak, pillow starts calling your name, you lose the will to shower, next thing you know, it's 8:15 and you're praying for the grid to melt down.OR, you get up at 5:45 a.m., drop a K-Cup in your Keurig, push a button and your cup runneth over (especially if you accidentally pushed the button with the picture of the mug on it).  And if it's San Francisco Bay Fog Cutter, you also get a deliciously rich, full-bodied, fragrant brew that is acid free and gentle on an early morning tummy.  Best of all, you can drink your Fog Cutter while waiting for the stuff in the Boodum Coffee Press to be ready. Now you can face the shower, the hair dryer, the curling iron and the eyelash curler without fear.I prefer the Boodum to the Keurig, but when you need coffee now, this blend can't be beat.  It's the best of all the K-Cup offerings that I've tried, and I've tried everything from Donut Shop to Newman's Own and most points in between.  It is my early morning wake up favorite.I was very amused, not to say impressed, by one reviewers comments about the packaging  He notes that there is a drawing of a K-Cup type machine on the front of the box and a list of various K-Cup brewers that will accommodate this version of the K-Cup.  He points out that the San Francisco Bay Coffee supports many environmental projects, as noted on the top of the box, which also shows photos of these worthy projects.  The Rodgers Family, who own the company, are shown in a family photo on one side flap, along with an essay on the company's values.  The other flap has a description of the actual coffee.  This guy is a whiz in the a.m.  I'm happy if I find the sink on the first try.Anyway, this is the best pre-coffee coffee I've ever had. And it's an excellent main course coffee too.Enjoy.

column9: If you like it strong, this one's for you!
column10: This variety is strong and bold!  The price is reasonable as it is.  But, if you want to stretch your K-cup value even more, you can make 2 cups from one K-cup.  I brew a medium and a small cup into my large coffee cup.  And, it's still a strong cup of coffee!  I like this so much that I signed up for subscribe and save!

I generally like the stronger coffees.  A lot of the k-cups have been very weak and flavorless.  I have nearly finished my first order of the Fog Chaser and it is one of the better coffees I've had for the Keurig.  The k-cups are little different than the traditional plastic cups, but who cares?  And I can't figure out what "smell" other reviewers are talking about.  When you open a bag, it smells like ground COFFEE.  Uh, that is not a bad thing.  It is because the cups are made of a breathable filter pouch.  What does a box of regular K-cups smell like?  Plastic cups?Each twelve comes in its own sealed plastic bag so I am not worried about them going stale unless it takes you a couple months to drink 12 cups.  And the price is much lower than most of the of the other brands.  I can't see spending 1 1/2 to 2 times as much for coffee that is either not as good or at best just as good.  I singed up for the subscribe and save to get it delivered regularly so I dont run out.  I just hope others find it as great tasting as I do so amazon keeps carrying it!

I wish I didn't feel like I have to give this product a low rating, but I wouldn't buy it again without some changes.  It's really delicious coffee -- bold and flavorful, without the mouth-puckering acidity of some of the coffee I've tried.  The flavor changes as it cools, too.  Most delightful.However.  The first time I used one it really made a mess.  I had to clean coffee grounds out of the brewing doohickey on the Keurig (which I hate doing because it's tedious), and there was quite a bit of sediment in my cup, too.  It's exactly the same thing that happens with my reusable k-cup.  I was trying to find an alternative to that, and to contributing so many of those little plastic planet-polluter K-cups to the landfill.  (We drink a lot of coffee.)If the company could find a way to keep that from happening -- a coarser grind, maybe? -- I'd for sure try this again.  I can use the remaining pods, though. They'll be handy for traveling with. I tried opening one and brewing the coffee in my Aeropress and they're just right for that.And then, later on...I had to come back and update this review.  We ran out of Kcups, and I dug these out of the cupboard in desperation.  My husband likes them so much that I'm ordering more, messy or not.  BTW, he said he considers the sediment minimal, and not much of an issue at all.

After having the conventional plastic packaged k cup brand coffees this was a very eco-friendly and satisfying alternative.  I have tried each of the Rogers family flavors and find them all aromatic and good tasting.  Only one downfall, as they cannot be stored in my countertop carousel.  This flavorful coffee is well worth the inconvenience of having to store the unused cups in an air tight container.  Who would think that such an economical coffee could taste so good.

After reading the reviews that indicated a non-traditional k-cup packaging, I was a little leery-- but the packaging works well in my coffee maker and leaves no residue in the cup. The coffee is delicious-- I tend to prefer strong blends and this is satisfying. Good product, good price.

column9: The best K cup coffee so far
column10: I have owned a Keurig for about 2 years now and this is by far the tastiest cup of coffee I've had and I've tried LOTS. I love the little paper filter as opposed to the full plastic jacket of most K-cups. It's a keeper!

These brilliant K-cups have about 10-20% of the plastic of a normal K-cup.  A persistent criticism of K-Cups in the press is the amount of plastic that winds up in the landfill.  We all know (and love) the ease of popping in a cup, pressing the brew button, and tossing the cup afterwards.  So easy!  However I've always felt guilty about the waste, as normally I compost coffee grounds and of course there is no plastic associated with a paper coffee filter.  You can buy refillable K-cups but none of them fit my B30 apparently and anyway the convenience factor diminishes greatly.  These work in my B30 perfectly.  It's hard for me to judge the taste - I add milk and sugar - but the bouquet is pleasing.

column9: You really can have it all
column10: Function: these cupless k-cups work perfectly in our Keurig B130 (the business version of the small personal brewer).Less waste: I was terribly disappointed when I discovered that the plastic k-cups aren't recyclable.  These are a terrific low-guilt, more responsible alternative.Less storage space: they take up much less room to store.  I buy my k-cups in quantity to save money, but then I had to dedicate a large cabinet to storing them!  Not so with these, partially because they're less bulky and partially because...Great Price: these k-cups are much less expensive than other brands, especially at the Subscribe & Save price.  At this price, I can buy less at a time and still pay way less per cup than I could finagle with coupons & sales & bargain-shopping the major brands.Taste: Ok, obviously this is the most important factor...and so as soon as they arrived I threw one in and...hurray, they're tasty!  Fog Chaser is a slightly less strong taste than I usually drink, but I find it pleasant & smooth & complex in flavor.  It tastes like it smells, which is very nice.Conclusion: I'm keeping my subscription.  How can you beat cheap, tasty, less bulky, and less waste?  You really can have it all.Update a month later: this roast has really grown on me!
This coffee has a wonderful flavor.  It is very aromatic.  I love this coffee and the price!  I love my Keurig, but k cups are spendy.  This product is perfect.

Wow! When I first tried this coffee my response was "That's way too strong"! And yet, after getting into the 2nd cup, I found that I am starting to enjoy real coffee again. Definitely the big favorite in our house, and highly recommended. Also, a little less plastic in the landfill, so that's a plus.

column9: Great Coffee -- some of cups flawed
column10: Yes, these cups have to be kept in a bag or jar to keep their freshness. However, there are only 12 cups per bag, so I didn't find any flavor loss when I clipped the bag closed. I used 12 in about 15-18 days.I loved the flavor: a nice, rich cup when set on medium setting on my Keurig (which is what I always use except for some weak flavored blends). They fit perfectly in my B70 Keurig -- and I love saving on extra packaging.But I had a problem I don't see anyone else mentioning: Of the 36 cups total, 3 were duds. The water flowed them, but only light brown water came out. Three out of 36 is too high a failure rate for me. With regular k-cups (of which I've used at least 1200 in 5 years), I've only had maybe 5 duds.Therefore I rate this as 3-stars for now (not less as I don't see anyone else having had this problem). I might try this or another flavor again at some point because the coffee is good and the price is right. Then we'll see...

I purchased the Fogchaser Kcups and really enjoyed the strong earthy taste. The coffee tastes like "organic" grown beans. I stopped buying Kcups because I just wasn't getting the caffeine kick that I demand from my coffee. San Francisco Bay Fog Chaser coffee is the only Kcup coffee I have ever purchased that actually tastes like strong black coffee as opposed to the usual Kcup brew of hot colored water.I will definitely keep my "Subscribe and Save" order for SFB Fog Chaser coffee.
Coffee is excellent.  The K-Cup is different in that a filter is at the bottom and really provides a great taste.  Set up a subscription and you can not beat the quality and price!

I have been having trouble with my small Keurig with the regular kcups.  (this is the smallest Mr Coffee made by Keurig and is brand new), but it would only brew half a cup and sometimes the pressure would rupture the seal on the k cup and grounds would overflow...I bought the San Francisco Bay Fog Chaser and not only is the taste awesome...but my keurig loves them...I think the filter bottom vs, the plastic cup allows the water to flow thru better and I get a full cup every time and no more mess!  I was going to return the Keurig and try something different...Not now!  Mr. Coffee Single Serve Powered by Keurig Brewing Technology

column9: By far the best cup of coffee ever!!!
column10: I received a Keurig machine as a gift for my birthday and had been using the regular run of the mill products that were available.  Then low and behold I found the San Francisco Bay brand of one cup brewing pods and you could not pay to stop using them!  By far the best cup of coffee ever, every single time!

Life is hectic and it's the small things that matter.  A fresh start to each day with a cup of great coffee!  The personalized product of the one cup San Francisco Bay is AMAZING!  The depth, aroma, flavor, color are far superior to others on the market.  Great quality, great price, great cup of coffee-

column9: Good coffee with one BIG flaw!
column10: I really liked this coffee, but it will not be on my list of coffees to buy again because of the one major flaw.  It comes in a sealed bag and when you open it, the aroma is tantalizing.  Too bad it is so short lived.  Unless you are going to drink 12 cups of coffee, or have a bigger family who will in one day, that is the last fresh cup you will get.  There is no bottom to this K-cup except what would be around a pod of coffee so the air destroys it quickly.  After I took out the few we would need for breakfast, I sealed the unused "k-cups" in a plastic bag, but for the next couple mornings when I got some out, the aroma had faded more and more.  I love the way the original K-cups stay fresh until you use them, and these are not like that.  I also didn't like how I couldn't put them in my carousel of other K-cups.  Kind of a pain to have them sealed in the cupboard until I wanted them.  Don't get me wrong, the coffee was excellent when we first opened the package, but the quality diminished quickly.  If you are one of those people who drinks the same kind of coffee every morning and have several people drinking it, this may work for you.  I like to have variety in the morning whether it be Jet Fuel or Italian roast according to how I feel that day so these won't be purchased by me again.

column9: This is supposed to be French Roast????
column10: I went into this purchase with an open mind. I liked the price and thought about how nice it would be to finally get a serious French Roast for my Keurig. Unfortunately this one did not measure up in the strength of flavor dept. I may try some of their other coffees though because I liked everything else about them very much. I just need my French Roast to have more punch than this one.***** price***** fast shipping**  French Roast flavorSorry guys but I'll stick with Midnight Magic and Jet Fuel for now.Please some show me a reasonably priced French Roast K cup that actually tastes like a French Roast.

column9: Great coffee. Great price. Get a ziploc & enjoy
column10: I like strong coffee and this coffee taste very good even when brewed on the big/travel mug setting. It's flavorful, not burnt tasting, and has a good kick. And to me represents a standout value in the world of Keurig choices. Do the math, especially with Subscribe and Save. I know some folks complain about them losing freshness... I just transfer them to a ziplock bag upon opening the package. Not a big deal and I don't sense I've lost freshness.I'd dock them half a star for the bag-to-bag transfer  (here's an idea: package them with a zipper, like cold cuts!) but it still rounds up to 5 stars. :-)

I have purchased these k-cup/pods a couple of times.  They brew a nice strong cup of coffee.  Bold flavor without bitterness.  These pods work great in my Keurig.  They brew a great clean cup of coffee.  I haven't had a problem with freshness because I go through a twelve pack in a few days.  If you want a flavorful and bold cup of coffee give Fog Chaser a try.

I at first thought I ordered the wrong product, and had to go back and check. This defeats much of the purpose of a K-Cup, having a sealed package with nitrogen gas to keep it fresh until ready to use. When I opened the bag, it was a great smell, as all the aroma escaped into the atmosphere!Know how do you keep the rest fresh? Opening and closing a zip lock isn't going to cut it, as air gets in each time.Also, without the cup, I don't think the coffee gets a chance to 'seep' long enough, as it seems a bit weak for something called Fog Cutter.Think I'll avoid this one in the future.

I found this coffee to be a bit too mild and flavorless for my taste. It reminded me a lot of the coffee I sometimes have to have when the family all wants to stop at Mcdonalds for breakfast. I also found that the coffee pods/K-cup quickly lost its freshness after two days. I had it inside an air tight container but soon after a couple of days the freshness was gone and the aroma of the coffee smelled like the can of Folgers that my mother-in-law has on her shelf. They also make a french roast which I thought was OK. But again, a bit weak for a french roast coffee. The french roast coffee, as was with the fog chaser,after a couple of days, soon lost its flavor and the aroma became "Folgers coffee" like. I guess the packaging makes a difference. In conclusion, I do not think I will be purchasing this again.

I picked this up at a Fresh & Easy.  While I like the idea of more choices than the officially licensed K-Cups, this is just not a good coffee.  It tastes bitter and bland.  Not recommended.  Try Millstone's Fogchaser K-Cups instead.

column9: San Francisco Bay K-Cups for Keurig Brewers
column10: Outstanding Cup of Coffee!  I have tried at least 20-25 different K-Cups for the Keurig Brewer.I highly recommend this one!  The aroma of the coffee in the K-Cup was fresh and smelled like the beans had just been ground. The flavor was not bitter or too strong.  I am impressed and now a fan of the San Francisco Bay Coffee makers. I also tried the French Roast and loved it as well. I appreciate other AMAZON users posting their reviews or I would never have tried it.
Excellent coffee and one of the best Keurig cup bargains there is I will buy more of this product and no plastic bottoms

column4: LT "Signed : LT in Beautiful South Florida"
column10: Loving the Greenmountain Nantucket K-cup .  I like a variety of coffee.  Love trying newbut Regular types of coffees.  I found this to be a nice cup of coffee.  Not Acidic at all.Some people are Starbuck lovers , some poeple are Dunkin Donut coffee Lovers.  Ima Dunkin Donut coffee lover.  This coffee was enjoyable to both me and my husband.  Woulddefintely order again.  We love that it has less plastic on the actually pod/k-cup to savethe earth.  The downside is that it doesnt fit in our k-cup  stand.  I actually storethem in a ziplock to keep there freshness.  Would be nice if the company when they soldit had it in a ziploc bag atleast as we had to transfer it to one ours.  Other then that.Great Taste,

I am so happy that I found this coffee. I have been using a Keurig for years now, and tried many of the single use cups on the market. I have even used the cups that you fill with your own coffee, but nothing compares to this San Francisco Bay coffee! And can you beat the price? Love the coffee, love the price and love the convenience of the 80 count box.
This coffee is at least as good as any of the actual Keurig K-cups at a much lower price. I will definitely order it again!
Excellent packaging, aroma, taste and delivery.  A little too bold for my husband's taste (he likes a lighter coffee), so I am not going to hesitate to try the breakfast blend next time.

I actually stopped using my Keurig coffee machine for several months before finding these tasty SF Bay fog chasers.  Now I'm using my k-machine nearly every day again and loving it.  The best part of these k-cups is they're not made entirely out of plastic like all the rest.  I do think that the "all plastic" k-cups affect the overall taste of the coffee.  The fog chasers have a "filter paper" bottom that contributes to a much more authentic brewed coffee taste.  Great deal and a great cup of coffee!!!
This coffee is something all should rave about at the price compared to other you must pay more for a commerical resaurants.

I am a big fan of bolder coffee's and have struggled to find coffee pods that live up to the bold flavor, until now! I am such a fan of the Fog Chaser blend, that I have it on auto ship & save from Amazon!  One taste and you will see!
Much smaller, less plastic than original k-cup style, good flavor and for the value pricing when you use repeated mailing option. Would recommend the bold version.

Yep - I'm totally sold!  And it's about time too :)  I love a strong / bold flavor that's not too bitter.  My favorite brands were Black Tiger by Coffee People and Extra Bold by Paul Newman.  However, the price of K-Cups keeps going up and up! So I saw these and decided to give it a try. I'm a big fan of Amazon's "Subscribe & Save" program b/c it's so flexible where I can choose my delivery from anywhere from once every 1 months, all the way to every 6 months.  So I generally signe-up for the S&S for many things starting off a delivery every 6 months just to see if I like it.  Unfortunately for me I end-up liking many of my S&S items and bumping the delivery to every 2 months! But the price for this at .41 cents is unbeatable.  And the flavor is right up there with my Black Tiger & Extra Bold.  So this is it - I've found my new coffee, at a great price, with less plastic.  A win-win all the way around!

I love my Keurig, but the cost of the cups had me looking for a better deal, and I was getting tired of adding to the plastic in the world with every cup of coffee.  I tried peeling the tops and bought the new lids to iron on (too messy and time consuming) and I do have the refillable cups you can use repeatedly, but those are messy, too.  I always thought the goal of a Keurig was a quick single cup of good coffee without the mess or fuss of a regular coffee maker. During a recent browsing day on Amazon, I ordered this product.  Surprisingly, the missing bottom to the cup is not an issue!  Spouse and I love the coffee, it is rich (read strong) enough for him, and tasty for me (I add a little hot water to mine.)  If you want to recycle the grounds, they are much easier to get to since you only have to tear open the paper basket on the bottom.
