Beef sticks have great flavor, without the greasy feeling. Not as spicy as I would like, but there is enough.  Great product to snack on.

I bought these after having the craving being pregnant.  I searched for something that tasted like real meat but not greasy like slim jims and something I would feel good about eating and feeding to my 19 month old as well.  These are geat.  They're handy for on the go, very tasty and the paskage lasts a while.  Especialy considering I am pregnant and we pregnant women can go through some food!!!!
Who would have guessed that Beef, Beef Hearts, and water would be so good together (evidently Buffalo Bill's)

I purchased these for my family to snack on and I haven't tasted flavor this good since I was a kid. It's worth every penny and you won't be unsatisfied. I found that we have purchased more of these and will be ordering more. This company has awesome products and stands behind their customers. Customer satisfaction is their number one priority.

column9: Taste is passable, they have other products that are better.
column10: I give the company high marks!  The product arrived quickly, and I very much appreciate the 'gift' package of free 'Honey' Jerky' included. The package was small, but delicious. That in itself prevents me from going below 3 stars.  I took off a star because the Hot Shorts are not even close to being 'mild', and far off from being 'hot'.  Another star because the taste is...just passable.I don't plan on ordering these specific 'Buffalo Bills Hot(?) Shorts' again, but I do plan on ordering other products of theirs.  I am a 'subscribe & save' customer here on Amazon and have a couple of other 'Jerky' subscriptions that I'll end up cancelling and then changing to other offers once I find better replacements.

column9: Great HOT Beef Sticks! Tasty, not bland!
column10: My mouth feels warm and these are delicious!  I have never had anything this good for this type of snack!  I'm definitely going to order from them only!  I'm getting some of their jerky because their example is superb!  I can't wait to try more!

I bought the Hot Short Shots because I was craving jerky and I wanted something inexpensive. I like really spicy food, so I should first agree with the other reviewers that these snacks will not light your mouth on fire, but there is a noticeable bite to them. But that doesn't stop them from being a thousand times tastier than a Slim Jim or even from regular, grocery store jerky. Plus, they are low calorie - just 25 cal per stick - so they make a great mid-day snack.But there's more to them than their deliciousness. When they arrived, they came well packaged, with a menu of other Choo Choo R products, and even some samples of their other great jerky. This is clearly a company that wants happy customers, and I am happy that my business is going to someone who deserves it.I will definitely be getting these on a regular basis now - I'm hooked!

Shipping was very fast, but the product is so so. Many other reviews compared these to Slim Jims in one way or another,so here is my thoughts. These are alot drier and a whole lot less greaser than Slim Jims, which is 2 good things about them, but I didn`t care for the flavor or after taste they leave you with. I rate these average at best, but will keep them for a quick snack now and then. Along with my order I also recieved 2 samples; Maple Pepper Beef Jerky & Buffalo Bills "Moist & Tender" Beef Jerky, both are very tasty and a product I will buy again. I still plan on trying more of CHOO CHOO SNACKS other products in the future.

Just received my first order today.  I purchased lots of different styles of this company's products and will review each one as I try them.  Well packaged and delivered, 2 packs had lost their vacuum.  Was given 2 different samples to try and will review those as well when I taste them.  I consider myself somewhat of an unofficial jerky connoisseur, even making my own jerky in the past.  I like the meat to shine through the taste, not sugar or salt.  A vegetarian I am not!Tasted my first pepperoni mild short shot today.  Upon the first bite I noticed it didn't have squishy fat oozing out of it like I remember these types of beef sticks having years ago when I ate them as a kid.  It had a mild pepperoni taste, not hot, not spicy.  Was that a slight hint of vinegar behind the nuance of flavor?  Had a nice, firm mouth-feel and a slight 'snap' around the edges when bitten into.  Wasn't hit with any sweet, and it certainly wasn't over salted.  Over-all, I rate this product high on the beef stick scale.  These weren't dried out, they were supple.  As a treat, I gave my dog a couple inches of it.  When his face came up to my hand and his nose hit the beef-stick, his eyes sort of rolled back in his head, Ha! To say the least, he loved it too!I have put all the packs of beef into my big freezer so they stay fresh and hold their integrity, since I bought over 150.00 worth (free shipping with 125.00 or more, at this time!)  I started a low carb diet and these are the perfect snack item to have on hand.  The beef is USA grown!  I would reorder these mild pepperoni short sticks again.
Love,love.love this product. Will continue to buy this product for my hunters to take on their trips out.

I've always gotten exactly what I ordered in a very timely manner.So far I've ordered the following products:1) Buffalo Bills 2.1lbs Mild Short Shots2) Buffalo Bills 2.1lbs Hot Short Shots3) Buffalo Bills 2.1lbs Pepperoni Short ShotsThe first two short shots are very similar to Slim Jim's, just not individually wrapped, I just put them in a zip lock bag and find them very convenient to munch on( about a quarter pound per bag.4) Buffalo Bills 1.2lb Extra SmokeysThese are very smokey, but a little too dry for my taste.5) Buffalo Bills 16oz Premium Hickory Beef Jerky Pieces (random size)Taste great if you are a jerky lover.6) Buffalo Bills 2.1lb Pepperoni  Short ShotsProbably the closest to Slim Jim's of all the short shots7) Big Buffalo Ole SmokiesFatter, crisp not as crunchy as short shots, individually wrapped.8) Buffalo Bills 2.1lbs Honey StrungO.K. taste.  My wife hates the smell.  My Brother doesn't care much for them either.All- in- all, I highly recommend these products (in the order listed) and this company.Gunner  January, 2010
These little sticks have great flavor and are the right price for what you get.  The package was used for the superbowl party I had and everyone loved them, should of ordered two bags!
These tasty Pepperoni Short Shots are my favorite "grab on the run" treat. Small stick packed with big flavor.
These little sticks have great flavor and are the right price for what you get.  The package was used for the superbowl party I had and everyone loved them, should of ordered two bags!

Another great beef stick from Choo Choo - how do they pack so much wonderful flavor in those little sticks? The Hot Short Shots are the perfect treat with a zing anytime you need a quick snack. I love the 2.1 lbs package. I can keep plenty of beef sticks on hand for when the gang drops in to watch the game. Everyone loves the delicious beef taste of Short Shots and the hot ones are perfect with the cool beverages. Our friends would call it a foul if there was football without Hot Short Shots!

column4: Hurley "I thought I was wrong once but I was ...
column9: Not too bad but probably won't be buying more...
column10: First off, I feel that in this day and age, with all the online shopping people do, most places should not be so greedy with their shipping prices.  Maybe I've just become spoiled by my Amazon Prime membership but even beyond that, I'd be willing to wait a couple extra days to save the money it costs to ship these things if they shipped free.  I'm sorry but $6 to ship these had me skeptical already and that alone will probably keep me from purchasing more.  That puts the price at just under $30 and in my opinion, they are not worth that.Second, the taste.  To be honest, there isn't much of a difference between these and Slim Jim's.  They might be a bit less greasy, but they are practically the same shape, only shorter.  It's like someone cut a bunch of Slim Jim's into quarters and then bulked them together to make it seem like you're getting much more than you really are.  Okay, sorry, back to the taste.  They do happen to taste fairly well.  If you like Slim Jim's I can't see you not enjoying these.  Also, in terms of heat, they are not bad.  If you hate hot things then you'd probably have to eat more than a couple without drinking anything before it started to bother you and even then it wouldn't be unbearable by any means.Third, the texture is decent on the outside.  The skin provides that "snap" that most people enjoy, however the inside is, as other reviewers have described, a bit on the mushy side.  Maybe that's your thing and you enjoy that but I prefer mine a little more dense.Overall, I'd say 3 stars is all I'd give this product.  Were they ever to offer free shipping then I'd have to bump it up to a 4 star review but like I said, at $30 I will not be purchasing more of these.
THIS WAS EXACTLY WHAT I WAS NEEDING. GREAT PRICE, GREAT QUALITY, GREAT SERVICE!!!IT IS GREAT TO KNOW YOU CAN IMAGINE SOMETHING, FIIND IT, AND MAKE IT REAL!~!
After tasting a handful of this product, I threw the rest out!  I love beef jerky but this product is not even close!!

column9: Much more appealing than Slim Jims
column10: As a kid I loved to eat Slim Jims but gave them up as an adult because I can't tolerate the greasiness.  I wish I knew about Short Shots sooner because these things are a great replacement!  I originally bought the Mild flavor as a camping/hiking take along snack and it was well received by all of the adults, but none of the kids.  After our trip and running low, I bought the Pepperoni flavor which I found to be more peppery and much saltier than the Mild flavor.  While I prefer the Mild, my husband and older daughter prefer the Pepperoni.  Next flavor we will try is the hot.  The texture is drier and chewier than Slim Jims, but I think the quality is better also.  I realize some people have a problem with beef heart as ingredient, but muscle is muscle (and this is probably in Slim Jims too).

Before purchasing this product, I read the reviews.  Most were very positive which ultimately convinced me to make the purchase.  Unfortunately, the only real way to know if you would like a product such as this is to taste it.  After doing so, I was very disappointed.  I found the flavor to be absent except for all of the salt.  It's labeled "hot", however, I didn't detect any spicy heat whatsoever.  The texture was stringy and chewy.  After chewing on them, the Short Shots wind up as a balled up mass which you either decide to swallow or spit out.  Overall, I did not like the product one bit and rated it with one star.

column9: These Are NOT Slim Jims....They're BETTER!
column10: I read the reviews of these Short Shots & they get compared to Slim Jims a lot.  They are not anything like Slim Jims!  These are small, moist & most of all tasty little sticks of beef.  When you finish eating 1/2 a dozen (if you can stop there) of these, your fingers & mouth are not bathed in that orange grease that Slim Jims leave you with.  One bag of the Short Shots is almost 1/2 the cost of Slim Jims.  What gives there?  On the "Bang For The Buck" Scale, this product receives a 9+.  Only because a 10 is perfect & everybody knows that nothing is perfect nowadays.  Now I know I've said enough because I've just finished the 8th stick while typing this review!  Enjoy them, they're addicting!!!!

I have memories of when my father used to bring us slim jims and we just loved them. As an adult I do not like the taste any longer of most slim jim products. I think these taste much better and the 2.1 lb bag goes a long way. I use food saver to put them in smaller packages. I have ordered several bags of these over the years and enjoy them as a quick snack. These are labeled HOT but to me are not that hot. Hope this review helps, pick up a bag I am sure you will enjoy them.Cheers.

I buy this occasionally for work so the guys and me can have a snack for a few days. Tastes very simular to a Slim Jim but in my opinion a bit better. Best Jerky bang for your buck so you can't go wrong with it.

I wrote a negative review about Buffalo Bill's Hickory Beef Jerky, but I really enjoyed these mild beef sticks.  They have a lemony sourness that I found very appealing, and they were the perfect snack during long hikes.  I will order them again.

I have ordered the Hot Short Shots many times in the past, and they are usually of excellent quality. My family loves them, as well as our two pups. However, this last order was not as good. Some of them were very tough and were collapsed and wrinkled on the outside. The taste seemed a little off, and I thought it was my imagination so I didn't say anything, but when my husband tasted his first one, he noticed right away. I am hoping that this is just an off batch, because this is one of our favorite snacks and I don't know of any other snack sticks that have the distinctive flavor and texture that these have. I will cross my fingers and order again!

I have eaten alot of meat snacks over the past 60 years and I have to tell you these are some of the best.  They are not the cheapest but they sure are the tastiness.  Well worth the price and the 2 lbs actually lasts a long time.
Like other customers I divide these into handfuls in ziplock bags.  They keep well and are not messy at all to eat (good for kids).  Great for road trips, camping and hiking, or just snacking.

I've had several brands of beef sticks and am not a very picky eater, so was surprised that there was a pretty big discrepancy between how this product was reviewed here and how it tasted. To me it tasted more like beef heart than beef (and I have actually sampled beef heart before, so I know what it tastes like! Not something I would buy); the skin provided some resistance but then it was very mushy on the inside. Maybe my batch had a higher proportion of that than normal? I got the hot flavor, but that did not mask the weirdness of the taste.The reason for two stars instead of one: I brought it with us while we were camping, and we were a little short on food. The short sticks provided sustenance even if we all grumbled a little bit about the taste. They didn't cause any diarrhea or stomach problems.Unlike other people I did not receive any samples from Buffalo Bills and so have no input with regards to how their other stuff tastes.

These things are MUCH, MUCH better than Slim Jims.  These are exactly what I was looking for.  They are not all oily and greasy like other beef sticks.  I could probably eat the whole pack in a day! LOL!

I always worry about these other brands, but you will be pleased with this brand if you normally like Slim Jim.  These are not as greasy but have all the same great taste.  You will not be upset you bought them.
Such a large packaging means you have to eat these fast. Flavor wise, it's okay, but kind of salty. Texture wise, nice and snappy on the outside but mushy in the middle.
I bought these for my annual backpacking trip i go on with my cousin and friends and they were fantastic.. Good enough that im buying them again this year.

I ordered the mild sticks about 1 month ago an loved them. They were better than slim Jim's. Better flavor, less greasy. So I was running out and ordered more MILD sticks. I got the hot ones. These lack the snap of the mild so are less satisfying. The spice was nice, but still I want my mild sticks.

column9: Good, but possible quality control issue
column10: I've bought Slim Jim and Jack Links X-Sticks quite a few times, so figured I'd give these a try. I purchased these based on the reviews, and they taste absolutely awful. I choose to go with the "Mild" flavor, and there is no mild flavor to it. Just extremely salty and some sour taste as well. I don't write reviews often, but considering how high the ratings are and how bad the product I received was, I figured I should share my experience.-----Update. The seller happened to email me and sent me a "free sample pack" of beef jerk products after I wrote my initial review. The strange thing is that sample pack included a pack of "Beef Sticks (didn't say mild, hot, or anything on it). These beef sticks look just like the mild beef sticks I got from Amazon. However, they actually taste good, slightly less salty, and have the mild flavoring. This leads me to believe that there was something wrong with the ones from Amazon, and that these do taste quite good as long as you get a good batch.
These are better than slim jim. the only reason i gave them four stars is because of the price. If you put them in snack bags then in the fridge, they make a great portable warm weather snack.

I obviously like those beef sticks because i ordered it again! thanks for the samples on the first order. I am deployed so those sticks makes for a good snack. thanks for the quick shipping! I will be ordering more!Mahalo
The item is really good. I just had to wait 10 days to recive the item. so I probably won't order again.
Package arrived within 4 days of purchase. I LOVE the taste simply amazing.  My only complaint is I can't afford to buy 100 pounds of this stuff.

These are not really that good. They have like twenty or so ingredients but none add anything close to flavor. imo buy something else, also its 2 lb's so once bag is open have to store it in something else unless you eat it all at once and that would be unlikely with the before mentioned taste.

I have the hot spicy kind. I'm not very big on greasy foods, so these beef sticks with a little bit of flare to em do it for me. :) I've only had a couple so far, so I can't describe the flavor to well, not a hot hot spicy or anything though, more like a mild with a flare.

For the value and for the diet this is an amazing snack! Just ordering the mild and another hot. Fast shipping with prime and will be a repeat customer! Better than a slim jim and quality is cleaner :)

My daughter loves mild Slim Jim's so I decided to give these a try. As far as I'm concerned they taste very similar, but seem much less greasy to me.  THese end up being a better value than buying regular Slim Jim's and so I've got no complaints.

column9: Great Deal & Tasty but Hot is a little mild for me.
column10: Only tried Hot.Amazon $25 on 02/12/2012.ProValue for weight & priceTasty.Nice Texture.Outside Snappy.All Beef.ConsHot is kind of mild, takes about 3 sticks before I feel it mildly.Would be nice if individually wrapped but Zip Lock Bags work just fine for portability.
I liked them, i liked the taste alot, the inside was a bit to mushy though, not enough of a meaty feeling to it.
They taste great, its the only way my and my shop can get fresh jerky out here in Afghanistan. Recieved the package promptly for my area and everything was fresh and un-damaged.

The delivery was quick and the package arrived without issue. The reason for the 2 stars is because i wasnt satisfied with the Flavor . I just dont have a taste for it. so now i have 2 pounds of meat sticks that im not going to eat. the company did send a sample of its barbecue beef jerky which was really nice. next time i will have to order that. you win some and you lose some. it happens.

I buy these for a snack for the guys at work and everyone loves them. They taste great and keep for a long time - not usually a problem when people grab them by the handful. I suggest buying these and the Hot; both packs last the 6 of us about 10 days. These are also a great side item for school lunches.

These are way better then Slim Jims. Less greasy and more flavor. The Mild Short Shot's are just a really good product, nice smokey flavor, no pockets of grease like a slim jim and very consistent. Fast shipping as always.

Purchased the mild shorts:Gladly surprised when I opened the package up. They didn't feel or taste "greasy" in the least (think Slim Jims).All in all, I think they were fantastic and the price point was pretty solid.I will be purchasing again later.

When I saw the product on Amazon, I did'nt know the size of the package. 2.1# is a lot of meat. Ordered it on March 14th, got it on march 16th. Good beef sticks, and the sample pack of beef jerky was delishish!!!

I've eaten about 1/3 of them and now they just make me feel sick.They taste good and I love the pop when you break the casing biting into the sticks.I'm going to have to re-seal the rest though. No way I can go through 2 lbs of that before they start going bad. :

While the cost on this item is sure to bring attention, I found the taste to be a little bland while the product was dryer then I am used to with jerky of this type. Please note this is for the "Hot" version of this product (there are three flavors and I have not tried the other two so your millage may very on the other flavors) Shipment was fast and packaging was A1. Perhaps I'll give the other flavors a try.

column9: Better then store brand beef sticks.
column10: These are realy great.  They have a nice tangy smoke flavor, that goes great with the heat.  They're also alot less salty then other beef sticks I've had.  I guess they use the smoke to perserve them.  Instead of using lots of salt.The heat is not super intense.  It might be to much if you are sensitive to heat, but in that case.  Buffalo Bills has a mild version.

column9: It was exactly what i wanted
column10: I was extremely happy with this item.I received it in a speedy fashion and it was exactly what i was expecting.
i got a factory 2nds bag of these, so a bit disappointed.though the price is right, and the flavor, texture, and moisture in these are great.  you like beef sticks?  these are great.

I bought these as a birthday gift for my jerky-loving husband and was he ever happy. He thought they were great and we intend to order many more products from this company.They are salty, and a bit greasy with a mix of chewy crunchy outer and a chewy inner. The first bite is a tad spicy but after that its fine. You defiantly can't stop at just one! My husband made me hide them from him because he quickly polished off about 8 of them and he wanted to make them last!Also, our order was received three days ahead of the estimated time to ship them so that was a big plus.My hubby was thrilled because the company also threw in a free sample pack of honey pepper jerky as a thanks ( the price of which covered the shipping and handling charge, so I feel like I got a good deal).Completely pleased with this product!

column9: Oh My goodness! Spicy and Perfect! More meat then Greasy!
column10: I enjoyed them as soon as I opened box!  I also purchased the HOT short beef shots They are incredible and leave a wonderful HOT warmth to your mouth.  These are so much better than Oberto and I went to school with those guys, they were friends of our family. They have good, but this is better than that in my mind! Excellent sticks not bland and icky, they are GREAT!

column9: Very good But... Muy buena pero...
column10: De verdad los productos de esta marca son excelentes, pero a pesar de ser de carne tienen una textura un poco grasosa y un sabor acido, prefiero las Slim Jim.this brand is excellent, but the taste is sour and the texture is a little greasy, i prefer the slim jim.

I had never purchased Beef Jerky or Beef Sticks through an on line vendor, prior to placing an order with Choo Choo R. Snacks. The products arrived on time and in good shape.  They were great. The peperoni sticks lasted about 4 days.  The big bag of jerky, about 6.  I had heard several customers complain about the jerky being tough.  When I was growing up, some 50 yearsw ago, jerked meat WAS TOUGH, chewy, but tough.  Bufflo Bills' Hickory smoked jerky was delicious.  They sent along a packof Teriaki (SP), flavored jerky.  Wow, that was soooo good!  I have placed another order with Choo Choo R Snacks.  I will buy all my Jerky, Beef Sticks, etc from Choo Choo.  They do these products right!

I've been ordering these for the past year or so. They make amazing snacks for camping trips and they're fun to share with people (until they come back asking for 2nds... and 3rds...). Yeah, they're that good. As some others have said, imagine a Slim Jim, but without all of the grease that soaks out everywhere. It's true that it doesn't have that 'authentic' pepperoni taste, but in my opinion it's more than good enough. Not only that, but the people at Choo Choo snacks are generous enough to add in a sampler for some of their other products in every order. Their jerky samples taste incredible, but I'm more of a beef stick person. I like the snap that they make when you bite into them. Buffalo Bills short shots are more than worth the asking price. If you've never tried them before, don't be afraid. If you're a fan of meat snacks, you'll like these without a doubt. Hell, I bet you could even get some vegetarians to convert just from the scent. :D

column9: All my other friends like them, I don't
column10: I was real excited to get these and I was personally disappointed with the heavy beef heart texture and gently flaking casing. My friends though swear they're better than slim jims as they are much less greasy. They didn't taste bad to me, they were just not my thing. ChooChoo was awesome as usual with fast shipping. Try em, they're cheap enough and everyone else loves em.

These taste better than Slim Jims, have better texture and aren't as greasy.  The package is much bigger than it looks in the picture.  They aren't individually wrapped, so I put them in small zip lock bags in the freezer.  These are pretty good, but I like the Tillamook beef sticks better.  It's a good value considering how many you get.
Great Taste, not greasey whatsoever like Slim Jims.  Extremely addictive, I would take 10-12 to work and they would be gone by 1030.Will definitely buy again!

The taste was somewhat greasy.  Hoped for a product better than "Slim Jims" but they are not. They responded to my criticisms and are sending me a sample of another product they feel I might like better.
Choo Choo snacks is unusual in their customer service in that they are very supportive of customer feedback.  This attention to the customer makes them a company worth doing business with

column9: Good but not excellent, but I'd buy again
column10: These are good little beef sticks.  I bought the mild, but I wonder if I'd enjoy a more spicy one.  The flavor isn't the best for this sort of thing, but it's far from the worst and is quite good.  Just not quite up to a "five star" rating for me.  Still, I can't complain and I'd order products from these people again, just try a different flavor or product maybe next time.As an aside, they also sent a sampler size pack of their "country cut" beef jerky in Teriyaki flavor, and that I found to be excellent.  The next thing I buy from them might be the beef jerky instead, just based on the small sample package I found that much closer to a five star product.I did a seperate review for the seller proper, but in brief I'd call their shipping five star, very fast and well packaged.  Just for the record without making a comment pro or con about whom they used to ship, they used US Mail.

column9: If you like the type of "beef straw" products like this, then you won't be dissapointed.
column10: First off, the products from choochoorsnacks are as good as there shipping and customer service. I have not had any problems with these short shots other than having to hide them from scavengers. Guess that means i'm not the only one who enjoys these things. these things are quite mild and i will be trying the hotter ones eventually. Much better than slim jims or any other kind of beef straws out there. If these sticks sound good to you then chances are you'll be happy with this purchase.

These mild beef sticks are awaesome....they taste great and much better than Slim Jim's.  I'm a beef stick fanatic and this is one of the better beef sticks that I have tasted.  Not oily or greasy at all.
I like the slender, easy to pack, snack, toss aroundfeel of these little fellas.Bought em twice now, and will likely buy them again.

column9: Buffalo Bills 2.1 lbs Mild Short Shots, Excellent
column10: These were just what I was looking for. They remind me a bit of a SlimJim but much higher quality and not suspended in whatever strange greasy/watery residue a SlimJim is. They had just a touch of heat to give them flavor, but very mild. I threw a couple in sack lunches for a few weeks and they were a real treat.
Better than any Beef Jerkey that I've ever purchased from the store, and Slim Jim's are no comparison to this brand either.
These beef sticks are a great snack.  Perfect sized sticks.  Great for camping and also goes good with beer.
These taste pretty good and they're not greasy.  Not too hot, not too mild.

I've been trying unsuccessfully to find this flavor.  I've bought out all the A&W cream sode jellies in the Target and Cub Foods stores in my surrounding metropolitan areas.  They never replenished this flavor.  So, I just thought I'd try googling them - was I excited to find amazon carries them - I'll be ordering shortly!!!!!!!!!!
This is some of the best tea! Great flavor and great benefits too! A little bit goes a long way, so it lasts forever.

column9: This is the tea you want
column10: If you have a chance to visit the Tao of Tea shop at 3430 SE Belmont Street in Portland, Oregon, you'll find a unique place with a unique approach to tea. Fine tea there is not chopped beyond recognition. Think of a salad bar of various teas, all nicely dried, of course, displaying a range of colors and shapes that cry out to be sampled. Tea is, of course, a matter of taste. I especially like the Kukicha, which includes tea leaf stems that provide a richer, darker taste that I crave. Getting it from amazon.com is much easier for me, since I live in Southern California, and cheaper than at the local store that carries it.

These taste awesome and until you taste it yourself you won't know what your missing.  They are my crack, I can't stop at just one.  They lie somewhere between a candy bar and a biscuit.  I am so glad I found a place to purchase these in the U.S. :}  The closest thing I could compare them to stateside would be if you replaced the peanut butter in a Little Debbie's Nutty Bar with caramel.  So much better though!

I have generally purchased loose teas at one of the brick and mortar specialty stores.  I took a chance on this selection as I've enjoyed Boston Tea's bagged selections in the past.  They did not disappoint.If you like fruit flavored, black tea this is a KEEPER; mild, yet fruity and flavorful with just enough ginger to tantalize.  Black tea can be strong and sometimes bitter if brewed incorrectly.  However, this tea hasn't been bitter through my first whole pound!  The black tea has never overpowered the subtle added flavorings and vice versa; an absolutely perfect blending for an absolutely satisfying cuppa either on its own or with a little something.  I suggest a little sweetener of your choice and you're ready to sit back for that "Ahhh!" moment.HIGHLY recommend.

column9: Full-bodied, fruity black tea with zing!
column10: This brews a wonderful pot of tea that's great hot and also delicious cold. The ginger adds just a hint of zing to a slightly sweet black tea. I've been drinking a lot of it!
I love this tea...steeping it every morning has become almost a ritual. I first tried it on a whim...what a great choice (and surprise).

column9: Very nice tea and great price.
column10: I like this tea, I bought it as a replacement for another brand of Peach and sweet ginger tea that came in teabag form. This is just as good and the price works better this way.
Got my tea today and LOVE it. The smell is awesome right out of the bag, but the brewed tea is even better. Definitely pleased with this purchase.

column9: Best one of the flavored loose teas
column10: This is a very good tea for aficionados and for me only Taiwan Spring Tea is better. Sure will not last long.

This is my most favorite tea.  My most excellent Sis got it for me several years ago, and now, since I asked for it, I got it again.  It is very pretty.  It smells wonderful, just like it tastes (fruity and spicy)  I have not checked it yet, but suspect that it is very good for you also.  After I have checked that out, I will update this.I guess it is very good for you.  If you are a health nut, add buckwheat honey (antioxidants) and lemon (helps get more of the good stuff into your system)

Land O Lakes Hot Chocolate is by far the best tasting instant cocoa mix I've ever tried - and I've tried alot of them. It's creamy without being off the scale in calories and fat; little high on the sugar but that's probably why it tastes so good. Highly recommend this product!
Used to be made in america now there soggy not chewy and made in mexico!No wonder the price has dropped at the local store $2.59 for this box.

One of the troops I support, who is currently in Iraq, is from Louisiana, and he was craving Louisiana Original Hot Sauce.  He made a bet with another friend that we couldn't get it to him...I proved him wrong...and he was delighted.  Louisiana Hot Sauce gave this soldier a taste of home, and he definately gave it 5-stars for giving the pretty bland food served in Iraq a "taste of home".
I used to eat these licorice ropes as a kid all the time, I am 39 years old and still enjoy them whenever I can find them.  I am now buing them for my three sons too.  The BEST!

I was very disappointed in the ropes. They were tough to eat. If I put them in the microwave for 10 seconds, they were pretty good. I did get a response from the seller, and they said that they were in a warehouse, and due to the cold weather, they were firmer. The ropes were within their expiration --or shelf life date. I probably will not order them again.
The licorice was stale and many of the wrappers were split.I would not buy from them again.

column9: Good pop. Not to be confused with the gum.
column10: BR is a great soda found in mainly the southern US, and is a very popular drink in Texas. The flavor is quite hard to describe, some say bubblegum, others say vanilla, others say cherry. But it tastes great! Another thing you can make is a Big Red Float. Just pour a glass of Big red into a glass, put a scoop of vanilla ice cream on it and VIOLA! A great treat! Try this pop out! It also comes in a new flavor, Big Red Vannila Float. BR with a hint of vanilla!

Big Red - the unofficial soda of Texas is excellent.  It's hard to pinpoint the exact taste; some say bubble gum, while others compare it to cherry.  Regardless, you should definitely give this a try.  Best tasted cold - you won't regret.  I only wish it was distributed in New England.

This is the soda I grew up on, that and Dr Pepper. Has a great taste and nothing says Texas better than Big Red. Instead of Root Beer Floats, we had Big Red Floats, ten times better! Just have a sip of it and it will take you back to when you were a kid with no cares in the world.
This is a very good soft drink.  Smooth strawberry cream soda.  Very tasty!
THIS is the ONLY POP, period. Awesome Vanilla Floats. Once again, necter of the Gods.

column9: been lookin' fer this for over a year!
column10: i moved from the midwest to california and can't find it anywhere i use to be able to just walk around the corner to the liqure store or gas station and get a bottle or two but now wish i could find it around her I LOVE THIS STUFF!

column9: Big Red Soda Hard to Find
column10: Big Red Soda is hard to find in the Northeast - thankyou for providing us with fast service and shipping!
this is a TX fav.  but not living there anymore.  decided that i needed a taste of home and found it right here.  drink up!!!!

I'm a big fan of this soda. There is a local restaurant that sells it (Texas BBQ style) and it is so good! Bright red, tastes like vanilla with a very light cherry taste. I see others describe it as bubblegum taste but I don't think it tastes like bubblegum. Its more like vanilla cream with just a hint of fruit. This drink is a must taste! Too bad we can't get it here in California grocery stores! Awesome!
I love this soda.  I wish I could find a store where I live that sells it.

column9: Big Red, not so big with me
column10: Well I had to try it based on the rave reviews. Glad I only purchased 12 cans ... I just don't like this stuff at all(can't give them away fast enough)... Tastes like carbonated perfume to me. If you want a REALLY DELICIOUS creme soda try Hansens Cherry Vanilla Creme. Now THAT is a GREAT creme soda

We have grandchildren born in Nebraska but have moved.  We had a case sent to the twins on their 11th birthdays!!  I mean GO BIG RED soda is a perfect gift from very proud Nebraska grandparents.  Already they are asking for more!!

It was quite a thrill for me to suddenly find cartons of Big Red sitting on the shelves of a local mega-large retailer a few months ago.  I had never heard of Big Red until one of my college roommates brought some to school with him (and that has been some years ago).  At the time, I found the bubble gum taste interesting, but I didn't get a large enough sample of it to really know whether I liked it or not.  Then, several years later, some Big Red magically appeared in a local convenience store, and that is when I grew to love it.  Alas, the stuff soon disappeared off of this store's refrigerated shelves, leaving me to wonder if I would ever enjoy this unique soda drink again.  This may be a Southern product dating all the way back to 1937, but few folks here in North Carolina have ever heard of the stuff.  Maybe that will begin to change now - as long as the Big W keeps it on the shelves.  Some folks are bound to try it, if for no other reason than the price, which is significantly cheaper than all of the well-known colas.  In my opinion, the carton and bottle designs (as well as the price) actually make this look like a knock-off, discount product.  We all know how nasty those knock-off colas taste, so don't let yourself be fooled into thinking that Big Red isn't worth a try.  This stuff is all kinds of good.  It is reportedly available in 43 states now, so keep an eye out for it - or just order some from this site.There is one issue you need to be aware of, though.  Big Red will turn your mouth red.  That includes the lips, so guys who drink this stuff should probably take a look at themselves in the mirror before heading out for a night on the town with their buddies - unless you want to take the chance of a lipstick joke or two thrown your way.  If I drink it at night, I have to wash off my lips inside and out to avoid waking up to a pillow sporting various red stains the next morning.  It's a small price to pay, though, for something that tastes as good as Big Red.
If you have never drank a Big Red before you need to have one immediatly. These are delicious sips of heaven.

I love red cream soda... not the plain cream soda.  Red Cream soda can be hard to find so I went looking online and found this - and tried it a few times.  I love it!!  Its worth the extra cost in shipping.  I tried the diet big red too and loved it (and I'm not a diet drink fan).  Also, some red cream sodas are too "syrupy" or too sweet...this Big Red is just right.

column9: I thought I was the only one....
column10: Back when I was a child my parents used to buy this for us while we were camping.  For years I didn't see a drop of it, but it was always there at the back of my mind.  Recently I've found that they've started stocking it in a near-by gas station.  Its a bit more expensive there, but definitely worth it.The GREATEST soda I've ever come across.

column9: ONE OF THE BEST DRINKS OF ALL TIME
column10: BIG REDThis is one of my all time favorite drinks of all time and to be honest when it comes to cokes, soda, pop or what ever you want to call it I doubt there is much out there that can top this. I was born in Texas and once again as off 5 or 6 years ago I made way back here and could not have been happier to have this drink at my disposal once again. For many many years while living on the East Coast namely Maryland were this drink is not available all I could do was bring some back with me after visits to family back in the Lone Star State.If you want to be specific this is a cream soda, a red cream soda to be exact. But to all those saying I am not a fan of cream soda I assure you that red cream soda has a much different taste as compared to just cream soda. This wonderful drink that comes out of Waco Texas is really one of the most refreshing soft drinks I have ever had the pleasure of tasting. For all you calorie nuts out there this does have 150 worth per can of it but if you watch your intake this could be a wonderful luxury drink as my grandmother says about the Vanilla Float version of Big Red.If you ever come across this drink any were or order drinks from the net I highly recommend it, even if you only drink these type of drinks every so often you should at least try it. My best friend from Maryland came with me to Texas a couple of times and after trying this drink he is hooked. It is important for you to know that the guy is a mixed martial artist and does not really drink soft drinks; this would be his luxury drink.

I got this gardenia bonsai in mid-February and it is not as I expected. Upon opening the package, the leaves are dull green, no buds, dried out and mostly dark brown. I followed the instruction and even did some research work through the internet. I even bought extra stuffs like plant food, cool mist humidifier just to revive the plant. Well now, after 3 weeks, 90% of the leaves are gone, branches bare, looks like those bare trees that you see during winter. I tried to contact the merchant and ask for advise, but I did not get any response. I have other bonsais and regular gardenias that are healthy and I really wanted this gardenia bonsai so bad.

I'm always hesitant to write a negative review because tastes are different but with this product I felt I had a duty to alert consumers.  I bought this and out of the box it was pretty until I looked close and found it was infested with tiny white bugs that clung to nearly every branch and leaf.  I hoped they would die on their own but after three weeks they were still there and the plant itself had started to die.  I bought plant insect spray and they killed the bugs.  The plant died two weeks later.  I was very disappointed since I'd always wanted a bonsai tree and gardenia is my favorite scent.

column9: Not the Plant I ordered, DON'T BUY THIS PLANT
column10: I ordered this plant and I can't even beleive you're allowed to lie like this and get away with it. The item description clearly states that the plant is supposed to be a 4yr old that is 8 inches high and in a 10 inch pot. This is not my plant at all, its about 6 inches if that and in a 6.5 inch pot. I can't beleive I paid $32 for this plant. There is no one to get in contact with to return it or ask WHAT IS GOING ON?!?! I don't understand why you say you will give a plant that is completely different from what I received. I am very unsatisfied with my plant and even more with your bad service, no one anwsers my emails or questions. If anyone can help me, my email is chanteldionne@hotmail.com

Not sure if the plant is going to survive, The pot was broken when we opened the box yet the shipping box showed no signs of damage. I can't find out how to return it either since it is a plant - these independent Amazon merchants make returns difficult : (  So much for this present.

The bonsai was packed well and looked great out of the box.  It shed a lot of leaves about a week after arriving, giving us a scare, but new leaves are now sprouting out all over the place.  It's healthy and growing.

column9: Doesn't look like a bonsai tree at all
column10: Positive: Gardenia Bonsai arrived in good shape and packaged well.Negative: Did not look like a Bonsai at all, they advertise they are suppose to be 4 yrs old?? Mine looked like a normal Gardenia bush that was pruned way back and stuck in a small pot. I plan on returning it, my wife was disappointed because it was a christmas gift for her!

I ordered this bonsai tree for my daughter-in-law because she listed it on her Amazon wish list as "highest" for this Christmas 2005.  The order came in record time, three weeks before Christmas so I set about babying the tree each day by following all of the directions to a tee!  I sprayed it and watered it  exactly as the directions stated and I placed it in a sunny well lighted area and the temperature in our condo was never below 65 degrees and that was only at night while we slept. Nonetheless, after two weeks, still a week before Christmas, the leaves began to curl, turn splotchy and fall off. I was very sad about this because the tree had looked wonderful when it arrived and it was very well packed.  But, by the time Christmas Eve arrived it had only about half of its original leaves.  We are now waiting to see if the tree does better at my daughter-in-law's home since she is very happy to have it and she'd love to keep it...she is going to try to nurture it into a healthy life.  We'll see...  M. Buchanan

I reviewed some of the comments from others about broken branches, and dead leaves.  I was very worried what I would get but my tree arrived in one piece no broken branches and beautiful.  I love the bonsai I have only had it about 2 weeks and already I have a ton of buds on it which should be blooming in the next week.  This was a great buy for the price!!

I was a bit worried from some of the reviews I read here on Amazon, but this Bonsai arrived as pictured(minus the flowers, not in blooming season)  I even used Amazon's free supersaver shipping.  We have only had it for a few weeks but so far so good.  Very good value from Brussel's.

I've been looking for a reasonably priced Gardenia Indoor Bonsai Tree for a long time. I knew Amazon would be the place to buy.I've read all the reviews and searched all the items available here. Although there are some bad reviews about this item, i still decided to give it a try.and I am so glad that I did!I have used a 2 days shipping just to make sure the plant won't be stuck in the box for too long. It arrived on time.The package is really well packed. the soil is nice and moisture when it is arrived, as the pot part was wrapped carefully in a plastic bag. ALL the leaves are green! This is much better than i have expected. I thought couple yellow and dropping leaves were understandable as it has been moved around. But i guess they have exceeded my expectation. No single dropping leaf or yellow leaf at all.I saw 2 flowers already, and it smells fantastic and gorgeous!I am completely satisfied with the order.

So i ordered this gardenia and its gorgeous. Ive had it now for a couple of weeks and i leave it in my window. The sun form this is enough to feed it , along with some water everyday. Very healthy plant and a very healthy idea. Great guy to buy from....call Lou.

column9: All I have to say is WOW!
column10: Plant ordered 12/12/2011 Like the others I was very skeptical ordering this plant due to there being many negative reviews, but my mom loves gardenias so I decided to give this a try anyways for christmas. I used 2 day shipping and as ordered the plant arrived in 2 days exactly. Opening the box I was ready for the worst but to my surprise i opened the top and all I could see was tons of little green leaves!! This plant is seriously amazing about 6-8 inches tall and looks like its ready to flower with tons of branches and leaves. The packaging job was amazing all the soil was still together, no broken branches and came with a how to care booklet. I am 100% satisfied with this order!PLEASE NOTE: If you are going to order dont be cheap and spend the extra $15 on 2 day shipping. I believe that really makes a difference in the condition your plant will arrive in. if you pay for regular ground shipping your plant is going to sit in a box for 1-2 weeks can you really expect it to show up in healthy condition?

The bonsai plant itself looked like it could have been beautiful.  Unfortunately, when it was shipped to South Dakota around Christmastime, the state was experiencing extremely cold temperatures.  Only packing peanuts were used for insulation, and the plant died.  Restrictions should be placed on shipping these type of products to cold climates or packing material that provides better insulation should be used.

I am very pleased with my order.  The trees were packed very carefully and arrived in excellent condition.  It seems to me that these people really care about bonsai and will have my business in the future.

Not too thrilled with this one though.  Seems to not have any growth and getting yellower by the day.  I'm not sure it survived shipping very well.  It was moist when we got it, but there was only one bloom left on it which dropped after one week.  I didn't care for it any differently than the Jade, which sits right next to it on the counter.  The only thing it seems to attract is bugs.  We finally had to put it outside because it was getting pretty bad.  I think its still alive, but not sure how much longer it has.

My Gardenia Bonsai Tree arrived today, and she's in terrific condition, complete with a bloom and at least two more, on the way! There are no yellowing or brown leaves and the soil, upon arrival, was very moist to the touch! The bonsai pot is nice and large and mine's a gorgeous color blue. I HIGHLY RECOMMEND this fragrant, beautiful and well grown bonsai, to any bonsai lover and makes a terrific gift! Ships quickly and packed very safely.

I'm skeptical of the "helpful" reviews here with such low marks. I purchased this plant as a Mother's Day gift and my mom has had nothing but success with it. They aren't supposed to flower for a year or two after you get them (due to the adjustments they need to the climate and your particular (bad?) watering habits), but she got the plant to flower twice in one year. I think a key to this was keeping it outside during our nice, sunny Minnesota days, and then bringing it inside again each and every night. Adding the correct fertilizer in the correct amount is important.Bonsai aren't necessarily easy, but this one has done well. That's my experience anyway.Also, I was impressed with the packaging - securely shipped and eco-friendly. And the flowers smell absolutely wonderful!

So it came with beautiful greens and full of flowers.  Was really optimistic, no instructions - i.e. how old is it? After the flowers died, it got fleas, which are soil related. It bugged my other plants. However, its a cutting of a shrub, not a bonsai. Its just stuck in a bonsai pot. Now I'm in the bug spraying mode- frustrating. It would have been easier to care for it as a plant, since its buggy. Now I have to train it into a bonsai. It seems root bound, but we're not supposed to anything the first year. Gardenias are hardy but delicate so I'm frustrated with spraying for bugs and for the season I have to bring it in and I hate bugs.

The Bonsai came pretty healthy looking with the majority of leaves being nice and green (only a couple were yellowing) and with many buds ready to open.  I watered it as directed and gave it a little fertilizer to help improve the yellowing leaves.  It did improve and it bloomed profusely.  I think it is natural for it to drop some leaves as it acclimates to it's new environment.  The flowers are now starting to fade away with the season for gardenia plants.  I have noticed some new growth already with new leaves which means the plant is growing and is still healthy.  I would recomend this plant to others who do not mind giving plants some extra attention.

I will admit, I was very hesitant buying this after reading the 3 negative reviews on the main item page description, but I ordered it anyways, I always wanted a flowering bonsai as I only have had the pleasure of having regular bonsais. But when I received, it was extremely healthy and taken care of. Only 3 leaves needed to be trimmed due to discoloration from being inside the box. I know it will take time to flwoer and won't expect it right away. My only concern is that the potting soil is not what I expected. I expected it to be softer and easier like the soil is supposed to be with bonsais, but instead it was regular soil with wood and rock in it. When I got to transplant it later on, I will be fixing that for sure because I want it to grow up healthy.But it's growing quite well and nothing was broken or dead. It was shipped out the next day and arrived at my house 3 days later. The other negative reviews probably had their shipping take longer and that is why the leaves were dissatisfying.Awesome work on this little guy, I would buy from you again. :)

The tree came with no problems. It was packed well, no issues with the packaging or anything, it was all perfectly intact. It is very healthy, with a ton of buds and has no problems whatsoever. Fancy fancy little tree.
Concerned as I have not seen any more blossoms since its arrival. Lots of green leaves.

I received this as a gift and think it is a wonderful plant. Much better than cut flowers that will die off in a week. My bonsai arrived in really good condition with no broken branches and green leaves. It doesnt have any flowers or buds but I am hoping with a little love and care it may eventually get some Gardenias.
I sent one of these to my Mom as a gift and she's still talking about it. Delivered quickly and in perfect condition and at a very good value. More importantly, she loves it!

PURCHASED AS A GIFT FOR MY WIFE. LOOKED GREAT ON ARRIVAL AND WENT DOWN HILL FROM THERE. THREE WEEKS LATER ALL GONE, UNLESS YOU LIKE MINATURE BROWN TREES!  IF I TOOK CARE OF IT I'D EXPECT THAT OUTCOME. BUT MY WIFE HAS A GREEN THUMB AND REALLY TRIED TO SAVE IT.

i got this for my mom for mother's day, it came right away in the mail and already had flower buds on it, its very easy to take care of and the flowers are so pretty and they smell very nice. everyone has complemented her on it.

This gardenia tree looked so cute online and we love gardenias. It arrived with a note to hurry and purchase a tray to go under the pretty pot which has 2 draining holes. It was a surprise this was not included. The plant did however come complete with ectoparasites (something like green scales clinging to the branches) and white flies. It was also not as mature as shown in photo - more like 3 branches with scant green and yellow leaves.

I was a bit hesitant about ordering this because of the mixed reviews.  However, the good seemed to outweigh the bad and this just looked like something my mother would like so I ordered it.  Ever the procrastinator, I ordered this for Mother's Day.  As I ordered it on a Wednesday (the 9th), I knew it wouldn't make it in time...SURPRISE - even though the The estimated date was the 15th (the following Tues), it actually arrived on the 11th in plenty of time for Mother's Day.  My mom called and told me it was gorgeous with lotzzz of flowers.  I asked her about the leaves, size, etc., all the warnings from some of the bad reviews and she said it was in perfect shape and she LOVED it.

The plant came very well packaged & very fast.It came with two flowers on it, smelled so good. I know the gardenia is an indoor plant, but it started showing some yellow leaves,(I live on the west coast)so I put it outside where it get some early morning sun, no afternoon sun.It is doing very well!! In the winter we will bring it in. As for the pictue of the plant I saw on line and the one I recived are very differnt. Mine is more of a bush than a tree. But the price was only $31.00 and this is a bonsai so I can train it anyway I want. I am looking forward to putting my touch on this tree.

I am really please with this bonsai. I can already see that it is going to bloom soon, i am so looking forward to the sight and the smell.My only problem with this item is that i received it WITHOUT the plate that i shown on the pic. Amazon resent me the whole thing again (They can't send only part of the item) but still the plate didn't come with it.I don't understand why i didn't get the item the way it was shown on the website....that's a pity i am quite disappointed.

column9: Lamb Ears Dog Chew Box of 100
column10: Shipment was delivered fast. Dogs love lamb ears, good for their teeth and healthy for them. Will purchase again.

I found buying online by the 50-count box -- with free shipping -- considerably cheaper than buying individually at my local pet supply store. These are a nice size for my two small dogs, andare very clean with no odor.  Many body part treats seem to be messy and smelly, but not these.  I recommend them for small dogs, a big dog would probably demolish one in 2 seconds.  Keeps my guysbusy for about 20 minutes.

Product received quickly but unfortunate it gave my dog diarrhea after one lambs ear.  After waiting several days I tried again with same results.  Returned the lambs ears, placed an order for more lambs ears with a name brand that she had eaten before.  I went through the same company so they still got a sale.  Wish I had of waited before ordering.  I received a credit minus 6 missing lambs ears.  Since I had only taken two from the box, I figured I must have been shorted to begin with.  Meanwhile I paid shipping two ways and had a vet bill for $225.00 because the dog had to be put on antibiotics to clear up the diarrhea.
I received the plants in good condition and they have thrived since transplanting. They are now three times the size as when I got them. I would buy them again.

Product was shipped lose in a large box, 3 times to large, resulting in the container breaking.  Most of the product was crushed, melted, and unusable. I will not be shopping with this supplier again.
Items were received quickly, well packed and taste as great as any Andes mint. Worked out great for my tradeshow booth -- no cumbersome bowl refilling from bags of candy.

The Mints arrived with a chill pack to insure they would not melt in the summer heat! The jar is handy for serving and the mints are fresh and tasty. Recommend this product for entertaining and as a gift to send or bring.
Bought two of these for a green and blue candy buffet and these are perfect. They look great and are super tasty!

Even though I did not get to eat any, my children told me they went through it like nothing and exclaimed they were DELICIOUS! I wasn't expecting anything less knowing that Andes mints are scrumptious ^_^

column9: Awesome Mints for a Great Deal!!
column10: Got these for a xmas gift. There is a lot of them in there to satisfy even the biggest mint fanatic!! Highly Recommend!! Great Deal!!

I ordered 2 different types of mint chocolate in the month of august and the one shipment from a competitor arrive all of the chocolate had melted.  Had expected the worse for the shipment of the Andes chocolate but to my surprise they had packed 4 ice packs with the chocolate and had no melted chocolate. Very impressed with service and chocolate and will be ordering more soon.
very good service recieved it alot earlier than expected I ordered right before christmas kinda late but recieved it in enough time for christmas  thank you great service
I've loved Andes ever since I was a kid.  I hide my stash in my room and nibble at it a little at a time like a mouse.  Beautiful blend of creamy chocolate and fresh mint!
My package was perfect. My husband is so happy because we can't find these mints in our area.
The tablets had discolored from age.  These tablets are suppose to be yellow, not orange or rust colored.  I should have returned.

column9: Honestly the WORST chocolates I have ever had
column10: ANYTHING is better than these.  Some taste bland.  Some taste like wax.  Most just taste really weird, kind of bitter, and just not Good.Here are some chocolates that taste a Lot better than these...SeesGhirardelliLindtReesesGodivaJust to name a few...Even Palmer Chocolates found at Dollar Stores taste better than these!!

column9: Good, but doesn't taste like it's worth $40
column10: Just got this as a gift, and we were really impressed with the box/wrapping. The chocolate is good, but I think I've had better from Sees in general. This box has about 12 flavors per box. I think the hazelnut (?), chocolate (square one), and french vanilla (?) are really good- most have a light texture to the filling that is really nice.
