column9: Cheapest Chocolate You Can Buy--And it' Tastes Like it!
column10: Just got this as a gift and it tastes like it's sold by junior highers to make money (like wrapping paper). it's not chocolate as much as it's cheap waxy choco-flavored covering a ball of sugar and lard. Do not buy this. Disgusting product. Don't be tricked.

column9: Absolutely the Best Tomato Juice on the Planet
column10: There is no better tasting tomato juice. Thick, rich, filled with vitamins. Yeah, it's still the old can and you have to use a can opener, but it's really worth it!

I've always been a fan of Figs, and these are the best I've tasted.  I don't like the dates and apricots as much but even if I could buy the Figs by itself, I'd probably still go for this mixed pack since it becomes a snack with a bit more variety and texture.  The figs are very soft with an odd crispness to the outside, while the other items are much more chewy.  Watch out for the small seeds though!

column4: Richard R. Capuozzo "owned by my dog Max"
column10: Tried these in a movie theater instead of popcorn and enjoyed them a lot. I felt I was doing something good for my body, too. They are a bit expensive though.

column9: Caution, I was Glutened by MI-DEL Ginger Cookies
column10: I purchased these and once home ate them and experienced a severe gluten reaction.  On the bag in small print at the bottom it said they were manufactured in a facility with wheat and dairy.  The label also stated that routine testing occurs only to maintain gluten free label status.  Our bag tested positive for gluten which caused severe bleeding.Please be careful when buying this brand as the statement is for CYA and labeling purposes only.  That way they can charge more for the product.

My daughter and I both have celiac and these are my favorite gluten-free cookies. I loved ginger snaps and molasses cookies before I was diagnosed with celiac and this are a lovely indulgence in a sparce market. I dip them in milk, my daughter eats them plain. Good texture too!
This sandwich cookie is crisp, not too sweet and delicious with a cup of coffee or tea.  Really satisfies the craving for something to dip into your coffee.

The Mi-Del Royal Vanilla Cookies do not have a "cream center".  The center is a vanilla-flavored hard sugar disc.  The outside cookie is delicious but only after removing the sugar disc.  After receiving the first order, I contacted Amazon and complained that the cookies did not have the creamy center as stated in the cookie product description.  Amazon immediately sent a replacement but the second order was exactly the same as the first.  I contacted Mi-Del through their website email and asked if the cream center was supposed to be hard.  Mi-Del did not answer my question but sent a coupon for my next purchase.
Out of all their different kinds of cookies, this is the one that rocks.You would never know this was gluten free.

We know a lot about GF producs in my house and my son really likes these cookies.  They are good Oreo substitutes.  The only reason I'm giving it 4 stars instead of 5 is because the cookie part is very hard and brittle.
My 5 yr. old son (Tyler) who is Autistic and had to go on the GF diet likes them very much. I found these cookies at Liz' Healthfood in Conway, AR. They taste almost like an Oreo. Great cookie.

column9: Great cookies, makes a nice pie crust too!
column10: I keep these in the house at all times.  They are a fabulous cookie- nice taste, not hard or crumbly.  I also use them as a pie crust.  I put them in the blender to chop them up, then mix in a bowl with melted butter.  I spray my pie dish with non-stick spray before pressing it in the plate.  My family likes it as a crust for chocolate pie, but I've used them with others also and it turns out great.  I've never used them for baking pies so I can't recommend that, only for no-bake pies, cheesecakes, etc.

column9: Product shipped and arrived quicky... the cookies in each of the bags were in pieces.
column10: I order two (2) cases of cookies on the same Amazon order. A case of Ginger Snaps and case of Chocolate Cookies from another manufacture.  Both cases arrived quickly from Amazon.  But the ginger snaps had many bags where nearly the entire bag of cookies were broken up and in pieces.  The other case of cookies (Chocolate Chip) was perfect, Hardly any of them broken.

column9: They are GINGER SNAPS so they better be spicy!
column10: I like all the gluten free flavors of cookies that Mi-Del makes.  These are a perfect ginger snap.  Yes, they are crunchy and spicy, but that is what I expect in a ginger snap.  They are wonderful to dip in milk.  The milk cools the spiciness and softens the cookie.  My kids like them so much I have to hide them if I want some left for later!
These are the best gluten free cookies ever.  If you have had the real thing before you won't know the difference.  Even my friends that aren't allergic to gluten like these cookies.

column9: Center of cookie is rock hard
column10: The outer layer of the cookie is good but the center is far from creamy. It's rock hard and inedible IMO. I bought these and after eating a couple they sat in our pantry until they went stale and were tossed. I won't buy these again. However MI-DEL makes other cookie varieties that are delicious--my whole family loves the GF arrowroot animal cookies and the GF ginger snaps.

These cookies are cloyingly sweet, i had to throw out the middle as it tasted like sugar! The cookies themselves are hard without much flavor. I wouldn't buy them again. I'm wondering what to do with those that are left.

Not only will these cookies satisfy a "sweet tooth" attack, but they're healthy and will calm nausea and/or upset stomach.  Strong ginger flavor, not sugary, so although adults really like them, a lot of kids probably won't be crazy about them.

These are some of the best mass-produced gluten-free cookies I have found.  (Never mind the gluten-free part -- most people could never tell that these ginger snaps are not made with wheat flour.)  They've got great snap and just the right amount of gingery heat.  When crushed and combined with a few other choice ingredients, they make a fantastic pie or dessert crust.So why only four stars?  Well, I've bought these ginger snaps many times at the grocery store, and never have I had so many broken cookies as in the box that Amazon sent.  The box itself showed no signs of damage, so I'm a bit puzzled as to what transpired in the Amazon warehouse or in transit.  All in all, however, I love the cookies and am pleased with the Amazon price.  I'll be ordering these again.
Hard as a rock.  Some companies are able to make gluten free sweets palatable, but these are really not very good.  Soaked a cookie in milk for 5 minutes and it did not soften.
yummy! these are amazing. thanks midel for making delicious gluten free cookies. these melt in your mouth. most gluten free foods taste like cardboard but these are very tastey. i'm hooked....

column9: Mmmmm and I don't even like Ginger
column10: Found out I gotta go gluten to due to nursing a gluten intolerant baby , I love my gluten desserts so I have to have something good to eat. These Ginger snaps dipped in almond milk are soooo good mmmmmm mmmmm : )

I haven't been gluten-free my whole life, and Oreos were a common dessert item I used to have. These cookies are very similar in flavor, although the cream filling is a bit more crumbly. These do have corn and soy products in them, which I'm not fond of, but as an occasional treat isn't too horrid.

column9: La15cats - Midel Gluten Free Chocolate Sandwich Cookies
column10: I have been buying this cookies for a long time now, and enjoy them very much.  They taste great - as good as oreo cookies.  LOVE THEM, and will continue to buy them.  I recommend them highly to anyone who must eat Gluten-Free.

We buy this type of product because of a health condition. We ordered these cookies fully expecting them to arrive in a some what good condition. Instead all we received was crumbs and partial cookies, there were very few whole cookies. I suspect the lack of care in the packaging was one of the main problems.

column9: Ginger snaps are okay but I've had better.
column10: I am a huge fan of ginger snaps. When recently diagnosed as needing to be gluten-free, and recently pregnant, I've been on the hunt for GF ginger snaps. I've tried three:Mi-Del Gluten Free Ginger SnapsAnnie's Homegrown Ginger Snap Gluten Free Bunny CookiesMary's Gone Crackers Love Cookies Gluten Free Ginger Snaps1. Mi-DelTexture: a bit grainy. Crunchy, but crumbles in the mouth in that gluten-free grainy way that is not my favorite textureGinger flavor: middling, a tiny bit spicy on the tongue but not too muchSweetness: sweet, like you'd expect a cookie to beSize: about 2 inches, and about 1/4 inch thickDensity: the most heavy or dense of the threeOverall 2 or 3 out of 5 stars2. Annie'sTexture: a bit grainy, but less so than Mi-Del. Very crunchy. Little goldfish-sized crackers perfect for kids or snacking.Ginger flavor: the most mild of the three, has that gingery hint to it, but not enough where it is spicy or leaves a tingle on the tongueSweetness: mild, less sweet than Mi-Del. More like eating an animal cracker than cookie. Tastes great with a slice of cheese.Size: about 1/2 inch to 3/4 inch, and very thinDensity: lightOverall 4 out of 5 stars. If you wanted a kid-friendly cracker-like snack, this would be 5 of 5 stars3. Mary'sTexture: VERY crunchy, not at all grainy. Texture was the least "gluten-free" like of the three. Felt like I was eating a regular cookie.Ginger flavor: very spicy. I could only eat two or three crackers before my tongue needed a break (but I'm not big on spicy foods in general so consider me on the sensitive side). I actually prefer a ginger cookie to be like this though. Plus, it killed my pregnancy nausea in minutes - bonus.Sweetness: not as sweet as Mi-Del, but not as mild as Annie's. very pleasant to me.Size: about 2 inches, and about 1/4 inch thick, basically the same as Mi-Del.Density: Ultra light, most airy in the centerOverall 5 out of 5 stars.Everyone's tastebuds are different, but these were my perceptions. I personally want a ginger cookie with a good "bite" to it, and I really can't stand gluten-free products that are grainy in texture (which seems to be most of them). I want the texture to act like a regular gluten item.  For me, Mary's fit the bill exactly, and Annie's was a close second. Annie's was so different though, I'd eat Mary's as a cookie, and Annie's as a snack, so I could see having them both in the pantry.The one I still want to try is Pamela's, because it has great Amazon reviews. I just don't want to buy them in bulk until I try them, so I need to find them locally.

"Oreos" are America's favorite cookie. Frankly, I've never understood the fascination. But my kids sure do! They devour these cookies. I have tried them myself, and they are very similar to the gluten-containing version. But the important thing is that my kids love them and don't have to feel like they are missing out on a vital part of American childhood!

column9: Delicious Gluten Free Ginger Snaps From Amazon
column10: I am on a gluten free diet and enjoy the ginger snaps as a snack.  My cookie jar is often empty as my husband loves to eat them too. We have bought them at major grocery and health food stores. It is wonderful to have fresh ones delivered.  The next order is for 2 boxes a month but then one box a month until winter.  I must try them in cooking:  sauerbraten or pie filling.  They are very tasty and great with tea or coffee.  I receive the MI-Del Ginger Snaps from Amazon.

I received a basket of gluten free items for Christmas and these Midel cookies were included.  These cookies tasted just like Oreo's and, so far, they are the best gluten free cookies that I have found!  I do not understand why anyone would give them a bad review.  I am glad that we received them as a gift---we just love them!

column9: I knew that being diagnosed with celiac would change things....
column10: The cookie part is ok, but the filling is not good at all. It is dry and splinters apart when bitten into. The taste is barely noticeable and then all of a sudden there is an odd chemical frosting taste. *sigh* I will continue searching for a gluten free cookie, but have resigned myself to the fact that I will have to cook most everything from scratch from now on. On the bright side, it will certainly make me plan ahead better and a more inventive cook.

I purchased these cookies blind, I had not tasted this brand. They were a little crumbly, but not enough to affect the taste. I thought they were wonderful, with only a few broken ones in my delivered box. I would order these again.

I really struggled  finding a decent replacement for Oreo's. This is the closest thing I've found. It is a bit more grainy, due to the rice flour but the crispness is there and the chocolaty sweet taste of and Oreo is satisfied. Use it for recipes as well.
Good tasting cookie.  Will satisfy your sweet tooth.  Very hard, though.  Definitely good for dunking in your coffee!
THESE LITTLE COOKIES ARE VERY SPICY.SO IF YOU LIKE VERY SPICY THINGS YOU WILL LOVE THESE.FOR ME I AM NOT ONE OF THOSE PEOPLE.........
I try to find different snacks for my girlfriend who is gluten intolerant. She really likes these and I have had a few myself and think they taste pretty good too!

These Mi-Del Pecan cookies are excellent!  They are, like all gluten free stuff pretty hard (like trying to eat a poker chip) but if you dunk them in coffee, milk or (I use) Root Beer they soften up nice and taste great!

These are my least favorite of Mi-Del's gluten-free lineup -- which is sad, because I love chocolate and caramel and had high hopes.  However, these cookies are hard and dry.  I'd compare them to biscotti, but that would be unfair to biscotti because these have neither the delightfully craggy texture nor the depth of flavor that good biscotti do.  The "chocolate" part of the equation comes not from true chocolate, but from cocoa, which makes the flavor dull and flat.  The caramel flavor is not awful, but it's marred by the hard-candy-like texture of the caramel bits.  And when Mi-Del describes these as "bite-size," they mean it:  These cookies are approximately the size of a nickel in diameter.If I were to do it all over again, I'd find a bag of these in a local store and try them first.  As it stands now, I'm stuck with a case of the lil' suckers.

column9: MI-DEL GLUTEN-FREE ROYAL VANILLA SANDWICH COOKIES
column10: I WAS SCEPTICAL AT FIRST ABOUT A SANDWICH, GLUTEN FREE COOKIE.  BOY WAS I WRONG!  THEY TASTE GREAT!  HOWEVER, I HAD TO STOP EATING THEM, I AM ALLERGIC TO POTATO!  WHAT A BUMMER.  I WANTED A SANDWICH COOKIE AND THIS FIT THE BILL.  I BOUGHT A CASE, TOOK SOME COOKIES TO WORK AND EVERYONE IN THE OFFICE LOVED THEM.  (I AM THE ONLY ONE WITH CELIAC DISEASE IN THE OFFICE)  SO WHEN I COULD NO LONGER EAT THE COOKIES, THE OFFICE ATE ALL MY COOKIES!  THEY WANTED MORE.  I DIRECTED THEM TO AMAZON.COM.  THE LADIES IN THE OFFICE HAD NO IDEA, GLUTEN FREE COOKIES TASTED SO GOOD.  THEY HAVE ALSO EATEN MY CHOCOLATE CHIP, GINGERSNAPS, SHORTBREAD COOKIES TOO.  SO THESE COOKIES APPEAL TO EVERYONE!

column9: Gluten free, really? They taste AMAZING!!
column10: Finding gluten free products that taste decent is a challenge and I bought a box of these cookies expecting them to taste "good" but still, with an off taste from being gluten free. Wow, was I wrong! These cookies are amazing!! They are shaped like animals, light, crunchy, buttery, and a hint of lemon. These are hands down the best cookies I've had in my life, including "regular" cookies, and this is the first time I can actually say a gluten free item tastes better than its gluten counterpart.My WalMart sells these for 3.38/bag and I got them here for a bit over 2.00/bag with subscribe and save. This will definitely be a staple in our household! We've eaten an entire bag in less than 24 hours. Nobody could ever guess that these cookies are gluten free, they are AMAZING!!

REALLY ENJOY THE 'SNAPPY GINGER' TASTE IN MI-DEL GLUTEN-FREE GINGER SNAPS.THIS CASE SEEMED TO ONLY HAVE ABOUT 5-8 WHOLE, IN TACT COOKIES IN EACH PACKAGE.  THEY WERE MOSTLY GINGER SNAP CRUMBS!I HAVE ORDERED THESE GLUTEN-FREE COOKIES OFTEN AND THE MOSTLY CRUMBS WAS A FIRST.  I HAVE BEEN PLEASED WITH OTHER MI-DEL GLUTEN-FREE COOKIES I HAVE ORDERED IN THE PAST.HAVEN'T DECIDED IF I WILL ORDER A CASE OF THEM AGAIN.

I love this company and what they are trying to do.  However, when I first got my celiac diagnosis, though, I got glutened by these.A couple of years passed.  The buzz on the celiac boards was that Mi-Del had really cleaned up their act, and that their cookies were safe.  From about 2004-2009, I ate these without incident.  I even figured out how to make cookie pie crusts in them and put the recipe in my gluten-free cookbook.  Then, I got a bad batch two times in a row, and got glutened again.Maybe they have problems with suppliers?  I understand they've been a lot more careful with the actual manufacturing process.It's sad, but I would buy Pamela's ginger cookies (available on Amazon!) instead.

We love these cookies, better than "K" vanilla.  My husband is not gluten free, and this is his favorite cookie too.  Yes, they are a crisp cookie (some may call hard), but that is why I like them.  They have a rich vanilla flavor which the "K" cookies do not. I carry these in my purse when when we are dining out so I have a gluten free dessert, restaurants never mind this.  For chocolate, we still like the "K" chocolate the best. Note: I use the auto delivery every 6 month for a better price.

column9: All six gluten free people in our house love them!
column10: These are so tasty! Just the perfect amount of sweetness! They are nicely brown around the edges, so delicious!

Mi-Del Gluten-Free Ginger Snaps are the only gluten free cookies I've found that I would put on par with really good regular cookies. Besides a taste that I enjoy, they have a nice slightly chewy texture. You'll be doing double takes to make sure the label actually says gluten-free.

column9: Review of Mi-del Chocolate Sandwich Cookies
column10: These are the best "wheat" free cookeis.This was a great price and availabiltiy.Would love to business again! Thanks.

These ginger snaps are delicious with a lot of ginger flavor. They are good alone or with fruit, and they make an excellent substitute for graham cracker crumb crust, especially with lemon merengue pie. We love them. No one would ever guess they were also gluten-free.

column9: Great to use in cheesecake crusts
column10: I use these cookies to make gluten free cheesecake crusts.I turn them into crumbs using a chopper and then use these crumbs in place of the graham crackers in the recipe.I also use less butter than the recipe asks for in the crust as the cookies have some oil already in them.Anyway the cookies taste great as a gluten free cheesecake crust and everyone gives compliments ;-)My husband and I also like to eat these cookies with pudding by Kozy Shack, which is also gluten free.
The flavor of my first bite was unbelievably intense.  I've tried numerous GF cookies, these are my favorite by a long shot. The package has been redesigned, it is now cream & blue in color.
I will buy these cookies again. I am glad that I order them regardless of the not so good reviews.

To date, this is the only gluten free cookie I've tried and absolutely loved.  They have a livelier flavor than vanilla wafers and are sweeter (but not too sweet) than what you expect from regular animal crackers.  I subscribed to these and am glad they come in the bulk quantity they do, since even my gluten-loving coworkers devour them as soon as they see they're out for taking.

Delicious? Check!Gluten free? Check!Good price? Check!Thank you, amazon, for making these great cookies available!  It is difficult finding things to eat when you have a gluten intolerance and it is even HARDER finding things to eat that TASTE GOOD!All of the celiacs in my family enjoy these animal crackers! Five stars!

Mi-Del Ginger Snaps are far better in texture and flavor than any I have ever purchased. I have eaten many varieties of ginger snaps in my 85 years of life, and appreciate this as an exceptionally good product.  The only problem I have is that I can't stop eating them!

My grandson's gluten allergy led me to these cookies because animal cookies are a tradtional Christmas gift for children in our family. Our entire family loves them, but the real test is on unsuspecting gluten consuming individuals and they past the test. Recently the contractor came by in the afternoon with his son's 8 and 10 years old.  They looked hungry and so I offered cookies, with Dad's permission.  They almost wiped out the bag. Good Cookies!
These animal cracker cookies taste the most like the "other" kind that I have tried so far.  So much fun to eat with the grandchildren.
My son loves these cookies! They're tasty and reasonable-2 traits which often don't describe gluten free baked goods! Enjoy!
These are great cookies.  I have two girls with celiac disease, one is a toddler. Finding foods that are like the "real" thing is tough these are a great treat and we love them!

These cookies are a wonderful replacement for any kid ( or grown up ) wanting to eat a long time favorite. There is about 80 cookies per bag, so it makes it well worth the money spent. They are light, buttery and crispy making them great for milk. These pack well in bags for lunch  ( don't break up easily ) so they would do great in a kid's lunch for school or daycare. I actually give these cookies to people to show them gluten free doesn't mean cardboard.

column9: You can eat ginger snaps again!
column10: These ginger snaps aren't too overpowering on the ginger and go great with some milk. Really enjoyed having these in the house and they are a great buy - so affordable compared to most alternative diet foods. They'll last for at least a week or so and store well.
I love these cookies.  I can't eat gluten and they are a healthy treat. Family members who can eat gluten enjoy them also.
Ginger Snaps are delicious.  Not too sweet and loaded with flavor. Wonderful texture, great with a nice cup of tea.
Very good gluten free animal cookies... We use them as re-inforcers for my son.  Very good product.

I picked the Cinnamon Snaps up at my Grandma's local health food store the last time I visited and loved them.  I have yet to try the ginger snaps but I'm sure they are just as good.  Hopefully Amazon will start carrying the Cinnamon Snaps.

These are one of the two best gluten free animal cookies on the market.  The other being: EnviroKidz Organic Gluten-Free Animal Cookies, Vanilla, 9-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 12)  I prefer Mi-Del because they are more economical than EnviroKidz and my daughter loves these cookies.

Even if you're able to eat regular cookies (not Gluten free) you'll love these. Really sweet, and incredibly tasty. Since I can't have Gluten in my diet, these have become my staple desert. I buy them two cases at a time so I'll never run out.

column9: Both my 5 yr old son and I love them.
column10: Hard to find products that my son's diet allows him to eat.  This is a great treat.  He loves them.  I have a hard time keeping out of the opened bag of cookies myself.  They are crunchy but we love them.
These ginger cookies are great if you are on a gluten-free diet. They are spicy, not too sweet and are great for dunking!

column9: Not pleased with these att all!
column10: This cookie is too hard to bite into and the center is like eating crispy sugar.  I did not care for these at all and now I have a whole case of them.  Guess they will end up as a pie crust or something.
These are spicy, and my kids love them too. They are crispy and I am SO glad I found these after being diagnosed with Celiac.

Thanks to hubby's recent diagnosis of gluten allergy, I've begun to explore the world of gluten free foods. While some are quite bland, these little cookies pack a flavorful punch! Nothing "depriving" here.
These Ginger Snaps were very good but I ordered the gluten free ginger snaps and they were shipped in error and all my complaints to Amazon were ignored.Bill

I ordered these for my son (age 11). He doesn't like them at all. I thought they would be similar to the Kinnikinnick cookies we get at our local health food store, but they're not. These are rock hard and although sugary, otherwise have no flavor. We'll stick with the Kinnikinnicks. I'm just hoping maybe I can use these for making a cookie crumb crust.
I love these and it is the best treat.  I love cookies and couldn't find one that was very good until I found these.  I can eat a whole bag in one day!  Matter of fact, I need to order another case.

These cookies are so good - you'd never know that they were wheat free!  The bags are not filled anywhere near full (my only compliant - too much packaging) so a package of 8 is not really too much.  2 bags of cookies will fit in a medium clamp-top glass jar (which is how I store them in my kitchen)  Looking forward to trying the Chocolate cookies next...

I have a 4 yr old and a 2 yr old that can't eat gluten and this is an awesome products for them. We always have some with us where ever we go and they absolute love them. They are moderately sweet and crunchy.They also make a wonderful pie crust. 1 1/2 cup cookie crumbs, 5 TBS margerine, 1 TBS surgar. Mix and pat into pie plate. Bake 10 min at 350 degrees.We couldn't live without them. Thanks Mi-Del!!!

column9: A Comparison to Nature's Path EnviroKidz Animal Crackers
column10: Mi-Del: Slightly cheaper per ounce, crackers are actually animal shaped, butter cookie taste (like those that come in a tin around the holiday season)Envirkidz: Square cookie/cracker, vanilla flavorNature's Path EnviroKidz Organic Gluten-Free Animal Cookies, Vanilla, 9-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 12)Both have similar nutrition profiles (calories, fat, grams of carbohydrate) and are GF.My shipment was not stale, unlike the other reviewer's complaint. Both taste fine and I find I can't put the box down sometimes, but I am not a big sugar/butter cookie fan, so I think I prefer the Envirokidz. Definitely a better deal than the local health food store and, trust me, you WILL be able to eat the whole box before they expire.

Great replacement for traditional animal cookies.  My daughter, like me, cannot have gluten but loves these cookies.  I even serve them as a snack for the nursery at church.  The kids love them.... and here at Amazon, they are the right price for sharing.

column9: A favorite of my autistic son
column10: Although made with butter (my son is GF/CF), my son has no digestive or behavior problems after eating these.  He's thrilled to be able to have animal crackers again.  They are perfect for school snack or in the car.  The cookies are tasty enough that Mom and Dad (who do eat wheat) will snack on them as well.  They are quite pricey in the store, but Amazon's subscription price makes them fairly affordable - and much easier than always making homemade.

column9: Great for everyone in the family.
column10: Both my kids (8 and 4) love these cookies.  They have always been really crunchy.  We've never had them mushy like in another review.  They are not too sweet and have fun shapes.  Great for anyone gluten sensitive, and everyone else in the family.
Sadly, the cookies in this shipment  were soft (they should be crunchy).  I now only buy them from the store self where they are fresh.
Recently diagnosed with celiac disease. Bought these at a grocery store, but the ginger flavor is very strong. The tecture is good, though.
If you are looking for mild ginger flavored snaps...these are not it.  If you however, enjoy a very strong ginger taste, give these a try.

These cookies were AWFUL!  Really bad.  My co-worker and I each bit into one and we couldn't finish it.  I tried one a week or so later when I was really hungry and it was still terrible.  Not only do they not taste good, but instead of being bland, they actually taste BAD and leave a horrible aftertaste.  I buy a lot of Gluten Free products and almost everything is really good but this was far from it.

I love me the regular Mi-Del Ginger Snaps... but out of a fluke I picked me up a gluten free bag once and thought it tasted not so yummy.  like ginger flavored sweetend hard dirt.  so unless you have to have the gluten free for some reason go get you the normal ginger snaps which as of Sep 2006, Amazon offers
Took FOREVER to arrive and the case is way too many cookies to consume! Will stick to my local organic grocery next time. Once again, ordering food from Amazon has fallen far below expectations.

Wow! I've been buying dog treats for over 40 years and this one takes the cake! Pay no attention to the photo in the advertisement for this product. What you get is two (2) small chews in each of three (3) shrink wrapped over cardboard packages. That's a total of six (6) small chews for $30.00 not including shipping! I couldn't return my order quick enough.

I was not impressed about this product (Made in China). Cheaply made and not very good quality. Outside was coated with redish brown sweet something which stained the carpet.  My dog first tried to lick the coating and then bit the "bone".  It was like hard leather, more than bone, and left a mess of shreds about as well.

column9: Only rawhide my dog will chew
column10: Okay, my chihuaha is finicky...i have wasted lots of money on other rawhide chews and finally found one! Thank you beefeaters.

My little yourkie absolutely loves these treats. He chews all the chicken off first, which I think helps keep his teeth clean, and then goes to work on the rawhide.GREAT product, but the packaging wasn't too great. The bones were falling out when I got them... a little concerning.
Each evening before going to bed my dog gets a chick n top.  It relaxes her with a treat that she really enjoys.
My hound is surprisingly picky about treats.  But these are his all time favorites.  He, Wimsey, likes all the chicken top/treated Beefeater products
THIS IS NOT A PACK OF 12 BUT OF 3. I AM VERY UNHAPPY. PRODUCT IS NOT AS DESCRIBED  DO NOT ORDER IF YOU EXPECT 12 BONES. RIP OFF.  AMAZON SHOULD BE ASHAMED.

column9: wonderful treat but doesn't last as long as other rawhide
column10: My 30 pound puppy goes crazy for these, he really loves them.  He's just in heaven when he's chewing on one of these, but they only last about 20 minutes.  If you're looking for something that lasts much longer than a biscuit but doesn't need to last for hours like other rawhide treats then this is perfect.

column9: Very convenient box sizes with good price
column10: I like the convenience of subscribe & save along with the box sizes which makes it convenient to give to day care for our son as well as carrying it with you in his diaper bag (either the full box or a few of the packets inside the box). Even when traveling it was convenient to carry the packets rather than a box which when opened is always spilling out.As for the taste, our son loves it. We have tried other Earth's organic product like the food jars and our son loves all their products.

column9: Prefer the rice Earth's Best over this one
column10: We've used this cereal many times for our twins and have had no problems. It's a great brand.  Earth's Best rice cereal is made from whole brown rice whereas this one lists organic whole oat flour as the first ingredient.  Flour compared to whole grain, for the same price.  That first ingredient is a qualitative difference, whole rice versus oat flour, is the reason we go for the rice one when we can.I have to load up at the store when they have Earth's Best rice cereal. They always have this one, the Whole Grain Oatmeal Cereal though. This one is never sold out.Both of the two above-mentioned cereals work perfectly in formula, mixing right in as you'd want. Our babies are growing and they liked these cereals the moment they were introduced. Of course, one has to test a food out on one's baby(s). You never know if for some reason your baby will have a negative reaction. But we've had a very positive experience with Earth's Best. We also subscribe through Amazon to several Earth's Best baby food jars.

column9: Not bad for diet, if you like the regular Moxie
column10: I was thrilled when they developed Diet Moxie as I usually drink diet soda. This is faithful to the recipe of the regular Moxie, without sacrificing too much of what makes Moxie Moxie. For a very limited product (only really available in scattered locales in New England), I was frankly surprised that they would produce a diet edition, but am very happy that they have. I understand all the reservations the full-octane drinkers have about diet drinks, but if you love Moxie as I do, your avenue is not cut off for enjoying the flavour of it if you need a diet variety.

I was very pleased to discover a few years ago that HometownFavorites continues to sell Moxie, which according to Wikipedia has "a unique flavor that is not as sweet as that of most modern soft drinks and that is described by some as bitter".  Most sodas are too yucky sweet for my taste, but Moxie has a zingy flavor that I really like.Even so, I don't drink any non-diet soda (non-nutritional junk, imho), so I'm glad that a diet version is available.  I've bought it both directly from HometownFavorites and via Amazon.Some of its appeal to me is undoubtedly nostalgia for a regional brand from New England, where I grew up. (I don't recall actually drinking the stuff as a kid.  It was out of fashion by that time, and like most kids, I probably wouldn't have liked the slightly bitter taste.)  If you're looking for a soda for grownups, you might like Moxie.

I don't care for Moxie, but my husband remembers it from when he was young and loves it.  We order a couple of times a year for him to enjoy.  My 10 year old grandson loves the taste also.  Will buy again from seller, very fast shipping.  Shipping costs are a little expensive.

column9: This is the one for you!
column10: If you ever wanted the fine taste of used motor oil in a soft drink then Moxie is the One for you!  And now you can get Diet Moxie with the same old flavor with none of whatever diet drinks are supposed to take out!

column9: Fruit basket not exactly as pictured or described and not so great
column10: While this fruit basket looks nice enough, it is not exactly as it is described here.According to my inventory and the actual product label, the basket contains:dates, apricots (preserved with sulphur dioxide), prunes (preserved with potassium sorbate), pineapple (processed with cane sugar and citric acid, preserved with sulphur dioxide), coconut date roll (dates, almonds and coconut), cherries (processed with corn syrup, high fructose corn syrup, water citric acid, natural and artificial flavor, preserved with potassium sorbate, sodium benzoate and sulphur dioxide, artificial color - FD&C red no. 40).The basket does not contain:Apples, Figs, Pears or Peaches - All of which are listed as included in the Amazon product description.Also the Amazon description says "Made of assorted dried fruit from the fertile California Valley" and "This generous, large basket provides two pounds, 12 ounces of sweet, healthy, and delicious dried fruit from the fertile California Valley," but according to the actual product label, the product contains fruit from The Philippines, Thailand, Turkey and the USA (in that order).  I wouldn't have even purchased it if I knew that.  At least China isn't listed.Additionally, some of the fruit just isn't that great.  For instance, some of the dried apricots were moist and some of them were tough and dry - some of the dates were moist but some were bone dry.  The cherries are basically maraschino cherries without the jar - IMO, they don't really belong in there.  The prunes were all pretty good and the dried pineapple was okay.  The coconut covered dates were also good, but there are only six of those.Also, it's not really "healthy" to consume all of those preservatives (that aren't mentioned in the description) such as sulphur dioxide, potassium sorbate or sodium benzoate.  I'm not even going to get into the problems with those colored fructose soaked cherry hulls.If you spent $40 on assorted dried fruits and made up your own baskets, you could probably make four of five baskets of fruit of better quality than this.  It's not that this basket is bad, but it just wasn't worth $40.  I's say $15, tops.Please see my photos of the actual item and the label to see for yourself.

It is such a big difference that Luzianne is worth ordering if it is not available in your area.THE Southern Sweet Tea recipe is:- 1 part boiling water- 3 parts hot water(not boiling)- 1 family-size Luzianne tea bag per cup of boiling water (use more bags for more flavor)- 0.25-0.75 part granulated sugar (depending on taste)1) Pour boiling water over tea bags (DO NOT AGITATE, JUST POUR)2) Let steep for 5 minutes without agitation (don't stir, don't squeeze, don't do anything!)3) Remove tea bags quickly without squeezing or draining and discard4) Pour steeped tea into hot water5) Mix in sugar and stir until dissolved6) Serve over ice

column9: Great for Summer Iced Tea Lovers!
column10: I am new to brewing iced tea at home, and I must say, Luzianne tea is fantastic for this very purpose.  The flavor profile is not too robust, but not weak.  It's a perfect balance of black tea that will leave you wanting more!  I use subscribe and save and take advantage of the great price.Some people use home brewers, but they take all the fun out of tea making.  I've adopted the below strategy for the perfect cup of iced tea.Place six cups of tap water in a pot.  Pour 2/3 cup of sugar into the pot, and then bring this simple syrup to a rolling boil, with an occasional stir.  When you reach the rolling boil, steep three of the family sized teabags for about 10 seconds, then remove from heat.  Allow the bags to sit in the pot for 5-10 minutes.  Use a wooden spoon to squeeze any remaining tea out of the bags, and discard.  Allow your tea concentrate to cool to room temperature.  Pour six cups of fresh water into an empty gallon jug (preferably glass, but BPA free plastic works as well).  Then, pour your tea concentrate into the same jug.  You now have delicious iced tea - refrigerate, and serve with ice and a wedge of lemon!  Variations: 1 cup of sugar for southern sweet, 1/4 cup of sugar for sunkissed sweet, or no sugar at all if you like unsweetened tea.Enjoy!

column9: No need to miss wheat spaghetti anymore
column10: I highly recommend this to anyone who eats a gluten-free diet. Other than price, it stacks up quite well to wheat spaghetti, though the taste is slightly different. My pasta-loving kids eat it happily and I can enjoy "spaghetti night" with them now. The texture is very good with either the normal or energy-saving cooking directions. However, I've found that there are a few things that make a difference in the final quality.First, regardless of which cooking method you use, after you add the pasta to the boiling water, STIR until you're sure all of the noodles are completely separated. If you don't separate them when you first add them to the boiling water, they might stick together and not cook properly. (This is true of wheat spaghetti, too, but the Tinkyada pasta seems a little more prone to it.) After they are all separate, you don't have to stir again if you're using the energy-saving method. With the normal method, I recommend a quick occasional stir to make sure none of the noodles are sticking to the bottom of the pot.Second, don't skimp on the rinsing. You'll see the water goes very cloudy when the pasta cooks - a lot of starch is being released into the water. You have to get that rinsed off or the pasta will stick together after you drain it. If you do the rinsing right, it won't stick together - even leftovers that have been refrigerated won't be sticky.  The cold water rinse seems to be particularly important. Since I like to serve spaghetti noodles hot, I start rinsing with cold water and then finish with hot water. The result is hot spaghetti with no stickiness.Third, unless you're on a low-sodium diet, I recommend salting the cooking water as directed on the package. Salting improves the taste (it's slightly sweet if you don't salt the cooking water) and it also seems to improve the texture slightly.About the energy-saving cooking method: This is great in the summer time since you can turn off the burner sooner and not dump as much heat into the house. But when it's time to rinse you may find that not only is the water very cloudy, but a skin of starch has developed on the surface of the water. It's not pretty, but it rinses right off. (I mentioned this because it freaked my husband out the first time he saw it; I thought I'd save someone else from that surprise.)

column9: Not Bad - But Not So Good Either
column10: The reviews were so good I just had to try this - and the result was the usual fat cold noodles tasting like rice (i.e., nothing much).  Tinkyada isn't any worse than any of the others - but I find the thickness of conventional spaghetti makes the rice taste much more noticeable.  Take this with a grain of salt, since I preferred vermicelli even before I went on a gluten-free diet (about 15 years ago), but to me, vermicelli works a lot better than conventional spaghetti, because it's thinner, making the taste (or lack thereof) less noticeable when coated with sauce.  People not on the diet notice the pasta when I use rice spaghetti, but no one has ever found fault with the Ener-G Foods Rice Vermicelli, 10.5-Ounce Bags (Pack of 12) I used to use, or the Annie Chun's Brown Rice Noodle, Pad Thai, 8-Ounce (Pack of 6) (more like linguini) I've been using in place of spaghetti recently.  I still buy the Tinkyada spaghetti to use in soups - fine for chicken noodle soup, etc. - but am going back to the above products that I've been using quite happily as spaghetti for years.  Not only is the rice taste less noticeable, but the vermicelli cooks in 4 minutes or so - 1/3 the time it takes to cook Tinkyada spaghetti.  (Given my attention span, this also makes it easier for me not to forget and overcook it into a gooey mess.)

They must have been Tinkyada employees, friends, or family because there is no way that it tastes five-stars.To be fair, I do eat gluten and it is my wife who has the gluten allergy.  So I do have my own biases as I eat gluten on a daily basis.  My wife tells me that she forgets what gluten tastes like after months of going on the gluten-free diet, and she is able to eat alternatives that I believe do not taste as good as the wheat-full version.  However, my wife is not particularly fond of this product either.Based on the reviews, I bought this thinking this spaghetti was going to taste exactly the same as regular pasta, but the consistancy, though constant, is kind of slimy.  Additionally, the "energy saving method" turns the pasta especially gooey, so I do not recommend that method of cooking should you be persuaded based on the other 25 reviews.There are lots of other gluten-free pastas out there, like corn-based, or a mixture of potato, soy, and rice that taste a lot closer to the "real-thing."  I haven't found too many alternatives on Amazon yet, but my local grocery store has a few and my wife prefers them over this brand.  So at the moment, I have 11 packets of gluten-free spaghetti that I would be happy to get rid of.

All Tinkyada brown rice pasta products have been wonderful!  You do need to learn not to overcook them.  I find using the energy saving technique (boil a minute or two and then cover pot and wait about 15 minutes) works perfectly.  We love this pasta and find it better than the pasta we ate before our gluten free days.

column9: You better like your pasta AL DENTE, otherwise forget it ..
column10: Most of the grocery stores in my neighborhood sell this product, so I've been buying it locally for the past year. I really enjoyed it up until recently.Tonite, I realized there are two things I don't like about this pasta.#1 - It takes too long to cook.  I have to boil it for at least 20 minutes to get it the texture I like.  That's a long time when you can boil angel hair pasta in 6 minutes and stir fry some veggies in less than 2 miinutes.#2 - Even after 20 minutes of boiling, this pasta is super AL DENTE.  It just always seems like it's not cooked enuf.I wish they had a thin angel hair version.I couldn't even finish my dinner tonite.  After boiling 20 minutes, this stuff was just too hard. It was almost as gross as eating UNDERCOOKED rice.  Yes, it is gluten-free, but, it's got a thick, starchy texture that I can't stand chewing and it takes too long to cook.IMHO, corn-quinoa pasta is better.Edit:  6-28-12Tinkyada's FETTUCCINI in the red package is better.

Based on reviews, I tried this pasta. It may have been better than some other brands, but it certainly didn't taste good. The only gluten-free pasta that I think tastes like "real" pasta is made by Bionature--both their penne and their spaghetti are terrific.
This deal is the best deal I can find for this name of pasta.  I'm trying gluten free, and this fits easily into the budget.  Taste great or better than regular (wheat) pasta.
This is our go-to pasta.  It is easy to cook (definately try the energy saving method).  The price is reasonable and leftovers keep well in the fridge without breaking down.

I bought this thinking it would be nice to eat a spaghetti that was gluten free and not expensive. I bought a few packages because I always follow the package directions first, then I play with it if it's not to my liking.Attempt 1 was like eating a gummy spaghetti noodle with a nasty after taste. I had to add sauce and butter to kill the taste.Attempt 2 wasn't any better. It was still gummy and gluey like and the flavor wasn't very good either.Attempt 3 was a little better in that the water didn't look like a gelatin style mess when we drained it but the noodles were chewy and I couldn't finish the second bite.Attempt 4 was when I finally said no more "pasta joy". I ended up trying to cook it by breaking the noodles in half first, thinking maybe it just isn't that great for cooking as long noodles. Oh no. I ended up having to take out clumps of noodles, tear them apart from each other and put them back in the pot. I gave up towards the end and just threw the clumps of noodles out. The texture was slimy, gummy and sticky and the aftertaste is still like pet food.If you are used to over cooked spaghetti drowned in sauce, I could see how this would be great... But if you want something that tastes and acts like spaghetti, this is NOT it.I can't figure out how this got 5 stars. It was horrible in taste and texture and was nothing close to spaghetti. I bought Hodgkins Mills rice and flaxseed noodles and they are perfect in texture and taste. But I won't buy pasta joy again.
I have been eating this pasta for years.  I think it's the best in terms of taste and texture.  You can't beat this price.  Excellent value.

This stuff takes awhile to ccok, but it doesn't turn to mush when you cook it! Holds up really well in soups, slow cooker meals and pasta main dishes (both hot and cold). Nice flavor, too.Before I ate gluten-free, I used to eat 100% whole wheat pasta. This is nowhere near as flavorful (and is softer in texture), but I've gotten used to it. If you like white/refined/semolina wheat pasta, there will be less adjusting to do (regarding taste.) This pasta definitely has more flavor than white rice pastas, and it really does hold up much better in cooking.

column9: Delicious- Tinkyada is my favorite GF pasta
column10: I've been eating this pasta for at least 12 years- no other GF pasta compares to this one! I do salt the water, put the pasta in when the water's boiling, and I always have to cook it for a few minutes longer than recommended. Afterwards, I rinse in cool water. I like that it is somewhat nutritious because of the rice bran and brown rice. I also like the taste and the consistency of the pasta. It is quite filling, but I've found this to be true of all GF pastas.
Have brought this pasta to dinners and people just think it's whole wheat pasta. My husband and I really like it.
This is the best pasta we've tried.  Add more water to the pot because it's a bit starchier than regular pasta.
This is the best rice pasta I ever had and enjoy every week now that I have found what will be a staple in our home.
After trying many different kinds of pasta....this is almost as good as the wheat pasta that I have used for years....

This pasta is so authentic no one in my family could believe it wasn't wheat.  We were buying the Tinkyada white rice pasta and, while it was pretty good, it didn't quite have the same taste & texture as a wheat-based pasta.  This one is great.  The price on Amazon, by the case, is much cheaper than in local stores, esp. with super saver shipping.Can't say enough about how great this pasta is.  If you are gluten free and have to serve pasta to family members or friends that you can eat, this is your best bet.

This company makes the BEST non-wheat-based pasta I have tried! Taste, texture, the way it holds up and everything considered. The only one I've had trouble with was the lasagna - it broke. But that may have been the way I was treating it. I have not been able to enjoy pasta for a while now,... until I found Tinkiyada. MMMM... macaroni and cheese! Spaghetti and meatballs! Didn't know I missed them so much.

I have been gluten free for over 2 years, and I've tried many types of gluten free spaghettis, and this is the best by far. It has the best texture and flavor. It sometimes sticks a bit, but if you put a little olive oil on it before you boil it, and add a bit to the water then it doesn't stick at all.

For those looking for a delicious brown rice pasta Tinkyada is the best.  I've tried just about every brand and Tinkyada is the best.  My family loves it.  We choose to eat this pasta as opposed to wheat pasta to be healthier.  It cooks up good.  And buying from Amazon is great.  We can buy large quantities at a substantial discount.

We tried this pasta on a whim when grocery shopping one day.  No one in our family eats a gluten-free diet or anything, it was purely an impulse buy.  Wow- was this a good purchase!  I fed our whole family (6 including 3 teenagers) with this one bag and we had a lot leftover.  It is of such high quality that it filled everyone up on less than traditional white pasta AND they couldn't stop talking about how good it taste!  I used this brand's mini-shells for a dish a few nights ago and again- THEY COULDN'T SAY ENOUGH ABOUT HOW GOOD IT WAS!! This will now be our pasta of choice as the flavor and value (because less fills up everyone)from now on!  Can't say enough!

I really like this product especially since I can't have wheat. The flavor and texture are great. One word to note though is you should eat it the same same day you make it. It holds it's texture better that way. Otherwise it tends to brake down into smaller pieces the next day. Also, I found the best way to cook this is by boiling it for two minutes and then letting it sit in the hot water with a cover for 15-20 minutes (depending on how you may like the texture to be). This seems to be a fail proof way of making it. I found if you boil it for the whole 15-20 minutes it has a tendency to become mushy and breaks apart easier. Otherwise it a very good alternative to wheat spaghetti.

Tankyada spaghettis are first quality. My husband has celiac disease and has to eat a gluten free diet, which can be a real pain. We have purchased other brands of pasta before. They turned into mush and were very sticky.So we purchased Tankyada spaghettis from Amamzon, and we are thrilled.They don't stick together and are easy to serve, if one follows the directions. My advice is: If there are leftovers, please, rinse them in cold water again, drain and store in the refrigerator.I hope my review will help others.
This pasta takes about 20 minutes to cook but it is delicious, firm, gluten free and hard to mess up!
This pasta has a great taste and texture.  It is very similar to "regular" pasta.  My husband, who does not have celiac, enjoys it too.
This tastes better than spaghetti that is made with wheat.  Gluten free is more expensive, but I got this at a good price.  Will buy more when I am finished with this.

column9: Finally a wheat free pasta to love!
column10: YES, you can have yummy pasta!!Love, love ,love it!! just remember to boil it in lots of water then rinse it when it is done to your liking. No one even guessed that it was not regular pasta in my house. I am so glad it is here so that I can get a better deal as it is well worth it in my opinion. To use leftover pasta drop into boiling water quickly and strain and its ready for another meal. The rotini is great too but I have not tried any others from this brand yet. Enjoy
Great pasta. Tastes the same as regular pasta if not better. I really like it!

column9: The only gluten free brand I buy
column10: I've started buying this in bulk from Amazon because it seems to be the only GF pasta that works.  Others fall apart or are simply awfultasting in addition to being overpriced. I have to keep telling my mother in law not to buy the little $4 a bag GF pasta she buys because I've found the one that works.  If you follow the "energy saving" method, it works even better.  That way the pasta isn't torn up by all the boiling.

Tinkyada is the best brand for gluten-free pasta we have found so far - and I'm not inclined to keep looking, it's that good!  It's made of rice and bran, instead of wheat, so of course it will taste differently, and cook differently, than what some people are used to when they first switch over to wheat-free, but it's thoroughly delicious.  Also, let me say again that it is (hands down) the best brand we've found for gluten-free pastas!

I was diagnosed with Celiac Disease in Dec. 09.  I have tried a lot of different rice noodles.  This brand is by far the best I have tried.  They are not gummy or sticky like others!Tinkyada Brown Rice Spaghetti with Rice Bran, 16-Ounce Packages (Pack of 12)

column9: Best gluten free spaghetti on the market!
column10: This is the best gluten free pasta brand I've ever found on the market, I buy this in bulk every 6 months on schedule, and I recommend it highly!

column9: The only gluten-free pasta worth eating
column10: Since I developed a wheat allergy I've tried every gluten-free pasta out there. Most are gross- they either have a strange taste of corn or beans or they get mushy or have some other weird texture. The leftovers have a tendency to turn to a weird sort of paste. Yuck!This stuff, however, is fantastic! You must follow the directions correctly but if you do it has a great texture that is close to regular pasta. While the flavor is obviously slightly different than regular pasta I've served it to people with a properly seasoned sauce who said it was better than regular pasta. It holds up, covered in sauce, as well for leftovers as regular pasta.I especially love the spaghetti with a homemade marinara sauce and the lasagna noodles made in the best lasagna recipe EVER [...] though I alter the recipe a bit by making extra sauce, baking a little longer, and don't bother pre-cooking the noodles.I'm LOVING that I can buy in bulk from Amazon, at a much cheaper price than my local health food store.

column9: No More Feeling Sorry for Yourself!
column10: After being diagnosed with Celiac, I tried many, many brands of pasta. They were all a disappointment. Grainy, squishy, and if they even got slightly cool they'd harden up. Or they'd just fall apart in the pot if they weren't carefully watched.Then an online friend recommended Tinkyada.I bought a package. Just one. I figured it couldn't hurt to try it. My non GF'ers in the house couldn't even tell the difference from their regular pasta. The taste, texture, and ability to be al dente unlike most other GF pasta's makes this pasta the King of All GF Pasta's in my house. We've tried all the various pasta's that Tinkyada makes by this point and not a single one has disappointed us.The ONLY con to this pasta is if you don't use it all at once, and refrigerate it for later. It tends to get stiff and grainy feeling. However, my 15 yo GF daughter microwaves the pasta for a couple minutes with about a TB of water and then puts them in a microwave safe dish to take to school for lunch. Just those few minutes with some extra water fixes the issue no problems.All in all, I definitely recommend this pasta to anyone struggling with a gluten-free diet. This pasta absolutely replaces all gluten containing pasta's, especially with how very many varieties Tinkyada makes! No more feeling sorry for yourself or your child with yucky pasta.

I've been gluten free for almost 20 years and a cook forever but since I discovered the Tinkyada pastas I'm actually having fun making pasta again. This summer I treated guests from out of town to a picnic featuring pasta salad - no one guessed the dish was gluten free. I've made mac and cheese to die for! And spaghetti? Wow! Don't get me started. Don't know how they do it but this stuff beats the heck out of any gluten free pasta I've ever used. Was ready to order a couple of cases from the factory in Canada until I discovered I could order it on Amazon.

The only difference between this brand and "regular" noodles is the cooking time. I made these terrified they would be awful, and delighted that my husband actually liked it more than regular pasta. (He doesn't have to be gluten free, so if he likes it, that's a good thing!)When you're cooking these, you'll notice the water gets really white, so be sure you rinse it off and they do tend to take a little longer to cook than traditional wheat pastas. When you think they are done, take a bite of them to make sure they're not too "al dente". Once they are cooked, they have the exact same color and texture you'd expect.The price here is pretty good, especially if you have to travel a distance to find them near you - if 12 is too many, split the case with a gluten free friend or two.

Tinkyada makes the best gluten free pasta. It's relatively inexpensive, takes the same amount of prep as any other pasta, and typically people won't notice the difference between this and conventional pasta. Make sure you add a splash of olive oil before boiling the water to prevent sticking. Also, stirring frequently prevents the pasta from sticking together, too. All of Tinkyada's varieties of pastas are great, even the stuffed shells and lasagna.

column9: Don't even bother to try another brand!
column10: My family has been on the gluten-free diet for the past nine years. I have spent literally hundreds of dollars trying out various brands of wheat/gluten free pasta - that have generally ended up in the trash. I even quit trying to find a good substitute for a long time. UNTIL a friend suggested I try this brand. I was skeptical, but it tasted great. It won the approval of every member of the household, even my husband who isn't gluten intolerant.I have tried 6 shapes of the pasta and they have all been consistently good. I can make spaghetti, mac & cheese, casseroles, lasagna and all of the other foods we used to enjoy before going GF. I follow the cooking times listed on the package, and I have never had a problem with mushiness, or the pasta being undercooked in the center. If I am going to bake the pasta after I've boiled it, I cut down on the boil time by 2-3 minutes. There is NO CORN in this pasta, so if that is  concern for you - know that you can purchase this!I really do love these pastas and I hope your family will too!

I only use pasta products made by Tinkyada. The pasta always comes out perfectly and non-celiac people can't tell the difference. I've used the spiral pastas for my veggie pasta salads and they turn out great. I eat Tinkyada pasta every week!
Tinkyada makes the best gluten free pasta I have ever tried.  It cooks up great and my whole family loves it.  The Lasagna and Penne are equally good.

column9: Our favorite pasta company - really GREAT Spaghetti that holds it's shape!
column10: We adore all of Tinkyada's products, their pasta keeps it's shape far better than any other pasta rice product we have tried. Friends are never able to tell it isn't a traditional pasta product. I served a cold Rotini salad made with Tinkyada pasta at our BBQ last night and no one knew it was Gluten Free, they all said it was delicious. A guest who was also on a Gluten Free diet said she couldn't believe it was really GF - she has been so disappointed with other rice pastas and was happy I'd discovered the Tinkyada line of products.

As one who suffers with gluten and wheat sensitivities, this product was just what the doctor ordered. I love it. I make lots of dishes with this  brown rice pasta, spaghetti style. It works great when making spaghetti, pasta with shrimp. Keep up the good work, you've got a customer who's very satisfied.

column9: Best gluten free pasta. Your kids will love it.
column10: Being gluten free can be a challange to find products that can be fun to eat not just a substitute that reminds you that you are being deprived of what everyone else eats. So far, (and I have tried several) Tinkyada is the only GF pasta that I have found that is close in texture and fun as wheat spaghetti and I am including other pasta shapes in this review. My husband even likes it and I have served GF pasta with chicken and sauce over it to guests and they were suprised it was GF. It doesn't bloat you like wheat pasta. You just feel comforatbly full after a big wad of "sketti". One downside of any of the GF pastas is that they are stiff and breakable when cold so it is hard to use them for cold pasta salad. However, I had some that I had overcooked a little and that seemed to work pretty well for cold salad. You will have to experiment for yourself with that. At any rate, I would definitely suggest you try the spaghetti especially if you have a child who is gluten free. Also the pasta will make great mac and cheese.
This pasta is delicious, the best I have ever eaten and I highly recommend it.  I would like to see Amazon stock all the different types of pasta that this company makes.  I would order some of all.

This pasta is GOOD!  You really can't tell much difference from wheat.  I was surprised.  I'm fairly new to the world of gluten free eating and have not been won over by products other people say are tasty.  My taste buds haven't become accustomed to many years of wheat free living yet but they gave this product two thumbs up!

My grandchildren LOVE the sour gummy vitamins. They really liked the sour gummy worms by Rhino, but alas, I can't find them. These were a good second choice. The big problem is keeping them from eating more than 2!
WHO WOULD SPENDPrice: $53.34 FOR ONE BAG! WHEN YOU CAN GET A CASE FOR LESS!! BEST OF LUCK TO YOU ALL

Product was exactly as advertised.  It arrived in a timely manner in excellent condition.The taste is spot on.  I put a few drops of the pure maple extract, along with a couple of drops of pure vanilla extract in my oatmeal (with 1/4 chopped walnuts) every morning.  It's a great way to start the day. http://www.amazon.com/gp/product/B004QQA4KK/ref=cm_cr_rev_prod_title

We go through a lot of syrup in our house and I was concerned about the corn syrup.  When I searched the local stores for maple extract, all I could find was imitation.  We are now on our second bottle of Cook's and it works perfectly for what I wanted.  The only complaint I have is the price and shipping are a bit expensive.  Other than that, the product is great.

Finally no spinach!  This is a great tasting pasta.  Instead of spinach it has the full flavor of basil.  With a sauce or just some grated cheese on top, it is a wonderful addition to any meal.  I serve it weekly.
Great tasting pasta that is easy to make. Cooks fast, excellent texture, and can be used in many pasta dishes.

column9: Most flavorful easy too prepare pasta available!
column10: Excellent product. It takes 3 minutes to prepare and has a wonderful flavor. No sauce is even necessary,a little butter or olive oil maybe a little garlic - wonderful.

This is one of my favorite Indian sweets & this brand is as close to a homemade taste as you can get without making it yourself. For Americans unfamiliar with Indian sweets, the best analogy I can give you for soan papdi is that it tastes & feels similar to the inside of a very soft, very fresh Butterfinger... except the nuts used for flavoring are pistachio and almond instead of peanut. It also has about 1/10 the calories and melts in your mouth. Loooove it!
I was introduced to this by a co-worker and I couldn't get enough!! I never knew these sweets existed.  Delicious!

The company gets a 5 star for rapid fast shipping and great customer service! The product gets a 5 star for the flavor. I can get addicted to this brand of Soan Papdi! If you are "new" to Indian Sweets and like the inside of a Butterfinger Candy bar, than you will love this. Not too sweet, and yet crispity, crunchity, delicately sweet with complex flavors of heaven!I will for sure be ordering this regularly.Warmly,Jackie
Love, love, love this coffee!  It is the perfect roast for breakfast.  If it's not good coffee I won't drink it.  And I love this one.
This product is a great value for the money.  A great way to sample these coffees and share with friends!

column9: Not as good as belly flops
column10: I bought 10 lbs of belly flops a while back and those were so good and very sweet.  These jelly beans or not as sweet nor tasty. There seems to be a lot more root beer beans than any other ones.  They did not come in bags just a box of jelly beans.  The value was very good for the money, but in the future I'm only going to stick to flops.

My pug-chihuahua has learned that the only time she gets a treat is after a bath and nail trim. After she's dried off, she runs to the kitchen and stares at the basket where I keep the Greenies - she knows she's owed a reward! She loves Greenies and I was happy to discover this Lite version. She seems to enjoy them as much as the regular version, and this is a much more economical way to have them on hand rather than buying them at the vet for a dollar apiece!
My dog loves them. I give her one when I leave for work. She not only enjoys the treat but it cleans her teath and keeps her busy so she doesn't notice my leaving as much.

Mollie, my Aussie Shepherd mix, loves Greenies.  And I like that the lite is better for her--even though she is an active dog.  We've not had any problems with her chewing or digesting them--as others have.  She loves the taste, but eats them slowly enough to make the bits small pieces.  And I value how they clean her teeth.  All in all, we love them, but I watch her while she eats; I wouldn't put them in her kennel while I was away.

It doesn't really clean up the smell from my dogs' mouths. They love Greenies so much because Greenies got by-products in the ingredients which taste really good but doesn't do good job for the breath. I would recommend Halo's dental chew than Greenies.
Greenies were recommended to me by a friend, and I love them for my dogs!  Greenies really help with bad breath!  My dogs LOVE THEM!

I use a ton of "greenies" or other dental products for my little dog (a 7 lb Yorkie/Maltese mix.)  She used to hate it when I left the house, so I started giving her the regular greenies as a special treat for departures only.  However, she was started to get a little chunky, so thought switching her to the "light" version  might be a better option.  I was initially worried because she has an insanely sensitive digestive system, but I've seen no problem thus far, and I've been using them for over a week.  She doesn't seem to notice a difference at all, and I feel comfortable knowing I'm not overfeeding her (in order to assuage my guilt for leaving in the first place!) I would definitely recommend this product.

We have two yorkies, one is very picky and one whom we nicknamed a porkie yorkie will eat anything.They both love these. We do not give them one everyday, because we like to give them variety. We do treat them like our kids. The Lite is for the tubby little one, she is 4 and the picky one is 12. They are so spoiled that we have at least 10 different treats for them to keep them happy. And boy it is hard to find treats made in USA!  We have been giving our babies these treats since our 12 year old was a puppy, the vet says she has the best teeth of any 12 year old yorkie she has ever seen. The little one is no slouch either.But Yorkies are nortorious for getting bad teeth. Not ours. They love the greenies and the teenie lites are perfect for their after our dinner treats. And made in America. How much better can you get then that? Your pets are important, treat them  to a greenie!

My dog absolutely LOVES greenies!!! Started him out on regular ones, but because I give him two a day, I buy the smallest ones in the "lite" version and give him one in the morning as a reward for "doing his business" and going back inside when I ask (it helps that he knows he'll get one if he goes inside) and one at night, once again, for going back inside. I keep them in the freezer and he loves them cold. It makes me happy that these will help with his dental care. Its fun to see him get so excited! LOL.
a gift for my daughters spaniel.  My daughter swears by this product and will use no other.  would definatly recorder
I did not like it so much. The pumking coffee from the same brand is Excellent!
I received the tea a lot quicker than I thought I would. I will be ordering it again because it is very good tea.

This tea is overpriced. At asian markets, retail is $6.95. Certainly, wholesale is drastically less. The price asked for here is appalling. It's the exact same tea and Foojoy is considered one of the lesser brands in teas. The product is great, the seller? Doubtful.
Not a bad tasting tea!! And actually does seem to help with appetite suppressing. Good value for money.

This stuff is great!  I was nervous about the taste at first, but it's awesome!  I put a teaspoon of honey and a teaspoon of Splenda sugar Blend in it and it is just yummy!  Thank you for your fast delivery too!
This is the only tea that I will drink.  It has an amazing taste.  I have been ordering this product for some time and can always rely on value as well as the flavor.
Love the tea it helps with my hunger pains and my metabolism Would recommend this to everyone .  Thank You

This is a very good tasting tea that steeps nicely into a light colored beverage. However, about 50% of the bags had tears in them or were otherwise unsealed.  I would buy again only as loose tea, as that is basically what came.  :-)

I have purchased this tea before and just love it but my latest purchase have inferior bags.  They break no matter how carefully you place them into the hot water or pour over.  The former bags were not the flow thru type and never broke.  These flow thru bags are very thin and cheaply made.  The tea still tastes great.
This tasted fine but I didn't really see any weight loss. I liked the tea tho. Maybe I just didn't drink enough to benefit from the weight loss.

I'm kind of an amateur when it comes to tea, but I've tried several kinds of oolong tea, mostly because of the supposed visceral fat-burning benefits.  [I can't really comment on the fat burning because I'm also dieting and exercising.]  But I can comment on the flavor of the tea.  I use one tea bag in an insulated mug of about 14 ounces, add a heaping teaspoon of Splenda, and leave it in the mug as I drink it over two to three hours.  Probably not the best way to drink tea, I know. Nevertheless, this tea has a good, moderately strong, pleasant flavor; holds its flavor; and does not have a bitter aftertaste like some of the others I have tried.  Best of all, this was very economical [$7 for a hundred bags, and eligible for free Prime shipping].  I highly recommend this tea and plan to buy it again.  Do watch to make certain it is specifically this brand and kind, since Foojoy has several that sound similar and I have tried one of the others that I did not like as well.  [...]

Most of the bags were broken and unusable... however, I eventually found a good bag and brewed some of this tea, and it was dreadful. It has tons of floating powder in it, and really sticks in your throat. The flavor is bitter and acrid, and nothing like what I have ever had in any Chinese restaurant. It's truly awful.
I like it. I drink at least 1 or 2 everyday. You have to get used to the flavor though, since it's kind of bitter. I find it a much better option to keep you awake than coffee.

I usually do not leave negative reviews. But I was so excited to order this tea at such a good price. I ordered two boxes. One for me and another for my friend. Well, I would just like to say that this was the worst experience I ever had with an online order. I ordered two boxes of this tea and only received one. Then I got one box of the tea, me thinking this is weired. I sent an email to the company. I had to wait at least 2 1/2 weeks to get a response from my email. Granted, the owner emailed me back and said he was out of the country and did apologize. His wife was helping him. The thing is, if the help is not good or don't know what they are doing. It is like leaving your business on auto pilot and hoping nothing goes wrong! Well it did, things went terribly wrong! I did not even try the tea. The box I did get I just put it to the side. The owner did refund my money for the one box I never got, I thank you for that to say the least. But over all next time please do not leave you business unmanned. The results are not good at all!
I have been drinking Costa Rican Coffee for years. What came out of this bag was too bland to be Costa Rican.. Or maybe just too old.

Sorry to say I was disappointed with this coffee.  Costa Rican is one of my favorites and I guess I should have known better than to buy already ground, but they were out of whole bean so I thought what the heck!  When I opened the bag and hardly smelled any aroma I had my first clue something was amiss...then when my husband said it tasted like swill...that sealed the deal.  Can't recommend

I ordered this on 7/30/12. It came on 8/25/12 (not super fast, but not unreasonable coming from India). I wanted to be excited to get this product, but was initially worried about my cardamom because the small cardboard box was very warped and appeared as though it had gotten quite wet at some point. I hoped that the product inside had been packaged in a way that allowed it to remain dry. Boy was I disappointed (I've bought on amazon for years, and this is my very first review. Yep, I'm that unhappy). I cut the tape and looked inside. All of the pods were loose inside the box! They were not contained in any protective covering whatsoever. I removed the pods from the box and did locate a split plastic ziploc bag. Nothing else. It appeared as though it had no hope of keeping my product safe through the shipping process, and not just because of the split in the bag. Nope. It also was completely unsealed. I took pictures but there is no way for me to attach them to this review. The cardamom smelled musty, and I had to throw it away. I was very disappointed. I know accidents can happen, but placing my cardamom into a low quality plastic bag, failing to seal it, and tossing it into a cardboard box just doesn't cut it. This is a poor practice when shipping from so far. I cannot tell if the cardamom would have been fresh otherwise, I will not order again.

This black type of cardamom is impossible to find in local stores, which otherwise offer nearly all the spices used in South Asian cooking. It is essential to certain recipes.It arrived faster than promised in an airtight bag within a sturdy box; this resulted in fresh product delivered to our house. The price was reasonable.

column9: Mount of Olives Treasures Jasmine Green, 20 count tea bags
column10: My wife and I really like this Green Tea.  It is the onlyGreen Tea that we like to drink.  We often mix it with otherflavors like Apple Spice.

column9: Caution, I was Glutened by MI-DEL Ginger Cookies
column10: I purchased these and once home ate them and experienced a severe gluten reaction.  On the bag in small print at the bottom it said they were manufactured in a facility with wheat and dairy.  The label also stated that routine testing occurs only to maintain gluten free label status.  Our bag tested positive for gluten which caused severe bleeding.Please be careful when buying this brand as the statement is for CYA and labeling purposes only.  That way they can charge more for the product.

My daughter and I both have celiac and these are my favorite gluten-free cookies. I loved ginger snaps and molasses cookies before I was diagnosed with celiac and this are a lovely indulgence in a sparce market. I dip them in milk, my daughter eats them plain. Good texture too!
This sandwich cookie is crisp, not too sweet and delicious with a cup of coffee or tea.  Really satisfies the craving for something to dip into your coffee.

The Mi-Del Royal Vanilla Cookies do not have a "cream center".  The center is a vanilla-flavored hard sugar disc.  The outside cookie is delicious but only after removing the sugar disc.  After receiving the first order, I contacted Amazon and complained that the cookies did not have the creamy center as stated in the cookie product description.  Amazon immediately sent a replacement but the second order was exactly the same as the first.  I contacted Mi-Del through their website email and asked if the cream center was supposed to be hard.  Mi-Del did not answer my question but sent a coupon for my next purchase.
Out of all their different kinds of cookies, this is the one that rocks.You would never know this was gluten free.

We know a lot about GF producs in my house and my son really likes these cookies.  They are good Oreo substitutes.  The only reason I'm giving it 4 stars instead of 5 is because the cookie part is very hard and brittle.
My 5 yr. old son (Tyler) who is Autistic and had to go on the GF diet likes them very much. I found these cookies at Liz' Healthfood in Conway, AR. They taste almost like an Oreo. Great cookie.

column9: Great cookies, makes a nice pie crust too!
column10: I keep these in the house at all times.  They are a fabulous cookie- nice taste, not hard or crumbly.  I also use them as a pie crust.  I put them in the blender to chop them up, then mix in a bowl with melted butter.  I spray my pie dish with non-stick spray before pressing it in the plate.  My family likes it as a crust for chocolate pie, but I've used them with others also and it turns out great.  I've never used them for baking pies so I can't recommend that, only for no-bake pies, cheesecakes, etc.

column9: Product shipped and arrived quicky... the cookies in each of the bags were in pieces.
