The flavor is very smoky and delicious, and the person it was purchased for said that the taste was spot-on for what was remembered from buying this same product in Canada proper.The amount of meat for the price is very reasonable.We'll be shopping from this seller again.

It tasts fine... But I was expecting a 3 1/2 lb. beef brisket...instead i got five packs of shaved smoked beef. Not bad mind you, but the description clearly leads one to expect a WHOLE beef brisket... I can get sliced meat at the local deli... I was expecting much more.James Hatsis

I am fully satisfied with the brisket.There is only two reasons that I would like it better.#1  more fat on the meat, Pastrami with out fat just does not taste  like pastrami#2  more broth so that I could make a pastrami dip.

Our dogs simply love these. They can even double as pill pockets if the pill isn't too big. I have never found a good replacement for them since moving away from the PetCo that carried them, which is why I'm not ordering them off of Amazon. It would be easier to pick up a different treat when we go grocery shopping, but they ALL have high fructcose corn syrup listed as the first couple of ingredients. Here are the Bil Jac ingredients:Chicken Liver, Chicken, Chicken By-Product Meal, Wheat Flour, Glycerin, Propylene Glycol, Phosphoric Acid, Salt, Potassium Sorbate and Citric Acid and BHA and Calcium Propionate (Preservatives), Iron Oxide.Notice the first three ingredients are all CHICKEN.
These are the best for keeping your dog happy!  And they really help emphasize tasks completed well!

column9: Can't Go Wrong with These Treats!
column10: I bought these as a gift for a friend's dogs after one had surgery. I previously had wrapped these up at Christmas for my dogs and put under the tree ... but only for one year. They could smell them and chewed up the carton to get to them while i was out! I couldn't be mad, i should have known better. Anyway, these are great treats.

column4: N. Ferguson "Two, Daisy, Hannah, and Kitten"
column9: hmm... dogs enjoy, but there are healthier liver treat options
column10: My dogs love these treats, and I do buy them occasionally because they are cheap and perched at the check-out counter of our local garden/feed store. But check out the ingredient list-- I don't think anyone can feel good about feeding their dog high-fructose corn syrup! Just not the healthiest option-- when so many of our dogs are overweight, it seems better to feed them a real liver treat, versus this product which is "made with liver".My dogs absolutely love Pro-Treat Beef Liver, Freeze Dried 14 Ounce (the larger size packages are more economical). I just feel a lot better about feeding real freeze-dried liver that doesn't have all the extra junk in Bil-Jac liver treats.Specifically, these treats have chicken "by-products"-- that means liquid slaughterhouse run-off and other non-human grade leftovers from the slaughterhouse. UGH! Bil-Jac also includes three preservatives, glycerin (?!), and the corn syrup.~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~Here's the ingredient list for Bil-Jac liver treats, so you can make your own decision:Liver, Chicken By-Products, Chicken By-Product Meal, Corn, Chicken Fat, Glycerin, High Fructose Corn Syrup, Propylene Glycol, Wheat Flour, Phosphoric Acid, Salt, Sodium Propionate and Potassium Sorbate and BHA and Citric Acid (Preservatives), Iron Oxide.

Hmmmm. I read somewhere that a little dark chocolate is now good for you. Well, I was passing the desert isle in my nearby Fresh and Easy Market and there were some Gamesa Sugar Wafers. I had tried the Vanilla ones and then felt guilty afterwards. The were sure good. Imported from Mexico. But today, there were also some Chocolate Sugar Wafers next to the vanilla ones. How could I resist? Especially after reading about the benefits of a little chocolate in your diet. Into the cart a 6.7-ounce packet went. Mmmm. They're good. Nice and fresh and tasty. Now the trick will be to keep the amount down.Gary Peterson

Bought these for a party...guest of honor's favorite cookie!  EVERY COOKIE IN ALL 4PACKAGES WERE BROKEN!!!!!  So if you wanted to put out nicely...forget it. Just  thrown in the box.Fresh, but broken to pieces! I ended up using them for a pie crust!!!

column9: Excellent taste... but a bit costly
column10: The Mint Milano cookies are wonderful. They have a light and crispy texture with a mild mint chocolate taste. The flavor reminds me a lot of the chocolate mint Girl Scout cookies although the texture of the 2 cookies are very different (the girl scout cookie is much denser).Unfortunately the cookies usually arrive with very few intact and several of mine were even broken into multiple pieces. They still taste pretty good though.Nutritional Facts copied from the actual package (July 2011):Serving size 2 cookies (25g/ 0.9oz)Servings per container about 8Calories per serving 130Calories from fat 70Total Fat 7gSaturated Fat 5gTrans Fat 0gCholesterol less than 5 mgSodium 65mgTotal Carbohydrate 16gDietary Fiber less than 1gSugars 8gProtein 1gVitamins A and C 0%Calcium 0%Iron 4%FYI, I purchased my cookies during 100 degree weather and except for some of the chocolate melting onto the inner wrapper the cookies were fine (I used 2 day shipping which might make a difference since the cookies weren't in the heat that long).At 15.88 for 4 bags of cookies the price per bag is 3.97 which is 48 cents more than the price printed on the cookie bag (3.49).

These are our favorite kind of cookies! Usually, I just buy the dark chocolate one, but Pepperidge has so many different types, I recently decided to try the others. The mint adds a refreshing hint to the chocolate, which we like. These are nice to enjoy with tea as a midafternoon snack or something of the sort.

column9: OK, but not up to normal Milano standards.
column10: I guess I should've known: I checked out the prices for the various permutations of the Milano brand name and this was the cheapest.  The cookies arrived in fair condition, with some of them broken already.  Slight breakage is okay, since we break them up to eat them anyway.  However, when they are broken to the point of powder, they become useless.  I believe that these were overbaked or the mix failed.  There was a powdery texture to the cookie instead of the smooth surface.  It's a subtle difference but the 'Milano' experience is very specific.  At these prices, they better be perfect.  These cookies weren't.I know Pepperidge Farm products; my parents lived in Norwalk, CT near their factory.  I have shopped at the company store.  What's amazing is that their products are perfectly good at the expiration date or even one year later.  However, in the case of the product above, they were not good right out of the factory and thus they were discounted.

All of the flavors I've tried are great; but my favorite are the mint.I was concerned re the shipping issue based on other reviews.  When they arrived, the cookies were packed so tightly into a box filled with canned goods that the outer carton was pushed out of shape right on top of where the cookies were - which carton was pretty battered on that location, as one might expect from an incorrectly packed carton.  Amazon, what is up with your packaging logic?  It's so weird what you do when packing things....Anyway, I figured the whole batch of cookies would be crushed.  To my amazement, only 3 of the cookies were broken (out of a pack of 4 bags).  I think that was a fluke really.  Anyway, otherwise they were fresh etc.  The only other odd thing was that these seemed to be different cookies than what I was used to.  They seemed to be thinner.  I've noticed since moving from the West Coast to the East Coast that a lot of products seem different here in various ways, so I figured it was either that, or maybe I was imagining it; but I don't think so.  Anyway - I actually preferred the thinner ones, as the overall flavor balances were better and the texture was more appealing.So while my shipping story was a success, I can't claim that the product was really properly packaged, and I wouldn't therefore want to leave a review claiming that.

A tasty treat for those who remember what these were like when they used to sell them in the stores, now I can't find this one, but they have the double chocolate, mint, and other random flavors that I don't find quite as appealing.Note that this is a pack of four, but still expensive for such - probably designed to extract the emotional value from people like me. Considering the other kinds can be had for far cheaper at Target... I can do without these for a while again, especially as most of us don't eat through these fast enough to get through four packs by the due date.

This review is regarding the cookie, not the price set by this seller. The cookie.... is fantastic. What a perfect little treat. Three cookies are only 180 calories. Since I am trying to watch my weight, I eat one - only 60 calories!! It's perfect for those times you NEED something sugary or chocolately. You can eat one of these and not blow your entire day dieting.Yum. Yum.

These cookies hardly need a review. They are so amazingly delicious. The perfect amount of rich chocolate between the cookies. Pepperidge farm sure did it right with these cookies. Stick to the classic ones, though. I've tried a few other variations and they aren't nearly as good.

The cookies were delicious, chrisp and whole. I can only say they did not last long.  Pepperidge Farm Mint Milano is the only cookie I realy enjoy and would eat a lot off.  The others, even in Peppridge Farm I would only eat one or two.  But I have found that the Mint Milano is hard to get.  Pepperidge Farm should try selling in Canada and Jamaica,  West Indies.  I actually live in Jamaica, W.I. and can not get Mint Milano there so I either ask friends to buy it for me or buy it on line.  Would recommend this cookie for all those people that like a lite combination of mint and chocolate.
These have minty chocolate in them, but it's not too minty, wich is good.  They're a lot like the Thin Mint Girl Scout cookies in reguard to flavor, but the texture is lighter and crisper.

I LOVE raspberry, and Pepperidge Farms, so I thought this would be a "no brainer".  However, when I received them they were already a week past the freshness date, and they were very dry.  I don't think I will order again.

column4: Doreen B. Bishop "Doreen Bishop cat parent"
column10: By the time I buy a few four packs and get amazons free shipping to my door it is a better deal than my local store.Its a wonderful crispie cookie that holds up well in shipping Try it for yourselves  :)

We've tried a lot of Progresso soups lately, and this is one of the few I've been disappointed in. Normally even their light soups are well seasoned and thus have a strong, good flavor. That was not the case with this soup. It was just kind of blah tasting. It also had very little chicken in it. It did have their big twisted noodles, which I'm also not a fan of. They tend to be tough and irritating. It is only 70 calories a serving, which is its only real plus. However, a lot of other Progresso soups are in a good calorie range and also a delight to eat. Try one of them instead.

column9: My kids love it (and so do I)
column10: Finally: candy that is good for your teeth. My kids love it. Nice to have a variety of flavors in a single container. And with the amount in the package, it lasts a long time.In the car for misc diversions.

We first tried this Olive Oil in a high-end restaurant, and fell in love with it. It is subtle and smooth. It's less picante and more clear flavors. We dip bread in the oil, or spread over an argula pizza. Highly recommend this for anyone.
I like the other reviewer bought this from World Market, and it is DISGUSTING. I chucked it and the other boxes I had bought straight in the trash.

First and foremost I will say that I was sorely disappointed with this item.  I purchased mine at World Market where I have previously had great success with another brand that they sadly no longer carry.  That previous brand was real tabouli.  This one was not.  Tabouli is made with Bulgar wheat.  This is couscous.  The packaging is very misleading.I only give this two stars because the finished product was edible, but not flavorful.  Moreover, in trying to follow the instructions for preparation, the first instruction says simply, "empty package contents into bowl and add an equal amount of water."  I tried to eyeball it and was able to come out with a decent guess at 1 1/2 cups.  Regardless, one shouldn't have to guess.  I will not buy this again.

Real Food Toppers is truly a quality product with an extremely small amount of hard, unusable pieces. I am pleased with this purchase and so are my cats. I will continue buying this product for my finicky kitties. Thanks for money well spent.
The best micro popcorn by far.  Totally unhealthy, what with that buttery packet and all, but worth every bite!  As close to movies theater popcorn as you can get without leaving your house.

column9: It doesn't look pretty, but authentic
column10: The package looks a little cheap, but it is a authentic product.I use this as a supplement of my diet. I usually get hungry around midnight but no way to eat food, so I drink this, low calories and make me full.
Makes you so sick, stomach hurts, stay away!!!!Not worth the cheap buy. Just go to the grocery store and pay a little more for good mixes.Or go with brand name brands instead

I looked these Halo pumpkin dental chews up on Amazon to see reviews.  I also read the ingredients on them, and found they were wholesome good food products that I would want my dogs eating.  I went by my local animal food store and bought two of these chews for the 25-60Lb size.  One was for my 20lb jack russell who is an avid chewer and the other was for my 40lb aussie/heeler.  Great ingredients.  Since this size has 85 calories a piece, I needed to give only half to the jack.  I gave the jack the half one and the aussie the full one.  Wow, were they hard.  Problem was my jack wanted the whole thing in his mouth while he tried to chew pieces off which he couldn't really.  So I thought uhoh I better get the rest away from him but if he thinks I am coming to take it he will gulp it.  So I distracted him with squirt cheese and took half of the half away.  The aussie promptly gulped the rest of hers fearing I was going after hers too.  So where these were great that they were hard so they actually had to chew on them, maybe not for gulpers.  The dogs seemed very happy with the taste and smell.

My dogs eat nothing but Halo brand dog food because it has all REAL ingredients and they love it!  The treats and chews are just icing on the cake for them.  It's their favorite!  I know they love it and that it's good for them so I can feel good about feeding them Halo!

I was given a couple of these as a gift for my dogs.  I always read the label and make sure that the dogs chews/treats/food is made in the USA and wholesome products.  The ingredients look healthy and today  I gave one to my senior wire fox terrier to keep him occupied at my office.  He went though it in record time and vacuumed up the crumbs as well.  A four paws up from here. Giving only four stars because I still don't know the outcome of today's chew!

I was quite impressed by these chews!  My dog is allergic to almost everything, so a lot of dental chews are out, but these have very few ingredients that are allergens and my dog just loves them!  The pumpkin one also helps with her digestion (pumpkin always has a way of doing that!)  They are definitely tough to chew, but my 15-pound dog is quite the chewer so she's in heaven!
My Chow girl Anaya loves these & they are made in the USA. Always a plus with so many treats that are made in China! YUCK.....

I am impressed by Halo's products, although the canned food variety is the only thing I had previously tried, when I was babying my dog while she was recuperating after her spay surgery. I can feel good about feeding her such wholesome food, and she devours it. This was my first time buying Halo treats. Even though the package says they're for dogs 25-60 lbs, my 17 lb, one year old terrier mix is still in the puppy stage and is an avid chewer. I was looking for a product to change it up from the old reliable rawhide, for something she would not demolish in 5 minutes, and something different than meat-flavored treats (for variety). I was unsure if she would go for the pumpkin flavor, but this was an instant hit! She LOVES the taste of these treats and has no problem chewing them. I gave her a whole stick and she worked on it (kept her occupied) for about 45 minutes until it was completely gone. They smell really good, like pumpkin pie spice, and although they are dark brown in color, they do not stain like some of the red-colored rawhide products I've tried. I have gone through half the bag so far (7 sticks in a bag), giving her one every few days, and she really enjoys them. I am definitely buying these again, and I am going to try the mint variety and see if that's a winner too. I'd recommend that even if you have a small dog, give them a try to switch up your choice of hard chew treats if your puppy or dog is a big chewer.

column9: Our Mini Aussie loves Halo Spot's Chew!
column10: Our 1 year old pup loves these things! They are a bit harder to break like the previous review stated but the whole stick is actually perfect size for our Mini Aussie (med. size dog). The leave his breath smelling minty fresh! Also the heart shape is a cute touch.Too bad our local Petco stopped carrying these all of the sudden, but thank goodness for Amazon :)

Halo truly is a great brand, natural and healthy. My only drawback for these are that if you have a smaller dog they are very hard to chew and break up for them it seems as my dog is having trouble with them. They are good though an stick by this product as well as the seller!

These have great ingredients and smell so good, I wanted to eat it lol. However they are really hard so if your dog isn't a big chewer, like mine, it's not such a good idea. Brownie stopped trying after 30 minutes. So these are going to be donated to the animal shelter. These are for medium to large dogs, not so much for small dogs unless they're really aggressive chewers.

column9: Our dog loves these minty chews
column10: We've tried other Halo products previously and have been happy so we thought we'd give this one a try.We first bought these at our local pet supply store when we ran out of Paragon toothbrush chews one day.  It turns out that our 15lb pom mix loves Spot's Chews and they smell great to us as well.  The only issue is that it's a lot of chew for a small dog, although they are labeled as being for "small/medium" pets.  They are hard to break so my husband was slicing them into thirds with a knife and we'd give a third of a chew a day.One cute thing is that if you look at them top down, they are actually shaped like hearts.

column9: Very tough and come apart in large chunks
column10: I worried that my dog would swallow one of the chunks that came off the stick whole. It looks very dangerous! I gave my dog one and threw the rest away, as a precautionary measure.

I am not a big fan of this candy. It is basically a little round gummy with chili on the outside. The only thing I like about this candy is the the chili on the outside but I don't like the rest. I hate biting on the gummy part because it sticks strongly to your teeth.

I ordered the 200-count box of 4-inch bones for the first time, and I'm happy with the purchase so far. My dog is small but a ferocious chewer, and supervised pressed rawhides are the only way I can afford to sate that desire. Amazon has the best prices I've seen anywhere.I do think I underestimated how small the 4-inchers actually are. They're not bad, but for the next purchase, I may opt for the 8-inchers, which are currently slightly cheaper on a per-pound basis.I ordered my bones direct from Amazon. Based on one of the reviews, the first thing I did was count the pieces. There were exactly 200 in the box. As seen in the product photo, the Ranch Rewards box has a large opening. Before shipping it, Amazon places it into another, much more secure, box. Perhaps some of the third-party merchants take less care.
i dont know if they taste good or not..my dog eats them, and every time i ask her she tilts her head sideways and gives me the silent treatment like i'm speaking some foreign language to her.
THERE SHOULD BE A WARNING LABEL ON THE PACKAGE THAT SAYS: "YOU MAY NOT BE ABLE TO STOP AT LESS THAN THE ENTIRE BAG; HOWEVER, SCHNEIDER'S IS NOT LIABLE IF OVER-INDULGENCE DOES OCCUR!"

column9: Pleasantly surprised, should have been the original pretzel-type recipe!
column10: Pleasantly surprised, should have been the original pretzel-type recipe!...but, am sure technology is the only way they could make a pretzel-type snack so light and crispy, not hard and sawdusty at all!  I usually can't eat more than a few pretzels, but these I can probably munch at least ten.The dough is rolled with random air pockets somehow inside and if there weren't or aren't it's still airy-light and crispy, unexplainable...Well, that's the texture, the taste is light and delightfully tasty.These would be terrific if I had some dip, but on there own they are great, but not terrific.They don't seem to fall apart into little pieces either, pretty stable when you bite it.Ir looka about 3 inches long...hey, I believe they were rolled up on a piece of metal, then cooked...why they have a hole throughout the center that is not punched, but flaky layers around it.Some bites taste buttery, some multi-grainy, all great...I love a snack that every single spec tastes the same.  It's not often an actual five star pretzel-small breadstick at a reasonable price with a hefty portion....they are a lot lighter than pretzels, so more volume.

column9: at least makes me think it's healthy
column10: Tastes more buttery and less sweet than the Trader joe's honey twists.  Kids will eat it for snack.  Good stuff, but if you're looking for a sweeter taste, go to TJ's for the Honey twists.

Love it!!!! A pleasant soothing cup of tea.  Always order this tea at our favorite Indian restaurant , now we can have it at home whenever we like. Plenty of recipes for making it as they do in restaurants. Enjoy!

column9: Not a K-cup but works in a Keurig
column10: As the other reviewers have said, this is not a K-cup! I uploaded an image of one of these pods next to a K-cup for comparison. The difference is the filter is exposed in these pods as opposed to being fully sealed in a K-cup. Since the coffee is exposed to the air when you open the package, you will have to seal them with a clip or put them in an airtight bag or tupperware to prevent the rest of the pods from loosing freshness. Having said that, in my experience they are a great inexpensive alternative to use in your Keurig brewer. The 36 count boxes arrived as unmarked brown cardboard boxes, not the colorful retail packaging shown on amazon. Inside each cardboard box, there are three clear heavy duty plastic bags, each of which holds 12 of the pods. The bags are not resealable!

column9: Love this coffee!  Better then Keurig brands!
column10: I did not buy this at Amazon even though I am an avid amazon shopper.  Needless to say I went to cosco with a friend and got this exact box for $25 at Cosco.  I debated getting it and once it was in my cart I had two different people tell me how much they loved the coffee and with 80 pods at that price I figured I would try it.  I came home at 8 pm and decided to open it up.IN THE BOX:  Inside I have 10 clear plastic bags each with 8 pods.  The bottom has no plastic white thing I am used to and not only is the coffee in a mesh bag making it so you can not store it in the carousel (it is loose and falls out) you would not want to because it would lose freshness.  SO the other 7 went in Tupperware.  I give it 2 points for helping the environment and 4 for the price without trying it!TASTE:  Brew it at 8pm (not the best time for coffee but ahhh)  It smells absolutely amazing!  Super strong odor if you like the smell of coffee.  Color is very dark, smell is strong.  I taste it black and it is stronger then even the jet fuel k-cups.  Add some creamer try it again and then add a little more and it is the best coffee I have had in my life and that says a lot as Paris had some amazing coffee!Needless to say I grabbed the phone and called my friend who also bought a box after the two people commented on how much they loved the coffee to find out she had tried it and loves it as much as I do!  If you are debating trying this like I was I am hoping this review will help as I think I have finally kicked my expensive k-cup habit and I no longer need to worry about losing a bang for my buck!  Hopefully amazon will start matching Cosco prices as I do not have a cosco card though :)
These are a wonderful alternative to expensive K-Cups.  After opening up the sealed bags, I kept mine in a ziplock bag until use.  The 80 count French Roast is significantly cheaper at Costco.

This is a wonderful coffee, and it works perfectly in my Keurig Platinum. There is no noticeable residue in my coffee cup, and the flavor is excellent. I recommend storing the unused 'pods' in a resealable storage bad to maintain their freshness.

column9: The best coffe for a Keurig
column10: I think I have tried almost all of the k-cups, and really was ready to get rid of the machine because of the weak, almost tasteless coffee.  I like strong, bold coffee, and this one is excellent.  And the price is very nice, too!

column9: Great Product, excellent quality at an outstanding price!
column10: I was mildly surprised by the shape of the K-Cup but the first time I tried it in my Keurig Coffee Maker, I was provided with an excellent cup of very rich coffee.  This is a great product for an excellent price.  I highly recommend this product to any Keurig Owner.

We purchased this coffee yesterday for the first time. It's a very good coffee.. an 80 count box was under $25, that's half the price that it's listed for here. Of course it was at Costco.. The most worthwhile membership I've ever owned! If there is one near you, pay your membership.. buy your coffee there.. it will only take saving half the cost on your coffee on 2 boxes to pay yourself back for your membership! You can store your pods in a ziploc bag to maintain freshness after the celo packs are opened. If you are like us as coffee drinkers, it won't last long enough to get stale anyway.
this is a delicious coffee that is good any time of the day.  black, with half & half or milk & sweetener it is great.
Pelindaba Lavender and honey is the perfect combination. It's so heavenly tasty, that all other honeys are just not worth it anymore.

column9: Fantastic delicious natural product delivered quickly
column10: I have actually visited the Pelindaba lavender fields a few years ago on a visit to the San Juan Islands so was thrilled to see this product available.  I was reminded of the warm smell of lavender growing in the July sun with bees swarming around the plants.  One of my best travel memories.  Love this honey- it has a more lavender flavor than some honies but is really wonderful.  Great value for the money.  Adds a wonderful something extra to Greek yogurt or to a bowl of fresh blueberries.  Fresh blueberries take very well to a little dollop of lavender honey. Try it!
Priced in the range of a CASE, this is a single box.  If you buy this you are paying three times the full price for a box.  You are getting ripped off if you buy this!!!!

I've been a tea lover for a long time, though I generally drink loose leaf varieties.  I tried this for the first time at an office location I was doing some work at and was immediately addicted.  I now keep it and the caffeine free version on hand at home at all times.I've tried many different spiced tea's and have never found anything similar.  The spicy smell is comforting and warming while the flavor is strong and delicious.  The 25ct package is the commercial package and larger than I could find in the local grocery for a similar price making it a good deal.The only thing I've found is that I like it steeped longer than usual.  Typically you would steep this for 4-5 minutes, but I like it with a stronger flavor and generally leave the tea bag in the entire time I'm drinking it.  Make sure you squeeze the bag as well or the flavor can sometimes be a little weak.
This herbal tea is wonderful and naturally sweet.  I highly recommend for anyone who likes drinking healthy and decaf products.
I really love the Good Earth Tea, too, and have it every day.  But until they changed the formula a few years ago, I could get 2 good cups of tea from one teabag, and now it only makes one.

I ordered this partly because I wanted the cute paint can.  The shipper was slow to ship it, and when it did arrive, the gum was not in a can.  It's in a cheap plastic container.  If that's what I had wanted, I would have gone to Sam's Club.

If you like the taste of strawberry Pocky or strawberry Yan Yan, you will like these.  My fiance and I have an  American palette, but we were hooked on Hello Panda ever since he bought the "Milk" (Vanilla) flavor on a whim from the international aisle of a supermarket.They arrive in individual boxes packed in a display box (like at a store).  The individual packaging make them easy to throw in a bag or purse on the go (easy for pacifying fussy kids too!), and the individual outer cardboard package means these creme-filled cookies don't get crushed by your water bottle. :)
These cookies are great. The biscuit part is not too sweet and the inside is a nice vanilla flavor. The designs are super cute as well~

column9: Hello Panda Chocolate Cream Filled Mini Cookies.
column10: These little chocolate cream filled cookies are pretty darn good.  I sent a few boxes with a friend of mine to take to work with her.  The people she works with devoured what she handed out and they were asking for more.  Looks like those folks will be placing orders with Amazon.com for more of these little chocolate cream filled devils.  Thanks Amazon.com.

I bought these when I couldn't find the Choco-Koala cookies we usually buy. These are great little cookies and seem just like the Choco-Koala cookies. A light crunchy exterior with a wonderful chocolate center. They are small, so you can quickly chow down quite a few. Very, very yummy. Santa always remembers to bring some for the kids. Don't buy just a few boxes, get the whole case!

I bought these for a Halloween party with a lot of 2 & 3 year olds.  My kiddos treats were the hit, all the kids loved them and asked their parents for more.  Several parents said they snuck some of the cookies from their kids and loved them.  A fun snack for all!
these are by far the best cookies ive had in a long time, almost addicting for me xD

Saw it at F.Y.E. At there unlike Amazon it was only $3.00. It was worth buying after I tryed it out. Taste like a fortune cookie with vanilla filling inside of it. Love it and yes would highly recommed.
These are made with partially hydrogenated vegetable oil; an adult can make the choice whether to eat them or not.  But why give them to kids with a perpetual sweet tooth who don't know any better?

Very flavorful and gives amazing taste to salads and food in general. Just a pinch make a huge difference in the way your food tastes like.  This is the only type of salt I am using since I discovered it. I put it on meat, fish, veggies, salads, soups,etc. Everything tastes better with this salt. I wish they would offer it in bigger sizes. I usually order 4 at a time so they last for a while since the size is small. You will not be sorry for ordering this salt.

A good buy if you are looking for a fairly large quantity of Green Mountain Breakfast Blend Decaf.  The price of shipping made the individual cost of each cup a litter higher in cost but not to much.  I would buy again.

column9: Great flavor but officially discontinued by Kraft
column10: Our family loves the White Grape flavor of Crystal Light. In fact, if it weren't for this flavor, some members of the family would have never drank Crystal Light at all. It has a great taste that's not too bitter and not too sweet.It seems like the availability of this flavor has been going through ups and downs for the last few years, with many people even claiming it was discontinued earlier. It wasn't discontinued then but I stumbled upon Crystal Light's official Facebook page where someone asked for a list of recently discontinued flavors. Crystal Light responded with a list and - lo and behold - White Grape was listed as a flavor that was discontinued as of November 2011. Here's a link to a screen shot of the post by Crystal Light for anyone who wants to see it - the post was made on Feb. 13, 2012: (...)After running into the post, I confirmed via the Crystal Light official website and White Grape is no longer listed as an available flavor in any quantity. So it looks like this great flavor, possibly one of the best Crystal Light had, is no more - sacrificed to market all the new "specialty" flavors.

column9: I'm hooked on Crystal Light White Grape!
column10: White Grape is my all-time favorite Crystal Light flavor ever. Imagine my despair when, one by one, my local stores quit carrying it! One evening, while looking for Christmas gift ideas on Amazon, I decided to do a search for it and was so happy to find this 10-count box of ten. My order arrived very quickly and with no problem. I will definitely be buying more of this!
Love White Grape Crystal Light.  Can't find it where I live.  Great to know I can get it here.

When I purchased this item, I was oblivious to the meager amount of on the go crystal light white grape packages that was being purchased!! My ignorance of course! Each small box cost over 7 dollars. Do I feel asinine!
You are kidding about the price right??  $7.66 a box??  glad you can afford that, I can't....this is by far the best flavor ever, but not in my budget..

column9: crystal light on the go white grape
column10: Best product that crystal light produces and well priced and can not buy in stores anymore. Great taste and easy to use

A box of 10 packets of mix will do several more than 20-30 glasses of drink.  Don't need to use entire packet per drink.  Prompt delivery, packaged safely against shipping damage.  Have not been disappointed yet with service from orders placed with Amazon!!!!

Was just what I wanted, I bought this in the market but they quit stocking it so I tried Amazon. Lo and behold they had it!  But I learned that I must browse when looking for it as I found it cheaper from other vendors..but I am very pleased the my purchase.

column9: This is the first decaf I've ever had where you could not tell it was decaf!
column10: Whenever I try and cut the caffeine I have struggled--usually I would have to order a Cafe Americano type thing (watered down, decaffinated espresso--tastes just like a regular cup of coffee, but oi, the price!) because I could never find something drinkable I could brew myself.A friend bought me some Peet's for my birthday and when I shopped to buy more (it is ALL excellent coffee!) I decided to give the decaf a try.  It was amazing!  I really could not tell I was drinking something decaf--and it was just their regular coffee--not espresso or anything else.  I have tried most of the different flavors at Peet's and the coffee is consistently fabulous--including all the decafs (for some reason I don't care as much for their Sumatra but my husband assures me it's my imagination as he loves it).In any case I HIGHLY RECOMMEND any and all Peet's coffees but most particularly their decafs like the French roast.As I always caution buyers on Amazon, look to see who the vendor is if it's not Amazon directly.  The products stay the same but the vendors may vary.  This includes some that actually keep their stock on Amazon's shelves which is great for shipping but also examine the pricing structures carefully.  Do your due diligence regarding the specific vendor including ratings, prices and shipping policies.That said, the decaf Peet's coffee is amazing!JTG

NEW! POOP-FREEZE Aerosol Freeze Spray (10 oz) This product worked fine on regular poop, so what, I can pick that up with a baggie any day.  I purchased this product for when my dogs had loose stools but it did not work on hardening these stools up to prevent a messy clean up.  Sorry, it appeared to be a great idea!

You know those cans of air you buy to clean your keyboards & other things?  Try turning one of those cans upside down and spraying the poop -couple of blasts - each about 5 seconds works great! That and a putty knife lifts it right off the carpet!

I'd heard good things about Poop-Freeze from other pet owners, so I ordered a can.  Sadly, I wasn't as impressed as I'd hoped to be. I followed the directions the first time, and instead of frozen poop, I just had cooler poop to pick up.  The second time, I sprayed for longer than recommended. This gave me cold, but still not frozen, poop. Granted, if you're picking it up with a plastic baggie, cold poop is slightly more pleasant that still-warm poop, but the product implies that the poop will be frozen nearly solid and that is not the case. (Incidentally, we're talking a pug here, not a really BIG dog).
Doesn't do the job of hardening or drying up the poop enough to pick up right away. You still have to give it time to air dry, which defeats the purpose...

column9: OK, but not quite up to product claims
column10: The spray does at least partially freeze the poop all canine owners need to responsibly pickup, but it falls well short of the product claims. My family has used it under varying weather conditions and had uneven results, though we have precisely followed the directions. It is most effective (provided the directions are followed exactly) on very solid stool and least effective on soft/running stool. The obvious problem is the latter is exactly why one would purchase the product. We bought it to do a more thorough job picking up after our dogs on a multi-use trail. We bike with our dogs (using Walky Dog) and like to leave the trail as clean as possible for others and to ensure dogs continue to be permitted to use the trail. The product did not help as much as we had hoped. When our multi-can supply runs out, I don't think we will purchase more.

They don't explain you not only have to take the can out but then find and put the straw on..not easy with 1,2,3 or 4 dogs on leashes. Then the item does freeze the mess but also the grass. Also you need to turn the item over and freeze the back "according to the instructions".. I have been unable to do this. I guess its an art... like... flipping pancakes.The freeze spray does help but don't expect it to be anything like the commercial

column9: Does not work well with Great Danes or English Mastiff's
column10: One can is not enough for a movement from either of my dogs. I try to be proactive by feeding them lots of popsicles. It does seem to work better in the winter though.

This is great stuff. My dog gets the runs from time to time. Just zap the juicy pile and it comes right up. It also makes clean up a lot easier. Usually I wait till it ages a while before I chuck it in to my neighbors yard. Now I don't need to and my yard is nice and clean.

My dog's poop is generally soft and hot and my son and I dislike that oozing-between-the-fingers feeling on the pickup.  Works well on most dog poops, not effective on diarrhea.  Would be better if it was combined with an applicator scoop so that after freezing it the scooper would scrape it up.

So not only does this not work at all on any type of fecal matter that is not solidified (and randomly, at best, on already hardened stool - in which case, the product is really pointless anyway), but when I got the item in the mail, I was both amused & shocked at the directions. It indicates that you are supposed to spray the top of the poop, then there's a step where you must flip the poop over to spray the underside. Well, if I'm gonna flip the crap over, I may as well just pick the damn thing up. Pardon the pun, but this product is the biggest 'waste' of money ever.
I used to use liquid nitrogen and believe me it was painful!I nearly lost one of my fingers once, but now it's all in the past all thanks to Poop Freeze. My life is now complete and worriless.
This product is a waste of time. I have been getting far better results freezing my own poop using my ordinairy under counter freezer! Why would you wait for the dog to go?Pointless!

I love this product.  My dog drops bombs in the house on a regular basis.  Perhaps he does it just to let me know that he needs more attention or maybe he does it to piss me off.  Poop Freeze has saved the day!  It makes picking up poop easy and fun.  Did I say fun - YUP.  My kids love picking up after the dog outside in the yard with Poop Freeze.

column4: Amazon/debnroo cheated me and didn't make it ...
column9: Too expensive to matter if it works or not.
column10: Price:  $29.98Sale:  $13.20You Save:  $16.78 (56%)What? For one tiny single itty bitty TEN OUNCE can. I got burned once this way, never again.

column9: Zap it before it hits the ground!
column10: Here's the trick.  If you zap it on the ground,  it sticks to the grass. Not good,  especially the gummy stuff.What you need to do is position your can so that as "scruffy" is doin his deal you get it before it hits the grass! Don't shoot too early though...

column9: Not good on loose stools or chairs
column10: When my dog usually lays a loaf, it's of the super soft squidgy kind.  Kinda like a Hostess Snowball.  After using this product, his doggy little debbies are a bit more solid, but still way too squishy for me to want to pick up with my bare hands!So do what I do!  Sprinkle some cat litter on the poop and convince your dog that it's cat poop.  He'll scarf his own doggie tootsie rolls like they were leftovers from dinner.How's that for recycling Mr Gore?!?  BOOYAH!!

Last time I checked, water based products such as Poop aren't really frozen at 62 degrees F.Personally I try to catch the poop in a zip-lock bag and take it straight to the deep freeze. This prevents freezer burn and that white crusty layer.

I don't know about you but there is nothing like a warm poo in your hand first thing in the morning.I don't think I'd even be interested in having a dog anymore if there wasn't the thought of being able to scoop up the warm poo after intently watching him give waste to his kibble every morning. How would I know I was still alive if not for the warm embrace?This product is absolutely brilliant but what about the fecal freaks... Where is our product?

These pretzels are evil. When my snacking comes to an end, I see flashes of myself laying on the unkempt wooden floor of an abandoned house. Scant beams of light burn between the cracks in the boards on the lone window frame, illuminating my tattered and orange-stained clothes. The sound of my body writhing over a pool of empty yellow aluminum bags, a half foot high up the empty broken walls, is quieted only by the echo of my cries of longing and despair.

column9: These are awesome, fatty, and flavorful.
column10: These little pretzel pieces are totally addictive, which is probably not a good thing because they're a lot worse for you than you'd think pretzels should be. They have around 60 fat calories and 3 grams of saturated fat in ONE ounce, which equals out to be 15% of your daily sat fat intake per serving (one ounce).The reason they're so good AND so fatty is that the mustard/onion seasoning is in an oil that permeates through the shell of the pretzel, making them extra flavorful and not dry at all. They're a little sweet, have good mustard flavor, and the onion flavor even comes through a little (they taste like they're supposed to). I try to just grab a handful at snack time and quit while I'm ahead, but I usually end up going back for more later.If you're willing to put up with a little extra fat for a lot of extra flavor, these are a perfect snack.

column9: It's like eating real hot wings!!!
column10: If you like pretzels and you like hot wings. Do yourself a favor and try these. You will not believe how much like a true hotwing they made these pretzels taste.Oh and to the 3 star reviewer who didn't like that they are hot. Umm they don't call them cool wings. They are not hot, but do have a spice to them. If you are someone that eats hotwings you will love them.

I love buffalo wings; not just the heat, but the flavor! This product, while not offering tongue-burning, sinus-clearing heat, has good bite to it. The flavor--how can I describe it? It's very addictive! I can down a whole 10 ounce package in no time. I'm not sure if I'm imagining it, but there seems to be a hint of a bleu cheese taste in there as well, which adds to the whole "hot wing" experience of the snack, in my opinion.My kids like these as well. I have to hide the bag from them sometimes just to ensure that I get my fair share.
These are delicious. Taste exactly like a buffalo wing should taste. They are not very healthy but I don't care. I love them.

I'm a girl from buffalo NY and these have true Buffalo hot wing /hot sauce flavor. I can easily eat a whole bag - although it probably would not be wise. Do yourself a favor and buy this snack! I just bought a case to give as treats to friends that enjoy a good hot wing

I've tried the Buffalo flavor and loved them.They taste great all by themselves or tossed in a salad.Then I saw they had jalapeno.Anything with jalapeno and I start drooling all over myself.I saw.I bought.I ate.I cried...they were all gone.I bought more.(Brian doing happy jalapeno dance).Delicious.Unhealthy.Who cares.......recommended.

Snyder's Honey Mustard & Onion Prezel Pieces might very well hold the title for most delicious non-candy snack item.  A large bag rarely lasts a day in my house, which isn't a good thing when they're pretty caloric.  They're so delicious you just want to stuff a whole handful in your mouth and slowly suck the flavor out of them, crunching on the remains as you look like a mad squirrel.I would go as far as to say that you could eat these every day and not get tired of them.  I would replace every meal of the day with these things if I wasn't afriad of them giving me heart disease.Try them once and you'll be hooked.  I have tried the other flavors since some stores run discounts, none of the other flavors were anywhere near as good as the Honey Mustard & Onion.  Buttermillk Ranch is ok, but you can't top Cool Ranch Doritos.  Cheddar Cheese wasn't good at all, and Buffalo Wing was hard to eat (flavor makes your hands all nasty).

There are many types of honey mustard pretzel but the Snyder Honey Mustard pieces are the best most flavorful and satisfying to me others just don't compare and are lightly flavored in comparison.  I LOVE them.

This is a kind of pretzel that will make your taste buds tingle, if you honestly don't like pretzels much at all, you will love them after you try these pretzels.  They are the most excellent tasting pretzels around.  I would strongly inform people to try these amazing pretzels.

Bought a trial bag at a local market.  Taste is very addicting.  The whole family loved it, even the little ones.  Bought bulk at Amazon and spread the wealth to other family members, co-workers, and friends.  All seem to enjoy this flavor and texture quite nicely.  Good price at Amazon and 12 pack is gone in no time.
Love them! Gotta have them! They really are good especially if you like HOT treats!

If you like Buffalo Wings, You'll love these. I can't believe how they can make a pretzel taste so much like a buffalo wing. These are GREAT!If you haven't tried them yet, do yourself a favor and try them today.
Everyone in the family (and my daughter's friends) like these.  Even though you get 12 bags they don't last long.  Need to refill every few months.

Snyder's of Hanover Hot Buffalo Wing Pretzel Pieces, 10-Ounce Packages (Pack of 12) If you like pretzels, buffalo wings, heat and salt you will love these.  They are a product that actually delivers on their promises.  They are hot and spicy, but not in the bland heat just to say they are spicy of so many other products.  These have the heat and the vinegar tang of actual buffalo chicken wings.  I love them.  Unfortunately they don't last long at our house.  Once a bag is opened they are gone as the burst of heat you get from them is addictive. The only downside aside from the speed at which they get eaten is the orange fingers you get from them.  But that is a small price to pay for entrance into flavor heaven.

I found the Butermilk Ranch Pretzel Pieces while on a trip to Texas a couple years ago.  My family and I feel in love with the flavor as well as the crunch.  But, to our dismay, that particular flavor was almost impossible to find in our state of Connecticut.  I found the web site and Voila!!!! Twelve scrumptious bags of the tasty treat.

I am huge pretzel lover.These in my opinion, are the best tasting pretzels out there.They are TRULY finger licking good.  Everybody I know who has tasted them raves about the flavor.  I don't think you could have found a better combination of flavors to add to a pretzel.  I've tried Hanover's other flavors but they don't come near this all time favorite.  I did have to stop buying and eating them because of health reasons, but when I did eat them, I would not be without any in  my house.

Honey mustard and onion was so good I wanted to try more flavors...buttermilk ranch tasted more like a pickle than ranch.  I hate to throw food away but I just couldn't eat them.  Like I said though honey mustard and onion are great, just don't kiss anyone after eating them.

These are pretty good and these are not low calorie..they are about the same as potato chips....so they are not like regular pretzels....get em on sale in Amazon Warehouse and then go make some friends.

I just love these pretzels.  There was only one bag on the shelf at the store today and I nearly had a heart attack!  Totally panicked thinking "Oh no what if they have discontinued them"  I sure hope they never will!

column9: The best pretzel snack you can buy.
column10: These are absolutely mouth-watering.  About 10 nibblers will cost you:-130 calories-3 grams of fat(1.5 sat. fat.) - no trans fat95 mg sodium (just 4% dv)3g protein (amazingly you get protein out of this)Less than 1g sugars23g carbs (8% DVAlso has 10% DV or less of: Iron, Riboflavin, Folate, Niacin, Thiamin.With the taste this good and nutrional value so great, this might make you ditch the fatty chips and start buying these.  I don't even feel guilty about over-eating these from time-to-time.  I solute Snyder's for making these!

A few words that come to mind.....amazing, wonderful, astonishing, delicious, fantastic, and delightful.  Thank you Snyder's of Hanover for these pretzle pieces bravo!These are the next best thing to an actual Buffalo chicken wing!

These taste great and they are my snacking weakness! however, they get on my nerves because the non-uniformaly shaped pieces exhibit the brazil nut effect where granular particles of similar/equal density tend to be on top aka the larger pretzel pieces tend to be in the first handful but as you eat more the smaller ones are always on the bottom of the bag no matter what you do. frustrating but unavoidable. just be aware.snyder should get a better pretzel chipper machine or whatever they use and keep the size consistent! if it works for potato chips why can't it work for pretzel???

I don't like pretzels and was hesitant about trying these but omg they are gooood!! I couldn't taste the actually pretzel, just the hot wing. I love this and definitely adding to my favorite snacks. The honey mustard isn't bad either but hot wings are #1!
These are not sold in stores where I live, so I had to order them online.  They are the best pretzels ever, we eat them all the time.

Snyder's of Hanover Cheddar Cheese Pretzel Pieces, 10-Ounce Packages (Pack of 12) package claims these pretzels are bursting with flavor. I agree with this claim, my family agrees with this claim, my son's family agrees with this claim; as a matter of fact, everyone I've shared these pretzels with agrees with this claim.These are hard, sourdough pretzel pieces.  I'd guess the average size is 1/2" x 3/4" - 1"  of all different shapes because they are randomly broken. I ordered these using Amazon's subscribe & save program which brings the price down to less than I'd pay in the supermarket. Twelve packages are a lot. I share them with my family & friends.Nutrition Facts:1 oz. or approx 1/3 cup serving = 130 caloriesTotal fat 6g~Saturated fat 3.5g~Trans fat & Cholesterol 0Sodium 260 mg (11% of your daily value)Total Carbs 18g~Fiber less than 1g~Sugars less than 1gProtein 2gVitamin A, C, & Calcium 0Iron & Niacin each 6%Riboflavin 8%Thiamin 10%Folate 20%I can't really describe the flavor so I thought I'd list some of the ingredients which make up the 'burst of flavor.' Included in the ingredients: Cheddar cheese, buttermilk powder, onion powder, tomato powder, spice, nonfat dry milk, garlic powder, turmeric extract, annatto extract, & paprika extract.Allergy info: These are produced in a facility that handles peanut butter.Warning...very addicting!!!

column9: Jalapeno: Awsome Tase, can only eat 5 at a time...
column10: There is 3,800 MG of sodium in this entire 10oz bag, that's alot of salt. It's very salty, its unnessary for the flavor, but hey, its awsome when you eat like 5 pieces, than another 5 an hour later. I reccomend these

These taste great and arrived well packaged.  However, be prepared to eat these in a hurry - the expiration date was only 2 weeks away when they arrived. Eat quickly or throw away.  Amazon really needs to improve this problem.
Excellent product, received promptly and fresh when opened. However, I found it was priced about the same as in Walmart. I expected more of a price bargain when ordering in bulk.

Love this snack!  Snyder's of Hanover Cheddar Cheese Pretzel Pieces, 10-Ounce Packages (Pack of 12)Cannot find it locally any more so Amazon is my go-to store.  Ordering is easy & convenient, price is comparable to stores, delivery is quick.
excellent product, however high in salt, but I love them...recommend to allpeople who like spicy stuff..
these pretzels are so great! i purchased them for my husband because we can no longer find them in the grocery store. i highly recommend them to anyone who likes spicy foods.
I bought a bag for our road trip and everyone just dived into it till it was all gone. Nobody could stop, even those who don't usually like pretzels. It's savory with a hint of sweetness. Yum.
Although these are really excellent by themselves, I use them as croutons on my daily salad.  Totally wonderful.  It just wouldn't be a great salad without them.

As a rule, Snyder's just makes the best pretzels, hands down.  They've been making them for 100 years now and well, there's a reason they're still in business!  These are great - they disappear rather quickly.  My only complaint is that they're small and very hard so they scrape the roof of your mouth.  Other than that, they're the best tasting things out there.  Highly recommend!

column9: You can't eat just a handful!
column10: These are the best pretzel snack out there.  The broken pieces really soak up the flavor which a whole pretzel would not.And what everybody else said!

column9: WILL EAT WHOLE BAG AT ONE SITTING !
column10: Goodness, these are soooo good. the most tastiest snack on the planet. It lights up your eyes. and you go YUMMMMM. and you cant stop. they are addicting !  There must be a cult fan club over this particular snack if there isnt one already. Get someone to try it who never had it before. They will be addicted as well.
These are awesome tasting, like authentic Ranch dressing, but dont eat too many in one sitting as the flavour can overpower!
These are spicy and salty, and highly addictive if you don't worry about the salt content. I am sure after the case of 12 I will die of kidney damage one day. But they are that good.

My son discovered these somehow so we purchased some from the grocery store. Yummy. Very salty (but not as much as the buffalo wing flavor), and yes, not as "good" for you as the regular pretzel, but hey, they taste 10 times better. Bag gone in 10 minutes. Thanks to the other reviews I now have no fear getting the box of 12...

Snyder's are the best quality pretzels, in my opinion.  The fact that they have been around for 100 years speaks for itself.Also as a retail convenience store I get my supply from Amazon because the price is right.  On Subscribe and Save I make over 40% at retail price as oppose to the 25% I use to with a local middle man distributor.
Oh Glorious day when I found the best snack treat on Amazon.  Just like hot wings, except in pretzel form.  No longer have to wait for the store to get in stock, I can order online now.
These pretzels are wonderful.  The heat is present but not overpowering.  My 4, 7, and 13 year old kids love them.  Try using them in your "famous name cereal" party mix.  It makes a big difference!
I tried these as I had already ordered the regular Snyder's pretzels.  They are very good and very hot.!  If you don't like "hot stuff" they are probably not for you.

column9: A little broken up but the taste is GREAT!
column10: I really loved  Snyder's of Hanover Cheddar Cheese Pretzel Pieces, 10-Ounce Packages (Pack of 12).  The taste is fabulous and texture is crunchy.  Mine arrived a little broken up but that doesn't change the great taste.  Just smaller bits to nibble on!  Wish I could put this order on automatic!

If you are in the mood for good eats (ok maybe Alton Brown can charge me for that) try these jalapeno pretzels. They are very good, not too hard and great flava flav. And it's really true you get 12 packages.
It can be hard to find this flavor in the grocery stores; I made sure to stock up.

Who knew they could put buffalo wings in a bag?  These pretzel pieces are absolutely wonderful . . . and  . . . a-hem . . . less fattening than actual chicken wings.  All the glory, less fat!  Yummy!  Yummy!  Yummy!
I am hopelessly addicted to these jalapeño pieces. Someone help me. I need some kind of medication to wean me off of them.
I tried it in a party and found it very tasty.  It is kind of oily, though.
Taste is good.  Received the product on Oct. 22nd, 2009, but ALL 12 bags expires on Nov. 29th, 2009.  Only 38 days to eat them all or give away.  I will NOT order again.

column9: Great, but 11 of the 12 bags came.
column10: These pretzels are very tasty when you crave a salty, mild cheddar cheese flavor. They are crunchy and hard, which I love. But, the box was one bag short (11 out of 12).

Very flavorful, jalapeno is a fantastic concept for Pretzels. Random bags yield random results, the first pretzel in your mouth is an awesome experience, for the most part.But, for crying out loud, why do they have to add an YEAR'S WORTH OF SALT in one friggin bag?!! It's not consistent, sometimes you get lucky with the top portion of the bag when it's not all that salty, but by the end of one bag, you do get the feeling that you have consumed an ocean's salt content. Why this idiocy? When all one craves for is the taste of spicy jalapeno? The sucker that I am, I eat the first couple of pretzel pieces and then throw the whole bag away, it's serious sodium poisoning if you do consume the whole bag.

column9: Not the best Snyder's of Hanover Pretzels
column10: Snyder's of Hanover makes good pretzels (Honey Mustard & Onion is my favorite), but these are just not appetizing at all.  "Hot Buffalo Wing" gets its kick from dried cayenne pepper sauce.  So if you are a fan of peppers you might like this pretzel.  They are nowhere near as good as Honey Mustard in my opinion, though they aren't as bad as just cheddar cheese.  Hot Buffalo seems to be enhanced by eating them with other food, in my case, chocolate M&M's.  If you like a spicy zing, try these pretzels, they are not horrible.  If you like sweetness just stick to Honey Mustard & Onion.  Nutrition-wise, are not the best as they contain MSG and caramel color.  Also, if you consumed an entire 10 oz. bag in one sitting, you would be consuming 1400 calories.  I guess their good if you are trying to gain weight like I am trying to do.  Otherwise stick to the healthier counterpart of the unflavored ones.
the "hot wing" pretzels were hot. if you like hot things you will like these.

I just finished a 32 ounce bottle of Lakewood Organic Lemonade. What a joy to drink lemonade that tastes great without high fructose corn syrup, sugar, cane sugar, or sugar substitute.  This lemonade has pure agave and white grape juice used for sweeteners; therefore, I can serve it with confidence knowing that it is good for me and my family. I don't think I will ever buy another brand of lemonade again.  Try it . . . you'll love it!
I tried the lemonade as it was recommended in the "eat this not that" series as I was concerned about the amount of sugar in normal lemonade and juice.  Absolutely the best lemonade out there!
Lemonade is Wonderful Tastes Great but not too sour!!! Enjoyed all six bottles Immensenslly!!! Well packaged no broken or Cracked bottles!!!!!!

column9: I would buy this Lemonade over and over  so good
column10: we have lots of food allergies and search for something real well this Lemonade is the right one for us and we would buy it over and over again can only say good things

Its not as tart as one would expect from your standard freshly squeezed lemonade and certainly not like the Minute Maid/Snapple stuff.  Does goes down smoother, weak lemon taste.  Don't know if I would buy again.  Its an acquired taste.

I have read that Community Coffee is good and beloved around New Orleans. I'm a regular Kona and Blue Mountain drinker so I had tempered expectations but boy I was pleasantly surprised.I like full flavored coffee and my brewing of choice is a dark roast through an aeropress followed by sugar and cream. The Community dark roast is very tasty. A nice full flavor with a sweet/non-bitter aftertaste.Obviously everybody's taste is different, but I'm very pleased with this one.

........so I decided to try the Whole Bean Dark Roast this time and this is one of the better coffees I've ever tasted. Expiration isn't until May of this year. My last experience was the CC Hotel Blend and that was a disaster. Expiration on that was 1 month after I ordered it.  Anyway, this coffee is strong and smooth. When you can taste the smell of coffee beans, then you know you have great coffee. I got it here at a great price too. May purchase if it goes on sale again.

My beans weren't that dark. When I opened the package it did not hit me with a lot of aroma. I'm no coffee expert, but to my taste buds this is on par to the Sam's Club private brand I was buying.  Sam's price/lb was less.Since I like my coffee strong, I'll give the French Roast a try next.

Great deal for a decent coffee. I didn't give it five stars frankly because it is not starbucks:) I happened to grab this when it was on sale, which I am leery of spending a lot of money on a coffee on a brand that I have never tried. So I got a great deal, tried it and am very happy with it. It may not be my # 1 choice of coffee everyday, but it does a great job at filling in the other days as my caffeine! Will buy again.

I used to roast my own coffee beans to make the freshest tasting coffee.  But, ever since my local roaster upped their prices of the raw green beans, I decided to try this coffee out.  Community Coffee often goes on sale, and you can sometimes find it as low as $2 a bag!  At those prices, I could not resist.The coffee comes with a brew by date, and that tells me a lot about the quality of the roasters.  The bags also have a one way air bag seal to keep the coffee fresh.  The quality of the beans is 100% Arabica, and that's important for flavor.Overall, really good coffee, especially for the price!

This is very good whole bean coffee. I have had better, but it is well worth the price. I have to brew a couple of more scoops than normal to get the rich flavor out of it, but it is still more than worth the price.

column9: not fresh, no aroma, chicory flavor
column10: The box arrived on July 22, the date on the coffee bag is Sept 30.  So that doesn't leave much shelf time here.  Thing is, most vacpac coffee has at least a 6 month shelf life, so that is worrisome.Opened the bag, no smell.  That in itself tells the whole story.  Coffee is aromatic.  You open a bag of bean, particularly french roast bean and you're going to smell coffee, even before you grind it.  It's the nature of the oils on the roasted coffee beans, and it definitely affects the flavor and experience.no smell.Brewed up a pot this morning in my cuisinart coffee grinder/brewer:beans were not consistant in roasting, some darker than othersno aroma when brewing whatsoevercoffee turned out very darkmed chicory like flavorcoffee flavor not strong or rich.I've been playing with this coffee for a couple of days and after a while it's not terrible.  Compared to a stronger flavored French Roast, it pales.  But on it's own, if this is how you like your coffee, okay.I can't say if it's the blend of bean or if it's fact that it was roasted a long time ago and it's lost it's strength.  But it lacks a rich coffee flavor.  except it has that mild chicory backtaste going.so if you want a mild coffee with a hint of chicory, you found it.

column9: Great whole bean dark roast coffee for my Jura Capresso
column10: I normally use Illy whole coffee beans medium roast for my Jura Capresso S8 machine.  Sometimes I use Illy dark roast which has a richer and stronger taste plus no aftertaste, but of course I can't always justify spending that much money all the time.  Then I found this Community Coffee Whole Bean Dark Roast.  I'm very happy with it because it is similar in taste to the Illy dark roast and is much, much less expensive.  I'm sticking with this product from now on.
i have been using coffee beans to make expresso and in my french press. I really like the taste of this coffee. Family owed business grown in the USA.

Ever since I can remember, Community Coffee has been a staple in not only my family, but my husbands as well. We drink it, our kids drink it - it's a crowd pleaser. Since my husband can only drink decaffeinated coffee, he sticks with Community Decaf. However, every once and a while I'll buy my own bag of Dark Roast. I've been introduced to others in the Community family recently and have found Huehue Tenango and Cafe' Special are two very delicious coffees. There are many blends I still haven't tried, but rest assured I would recommend Community Coffee to anyone.Faithful Community drinker,Connie

column9: Community Coffee Dark Roast whole Bean
column10: I have tried many different brands of Dark Roasted Coffee and I keep coming back to this coffee.  It is delivered quickly and has the best deep roasted flavor of any thing on the market in my opinion.

column9: The Best Community Has to Offer..
column10: the dark roast in general is good, whole bean or ground.. even better when its only  3.33 per bag..the other roasts are pretty bland by comparison- you have to use a lot of coffee to make it taste good..the dark is good. compare to Starbucks dark sumatra..nice.
Read the reviews and decided to take the plunge.  It was O...k..  not bad by any means, but nothing exciting either.  I'd rate it lower than Starbucks coffee.

I gave this a shot and it turned out much better than expected.For the price, it cant be beat.Much better than the (nine-1) O'clock that are at similar price point, packagingand variety. Beans are shiny and smell good. Gave you a sense of freshness.

This is a really great tasting coffee.  I brew my coffee using fresh ground beans and a press every morning, so I am a bit particular about coffee.  Actually, I am insane about preparation and quality of the coffee bean and I am always looking for the best bean with the best taste for the best price.  After reading all of the other wonderful reviews (thank you reviewers), I decided to give this inexpensive brand a shot.  Well, I am so very happy to say that it is delicious.  The aroma is full, taste is bold and rich with a very long lasting lingering flavor after the last drop has been drunk.  I am so happy with this that I became a subscribe and save member for it.  My next purchase will be the French Roast for my daughter, but I can tell you that I am going to be staying with the Dark Roast for a very, very pleasantly long time.  Yum

column9: Just finished the last of my Cafe Cubano
column10: Actually, I bought 12 oz X 3 bags for my daughter.I am a coffee deal junkie and could not pass up this offer for US$14.58 (incl S/H and no sales tax).
I like dark / bold coffee.  This blend does the trick.  And you can not beat the price. I will be back for more when these bags are gone!
makes a delicious cup of coffee. dark, fresh,and the price is resonable.Would definitely order again.A hot cup of this cofee helps motive me in the morning.

column9: Delicious and easy, but short shelf life
column10: I'm on a bit of a Southern food cooking kick, so when I saw a great deal for this coffee, I jumped on it! 3 bags of specialty coffee for the same price as 1 bag of Starbucks is amazing, in my opinion. The bag is cute and more importantly, easy to open and close securely as opposed to some coffee bags. The beans smell lovely and my first cup was delicious. I subtracted a star b/c the bags are dated 12/13/11, which is not that far in the distant future. I will probably just be finishing up the last bag around that time, so it won't be expired, but I'd never purposely buy nearly expired coffee in the store--it just isn't fresh. If you go through more than one bag a month then I wouldn't worry about it--either way, it's good to support this smaller producer and put a little extra flair and "flava" in your day :)

This coffee is a great bargain. It is fresh, and rich, with no bitterness. I really enjoy a good, dark-roasted coffee, and was very happy to discover Community Coffee. People who favor a dark roast coffee should know that this blend of dark roast does not have a smokey flavor. Some people prefer the smokey flavor to their coffee (myself included), so I want to be sure potential buyers are aware of this. It still makes a fine cup of coffee, so I would definitely recommend that someone buys it at least once to try it, especially if they do not have it regularly available in their part of the country (myself included, again).
BEST COFFEE EVER....DARK ROAST IS SO SMOOTH!  GAVE ME LOTS OF PEP IN MY STEP ALSO!  NEW FAVE!  MAKES STARBUCKS TASTE LIKE MUD!

I like the stuff! Despite of its dark roast it doesn't taste any bitter or cause any heartburn. It has a rich & full flavor, just what I need for early morning breakfast. I prefer to buy the whole beans version, because it keeps fresh for a long period of time and you are free to determine the grade of the grind.
Great Coffee and a Good price! Can't get it in whole bean here, nearest is 3 hours away. Amazon to the rescue! Even a cheaper price than the store!!!
This is the second time I've ordered this coffee. I really like it! I have found a new regular for my grocery list.

No aroma and tasted like cigarette ash. I think the beans were rancid when I received them since they were so close to the expiration date. Beware of low price because you get what you pay for. Old beans!
The dark roast coffee is not at all 'full bodied' - if you are used to coffees like Starbucks, Coffee Bean, Peets, etc this will be a major disappointment.

column9: Not very dark, bitter acidic flavor
column10: Easily the worst whole bean coffee I've ever tried, tasted like cheap ground coffee from a can.Not dark at all more a medium-light roast. Had a nasty bitter flavor and maybe a stale flavor, pretty horrible, will be throwing it out.EDIT: as it's so light, once I adjusted the grinder to quite a bit coarser, it was better and drinkable. This is a LIGHT roast, do not grind on fine.Still not very good coffee.

column9: This product is expiring in 3 months
column10: I didn't notice the expiration date until a few weeks after I got the product. I was stunned that it was going to expire in 3 months. I would never buy any stuff from this seller anymore.

I expect my dark roast to be exactly that. DARK. This was not. It was a dried-out, light brown mess that wasn't even as good as Maxwell House. One pot was more than enough to come to a conclusion about this. We're using the remainder as lawn fertilizer.
Regular oreos are good but the golden ones are way better. First you don't have that embarrassing dark pieces stuck between your teeth like regular Oreos. And the golden just have a better flavor.
I order this for my son because this is favorite cookie and I will do it again. Thank you for having this product. God Bless.

column9: I've struck gold, gold I say!
column10: It all started when I was working late at night, no food left, and no place open to get food in the building. I stumbled across a snack machine wanting cookies, but the only cookies they had were golden oreos. I opted to try them since I loved regular oreos, and they were the most delicious cookies I've ever eaten.Now i get the full size packs for at home snacking, and they're delicious. They taste similar to regular oreos, but are vanilla flavor. The creme in the center is still the same, so no flavor change there.The new packaging is also great, no more opening one side and having all the cookies go stale. You can lift up the tab on the top of the packaging, and you can see all the cookies in plain view. When you're done, just reseal it, and it magically closes perfectly and air tight each time.I haven't tried eating them with milk, or dunking them in milk yet, but I'm sure they're just as delicious as the regular Oreos. Another nice bonus is the fact that they don't turn your teeth and tongue black like regular oreos do. I always opted out of eating regular oreos in public because I didn't want people to think I had bad teeth, but these leave no marks or stains all over your mouth.Buy them on amazon, they're delicious cheap, and you cant just have one!

For those of you who wondered what a vanilla Oreo might taste like, look no further. I love original Oreo cookies, but I also really like vanilla/yellow, and when this cookie came out, I tried it, and it did not disappoint. Uh-Oh Oreos (vanilla cookie with chocolate frosting) is also really good.

I also bought these at Costco for $10.00 per box which included 24 bags that are .8 oz each.  My kids are fighting over the few remaining bags, and they are very good, but I won't be buying them again due to the price.  The high price will prevent this product from reaching mass distribution.

column9: Great fruit snacks, too bad they are soo expensive!
column10: I bought these as part of a promotion they were having at our Costco over the weekend (8-28/8-29) in Lakewood, CA and these fruit snacks are great. The Tasty staff at the store wasn't kidding me when they said that 24 for $9.99 Costco promo was 60% off the retail price. I thought to myself even with ship and save I thought oh they can't be that bad, but the price is $23 even with ship and save. Now I wish I would've bought a few more of these yesterday to get my 4 yr. old through a few months of eating them once a week at preschool. I seriously hope Costco gets these and or they lower the price on them because honestly even here in the LA area where people don't care what and how much they spend on food I don't think the idea of $2.00 pouches of fruit snacks is going to last.

I'd give this candy five stars (great texture, great flavor, pretty colors, no corn syrup!) except for the fact that the packaging it comes in has a distinct chemical smell - very like silicone, but with an edge of something else.  I don't know if it's the plastic or the printing or what, but if you have multiple chemical sensitivities, you may want to have someone else open this up for you and put the candy in another container so you don't have to deal with the chemical stink.  FWIW, the candy itself doesn't seem to pick up the smell, so maybe it is the ink on the outside of the pack after all.I don't have MCS, but I found the smell so offensive that I dumped all the candy into a bowl and got rid of the packaging ASAP.  Just too stinky.  Sorry Tasty people, you make a great gummy, no question about it, but your packaging may taint the experience for some.

column9: Awesome snacks from Amazon! Tasty Brand Organic Snacks
column10: These are the best snacks. Kids and adults love them alike. NO added refined sugar. Take on the road, Send to school. Pack to take to work. LOVE these.

Being Greek and loving cooking I bought this ot make some dolmades. Now let me tell you, 90% of a dolma success is about getting good leaves. Best leaves must be young fresh leaves that grom on top of the vine and are cabbage-like green. The leaves growing on lower part of the plant are way hard and useless for cooking. Well this product was 99% these leaves. Even after boiling these for 1 hour they were useless. Do NOT buy.
I was very happy with these grape leaves.  They were a nice size and firm ... Not torn, easy to work with... Very satisfied and would recommend the purchase.  I will again and again.

While I love this product, I feel disappointed the seller no longer offers this with Prime 2 day shipping.My dog is a super picky eater, and she really seems to love Fromm.  I switch between flavors so she stays interested.
I bought their dry food and canned food based upon a New York Times review.Well, maybe my dogs are spoiled but they would touch any of it, ever!I will donate them to an animal shelter.

Dynamic Health Organic Beetroot Juice comes closer to fresh than any other bottled beet juice I have tried. It's also a little more expensive.  When I am traveling and can't make my shake, I usually drink about sixteen ounces a day.  I have found the plastic bottles sturdy enough to travel safely in checked luggage.Most mornings, I add fresh, diced beets to a shake in the blender.  No bottled beet juice even comes close to the strong taste and intense color of fresh beets.  Even though they are only about one sixth by volume, the fresh beets impart a vivid red-violet color to the shake.  The color and taste of beet root juice in bottled products is pale by comparison. Lacking scientific research, it is hard to know how much, if any nutritional value is also lost in bottling.
Very good deal, my babies love them. All three were born in the month of October so the gourmet dog cookies were a nice treat.
Treat yourself or your guests!  They are rich and give you a great chocolate fix.  Especially great with coffee. One goes a long way.
I love this so much, I love the combination of the chocolate but i wish they put more white chunk chocolate.
These are really, really good.  Expensive but they are almost like eating a candy bar.  The cookie is a crumbly cookie, not a soft one.
