I ordered the complete set of Totonac sugar free syrups and tested them out with my morning Kellogg's Eggo waffles.Some of the syrups are pretty good; others are really not my thing and I threw them out. My verdict/opinion is: Almond, Maple Syrup and Vanilla are pretty good; the Raspberry is okay (if you crave some fruit taste); but I couldn't handle the taste of the Blueberry, Butter Pecan, Caramel, Hazelnut and Vanilla Cinnamon.The syrup is not thick like most syrups on the market; it's more runny and I find myself pouring some syrup out on to a plate and then dipping pieces of torn waffles.

column9: Not great if you are a supertaster, but has potential
column10: I really wanted to like this syrup, first because I can't eat much sugar and second because it's made in my home state and I like to support local businesses. Also the ingredients are high quality and all natural.  I picked 4 different flavored bottles up at a Home Goods store and was anxious to try it. Unfortunately this was really bitter for me, as almost all products with stevia are. (Truvia in iced tea seems to be an exception, perhaps because the bitterness enhances the tea flavor.)I'm a supertaster, which means I have more tastebuds than most. It also means that anything with stevia will always have a funky bitter taste to me, no matter how hard it is masked. I was hoping the Lo Han Guo would help ease the bitterness but it didn't. I tried it in milk and the only way to get rid of the bitterness was to pour a lot more milk in the cup, but then the almond flavor washed out too. In short I'm giving this a three, because even though I didn't like it, the quality of the ingredients will ensure that it will probably be very tasty for others who are not supertasters.

Compared to local stores where only 2-4 oz packaging is sold, this is a great bargain.  It's an advantage to have a large amount available--this inspires experimental use that livens up meals and contributes to good health. (Cayenne has significant, clinically proven health/medical benefits.)

1ST THE SLICED VARIETY. SHE LOVES IT. THEN THE GRILLED SEAFOOD VARIETY. KITTY BLISS. NOW HER 1ST DELIGHTS FLAVOR, TURKEY + CHEESE. LICKED THE PLATE CLEAN AS WITH THE OTHERS. MY BABY CANT GET ENOUGH OF THIS FANCY FEAST SO I'M OFF 2 CHOOSE ANOTHER FLAVOR 4 HER. I AM HER MORE THAN WILLING SLAVE 4 LIFE AFTERALL. 4 PAWS UP! ..P.S. ORDERED THESE WEDNESDAY NIGHT, RECEIVED FRIDAY MORNING. FASTEST DELIVERY TO BE HAD!

The wife and I like Mustard as opposed to ketchup. We experiment with many brands of mustard. We do like this among others we have selected at Amazon. Buying from Amazon is simply easier and generally ships free... I am so happy with the Amazon selections. Bottom-line, if you want something different buy this. Hope this helps.

column9: Great product for quick, easy tacos!
column10: This is an awesome, convenient product.  My kids actually like this better than "real" (i.e. meat) taco filling.  It's much quicker to make than hamburger, lower fat, and obviously stores for much longer.  We aren't vegetarian but I try to limit our meat intake so I always use this in our tacos.  I'm glad Amazon carries this because it's not available at our local grocery stores.  Yummy!
Excellent product, very tasty. Highly recommended by people who areon the Nutrisystem program.  Makes up very fast and you can freezeservings for future use.  Five star rating. M
This is a great product if you don't eat meat.It is easily made with water and tastes great ! The taco flavoring is yummy.

I am always willing to try New Products; however, I didn't want to buy Twelve Boxes from Amazon, What if we didn't like it? So I got one Box of FANTASTIC Taco Filling from somewhere else, and decided to give it a try, Followed the Cooking Directions and made the Entire Package in a Sauce Pan with 1 3/4 cup of boiling water and two teaspoons of oilSince I found the Sodium a little high for our taste 520 MG, 22% (we don't use a lot of salt) I decided to compensate all that salt by adding about one Tablespoon of Onions and another of Green Bell Peppers to the mix, very finely chopped that I had sauteed in a non-stick skillet with two drops of oil (no salt) even though in the List of Ingredients there is Dehydrated Onions and Onion Powder but I also wanted something fresh, so I mix it all up reduce heat and simmer 5-6 minutes or until liquid is absorbed, stirred every now and then...and like Magic it turned into what it looked like Ground Beef,...Wow, Wee! It was Good, we were very SurprisedI make my own Taco Shells, I like the White Corn Tortillas, Crispier, fry them in vegetable oil folded into a taco shape, I use tongs and a spoon for help, drained on paper towels, filled them with about two or three Tablespoons of the Fantastic Taco Filling, add Salsa, Chopped Romaine Lettuce and top them with Shredded Cheddar Cheese,...So Good, The Best Tacos We Had in a Long TimeYou can get about 10 Tacos out of one Box and Yes, we liked it Better than Meat, and we felt good knowing we were NOT Eating a Cow-Steer, Now we are ready to order the Twelve Boxes from Amazon.com,... in fact we just Did! ... Check Pictures Posted Step by Step of Making Tacos, located under the Item's Image, Thank You

I've been a fan of this product for about 12 years now.....it is easy, fast, healthy and delicious....but I have to gripe about the price.....less than ten years ago it was about $23 a case (shipped) now it's over $33Soon I'm going to stop buying it (like I have with so many other products) because they are (unjustifiably) raising the prices exponentially on a simple dried soy protein product. Realistically, it should be about $1 per box.America will pull out of this recession when we finally figure out that sticking it to ANOTHER American is not going to help pull us out of your financial problems, and when we decide NOT to stick it to the next guy to recover our lossesHaving said that, I still eat this product, but the price hike turned me off bigtimeIf I see it go up one more time, I will add it to my list of gouger companies, and never buy it again.At that point it will be cheaper to make my own.

I usually add half a pack of taco seasoning for more flavor. It makes great chili too (that I also have used for enchiladas). Tastes awesome in an omelet and great on nachos.I have had many countless people try it and no one could tell it was meatless (and I'm from Texas). It's the best tasting meatless tacos I found yet, and each box is equivalent to a pound of ground beef and barely over $2.

My wife and I recently became vegetarians, some days its a little harried to get home, kick off your shoes relax a minute before you start dinner..FANTASTIC FOODS to the rescue...some days when you need help to get a meal out in a few minutes..FF does the job well..we have tried several different flavors like the Taco filling, Tofu Scramble, Hummus, Sloopy Joe's, Vegetarian Chili, Falafel...none of which have dissapointed us and as you can see I am semi-retired chef. The best part is the  ease of preparation...amazing flavors with no meat!! and nothing really strange in the ingredients label. We have learned to buy it by the case as it can be somewhat expensive at most grocery stores as they price it like a specialty product...I'll put it to you this way..it taste go enough to fool most meat eating palates and if you want to turn the kids over quick..use the Sloppy Joe's as much as the Taco Filling.  The taste is a winner!! Bon Apettit!

I have been buying this for years. We are a vegetarian family. I have tried many taco products, but this is by far the best! It is shelf stable, so no refrigeration is needed. You can stock up on a whole case, however we love it so much that it doesn't last long. I use it in many recipes such as Taco soup, Taco casserole, nachos, taco salad and of course, tacos! This is quick to prepare and popular...even with meat-eaters!

Fantastic World Foods mixes are terrific! We're new to vegetarian eating and experimenting with the many products available now.  We've tried the falafel, chicken patty, hamburger, hummus, sloppy joe, and taco filling mixes.  Every one of them is delicious.  For me, it's about the texture and flavor.  This taco filling nails it - you will not be able to tell the difference between this vegetarian mix and hamburger.  As a matter of fact, I like the taste better than ground beef. Amazon makes it easy and inexpensive to stock up with the 12-box packs. You can also find Fantastic Foods brands at most whole/health food stores. I like to add diced onions to the mix. Toss in some jalapenos for a little kick. Yummy!

column9: Edible, but not what I like really...
column10: The flavor to me seems like just chili powder. It's just a matter of preference as to what you like. I've been mixing salsa in it to add some veggie flavors and textures, and for me it's an improvement...

I was skeptical at first because it didn't look like it would make very much. But it makes PLENTY! We had a lot of leftovers and we invited people over to have it. It tastes really good and has the perfect texture. It is easy and fast to make. Even the omnivores couldn't get enough of it.

tried this for the first time today it was so good. kids loved it .the texture is just like taco filling and no grease. and one box make a lot of fillinghttp://www.amazon.com/Fantastic-Foods-Filling-4-4-Ounce-Boxes/dp/B000GZY9HY/ref=sr_1_1?s=grocery&ie=UTF8&qid=1302206977&sr=1-1

column9: Just like Taco Bell, but less nasty
column10: I love making my own mock taco bell tacos, ever since I swore off that place. This 'meat', even my die hard meat eating family members like it. Yummay.

I decided to try this based on the review here. It's absolutely wonderful! So quick to make and YUMMY. No icky grease to deal with like hamburger meat, too. My 16 month old granddaughter loved it. I didn't add any spices to it at all, and it was great just like that. All you have to do is boil some water and let it simmer for about 5 minutes. Easy!

Great vegan tacos in a few minutes. Add water and a little olive or any oil. Heat quickly to eat over greens  for a high protein, low calorie, fast lunch, or add extra onions while sauteing and build tacos with all the fixings.  Very tasty, made right here in Petaluma,Ca, with high quality ingredients.  Healthy for kids!

This product is great.  It cooks up in minutes and tastes just like seasoned beef.  We use it for not only tacos, but casseroles, mexican lasagna, etc.  I'm sure we'll be buying another case shortly, even though there are only two in our household.  Thanks Fantastic Foods!
I love this stuff because it tastes great, does not require refridgeration and takes only minutes to make.
This stuff is great -- tastes kind of like taco bell meat. Seriously!Good for vegetarians, and the just plain lazy. =)

The product is great and a healthier alternative to ground beef, inexpensive, easy to prepare in tacos, taco salad, burritos, and nachos, easy to store for long periods and a crowd pleaser.  No worry about cholesterol or BSE either.My only problem was with the distribution center that has on four occasions sent only one box instead of the 12 boxes (case lot) that I ordered.

I originally found this taco filling at the local health food store.  They no longer sell it, and I was estatic on finding it on Amazon!  I absolutely love it!  It tastes great!  I even have made it for my meat eating family, and they all liked it!!  The expiration dates on the boxes are early summer of next year, so I will have plenty of time to eat them before they expire!  Looks like I will be having tacos tonight!  YUM!!

Anyone who has gone vegan or vegetarian knows how much you miss tacos. I tried this and I just can't believe how good it is! I made hard shell tacos with this today and soy cheese and I just can't believe how fabulous it tastes. The falafel this company makes is pretty good too!Please don't ever stop making this stuff! None of my carnivore family can even tell this is soy....If you are on the fence about this, don't hesitate-try it! The people who are saying it's too salty are entitled to their opinion, but this has no more salt in it than any other taco I've had in my life.

column9: Very good, a little salty on its own...
column10: As I was cooking this for the first time, I took a taste to check for seasoning and thought it was a little on the salty side.  Once I added the usual toppings to my taco it was excellent.  Very close to ground beef tacos in taste and texture.

I find it kind of funny how some people found this too salty.  I had to add more salt because to be it wasn't salty enough!  I made some nachos with this and they turned out great.  Most likely someone who didn't know this wasn't real meat wouldn't be able to tell the difference.  I made some enhancements for my tastes, by adding some extra salt, garlic powder, onion bits, and substituting some of the oil it calls for with sharp cheddar, which melts right into at and gives it a little tang and richness.  I bought 3 of these on special at the local grocery store, hoping I wasn't making a mistake, and I'm happy I made the purchase.

This is a great idea..easy to make..and nutritious...but it is way too salty. I had to cut it with a bag of white rice to be paletable. I wish they would provide the spices on the side so you could add as much as you need.

These are easy to make and are always in rotation in my pantry.They taste better than real meat with that taco flavoring added.Unfortunately they seem to be getting harder to get at my local store.I would also highly recommend the sloppy joe mix from them too.Jaime Pico
These tacos are great. Highly recommend for all vegetarians. Better tnan the meat tacos you make or get out.

column9: Vegetarian Approved... Omnivores still withholding decision
column10: I've been a vegetarian for almost 15 years, and I LOVE this taco filling. I've used it to make straight up traditional tacos, enchiladas as well as "taco pie. I love that the texture somewhat resembles meat, so you can easily substitute it in recipes that call for ground beef.  However, my omnivorous family members are quite skeptical about this product and prefer that I leave it out of dishes. Ultimately, I look at this as a vegetarian's meat substitute, and not a universal meal substitute.

column9: Check sodium content before you purchase
column10: I received a case of this hoping to add it to our vegan menu. Made the first batch and could not eat it is was so salty. Gave the other 11 boxes to the owner of our local organic market.
The indicated shelf life seems much too short for a dry product.  Either the product is particularly sensitive or I got old stock in my shipment.

To everyone crying about the salt content:If you look at the nutrition facts and do the math you'll find the salt content of pappy's seasoning is only about 24% (290 mg of salt per 1.2 g serving size). one of the most common dry rub methods called the 8-3-1-1 formula uses 3 parts salt. that is equivalent to about 23% salt in the rub mix. Based on those numbers it is apparent that pappy's is right in line with traditional dry seasoning recipes.This is one of my favorite seasonings for chicken and beef and I suggest that the lower scoring reviews be disregarded when considering purchasing this product.

This rub is not only my secret seasoning on my bbq in my wood burning pit but is awesome on rottissiere(sp?) chicken. I give it out to my friends w/o the lable on it to keep the secret in TN. SHHH! Pass it on.M

A friend from California introduced us to this seasoning and since then, it is a must have for my kitchen.  It adds a nice zing to a variety of dishes; to season steak & B-que, in spagetti sauce, chili, etc.  Pretty much anything I cook that is beef or pork has some Pappy's seasoning in the dish. You won't be disappointed.

I bought this rub on a whim, which is unusual for me. I'm glad that I did. It's an exceptionally good, well balanced  and versitile dry seasoning mix. I have used it on beef, chicken, salad and soup and it worked on all. Last night, the SO wanted a rub for some shrimp dish and I let her pick from several, all but one of which were my own formulas. She was delighted with the Pappy's Choice. I suspect that I'll be glad to have the full two pounds because it's going to get a lot of use. About the only thing that I cannot see using it for is on desserts.
Rub or seasoning for meat or fish. If you like to grill you should have this seasoning.
I love this stuff! It is an easy seasoning to use and makes meat delicious.
Great rub, great service, arrived in record time. Have ordered this several times it is a favorite of ours!

column9: Great Seasoning Spice for BBQ, Shrimp Skewers and more!
column10: This used to be sold at Costco and was discontinued for some reason, so we searched high and low and finally found it on amazon.  We LOVE this seasoning - it's an all-in-one bottle of delicious.  It makes the flavor pop from shrimp to rib-eye.  You just have to try it, but if you need a recommendation... I give it a thumbs up!

I was introduced to this product by a butcher shop in California. THey would perferate a steak and then place some Pappys on it and put it in a ziplock bag to marinate. It really brings out a good flavor when BBQ'ing the meat after it has soaked up the spices. The part I really like is that it does not contain MSG!

Pappy's is a perfect addition to anything. Especially any meat cooked on the grille. Just enough pop to spice things up, but not too hot or spicy. We shake it on meat before we grill like a light meat rub. Pappy's stays on the meat and gives it a nice flavor.
By far the best seasoning for steak or pork. Ordered extras for family members because they always ask what I used on the steaks. No need for steak sauce with this seasoning.
Love this stuff for steaks and even fish on the grill.  So nice to see it online.  Thought I was going to have to have brother send me up some from Ca. I'm hooked on this seasoning.

I discovered this at Costco also but am now buying it from Amazon. Got some on the way now.I use this everywhere. Steak, Tri-Tip, Hamburger, Pork Chops, Fish and in Soup's and Stew's. I've overdosed a few times and made things a little too salty. So go easy till you figure out the right amount for your application. But they also make a 50% less salt and a salt free version.Thanks Pappy!

I just replenished my supply of Pappy's, having used it for years. I discovered it one day at Costco, but since they no longer carry it I'm glad Amazon does. I'm buying some for my son, who's always asking how to prepare different foods.I tell him when you're grilling, start with Pappy's!
Being a fan of Central California Santa Maria style BBQ I can't live without this stuff. It goes on everything. Especially good as a dry rub for Tri Tip
We use Pappy's seasoning on every kind of meat, fish and fowl. It even peps up the taste of grilled  veggies. We've been using it for years and will continue.

I am absolutely in love with Pappy's spice blends!  They are great on a variety of meats and my family gobbles up anything I BBQ with it. You can't go wrong using this product, trust me!Thank you Pappy's for creating the perfect spice blend!Sincerely,Audra Van Fossen

My neighbor got us turned on to this. We are using it a lot now. We make soup base out of half chicken broth and half pappy's seasoning, then add chicken or beef and cut veggies.  Everyone raves about it, even neighborhood kids. It's different every time depending on what veggies we use.  Famly size soup can be made from scratch for just a few dollars.  Even kids like it. I also use it to flavor steaks and roasts.  This seasoning is a well kept secret.

My nephew in Fresno CA turned me on to this.  Packed some to take home, used it up and glad I can order on line.  We love this on everything.  Other reviews about salt, they do make a low salt version to try.  Great on burgers, steaks...chicken.

column9: Salt, some more salt, and a little bit of spice, somewhere in there?
column10: I put this on some steaks and grilled them, expecting some great flavor. What I didn't realize, was that I had just put on a whole lotta salt and barely any flavor. The steaks turned out to be the saltiest piece of meat I have ever ate. I opened the top of the bottle and looked inside and I actually saw just the crazy amount of salt that is in this thing.(The kosher salt grains are listed as the #1 ingredient on the bottle, meaning there is more salt than anything else in thing thing)EDIT: I have used it since, and much more sparingly, and its usable now. I would still like to get more flavor when using it.

column9: Good seasoning for a lot of things..
column10: Overall this is a good seasoning not only on meats, but I put on fries, mashed potatoes, steamed veggies.. you name it. Someone introduced me to this rub and thought it was ok.. there are better ones out there..

column9: too bad they don't list the ingredients
column10: Number one on the list is saltOh Yeah! Lottsa salt. So much so that it overpowers everything else.WAY too much salt. Eating it straight from the shaker comes to mind.I tried to cut it with about two cups of other spices. No dice.Can't kill the salt.Save your money and make your own.

This product becomes available every Easter and I always purchase them for the kids. The description says it all:"solid milk chocolate bunny made with Cadbury dairy milk"The two keys words being 'solid' and 'Cadbury'Cadbury chocolate is amazing, more milky than most other chocolate.

column9: Excellent if you're looking for a robust chai
column10: The normal Oregon Chai is good, but if you're more fond of the chai that you get at a certain chain of coffee shops that originate in Seattle, you want this chai.  It has the same tingling, almost burning, sensation that theirs does, and it's much cheaper and more convenient.  Just make sure you pick up a pump as well.

My favorite has been the Tazo Organic, which is a little spicier I believe than the Tazo Original Chai.  My understanding is that Starbuck's uses the Tazo Organic.I tried the Extra Spicy Oregon Chai because the price of Tazo Organic concentrate went very high, from $24 to $40 for a 6 pack, well above retail.  I cannot get it locally.This stuff is super concentrated.  I use 2 ounces to make 14 ounces.  The package recommends 3 ounces for 16, and that is fine, though perhaps a little spicy.  I am pleased that I get a great cup of Chai for a relatively low price.  It is costing $0.76 for the concentrate per cup plus the cost of the milk.  I took the every 6 month automatic shipping option to save 15% ($15).To me, at this concentration, it is very similar to the Tazo Organic Chai.  In fact, I recently had a Starbuck's Chai, and I actually preferred my home made stuff to theirs.

This exact product is used at all of the high end coffee houses around here. The taste is very authentic and filled with flavor. The extra spicy has more of a ginger and cardamon taste than the regular chai in this brand. Personally, I grew up on home brewed chai so, for me, this is as close to that as I have tasted and I have tried all of the concentrates available to the public. A 64 ounce jug of concentrate will make 32, ten ounce chais. Of course you can add more or less concentrate to taste. But the recommended ratio is 5:1. As you can see, you can save lots of $$$$. At the prices that you pay around here for chais, I have paid for the jug after 5 chais!

When I traveled to Boston late last summer, the ex and I planned to serve margaritas as a prelude to several dinners for family and friends.  We bought the tequila and the triple sec, and I brought along a large bag of coarse sea salt.  For the limes, I suggested that she buy two 16-ounce bottles of Realime, rather than us doing all that washing, cutting, and juicing of dozens of the real things.That was a major mistake.  On the first night, the cocktails were bitter and insipid.  We raced out the next day to buy some real limes for the other dinners.This product is probably fine if a recipe calls for a quarter teaspoon of lime juice, or if you want a splash of lime on your broiled or pan-fried fish.  But don't use it when lime juice is a principal ingredient.  Bite the bullet and juice the real thing.

This seasoning is without a doubt the best I've ever come across - and the most versatile.  It can be used on veges, potatoes, salads, beef, pork, chicken, fish and probably lots of things I've forgotten to mention.  The flavor is robust yet does not overwhelm the food it's used on.  What more can be said?  Love it!Weber Grill Seasoning, Roasted Garlic Herb, 2.75-Ounce (Pack of 6)

This is one of the most delicious fruit strips I've ever had. Fruit strips are one of my favorite healthy sweet-tooth snacks & I buy a variety of brands. These have much more flavor than the Stretch Island, but are incredibly more expensive, so more of a occasional treat. They do also have quite a lot more Vitamin C than the Stretch Island at the same calorie count, so they are more healthy - but there are only ten per box.

I did not think that the red buffalo chocalate flavored coffee was very flavorful at all. It smells really good, but is definitely lacking in flavor. The coffee tastes good, but it doesn't taste flavored. It is not worth the money.

column9: Better than paying $1 per pack at the corner store
column10: If you love this candy, then go ahead and buy this package. If you have no idea what this tastes like, don't bother. I bought a case because the price of the case versus each pack of candy worked out to much less than what I would pay at the store. The product was fresh and tasted even better than the ones that sit in vending machines for weeks.My only complaint/concern is that I ordered for this product in the middle of a heat wave, and consequently the little jelly candies had melted or burst a little in the bag, so they stuck together. Other than that, it just gave me a reason to eat them sooner.This is a good idea to buy if you want some Halloween candy or something to pack with your lunch as a little dessert.

In 1976 Mars brought Starburst candy (a fruity taffy) to America . These days (2008), Starburst remains an incredibly popular choice amongst tweens. In an effort to draw in more tween consumers, candy companies are offering new creations of old favorites, such as Wrigley's creation of life saver flavored gummi candy, called gummi-saversLife Savers Gummies, Fun Sized Bag, 5 Flavors, 13-Ounces (Pack of 6).Unlike Gummi-Savers, which have remained popular, most of these candy creations usually disappear from shelves after a couple of years (such are lifesaver-holes). I think this candy (Starburst gummi-chews) may go the way of the lifesaver-hole. First, they don't taste anything like Starburst. Second, the liquid candy filling is too sweet. Basically these taste like gummi savers with a Fruit Gushers Variety, 12-Count Value Pack (Pack of 6)gushers filling.
This is a very sweet candy.  It doesn't taste much like Starburst except for the flavor choices, strawberry, cherry, lemon and orange.

column9: First Order, Last Order from these guys
column10: I ordered several boxes of Starburst candies from this business because their website site said "free shipping" for orders over $80. Soon thereafter, I received an email from them saying my order has been cancelled(no explanation why). I go back to their website afterwards and noticed that the price for these candies had risen by $4 per box. Guess they thought they weren't making enough money off of me. I won't be ordering from them again because I don't trust them. Who knows if you will get your order or not. Sorry fellows, but you won't stay in business doing stuff like this.

Keep up the good work. This is the best pepper sauce ever,not to hot but has a definate kick with great flavor. The best ever. We've used this for years(a gift from a child who traveled). So glad to find a place to purchase it.

column9: EXCELLENT!  The Spicy Hot Flavor Never Overpowers The Flavor
column10: I too have been a devoted fan of The Pepper Plant Hot Pepper Sauce for years.  True, it has a spicy hot flavor - but the hotness never overpowers the wonderful flavor this sauce emparts.  Terrifically versatile, I've used it on beef and chicken - even in soups! So if you're looking for a hearty, rich-flavored sauce with a hotness that won't melt your molars, give this one a taste. You won't be sorry.Truly exceptional.

My husband and I love this stuff!  We tried it for the first time about 10 years ago at a small steakhouse in central California.  We have kept it in our fridge ever since.  We used to be able to buy it in the grocery stores in California, but since moving to Arizona we now purchase it online.  We love it with grilled New York steaks.

I first tried this sauce at Nepenthe in Big Sur and absolutely loved it.  I bought a small bottle there, and that was quickly gone once I got home.  I was thrilled to find that I could order it online!  I bought 6 large bottles and went through them in a few months.  Luckily, I was back in CA again a few weeks ago and brought home more large bottles.  But, I know I'll be done with those soon and will order online again!  Also, I'm not the only one that thinks so highly of this sauce.  Everyone that tries it in my house loves it!  Note that I like the other sauces, but don't love them as I do this original one.

I have been using this stuff for over 14 years. Yes that's right over 14 years. I try others but nothing and I mean nothing even comes close to Pepper Plant. I moved from Ca to FL and was really bummed when I could not find this here. I had my mom send me 6 bottles every 3 months till I found it online. Now I buy it by the case. It's got some kick but wont burn your tongue out of your head and has tons of taste( will make your tongue lick your lips looking for more). I have yet to find anything that this does not taste good on. If you want a pepper sauce then look at nothing else cause this is what you have been looking for. Every person I have let try this has swapped over and this is the sauce they all use now. I don't even want to think about them ever stopping making this stuff. Life would just not taste the same.

The best hot sauce you will ever find. I live in Ft Worth Texas, and I always have my father ship me this hot sauce whenever I need it(he lives in San Jose) Now that I can buy it online, I never run out!!! Its a bit expensive here on amazon, but if you look around, you can buy it directly from the manufacturer. You will have to buy it by the case though (12- 10oz bottles) but its well worth it if you use it as much as I do.

I discovered this hot sauce in a small cafe in Big Sur on my way back from Mendocino on my motorcycle.  I usually use the green Tabasco but gave this a try.  I now use 1 bottle minimum per week.  I love mexican food so it goes great with burritos and such.  I now buy 1 dozen at a time.

You really need to try this Pepper Plant Sauce. You can have it with any type of meat or you can add it to almost anything and mix. I really don't like hash browns but I add a little Peper Plant and I eat then all. It's really great stuff, wish more restaurants would have Papper Plant on hand over any other steak sauce

column9: Wake up with Pepper Plant Original Hot Sauce
column10: I first had this wonderful concoction on a breakfast table in Carmel California.  It is a wonderful addition to any egg dish and particularly on omelete's.  Mildly spicy hot with underlying taste of roasted peppers.  I've been buying it in Gilroy California for years until the store closed. This is the perfect online source, and the price is exactly the same.  You won't be dissapointed.  Their Chipotle is milder but also a beautiful sauce for steaks with a slight garlic flavor along with mild peppers.

There is a reason this pepper sauce has garnered nothing but 5-star ratings. It can't be beat. We first encountered this product at the Wagon Wheel in Carmel Valley. It is terrific on eggs and fried potatoes. Fortunately, they were also selling it, so we purchased a bottle to try at home and we have never stopped buying it.Living in Southern Cal, we have not found a source in this area, but it is plentiful in the Central Coast and Northern Cal areas. We buy it by the case directly from the producer at a great price.We recommend sticking with the Original California Style. Have tried the other variations, but the Original is the best. It has plenty of zip, but does not overwhelm your taste buds with heat. The focus is on flavor.

i first tried this hot sauce at a wonderful restaurant on a trip to San Luis Obispo and was immediately hooked!  I desperately asked the waitress where i can find it, contemplated stealing the bottle but thought better of it, and she told me they sell it at Vons!!!  So i picked up a couple bottles of different flavors, and they were spent in just over a months time!  It has that nice peppery flavor that often gets masked with too much spice, when compared to other hot sauces.  The flavor comes out, not just the heat, making this my favorite hot sauce!!!  I like to have it on hard boiled eggs mixed with mustard, i use with any marinade as well to add some heat.

I love this stuff. I first encountered this sauce at "The Lucky Cafe" in Sacramento, CA and couldn't find any where I now live in Oregon. This stuff is available through an amazon affiliate Taylors Market (great people). Go get some and you will swoon.

I order this for my husband and he absolutely loves it.  Anyone who eats with us and tries this sauce loves it as well.  I have ordered before from Taylor's Market and will do so again.  They always arrive quickly and the bottles are well packed.
The Pepper Plant Original California Style Hot Pepper SauceIt's spicy but doesn't burn. My family is hooked, and we put it on everything. Try it on grilled fish for something a little different.

I first discovered Pepper Plant when I was living in Northern California and since then I have relocated to Southern California and now Marietta, Gerogia and each place I have had cases of Pepper Plant shipped to me. This the best hot sauce because of it's flavor and consistancy. It has a thick consistancy, so it doesn't run all over everything, stays were you put it on your food. Eggs, Stews, Bloody Mary's and on meats is all good.

column9: Best tasting sauce we have ever had
column10: We discovered this sauce, the Original California Hot Sauce, while staying at a hotel on Monterey Bay in Sand City, CA in September 2008. We loved it as soon as we tried it. Brought a bottle home and now it's history. Glad to see we can buy more and enjoy our little taste of California again and again.This sauce isn't like other hot sauces where you get an intense burn, it has a nice heat tingle and great taste. We have never tasted a sauce similar to this so we have nothing to compare it too. Try this sauce and we are sure that it will be one of your favorites too.

We have been using this stuff for years even though we have to buy it online. We buy it by the 12 pack and like the other reviewers, it is a staple here - almost it's own food group. For the best nachos - lay out a bunch of Mission Tortilla strips in a toaster (about an inch high), with a "healthy" amount of shreaded cheese on top - toast one cycle, then sprinkle the sauce over the top. The best.

column9: The best hot sauce I've ever had
column10: This hot sauce has a complex flavor that goes with just about everything. I particularly like it with broccoli in cheese sauce! I've also had it on pork chops and buffalo chicken. It's zesty without being a wallop of peppery heat. Highly recommended!
This hot pepper sauce maybe among the best in the market !!Excellent with meats , seafood.

I tasted this at the Olive Pit in Corning, CA on an olive burger this summer and I couldn't get over it.  I eat a lot of hot sauce and I believe this is the best I've ever tasted.  It is now a staple in my fridge.
Oh man!  There is not much to be said about this sauce apart from Wow!  The Pepper Plant Hot Sauce - 'Practically Perfect Hot Pepper Sauce' - does anyone have a straw?

column9: Best Pepper Sauce in the World!
column10: I've been using Pepper Plant ever since I attended Cal Poly on the Central CA coast in the late 90's.  I usually order it now in bulk and pass it along to friends.  Every single one of them has become a convert and we are all addicted!  I'm not sure I could live without this sauce.  It is amazing on nachos, breakfast burritos, in chilis, you name it!For those of you that may be a little timid to try a "hot sauce"; this is definitely the sauce to try!  It is spicy, but the flavor is so full and bold that you'll forget about the "hot."I would recommend this product to anyone wanting to try a hot sauce.  It really is the best sauce on the market.

This is the most flavorful sauce with great consistency.  Not watery or vinegary.  Could almost be used as a thin salsa, but it is great on eggs, burgers, and anything else you might put hot sauce on.  I buy it by the case now.

I tried this sauce at a restaurant and was immediately hooked. The sauce is no ordinary hot sauce. It does pack a little bit of spice, but what really does it for me is the hints of garlic. A good purchase to add to anyone's hot sauce collection.

This hot sauce is most unlike any other sauce I have ever had. It is chunky and thick and really a cross between a hot sauce and a salsa. The flavor is phenomenal. It is to "too hot" but has enough kick and flavor to make just about anything taste better. There is just enough garlic in the sauce that you can taste it, without garlic dominating the taste. I use it more like most people would use ketchup. It's great on eggs, omlets, pizza, or even pasta.  I just wish they had a slightly larger bottle. I go through about a bottle every 1-2 weeks!

I was recently gifted my first bottle of the Pepper Plant Original CA style hot sauce. Good garlicy/chili nose when opening the bottle. The chili flavor is very present (2-star heat), followed by the garlic. Balanced "heat" & flavors. Not too vinegary or salty. It reminds me of a "Southwest Sriracha". Makes a good everyday table sauce.

column9: Truly the best hot pepper sauce around!
column10: This has to be my favorite type of hot pepper sauce. The problem with it is that I go through it too fast! Some people might find it to be too salty compared to other hot pepper sauces, but I enjoy it and wouldn't change a thing about it. It has the perfect blend of spice and heat, and goes great on everything. Do yourself a favor and give it a whirl!
Hands down my favorite sauce, especially for Mexican food, eggs and stews. It has become a staple in our kitchen.

Taylor's Market is the best.  This product is versatile and a medium heat.  Goes so well with odd things, like baked potatoes, fresh trout w/lemon and pepper, nachoes, chicken wings galore, barbecued hamburgers.

I love hot, and I love this great tasting Pepper Sauce.  I can't buy it in the store in Reno, so I buy it online!  I went through my first bottle in 2 weeks because it's great on everything!  I am buying and giving to my friends and family as well.  We are hooked, and wish I could buy it in the grocery store because I can only buy it when I'm buying something else from Amazon, because I refuse to pay more for shipping than I do the product!  It would be 5 stars if the shipping were free!
I use this prod on chicken,burritos,eggs it has a great taste cant get enough of it you should try it for your self.

The product is awesome, I moved out of California and could not purchase it where I currently live.  My husband loves it so I was so thrilled to find I could order it on Amazon.  I gave him a case for his birthday.
Since my daughter moved to the east coast - she can't find her favorite hot sauce!  So - Amazon supplied the means of getting it to her - and she says it is great as always!

I love me my hot sauces, but I am often disappointed by sauces that go for pure spicy kick at the expense of flavor. This sauce, however, has the most amazing balance of spice and flavor of any sauce I have ever tried. A little tart, but not too vinegary. A little smoky, but doesn't taste like it had artificial smoke flavor added. Good amount of spice warms the tongue but doesn't kill the taste of the rest of the sauce, or the food. Although I've lived in California my whole life, I only discovered this stuff recently, but I am committed to keeping it around my kitchen from here on out.

Being from the central coast Pepper Plant sauce is EVERYwhere. On most restaurant tables, stores, etc. I love it. I make a wicked carnitas style pork using just pepper plant sauce and my crock pot. It's also really good on chicken. If you think the original sauce is good, try the Garlic version. It's supreme! and makes yummy buffalo style chicken wings!

I'm not generally a fan of hot sauces.  However, when I initially came across this in a diner I gave it a sniff, and it smelled promising.  It was quite good with my steak that morning.  Now that I have it at home, I will admit it's a touch salty, but the flavor is quite savory in comparison to your run-of-the-mill hot sauces.

We first tried this sauce in July when we stopped for lunch at Big Sur, as we drove down the coast road. I was amazed at the unique taste. It is rich, a little bit spicy, and unlike any other pepper sauce I've tried (I love salsas). We bought a couple bottles for home, but they didn't last long. This stuff goes great with eggs, chicken, vegetables, etc. I've never seen it in a local store in southern California, and wasn't planning another central Cal drive, so I was very happy to find it available online. I ordered it with a couple other items from Taylor's market. On my first order, they made a mistake on one of the items, but told me to just keep the mistake and then quickly sent the correct item.

The California Style Hot Pepper Sauce is perfect for my palate. It is not industrial strength hot but a perfect blend of taste and spice easy to enjoy. Unless you insist on "napalm in a bottle" you will like the middle of the road flavor.

column9: This was very tasty but way to fatty!
column10: This rack of lamb cooked up beautifully and tasted terrific (with a whole lot of herbal rub plastered all over it) but it was just WAYYYYY too fatty.  The amount of grease coming off of it astounded me. I did let it rest on a rack after cooking it so I could eliminate a lot of the grease but there was a whole lot more on the meat itself.  I chaulked it up to a really nasty, fatty, horrendous meal that I allow myself to eat once a year because it really does taste great but is just so unhealthly to ingest. Usually I reserve this once a year deadly treat for eating fried clams .... but......not this year.  I will not ever be buying nor recommending this lamb product!

This is not for the faint at heart. Use sparingly till you find how much you can tolerate. Trust me its extremely hot. One note.... the after taste is a bit different. I wouldnt call it bitter. Maybe call it a dull taste. I have found that the dull taste disappears if used with other strong flavors ( not nessesarily hot ones) Those additional flavors mask that kind of dull taste of the Ghost Chile flakes. Curry or Cumon are great spices to use with the flakes. Good luck.... check your will before your try this!!!!
Just licking the dust off of the freshness seal set my mouth on fire! These aren't the sissy hot pepper flakes you find at a pizza shop.
This is a great Hot pepper  the Ghost pepper has a unique flavor other than just being hot  and the heat creeps up on you after a little while

I have an extremely picky yorkshire terrier, and he goes nuts over these treats. I have his full attention during training if I use these.One comment: the treats are too big for my dog (he is four pounds). I broke them up with a hammer to make them small enough. On the positive side, that means that one bag lasts forever.
I have two Bichons and they absolutely loved these.  I gave four stars because I wish the price was lower.  With two dogs one package doesn't last long at one a day.
We found that cutting up the sticks and add them to our dog's wet dog food for dinner she will eat them.

column9: Inconsistent Product with Terrible Customer Service
column10: We have purchased this product before from the same seller (AWORLDOFPUPS) and received a wonderful dog treat that was soft enough to break into multiple treat size pieces. My puppies absolutely loved them. We ordered another batch when we quickly ran out and this time we received very hard, dry sticks that would snap in half with a great deal of pressure but did not appear to be safe enough for my 20lb puppies to eat. We did give them one half of a treat each and were amazed at how LONG it took them to chew threw this small piece of treat. These are dogs that usually can chew through anything quite quickly. I held off writing a negative review until I heard back from the company. However their policy is that I must pay for the shipping on the return and I can not return anything opened. After numerous emails back and forth they appear to be unconcerned (at least they have not commented on) the fact that this particular bag appears to be defective and unsafe for consumption. The lamination on the bag itself arrived peeling. Upon closer inspection the product is made in China so the lack of quality control is not surprising, however the lack of concern and willingness to take responsibility by the seller is. We will be looking for new treats elsewhere. We are very disappointed; the first batch we received was great. I'm giving two stars instead of one because the first bag was fantastic as were the other treats in the same collection.

The minute i opened the box, i knew i had bought the wrong item. My dogs don't like this item, probably because it is very hard and my chihuahuas have very small teeth. So i'm sorry but i won't buy this product again unless i get new dogs.

column9: Long ship time, but great product!
column10: This took an extremly long time to get after I ordered it, but my puppy absolutely loves them, and they are very healthy for her bone and joint development! Less likly to choke on the sticks they are softer than the jerky, but she loves all the Loving Pet products, even the jerky, but reccomend keeping a close eye on them with the jerky. Great all natural product line!

My dog loves these but they are made in China.  I need to read where her treats are from as she has kidney problems from the last time all treats and foods were recalled because of being made in China.  Her food has always been homemade but she likes her treats. This is the only reason I didn't give it an excellent rating

column9: I hammered a nail in with one of these!!!!
column10: Package claims these treats are soft, marketing towards very young and senior dogs.I used the treat as a back up hammer!!!!!  Three different packages, all with the same results.I expected "Gourmet Treats" were just that, based on the cost.....Buyer beware!!!!

This is a deep, rich coffee that holds up with the largest cup sizing. Not bitter. And I like to brew this on the smallest size to make espresso as its strong enough to be be an easy, passable espresso.

I had a craving for a reuben and am too poor to go to a restaurant. I've never bought this before because sauerkraut in a can seemed gross and perhaps too cheap to be any good. The jarred and bagged brands at my local grocery were too big and too expensive, so I took a chance on this. It turned out just fine for my purposes and I will surely buy it again. It seemed a little more sour than other brands I've tried (but I could be wrong - I only buy it every few years). It seemed maybe a little less crispy, but it wasn't too soggy or anything. I was pleasantly surprised by this product.

When I first opened the bottle it smelled medicinal. I added it to some iced tea and it tasted just like it smelled, very medicinal and only a trace of fruit flaver. I ordered 2 other flavors and they're the same. I gave it an extra star because service is good, but I can't recommend the extract.

column9: Ughhh!  Be warned - don't buy if you want something natural.
column10: If I could give this no stars - that is how I would rate it.  Called extract, but is, in fact, artificial.  Misleading information - no indication in the detail that this is an artificial flavoring - be warned.  Only realised when I actually received the item.  Learn by my mistake.

I ordered primarily peach(16oz) bottle to make ice tea. It had very little peach flavor, and smelled like propylene glycol(the agent they use to carry the flavor.) I added an ounce of flavoring to 1 gal and still didnt get a peach flavor to the tea.The other 3 flavors were also very poor quality. They definitely are not"extracts", so I returned them all.
This product arrived quickly and in good condition.  The flavor is definitely peach and I use it to flavor my tea.
This product worked out so good for me!  I was making Peach Butter and need a little more peach flavor ... fantastic!
It wasn't what I expected, but that was probably my fault.  I just want to flavor non-carbonated water.  I didn't like the flavor when I did that.  I'm sure I'll find another use for it.

These are great candy bars. We can't usually get them on the West Coast, here in CA, so that is why I ordered some online. They are my husband's favorite. I got him the box for Christmas. The price was good and the candy is fresh and delicious. I definitely will buy from this seller again and recommend them.

I would like to thank you for having my favorite childhood candy, Zagnut.  It has been more years than I care to say that I have had Zagnut.  I got my 26 year old nephew and 15 year old niece to like the Zagnut.  I had seen the candies from the time of my parents and unfortunately neither are here to have me order the candy for them.  I plan on ordering more Zagnut and other products from Amazon.
This is the best coconut juice I have ever had, great taste, natural.  No sugar added.  I drink this coconut juice after yoga practice and during my long driving time.

column9: Clean sweet flavor without off colored aftertaste
column10: I like the clean sweet flavor of this coconut juice. No off flavor aftertaste. I've probably tried 90% of all coconut waters commercially available in the United States. I usually rate them by garbage, bad, okay, and superior. This coconut water would fall under the superior category.

I purchased these for our overweight dog based on vet's recommendation.  Cut back on food and give her green bean's as a filler.  (Who knew dogs love green beans)?  I paid about $.60 a can!  Don't think you can beat that price and UPS puts them right at your front door!
Every can in the case looked as if it had been drop kicked and thrown. Had I known this would be the condition I never would have purchased it.
Upon reading the reviews for this product, I was excited to try them. I was sadly disappointed. The honey sesame roast tasted burned. I was not impressed with any of the varieties.
I think sassafras is very underrated.  This candy is very good.  If you like sassafras and / or rootbeer I highly recommend that you try this.

These are great, the perfect size and gluten free. I keep one with me always for those times when you feel like you're going to kill someone if you don't get some food soon. Preventing murders everywhere. Deliciously.

My daughter is 1 year old and LOVES these! She can't get enough. Perfect size for her and great as a snack to take on the road. My only complaint is that they are very sticky and when I break off pieces for her, if she drops any of it, it STICKS. So I have little bits of theses bars stuck all over the place, but she loves them so we keep buying them!
Junior size Bumble bars are just right to stave off  an energy drop.  Fewer calories and great flavors.I carry these with me all the time.
My three year old daughter loves these.  I eat the larger ones and I got these smaller ones for her.  They are a perfect size for her tummy.  She thinks they are cookies!
I have been a fan of Bumble Bars for several years.  The smaller junior size is very convenient and quite nice as an afternoon snack.
Wow, these got stuck between every tooth in my mouth but were very tasty and amazingly filling for how small they are.  Brush well and they are good.
My little yorkie loves this food. He has allergies, and when he eats this food they seem to improve. I do have to crush them into smaller pieces for him though.
This was a gift to my brother-in-law.  A true New Yorker where pepperoni wins hands down.  Have not heard from him yet but I am sure the product is good.  Arrived in a fast manner and well packed.
Really good , has a different taste then most, could see how many people wouldn't like it. Yes i really like it.

It started in middle school, everytime we went on a class trip I got a bag of circus peanuts for the ride. Twenty years later, it is a C-stop necessity! They are just as I remember, chewy and chock full of sugar. Sathers is the only!

column9: Not as good as Bigelow Fruit & Almond
column10: Not as good as Bigelow Fruit & Almond. It tasted more like apple than anything else. Also this is a loose tea but in one part of the description it mentioned bags. I have the stainless loose tea thing so I had no issue w/ it being loose. Just not as Almond tasting as Bigelow which you have to buy in bulk from Bigelow directly now.

We ordered this arrangement and it was beautiful. Great colors, fresh flowers and delivered early in the day so the recipient could enjoy all day long. Excellent service.  Will definitely keep using this seller in the future.

I was so happy with the flowers that arrived today for my aunt.  The flowers were so beautiful!  I received updates consistently so I didn't even have to follow up.  The flowers got there at exactly the right time.  I couldn't be happier with my order. Flowers - Fields of Europe Arrangement - Large

1-800-flowers.com RUINED A 90TH BIRTHDAY gift!! I ordered flowers on Tuesday for a Friday delivery for Mom's 90th birthday party.  Due to health issues my husband and I were unable to travel so we ordered a flower arrangement that was made to look like a birthday cake with candles.  The ad listed the flowers as available for next day delivery so I assumed that meant something like this was kept on hand.  I ordered the arrangement 3 days in advance just to make sure (or so I thought) they would be there!  I looked at several flower sites and we liked the colors and flowers of this arrangement the best.  My brothers and sisters were giving Mom a party at the apartment complex where she lives so since we couldn't be there I thought this would at least let them know we were there in spirit.  I got a call Friday afternoon from customer service telling me the flowers could not be delivered.  They said they could delivery some flowers Saturday, but not the flowers I had originally ordered.  I ordered 3 days ahead of time!!  You would think if they weren't available they would call prior to the day they were supposed to be delivered?  That way I could have made other arrangements.  I would have even considered picking out something different if that meant getting them there ontime.  The site says "100% satisfaction guaranteed".  I am not at all satisfied because what good is it to have flowered delivered the day after you need them???  They are supposedly crediting my credit card but they didn't know how long that would take.  I will definitely be writing more if that doesn't happen.  I have bought many many flowers online and never had a problem until now.  I am very dissatisfied with 1-800-flowers.com and will make sure everyone I come in contact with will know they are not reliable to get flowers there ontime!

"My experience with the seller was outstanding. The arrangment arrived the day I had chosen, and my mother was both surprised and thrilled to receive such a beautifully creative arrangement. The flowers were very fresh and plentiful for the price. I will definitely order from this seller again!"

I've ordered this arrangement many times for a number of people including; mother, step-mother, Grandma, aunts, father, people recovering from operations.  They all say the same thing: it's beautiful.

3 orders not one of them good!  First roses sent to me (day after my 2 orders), mailed to me even though there are florist who work with them in town.  110 degree heat the boxed flowers have no moisture inside - no water caps or even moist towelettes just cut flowers open on the ends with a plastic open wrap around the top.  Well they were wilted, brown and gross!  Smelled of MOLD!  Called they fed ex'd another batch, mold free but tired looking never really looked any better after water.  Local grocery store better flowers at 1/3 cost!  2nd order I made for relative.  Days later got a call that they can't fill the order as requested, made changes to order supposed to get gift certificate for the problem.  Just found out the order never arrived - from the intended recipient!  Called them, all of the sudden emails arrive (while i'm on the phone) saying they have a problem and I need to contact them (after the delivery date)  the emails have a date stamp when they were sent but the typed in date was days before - really?!  How moronic, I can tell when you sent the email - it has a date stamp!  Anyway they claim they tried to call and left messages - I have caller ID and voice mail - THEY DID NOT CALL!  So no flowers for my relative oh but they will mail something (of their choosing) out today for them - gee thanks late and lame Hope it's not a funeral wreath.  They missed the b-day so now it just doesn't matter anymore.  Plus that gift coupon for $20 they were 'emailing' oh well now when I ask where that is - oh well I guess we mailed it and you will get it in about 6 weeks.  Seriously???  How are you sending it? Pony express?? Is someone walking it to me??  They failed, lied and tried to make it look like they did what they said.  Unbelievable!  Oh but we are not done...  Order number 3 (made at same time as order 2) I though i better ask if that one delivered ok...they say 'What order?'  They claim they have no order.  It's on the same receipt as the previous one - paid the same time.  They totally missed that one but they won't even refund my money until I send them a copy of my receipt. MY RECEIPT?  Are you serious, they don't have a record of it ?  I paid with paypal, they have that and with the order number they should have the original full order that includes all this mess we have been dealing with for the other one.  Never in my life has a national company so screwed up - repeatedly.  The only orders these morons can get right are the ones that actually make it to a good local florist then anything that goes right is the florist not 1-800-flowers.Do yourself a HUGE favor - find the nearest florist or floral department in a store (many will deliver), call them and place your order - any online map service or phone service will help you.  Do not ever use 1-800-flowers!!!

column9: Ehh....I could have matched the bouquet better if I'd have done it myself.
column10: I ordered the large version of Fields of Europe, the orange rose version. While the flowers are "close" I really didn't want pink roses. If I wanted pink roses I would have ordered that bouquet instead. I was hoping for something that really popped of summer, not a springy love bouquet. For the price, they should send you what you order and not just make it up and hope for the best. I've ordered lots of flowers through 1800flowers and I think from now on I will find someone else! Just disappointed that something that cost $75 would come looking closer to what I was wanting.

FALSE advertisement alert!  Amazon deal for $15 voucher for $30 credit at 1800Flowers, does not list the $20 service fee!!!!!! This company does not offer full disclosure of billing.  Use with caution!!!

I ordered the 50 blossom rose bouquet for my husband's birthday.  The flowers arrived on time, but in poor condition.  They were tiny, dried out, and several of the buds had fallen off the stems.  I'd have done better at the local supermarket.

I have been feeding this to my sled dogs for about 6 years now. They all have done great on this. Packed full of nutrition so they don't need to eat a lot and they maintain a good body weight. I would recommend this product for any sporting dog.

We purchase the small cans to give our fussy dog just the right size serving for breakfast. I worry that this company might change their formula one day. Tip for fussy dogs? Start with this product or a treat and then see if REX will switch to a top dry food. Our dog eats this and then wants something else because he is still hungry (OK, yes, I did switch to dinner). Keep mixing the variety for REX, the spoiled. and even offer a few different dry selections to MR. FUSSY. Do not try to just feed Mr. Fussy duck. Mix it up.

column9: The best raw hide chews I have found
column10: I love this brand of chews for my Shih Tzu. They do not come apart easily so she really just chews on one for hours. Other brands that I have purchased in the past break apart and she chokes on them. Some other brands she actually tries to swallow whole, but not with these. She just chews on them and bites off little pieces at a time. I will not give her any other raw hide chews. These are the best.

I live with about 1000mg a day of sodium in my diet.  It is crucial that I stay within my limits or else I suffer the consequences the next day and it's not pretty.  Mrs. Dash seasoning, especially the Fiesta Lime, I've found is one of the best seasonings I've come across so far.  Light, spicy and flavorful.  Try it you'll like it.

I got hooked on these babies when I was stationed in Japan 40 years ago.  They are addictive....  Try them once and you will be hooked.  The delivery was quick and the product was as advertised.  I would buy from this vendor again.
baked, tastes like shrimp, and so much better then a regular potatoe chip, they're extremely addicting so be warned. But they taste amazing and go really well as a side with some ramen.

These are great when you are looking for something other than your average potato chip. They aren't too greasy and they are full of flavor. Add a  Ramune drink (Japanese soft drink...I like the lychee fruit flavor) and you've got a delicious snack!

Two good things are apparent about these snacks right away, they arent round like the typical chip, but are more shaped like 'fries' making them easier to eat; and you can clearly taste the shrimp flavor but it's more delicate than some snacks, so the taste is not over whelming or too salty- even though there is some MSG included on the ingredient list.  The consistancy is also quite nice, there is a crunch to them, but the chips arent so hard as if you're chewing glass or some foreign matter; eating these won't make sensitive teeth hurt. They also come in a four ounce bag; enough to satisfy but not make you feel bloated and easy to count calories if you care about such things.  If you like your snacks with a seafood taste there really isn't a downside to this brand.  Enjoy.  Hope this helps.
It's hard for me to limit myself to one bag per day. Extremely good tasting and a bag feels as if you are eating more than four oz. Hard to describe the taste but much better than potato chips.

I was debating on whether to share my first bar with a friend because I wasn't so hungry at the time.  We were in a walmart waiting in line to purchase the delicious Kinder Bueno.  Upon hearing our dilemma, the lady waiting in line in front of us told us that it was imperative that we get our own bars because there wasn't enough in one bar to share.  Based on her persistence, we both got our own bars and have never looked back since.  Thank you Kinder Bueno!

column9: Dog consumes it like Kibble Crack!
column10: We got a 6oz sample in the mail.  We use them as treats for our 10 pound, 13 year old miniature fox terrier. She still eats them like they are kibble crack. column10: Around three years ago me, my college room mate Kenny, and my girlfriend went on a cross-country roadtrip to hang out in Kenny's uncle's condo at a ski resort during the summer.  Now, Kenny's uncle Rodney is a weird dude to be sure, and in retrospect we should have known something was up when he invited three college students to stay with him in the wilderness for a week, but at the time we were just excited for an adventure and a free place to stay.  It took us almost a whole day to find the play when we got nearby; it was in the middle of podunk nowhere and there was nobody to ask directions of because the ski resort was deserted during the summer.  By the time we got there it was already dark, but Rodney welcomed us and provided us with booze.  We were content until we realized that we were starving, that Rodney's condo was out of food, and we were all too smashed to go get any.  I was distraught until he assured me that "there would be plenty of food tomorrow," while discreetly watching Angela (my girlfriend) out of the corner of his eye.  Soon, we were all passed out in Rodney's guest rooms.  I distinctly remember Angela getting up in the middle of the night to go to the bathroom (I assumed), and thought no more of it until I awoke at 4:00AM alone, and the bathroom was empty.  I went and found Kenny, and hungover and starving we went in search of the two missing members of our party.  It was dawn when we smelled it: an unearthly aroma wafting through the house and tempting our taste buds.  The smell got stronger as we approached the boiler room door in the basement.  We began to open the door when Suddenly Pasta Salad! The entire room was filled with it!We never saw Rodney or Angela again, but we visit that condo for the pasta salad in that delicious room every summer.

column9: really good tuna; wild caught off Thailand; "good alternative" according to Seafood Watch
column10: I often need fast protein & I find this tuna to be the answer; it is delicious, not fishy like Trader Joe's tuna.I looked up the best sustainable canned tuna choices, since I love tuna, and hope to not eat unsustainable food ... a website I like & trust is the Monterey Bay Aquarium's Seafood Watch site; I consult it before buying seafood, and they give Tongol tuna, wild caught off the coast of Malaysia to be a "good alternative" - this Natural Sea canned Tongol Tuna is wild caught off the coast of Thailand - so enjoy a safe pleasure![...]Tongol TunaMost tongol tuna is ranked as "Avoid" due to high levels of bycatch and poor enforcement of fisheries regulations.Consumer NoteTongol is typically marketed as either tongol tuna or canned light tuna, and is gaining popularity as a slightly moister alternative to albacore (white) tuna.SummaryUnlike most other commercially caught tuna species that travel the world's oceans, tongol tuna is "neritic," meaning it favors nearshore waters. It's found in the Indian and Western Pacific Oceans.Over 90 percent of tongol tuna in the market comes from four nations: Indonesia, Iran, Malaysia and Thailand. All have numerous management measures in place to help protect tongol tuna populations; however, Malaysia is the only one that also has adequate enforcement. For this reason, tongol tuna from Malaysia is ranked as a "Good Alternative."Tongol tuna is caught in a variety of ways. Gear such as trolls, handlines, or pole gear is more selective, and tongol tuna caught these ways are "Good Alternatives."Tongol tuna caught using all other gear (including gillnets and purse seines) has high bycatch of sharks and juvenile fishes and is ranked as "Avoid" - unless caught in Malaysia, in which case it's a "Good Alternative."

Excellent product.  I ordered the Key Lime.  Though it is extremely concentrated a little goes a long way.  Made a great Key Lime Pie.  Only complaint is the shipping.  The shipping is more than the product itself.  Probably won't order again.

I used it to make white chocolate raspberry cheesecakes, raspberry vinaigrette, raspberry mousse filling for cake and an accompaniment to flourless chocolate cake and lemon pound cake. Whether you like the basic fruit smoothie or a gourmet fruit based sauce -- this is a gourmet item in its simplest and finest form.  I have also tried some of the vegetable items as well.  Good too.
...maybe at half the price and shipped better. We got mostly Kale crumbles :(These were hot but just a little, good flavor though.

This is one of my favorite teas. I enjoy the smooth taste and especially being able to taste the  cinnamon.

I've been a chewing gum addict since high school, but have decided to avoid aspartame.  Imagine my dismay when I found that every gum at the grocery store and warehouse store contained it!  Happily, I discovered this gum at a local health food store.  The gum is flavored with natural ingredients (Fruit also contains artificial flavors), has no food coloring, and is sweetened with Xylitol (a natural sweetener with oral health benefits).  The flavors are delicious (I like to chew one Green Tea with one Cinnamon), and Amazon's price is awesome compared to $2 for 10 pieces I paid at the store.The flavors do not last as long as gum that contains aspartame, and I miss having a gum wrapper in which to dispose of my old gum, but I love being able to enjoy gum without worrying about my health!

Been chewing this gum for years, very good taste on all 5 different ones and as other person said flavor doesn't last long as aspartame gums but it doesn't totally disappear in minutes like some other gums.  i buy at whole foods but soooo expensive so this price on line is much better.  i have 4 kids and we will go through 4 bottles a month easy but it' sbetter than chewing the aspartame crap that everything else has.  the green tea flavor is pretty awesome and so is the fruit.

column9: I like it a lot and it work for what I purchased it for
column10: I purchased Spry at the recommendation of my dentist to assist with dry mouth(not to be confused with cotton mouth :P, but I am sure it could help with that too).  I am not a big gum chewer, but decided I would like this better than the mouth wash, which I have tried.I like all the flavors of this package.  I try to chew on a piece after eating/drinking anything, but usually at least twice a day after a meal. After using Spry, I have noticed a significant improvement from before trying Spry. My teeth and mouth feel cleaner longer than with just regular brushing.  Additionally, dryness isn't nearly as bad as before.At first I thought the price was a bit high, but I don't feel that way anymore. Is cheaper per piece than many popular gums. You don't want to buy this with the impression that it can replace your typical chewing gum.  It wasn't designed to be a long lasting gum.  However, I haven't had any problems chewing on a piece of Spry for up to 20 minutes(direction say to chew for 5 minutes) and it didn't start to break down or taste bad.I recommend this product.

I think the price is also great.That being said, I will be trying other brands and options before buying this again.  The flavor lasts right around 30-45 seconds of normal chewing.  I usually pop in a new piece every few minutes depending upon my mood.  Sometimes I'll chew up to 10 pieces in a 30 minute timeframe.  I like to have flavor for at least a few minutes and this gum does not do this.Initially when I tried these, I would have given them 4 or 5 stars.  But now that I'm so used to the flavor disappearing on me quickly, 3 stars is the perfect rating for me.I would maybe buy again.  But I'll be trying some mints and other brands before I do this.

I never realized that my little headaches were cause by anything. I guess I thought the chewing of the gum and the caffeine from the sodas caused them, plus they weren't terrible headaches. But now I am headache free! Such an easy little change improved my quality of life. I would recommend this gum to anyone! It tastes really good, and all my friends that have tried it, like it. The only downside is it can get tough, but I don't mind. I only chew it to freshen my breath. I don't think it's a good gum for exercise.

if you have children. Everyone gets there own bag and there is no hassel. Kettle corn is the best flavor.

Mate is actually not tea but a tea-like beverage originating from Argentina and Uruguay, and primarily consumed in those countries as well as in Paraguay and southern Brazil; brewed from the dried leaves and stemlets of the perennial Yerba Mate tree. Its name derives from the quichua word "mati" designating the gourd in which it is traditionally served. On average, 300,000 tons of Mate are produced each year.In its consistency similar to green tea, mate has a distinctive, full, bittersweet flavor with a note of alfalfa, resembling that of tea but milder. Of the 196 volatile chemical compounds contained in Yerba Mate, 144 are also contained in tea. Knowing its manifold health benefits - among the plant's ingredients are the alkaloids xanthine, theophylline and theobromine as well as vitamins C, E, several B vitamins and numerous minerals - the South American Guarani Indians have traditionally used the plant for medicinal purposes, inter alia as a stimulant to the central nervous system, to promote mental, physical and cardiovascular activity, enhance resistance to fatigue, reduce fever, mitigate thirst and hunger, decrease blood pressure, and as a diuretic, laxative, purgative, sudorific, and antirheumatic.Legend has it that knowledge of the infusion's powers was first imparted to a young Guarani woman and her father by a mysterious shaman, rewarding the woman's faithfulness in staying with her exhausted father while her tribe continued their search for arable land. In recent years, mate has become a cultural phenomenon throughout large parts of South America, and it is now gaining increased popularity in Northern America and Europe as well. In South America, sharing mate from the same container and the same straw (bombilla) is a symbol of closeness and friendship, both in a family and in other social contexts.

That said, this is hands down the best nationally distributed biscotti I've had.The chocolate is a nice thick coat and the biscotti itself is not too sweet. Just sweet enough to make a nice treat. The individually wrapped packages keep it crisp without letting it get too hard.Biscotti is twice baked, the second baking gives it the right amount of hardness and people like different amounts of hard. I want a cookie that I can bite into without soaking it for several minutes in coffee by that will also hold up to being dunked. If you are used to very hard biscotti, this may be too soft for your tastes.Nice size, doesn't fall apart in coffee, good amount of chocolate and individually wrapped. These are a good option for people who want a treat on the go with a cup of coffee.

I ordered this product hoping it would arrive in a decent time because I am deployed to Kuwait. I had no issues with shipping and the product arived quickly. Nonni's is one of my favorite cookies, so I really am happy that I can enjoy them here.
package arrived on time but pieces broken and chocolate melted. Price was twice as high as at Costco (too high).  Dissapointed with product.
I really enjoyed the flavor and texture.  The only compliant is the packaging or method of shipping.  Many were broken.  Highly recommend

They come well packaged for shipping, and because they are individually wrapped they don't break and stay fresh for a long time.  The Cioccolati are my favorite for their delicate almondy taste and the rich dark chocolate coating.I've tried a LOT of biscotti from different places like Whole Foods, coffee houses, bakeries, and more.  This is by far the best, especially for dunking in coffee.  Unlike all other biscotti, I never have a problem with these rather large biscotti falling apart.  I can dunk and wait for the last drops to fall before taking a bite and I don't get the end of it falling off and plunking into my coffee to become a sodden mess.  And the coating becomes a delicious liquid chocolate.Compare these to the vanilla and almond biscotti at Starbucks, which always taste like they're weeks old despite being individually wrapped. They are crunchy, tasty and best of all dark chocolaty; and, you don't feel like your teeth are going to break because they are tender at the same time having that delightful crunch.  Did I mention they are about twice the size of a regular biscotti?  Now my only problem is whether or not I can eat them all before they become stale!  Oh, yeh, that's why I buy that expensive Tassimo coffee!
They sent this to me and I never ordered it cause I don't like dark chocolate at all.Trying to send it back to who sent it.

The CK ones are okay, and I thought they would be quite similar -- same bad hydrogenated oils and the reviews.  These are certainly fine for a cupcake. These are very colorful but not the best tasting. I used them for my sons first bday as we were having a very large party and didn't want to buy 20 mini cans but taste wise the quality was not there....the look was great. I'm sure no one knew any better after all frosting fixes all.

The Jimmies had purple in the mix.  That was exactly what I was looking for.  Since we are not planning on eating these (but throwing them instead of rice). I won't know taste.  But color is excellent!

I used these rainbow jimmies for a rainbow cupcake topper and added them to rice krispie treats for my daughter's 6th birthday.  Obviously, it was a rainbow party.  The package didn't look like the picture, but I was not disappointed in the product.  I would buy from this company again.

We chose a Thing 1/Thing 2 theme for our twins' first birthday party, and these sprinkles were the perfect color. They lean more towards turquoise than a true blue, but with our red baking cups, and white frosting, they were the perfect finishing touch!
These sprinkles make a great presentation and are tasty too!  Used them for my french chocolate balls.  Would recommend them highly.
Exactly what I thought it would be. ALOT (more then I will ever need) of pink sprinkles, that taste like... sprinkles!
Great size bag for the price! I am making a funfetti cake with just purple. These sprnkles/jimmies are exactly what I wanted. Although, the color could be darker.

Jimmies sprinkles are the best i love them because they are soft and unlike the other hard sprinkles don't get stuck in your teeth. lol But it was a great buy. You have a better deal here that anywhere else.

Only gripes: the "partially-hydrogenated" ingredient and non-resealable bag.  By the way, the advertised bag looks completely different than the one you get - it's not black.  Tastes like classic Jimmies too and isn't so sweet that it'll over-sweeten your frosting.
