This was perfect for my purposes! I made a personalized "funfetti" cake for a bridal shower for a girl whose colors were hot pink and black, and this was awesome to get it done! Fast shipping too!
I bought these sprinkles for my cupcakes and not only are they gorgeous but you get a lot for the money. The silver is very true to color and they make a lovely accent to your cupcakes.

I bought these jimmies because I couldn't find the needed orange color in any of my local stores.  A pound of jimmies is a lot, but I went through more than I expected, probably half the bag to thoroughly coat a recipe of chocolate truffles.  The taste is, well, jimmy-taste.  My only disappointment/surprise was how short these jimmies are -- about two-thirds of the length of Wilton and CakeMate brands I have in the cupboard.If you need a special color that only CK makes, don't hesitate to get them.-- Debbie Lee  Wesselmann

I just have to find a proper container to put the bag ones in so they are easy to shake out onto cupcakes, as that is what I use them for mostly. I'll check on amazon to see if I can find an appropriate shaker.  I may just buy a smaller one (about 10 oz) shaker and use and re-use that one.  My son and I like them also on ice cream, topped with ready whip canned cream. Gives pleasing texture to  ice cream. Yum!

20 tea bags dropped in one gallon of 100% Pure Aloe Vera Natural Juice with every meal, snacks also ( do not cheat! tastes bitter but works) helps with those hard to lose extra pounds, I saw results after two weeks.

After the grilling season it was not carried anymore.  Then the next year it did not come back Weber had other spices but not the Six Pepper Fusion variety. There were only three (3), left in packs of three (3).  So I ordered two (2), leaving one.  I am enjoying grilling with it again. While traveling in Nepal, I was introduced to full-cream powdered milk. Not only was it great tasting, but was a safer alternative to local supply. Since returning to the United States, it has been IMPOSSIBLE to find! Yes, plenty of the poor tasting low-fat varieties are in every supermarket - but no full cream anywhere!Some months ago, PEAK Dry Whole Milk became available through internet suppliers. Four cans were ordered and enjoyed. The milk has the fine full taste of European dairy products.BEST USE: put powder directly in tea or coffee. Makes your morning brew rich and creamy!Hope Amazon will also offer the smaller cans which are more convenient for travel.

Powder mixes easily when shaken; I found adding more than the recommended 3 tablespoons per 8 ounce of water gave milk a "milkier" taste and helped disguise the dry powder milk flavor you often find in dry milk products.  Best powdered milk I've ever drunk.  When more powder is added to water than recommended on the label (maybe twice as much), and milk is allowed to chill, reconstituted milk tastes very similar to fresh milk, with minimal dry powder milk after-taste.  Highly recommend.  Though wish it were less expensive, would buy again. In disaster preparation and long term food storage, it's nice to have foods/beverages you actually enjoy eating/drinking, rather than just any old thing.

This is, by far, the best whole milk powder on the market. Even immediately after reconstitution it has a fresh, creamy taste and when chilled, is better than many "fresh" milks on the market. It is a bit pricy as milk goes, but no more so than any dried non-fat milk in the market. excellent for when fresh milk is unavailable or for lack of refrigeration. Highly reccommended!

For years, I have missed out on a high quality, digestable, nourishing product.  Drinking whole milk has caused me indigestion, among other things, gas, and weight. My first glass of this milk acted like a probiotic. Milk I had as a child which I had gotten away from.  My food settled down where it supposed to go after my first glass of this milk.  I was so happy with this powdered milk that I would recommend it to anyone. Throw out the lactose milk and get good quality milk. True, it is expensive, but it is worth the cost.  The feeling of not being bloated, not drinking milk with additives and preservatives, knowing that it is nutritious, that the milk comes from the best dairy country, thrills me greatly. I have wasted too many years in getting the best product from Amazon.  This product has my highest recommendations.

I bought Peak whole dried milk a few months ago, and it is yummy and wonderful! While I am lactose intolerant, I take a digestive capsule with lactase and other digestive aids (getting older!) and it seems to work. I use it for my gluten-free oatmeal that only takes a minute of boiling water, add a spoon or two of this, and I am in heaven for a while! Fresh blueberries and again, a heaping spoon of this, a bit of lactose-free milk for liquid, a little sugar- and back into heaven again. I can't tell you how WONDERFUL it tastes after years of  2% milk on everything!

Frankly, I don't care if food is organic, or non-organic, or natural, or whatever. I like food that tastes good. And while I recognize that cookies aren't really "food", in the sense that they're a desert -- and certainly not something you turn to if you're looking for your basic nutrition, I find these particular cookies to be totally AWESOME. I like my oatmeal raisin cookies soft, and that's what these are. Soft, sweet, chewy, superb. I wouldn't mind if they were a smidgeon cheaper, but I would imagine making them organic adds to the cost -- so I blame you danged hippies with your granola-crunchy desire for kumbaya soul harmony when it comes to the sticker shock. Still, they're good enough they're worth it. They'll probably negatively impact my waistline, but as I'm not a believer in reincarnation, I figure I got one shot at existence. May as well take the time to stop and gorge on the cookies.The delicious, delicious cookies.

column9: If you want an old-fashioned, homemade taste in your cookies, Country Choice oatmeal raisin might be your cookie of choice ...
column10: If you want a cookie that has that homemade, old-fashioned taste, Country Choice organic oatmeal raisin cookies will fit the bill.  They are rather pricey, but you do get what you pay for.  These cookies are individually wrapped and that makes it handy to put them in a lunchbox, backpack, or any portable bag.  They are quite soft so you can't expect them to be in one piece if you pack them with solid items like an apple.These cookies are small at just under 3" in diameter, so don't expect you are getting a box of giant sized cookies.  They are great for people who are trying to watch what they eat or are perfect for small hands.  I'll list the ingredients below for people who have special dietary needs or allergies.  All the nutritional facts for this product are on the company website.NOTE:  These cookies do contain egg, soy and coconut ingredients and are "Manufactured on shared equipment with milk, wheat, peanut and other tree nut containing products."Ingredients:Organic Whole Grain Rolled Oats, Organic Sugar, Organic Raisins, Organic Cane Syrup, Water, Organic Whole Grain Oat Flour, Organic High Oleic Sunflower and/or Safflower Oil, Organic Brown Rice Flour, Organic Honey, Organic Coconut, Organic Whole Eggs, Leavening (Baking Soda, Monocalcium Phosphate), Corn Starch, Sea Salt, Organic Vanilla Extract, Soy Lecithin, Guar Gum, Organic Cinnamon

A cookie a day (or 2, depending on serving size) is one of my few indulgences. I discovered the Country Choice line at my local Wegman's originally. Their prices are good, but I think Amazon has them beat for the Oatmeal Raisin cookies.These cookies are individually wrapped. One cookie is a serving, at about 100 cals.I like that the cookie is soft, and the raisins are soft and still moist.I really like that the ingredients are organic.They're good tasting to me, not too sweet, not too anything. Just right.Along with their Vanilla Wafers, and Trader Joes' Almond Windmill cookies (and lately, their Southern Style Pecan cookies), these are definitely in my Top 5 Cookie list.Give them a try by buying a single box locally ... then come back and get the mega pack from Amazon.

These cookies are fantastic! They're not too sweet, and not loaded with chocolate like other products. Tons of chocolate in a cookie doesn't necessarily mean that it'll taste better. I like soft cookies, and these have a nice texture and don't fall apart when I bite into them.

These cookies are delicious.  Not too sweet, and the perfect size for a quick, guilt-free snack.  Convenient to pack in lunches or as a snack at work.  Plus, no ingredients that I can't pronounce.  This is a great, tasty choice when looking for an organic treat.  And the price is a great deal on Amazon!

These are the best organic oatmeal cookies I've been able to find.  I've been getting Mrs. Denson's for years, but they have raisins, without which I can do, and they're very good when they're not too crisp.  But I just saw these at Amazon, and decided to take a chance and give them a try.  I'm delighted with them.  They really are soft, not crunchy, they don't have any raisins, and they're packaged in individual sealed packets.  I've got a new standard cookie!

column4: Joyce L. Thom "Joyce Moxley Thomas, mother, m...
column10: These are soft, individually-wrapped and have only 100 calories!  Great taste, soft, and no transfat!  Great meal replacement.  You've got to try it!

column9: Worst. Cookies. EVER.  *****review for Double Fudge Brownie flavor*****
column10: I actually feel awful giving a bad review to a product manufactured by a company that might be a small, independent operation, but... dang, these are bad.  I checked the label before purchasing them b/c while I am all for the idea of organic, I did not want some crazy gluten-free, vegan, tasteless, saw dust biscuit.  These were neither gluten-free nor vegan, passing the test with real ingredients like whole eggs, flour and real chocolate.  I figured I was in for a treat.  WRONG.  Unfortunately, they are dry (even though they're "soft baked"), and flavorless.  They have that very specific, cardboard, non-flavor that you get with weirdo hippie-food.  (Nothing against weirdo hippies - they're great - it's just that sometimes their packaged food sucks.)Bottom line... if I'm going to indulge, I'd rather eat crappy cookies filed with unpronounceable sludge from some evil multinational.  Truth is, sometimes hydrogenated & high-fructose tastes better.P.S.  Despite the large photo on the large box, the cookies are quite small.  About 30% smaller than pictured.  Not cool.

I really like this cookie. First of all, there is nothing in the cookie that I don't feel comfortable eating. The majority of the ingredients are organic. The taste is sweet, but not overly done. I have the oatmeal chocolate chip and it really fits the bill as a good snack. At 100 calories - its just right.Now, this isn't a meal replacement - it is kind of small so it won't fill you up. But the taste is really good and you can feel good eating it.  Not as sweet as many oatmeal cookies that you find, but you can definitely taste oatmeal and chocolate! I have these on SS. I think they are a good deal for the quality of the ingredients.Ingredient list:Organic whole rolled oats, organic sugar, organic dark chocolate chips, water, organic high oleic sunflower oil, organic honey, organic brown rice flour, organic whole eggs, leavening, organic corn starch, sea salt, organic vanilla extract, guar gum, soy lecithin, organic cinnamon.100 calories4 g fat15 g carbohydrate1 g fiber8 g sugar1 g protein

The cookies taste like the cake snack called Devil Dogs.  They're very dry.  It's probably what chocolate dirt sprinkled with chocolate chips would taste like.  If you like Devil Dogs then you'll probably like these cookies.

In my opinion, these chocolate chip cookies are, by far, the best-tasting cookies I've ever eaten!  They're the only cookies I buy. I really like the soft texture of the cookies, the oatmeal flavor, and the melt-in-your-mouth deliciousness of the plentiful chocolate chips.  In addition, they're made with organic products and they are relatively low in calories (100 for a 23 gram cookie) and saturated fats (only 1 gram per cookie).  My suggestion is to try just one and see if you can resist having another  { : > )

This cookie is somewhat smaller than other individually wrapped cookies.  It is a soft cookie, somewhat more crumbly and a little less chewy than some others.  Like other individually wrapped cookies, it is convenient for a lunch bag, shoulder bag, backpack, or just to keep in your desk drawer.  It comes in various varieties, and I have only tried the oatmeal/chocolate chip.

These cookies have just the right amount of sweetness and a lovely chewy texture. The cinnamon balances out the added sugar and the sweetness from the chocolate chips. It's great that these contain chocolate chips and not the usual raisins because it's unexpected, and it's a bonus for chocoholics looking for something more.

These cookies are OK.  The texture is soft and spongy, not rich and chewy like I would expect from "fudge".  They are probably trying to make the cookies look larger while keeping the calorie count down.

column9: Women's Health names Soft Baked to top 125 list
column10: Country Choice Organic Oatmeal Chocolate Chip Cookies were recently named one of the Best 125 Packaged Foods for women by Women's Health magazine.  The editors were won over by the chewy homemade taste, organic ingredients and portion control wrapper.  The cookies are also made with no wheat ingredients.  Available wherever organic food is sold.

This salt is NOT smoked. Read that again. It is a 2 pound bag of white salt that has a fake hickory smell. It is small crystals, about the size of table salt crystals. My guess is that they tried to infuse flavor into the salt rather than smoking it. The hickory flavor is very faint, and very fake tasting. You are much better off buying real smoked salt, such as Gourmet Hickory Smoked Sea Salt by The Spice Lab Inc. I am not in any way affiliated with The Spice Lab - I bought their salt simultaneously with Faerie's Finest in order to compare the two. Not only is it inferior to The Spice Lab, but Faerie's Finest is the worst smoked salt I have tasted.

column9: Endangered Species Zebra, Organic Dark (70%) Chocolate Tangerine Essence
column10: Its now changed to orange essence and you can really taste the orange, it over powers the dark chocolate flavor making the combination not so great.  One small bite is ok, but a whole bar just makes me sick, even just eating a little square is too stronge for me, but then again thats me.  I love orange and chocolate, they go so great together but this one is just overpowering and doesnt work for me.  My favorite by The endangered species bars is the dark chocolate deep forest mint, that is the best so I would go with that one but stay clear from this one unless you like a very strong orange flavor that overpowers the dark chocolate.  I like just a little bit of essence of fruit or some other flavor in my chocolate but this one just doesnt please my taste buds.

This has no unnatural additives and is organic. The other reviewer may have been looking for something more traditional in chocolate.  If you're looking for something like hershey's, this won't taste like that. This is much more natural in form, flavor, etc.And part of the proceeds go to help protect animals!

First let me say I am a huge fan of endangered species chocolate.  This is my first time however trying this particular mixture.  I love orange and chocolate as a combination but this one definitely falls short.  Unfortunately from what I can gather and the type of bitterness it is I am guessing they add too much of the pith while creating the orange oil.  It has a smooth delightful start but the more you eat the more pronounced the bitter taste becomes.  I am disappointed by the purchase and will not order this type again.

My local health food store has these for $6.89 a bottle... $6.89 x 6 is $41.34, cheaper than the $45.84 directly from the manufacturer, and that isn't even counting the insane $25 shipping cost.Now of course, my local health food store probably isn't anywhere near you, but my point is, ordering this product online seems quite pointless, especially factoring in the shipping, unless you live in the middle nowhere. Considering this is direct from the manufacturer themselves, you'd think the price would be something reasonable.As for the juice, it's quite delicious, and I try to have several glasses a week.

I like the Crystal Geyser 18 ounce water. This is a refreshing water to drink by itself, or mixed with fruit juice. The 18 ounce bottles are perfect to take with you on the go. Crystal Geyser Sparkling water is great to drink if you are trying to cut out soda. It has the fizz you are used to, but no calories. That makes it perfect to mix with juice.

Born in Italy - my parents drank this often after dinner. I do not like black licorice, but like this drink. It's smooth and does burn a bit going down but gives your belly a nice warm feeling after the first, second, etc. Haha. A great (and Italian) way to drink it is to get coffee beans and put 1-2 in with the shot, light it on fire, blow it out (essential part here! LOL) then drink the shot and chew the coffee beans. It tames the liquor flavor and puts a bit of coffee flavor into the drink and your mouth. Have had Romana Sambucca as well but this is our family's favorite!

column9: Good taste but little amount of curry
column10: Tastes just like restaurant red curry but me and my wife needed 3 packets to make enough curry for us.  Boxes are alot smaller than we thought.  I give 4 stars for taste and 3 stars for the amount.

column9: in my opinion Thai Pavilion is best boxed Thai  product
column10: I really appreciate Thai Pavilion's quality. especially when it comes to their sauces. their sauces are just not a watery paste they have real vegetables in them. open up any other thai product and just look at the sauces, I think you'll see literally that Thai Pavilion is much higher quality. taste them smell them. I think you agree with me Thai Pavilion is head and shoulders above the competition. I found this to be true with all their flavors.

The noodles have to be cooked for 10 minutes, and the sauce must have sauteed meat added (according to the package) and would be improved with the addition of some vegetation (according to me).  Therefore this item is neither quick nor complete.  If the sauce was REALLY great, that might make it worthwhile- but it isn't, its just OK.

These are just like any other noodles... the only difference is that it takes twice as much to cook.  The sauce that comes with it is EXTREMELY HORRIBLE.  It tastes so bad that I had to use my own spaghetti sauce.1.  Would I eat the rest I have left?  Only if I'm really hungry.2.  Would I buy it again? No3.  Would I recommend it? No
This is my favorite flavor of all (peach, desert pear and raspberry) the syrups I use for my unsweetened teas.  Great stuff and really tastes yummy!

column9: Really Good Sugar Free Candies - Recommended!
column10: Being diabetic, I am always on the watch for sugar free snacks. The "GoLightly Hard Candy" is a great addition to my snaking list.At only 45 calories and 0 Net Carbs for 4 pieces, these do not impact my blood sugar levels or ruin my diet. These are sweetened with Splenda, so they are slightly less sweet than regular candies, but do not cause the "laxative" effect other dietetic candies can have.There are serveral types of available and they are all good!Highly recommended!

This has all kinds of goodies in it, and I was excited to try it.  I learned quickly that it *needs* a sweetener.  I'll eat plain oatmeal, but all the cocoa in this stuff is pretty awful without something sweet.  I eat this at work, so I cheated and used a flavored coffee creamer, which instantly made any quantity of the stuff pretty yummy.It's good.  It tastes good, it's made of good stuff, and I'm pretty happy with it.It has "WHEAT-FREE" in all caps on the front (along with VEGAN, SUPERFOOD, and some other marketing words), but notes that it's made in a facility that also processes wheat.  I'm not as sensitive as some and more sensitive than others, but I didn't die or explode, so that's good.My big complaint about the stuff is that the nuts and oils seem a little stale.  I hate rancid oil and can pick it out a mile away, so I'm pickier about that than some people would be.  My parents are older now and eat all kinds of things I consider past their prime.  The expiration date on my can of chocolate hot cereal (let's call it what it is:  it's oatmeal with lots of other fun stuff mixed in) is over a year into the future and I've always stored it sensibly, but I'm just not crazy about the quality of the ingredients.  I know the ingredient list is awesome, but they've really suffered from bad storage, old age, or maybe just getting a sub-par crop mixed in.My review is based on only one can of the stuff, so perhaps my experience is unusual.  It's impossible to tell without buying a second can, and based on the too-far-gone smell of this one, I'm not sure that's going to happen any time soon.  If you're familiar with rancid oil or nuts that are past their prime and have a different experience with your own batch of this stuff as you get toward the end of your can, I'd love to hear about it.  This is the kind of food I really *want* to like, as it's convenient for work breakfasts and full of ingredients that should be healthy and delicious.

After reading the 1st review, I was scared, but finally thought, will return if it is outdated (cause this is my 2nd order for same product except it was by general mills). Amazon does not disappointed me. Exp.date is May 2012 ! Happy & suggest to purchase if you have more than one member in your family to finish it (I have two kids & they loved the new Wild berry flavour).

column9: Shocked at the date on the boxes!
column10: In December, I bought the 14 box case of Trix for a Christmas present.  The receiver was appauled that all 14 boxes had expired 3 months prior!  Buyer beware of shopping for food items at this site!

column9: Trix...can get it cheaper at grocery store
column10: Can get it  same or lower price elsewhere...Don't see the point of ordering. Like this then. The other comments solidify this idea.
Less expensive than anywhere in town, plus at my local store, you have to special order these smaller cans. Always fresh and well within expiration dates.

I wish my feral queen with CRF would eat this stuff.  She's so not a fan of her special renal diet foods that I try to give her commercial brands (the ones she can keep down) from time to time just to liven things up for her.  Senior foods are best, because they tend to have lower phosphorus and less protein, with the protein included being of higher quality.  This is great quality food, but it seems to be not very palatable.  Mary-Kate's very finicky these days.  I guess if I had to risk tasting everything twice I would be, too.  But her son, Fluffypants, is usually willing to clean up even the least tasty treats we give his mom.  Not this stuff, though. e stuck his nose in the air and walked away.

After playing sports for many years I thought the "Lace Cover" would save me a lot of electrical tape that I normally use to secure boot laces. So when I saw these I thought what a great idea. Well yesterday they were used for the first time and......FAIL. The Lace Cover comes in 1 size only ( too large for most people ). I have a reasonably large foot ( size 13 US )and although the Lace Cover is elasticized , was reasonably loose fitting. Hence , they never really did cover the laces properly. Then after some scrummaging ( Rugby Union ) , one of the lace covers vanished completely. Although the item is not expensive , save your money. It's back to the electrical tape for me !

Lakewood's ORGANIC 100% PURE Pomegranate Juice is expensive compared to Wild Oats's brand, but it's organic (Wild Oats' is not), and pure pomegranate. The flavor is outstanding, and it come in glass bottles, a definite plus over plastic. Shipping was reasonably fast and the packing was also outstanding. My only complaint: I wish shipping would fall under Amazon Prime, but alas it does not. To me, Lakewood's Organic Pure Pomegranate Juice is the best choice in the pomegranate juice market.

I was interest in this particular brand of juice because it is not from concentrate and I know won't being getting filtered tap water with frozen bits of fruit. Also because it's organic, I know I won't be drinking unneeded chemicals to prolong shelf life. I'm fairly certain all drinks (at least juices) need to be pasteurized if bottled. This is the next best thing to pressing the pomegranate juice in your own home. The taste was delicious and I still drank in the antioxidants and nutrients found in pomegranate. Because I do not have the time or instruments to press the pomegranate myself, this is convenient for me to just pour and go. Although it is a little pricey, I figure my well being is worth it.
Lakewood pure 100% Pomegranate Juice is $9.99 at Whole Foods. Excellent Product  . Amazon should be more competitive on  the Price

I buy this stuff every week at Publix.  I have seen a ton of health benefits and the high potassium helps keep the water weight down.  Also, it is delicious to drink, especially the type with blueberries mixed in.Having said that, I pay $5.15 for a 32 ounce bottle.  $5.15.  Yes, and with sales tax, I'm sure it's closer to $5.75.  Come on, Amazon.  This is a friggin' rip off.

One can buy the same 32 oz Bottle from grocery store for $9.99 thus making a 6 bottle purchase to $59.64 even after paying sales tax it will be much less than $75.36 +shipping. I dont know why would someone buy it from Amazon.
I was getting the Langers fresh pressed pomegranate juice at Rayley's(they recently stop carrying it) for a little over 5 bucks this is 16.67 per bottle...please

This product description does not say whether this product is pasteurized. Alton Brown on Good Eats says that if pomegranate juice is pasteurized you lose a lot of the antioxidant benefits. I would likely change to more stars if it is not pasteurized.

If you are reading this you probably know about Huy Fong, Sriracha Hot Chili Sauce, 17-Ounce Bottles (Pack of 6), which is a great condiment and a must-have at my table. Huy Fong also makes Chili Garlic sauce (i.e. the one on this product page) which is a better sauce to cook with. The blend of Chili & Garlic is a wonderful flavor combination for stir-fries etc. You can also use it as a condiment, although it is not as fine and blended as a condiment sauce. While Sriracha is a great condiment I find that it's not that great for cooking use - the flavor seems to change due to heat. The Chili Garlic sauce is much better for cooking use.I hope you find this helpful!

column9: The best stuff in the world
column10: This is by far the best thing ever!! It taste fantastic and goes well with everything. I found myself making excuses to eat it on everything I possibly could. Personally I find it to be the most addictive thing I ever tasted. The smell alone is reason enough to buy it.

Received this about a week ago and I have already used it in tacos, black beans and rice, salsa and Chinese stir fried chicken and vegetables. The primary ingredients are chili, salt, garlic and distilled vinegar. It does contain preservatives, namely potassium sulfate and sodium bisulfite so if you are allergic to sulfites you might want to avoid this sauce. Be forewarned that it is very potent so a little goes a long way. As with any spice, just add a little at a time until you reach the amount of heat that is right for you. I can't wait to mix a bit in with my pizza sauce. It is a five star sauce but I deducted a star because I think it is rather pricey.

This is a similiar product to one we used to purchase years ago at a speciality shop here in Florida.  We were both thrilled to find it.  It is a great spice for almost anything.  Spicy, but used sparingly, not hot.
This will not "burn out" your mouth. It is spicy with a great flavor. They need to make this in a larger jar!

column9: My new favorite go to hot sauce!
column10: I purchased this at my local grocery store.  I have had the Sriracha hot sauce(Rooster sauce) and like so I thought I would see how this was.  It tastes similar to Sriracha sauce BUT HAS MUCH MORE FLAVOR AND MUCH MORE VERSATILITY.  Don't hesitate to order this, except you should get the larger size.  The 8 oz size only lasted two weeks.  It's now my newest favorite sauce.

The first time I tried this sauce was at a Chinese restaurant. It has the right amount of spice to wake up the tastebuds and kick the flavor,of a dish, up a notch. If you enjoy spicy food, give this a try. I love it!

If you like Asian food, and you like it HOT, this is just the ticket for you.Also good in curries and cajun dishes.Use it to stir fry shrimp, chicken, or beef, or just use it like you would anycondiment like salsa or Tabasco sauce. Amazing flavor, and trust me, this stuffis hot. About a 7 on a scale of 10. Tremendous garlic and hot chili flavor, willmake you discover cooking all over again! This will perk up any Chinese takeout,and its even good in Hot n' Sour Soup! Its very thick, almost like a paste so alittle bit goes a long way. Sells locally here for around $3. 5 Pods

In the infamous words of Sir Glenn Quagmire; "Yes, yes, yes..."  This is really the best hot sauce I've ever tasted.  And although I've only ordered it from Very Asian, they were johnny on the spot with my order.
This is a Must Buy! its very great tasting and its very hot! I recommend this!
I love this stuff!  It is extremely hot and a little bit goes a long way.  My favorite uses are in stir-fries and on burgers.  I suppose it would be good on pizza too.  The uses are endless!
If you want to add a kick to you food try this product.  It's delicious.Be carful though, a little goes a long way!

Huey Fong Chili Garlic Sauce 8 Oz This sauce made of crushed red peppers and garlic is Out of This World! You will find a growing list of uses for it. Add it to Mexican, Chinese, and Italian dishes (carefully its hot!) Or put it on the table so your dinner guests can heat up their dishes individually. If you like spicey hot dishes you will love this chili garlic sauce!
This sauce is delicious. Adds quite a kick to salsas or chilli. It's also good with eggs. Good for people who like spicy food. It has a wonderful flavor.

I just tried this out for the first time, and I am going to make it a permanent part of my flavoring arsenal. It is strong/potent, so use it sparingly. This is a great option for anyone who wants to avoid the sugar content of the more famous 'Rooster Sauce'.

There are a lot of Chili Sauces that I like, and it really depends on what I want to use it for, but when it comes to cooking, this is the stuff. I add it to any meat to make stir-fry, chili con carne, Thai dishes, burritos, etc. It's wonderfully versatile and can be used anywhere that garlic and chilies are appropriate. One of the reasons it's so perfect for cooking is because it's not all heat. You can add a good tablespoon of this to a dish and really mix it in without killing it. With, say, Dave's Insanity Ghost Pepper sauce you get lots of heat in a few drops, which can lead to uneven flavor in the dish.

column9: A good bit of good heat
column10: Great taste and spicey hot. Great on pizza and chicken dishes. I've even used it in soups. Very potent so use sparingly.
Just tried this in a new soup recipe with the miracle noodles and it was soooo good! Use just 1 tsp on a serving, it is very hot!
This is a very tasty product but way overpriced on line.  The sauce is readily available at most markets at a much lower price (much lower).

column9: Savory spicy sauce - a must have for any kitchen
column10: I grew up with this chili garlic sauce. My parents would usually use another familiar Huy Fong product Sriracha for our foods. This Chili Garlic sauce is a whole another level. It is like dog treats for humans. It adds a lot to any dish, whether it's rice, chicken, pork, noodles, etc. The ingredients are mostly natural, which is a plus.Pick a jar up if you haven't already. It is truly a spicy treat.

I love this stuff and add it to all my stir-fries: it's delicious, and not sweet, like the Rooster.  But this is ovepriced.  The same 8 oz. little plastic jar sells for $2.89 at my corner bodega, and they charge a premium for being open 24 hours.  When I make it to a grocery store, the jar is usually $2.29.  So the price here is more than double.  Two stars deducted for the overprice; five stars for the sauce itself.

I was imagining a taste of smoothness (kind of like buttered rum toffee), instead,  bitter tasting.  Aroma was pungent.  It was like drinking rum(and bad rum at that!) without the butter which would have given some smoothness.  I will be throwing out the unopened coffee.

These noodles are the best. I have used them since first trying them about twenty years ago. They have a nice light taste and are not at all starchy. I am just disappointed to have  recently been notified that they are going to be discontinued. I hope that I will still be able to find them somewhere.

column9: the only pasta my italian husband will eat!
column10: My Italian husband likes his noodles; of all that he has tried, ready-made, DeBoles is his preference. And I like the fact that they are made with Jerusalem artichoke flour- healthful AND tasty!

The description on the product page is really spot on. It has a kind of nuttier taste than normal semolina or egg noodles, and is definitely far less starchy. You can overcook it a bit without it getting mushy eaither, which is nice if you lose track of time a little bit. I cant speak to it actually being gluten free. There seems to be some debate as to the accuracy of that, but it isnt a factor for me, so i havent really researched it. One other note is that the artichoke flour in question is actually Jerusalem Artichoke, which is different than the one people are familiar with, and in fact makes a great substitute for potatoes in its natural form. Anyway, this pasta is definitely a worthwhile purchase. Please be advised though....10 pounds of pasta is a large amount. Have something you can seal to store it in if you dont eat pasta every day. It will definitely stay fresh for longer that way.

column9: love the fact I can eat "noodles" again!
column10: These noodles are fabulous!  Even my kids love them.  I'm gluten intolerant and love having noodles back in my life!  These have wonderful flavor and texture and are amazing!
Both steaks in The Celebration are sufficiently large, and the filet is amazing. The strip is good but not great, but can feed two.
The Flavacol Salt has a good flavor! It was very easy to use. We also bought the caramel and chocolate flavoring - which we also like. Shipped on time.

I use this stuff all the time especially now that i am studying 24/7.. had got it at a store locally but was to lazy and shipping was free.  Good price and they dont expire for like 7 months so 48 will be gone long before then!!! thanks for the quick shipping
As good as or better than the tea-bag version. Temperature is always right on with Keurig brewer so no more too hot over-steeping.

I discovered this rub while shopping in Napa;t he saleswoman in the Tyler Florence storerecommended it , along with some of his other flavored rubs.  I bought one bag, rubbed iton chicken and grilled it... WOW !!  Now I use it on lamb, potatoes, vegetables, even fish.It is outstanding... just the right amount of seasoning with dried herbs; it is perfect oneverything.  In November the Thanksgiving turkey will be covered in it.  I ordered 6 bags, along with the brown sugar rub for pork which is alsofantastic.

We have had problems with our cat and her food in the past. She was having a few health issues so with some advice from the vet we decided to go with a more natural food than Science Diet. Like humans natural foods are better because they contain more of the vitamins and nutrients that the body needs. Our cat loves this food. She doesn't get ear infections or have feline acne anymore. She also have more energy and overall happier. The only downfall with it is that it is quite a bit more expensive than Science Diet or the like. However, I would much rather spend a little more for food than pay hundreds at the vet for preventable issues.
but slightly overpriced my one kitty last 3 month more or less with only 2 to 3 pound bags I recently purchased this from petsmart for 8 dollars for a 2 pound bag

column9: Is there mocha flavor in this?
column10: Got the Peppermint Mocha for Christmas and it was pretty good.  The mocha was not overwhelmed by the peppermint and I enjoyed all 32 oz of it. When it was about gone I checked the company's website for info and saw this one.  Peppermint Mocha is seasonal, but still I am looking for Mocha flavor.  White Chocolate Mocha...At the store where I got it they only had the 32oz.  Pulled it out of the cooler and checked the expiration date.  As soon as I got home I put it in the coffee and as I lifted the cup I got a waft of coconut, like I was on a hot sunny beach. The taste also gave me the impression I just took a sip of suntan lotion.  Not enough mocha like the Peppermint Mocha.  The ingredients have palm oil and I checked the Peppermint Mocha and it does too, but I never noticed it.  Not sure if I can finish the other 31.5 oz of this White Chocolate Mocha. One bad post mentions the taste another becauses of shipping, this IMO is another bad for the taste promoted as White Chocolate Mocha on the label. Should have checked the reviews here first...update...tried a little more.  Shook the bottle well. It's better than the first cup.  Still what I taste is a sweetened coconut with a little white chocolate, not the mocha punch that's in Peppermint Mocha.  I'll bump it up a star for the slightly less coconut, slightly more mocha(?) from the first impression.

column9: Tastes like Burned Melted Plastic in your Coffee
column10: I have never met a coffee creamer I couldn't stand until I tried this stuff. It's just horrible...the taste reminds me of how burned and melting plastic smells. I took 2 sips and I was absolutely disgusted. I threw my coffee out and brewed a fresh cup (skipping this awful creamer). I will NEVER buy this stuff again.

column9: Its like mixing paint with your coffee, 1 star, I hate it.
column10: I purchased this at my local store in a quart bottle. This flavor is bad... real bad. I felt like someone mixed paint in my coffee. Something is really off in the flavor, can you call paint a flavor? Because that is what this taste like, and sorta smells like. It has a plastic, weird, chemical taste, not good. I emailed the company, do the same if you bought it and do not like it, they will send you a coupon for FREE creamer. Just trust the reviewers here, don't get this flavor, someone screwed up at I.D. Someone needs to get fired for this or made a janitor. Try Almond Joy, I have been using that for months, it taste the best.

I'm afraid I must agree with most other on this.  This creamer is just awful.  It's like they pureed cardboard and added sugar.  I don't think the people that made it have ever had a white mocha before.

Does not taste like white chocolate at ALL! I just purchased this from the dairy section at walmart. It's terrible. Sucks because i bought a huge size thinking it would be good. hopefully i can return it. thought maybe it was just me since i am new to flavored creamers but i think the votes are in...stay away from this product.

column9: I wish I could give this 0 stars!
column10: My wife is a flavored-creamer junkie, so I have tried a LOT of different creamers, so when I say that this is probably the WORST coffee creamer I have ever tasted, I know what I'm talking about. The chemical aftertaste is so strong, it's impossible to determine what the underlying flavor is. I honestly thought I had gotten a bad batch, but after reading all the reviews here, I realized that is how it is supposed to taste. Several of the other International Delight flavors have a slight aftertaste, but nothing like this!I'm not sure who they had taste-test this flavor, but whoever it is should be tested for brain damage, or maybe they just lost their sense of taste completely.

I just bought this White Chocolate Mocha creamer in the dairy section of my grocery store, and I have to say...it's terrible!! I am so disappointed. I usually enjoy International Delight creamers, but I honestly dont know how this made it to the shelves. Did any of the International Delight workers try it before deciding to package it up and ship it out? It tastes like plastic. And I am very upset that I spent $4 on a 32 oz of this stuff...I wont even use it now. What a waste!!! I would give it 0 stars if I had the option to.

I love white mochas, but this is horrible. I can't even drink it. I came on to see if others felt the same or if there was actually something wrong with my creamer. I guess I'm not alone in thinking this is horrible. I'm calling international delight tomorrow :/ how does a company let something this bad into stores!?!?

This is by far the worst coffee creamer I have ever used. I was at the store and I decided to try a new creamer and I picked this one because I never had international delight before. But this gave my coffee a horrible taste, I had to use at least 1/3 of this to coffee before it tasted kind of ok.

I can't even describe the flavor of this creamer...it's definitely not chocolate or mocha.  It's terrible.  Like others have said, I thought maybe it was expired or may it was just one in the box that was bad.  I tried tasting some of the creamer alone (without coffee) and it was just as bad.  Hopefully the other flavors are better...kind of an expensive way to have to find out by buying a whole box and then not liking it.  Who'd have thought I needed to read a review about a creamer before buying.
This stuff does not taste good at all.  I thought that maybe it had gone bad or something but it's not close to expiring.  Definitely the worst tasting creamer I've had yet.

column9: Nice change to a plain cup of coffee
column10: I hate drinking my coffee black.  These white chocolate mocha singles are easy to keep in my desk at work, they don't need refrigerated unless opened.  I use 1/2 of a tub to a cup of coffee, any more and it's too sweet for me. Until I got the combination right (1/2 tub, 1 packet of Splenda), I didn't care for these. After experimenting some, they are pretty good.  I hope these eventually are offered with dark chocolate instead of white. The more chocolately flavor, the better!

column9: Did i burn my coffee? Nope, it's just the creamer...
column10: Awful, awful, awful. After the first sip I thought I somehow screwed up the coffee without knowing it. I kept sipping, and with each swallow, I realized that it wasn't getting any better. This is the most disgusting creamer I have ever tasted. What a disappointment! The taste reminded me of burnt popcorn covered in moldy chocolate. Gross!

When I received this order, the outside of the box was wet from the leaking contents inside. The creamers were just thrown in the box and were not even in a plastic bag. It was a mess. I had to wash the few remaining creamers that were still in tact because everything was sticky and dirty.  I will not be ordering this item again.
Since I've lived in India and Pakistan; I know chai first hand...this is by far the only best powder form available...my friends all agree.
Great Product, love it!  Add cinnamon to it, and it will taste even better :)

column9: MoCafe Precious Divinity Spiced Chai Tea Mix, 12 ounce tin (Packof 4)
column10: Talk about comfort food and drink!  This is pure yummy at its best!  Pricey...and well worth every penny.  The steamy smell is intoxicating and the taste even better.  After a long hard day...wind down with this marvelous blend of chai spices.  Wow!

My husband and I share a cup of this on a cold day.  We bought it first at marshalls and couldn't find it again.  We were able to get on line and get our shipment every 3 months automatically, this beats driving around looking for it as we have been doing.

I ordered this product for my daughter who LOVES it! We had bought this product at Sam's Club in the past in a larger can, but they have not had it since. So when I found out I could order it online I bought several cans. My daughter drinks at least 1 cup a day of Chai, usually at night after a long day at school or when it is chilly. It is especially nice on rainy days, that chill to the bone, it really warms you up!She always drinks it warm but I have heard it was good over ice as well.

The reason I gave this only 2 stars is not because of the taste. It tastes great! I actually had this at a restaurant for the first time, which is what prompted me to find it online and buy it.But, almost every ingredient is artificial. Hardly anything about this product is something I would willingly put into my body on a regular basis. It's a powdery mix when you open it and pour one scoup into a cup of hot water. It makes you wonder where the tea actually is.I don't recommend this highly processed, chemically manufactured, mostly artificial ingredients, product to anyone. Unless you just don't care what you put into your bodies and just want it for the taste.
My first purchase of this product was made from curiosity. I have been using it for a few years.  I really enjoy it and even share it with my cousin.

I love the Chai latte @ Starbucks.  Since I couldn't find that at a reasonable price in Amazon, I chose to try Mocafe Divinity Spice Chai mix.  To my surprise, it came out really very well.  The Starbucks chai and this one are totally different things.  Both taste good in their own fashion.  Starbucks chai seems watery but this one is the thickest you will ever get.  Mocafe is highly creamy all the way down but Starbucks is not.  This is a powdery product, Starbucks is liquid product.Again, I seem to love Mocafe even though I am a big fan of Starbucks Chai.  I highly recommend this to all the Chai lovers out there.Note: This had a price advantage over starbucks chai when I initially bought.  But I later found that Costco is selling Starbucks chai at a very cheaper price.
I love that I can still have my Chai tea at work and not have to worry about having milk there. Tastes great!

I have a cup every morning!  Cant describe it but it just makes me happy :)  its not too sweet and just the perfect amount of creamy (I mix mine w water)I have been buying this at a local small coffee shop at 13$ per can. I can't tell you how happy I was to find this on amazon for such an amazing price. If you are looking to try a new chai, look no further!

This Chai tea has a delicious flavor.  The only bad thing about it is that it doesn't dissolve completely no matter how hot the water is or how much you stir it, which makes the last 5 sips or so a bit gritty.
We have tried Chai at a number of venues as well as buying various brands to try at home. This is the hands down winner - and company always agrees. Cannot recommend this product more.
I can never find this chai in the last 2 states i have lived in. so i order it here. I have tried other chai mixes that i can find at stores to replace it, but this one is the best. so delicious!

column9: Amazing flavor-even better when you mix it
column10: Paid over $4.00 for a cup of this at a coffee shop in town.  After raving about how delicious it was (and thinking of how I was going to need to come back...soon...for another cup) the owner told me it was MOCAFE.  She mixes equal parts of the spice and the vanilla chi tea mix and wow--it is amazing.  I was so happy to see Amazon has both flavors!  I buy them both, dump them together in a container and mix well.  Then I spoon back into the tin (I also put into jars and gave as Christmas gifts...well received!) and enjoy!  The only thing I add is a puff of whipped cream on the top of the mug.  Now if only they made a sugar free version....

this chai is the best! fast shipping, can only recommend it to everyone else!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!! you will love it,  i can also recommend the vanilla chai as well! great taste! love it in the fall and winter time

I enjoy drinking all types of tea, in loose and bagged forms, but this tea is a delight to drink.  It is a chai tea mix with the spice, sugar and milk already added so all you have to do is add hot water.  It tastes great cold as well and though it already has the added milk, I sometimes add a touch of coconut milk to it to give the 'spice' of it a little more exotic taste. Yet no matter how you may want to serve it, this all-in-one drink is a taste-tea, tea-licious treat!

I buy this all the time and drink it just about every day as my special treat.I use soy milk or almond milk with it and it is delicious. I mix it with 3/4 cup hotwater and then 3/4 cup of whatever milk you want and then micro-wave again. My sister told me about it. That is how I found it. Then I found I could order "MOCAFEPrecious Divinity Spiced Chai Tea Mix" from Amazon.
If you like iced Chai - this is it.  Disolve powder in a small amount of VERY hot water.  Add ice and milk.  YUM x 2!!!
This chai is less creamy than some I have tried.  It is heavily spiced and I use less than the amount called for when I mix it with half water and half vanilla soy milk.  Tasty.

You will love this Chai it is perfect for a chilly fall evening.  I purchased it to share with family and friends.  The product is delicious and the shipping was super fast. Try it, you will not be disappointed.

I was tired of paying $4 - $5 for each chait tea drink at the coffee shop but it was an adventure to find an at home product that tasted as good as the coffee shop.  THIS IS IT!  It is really delicious you won't be disappointed.  :)

I have been drinking MOCAFE Chai for 6 years, always finding it at a discount retailer.  They no longer carry it so decided I would go to MOCAFE and see if I could purchase directly.  Was pleased to see that Amazon.com is now carrying --- I appreciated the free shipping as it saved a considerable amount and allowed me to buy more of my favorite, yummy, morning drink.  A great beverage for coffee drinkers and non-coffee drinkers like myself.

We keep this stuff around the house and drink it during the winter a lot, as well as around just about any holiday.  It truly is amazing stuff!  Everyone I've had try it absolutely LOVES it.  It tastes like... pumpkin pie-it's awesome with whipped cream on top.

I have tried various chai teas and this is the only one that I LOVE!  I would go to ROSS to see if they had any more but I got tired of looking so I decided to see if they sold it online and the price on here is great.

I am not a big coffee drinker, but several years ago someone turned me on to the chai tea latte at Starbucks.  During the winter, I tend to treat myself to a tall chai a couple days a week, which can really add up!  My sister bought me a tin of the Precious Divinity Spiced Chai Mix for my Christmas stocking this year and I LOVE IT!  It has a nice, mild, sweet flavor.  I just ordered a four pack of the tins for myself, and I keep one at work so I can enjoy a hot, caffienated drink in the morning.  Each serving is fairly small, but even if you make a double, you're still paying a lot less than you would at Starbucks. Very good stuff!
This is buy far the most delicious chai mix I've ever had, way better than what I've bought in actual cafes. I am never going to Starbuck's again.

I originally purchased this Chai tea at Sam's and fell in love with it however, Sam's quit selling it at their stores.  I got online and found that Amazon.com sold it.  I was in love all over again!  I serve it with milk instead of water and put a little hazelnut syrup in it as well.  To top it off, I put whipped cream on top with a sprinkle of cinnamon sugar.  By this point, the tea has now become a decadent dessert instead of a hot tea.  Thanks to Amazon.com I received my tea in record time and the product was in perfect condition!  The only reason why I didn't give it 5 stars is because I wish the containers held a little more product.  Other than that, I love, love, love it!
I love this stuff!!!!!!!!!!  Share with all your friends !!!!!!watch the calories !!!!
This is a weekend morning ritual for me and my wife.  The product is sweet, delicious, and keeps me going when I'm deployed overseas.

I love this chai! Better tasting than Trader Joe's, Oregon Chai and Tazo. I love the Vanilla version too! I discovered it a few years ago and stumbled upon it at a discount grocery store. So now I order it using Amazon's "Subscribe & Save" feature.

column9: The cans they come in are good for storing rubber bands
column10: That's the best thing I can say about this formula.  Clumpy, does not dissolve and tastes pretty well nasty.  I'm trying to find people I can give the cans away to without feeling mean.

column9: Not as good as the original chai of this brand...
column10: I find to be too sweet tasting after I make a Fog, and the amazing & spectacular spice that the original had is numbed down. It's a decent chai, but I just don't like it that much...

Use the following recipe for this dip:1 pkg Fiesta Ranchero Dip1 cup grated cheddar cheese1 cup real mayo1 can chicken breast, drained1 cup sour creamMix all ingredients and serve in a small crock pot or warm up portions in the microwave on a low setting.  If it gets too hot the cheese will become oily and yucky looking.  Serve with tortilla chips.  Your guests will absolutely love this dip.

I absolutely LOVE this dip, simple as made with pretzels.  However, when I went on a diet it got stuck in the back of my pantry until I discovered that using 2 cups of fat free Greek Yogurt produces a delicious low calorie substitute for the mayo and sour cream that the box calls for. So now, my favorite pretzel and veggie dip is back on the forefront of my snacking!

I bought 2 boxes of this dip at a flea market.  I used both of them by Christmas and was afraid that I wouldn't be able to find them again.  I was so excited when I found them.  I will reorder them again and again....

Just because of the bad review based on packaging above let me say Deboles makes top of the line pasta and we are extremely lucky to get the deals we do from amazon. You can pay double or triple the price in any store that sells this pasta. The recipe for their Jerusalem Artichoke pasta is the same for all types afaik so I would direct you to reviews of the De Boles Pasta Organic Artichoke Fettuccine, 8-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 12). To that I can only add that with regular semolina pasta it took about double the amount to fill me up as the Deboles Jerusalem Artichoke which stands to reason because it's got 2x the protein. Just be advised with this deal (2.40/lb is a great deal) you'll want a tub or some kind of jar (2 gallons will do) to hold 10lbs of pasta.
There's no going back!  Absolutely tastes like the real thing... the only difference is it's less sticky, a smother surface, which is a great difference.  I'll never miss wheat pasta!

DeBoles elbows are better than any other elbows I've tried. Believe me, at my age, that is a lot! However, as one reviewer stated, the product does come in a plastic bag.Rest assured, it IS what you are ordering.  How do I know? Went to another web site and viewed a large image of the elbows in the box from DeBoles.The pasta's are exact.  There is what appear to be cracks in the pasta.  All is good however!This product is genuine and excellent for your health. Especially if you are diabetic.I reordered these elbows to make macaroni salad for a friend who is diabetic.  She will appreciate that when she checks her glucose levels.Love this product and wish everyone would try it at least once.
This is best pasta I ever ate plus nutritional. I will never go back. Its worth increase in price to me & buying in bulk makes it affordable.
great, fast to cook pasta... but the packaging or NOT packaging is quite weird it came in a shipping box in a large plastic bag without any description ... I hope I got what I bought

I LOVE Snack Factory's Everything Pretzel Crisps. They are full of flavor but not too salty. I would be content living off of these crisps, veggies, fruit, and water for the rest of my life, seriously. Kudos.

The first time I tried these I bought them at a local health foods store in my hometown.  I loved the taste but was discouraged from the price.  After checking out Amazon, I bought two (yes, I love them that much) cases of these Pretzel Crisps.  I am a closet snacker and have tried to find healthier alternatives to traditional snacks.  I pair these crisps with hummus for a delicious treat!! And the price was much better with Amazon!

These pretzel crisps are delicious.  The flavor is very similar to Bruegger's everything bagels.  Shipment was perfect.  They arrived on time and the box was packed well.  No flattened bags with broken pretzels here.

column4: Writer of Books - Mage - Mom to Two "Writer, ...
column9: Just don't buy one bag, save yourself the hassle!
column10: I am just trying to help you out. Do yourself a favor. Don't just buy one bag of these. I mean, if you live alone, maybe you will be okay, you might be alright. But for the love of all things good and fine in the world, if you plan to open these around other people or ::gasps in horror::: share them!!! then stock up by buying a few bags, not just one.Don't say I didn't warn you. They are everything an everything bagel is, but super thin and crunchy. Everything should be crunchy.Sheri Gill

I've been trying out a variety of snack items with the idea of finding something that is both tasty and nutritionally sound. These Snack Factory Pretzel Crisps (Everything) caught my eye and seemed worth a try. They're okay, but I really don't care for them all that much. Mine are nice and crisp, but they have a taste somewhat like slightly stale matza. Perhaps I just got a stale bag. Well, at least the fat and sodium are low and they're not too high in calories. I can't quite see putting them on the table for guests. Perhaps I might try one of the other flavors before abandoning them.Gary Peterson

column9: snack, delicious, crispy, perfect after workout, perfect with sandwiches
column10: Best low calorie snack that goes with any other foods. Put cream cheese on it; dip it in cottage cheese, eat it with an apple, try peanut butter on it, snack it plain when hungry and dinner is not ready, gives you a lift when you are tired from working out, take it for lunch with a sandwich or a wedge of cheese, have it with soup, have it with cocoa, coffee, tea or just munch some while watching TV. I love them!!!

I picked these up while grocery shopping and love them!  They do give me a slight, weird aftertaste (that "everything bagels" don't, so I'm not sure why)...but even that isn't enough to stop me from snacking on them.  I'm excited to try other flavors!

I took an oath, no more kettle chips...rice chips are good, not great. These pretzel chips are super crunchy but not hard on your teeth like some fancy brands I cant name that make their pretzels more like something the dog would love to chomp on. Snack Factory Pretzel Crisps are crunchy from being well toasted and thin, then sprinkled with caraway, sesame, poppy and salt; I think there's a pinch of other spices, but its so mild we used them for dipping.They are darn delicious.
I love these! If you look around, you'll find them cheaper else where! I got them for $3.69 a pack at my local store.

I discovered and got hooked onto pu-erh during a recent trip to China and have only had the teabag variety thus far. Among the 3 brands I have tried thus far, one store bought, one an international brand, this is the best tasting pu-erh in a bag I have found.  I intend to try couple other brands available on Amazon.com or if I see in any of the local Asian grocery stores.One thing that could be better about this brand is the bag around the tea bag, which is a bit hard to open (even though it has the guide slit). On the brigther side, each tea bag is individually wrapped in a 'plastic like' silver cover, which helps seal in the flavor very well.Characteristics of this tea:- 'fishy' like smell when you first dunk into hot water (not overpowering or nasty by any means)- steeps fully in about 4-5 minutes- neither bitter like the stronger black teas nor mild like the greens.  perfectly balanced somewhere in-between.- satisfying flavor, makes me feel good about drinking a cup of tea.If you have not tried this brand, worth giving it a shot.  I typically drink 4-5 cups every week and will likely get a refill ordered soon, unless I find an even better pu-erh out there.  Giving it a 4 star rating since this is a good buy, and my reference point is limited at present.

I think the other reviewer's right about the under-cooking, but hadn't thought about it--partly because it didn't diminish my enjoyment of this soup at all. It's quite well-seasoned, with the beans giving adequate "body". Though I enjoy a number of other Dr. McDougall's soups, this is among my favorite.

I enjoyed the low sodium lentil soup more, and the pasta in this soup just didn't seem to cook all the way no matter how long I let it sit.  Next time I will try to simmer it in a saucepan rather than microwave it.

WORST PURCHASE I EVER BOUGHT OFF OF AMAZON AND I HAVE BOUGHT 100'S OF ITEMS THIS PRODUCT SMELLED LIKE A SMELLY OLD CLOSET. I THREW IN TRASH, MOST DISGUSTING SMELL, HAD TO BURN A CANDLE TO GET SMELL OUT OF MY HOUSE.

The tootsie pops were not fresh.  They were very old.. The outter covering was not crisp and brittle as all tootsie pops are. The outter covering was very soft and mushey and a lot of them had holes in them. And the inner tootsie roll was very small and looked old too.  The Green Apple flavor is very hard to come by in the assorted flavor bags. I loved the taste of the Green Apple Tootsie Pop that came in the assorted flavor bags so I thought I would I would order just that flavor in the 5lb bag.. .I was very dissapointed in the quality of the product.

I got this Dinner of the Month Club pasta meal as a gift from a very special person back in CT where I used to live--I believe they are one of the leading gourmet presents companies nationwide.The pasta is ready literally within 15 minutes--a quick meal is a good thing, especially for a single guy like me who doesn't have the time of day to cook complicated stuff--and not only that, it tastes excellent! (I added some parmesan cheese to the sauces that I got in my fridge and it made it even better). Honestly I wasn't expecting it to taste this good. As an Italian food fan, I was pretty satisfied with this gift. If you don't want to leave the house or what to stay home to watch the game, it's a perfect gift. Do I recommend their food and services? Absolutely! Giving gifts like these are a good idea for single people like me, so I am thinking returning the favor and sending these to some people I know for the upcoming holidays.

I recently joined the dinner of the month club and I am so glad I did! It may be the best gift I've ever given myself:) My entire family reaps the benefits because it is a treat for everyone, no matter age or gender. We always look forward to the arrival of a new and exciting pasta in the mail every month. We even have a tradition now in our house that we all cook dinner together on "pasta night" and enjoy a savory dish provided by the dinner club.It is so easy to make an impressive dinner with dinner club because they even send recipes to go along with their noodles and sauces! I recently received the Vegan Pumpkin pasta fettuccine paired with the Butternut Squash with Parmesan Cheese. I also got the Italian Spice Linguini with the Organic Roasted Garlic sauce. Even just boiling the noodles warms your home with a delicious fragrance. Everything I have ever received from Flying Noodle has always been of the highest quality. I have friends over to play dominoes every Tuesday night and I always brag about my Flying Noodle packages. They have tried most of my dishes and always want to know where they can get the noodles and sauces at our local grocery store. There is just nothing like it that you can buy from the store, I have since gotten all of my domino friends on Flying Noodle- dinner of the month club.I definitely know where to go to do my Christmas shopping this year! There is something for everyone and I know I can trust Flying Noodle to deliver the best quality of products to my loved ones.

column9: Love the tea, don't order this item
column10: I love Celestial Seasoning's Madagascar Vanilla Red tea, which is sadly becoming harder and harder to find in stores.  But don't order this item.  I placed an order for it, and had the order randomly canceled by the company.  The seller was listed as ABC Wholesale, and it is now listed as RED TAG sale, even though it's the exact same item.  Buy it from another source, it's a great tea.  I personally think it works great in combination with other teas, my favorite is a combination of four bags of this tea and one bag of plum black tea to make a gallon pitcher, which tastes great both hot or cold.
It is difficult to find. I do not know how many boxes you get from Amazon, but the price is over 100.00.
candy came fast but was not what was pictured. It was the new variety with mango and pinapple, NO watermelon or blue. bummer

column9: Good, but not as good as others
column10: The bars are a good quality.  The flavor is good, but not as fruity as I thought it would be.  It is a very berry flavor, like the box says.  That's not a bad thing; it's just not as sweet as I anticipated.  The bars looked a little small, but they're dense.  The density makes up for the size of the bars as far as being an effective snack, but I found them kind of hard to chew.  I might try other flavors by this brand, but I probably won't buy the wildberry flavor again.
These are a great, portable snack. Am so happy to have found them on Amazon as most local stores have stopped carrying this flavor.
I'm slowly working through these but it's a chore. The Glutino breakfast bars are very good and I ordered these because I assumed they would be good too.
I miss eating the way I used to before I found out I am allergic to wheat.  This is a great substitute for cream of mushroom soup.  You cannot tell the difference.  It tastes great!

My mom has a wheat allergy.  We have been unable to find Progresso Mushroom soup in stores here so looked here and could order it with free shipping.  Received the case in just a few days.  Looking forward to cooking all our recipes.

I suppose that every coffee lover has their own favorite brands, roasts, and blends.  Well, Cameron's has become mine.  The Gold Cup is an excellent roast of coffee.  We're not talking about any fancy flavors or tastes, but just a good, straight up coffee.  I also mix about 50/50 of this with some of Cameron's flavored blends when the flavors seem too strong.  If you want something that's a good coffee but won't totally break your budget, give this a sip!
Ordered these for a quick out the door snack, they are perfect! Delicious and perfectly portioned. They have a great shelf life as well.

I've ordered these cookies several times and never had any trouble with the packaging as the other reviewer has. More to the point, the cookies are absolutely delicious, and are always quickly devoured after I receive them.

I ordered this before and I was very pleased with the product and vendor. This is my second time ordering this product and the item was sent to me open and the packaging was terrible.  I contacted the vendor and they were sorry for what happen and offered to send me a replacement. When the replacement came it was package correctly, but the replacement item was totally different from what I had ordered.

I purchased this product as an alternative to a rawhide. Our 5 month old German Shorthair Pointer puppy ate it in a matter of 6 minutes or less. She loved it, but it was more of an expensive treat.With a puppy, I needed something to satisfy her chewing urge. The treat fractured into small bits all over the floor but our dog was willing to pick those up. The pieces looked rather sharp and that was a concern. Others mentioned it was made in China and I would like to add the first ingredient is corn.  It might last longer for very small dogs.

Good product, but more of a treat for my dogs.  It took them just a matter of minutes to have the SmartBone gone.  Maybe good for dogs that are not big chewers.  I was hoping for something more digestible but as sturdy as rawhides

column9: Safer than rawhide, don't last as long but also cleans teeth
column10: I picked these up from my local pet shop for a bit cheaper than what they are on offer for from Amazon, so you might wish to shop around.Over all I am quite satisfied with these "bones." They are much safer than raw hide chews given they are made from dried chicken, which means unlike raw hide you know these are actually digestible. This is the biggest reason I bought them. My vet recommended not giving my Sheltie raw hide as they aren't properly digestible. Whether this is true or not, I've heeded her advice.Baird, my Sheltie, really seems to enjoy them. When he sees one coming out of the bag, his tail is wagging like crazy. He enjoys these as much as our old family Sheltie McGyver enjoyed raw hide. The only difference I see between these and raw hide is that raw hide lasted roughly 30 minutes longer in chew time than these. I'd say Baird can chew through one of these in about 30 or so minutes, while our old Sheltie could chew on a single raw hide for an hour, at which point we would throw away the little nub. There is nothing left of these bones after 30 minutes.As far as the dental application goes, it does smell of mint, so I assume it should, if nothing else, help with doggy breath, though to be fair Baird has never really had "doggy breath." I also use some dog mouth foam so I don't know what really keeps his breath "fresh" between the two.If you aren't too sure about raw hide for your dog and want something you know can be digested, these are definitely worth it.For those that try to keep track of where the things they give their dog come from, these are made in China. I've tried finding something similar not made in China, but it seems such a thing doesn't exist or I just can't find them.

Great product but made in China. Once I realized this after purchase, I got a little worried. Kind of over priced in the regular retail market. My dogs like it & have been ok but I wish I knew ahead of time where it was made.
SmartBones Dental Dog Chews are the perfect treat for my two pomeranians and one Pembroke Corgi. No rawhide, nothing to upset their sensitive stomachs. They "dance" when I give them their daily chew.

The girls lost their taste for rawhide, but were still looking for something to chew. They love these Smart Bones, and they are better for them as well. I will be reordering them when there gone!SmartBones Chicken Dog Chew, Mini, 24-Pack
Read your labels, people!!! SMART bones are made in China!!!!!! A neighbor told me how great these were. After buying them, I read the fine print in the back. "Made in China!!"
there wonderful, my dog loves them, and I feel good giving them to him, I will always get these for him.
My dogs just love these and the chews are safe for them. Their breath benefits from the mint and their dental exams show much less plaque . I must keep bags on hand; they expect them.
I have given this bone to several different breeds and sizes of dogs and it is a major hit! And I don't worry about them choking on it as you do with rawhides. LOVE this product and will buy more!

column9: picture of the package of the dog chew is not what I recieved
column10: If you open the link to the Smartbones you will see that it shows a picture of a package containing a 3-pack of dog chews.  I did not get this bag, I recieved a single dog chew.  I was under the impression by looking at the description on the bag I was getting a single pkg of 3, Not just 1 dog chew.  This made these quite expensive and I ordered two :-(

column9: Best solution for dogs with weak intestinal system.
column10: I've tried about 7 different dry foods and 3 different wet foods. Non of them, again NON made my dog have normal running intestines, ever. I started mixing in preference with Oma's Pride (wet) and it has been about 2 years that he has NEVER had intestines issues again. Highly recommended and worth every penny.

column9: An easy addition to raw diets
column10: Preference is an incomplete dog diet that is made complete by adding meat.  Preference is added with equal parts water and allowed to rehydrate for 5 to ten minutes.  Then you mix in meat an whatever else you feed your dog.  I usually mix it with a ground dog food from the butcher that contains ground beef, liver and heart.  I also throw in a couple of raw eggs and fish oil.  The dogs absolutely love it!  I've been feeding a raw diet for several years, and this product is a great supplement.  The chelated nutrients in Preference are more readily available for absorption in the digestive system, something that is hard to find in the vast majority of dog diets.  I don't feed Preference every day.  I make large batches, freeze in single serving sizes, and thaw them out for two meals per week.I also use Urban Wolf Dog Food Mixer 3 lb Bag, which is also an excellent product.  But what I love about Honest Kitchen is that they make their foods from human grade ingredients, most of which are sourced in the US.  After the scare with Chinese gluten poisoning so many pets a few years ago, I am careful about where my dogs' food comes from.  Note that many of the chicken/duck jerky treats are from China!Please note that this stuff STINKS while it's rehydrating -- I think it's the kelp or the alfalfa.  Once I add the meat, and it smells fine -- unless I add sardines!  I highly recommend using this product or a product like it if you're feeding a raw or otherwise grain-free diet.  Your dogs will thank you.

column9: Healthy dose of love thru veggies!

Perfect solution for us.

column9: Superb addition to a dog's daily diet
column10: This Preference veggie mix has been an important addition to our dogs' daily meals for the past 2 years.  I first began using one of Honest Kitchen's other products, Thrive, when our youngest dog (still a pup) was diagnosed with severe hip dysplasia.  I chose to use a bunch of natural supplements/herbs to deal with his joint mobility/pain rather than twice-daily strong prescription meds that would destroy his liver.  It put him off his food though since he didn't care for the taste of some of the supplements; so I tried to add plenty of good-tasting, healthy additions to his kibble (Pure Vita) to encourage him to eat.  The "Thrive" dehydrated mix was convenient...meat and veggies together...and I still occasionally use it for that convenience when the dogs are being kenneled or kept by others.  For regular daily use though, I use the Preference veggie base and add my own chicken, turkey, salmon, or bison.  I find it a bit more economical to just add my own protein source since I go through quite a bit (2 dogs, and 1 is huge).  Another thing that I like about the Preference mix is that one of the first two ingredients is alfalfa which has been shown to help with joint inflammation...just what my big guy needs.I usually mix up enough for a couple days worth of meals and just keep it in the fridge.  I just scoop the appropriate amount into each dog's bowl and then mix in the supplements for each pooch.  I then stir in the meat and kibble along with salmon oil.  They love it and they're both doing great on it!

column9: This food item fills a void inside me.
column10: First of all, I must state that this is the tastiest pre-packaged soup known to mankind. The spice mixture is a delight to my taste buds. The noodles are better quality than most pre-packaged Ramyuns. The ease of cooking this is just what you would expect. It's simple and that is why I'm often inclined to make this a meal when I know that I shouldn't. I opt to live a little in these situations.Preparation is key. The soup by itself is probably a health hazard if you eat it each and every day. As others have mentioned, it has little to no nutrients of particular value for any diet, and high sodium content. However, when one adds a variety of meats and veggies, it could possibly be gourmet caliber soup.I particularly enjoy cubed pork tenderloin or shrimp, mixing that with the soup. Poaching an egg or two in this soup will make it better as well. As for veggies, green onion is a definite must have, along with shitake/portobello mushrooms (I like both), and I like to add broccoli. Many times, I'll add bean sprouts and cilantro, but those are truly optional in my opinion. However, a personal favorite of mine to add to this soup is fishcake. If you don't know what that is, don't let the name fool you. Go to your local Korean market and pick some up. It's sensational in this soup.As for the unhealthy aspect, simply use less of the packaged spice and you'll probably feel better about yourself. I use the whole thing myself, but I really don't eat these as much as I used to. Lastly, the soup without all the additional meats and veggies is still tasty, so it's not a necessity to add the extras - only recommended. I still must suggest that one poached egg be the bare minimum. Enjoy!
