I thought the honey was much thinner than any other honey I've gotten and It didn't have much flavor.  Even my kids didn't care for it.  Good price though and I like the bottles the honey came in.

I might be used to higher standards of honey -- please don't get me wrong, it is not a bad honey, but I specifically purchased it because of its high ratings. It does have a distinct flavor with higher sweetness and definitively better than any of these honeys you can find in any "normal" supermarket, however if you compare it to a Eucalytus honey (in this case from Australia), "wild flower" honey from Germany it doesn't add up.

You get 4 small bottles of tasty honey here.  I was expecting to get bigger bottles.  I am looking for the best deals when I purchase online, and to be honest I can get a similar price to this at a local supermarket for a bottle of honey.  So I probably would not buy this again.  The honey is tasty and I like it, but if you are not saving any money why go through the process of ordering online. Unless of course this is some sort of special honey you cant get locally, but thats your call.

This is NOT the same honey, as contained in the 23 oz. bottles I've ordered in the past. MUCH lighter in color and RUNNIER!I immediately cancelled my 'sub/save'...WHY DO THINGS HAVE TO CHANGE...FOR THE WORST?!

I own a bread machine and use honey for my whole wheat loaves.  This product works great for a few weeks, but then something happens to the honey.  It gets thicker.  (And this was in bottles that were sealed and unopened).  This resulted in my bread not mixing properly.  The dough would get clumpy and would not blend together properly.  I had to throw out half of the honey.

I just opened my second can of this and for the second time there was no pot roast in braised beef pot roast soup.  It contains mostly broth with a few vegetables.  It's best suited for a vegetarian doesn't like vegetables.  Seriously, I suppose Campbell's might be having problems with their mixing equipment, but I won't be buying it again.

I bought the first one at the Las Vegas Bellagio hotel, the price tag on it was over $18. All that you have to do is add hot water. I have put them in my desk drawer and brief case and used them in my coffee to make wonderfully flavored mochas in the morning or afternoon for a pick-me-up. Of course, as cocoa they are outstanding with just water.

Great product but this is a GIFT pack and was purchased as a gift.  When I recieved it there was a large orange sticker on the front of the box that said "gift pack".  No kidding!  Anyway sticker is very ugly and covers part of picture on box.  Sticker did not come off without pulling picture off box either.  Gift packaging doesn't look so nice now.  The sticker was very unneccessary!
This stuff is tasty but caveat emptor: it's glorified non-dairy creamer, which is the first ingredient. Enjoy this with artificially flavored vanilla sandwich cookies.
top class chips, and can't find outlets on East Coast.  Will reorder again soon.you can't beat this Boulder Canyon chip!!!

column4: Jon Atwood "Computer Geek and loving owner of...
column10: Curry has become one of my favorite foods over the past year.  We've always struggled to make good curry at home as the grocery store curry pastes don't have very much flavor.  I always found myself having to use an entire jar instead of the 1Tbsp that they tell you to use.A friend of ours recommended we try this brand.  It had AWESOME flavor but ended up being a tad too spicy for our taste.  I'm not sure we'll purchase it again.  If we do we now know to not use quite as much.We've really been enjoying the Mae Ploy brand of curry pastes which can be found here on Amazon as well.If you like your green curry at Thai spice levels though, you'll LOVE this!

column9: Really Great Tasting Green Curry! Highly Recommended!
column10: We love Thai food and was thrilled to find Maesri Thai Green Curry. This curry is great tasting, authentically flavored, and fairly hot. We like that it comes in a paste as it easy use in our cooking.Highly recommended! You might also want to try Maesri Thai red curry - 4 oz x 2 cans.
good spicy tasty. but u have to develop a taste for it. If u dont like thai and trying this out as a first option, i would suggest that u wait

My friend has one of these and it keeps her dog occupied for hours which allowed her to study or whatever she needed to do. So I decided to try it. My 2 1/2 year old mini dachshund figured out how to pop the hard treat out in less than 5 min. If this was it, I wouldn't have a problem because she's pretty smart, but it says on the package virtually indestructible and she tore chunks out of the thing you put the treats in. I've never had a problem with her ripping things (other than cheap stuffed animals if she can get them) and she bit chunks off. It's a good idea and works for some, but definitely not hard to destroy as they claim, at least not for her...

This sauce is very strange tasting with a lot of spice.I was going to use this as the base for a pizza sauce, but not even huge amounts of sugar / honey could save this sauce.  It also starts off very watery (not good value for your money).I will never buy this tomato sauce again.

This is the most acidic tomato sauce I've ever used. It's almost as tart as a lemon. I put it in an old family lasagne recipe, but neglected to taste it at first. By then it was too late.  I tried to soften the astringent taste with sugar and sauteed mushrooms, but this was only partially successful. The only thing that saved the dish were copious amounts of Bechamel sauce in the layering. They claim they use only Roma tomatoes, but I'm doubtful. I can't imagine any recipe that would benefit from this sauce.

column9: Amazing alternative to the chemical filled pop
column10: I was introduced to Zevia by a friend.  This is the "cleanest" pop you will find and it is delicious!  The grapefruit is my favorite but all have been really good. Warning to those who have NEVER tasted anything with Stevia in it be prepared for a different taste.  I recommend you use stevia in other foods to get accustomed to the taste before forking out the $$$ for this.  If you haven't had stevia before then you probably won't care to much for it.  In my opinion stevia is an acquired taste...which now I love!  I like the fact that I can give this to my kids with worrying about what the harsh chemicals and sugar are going to do to them!  They both love it too...especially the orange and grape.  Even my husband likes the rootbeer!  I can't wait to get the rainbow pack in this week!!  Yummy!

I know you're thinking no way, but actually this is really good. It is hard to find this soda on sale in grocery stores, so the price of this case is pretty competitive. The best part about this purchase was getting to try 2 cans of every flavor. Here are my favorites:Cola, Caffeine free Cola, Root Beer, Grape, Dr. Zevia, Mountain Zevia, Cream Soda, Lemon Lime Twist.Flavors I wasnt crazy about:Ginger Ale, Black Cherry, Grapefruit Citrus, Orange.Having a husband to pawn those last four flavors off on is awesome! Stranded on a desert island, I would pick the Root Beer. It even makes a great chaser, although I prefer the Cola for chasers.
This is such a great idea.  I like drinking all 12 flavors, depending on my mood.  Now I can buy them all at once.

Love the Zevia Zevia All Natural Soda, Rainbow Case, 12-Ounce Cans (Pack of 24)products. I don't eat sugar and the sweeteners in all the other diet drinks I've tried (they usually have aspartame) give me a migraine and make me feel horrible. This uses the stevia plant (or rebiana) and erythritol. I've researched erythritol and it seems to be the least harmful of all sugar derived substitutes (it also does not kick me into a sugar craving like some of the other substitutes). Anyway, some of the flavors were a little weird to me at first, like the cola flavor but after the second or third can I started to get a taste for it. I now find them more enjoyable than regular or other diet sodas. Other flavors were great off the bat, like cherry. My favorite is Mtn. Zevia but I read some other reviews that thought it was horrible. FYI Truvia Truvia Nature"s Calorie-Free Natural Sweetener - 40 Packetssweetener is also made of stevia and erythritol and I find it great for sweetening and cooking, though it took some practice. Zero cal. SOBE Sobe Lifewater Variety Pack - 12/20oz Bottlesalso a great drink and sweetened with erythritol. Many grocery stores carry the SOBE Lifewater for $1.00 per bottle.

Zevia arrived promptly and in perfect condition. Very satisfied with purchase and would purchase again. Good opportunity to sample all the flavors, many of which are not available in retail grocery stores in my area.

column9: Ginger ale= good, the rest not so much
column10: I had a ginger ale from a health food store and was hooked! I have been trying to get away from diet coke, a battle that has been going on for years. I use stevia in the raw in pretty much everything now and was really excited to find a line of sodas that used it. I, or course, was carried away and ordered a case on auto delivery. Mistake. The sodas really are all SOOO sweet, it's nauseating. The makers need to lighten up on the stevia. I still enjoy the ginger ale but am forcing myself to try and get through the remaining case. I can take 2-3 sips of the others before I am turned off. So just get the ginger ale or skip in general. Blah. too bad:(

My husband and I try not to drink any soda, diet or regular but I saw this on special on Amazon and got some. Really great flavor! My husband who likes regular soda when he can get it (we drink alot of iced tea and coffee) enjoyed this and all the flavors were a surprise! The flavor that was supposed to be like Mountain Dew was just gross to us, nasty so I took one star off for that flavor. The Dr Pepper version and the ginger ale were the best. I would still buy this in a mix and will give the Mt Dew flavor to my son:o)

I RECIEVED MY DRINKS AND WAS LOOKING FOR LOTS OF FLAVOR--WRONG.  THE FLAVOR WAS WEAK AND THERE WAS, WAY, TO MUCH FIZZ. NOT WORTH THE EXTRA MONEY YOU PAY FOR THESE DRINKS.  EVEN THE SWEETNER, WAS NOT MUCH PRESENT, NOT VERY SWEET.

Honestly, I hate drinking regular cola because of the excessively sweet sugar taste lingering in my mouth, and the diet or zero versions aren't much better because the sweet-n-low taste is just as bad as sugar. So I tried what supposedly is the only carbonated drink that is truly natural.Taste-wise, it is NOT an alternative to other popular cola brands.Zevia comes in variety of flavors that are suppose to imitate the regular drinks (Mountain Zevia, Dr.Zevia, ... really??), but they are not even close to how the originals taste.However, different as they may be, I LOVE the taste of these Zevia soda, much more than other 'original' soda. They taste much more... crisp and natural, without having the lingering sugar/sweet-n-low taste. The natural ingredients, mainly stevia, really has a unique taste that is completely different than sugar.If you are looking for a healthy alternative that taste pretty much the same as regular soda, you WILL be disappointed.However, as an entirely separate drink with a completely unique taste, it is, by far, my favorite soda, and I am completely addicted.

column9: Great alternative to the "popular" diet sodas
column10: If you are looking for a great tasting diet soda and want to stay away from aspartame and saccharin this is a great alternative-- tastes GREAT!

In an effort to cut down on my refined sugar intake, I use Stevia as my main sweetener so was glad to stumble across Zevia.  However, you need to keep your expectations in check.  Think of them as a bunch of new unnamed sodas without the sugar.  So enjoy the discovery of the new soda flavors.  For example, I was a huge Dr. Pepper fan and there is no way that I would mistake Dr. Zevia for Dr. Pepper.  And if you were to ask me if the Cola tastes more like Coke or Pepsi, I would have to say "none of the above".  For root beer fans, the Zevia root beer comes very close.  I do enjoy the Zevia flavors and Dr. Zevia is one of my favorites, but it just doesn't taste at all like Dr. Pepper.  The rainbow case is a wonderful idea as it lets you try all the different flavors.  Until they come out with a Stevia sweetened Dr. Pepper, I will enjoy the different flavors of Zevia.

I love the rootbeer, cr soda, blk cherry and Dr zevia.  The taste of stevia is distinct and to most who have not given up sugar yet, this will probably not be the savior that you may be expecting, but to those of us who have, it's delicious. Mix it with unsweetened iced teas, or juices and it stretches the cost of the soda.  I have not tried the new flavors yet but am looking forward to trying the strawberry.It's worth getting used to it since sugar and Donald Rumsfeld's Defense Department's laboratory byproduct (mistake), Asperatame, is a soft kill and highly addictive.  It took me a year of abstinence to lose my craving for diet coke (drank one large McDonald's size a day), it only took me a week of abstinence to lose my craving for sugar.  Crazy stuff.

I was looking for an acceptable substitute for diet pop as i am looking to get away from aspartame.  Zevia fulfills that need and i love all the Zevia flavors.  The 24 pack is great as i get 2 of each Zevia flavor. Can't wait to try their 3 new ones.

When i order this soda I was expecting the worst. But much to my pleasant surprise the soda was great. My Daughter 15 and 6 both love them. They pack them in there school lunch. The ginger ale is wonderful. The taste is great. I't hard to believe that this soda is the real deal but it is. I had put my self on auto ship for 3 month but the case a disappeared because every time someone come over I have to let them try it.I need a new case now. Can't wait to get it. I haven't had cream soda in a very long time but that Cream soda is Delicious.

With all the positive reviews I really was looking forward to trying this but was sadly disappointed when I received my shipment and tried 2 of the flavors.  So far I've had the orange and the cola...not enjoyable at all.  I had realistic expectations and did not expect it to taste like the "regular" sugar or even "diet" versions that are popular.  But, I had hoped they would at least be good.  My teens and I dislike the taste completely.  There is also a very bitter aftertaste that lingers for a long time.  Ugh.  I'm going to stick to my carbonated water with a slice of lemon from now on. **Have tried all the flavors and still do not like this product.  I have had other products with Stevia that are acceptable, the aftertaste on this one is horrible.

I bought this thinking it would be a good alternative to the regular soda I drink.  And I have to admit, when you first drink it it is OK.  It does have a weird aftertaste though, which bothers me the more i drink.  Maybe I will get used to it but I doubt it.I will certainly not be purchasing this product again.

column9: Stevia may be the ideal diet sweetener
column10: If you are drinking diet soda for the taste, please read what other reviewers have written re: the taste of Zevia.  Stevia lends a unique taste that may take some getting used to.  It is "different" than standard diet drink taste.  That being said, if you are drinking diet soda to watch your waistline, you need to step over to Stevia as a sweetener NOW.  Journal papers in Behavioral Neuroscience and the Journal of Animal Science have established the so-called "sweetness response" in which insulin is released in response to sweet taste, rather than as a direct response to sugar-based content.  Insulin without something to metabolize is very efficient way of creating fat.  This is why drinking diet drinks does not help you loose weight.  In fact, if you switch to diet drinks and change nothing else about your diet and exercise regimen, you will GAIN weight.  I have not seen the scientific evidence, but I have  read in at least two non-science books, that Stevia does not cause the insulin release that nutri-sweet and saccharine  do.  This makes Zevia an actual diet drink.  While I agree that soda should be refrained from for reasons other than making one fat (it is bad for the teeth, irritates GERD, among other ill effects), it is unfortunately, the one habit I simply cannot break myself of.  While Zevia is not a health food, at least won't make me gain weight.

I'm not a huge soda drinker because of the carbs and calories. I don't ever drink traditional diet drinks because I do not like the diet soda taste. I use stevia in the raw at home daily and I have enjoyed the lack of calorie sweetness that it gives me, which lead me to try these sodas.To wrap it up, they have a very strong diet drink taste which is what I was trying to avoid to begin with. If you don't like artificial sweeteners as a concept but don't mind the taste, these drinks may be a more natural alternative for you. Dont expect any of the flavors to taste like anything but a diet soda.

I purchased these for their "0 effective carb" rating, but was surprised to see that they actually have 7 carbs of erythritol per can. However, the can claims that the carbs don't impact blood sugar, and I believe that must be true, because though I am new to low-carb dieting, these did not move me out of ketosis, even though I had approximately 20g carbs from other sources for a given day.I liked most of the flavors in this variety pack, but will probably just focus on one or two in the future, since they weren't all hits for us. Also, it felt weird drinking a clear grape soda, but I appreciate that they don't use artifical colors. Over all, I would buy this product again, just probably not the variety pack, but it is good if you want an experiment in flavor options.On a final note, the "Mountain Zevia" and grapefruit flavors are not returnable at our local (Oregon) automatic recycling center, because their bar codes are difficult for the scanner to read, but this is just a minor issue in general.

All the flavors are pretty great, the least tasteful mostly because the aftertaste is a little funky is the orange flavored one albeit everyone's opinion will vary. My wife likes the Dr. Zevia but does say it pales in comparison with the brand name product it's trying to replace.  Well anyway if your on a diet or can't use sugar this is the way to go! At least it'll keep you away from nutrasweet and similar other harmful products that are allowed in our food.

I've been using stevia for years, so when I saw this product, recommended by Shane from the people's chemist, I knew I had to try it. I am so glad I did! Now I can have a soda without feeling that I'm doing my body harm. And the best part is they taste great! The root beer is my favorite, but I do like getting  the variety pack so I'm never bored.

column9: good flavor but I'd rather have glass bottles
column10: I believe many people who choose Stevia as their sweetener of choice are health-conscious and, as such, would prefer to avoid Aluminum cans (re: Alzheimer's risk) and plastic bottles (re: cancer risk from BPA and phthalates) so glass is the only viable packaging material for this discerning audience.  Otherwise  I enjoy the taste and appreciate the all natural ingredients (especially that no artificial colors are added). I have tried Grape, Cola, and Orange.  For now I will experiment making my own soda on-demand with club soda and organic flavor extracts with either Stevia or Dextrose sweetener.

Everybodys taste is different.  This is a good variety pack to sample the different kinds to see what you like.  A few of the flavors were not good. I could not drink the Mt Zevia taste was very sharp metallic.  Best of them were DR Zevia, Black Cherry, and Cream.

I AM A TYPE TWO DIEBETIC....,I NEEDED A SODA THAT I COULD ENJOY BUT NOT RAISE MY BLOOD SUGARS........NOT ABLE TO FIND ANYTHING UNTIL FINALLY ZEVIA CAME ALONG....I LOVE THE TASTE....I EJJOYED TASTING ALL THE FLAVORS IN THE RAINBOW PACK....BUT MOST OF ALL I LOVED THAT MY BLOOD SUGARS ARE FINALLY LEVELING OFF AND I FEEL SO MUCH BETTER ALL AROUND........HURRAY FOR ZEVIA!!p>s> ANOTHER SUGGENSTION WOULD BE TO MAKE MORE FLAVORS IN CAFFINE FREE TO HELP THOSE NON SLEEPERS GET SOME SLEEP!!

column9: Good flavor, happy to find a natural soda
column10: I have not had soda in years because of all the garbage ingredients that they all contain. I decided to try these out since they were sweetened with stevia. I thought it might be a nice treat to occasionally have one. They are very good and my husband seems to like them too. I don't notice any weird aftertaste as some other have reported, and they also arrived quickly and in tact. They are a little pricey, but I would definitely be willing to order again as an occasional treat or to keep some soda in the house when visitors come over. The variety pack also gave us a good opportunity to try them out and figure out which ones were our favorites.
This 'rainbow pack' has a great selection of different Zevia drinks.  Love Zevia and this gave me an idea of what other flavors are available. Will keep ordering this.
Awesome,Shipped fast, and a great value.  Many flavor options and they are all good. Great alternative to other options available in stores.

column9: I like it. Has a different taste, but not bad.
column10: As other folks describe, this soda has a different taste due to the stevia and erythritol sweeteners. It's not bitter or bad like other diet sodas, but it definitely tastes different than sugar sodas. However, when I crave a sweet soda, this fills the need without all the sugar and without the side effects of other artificial sweeteners. I bought the variety pack figuring that I'd prefer one or two of the flavors and so I'd buy only those next time. However, I like all the flavors equally.

I hate to say it, but do not expect Zevia to taste the same as regular "soda". It has a distinct flavor all it's own. So far I like the Dr.Zevia as it is not as strong and tart as the ginger soda. My local supplier only carries 3 flavors. The rasberry is also very tart. So this is the only recommendation I can make, but not having artificial flavors, caffeine , carmel coloring, high fructose corn syrup is worth getting use to in my opinion. Thanks Amazon, face book and Zevia for teaming up!

column9: Apparently Stevia does not belong in sodas
column10: Greatly appreciate Amazon carrying this product, as it affords customers the opportunity to evaluate this product.The case arrived without the Dr. Zevia (Dr. Pepper cans).  Ginger root beer had been substituted and doubled.  Unfortunately, I bought this specifically to try the cola, ginger ale, and Dr. pepper equivalents.The grape and orange are the better products, although they have no coloring.Unfortunately, almost all of the soda's have an aftertaste...reminiscent of saccharin in some peoples opinion.Some found the taste to be cloying.  No one found any taste to be fresh, crisp, or refreshing.I had such high hopes for Stevia in soda.Even Canada dry diet ginger ale has more ginger taste than Zevia ginger ale.  Zevia cola did not remind me of any similar cola I have ever had.  In fact, a blind test would have revealed a mildly sweet beverage with no outstanding taste markers and of benign flavor.

column9: Some Taste Great Some Taste Like .....BEEP
column10: I will break it down for you.The fruit flavors are awesome and so is Root Beer and Cream Soda. I REALLY LOVE THE CREAM SODA AND CHERRY.The cola flavor is the worst tasting drink I have ever tasted.  The Dr Pepper wanna be is nothing like it at least Mr Pibb ot it right. The mountain dew is like something front the bottom of a swamp.  I just want to ask the makers of these drinks, " Have you ever had Coke or Pepsi, mountain dew or dr. Pepper? I'm guessing if you have then your taste buds don't work because you haven't even come close.Keep upthe grwat work on the cream soda and the awesome fruit flavors.  Go back and try the soda flavors again.

I'm amazed at some of the bad reviews here, but can only assume that some of them, at least, come from people who expected Zevia's colas to taste just like their more famous counterparts.  Well, they don't taste exactly the same... The ingredients are totally different, so of course they will taste different.  However, I LOVE the taste of Zevia.  It tastes clean and crisp, and makes brand-name sodas taste especially gross to me now.  I am a former addict of Diet Mt. Dew and was so happy to find a healthier product to replace it.  Was the first glass of Mt. Zevia exactly what I expected?  No.  But by the second glass, I was hooked.  I haven't looked back!  I've liked every flavor I've tried, and am on the hunt for the new Strawberry flavor to buy locally.

column9: Delicious but not the flavor you're used to.
column10: When I first started drinking this soda, I was really surprised. None of the flavors that come in the rainbow case accurately recreate their non-stevia counterpart. In general, this could be because  of the stevia, or it could be due to a flavoring. However, they don't taste bad! In fact, they're quite tasty, and in a lot of cases, I actually prefer the taste of this version over others. For example, while the "Dr. Zevia" tasted nothing like Dr Pepper, I loved it! Out of all of the flavors, I would say that the ginger root beer and the grapefruit are my favorites. I've gone through at least 10 cases at this point, and I doubt I will stop any time soon.

I was pleasantly surprised by what I've tried so far.  The grape, orange, etc. flavors are clear, no harmful artificial colorings. Friends over enjoyed it also.  Trying a variety pack is the way to go.

column9: If you want a great soda substitute, look no further :)
column10: I have been drinking Zevia for about two years.  They have a ton of flavors now compared to when they first started out.  Their 'Cola' and 'Root Beer' equivalents are my favorite.  I'm NOT a fan of their 'Dr. Pepper' equivalent.  I have tried most of their flavors and enjoyed their 'Mountain Dew', 'Grape', 'Orange', and 'Cream Soda' equivalents, but again, really really enjoying their 'Cola' and 'Root Beer' flavors the best.If you want to try a healthier less sugary version of your Coke Cola, give this a shot and I think you wont be disappointed.  I just added their "rainbow pack" to my subscribe and save for the family.  I have one coming every 2 months.  They like them as well :)It's really a guilt free soda and you don't have to worry about all the crazy chemicals that come with the name brand diet soda's.As a side note, I had to deal with their customer service once and was happy with how they handled me question.  It was in regards to one of their "natural flavor" ingredients.At the very least, give them a shot, you might end up being glad you did.
I use stevia and sugar blend in my tea etc.  I thought this would taste good but it tasted just like other diet drinks (bad).Very expensive mistake.

I received this product last week and my husband and I have been slowly trying the drinks. Thus far, the horrible outweigh the okay. The Grape was okay...the Dr. Zevia was okay...and that's been about the only okay products. The Mt.Zevia was like a flat Mt. Dew, the Cola was nothing like cola, the Ginger root beer was like a carbonated chai drink. They have been such a let down. I am very bummed that this was not a good product as I grew up on diet drinks and am quite attached to them. Not these. Never again, nor would I recommend them.

column9: All kind of tastes the same...
column10: I know this is supposed to be the "healthy" alternative for pop drinkers, but I'm just going to continue my shift towards iced green tea for my caffeine and drink fix.  The Stevia just has too much of a tangy aftertaste for me, and this stuff isn't exactly priced in the everyday-consumption price range.
My personal opinion is they are terrible. I will not recomend them, or buy them again. NO FLAVOR AT ALL

I do a lot of shopping on Amazon and this is the first bad product that I have received. I usually don't bash products but, these are terrible. The root beer and dr pepper clone do smell good at first but, it goes down hill from there. The mountain dew clone was the worst, I about gagged. All have the same nasty bitter taste and terrible odor with the individual flavor added on top. All 24 cans down the drain or should I say 27 bucks down the drain. It kind of reminds me of red bull or a preworkout/no2 drink. Fine if you have to drink it but, not if you want a drink to enjoy. I use stevia daily in my ice tea and coffee and it is great so, I don't think it's the stevia.

I so wanted to like this product.  I am trying to eliminate Splenda from my diet and was hoping this would be something I could use in this.  Unfortunately, I did not like it.  It tastes like Alka-Seltzer to me, with some flavorings thrown in.  :(

column9: Hopefully this is good for me :)
column10: The all natural taste comes with a hefty price and a little bit of a bad after taste.  I have since went back to diet coke and perhaps the onslaught of all the bad health(Unproven) issues associated with it
My order arrived in a very timely manner and was in great condition.  It has been so nice to try the various flavors without having to purchase large quantities of them.

column9: Great taste and I love the variety
column10: I like to drink diet drinks over tea but do not like to eat or drink anything with aspartame, so I tried these a few months ago. I was pleasantly surprised, the flavors are refreshin, love all except for their version of mountain dew, as I really don't care for the dew original.I have several favorites, but will still continue to subscribe to the "sampler" case as I love having choices when going to the fridge or the cooler. And the price is so much better than buying the limited flavor six packs at Whole Foods.Hooray for Amazon, my favorite place to shop for anything!

First I must say until recently I have never found a diet soda that actually tastes good enough to drink regularly. I was very excited to receive the Zevia All Natural Sodas because I have insulin resistance and I'm not supposed to have alot of sugar. I use the Truvia and Stevia sugar and I thought it would be a good idea to try the soda. I ended up giving the sodas away to a coworker and I'm sure my coworker threw them away. The taste is awful. The "coke" soda is way too sweet. The only flavors that I tried to convince myself that I could drink were grape, orange and cream soda and even those are not really good. If you are looking for a good tasting diet soda a coworker brought me a can of Sprite Zero, and it was actually good. It's not far off from the original Sprite. Oh, and my coworker was drinking Rockstar which I guess is another diet soda and he said Rockstar tastes better than the Zevia soda.

I saw this product on Amazon and was excited that it was all natural and zero calories, so i brought a case of the Cream soda. What a disappointment.  The soda has a really wicked after taste that lasts for a long time,very bitter. I will stick to my Diet Pepsi, it's cheaper and no aftertaste.
I'm so sad because I REALLY wanted these to be good.  They're not.  Seriously, don't waste your money thinking you'll enjoy one of them, as they ALL have the same terrible aftertaste.

I recently began using an artificial sweetener called ZSweet (ingredients: erythritol and stevia).  THere is absolutely no aftertaste or bitterness to this product, and I nearly can't tell the difference between it and sugar - and it's the only zero calorie sweetener I can stand.I went looking for products that contain erythritol and I was SO excited when I discovered this brand of soda. It would be so nice to be able to drink the occasional soda again. So I ordered this sampler.I've tried 6 of the 12 flavors.  They all have a very distinct, terrible aftertaste.  What a disappointment.

I was very let down with this product, I have purchased the Switch The Switch Sparkling Juice, Orange Tangerine, 8-Ounce Cans (Pack of 24)brand soda and was very pleased with it's delicious flavor but this drink is totally different. First of all it is sweetened primarily with Erythritol which is an alcohol based sweetener and is bitter tasting like other diet sodas,but that isn't all, it also causes stomach cramping (among other things) within 30 minutes of drinking it.Needless to say I'll be cancelling my future orders and going back to the Switch brand.

At first, the soda tastes great, but then the stevia or whatever else they put in it kicks in.  You are left with a very unnatural taste and feeling inside your mouth.  The aftertaste is a deal breaker.  I resolved to slam the last four of the sodas so I only had to deal with one final aftertaste.  The aftertaste/freeling of four sodas lasted for several days, even after drinking other things, eating, brushing, flossing, and waterpik'ing.

1.  Box arrived with case wrapped in a plastic bag, containing one can (empty), and a soggy cardboard tray with the other 23 cans. It appears to have blown up either prior to, or at UPS, as the box was a UPS box.2.  Positive- the level of carbonation was very good.3.  The flavors reminded me of rancid cough syrup. NONE of the 12 flavors were worth more than a sip, or the second can. There was a full-on flavor malfunction and also an aftertaste that did not want to go away.  The Dr. Zevia certainly was named well, for the resemblance to medicine.  The root beer smelled like root beer.  The fruit flavors weren't artificially colored, so essentially all looked like lemon-lime (which is actually fine by me).I'm just glad I got the sampler case, and wasn't left with 23  full cans and one with a single sip taken out of it.  The first two cans, I'd poured over ice, and took a good slug, and nearly choked.  After that, it was a tentative sip of the remaining 10 flavors.  I couldn't find ONE that I'd ever want to have again.I REALLY wanted to like this stuff. I'm a diabetic, so diet soda isn't just a preference- it's what I have to have if I'm going to drink soda at all. I budgeted for 2 cases from my next pay check (guess I'll be getting more cases of WATER).  I generally like erythritol and stevia sweetened items- especially erythritol- I use it on cereal.  Tastes just like sugar, and can be used for baking as well as cold items.Total waste of more than $25.  That could have bought my perishable items this week.

column9: Little smaller than what I was expecting
column10: They taste great but you're getting a package of ice cream about the size of a roll of quarters. Taste yummy, terrible value.

column9: small tube filled with freeze-dried ice cream balls
column10: There really isn't much to say about this.  If you like freeze-dried ice cream, you'll probably like this.  Like all freeze-dried ice cream, it seems ridiculously overpriced for what you get, but that's the way it goes.  About a quarter of the tube is filled with smooshed crumbs, but it eats the same.  The tube is small, of course - about 1.5 times the height of a chapstick and maybe twice the diameter.  It has white, brown, and pink balls (white seems to be the largest).  I listed them by color because I can't really say that they taste like vanilla, chocolate, and strawberry because they are so small.  All in all, I think I prefer the small bricks better than these little balls, but I kind of enjoyed flipping the top and pouring some into my mouth.

column9: The original, for a great price!
column10: Glad to find good old fashioned dubble bubble for a good price. My whole office likes to indulge their sweet tooth, and the child inside!

Ah Dubble Bubble.  It starts out really hard, the flavor doesn't last too long, but you can blow amazing bubbles!  This is a great bucket to get for stuffing a pinata or just to keep around.  This is sure to delight kids or nostalgic adults.

I found out about the pepper sauce (actually more like a paste) from a recipe using it in the LA Times magazine. I decided to try a jar, & fell in love at first taste. Use it as a base layer on home made pizza dough, just smear some on & put your other topping over it. Heat up a big blob of it in a pan w/ some olive oil over low heat to get it melted into a sauce (I add a couple chopped clove of garlic in case of vampires, add some uncooked thawed shrimp till done, and toss with some al denta pasta. Shrimp scampi with attitude!Tutto Calabria Hot Pepper Sauce 6.7 oz

Definitely unlike other pepper pastes, like GIA and Amore that come in tubes. It's thick like a tomato paste. The flavor is tangy and hints a little Asian flavors, though it is distinctly Italian pepper flavors. I wasn't expecting a specific taste or texture when I bought it so I'm pretty happy with getting something that I haven't experience before. I will find a lot of uses for this.I could see it being an excellent addition to a spicy pasta sauce, or pizza sauce. It may also work well mixed with olive oil and used as a base or spread for breads and pizza and such.Also, it's fairly hot, but not too hot. It's fine for most people who like a little heat, but anyone who likes only very mild spiciness will want to pass on this.

I swear it tasted like vinegar, so very disappointed. I know I have bought Pepperwood Grove before, maybe it was the Chardonnay that was good but the Pinot Grigio was an absolute waste of money, won't even save it to cook with.

column9: Just like Starbucks green tea frap
column10: I just used 2 tablespoons with one half cup of milk and some ice and it tastes just like a green tea frap from Starbucks. Add a little whipcream to the top and it's perfect. It's at a fraction of the cost. We love it and I will definitely buy again.
I Made Green Tea Ice Cream with this using the recipe on our Ice Cream Maker, minus the sugar called for.Janice M.

If you have ever spent the summer in Japan and had their green tea shaved ice this is what you had. They serve up shaved green tea ice in a big bowl and it is the cats meow. You can find it cheaper in some of the Asian stores. Buy it durning the winter as it us usually on sale and then enjoy it on a hot summer evening. Mix it up and freeze it until it is almost hard and throw it in the blender to make a slush. Pure enjoyment

If you are tired of spending 5 bucks at the local barrista for a green tea frappichino, cheat. This powder is the same mix as used by the big coffee house chains. Get out your blender and make your own. Addictive!!!
It def tastes very similar to starbucks green tea latte / frappiebut it's just WAYYYYYYYY too sweeet... I think more than half of it is just sugar...

column9: Starbucks is a thing of the past now!
column10: Surprisingly, the recipe on the back for Matcha Milk is just like the base of a Starbucks (or shall I say "Sixbucks") Green Tea Frappuccino. I will use this product wisely!
Bought this so I can make green tea cake and cupcakes.  When I opened the package, it was a smaller bag than i thought it was going to be but I guess a little goes a long way?  Great price.
I love love this product. easy to make and so refreshing. i was able to contact the maker and found it in my area, now i can save on the shipping and handeling!

column9: delicious and refreshing but too sweet
column10: I wish they would use xylitol or stevia instead of sugar to make this healthier.It's very delicious and probably healthier than soda though. I would recommend this for an occasional sweet treat. Addictive.

this powder tea has granulated sugar in it to make it sweet. If your looking for it to be a healthy sweet your out of luck but if not I would say this product is delicious. It's presweetened so you ust put in a scoop and your on your way to drinking traditional green tea.

I apparently did not read the add thoroughly enough.  They have added sugar to this matcha which makes is basically useless for traditional tea ceremony and the sugar is not very healthy.  It tastes ok, so for someone just wanting some matcha ice cream or a dessert, its ok.
This stuff does taste kinda like starbucks. But with all the sugar I did'nt really enjoy it. Buy this if your running low on sugar and don't like green tea.

I first learned about maqui berries in a health food magazine, and couldn't wait to try it out. Not only is it jam packed with great vitamins and minerals, but it also has the highest antioxident value of any discovered fruit. The taste is very similar to the Acai berry, but in powder form, the maqui is quite bitter. I recommend mixing it with some other fruit. The way I use this powder is in a morning smoothie---it gives me a full day's worth of fruits and 1 serving of veggies all jam packed into my breakfast...I love this because it's always so hard to fit in fruits and veggies otherwise.My smoothie:2 tsp maqui powder1 tbsp chia seeds (also a super food)1 tbsp wheatgrass powder (another superfood)1/2 cup fresh or frozen fruit (I normally use strawberries, blueberries, or mango)6 or 7 ice cubes1/2 to 3/4 cup waterMakes me feel full all morning long. Hope you enjoy this as much as I do!
This stuff is amazing. I eat it right of the bag by the spoonfull.The deep purple color is very captivating to the senses.

This tea blend is excellent and tasty. Usually teas with valerian root are hard to drink as they smell/taste bad; not this blend! The Healing Tree blend has great flavor and will put you to zzzzzzzzzz.Finally a good valerian root blend on the market.We also like The Healing Tree Herbal Blend Echinacea Immune, Caffeine Free Loose Leaf Blend Tea, 2.08-Ounce Bags (Pack of 2)It works wonders especially during the cold season.

These are great snacks.  They're similar to the veggie sticks I often get in my local supermarket, but the shape is a bit fatter and hollow in the middle.  this makes them lighter and unfortunately easier for me to eat a lot of them.

column9: We love these! GMO-free & big hit with the kids.
column10: I just reviewed the sweet potato variety of these and wanted to share my thoughts on the veggie tortilla. I have bought bagged snacks very similar to these in the past for my kids, but while relatively healthy they weren't GMO-free. My kids loved these and I really appreciated the lack of genetically modified junk.
I couldn't get enough of these things.I couldn't get enough of these things.I couldn't get enough of these things.
wow. they may have good numbers as far as nutrition (or lack of bad things) goes but where's the flavor? yuk.

Too pricy for what you get. I was expecting something delicious but unfortunately it's just a plain tortilla taste with a different look. You could get the same thing with any other brand name without having to pay a lot for it.

These really are great bars- no I am in no way associated with the company, but can say I have tried all kinds of sports nutrition bars and this is one of the best around for sheer performance.  Use it as directed and you will be impressed too. I think this flavor is pretty tolerable-- after about 10 of them they begin to feel a little like compacted saw dust, but if you mix up the favors a bit it is not a big deal.  My wife loves this flavor, but it is my 3rd favorite that I have tried.  I wish they sold them in larger boxes or you could put them on auto delivery and save a little more on them.  I wouldn't do another tough mudder race with out them!
I typically get these bars at race expos but ran out and needed some to take on a trip.  They were a great price,  delivered on time.  I really love this product.

There spices and products are great. I live in a very northern area that does not have big stores or specialty shops so it is wonderful to be able to fill my spice shelf with every thing I need. Fabulous customer service too.

My girlfriend procured a pack of these the other day and had me sample several of the flavors.I generally have a discerning fruit candy flavor- I dislike many flavors (Eg orange, anything blue etc etc) however I was taken aback by the incredible flavor of these gummies.The consistency is perfect- firm but yielding in each piece, lightly covered in non-overwhelming sour grits perfect for chewers and suckers alike. I will continually use perfect to an excessive amount, because this is exactly what these sour candies are.The shapes are all in hearts, which makes perfect (again!) sense. There is a myriad of flavors, including out-there pomegranate and mango, which is not normally found in the sour candy sections. Each pack contains a generous helping of these candies, so each pack, regardless of the count, will last you quite a while (unless you're like me, or have friends).Contains real fruit juice, great flavor and is so addicting I'm going to go steal more from her, and not finish this rev
Have introduced to a number of people & have them all hooked. Best sour gummy ever, great flavors! Got it at a great price!
I highly recommend this product. However, it is cheaper to buy it at a store than online in bulk!

These are pretty good. In my opinion, they aren't nearly as good as the Teriyaki Beef Steak Nuggets (which are sort of similar), but they aren't bad either. They have sort of a prime rip au-jus flavoring, but you can tell that the meat itself isn't prime rib. It's definitely work a try to see if you like it.
I typically like this type of jerky.  These bags were dry, and had short expiration dates.  I am disappointed that amazon would ship these out with such close dates of expiration.
I purchased these as a treat for my dogs.(Yes they are spoiled).My grandkids, husband and I found them delicious!! P.S. The dogs loved when they could sneek some.

Jack Link does jerky better than just about anyone, and these are no exception. Nicely chewy without feeling like your jaws will give out. Good salty and beefy flavor. Amazon's prices are usually lower than in the store, even store sale prices.

column9: Very Tender and Consistently Great Jerky.
column10: This Jerky has been the Greatest I Have Had in Years Only Home Made Jerky is Better.  Mick PHX AZ.

Ordered two packages.  Each was supposed to have four bags.  One package was opened and one bag was missing.  Whoever boxed the two packages must have been hungry and helped themselves to one.  In addition, they were overpriced.  I see them at the checkout counter at WalMart for $3 a bag.  Do the math.

Love this product, just wish it were available in stores near me. I have found the buffalo fire kind which I don't like. Have not found the turkey jerky yet. Till then, guess I'll continue to purchase it from here.

column9: Like Beef Dipped in an Ashtray
column10: I'm a big fan of Jack Link's beef jerky, especially their flavored jerky's. I hadn't seen this one in the stores so when it went on sale on Amazon I scooped it up. Generally the beef nuggets and tendercuts style jerky's are not my favorite, for some reason the beef gets very rubbery compared to the regular style cuts, but I knew this diving into the bag of jerky.At first the taste was like the beef had been dropped in a pile of debris on a smokehouse floor, smokey, meaty and ashy tasting. I thought maybe it was just the initial taste  and continued to chew. It only worsened as I continued and eventually I swallowed and was met with a disgusting taste left in my mouth.Now that I have all four bags remaining I'm not sure what to do with them. I may give them away as a gag gift for the holidays and literally watch people gag as they try to eat this.

Very good. Tastes like Original Jack Links only with a little more flavor. Very tender and not dry, but a little on the salty side. The bag is HUGE though and there is a tiny amount in the bag! It's disappointing.

It's hard to judge this stuff as jerky, really, since it doesn't have a lot of "jerk" - they're little strips about the size and shape of a french fry - perhaps three inches long, and about 3/8" square. Thanks probably to powerful industrial meat chemicals, they're incredibly tender, and make great little meat-flavored snacks. My only problem with them is that you get maybe a dozen strips per bag, and they're kinda expensive to get so little. Oh well, meat's expensive.

column9: Not Prime Rib Beef and Salty
column10: - Obviously the beef is not prime rib as the name "Jack Links Prime Rib Beef Tender Cuts" suggests.- It's salty, contains MSG and doesn't taste as good as the steak nuggets.- The smell is too strong, especially its  "natural smoke flavor" ; eating in a room is not recommended.

I buy the turkey jerky now and then as a tasty way to get some extra protein either before/after a workout or as a snack throughout the day. It's a little bit steep on the sodium to have a bunch of it but other than that it's great. I like it a lot. Recommended.

I liked that it was chicken, you dont have to rip your teeth out tearing a bite off. With a chew it comes apart. Probably would have like a different flavor and with the bulk that I bought that was kind of a bummer. Id advise people to get a bag of each to see what flavor you like best. Not do what I did and get a unknown flavor in bulk.
I couldn't eat this after 1 first bite. I thought I was chewing salt marinated beef strips. Yuck! So disappointed at Jack Link's
This is not up to par for Jack Links products.  These are awful!  Gritty, they taste like I imagine dog snacks would taste.

column9: Make your own jerky save money.
column10: Make your own jerky and save money.  This product has MSG in it.  It's bad for you and unhealthy.  Just look on youtube how to make it yourself.  You don't need preservatives in your homemade jerky if you eat it within the week.

I by chance found this on the bottom row at a super Wal-Mart. I have tried a few other brands...some made from just corn and some from rice, but this company has got to be the best so far. It is just like eating regular pasta. I am hoping Amazon will carry it, but for now, I will just have to hope they are still being sold at Wal-Mart. Being allergic to gluten is not enjoyable. The alternatives that we find, most times are just not the same, so it was nice the night we sat down to dinner and discovered how good dinner was.

column9: Hands down, this is the best one in six years of looking.
column10: A distributor for foods here in Vegas gave me a package to try and I fell in love with it. I couldn't find it anywhere. Then I heard it might be a WalMart, and sure enough it was! I bought two packages and just finished a big bowl of spaghetti. On a hunch I checked Amazon and lo and behold it is here and on PRIME no less! Another reviewer echoed my same feeling that it is the perfect blend of rice and corn, so the corn doesn't overwhelm the sauce. Bravo!!!! I'll be making this pasta our household standard from here on. No more need to look. This is it!Vicki in Vegas

This pasta is so much better than other GF pasta. It must be the combination of rice and corn that makes it so much better. I've not been too excited about pasta made from just rice or corn, but this one is terrific.

column9: Finally! A GF pasta that I can enjoy.
column10: And my picky son even enjoyed it with plain butter.  No bitter after-taste, keeps its consistency, even when reheated in hot water for a couple of minutes.

My 15 year old daughter has just been diagnosed as gluten intolerant so we are on the quest to find as "normal" of food as we can.  This pasta definitely fits the bill - tastes great, just like semolina pasta. I'm very happy my sister told me about it - it will be our pasta of choice from now on.

Like most who find out about the GF world, we've tried all the pastas we could with mixed results.  The rice pasta would be a gummy mess and don't ask about leftovers...  The corn based pastas weren't bad, but still not as close to the old wheat flour pastas as Heartland GF pastas.  There's another GF company who also does a really good corn/rice pasta blend, but comparatively Heartland is a better buy and hard to tell the difference.  Now with both WM and Amazon carrying them it's a great buy vs. others at $4+/box!  Well, until Heartland or the like make the corn-rice blend in a full-size lasagna sheet we'll just have spaghetti night around our house until then.  At least now we're able to fully enjoy it!

column9: After 32 years, this is the best!
column10: We've been cooking gluten-free for 32 years, with three celiacs in the family.  My husband discovered Heartland GF Spaghetti at a restaurant and we all agree this tastes and cooks like "real" spaghetti.I was delighted when Amazon started carrying it.  Now it's out of stock!  Please say you'll carry it regularly.

column9: Stay away if extremely sensitive to wheat!
column10: I didn't buy this item, although I was about to. I went to the manufacturer website to look at the nutrition label. All is good until you get to the very end where it says it is processed in a facility WITH Wheat.

column9: Yummy! Pasta like we remember it!!
column10: We have found this pasta to be the best we've tried yet in our 6 months of GF living. Definitely recommend this product for those who have to be GF and those non-GF sharing a meal. You'll love it! Tastes like 'regular' pasta.
So far these are the best gluten free noodles I have tried.  The hold up well when boiling and taste good.  I love them.
I'm very gluten intolerant, but my family isn't.  With this pasta, they can't tell the difference so I can fix us all the same and they don't even realize it's wheat free.  Love it!!!

This is the best gluten free pasta I have eaten to date. When it was no longer available at Walmart I started shopping, and bought up some Penne and Fusilli. A call to Heartland revealed that the gluten free products will not be run again until the fall. Start posting alternatives boys and girls because thats's all there is and there ain't no more.

This was the first GF pasta I tried and I'm happy that it was!  This made great spaghetti.  I cooked it towards the longer end of what the bag called for.  There is NO aftertaste and is edible without any sauce on it!  The great thing is that you can find this at Walmart.  I've stocked up now!  My whole family enjoyed it (including my toddler)!
This pasta is awesome. It has great texture and flavor. There is no difference between this pasta or wheat pasta.  I highly recommend this to anyone who loves pasta whether it is gluten free or not.

This was a super tasting pasta.  It did not stick together or taste very much different than regular wheat pasta.  Did not have the texture of rubber like some rice pasta's. Make sure to take note of recommended cooking time.  Will definitely buy again!

column9: Processed in a facility that uses wheat
column10: Customers with gluten-intolerance: Be aware that this product is described as "gluten-free" and "wheat-free," but it is "processed in the facility that uses wheat and egg."12/02/2011: As "food," this item cannot be returned. However, Amazon still issued me a refund. Thank you very much. I am going to donate the item to a food-bank.
Was excited to try based on reviews.  No matter how much oil and stirring this is stickly and mushy and is nothing like the real pasta consistancy.  Do not waste your time and money on this product.

column9: Best so far, but no longer offered in the "Subscribe & Save" program
column10: I really loved this pasta! It tastes just like natural spaghetti but without all the pain and issues associated with gluten. Many other products would come out mushy and like oatmeal - but not this one, it tastes so much like ordinary pasta, I cannot tell the difference.I just purchased the "bionaturae Organic gluten-free pasta" because the Heartland G.F pasta has increased in price, is frequently out of stock, and no longer participates in the "Subscribe & Save" option (for those who aren't aware of this program, it saves you 15% and you can cancel at any time).  The other product mentioned, the Bionaturae pasta gives you 6 packs of spaghetti (rather than 5 included in Heartland) and still costs less when choosing the subscribe & save. The Bionaturae is offered in the subscribe & save and also has great reviews, so we'll see how it turns out. If it doesn't measure up to the heartland then I will just bit the bullet and order the heartland product.

I prepared this pasta according to the package directions, cooking it for 12 minutes.  It was great! I served it to my hubby and my gluten-free daughter who has never had spaghetti as far as she can remember.  Well, she used to eat it when she was three years old until she was diagnosed with celiac.  She loved this pasta.  Now, I'm afraid she can't get enough pasta.  She recently discovered pizza (gluten-free, of course) and now she has it at least once a week.  My hubby didn't realized the Heartland spaghetti was gluten free until I told him.  He thought it was wonderful, as did I.  I will certainly buy it again.  Now, I'm just waiting for it to come back to Amazon, because I don't know what store I bought it locally and don't want to start searching each one.

Bought this after reading all the favorable reviews. The pasta clumped into a massive ball when cooked according to directions. I tried unclumping and rinsing off the "slime" as it cooked. When I poured out my pasta what had been an entire pack had turned into about 1/2 cup. So much for a family meal that I could participate in without having to eat special food. I will never buy Heartland products again.

column9: Just like a regular white gluten pasta!
column10: Quite random but I found this pasta by a woman who told me in the gluten free section about how this pasta tastes and doesn't have any sort of gluten-free like texture.  We've bought Tinkyada brand for quite some time and still like the spinach and that bit of gritty texture but Heartland's pasta has been our regular go-to pasta these days.  It's very smooth, can't really tell it's gluten free and cooks fairly quickly.  I'm assuming it's becoming popular as often times we only see few in left at the store so we've decided to just buy them in bulk!  Highly recommended pasts if you miss that traditional starchy gluten pasta :)

This is the best gluten free pasta that i have found in the two and a half years that i have been gluten free. i really enjoy that i can bring it and cook it without it being known that it is gluten free. This tastes almost identical to regular pasta. this is also the cheapest pasta that i have found. i originally found it at a super walmart and the other day i saw it at hannfords which is closer. i love this along with the penne and the fusilli as well. I would recommend this product to anyone who is starting or already been on a gluten free diet.

I had someone visiting that requires a gluten  free diet . I make a mean marinara sauce so I ordered this pasta So that she could try it .  I personally enjoyed it immensely and could not believe it wasn't the real thing . Not only that, but I did not feel full or bloated after two bowls of it. I think I'm going to replace my pasta with this product because it taste so good and feels so good when I'm done eating.  It took exactly the same cooking time as regular pasta and my friend was surprised that the usual gluten free pasta characteristics did not exist with this product Like gooey and stickiness. I would highly recommend this product even if you don't Require the gluten free diet. Another point is as a leftover it was just as good which I understand is not true with Gluten free pasta.

column9: Love this pasta but price is expensive on Amazon
column10: This pasta is great for Gluten free! There is no film when cooking it and it tastes no different than wheat pasta. My only regret is the cost when buying it on Amazon. The only other carrier is Super Walmart and there is not one close to me so unless I want to travel for it this is the best alternative.

column9: Hands Down The Best Gluten Free Spaghetti!!!!!!
column10: This is by far the best gluten free spaghetti!  The taste and texture is EXACTLY like regular spaghetti!  You also cook it exactly like regular spaghetti.  Even thought only my 9 year old has Celiacs and cannot eat gluten, we all love Heartland Gluten Free spaghetti and eat it too!  Thank goodnes this product is easily available at Walmart or on Amazon.com!

I'm trying to eat healthier and I eat a lot of pasta but this is almost inedible. The pasta dissolves in the boiling water and makes a big mushy mess. I tried adding my sauce to it, but the combination is terrible. I won't be purchasing this brand again. I had high hopes.
Great taste, texture, flavor, and works well with any sauce! Wonderful pricing, too! Gluten free products are so expensive normally! Definitely recommend this!

So greatful for Heartland pastas. They are the best ones I've found! My husband, who does not need to eat gluten free, will enjoy these with me! They are not great for reheating but few things are. Thank you sooooo much!

column9: Best GF pasta I'v ever had
column10: Since I have had to go gluten free a year ago, I have missed the taste of "real" spaghetti!I have tried nearly all the GF kinds of spaghetti, and though they were alright, they were still not the same.  But I recently bought this, and I thought I was not eating gluten free!  I had to double check the package to make sure I made the right thing!  It was same in texture and taste!  Only I had NO reaction to them like I would a gluten pasta!  It was FABULOUS!I will forever buy only this kind of spaghetti!

column9: Taste & texture is just like regular pasta!
column10: I fixed this pasta a few days ago with a meat sauce, honestly, there was no difference in taste & texture and it warmed up beautifully. My son ate the last of it two days after I made it and he said it was delicious. We don't own a microwave either so he had to warm it in a pan. It held together as well as regular pasta. Found mine at Walmart and the price was reasonable.

My husband and I loved this pasta. It was our first experience with gluten free and we really could not tell the difference. In fact it might even have better than regular pasta. Also we didn't have the heartburn that usually accompanies pasta. I am thrilled that I don't have to give up pasta because I can't eat wheat. I highly recommend this product!

column9: WHAT A RELIEF TO HAVE GOOD PASTA AGAIN!
column10: We were introduced to this brand at a high-end restaurant.The secret is apparently that the primary ingredient in corn rather than rice.No more mushy GF pasta.  Incredible!
The Heartland Gluten Free dried pastas are great....much better than the brand the stores in this area sell.  I've requested them to stock it, but hope to find it available here on Amazon too.

Purchased these noodles when our family was put on a gluten free diet.  Thankful to find a alternative to wheat noodles I can not express my great disapointment.  The noodles became mushy and break down very badly.  While cooking a package for dinner I carefully watched and stirred the noodles as they shrunk in my pan.  In fear that there would not be enough noodles from this one package to feed my famiy of 4 (both of my children a small and do not eat large portions)  I put on a second pot and started cooking an additional bag of pasta.  By the time they were cooked and serve My husband and two chilren received a 1/4 cup of noodles and I received none.  They were gone it was like they shrank.  Not only were there not enough noodles, they were mushy.  I actually took every bag I had left in the pantry and returned them to the store, I have found the Tinkayana brand to be a much better pasta for the gluten free families.

column9: If Your Kids are Stupid Enough to Think Water is Cool When It's In a Bottle with a Cartoon Character, Then Fork Over Your Cash
column10: Each of the different Wat-aah! varieties have themes. I picked up the Power theme at the Natural Foods Expo, and I asked the guy what made it different. He looked a bit stunned, but he pointed out the magnesium in it and then looked at me blankly. That's one of two things wrong with the company's marketing. Everything else is spot on--well, except that they're selling water, and they're selling it to parents who should be making their kids drink water whether they want to or not. But that would require parenting. I digress.The other thing wrong with this product is the label copy. I don't know what the other bottles say, but I'm guessing kids aren't buying this water, so the label copy SHOULD sell the parents rather than the kids, but I would think the parents would reject the water, based on the copy. The copy explains to kids that they should fight to drink this cool Wat-aah! Power instead of spinach, because of the magnesium, which is apparently the only value in spinach. I digress again. The label even says that spinach "is green and sticks in your teeth" in comparison to the water that "comes in a cool bottle." Right under all of this is a Fight Childhood Obesity logo. Right. So, I'm going to bring something into the house that argues against them eating spinach, AND that helps me fight childhood obesity how? Now, I'm not saying that spinach is the answer, but do I need a company marketing themselves as a substitute for something else that is good for kids? Moreover, how could they think that's a good idea, a selling point to adults with critical thinking skills?Well, apparently they do. This water is marketed based on its cool bottle. But it's just water and some of the usual "special" stuff that is often in water we buy. It's also marketed to give kids "buying power" with the cartoon front and the spinach argument. Frankly, I'd rather any kid of mine didn't rely on marketing to make a product choice, and oh, guess what: they are kids. They don't get to make the product choices.The company has somehow made the right connections, gotten the right endorsements, achieved school distribution, and is conducting a social media campaign that is textbook perfect. Too bad they're also selling water and the idea that marketing to kids (and marketing to them in a way that doesn't support eating leafy green vegetables) is a good thing. If it wasn't for the mixed message on the copy, maybe I could accept that it's marketing like sugary cereals do: to the kids. But this product just teaches kids that bottled water is good. It's not a horrible lesson, but parents should be teaching their kids through the parents' buying power--not the kids. When they get a job, they can buy spinach-replacing water. And eat their damn spinach.

column10: First and foremost, I cannot stress how important it is to feed your cat an all canned food diet - cats do not have a drive for thirst, so only a canned food diet will keep them correctly hydrated [diabetes, urine crystal free].Important to learn: if you feed your cat all wet diet, they only need to drink 1oz of water a day to keep fully hydrated.  If you feed your cat an all dry diet, they need to drink 7oz of water to keep hydrated.  That's a full cup of water!Second, cat food must be high in protein, high to low in fat [depending if you want your cat to be lean], and have no more than 10% carbs.  Dry foods are 30% plus percent carbs. Diabetes is rampant in older cats, and it's recommended to keep their carb intake at 5-10%.You should feed grain-free diet and feed meat from feathered birds, not beef, never fish.  Grain free almost always means high fat, so be careful if you want to keep your cats lean and healthy.I feed this Fancy Feast formula, plus Merrick's cowboy cookout or grammy pot pie [grain free, low fat], plus wellness turkey and chicken formulas [grain free, low protein, high fat].
