The Orchid pot was covered in paper towelsls which were taped atop the bark mix, the entire plant was wrapped in SHREDDED newspaper INSIDE more paper wrapped around that AND taped THEN covered in packing peanuts AND the heat pack was TAPED to the box, so it didn't knock around and damage the Orchid! I have NEVER seen someone take such good care of a plant. I had another order arrive the same day from another company, in which I had ordered two Maranta Prayer plants. The soil was only covered with tape, nothing really to keep it in the pot (soil actually came through the bottom of the box) and they were set in the box unprotected and only surrounded by a few packing peanuts. The box was way oversized, the heat pack was ice cold, the plants could be heard moving just by tipping the box. Needless to say they were in complete shock! That is what I usually expect, and I prepare for it. This I was NOT prepared for. This order I am beyond pleased with. I cannot wait for the three I just ordered today. You have my total thanks and the packing is why I came back. Well, and the price. Haha. Thank you eternally.
Amazing!  Amazing!  Plant was received very nice and healthy, bigger than the picture.  Nicely packed.  Mailed to me on Saturday, received on Monday.  Thank you!

wonderful little seedling. Can't wait for it to get big enough to flower. It was well packed with shredded paper around the leaves and pot, then wrapped with paper and taped well. the outer box was of a heavy cardboard and very well taped closed. There were 'fragil' 'handle with care' and 'do not freeze' labels all over. shows that the people that did the packing really care about their product. Everything was just as I hoped it would be.

I had this shipped to a very dear friend who has taken up orchid growing. I didn't see the orchid myself yet, but my friend was beyond thrilled with it. It arrived in perfect condition (must be some brilliant packers at this grower) and it ws a very healthy specimen that she was excited to watch grow. I would definitely use this grower/shipper again based on my friend's report.

My orchid arrived within about 2 days after I ordered it and was perfectly packaged and healthy. Please do remember, it is a seedling and will take up to two years before it is mature and flowering! I've had mine for a month and a half now and it is doing beautifully!

This was a great deal for a chocolate orchid, which is quite pricey, and came in a well cared for manner as well as looking very much alive. It did not come ready to bloom as stated in the details of the item but it is on its way to blooming and think this is a very good product for a person who knows how to take care of orchids.
Plant was in good shape but missed the bit about not blooming for perhaps up to a year.  Mom very disapointed.

These decorations are perfect for whatever you are making for Valentine's Day!  Sprinkle them on cupcakes or cookies.  Dip pretzels in chocolate and sprinkle the chocolate before it cools.  Can be used year round for a fun sparkle of pink/red on your desserts.
These were exactly what I was looking for to add a finishing touch to my Valentine's Day cookies!  Arrived quickly.

The taste of this Balsamic Vingear is very good for the price!!! Vinegar comes in a spray bottle wonderful for salads & cuts down on waste when you added to anything else!!! Vinegar comes in a six pack each bottle 8.5 Ounces.Price $33.25 for six pack but some of the Very Best sells for Over $100 a 4 Ounce bottle. I never tasted that Quality but like I stated earlier DeLallo tastes deliteful & its made in Italy!!!

I am a nurse that has suffered with GERD or acid reflux. After also suffering the side-effects of medications like prilosec, I was introduced to this product. By the time I finished the bottle, I no longer needed the medication. It has beneficial enzymes that aid in the breakdown of your food, it enables you to absorb more nutrients, and helps you achieve regularity if you don't already have it. In addition to that, it helped my whole family reduce allergy symptoms. Even if you have great insurance that will cover the cost of your meds, this alternative is worth every penny. Trust me--I'm a nurse!

price is good, taste is good; but from description I somehow assumed it would be whole baby beets, but it is not. also, I don't think I have the palate to determine if a ground/pureed beet is a baby beet or not lol.some added sugar, but according to the label no preservatives at all, which is great. (beetroot, water, horseradish, sugar, vinegar, salt). imported from poland.anyhow they're tasty (if a little too salty for my taste) just have to find a different application for them (soup bases maybe)

I can tell by the packaging that this product was geared for kids, and it makes for a completely trustworthy snack. But I have to say that I loved it too! I'm currently on a kick to eliminate refined sugar from my diet, and it's been a challenge. But products like this one make it doable.Bear in mind that this isn't just dried fruit, it's freeze-dried...devoid of moisture. That may sound unappealing, but it's really good--the texture is crunchy, and you can soak it in your mouth for really long flavor. There's no added sugar in this, but it's really sweet on its own. I use it for dessert or whenever I need a sweet fix.

I absolutely LOVE this stuff! I love the crunch, and knowing I can eat the whole bag guilt free because it is a healthy low calorie snack. So far this is my favorite flavor, but I still need to try the pineapple lime ~ I can't wait!!!

I've tried nearly all available low calorie freeze-dried pineapple snack treats.  "Funky Monkey" ranks at the TOP of my list!  This wonderful freeze-dried pineapple snack is imported from Brazil.  It's all natural and gluten-free.  One one-ounce package contains 110 calories.  It has the best flavor of all the freeze-dried pineapple snacks I've tried ever.  The pineapple chips have a crunchy texture that's like eating candy.  If you live in California, you can find them at your local Ralph's Super Market.  Unfortunately my local Ralph's runs out quickly.  Thankfully Amazon provides me with a way to satisfy my craving for Funky Monkey.  Be sure to get the 1-ounce packages.  The 1/3 ounce packages are disappointingly small portions.  However, if you are dieting then go with the small packages.  They make a satisfying low calorie snack to get you through the day.  I highly recommend this product!
I like this flavor of the Funky Monkey snacks best.  It's tart and not too sweet.  This makes a gret snack to keep at the office or for the kids!

Being diabetic, I always carry one of these little delicious, no added sugar snacks in my purse, in case I need a pick-me-up to prevent low blood sugar. Another thing in its favor is this snack is gluten-free. Ordering from Amazon is fast, and they always seem to have the food products that I need.
My little guy loves these snacks.  I like that they are healthy, relatively mess-free (as much as anything can be with toddlers), and easy to take along anywhere.

This is delicious and my kids love it.  As far as I can tell, it's actually dried pineapple with guava dusted on it, rather than chunks of guava, as other reviewers have described.  Perfect lunchbox snack when the kids want something sweet and I want them to have something healthy!

Our family loves dried fruit as a healthy snack, but the Pink Pineapple flavor of Funky Monkey is beyond a doubt the best we've had.  My 3 and 5 year old children and I eat it regularly.  It makes a healthy dessert substitute, a delicious after-school snack, and a simple way to pack a serving or two of fruit in a school lunch box.The pink pineapple product is made of freeze-dried, organic pineapple.  A light powdering of guava paste gives it a subtle pink color and guava taste.  This freeze-dried fruit is very crunchy, and I've noted that it stays crunchy with the package open much longer than other freeze-dried fruit products that seem to absorb moisture from the air quickly and turn spongey.  Ew!The .42 ounce size is a perfect size to put in a child's lunch box and delivers a full serving of fruit and 40% of your Vitamin C for the day.  The 1 ounce size makes a reasonable snack for an adult, shared between two children, or for one hungry after-schooler.  You will be surprised how quickly 12 packs of this versatile snack will be used.Pink Pineapple Funky Monkey packages contain full servings of fruit, are gluten free, fat free, vegan, raw, all natural, 95% organic, and have no added sugar, color, flavors, or preservatives, .  What's not to like?!

I had high expectations - 50% pineapple 50% guavaTurned out it is 100% pineapple 0% guavaI could not find even a single piece of freeze dried guava in 4 packets i finished.The freeze dried pineapples get 5 stars and the product is overall satisfying, though you will finish a featherweight packet in seconds and then have to resist the urge to open the next packet to fill a void. Since the company deceived me you get 1 star.
I wish they had included directions because it cost me some trouble shooting to figure out the proportion of milk to powder, but after a few tries, I got it down and it was deeelish!

Acana Grasslands is one of the only dry kibbles I didn't have to mix into another food (or transition in) for it to be accepted by my one year old cats. They dove right into it.It's an all breed, all lifestage grain free kibble made by Champion Foods, who also produces Orijen. They are Canadian based and tout having regional meats delivered each day to add into their formula. They utilize regional ingredients and likely, regional suppliers. I'm cool with that.I mix Acana 50/50 with other high quality kibble as part of my rotation. Acana kibble shape is round and flat. The colour is very dark and if you're transitioning from a light colour food you'll note kitty's darker 'output'.I believe it's true Acana is more fish based than Orijen, but it's an excellent quality food which I'll continue to purchase. I like to buy the smallest bags available and plan to try Wild Prairie formula next.

column9: Best dry cat food I know of
column10: This is the best dry catfood I have tried to date.  A friend recommended it and I can't praise it enough.  So good I was initially using it as cat treats to teach tricks while I was transitioning from their old food.  This is grain-free with stellar ingredients and is sold for decent price by Amazon and most of the better online pet stores (petfooddirect, Mr. Chewy, etc.).  Good stuff and worth every penny - and doesn't cost any more than the cheap stuff in the long run because with this you are feeding quality not quantity.
Obviously the candy was delicious, the packages inside the box were smaller than I find at the local stores.  shipping speed was good.

column9: Way better than the usual Twizzlers
column10: I was involved with a Teach-In at my daughter's school.  Since my subject was the visible spectrum and how rainbows get created, this box of Rainbow Twizzlers provided the perfect handout (along with some diffraction-grating glasses).  The kids went wild!Since there was a pack or two left over, I tried a few of the Twizzlers.  They were fruit-flavored and quite tasty when compared with the standard dark red Twizzler variety.  My daughter (and son) loved them.
These were perfect party favors for our tea party. The girls loved them all. I would buy these again.Nice variety.

I just had an adult Mad Hatters Tea Party and put a whole bunch of these lollipops in a vase as part of the centerpiece on each table, They are so detailed and beautiful and just made perfect Favors for the Ladies.

column9: Great party token for a Tea Party
column10: I ordered these to go in the Party Bags for my daughters 4th Birthday Tea Party!  They were a hit.  I never got to taste one, but it was the first thing the little girls grabbed and I saw happy, messy faces everywhere.  They must have been tasty!Thanks for the smiles.

If you are unfamiliar with miso find out about it.  If you know what it is be assured that this is the best.  Using a small amount is better than a large amount. Add this at the end after mixing it with a bit of water to dissolve. It should not even be simmered, add it and let stand.

column9: This is a light and refreshing drink that is good for you when are hot from exercise or working outside!
column10: Working outside in the summer or exercising can deplete your body of necessary water, electrolytes and energy. This is a good tasting low calorie drink that refreshes you and helps maintain a healthy balance of what your body needs. Each 32 ounce bottle has 4 servings and each serving has 20 calories, 5 Grams of sugar, 110 mg of sodium and 30 mg of potassium. It replaces the salt you have lost from sweating and the potassium helps your muscles not cramp.This is an ideal drink for those lighter workouts or if you are diabetic and need to get refreshed quickly but don't need a lot of sugar. It contains the same electrolytes and hydration as the original Gatorade with ½ the calories and 1/3 of the carbohydrates.It is great for those hot summer days. It is best served cold and shaken before drinking.The unit price here is not bad but the shipping is extremely high. It is a very good product.

Bookbinders White Clam Sauce makes linguini or spaghetti taste just wonderful.  Sauce is great, but the clams are tender, and sweet, making everything taste terrific.  Buy a lot of this because you'll want to have a lot on hand to serve surprise guests, or to secretly stash away, for yourself.Preparation is easy.  Make your favorite pasta, heat the sauce, and combine.icq3PS...Thank you again AMAZON for having this product available.

column9: Best pancakes I've had in long while!
column10: Picked this up at the Milk Pail Market in Mt. View, Ca. Later read that the company was local (San Francisco) and I was very impressed with the taste and quality! I even got my boyfriend to eat a stack of three and he HATES sweet food :) Needless to say we were VERY impressed.

I received the recommendation as a more natural healthy alternative to the more commercialized brands of avoderm, royal canine , and others.That have either reduced the quality of there food over time or bought out by larger pet food companies and drastically change the formuls. I was very pleased to have changed considering my english bulldog started to get allegies from those other foods. Her allergies eased dramatically once i started her on the Pinnacle. I find the food to be substantially better in quality and ingredient structure and heriarchy of the elements contained within. i find it equally comparable to Halo and Lonovo. The only negative is that if your dog has yeast problems inside and out then this product delivers its fair share of sugars(Carbs) from the potatoes which help fuel the yeast. i used for several months and would recommend to other dogs without yeast problems. good luck but, trying many types and finding the one that works is the best strategy.

My pointer mix has a sensitive stomach, and he also has a sensitivity to chicken.  This has been working really well.  Solid stools and no more noticeable gas!  My small dog, a havanese , is also doing well on it, but he has a strong stomach anyway.  And they both seem to love the taste.  As an added bonus, the pieces are small.  So that is helpful for my little dog.
Our dogs love this food and it good for them; no fillers, no corn, no wheat. It doesn't smell bad even though its made of fish. Highly recommended.

column9: Excellent Buy On GOOD Food for Dogs
column10: This is a good value for an excellent dog food. She loves it alone, but I usually mix in a little "Stella & Chewy's" so she will eat it all up at once. Has really helped her skin allergies!

I was looking for good quality limited antigen ingredient diet that has not had a recall in last few years. This is no easy task, but Pinnacle is one of those diet. I feed the Salmon and Potato to my chocolate lab who was having chronic ear infections since he was 9 weeks of age. As soon started diet at at 6 months of age the ear problem resolve with in a week. He is now 2 years of age and I have not even had to clean his ears since starting this diet. Reputable company, quality ingredients, good comparative price, and no recent recalls on diets. Thanks Pinnacle for producing a quality product for my pet.

column9: Best service for a great item
column10: I had ordered both fresh white trufflesFresh White Truffles 1 ounce ( White Alba Truffle) and some caviar close to a holiday weekend (on the Thursday before Christmas on Sunday) and I had done so without anticipation of getting them except in time for New Years. Shipping was noted as $6 for each of the 2 items I'd ordered.Not only did the seller notice the 2 orders shipping to the same location and consolidated the shipping cost to $8 for both. But they obtained my phone number from Amazon, called me to tell me that normally they overnight these types of items in any event, but while they would happily upgrade for Saturday Delivery at no charge to me so I would have the order for Christmas, they had worries that there was possibly no Saturday delivery in rural area (I live in Bridgehampton NY and they were correct, there is no Saturday deliver here even from Fed-X) and so, to avoid the order sitting around unrefrigerated from Friday till Tuesday, they were calling to ask if they should hold the order and instead ship Tuesday for Wednesday.Since I did not pick up my calls Thursday eve or Friday AM rather than just leave a voice-mail a call their job done, when I finally answered a call at 5:20 Friday, it was from a seller employee's cell phone, who had my order with him, in order to be able keep it freshest, pending an instruction from me, and so as to make absolutely sure they were following my wishes.As you can imagine the items received were commensurate with that service, and when they arrived Wednesday morning they were perfect IN EVERY WAY.And no matter how expensive the items (and they were the cheapest of their kind I found this season), this kind of service, while certainly also rare as the items themselves, is in my estimation, priceless.
We've enjoyed this tea.  The wooden box is also nice - lightweight and certainly not fancy, but a nice holder for the tea.

This product is by far one of the best cookies this universe has ever known. Tiny TRON discs of delicate and balanced crunch and chocolate that ebbs and flows like a dream landscape, reality becomes liquid candles and you are the wick... set yourself ablaze and eat these cookies.They really are the best cookies, I'd place them side by side with those LU Cookies Le Petit Ecolier, The Little Schoolboy which can also be bought here on Amazon.Why settle for boring cookies when you can eat the best?
When I got this product it was packaged a little tight but the chips WERE AMAZING. Got the product sooner than I thought I would. All over all great product!
Great product. The taste is on fire! The Takis got here weeks ahead of estimated time.  Only problem is it is a small bag.  I will have to order the bigger bags next time.

This are so good the little ones are the best and there hard to find in San Diego, Ca. They only thing is there expensive at this place wish they would cut you a better deal. But will still buy from time to time.

column9: Wow love the Spices and Lime, Spices Have A Real kick to them
column10: Wow, love the Spices and lime.Spices Have a Real kick to them, and each one is well covered with them.Hard crunch but good crunch. After all it is a tight rolled up tortilla.Looking forward to buying more.
today i got my takis mini it came quick and fast it only takes 5 days for me to get my.but when i got it it taste great it came in a big bag and it was good
Great price daughter enjoyed. Perfect little snack bags. These would be perfect as party favors too. I will most likely order again.

The products great! we love it and that is why we ordered it all the way from back home. We miss getting them all the Time in San Diego,The shipping started off slow but when they did ship they used 2 day so it is all good.

As noted by others, this item arrived days/weeks ahead of the projected arrival (I've purchased it twice).  The packaging by Party Favors Club is well done; the chips are not crushed during delivery.  My boyfriend and I find the Fuego Takis to be addicting, so having a 200 calorie snack size helps with portion control--and a little really does go a long way!  The corn chips are crunchy, pleasantly spicy-hot, and have a perfect touch of lime.  Yes, I wish they were a little cheaper . . . but having 25 small servings does help them last longer than a single large bag would last in my home.

Sadly, NO. This little boy in a hospital three states away from here wanted ONLY this package of Taki's (25 pack) from his father when he had to be transported 2 1/2 hours from his home in an ambulance....BUT...the product took too long to be delivered through the mail (?) apparently and the young boy was discharged about four or five days after admission so left the hospital before his package ever arrived. I assume it did arrive, never heard from the hospital and it was never forwarded...sorry!

We bought this from a candy shop a couple of years ago. Make no mistake - this is not chocolate and it has no chocolate flavor. The orange in its name refers to the color it changes - not to its flavor.The directions call for you to mix the powder with hot water. If you do this it will taste terrible. It becomes only mildly acceptable (to some) when mixed with hot milk rather than water.Its only real use is that the empty cauldron can be used for a decoration around Halloween.

I totally agree with the other reviewer.  I bought this (although I bought it with a Harry & David label on it so it was probably more expensive!) and no one in my family liked it.  It is not hot chocolate - more like what they call "white chocolate".  I thought it would be a chocolately orange flavor, yum.  Neither chocolate nor orange flavor.  Only the color is orange.  A big disappointment, I ended up throwing it out.  The cauldron is cute, but the words around the edge don't come off so it's not really reusable.

Well I wish I had seen the two reviews above before buying this! It did turn orange, but it certainly was not chocolate. It tasted like a overly sweet and yet bland orange cream. Wreaked havok on my innards! Very glad we did not serve it at our Halloween party as planned.
If you are like me and just like the cauldron you can pick it up at Walgreens for just a little above four dollars.They have the coffins as well.
I'm always looking for things to put these toasted seeds on. Great in salads, meat loaf and on sandwiches. Love them!

I never say it but I say it today...OMG! These are the best sesame seeds I have ever tasted!!!!!!! I was shocked at how crispy and tasty these sesame seeds are right out of the bottle.  It was difficult to stop eating them.  I use these in cookie recipes, on salads, on steaks, on PBJ sammies, in yogurt. These guys did an awesome job with this product, especially for the price. You will not be dissapointed.
I have had problems with high blood pressure so I changed to a low sodium diet. This product really helps me in making sauces and soups without sacrificing taste.

Bonne Maman has done it again - captured the natural flavor of the fruit.  In the case of Bonne Maman Grape Jelly, the muscat grape flavor is so true that you almost feel you are using jelly Grandma made.  The color of this jelly is a reddish-purple; it is a clear, fresh hue - exactly like that of the muscat grapes from which it is made.  The consistency is not so firm that it does not spread easily, but not so runny as to flow off the sides of your bread/toast.I have found Bonne Maman Grape Jelly at our local grocery stores.  It sells there for $3.49 - $3.99 per 13 ounce jar; I have not yet seen it in some of the off-price retailers who generally stock a limited supply of Bonne Maman products.If you are tired of the grocery store concord grape jellies which taste like sugar and little else, I recommend you try Bonne Maman Grape Jelly.  It has a natural, true grape flavor and is worth the extra cost.  I hope Bonne Maman will expand their product line further and introduce a concord grape jelly/preserve.

I bought this coffee at a local store.  It is truly the worst coffee I have ever had.  I first noticed the flavor was almost like burned plastic.  When I poured it out it looked pale, not dark. There were big pieces of what looked like pieces of grass or wood.  It had almost no aroma, but the bag was not broken.
I ordered this because I was looking for something to replace Millstone Foglifter after the price got so outrageous.  Wile not quit as rich it fit the bill will reorder

I took a chance on this coffee becaused the only rating gave it a one star.  I was pleasantly surprised.  I make my coffee one cup at a time with a mesh camping filter and drink it immediately thus getting all the benefits of the flavor before it leaves for the atmosphere.  Hopefully the quality control is such that your cup will also be pleasant.
This is the worst coffee I have ever gotten from amazon.Not worth the time and effort I spent reviewing all the coffees at the site.

column9: I was looking for something different
column10: So, I tried some of this coffee , I made a pot about five Minuets ago Ill try to describe for you what i'm tasting . Its ok , Its light but, not to light ,well rounded and I slight Vanilla taste witch I usually sum up to poor quality coffee . I think some people would really like this one , I prefer the Jamaican blue but , This is Vary good also .Ill try this on some friends I know like this kind of coffee .Coffee is pretty much personal taste , although I like something better doesn't mean its not great coffee .

I ordered this bag of coffee just to get my order up to $25 for free shipping but I won't ever order it again.  It's hardly even on par with grocery store stuff, a little stale smelling too  - it's sure no Peet's Coffee!  Of course Peet's costs a fortune!

Hands down this is one of the best prepared soups out there. Add 4 1/2 to 5 cups of water.  After it's cooked (about 30 to 45 minutes), I add yogurt to the bottom of the serving bowl, pour in the soup and mix. The yogurt helps to enhance the other spices. I sometimes add salt to this soup.  Yum!  It really is a favorite in my home.  If you love soups...try it.  You'll be pleasantly surprised at how good it is.

I love Sadaf products in general and their soups are so yummy. Really easy to make and taste so good. Great dinner/ lunch for winter time and you don't have to go through few hours of prepration. I also took them to our ski trip last year and had the Ash ready for 20 people in 50 min.

I looked high and low for over a year trying to find this salad dressing.  It won awards for best salad dressing two years in a row at the Fancy Food show.  I finally found it here.  To be honest, I don't love it.  It tastes a bit like the Italian salad dressing offered at many inexpensive salad bars I used to go to.  I am surprised because I buy a lot of products from this company and all of them have been amazingly delicious.  This isn't my favorite.
I was looking for something with a good taste and less "chemical" ingredients so I decided to give this a try. BINGO! This is great tasting.

Good opportunity to sample some of the various Timothy's k-cup selections and find your favorites. You can't beat the convenience and consistency of the k-cup system. Since I don't see that Amazon provided a description of what's included in the variety pack.....Includes two of each of the following varieties: Breakfast Blend, Kona, Parisian Nights, Espresso Extra Bold, Colombian Dorado, Italian Blend, Hazelnut, Colombian Decaf., Chai Tea, Green Tea ,English Breakfast Tea & Canarino.

I couldn't find any place that would tell you what came in this variety pack.  So here you go.  There are 2 of each kind in each 24 ct box.-Parisian Nights extra bold-Italian Blend-Kona Blend-Breakfast Blend-Decaf Colombian-Colombian Dorado-Rainforest Expresso extra bold-Hazelnut-Chai Tea-English Breakfast Tea-Chinese Green Tea-Italian Hot Lemon BeverageHopes this helps, I wish someone would have done this for me, because I don't like the idea of having tea in what I thought was a coffee variety pack.  I like tea don't get me wrong, but I was hoping to try a bunch of different coffees.

Great mix of flavors. Just read the fine print. This pack also includes teas, decaf, and a lemon drink which is just horrible. My coworkers don't drink tea or decaf, so I won't be buying this mix again. For those that do, this is an excellent choice. The Timothy brand overall is our favorite for our Keurig.

While variety packs sound like a good idea, you should be aware that there is a reason you usually aren't told exactly what's in it. It's because almost always, the vendor throws in a bunch of flavors, blends, teas, and decafs that are not usually what you want. It can be a waste of money for most.A much better solution, besides sampling a friends K-cup favorites, is to go onto the Keurig site ( http://www.keurig.com/KCupResults.asp?AllProducts=AllProducts&mscsid=HGR8G81WMFQB9NS0DN0EH4MKJREN8UAF ) and buy their low cost 5 packs. They usually cost under $3 and give you enough coffee to help decide what you might like. Plus, you'll know exactly what's in the smapler before you buy it.It is also a great idea to visit the K-Cup Exchange on Yahoo http://groups.yahoo.com/group/K-CUP/  This site is an excellent source of K-Cup info and allows you to trade unwanted k-cups, and talk to others to find the best deals and brewing tips.
I thought I was geting a variety package of coffee.  There were  2 lemon drinks , 2 green tea, 2 chia tea and 2 decaf coffee.  Not enough real coffee in this product.

I too was shocked that a third of the k-cups in this product were tea or lemon beverages.  Foolish me -- when I order a product called "Timothy's World Coffee K-Cup Variety Pack," I actually expect it to contain a variety of COFFEE k-cups. Having to order a minimum of two boxes from Amazon only compounded the problem.I am giving this product one more star than it otherwise deserves because when I called the company to complain, they did send me one free box of just coffee k-pods. However, the combination of deceptive labeling and having to throw away a third of the contents of the box unused makes this a poor product choice in my opinion.If this product contained only coffee k-pods, I would probably order it again because the coffee k-pods actually in it were pretty good, but I certainly don't recommend it now.

I have never ordered k-cups on-line before! Is it not deceptive, not informing consumers that the coffee is outdated, as mine was almost a year out of date. Now i am skeptical ordering k-cups again, also i have some more on the way as gifts, and hope these are not outdated!

Includes two of each of the following varieties: Breakfast Blend, Parisian Nights, Espresso Extra Bold, Colombian Dorado, Italian Blend, Hazelnut, Colombian Decaf.,  Green Tea ,English Breakfast Tea & Canarino.NO KONA OR CHAI TEA,they sent  French Roast, Ethiopian Kimssa instead

column9: A very good sampler if you are giving a Keurig as a gift
column10: It's hard for me the believe this myself but so far I have given 8 Keurig coffee makers away (five model B40s, two B60s and two B70s) as gifts and I always give this sampler to go along with the k-cups included with the machine.  I feel that it includes a very good selection of coffees and teas.  If someone does not like a particular beverage (some people NEVER drink tea for instance) the recipients have found that they can keep them on hand for guests.  This does not include all of my favorites but it does have a very good mix.  Here are some of the most popular:Hazelnut:  I don't know why but most of the women in my family (and many  of the men) LOVE this one.Rain Forest Espresso:  If a person likes a full bodied coffee then this could be the one for them.Breakfast Blend:  A milder, medium blend that a lot of people enjoy.Chinese Green Tea:  This is becoming more and more popular in the US and my friends who drink tea like this K-Cup.English Breakfast Tea:  A classic.And the not-so-popular ones:Italian Hot Lemon Beverage:  I have personally never met someone who liked this one.  I am sure that someone does, just no one that I know.Italian Blend:  I usually like an Italian coffee but this one is not popular with my friends, family and guests for some reason.There are others in this pack but in my experience these are the ones that the people in my life usually love and the ones that they avoid.

Hey, don't take the list of included flavors too seriously, I got different items in mine, and I suspect you will too... It was kinda fun to get the surprise flavors! Now if only they'd decide which flavors for which days, lol, I spend so much time just deciding which of the wonderful flavors to try each day!p.s. Rainforest Espresso: way strong. Good, but strong. Consider having some flavored creamer around in case you find it to be too much (I usually don't, but was lucky I did today)

Great sampler just got better! They no longer have the hated "hot lemon beverage" and instead have replaced it with Kahlua flavored coffee! YUM! I just ordered 2 of these, arrived here in 2 days even with the free super saver shipping and here is what I was in the box:-Parisian Nights extra bold x2-Italian Blend x2-Kona Blend x2-Breakfast Blend x2-Decaf Colombian x2-Fair Trade Colombian Dorado x2-Rainforest Expresso extra bold x1-Hazelnut x2-French Vanilla x1-Kahlua coffee x1-Original Donut Blend x1-Mexican Organic x1-Chai Tea x1-English Breakfast Tea x1-Chinese Green Tea x1
I love this coffee.  Timothy's is a good all-around coffee if you're not sure what to order.  It isn't too strong and the variety pack let me try all the different kinds.

I'm not what most people would call a coffee drinker. I love an occasional cup but I don't have to have coffee everyday. Being able to brew a single cup at home using my Keurig Brewer instead of running to St@rbuck$ saves a bunch of money. Timothy's World Coffee is some of the best tasting coffee around. I prefer the rich bolder blends. I got the variety pack, as it allows me to taste different kinds and find out what I like and what I don't. My shipment came very quickly and was well packed. I have been enjoying my occasional cup of java a bit more often since it arrived.I do wish they would leave out the teas they included. I want coffee not tea. In addition, if I wanted decaf I would have ordered decaf. They could have left the decaf out too. Otherwise its a pretty good mix.

column9: Good but ... Timothy's needs a coffee-only variety pack
column10: The box contains a true cross-section of coffee types, from flavored types to darkest roast. The Rainforest Espresso was a favorite dark roast, and the Columbian Dorado was the ideal medium roaster (IMO). Others in my family have different tastes though, so your mileage may vary as well.As other reviewers have pointed out, the heavy presence of teas included here, raised the cost-per-cup significantly. Nobody in our home likes hot teas, and although I did get one good iced-tea conversion, the effort expended removes convenience from the picture.Bottom line: Timothy, you need a coffee-only variety pack!! Maybe one with some more varieties in addition to the coffees already there. I would then rate the score upward to a 5. As it is, the ever-present frustration of seeing those darned teas in there, takes some of the fun out of deciding which K-Cup to brew next.Just a closing thought - Big Cat Coffees offers a build-your-own box of five selections (including Timothy's), which IS very useful, but not much different in price.

I love Timothy's coffee and have purchased their K-cups several times.  Just for the heck of it, I decided to count the K-cups when I opened the box.  The first box only contained 20 k-cups (despite the fact that the box and Amazon listing said that it would contain 22).  I opened the second box--and I got the same thing, ONLY 20 K-cups! Each box was shorted by 2. That's almost 2 dollars worth of product. Ridiculous! I called Timothy's Coffee to complain. I haven't heard back from them, yet.  I will update when I do.I have another package of K-cups coming.  You better believe I will be counting those as well!**Update: Amazon customer service was great.  They sent me two more boxes, both of which contained the advertised number of K-cups.  Maybe the first set of boxes I got were a fluke, maybe not.  Either way, I'll be counting them from now on.

Yes, it does include tea, and a lemon drink, but now amazon does state that in the description.What I found slightly disappointing was that I had mixed quantities of each item in the 48 pack.  I had 2 of some drink and 4 or 5 of another.  Makes me wonder if I was missing any flavors.  Just be prepared for a true variety.  I found Timothy's coffee's to be a much bolder, stronger taste than the Gloria Jean's variety I tried.
didnt know there was tea in the pack-wasnt specified anywhere. I dont like the tea that was in there,and wouldnt have ordered it. Some of the coffee pods were too weak.
This box contains a pretty good mix. I'm not a big fan of K-cup teas and could have done without those.
This box of k-cups has something for everyone: coffee in bold, medium, and decaf, plus tea. We opened it for Thanksgiving and everyone had fun choosing their own flavors.
I bought these for my parents. They LOVE them! There are at least 15 different kinds in each box. It's a GREAT variety of choices!

This is an excellent way to have a variety of different K cups rather than just having the same ones day after day. The selection is very good, includes a couple of de-cafs along with other blends. I like strong coffee and Timothy's blends are one of my favorites

column4: Jolly Green Giant "You can try Birchbox too! ...
column9: One of my favorite variety packs to date
column10: I've had my keurig brewer for a few years now yet I've not had a chance to sample several of the varieties included in this pack. I especially loved getting to try the Kahlua (pass), Italian Blend (interesting), Kona (not as good as I expected), and Parisian Nights (definitely will buy) since those have piqued my curiosity for a long time. I just never wanted to order four dozen of each of those k-cups at a time. I was also curious on how well tea works in K-cups and have decided I will stick with Stash bags for now. This is a great way to find your favorite k-cups without buying box after box. It's also great to have for guests so they can have some variety to suit their palates. I wish all of the companies that make k-cups would do this.

*Previous lists don't mention the French Vanilla, which was incl.I've enjoyed quite a few varieties of Timothy's (and others)K-Cups and had little to no problems with them. Cinnamon Pastry is one example of a coffee I really enjoy.This variety pack however seems to be a mix of their least popular blends, or perhaps the batches that were slightly "off". And going off this experience I won't be trying any of the coffees in the pack on their own except for the Kona & Breakfast blends.The tastes were dark (burnt), bitter and unappealing, each cup made me regret my choice to reach for the coffee mug. Not to mention the after effects were not pleasant, I actually could feel the crappiness of these blends for hours.The French Vanilla was downright disgusting, I don't think they could decide if they wanted to make a soft vanilla flavor  or a strong vanilla liquor experience and it's a horrible mix of the two.Also, as previously mentioned, nearly half the box is NOT coffee but tea's that sound... more interesting than appealing.So if you're in for an adventure and don't really care about the taste of your coffee or tea, go for it!Otherwise... consider sample packs directly through the coffee company, they cost less and give you better options.

Being new to the K-cup world, this variety was a good introduction to the flavors out there.  However, my husband uses it mostly, gravitating to the strong flavors and there are no decaf drinkers in the house - so we are waiting for guests to comment on those.

The coffee was good, but there wasn't enough of it.  Ten of the 22 cups were tea or decaf.  A list of what's included needs to be added.  I wouldn't have ordered this had I known that there was so much tea in the pack.
Delicious cup of coffee anytime without the waste of making a full pot.  After searching other sites, found that Amazon.com had the best price.
Makes a great cup of coffee and the variety pack is fun because it offers you the chance to try flavors you normally wouldn't.  Timothy's is a high quality product.

column9: Nice variety but no hot cocoa
column10: I decided to try this variety pack, as I needed an assortment and it seemed my only option. It contains a nice variety of teas and coffees, but I was disappointed that there wasn't any hot cocoa. I don't really want to buy a whole box of cocoa but maybe that's my only choice. I'd like to see a variety pack of just teas or teas and cocoas but no coffee. Also, it would be nice if the amazon description told you what would be in the variety pack. I like Timothy's K-Cups very much.

column9: I didn't care for this pack
column10: 1st off, this is what is in the box:Two of each per 24 pack:-Parisian Nights extra bold-Italian Blend-Kona Blend-Breakfast Blend-Decaf Colombian-Colombian Dorado-Rainforest Expresso extra bold-Hazelnut-Chai Tea-English Breakfast Tea-Green Tea-Lemon drinkI bought this so my husband could try the teas (he is not a coffee drinker).  I paid about $.33 per K-cup which is a good price, however I thought the coffees were not that great.  I prefer the Green Mountain brand and I suspect for me, it will be worth it to pay a little more for them.

column9: Good Coffee at a good price
column10: While I am getting over the sticker-shock of pod coffee, it's still cheaper than the coffee shop and I can keep my slippers on.This will give you a chance to find the coffee style you like but the inclusion of tea makes this more expensive than it needs to be.I recommend the Colombian Dorado. If you are a real fanatic, the Parisian Nights should tingle your taste buds.If you can gauge how much you will use, Amazons subscription delivery gives you the best price.

Timothy coffee is my favorite brand of K-Cups. I have tried 20+ different K-Cup flavors and Timothy is the best when it comes to flavor and consistency. I subscribe to this variety pack and receive it monthly. I like the variety including the teas (the lemon stuff is weird). It is refreshing to have a different flavor everyday.

column9: Coffee is pretty good, price is better than most
column10: My wife loves the Keurig machine I bought her. I've tried the coffees and the K-cup system is the best coffee for the single-serve machines I've tried. Timothy's is very good coffee and at Amazon's subscription price it's more reasonable though still not inexpensive.For me, I still brew single cups of Yuban with Melita paper filters. Way better & cheper.

This variety pack is AWESOME!  It is the best ever for my household.  It has 8 different coffee's and 4 different teas in it.  My only problem is that 1 of the coffee's is decaf, but my wife will drink those :)

I thought that I was getting a variety of coffee, not coffee, tea and hot lemon aid. There were very few products in this variety pack that I will use and I made the mistake of ordering the pack of 2.

terrific selection to get to know the product ... all different goodies ... coffee of various strengths & flavors ... several different types of teas & even an exotic hot lemon beverage ... great if you have a cold ... highly recommend !

I enjoy trying different kinds of k-cups, so this variety pack was perfect for me.  Not only were the coffees great, I also enjoyed trying the teas.  The lemon drink though, I'll save for adventurous guests.
pretty good selection and with the teas and the lemon drink, it provided something for someone who is not a coffee drinker.

I am a coffee drinker and I thought this would be a variety of coffee,but there is a lot of tea in the box and there is not much variety from box to box each month.  With how many different coffees Timothy stocks, I thought I would be getting many different coffees to try.  Not a bad deal, but after a few boxes, the teas start to really pile up.

Three of the 22 cups were TEA, not coffee...1 Chinese green tea,1 chai tea, 1 English breakfast tea.Three more of the cups decaffeinated Columbian.If I had wanted tea, I would have ordered tea. If I wanted decaf, I would not have ordered a coffee pack, I would have ordered decaf.

I enjoy that this product gave you a number of various flavors to try at once. I also liked that it wasn't one of each flavor (especially since there was two boxes) so that you could try them a couple of times to be sure that you enjoyed what you were getting or not.I noticed a lot of people stated that there was a plastic taste to their beverages after having these. I have not noticed a plastic taste in the ones that I have tried so far. I'm wondering if older ones that have been stored for longer may get this plastic taste?Someone else said that the Timothy's products had poor seals and would leak coffee grounds all over in the pot and into the drinking vessel when they were being used. I'm not sure if this is linked to a certain Keurig coffee pot or not but mine, the Mr. Coffee Keurig coffee pot does not do this. I have also not noticed poor sealing in this cups either.I have also enjoyed the flavors that I have tried so far and I can't wait to try more of them.
We found this coffee to be  rather bland and fairly weak. For an assortment it all tasted the same. Won't buy it again.
Good starter kit, It helped me figure out what I liked and didnt like.  I wish they didnt have the decaf coffees and teas and a few more of the Extra Bold but that is just personal preference.

column9: Good, but there are a lot of Decaf k-cups
column10: This variety pack is good, epecially if you're new to your Keurig and trying to figure out which k-cups you like, but there are a lot of decaf k-cups in the package.

column9: Not a very good sampling of coffee
column10: I am not impressed with this "variety" pack.  Most of the coffees are pretty standard coffees with the only difference being variance in boldness.  It only came with three flavored coffees, Kahlua, Hazelnut, and German Chocolate Cake.  (And honestly, who hasn't had hazelnut coffee?)  It would be a much better offering if there was a lot more variety.

The K-cups work just fine in our standard Keurig.  The coffee itself is not very strong.  Some fun flavors, like Kahlua.  The few tea cups were rather watery.Good for a sampler, but I wouldn't buy it again.

Very good coffee and tea. Had a very goodvariety in package. I had 14 different blendswith 3 being teas. Perfect to see what youwill like. My favorite was Hazelnut. The Boldswere strong. Even the Breakfast Blend wasplenty strong. I used the large cup on theBold and run a second cup when I was downto a third of a cup and it was still strongenough! I will be using my own coffee sincethese are pricy.....use two to make a 10cup regular pot!!
is a great sampler of different Timothy World coffee K-cups.After trying Timothy's, prefer their brand over Green Mountain's (which is not bad), but Timothy's better.

This is a nice variety pack.  It gives you a chance to sample a lot of different coffees and tea.  I enjoy flavored coffee the best but also like to sample different styles of coffee and just use flavored creamer.  I really enjoy this pack and enjoy Timothy's brand.
The thing that I liked about the product was the price. Much cheaper than other postingsHowever the k cups inside were different from the ones of other buyers described. I guess it could vary
My husband and I like the variety of coffees in this selection. Several have become favorites such as Parisian nights & the Hazlenut.

Just purchased this last week.  Would have given 5**** but, price seems to have gone up quite a bit.  Mine was only $23. Great box filled with over 16+ choices. Great sampler only a couple K cups were duplicates. Will buy again, BUT ONLY if price goes back down.

good variety.. not a tea or decaf drinker, so i won't be buying any more, but now i have figured out what i like and don't for later purchases.  thanks to those who posted the different flavors in the pack.
I like to purchase this variety pack because it has a little something for everyone. It gives guests choices from tea to really strong coffee.

column9: Good for people who don't drink a lot or host
column10: I am not a big coffee drinker and I do not like to make huge pots of coffee for when I want 1 cup.  In addition to that it is great when hosting because people love to go through the assortment pack and pick something out.  They have a glimmer in their eyes like it is Christmas morning picking out a coffee/tea they know they will like instead of the same boring old cup of joe.  It is a real hit having variety for people.  Highly recommend.I am giving it 4 stars because of the stupid Italian lemon beverage.  That might be good if you get sick or something but I wanted a coffee/tea assortment pack!

Really good variety here in this pack.  Not only do they have flavored and straight coffee, but they also included three different teas that can be used in the Keurig brewer.  They also included some Decaf as well.  Nice variety and good flavors.

Just got a Keurig machine as a gift, and don't really know what coffees i would like.  My favorite brands of regular coffee don't seem to make k-cups.  I got this to try a bunch of different ones.  Some were really good, some ok, some pretty bad.  We kept a notepad by the coffee machine for my wife and I to keep track of how we felt about each one.  Now we are going to order a few boxes of our favorites from this set.If you are not sure what you will like in k-cups, or want to have a wide variety on hand for guests, etc, this is a good box to buy to get started.

column9: Great Coffee and Variety, but includes Tea and Decaf
column10: As many other reviews have mentioned, there is not a clear description of what is included in the box. I will not bother to repost the lists others have made, however I can say the variety is MUCH greater than the Gloria Jean's or Green Mountain Coffee variety packs I've tried (both of which include only Four blends of coffee), which is a definite plus. And I always set my Keurig to the smallest cup-size setting and feel this is the right level for maximizing the flavor of each k-cup - haven't tested how these taste with larger cups. Good brand overall, you will not be disappointed.Be sure to know that this package includes both TEA and DECAF COFFEE - you will be sorely disappointed if you're left with those at the end of the box because you didn't want them in the first place.

column9: Variety is the spice of Life
column10: I was very please with the variety I received.  It had everythong I like and gave my a good chance to try everythin.Thannk you
I liked this because I was able to sample many of the flavors and then choose the ones I wanted to buy a whole box of.

column9: Great variety at a great price
column10: Great variety in this box from Kona to extra bold blends to tea to decaf.  It gave me an opportunity to try other flavors without needing to buy them in bulk first.  I would recommend if you are interested in trying other flavors.
it's a nice blend of coffee, etc., which i like to keep on hand.  however, i prefer to keep my favorite blend on hand and order more frequently.  great prices.

column9: Very good variety pack for finding what you really like
column10: Wide assortment of coffee, chocolate and tea. All the coffee and chocolate were pretty good.  I'm not a tea drinker but tried one of them anyway. It was fine for tea, I guess,  but not for me.

This is an excellent starter or tester box of k-cups. I did like most of the coffees enclosed especially the Kona Blend. I also found that I like the Colombian Decaf. It came in handy when I was in the mood for coffee late in the evenings.  However, there were two that were to bold for my taste. I am glad I made this purchase. Now I know which coffee blends I favor over others. In my opinion, it would be great if all of the k-cup manufacturers would sell variety packs. Timothy's Variety Pack gets two thumbs up!
It is always nice to update our taste buds and see if there is a new coffee out there.

Great tasting coffee.  no bitter aftertaste.  Spoiled us to the point of taking our Keurig brewer with us when we go visiting, even just an evening playing cards with friends.  Now we are asked if we are bringing  the coffee.  Kind of created a monster.  Our house is now the Coffee House.  Can't say enough good things about the coffee.

I like this variety pack. There are a few items that I didn't enjoy drinking in the a.m. However, I may have guests that like them. This includes tea, which I like. Not everyone wants tea in his or her mix, esp. when the title of the box is coffee k=cups.
This variety pack contains a great sampling of Timothy's Products.  It was very enjoyable.

column9: Timothy's World Coffee K-Cups, variety Pack
column10: The variety was great.  I decided to go with the subscription plan, and the coffee and the pricing can't be beat. I received the 24-count boxes (Pack of 2) very quickly upon placing my order, and I am looking forward to receiving this order each month.  I have tried various brands of K-Cups, and Timothy's has always provided great taste.  It was nice to not only have the coffee but the tea as well in this order.  I highly recommend this product.  There are lots of sites for K-cups on the web, but I don't think this price can be beat.

column9: Great Starter Pack for new Keurig Coffee Maker
column10: Great variety for anyone wanted to test a lot of types of Timothy's coffee and teas. Very smooth and flavorful coffee.

Loved the variety of flavors to try before committing to a full box of a single coffee flavor. I found a new favorite that I will be reordering. I would have liked it more if the description gave you all the flavors in the box. Think they should have more flavors in the pack. Thanks Amazon for the fast delivery and high quality customer service.

I have always wanted to try Timothy's Brand Coffee. And decided as a gift I could sample as well as my co-workers. And so I bought this box of 24 for us. Everyone one was very delighted with this variety pack. We will no doubt order again!It is a great cup of K-Cup coffee!
Coffees are ok, but 9 of the k-cups were tea. What a waste. I thought this was a coffee sampler pack. Won't buy again. Try Coffee People coffees instead...delicious!

I love the coffee's in this assortment, but it also included too many decaf and tea varieties that I was not expecting.  There were also these "lemon drinks" that I have never seen before and don't like very much.  To top it off there were 2 kkups missing from the 48 that should have been there.  Next time I will order one flavor that I like the best instead of this.
The images outside looks like it'd be dark roast coffees. However, most of it tastes weak with a light sour taste when cream is added.

Timothy's K-Cups are very good.  Timothy's and Green Mountain are my two favorite bands for my Keurig coffee machine.  There is a good variety of selection.  If you're a coffee lover, you'll like these.
I usually buy my coffee from Tully's at around $15 for 25 cups. This package not only gives you a good variety but the coffee also tastes great and is a great value.
Timothy's K-Cup variety pack is awesome way to try various coffees and teas without buying a box of everything. Good coffee.
While I really like Timothy's coffee- found the variety pack to have several K-cups I did not enjoy- far too many chai tea.
Received product and was pleased with quality and assortment. What a savings over local store prices! Will order again!

column9: 'Not enough, too much, too weak, thats wierd'
column10: All of those thoughts will go through you head once you get this pack.Go with the Green Mountain coffees. And go with bolds. Even if you like lighter coffees. These k-cups have a hard time delivering on larger water sizes (not all types do.) There is some not very good stuff in this pack... It would be great if they sold with just one of each so you could quickly figure out what you wanted without having a lot left over.
Variety included tea which I did not expect and have little use for. Other coffees were fine.

Timothy's World Coffees are always great.  Their selections are top notch, with coffee blends from mild to medium to extra bold.  The blends typify coffees from South America and Europe as well as the US.  There is a coffee for any time of the day or evening in regular or decaf.

MY GRANDSON SUGGESTED I BUY TIMOTHY'S VARIETY PACK THROUGH AMAZON AND THE PRICE WAS GOOD.I ALSO THINK IT IS A GOOD IDEA TO GET STARTED, THIS WAY YOU CAN TRY ALL DIFFERENT FLAVORS TO SEE WHAT KIND OF COFFEE YOU LIKE WITHOUT HAVING TO BUY A ONE FLAVOR BOX AND BE LEFT WITH THE REST IF YOU DIDN'T LIKE IT!

I'm really sorry I didn't read the reviews before ordering Timothy's Variety K-Cup.  What a disappointment to find 9 out 24 that I won't drink. I also ordered Gloria Jean variety and will definitely order that again.

....buy a "sampler" pack that. a. Does not state what is in the box and b. Is waaaaaaay overpriced.  Are you kidding! $38.00+ for 44 coffee pods!  NEWS ALERT! - The going price is like $23.00 or less for 48-50 pods. Whoever orders this, deserves what they get. :|
Have not received this item so I can't write a review!  Where is it?

I received the plant right on the due date.It package very protective and the plants very healthy.Overall I am satisfy with my order.I canot wait for it to flower (so that way I can tell that I received the colour I order or not).
I reviewed this before...I don't think it will live but 9GreenBox said to wait for awhile to make sure thatis not going to live and if it does not they will replace it....

This plant was in the budding stage when I received it and in full bloom shortly thereafter.  Several gorgeous red blooms adorned it's branches. Desert roses are beautiful plants.  Thank you 9GreenBox.

This plant type is easily stressed and it was stressed when I received it. After a few weeks, It is doing fine.  The plant came in bloom; this was different then the other desert roses I have purchased from other sellers.  It is making itself at home in the bright Florida sunshine.  Doesn't need much water and love sunshine what a good plant.

It took them a few days to fill my order but once it was filled it arrived the next day. Came in small plastic bag which was flat due to shipping. Had my pots and soil ready to go so planted them right away. Perked up the same day and I have new growth in just one week. They shouldn't even be surviving in my climate zone(North West AZ, its been 110 in the shade the last few days) but seem to be doing ok. Only get alittle morning and evening sun, full shade rest of the day. Please do your research about these plants, very toxic, I planted with surgical gloves to protect my hands from possible sap. Can't wait for my flowers to bloom.

We LOVE Ian's gluten free cookie buttons!  They are a great-tasting little snack for my kids who can't have gluten but like an occassional treat and I love the fact that the portion is very reasonable, too!  Bravo! 10 stars!

Ok , well first I did not get the variety I ordered , I got the Crunchy Cinnamon kind , and I was going to send them back. Until I saw they were all out of stock... things like these save me , when we need to be out and about , now that we cannot have wheat. So we tried them , the 8, year old says they taste like  mini muffin tops, the 12 year old says , they are good coverd in milk like cereal , the 14 year old , who eats nothing ,ate them , and the two older ones did too , but in all fairness they eat everything..  we all like them , and Ian's is a great company to support , with wonderful kid food ,  for kids who can't have wheat .

column9: Whatever this tastes like it isn't a chocolate chip cookie
column10: I'm trying to figure out what it is that tastes so very peculiar and unpleasant in these cookies. Could it be the soy flour? In any case, I get no taste of chocolate chips at all. Zero. Zilch. They might as well have left that out of the name. The texture isn't bad. It's crunchy and not overly gritty. But there are better gluten-free snacks out there. I hope.

These cookies not only taste great, but they are prepackaged so you can just throw them in a lunchbox.  When you have a child on a gluten-free diet, saving time on food prep is always appreciated.  They are definitely a favorite in my house.  We love them.  They are small in size, but are the best tasting chocolate chip cookie so far that we have found gluten-free.

These are great.  I like the fact that they are in portion controlled bags which make them easy to throw in a book bag, carry-on bag or lunch box.  They are a bit hard so they don't crumble easily before you get to them.  The taste is similar to cinammon graham crackers.

My three-year-old who can't eat gluten loves these cookies, and I've had them too and they're very good.  They're small, maybe 1/2 inch across, but they come packaged in bunches.  They're crunchy and sweet and you can definitely taste the chocolate.  A good product overall.

These are excellently portioned and very tasty.  My only complaint was that they are too hard.  I love them with coffee but for my daughter they were a too hard ---have to watch her VERY close when she is eating them.
Great GF cookie alternative.  My son loves them and he is a very picky eater.

I was so excited to find these in our local Whole Foods.  I loved the fact that they came in individually wrapped packages (great  for travel, lunch boxes, etc).  Unfortunately, the taste was quite disappointing.  The cinnamon flavored ones were even worse.  Neither myself, nor my youngest liked either of them.  Granted, we are both somewhat picky when it comes to store-bought cookies.  I'd have loved to have given them to my oldest son (who has a real sweet tooth and likes most GFCFSF cookies I buy), but they have both soy and corn in them and he is allergic to soy and corn in addition to gluten and dairy.  Fortunately, I hadn't bought them in bulk on Amazon ...  I was surprised to see that they got such good reviews.

This is a very delicious curry, and I loved the unique flavor it gave my eggs. It is spicy but you can adjust that to your taste. Went very well with basmati rice! The curry flavor overpowers the egg, but that is not a bad thing because it's so good! It tastes pretty much like any other Parampara curry though. I guess if you wanted to try out the recipe, you could add the eggs to any of the other Parampara curries, or even a generic red curry that you can make at home.

Read the reviews and decided to try this. We've gone through the first box and have subscribed for monthly delivery. It is absolutely delicious. To make it even better, I add a little Creme Brulee Coffee-Mate creamer. That boosts it up to the absolutely-awesome category. At the rate we're going, we may have to up our subscription delivery to bi-weekly!

I felt compelled to write a review here for 2 reasons.#1  This is seriously, without a doubt, the best instant cappuccino I've ever had (and, perhaps, best cappuccino, PERIOD).  Originally purchased in canister format, the single serve packets are even better, as it offers just the perfect amount for each serving, and you can take it w/ you on the go.#2  The one and only review here is not indicative, informative, helpful nor is it relevant to the actual product for sale!I've given out packets to friends and co-workers.  All have come back w/ ecstatic responses.  I highly recommended this product.  You will not be disappointed!

column9: Description misleading, top ingredient SUGAR, not mentioned at all!
