I ordered this item once and received the sugar free version.  Then on the replacement order Amazon sent, it was still the wrong product.  However, customer service was great and they refunded me within 48 hours.

When I first started to buy VitaGravy, my dogs loved it. After a few weeks, they don't seem to care too much for it anymore. They still get it in their kibble every day, and will eventually eat it when they are hungry, but they don't consider it to be a treat anymore. I still buy it because of its beneficial nutritional value and decent price compared to a pill vitamin supplement. One big negative I have noticed about it is that their face is getting dirty from it. They are white dogs and this product tends to cause increased tear and around-the-mouth stains. I used to buy all different flavors of VitaGravy, buy my groomer told me the chicken flavor is best as the beef and pork based flavors can cause an even worse increase in face staining.
These are great cookies.  The price is reasonable and I like that they are delivered to my home.  I have also ordered the vanilla and cinnamon for myself and the arrowroot for my grandson.

column9: Not as good as they used to be
column10: About a year ago, Newman's Own Organics changed these cookies.  While the list of ingredients did not change, the taste clearly changed so I suppose something changed in the process.  They became a little thinner and the taste is totally different.  The old version tasted much, much better.  I don't know what they were thinking.  These cookies are still pretty good, but the old version was great and I wish they would fix this mistake.
We used to love these cookies, but now they aren't as as rich in chocolate as before. They *look* the same, they just don't taste the same. More sweet without as much cocoa/baker's chocolate.

We have been buying these for years now. My husband loves them in his lunch every day. They just reduced the size of the bag by 3 oz due to rising ingredient costs. Amazon had the best price on the smaller bags. The product is the same yummy chocolatey cookie as before, you just get less of it per bag.

column9: excellent the best you can buy
column10: All Natural the best cranberry sauce on the market!You will not be disappointed ENJOY

I love these baked lentil chips w/hummus. Everyday after work , I have a snack of lentils & hummus before preparing dinner. I have alot of food sensitivities and allergies and these are a blessing for someone like me. Thanks again for a great product.Carole

I have purchased these in the larger size and love them! This size is just perfect to keep in my purse for a snack, especially for those times when others are having a dessert or snack and I can't eat theirs because I must have gluten free. My spouse, who won't touch any other 'diet food', loves these!

I was looking forward to getting this product, but found it a tad too salty,enquired if it came unsalted but was told no,Because of high blood pressure I don't think I'll be ordering them again,unless they come with less salt, which is a dissapointment for me.Marina j.

I ordered these chips after buying a bag of lentil chips at a store and wanted more without going to the store all the time and found these on Amazon. I love the taste and crunchiness of it and its a healthy version of chips with protein which would leave you feeling satisfied instead of craving more. The cracked pepper has a slightly sweet hint which I find interesting and took a bit to get used to. I would buy again, its too bad you can't subscribe.

column9: Good alternative to higher caloric chips
column10: Saw these chips on Dr. Oz as an alternative to potato chips.  These chips work for me, but not my husband.  The chips have a light flavor, are crunchy and have a puffed texture.  I have just ordered my 2nd box of the 1 oz size to control my portion size because  I don't trust myself to stop eating before the bag is empty.  I hope this becomes a regular Amazon item that I can subscribe to and get Super Saver Delivery.  Perhaps Dr. Oz  should get a percentage for all the items and books that he introduces on his show that I end up buying on Amazon!

We discovered these as one of the snacks sent by a diet my husband was on.  They're good enough we then looked them up ourselves.  They're cheaper per ounce in the larger bags, but the 1oz bags are great for potion control.  All three flavors available on Amazon are delicious; my husband's favorite is the cracked pepper.  The rosemary is a reasonably strong taste, so I would recommend liking rosemary if you order it.I make fat free 'hummus' to serve with them (no sesame/tahini or olive oil, so it's not quite traditional, but that's necessary to cut the fat).  I just throw a can of chickpeas, juice from a lemon, salt, a handful of fresh cilantro, and varied roasted peppers & garlic in to the blender, until it's all mashed up good.  Delicious combination.I wish these were available on subscribe and save, since we would, in a heartbeat.
I loved these chips when i got first time from Dierbergs.... but this size is perfect. you can also try Simply 7 Chip Lentil Sea Salt 4 oz (Pack Of 12)

I tried this brand after having a successful experience with the 'Simple 7' brand and they didn't measure up. The baked chips are bland and they are coated in a film that changes their texture. They are to thick and just do not satisfy chip-craving. As the calorie in take is identical to that of the 'Simple 7' brand I'll stick with the latter, which is amazing.
These chips are very good.  Crunchy yet low in calories and fat.  I love the 1 oz size - perfect for my lunches.

These chips make a wonderful snack.  They give you the crunch and saltiness that you need at times, without a lot of calories.  They also contain protein to keep you from getting hungry again until meal time.  They came in a single serving size package which is nice when you are mindful of portion control.  I would order them again.

These chips are the *perfect* snack, especially for gluten sensitive snackers!  I keep these on hand, okay...I usually have 3 boxes (of 24) on hand because I can't bear to be without them!  :-)  They are tasty with just the right amount of sea salt - but wait!  You must try their cucumber dill and sea salt cracked pepper flavors too!  You will LOVE them!
I normally love these chips and buy them in the large bags. The individual bags tasted totally different - makes no sense. I through them out and bought the large bags which tasted great.

column9: Absolutely Delicious!  I am thrilled!  Great Chips!
column10: Boy, I feel like I hit the jackpot with these.  I have been searching for a chip that doesn't have onion/garlic/or tomato in the ingredients,,,,and are more protein based, preferably without wheat or corn.  And not only do these fit the bill, they are delicious!  Are light, low calorie, and absolutely yummy!  Great, great chips!And an entire bag is only something like 100 calories!  Wonderful.  I think these may actually be the "perfect chip!".  Have salt, but just the right amount.  Whoever dreamed these up, did a great job and I am grateful, and grateful to Amazon for carrying them.  Thanks, Mediterranean Snacks,,,,,,,!

I ordered Rosemary Lentil Chips. THEY SENT 24 BAGS of cracked pepper. I can't have pepper! Instead of saying they are out of stock, they figured they'd send whatever and I wouldn't notice. Then they say you can't return food BUT I DID NOT NOT order pepper chips, I wouldn't do that. So good luck if you order from them because you will NOT get what you ordered.

column9: Best Gift for my mother she was happy
column10: Dear Seller,Thank you so much for the chocolates. My mother loved them, these chocolates were so good she almost cried tiers of joy.Thank you so much for the delivery.
very good treats for your dog, they are soft and small, good to put pills in and my dog loves them!!!

I found out about these dog treats from my Mother who used to work for a Vet. The Treats themselves are great and my dog loves them!But I paid over $7 for these treats and later found out I can get the exact same size bag for $2.50 locally, So I will not order from here againknowing I can get almost 3 times the amount for the same price.

column9: I've been getting these for years...
column10: My vet recommended these treats several years ago as a healthier alternative to the treats sold in supermarkets (like the treats shaped like fake bacon, sausages, steaks, etc). My dog LOVES these treats, probably more than she ever like the fake bacon variety of treat. She's not usually bribable, but these seem to do the trick. The only drawback to these treats from my point of view is that they're only available at the vet's office, so I'm thrilled to find them here online.Just a note about one of the other reviews I read: I purchased 4 packages of these at a time at roughly $1.30 per package, and the shipping was still only $5 for all 4 packs. So, even with shipping, the per-unit cost is around $2.50 (which is better than the $5 I was paying at the vet). And I don't think the package is misleading- I've only found these treats in 1 size, and they all have the same picture of a dalmation on the front.Finally, people have mentioned that these could be used to give pills. I think they're probably a little small for hiding pills (unless you're trying to give a 1/2 or 1/4 tab of a VERY small pill). If hiding pills is what you're going for, you'd be better off getting pill pockets (small, cup-shaped treats that you can mold around a pill or capsule).

column9: Be aware of treat size and excessive shipping costs
column10: These Lean Treats were initially recommended by my vet. I have a large dog, and the larger-sized treats, which I purchased for $6 (12 oz)  from my vet, are large enough to hide pills in, and also to tear into smaller pieces for training. I ordered these treats as replacements, thinking I was getting a bargain. HOWEVER the shipping cost was over $6 for a 4 oz pkg!!!! The pkg contents were not accurately described, as the size of the treats were appropriate for tiny dogs like chihuahuas. The pkg image is blurred, it shows a large dog, a dalmatian, and so further misleads the consumer. So, while the treats are great, the images and the descriptions need to be clarified. I won't order online again until this is cleared up. Perhaps if there were actual size pictures of the treats, that might help.
These treats are great.  The dog is crazy about them.  They are small but he really likes them.  You can also use them to conceal small pills if you need to give your dog medicine.
Impossible to find locally.  Can't be without them. Seller was very prompt in delivery.

I purchased these little gems last week on a whim, after researching the history of the Abbaye de Flavigny. They have been making these candies since the year 1591! Anise is an acquired taste, I think, akin to a delicate licorice, and those who enjoy it will absolutely love these anise drops. A fact I found quite interesting is that it takes fifteen days to make just one of these candies!Each candy is roughly the size of a medium pearl, with a pleasantly smooth texture. They are not meant to be chewed, (the word "jaw-breaker" comes to mind!) but savored. The taste is exquisite: strong but not overpowering, herbal and sweet. At the heart of each drop is an anise seed, the texture of which contrasts beautifully with the hardness of the candy surrounding it. Very refreshing.I am so glad that I stumbled upon these! They are a real treasure in a world where artificial flavorings and chemical-based sweeteners are the norm. There is something quite special about these Anise Drops from Abbaye de Flavigny.As for the seller, Touch of Europe, I couldn't be happier with their service. My package arrived quickly, (two days before the estimated arrival time!) wrapped safely, and included a hand-signed letter thanking me for my business, which I thought was a nice touch.

My first thought when opening a pack of these...was wow! They have MUCH more filled then the classic ones do, and even more than like "Double Stuff" oreos do.The cookie its self has a unique flavor that I can best describe as a sweet buttery shortbread type flavor. It's definitely not one of those cookies where you take them apart to get to the filling, and forget about the cookies lol. They are fantastic, and CERTAINLY worth a try if you have never had them. I am a huge chocolate fan, but not usually too big on sweets. But these have and always will be a classic and my favorite.Pros: Everything.Cons: I can eat a whole pack by myself. I blame Keebler fully for this.
The Keebler E.L. Fudge Sandwich Cookies, Double Stuffed arevery tastey, very satisfying. A high-quality product that I would recommend.

I ordered the Hershey's Sugar Free Chocolate Chips.  I received the order ONE:In an envelope - not something I would send a food Product in.  TWO: The product looked Old and Out Of Date, the bags were cut (yet the packaged shipped in was not)and everything looked like it was melted together.  When I contacted this seller - he called me a liar and did not believe I received the items this way.  When I said I would send a picture - suddenly he hung up. I was told I would be refunded (including the $9.00 shipping fee I was charged plus my $5.35 fee to ship back) I still have not received my full refund!

I recieved my package today, much quicker than I expected. The items in the set were so fresh; also I really enjoyed the festive packaging. I love Thai food, and have recently am trying to adopt a totally Asian way of cooking for health reasons, I am now in my third week, and have lost 15 pounds, and pain from my fibro and RA is gone. In addition to the health benefits from Thai cooking, is it satisfies my taste...I don't crave fatting spicy foods, or even sweets anymore...:). I encourge those that want to try, to give it a shot...it's not as hard as it looks. If you live in area, such as I do..and have limited access to Thai ingredients, this package will get you on your way..to health wholesome Thai foods...thanks for offering this product...Pam

There ain't really a whole lot to say about these things but I still wrote a review that I hope others may find helpful just in case they have a need for these things. I bought these ingredients because I always cook Tom Yum Soup specifically the tom yum seafood. I am from Asia and I love to cook and I would rather use the organic ingredients rather than the ready mix flavor. My husband is American and he loves Tom Yum. I brought some of these when I went back to Asia last December but I already ran out so I had to buy some.  When I received these product, they were in an excellent condition. Considering that these are perishables, I got them still fresh and got them the way the seller had described/advertised them. The packaging was neat and was absolutely done carefully. The price for me is reasonable because you just cannot find these stuff in some groceries at least here in Texas. Nice doing business with the seller. So over all rating, I give both the seller and the product a 5-star rating.

The package arrived on schedule and in good condition, with plentiful quantities of each fresh herb. No complaints, would definitely buy again. Perfect for lovers of Thai cuisine who want to try their hand at some home-cooked meals, but don't have an Asian market nearby to satisfy their needs.

I realize that vendor reviews are in a separate area, but when dealing with perishable items such as this, the vendor DOES make a difference as to the quality of the item, and therefore also to the review of the item itself. I was skeptical about ordering produce in this fashion, but the other positive reviews and my desire for the ingredients won out. I'm so glad I took the chance! :)My order arrived two days before the earliest delivery estimate. In the high-90s heat we've been having right now, that makes a big difference, as did the fact that it was very well packed and obviously very fresh produce to begin with. The items were of excellent quality and generous portions. I can make an insane amount of Tom Yum soup now and have enough left over to throw together some other delicious dishes.Give it a try. I think you too will be very pleased! :)

Unfortunately my order never arrived.  After 3 weeks of emailing, I was able to get in contact with customer service.  Mam with customer service was very helpful and apologetic.  She made everything right and reshipped the order the next day.
What more can I say? All the items were in great condition, tasted delicious, and made a great meal. I would highly recommend this product.

column9: Great, fresh ingredients for perfect Thai food
column10: The ingredients arrived fresh and in only two days.  I made the perfect green curry taught to me in Thailand on my travels. Just placed a second order.A very happy customer
We received everything in the photo plus three unexpected Lemons.Everything arrived fast and fresh.We are going to freeze the excess veggies for future Tom Yum Gai Soup (Hot and Sour Soup).
Ate these in college in California---better than M&M's!  Can't wait to be able to order some (hopefully in less than 25 lb increment)

Note: these are hard-core choke hazards--NOT for small children!Contrary to previous review, I found the bag to be clearly marked regarding allergens.These are not "pebbles". The image shows them roughly all the same size--they are NOT. They range from M&M size to small eggs. They contain a variety of fillings, probably not everything Koppers makes, but a nice sampling (dried fruit, cordials, nuts, hard candy). Also be aware, they do not all have chocolate inside; some are candy coating all the way down to the filling. Better be VERY confident in your dental work before you bite! This is the only reason I did not give it 5 stars.Actually kind of fun...not knowing what's inside. A nice introduction to Koppers products.

I have not truly sampled all the different types of chocolate in this five pound bag, but most of them are very good.  My favorites are the malted milk and the coffee flavors.  Some of the fruit flavors are nice as well, but the mint chocolate is awful, and hard to get the taste out of you mouth.  The dried fruit is good, but some were a bit sour for my taste, but my mom loves dried fruit and she really enjoyed the chocolate covered fruits the most.  The nuts I don't like at all, I have been eating the chocolate around the nut and throwing the nuts away.  If you like nuts there is a good variety, from small pearl size to giant almonds.  The chocolate itself is smooth and delicious, very well made.  I don't really like playing guess the candy, I wish there was a way to identify the candy before taking a bite.  If love all types of candy you will enjoy this mix, if you are picky stay away.

Wow, in this day-in-age, one would think that products containing nuts would be clearly labelled.  I purchased this product, thinking it was coated chocolate.  I was aware that it was manufactured in a facility that has nuts, but the description does it clearly state that these candies have various centers such as nuts, fruits and other things.  I used these for a children's gingerbread house decorating party, and there were kids that had nut allergies in attendance!  Thankfully, all went well, but it is outrageous that Koppers does not clearly describe this product. Although not the tastiest candy, the overall quality was good, not great.

This product is hard to find in my area, so even though I didn't need an entire case, I purchased them and handed some out to other family members over Thanksgiving. I love using the Corn Flake crumbs for anything that needs breading as it has a nice flavor even without spices and makes food extra crispy with just a very small amount of olive oil in the pan! Great on fish, twice baked ravioli and chicken to name a few. I have also used the crumbs in yogurt and on salads for a little extra crunch. Highly recommended!

This is my favorite breading for seafood, poultry, onion rings, etc.To me, it comes out much more crispy and flavorful. It tastes more clean and natural.It doesn't get soggy easily like regular crumbs from bread, it just doesn't seem to absorb all of the oil and lay limb.If you like more crunch that allows the flavor on the inside to come through, this is just the right breading.I also like to fry in this breading and then add to a pan of sauce and this coating still stays crunchy and crisp even through that.

The only mint I taste is natural flavor, that's not mint. What's up with sugar and honey in it too. This make it too sweet. If I want sweet, I'll get the Southern style tea. Try some organic mint for a change and see the different.

This was not a pasta salad kit as described. It is a kit for pasta stir-fry. Needless to say I was surprised and not very happy. I will use the pasta for something but, will not be ordering this product again.
I bought these on a special sale. The mix is sour and in many of the sticks, the mix has clumped together so that it's very hard to get it to dissolve into water.
Taste is sour- I use drink mix sticks every day and no matter how I mixed them, I just couldn't get them to taste good.

This is not an over-the-top sugary drink mix like Kool-Aid, as others pointed out it is on the sour side.  While not what I was expecting at first I still find it to be a refreshing mix.  I have just received my second "Subscribe and Save" shipment of this the other week shortly before Amazon removed it from that service.  In the first shipment I had received there were a number of packets where the powder had solidified a bit as another reviewer reported.  I think I calculated about 18-20% of the packets in that shipment had that problem.  The only issue this gave me was getting the mix out of the packet; some alternate squeezing of the packet would break up the chunk enough to drop out into my water bottle.  It took a little longer to dissolve but then was fine.  In the most recent shipment all packets felt and sounded to be in loose powder form.  The only other complaint I have is that the packets never seemed to tear open well.  As a result I find it easier to cut them open with scissors, not a problem for me as I drink these in my office cubicle.  When this shipment runs out I intend to order a restock, hopefully it is available again at the SnS discount.

column9: Takes Your Ice Cream to New Heights!
column10: I use this professionally and while it makes Ice Cream creamier, it also allows more air to be held in the finished Ice Cream, thus extending the time it stays frozen on the plate.  If you want to take your ice Cream to the next level, you need this product.
Made icecream with and without it using same recipe. When I used Cremodan everything is creamier, so I blame this particular product for a better icecream in my case. Thanks a lot!

The shipping from Amazon was great as usual.  However the product I received was not.  These truffles were almost past the expiration date and obviously had be stored in a non-climate controlled place.  The chocolate had been melted and the peanut butter nugat inside had melted down to blob in the bottom of the sphere.  These truffles were not a bargin at the price I paid for them. I will buy my next ones locally where I can be assured they will be what I am paying for and not something somebody is trying to get rid of.
Box arrived shipped well and not damaged.  However, inside the box, every chocolate had been deformed with chocolate on the outside of the wrappers.

I received my first box and when I opened it the chocolate had been melted. It was no longer smooth and creamy as Lindt truffles usually are. The weather had been cold and I accepted the package directly from the post women so I assumed it had arrived that way. I called Amazon and they gave me a replacement box which arrived in 2 days. Unfortunately it had also been melted and at that point I just gave up. I have two boxes of yucky chocolate.  I'm assuming that they melted while they sat around at amazon or Lindt provided a sub par product.  Do not order these. Buy them somewhere where you can inspect them first.

column9: Lindt Peanut Butter Truffles are the BEST!
column10: Thank you so much for being a source for the Lindt Peanut Butter truffles!  Yes, the Hazelnut are amazing, but my favorite by far are the peanut butter and there are fewer and fewer stores that carry them.  I just received my box of 120 count and they are fresh and in the best condition.  They just melt in your mouth.

This stuff is hot. You can use a third as much as you normally would and still end up with a hotter dish.  I don't know if it's so hot because it's fresher than what I've gotten in the grocery store or if it's because it's grown in different soil.  But, whatever it is, the product is both hot and flavorful.

Better than that stuff you get at the health food store.  Not sure why it's so better but IT IS. These 3 flavors go together really well. Getting compliments on everything I make. Going to buy more from Red Monkey soon.
This stuff tastes great!  I love that it is in glass bottles and not in plastic.  I highly recommend it.
This is the good stuff because it is R E A L so buy it, you'll like it just as I did. By the way, the other juices of Lakewood are great, too.

column9: Now this is how pickled ginger should taste!
column10: This is my third order of this pickled ginger.  After trying another brand sold here, I almost passed on this ginger.The pros:+  This ginger is sliced thinly & there are no large pieces that need to cut before you can eat it.  I use my ginger on my tossed salad to add a bit of kick & sweetness to the dressing.+  The flavor is smooth, sweet, slightly hot, but not overwhelming & there's no unpleasant aftertaste.+  The shipment arrives very quickly & is very well packed. :)The cons:-  This ginger is a bit on the expensive side, but in my opinion, well worth the extra cost.

This is an excellent product.  It is difficult to find this brand very many places.  The ginger has the right amount of bite and tastes like the finest available in the sushi restaurants.  I highly recommend this for people who love pickled ginger.

column9: Wrong Product?  This one had ASPARTAME
column10: I was furious when I found out the ingredients listed on the webpage are different from the product's true ingredients and it is  way different!  ASPARTAME is in this product and YUCK YUCK YUCK. I am so sorry I ordered this and even sorrier I believed the Amazon webpage. I wish they would correct this!

column9: Comparing Velveeta pasta and cheese mixes
column10: There are two Velveeta pasta and cheese dinners. This one, and Kraft Velveeta Original Shells & Cheese, 12 oz. They both use packets of cheese sauce, not packets of powder.But sadly, this one's not that good. It's salty, and the tiny bits of broccoli are few and far between. And with all the sodium (1230 mg per serving compared to 940 mg for the regular Shells and Cheese), it's a long way from healthy.Shells and Cheese is better. It's pure, creamy comfort food that goes down smooth and leaves no aftertaste. The pasta's ridged-shell shape makes every bite taste good, as dribbles of cheese seep into each piece and stick to its sides. It's much better than the broccoli version... and way more yummy (if more expensive) than the regular Kraft Macaroni & Cheese Supermac & Cheese Pasta and Sauce, 6-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 24).

I love Velveeta and I love the rotini and cheese; I have had it before but it is hard to find in the grocery stores I shop at...I found it not to be as good as I remembered....the broccoli was minimal at best.
Tastes good because, well, it's Velveeta.  But if you're buying it for the broccoli, don't bother.  The tsp of dried broccoli included in the package hardly makes it "with broccoli".

I came across this product in the store in the form of those little 2oz cups that Easy mac comes in (I don't know if it's 2 oz exactly but it's the small single serving cups that you can put in the microwave). I liked it so much I came to my best friend Amazon to see if I could buy more and was pleasantly surprised when I found that you could buy it in the larger size. Obviously there are no health benefits and the broccoli comes dried in a little packet so there's not much to be expected, but if you like Velveeta and broccoli give this a try! I love it. It's quick and easy and difficult to find in a store so this is the place to get it. It's everything you love about traditional Velveeta with the fun twisty rotini pasta and broccoli parts. Very happy.
these people are crazy I haven't met a person who didn't like this stuff, but it is about a dollar overpriced PER BOX on amazon.com

column9: Fritos Corn Chips, Chili Cheese, 2-Ounce Large Single Serve Bags (Pack of 64)

This should be known to the consumer but I wasn't thinking about that when I purchased it early in December for a Christmas present.  I would have waited a few more weeks.
This is A good product and it is good but can do with LESS SALT than it has, God bless.
I started eating chilicheese corn chips out of the vending machine when I was a young soldier in the Army. They were Delicious back then and they are Delicious today.

This is our favorite chip and the single serving bags help to keep the kids for wasting them.  They are good for those times when you have to grab something on the run.  I keep a couple of bags in my car for the kids.

column9: FRITOS have been great since I was a kid and nothing has changed!
column10: Nothing has changed over the years: They were great 35 years ago and still are!

column9: Feeling like a kid in a candy store ............

The remainder of the un-opened bags taste fine, albeit the fritos are noticably smaller.  It just wasn't worth complaining but since you asked....

i ordered the product on 8/29/09 and received it on 9/3/09.  64 single serve bags.  I was very pleased until i noticed the freshness expiration date on the bags was 10/6/09... way too soon compared to snack items that i would have found in a grocery store on 9/3/09. i doubt that i will order food products from amazon again... what a disappointment.

column4: D. Mikels "It's always Happy Hour here"
column10: Big sporting events. . .I'm into them all.  Super Bowl.  BCS Championship.  March Madness.  NBA Finals.  The World Series.  Pay-Per-View Boxing.  Wimbledon. . . .not.  And when you're watching a bigtime sporting event, you need a bigtime snack with taste and crunch and texture to hold its own in all the excitement.  You need a bag (or more) of FRITOS CORN CHIPS.Just something about the original corn chip and sports.  They go together like bacon and eggs. . .salt and pepper. . .Ginger and Mary Ann.  Could be because FRITOS CORN CHIPS go great with brewskies--or pile them on top of a steaming bowl of chili.  Mmmm, now you're talkin' Super Meal.  And for dipping, nothing beats Fritos Scoopers (not available here, alas) into a bowl of Lay's Creamy Ranch Dip (also, alas, not available here).So bring on the playoffs; usher in the buzzer beaters; welcome the wild card.  As long as you have FRITOS CORN CHIPS, it's all good.  Your taste buds will score.--D. Mikels, Esq.

column9: Used for G.F. gingerbread cookies - worked great!
column10: Our daughter's school always has a gingerbread booth as part of their annual fundraiser and we wanted to offer a gluten free version for the kiddies, like our daughter, who can't have gluten.I figured this mix would be a great base to start with, as shortbread cookies are crunchy and often cut with a cookie cutter into a special shape. It did work great for gingerbread cookies with just a few modifications on our end.We followed the instructions exactly except that we used 1 whole egg, a 2nd yolk, and saved the extra egg white if the mix seemed too dry (it will indeed be dry as the instructions say, but if it's so dry that it flakes apart when trying to move it to the cookie sheet, absolutely add more egg white!) We then added an extra tsp of vanilla, 1 tsp cinnamon, 1/2 tsp of nutmeg to alter the flavor to be more like gingerbreads. You can add powdered ginger if you want, however, our daughter prefers this milder "spice" recipe than when we add ginger, so we didn't use any.There was tons of positive feedback about the GF gingerbread cookies from both Gluten free folks and regular people - the recipe was a great success! We also thought they were incredibly tasty.Tip: ABSOLUTELY use the parchment paper when making these cookies! put it as a liner on the cookie sheet, also use it to roll out the dough on and also as a layer between the dough and the rolling pin. It made a huge difference! I've also heard that if you refrigerate the dough for an hour before rolling it out that it works better - we didn't try this though.So! whether you want to make G.F. shaped cookies for Halloween, the winter holidays, or whatever, this is a great mix to adapt!Happy Gluten Free Baking!

column9: If taste matters then skip this product
column10: I'm an avid gum chewing person who has been trying to switch over to natural sugar free gum. column9: Better than any typical "just out of the cow" milk....EVER!
column10: I first had instant whole dried milk when doing missionary work down in Honduras, CA. That dried milk happened to be either KLIM, a Borden product, or Nido, a Nestle's product. For all you dyslectics, you probably picked up on KLIM is just MILK spelled backwards......LOL.  I have had whole milk in the UK and even their full cream Jersey, gold topped, milk and thought that might be the best milk ever.  Matter of fact, I grew up in Houston, Texas and raised on a local dairy milk, Westmoreland.  During those days the very best milk was the one that was the creamiest and Westmoreland guaranteed that, as all their milk was from Jersey herds.  Peak easily surpasses that great "fresh" milk.  Not only does Peak taste great, not dried/instant, but it has the greatest milk taste ever.  I dare say that as long as I can order this stuff, I will never buy "fresh" milk ever again.  I am no longer a frequent milk consumer, but I do use it to make yogurt occasionally, on cereal, or even drink it, but rarely buy it as it typically goes bad/off before it is consumed.  Frankly, I do use it every morning in my coffee or tea.  I would recommend that it is made in a blender, chilled overnight, and then consumed.  I also have used half Peak and Sanalac powder to achieve a lower fat, but full flavored milk.

I tried this based on my mother-in-law's recommendation. This milk powder is nothing like the nonfat milk powder that they sell at most grocery stores. You know what I'm talking about--the kind that tastes like powdered milk. Blech. This one is so rich and delicious. You have to use a lot of it to make a single glass, so it doesn't last very long. This is also great to keep at the office to use in your coffee where it's not always practical to keep a carton of milk.I can't emphasize enough how good this milk is.  This may sound strangely random, but when I first made a glass, I noticed my dogs intensely staring at me, hoping I'd give them some.  So I did.  They absolutely love it, too. They reacted to it as if it were the most delicious thing in the world.  They don't even react that way to steak. My husband even noticed and commented it's like doggie crack. I've never seen anything like it.It's also nice that you can control the richness of it by adding more or less powder.  I also tried the Nestle Nido milk powder that I got as a sample, and it is just as good.
This product is suprisingly delicious. Unlike the instant non-fat milk that I am familiar with, this product tastes exactly like milk on cereal, in coffee/tea and from the glass. Rich and creamy.

Homogenization and ultra-pasteurizing having ruined milk as a healthy product, we have long searched for a tasty powdered milk substitute. This product has superior flavor and is easily mixed into either cold or hot water. The container is a tin and has a tightly-sealing cap to ensure freshness.

I have only used Carnation or generic instant milk before. awful stuff. this product is excellent. I added it to oatmeal while it was cooking vs plain water and I was very pleased. I USED IT FOR MY ELDERLY MOMS COFFEE VS USING NON NUTRITIOUS COFFEE CREAMER.  Looking forward to trying it other ways but at this point I can forsee me ordering it again. I have now started using it in canned cream soups for my elderly mom. i fill the empty can with desired amount of water and then add the Peak.  and the best part because i use non fat or skim for myself....THERE IS NEVER ANY SPOILED OR WASTED MILK OR YOU NEVER HAVE TO GO WITHOUT MILK.

I was looking for milk for my coffee that I could keep at work unrefrigerated and was planning on purchasing those little creamer cups. After reading reviews on Amazon for Peak, I decided to try it. This is not like instant milk of old. It is a very smooth and wonderful powder that easily stirs into a cup of coffee. So much better than  coffee-mate type powders.

This is great for those that don't drink milk on the regular. This way your milk won't go bad, and you always have delicious milk on hand when you need it. It is really sweet, so if you don't like sweet, just add more water. It comes out creamy when you mix according to the instructions. Good packaging, doesn't get stale, and I usually keep it for about 4 months. Great purchase, and I have Amazon Prime, so it came quick.

column9: So many uses and yet so yummy!
column10: I ordered this with several uses in mind, and keep finding more as I get more creative! I do not buy milk because I just don't drink it, however, this powder is the best tasting milk I have had since I was a kid! I decided that CoffeeMate is just alot of chemicals, so each morning I put a tablespoon or so of this into my coffee and it is heavenly!! It has vitamin A and D too! column9: The best possible substitute for whole milk
column10: My parents took us to live in Nigeria in the eighties and one thing we missed at first was having a glass of ice cold milk after school. That is,until my Dad came home from the university he was teaching at with a huge tin of Peak Milk,given to him  by a colleague who'd heard of our yearnings. It was perfect. For one serving ,just dissolve 2 heaping tablespoons of the powder in two ounces of water, mix thoroughly to get any lumps out then top up with another six to eight ounces of water, either hot or cold, depending on how rich you like it. Peak milk and Klim ( a similar product by Borden)were life-savers in Nigeria at a period in the nation's history when electricity was a luxury rather than a take-for-granted amenity.* It is a splendid pantry item in areas where power is spotty and you can't keep things refrigerated for long;* With the rest of my family on vacation(without me,*whine*),I find that I may not always be able to use up the container of milk before it starts going south so this is great if you find that happening to you a lot. (I need sour milk for several of my chocolate cake recipes,but there's only so many brownies a girl can bake when the rest of the family is out of town...);* It works wonderfully for baking and yogurt making. Just reconstitute according to package directions and carry on;* One strange thing I noticed: like many adults of African ancestry I began to develop lactose intolerance as I grew older but I find that unless you are truly allergic, drinking reconstituted dried milk somehow has no ill effects on "the pipes". Go figure.* You will find Peak milk in powdered and evaporated forms(better than Carnation by me)in most African and Spanish stores,in varying sizes. The size offered here is the Granddaddy and great bang for your buck.

column9: I wanted to love everything about these, BUT...
column10: I am definitely in the middle of the fence regarding this product. :-(The good:* Non-BPA packaging (as we all know, almost impossible to find for a plain tomato product)* low in sodium* not sourced in ChinaNow for what I consider the downsides (other than the price, which may not be a deterrent to some).First, compared to the no-salt-added product I used to use (Del Monte Petite Cut Tomatoes, No Salt Added), I do think these tomatoes have FAR less taste. The difference is not due to salt content because the sodium content as given on the packaging of both products is the same. IMHO the Pomi tomatoes taste less "tomato-y" than what I used to buy (a friend who also tried the Pomi said she finds the taste "insipid"). But that is not my main gripe.The package claims 26 1/2 oz net weight (approximately, but close enough). However, a LOT of that weight is the watery juice from the tomatoes and thus I was unpleasantly surprised to see how little of that 26.46 oz is actually TOMATOES. So one day I took the time to strain the package and see exactly how much chopped tomato there is, versus their juice. The strained chopped tomato pieces were weighed on my electronic kitchen scale and came to 13.4 oz; the juice which was strained directly into a measuring cup came to just below the 11 fluid oz mark. Also, some of that 13.4 oz of chopped tomatoes also included a little bit of juice as well, since they were impossible to drain completely "dry". So this means that for the current price ($2.50 per box of Pomi at my local supermarkets) you are getting only about 13 oz of chopped tomatoes. That comes to about 19 cents per ounce. Hmmmmmm.This made me curious enough to invest in a "throwaway" can of my former choice, the Del Monte Petite Cut tomatoes which comes in a 14.5 oz can, to see how they compared. I strained it in the same manner as I did the Pomi. The results: I got 12 oz of actual tomatoes and only 2.5 oz of their juices. The can of Del Monte was $1.29 (at the same large supermarket chain that sells the Pomi for $2.50) which comes to 10.7 cents per ounce... almost half the cost of the Pomi if you are calculating how much actual chopped tomatoes you get for the money.I must also comment that the consistency of the Pomi chopped tomatoes is much "mushier" than the Del Monte petite cut or other typical canned ones ... in fact, IMHO the Pomi chopped is more than halfway to "sauce" consistency right out of the box, which is okay for some recipes but not good for others. The Del Monte diced served me perfectly in that regard but again... that darned BPA in their cans! :-(I really DID want to love the Pomi chopped tomatoes and if it was only the taste and the consistency that disappointed, I could probably learn to live with those shortcomings. However the realization that they cost almost twice the price for approximately the same quantity of ACTUAL chopped tomatoes compared to the equivalent canned product, is very frustrating especially in today's economy. Because I usually need little or none of the juice which makes up more than 35% of the package's contents, basically I'm paying a 90% premium for the non-BPA packaging.There should really be a better alternative but I've yet to find it. The few tomatoes in glass jars that I have found, have all contained spices (which I can't use, being allergic to garlic and onion) or have high sodium contents. Ideally, I wish Pomi would add a straining step to this product (which perhaps Del Monte does?) so that their package would contain more tomatoes and less liquid.

I like these Pomi tomatoes because they are fresh and flavorful.  Also, they come in a carton that is a welcome alternative to metal cans which impart flavor and which sometimes are lined with a plastic containing Bisphenol-A.

Apparently, the Italian soil does something magical for tomatoes.  I much prefer Pomi tomatoes over the locally grown tomatoes.  There is no comparison.

i got this (dark chocolate) from my mom for easter, and being 22, im grateful for any present i get at my age. but this candy...i dont know..it just tastes funky. i tried all the flavors and none of them taste like the fruit its supposed to taste like; cherry and chocolate does have a slight sweet chery taste, but it only lasts for a split second and this is the only one that has a taste even remotly close to the fruit taste. the coconut one also has a fruity-ness to it, but coconut shouldnt be fruity... i love Jelly Belly jelly beans and i love chocolate and the idea of this candy is fantastic, however, they need to taste good....right??? i figure it had to be common sense but nothing about this is good..not even the chocolate tastes like chocolate. major fail on this product.

I love Decaf Cafe Verona, especially in whole bean.  It's definitely one of my favorite roasts.  It's a nice dark roast, but sweet and cocoa-ey.  I like this roast with dessert or in the evening.  The beans are nice and oily and fresh every time.  I highly recommend this roast!
Whole bean Decaf Verona is a strong decaf that I blend 50/50 with either Italian or French Roast whole beans (usually French).  This blend makes a robust, richly flavored cup of coffee.
Out of the four blends of Starbucks coffee I have purchased and tried, this is by far the worst. Super bitter with a complementary disgusting after taste.
This is our favorite dressing!  It stays mixed, and the dijon is just spicy enough but not too spicy.  The flavor of the tarragon with it is delicous!  You should try it!

I usually pick this up (every bottle available)when I see it at Home Goods or TJ Maxx but, it's so hit or miss. Sometimes I can grab 4 or 5 and sometimes it goes for months where there are none.I'm hoping more people will catch on to how great this vinegar is, popularity will grow and I'll be able to grab it at the local Stop & Shop. I't so good that I'll search & buy on the internet when I can't find it and I don't do that for just any condiment.This is great in any dish calling for red wine vinegar. If you think you don't like red wine vinegar, it's because you've been using such substandard brands (progresso - ewww!! and don't EVER buy the store brand!) that you don't know what red wine vinegar shoud be.You should be able to taste the wine. It should not be watery in the least. It should make you happy!I cook with this on a regular basis. I'm basting cornish game hens with this vinegar right now (Mud Hen in a Mud Pack from Barbara Byfiend's The Eating In Bed Cookbook copyright 1962)and I use it when I make my sausages in red cabbage [...]

I love the taste of Tabasco. Love it! However, I'm a wimp. It's too hot for me to use to the degree I'd like to use it and still maintain my dignity. Well, that's where Trappey's Red Devil Cayenne Pepper Sauce comes in. For those of us who love the "taste" of the heat, but not so much of the heat itself, or those of us who can't eat jalapenos or habaneros whole from the plant, or those if us who just want a little spice, this is the perfect condiment. It does have heat, don't misunderstand me. Your nose will run and maybe even yours eyes a bit, but, it's not so hot that you really can't enjoy it. I put this on chili, mac and cheese, pizza, chicken wings, and on and on. For me, Trappey's Red Devil Cayenne Pepper Sauce is one of the perfect foods around.

column9: Great taste, better than Starbuck's beans!
column10: We have recently switched to decaf and were buying Starbucks' decaf espresso beans.  They were good but prettyexpensive and weren't organic.  We saw these and the price was much better PLUS they were organic.  We didn't have high expectations because usually you get what you pay for.  We were pleasantly surprised!  The beans are very smooth w/ an excellent flavor!  Due to this we're almost out again and will definitely be buying more.

column9: A canadian treat perfect as a Ceaser pleaser (the drink not the salad)
column10: Crispy crunchy and a delicate bite that chomps back if you nibble too many, these beans are perfect for pairing up with your Ceaser instead of a stick of celery. Hard to find in the area of California i reside in, i was excited to find a supplier that was able to ship so quickly and serve my cravings for an item so readily available back home in canada

My dog LOVES this chew bone, is highly disappointed if I run out. She generally chews one each evening, and has been doing so for at least 1 1/2 years without ill effects. It is sort of expensive, and occasionally I try to substitute, but she gives me this guilt-inducing stare, may grudgingly take the substitute which she then may not finish. My vet recently commented that my dog's teeth looked great for a dog of her age - 9yrs.

column9: Research this product online before purchasing!
column10: Warning to dog owners! This product has caused many dogs, including mine, diarrhea, vomiting, and seizures.~~~~~~~~~My history with this product:My dog was very ill for 3 days: violent diarrhea and vomiting. Called vet after first day, they instructed me to keep him on a bland diet, and to bring him in if this persisted more than 3 days. Luckily, he got better and I didn't have to take him in. I thought, maybe it's just my dog and he has a sensitive stomach?I went to the web to research the product and found others had experienced the same thing. So I wondered...why is this product still on the market? I contacted Purina, and after no luck with them (who claimed they never heard of any complaints), I contacted the FDA, which currently has this product under surveillance.By the way, my dog is not a toy breed, he's a 20 lb. mutt. So say what you want to say about the latest 'not meant for toy breed' disclaimer on the package, he doesn't fall into that category.Sure, some dogs can tolerate this treat, but why take a chance on your pet's health and life?

This treat has given my 120 pound doberman seizures and diarrhea badly. He is shaking all over and can barely walk as his hind legs are not wanting to stand. The muscles keep contracting. He finally vomited a lot of the bone.I fed him one small busy bone. How can a company allow this to be sold?????????????The chemicals and colors in this treat are off the chart. PLEASE DO NOT FEED THIS TO YOUR DOG. I HAVE REPORTED IT TO PURINA AND THE FDA

Everyone's tastes are different. But this is my absolute favorite olive oil. It has complexity, and has this incredible long smooth finish. I pour it over heirloom tomatos, or grilled asparagus, or just dip good bread into it!
Antara Olive Oil is wonderfully smooth.....like silk in your mouth.  The taste is pure olive oil.  I've tried many others, including in Italy,  and this is one of the best for the value.
This oil has got to be the best tasting oil I've ever tasted! Very addictive as a dip with good bread! Five stars! Love it!
This is by far my favorite olive and and it is excellent for dips and dressings!!!

My enthusiasm for this product is mainly that I'm a Vegan and have used it as a supplement.  I believe it's only 2 tbs. for the serving and you get 45% of Iron for your recommended daily allowance which is phenomenal.  I haven't seen any other cocoa product in my experience with such a high percentage of iron except for chocolate bars coming close and of those, only the one's that really don't use filler or water down the product.  Look for "cocoa mass" in the ingredients list if you want the higher iron there by the way as well as a higher percentage.All these compliments being said for the current time I would advise one not to order the product here as the shipping cost kills the value.

Geewees, where do I start? First, I'd like to say that I have personally tried this Ojio brand, although I'm not a Verified Amazon Purchase and would recommend it over any other brand from all that I've tried, (The only one that comes close is Navitas Naturals). No, I do not work or represent the company but just wanted to share my opinion on a great product. The good thing is, the supplier sells direct through Amazon, so you don't have to worry about counterfeits or any funny business.Anyone can tell you that the main component for real chocolate is cacao powder. If you didn't know that, I bet your grandma did. We have this big misconception about chocolate and many of us have been raised to think that it is bad for you. This is mainly because of the high content of white sugars, synthetic sugars and dairy products that are in most chocolate candy. Whether dairy is beneficial for you is another subject all within itself and based on your personal research, understanding and belief system. The subject here is CACAO POWDER and although I am not vegan or on a 100% raw food diet, for many years now, I have been eating 50 to 70% raw food and cacao powder has been an invaluable ingredient to most of my homemade protein bars, carb bars and desserts. It is a fat burner, aphrodisiac, an energy booster (with low grade-slow caffeine release) and a great nutrient for the blood. This explains why women crave chocolate during their cycle. Check the internet, do your own research, it is remarkable. The most important thing is-- to consume it in combination with the right ingredients/foods that are healthy for you.Lastly, cacao powder contains a high volume of the amino-acid Arginine also known as L-Arginine (no other vegan source carries it in such high amounts next to rolled oats), which reduces healing time of injuries (particularly bone), quickens repair time of damaged tissue,  and helps decrease blood pressure. Most importantly, it is the precursor for the synthesis of "Nitric Oxide", a vessel dilator present in a lot of sex pill formulas and bodybuilder supplements. This is what helps men get that extra pump in every sense of the word! A scoop of this raw cacao powder should go into your daily protein drink and you can't go wrong. See all my reviews for more tips on male supplements.

I was hesitant on buying this organic cacao because of the 0 reviews but after seeing the nice packaging photo and visiting the company's website and finding out more info on the product I decided to purchase it. Initially I bought this organic cacao to prepare a facial mask from an online beauty recipe I found along with some other natural ingredients but was so impressed by the packaging (I'm a graphic designer hehe) and the little history on the back that I thought I'd give it a taste. It's definitely very rich tasting and very high quality. I'm not a cocoa drinking type person so I sprinkle a teaspoon of it to either my coffee or chai tea and I can immediately taste the richness of it.

I've tried a lot of coconut oils and this is the best I've ever had! Why? It tastes amazing, for some reason it has a lighter taste, and it's cold pressed and extra virgin. I cook with it, eat it straight out of the jar, put it on my lips and face, and make yummy desserts with it. AND it's healthy!!!
i thought it was the big ones u get at the corner stores but i was wrong, its ok still good.

This is a great cereal bar, and I'm suprised that it's not widely sold at grocery stores. I think it tastes far better than the Lucky Charms treats and much better than the Cinnamon Toast Crunch bars that are sold both which I think taste good as well. The Golden Grahams Treats though have a very distinct flavor, and the marshmallows and chocolate chips throughout it make it one of the richest tasting cereal bars I've ever had, and as a result does satisfy your hunger. I highly recommend this product to anyone that likes Golden Grahams, you will not be disappointed.
For some reason I woke up craving these and couldn't find any near my house so ordered a whole box. The price was great. And as soon as I ate one it brought me back to my child hood yummy!!!

column9: Great flavors, fresh, and value for price
column10: This product is very good and Quaker is one of my favorite brands.  The single serving bars are wrapped in a light aluminum foil and shipped well in package plus carton. The flavors are yummy and at least two months on date when I received.

This was a great find in the Warehouse Deals!  I was concerned I'd receive them and have a week til they expired, but they were a full 2 months ahead of the exp date and in my household they will be devoured by then!!

I have an office in an extremely remote and often frigid location and sometimes have co-workers visiting.  I try to make the workspace welcoming and hospitable.  I set out a box of other assorted teas and a box of this Numi assortment and visitors ALWAYS go straight for the Numi.  This also serves me well because I can pick out a tea to suit my mood, whatever the occasion.  All of the teas have great, deep flavor.

column4: E. Allen "butter my toast and sugar my tea, h...
column10: I got the assorted box after I fell into Numi's fabulous tea and wanted to sample the others. However, I noticed that the assortment of teas actually do not enhance each others flavor but rather take away from it. What I mean, is that with so many flavors crammed into one box (18 to be exact) is a collusion of scents and flavors that may or may not be conducive to the palate. I found even the teas I was familiar with tasted rather stale, lacking its vigor. Case and point: rooibos. Case and point: jasmine green tea.On the upside, I did discover that the toasted rice and chocolate pu-erh were rather great surprises.My advice to Numi is to break it up like Celestial Seasonings does: group 3 or 4 each of conducive flavors into a 4 flavor variety box as to not lose its aroma/taste that will offer enough variety and give each box a theme, like Energize, Soothe, Revive, etc. Allow people to choose the sampler they want.In the end: Numi makes wonderful, out-of-this-world, amazing tea. But this assortment did not do the brand-name justice. :( Sorry!!!
I ordered this collection in error but it was a nice error.  I have enjoyed the variety as it allowed me to try some different flavors.  I am still most fond of the Chocolate Pu-erh Tea.

This is some of the best tea I have ever tasted! Love the variety as well, every tea bag is like a little surprise, and always delicious! A great purchase, immediately ordered a second after trying several of the tea bags.

column9: A nice variety and pretty good quality, but I didn't like many of them.
column10: I love Numi's organic loose leaf jasmine green tea and drink it every day, so I figured I'd try this sampler to see if there were any other Numi teas that appealed to me.Honestly, I was disappointed.  Out of 18 different teas, the only one besides my favorite jasmine green that really appealed to me was the breakfast blend.  Maybe it was the fact that they were bags instead of loose tea, I don't know.  I just didn't like the flavors that much.However, the quality of the tea was decent for bagged tea.  It didn't seem like it had been sitting forever and getting stale.  Especially the floral teas, like the rose infused white tea, tasted fresh and the floral scent was vivid, but not overpowering.Also, it's a mix of herbal (no caffeine) and black/green/white (with caffeine) teas, if that's important to you.

I was pleasantly surprised by the selection of this tea. Another review said there were 9 teas with two of each flavor but mine is just as described in the product description with 18 DIFFERENT TEAS!! Im thrilled to try so many of this brand of tea. Great selection! My only concern is that the scent of the teas mixes in the box, perhaps the individual wrapping should be another material? Overall, very satisfied!

I really liked this collection which I purchased it the first time about two years ago.  Given that I am already familiar with these teas, I made this purchase because the product description included two teas that I had not tried.  I thought this was a new collection with a combination of new and old products.  Turns out that it was the same 'old' collection and despite what was in the product description, this collection did not include the two teas that I had not tried.  I thought it may have been a shipping problem because the two teas are also listed amongst the ingredients on the box.  Sale or no sale, I am making my tea purchases in a store so that I will know what is in the box.

column9: Good product but did not include my note in the box.
column10: Good product, arrived on time as promised. The only thing is that it was a gift for someone as they really enjoyed this tea and I put a note to go along with this gift but the person never received a note :( A little upset but i guess not a big deal at the end :)

I bought this teas as an alternative to plain iced tea. Drop a single bag into a gallon jug of warm water and in about 30 minutes you have a oitcher of very flavorful and refreshing tea. Add a little sweetener and some ice and sit back and enjoy.

Let me start by saying that I'm a lifelong tea drinker and I love tea, and I've tried all sorts.I started out years ago with Lipton's before all these different designer brands and flavors came along. Black Ceylon tea was what they called it. Then when all these designer brands and flavors came out I tried all the exotic flavors I could get my hands on, mango, vanilla, raspberry, chocoloate, peach, whatever. I tried different brands, I tried expensive teas, cheap teas, organic teas, the standards such as Earl Grey, Darjeeling, Assam, etc.Finally, I came back to this tea. It was like travelling around the world in a circle and coming back to the start. I love this tea because I've found all that other stuff, apple, peach, raspberry, just detracts from the true flavor of tea. This tea is just pure tea, without any other distracting flavors and that's what I love about it. A stong tea, a robust tea with full strong flavor, for a man (or a manly woman).When I make it just right, the right temperature, the right strength, this is what I imagine Homer's nectar of the gods to be like. It's like Zeus brews me a cup, hands it over and says "here, drink this".So far I have not been able to find another unadulterated tea with such a full and strong flavor. A 10/10.

When  I could no longer drink coffee  ( I loved it but it stopped loving me at age 50, making my nerves too jangly and insomniac for comfort) my favorite advisor about coffee and tea suggested I try Taylor of Harrogate"s Kwazulu Tea from South Africa.  Enough caffeine to keep a busy evening nurse clear and running at San Francisco General Hospital, but no frazzled nerves, and deep sleep like a baby restorative rest once off duty.  i love the clean, slightly bitter taste it gives to my palate; other black teas taste insipid by comparison.  If you like English or Irish Breakfast Teas, you'll find Kwazulu Tea a magnificent improvement and frankly, never want to settle for anything less.  It's sometimes a little difficult to find, but like the search for the Holy Grail, worth the pursuit.  Shop around on the internet for the best price since there can be overpricing.A sante, as Julia Child always signed off.

column9: If you like Real black tea that is rich and dark but not bitter..this is the tea for you!
column10: I drink this tea everyday, you can say I am addicted to tea. This tea is what I call Real high quality tea from South Africa, not that Lipton stuff. It is rich and dark without being bitter. Best paired with sugar and milk, just like the English.

column9: Major problem: new stuff is not what I loved, should be 2 stars
column10: This is a strong but not bitter tea, as others have mentioned. The thing that really distinguishes it is a rich tone like fresh-cut cherry wood in the middle of the flavor.  Keeps very well, smooth on the throat.  I can put a gram in a full cup, let settle,  and have a tasty dilute lunch tea that's more woody, or 3 grams per in a pot for something really rich, with sugar.  Takes less than other teas.  I've been raiding an office-mate's box, so the 6-pack of boxes will let me replenish that store and load up my own tins.9/24/2009 update:  An office mate had this and I loved it.  I ordered this 6 x 4.4 oz.  set, and at first taste, it was very different.  A lot more bitter, much less fresh woody flavor, more like a Ceylon.  I was surprised and disappointed.  The office mate noticed too.  She says it isn't even close. We made some, compared again.  The bits and the tea color look similar, but the flavor is way off, with a flat bitter note instead of the wood note.  Not sure what to do with this.  Many people like this, but it isn't the Taylor's/Kwazulu charm I got to like before.  Maybe I can add some wood chips from a wild fruit branch...I dunno.  Woe.The editing will NOT let me alter the rating stars.  I would give it: 2 stars now.  This is not what I was raving about before.

This is an excellent black tea. My preference in black teas runs toward those that are smooth and not at all bitter. This means I often end up with  somewhat blander brews with little to distinguish them. This Ntingwe Kwazulu is a great exception to that experience. It's quite brisk, has robust flavor and yet is very smooth with no bitterness. My only complaint is the powder residue in the bottom of the cup, but it's well worth it. Now my favorite black tea!

This is a very smooth loose leaf tea which tastes great in the morning. It's really good with 1/2 & 1/2! You need to brew it just right preferably in a bone china teapot! The best thing about it is that it is really well blended. I've been drinking it for years and highly recommend it!!!
Perfect cup of tea. The best tea I have had since leaving the UK to live in the US. Worth the effort to use leaves instead of a bag. It's become our daily drinker.

column9: It's the perfect tea for anyone wishing to give up coffee.
column10: Taylor's of Harrowgate South African Kwazulu Tea is the perfect tea for anyone trying to give up coffee.  I switched 22 years ago. Rarely, I still enjoy a really good cup clean interestingly blended, freshly ground coffee orvery occasionally, an expresso with lemon zest, but for the day to day morning dose of wake-me-up caffeine that doesn't jangle my Irish nerves or upset my tummy, it's Kwazulu Tea the is perfect for me.  Try it and see what you think.  M. Tealeaf, R.N. 65y.o. female

column9: Okay taste but cut fine for a loose tea
column10: Much smaller cut than other premium teas I have bought. Taste is okay - you will need a fine mesh filter.

column9: This tea made me feel like a Zulu Warrior!!!
column10: Drank this tea almost exclusively for about two years.  It brews up with a full body and thick liquor and an equally robust albeit smooth flavor.  This tea has a look peculiar to itself in that the leaves appear almost ball-like.  I don't know if this is the type of tea bush used in this variety or if it is a characteristic of the picking and curing process.Anyway, I ceased drinking this tea about three years ago when the formula appears to have been changed with a consequent flavor change.  The tea now has a strong, and to me, unpleasant aftertaste that puts me in mind of something chemical.  Anyway, I don't like it and ceased buying this blend.  Before then, however, its robustness made me feel exactly how a Zulu Warrior must have felt as he went off to battle.I believe that a reviewer below states he began drinking this as the next best thing to coffee and I wholeheartedly agree.  I too kicked around for a tea that came close to the strength of coffee before settling on this one.  Highly recommended to those who have to wean themselves off Java.If you are looking for flavor, the loose leaf tea with I find the one with the most refined and complex flavor that is both robust and inexpensive is Ahmad Tea's English Breakfast tea.  I see it sold only in bags here on Amazon but it is definitely a superior everyday drinker.

column9: One of my favorite Polish candy
column10: What can I say, I love these. Not too heavy, but filling at the same time. I used to get them straight from Poland, but that's no longer necessary.

My mother loved them. However I wasn't too fond of them. What they are is a sugar wafer type cookie enrobed in chocolate. It's quite large but airy and crispy. The flavor lacked a bit for me, but as I said my mother enjoyed them. She wants more yet they don't seem to be available.

Arrived shortly after ordering. They were good but they were stuck together and weren't as fresh as the ones at a grocery store. One of the few places to be able to get 5 pounds of gummy worms and for a fair price.
Well, I didn't really think this tasted much like pumpkin.....But the chocolate around it was delicious!  I think I may just buy the plain chocolates next time!

You have got to try this! So nice to have freshly ground spices. I put this on everything hashbrowns, eggs, chicken breasts, taco meat just about anything. has a nice smokey flavor with minimal heat! Worth a try!
Being a person with Type 2 diabetes, I have to eat whole grains. Finding a flavorful whole wheat couscous is a boon.  This couscous does not taste like cardboard.
Was looking forward to lovely whole wheat looking and tasting couscous, and got the same white bland tasting stuff I can buy at the local store for a whole lot less money.
I bought far too much of a product that I was experimenting with--I may have cooked it improperly, but the end result was a little less than satisfying.  Operator error, pretty much.

After much deliberation about wedding favors, I ended up going the edible route and bought the Leonidas chocolate favors from Amazon.  I highly recommend these for many reasons - one, they are yummy and go well with champagne; two, they are shipped fast and no hassles; three, it's super easy - you get a box of nicely wrapped favors and you can just take it to your reception and be done with it.  All in all, I was very happy with this choice!
The product came well packaged in a Styrofoam box and each box had a nice orange bow on it. The price can't be beat. Much cheaper than Godiva and much better chocolate as well.

We gave these as a gift, they are great you can't go wrong w/ Amazon.  Just make sure you don't leave them out in the warmth of the day or the chocolate might melt.You should be home when deliver is made.

My small dog loves his new food! Due to allergies, he only eats raw food.  This is by far the best and easiest food, preparation wise, that I've purchased thus far.  He devours every morsel, however, I do recommend mixing it with another food in order to prevent weight loss or increasing portion sizes.  At first, Ewee (he looks like an Ewok) lost a considerable amount of weight on this food, so I had to increase his portions to compensate.  Other than that I think it's a great, healthy product!  Oh yeah, and it lasts for at least a month.

column9: go for turkey if first time
column10: We have tried this a few times. Firstly I never seem to get it fully rehydrated, so I end up giving it to our pup as a soup. He eats it, but is not a big fan. It smells exactly like cup-o-soup or ramen and if you read the ingredients that is about what it is. I recommend that if you want to try it, DON'T start with the beef. Our dog is NOT a fan. The turkey is fine. All the flavors are the same they only swap out the meat.

I wrote an extensive review of this brand for the Sojos Complete Turkey Dog Food Mix, 8 Pounds and how it has improved my dog's life and helped her allergies. It is exactly the same for this product.However, my dogs MUCH prefer the beef flavor to the turkey. We try to switch between the two to give variety, but they eat the beef immediately and are much more excited when they are on the beef bag. The beef also looks different and has more distinguishable vegetables. However, as puppies we fed them vegetables as snack and they really like them, whereas my sister's dogs do not.My dogs love this dog food and I love how healthy and shiny it makes them and their coats. We will continue to purchase and love the convenience of Amazon.

column9: our dog won't eat this!  loves the turkey Sojos...
column10: perhaps it's not fair to give this Sojos Beef only a three stars as the ingredients appear just as wonderful as the Sojos Turkey.  our 8-month old Golden Retriever loved the first bag of Sojos Turkey we tried. we decided to give her variety and introduced the Sojos Beef and it has been a no-go. she normally will eat most anything and has not been picky at all. with the Sojos Beef, she will not finish her meals. she will pick through the bowl and leave food bits on the floor.on a human level, the Sojos Beef does not smell as yummy as the Turkey. it also appears to be more vegetal.  our pup will normally eat vegetables that appear as treats ... carrots and broccoli, etc ... but is simply not thrilled with this Sojos Beef in any way.I've quickly just ordered two bags of Sojos Turkey from Amazon. in the meantime, I will be augmenting what is supposed to be a complete meal with things I know our pup will eat. last night she got minced turkey and cheese in with her Sojos Beef and she mostly finished her dinner. today's breakfast was just the Sojos and there is quite a bit left. this is a dog who has cleaned her bowl in the past.some guessing on my part...there is less beef in the Beef Complete. the flavor is not as full as in the Turkey Complete.our dog gets human beef from the table on a regular rotation and freeze-dried beef doesn't compare.  the turkey survives thefreeze-drying better.lastly, our pup is neither too fat nor too thin. her looks are stunning. her coat is like silk.  she is healthy in every way.  she will try most anything that may be edible. I am really surprised this Sojos Beef has flopped for us.

This is Knorr's Hunter Sauce that you use to be able to buy in your local supermarket.  It is good and just what is needed to add that extra little something to your meal.It was shipped right away and arrived before the suggested delivery date.

It doesn't matter who sells the Hunter Sauce (Jaeger Sosse), or what language is written on the package.  This sauce is perfect with mashed taters and pork chops.  According to the directions, one can use this sauce with steak and chicken; I don't doubt it.  I wish I could buy it here in Korea, but I can't.  Amazon makes buying stuff like this very convenient for me.

column4: ChibiNeko "Sooo many books, so little time!"
column9: Really yummy, but high in sugar.
column10: I'm always on the lookout for something I can use as a quick breakfast or a relatively healthy dessert, so when I saw these on the shelf I figured that I had to give it a whirl.The good about this product is that it is only 160 calories, is pretty filling, has 40% of your daily vitamin C, & is awesome when heated. I decided to try mine heated as was recommended & I found that it didn't burn or taste funny, which is a huge bonus.The bad is that this isn't nearly as easy to open as the manufacturers would have you believe. The plastic wrap covering the apple portion didn't peel off cleanly & I ended up getting apple goop all over me. The other bad is that this has about as much sugar in it as a 3 Musketeers bar. I'll probably end up buying this again, but only sporadically as a treat. That's just a little too much sugar for my current diet.This does make for a filling meal, but if you're watching your sugar, looking for something to put in a bagged lunch, or wanting something a little more diet-friendly, I'd avoid this.

column9: Dole Fruit Crisp - Tasty, but could be tastier.
column10: Dole Fruit Crisp, Apple Cinnamon sure sounds and looks appealing.  I love apple crisp, so figured this would be a good way to have a quick serving now and then.PROS:- Convenient packaging.  Easily fits into bags for overnight trips.  Is nice to have if you're staying at a hotel/motel which doesn't provide a real breakfast.  Is good for at home when you don't have a lot of time.- No high fructose corn syrup.- 40% DV vitamin CCONS:- Packaging may be convenient, but produces a lot of waste.  NOT environmentally friendly.- Plastic cover top which seals the apple portion doesn't pull off with as much ease as it seems it would.  Go slowly and carefully or you'll have a sticky apple mess all over the place.- Can be heated to make it even tastier, but I don't like to microwave in plastic.FLAVOR:I was surprised at how little of an apple flavor there was.  I mostly just tasted a sugary sweetness that was a little too much.  There was a hint of cinnamon.  The crunchy oat topping was very tasty, though.  The whole oats made me feel more like I was eating something healthy.  The brown sugar in the topping made it even better.OVERALL OPINION:For 160 calories and 20g of sugar, this isn't a snack I eat daily.  It's also pricey, and for how much it costs, I wish it had a better apple flavor.  Maybe if they backed down the sugar, those apples would have a fighting chance!  I do still recommend this for an occasional convenience factor.

This is absolutely awesome! OK, so it may have sugar, but with oatmeal and apples, you still can't go wrong. The flavor is oh, so fine. column9: One of the best vanillas you will taste and at a great price
column10: I discovered Orlando Vanilla a few years ago while spending a week in Puerto Vallarta. I am a chef and specialize in pastries so a good vanilla is important. I've tried Nielsen Massey vanillas and they are excellent but they still have a bit of a chemical/alcohol scent to them. McCormick extract (the most commonly found at your local supermarket) is so strong alcohol-wise that once you've had good vanilla you'll never go back to cheap chemical tasting junk.Orlando vanilla (and their other brand La Reyna) is strong, smells sweet with no chemical notes.  The aroma of vanilla permeates the kitchen when you use it. It is very reasonably priced and since most recipes call for about a teaspoon of vanilla you will find that an eight ounce bottle like this gives you enough for 48 typical recipes. Depending on your taste or the strength you are looking for you might get fewer or more portions.I buy mine from Puerto Vallarta when I go. I usually buy two liters (a liter is a bit more than a quart) and this year I have a tour of the factory scheduled. Kept in a cool, dark place vanilla extract has an extremely long shelf life so no need to worry about spoilage. I don't think you can go wrong using this extract. The only other way to get better flavor is to use good quality vanilla pods (see my review on those if you are interested)

I actually really liked this vanilla!  I truly didn't think I would, but it's quite fragrant with a bit of a sweet vanilla smell.  It's nice.  The only thing that would be great, is if it didn't come in a plastic bottle.

column9: Chili = spicy, not Mexican style. Spice up your ramen!
column10: Yes, it's packaged ramen, not a health food. However, for those who want a fast and inexpensive snack or meal, Maruchan ramen is a classic.  This Chili flavor can be hard to come by in some markets; I haven't found a reliable source locally for the past year or so.Some may mistakenly think that "chili" means Mexican-style, like the dish with tomatoes, beans, and beef. Here, "chili" means chili pepper, as in spicy broth. Don't pay extra for those bowl noodles with the additional spicy seasoning packet. Maruchan chili-flavored ramen gives you the same flavor and heat for less money and less wasteful packaging.This Chili flavor makes a great, spicy ramen with flavor and a little kick. You can enjoy it as a simple ramen soup or add meat and vegetables for a more nutritious and tasty meal. Give it a try!
